jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
ORIGIN

Origin is building the AI-native wealth management platform that democratizes sophisticated financial services — combining money management, personalized AI-grounded advice, and financial products in a single intelligent system. We're a Series B company founded by repeat entrepreneurs, backed by Founders Fund, Felicis, and General Catalyst.

We've reached profitability and are expanding from our core personal-finance product into banking, high-yield savings, and mortgage & insurance referrals — while growing 100%+ year over year.

The Role

You'll own AI-driven product surfaces inside one of the most design-obsessed consumer finance products in the market. You will report to the CTO, partner daily with the CEO, and ship hands-on against the two things Origin is maniacal about: speed

and design

.

What you'll own

End-to-end product surface for a major area of the Origin Financial app (AI assistant, planning, investing, or onboarding — scoped on day one with the CTO).
The full PM craft, hands-on. You write the PRDs, run the discovery, push the Figma files with our design partner, define the test plan, draft the QA cases, sit in on engineering standups, and own the metric.
AI-native execution. You're expected to use AI heavily — for research, competitive teardowns, prototypes, PRD drafts, deck building, test-plan generation, exec readouts. Tooling preference is yours; the bar is the output and the speed.
The interface between engineering, design, marketing, and Origin Financial's leadership team. You make the cross-functional motion run.
Metric ownership. Every ship declares its activation / retention / ARPU / NPS target before the build starts, and you own the readout after.

How you work

Low ego. You thoughtful, an amazing listener and want to deeply understand problems before acting. You happily share credit and split scope with peers. You'd rather be right tomorrow than loud today.
Hands-on, every day. No throwing work over the wall. You produce the artifacts yourself.
You move fast. A week feels long. You ship the smallest thing that proves the bet.
Design taste is non-negotiable. You don't have to push pixels, but you must be able to look at two flows and pick the better one — and say why.
You write. Specs, decision memos, post-mortems. Writing is the artifact at Origin.

What you've done

6+ years in product management with shipping reps in both a larger company (mature surface, real scale, real cross-functional rigor) and a small / early-stage company (0→1, no scaffolding, owned a P&L).
Strong written communicator. Your PRDs, decision docs, and exec updates are short, testable, and unambiguous.
Either one of the two paths:

3+ years in financial services — consumer fintech, wealth, neobank, brokerage, lending, or insurance. You understand RIA / BD / custody / regulated-flow constraints well enough to ship without breaking them.
3+ years in highly competitive direct-to-consumer SaaS — consumer product, growth and distribution, rapid iteration and research. You understand the metrics and the pace that is required in a competitive marketplace.

AI-product experience (Nice to have) — you've shipped an AI feature (LLM-backed, agentic, or assistive) inside a consumer or financial product, with real metrics.
Quantitative fluency (Nice to have) — You pull your own data if needed. You read a retention curve and a funnel without a deck. You partner with the data leadership for complex modelling, but don’t sit idle.

This is not the role if

You expect a "hand-off executive" seat where you delegate the craft. At Origin you own both the vision and execution.
You believe AI-leveraged PM work is beneath you. Origin is an AI-heavy org — if you wouldn't draft your own PRD with AI, this isn't your role.

Reporting & location

Reports to the CTO. Weekly 1:1 with the CTO; bi-weekly 1:1 with the CEO. Direct exposure to the founders is structural, not optional.
Monthly Boston on-site. 2–3 days at our Boston HQ during one designated week; travel covered. No Boston residency required.

What we offer for this role

Principal PM band, calibrated for Tier-1 metropolitan areas.
Meaningful equity grant package.
Travel covered for in-office weeks.
Healthcare.
Wellness stipend.
Mental wellness program.
Unlimited access to financial planning.
Life insurance.
Retirement 401k.
Unlimited DPTO.
Paid Parental Leave.
Parenthood and fertility assistance.
Monthly co-working membership reimbursement.
Build your home office one-time stipend.
Pick your setup (Apple, Windows) and accessories.

Eligibility Requirements

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Origin does not sponsor visas.

ORIGINALS

Fulfilling our mission is only possible with a diverse team that breathes for excellence and is hugely committed to making money simple for everyone, everywhere.

As a team, we are obsessed with delivering the best solution possible to our members through an elegant and self-guided experience. We know that building a product of this magnitude requires from us tons of creativity, autonomy, and flexibility to move fast and embrace uncertainties with ownership. This is who

we daily pursue to be!

To embrace talented people like this and provide the necessary resources to achieve their best versions, we believe in the power of a healthy environment where each person is valued for who they are and have clear goals and expectations for the future they can build within the company. Each person here is seen as a key player in our team.

Our environment is diverse, with excellent people and equal opportunities. We believe in the power of the individuality and uniqueness of each of us to make our team even more powerful.

We are building an outstanding solution, and here is an invitation for you to become an Original and join us on this journey!

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Payments
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About The Role

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager, Payments
to lead one of the most critical areas of our infrastructure: how money flows in and out of Flex. You will oversee our end-to-end payments platform - including transaction processing, payment-related fraud and disputes - and ensure it evolves into a strategic growth and margin lever.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks in platforms and systems, understands payment mechanics, and knows how to balance user experience, risk, and cost. You’ll work closely with Platform and Risk leadership to drive innovation and performance across payment rails, dispute automation, and fraud prevention, while enabling seamless user experiences and future expansion.

What You’ll Do

Shape the cross-functional platform product strategy. Map how future products fit together into a coherent architecture, and help ensure they’re built with speed and stability in mind.
Own Flex’s payments platform strategy and roadmap end-to-end: vaulting, authorization, processing, reconciliation, and refunds across all payment methods (card, wallet, ACH).
Drive down payment processing costs through better routing, smarter retry logic, and fraud/dispute efficiency - without sacrificing UX or resilience.
Build and scale fraud detection and dispute infrastructure to reduce losses while minimizing false positives and user friction.
Expand our payment method coverage, ensuring all channels (cards, bank transfers, wallets) are supported with the right controls, guardrails, and visibility.
Partner with Risk, Finance, Ops, and Engineering to align on business goals and build resilient, compliant, and scalable payment solutions.
Lead and grow a high-performing product team, coaching PMs while maintaining a strong bar for ownership and quality.
Define success metrics and build dashboards, tooling, and processes to measure performance across cost, reliability, speed, and loss rates.
Champion clear thinking, technical depth, and rigorous prioritization in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.

Key Qualifications

7+ years of product experience, with at least 3+ years in payments, fraud, or platform product roles at a fintech, bank, or B2B2C fintech products.
Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem: authorization, retries, tokenization, payment gateways, fraud systems, and card networks.
Demonstrated ability to balance user experience, cost optimization, fraud risk, and regulatory requirements in product decisions.
Strong technical acumen and systems thinking - you’ve worked closely with engineers to design reliable, scalable systems.
Proven success as a player-coach: you’ve managed PMs and enjoy mentoring while rolling up your sleeves when needed.
Bonus: Experience working with Payment processors, building dispute automation, or expanding payment options in regulated environments.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. $248,000—$310,000 USD

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

As the Senior Product Manager
for our Integrated Services team, you will play a pivotal role in defining and executing our technology strategy and roadmap for our business partners responsible for centralized services that manage and maintain our properties. Communicate and collaborate across many levels in the organization with excellent and written communication skills.
Translate innovative ideas into functional and technical requirements to helping our teams work smarter.
Guide, influence, and persuade business partners and team members towards solutions that meet business needs and goals.
Maintain relationships with external partners and vendors that challenge them to deliver world-class service for Link.

Project Delivery

Develop business cases, user requirements, and project charters.
Manage processes to prioritize projects, plan releases, and manage resources.
Create and manage processes for testing, release management, and change control.
Manage communications with business partners, project team, and IT management.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Air Cargo, Amazon Air Cargo
jobs.description:
Description

You’re a Principal Product Manager – Technical with deep experience in supply chain systems, consumer experience, or logistics product strategy within complex, rapidly scaling organizations. You’ve owned end-to-end product vision for customer-facing and platform capabilities at scale, and you have a track record of turning operational infrastructure into differentiated experiences that drive business growth. You excel where the problem spans platform engineering, operations, commercial strategy, and consumer behavior — and you bring the strategic judgment to define the right long-term bets while delivering near-term value.

You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable diving deep into delivery economics, attainment-loss and failed-delivery patterns, geocode-confidence and address-quality data, and consumer behavior to identify where experience and platform investment drive outsized cost and revenue impact. You understand that this is not project management — this is setting direction for capabilities that touch every shipment Amazon Air Cargo delivers.

High judgment is expected at the Principal bar: defining the right experience and quality bar, making trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer delight, deciding when to build versus influence a platform team’s roadmap (and avoiding tech debt and duplicated systems), and influencing across operations, platform, commercial, finance, and engineering teams without direct authority. You set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to, you regularly engage with senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions, and you are relied on to be right a lot. You have a proven track record of building delivery, platform, or consumer experiences that became a durable competitive advantage.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Product Management Define the executive-level vision for address quality and recipient experience and translate it into actionable multi-year roadmaps aligned across partner organizations, operations, product, commercial, and engineering. Proactively surface risks and opportunities with data-driven recommendations to senior leadership; frame the strategic asks (not just feature lists) that move platform partners from reactive collaboration to proactive co-investment. Innovate on behalf of the recipient and the shipper while balancing operational priorities, commercial needs, and cost; own end-to-end outcomes and business impact (delivery success, failed-delivery and lost-package rates, premium-service revenue, cost per shipment, customer satisfaction).

Cross-Team & Platform Leadership Lead product vision and execution across multi-org dependencies, including driving alignment across the routing and delivery-execution systems and a joint engagement model with the platform teams that own the underlying geospatial capabilities. Eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the address-to-doorstep journey; own the build-vs-influence calls and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home.

Operational Excellence & Scale Design products and platform capabilities that scale with volume growth without proportional increases in manual exception handling (e.g., address corrections, missed pickups, support contacts). - Use data to identify and eliminate the highest-impact friction points across address quality and the recipient journey. Build the governance and review mechanisms that keep cross-org investment aligned year over year.

A day in the life

Set the strategic direction for address quality and recipient experience across teams — aligning partners around shared outcomes, not just deliverables.
Deep dive into data (failed-delivery patterns, geocode confidence, post-delivery feedback, delivery economics) to shape the intervention roadmap and decide where to invest engineering resources for maximum impact.
Challenge and refine technical designs with engineering and platform leaders, ensuring solutions scale with network growth and don’t create long-term tech debt.
Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting technical progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and on the ground to pressure-test whether what we’re building actually works in the real network.

What this takes

Someone who toggles between deep technical/platform depth and strategic product leadership — turning complex operational and geospatial challenges into scalable, automated, experience-led solutions that recipients love and shippers choose Amazon Shipping for.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

jobs.description:
Description

The Velocity Labs team mission is to think beyond the confines of the normal product-orientated approach and to discover new ways to apply and embrace agentic AI. jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Adobe Lightroom Creative Pro
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Lightroom is the world’s leading photography ecosystem, empowering photographers to edit, manage, store, and share images across desktop, mobile, and web.

As professional photography is reshaped by AI, automation, new client expectations, and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape, we are looking for a Director of Product Management to help define what the modern professional photography workflow becomes next.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with deep product leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency in professional photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy.

Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences.

This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control.

What You’ll Do

Shape the Creative Pro product agenda

Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web.
Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive.
Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures.
Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years.

Represent professional photographers inside Adobe

Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography.
Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows.
Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations.
Help teams distinguish between technically impressive ideas and experiences professionals will trust in production.

Imagine and ship new experiences

Partner with teams in advanced technology, design, and engineering to shape new capabilities into experiences photographers love and rely on.
Define how AI, agents, and automation should show up in Lightroom to save time, improve quality, reduce repetitive work, and expand creative possibility.
Balance innovation with quality, performance, reliability, transparency, and user
control.
Drive clarity and alignment across cross-functional teams, strategic forums, planning cycles, and executive discussions.

Ground decisions in insight

Stay close to the tools, services, communities, and workflows professional photographers use today.
Develop a strong point of view on where Lightroom should lead, where it should partner, and how we can exceed expectations of our most advanced customers.
Connect customer insight, product quality, adoption, retention, monetization, and competitive differentiation into precisely structured product recommendations.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Proven experience as a senior product leader who has defined strategy and shipped high-impact products, ideally for creative, media, professional, technical, or workflow-intensive customers.
Deep understanding of professional photography workflows, including speed, quality, consistency, client expectations, high-volume production, and creative control.
Strong product taste, with the ability to evaluate whether an experience meets the bar for professional use.
Experience turning ambiguous customer needs, emerging technology, and business goals into well-defined product strategy, tradeoffs, and shipped outcomes.
Experience partnering deeply with research, design, engineering, and product marketing to deliver customer-facing products at scale.
Experience with AI, automation, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic experiences, holding a clear stance on trust, control, quality, and user value.
Executive-level storytelling and influence, especially in senior IC roles where impact depends on alignment rather than direct authority.
Strong analytical judgment, showing proficiency in combining usage data, customer research, market signals, competitive insight, and hands-on craft expertise.
Excellent collaboration skills, high ownership, and a demonstrated ability to build trust with photographers and internal partners alike.

Strong Plus

Over 10 years spent working professionally as a photographer specializing in one or more genres.
Experience teaching, mentoring, writing for, or building community with photographers.
Experience collaborating with camera manufacturers, lens makers, imaging hardware companies, or other photography ecosystem partners.
A photography portfolio, shipped product examples, writing, talks, or other work that demonstrates extensive knowledge of professional creative workflows.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Technical, Core Shopping Data Science
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon cannot fix a customer experience problem it cannot measure. Our team's job is to make shopping quality measurable: to find the defects customers actually encounter, quantify how often they encounter them, and put a number in front of leadership that teams are willing to be held to. Today that capability is strongest on the search results page, where we run a portfolio of quality metrics covering areas such as relevance, duplication, and brand quality, backed by a mix of human annotation and LLM based measurement.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager - Technical to own the quality bar for core shopping: the standard that defines what counts as a customer visible defect, how precisely it must be measured, and what evidence is required before a number can be trusted. You will drive alignment on that standard across the organizations whose experiences it judges. Owning the bar is the job. Measurement and inspection are how you enforce it: you will own the quality metric portfolio for the search page, the inspection mechanisms that surface the defects we are not yet measuring, and the scalable mechanisms (human annotation, LLM based evaluation, and the audit loops that keep both honest) that hold the system together as coverage grows. You will expand that coverage beyond search to other core shopping surfaces, including the Homepage and Detail Page.

Key job responsibilities

Define The Quality Bar

Own the standard that every metric definition, annotation SOP, and automated measurement approach must satisfy before it can be trusted or published. Scientists, engineers, and annotation partners build to that bar.
Own the portfolio of shopping quality metrics against that bar, covering areas such as relevance, duplication, and brand quality, and grow that portfolio as new defect classes are identified.

Own the inspection mechanisms

Own how we find quality defects, not just how we count the ones we already know about: sampling strategy, audit cadence, anecdote review, and systematic inspection of pages customers actually saw.
Turn qualitative signal into quantified metrics. Work with UX Research and leadership to convert customer anecdotes and research findings into defect definitions that can be sampled, scored, and tracked.
Own the audit loop and the SOP bar. Specify what gets audited and against which criteria, review findings, and require the resulting corrections in annotation SOPs or LLM prompts. When a measurement approach systematically misses a defect class, you own defining what the corrected standard is, and the team builds to it.

Drive quality measurement into online systems

Drive the agenda to move quality measurement from offline, after the fact reporting into online systems, so that quality signals are available where experiences are ranked and served rather than only in a periodic report.
Partner with central platform teams to embed quality metrics into online evaluation and serving paths.
Make the case for where online quality signals change decisions, including experimentation guardrails, faster detection of quality regressions, and closed loop correction of defective experiences.

Own the roadmap

Own the multi year roadmap for shopping quality measurement and inspection: which defects to measure next, which surfaces to expand to, and what each expansion unblocks for the business.
Extend the charter beyond search to other core shopping pages, starting with Homepage and Detail Page. For surfaces with no measurement today, define the defect taxonomy from scratch: what a quality defect is on that page, how it is sampled, how it is scored, and how it rolls up.
Drive alignment across Organic Search, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and International as definitions evolve, including with the teams whose experiences the metrics judge.

About The Team

The mission of the Core Shopping Data Science team is to provide the data-driven foundation for building a world-class shopping experience that maximizes long-term free cash flow by delighting customers. We focus on the long term and big picture to ensure that the full Amazon shopping experience balances strategic trade-offs. We believe data science is the discipline of making smart decisions and we empower feature owners and systems by 1) developing and vending metrics which assess and value customer engagement, 2) building tools and datasets to inject data into the decision-making process, and 3) delivering deep analyses to inform high-touch decisions.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's community spans developers building new products, individual Claude users, and practitioners and buyers inside enterprise accounts — from the staff engineer using Claude Code to C-Suite decision-makers. We're hiring a Head of Community to turn our current set of programs into a function that helps millions of people build real skills with Claude, measurably growing retained users and product adoption.

You'll lead and grow a global team that covers ambassadors programs, regional community leads, and enterprise champion programs. Your job is to give this team a sharp operating model and a measurement framework that ladders our initiatives to business outcomes, so users can get the most out of Claude. You'll build community across audiences, seniority levels, functions, and roles: enterprise buyers and executive sponsors, developers and technical practitioners, and the knowledge workers in between. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, PMM, Brand, and Comms.

Key Responsibilities

Own the global community strategy and operating model: the audience thesis, the portfolio of programs, and what's built centrally vs. run in-region
Lead, coach, and scale a global team of program and regional owners; hire the gaps, set the bar, and develop community-native operators
Define the measurement framework that replaces activity metrics: partner with Product and Data Science to define success metrics and segment the base (non-user → occasional → high-value daily) — with recurring retained users and product adoption as the top-line outcomes
Build community across the full range of audiences and seniority levels, with programs and voice tuned to each without fragmenting the experience
Connect bottoms-up adoption to enterprise expansion: architect the champions, train-the-trainer, and partner ecosystem motions that turn power users inside accounts into org-wide adoption, and integrate them into how Sales and CS run strategic account plans
Bring training, certification, enablement, and community help together into one engine that scales through champions and partners — so users experience a single path to skill-building with Claude
Partner tightly with Brand and Comms to keep sentiment and awareness healthy: define where community shows up in Anthropic's brand and how we best serve our users
Align community strategy proactively with product direction, launches, and pricing & packaging — owning community's job pre-launch, at launch, and post-launch, and proving it drives value for our users

Minimum Qualifications

Have built and led a community or customer advocacy function at a company where community was a growth lever, not a cost center — and can point to the retention, adoption, or expansion outcomes it drove
Have led and developed a distributed team of program owners and regional leads accountable for commercial impact
Think in funnels and segments as naturally as you think in programs: you're comfortable putting your name on a metric in a QBR and defending how community moved it
Have connected self-serve, bottoms-up adoption inside large accounts to enterprise expansion, and can articulate exactly where community sits in that motion
Can flex your playbook across very different audiences — a technical, API-first developer community and an enterprise executive buyer community are different jobs, and you've done versions of both
Operate as an integrated marketer: you've worked day-to-day with cross-functional teams and have strong opinions about how community stays customer-first
Are comfortable partnering with Product and Data Science to define usage quality, instrument it, and hold your team to it
Write and communicate clearly, hold a room with both a Staff engineer and a CIO, and are energized by ambiguity and building at speed

Preferred Qualifications

Run community or advocacy at a company operating both a PLG / self-serve motion and an enterprise sales motion at the same time
Built or led a recognized champions, ambassadors, or advocacy program at a company known for the model
Experience with developer tools, infrastructure, or AI products, and credibility with technical audiences
Built the measurement plumbing for a community function before including cohorting, attribution, and usage segmentation
International experience standing up or scaling community in-region (EMEA, Japan/APAC) with a clear philosophy on what runs centrally vs. locally
A track record of listening to communities and building user trust through hard moments alongside a Comms team
Background spanning more than one of: community, customer marketing, developer relations, customer education/enablement, or growth

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$400,000—$400,000 USD

Logistics

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Automotive and Manufacturing is one of AWS's highest-priority industry verticals and a centerpiece of Amazon's broader enterprise strategy. Our vision is to be the most trusted technology partner for the world's automotive and manufacturing companies as they navigate the greatest transformation in their history: the convergence of AI, electrification, and software-defined everything. Three industry forces make this moment urgent: (1) the rapid shift to software-defined vehicles and autonomous mobility is rewriting how cars are built, sold, and operated; (2) generative AI and agentic AI are unlocking a new generation of smart factories, predictive supply chains, and industrial automation at scale; and (3) manufacturers are under intense pressure to reduce costs, localize production, and build resilience against geopolitical and tariff disruption. jobs.description:
Description

The Outbound and Flow team within the Amazon Fulfillment Technologies team is looking for an experienced Product Manager who will contribute to the vision and strategy of our products. Our team provides products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment - they ingest shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and process them through picking, packing and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience - Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality and Cost, while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed with focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce from the start.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will drive innovative product features that help us deliver on this vision. You will work on identifying opportunities to make our FC operations more efficient, and drive design and development of software features to address these opportunities. You will drive the design and buildout of features to streamline Fulfillment center (FC) operations across different types and WW regions, while leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization. You will also serve as a product lead for cross outbound and flow initiatives that span multiple director portfolios

Key job responsibilities

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

Setting a holistic vision for your products and technologies in development -- or haven't been invented yet.
Managing relationships and reporting with leadership across AFT and our customers / stakeholders
Driving strategy and planning for expansion and year-over-year investments across initiatives.
Developing strong internal relationships with key internal stakeholders and drive cross-team and cross-org alignment.
Establishing priorities across multiple workstreams and initiatives.
Finding creative ways to unblock challenges that arise and deciding when to escalate.
Working closely with Product Managers, Software Development, Operations, Science, and EHS teams to ensure investments and develop deliver on strategic goals.
Reporting (monthly and quarterly business reviews, yearly strategy documents).

About The Team

AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware– these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non-sort buildings, traditional sort and non-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. AFT also owns and operates the FaaST Warehouse Management System (WMS) that runs in Vendor Flex buildings, India Mini-FCs (small footprint, manual buildings in IN), and select Seller Flex locations (3P Sellers who are Prime enabled leveraging the FaaST WMS). AFT also owns the External Fulfillment Platform (EFP), a technology that integrates 3P WMSes to the Amazon Supply Chain. AFT owns network infrastructure and devices in all building types including Sort Centers and Last Mile sites and owns labor planning and scheduling technology that is leveraged for Fulfillment Centers in NA and EU and Sort Centers in NA.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech (PMT), HR Experience Technology
jobs.description:
Description

Own the product strategy for the agentic AI platform and cross-platform shared services that power HR experiences for 1.8 million Amazonians. As a Principal Product Manager - Tech in our HR Experience Tech (HRXT) team, you’ll lead product delivery for the horizontal intelligence layer—Agent Skills (our AI-native no-code automation platform), Employee 360 (the unified employee context layer), and the integration, orchestration, and routing infrastructure that makes every HR interaction smarter, faster, and more consistent across all personas.

This is a rare opportunity to define how AI agents work in HR at Amazon. We’re building the PXT skill catalog—the governed library of agentic workflows that any compatible AI agent can execute. HR professionals author deterministic, auditable workflows in plain language. These skills combine procedural knowledge (step-by-step instructions, edge cases, business rules), permissioned data access (via PXT MCP Gateway connections to E360, Case, Timehub, ETM, Manager Hub, Engage, ADAPT), and the ability to apply business rules across multiple systems to produce reliable, auditable outcomes. You’ll own this platform end-to-end—from the authoring experience through governance, versioning, and production execution.

You’ll work across a multi-product technology stack spanning agentic AI workflows, intelligent routing, automated communications, employee data platforms, and cross-platform integration layers—coordinating across all of these to deliver seamless end-to-end HR experiences while designing for Service Central, our converged AI-first platform. You’ll partner with HR operations leaders, AI/ML scientists, engineering teams across HRSC, USC, PXT CMS, and domain experts to build the composable automation framework that makes every HR team more effective.

This role demands someone who can think in platforms and composability—building horizontal capabilities that amplify every vertical team’s impact. A single Agent Skill you ship gets used by 7,000 contact center agents, 11,000 Ops HR users, 500 corporate HRBPs, and 308 investigators. A single MCP integration you connect unlocks data access across every AI experience in the stack. You’ll leverage agentic capabilities, conversational AI, intelligent orchestration, and unified employee context to transform HR support from reactive case processing to proactive, AI-driven employee experiences.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision and strategy for Agent Skills—the AI-native no-code automation platform that enables HR professionals to author, govern, version, and deploy agentic workflows in plain language, embedded in HRSC and USC.

Define and scale the PXT skill catalog—building the governed library of reusable HR workflows, establishing quality standards, governance frameworks, and the discovery/sharing mechanisms that compound institutional knowledge across the organization.

Lead Employee 360 (E360) product strategy—expanding from a data retrieval tool to a context-aware agentic platform that integrates 10+ AI workflows, enabling HR professionals to complete complex tasks through natural language with comprehensive employee context.

Own PXT MCP Gateway product direction—the registry/gateway providing Maple-permissioned connections to HR data systems, including tool filtering, auth, matching, and the roadmap for onboarding new data sources that feed both E360 and Agent Skills.

Own Auto Work Assignment (AWA) evolution—building intelligent routing that considers agent skills, workload, case complexity, and organizational context to optimize resolution time and quality across all HR domains.

Define the automated communications framework—AI-backed, template-driven correspondence at case milestones that reduces manual drafting across all personas while maintaining quality and personalization.

Lead the closed-loop experience standard—defining how cross-platform case visibility, handoffs, and task assignment work across USC, HRSC, PXT CMS, and domain boundaries (Payroll, Ops, Corp, Investigations).

Own PXT One product direction—the centralized intake platform for PXT improvement requests, providing voice-of-the-field, leadership visibility into trending themes, and mechanisms to reconcile misaligned priorities.

Drive platform analytics and Insights—delivering cross-persona reporting, operational dashboards, and the metrics infrastructure that measures automation impact, adoption, and quality.

Ensure all cross-platform services are designed as native Service Central capabilities, influencing Phase 3 architecture decisions and ensuring convergence-alignment across every investment.

A day in the life

Your morning begins reviewing Agent Skills adoption dashboards—you’re tracking how many HR professionals have authored new skills this week, which skills have the highest execution volume, and where the authoring experience is creating friction. You notice a skill authored by a Central HR team lead has been forked and adapted by three other teams—a signal that the governance and sharing model is working. You also review E360 agentic workflow completion rates and identify a newly integrated MCP tool that’s driving a 40% reduction in employee lookup time for Corp HRBPs.

Mid-morning, you join a working session with the HRSC team to define the closed-loop experience for a newly onboarding domain. Payroll is coming onto USC, and their cases frequently require handoffs to Ops PXT users in HRSC—you’re designing the cross-platform visibility, task assignment, and case handoff workflows that let both teams collaborate without context loss. You validate that AWA routing will correctly assign cases at each handoff point and that the automated communication templates fire at the right milestones to keep employees informed throughout resolution.

After lunch, you lead an Agent Skills design review with engineering. A new skill for leave-of-absence eligibility verification chains three MCP tools (Timehub, CTK, and policy data via E360), applies multi-step business logic, and produces an auditable determination. You ensure it follows the skill catalog’s governance standards—deterministic execution, version-controlled, permission-scoped via Maple—and validate that the automated communication template fires correctly when the skill completes.

In the afternoon, you present your Q3 cross-platform services roadmap to HRXT leadership. You frame the portfolio through the Service Central lens: Agent Skills becomes Service Central’s automation runtime. E360 + MCP Gateway becomes the context and integration backbone. AWA becomes the intelligent routing brain. Closed-loop becomes the cross-platform coordination standard that connects every persona. You demonstrate how one Agent Skill authored for Central HR automatically works in Service Central for any persona—the platform compounds with every skill added.

You end your day in a pre-flight session for the upcoming Agent Skills Demo with PXT leadership. You’re preparing to showcase how the platform has moved from concept to production: real HR workflows authored by HR professionals (not engineers), executing against live employee data, producing auditable outcomes. You highlight the compounding effect—every new skill signals which MCPs to onboard next, and every verified skill becomes an org-wide standard that replaces ad-hoc tribal knowledge.

About The Team

The HR Experience Technology (HRXT) team is on a mission to fundamentally reshape HR work at Amazon. We bring together PXT (People Experience and Technology) teams and harness technology to provide seamless, intuitive experiences for HR teams serving all Amazonians. Our vision focuses on elevating HR service delivery through integrated technology solutions that span multiple platforms and touchpoints.

We own six major product areas—USC, HRSC, PXT CMS, Investigations, PXT One, and M&A Integrations —plus the cross-platform services layer that makes them all work together. We serve over 18,000 HR users globally, handle 30M+ interactions per year, and are actively converging toward Service Central: one AI-native platform for ALL of HR.

Our team culture embraces innovation and experimentation, particularly in applying agentic AI to transform HR workflows. Agent Skills launched in April 2026 with strong early product-market fit, putting automation directly in HR professionals’ hands. E360 launched in December 2025 on Aza and is expanding to 10+ agentic workflows. We’re at the inflection point where these platforms compound—and this role will lead that acceleration.

As part of our team, you’ll work with talented engineers, product managers, ML scientists, and designers who are passionate about using technology to transform the employee experience. Join us to define how AI agents work in HR at Amazon.

to establish and lead the data and insights strategy for Microsoft Commercial Marketplace. This role will be responsible for designing a comprehensive measurement system that enables the team to understand customer and partner behavior, evaluate the success of product investments, identify experience friction, and make informed product and business decisions.

You will ensure that new features are designed with measurable outcomes from the beginning and that teams have timely, reliable insights into adoption, conversion, engagement, reliability, and customer impact.

This is a high-impact role with visibility to senior leadership and deep collaboration across engineering, design, strategy, operations, finance, product groups, and some of the largest software development companies in the world.

The Senior Technical Product Manager
is a data-driven product leader who is intellectually curious, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and able to turn complex datasets into clear product direction. They have a point of view on product measurement, ask thoughtful questions, and know how to distinguish meaningful signals from noise.

We value people who create clarity, generate energy, and deliver success for their team. They embrace AI to accelerate analysis and uncover insights, take end-to-end ownership, and connect the dots between customer behavior, business outcomes, product experiences, and platform technology. If you love using data to build better products and want to establish the measurement foundation for a global commerce platform, this is the right role for you.

Responsibilities

Design an end-to-end measurement system for the Find, Try, Buy, and Manage customer and partner journeys, including acquisition, discovery, engagement, conversion, activation, retention, and product-management scenarios.
Build and maintain product scorecards, dashboards, funnel analyses, and recurring reports that provide timely visibility into adoption, conversion, customer friction, reliability, and business impact.
Evaluate and improve the quality, completeness, consistency, freshness, and reliability of Marketplace data used for product decisions and reporting.
Create self-service measurement capabilities that enable product teams to answer common questions while maintaining consistent definitions and governance.
Apply AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation, identify emerging patterns, and improve the efficiency of product investigations.
Align stakeholders on measurement priorities, metric definitions, analytical conclusions, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
Foster an inclusive, data-driven culture focused on customer obsession, intellectual honesty, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.

You bring genuine technical curiosity, you stay current with advances in large language models, agentic AI, and conversational systems, and you translate that understanding into better product decisions. You regularly engage directly with customers through beta programs and feedback channels to ground your intuition in real user needs. You will work closely with many partners such as marketing, technical PMs, solution architects, engineering, content, business development, and legal to ensure customers have access to a world-class Alexa experience in Canada.

About The Team

The Alexa Canada team's mission is to deliver products and services that are delightful and locally relevant for Canadian customers. We operate within the broader Alexa International organization, scaling Alexa globally while advocating for the unique needs of customers in Canada. Our work spans product launches and feature expansion across both English and French, ensuring that every Canadian customer experiences Alexa as a trusted companion in their daily life.

Job Overview

You are responsible for customer experience with considerable complexity where problems, opportunity, and strategy may not be defined. You take the lead on initiatives and deliver independently. You influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, and organization priorities through well-crafted written narratives and data-backed recommendations that earn trust with senior leadership.

You champion exceptional customer experiences by defining requirements for Canadian customers and partnership with global stakeholders on roadmap development. You balance constraints—compliance, localization, and accessibility—with customer experience considerations. You establish direct customer feedback loops and regularly validate assumptions through qualitative and quantitative research. You monitor operational health after launch and work with teams to address issues with appropriate urgency.

You demonstrate curiosity and a desire to dive deep into the technical aspects of your product, particularly in AI/ML systems. You evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses, asking the right questions to identify risks and ensure appropriate trade-offs are surfaced before commitments are made. You understand how AI, including agentic systems and large language models, is reshaping product development and apply this understanding to make better product decisions. You proactively explore new AI capabilities, attend technical deep-dives, and maintain enough technical fluency to be a credible partner to engineering. You use all means possible, including AI, to accelerate development cycles, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation.

You demonstrate high skill at using data to drive decisions. You define success criteria, KPIs, and metrics distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You design experiments and analyze results with statistical rigor. You analyze usage data, performance metrics, customer behavior, and market trends to inform decisions and prioritize roadmap investments—going beyond surface-level reporting to uncover causal relationships and actionable insights. You use AI capabilities to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment.

You collaborate with other product managers, sharing mental models for decision-making, providing feedback on documents and strategies, and helping others grow their technical and strategic capabilities. You raise the bar for the PM community through knowledge sharing and thought leadership.

You communicate with precision and influence—crafting compelling written documents that drive alignment across teams and leadership levels. You tailor your communication to your audience, whether presenting to executives, aligning with engineering partners, or rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Description

Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.

Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.

Key job responsibilities

Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing

Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against

Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain

Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements

Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems

Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthcare
Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems
Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Sr. Principal Agile Product Owner—Network Team Lead (26-406)
to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview

The Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a key component of the Missile Defense System. It is a vital operational system that enables the U.S. president, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at strategic, regional, and operational levels to plan ballistic missile defense operations systematically, collectively monitor the battle, and dynamically control networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission goals. C2BMC supports layered missile defense capabilities that enable an optimized response to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It serves as a force multiplier by networking, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensor and weapon systems and operations, both globally and regionally, to improve performance. C2BMC is essential for all ground and flight tests that verify and demonstrate the current and future capabilities of missile defense systems.

In this role, the candidate will serve as a Network Team Lead. The candidate will coordinate the planning, organization, and execution of engineering activities to develop assigned technical capabilities integrated into the C2BMC Network Enterprise. The candidate will work within an agile team and plan work based on customer requirements and program contractual agreements. The candidate applies extensive expertise to solve complex problems that require regular use of ingenuity and creativity. Work is performed with minimal direction and is reviewed for desired results over a relatively long time frame. Erroneous decisions would normally fail to achieve major organizational objectives.

The Network Team Lead will serve in project leadership roles and represent the organization as the primary customer contact for significant technical matters on contracts. This position is accountable for the capability's overall engineering, technical, cost, and schedule performance. The candidate is expected to maintain clear, open communication with program and engineering management regarding status, staffing needs, and engineering projects. The candidate will drive the use of best practices within the engineering team through Agile processes, tools, and frameworks, and will review capability artifacts and development practices for compliance with engineering principles, company and program standards, customer contract requirements, and related specifications.

The candidate will provide input to standard metrics packages used for program execution status, technical improvement, and management/customer status updates. Responsibilities include managing risk mitigation activities, planning schedules, and handling change requests associated with the capabilities. The Network Team Lead will manage the execution of assigned ECP effort(s) added to the capability, coordinate and resolve deconfliction of multiple spiral and capability resources across the Agile Release Train (ART) and with other program ARTs, lead Agile and other planning activities to ensure priority and maturity are achieved, maintain the team's Hive structure and keep it up to date daily, and perform any other required tasks as directed by the program.

Essential Functions

Lead an agile network engineering team responsible for development and integration of technical capabilities into the C2BMC Network Enterprise
Coordinate planning, organization, and execution of engineering activities in accordance with program contractual agreements and customer requirements
Provide technical leadership across cost, schedule, and performance for assigned capabilities and associated ECPs
Serve as primary technical interface and customer contact for significant network-related technical matters
Apply advanced technical expertise to solve complex, multi-disciplinary problems requiring creativity and innovation
Plan and lead team Agile ceremonies and other planning activities to ensure clear priorities, maturity of work, and alignment across the Agile Release Train
Review technical artifacts, designs, and implementation approaches for compliance with engineering principles, company and program standards, customer requirements, and related specifications
Develop and provide standard metrics and status reporting for program execution, technical improvement, and management/customer updates
Manage risk and opportunity, including development and execution of risk mitigation plans, schedule planning, and change request management for assigned capabilities
Coordinate and resolve resource conflicts across multiple spirals, capabilities, and ARTs
Maintain and continuously update the team’s Hive structure and related tracking tools daily
Support planning, execution, and coordination of documentation development, technical exchange meetings with stakeholders, test events, and capability deployments
Support program management of strategic technical projects, problem solving, and overall business rhythm to ensure effective and efficient operations
Perform other duties as assigned in support of C2BMC program and network enterprise objectives

Basic Qualifications

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 8 years of experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with 6 years of relevant work experience; or 12 years of relevant work experience may be considered as an alternative to a degree
Applicants must have a current, active Government-Issued 8140 certification at IAT Level II or higher (such as Security+ CE, CISSP, CCNA-Security, CySA+, CND, etc.) at the time of application, which is required to start. The candidate is responsible for maintaining their 8140 certifications throughout the entire contract period
Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
Active project management certification such as Project+, CAPM, or PMP (or the ability to obtain within 60 days of start)
Prior experience as an Information Technology Engineer, preferably in network or infrastructure engineering
Proven project management experience as part of large DoD systems and capabilities under development
Experience managing and reporting cost, schedule, and technical development on a large program, demonstrating the ability to coordinate planning, execution, integration, and completion of projects within an assigned area of responsibility
Experience in planning, conducting, and coordinating activities such as documentation development, technical exchange meetings with stakeholders, test events, and capability deployments
Experience managing the design, development, and implementation of complex systems
Experience with Agile methodology and/or Agile Product Owner practices; experience supporting Digital Transformation and DevOps implementation
Ability to analyze project, program, and portfolio information needs and determine the resources needed to achieve objectives
Ability to understand both the long-term (“big picture”) and short-term perspectives of situations and program needs
Demonstrated experience leading high-performance technical teams, including mentoring, coaching, and performance oversight
Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and facilitation skills, including the ability to effectively interface with customers, program leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders
Must be able to travel to alternate work locations as required to execute job duties

Preferred Qualifications

Prior C2BMC experience and familiarity with C2BMC NT/BC processes and procedures
Prior Team Lead and/or Product Owner experience leading Agile teams or technical capabilities
Experience developing key performance indicators (KPIs), tracking other metrics, and creating reports to support program and customer insight
Ability to quickly comprehend the functions and capabilities of new and emerging technologies and apply them with complex networked systems

jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

As a seasoned product marketer and leader, you possess a knack for being able to identify business and market needs, conduct research and build strategic plans, craft compelling messaging and positioning, work directly with clients, and collaborate with teams across the business to bring game-changing products to the market. You see the big picture while managing seamless execution for your portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Coaching

Mentor and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketers, providing regular coaching on core competencies such as messaging, GTM execution, and cross-functional influence.
Establish a culture of professional growth by creating tailored development plans that align individual career goals with company objectives.
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, offering actionable feedback to help team members navigate complex projects and evolve their strategic thinking.
Define and prioritize the team’s roadmap, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across product launches, sales enablement, and demand generation efforts.
Standardize PMM workflows by implementing scalable processes for launch tiering, messaging frameworks, and competitive intelligence to ensure consistent quality across the team.
Act as a strategic influencer, navigating internal stakeholder dynamics and clearing hurdles to ensure the team can execute on-time and with high impact.
Serve as the primary advocate for the PMM function at the leadership level, communicating team impact, resource needs, and strategic wins to the executive team.
Act as liaison between Product, Sales, and Marketing by aligning team output with the broader growth strategy and ensuring a unified narrative in the market.

Strategic Execution (The "Player" Role)

Own the end-to-end messaging and GTM strategy for the Benevity Enterprise Impact Platform, while guiding the team in translating this strategy into actionable plans for their respective areas.
Direct the team’s research into market trends and persona development, ensuring these insights are consistently applied to sales playbooks and GTM planning across the portfolio.
Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Sales, CS) to align on high-level positioning, while mentoring the team on how to execute these partnerships at the project level.
Provide “Voice of Customer” insights to product management to inform product strategy, drawing from both individual research and team-wide feedback loops.
Ensure product messages proliferate throughout the buyer and client journey by collaborating with website, content, and demand generation teams.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 4+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
A "player-coach" mindset: The ability to shift seamlessly between high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution.
Proven ability to lead through complexity, framing up strategic issues and identifying key assumptions required to gather and analyze information resulting in a GTM strategy.
Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level and mentor junior team members.
An analytical mind that balances a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing.
Outstanding presentation and business writing skills.

Bonus Points

Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits.

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.
