jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Product Manager-Service Intelligence
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Join an iconic brand that is redefining the pickup truck and rugged SUV marketplace. As Senior Staff Technical Product Manager
– Service Intelligence
for a confidential digital initiative, you will lead the strategy and execution of a foundational backend intelligence platform that powers critical decision‑making across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail and service ecosystem.

This role focuses on designing a backend‑driven decisioning and orchestration system that evaluates complex, interdependent operational inputs to produce reliable, scalable outcomes in real time. The platform is being built ahead of Start of Operations and will play a central role in how Scout coordinates resources, responds to events, and enables consistent execution across locations. This role operates at a cross-domain level, shaping how multiple systems, products, and operational workflows interact through centralized decision intelligence.

Initially, there is no end‑user interface or traditional UX design responsibility associated with this position; success is defined by system behavior, decision quality, and operational outcomes.

This is a deeply technical, AI‑driven and analytical role requiring strong systems thinking and comfort operating in a highly ambiguous, 0‑to‑1 environment. The successful candidate will help shape core capabilities from the ground up, owning both initial delivery and long‑term evolution of a mission‑critical intelligence platform while maintaining strict discretion around sensitive product details.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Define and Lead Strategy

Define, evolve, and drive the product and ecosystem strategy for a confidential, intelligence‑driven core platform supporting Scout’s operations and service experience.
Define how complex operational signals, constraints, and policies are modeled into automated decision logic.
Lead early-stage platform definition ahead of Start of Operations, building foundational capabilities with no existing baseline.
Accountable for system performance across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail network, ensuring decisions are reliable, explainable, and scalable.
Influence senior leadership and align platform strategy with long-term company objectives while protecting sensitive capabilities.
Identify new problem spaces and expansion opportunities for decision intelligence across additional domains and systems.

Complex Decisioning & Problem Solving

Frame and solve highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems through intelligent system design and decision frameworks.
Model operational constraints, dependencies, and priorities as structured logic, rules, or machine‑assisted decision frameworks.
Drive solutions where “missing inputs” require downstream actions to resolve constraints rather than blocking outcomes.
Navigate ambiguity inherent to 0‑to‑1 product development, making informed tradeoffs as requirements and dependencies evolve.
Evaluate tradeoffs involving accuracy, speed, scalability, and explainability, including intangible system behaviors.
Ensure system behavior is consistent, explainable, auditable, and adaptable as business rules change.

Lead Product Development

Guide product development across multiple related initiatives, teams, and domains to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
Lead end‑to‑end product development for a highly complex, logic‑heavy platform from concept through scale.
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data Analytics, AI/ML teams, IT, and Operations to:
Translate operational needs into system logic and technical requirements.
Define data models, decision flows, signal ingestion, and output generation.
Balance deterministic rules with AI‑assisted approaches where appropriate.
Ensure platform extensibility as new use cases and domains are added over time.
Establish best practices and frameworks for decisioning platforms adopted across related systems and teams.

AI & Intelligence Enablement

Champion the use of AI, machine reasoning, and advanced analytics to enable scalable decision‑making.
Define where AI augments human decision processes versus fully automated execution.
Ensure models and logic are transparent, testable, and continuously improvable.
Collaborate with data partners to ensure high‑quality inputs, feedback loops, and monitoring.

Stakeholder Leadership

Influence and align senior leadership, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders on strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs.
Serve as a trusted partner to Business, Software Engineering, fellow Digital Product Customer Experience team, and Leadership teams.
Translate complex, cross‑functional needs into a shared technical and product vision without exposing sensitive strategy externally.
Lead alignment across teams with differing priorities, timelines, and constraints.
Build long‑term trust in the platform through transparency, reliability, and outcomes.

Operationalize a Pre‑Launch Platform

Build readiness for a mission‑critical platform before Start of Operations.
Define rollout strategies, guardrails, fallback behaviors, and manual override paths.
Ensure the platform supports consistent execution independent of location or context.
Define scalable operating models for how decision intelligence is embedded across systems and workflows.

Drive Technical Excellence

Drive architectural decisions across systems, data flows, and integrations, balancing long-term scalability with short-term delivery needs.
Partner with Scrum and platform teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure architectures.
Define best practices for real‑time decisioning systems, data latency, reliability, and observability.
Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in logic complexity, system dependencies, and edge cases.
Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Treat the platform as a living system, ensuring post-launch stability and continuous evolution.

Own Live Decision Intelligence

Own system behavior and decision quality once the platform is live, ensuring outcomes are accurate, explainable, and aligned with operational intent.
Monitor real-world system decisions to identify gaps, edge cases, and unintended outcomes.
Lead continuous tuning of logic, rules, thresholds, and AI-driven decision frameworks based on live data.
Define criteria for acceptable system behavior, including fallback paths, overrides, and escalation mechanisms.
Use system insights to influence product strategy and operational decision-making at a broader organizational level

Location & Travel Expectations
:

The role will be based out of a Scout Motors location in Fremont, California.
This role requires 1-3 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change.
Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

12+ years of product management experience with deep focus on technical platforms, complex systems, or decisioning engines.
Experience working with AI/ML technologies in a product, engineering, or business context
Proven experience leading 0‑to‑1 products in pre‑launch, startup, or transformation environments.
Track record of building logic‑heavy or intelligence‑driven systems that coordinate multiple inputs and constraints.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data architectures, and real‑time processing.
Hands‑on experience working with AI/ML systems, rules engines, optimization problems, or decision frameworks.
Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs between accuracy, speed, explainability, and scalability.
Comfort working closely with engineers and data scientists on system design.
Experience owning backend or platform products where value is delivered through system behavior and decision quality rather than user interfaces.

Skills

Demonstrated ability to define strategy in highly ambiguous environments.
Strong ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical and structured problem‑solving capabilities.
Ability to define complex logic and decision flows with precision.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complexity without oversharing sensitive information.
Data‑driven mindset; comfortable working with metrics, experimentation, and system telemetry.
High tolerance for ambiguity; energized by building something new where the path is not fully defined.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Advanced technical degree or MBA preferred.
AI-related certification required.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

Competitive insurance including:
Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

401(k) program with:
An employer match and immediate vesting

Generous Paid Time Off including:
20 days planned PTO, as accrued
40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually

jobs.description:
Description

We're building the next generation of AWS enterprise contract automation, making deal creation autonomous, intelligent, and self-service. You'll define the AI-powered platform behind billions of dollars in AWS private pricing agreements, serving customers from mid-market companies to the world's largest enterprises. This is the foundation for how customers commit to AWS and how AWS delivers on those commitments accurately and at scale.

As Principal Product Manager - Technical External Services, you'll define the future of our contract automation platform including AI-powered systems that can draft, simulate, negotiate, ingest, and validate contracts without manual intervention. You'll define how AWS represents commercial intent as structured data, establish governed libraries of reusable contract terms and negotiation policies, architect the guardrails that make autonomous contract generation safe, and build the self-service experiences that let customers of different size configure and commit to agreements through digital channels. Your work directly determines how quickly AWS can close enterprise deals, whether contracts produce accurate billing from day one, and whether customers can self-serve commitments without sales engagement.

In this role, you'll define product strategy that spans multiple years, driving initiatives that fundamentally change how enterprise agreements flow through AWS. You'll architect complex data models for ambiguous commercial domains, design how AI agents generate and negotiate contracts within defined boundaries, and build simulation and decision-support capabilities that help deal teams model revenue impact and make better commercial decisions before committing. You'll establish the mechanisms — operating cadences, metrics, escalation paths — that make contract automation delivery repeatable across multiple organizations. You'll conduct direct research with deal teams, enterprise customers, and commercial operations teams to understand where the contracting process creates friction, translating those insights into product requirements.

You'll collaborate with engineering teams across AWS's billing, agreements, and commercial operations organizations, as well as applied science teams building the AI models that power drafting and negotiation. You'll partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align contract automation with go-to-market strategy for enterprise and mid-market segments. You'll mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar across the organization. This role requires deep understanding of how AI agent systems work and how to constrain them safely, combined with the cross-organizational influence to bring diverse stakeholders together around a common vision.

If you're passionate about building systems that fundamentally change how enterprises transact in the cloud, and excited about defining how AI transforms the most complex commercial negotiations at scale, this role offers the chance to create AWS's contract automation platform from the ground up — serving everyone from deal negotiators managing billion-dollar relationships to mid-market customers self-serving their first private pricing agreement.

Key job responsibilities

Define product strategy spanning multiple years, driving contract automation initiatives from concept through production
Architect the machine-readable data model that represents AWS's commercial agreements as structured, actionable data, including reusable contract terms and policy rules
Design AI-powered contract generation and negotiation experiences with appropriate guardrails and escalation mechanisms
Define self-service contract experiences for enterprise and mid-market customers
Build simulation and data-driven decision-support capabilities for deal teams
Establish mechanisms that make cross-organizational delivery repeatable
Conduct direct research with deal teams and enterprise customers to validate product direction
Partner with sales, business development, and deal strategy teams to align with go-to-market strategy
Mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the product bar

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
6+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using data modeling experience
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
Experience building deep client and agency relationships

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in computer architecture
Experience with contract lifecycle management, legal tech, or enterprise deal automation
Experience with billing, commerce, or financial systems at scale

Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives

Scope Of The Role

The Sustainable Product Technology and Design Leader is responsible for defining and embedding end-to-end sustainability strategy across the Gorilla Glass product portfolio, with particular emphasis on integrating Design for Sustainability (DfS) into new products (e.g. glass, glass ceramics, surface treatments) and next-generation platforms such as 3D-formed glass (Forge) and augmented reality glass systems (Cascade). This role serves as the central leader of sustainability across product development, supply chain, and customer engagement, ensuring that sustainability is not an afterthought—but a core design input that drives product differentiation, customer value, and regulatory readiness.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Data Feeds
jobs.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

YipitData is building the default intelligence platform for anyone evaluating companies and markets. Our data feeds are central to that ambition, bringing proprietary and exclusively licensed data directly into our clients’ research, investment, and business workflows.

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead and grow our Data Feeds product management team. You will own the strategy and performance of a portfolio of data products, develop a strong team of PMs, and help build a more connected, scalable feeds business serving fundamental investors, quantitative and systematic funds, and corporate customers.

This is a player-coach role
. Alongside managing the team and setting portfolio direction, you will directly own a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative - from customer discovery and product strategy through development, launch, and ongoing performance. You should enjoy moving between portfolio decisions, coaching PMs, and working through the details of a product yourself.

Our opportunity extends beyond bringing more datasets to market. We are building differentiated products around clear customer problems, combining data and capabilities where they create greater value, and making our feeds easier to evaluate, integrate, and use. You will help determine where we invest, how our products fit together, and how we translate our data advantage into durable growth.

As Our Group Product Manager, Data Feeds, You Will:

Lead and Develop the Product Team

Manage, coach, and grow a team of product managers, strengthening their customer discovery, strategic judgment, execution, and commercial ownership.
Establish clear product responsibilities, goals, and decision-making expectations, giving PMs the autonomy and support to own their products.
Build effective practices for planning, roadmap reviews, customer feedback, and performance measurement.
Recruit and develop talent as the team grows, while maintaining a high bar for product thinking and accountability.

Lead Product Portfolio Strategy and Execution

Own a cohesive product portfolio strategy aligned with the broader business direction set by the Head of Data Feeds, defining how our feeds fit together, serve customer needs, and deliver differentiated value.
Guide PMs in developing product visions and roadmaps that strengthen both their individual products and the overall portfolio.
Prioritize across product roadmaps and shared capabilities, balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, and available resources; partner with the Head of Data Feeds on broader investment decisions.
Work with PMs to validate use cases and commercial demand early, including during the evaluation of new data sources.
Identify portfolio gaps, overlap, and opportunities to combine datasets, reuse methodologies, and extend products across customer segments.
Use customer feedback and product performance to recommend which offerings to scale, improve, consolidate, or retire, and lead execution of agreed decisions.

Directly Own and Build Products

Serve as the hands-on PM for a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative, owning its vision, roadmap, requirements, and outcomes.
Lead customer discovery, investigate the underlying data, and translate customer needs into clear product decisions.
Partner with Data, Engineering, Data Science, and Quant Research to assess feasibility, shape requirements, and bring products to market.
Stay close to client evaluations and integrations, using feedback to improve the product and establish practices the broader team can reuse.

Drive Commercial Performance

Share accountability with commercial partners for portfolio revenue growth, retention, expansion, and product economics.
Partner with Revenue, Client Strategy, Product Marketing, and Solutions Consulting on pricing, packaging, positioning, and effective sales and evaluation processes.
Build a clear portfolio story that helps customers understand which products meet their needs and how those products work together.
Balance near-term client requests with repeatable market opportunities, ensuring commitments inform a scalable roadmap.
Define and track success through customer adoption, evaluation conversion, time to value, retention, and commercial results.

Build a Consistent, Reliable Client Experience

Establish product expectations for data quality, coverage, timeliness, documentation, and delivery across the portfolio.
Partner with Data and Engineering on quality controls, monitoring, change management, and issue resolution.
Improve how customers discover, evaluate, onboard, integrate, and receive ongoing support for feeds, working with Applications and client-facing teams.
Ensure clients can understand each product’s methodology, limitations, historical changes, and appropriate use cases.
Help build a repeatable experience for quant and systematic customers, including the data history, consistency, and transparency required for rigorous evaluation.

Connect Teams Around Shared Outcomes

Align priorities and responsibilities across Product, Data, Engineering, Research, Quant, Applications, and commercial teams.
Partner with Quant Research on systematic investor requirements and research-informed product improvements.
Work with data sourcing and partnerships teams to evaluate opportunities against customer needs, licensing constraints, quality, and economics.
Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, progress, and risks clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

Significant product management experience, typically 7+ years, including ownership of commercial data products, data feeds, or similarly data-intensive B2B products.
Experience directly managing and developing product managers, with evidence of improving both team performance and individual growth.
A track record of taking products from customer discovery through launch and scaling, with measurable customer and business outcomes.
Strong portfolio judgment: you can prioritize across products, allocate investment, and make difficult tradeoffs.
Commercial fluency, including experience contributing to pricing, packaging, revenue growth, retention, or product economics.
Hands-on analytical ability, including proficiency in SQL and comfort using Python to investigate data and assess product questions.
Technical fluency in data products, including schemas, methodologies, quality, delivery mechanisms, and the implications of product changes for clients.
Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align teams you do not directly manage.
A desire to remain a hands-on product owner while building and leading a team.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with alternative data, financial data, or investment research products.
Familiarity with fundamental, quantitative, or systematic investment workflows, including dataset evaluation, backtesting, and integration.
Experience building a portfolio that serves multiple customer segments or combines multiple data sources.
Experience with third-party data partnerships, licensing considerations, and vendor dependencies.
Familiarity with APIs, cloud-based data delivery, and data quality and operational reliability practices.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $190k - 205k, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 15%. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Measurement
jobs.description:
About Us

Applecart
is the leading technology company that C-suites rely on to reach business-critical decision makers. The most important decisions are made by the hardest people to reach and influence. Historically, C-suite leaders have lacked the tools to reach the stakeholders who matter most to their business. The C-suites of hundreds of Fortune 500 companies, major agencies, trade associations, nonprofits, and governments use Applecart to put their best content in front of business-critical decision makers and those they trust — from policymakers and investors to CEOs, key employees, members of the media and more. Decision makers are informed by what they read, learn from advisors, hear from colleagues, and discuss with family and friends. To break through to them, you must reach them through the only channel that really moves them: those they know and trust. Applecart’s platform uses publicly available data to map billions of social relationships between nearly every American adult and enable clients to deliver content directly to decision makers and those who matter most to them.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management, Measurement in our New York City office.

About The Role

Our Decision Maker Targeting products are a critical part of our clients’ strategic execution. Applecart is used as an amplification layer for their ongoing communications with a broad cross-section of key stakeholders. Quantifying the impact of using Applecart audiences across all of these communication strategies is essential to our clients’ success.

In this critical role, you will drive the product vision and execution of our measurement and insights products as we grow our offering and client base. The ideal candidate would combine enterprise product expertise with a deep technical understanding of media measurement and/or research methods.

What You’ll Do

Define and build the next generation of our Measurement & Optimization offerings in collaboration with a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, product managers, and sales and client service leads
Own the product strategy, business planning, roadmap and requirements definition for your own product offering
Evangelize product solutions with internal teams, clients and industry partners
Collect user and client feedback via both direct and indirect channels and translate them into product requirements where applicable
Collaborate with key clients on implementation strategy and adoption of new features
Manage high visibility product launches and define and track KPIs to measure success and identify ongoing improvements
This role may also manage 1-2 Product Managers under them

Experiences And Capabilities You Bring

Experience and domain expertise:

8+ years of experience in a product management role, including 3+ years managing direct reports
Deep understanding of digital marketing, advertising technology, market research, or a similar industry, with specific expertise in media effectiveness measurement
Hands-on familiarity with the data that flows out of the ad tech stack — DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP), ad servers, and SSPs —including log-level/impression-level data, bid and delivery signals, and audience and taxonomy data
Personally rolled out measurement technology solutions to large enterprises and/or their agencies, owning both the client-facing reporting layer and the underlying methodology

Leading Mixed-discipline Teams

Proven track record leading mixed-discipline teams where you are the connective tissue between functions — partnering with data scientists on methodology and model validation, with analysts on insight generation and QA, with engineers on data pipelines and platform tradeoffs, and mentoring junior PMs on scoping and execution
You can translate a statistical approach into a client-ready narrative, and a client asks into a well-specified technical requirement
Experience working closely and managing asynchronous communication with a geographically distributed team

Technical Depth

Strong SQL — you write your own queries against large datasets to validate outputs, size opportunities, and debug discrepancies rather than waiting on a ticket
Experience owning products built on big-data platforms such as Spark/Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake, with a working understanding of batch vs. streaming, partitioning, cost/performance tradeoffs, and why a pipeline change can move a client-facing number
Experience shipping a client-facing application end to end — you have owned a standalone product surface, not just a reporting feed or an internal tool. That includes partnering with design on information architecture and UX for complex, data-dense interfaces; making deliberate calls on self-serve vs. guided workflows; and handling the realities of a production app such as onboarding, permissions and multi-tenancy, performance under real query loads, and instrumentation to understand how clients actually use it

This is a hybrid role. Work from home on Monday and Friday and in Applecart’s New York City office Tuesday through Thursday.

Compensation

Our compensation package consists of three components: (i) a base salary, (ii) annual cash bonus, and (iii) generous equity compensation.

The base salary range for this role is between $220,000 to $250,000, based on the candidate's experience and skills relative to the requirements listed above. The salary range provided is exclusive of discretionary annual cash bonus and equity compensation. The salary range provided for this role is specific to candidates located in the New York City area.

A Few Facts About Us

Applecart’s platform has been used by hundreds of industry-leading clients spanning Fortune 500 companies like Blackstone and Intuit, leading nonprofit organizations like the Environmental Defense Fund, and top-tier advertising and communications agencies like Teneo, FGS, Weber Shandwick, and OMD.
Applecart is growing quickly — over the last 4 years, we’ve increased our revenue by 10X, grown our headcount by almost 5X, and we’re cashflow positive.
Our senior leadership team includes two members of the Forbes 30 under 30 list for Marketing and Advertising, the former Head of Product at Moat, Oracle’s online ad measurement platform, a former senior White House advisor, early sales and talent leaders from Google and Twitter, two of the Democratic Party’s most successful pollsters and strategists, and alums of top-tier organizations like Bain & Company, Amazon and Simpson Thacher.
Applecart raised a $100M Series C from Blackstone’s tech growth fund at the end of 2025. The company’s other investors include Bain & Company, global sports, entertainment and marketing giant Endeavor, KKR Co-Founder Henry Kravis, entrepreneur Chris Burch, a founder of Palantir, senior engineering leaders at Twitter and Yelp, former Fortune 50 and advertising agency CEOs, and a number of well-known venture capitalists. Ari Emanuel, CEO of TKO and Executive Chairman of WME, Wayne Berman, Blackstone’s Head of Global Government Affairs, and Risa Heller, CEO of HELLER, serve on our board.
Our work has been featured on Morning Joe on MSNBC, BloombergTV, and The Colbert Report, and in Axios, Semafor, BusinessWeek, the Associated Press, Forbes, the Washington Post, and Politico, among many others.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Overview

Mid-market product-based businesses — manufacturers, distributors, and B2B and B2C commerce companies doing $2.5M–$100M in revenue — are one of the largest underserved opportunities in financial software. Manufacturing alone represents 32% of the global ERP market, worth over $20 billion in North America and projected to reach $32 billion by 2029. And yet most of them are running their finances on tools built for businesses nothing like theirs. That is the gap Intuit is building to fill.

Intuit's strategy is to become the financial operating system for this segment — delivering AI-powered financial intelligence and a connected ecosystem that makes Intuit the system of record mid-market operators build their stack around.

The financial burden is two-sided: inventory-based operations complexity — COGS, multi-location stock, purchase orders, landed costs — and product revenue complexity — deferred recognition, multi-element arrangements, and margin visibility by SKU, channel, and customer. Most have no system that handles both. That is the gap Intuit is building to fill.

As the Senior Staff Product Manager for Product-Based Businesses, you will own the strategy for product-based businesses — defining where Intuit plays, driving build, buy, and partner decisions, and converting high-value customers in partnership with Sales, Lighthouse, and Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Define where Intuit plays in the mid-market product-based business segment — ICP, competitive positioning against ERP incumbents, and the build, buy, and partner decisions that sequence the roadmap.
Build the integration strategy across inventory, commerce, supply chain, and operations — making Intuit the financial hub mid-market customers build their stack around.
Design the agentic layer — agents that execute inventory reconciliation, revenue recognition, period-end close, and cash flow forecasting — with confidence thresholds and escalation logic that make automation trustworthy at mid-market scale.
Deliver margin visibility by SKU, channel, and customer; cash flow forecasting; and variance analysis surfaced through natural language that replaces manual Excel modeling.
Partner with Lighthouse, Sales, and Customer Success to drive resolution on high-value escalations — translating customer friction into roadmap decisions that improve the product for the broader segment.

Qualifications

7+ years in product management with deep expertise in mid-market financial software, ERP, inventory management, or B2B SaaS serving product-based businesses.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree (MBA or MS) a plus.
Firsthand knowledge of how product-based businesses operate — inventory costing, COGS, multi-location operations, purchase order management, and margin visibility by SKU and channel — earned running or building software for manufacturers, distributors, or commerce companies, not learned in a spec.
Proven ability to define segment strategy, set competitive positioning against mid-market ERP incumbents, and make build, buy, and partner calls that compound over time.
Track record shipping AI-native products in production — writing agentic specs with objectives, tool definitions, confidence thresholds, and escalation logic.
Experience owning integration strategies across commerce, inventory, and supply chain platforms — and building the ecosystem partnerships that create structural lock-in at the mid-market.
Ability to operate across strategic and tactical registers — defining long-horizon vision while driving high-value customer escalations to resolution in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

New York $205,000 - $277,500

Mountain View, CA $205,500- $278,000

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Temporary Role
ASAP – 12/31/2026
Semi-Monthly, Exempt – W2 on Dentsu Payroll Only
Location: Remote or Hybrid depending on location.
EST Time Zone
Must be US Based

About Dentsu Creative:

Dentsu Creative is a global creative agency network designed to unlock exponential growth for clients. We use Transformative Creativity as a differentiating, driving force to bring our capabilities together to positively impact people, business and society. Established in June 2022, Dentsu Creative is integrated with Dentsu's Media and CXM businesses in over 145 countries and regions, to offer integrated Growth Solutions.

Overview:

TEMPORARY DIRECTOR, INTEGRATED STRATEGY

Reports to:
EVP, Integrated Strategy

YOUR MINDSET

You have developed fluency in disciplines most people keep separate. You don't see creative strategy and media strategy as different languages. You see them as different expressions of the same brilliant strategic thinking and that fluency informs everything you do.

You believe that the best creative ideas scale, that strategic coherence matters, and that you grow by collaborating with people who think differently than you. You contribute with conviction and follow-through. You help build a culture where people understand how their work fits into something bigger and you are here for more than your role. You understand that ideas and how they reach people are equally important—not one secondary to the other.

Role Overview

You will develop and execute a range of integrated strategy projects for a specific brand or strategic focus area within a multi-brand consumer healthcare enterprise, translating strategic direction into inspirational insights and briefs that enable great creative and media execution come together.

This role demands fluency in two disciplines that most separate: Brand Strategy and Connected Strategy. You work from both perspectives simultaneously. You don't just translate between them, you hold them together with clear strategic thinking that helps them operate as one. You understand how strategy needs to live across earned, owned, and paid channels—including social and influencer partnerships.

You turn strategic direction into clear big ideas and briefs grounded in audience insight and media possibility. You work with creative and media teams to help them understand how their work fits together into a coherent whole and inspire both to think bigger and think together. You are the bold strategic voice in the room who helps teams see how their work connects and why that connection matters.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Development — Ideas & Brief

Translate strategic direction into powerful Catalyzing Ideas and briefs grounded in creative insight and contextual possibility
Build the strategic rationale—not just what we're doing, but why it matters and how it moves the business
Develop brand worlds that breathe life into ideas—articulating character, conviction, and edges with specificity
Help creative teams uncover the strategic insight that should drive their work. Help media teams see how that idea scales. Understand how ideas need to live in social and influencer contexts.

Strategic System Operationalization

Identify WHERE ideas reach the right audiences and HOW they show up in context—across paid media, owned channels, social platforms, and influencer partnerships
Research and surface audience signals that inform where and when strategy becomes relevant and urgent
Understand signal stacking—how multiple signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Help teams understand how their work feeds the whole and why that connection matters

Cross-Disciplinary Alignment & Leadership

Work with creative, media, social, and influencer partners to ensure strategy translates consistently across all touchpoints
Help creative teams understand media strategy and what's possible at scale. Help media teams understand creative strategy and what ideas demand. Bridge social and influencer thinking into the broader strategic conversation.
Bridge creative and media conversations so both disciplines understand they're working from the same foundation
Think in both languages simultaneously—you are fluent in creative strategy AND media strategy, weaving them together

Stakeholder Communication & Relationship Building

Brief brand partners and internal stakeholders on strategy with clarity and confidence
Be a reliable strategic voice partners turn to when asking "how should this idea work?" or "how does this fit what we're doing?"
Engage with senior team to gather input and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities

Team Contribution & Development

Support team leadership by modeling integrated thinking
Mentor junior strategists, helping them understand systems thinking, not just tactical execution
Ask good questions that help teams think beyond their discipline
Contribute to creating psychological safety where people challenge siloed thinking

Measurement & Learning

Help monitor how strategy translates in market and gather feedback for refinement
Support measurement that tracks whether the system is working, using data as feedback not just reporting
Contribute insights on how ideas are propagating and whether signals are clustering as predicted

What Success Looks Like

Your strategic briefs are clear, actionable, and inspiring. You are a student of great work and hungry to do your best work
Creative and media partners use your strategy as a real tool, not just a document. They understand how the two disciplines work together
Teams understand the coherence in what they're building—how each piece connects to the whole. They think in systems, not just tactics
You've demonstrated you can develop strategy and help bring it to life in integrated ways
Junior strategists learn systems thinking by working with you. You are an inspiring mentor to junior talent
Measurement shows ideas propagating and signals clustering as predicted
Relationships deepen because you bring perspective that helps partners operate more strategically

Key Qualifications

Experience:

6-10 years strategy experience with demonstrated fluency in BOTH creative strategy AND media strategy
Proven ability to develop and communicate breakthrough strategic thinking, not just execute briefs
Track record working on consumer or B2C brands in complex strategic environments
Experience working across creative and media functions
Comfort engaging with senior stakeholders in strategic conversations
Experience with social media platforms and/or influencer partnerships a plus

Intellectual Foundation:

Understanding of how ideas propagate and land in culture—not just single-moment performance
Ability to hold multiple perspectives, audiences, and signals in mind simultaneously
Comfort moving between strategic thinking and tactical execution, between 30,000 feet and the work itself
Understanding of signal stacking—how audience signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Genuine curiosity about how creative and media thinking complement and inform each other
Evidence that you think about systems, not just campaigns
Evidence that you learn from people and disciplines different from your own

Communication & Collaboration:

Strong communicator who can brief stakeholders with clarity
Ability to contribute ideas within a broader strategic framework
Genuine interest in how creative and media thinking complement each other
Collaborative spirit; you get smarter working with others
Ability to mentor and develop other strategists

Additional Information:

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Department Information

Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.

Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

Description Of Job

IMPORTANT NOTE:

Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.

We are looking for an innovative and experienced technical Senior Product Manager
to join our team at OIT. In this pivotal role as our new Senior Product Manager, you will contribute to the development and delivery of technology solutions that drive business success. You will serve as a vital liaison between stakeholders, service management, and the development team, ensuring that product requirements for the Salesforce and other SaaS based platforms are clearly defined, prioritized, and delivered on schedule.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will play a crucial role in shaping our Platform Services product strategy and ensuring that our solutions not only meet, but exceed customer expectations. Your influence will drive outcomes that align with our strategic goals while promoting a highly tactical approach in a collaborative and supportive environment.

We're looking for an individual who wants to do the best work of their career in service of the public to design, deliver, and continuously improve services that work for Coloradans.

Essential Functions

Write and maintain a well-groomed backlog using user stories that are outcome-oriented, appropriately sized, and grounded in real constituent needs; Draft initial product backlogs for RFPs, translating problem spaces into indicative user stories that structure procurement without locking the pod into fixed, rigid scope.
Apply frameworks such as Value vs. Effort or "Now/Next/Later" to make and defend prioritization decisions.
Proactively manage scope by saying "no" clearly and constructively to work that does not serve the current priority.
Run essential agile planning cycles, including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
Conduct quarterly roadmap conversations with stakeholders to align long-term goals with delivery capacity.
Regularly update the Director of Platform Services, IT Director, and program staff about status in terms of outcomes (mission impact) rather than just progress (activity).
Partner with Service Designers to understand, apply, and interpret journey maps, blueprints, and problem frames, translating these artifacts into actionable backlog inputs.to understand
Define and track objectives and key results (OKRs) and success metrics; evaluate and communicate when shipped features fail to deliver expected outcomes.
Build the product ownership capacity of agency staff over time, ensuring the agency becomes a stronger partner rather than a dependent.
Manage the product's lifecycle from discovery through to ongoing continuous improvement.
Collaborate deeply with engineering to validate technical architecture decisions.
Collaborate with the Delivery Engineer on build/buy/SaaS evaluations, contributing backlog context, mission-impact perspective, and constituent needs to inform the technical decision.

What You Bring

Knowledge of product management fundamentals, including backlog ownership, user story writing, prioritization frameworks such as value vs. effort or now/next/later, and what it means to govern a product rather than a project.
Knowledge of agile planning and development cycles: sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives work, and the PM's role is in each.
Knowledge of user-centered design principles sufficient to work productively with the Service Designer, interpret research findings, and translate constituent needs into backlog priorities.
Knowledge of State agency program context with regard to the way in which Colorado agencies deliver services, make decisions, and structure program priorities.
Knowledge of the product lifecycle from discovery through to continuous improvement.
Awareness of the build/buy/SaaS tradeoff space, common state IT patterns, and how technology investment decisions get made and funded in state government.
Ability to define and develop meaningful success metrics that go beyond delivery activity toward mission impact.
Ability to decline work that doesn't serve the current priority, and document that decision in a way that keeps stakeholders informed rather than surprised
Ability to communicate product status in terms of outcomes, not just progress.
Ability to facilitate stakeholder conversations that produce ranked decisions, rather than a list of any and all desired items.
Ability to distinguish between user needs and stakeholder “wants, make operational decisions based on that information, and bring stakeholders into alignment.
Ability to own the product's success metrics and track them honestly, including when a shipped feature isn't delivering the expected outcome.
Ability to adapt communication style and level of detail to the audience.
Ability to define long-term product vision and translate ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to use customer insights, metrics, and experimentation to drive prioritization and investment choices.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions Of Employment & Appeal Rights

A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

A minimum of five (5) years of product management experience, with a proven track record of owning and launching complex technical products or platforms.
Experience with Agile Methodologies: working competency with Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) and tracking tools like Jira or Rally.

Substitutions

Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.
Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.
If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year-for-year

Preferred Qualifications

Experience evaluating software solutions (e.g., custom build, SaaS, commercial off-the-shelf) and managing vendor relationships to ensure external technical deliveries align with agile, outcome-oriented product roadmaps.
Strong architectural and technical fluency, with the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, understand system design, and collaborate deeply with principal engineers. Direct experience working with APIs, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices, data pipelines, or complex software development frameworks.
Experience querying data independently using SQL or interpreting data using technical analytics tools.
Experience leading decision-making across engineering, design, marketing, and sales without direct authority.
Experience translating ambiguous, high-level business goals into concrete, data-driven product requirements and long-term technical roadmaps.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
jobs.description:
Integration meets Innovation
At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.
Celigo is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.
What would you do if hired?
Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

Who are we looking for?
Skills & Abilities

You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.
You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."
You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.
You treat the program's problems as your own. You move on things before being asked, you measure yourself by outcomes rather than activity, and you find the faster path and take it.
You drive results through influence, not authority. You create alignment with engineering teams, Sales, and the CPO's org by understanding what each team needs and making it easy for them to say yes.
You're comfortable applying AI to your own work: drafting, research, analysis, and wherever else it frees you for the judgment calls that matter. Genuine curiosity about what AI can and cannot do is part of what makes someone thrive here, especially in a role that's also responsible for making AI credible to customers.
You translate clearly between business stakeholders (GTM, CX, G&A) and technical teams. You know enough about the systems to design processes, not just manage a backlog.
You're credible on stage and in a boardroom. Executive presence is real for this role: you will represent Celigo externally and need customers and prospects to trust what you say.
You use data (adoption, usage, outcomes) to prioritize, to influence colleagues and executives, and to know early when something isn't working.

Education & Experience 

8+ years in product management, comfortable operating hands-on as a Principal individual contributor while owning a program end-to-end.
Deep functional experience in GTM and/or CX operations and the systems that run them (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or similar), sufficient to design the processes, not just manage the backlog.
Track record of running an internal-as-first-customer, dogfooding, or Customer Zero program, or standing up a Product function where one didn't exist.
Experience building and packaging reference stories or proof points that Sales and Marketing can use externally.
Preferred: background with SaaS, iPaaS, integration, or automation platforms, and comfort with AI-first or agentic products.
Preferred: hands-on experience using the product you support internally.
Preferred: close partnership with a CPO or Product org to influence a public roadmap.

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base
salary between $175,000 and $200,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.
Celigo is proud to be

A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award.
Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year
Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.
Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency
A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented
Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field
Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily
Competitive compensation and benefits, including:
Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)
Wellness days and holidays to recharge
Parental leave and a generous benefits package
Monthly tech stipend
Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about Taking a Stand .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Field Systems (Salesforce)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Field Systems team, the group responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling the commercial go-to market tools including CRM, e-signature, opportunity management, sales engagement, marketing automation, and forecasting platforms. You will own the product roadmap and serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and an agile delivery team to ensure the right work gets prioritized, scoped, and shipped at the right time.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of enterprise systems, business strategy, and Scaled agile execution. You'll thrive here if you love translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, leveraging modern AI tools to work smarter and faster, and partnering closely with sales, marketing, finance, and customer success to drive measurable outcomes.

You will report to our Director, Field Systems. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.

You Will

Partner with the Director of Field Systems to define, maintain, and communicate a prioritized product roadmap aligned to company go-to-market objectives
Continuously assess the value, urgency, and feasibility of roadmap initiatives to ensure the team is always working on the highest-impact problems
Translate strategic priorities into quarterly PI (Program Increment) objectives within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
Engage directly with internal stakeholders including Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Technical Support to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and business goals
Define clear epics, features, and user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria.
Lead discovery activities including stakeholder interviews, process walkthroughs, and data analysis to inform solution design
Leverage AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to accelerate requirements documentation, synthesize stakeholder feedback, draft communications, and surface insights from data bringing a modern, AI-augmented approach to everyday PM work
Serve as the Product Owner for the agile team, owning and grooming the team backlog to ensure a healthy queue of well-refined work
Actively participate in SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Refinement, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospectives, and System Demos
Make real-time prioritization and trade-off decisions to keep the team moving and unblocked
Maintain transparent, proactive communication with stakeholders on roadmap status, delivery timelines, and change impacts
Build trust with business partners by consistently delivering on commitments and surfacing risks early
Collaborate with change management and enablement teams to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities
Define success metrics for features and initiatives; track outcomes post-deployment and use data to inform future prioritization
Drive retrospective insights from delivery into roadmap refinement and team process improvements

You Have

5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on go-to market tools and platform products in an enterprise environment
Demonstrated experience working within SAFe or agile framework, including PI Planning and cross-team coordination
Strong product sense with experience balancing user needs, business value, and technical feasibility
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present confidently to senior leaders and technical teams alike
Experience writing detailed epics and features, lean business cases, and user stories with strong assumptions and acceptance criteria
Comfort with data including the ability to query data, interpret metrics, and build business cases
Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification
Experience supporting sales operations, revenue operations, or marketing operations functions
Familiarity with CPQ, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud implementations
Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) applied to PM workflows such as documentation, research, or analysis.
SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification
Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Current US Perks & Benefits

Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$135,000 - $176,250 USD

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

BCG continues to expand its Marketing, Sales & Pricing practice and is experiencing increasing demand, particularly in the areas of B2B Sales. We are thrilled to expand our breadth and depth of expertise in this space, especially in Sales and Customer Success technology, CRM Sales Cloud & Service Cloud implementation, and familiarity with B2B Sales, Support and Customer Success best practices.

Own multi-channel growth strategy based on marketing, sales, pricing, and digital self-service

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, New Product Line
jobs.description:
About Alia

Alia is an e-commerce popup and list-growth platform used by more than 4,500 merchants, from emerging DTC brands to household names like AG1, HexClad, and Dollar Shave Club. Our products, including Smart Triggering, Smart Offers, Smart Testing, Smart Timing, and Prism AI, help brands convert more visitors into subscribers and customers. Alia was founded without outside funding, grew to $13M ARR, and was acquired by Dotdigital in March 2026.

The Role

We are launching a new product line that extends what Alia does for e-commerce brands. The product line will sit in the ads, media buying, and data space, and it is still at the earliest stage. There is no existing product, roadmap, or defined scope yet, so you will shape what it becomes from the ground up.

This role owns the product line from zero to one. You will define what we build, validate it with merchants, ship the first version, and grow it into a meaningful part of the business. You will have access to more than 4,500 merchants, a Customer Success team that knows them well, and the distribution of Dotdigital's broader platform.

This is one of Alia's first two product management hires. There is no product operations team and no established product process. You will help build the product function from the ground up, including how we plan, prioritize, write requirements, and measure results. If you want a mature product organization with defined rituals, this is not the right role. If you want to shape how product works at a fast-growing company, it is.

You will report directly to our Chief Customer Officer. That gives you close access to our largest customers, the teams that serve them, and company leadership.

What You Will Do

Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the new product line, from initial concept through launch and scale.
Lead customer discovery with merchants across segments to validate the problem, the solution, and willingness to pay.
Define the first version, set launch criteria, and make clear scope tradeoffs to get product into merchants' hands quickly.
Establish and own the success metrics for the product line, including adoption, activation, retention, and revenue, and report on them to leadership.
Partner with Marketing and Revenue on positioning, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market for launch.

Blink UX is seeking experienced Senior Technical Product Managers,

Opportunities may range from short-term engagements of 1-4 months to extended embedded placements of 6+ months supporting a single client. Most roles are full-time, though part-time opportunities may occasionally be available.

What We Are Looking For

As a Senior Technical Product Manager,
you will define, build, and scale AI-powered products, tools, workflows, and decision-support systems that drive measurable business impact.

A successful product manager will identify opportunities where artificial intelligence can improve productivity, automate repetitive work, enhance decision making, and unlock new capabilities across the organization. This role will be responsible for translating business challenges into a portfolio of high-value AI initiatives, ranging from rapid experiments and process improvements to transformational products and platforms.

This position goes beyond traditional product management. The ideal candidate combines strategic product thinking with hands-on technical execution, actively building prototypes, evaluating emerging AI technologies, testing models and APIs, and guiding successful solutions from concept through deployment and adoption.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Product Management, or a related field

Strong understanding of product management fundamentals, including discovery, prioritization, roadmap planning, experimentation, and outcome measurement.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline.

Work hands-on with modern AI technologies, including LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks, agent platforms, evaluation systems, and automation tools.
