About 4MP

At 4MP, we are building a new technological foundation for precision manufacturing. Our systems enable CNC machines to self-measure, self-correct, and continuously improve their performance - transforming conventional machine tools into
autonomous precision systems.
Backed by a leading institutional investor and extensively vetted by recognized experts across industry and government laboratories, 4MP is at the beginning of a category-defining journey. We are transitioning from early development into building a visionary company that will redefine how precision manufacturing is done globally.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on VP of Software who has built and shipped industrial software that runs in production, on real machines, in real plants. You will build and lead the software organization and the product it delivers, from architecture through release, working directly with the founding leadership team and R&D team across machine physics, metrology, AI, and customer operations to turn our technology into a reliable, deployable, commercial product.

Joining at this seed stage means you will have a foundational voice in shaping the company, the product architecture, and how we deliver software to manufacturing customers. You will not simply manage a backlog; you will define what we ship, how we ship it, and the standard of quality we hold ourselves to.

What You Will Do

Own the Software Product:
Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and release plan, and be accountable for what reaches customers. You will lead the software and product function while staying technically hands-on in architecture, code, and design reviews.
Ship Production-Grade Software:
Turn research and prototypes created by the R&D team into a hardened, supportable product with real release discipline: versioning, testing, documentation, deployment, upgrades, and field support.
 Define the SaaS and Deployment Model:
Architect how the platform is delivered and licensed across cloud, on-premise, edge, and disconnected plant networks, with the telemetry and update paths each demands.
Own Industrial Requirements and Security:
Drive requirements for cybersecurity, data protection, access control, uptime, traceability, and validation, aligned to industrial and customer IT standards.
Run the Development Process:
Establish the operating cadence of the engineering organization: agile planning, sprint execution, definition of done, release trains, and honest schedule management.
Lead Customer Deployments and Pilots:
Work directly with customers on requirements, pilot installations, and production rollout, and convert what you learn on the floor into product decisions.
Drive Strategic Cross-Functional Leadership:
In close interaction with other functional leaders, you will contribute to defining the company strategy, technology and business roadmaps, and comprehensive project plans.

What We Require

Proven Industrial Software Delivery:
A solid track record of building and shipping commercial software used in manufacturing, robotics, industrial automation, or comparable industrial environments. You have owned products that customers run every day.
10+ Years of Experience:
Deep background in software engineering and product leadership, including time spent building software yourself before leading others who build it.
Real-World Sensing and Machine Data:
Direct experience with products built on sensor, metrology, control, or telemetry data from physical systems, and a clear understanding of how messy that data is in practice.
Industrial Requirements and Security:
Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity, on-premise and segmented plant networks, safety and quality expectations, data governance, and the validation and documentation that industrial customers require.
SaaS and Platform Product Leadership:
Experience defining and running a software-as-a-service or platform product, including architecture tradeoffs, release management, support models, and commercial packaging.
Software Team Leadership:
Proven ability to lead engineers and product managers, set priorities under real constraints, and hold a team to a shipping schedule without losing technical credibility.
Educational Foundation:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

What Will Set You Apart

Industrial Technology Pedigree:
Experience at a major industrial software or automation organization (for example Siemens, Hexagon, Microsoft on the industrial and manufacturing side, Rockwell, PTC, Autodesk, or similar), ideally combined with startup experience.
Agile and Scrum Master Credentials:
Formal Scrum Master experience or certification, and a demonstrated ability to install a development process that actually holds.
Project Management Discipline:
Structured project and program management experience, including PMP or equivalent, applied to multi-team hardware and software programs.
Manufacturing Domain Fluency:
Familiarity with CNC machining, CAM, metrology, quality systems, or robotics, and comfort speaking the language of manufacturing engineers on the shop floor.
Visionary Drive:
You are not just looking for a senior title; you are looking for the opportunity to achieve a career-defining milestone by building a product that fundamentally reshapes an entire industry.

As a community-driven software company dedicated to the success of technology solution providers, our suite helps over 45,000 of our partners manage their businesses better, sell more efficiently, automate service delivery, and remotely control technology so they can consistently deliver amazing customer experiences.

Our company is powered by our connections, our colleagues, and our community. And, we accept all kinds.

Game-changers, innovators, culture-lovers—and humankind.

We see you and value you for your unique contributions. Our inclusive, positive culture lays the foundation to ensure every colleague is valued for their perspectives and skills, giving you the choice of how YOU make a difference.

Curious? Read this opportunity to learn how YOU can make a difference at ConnectWise!

General Summary:

The Director of Product Management is responsible for leading a global team of entry level to experienced professionals focused on overseeing our integrated platforms and developing the department’s vision, strategy, and execution in alignment with the company’s goals. This role supports cross-functional teams and focuses on enhancing content across the assigned product line that increases the efficacy of product development across the organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Sets goals and objectives for team members for achievement of operational results
Typically manages a department or small unit that includes multiple teams
Influences others to accept practices and approaches
Communicates and influences executive leadership
Owns short to mid-term execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Product Management team
Leads and prioritizes the daily activities of the team
Manages, mentors, and coaches to develop a collaborative and dynamic team
Coordinates cross-functional communication to align on initiatives and strategies to drive efficiency
Participates in Go-To-Market (GTM) messaging, positioning, and strategy
Interacts with customers and prospects to define market requirements, and translate these requirements into product requirements that the engineering team can deliver within specification, on time, and within budget
Represents ConnectWise companies in key customer engagements, at analyst events, conferences and other venues
Builds, measures, and refines product requirements and user experience analysis process
Co-creates and manages product lifecycle management and software development lifecycle
Identifies, develops, and manages contractual, technical, and consulting relationships with strategic partners/customers and providers, including joint ventures, subsidiary relationships, and projects
Gathers, validates, and evaluates product/market requirements through market and customer research, competitive, and product research
Develops functional specifications for assigned product features to include effective product and user interface design, rapid prototyping, product validation testing, and usability testing, while ensuring that the product strategy is adhered to throughout the product life cycle
Develops and delivers materials to the appropriate marketing and sales organizations which convey the purpose and details of the product, definition of its user, benefits to the customer, customization capabilities, and competitive comparison
Leads the development, approval, training, and communication of new products/product changes and their associated customer, operational, system, & process impacts to the various internal organizations
Monitors internal processes for efficiency and validity pre & post product launch/changes
Delivers timely and high-quality product releases that solve our partners business problems

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities Required:

Exceptional leadership and customer service skills
Ability to address complex problems that often require extensive investigation and analysis
Willingness to work in a team environment
Strong organizational skills to give the team direction
Professional presence suitable for interaction in meetings, in-person, or via email, as well as at internal and external facing events
Excellent presentation and communication skills
Critical thinking and problem resolution skills
Project management, time-management, analytical skills
Ability to be pro-active with a sense of urgency
Strong ability to read, understand and communicate technical documentation
Highly motivated person with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment that is continually changing

Educational/Vocational/Previous Experience Recommendations:

Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent business experience
8+ years of relevant experience
5+ years of managerial experience
Preferred: Experience with B2B software products, services in MSP industry, and product development

Onsite/Hybrid/Remote depending on location
20-30% travel may be required

jobs.description:
Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned commercial property and casualty professional to shape product strategy, drive new market development, and influence meaningful product innovation across a multi-line environment. In this role, the Senior Product Manager serves as a trusted technical underwriting expert, helping identify opportunities, strengthen existing products, and support enterprise-wide best practices. This position partners across business units and lines business to bring consistency, insight, and strategic direction to complex initiatives, while leading high-impact process improvements that support growth, profitability, and long-term business success.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Identifies, evaluates and manages problem markets, underwriting trends, regulatory changes and emerging issues; provides reports and recommendations to support profitable growth and sound underwriting practices.
Analyzes current and potential books of business, including accounts above business unit authority limits, and makes recommendations on pricing, programs and risk selection as needed.
Develops, implements and monitors divisional underwriting policies, procedures, workflows, quality control standards and governance practices to promote consistency and best practices across operating units.
Identifies improvement opportunities, evaluates departmental programs and projects, and partners with management to strengthen processes, effectiveness and execution.
Develops and delivers training, programs and presentations at the business unit and divisional level.
Serves as a technical underwriting expert and advisor to Underwriting, Product Management, business units and other stakeholders on underwriting questions, audit issues, bureau inquiries and related business concerns.
Collaborates with enterprise operating units to support cost containment strategies, underwriting due diligence assignments, committees and approved enterprise initiatives.
Leads new market and product development efforts, including business cases, white papers, opportunity design, implementation planning and cross-functional coordination for multiple commercial lines of insurance.
Drafts, develops and implements new products, organizational practices, underwriting guidelines and letters of authority for new programs and products within the multi-line commercial insurance arena.
Evaluates complex reinsurance structures and clauses within proportional and non-proportional treaty and facultative reinsurance policies.
Conducts policy wording reviews for renewals to ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines.
Maintains a clear understanding of business requirements and applies expert product knowledge throughout the functional design process, including requirements documentation and technology liaison support.
Supports market intelligence initiatives, special projects and other assignments as needed while maintaining confidentiality of all information processed.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Insurance, Business, Math, Finance, or a related field required.
Progress towards, or completion of, industry-recognized professional designations (i.e., CIC, AU, CPCU) preferred.
Combinations of relevant education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required.
Minimum ten years of commercial property and casualty multi-line underwriting, and product management/development experience with demonstrated technical knowledge with both small and large accounts, or equivalent experience that provides the necessary skills, knowledge and abilities; or any combination of education and experience that would provide an equivalent background.
Two years of experience with the Enterprise as a Corporate Underwriting Consultant or equivalent experience which provides the necessary skills, knowledge and abilities required.
Residency in Eastern and Central Time Zones encouraged/preferred.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Other Skills And Abilities

Extensive commercial property and casualty underwriting knowledge with strong multi-line experience, including underwriting techniques, occupational classification codes, loss ratios, claims histories, retention plans, scheduled credits and other methods used to acquire and retain profitable business.
Experience in insurance product development, product ideation, market strategy, market research or risk management.
Ability to build enterprise multi-line capabilities and implement new product offerings within technology platforms.
Experience working with insurance-related regulatory and governing bodies.
Sound judgment in evaluating commercial property and casualty risks and determining whether to accept or reject risks for insurance coverage.
Ability to read, write, analyze and interpret policy documents, policy language, technical and financial information, and procedure manuals.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify improvement needs, develop solutions and perform necessary mathematical computations.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to exchange information clearly, present ideas, report facts and respond to questions effectively.
Strong interpersonal, negotiation and relationship-building skills with the ability to maintain productive partnerships.
Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines with minimal direction and make competent independent decisions.
Proficiency with computers, Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Word and spreadsheet applications.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and perform assignments at locations outside the office as needed.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Ads Quality
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, enabling Instacart and its retailer partners to deliver highly relevant, effective advertising experiences at scale. As part of the Ad Product team, you'll sit at the intersection of machine learning, marketplace dynamics, and measurable business impact — helping shape the future of how brands connect with shoppers across the Instacart platform.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the systems that drive core auction understanding and marketplace balance within our Ads Quality domain. This is a high-impact, technically complex space where your work will directly influence the health of the ads ecosystem — from how auctions are structured and optimized to how quality signals inform ranking and relevance. You'll partner closely with a team of talented machine learning engineers and ads engineers who are building at the frontier of what's possible in retail media.

If you're energized by ambiguous, high-stakes problems, fluent in the language of ML and online advertising, and eager to accelerate experimentation in a fast-moving environment — this is the role for you.

About The Job

Own the product vision and roadmap for ads quality systems, including auction mechanics, marketplace balance, and the signals that govern ad ranking and relevance across Instacart's retail media network.
Drive the strategy and execution for increasing the velocity of experimentation across the ads quality team — designing frameworks that allow the team to test, learn, and iterate faster without sacrificing rigor or integrity.
Work hands-on with machine learning engineers and ads engineers to translate complex ML model outputs and auction dynamics into clear product requirements, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.
Define and track the right success metrics for ads quality, navigating tradeoffs between advertiser performance, shopper experience, and marketplace health — and communicating those tradeoffs clearly to senior stakeholders.
Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where priorities shift, new data surfaces frequently, and the ability to make good decisions under uncertainty is essential to moving the business forward.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

2+ years of product management experience in online advertising, ad tech, or a closely related domain — with a demonstrated understanding of auction mechanics, bidding systems, or ad quality signals.
2+ years of experience working directly with machine learning teams or ML-driven products, with the ability to engage substantively in technical conversations about model design, evaluation, and tradeoffs.
Proven track record of defining and executing on product roadmaps in complex, data-rich environments with multiple cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product decisions, measure impact, and design experiments.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and how they can be applied within ads or ranking systems.
Experience working with ads machine learning models in a production environment, including relevance scoring, auction optimization, or quality filtering.
Prior experience at a retail media network, demand-side platform, or supply-side platform, with exposure to the full advertising stack.
Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments where structure and process are still being built — and an eagerness to help build them.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Description

At Amazon Ads, we’re re-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights.

We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and deliver results to both. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

Amazon is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the development of an AI agent for Ads that helps customers find and discover new products and engage with brands and sellers on Amazon.

In this role, you will manage complex technical programs that span multiple VP-level organizations. You will work across teams to align on project requirements, create work back plans, define API contracts, and manage strategic communications with executive stakeholders.

This is a leadership position that requires an ability to earn trust with stakeholders across diverse disciplines including engineering, product, operations, legal, sales, UX, and marketing. Work with teams across engineering, product, operations, legal, UX, sales, and marketing to define requirements and deliver complex ad products that leverage generative AI.
Define and deliver critical programs with broad cross-organizational impact, owning the technology roadmap for complex systems and managing a portfolio of interdependent initiatives from strategy through execution.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from early career university hires to senior executives.
Identify gaps and opportunities across architectures, services, and organizations, then drive system-level and business reviews that align teams toward coherent strategies and reduce redundant engineering effort.
Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, sharing best practices across the engineering community, and creating mechanisms that ensure long-term program success beyond your direct involvement.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management, Stablecoins and Open Standard
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Vice President, Product Management, Stablecoins and Open Standard

Overview

Mastercard's Blockchain and Digital Assets group drives Mastercard’s business and product strategy in the digital currency payment space. The team is at the heart of making Mastercard the trusted access layer that lets regulated institutions and their customers enable real-time payments and smart money movement through stablecoins, tokenized deposits and other forms of tokenized value.

We are looking for a Vice President, Product Management to lead the design, development, and implementation of innovative blockchain and digital asset solutions, with a primary focus on onboarding, enabling and operationalizing various stablecoins, including Open Standard, onto Mastercard’s suite of products through direct relationships and integrations with stablecoin issuers. The role has global responsibilities and supports the execution of Mastercard's broader crypto and blockchain product roadmap.

The ideal candidate is a strong leader and people manager who combines deep payments expertise with strong product development, partnership management, commercialization, and business leadership experience. The candidate should possess a proven ability to bring innovative products from concept to market, build strategic ecosystem relationships, negotiate complex commercial arrangements, and drive adoption at scale, while maintaining a genuine passion for the digital asset space.

Role

Lead Mastercard's strategic relationship with Open Standard and its member ecosystem, serving as a senior commercial, product, and governance representative to drive alignment on product strategy, ecosystem growth, operating models, and long-term network objectives.
Represent Mastercard in Open Standard governance and strategic decision-making, helping shape product roadmap, commercialization models, operating frameworks, and market expansion initiatives while ensuring alignment with Mastercard's strategic, regulatory, and network objectives.
Lead the development and commercialization of Mastercard's wholesale on- and off-ramp capabilities, enabling regulated financial institutions and Open Standard participants to efficiently mint, redeem, custody, and move tokenized money between fiat and blockchain-based networks at scale.
Drive strategic partnerships with stablecoin issuers, financial institutions, fintechs, infrastructure providers, and other ecosystem participants to expand Mastercard's stablecoin capabilities, accelerate market adoption, and create mutually beneficial commercial outcomes.
Lead negotiations with Stablecoin Issuers and issuers of other tokenized forms of money globally to ensure alignment, commercial viability and enablement of existing and new Mastercard products and services such as remittances, payouts, and B2B payments.
Drive the successful adoption, growth, and commercialization of Open Standard and other compliant stablecoins across Mastercard products and services by identifying new use cases, distribution opportunities, customer segments, and ecosystem partnerships.
Lead product and business engagements with third-party and distributed blockchains to facilitate payment product enablement and mutually beneficial business outcomes.
Develop innovative solution concepts that have strategic fit and value for Mastercard's customers and partners, including ideation, definition, design, and development of blockchain and digital asset solutions.

All About You

Partnership management: Proven experience building and managing strategic partnerships, including commercial negotiations, relationship management, ecosystem development, and execution with financial institutions, fintechs, technology providers, or digital asset participants
Blockchain and digital assets knowledge: Strong knowledge of and interest in the blockchain, crypto, and digital asset space. Experience building and contributing to well-known blockchain or crypto projects is desirable
Payments expertise: Experience in the payments industry with in-depth understanding of payment solutions across a variety of market segments, including familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements. Treasury and transaction banking experience a plus.
Product development: Experience in bringing new products to market, including concept definition and validation, business requirements definition, and comfort working in cross-functional teams, in line with established product development processes
Commercialization: Demonstrated success bringing new products and capabilities to market, including developing go-to-market strategies, pricing and business models, customer acquisition plans, partner enablement programs, and adoption growth initiatives.
Commercial acumen: Good commercial insight with experience building value propositions for all participants in a payments ecosystem, including Mastercard, our customers, and partners
Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify and describe complex concepts and technologies to audiences of varied knowledge, and to communicate vision and roadmap effectively to a wide variety of stakeholders
Entrepreneurial mindset: A strong entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to learn quickly, adapt to a changing market landscape, challenge the status quo, and work independently
Analytical rigor: Strong analytical skills and sound judgment with the ability to digest complex problems and take thoughtful risks
People leadership: Strong track record of leading and developing talent

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Behind everything we do is our purpose: We partner for positive impact to improve the lives of our clients and colleagues, and together, better our communities and society. We are an innovative, flexible, and inclusive organization that attracts, develops, and inspires performance excellence and a sense of belonging.

People are at the center of our partnership. Edward Jones associates are seen, heard, respected, and supported. This is what we believe makes us the best place to start or build your career.

View our Purpose, Inclusion and Citizenship Report.

Opportunity Overview

The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Controls & Observability
is responsible for driving the end‑to‑end development and delivery of AI platform capabilities to support safe, scalable, and reliable use of AI across Edward Jones in the build, management, and retirement of AI control & observability products from ideation through launch and ongoing optimization. This role translates business needs into actionable technical requirements, leads product discovery and validation efforts, and defines success metrics to evaluate product impact.

Unlike ‑Product Managers within the Digital Product Management organization, this role treats AI itself as the product
—owning firmwide, reusable, and scalable AI platform capabilities that power AI Product Manager experiences rather than discrete applications.

This role centers on strategy, discovery, and value framing, working closely with each Business and Functional area to shape AI direction, identify high‑value opportunities, and expand the art of the possible for how AI can transform their domain. Digital Product Managers will often serve as customers of the AI Product Manager, and leverage AI Products as part of their offerings. Digital Product Managers will remain accountable for the execution, delivery, and lifecycle management of AI capabilities within products and portfolios. The Director, AI Product Manager partners closely with Digital’s Product Management teams to ensure enterprise AI capabilities can be easily integrated, adopted, and leveraged across the firm.

This role ensures the adoption of responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory expectations, while clearly communicating progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. Working in collaboration with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas , the Director, AI Product Manager – AI Control & Observability ensures that AI platform capabilities deliver measurable value, maintain performance through ongoing monitoring, and support firmwide strategic objectives through shared AI capability development. The role acts as a connector throughout the full product lifecycle—navigating ideation, discovery, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

This position sits within the AI Platform Team
inside EJ Labs
, focused on building and managing the reusable AI platform capabilities that enable teams across the enterprise to clearly identify, observe, evaluate, and operate AI products through a consistent, standards-based ecosystem, rather than developing one-off or front-end solutions.

What You'll Do

Translate business needs into clear and actionable technical requirements for AI Products - reusable AI capabilities.
Lead product discovery, validation, and iterative improvement processes with a focus on how AI control & observability products are embedded across many applications, tools, and internal teams.
Define and track product success metrics specific to AI control & observability product performance, reusability, adoption, and ongoing monitoring.
Conduct research and engage internal customers to inform AI platform capabilities.
Ensure responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
Drive the development and delivery of AI platform capabilities, ensuring they are not one-off builds, but reusable, model driven products deployed across the organization.
Collaborate with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas teams to test, deploy, and refine new AI platform capabilities and ensure alignment with enterprise AI standards.
Communicate product progress, updates, and outcomes to stakeholders across the organization.
Conduct market and user research to understand demand for reusable AI capabilities and anticipate model and agent centric enhancements.
Monitor and evaluate AI platform capability performance, implementing refinements as needed as part of ongoing product lifecycle management and governance.
Actively shape the definition and evolution of product AI capability vision and strategy in partnership with business and technology stakeholders to drive measurable business impact and outcome-oriented delivery.
Translate business goals, user insights, market trends, and product model and agent knowledge into product AI roadmaps, themes, initiatives, epics, and user stories—informing prioritization and hypothesis generation in collaboration with partners.
Support product delivery, adoption, and business impact through influence and collaboration, reinforcing outcome ownership while navigating shared accountability.
Collaborate with product leadership, delivery partners, and enabling teams to support resource coordination, delivery execution, and risk management across delivery teams.
Deploy and test new AI platform builder capabilities, ensuring reliability, explainability, and functional integration with a broad set of consuming systems and applications.
Own the lifecycle of AI platform builder capabilities—including versioning, performance monitoring, retraining plan development, and continuous improvement.
Ensure EJ Labs’ AI platform capabilities are adopted by internal customers.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, product management or related field.
7+ years’ experience in product management includes translating business needs into technical requirements and leading product discovery and validation.
3+ years' experience in AI/ML.
Strong understanding of AI technologies and financial services.
Product operating model methodologies, including AI driven PDLC.
AI technologies and their applications in business contexts.
Metrics and frameworks for tracking product AI model and agent success and impact.
Responsible AI practices and regulatory compliance requirements.
User experience (UX) principles and their integration into product AI capability design.

What you'll need:

Master’s Degree in Artificial Intelligence, Product Management, or a related field.
5+ years’ experience in AI product management, with a focus on responsible AI practices and regulatory compliance in a financial services context.
Financial services industry practices and regulations.
Emerging trends in AI product model and agent development and management.
Data governance and integrity management.
Risk management and compliance in AI product AI model and agent development.
Advanced data visualization techniques for product insights.

Entrepreneurial drive with demonstrated success navigating ambiguity, taking 0-to-1 concepts to scale, and balancing bold product innovation with core metrics at scale.
Advanced ability to influence and align cross-functional partners and senior executives on long-term product strategy.
Passion for reimagining consumer products for the AI era, with experience building experiences powered by Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, or Multimodal/Large Language Models.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google Images is a visual discovery platform, helping people explore, evaluate, and understand the world visually every day. As generative AI and multimodal models fundamentally change how people search, visual experiences have become one of the most dynamic and high-priority frontiers in Google Search.

As a Product Manager, you will manage the strategy, roadmap, and user experience across core visual search surfaces on mobile and desktop. Working at the intersection of consumer UX and AI, you will reimagine how people browse, inspect, and interact with visual results, helping users seamlessly move from broad, open-ended exploration to understanding and real-world utility. You will partner with Engineering, Research, UX, and cross-functional leaders across Search, Shopping, and Advertising to shape product direction, deliver high-visibility initiatives, and produce modern visual experiences at scale.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Define and execute the multi-year product goal, strategy, and roadmap for core Google Image Search experiences across mobile and desktop surfaces.
Reimagine the end-to-end visual search journey, evolving how users browse, inspect, and interact with visual content to support both everyday lookups and open-ended, exploratory journeys.
Leverage Google's latest advancements in Generative Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models, and multimodal understanding to unlock more intuitive, expressive, and helpful visual search experiences.
Partner closely with UX, Research, and Engineering teams to elevate visual craft, interaction design, and ranking quality across the product.
Generate cross-functional and executive alignment across Search, Shopping, and Advertising leadership to deliver cohesive user journeys.

Job Title

Vice President of Product Design 

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

The position is accountable for establishing a strong design vision, improving customer experience, accelerating product innovation, and building a world-class product design organization.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 15+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

jobs.title: Deputy Program Director – Power Systems Product Value Stream
jobs.description:
Job Description

It’s about the journey. Whether it’s a bus ride or flight, our commercial electronic systems help transport millions of passengers every day. Every second a plane takes off somewhere in the world, enabled by our flight-critical products. On the ground, our electric and hybrid solutions save more than 22 million gallons of fuel per year. Be part of our journey at Electronic Systems where you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too. Our flexible work environment provides you with a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Innovate for Those Who Move The WorldTM.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems.

Position Summary

BAE Systems is seeking a Program Manager – Power Systems Product Management to support the leadership and management of advanced electrification products for heavy-duty ground vehicles and aircraft applications.

This Position Serves As Deputy To The Product Management Director For Power Systems And Provides Leadership Across Two Key Product Value Streams

High-Voltage Energy Storage Systems – battery systems and associated technologies
Power Electronics & Controls – Including but not limited to High Voltage / High-Power propulsion and auxiliary inverters, DC-DC converters, on-vehicle power generation / grid quality export power systems, and system controllers.

The role is responsible for product development, product strategy and roadmapping, lifecycle management, product commonality and reuse,and production oversight. The Program Manager works across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Business Development, and Program Management to ensure successful execution and long-term competitiveness of the Power Systems portfolio.

Product & Value Stream Leadership

Support the Product Management Director in developing and executing the Power Systems product strategy.
Provide leadership across the High-Voltage Energy Storage and Power Electronics & Controls value streams.
Manage products throughout the lifecycle from technology development and qualification through production and continuous improvement.
Align product investments and priorities with customer requirements, market opportunities, and business objectives.

Product Development & Planning

Oversee product development to achieve technical, cost, schedule, quality, and business objectives.
Develop and maintain multi-generation product and technology roadmaps.
Establish product requirements and performance targets in collaboration with Engineering and Business Development.
Identify development risks, technology gaps, and investment requirements and drive appropriate mitigation strategies.
Ensure effective transition of new products from development into production.

Product Commonality & Reuse

Drive common architectures, components,software, controls, interfaces, and technologies across products and applications.
Maximize reuse between ground vehicle andaerospace electrification platforms where technically and commercially appropriate.
Reduce unnecessary product proliferation through modular product and platform strategies.
Leverage commonality to reduce development cost and time while improving reliability, manufacturability, and supply-chain efficiency.

Production & Operational Oversight

Provide product-level oversight of production performance across both value streams.
Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality to achieve delivery, cost, quality, and reliability objectives.
Support resolution of significant production and supply-chain issues.
Drive Design for Manufacturing, Design for Cost,and Design for Supply Chain throughout product development.
Incorporate production and field experience into future product generations.

Business & Customer Support

Support product business cases, investment planning, cost targets, and long-range business plans.
Partner with Business Development to understand emerging customer and market requirements.
Support proposals, customer technical discussions, and strategic capture activities.
Ensure customer-specific solutions align with broader product strategies and maximize opportunities for reuse.

Product Portfolio

High-Voltage Energy Storage

High-voltage battery packs and modules
Battery management systems
High-voltage distribution and protection
Thermal management and safety systems
Next-generation battery technologies

Power Electronics & Controls

High-voltage/high-power traction drive inverters
DC-DC converters
Export and on-board power generation electronics
Power distribution systems
Vehicle and system controllers
Embedded controls and software

Leadership Expectations

The Program Manager will act as a key extension of the Product Management Director, balancing near-term product development and production execution with long-term product strategy.

Success will be measured by product development execution, production performance, product competitiveness, and increased commonality and reuse across the Power Systems portfolio, enabling scalable electrification solutions for both ground and aerospace applications.

Across the organization, there are ample opportunities to grow in your career and be a part of our community and build a sense of camaraderie with our teams.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
Demonstrated experience in program management, product management, engineering leadership, or product-line management.
Experience leading complex multi disciplinary product development.
Knowledge of high-voltage electrification, energy storage, power electronics, electric propulsion, or related technologies.
Experience managing products from development through production.
Strong understanding of technical, cost, schedule, and business performance management.
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence across a matrixed organization.
Strong communication, presentation, and decision-making skills.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program-management experience.

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

Advanced engineering or business degree.
Experience with high-voltage batteries, traction inverters, DC-DC converters, or system controls.
Experience with ground vehicle and/or aerospace electrification.
Experience developing modular product architectures and reuse strategies.
Experience transitioning advanced technologies into production.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $153377 - $260743

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Fitch Solutions is currently seeking a Director, Product Manager based out of our New York office.  Product Manager, Ratings Platform & APIs 

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the planning, development, and ownership of our flagship Ratings Data & Research platform and APIs. This role is accountable for translating customer and stakeholder needs into a prioritized roadmap, clear requirements, and an execution plan that delivers measurable outcomes. You will partner closely with Business Strategy, Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Fitch Ratings teams to define problems, validate solutions, and ship high-quality enhancements to the platform and APIs. You will iterate based on usage data, client feedback, and operational performance (e.g., quality, timeliness, reliability).

The ideal candidate brings hands-on product management experience, strong communication skills, and a solid understanding of credit professional workflows. Success in this role requires end-to-end ownership: leading discovery, writing and socializing clear product requirements (e.g., PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria), prioritizing trade-offs, aligning stakeholders, and driving delivery with cross-functional teams. You will define and monitor product KPIs (adoption, retention, revenue impact, data quality and timeliness, client satisfaction) and use them to guide iteration, release planning, and continuous improvement.

As the product manager, you will be responsible for increasing value to the business through new product launches along with enhancements and support of existing products through the company’s flagship platform, Fitch Ratings PRO. Fitch Ratings PRO is an innovative, robust and comprehensive platform serving the workflow needs of credit and macro professionals globally. Collaboratively working with other product managers across the team, you will be executing on the overall vision set out by the Head of Product.

How You’ll Make An Impact 

Own the product direction for the Fitch Ratings PRO platform and ratings APIs. Define OKRs/KPIs, prioritize a roadmap that balances client value, revenue impact, data quality, and technical feasibility, and maintain a transparent release plan. Drive prioritization decisions with clear rationale and documented trade-offs, balancing new capabilities against reducing technical debt.

Customer & Domain Discovery

Bring knowledge of credit data and research and how their workflows translate into product requirements. Conduct ongoing customer discovery (interviews, workflow walk-throughs, feedback sessions) and partner with Sales and Customer Success to validate needs and confirm value before and after release. Be a passionate product champion externally with clients and internally as the voice of the customer.

API Product Development

Lead the full lifecycle of data products from conception through launch and continuous improvement. Gather and group requirements into initiatives and epics, sequence and prioritize them, and prepare them for engineering breakdown. Maintain focus on data quality, usability, governance, and scalability throughout.

Business-to-Technical Translation & Delivery

Serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating needs into PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead agile delivery including backlog management, sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives. Manage capacity, dependencies, and delivery risk in partnership with Engineering and Data leadership.

Go-to-Market & Performance

Support product launches, sales enablement, and positioning. Track adoption, retention, revenue impact, data quality, and client satisfaction metrics to guide iteration and continuous improvement. Communicate product performance and roadmap health to stakeholders through Quarterly Business Reviews and other working sessions, and support clients directly through documentation, training, and enablement.

You May Be a Good Fit if You Have…

7+ years in product management, ideally in financial services, financial information services, or FinTech
Genuine expertise in credit markets - market structure, workflows, client segments, and commercial dynamics
A track record of driving initiatives from discovery through delivery across globally located cross-functional teams
Experience in Agile environments, using Jira, with iterative delivery
Comfort working with technical teams and a solid understanding of software development
Awareness of where AI/ML creates genuine value in a data product context
Excellent written and verbal communication; proven ability to align and influence in a matrix environment 

What Would Make You Stand Out 

Experience building or managing commercial products in credit
Hands-on AI/ML application: intelligent search, LLM chatbots, recommendation engines
Experience spanning both platform/website capabilities and APIs
Ability to rapidly prototype with tools such as Figma Make

Why Choose Fitch

Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. PrimaLoft partners with more than 1,000 brands across outdoor, sports, fashion, footwear, hunting, fishing, and other categories. Guided by our commitment to consumers and being Relentlessly Responsible™, we innovate for high performance while reducing our impact on the planet. Headquartered in Latham, NY, with an office in Xiamen, China, PrimaLoft has global reach across North America, Europe, and Asia.

SECTION 1 – Position Summary

The Director of Product Management is a strategic leadership role within the Product Creation Department responsible for defining, managing, and optimizing the company's product portfolio, product lifecycle, and line architecture to support profitable growth, market leadership, and consumer-driven innovation.

Serving as the commercial and strategic voice of Product Creation, this role connects market opportunity, consumer insights, competitive intelligence, innovation, and business objectives into a cohesive product strategy. The Director will lead line planning, portfolio management, market viability assessments, lifecycle management, and end-of-life decisions while ensuring alignment between Innovation, Product Development, Product Performance, Commercial, Marketing, Operations, and Executive Leadership.

This position will help establish and govern the processes, tools, documentation, and product workbooks that enable disciplined product decision-making across the organization. The individual will be responsible for ensuring every product has a clear strategic purpose, differentiated positioning, measurable market opportunity, and a defined path from concept through commercialization and eventual retirement.

The Director of Product Management will play a critical role in the organization’s approach toward a market-leading, consumer-centric, innovation-driven Product Creation model focused on delivering sustainable, high-quality thermoregulating solutions.

SECTION 2 – Duties and Responsibilities

Product Portfolio Strategy & Management:

Own and manage the overall product portfolio strategy across all product categories, technologies, and market segments.

Ensure the portfolio aligns with corporate growth objectives, innovation priorities, consumer needs, and commercial opportunities.

Evaluate product performance, market probability, position to win, relevance, profitability, and strategic fit throughout the product lifecycle.

Establish portfolio rationalization processes to optimize complexity, eliminate redundancy, and improve resource allocation…from conception, through growth/maturity, and into retirement.

Define and manage product hierarchies, architecture, and platform strategies.

Lead annual and multi-year portfolio planning activities, including product naming & legal trademarking.

Leadership & Organizational Development:

Serve as the primary advocate for Product Creation priorities and perspectives across the organization and with brand partners.

Represent Product Management in strategic planning, commercial reviews, business discussions, and executive forums.

Help define, develop, and implement frameworks that improve decision quality, cross-functional alignment, and speed to market.

Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing Product Management team by establishing clear goals, development plans, and performance expectations.

Foster a culture of accountability, consumer focus, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Key Deliverables:

Product platform, architecture, and line plan roadmaps with seasonal portfolio recommendations.

Product lifecycle management and feature-benefit-positioning frameworks.

End-of-life decision process and portfolio rationalization strategy.

Portfolio health dashboards/reporting tools, competitive SWOT analyses, and market reviews.

Product Creation workbooks and governance systems.

Sales Support collateral, data visualizations, and product presentations.

SECTION 3 – Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Apparel/Textile Design, Materials Science, Product Development, or related field; MBA is a plus.

10+ years of experience in product/portfolio management, product creation, business strategy, or product marketing; experience in materials science, apparel/textile, or an ingredient-brand business strongly preferred.

Demonstrated experience building and owning a product roadmap or portfolio strategy, including prioritization frameworks, lifecycle management, and business cases.

Comfortable with PLM or similar product data/workbook systems.

Strong understanding of thermoregulation, thermal comfort, insulation technologies, moisture management, and performance materials.

Cross-functional leadership skills; track record influencing executive decision-making.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical and materials-science detail for non-technical, executive, and brand-partner audiences.

Experience presenting to senior leadership and brand-partner-facing experience; with excellent analytical, financial, organizational, presentation, and communication abilities.

SECTION 4 – Work Environment and Physical Requirements

Job position will be Full-Time/Exempt, Remote location, with regular travel to Latham, NY as needed. (As per updated Employee Handbook policy.)

Will require travel to vendors, manufacturing facilities, and to customers for sales support, product development and integration. Travel will be both domestic and international, up to 33% of time.

High paced work environment with ability to perform multiple tasks with effectiveness and efficiency.

jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision and roadmap for Render's datastores portfolio, with our Postgres offering at the center. You will define what a modern managed database experience looks like, including how database products will adapt to new state patterns from agents and how agents as users of state-keeping products should be accommodated.

You'll drive the technical and strategic direction for Render Postgres and our broader data layer, working directly with your team and infrastructure engineering to shape architectural decisions. You'll engage with Render's customers and our product development teams to develop a deep understanding of their data needs and build conviction about where the datastores portfolio needs to go next.

What You'll Do

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Render's datastores, anchored on Postgres. Your scope spans provisioning and lifecycle management, high availability and disaster recovery, backups and point-in-time recovery, scaling and performance, connection management, and the extension ecosystem.
Drive prioritization across Render's data investments, balancing the leverage of foundational reliability work — replication, failover, storage performance — against near-term product and business needs, and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs.
Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's data layer, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for durability, performance, and operational simplicity. Databases are where customer trust is won or lost, so an instinct for reliability and data safety is essential.
Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how managed Postgres needs to evolve to serve AI-native builders — from vector workloads and retrieval pipelines to databases that are spun up, branched, and torn down programmatically by agents at scale.
Set the standard for how developers experience data on Render, providing clear guidance, sensible defaults, and abstractions that make it easy for teams to run production databases with confidence — without needing a DBA on staff.

We're looking for

7+ years in Product Management, with the majority spent on databases, data infrastructure, developer tools, or platform products.
Familiarity with Postgres — its architecture, operational model, ecosystem, and the tradeoffs teams face running it in production. Bonus if you have strong perspective on how agentic workloads and AI-native applications are reshaping database usage patterns.
Deep developer empathy, for both internal engineering teams and our customers, and the technical depth to make sound architectural tradeoffs in collaboration with engineering.
A track record of taking ambiguous, high-stakes reliability and infrastructure problems and turning them into clear strategy and shipped outcomes.
Strong communication and storytelling skills.

What Would Be Nice To Have But Not Required

Experience as a database engineer, DBA, or infrastructure engineer.
Hands-on experience with Postgres internals, replication tooling, or the extension ecosystem (e.g., pgvector, PostGIS).
Experience building AI agents or the data infrastructure that powers them.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

4 weeks of paid vacation.
14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.
Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.
100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.
Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.
Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.
Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.
Continuous learning benefits & related support.

Description & Requirements

Join Our Team and Make a Difference!

Are you looking for an impactful role where you finish the workday knowing you helped someone? ,we can positively impact the lives of the injured workers we serve and get them back to the things that matter most in life.

Salary Range

This compensation range considers a wide range of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate is not adjusted for geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. At One Call, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What We Provide in Return for Your Commitment to Our Mission

We offer a vast array of benefits to help support the whole you, including:

Remote Work: We are a remote-first company, and almost all positions receive the flexibility of working from home.
Generous Time Off: Besides 8 company holidays and 2 personal days every year, all colleagues receive a minimum of 18 days of paid time off.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Including medical, dental, vision, and pet insurance; 401(k) matching program; and company-paid life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage.
Supportive Services: Just like our colleagues get injured workers the care they need when they need it, we want to do the same for our colleagues in their time of need. We offer a Colleague Assistance Program that provides free counseling and financial services, and our One Call Foundation, a non-profit arm of our company, provides colleagues financial assistance during times of unexpected hardships.

Job Summary

The Principal Product Manager is a senior product leadership role accountable for driving multi-vertical platform strategy at One Call and translating it into measurable enterprise value. This role owns a portfolio that spans multiple lines of business (e.g., Physical Therapy, Diagnostics, Home Health) and unifies them under a cohesive vision for critical customer and operational journeys. The Principal Product Manager leads through influence and direct / indirect leadership of Senior/Staff/Associate PMs, partnering with Engineering, Design, Operations, Data/Analytics, and Commercial functions to deliver scalable automation, integration, and market expansion. Success is defined by accelerated revenue growth, substantial efficiency gains via elimination of manual entry across front- and back-office workflows, and diversification into adjacent verticals—prioritizing viability and time-to-impact.

Principal Product Managers are expected to lead product initiatives from ideation, story creation, delivery, launch and iteration, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, and time to impact. They work closely with engineering, design, operations, and other stakeholders, to understand the business processes, underlying technologies and business objectives in order to build products that are intuitive, scalable, and aligned with company goals. This role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, user empathy, technical fluency, and excellence.
