jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Adobe Builders eXperience (ABX)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

In the last 6 months, agentic development has taken off – changing how software is built. We have a clear vision on how to embrace it, and an engineering org already in motion. We need a product leader to take the spark and own the connection with the builders we serve. They will turn it into strategy and keep evolving that strategy as frameworks, tools, and processes change.

Join us in the ABX org, where agentic development is the platform – a managed harness that 15,000 builders at Adobe will use to ship software with AI. Every improvement you will make compounds across engineering, product, and design, on most codebases at Adobe!

This is a build role. You'll develop the strategy, build the organizational framework from the ground up, and set the bar for what agentic development looks like at Adobe.

What You'll Own

The Builders Experience strategy.
Take an articulated-but-evolving vision and transform it into written strategy, roadmap, and objective measures of success. Expect it to change continuously as the models, harnesses, and internal processes evolve.

The platform spanning all three modes of agentic development.
ABX will serve builders wherever they are on the curve, and make each mode repeatable:

Agentic Delegation - individual acceleration; the SDLC stays the same, each function just gets faster.
Agentic Transformation - cross-functional AI pods that compress the SDLC and dissolve role boundaries.
Agentic Orchestration - ticket-to-PR factories, multi-agent loops, self-healing CI, with customer and SRE signal closing the outer loop.

The objectives and key results (OKRs).
Platform adoption → per-engineer output → per-employee productivity → business impact. We start with adoption and build up to the rest.

The relationship with the builders.
Deepen trust with the Adobe Builders community, as past decisions on models and tooling created friction. You'll build the engagement mechanisms for a real partnership, and act as chief marketer and evangelist for the platform across the org!

Build vs. buy.
Own the decision process for which external models and tools we deploy. Know the latest across the labs, hyperscalers, and open-weights - and make high-conviction calls amid an embarrassment of riches.

Execution.
Relentless focus on shipping. Remove bottlenecks, streamline how the team communicates, and automate our own SDLC intelligently - designing the moments where humans stay in the loop so judgment and taste get applied at the junctures that matter.

The operating model.
Design how this team runs, in partnership with engineering. It must be agentic itself - we build the system with our system and eat our own dog food. Expect AI pods with real ownership, some led by non-PMs and product-design-engineer (PDE) profiles, not the classic backlog-and-execute approach.

A small PM team.
Direct one PM today (who owns external-tool deployment decisions) and grow the org as the mandate expands - setting the hiring bar and the culture as you go.

What You'll Bring

Senior PM leadership with a track record of building strategy and teams from scratch
Technical credibility with builders. The best instinct here is an engineer's instinct for what engineers want - we're building tools for people who like to build their own tools. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read it and reason about it.
Deep technical fluency in agentic systems: model evaluation and selection, orchestration frameworks, evaluations, inference cost, MCP and the surrounding dev-tooling stack. Comfortable debating latency-vs-accuracy tradeoffs with principal engineers.
Strategic clarity under ambiguity. The landscape shifts weekly; you will synthesize signal from noise, make high-conviction bets on incomplete information, and adjust course as needed.
Comfort operating lean and unconventionally - small team, novel AI pods structure, strong bias to action, allergic to process theater and fluff.
A driver of reinvention - energized by collapsing role boundaries and remaking the SDLC to be AI-first.

What Sets You Apart

You've led product for a developer or AI platform inside a large engineering org (hundreds to thousands of engineers), and driven adoption of AI-augmented development tooling at scale.
You're boundary-less - you'll collaborate across Adobe and go where the outcome takes you.
You can converse across the whole agentic stack: agentic coding, CI/CD, build systems, observability, evaluations, orchestration.
A technical degree (CS, Math, Engineering, or related) or equivalent experience. We value what you've built over where you studied.

Be ready for

A vision that will change, repeatedly. We optimize for agility over certainty.
A team that's small by design, with a non-standard operating model you'll co-invent.
Being both architect and customer of what we build. That reinforcement loop - the system building itself, and getting smarter every time Adobe builds on it - is our MO.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.
Build and lead the team. Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.
Drive design execution across the Enterprise product. Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.
Raise the craft bar. Uphold design principles and quality standards on your team. Push designers beyond digitizing workflows toward genuinely rethinking how people work with AI. Hold the line on quality without slowing delivery.
Contribute to the design system. Help shape and adopt Scale's shared design system, championing consistent component use and contributing patterns back so a distributed team can build coherently at speed.
Ground the team in user needs. Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.
Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction. Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

3+ years managing product design teams

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Remote, US

About Nametag

Nametag is building the future of secure digital identity. Our mission is to protect every human identity to restore trust in the AI era. We bring workforce-grade identity verification into the enterprise to verify the human behind accounts and critical actions. Today, global enterprises use Nametag across their workforce to prevent social engineering and deepfake impersonation attacks.

The Role

Nametag is hiring a Director of Product Marketing to own positioning, launch, and sales enablement for Nametag's core identity verification platform and its solutions; the account-recovery and helpdesk workflows most of today's revenue and pipeline run through. This is a senior, individual-contributor role for someone who has carried product marketing end to end at a B2B security company before: positioning that holds up under a CISO's scrutiny, launches that ship with sales enablement attached instead of following weeks later, and competitive claims a competitor's own product marketer would call fair. You'll be the person other teams turn to for the accurate, current answer on how Nametag describes itself across sales conversations, the website, analyst briefings, and every deck in between.

Role Overview

As Director of Product Marketing, you will own positioning and messaging for Nametag's core identity verification platform, and be the point of accountability for keeping that message consistent as the company grows quickly. You will lead messaging and materials creation for new product launches, build and maintain the sales enablement and competitive materials our go-to-market teams rely on daily, keep strict documentation of all product features and new releases, and partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Growth Marketing, Channel Partnerships, and Product Management. You’ll also have particularly close ties to the ITSM and IAM integration ecosystem (Okta, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Zendesk).

What you’ll do

Positioning & Messaging

Own Nametag's core-IDV narratives, and serve as the arbiter of how they're positioned across every customer-facing surface.
Maintain and enforce the company's messaging and style guide: sourcing rules, canonical terminology, approved claims, so the same product doesn't end up with different language in the market at once.
Translate product capabilities into messaging that holds up for a CISO, a security/IAM leader, an IT leader, and a helpdesk leader; the buyers and influencers Nametag sells into.

Product Launches & Go-to-Market

Own the go-to-market plan for new core-platform and solution modules and features from kickoff to launch: messaging, positioning, sales enablement, and cross-functional coordination with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.
Build repeatable launch frameworks: messaging pillars, soundbites, ICP and stakeholder mapping, objection handling, so each launch doesn't start from a blank page.
Define and track launch success metrics in partnership with Product Management and Marketing Ops.

Competitive Intelligence & Differentiation

Own competitive battlecards and differentiation materials against MFA/authentication vendors and consumer-grade KYC vendors expanding into workforce use cases, and keep them current as the market moves.
Research and articulate how Nametag's core verification differs from adjacent categories in terms a technical buyer will find credible, not dismissive.
Keep every competitive claim sourced and fair: testable against how the competitor would describe themselves.

Sales Enablement

Build and maintain the materials Sales, Customer Success, and Channel Partnerships use daily for deals: one-pagers, talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, and the master decks used with prospects.
Train Sales and Solutions Engineering on new positioning, features, and competitive intelligence.
Partner with Channel Partnerships on enablement for technology and reseller partners (e.g., ServiceNow, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID), so partner-sourced deals have the same quality of material as direct ones.

Analyst & Industry Relations

Brief industry analysts (e.g., Gartner, KuppingerCole) and manage Nametag's participation in relevant IAM/identity-verification research and reports, including our current Gartner Magic Quadrant Visionary recognition.
Represent Nametag's product story at industry events, webinars, and customer-facing presentations.

Pricing, Packaging & Proof

Own how Nametag communicates pricing and packaging for the core platform and solutions.
Maintain the ROI/TCO methodology used in sales conversations (e.g., helpdesk ticket reduction, cost-per-reset), with sourcing rigorous enough to survive a technical buyer's second look.
Develop customer stories and case studies with named accounts, in partnership with Customer Success, that hold up as proof rather than testimonials.

Customer & Market Research

Maintain and refine Nametag's IT/security ICP and buyer-persona models as the customer base grows into new verticals.
Stay current on the threat landscape and regulatory environment Nametag's customers operate in, and translate that into content and talking points Sales and Marketing can use.

What You Bring

We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every listed qualification. You'll thrive in this role if you bring most of the following:

8+ years
in product marketing, including several years at a B2B cybersecurity, identity, or enterprise security software company.
A track record of owning positioning and messaging for a technical security product, and making it hold up under scrutiny from CISOs and security/IAM leaders.
Experience leading product launches end to end: messaging, sales enablement, and cross-functional coordination, not just the content around the edges of one.
Deep fluency with enterprise security buyers and B2B security sales cycles; comfortable being precise about technical distinctions (e.g., authentication vs. verification) that matter to a technical audience.
Familiarity with the ITSM/IAM integration ecosystem (Okta, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Zendesk) is a strong plus.
Strong competitive intelligence instincts: comfortable building battlecards and differentiation frameworks that are accurate and fair, not just favorable.
Experience partnering with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, KuppingerCole, or similar) is a strong plus.
Excellent, disciplined writing. Comfortable being the person who enforces consistent terminology and voice across a fast-moving team, not just the person who writes copy.
Experience with sales enablement tooling (e.g., HubSpot) and building or maintaining ROI/TCO models is a plus.
A strong sense of ownership: comfortable being the final word on message consistency at a small, fast-growing company where that job doesn't yet have a lot of scaffolding around it.
Enthusiasm for integrating AI tools like Claude into your everyday workflow; a keen sense of the difference between “AI slop” and AI-generated assets.

Intellectual horsepower.
Quickly grasping complex technical and business concepts.
Kindness and integrity.
Earning trust is central to how we build relationships with customers and colleagues.
Bias for action.
We move quickly to deliver impact and protect our customers against fast-moving threats.
Ownership mindset.
You care about uptime and stability the way a founder cares about the product.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

Remote-first:
Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.

We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.

Cut advertiser onboarding friction and prepare for the next phase of Shopping @ Reddit.

Define the 1–3 year strategy that turns Catalogs into a platform - the spine connecting Reddit's paid and organic Shopping surfaces
Unlock new advertiser demand through catalog capabilities.
Land Limitless Catalogs (20M+ product catalogs for large retailers and marketplaces), regional metadata for global clients, and the Shopify integration that expands SMB Shopping on Reddit.
Build the Universal Catalog and Applied PKG.
Collaborate with content understanding teams to connect ad catalogs to the Product Knowledge Graph and organic product mentions on Reddit.
Be the Shopping platform voice across Reddit.
Represent Catalogs and Applied PKG in Shopping leadership reviews and exec readouts.

What You Bring:

Experience:
5+ years of Product Management experience. At least 3 years in AdTech, retail media, marketplaces, or shopping/e-commerce platforms.
Commerce / Product Understanding
: Experience with product knowledge graphs, product entity resolution, or product taxonomies at scale. An understanding of how digital shopping works across either organic or paid products.
AI fluency.

0-1 instincts paired with execution rigor.

Cross-functional leadership.

The Role

We are seeking a Customer Strategy & Planning Director to join the Operations organization for Agentforce Operations (Regrello) and lead strategic planning and operating strategy for our customer organization.

Additionally, this leader will drive the strategy and implementation of AI-driven capabilities to transform customer success workflows, predict customer health, and maximize value realization at scale.

Experience designing and scaling business processes, operating models, or new organizational capabilities.
Strong strategic and systems thinking with demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous, complex business problems.

Strong business and commercial acumen with excellent executive communication skills.

Description

Shape the future of AI-powered insights for Amazon's publisher monetization platform. As a Principal Product Manager, you'll define the product vision and strategy for APM's AI-driven insights suite, enabling 600+ internal users to transform complex business questions into actionable insights in minutes—regardless of their technical background.

You'll lead the design of intuitive, trustworthy AI experiences that replace manual analytics with self-service, autonomous intelligence, driving real business impact across 22+ Amazon publishers. In this product leadership role, you'll own what we build, why we build it, and how customers experience it—serving as the voice of the customer for our suite of agentic products and translating complex business problems into delightful AI experiences.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision and roadmap for APM's AI-powered insights products, defining strategic direction across near-term feature delivery, mid-term platform capabilities, and long-term autonomous intelligence investments

Lead customer discovery across 600+ internal users by conducting interviews, analyzing usage patterns, and translating unmet needs into compelling product opportunities

Design end-to-end user experiences that prioritize trust and transparency in AI-generated outputs, including information architecture, interaction patterns, and feedback mechanisms

Partner with applied science and engineering teams to translate AI capabilities—including language models, knowledge graphs, and anomaly detection—into intuitive experiences that build user confidence, while defining product requirements and acceptance criteria that balance scope, quality, and speed

Drive product launches and strategic trade-offs by developing go-to-market strategy, enablement programs, and adoption campaigns, while balancing self-service breadth and guided depth to deliver the right experience for diverse user needs

A day in the life

Your day blends strategic vision with hands-on execution. You’ll review customer feedback from recent user research sessions, identifying patterns in how teams interact with autonomous monitoring narratives and self-service analytics tools. You’ll collaborate with engineering and data science teams to refine how AI capabilities translate into user-facing features that build trust and transparency. You’ll synthesize customer needs into detailed product requirements, sketch out user journeys, and make trade-off decisions about automation versus human oversight. You’ll lead product launch strategy sessions, define success metrics, and prepare presentations for senior leadership on roadmap priorities. Throughout the day, you’ll connect insights across applied science, engineering, product, and design to ensure multiple workstreams align into one coherent customer experience.

About The Team

We're the Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM) Agentic Insights team, building scalable intelligence solutions that serve business, product, technical, and science teams across 22+ Amazon publishers—including Prime Video, Twitch, Fire TV, Stores, Books, Audio, and Live Events. Our mission is to be the trusted insights partner for every team in our organization, replacing manual, intake-driven analytics with self-service, AI-powered experiences.

You'll work alongside a collaborative group of software engineers, business intelligence engineers, data engineers, technical program managers, and applied scientists who are passionate about solving complex problems. Together, we're transforming how teams access and act on insights. Our customers span business, product, and technical teams—each with unique needs and varying levels of technical expertise—and your work will directly impact how they discover insights and make decisions.

Experience converting insights into strategy and communicating complex ideas clearly and logically in written communication
Experience with explainable machine learning and artificial intelligence methodologies and tools

Present and defend recommendations in leadership reviews. Resolve open questions and revise proposals when the evidence changes.
Lead product decisions through development and launch, including scope tradeoffs, positioning, pricing, and readiness for customer use.
Track adoption, workload competitiveness, and business performance. Use the results to change priorities and guide subsequent investments.

Required Experience And Expertise

Direct experience developing, evaluating, deploying, or bringing to market CPUs, GPUs, or AI accelerators, with technical depth in at least one category.
Enough understanding of processor and system architecture to evaluate engineering proposals, challenge benchmark claims, and defend technical recommendations with experienced engineers.
Prior product management responsibility for a processor, compute platform, or related infrastructure product. Your experience includes defining requirements, setting priorities, making business tradeoffs, and following a product through launch and adoption.
Evidence of consequential product decisions you made: the alternatives considered, the supporting technical and customer evidence, and the results.
Experience authoring decision papers or comparable proposals and defending recommendations with technical and business leaders.
Ability to connect workload performance and system costs to pricing, customer value, and an investment case.

Preferred Experience

Experience with cloud compute products or data center platforms.
Experience working with processor vendors, system suppliers, or infrastructure customers on product requirements and roadmaps.

Education

A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science is preferred. Equivalent technical expertise demonstrated through relevant industry experience will also be considered.

Years of experience are a guide. The scope of your ownership, quality of your judgment, and demonstrated results determine fit.

–Partners with engineering and senior teams to identify solutions linked to OKRs and KPIs.

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Are you passionate about leveraging AI to revolutionize life sciences? AWS Life Sciences Applied AI is seeking a visionary Senior Product Manager to lead the development of applications that reimagine how clinical trials are designed, executed, and delivered.

Key job responsibilities

As Senior Product Manager, Technical, you'll lead pioneering product development for AI-driven clinical trials transformation. You'll guide a team of builders (product managers, developers, and scientists) to invent and simplify on behalf of pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and clinical operations teams—defining novel, generative AI agent-based experiences that help them accelerate the path from discovery to treatment. You will drive innovation by reimagining how clinical evidence is generated and how trial operations are managed, replacing fragmented manual processes with intelligent, continuously learning systems. This is a highly visible and impactful role within AWS, offering the opportunity to shape the future of clinical development and drive innovation at a global scale. You will be responsible for defining key product directions, adopting or inventing new machine learning techniques, reimagining user workflows and experiences, and fundamentally changing how life-saving therapies reach patients.

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

jobs.description:
Description

Want to build and define how Amazon utilizes AI to run Amazon's biggest shopping events? We're hiring a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own EMERGE — the AI-native platform that orchestrates Prime Day, Black Friday, and 30+ high-velocity events across 22 marketplaces — with complete authority over the product's roadmap and future.

This is one of the most hands-on AI product roles at Amazon. EMERGE is transforming from an orchestration platform into a multi-agent AI system where specialized agents create events, generate content, manage levers, and coordinate 40+ partner teams — work that once took weeks now happens in minutes. You will define what AI-native event execution looks like for the entire company, and you'll do it with rare autonomy: you own the UX, the technical architecture direction, and the business strategy end-to-end.

Design and ship multi-agent AI systems on the bleeding edge of AI integration at Amazon — agentic workflows, multi-agent coordination, and intelligent automation in production at global scale
Total product ownership: you are the single decision-maker for roadmap, user experience, technical direction, and business outcomes — no committees.
Your work appears on Amazon's highest-traffic pages during the company's highest-revenue events
Influence how 10+ organizations across Tech, Stores, Marketing, and Merchandising adopt AI automation

Key job responsibilities

Own EMERGE (Event Orchestration) completely — vision, roadmap, UX, technical direction, and business strategy. You are the single-threaded leader with final authority over what the product becomes

Define and execute the platform's AI-native transformation: design the multi-agent architecture (event orchestration, event creation, lever management, content/wireframe generation, and strategy agents) that automates event execution company-wide
Push the frontier of applied AI at Amazon — evaluate emerging agentic patterns, run pilots, and scale what works into production systems serving hundreds of millions of customers
Design the human-AI interaction model: decide where agents act autonomously, where humans steer, and where manual control remains — and build the UX that makes that seamless
Own a portfolio of 25+ partner integrations, building data-driven business cases that influence partner team roadmaps across 8+ organizations
Establish the governance mechanisms — SLA frameworks, automated validation, guardrails — that let AI agents move fast on customer-facing surfaces without compromising safety
Author strategic documents (PR/FAQs, OP1 inputs, 3-year plans) and present your AI strategy to senior leadership up to VP level
Drive operational excellence and event readiness for Prime Day and other tentpole events

A day in the life

You own this product outright — so your day is what you decide it should be. That might mean a morning design session on your next AI agent: how should the event-creation agent handle ambiguity, when should it ask a human, and what does the review UX look like? Midday, you're running an evaluation of a new agentic pattern against your production baseline, deciding whether it's ready for the front page of Amazon. Afternoon, you're pitching a partner org on replacing their manual workflow with your agent-driven integration — armed with pilot data proving the efficiency gain.

Your stakeholders span capacity planning, content, homepage, advertising, and deal-sourcing teams across 8+ organizations. The problems are the interesting kind: How autonomous can an agent be when a mistake shows up on Amazon's homepage during Prime Day? How do you design trust and control into agentic UX? During event season, you're watching your agents execute live at global scale. Between events, you're setting the direction — because the roadmap is yours, from the next quarter's launches to the three-year vision.

We're a builder culture operating at the front edge of Amazon's AI adoption, with direct senior leadership visibility and an appetite for bold bets. jobs.title: Principal Talent Management, Amazon Talent & Compensation
jobs.description:
Description

The Principal, Product Manager in Talent Management is a senior individual contributor who designs, leads, and scales enterprise-wide talent management strategies and programs. This role operates with significant autonomy in highly ambiguous environments, driving talent management initiatives across multiple business units or geographies. The Principal serves as a recognized subject-matter expert and trusted advisor to senior leaders (Director and VP level), shaping the talent agenda and influencing long-term workforce strategy.

Come Build How Amazon Grows Its Best People

Amazon doesn't just hire great talent — we obsess over how to develop, retain, and grow it. Our Talent Management team builds the programs, systems, and strategies that shape the employee experience for over 1.5 million people worldwide. This is where people science meets product thinking at a scale no other company can match.

We're looking for a Principal who thinks like a product leader and operates like a program owner. Someone who can take a complex, cross-functional challenge — spanning product, UX, engineering, and analytics — and turn it into a launched experience with clear strategy, measurable outcomes, and executive-level visibility. You'll own end-to-end product management and design for talent programs, writing docs, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and presenting to PXT leadership monthly. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write one.

Key job responsibilities

Enterprise Talent Strategy: Design and own the end-to-end talent management strategy for the enterprise, including talent evaluation, high-potential identification and retention, performance management, and AI-enhanced talent experiences.
Product Ownership & Delivery: Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for talent management programs. Write strategy docs, engage UX/Design/Analytics/Engineering partners, and drive cross-functional teams to ship at scale — without direct authority over those teams.
Executive Communication: Present product launches and program updates to PXT LT and executives monthly. Translate complex technical and programmatic work into crisp narratives for senior leadership.
Organizational Health & Insights: Leverage data and analytics to diagnose organizational health trends, identify talent risks, and develop proactive interventions. Translate complex talent data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
Talent Evaluation & Calibration: Design talent evaluation and calibration processes, ensuring consistency, fairness, and alignment with role guidelines and leadership principles.
Growth & Development: Architect and implement scalable growth & development programs that accelerate the growth of high-value talent and address capability gaps across the organization.
AI Transformation: Drive experimentation and adoption of AI-powered talent experiences, partnering closely with engineering and technical teams to bring innovation from concept to production.
Mechanisms & Scalability: Create scalable mechanisms, tools, and frameworks that raise the bar on talent management practices and can be adopted broadly across the company.

A day in the life

You'll own the full lifecycle of products and programs that have considerable impact across multiple Amazon organizations. That means defining the mission and vision, writing strategy documents, aligning with senior leaders, building go-to-market and change management plans, and driving execution across UX, Design, Analytics, and Program Management teams that don't report to you.

You'll develop KPI frameworks that give leadership real visibility into performance, and you'll use data to tell the story of what's working and where to push harder.

You'll be the connective tissue between product, design, technical, and business teams — identifying gaps before they become failures, sourcing and coordinating resources across organizations, and proactively mitigating risks that others haven't spotted yet. When a problem is ambiguous, you'll define it. When a path forward isn't clear, you'll build one.

About The Team

The Compensation & Talent team is a newly formed organization within PXT that brings together talent evaluation, performance management, and compensation under one leader. Our mission is to accelerate and advance how Amazon identifies and rewards its people — uniting the full cycle of talent assessment and compensation into a streamlined, end-to-end experience. We own compensation product, tech, and program management, as well as talent management design, program, and policy work.

You'll operate at the intersection of people strategy and technology, working on initiatives that directly influence how Amazon identifies, develops, and retains talent at unprecedented scale. The stakeholders are senior, the problems are genuinely hard, and the work ships to an audience of hundreds of thousands.

jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical with a strong technical background to own our vision for the operator console that Amazon's next-generation fulfillment buildings are run on. This is a deeply technical role. You will work side by side with software development managers, science managers, and engineers, and you will push them to build better, faster, and cheaper with more capability every quarter. We are not looking for someone to ship another monitoring dashboard. We want someone who drives the team past monitoring and alarms toward a building that catches and resolves its own problems before a human ever sees them.

That ambition is concrete: move each capability up an arc from a health overview, to automated root-cause on an issue, to a recommended next best action, to directed and eventually autonomous resolution. You will own how far and how fast our equipment advances along that arc, and you will hold engineering and science to the bar that gets us there. This is also a role for someone who leads through influence. The console is built jointly across several Amazon organizations, so you will be the single product voice for how our equipment works in it, aligning partner teams you do not control and turning several groups' priorities into one coherent product. The strategy is still being written, so you will create clarity where the problem is not yet fully defined.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product strategy, vision, and multi-quarter roadmap for how our equipment shows up in the console, and push it up the arc from monitoring toward autonomous resolution.
Engage engineering and science leaders as a technical peer: challenge complexity estimates, weigh architecture trade-offs on their merits, and define acceptance criteria for software that runs a live building for years.
Be the single product voice for our organization across the partner teams that co-build the console, earning alignment through shared interest rather than escalation and reconciling competing priorities into one experience.
Own the business value case for your product, cost to run versus operational value delivered, and make build, extend, or partner calls with clear justification.
Run customer research in live fulfillment buildings, manage deployment readiness with Operations, sequence inbound demand against committed launches, and own the post-launch health of what you ship against adoption, reliability, cost avoided, and customer satisfaction.

A day in the life

What your morning will look like if we are successful: You start with overnight telemetry across deployed sites and a class of alarm the system should have caught and cleared on its own, which becomes your next roadmap push. Mid-morning you are with your engineering lead pressure-testing whether an automated root-cause capability can hit the latency it needs at the data volume a live building throws at it, and you hold the line on the harder, better answer. After lunch you align partner-team product leaders on how their data and your equipment views coexist in one screen, then run office hours with floor technicians during a surge to see where the product still makes them think too hard. You end the day walking a deployment readiness checklist with Operations for a building commissioning next quarter. Your customers are the operators, engineers, and technicians who use your product every day in fulfillment buildings.

About The Team

We are a passionate group of innovators, engineers, and business leaders dedicated to reducing the variability and complacency in our current logistics systems, and we thrive on collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared vision of bringing innovation and scalability back to our automation equipment.

Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year, and the historical model let each integrator use its own equipment, controls, and methods. That variability has proven hard to support and scale. Our software organization delivers the platforms, controls architecture, and AI and computer-vision capabilities that let Amazon own its industrial automation ecosystem end to end, and this console is where a building becomes legible to the people who run it, moving operations from reacting to problems toward resolving them before they surface.

Description

Denied Party Screening (DPS) prevents denied party(s) from transacting with Amazon businesses. We build highly scalable products to detect and prevent prohibited transactions using algorithms, machine learning, and sanctions/compliance domain expertise.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own product roadmap and innovation for our DPS products. You bring technical depth, domain fluency in sanctions screening, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product roadmap - use Amazon's Working Backwards process to identify customer pain points, define requirements, and prioritize delivery
Drive domain innovation - monitor trends in sanctions/AML screening, denied party list management, fuzzy matching algorithms, and AI/ML-based detection to inform product strategy
Partner cross-functionally - work with engineering, legal, compliance, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable screening products that meet both technical and regulatory requirements
Manage execution - track progress, communicate to stakeholders, mitigate risks, and maintain quality
Build feedback loops - analyze user data and operational metrics to continuously improve detection accuracy and user experience

About The Team

About Amazon Security

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Compute

Job Description

The ideal candidate is a curious, analytical problem solver who can investigate ambiguous questions, connect disparate data points, build well-supported points of view, and communicate what the findings mean for OCI. You will partner closely the strategic intelligence lead and cross-functional stakeholders to develop forecasting models, decision frameworks, executive narratives, and other intelligence deliverables.

This role is based in Nashville, TN. We are seeking candidates who are local to Nashville, TN or willing to relocate to Nashville, TN

Responsibilities

Support strategic intelligence initiatives to identify market shifts, competitive moves, emerging threats, and growth opportunities for OCI.
Analyze the AI and cloud infrastructure landscape, including customer demand, cloud service provider investments, GPU/ASIC adoption, semiconductor supply, capacity, pricing, and technology trends.
Conduct competitive analysis across hyperscalers, AI infrastructure providers, semiconductor companies, and emerging technology players to understand their strategies, investments, product roadmaps, and sources of competitive advantage.
Develop well-supported points of view on market and competitive dynamics; translate complex signals into clear insights and recommendations.
Build and maintain forecasting models and analytical frameworks to assess market growth, supply-and-demand dynamics, capacity requirements, and business outcomes.
Identify market whitespace, customer needs, competitive gaps, and emerging opportunities that can inform OCI's product portfolio and growth strategy.
Create executive-ready briefing, dashboards, and decision frameworks that explain what is happening, why it matters, where consensus may be wrong, and what potential action OCI can take.
Partner with product leaders and strategic intelligence lead to frame strategic questions, assess opportunities, and support product strategy and investment decisions.
Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Strategy teams to validate insights and translate intelligence into business action.

Qualifications

Intellectual curiosity and the ability to develop independent point of view rather than simply summarize existing research.
6+ years of experience in engineering, product management, competitive intelligence, market analysis, investment research, consulting, capacity planning, or related analytical role within cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, datacenters, or semiconductors.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, economics, finance, statistic, mathematics, or a related field.
Ability to develop a strong, evidence-based understanding of markets, customers, competitors, and technology trends, and to translate that understanding into clear, actionable recommendations.
Strong technical knowledge of compute infrastructure or demonstrated ability to quickly understand complex technical products and markets.
Ability to synthesize structured and unstructured information into clear, evidence-based conclusions.
Experience conducting market and competitive research, developing forecasts or business cases, testing hypotheses, and working with incomplete or ambiguous data.
Ability to translate market and competitive insights into practical recommendations for product, go-to-market, and investment decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear executive-facing presentations and narratives.
Collaborative working style and ability to partner effectively with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Strategy teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud infrastructure, AI systems, datacenters, CPUs, GPU/accelerators, semiconductors, datacenter, or networking.
Prior engineering, systems architecture, or technical product management experience.
Experience in competitive intelligence, market research, investment research, corporate strategy, or strategic analysis.
Experience building market models, capacity forecasts, pricing analysis, or financial projections.
MBA or relevant advanced technical degree.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Evaluates business value, feasibility, and internal and/or external user needs of products/features.

–Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, and Oracle's goals and strategy.

–Conducts analysis of market trends and the competitive landscape to contribute to competitive positioning.

–Engages customers, non-customers, and partners to obtain market information and discover opportunities for a feature or multiple features.

Product Analysis – Solution Identification:

–Identifies customers' unmet or unknown needs, market opportunities for products, and/or regulatory requirements.

–Develops problem statements for products with moderate complexity and forms hypotheses for new products.

–Takes independent ownership of the solutioning process by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to identify solutions.

–Evaluates and validates different solutions to make informed decisions on enhancing existing products/features or introducing new products/features.

–Creates and maintains required solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory requirements, functional and non-functional requirements).

Product Ownership – Product Development and Road mapping:

–Manages the product lifecycle from planning to release.

–Owns the roadmap for multiple small-scope products/features, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

–Develops feature requirements, resources, and best practices for internal stakeholders.

–Collaborates with stakeholders to mitigate risks and resolve issues.

–Tracks and analyzes existing metrics (e.g., Service Requests, bugs raised, customer feedback, customer volumes) to generate insights on product optimization.

–Writes user stories and acceptance criteria to maintain high product quality.

–Determines the features or experiences to prioritize in the roadmap, aligning them with success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:

–Acts as an innovation leader for a small-scope product/feature, providing recommendations for overall strategy and direction of products.

–Participates in the development of products to optimize the customer experience and align with business goals.

–Collaborates with team to drive new feature development using agile and continuous-delivery methodology.

Alignment and Collaboration:

–Collaborates with cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment across teams within the organization.

–Identifies pushback from stakeholders and uses data to address it.

–Works with senior team members to identify potential solutions tied to OKRs and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

–Partners with others in driving business impact across organizations, and tracking success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple small-scope products/features.

–Contributes to defining parameters for user testing and provides input on product iterations based on test results.

Customer-Centricity:

–Takes an active role in advocating for the customer throughout the product lifecycle, beginning to anticipate customer needs.

–Engages with customers to gather feedback and understand their experiences with Oracle's products and services.

–Collaborates with customers to understand how to align Oracle product capabilities with customers' specific business goals.

–Captures customer requirements to define new product capabilities and develop feature designs.

–Engages directly with product consumers during implementations to ensure the product meets their needs.

–Coordinates with senior team members to review and prioritize customer issues to ensure satisfaction and quality, escalating the chain as required.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Contributes to recruiting and supporting early adopters to validate product solutions.

–Supports the development of user documentation by drafting components of the document.

–Tracks product metrics about adoption, identifying trends and patterns in user behavior.

–Contributes to presenting product demonstrations to internal and/or external customers, partners, industry analysts, and field.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements.

–Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships.

Problem Solving:

–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate.

jobs.description:

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

À propos du poste

Salesforce recherche un·e Directeur/Directrice de la Stratégie Produit pour rejoindre le Chief Architect Office au sein du Bureau du CEO. Rattaché·e au/à la SVP Stratégie Produit, vous serez à l'intersection de la stratégie d'entreprise et de la technologie — évaluant les technologies, modélisant la monétisation à travers différents scénarios de marché, et traduisant ces choix en recommandations d'investissement concrètes.

Ce n'est pas un rôle traditionnel de gestion de produit ou de veille concurrentielle. Nous construisons une équipe proactive et créative pour tester la robustesse des hypothèses du portefeuille et façonner les investissements technologiques les plus stratégiques de Salesforce, à travers les modèles commerciaux, l'IA agentique et les architectures logicielles.

Vous êtes aussi à l'aise pour construire un modèle de scénario autour de la monétisation de l'infrastructure IA que pour évaluer les compromis architecturaux entre différents modèles de déploiement agentique. Vous comprenez que la meilleure stratégie technologique est celle où les choix techniques et le modèle commercial sont conçus ensemble.

Vos missions

Stratégie de portefeuille et d'investissement : Diriger la planification stratégique du portefeuille IA et plateforme de Salesforce — en définissant les priorités, en séquençant les paris stratégiques, et en évaluant les options de construction, d'achat, de partenariat ou de fusion-acquisition.

jobs.description:
Overview

Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer
, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first APIs, including the Work IQ API, CLI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, while respecting Microsoft Graph permissions, tenant policies, and compliance boundaries.

We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot extensibility engineering team, are looking for a Principal Product Manager for Work IQ whose primary product focus is evaluation
— the load-bearing quality gate of the Work IQ agent developer lifecycle. Evaluation is where an agent earns the right to ship: it spans the committed eval suite and its correspondence to the success criteria declared at scoping, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage against the response playbook, and the advisory-board sign-off that governs what customers actually receive. You will own that gate end to end — including A/B testing with BizChat, the feedback loop from production signals back into the suite, and post-release drift detection — and you will make it fast, evidence-rich, and continuous rather than a milestone event.

This role is deliberately an AI-native transformation
role, and it maps directly to the two M365 core priorities. On Changing the Way We Work
, you are expected to redesign the lifecycle itself rather than staff it: apply an agentic loop approach
to the evaluation stage so that evidence assembly, failure classification, remediation drafting, and drift detection run zero-touch, while accountable judgment — quality-gate sign-off, accepting a known failure into production, tenant admin consent, and any irreversible or externally visible action — stays with a named human by design. On Leading with New AI Products
, you will dogfood Work IQ’s own surfaces to build those loops, so the platform team experiences its activation, evaluation, and metering surfaces as a developer does, and feeds that evidence straight back into the roadmap.

We are looking for a growth mindset and thought leadership
measured in outcomes, not mechanism: human involvements per agent shipped trending toward zero for removable coordination toil, a rising acceptance rate for the loops’ recommendations, shrinking time from eval failure to resolution, a growing share of drift found by the platform before a customer reports it, and an absolute bar of no agent-caused false gate pass
. You will set the point of view, publish it, and bring partner teams along.

This is a platform PM role
at the intersection of Copilot
, agents
, Graph
, and enterprise trust
.

Description

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon’s transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon’s most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will work across engineering, science, compliance, finance, operations, and sustainability teams to automate global EPR programs, improve product and packaging data, enable compliant selling partners, and develop scalable capabilities for recycling, recovery, and circularity.

This role requires a product leader who can operate in significant ambiguity, translate evolving regulatory and business requirements into durable technical solutions, and influence across a broad set of senior stakeholders. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to build at the intersection of technology, regulation, sustainability, and Amazon-scale commerce, with the ability to influence how Amazon manages producer responsibility today and how it develops broader circularity capabilities for the future.

Key job responsibilities

Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.
Improve the Selling Partner compliance experience by building products that make requirements easier to understand and act on, reduce the effort and cost required to achieve compliance, and enable sellers to continue offering products across Amazon stores.

Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for EPR and circular economy, leading 3-Year Vision, annual operating planning, and quarterly prioritization while aligning investments across business, technology, compliance, sustainability, and operations teams.

Drive automation and simplification across Amazon’s EPR operating model, replacing manual processes with scalable technology, improving data and classification accuracy, and strengthening controls across reporting, fees, registrations, and compliance monitoring.
Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience technical product management
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience owning data-centric products
Experience interpreting and communicating analytics

jobs.title: Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts
jobs.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalyst

What You Will Do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role you will embed complex, high-priority products and related product teams to accelerate Amgens adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM), strengthen the product management capability, and help teams shift from output to outcome mindsets. Reporting to the Director, Product Management Catalysts, this individual contributor role will serve as a senior hands-on player-coach, partnering directly with Digital Product Managers, business leads, technology leads, data scientists, compliance and quality partners, adjacent product teams, product group leaders, and senior functional stakeholders.

This role will primarily embed with complex, interdependent individual products, though may operate across multiple related product teams when dependencies, stakeholder complexity, or where product outcomes require it. The Associate Director will coach and upskill DPMs and cross-functional teams while helping them apply DPOM practices to real product work. When no DPM is assigned, this role may temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning senior stakeholders, defining outcomes, resolving trade-offs, and supporting roadmap and prioritization decisions.

The Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts will help teams clarify high-priority business and user problems, shape product strategy, define measurable outcomes, improve roadmaps, establish OKRs and KPIs, support discovery, improve prioritization, manage cross-product dependencies, and connect delivery work to measurable value. This role will also capture learnings from embedded engagements and contribute insights back to the Product Management Hub to improve DPOM playbooks, tools, standards, Catalyst practices, and enterprise adoption approaches.

Responsibilities

Embedded Product Leadership and Coaching

Embed with complex, high-priority products and related product teams to improve product management practices and accelerate DPOM adoption.

Serve as a senior hands-on player-coach to Digital Product Managers and cross-functional team members.

Coach DPMs on advanced product management skills, including complex problem framing, continuous discovery, product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, investment trade-offs, stakeholder alignment, and value measurement.

When no DPM is assigned, temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning stakeholders, defining outcomes, and supporting roadmap, capacity, and prioritization decisions.

Coach teams to combine user insights, product data, business context, and experimentation to make evidence-based product decisions.

Help teams move from stakeholder-request and feature-based delivery toward empowered, outcome-driven product management.

DPOM Adoption and Cross-Functional Team Enablement

Help cross-functional teams understand and apply DPOM practices in complex product environments.

Partner with business leads, technology leads, business analysts, design, data, compliance, quality, and adjacent product teams to strengthen product ways of working.

Help teams clarify roles, decision rights, operating rhythms, success measures, dependencies, and expectations within the Digital Product Operating Model.

Identify product management capability gaps, adoption barriers, and recurring anti-patterns across complex product environments.

Support teams in building durable product habits that continue after the Catalyst engagement ends.

Product Strategy, Outcomes, and Prioritization

Connect enterprise and business unit strategy to product strategy, helping teams break silos and translate strategic objectives into product outcomes and investment decisions.

Help teams frame complex, high-priority user and business problems and connect product work to measurable outcomes.

Support development of product vision, strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, investment recommendations, and value realization plans.

Guide teams in making trade-off recommendations based on user needs, business value, feasibility, risk, capacity, dependencies, and enterprise priorities.

Support discovery, validation, and learning practices that help teams make better product decisions in ambiguous environments.

Help teams improve roadmap quality by shifting from feature and output lists to problem, opportunity, and outcome-oriented roadmaps that reflect product strategy, capacity, dependencies, and measurable value.

Cross-Product Dependencies and Stakeholder Influence

Identify and help resolve cross-product dependencies, sequencing challenges, and prioritization conflicts that affect product outcomes.

Influence business leads, technology leads, product group leaders, senior functional stakeholders, compliance partners, and adjacent product teams without formal authority.

Communicate clearly with team-level and senior stakeholders on product direction, adoption progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions needed.

Help teams align near-term delivery decisions with longer-term product strategy and measurable outcomes.

Escalate major blockers, trade-offs, or alignment issues to the Director, Product Management Catalysts when needed.

Catalyst Model Execution and Continuous Improvement

Execute the Catalyst engagement model, including product/team assessment, engagement planning, embedded coaching, adoption measurement, transition planning, and learning capture.

Contribute to refinement of the Catalyst model based on practical learnings from complex embedded engagements.

Define and track success measures for each engagement, including DPM capability growth, cross-functional team adoption, product maturity, product outcomes when directly accountable, and sustained DPOM adoption outcomes following Catalyst transition.

Surface insights, risks, and recommendations to the Director, Product Management Catalysts and Product Management Hub leadership.

Translate lessons from embedded work into reusable examples, practices, templates, and playbook improvements.

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Associate Director, Digital Product Management we seek is a senior product practitioner and coach with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree and 3 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
Masters degree and 5 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
Bachelors degree and 7 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
Associates degree and 12 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
High school diploma / GED and 14 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, including product strategy, discovery, road mapping, prioritization, delivery, and outcome measurement.
Experience owning or leading complex, interdependent, high-priority products or product initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or upskill product managers, product owners, business partners, and cross-functional team members.
Strong product management craft, including user and customer problem definition, product discovery, roadmap development, OKRs, KPIs, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, investment trade-off recommendations, and value realization.
Experience influencing senior business, technology, product, engineering, data, compliance, and adjacent product stakeholders without formal authority.
Ability to operate as a senior hands-on player-coach, balancing direct product leadership with coaching and capability building.

Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, including the ability to frame complex problems, resolve dependencies, make trade-off recommendations, and create practical paths forward.
Experience contributing to product operating models, playbooks, standards, templates, training, or adoption approaches preferred.
Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply.
Familiarity with AI-native product development, generative AI workflows, responsible AI principles, and the evolving role of AI in product management preferred.

What You Can Expect Of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.
