jobs.title: Vice President, Reporting & Analytics Product Development
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a Vice President, Reporting & Analytics Product Development

Are you energized by the challenge of transforming complex data into intuitive experiences that help millions of people make better decisions?
Do you have the vision and technical depth to bring reporting, analytics, insights, and AI together into a seamless, integrated experience?
Do you lead with empathy for clients, associates, and partners while making bold decisions and navigating complexity?
Are you a technologist at heart who builds high-performing, diverse teams and inspires engineering excellence and innovation?

ADP is seeking a Vice President of Reporting & Analytics Product Development to lead the strategy, engineering, and delivery of ADP’s enterprise Reporting and Analytics platform.

Data is at the center of every organization’s most important workforce decisions. Clients need more than traditional reports and disconnected analytics tools—they need an integrated experience that makes it easy to access trusted data, understand what is happening, uncover why it is happening, and determine what action to take next.

This executive will lead the evolution of ADP’s Reporting and Analytics capabilities into a unified, intelligent data experience embedded across ADP’s global Human Capital Management solutions. The platform will bring together operational reporting, dashboards, visualization, advanced analytics, benchmarking, natural-language exploration, and AI-powered insights—enabling clients to move seamlessly from a business question to a trusted answer and, ultimately, to informed action.

The VP will be responsible for the technology vision, architecture, development, delivery, and operation of this strategic platform. The role requires a leader who can modernize a large-scale global platform while continuing to deliver reliable capabilities to clients who depend on ADP every day.

The VP will lead a global, diverse, multidisciplinary organization spanning software engineering, data engineering, architecture, user experience, quality engineering, and production operations. This leader will work closely with Product Management, Data Science, AI, Security, Infrastructure, and ADP Business Unit leaders to create a common platform that meets the unique needs of ADP’s HCM products while delivering a consistent and integrated client experience.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership: Help shape ADP’s enterprise data, reporting, analytics, and AI strategy, ensuring technology investments align with client needs, business priorities, and ADP’s long-term growth objectives.
Unified Reporting and Analytics Vision: Lead the creation of an integrated experience that brings together reporting, dashboards, visualization, analytics, benchmarking, insights, and AI-powered exploration. Enable users to move naturally from understanding what happened to why it happened, what may happen next, and what action they should take.
Platform Strategy and Roadmap: Partner with Product Management and Business Unit leaders to define and execute a multiyear platform roadmap, including modernization priorities, shared capabilities, adoption milestones, and measurable business outcomes.
Enterprise Platform Development: Build reusable, scalable platform services that can be embedded across ADP’s HCM products while accommodating differences in data models, client segments, geographies, regulatory environments, and user needs.
Reporting Modernization: Evolve traditional reporting capabilities into a modern, intuitive, self-service experience that simplifies report creation, improves discoverability, reduces complexity, and enables clients to access trusted information more quickly.
Analytics and Insights: Expand the platform’s capabilities beyond traditional reporting to include interactive analytics, visual exploration, benchmarking, forecasting, recommendations, and actionable workforce insights.
AI and Agentic Experiences: Advance the use of generative and agentic AI to allow clients and associates to interact with data using natural language. Ensure AI-generated answers are accurate, explainable, appropriately governed, and grounded in trusted enterprise data.
Semantic Data Strategy: Lead the development of a common semantic layer that translates complex HCM data into consistent business concepts, metrics, and relationships. Ensure that reporting, analytics, and AI experiences use common definitions and deliver consistent answers.
Engineering Excellence: Build and mentor a world-class engineering organization focused on scalable architecture, secure development, automation, observability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
Architecture and Technology Strategy: Establish the architecture for a cloud-enabled, API-first, metadata-driven Reporting and Analytics platform capable of supporting large data volumes, complex queries, global scale, and near-real-time experiences.
Data Trust, Governance, and Security: Partner with enterprise data, privacy, legal, and security leaders to ensure appropriate data lineage, access controls, auditability, retention, privacy, residency, and regulatory compliance. Build client confidence by making insights transparent, explainable, and traceable to trusted sources.
Client Experience: Champion an intuitive, accessible, and consistent experience across ADP products. Apply user-centered design principles to reduce complexity and make sophisticated data capabilities usable by practitioners, managers, executives, analysts, and employees.
Business Unit Partnership: Collaborate with leaders across ADP’s businesses to understand product-specific needs, establish shared priorities, drive adoption, and balance enterprise standardization with differentiated market requirements.
Customer and Market Alignment: Engage with clients, prospects, Sales, Service, Implementation, and Marketing to understand evolving needs, validate platform direction, and identify opportunities to strengthen ADP’s competitive position.
Operational Excellence: Maintain a high standard of platform availability, performance, resilience, and supportability. Establish service-level objectives, proactive monitoring, capacity planning, and disciplined incident and problem-management practices.
Product and Delivery Execution: Lead all phases of development—from discovery and architecture through implementation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement—while maintaining transparency around progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.
Quality and Compliance: Establish comprehensive quality engineering practices that include automated testing, performance validation, security testing, data-quality controls, accessibility, and regulatory compliance.
Value Realization: Define and measure outcomes such as client adoption, time to insight, report completion time, platform performance, client satisfaction, support-effort reduction, implementation efficiency, and revenue enablement.
Risk Management: Proactively identify architectural, operational, security, data, delivery, and adoption risks. Work across organizational boundaries to resolve issues before they affect clients or strategic commitments.
Talent and Organizational Leadership: Attract, develop, and retain exceptional global talent. Create an inclusive, accountable culture in which leaders and associates understand the mission, collaborate effectively, and are empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes.
Innovation and Continuous Learning: Promote experimentation, technical upskilling, and the responsible adoption of emerging technologies. Create a culture that balances innovation and speed with the reliability, security, and trust required of an enterprise HCM platform.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced experience is preferred.
At least 15 years of progressive experience in software or product development, including 5–8+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing large, global, multidisciplinary organizations.
Demonstrated experience developing and operating enterprise-scale reporting, business intelligence, analytics, data, or AI platforms.
Proven success modernizing complex platforms while maintaining continuity, reliability, and performance for existing clients.
Deep understanding of modern data architectures, semantic models, metadata management, APIs, cloud platforms, data pipelines, analytical processing, visualization, and distributed systems.
Experience delivering integrated reporting and analytics experiences across multiple products, business units, client segments, or geographic markets.
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural-language interfaces, and agentic architectures, including the governance and controls required to deliver accurate and explainable AI-powered insights.
Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, security, lineage, access control, regulatory compliance, and responsible AI practices.
Proven record of leading globally distributed engineering teams and delivering secure, highly scalable, available, and resilient enterprise software.
Experience overseeing end-to-end production operations, including service reliability, observability, performance management, incident response, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and align stakeholders across Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, Security, Sales, Marketing, Service, Implementation, and Customer Success.
Experience in Human Capital Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, financial technology, or another domain that manages complex, sensitive, and highly regulated enterprise data is strongly preferred.

Leadership Capabilities

Strategic Thinking: Develops and executes a compelling long-term vision while translating strategy into clear priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes.
Technology Leadership: Demonstrates the technical judgment to guide architecture, evaluate emerging technologies, and make sound decisions regarding modernization, scale, security, and platform sustainability.
Client-Centric Innovation: Begins with the client problem and creates simple, trusted experiences from complex technology and data ecosystems.
Data-Driven Decision-Making: Uses quantitative and qualitative evidence to establish priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, measure progress, and adapt strategy.
Enterprise Collaboration: Builds alignment across organizational boundaries and balances the needs of individual businesses with the benefits of shared enterprise capabilities.
Transformation Leadership: Leads effectively through ambiguity, establishes clarity amid complexity, and sustains momentum through multiyear organizational and technology transformation.
Operational Discipline: Maintains a relentless focus on quality, reliability, performance, security, and the client experience.
Talent Development: Builds strong leadership teams, develops future leaders, creates inclusive environments, and holds the organization accountable for both results and behaviors.

This is an opportunity to lead one of ADP’s most strategic technology platforms and redefine how clients interact with workforce data. The successful candidate will help create a future in which reporting and analytics are no longer separate activities, but part of one connected, intelligent experience—making it easier for every user to ask a question, receive a trusted answer, understand its meaning, and take informed action.

You'll Love Working Here Because

Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of nine Business Resource Groups to connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.

We’re driven by the belief that cannabis can make life better, and that innovation can unlock its benefits in ways that set a higher standard for the category. Beyond our products, PAX is committed to moving the industry forward through advocacy, responsible access, social impact, and sustainability.

PAX is seeking a Director of Product Marketing to lead product and portfolio marketing across our global device business and U.S. cannabis consumables business. This person will help determine where PAX plays, whom we serve, and how our products win. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – GridBeats™ Device Management
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

About GE Vernova

At GE Vernova, we are leading the electrification of the world, helping to ensure a reliable and sustainable energy future. Our Grid Automation & Software business is at the forefront of this mission, providing critical solutions for monitoring, controlling, protecting and optimizing electrical grids.

About The Role

We are seeking a strategic, customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to lead GridBeats™ Device Management (DvM) — a core component of GridBeats™, our portfolio of software-defined automation solutions for grid digitalization.

GridBeats™ DvM is a powerful software suite enabling remote monitoring, control, and lifecycle management of grid intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) — including protection relays, fault recorders, power quality meters, and sensing equipment. Designed for distribution and transmission utilities, renewable operators, and industrial customers, DvM enhances operational efficiency, cybersecurity, and system resilience.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own product strategy, discovery, and delivery — working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to build solutions that solve real problems, deliver measurable outcomes, and shape the future of grid automation.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy

Define and own a compelling, outcome-driven product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap aligned with GridBeats™ business goals.
Translate market insights and customer problems into prioritized opportunities with measurable business outcomes — not just a list of features.
Make crisp, well-reasoned prioritization decisions and align senior stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, and executive leadership.

Customer & Market Discovery

Conduct continuous customer discovery — engaging operators, protection engineers, and utility leaders to uncover deep pain points and unmet needs.
Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory trends (NERC CIP, IEC 61850, IEC 62351), and technology shifts to inform strategy.
Represent GE Vernova at industry events and conferences (DistribuTECH, CIGRE, etc.).

Business Strategy & Commercial Ownership

Own and maintain the multi-year business case including revenue forecasts, cost-to-build, margin targets, and investment prioritization.
Define and own the software licensing model and policy — including license types (subscription, perpetual, term-based), optional module packaging, asset-count or capacity-based tiers, and yearly extension terms.
Establish and govern the software lifecycle policy for DvM releases — including version support windows, end-of-life timelines, upgrade path commitments, and security patch obligations — balancing customer operational risk with engineering sustainability.
Lead strategic decisions on deployment and go-to-market models — evaluating and recommending the appropriate mix of on-premises, cloud-hosted, hybrid, and SaaS delivery options per customer segment — and ensure these choices are reflected in pricing, contracts, and partner channel strategy.

Product Definition & Delivery

Lead the full product lifecycle — from concept and business case through requirements, development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Lead all release front-end activities — defining and owning business and product requirements across each release cycle, whether operating within a structured gate process or an Agile sprint/PI Planning cadence.
Write crisp, outcome-focused product artifacts — opportunity canvases, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that communicate intent without over-specifying solutions. Ensure requirements are baselined, traceable, and accepted by key stakeholders before development commitment.
Work in close collaboration with commercial, engineering, design & delivery teams.

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement

Partner with Marketing to develop impactful messaging, collateral, and campaigns across all channels.
Work with global sales teams to build key customer relationships, execute go-to-market strategies, and deliver product training and awareness programs.

Performance & Metrics

Define and track product KPIs — including adoption, retention, time-to-value, financial results, and market share.
Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to drive decisions and implement continuous improvement or course corrections.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
5+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading industrial or enterprise B2B software products.
Experience building modern software products using containers and microservices architectures, supporting multiple deployment models (on-premise, cloud, SaaS).
Proficiency in data-driven decision-making — defining metrics, running analyses, and navigating ambiguity to develop and communicate product strategy.
Hands-on experience with modern product innovation methodologies — Product Discovery, Lean Startup, Design Thinking, or similar.
Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate core PM workflows (e.g. customer discovery synthesis, PRD drafting, competitive analysis, opportunity sizing, etc.).
Familiarity with Agile and other NPI methodologies.
Ability to work effectively with globally distributed, cross-functional teams; willingness to travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with electrical utilities, smart grid, device management, protection relays, SCADA, fault recorders, IoT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850).
Experience applying AI/ML capabilities in product strategy and roadmap decisions and AI-based prototyping to accelerate product discovery and validation cycles.
MBA or advanced degree — highly desired

Desired Characteristics

A self-starter and strategic thinker with a bias for action.
Customer-obsessed and passionate about identifying and solving real-world problems.
Outcome-driven, with a focus on measurable impact.
An excellent communicator who can simplify complexity.
Comfortable influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Strong data literacy — comfortable defining metrics, running analyses, and using quantitative and qualitative evidence to drive decisions
Motivated by the energy transition and its global impact.

Join us and be part of a mission-driven team that’s redefining device management for the energy transition. Help utilities unlock the full potential of their infrastructure while advancing toward a cleaner, smarter, and more resilient energy future.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2008, DoubleVerify (DV) is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance by bringing transparency and accountability to the market and ensuring ad viewability, brand safety, fraud protection, accurate impression delivery and audience quality across campaigns to drive performance. DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies across every major vertical, including financial services, telecom, automotive, retail, CPG, travel, luxury and pharmaceuticals gain the most value out of their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital ecosystem. Let's build a better industry.

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Product Management — DV Publisher Suite owns the product strategy, roadmap and delivery for DoubleVerify Publisher Suite, a comprehensive suite of revenue analytics, quality & performance measurement, and inventory curation tools. DV Publisher Suite customers include some of the most recognized names in media spanning Broadcasters, News, Retailers and Device Manufacturers

The portfolio is broad and technically deep. It spans revenue analytics — a suite of tools for all publisher monetisation needs, managing both direct and programmatic datasets, letting clients build reports, dashboards, and forecasts across their entire revenue base– and the Inventory Quality & Targeting Suite is DVPS's analytics and curation suite that lets publishers discover and prove out their high-performing, authentic inventory. It measures across the same quality and performance pillars advertisers value.

Publishers are a fundamentally different customer than advertisers: different economics, different buying centers, different definitions of success. This role exists to make sure DV builds for them on their terms. You will lead a team of five Product Managers, partner closely with a dedicated publisher engineering organization and a dedicated publisher sales and client support team, and operate as the product leader of a focused, entrepreneurial unit with a single goal — profitable growth in the publisher business.

The mandate is ambitious. You will set a multi-year product vision for how premium publishers monetize in an environment reshaped by streaming, curation, AI-driven content discovery and continued pressure on open-web economics. You will make hard portfolio calls about where to invest, where to simplify and where to stop. And you will be accountable for delivery: clear requirements, realistic scope, and products that ship and get adopted.

This is a role for a product leader who can innovate against a long-term vision and a quarterly commercial reality at the same time — who is energized by owning a business, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and credible with publishers, engineers and executives alike.

Job Responsibilities

Own and be accountable for the DVPS product vision, strategy, roadmap and revenue outcomes across the full portfolio — Revenue Analytics and Inventory Quality & Targeting product suites
Lead, coach and grow a team of five Product Managers; raise the bar on product craft, customer discovery and delivery discipline, and develop the next generation of product leaders on the team.
Partner with the GM of the Publisher business as the product leader, jointly setting priorities against revenue and customer commitments while owning product strategy and prioritization.
Drive delivery velocity in close partnership with the dedicated Publisher engineering organization; establish clear requirements, make explicit prioritization decisions, and manage scope.
Define and analyze the metrics that determine whether DVPS products are winning — adoption, revenue attach, retention, and publisher-side yield impact — and use them to reallocate investment.
Own competitive and market position for publisher-side analytics, delivery and quality; ensure DV remains the best publisher product in market.
Engage directly and frequently with premium publishers and industry bodies, including IAB working groups; represent DV at industry events, standards groups and customer executive reviews.
Coordinate with DV's broader product organization on shared platform capabilities — classification, fraud, measurement infrastructure and reporting — to ensure DVPS benefits from company-wide investment rather than rebuilding it.
Become the organization's go-to authority on publisher monetization, sell-side verification, and the DV Publisher Suite.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of total professional experience, including 7+ years in Product Management.
3+ years of people management experience with Product Managers as direct reports, including hiring, performance management and career development.
3+ years of product experience in publisher-side advertising technology — publisher ad servers, order and inventory management systems, header bidding, SSPs, yield management, revenue analytics or programmatic monetization.
Demonstrated ownership of a product line with direct revenue accountability, including the tradeoffs between long-term platform investment and near-term commercial commitments.
Track record of leading products from strategy through launch and adoption, including complex platform migrations and modernization of mature products.
Superior data analysis skills; able to personally derive insight and action from data rather than delegating it.
Experience partnering effectively with a distributed engineering organization, including across time zones and cultures.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to present credibly to executives, to engineers, and to publisher customers.
Organized with rigorous attention to detail and a demonstrated bias toward decisiveness under ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience at a premium publisher, SSP, ad exchange or publisher-side monetization platform.
Deep working knowledge of media quality measurement — invalid traffic and fraud, brand safety and suitability, viewability, attention — applied to sell-side use cases.
Familiarity with CTV and streaming supply, and with how premium publishers package and sell it.
Experience building/developing a high-caliber product team.
Experience with agile development at scale, and with UX partnership on research, prototyping and usability.
Hands-on SQL and data analysis capability.
B.S. or higher in Computer Science, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

As the Head of Product Led Growth Marketing, you will lead a team that defines and optimizes Confluent’s product-led growth strategy from acquisition through high-value customer conversion.

You and your team will collaborate across Product, Marketing, Sales, Data Science, and Engineering to optimize signup quality, strengthen funnel conversion, and maximize downstream revenue impact. Your work will include building measurement frameworks, leading experimentation agendas, optimizing digital acquisition channels, including emerging discovery levers such as answer engine optimization (AEO), and translating performance insights into clear investment decisions. You will also design and refine the product-to-sales handoff, ensuring product signals translate into effective sales engagement. This role is critical to scaling product-led acquisition and demonstrating PLG as a durable, efficient growth lever for Confluent.

What You Will Do

Drive growth strategy and optimization: Define and optimize PLG growth strategy across the full funnel—from acquisition through high-value conversion—balancing efficiency, quality, and scale across channels, programs, and experiments in collaboration with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Data Science teams.
Lead and scale a high-performing growth team: Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of growth marketers and analysts; foster a culture of high-velocity experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning while aligning individual development with Confluent’s strategic goals.
Optimize digital marketing and channel performance: Evaluate paid marketing, organic, and product-led acquisition channels; translate performance insights into investment decisions; test and scale high-performing programs across both traditional and emerging discovery channels, including answer engine optimization (AEO).
Build measurement frameworks and experimentation rigor: Establish metrics, models, and analytical frameworks that assess channel quality, funnel health, cohort behavior, and early indicators of long-term customer value; lead a disciplined testing agenda to accelerate learning and improve conversion.
Strengthen product-led sales motion and GTM alignment: Design and optimize the handoff from product-led users to sales-assisted conversion; partner with Sales and Product on GTM strategy, qualification, routing, and feedback loops; ensure alignment across product launches, marketing campaigns, activation flows, and nurture journeys.
Evolve PLG for AI and agentic workflows: Partner with Product and Engineering to integrate AI-driven evaluation/personalization, agent-based customer interactions, and intelligent automation into growth workflows—positioning Confluent's PLG motion to capitalize on emerging AI use cases and developer behavior shifts.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

8+ years in product management, growth marketing, growth strategy, or growth analytics with a focus on product-led growth, funnel optimization, experimentation, and revenue impact; 2+ years in a leadership role managing high-performing teams.
Deep understanding of growth marketing and PLG best practices—including acquisition strategy, digital and paid marketing, funnel analysis, lifecycle optimization, experimentation design, and best-in-class PLG tooling and workflows (e.g., product analytics platforms, reverse ETL, activation tools, attribution and experimentation frameworks).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with strategic thinking ability; experience diagnosing complex funnel issues and translating analysis into clear decisions. SQL required, with experience in Hex, Tableau, Amplitude, BigQuery, or similar platforms preferred.
Experience in enterprise software or SaaS, with proven ability to collaborate across Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Data Science; excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences.
Strong ownership mindset with the ability to move solutions forward in ambiguous, fast-moving environments; proven track record leading and mentoring teams to deliver exceptional results.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience in developer tools, cloud/data infrastructure, usage-based business models, or other technical, developer-led product domains.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Member Experience
jobs.description:
About Atria

The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.

About This Role

Atria Health is seeking a highly experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of our Member Experience. In this role, you will lead high-impact initiatives across the digital and operational touchpoints that define how members engage with Atria—from onboarding and care navigation to ongoing engagement through our mobile app and member portal.

You will partner closely with product, engineering, design, clinical, and operations teams to create intuitive, personalized experiences that reflect Atria’s premium care model. This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives in ambiguity, has exceptional product judgment, and is excited to reimagine what a modern healthcare experience can feel like.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Ownership

Define and drive the multi-quarter product strategy for Atria's member-facing experience in close collaboration with the Member Experience Group Product Manager and the rest of the Technology team (Care Delivery, Clinical Experience, and Platform), ensuring alignment with clinical excellence, operational efficiency, and Atria's long-term business goals.
Explore and define innovative approaches to premium digital healthcare experiences, drawing inspiration from best-in-class consumer products, concierge services, and emerging AI capabilities.
Identify opportunities to streamline, elevate, and personalize the end-to-end member journey.

Lead development and delivery of high-impact initiatives across the full member experience surface area: mobile (iOS/Android), web, onboarding/registration flows, membership renewals, and cross-functional touchpoints.
Write detailed product requirements, build out functional AI prototypes, define success metrics, and drive high-quality delivery in close collaboration with engineering and design.
Continuously optimize post-launch to drive engagement, satisfaction, and measurable health and business outcomes.

AI Product Development

Identify and prioritize opportunities to embed AI into the member experience—including personalized health insights, intelligent communications, and workflow automation.
Define where AI meaningfully enhances the member experience and operational workflows, including the appropriate human oversight, evaluation criteria, and safeguards required in a healthcare environment.
Partner with engineering and data teams to build AI-assisted features responsibly, with appropriate safeguards for a regulated healthcare environment.
Articulate clear trade-offs between AI-driven and rules-based approaches, grounded in user impact, risk, and technical feasibility.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Serve as the connective tissue across content, design, engineering, product, and membership teams—building alignment around the member experience, and collaborating with clinical and operational partners where the member journey intersects with care delivery.
Drive clarity in ambiguous environments, proactively identifying opportunities and bringing structure to complex cross-functional problems.
Influence stakeholders without direct authority, building alignment around shared goals and measurable outcomes.
Communicate product direction clearly and compellingly to a mixed audience of clinicians, engineers, operators, and executives.

Operational Workflow Integration

Partner with care coordination, clinical operations, and partner teams to understand how internal workflows shape the member experience—and identify opportunities to improve them.
Translate complex, real-world workflows into scalable product solutions that balance usability, compliance, and technical feasibility.
Ensure member-facing products and internal tools are tightly aligned so that the experience is seamless and consistent across every interaction.

Data, Insights & Optimization

Use data and analytics to identify friction points, engagement gaps, and opportunities across the member journey.
Leverage qualitative research and quantitative signals to inform prioritization and iterate quickly and responsibly.
Define, monitor, and act on KPIs tied to member engagement, retention, satisfaction, and health outcomes.

Salary range: $170,000 - $220,000

Requirements

5–7 years of product management experience building consumer-facing digital products; experience in health tech, wellness, or high-growth consumer companies strongly preferred.
Proven track record of shipping consumer-grade digital experiences, with a strong intuition for what makes experiences useful, trustworthy, and engaging.
Strong product judgment with experience navigating ambiguity and leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent understanding of end-to-end user experience design across mobile and web products.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype, accelerate workflows, and identify high-value product opportunities.
Strong analytical skills with experience using qualitative and quantitative insights to drive prioritization and decision-making.
Experience working in regulated environments with sensitivity to privacy, compliance, and data security considerations.
An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment—comfortable with ambiguity and energized by it.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical, operational, and executive audiences.
Curious, resourceful, and motivated by improving people’s health and experience through technology.

Benefits

At Atria, we are proud to offer every member of the Atria team:

Excellent health and wellness benefits, fully covered by Atria, effective date of hire
OneMedical membership for employees & dependents, giving access to 24/7 virtual care
Fertility & family planning
Company-covered preventive health screenings through partner hospitals (calcium score)

The Associate Director, Technology Product Management
for Medi-Span

This leader is the primary Medi-Span Product partner for Commercial Sales opportunities and turns customer, market, competitive, regulatory, and product-performance evidence into clear priorities and investment decisions. The role balances growth with customer commitments, security, modernization, regulatory needs, and ongoing product health, while ensuring priority work moves from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable results.

The role leads Product professionals and works closely with Engineering, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Systems Implementation, and other Product leaders. Success requires sound judgment, strong commercial healthcare knowledge, and the ability to align teams around customer problems and sustainable business value.

Wolters Kluwer Health
is an established, fast-growing, and innovation-driven healthcare information technology company that delivers trusted clinical technology and evidence-based solutions to support decision-making and improve outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. Our flagship products include UpToDate, UpToDate Lexidrug, UpToDate Patient Engagement, and Medi-Span.

Essential Duties And KEY Responsibilities

Own and continually refine the Medi-Span strategy for the North America Commercial market. Use customer needs, market trends, competitive intelligence, product performance, and business goals to identify growth, retention, and portfolio opportunities.
Serve as the primary Medi-Span Product partner for Commercial Sales opportunities. Provide product guidance, participate in customer conversations, connect opportunities to the right experts, and set clear expectations about fit, priorities, and timing.
Own strategy and roadmap direction for assigned product areas. Translate product-line strategy into priorities and make trade-offs across growth, customer commitments, regulatory and standards-driven work, security, modernization, technical debt, and ongoing product health.

jobs.description:
Summary

Tungsten Automation is the leader in Intelligent Document Processing, and TotalAgility is the platform at the center of that leadership. As enterprises move from document capture to AI-native, agentic automation, we are looking for a Sr. Director of Product Management to own the roadmap and delivery of our Intelligent Document Processing pillar and the TotalAgility platform.

This is a senior, high-ownership role for a product leader who can both set direction and drive it to release. You will define where IDP goes next — AI-native capture, classification and extraction, agentic document workflows, and embedded compliance — and you will be accountable for driving it, allowing oversight and commitment to success through the process. You will turn market signal, competitive pressure, and customer need into a roadmap the organization can execute against, then partner closely with Engineering to bring it to market on time and at quality.

You will be the connective tissue between vision and execution: setting the multi-year strategy for IDP and TotalAgility, sequencing the roadmap against real delivery constraints, and owning the commercial outcomes — bookings, revenue growth, and net revenue retention — that prove it is working. This is a chance to shape how the world's largest enterprises process their most critical documents in the era of agentic AI.

Job Purpose

Own the investment strategy, product vision, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for the Intelligent Document Processing pillar and the TotalAgility platform — accountable for both the strategic direction and the operational and financial results of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Drive execution end to end. Translate the roadmap into prioritized, well-scoped releases and partner closely with Engineering to ship on schedule, at quality, and with measurable customer impact. This role is accountable for delivery, not just direction.
Own the numbers. Set and own product growth targets in partnership with Finance; be accountable for bookings, revenue growth, net revenue retention (NRR), and gross revenue retention (GRR) in the IDP pillar.
Lead the AI agenda. Own the AI and document-intelligence strategy for the platform — capture, classification, extraction, and agentic document workflows — including build-versus-partner decisions and how AI capabilities are packaged, metered, and priced.
Be the visible face of the product. Stay personally and consistently close to customers and the market — this is a flagship product, and the strategy behind it needs to be shaped in the room with customers, not developed in isolation and handed down. Participate directly in customer meetings, executive briefings, and prospect conversations, and treat that engagement as core to the job, not an occasional add-on.
Own the platform story across the broader portfolio. Drive product strategy and thought leadership not just for TotalAgility, but across the wider DWA portfolio — defining and managing the connected motion between TotalAgility and adjacent pillars (e.g., IVA+ and AP/AR automation) so the portfolio operates as a coherent platform, and so the organization has one visible leader setting direction across that space, not a set of disconnected point products.
Stay ahead of the market. Maintain deep command of the competitive and analyst landscape for IDP and intelligent automation; anticipate market and regulatory shifts — including e-invoicing and compliance mandates — and position the portfolio ahead of them.
Ground decisions in evidence. Lead customer and market discovery; synthesize research, product usage data, and field input into clear, defensible prioritization and investment decisions.
Drive adoption. Own go-to-market strategy for the pillar in partnership with Marketing, Sales, and Channel — positioning, packaging, pricing, and launch — and measure adoption, calibrating quickly where results diverge from plan.
Communicate with altitude. Communicate strategy, roadmap, and trade-offs credibly across every audience, from engineering teams to the executive team, board, customers, and prospects.

jobs.title: Head of Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Product Engineering
· Remote (US/EU) · Reports to the CEO
Immensity automates back-office work for operational businesses in construction, real estate and facilities: invoices, contracts, approvals, maintenance requests.
You own the path from a client’s messy workflow to a shipped, verified feature on Immensity’s AI agent platform. You decide what to build, write the spec, build much of it yourself with AI coding agents, and run the review and release process that keeps a multi-tenant system safe. You are the product owner and the engineering lead in one seat, so clients, engineers and founders all bring you the same question: is it built, is it live, and does it work?
You'll lead a small engineering team plus a fleet of AI coding agents. Also titled Product Engineering Lead.

What you will own

Product direction and design (~25%).
Turn client calls, demos and feedback into specs, one-pagers and a sequenced roadmap. Own the information architecture and the product’s look, and make the build-vs-buy calls on models and integration vendors.
Build and fix (~20%).
Ship features and root-caused fixes across a Python/FastAPI backend, a Next.js web app, an iOS shell and AWS infrastructure. Most of it through AI coding agents running in parallel, one worktree per ticket.
Quality, release and production (~20%).
Test every release on staging and production in a real browser and simulator. Root-cause client-reported bugs, keep CI and deploys healthy, and get through App Store and Google OAuth security reviews.
Team and delivery (~20%).
Write tickets engineers can build from, run sprint planning, review and merge PRs, and hire. Hold “Done” to verified in production. Own the AI development workflow: agent skills, shared memory, cross-model code review.
Client delivery (~15%).
Stand up client workspaces and client-specific agents, prepare and run demos, and track each client’s usage. Be the technical voice on client calls and in weekly client updates.

Shares reflect how this work was actually split over the last 12 weeks, rounded.

What good looks like

By month 6, the delivery loop is one people trust:
Client demos run on the client’s real data and pass a readiness check before anyone joins the call.
“Done” means verified in production, and the sprint board matches reality without a manual audit.
Every PR gets a different-model review and merges without waiting on you.

By month 12, clients get value without an engineer in the room:
The redesigned product is the default for every client, and the old screens are retired.
A new client can sign up and connect their email and accounting tools with no engineer on the call.
Fixes stay fixed: each client-reported bug family ends with a root cause and a regression test in CI.

What you bring

We interview for each of these, and a clear no on any one of them is a no.
Full-stack range.
Python and FastAPI, TypeScript and Next.js, PostgreSQL, AWS. Tenant isolation, secrets handling and audit trails are your defaults, not review comments.
Production scar tissue.
You have owned something real users depended on, been burned when it broke, and changed how you build because of it.
Operates without permission.
Handed an ambiguous problem, you narrow it, decide, ship, and say what you deliberately skipped.
Taste for slop.
You use AI coding agents every day and catch the confident hallucination, the subtle bug and the plausible-but-lazy fix.
Fixes properly or files the debt.
A shortcut under deadline leaves a ticket for the real fix, and you go back for it.
Comfortable in front of the client.
You would join a call with a client’s CFO tomorrow and ask how their Tuesday runs before asking about their stack.
Direct, even when it costs you.
You say what you think early, to the person who can act on it, with reasons.
Visibly faster than a year ago.
You can name a tool or habit you dropped this year, why it lost, and what you are testing now.

Nice to have: shipped LLM agents with tool use, routing and evals; construction, real estate or accounts-payable domain knowledge; iOS App Store releases; SOC2 or Google CASA audits; hiring a small team.

How we work

Spec first.
Every feature starts as a written spec, plan and task list, and ends as a PR to staging.
A different model reviews every PR.
Authors never merge their own work. People review only security boundaries, hard-to-reverse migrations and money paths.
Client data stays in our cloud.
Every model call goes through our own provider layer, secrets live in a managed vault, and every table enforces tenant isolation.
Done means verified in production.
Merged is necessary, not sufficient.
Brief, factual writing.
Updates go out by project, with no hype.

How to apply

Apply here. In your note, name one tool you dropped this year, what it lost, and what you’re testing now.

jobs.title: AI Product Senior Director
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

This is a reimagined product management leadership role for the agentic era, with direct influence over the way we build consumer-facing and enterprise AI.

You will not just measure customer delight, write specs, and triage tickets. You will also build alongside our engineers with AI as your primary force multiplier. You will prototype with Claude Code, Cursor, and Lovable; design and operate the evaluation harnesses that decide what ships; and treat your own PM workflow as a system to instrument, automate, and continuously improve. Our AI portfolio at FanDuel includes consumer-facing chat experiences, agentic marketing workflows and automation, AI-powered product and software development, and more.

As a senior director-level player-coach, you will own one high-leverage agentic product surface end-to-end in collaboration with product managers and designs in tech and commercial, while also mentoring and raising the bar for how Product Management is practiced at FanDuel. You will lead a team of AI PMs that interface directly with business stakeholders, codify patterns for how product management is done in the AI era, and shape the discipline of product management more widely. If your reflex when you see a problem is to open a terminal and an agent harness before you open a Google Doc, this role is for you.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Mentor and coach AI PMs across the AI and wider product org through pairing, design reviews, written critique, prototype tear-downs, and a shared pattern library you help author. You will supervise multiple AI product managers in the AI Engineering Organization, while also raising the bar for FanDuel’s wider product management practice.

Own end-to-end for one or more workstreams (growth & marketing, customer experience, product innovation, enterprise acceleration), including strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and outcomes. You will build working prototypes with Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, and modern agent frameworks. And you will design and operate evaluation systems — golden sets, offline evals, online experiments, drift and regression detection, human-rater pipelines — for every surface you own. Define what "good" means in numbers before you ship.

Partner daily with Business partners, FDEs, AI SWE pods, AI Platform, Trust & Safety, Responsible AI, and Legal. Translate ambiguous business problems into agent-shaped solutions that respect our regulatory and RG posture. Set the bar for AI-native PM craft across the function: write and maintain CLAUDE.md files, build MCP-aware tooling for the PM team, share patterns in writing, and pair with other PMs on hard problems.

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

10-12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years shipping AI and/or LLM-powered products in production.
Demonstrated fluency building with modern AI development tools. You can point to prototypes, agents, evals, MCP servers, or PRs you have personally built — not just shipped through others.
Strong technical depth: comfortable reading and writing code, comfortable in system design conversations, comfortable in an eval notebook. You don't need to be a senior engineer, but engineers should want to pair with you.
Working understanding of agentic infrastructure: MCP, orchestration patterns, tool use, retrieval, context engineering, prompt evaluation, and runtime observability.
Track record operating as a player-coach — elevating peers and shaping practice without org-chart authority.
Demonstrated experience designing or operating evaluation systems for ML or LLM products at meaningful scale.
Sharp written communicator with a strong bias toward written artifacts — one-pagers, decision memos, RFCs, postmortems.

About Fanduel

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

About The Team

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

The AI Platforms & Experiences (APEX) team is FanDuel's AI function for cutting edge artificial intelligence. We design, ship, and operate the AI capabilities that power our marketing funnel, product experiences, internal tooling, and emerging agentic platform. The org is structured around five pillars: Forward Deployed Engineers embedded in business units, AI Software Engineering pods, an AI Platform team, AI Product Managers, and AI strategy & transformation.

We are not a research lab, and we are not the Data org. We are builders, shipping production AI systems against real customer and operator problems, with eval-first rigor, responsible-AI guardrails, and a strong bias toward small, fast, instrumented teams.

This role is different, because:

You are not joining a mature playbook. This role exists to define what AI-native PM looks like at FanDuel and to ship the surfaces other PMs will build on.
You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with the FDEs, SWEs, and Platform engineers who build the agentic stack you'll own product for.
You will have air cover from a CTO-sponsored AI Engineering function, with direct line of sight into the company's AI roadmap and architectural decisions.
You will be measured on systems and impact, not pixels. Output is judged in evals, experiments, and shipped product.

Player Benefits

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards
. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, “We are One Team!”. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.

This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.

jobs.title: Director of Product Development
jobs.description:
We at Pelagic are excited to share an opening at one of our long-time partners, Equip Foods!

WHY EQUIP FOODS

We are a countermovement to over complicated health trends. Creators of the beef protein category - a clinically-proven, gut-friendly alternative to whey and plant-based protein. Nutrient-dense, minimally-processed, real-food nutrition. We believe humans should eat real food and when you do supplement, it shouldn't be with weird isolated ingredients - it should be with more real food.

We exist to set a new standard in an industry that is incredibly shady; fancy packaging with ineffective doses, lack of transparency, under-dosed products relative to label claims. Without regulation, it is up to us, the brands, to set the standard. Simple, real-food supplements with 100% transparency on label claims, third-party tested for hundreds of toxins that have found their way into our food supply.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on, high-output Director of Product Development to own our product roadmap, R&D, and commercialization from concept through launch. This is not a traditional product management role, and we're not looking for someone who mainly coordinates outside R&D resources. We need a leader with deep, direct experience developing and commercializing protein powders and nutrition bars.

You should be comfortable taking a product from brief to bench, through pilot and scale-up, and into successful commercial production. You'll set product development strategy, manage external technical and manufacturing partners, identify risks early, and get into the details when something needs to get unstuck.

This role works closely with Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Marketing, Growth, Retail, and co-manufacturers. It requires someone who can think strategically and is equally comfortable working through formulations, attending plant trials, calling ingredient suppliers, tasting iteration 17, or traveling onsite when that is the fastest way to solve a problem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Product Development and R&D

Pipeline and Portfolio Strategy

Commercialization and Launch Execution

Co-Manufacturer and Partner Leadership

Please review the full JD for a much more detailed description of your role, responsibilities, and specific expectations for each of the areas above - linked here: https://equipfoods.notion.site/Director-of-Product-Equip-Foods-3e412b868115806d9c77febfde76654d

HOW YOU OPERATE

More than anything, we're looking for someone with ownership, judgment, and resourcefulness. You'll do well here if:
Your first reaction when something goes wrong is, "I've got it." You start solving the problem instead of only reporting it
You work autonomously, set clear goals, and hold yourself accountable for the result
You identify risks early, communicate them clearly, and bring a recommendation with the problem
You keep digging until you understand the root cause and know enough technically to challenge food scientists and manufacturing partners when something does not add up
You are organized, data driven, and comfortable making decisions without perfect information
You move quickly without getting sloppy and can shift between high-level strategy and tactical execution
You are scrappy and willing to make the call, find the expert, chase the sample, run another trial, or get on a plane when needed
You communicate clearly in a distributed environment and are comfortable working asynchronously in writing
You have low ego, care deeply about health, and will do what the situation requires to get the right outcome
When you say you own something, people trust that it is handled

REQUIREMENTS

At least five years of hands-on CPG food product development experience, ideally in nutrition, supplements, functional foods, or beverages, with direct ownership of commercialization
Deep, direct experience developing and commercializing both protein or nutrition powders and protein or nutrition bars
A track record of personally leading multiple products from formulation through commercial-scale production
Strong technical understanding of protein systems, flavor systems, sweeteners, fats, binders, stabilizers, moisture management, texture, solubility, stability, shelf life, processing conditions, and ingredient interactions across product formats
Extensive experience working directly with co-manufacturers, navigating rapid iteration, and troubleshooting issues at commercial scale
A strong network in the powder and bar ecosystem, including manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, flavor houses, food scientists, and other technical resources
Experience leading bench work, plant trials, scale-ups, and first commercial productions
Working knowledge of food safety, quality assurance, specifications, labeling, claims, testing, and regulatory requirements
Strong project management and cross-functional coordination skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex programs and priorities
Willingness and enthusiasm to travel regularly for R&D trials, manufacturing runs, supplier visits, and hands-on problem solving
Proven ability to thrive in a fast-growing, lean, remote team and move between strategy and execution

NICE-TO-HAVES

Degree in Food Science, Food Engineering, Nutrition, Chemistry, or a related field
Experience with beef, collagen, dairy, or other animal-protein systems
Experience developing products with short, clean ingredient decks, natural flavor systems, and naturally derived sweeteners
Experience launching products into national retail, including retailers such as Whole Foods, Sprouts, and Erewhon
Experience with shelf-life validation, analytical and third-party testing, sensory programs, quality assurance, and product certifications
Experience qualifying and onboarding new co-manufacturing and ingredient partners

YOU WILL PROBABLY HATE THIS ROLE IF

Most of your product experience has been project management rather than hands-on development and commercialization
You do not have meaningful experience developing both protein powders and nutrition bars
You would rather manage consultants and co-manufacturers than get directly involved in technical problem solving
You expect a large team, a specialized resource for every problem, or constant direction before you can move
You prefer predictable, repeatable work, limited travel, or frequent calls to talk through decisions
You are uncomfortable pushing or challenging manufacturers, suppliers, and technical experts
Your first instinct when something goes wrong is to schedule a meeting instead of starting to solve it
You think the work is done once the formula is approved

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

Problems are identified earlier and solved faster. Products improve. Launches become more predictable. Equip's network of technical and manufacturing partners gets stronger. The rest of the company can move faster because product development is in good hands

OTHER DETAILS

Fully remote and location independent
High growth potential and opportunity
High performance will result in high compensation

BENEFITS

We are extremely intentional about how we support you as an individual. Our benefits contribute to your education, well-being, health, and self-improvement so you can be your best self!
Top-of-the-line health care, vision, and dental plans
$200 per month for local farmers market purchases and food
$200 per month for a gym membership or personal fitness
A free Kindle and unlimited free books
$1,000 per year for continued learning and training programs
$200 per month for emotional and mental wellness
No fixed work schedule or monitoring of hours. You create your own working environment

jobs.title: Director, Delivery & Release Management, Digital Product Operations
jobs.description:
College Board – OCEP/Digital Product

Location:
This is a remote role, aligned to core EST hours
. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type
: This is a full-time position

About The Team

The Digital Product division is driving the evolution of College Board’s digital assessment experience, providing opportunities that shape futures and open doors. As AI reshapes education, we are preparing students for the future by ensuring our digital assessments remain secure, meaningful, and reflective of the knowledge and skills needed to thrive in an AI-enabled world.

The Digital Product Operations team exists to bring clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes to how College Board’s Digital Product organization plans, delivers, and improves. We are a small, high-performing team that owns the operational systems, practices, and cross-functional coordination that enable 15+ product teams to deliver meaningful digital assessment experiences to millions of students and educators every year. We partner closely with Product, Technology, Design, and go-to-market functions, and we hold ourselves to the same bar we help others reach: rigorous, data-informed, and always improving.

Together, we are transforming College Board’s trusted assessment platform into a next generation digital assessment experience that is secure, user-centered, and built to evolve with the future of learning and assessment.

About The Opportunity

As Director, Delivery & Release Management, Digital Product Operations, you thrive in complex, multi-team environments, seeing dependencies before they become blockers and simplifying without losing fidelity. You are a change agent with the ability to lead through influence rather than authority. You're comfortable building something new in a thoughtful, incremental way rather than mandating change overnight.

In this role, you are the operational engine behind how Digital Product ships, the connective tissue between product development and go-to-market readiness. You own the systems, processes, and coordination that ensure new features and platform releases are planned with precision, tested with rigor, and launched with confidence, so the releases that reach millions of students and educators each year go out right. You build the process, then coach product, technology, and go-to-market teams through adopting it, bringing visibility, predictability, and accountability to how work moves from backlog to live. You earn trust through consistency and results, not a reporting line, with a drive to relentlessly improve the systems you own.

In This Role, You Will

Release Management & Launch Readiness (35%)

Act as a change agent for how Digital Product ships — convene Product, Technology, GTM teams, and leadership stakeholders to understand and align on their expectations before designing the release process; synthesize that input into a defined, documented release process that reflects the full organization’s needs and serves as the standard for how Digital Product ships
Own and drive adoption of the release management process across all teams — coaching Product, Technology, and GTM teams through the process
Own end-to-end release management for Digital Product — from feature intake through post-launch review — across SAT Suite, AP, CLEP, ACCUPLACER, and Bluebook platform releases
Define and continuously improve release management standards, including how product information, release notes, and updates are communicated internally and externally
Develop and maintain the integrated release calendar, surfacing cross-team dependencies, milestone risks, and capacity constraints to leadership
Partner with Product, Technology, and GTM teams to ensure every release is preceded by accurate documentation, confirmed artifact delivery, and resolution of operational blockers — coordinating with Learning, Enablement & Readiness on people-side preparation
Partner with the Director, ProdOps Intelligence & Strategy to use release and launch metrics to identify coaching opportunities and process improvement areas — continuously refining the release management process based on data and stakeholder feedback until adoption is consistent and self-sustaining

Platform User Acceptance Testing (35%)

Own and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Digital Product platform — the cross-platform validation that confirms the platform works as expected from a real user and stakeholder perspective before every major release
Act as a change agent for UAT practices across Digital Product — assess current UAT maturity across product teams, set clear UAT standards and goals in partnership with Product and Technology leaders, and motivate teams to develop the discipline of rigorous pre-launch validation; own the adoption of UAT processes across Digital Product, coaching teams through the process and iterating based on feedback
Plan and execute UAT in partnership with Product Leaders, Managers, Owners, and Technology, including issue triage and final sign-off before launch
Design and scale UAT processes that are repeatable, efficient, and appropriately rigorous as our portfolio of product releases grows
Track and communicate UAT status, open issues, and resolution timelines to product and leadership stakeholders
Serve as the quality gate between development and launch, ensuring releases meet user, performance, and accessibility standards before going live
Partner with engineering, technical testing, and individual product teams to ensure UAT complements — rather than duplicates — their testing efforts, and clarify where each type of testing begins and ends

Planning Coordination & Operational Visibility (30%)

Participate in quarterly planning cycles to surface and resolve cross-team dependencies specifically related to release sequencing, UAT scheduling, and delivery timelines — ensuring the release calendar reflects the full picture of what is shipping and when across all product domains
Own and maintain delivery-specific artifacts in Digital Product tools — including the integrated release calendar, UAT schedules, and release readiness trackers — ensuring they are current, accurate, and trusted as the source of truth for what is shipping and when
Provide leadership with clear, narrative-synthesized visibility into delivery progress, release health, and key risks on a regular cadence
Develop recommendations on process improvements with clear rationale and tradeoffs — own the implementation of changes, drive adoption across teams, and evaluate outcomes to confirm the improvement delivered the expected result
Own the annual capitalized software reporting process in partnership with Finance — coordinating with Product and Technology leads to compile new functionality descriptions, IT development timelines, and release dates across all Digital Product platforms (including BAWP) required for the FY capitalized software memo

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

5+ years of experience in product operations or product management within a digital product or SaaS environment, with a strong focus on delivery and release management
Experience leading or contributing to change management efforts, helping teams adopt new ways of working
Comfort operating with ambiguity, defining tooling and evolving processes for a team still establishing its ways of working
Demonstrated experience owning release management and UAT processes across multiple concurrent product teams
Deep familiarity with Agile delivery practices and product management tooling with a track record of improving how teams use them
Ability to lead through influence rather than authority, earning trust and buy-in from teams who don't report to you
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; equally comfortable in planning sessions and stakeholder readiness reviews with Product, Technology, Design, and go-to-market leads
Exceptional organizational and communication skills; you create clarity for others, not just yourself
A bias toward simplicity; you design processes people actually follow
The ability to travel 5-7 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All Roles At College Board Require

A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach To Compensation

The hiring range for this role is $88,000 - $145,000.
Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at College Board.
We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

About College Board

College Board reaches more than 7 million students a year, helping them navigate the path from high school to college and career. We’re a mission-driven, not-for-profit membership organization dedicated to excellence in education. Founded 125 years ago, we are committed to clearing a path for all students to own their future. We pioneered programs like the SAT® and AP® to expand opportunities for students and help them develop the skills they need. Our BigFuture® program helps students plan for college, pay for college, and explore careers. Learn more at cb.org

Mission

What Guides Us

At College Board, our work is guided by four Operating Principles, and we seek team members who not only align with these principles but actively live them out in their day-to-day work .

Prioritize and Simplify – We focus on what matters most, reduce complexity, and move quickly when needed.
Say and Receive – We give and receive feedback candidly and kindly, welcoming growth and healthy debate.
Go for Greatness – We pursue excellence using data, iteration, and bold thinking to raise the bar.
Lead as One College Board – We build a culture of trust, inclusion, and shared responsibility for long-term

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable.
