CoverMyMeds’ Shared Capabilities and Partnerships product team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our Next Best Action (NBA) initiative — someone who is genuinely energized by data, AI, and machine learning, and who knows how to turn that curiosity into a recommendation and decisioning capability that drives real outcomes across the care journey. This role requires the ability to translate ambiguous, data-rich problems into a clear product strategy, and to build the trust needed to align stakeholders across a large, matrixed organization.

About The Role

The Senior Product Manager will own the Next Best Action initiative end to end: defining what “best” means for the users and workflows we serve, partnering with Data Science and Data Engineering to build the decisioning capability that gets there, and continuously improving it through experimentation. You’ll operate at the intersection of product strategy and applied AI/ML — not writing the models yourself, but framing the problems, prioritizing the signals, and holding the bar on measurement and responsible use.

What You’ll Do

Drive product strategy for Next Best Action, grounding decisions in data, discovery, and research
Define which signals, use cases, and workflows the recommendation/decisioning engine should prioritize, and translate business and customer goals into a roadmap for the model and product experience
Partner closely with Data Science and ML Engineering to shape problem framing, success criteria, and trade-offs — bringing product judgment to model development without owning the modeling itself
Own the experimentation and measurement strategy for recommendations: define what “good” looks like, design A/B tests, and build feedback loops that continuously improve recommendation quality
Partner with Data Engineering on the data foundations — quality, access, and integration — that the recommendation engine depends on
Champion responsible AI practices, ensuring recommendations are fair, explainable, and compliant with healthcare regulatory and privacy requirements, in partnership with Legal, Privacy and Compliance
Navigate complexity across a large, matrixed organization — aligning stakeholders, clarifying tradeoffs, and building the trust needed to move work forward
Influence and align cross-functional partners across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Commercial, and Operations to gain buy-in on product direction and priorities
Own and communicate roadmap priorities to leadership, ensuring transparency on progress, tradeoffs, and decisions at every phase
Apply design thinking methodologies to solve complex problems, iterate on solutions, and drive MVP delivery and customer co-innovation opportunities

Skills You’ll Need

Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience
Healthcare Product Management experience or familiarity with technical product development methodologies (e.g., Agile)
Demonstrated fluency in data, AI, and machine learning concepts — enough to partner credibly with Data Science and ML Engineering on problem framing, model trade-offs, and evaluation metrics in a Healthcare setting
Experience defining and using experimentation (A/B testing) and quantitative measurement to guide product decisions
Experience working in cross-functional product teams spanning Engineering, Data Science, UX, Operations, and Commercial partners
Technical competency with direct experience in data and analytics, data science, or AI/ML, enough to partner credibly with Data Science and ML Engineering on problem framing, model trade-offs, and evaluation metrics
Healthcare experience, preferably Biopharma and/or Payer expertise

Preferred Skills

Prior experience building or launching a recommendation engine, decisioning system, or personalization capability
Familiarity with responsible AI principles (fairness, explainability, bias mitigation) and how they apply in a regulated healthcare context
Experience with healthcare technology, patient support programs, enrollment workflows, or HCP-facing products
Strong understanding of product-market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive landscapes
Financial acumen, including experience connecting product decisions to P&L outcomes and business goals
Proven stakeholder engagement and influence skills in matrixed environments
Ability to prioritize effectively across competing initiatives and drive alignment toward execution
Comfort operating in ambiguity with a bias toward action and continuous improvement

jobs.description:
About Accumulus Technologies

Accumulus Technologies helps life sciences companies reduce regulatory friction, shorten timelines, and lower execution risk across product development and lifecycle management—delivering measurable and transformational ROI. We support the full spectrum of regulatory engagements—strategy, submissions, and lifecycle management—spanning CMC, clinical and nonclinical content, labeling, commitments, post-approval changes, and reliance/work-sharing models. Our focus is on commercial impact: faster approvals, smoother post-approval change execution, fewer surprises, and tighter alignment between commitments and what teams can deliver. Our clients measure the value we bring in the tens of millions.

Role Overview

The Senior Product Manager will independently own complex, ambiguous product areas end to end—from identifying and validating the right problems to setting product direction, guiding delivery, driving adoption, and iterating based on evidence.

You will work directly with global health authorities, life sciences sponsors, regulatory operations professionals, internal subject matter experts, and Technology teams to uncover meaningful problems and develop scalable solutions. You will be expected to exercise strong product judgment, make clear recommendations—including when not to build—and remain accountable for whether the product changes user behavior and creates business value.

This is a hands-on role for a product leader who can move fluidly between strategy, customer discovery, rapid prototyping, analytics, and execution in a complex, regulated enterprise environment.

Product Strategy and Ownership

Independently own one or more strategic product areas, translating broad company goals into a clear product direction, and execution plan.
Develop a deep understanding of regulatory engagements, user workflows, market dynamics, and the technical and compliance constraints that shape the Accumulus Platform.
Frame ambiguous opportunities, evaluate alternatives, make principled prioritization decisions, and provide clear recommendations about what to build, what not to build, and why.
Continuously assess product direction based on user evidence, business priorities, platform strategy, technical feasibility, risk, and market change.
Articulate the value and future direction of the platform to internal leaders, customers, partners, and other market-facing audiences.

Discovery and Validation

Lead discovery directly with regulator, and sponsor users to uncover underlying needs, behaviors, constraints, and opportunities rather than relying on stated requirements alone.
Design and execute research plans, interviews, workflow studies, experiments, and concept tests that reduce uncertainty and test the most important product hypotheses.
Rapidly prototype possible solutions, place them in front of users, synthesize what is learned, and recommend whether and how Accumulus should proceed.
Combine qualitative insight, product data, market evidence, and technical input to make well-reasoned product decisions before and after launch.
Build trusted relationships with users and stakeholders while maintaining independent product judgment.

AI Product Leadership and AI-Native Ways of Working

Identify where AI can create meaningful user and business value, and distinguish those opportunities from use cases where AI would add unnecessary complexity or risk.
Lead discovery and validation of AI-enabled workflows with regulators and customers, with explicit attention to accuracy, trust, transparency, explainability, human oversight, privacy, security, and quality.
Partner with Technology and other stakeholders on build, buy, or partner decisions; model and data considerations; evaluation approaches; and the path from prototype to production.
Use AI fluently and responsibly in day-to-day product work, including research synthesis, analysis, product requirements, rapid prototyping, product analytics, and communication.
Help establish product practices for evaluating, monitoring, and improving AI-enabled capabilities after launch.

User Experience And Product Quality

Own the clarity, usability, and coherence of the end-to-end product experience; do not treat UX quality as a separate team's responsibility.
Use modern prototyping tools, including Figma and AI-assisted tools, to explore workflows quickly, gather feedback, and iterate before committing to development.
Translate discovery findings into intuitive workflows, interaction requirements, and implementation-ready product artifacts.
Work closely with frontend engineers and other Technology partners throughout implementation to preserve product intent and ensure a high-quality user experience.
Apply strong product and UX judgment without needing to be a visual designer.

Product Outcomes and Analytics

Define clear success measures for product initiatives, including adoption, engagement, workflow, quality, and business outcomes.
Partner with Technology and analytics stakeholders to ensure the product is instrumented appropriately and that the team can understand how users behave.
Monitor adoption and usage, investigate where expected behavior change is or is not occurring, and combine quantitative and qualitative evidence to determine next steps.
Use post-launch learning to improve the product, inform investment decisions, and determine whether to iterate, scale, reposition, or stop an initiative.

Execution and Delivery

Translate validated product direction into clear epics, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, and supporting artifacts that enable effective engineering execution.
Partner closely with Engineering in an agile environment to prioritize and refine the backlog, clarify intent, make scope and sequencing tradeoffs, and unblock delivery.
Identify cross-team dependencies, technical and product risks, and decision points early; present practical mitigation options and make timely tradeoffs.
Work in partnership with program management and business operations to support predictable, high-quality delivery across teams.
Ensure product issues identified during development or after release are understood, prioritized, and resolved appropriately.

Market, Regulatory, and Adoption Leadership

Stay informed about relevant regulatory expectations, industry standards, and market developments, and work with regulatory, legal, security, privacy, and quality partners to shape compliant solutions.
Serve as a product subject matter expert for internal teams, customers, prospective customers, partners, and market-facing communications.
Collaborate with product marketing, customer success, commercial, and operations teams on positioning, launch planning, enablement, adoption, and scalable operating processes.
Identify future growth opportunities and differentiated value propositions that advance Accumulus' mission and platform strategy.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or commensurate experience.
Seven or more years of product management experience, including a proven record of independently leading complex enterprise software products or product areas from discovery through delivery and iteration.
Five or more years of experience with enterprise SaaS platforms or supporting software in complex organizational environments.
Demonstrated strength in customer discovery, problem framing, hypothesis development, rapid experimentation, prototyping, and evidence-based product decision-making.
Strong product and UX judgment, with the ability to define coherent workflows and create prototypes without relying on a dedicated Product Designer.
Experience defining product success measures, partnering on instrumentation, analyzing adoption and usage behavior, and using qualitative and quantitative evidence to guide decisions.
Demonstrated AI-native ways of working and a practical understanding of the opportunities, limitations, risks, and responsible design considerations associated with AI-enabled products.
Strong technical fluency and the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering on architecture, integrations, data, security, scalability, and delivery tradeoffs.
Experience shipping complex software through agile development processes while balancing user value, business outcomes, technical feasibility, compliance, and delivery risk.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and formal presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, executives, customers, and regulators.
Willingness to travel up to four times a year.

Strongly Preferred

Experience taking enterprise AI/ML or large language model capabilities from discovery and validation into production, including defining evaluation, human oversight, trust, and quality approaches.
Experience in life sciences, regulatory technology, healthcare, or another highly regulated software environment.
Experience with secure collaboration, content management, data exchange, regulatory submissions, workflow, or project management platforms.

About Assembled

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust Assembled. We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London.

About The Role

Product Management at Assembled articulates the most important problems to solve in a way that will delight customers and grow the business. To do this, you should expect to partner closely with support teams at the world's best brands – small and large – and regularly meet with prospects to paint the vision and learn about their problems and what resonates.

Role

In this role, you'll own scheduling and forecasting — the core of Assembled's WFM product and the reason most customers choose us. You'll work closely with support operations teams to understand how they plan capacity, build schedules, and adapt in real time when volume or headcount shifts. A small sample of recently shipped work includes:

A schedule assistant that reduces manual schedule-building lift for complex, multi-queue environments
Intelligent schedule editing tools that reduce the time planners spend on manual adjustments
A new shift generation engine that automatically optimizes shift start times and durations against predicted support volume throughout the day
Forecast review and override tools that give planners the confidence to act on model outputs

This is an onsite role based out of either our San Francisco or New York City office, with an in-office requirement of 5 days, Monday - Friday.

Your Day To Day Will Include

Working directly with prospects and customers. You'll be in the room (and on the call) with support ops leaders at the world's best brands — doing discovery, co-building, and representing Assembled at the highest level. Strong GTM partnership with sales and CS is core to how this team works.
Owning scheduling and forecasting end-to-end. From how planners build and edit schedules to how forecasts are generated, reviewed, and acted on — you'll set the vision, drive the roadmap, and ship work that makes a measurable difference in how our customers run their operations.
Applying AI where it can genuinely change how work gets done. WFM is full of high-stakes, high-repetition decisions that have historically required deep expertise and manual effort. You'll define how AI makes those decisions faster, smarter, and more automated — turning reactive planning into something that anticipates problems before they happen.
Building for enterprise complexity. Your customers run 24/7 multi-channel, multi-site operations. You'll develop deep intuition for their constraints — SLAs, shrinkage, channel mix, BPO relationships — and make sure the product handles that complexity without adding friction.
Leading and mentoring junior PMs. As a senior member of the product team, you'll bring strategic leadership to how we build — helping raise the bar on product thinking, writing culture, and ways of working across the team

What Excites Us

5+ years of product management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS
Strong analytical and technical product skills: you love getting deep in the data and technical details, and you can quickly form and pressure-test perspectives on product tradeoffs
Experience at a growing, venture-backed startup where business needs and teams evolve quickly
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Customer-first mindset with strong discovery and communication skills to work directly with senior stakeholders as a representative of the company
Bias to action and an innate sense of urgency

Nice To Have

Experience building AI-powered product features in a practical, customer-value-driven way
Experience working closely with data science or ML teams to ship predictive optimization features

Our U.S. Benefits

Generous medical, dental, and vision benefits
Paid company holidays, sick time, and unlimited time off
Monthly credits to spend on each: professional development, general wellness, Assembled customers, and commuting
Paid parental leave
Onsite work model with catered lunches everyday (M–F), snacks, and beverages in our SF & NY offices

About Health Payment Systems, Inc. (HPS/PayMedix)

Health Payment Systems, Inc. (HPS/PayMedix), is redefining how people access and pay for healthcare. We bring together provider networks, payments and financing, and industry partners to remove financial barriers and simplify the healthcare experience for everyone involved.

Our team is solving one of the biggest challenges in healthcare: the flow of money and information between providers and consumers. The work we do improves access, reduces financial stress, and is reshaping how healthcare works at its most fundamental level.

Our solutions include:
HPS Network: a high-performing, independent provider network in Wisconsin that helps employers control costs while maintaining strong access to care.
PayMedix: a national healthcare payments platform that pays providers in full, consolidates medical information and billing, and offers members interest-free financing for all in-network costs
TempoPay: a flexible healthcare benefit solution that gives eligible individuals a simple, predictable way to pay for care over time, with zero interest or fees.

Join us in our mission to make the healthcare payments experience simpler, more transparent, and more connected – so people can focus on getting care when they need it, not when they think they can afford it.

About The Role

HPS/PayMedix is undergoing a major transformation of its payments ecosystem. As transaction volume scales rapidly, we are investing ahead of growth to consolidate vendors, streamline ledgering, increase operational efficiency, and further strengthen our enterprise-grade payments infrastructure.

We are hiring a dedicated Payments Product Manager
to drive the execution of this initiative. This role will focus on implementing a cleaner, more scalable, and strategically aligned payments architecture that supports card, ACH, virtual card, and emerging payment rails, while translating a defined modernization strategy into structured execution and measurable outcomes. This will help build the foundation for long-term enterprise value and scalable growth.

This role reports directly to the Chief Product & Innovation Officer and is fully remote.

Primary Responsibilities

Payments Infrastructure Execution: Create a multi-year roadmap that includes platform capabilities. Lead the implementation of a consolidated payments architecture across processors, banks, and ledger systems. Execute across authorization, settlement, batching, reconciliation, funding, payouts, and refunds/recoupments. Drive delivery through partnerships with finance, operations, compliance, engineering and executive leadership.

Ledgering & Reconciliation: Implement upgraded and outsourced ledgering capabilities that improve traceability, reporting accuracy, and auditability while reducing manual reconciliation and integrating claims, payments, and financial reporting.

Payment Rails Expansion & Innovation: Lead execution across RTP, FedNow, ACH, card, and virtual card programs, including routing logic, controls, reconciliation, and multi-rail requirements that improve flexibility, speed, and cost efficiency. Enhance provider, employer, external partner and member experience.

Vendor & Bank Integration Management: Own integration requirements and sequencing across processors, banks, and hybrid infrastructure partners, ensuring clean routing, scalability, flexibility, and support for advanced payout models.

Economics, Reliability & Scale: Improve authorization rates, returned payments, refunds, settlement timing, operational error rates, and cost per transaction while strengthening platform resilience and margin efficiency as volume grows.

Risk & Compliance: Ensure payment workflows meet applicable NACHA, card brand, sponsor bank, audit, and regulatory requirements while partnering with Compliance, Finance, and Operations toidentifyand mitigate risk early.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of Product Management experience in payments or fintech, including ownership of product roadmaps, product requirements, and direct partnership with engineering teams.

Experience in B2B and B2B2C payments environments with complex or intermediated money movement.

Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and lifecycle, including ACH, cards, payment gateways, merchant acquiring, ledgering, reconciliation, settlement, refunds, exceptions, chargebacks, and payment APIs.

Proven ability to build and scale payment capabilities across internal and external partners, including processors, banks, SaaS vendors, and cross-functional business and technology teams.

Key Attributes for Success

Cross-Functional Influence & Communication: Builds alignment across executives, technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners, translating complex payment concepts into clear decisions and actions.

Systems Thinking & Complexity Management: Understands end-to-end payment flows and how decisions across systems, vendors, ledgering, reconciliation, and operations impact one another.

Ownership & Execution in Ambiguity: Creates structure in complex or unclear environments, makes sound tradeoffs, and drives initiatives from requirements through successful delivery.

Other Important Details

Competitive salary and bonus depending on experience
Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA with company contribution, 401k/Roth with company match, 15 days of PTO, and more.

This is a remote position.

Opportunity Overview

The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Product Frameworks
is responsible for driving the end‑to‑end development and delivery of AI platform capabilities to support AI Product Managers across Edward Jones in the build, management, and retirement of AI Products from ideation through launch and ongoing optimization. This role translates business needs into actionable technical requirements, leads product discovery and validation efforts, and defines success metrics to evaluate product impact.

Unlike ‑Product Managers within the Digital Product Management organization, this role treats AI itself as the product
—owning firmwide, reusable, and scalable AI platform capabilities that power AI Product Manager experiences rather than discrete applications.

This role centers on strategy, discovery, and value framing, working closely with each Business and Functional area to shape AI direction, identify high‑value opportunities, and expand the art of the possible for how AI can transform their domain. Digital Product Managers will often serve as customers of the AI Product Manager, and leverage AI Products as part of their offerings. Digital Product Managers will remain accountable for the execution, delivery, and lifecycle management of AI capabilities within products and portfolios. The Director, AI Product Manager partners closely with Digital’s Product Management teams to ensure enterprise AI capabilities can be easily integrated, adopted, and leveraged across the firm.

This role ensures the adoption of responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory expectations, while clearly communicating progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. Working in collaboration with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas, the Director, AI Product Manager – AI Product Frameworks ensures that AI platform capabilities deliver measurable value, maintain performance through ongoing monitoring, and support firmwide strategic objectives through shared AI capability development. The role acts as a connector throughout the full product lifecycle—navigating ideation, discovery, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

This position sits within the AI Platform Team
inside EJ Labs
, focused on building and managing the reusable AI platform and marketplace capabilities that enable teams across the enterprise to discover, govern, scale, and consume AI products through a consistent, standards-based ecosystem, rather than developing one-off or front-end solutions.

What You'll Do

Translate business needs into clear and actionable technical requirements for AI Products models and agents - reusable AI capabilities.
Lead product discovery, validation, and iterative improvement processes with a focus on how AI models and agents will be embedded across many applications, tools, and internal teams.

Conduct research and engage internal customers to inform AI platform capabilities.

Collaborate with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas teams to test, deploy, and refine new AI model and agent capabilities and ensure alignment with enterprise AI standards.
Communicate product progress, updates, and outcomes to stakeholders across the organization.
Conduct market and user research to understand demand for reusable AI capabilities and anticipate model and agent centric enhancements.
Monitor and evaluate AI model and agent performance, implementing refinements as needed as part of ongoing product lifecycle management and governance.
Actively shape the definition and evolution of product AI capability vision and strategy in partnership with business and technology stakeholders to drive measurable business impact and outcome-oriented delivery.
Translate business goals, user insights, market trends, and product model and agent knowledge into product AI roadmaps, themes, initiatives, epics, and user stories—informing prioritization and hypothesis generation in collaboration with partners.
Support product delivery, adoption, and business impact through influence and collaboration, reinforcing outcome ownership while navigating shared accountability.
Collaborate with product leadership, delivery partners, and enabling teams to support resource coordination, delivery execution, and risk management across delivery teams.
Deploy and test new AI platform builder capabilities, ensuring reliability, explainability, and functional integration with a broad set of consuming systems and applications.
Own the lifecycle of AI platform builder capabilities—including versioning, performance monitoring, retraining plan development, and continuous improvement.
Ensure EJ Labs’ AI platform capabilities are adopted by the AI Product Managers across Knowledge, Models, Skills, and Agents.

7+ years’ experience in product management includes translating business needs into technical requirements and leading product discovery and validation.
3+ years' experience in AI/ML.
Strong understanding of AI technologies and financial services.

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Product Management - DV Marketplace Suite
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2008, DoubleVerify (DV) is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance by bringing transparency and accountability to the market and ensuring ad viewability, brand safety, fraud protection, accurate impression delivery and audience quality across campaigns to drive performance. DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies across every major vertical, including financial services, telecom, automotive, retail, CPG, travel, luxury and pharmaceuticals gain the most value out of their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital ecosystem. Let's build a better industry.

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Product Management — DV Marketplace Suite owns the product vision, strategy, roadmap and delivery for DVMS: DoubleVerify's solution for protecting and optimizing programmatic marketplaces. DVMS provides fraud/IVT protection, brand suitability and viewability measurement across desktop, mobile web, mobile app and CTV, helping platforms, exchanges and publishers ensure marketplace inventory is human, viewable and brand-safe. It is one of DV's fastest-growing businesses.

Your customers are the marketplaces themselves — SSPs, exchanges, ad networks and DSPs — who license DV's measurement and pre-bid capabilities to differentiate their supply to buyers. That makes this a distinctive product challenge: you are building for users who work inside someone else's platform, on someone else's release cycle, under commercial terms negotiated partner by partner. Success depends as much on integration design, packaging and partner economics as it does on features.

The role is highly cross-functional by design. DVMS is powered by capabilities that span the company — fraud detection, brand suitability, viewability, attention, pre-bid segment infrastructure, measurement tag foundations and data delivery. Turning that breadth into a coherent marketplace product, and building the partnerships across DV needed to deliver it, is the core of the job. This is a role for someone who excels at collaboration, relationship-building and ideating creative solutions.

You will lead a small, senior product team and be accountable for product strategy and execution that drives revenue growth: extending measurement into new quality dimensions, deepening supply-path and inventory-quality insight, bringing attention measurement to new marketplaces, leveraging AI-powered innovation, and expanding DV's reach across the programmatic ecosystem. You will set the strategy that keeps DVMS the market leader in a fast-moving and competitive category.

Job Responsibilities

Own and be accountable for the DVMS product vision, strategy, roadmap and revenue outcomes across the DV Marketplace Suite portfolio.
Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers; set the standard for discovery, prioritization and cross-organizational execution, and develop the next generation of product leaders on the team.
Grow the business through new and existing products — new invalid-traffic and quality measurement dimensions, supply path and inventory quality insights, attention measurement for marketplaces, and partner programs that extend reach into emerging and mid-tail supply.
Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the competitive landscape and ensure DVMS stays ahead of it across fraud, quality and supply transparency.
Build and sustain the cross-functional partnerships DVMS delivery depends on — securing clear commitments and a durable operating rhythm with the programmatic, measurement, classification, fraud and platform infrastructure teams whose capabilities power the suite.
Develop deep understanding of how SSPs, exchanges, ad networks and DSPs operate, monetize, and evaluate a measurement partner — and design DV's products to fit those realities.
Partner with Business Development and Platform Sales on pricing, packaging, contracting and revenue attribution for platform deals; support commercial teams in closing and expanding platform partnerships.
Own the product side of major marketplace partner relationships, including technical integration design, joint roadmap alignment, and executive-level partner reviews; partner with DV's Integrations organization on turnkey and custom integrations.
Own the product direction for the DVMS partner-facing interface and reporting experience.
Drive delivery velocity in close partnership with the dedicated DVMS engineering organization; establish clear requirements, make explicit prioritization decisions, and manage scope.
Partner with Product Marketing, Product Analytics, Revenue Operations and Finance on the business operations layer behind the product — usage tracking, rate application, product-level revenue attribution and product health reporting.
Represent DV in industry standards bodies and working groups relevant to supply-side and open measurement, and at industry events.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of total professional experience, including 7+ years in Product Management.
2+ years of people management experience with Product Managers as direct reports.
4+ years of product experience in the advertising technology ecosystem, with direct exposure to the marketplace side — SSPs, exchanges, ad networks, DSPs, or platform-side measurement and data integrations.
Demonstrated success delivering products through influence rather than direct authority — securing roadmap commitments and engineering capacity from teams outside your reporting line.
Experience owning technical integrations and joint roadmaps with third-party platforms, from design through launch and scaling.
Experience with media quality measurement — invalid traffic and fraud, brand safety and suitability, viewability or attention.
Demonstrated ownership of a product line with meaningful revenue accountability, including packaging and pricing input.
Superior data analysis skills; able to personally derive insight and action from data.
Experience partnering effectively with a distributed engineering organization, including across time zones and cultures.
Excellent written and verbal communication; credible with platform executives, engineers and internal senior leadership alike.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience at an SSP, exchange, ad network, DSP, mobile measurement partner, or curation platform.
Working knowledge of programmatic infrastructure — RTB, OpenRTB signals, supply path optimization, curation, prebid — and of mobile app and CTV supply ecosystems.
Experience with server-side and API-based measurement delivery models rather than tag-based only.
Experience building/developing a high-caliber product team.
Experience participating in or leading industry standards work (e.g. open measurement, IAB or AAO working groups).
Experience building the business operations layer for a growing platform business — usage tracking, rate application, revenue attribution and quote-to-cash.
Hands-on SQL and data analysis capability.
B.S. or higher in Computer Science, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV.

The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $219,000 - $336,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits.

jobs.description:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.

We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.

As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

What You'll Do

Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.
Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.
Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.
Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.
Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.
Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.
Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.
Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.

Who You Are

You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.
You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.
You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.
You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.
You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.
You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.
You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.
Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in New York or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $248,656 - $355,223, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. A core part of making this possible is predicting the future: How much will customers order? How long will new inventory take to arrive? What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more.

We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement.

We need your skills to help us push the boundaries of what's possible. Amazon's SCOT Forecasting team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager-Tech with a proven ability to influence across multiple organizations and drive innovation at scale. In this role, you will define and drive the long-term vision for both established and greenfield forecasting products within an ever-evolving supply chain landscape. You will partner closely with scientists and engineers to build interfaces for state-of-the-art deep learning-based systems that generate the predictions and estimates required to optimize Amazon's supply chain at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how we bring advanced science — including Deep Learning, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models — out of the lab and into production systems that serve Amazon's worldwide supply chain. And we're focused on doing it faster than ever

Key job responsibilities

Specifically, as a Sr PM-T in forecasting, you will be responsible for:

Working backwards from customer problems to define the 3-5 year vision for Forecasting products, and working with scientists and engineering to achieve that vision
Driving strategic communications (e.g. decision narratives, investment proposals)
Communicating, earning trust, and influencing stakeholders from multiple organizations
Working backwards from customers in the supply chain and business units to proactively identify opportunities
Experimenting and scaling new products and models from prototype to production worldwide
Diving into technical solutions and alternatives to understand areas of opportunity, defects, and customer needs

Drawing on familiarity with broadcast and OTT content delivery workflows, venue IoT and edge computing, and fan engagement platforms, you will guide stakeholders through emerging technologies — including generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, and modern data platforms. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that helps customers realize their desired business outcomes on the AWS Cloud. Working alongside customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN), we deliver focused guidance through specialty practices spanning a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

Owning the full engagement lifecycle for Sports, Media, and Entertainment customers: leading discovery sessions, defining target-state architectures, building proof-of-concept solutions, designing and implementing production-grade cloud solutions, and ensuring adherence to Well-Architected best practices

Description

Are you a strategic leader who thrives on ideating and building innovative, dollar-needle-moving campaigns from scratch that reshape how customers adopt GenAI? AWS is seeking a Principal Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist to own and evolve the worldwide GTM strategy for AI Inference through Amazon SageMaker AI. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise in distributed inference systems and sharp business judgment to set the strategic direction for SageMaker AI Inference adoption globally. You will identify whitespace opportunities, architect high-impact campaigns that move revenue at scale, and build repeatable mechanisms that the worldwide field organization can execute autonomously. You will operate with minimal context, rapidly synthesizing ambiguous signals from customers, product teams, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations absorbable by L10 leaders. You will challenge prevailing assumptions, pressure-test existing motions, and drive team-wide change that raises the bar on how AWS goes to market with AI Inference. You will take your insights from customer engagements and market intelligence to influence service evolution, roadmap prioritization, and long-term product strategy.

Key job responsibilities

You will bring your combined deep technical acumen in clustered computing frameworks/distributed systems and seasoned business judgment to architect the worldwide GTM strategy for Amazon SageMaker AI Inference. You will ideate and build innovative campaigns from scratch—identifying net-new market segments, designing quantified value propositions, and constructing self-service mechanisms that move the revenue needle at scale without requiring your direct involvement in every deal. You will operate as a force multiplier, elevating the productivity and value of Geo-aligned field teams, GenAI Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Marketing Managers by codifying best practices, creating high-leverage enablement frameworks, and mentoring specialists across geos to independently execute complex sales motions.

You will define and own the end-to-end sales motion strategy including customer segmentation frameworks, qualification criteria with quantitative thresholds, positioning of differentiated value through ROI models and competitive battle cards, and scalable mechanisms and campaigns that compress sales cycles. You will challenge existing assumptions about what works—pressure-testing current motions with data, killing underperforming plays, and replacing them with higher-ROI alternatives. You will execute selectively through high-signal direct customer engagements while building the playbooks, tooling, and enablement that empower Geo Data & AI specialists to prospect, develop pipeline, and close business independently worldwide.

As the principal authority on AI Inference GTM, you will synthesize complex technical and market dynamics into crisp, insight-driven narratives absorbable by L10 leaders and VP-level customer stakeholders alike. You will help customers reason through the landscape of AI Inference workloads (spanning agentic, real-time, batch, and traditional ML use cases), evaluate emerging open-source technologies versus native capabilities, and make sound cost/performance/quality trade-off decisions at scale. You will build and present compelling product demos, own the competitive positioning narrative, and handle objections with data-backed conviction from both internal AWS teams and external customers. You will architect the customer evidence flywheel—securing quotes, cultivating public references, and partnering with Marketing to build case studies that become self-sustaining demand generators. You will synthesize insights from outbound engagements, competitive intelligence, and market trends into written recommendations that directly influence service roadmap prioritization and long-term product strategy for AI Inference.

A day in the life

As the principal owner of a critical segment of the SageMaker AI business worldwide, you will context-switch fluidly across strategic and executional activities: You will analyze propensity models and market signals to identify the highest-leverage customer cohorts, then work with field leaders to architect engagement strategies that open doors to VP/C-level AI Platform stakeholders. You will lead consultative conversations with senior customer leaders, listening deeply to uncover latent needs, walking them through quantitative and qualitative differentiators with live demos, building custom TCO models, and securing commitment to workshops, PoVs, or PoCs. You will author and continuously refine the sales motion playbook—not just updating assets, but rethinking the underlying strategy based on win/loss analysis and shifting market dynamics. You will design and deliver enablement programs that make field teams self-sufficient, reducing dependency on central specialists. You will lead customer-facing webinars and represent SageMaker AI Inference at flagship AWS events. You will write crisp, insight-rich documents—product feedback memos backed by customer evidence, market landscape analyses, and strategic recommendations—that directly shape roadmap decisions in sessions with product leadership. You will proactively identify and drive team-wide improvements: new mechanisms, process changes, or strategic pivots that raise the bar for the entire GTM organization.

AWS is looking for a Product Manager to own and grow the Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA) program — a portfolio of assessment offerings spanning Microsoft, Database, Storage, and more. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution that keep the program delivering against its targets, setting annual goals, defining what success looks like, and steering the program as conditions change.

A core part of this role is turning data into decisions. You will use analytical tools to build and maintain tracking and reporting that gives the business visibility into assessment volume, pipeline, engagement, and delivery performance, then translate those insights into clear business recommendations on where to invest, what to prioritize, and how to course-correct. You will own forecasting so leadership has a reliable forward view for resourcing and planning. Beyond internal execution, you will manage the third-party vendor and partner relationships OLA depends on — covering roadmap alignment, incentive structures, invoicing, and commercial coordination — while partnering closely with sellers, partners, and customers to shape licensing and assessment strategies.

Key job responsibilities

Define and execute the OLA program strategy, owning the roadmap, annual goals, and delivery targets across multiple assessment offerings while identifying and negotiating complex partner and vendor deals.
Build and maintain reporting dashboards and forecasting models, interpreting data from analytical tools to surface actionable business recommendations that guide program investment and priorities.
Manage the lifecycle of third-party vendor and consulting partner relationships, including roadmap alignment, incentive design, invoicing, and commercial coordination.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Service teams, Field teams, and aligned Program teams to represent the OLA program in go-to-market strategy and contribute to planning documents.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

Overview

Search Platform is the retrieval and grounding foundation for Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. Our shared services turn Microsoft 365 knowledge into trusted, permission-aware evidence through indexing, retrieval and ranking, and grounding. Product teams across Microsoft consume them through Microsoft Graph and Work IQ, and relevance teams ship quality on top of them. Every Copilot answer, search result, and agent action is only as good as the evidence behind it, so our job is to make every quality gain land faster, cheaper, and everywhere, and to prove it with data everyone trusts.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager on the Enterprise Search and Grounding Platform team to drive strategy and execution to deliver Copilot and Agents quality gains.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

The strategy

Define the vision, multi-year roadmap, and success metrics for the Developer Experience pillar, anchored on the Search Platform north star: one trusted platform, tuned by scenario, with recall-forward, low-latency retrieval for agents.
Own product definition for the developer-facing API surface, including the next major version of our core retrieval API and the Work IQ and Retrieval API integration patterns, with a bias toward stable, scenario-agnostic contracts that outlive any single experience.
Decide what the platform should offer as a shared capability and what stays with individual agent teams, and drive the consolidation of bespoke integrations onto supported patterns.

Make the platform easy to build on

Design the onboarding path for a new agent team, from first call to production: reference integrations, documentation, samples, and self-serve tooling that remove the need for a bespoke engagement.
Treat debuggability as a product requirement. Specify the observability, tracing, and diagnostics developers need to understand why a query returned what it did and to fix issues without escalating to the platform team.
Translate agent needs into platform requirements for recall, latency budgets, and evidence formats, working with the Quality Improvements and Frontier Platform Innovation pillars so that recall-forward retrieval tuned for agents ships as part of the core platform.

Lead across the organization

Author crisp specs, requirements documents, and program plans; drive execution across multiple engineering teams and owners; and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership.
Represent Search Platform developer experience with senior stakeholders across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Work IQ, and partner organizations, landing decisions and aligning roadmaps.
Raise the bar for platform product management on the team by mentoring PMs and modeling data-driven, customer-obsessed decision making.

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development

This role will be based in San Francisco, Mountain View, Bellevue, or remote.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role may be remote or hybrid. jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Product Lead
jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in San Francisco, Mountain View, Bellevue, or remote.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. This role may be remote or hybrid. At LinkedIn, hybrid roles are performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. Remote roles are performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval.

What this role is

We are building the platform that a new kind of agents run on. These agents take on real work inside a company: sourcing candidates, qualifying pipeline, handling RFPs, keeping operations moving. You will bring the right agents to the right customers, across a wide range of work.

Our go-to-market is still taking shape, and we are looking for someone with enough versatile business acumen to plug in and help create it.

The work will be a combination of three things: working directly with customers, working with cross-team and external partners, and turning what you learn in those rooms into elastic workforce playbooks. Those playbooks serve us internally, and they serve customers and partners driving AI transformation in their own organizations and with their customers. Expect a lot of discovery, and a lot of systematizing what you discover.

What you will own

Work with customers on their real deployments, and stay close enough to see what actually happens after the pilot.
Work with partners on how our agents reach and land in their accounts.
Turn those interactions into repeatable playbooks: what to deploy first, what to measure, what to expect, what to avoid.
Feed what you learn back into the product, so the next customer starts further along than the last one.
You will operate at all altitudes depending on what is needed: sourcing leads and closing deals, working directly with customers on deployments, collaborating on our pricing and packaging structure, and building playbooks for all of the above

How we work

Small team, real customers, short cycles. If you want a defined territory and an established playbook, this is not it. If you want to write the playbook, it is.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role
The judgment that comes with principal-level scope. You can set direction in an area that does not have one yet, and other people can follow it.
Business judgment that travels. You can move between a customer conversation, a partner discussion, and an internal roadmap review without losing the thread.
A bias toward systematizing. You do not just solve the problem in front of you, you write down how it is solved.
You are able to simplify. You have good judgment about what to leave out, and you make complicated systems feel obvious.
Ability to bring order, calm, and maturity to messy situations.

Product Management
Go-To-Market
External Customer Engagement

jobs.title: Principal Product Strategist, Commerce
jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.

We are looking for a Principal Product Strategist, Commerce
to own the analytical and narrative spine of Commerce strategy: the person who can look across the whole agentic-commerce field and our position in it, size the opportunity, name the bet, and prove the business model works — then write it so it lands in the room.

This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.

In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:

Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM → SAM → capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

Own a current, first-principles POV on the agentic-commerce market, the protocol landscape (for example ACP, UCP, AP2, MCP), and where Microsoft’s advantage is real.
Design and pressure-test monetization: the payer model across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner, the methods, and the sequencing.
Build the opportunity models and forecasts that let the org rank bets and defend investment asks with numbers, including ARR- and ROI-based justification.
Bring repeatable decision frameworks to major product bets so the reasoning is structured and legible.
Synthesize the Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments threads into one coherent strategy and surface where they conflict.
Turn the analysis into the strategy spine — the MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, and investment cases — and prep the VP with a sharp POV and the two or three things that would change it.
Operate as a peer to senior leaders: form a POV, defend it, and change it on evidence.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Master's Degree in Business Administration or related field AND 4+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Liberal Arts, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in Business Administration or related field AND 8+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Liberal Arts, Computer Science, or related field AND 12+ years marketing, strategy, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience
OR equivalent experience.

10+ years in product strategy, corporate strategy, strategy consulting, investing (PE / VC / banking), or a strategy-heavy product leadership role, with depth on platform or marketplace businesses.
Business-model & monetization judgment: a demonstrated record of reasoning from first principles about who pays and why, and designing monetization that works. (Primary screen.)
Opportunity sizing & forecasting: can build a credible market or monetization model from the ground up and defend every assumption.
Decision frameworks: a track record of bringing structure to large, ambiguous product or investment decisions.
Commerce domain depth: genuine fluency in the economics of retail, marketplaces, and payments — productive on day one.
Narrative synthesis: turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible story that moves a senior room. (Close-second screen.)
Excellent communication and executive-influence skills.
Direct experience in agentic commerce, digital payments, or commerce platforms, and familiarity with the emerging commerce-protocol landscape.
Fluency in AI / LLM product economics and how they reshape unit costs and monetization.
Experience shaping investment or funding cases that cleared a senior bar.

Description

Amazon Devices – the team behind the best-selling Amazon Echo, Alexa, Kindle E-reader, Fire Tablet, Fire TV, Cloud Cam and Dash Button product lines—is seeking a seasoned product manager to join the Devices Pricing and Promotions team to help lead our pricing strategy and systems.

Our organization’s vision is to use science to automate forecasting, allocation, marketing, pricing and purchasing decisions for the Devices business. We build science and technology to create Hands Off the Wheel systems that automate digital marketing planning, creating operating and financial efficiencies for Amazon Devices. We are an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

We are looking for an experienced Sr Product Manager - Technical to tackle complex and ambiguous marketing optimization and automation problems that span numerous systems and organizations across the Devices business (Echo Device Family, FireTV, eReaders, Tablets etc.). They will be a highly visible individual that will own the communication, coordination, and execution of a long-term, multi-year product vision. As a Sr. Product Manager over our marketing planning workflow tools, you’ll partner with our team of research scientists, data scientists, economists, and developers to build out the next generation of marketing optimization and automation.

Key job responsibilities

As an ideal candidate, you have a passion to understand the interplay of our different marketing strategies to fuel scale and automation. You are responsible for defining and driving our product roadmaps. You will work with product line teams, forecasting teams, in-house scientists, data-engineers, economists, software teams, and product line marketers to identify new features and projects. As a product strategist, you must analyze the potential customer and financial implications, select the most promising ideas, prioritize them and create a cohesive roadmap. You will also evangelize new features to our internal customers, working to accelerate their adoption, track the impacts, and communicate results with senior leaders.

This is a highly visible position. You must have the experience and capability to prepare documentation for senior executives and align your roadmap with Devices strategic objectives. Excellent written, verbal communication and data analytical skills are a necessity. Successful candidates should thrive in a highly collaborative, creative, analytical, and fast-paced environment oriented around delivering better prices to customers worldwide. You will excel at looking around corners, and anticipating where to build and when to test to fail fast.

A day in the life

Define the multi-year vision for the space
Build and manage high quality product roadmaps based on your vision and strategy
Work backwards to determine what the initial building blocks to achieve that vision will be
Work with key business stakeholders, engineering partner teams, Pricing Research, and Central Econ to build out requirements for the different phases
Work with our in-house engineering team to build and innovate in the space
Manage prioritization and trade-offs for speed to launch, performance, and features
Gain support for your strategy and roadmap from stakeholders by writing narratives and influencing peers and senior leadership

Creating program goals and related metrics, track progress and manage through obstacles to achieve your objectives

Drive adoption of pricing science across organization with key stakeholders, including product line teams and functional partner teams.

5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS)'s Analytics Engineering organization is seeking a Senior Product Manager - Tech to define and execute the private pricing strategy for AWS's foundational Storage and Analytics services. These services—spanning object storage, block storage, file systems, data streaming, processing and analytics—form the critical data infrastructure layer that underpins virtually every enterprise cloud architecture, and increasingly, the AI and machine learning workloads reshaping them. As generative AI accelerates demand for large-scale data storage, high-throughput processing, and real-time streaming pipelines, these services represent some of AWS's largest and fastest-growing business lines. You will shape the pricing product roadmap and cross-functional execution required to drive service adoption and revenue growth at scale.
You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, pricing economics, and customer engagement—translating deep technical understanding into pricing constructs that accelerate cloud adoption, simplify complex pricing constructs and cloud migrations.

Key job responsibilities

Pricing Strategy & Product Roadmap

Own and evolve the end-to-end private pricing strategies for AWS Storage and Analytics services, including pricing model design, private deal structuring, and service-level approval frameworks for specialized and custom engagements.
Define and prioritize the pricing product roadmap, partnering with Engineering teams to build new private pricing features, automation capabilities, and scalable pricing constructs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Drive cross-functional alignment across Go-to-Market (GTM), Finance, Strategic Customer Engagement (SCE), -Legal, Service Teams, and Account Teams to evaluate pricing strategies, structure complex deals, and identify growth initiatives. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager (Tech), SCOT-AIM
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s SCOT-BizOps AI team is looking for an experienced Sr Product Manager (Tech) to conceptualize, articulate, and develop state of the art technology to measure and improve the shopping experience of every Amazon customer. The BizOps-AI team is a part of Amazon’s Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) organization, whose charter is to deliver the best possible customer experience and improve supply chain outcomes while maximizing the return on our inventory investment, fulfillment assets, and transportation network. We are never satisfied with the status quo and are convinced that there is always opportunity to innovate on behalf of customers.

Unlike brick and mortar stores where it is challenging to capture customer interest in a product unless they actually purchase the item, e-commerce offers the unique advantage of capturing customer "glance views" even if they don't convert to sales. Glance views, or GVs, are a leading indicator of potential future demand and allow us to capture a comprehensive set of data points (eg. price, delivery speed) to understand what we showed the customer and the resultant customer behavior. Amazon uses GV data to metricize and improve key performance indicators for customer experience like availability and promised delivery speed.

The person in this role will own Tier-1 CX and Supply chain metrics that provide stakeholders across Amazon with deep insights to identify and resolve defects. These metrics answer questions like: Was Amazon in stock on an item when customers were viewing it? Was the inventory in a location from where it could be immediately picked, packed, and shipped out to the customer? If not, what was the root cause? Your products will simplify the Business operations associated with these metrics, right from extracting insights from data, identifying opportunities for improvement, working with partner teams to deliver automated and scalable solutions, and providing regular performance/progress updates to stakeholders. You will build AI-powered solutions to automate repetitive tasks such as insight generation, identifying defects, debugging issues, developing/improving solutions for new use-cases and deploying fixes in production. This will involve managing the data infrastructure, software applications and CX interfaces.

The products you build will have a worldwide user base, spanning across multiple organizations that play a role in Amazon’s supply chain and the shopping experience we deliver to customer. You will own the process of first understanding what information is valuable to our internal customers and then working closely with our business intelligence, data engineering, and research science teams to deliver products that meet our customers’ needs in the long term. You will always be challenged to think several steps ahead so that the solutions you are building today will scale well with future growth and without adding excessive operational overhead. You will help define the product roadmap, serve as the voice of the customer, and champion your products across Amazon. You will work with worldwide retail category and supply chain operations teams, in-house scientists, other product managers, and software teams to define new features and products. You will analyze the potential customer and financial impacts, select the most promising ideas, prioritize them, and create a cohesive roadmap that makes the best use of available resources. You will also evangelize new features to our internal customers, working to accelerate feature adoption, track the realized impacts, and communicate results with senior leadership.

This is a highly visible role and will require regular interaction and communication with senior leaders. You must have the experience and capability to prepare documentation for senior executives and align your roadmap with Amazon’s strategic objectives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are a necessity. Successful candidates should excel at diving into data in order to analyze problems and implement simple, long term solutions. You will have the opportunity to thrive in a highly collaborative, creative, analytical, and fast-paced environment oriented around building the world’s most flexible and effective supply chain management technology.
