Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description: Product Management Director - Salesforce Success Plans

About The Team

The Customer Success (CS) Success Plan product management organization is responsible for managing Salesforce’s Customer Success Plan offer portfolio (Standard, Premier, and Signature Success Plans) with which we enable our customers to realize value from their Salesforce technology investments. We work backward from the customer to address their needs across all customer segments (Small Business, Commercial, and Enterprise) and across all Salesforce products. The team is the “voice of the customer and market” to the rest of the CS organization and we work across all functions within CS and the Salesforce product organizations to continuously enhance the customer value and experience delivered by the Success Plans offer portfolio.

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Management Director to build, justify, and operationalize changes to our Success Plans offers. This senior individual contributor (IC) role owns the path from evidence to execution: grounding decisions in customer and stakeholder research, developing and presenting the business cases — financial modeling included — that earn senior leadership alignment, and then owning the operating discipline that keeps those offers accountable once they're live, including feedback loops, performance reporting, and V2MOM updates. You'll also keep a close eye on industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's AI roadmap, translating what you see into concrete implications, and drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers in market.

Ideal candidates have deep Salesforce platform knowledge, proven Product Management experience (ideally in Customer Success), a strong record of turning strategy into actionable roadmaps, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

What You'll Do

Conduct customer and stakeholder research to understand needs, analyze feedback, and drive innovation.
Act as a thought leader and craft clear, concise and unbiased point of view documents on necessary changes to features, the portfolio, and the go-to-market (GTM) model.
Develop and present business cases for new offers or enhancements, including financial modeling, and secure senior leadership alignment.
Drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers
Own the operating rhythm behind the offer: feedback loops, offer performance reporting, and V2MOM updates, so the team stays accountable to its goals.
Stay ahead of industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Salesforce's own AI roadmap so you can proactively flag implications to Success Plans

Ideal Candidate Profile

Deep Salesforce Knowledge: You have a strong working knowledge of Salesforce products and a keen understanding of how enterprise software companies go to market.
A First-Principles Thinker: You don't just accept the status quo. You excel at breaking down ambiguous, complex business problems into their fundamental components and reassembling them into a coherent solution that is defensible with data.
Connect the Dots: You excel at systems thinking and can anticipate the second and third-order effects of a strategic decision. You naturally see how a change in one part of the business impacts another.
Proven Strategist: You have a background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a product management role that was heavily focused on monetization and business strategy. You have a portfolio of work that demonstrates your ability to drive significant strategic change.
Exceptional Communicator: You are a clear, concise writer and presenter. You can create the definitive document that persuades executives and aligns disparate teams on a complex issue.
Problem-Solver at Heart: You are not content to simply identify problems; you are driven to design the solution and see it through.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management or Strategy, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
10+ years of product management experience, including packaging/pricing of B2B SaaS support, success, or services offerings
Track record owning a product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, GTM enablement, and post-launch iteration
Strong cross-functional influence skills — comfortable driving alignment across Sales, CS, and Marketing without direct reporting lines
Experience with subscription/tiered pricing models and customer retention/adoption metrics
Familiarity with how AI and agentic technologies (e.g., Agentforce) are changing customer adoption, enablement, and support needs — and how that translates into offer GTM decisions

Preferred Requirements

M.B.A.
Experience building or evolving offers/programs tied to AI-driven products, including how to measure and support customer success with agentic or generative AI capabilities

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

This position is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, development, and performance of a portfolio of Treasury Management products and solutions serving Business Banking, Middle Market, Corporate Banking, and Institutional clients. The Senior Treasury Management Product Manager serves as a key strategic partner to Commercial Banking, Treasury Sales, Operations, Technology, Digital, Risk Management, Compliance, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership. Through influence and collaboration, this role leads cross-functional initiatives that enhance client experience, strengthen market competitiveness, and support the bank's growth strategy. While sales and relationship management teams own client acquisition and portfolio growth activities, this role owns product strategy, governance, lifecycle management, and the capabilities that enable sustainable Treasury Management growth across the organization. This position can be remote within our operational footprint.

As Part Of This Role You Will

Treasury Management Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership
Develop, lead, and continuously evolve product strategies that support enterprise Treasury Management, Commercial Banking, and Payments objectives.
Own the strategic roadmap for assigned Treasury Management products and capabilities, including prioritization of investments, enhancements, integrations, and innovation initiatives.
Align product strategy with enterprise growth objectives related to deposits, fee income, client acquisition, relationship expansion, and digital adoption.
Identify market opportunities through analysis of client behavior, industry trends, competitive intelligence, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies.
Develop business cases, investment recommendations, and strategic proposals supporting product growth and modernization initiatives.
Establish measurable performance objectives that evaluate product effectiveness, client value, market competitiveness, and financial contribution.

Product Lifecycle Management & Innovation

Partner with Technology, Operations, Digital Banking, and external vendors to implement product enhancements, new capabilities, and platform improvements.
Drive innovation initiatives involving real-time payments, embedded banking, artificial intelligence, API integration, fraud prevention, and digital treasury solutions.

Promote continuous improvement through modernization of product capabilities, service delivery models, and digital experiences.

Client Experience & Market Leadership

Lead efforts to gather and analyze client feedback, market intelligence, industry research, and competitive insights.

Support significant client opportunities, complex treasury solution design, request-for proposal responses, and strategic relationship initiatives.
Ensure relationship managers and Treasury Management officers have the tools, resources, and product expertise necessary to serve clients effectively.
Collaborate with Marketing and Sales leadership to increase awareness, adoption, and market penetration of Treasury Management solutions.

Enterprise Leadership & Cross-Functional Execution
Lead cross-functional initiatives involving Payments, Commercial Banking, Technology, Operations, Risk Management, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, Digital, Information Security, and external partners.
Establish governance processes, decision-making frameworks, and prioritization models that support effective product management and execution.
Drive alignment across stakeholder groups to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
Influence enterprise decisions regarding product investments, client experience improvements, technology modernization, and business growth opportunities.
Build strong partnerships across business lines to support long-term Treasury Management objectives.

Financial Performance & Business Management

Develop and maintain scorecards, dashboards, and executive reports evaluating product health and business outcomes.
Analyze pricing, profitability, market penetration, and client utilization trends to identify opportunities for optimization.
Evaluate return on investment for product initiatives and make recommendations regarding future investments and strategic priorities.

Partner with Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Audit, Fraud Prevention, and Information Security teams to assess and mitigate product-related risks.
Ensure Treasury Management products comply with applicable banking regulations, payment network requirements, and internal policies.
Lead product responses to regulatory changes, audit findings, and evolving industry requirements.
Oversee vendor management activities and third-party relationships impacting Treasury Management products and services.

Leadership & Organizational Development
Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Treasury Management team members.
Contribute to departmental strategy, talent development, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Establish repeatable product management practices, governance standards, and operating routines that support scalable growth across the Treasury Management organization.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Management, Information Systems, or related field.
Minimum of six (6) years of experience in Treasury Management, Payments, Product Management, Commercial Banking, Cash Management, or related financial services disciplines.
Minimum of three (3) years leading strategic product initiatives within a complex banking environment.
Demonstrated experience managing product portfolios, strategic roadmaps, and enterprise-level initiatives.
Strong knowledge of Treasury Management products, payment systems, commercial banking services, and liquidity management solutions.
Experience working across large, matrixed organizations and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong business acumen, analytical capabilities, and financial management skills.
Proven ability to develop and execute product strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
Excellent communication, presentation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience within a large regional, super-regional, or national financial institution.
Deep expertise in ACH, Wire Transfer, RTP, FedNow, Commercial Card, Lockbox, Integrated Receivables, Integrated Payables, Merchant Services, Positive Pay, Account Analysis, International Payments, and Liquidity Management.
Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), Accredited ACH Professional (AAP), Accredited Payments Risk Professional (APRP), or similar industry certification.

jobs.title: Principal Product Lead
jobs.description:
Unissant, Inc. delivers innovative capabilities to the agencies that keep our nation healthy and safe. We apply our domain expertise, data acumen, and technology know-how to achieve breakthrough results for our clients. Working collaboratively, we advance missions and careers through a focus on honesty, integrity, and dependability. We continuously look for talent excited to join that effort. To learn more about our exciting organization, please visit us at www.unissant.com.

We are seeking a Principal Product Lead
to join our team and support our government client on a large, multi-year IT services program.

The Principal Product Lead is accountable for program roadmap ownership, intake-to-prioritization governance, user and stakeholder alignment, value management, and sequencing of cross-team product work. This role will work closely with government stakeholders, program leadership, agile delivery teams, engineering, data, architecture, cybersecurity, and operations teams to ensure that product investments are aligned to mission needs, prioritized transparently, planned effectively, and delivered in measurable increments of value.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on product leader with demonstrated experience leading enterprise product management and product delivery on a large federal IT services program. They bring deep expertise in product strategy, roadmap management, stakeholder engagement, intake and prioritization, customer discovery, backlog management, agile product delivery, value measurement, and cross-functional leadership.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own, maintain, communicate, and continuously refine the program-level product roadmap in alignment with government mission priorities, contractual objectives, user needs, technical constraints, architecture, security, data, and operational requirements.
Establish and operate the intake-to-prioritization governance process for new requests, enhancements, mission needs, defects, technical investments, policy-driven changes, and emerging opportunities.
Define transparent intake criteria, evaluation methods, prioritization frameworks, decision rights, and governance forums to ensure that product work is assessed consistently and aligned to mission value.
Partner with government stakeholders, end users, program leadership, product owners, architects, engineering leads, data leads, cybersecurity leads, and operations teams to identify needs, clarify outcomes, and resolve competing priorities.
Translate mission objectives, user needs, policy requirements, operational constraints, and stakeholder feedback into clear product strategies, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable objectives.
Lead cross-team product planning and sequencing to ensure work is delivered in a logical order that accounts for dependencies, architecture decisions, data readiness, security requirements, capacity, release schedules, and operational readiness.
Manage and continuously refine product backlogs, ensuring that planned work is sufficiently defined, prioritized, traceable, measurable, and ready for delivery teams.
Drive user and stakeholder alignment through discovery sessions, workshops, interviews, demonstrations, feedback reviews, roadmap discussions, and decision forums.
Define and monitor product value measures, outcomes, adoption indicators, user satisfaction measures, operational impacts, delivery progress, and other metrics that demonstrate mission value.
Ensure product priorities balance user needs, mission outcomes, technical feasibility, security and privacy requirements, delivery risk, cost, quality, sustainability, and contractual obligations.
Coordinate product work across multiple teams, work streams, vendors, and stakeholder organizations; actively identify and manage product dependencies, assumptions, risks, and decision points.
Support Program Increment Planning, release planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, inspect-and-adapt activities, and other Agile delivery events.
Ensure product documentation and decision artifacts support client oversight, auditability, program transition, institutional knowledge retention, and delivery-team execution.
Communicate product strategy, roadmap changes, prioritization decisions, trade-offs, performance information, risks, and recommendations clearly to government and program leadership.
Facilitate timely resolution of product-related escalations, scope questions, competing stakeholder priorities, and cross-team dependencies.
Identify opportunities to improve the program's product operating model, intake processes, prioritization methods, customer engagement practices, roadmap transparency, value measurement, and delivery outcomes.
Perform other duties as assigned in support of program priorities and client needs.

Work Experience And Job Skills

Demonstrated experience serving as a Principal Product Lead, Product Director, Product Management Lead, Senior Product Manager, Product Owner Lead, or comparable senior product leadership role on a federal IT services program supporting 80 or more FTEs.
Deep expertise in product strategy, product roadmaps, product discovery, customer and stakeholder engagement, intake management, prioritization, backlog management, release planning, and value measurement.
Experience establishing and operating product intake and prioritization governance across multiple teams, work streams, vendors, or stakeholder organizations.
Experience converting government mission needs, user needs, business objectives, policy requirements, and operational requirements into actionable product strategies, roadmaps, epics, features, and delivery backlogs.
Demonstrated experience balancing competing priorities and making transparent, evidence-based product sequencing and prioritization recommendations.
Experience leading stakeholder workshops, user discovery activities, requirements elicitation, product demonstrations, roadmap reviews, and decision-making forums.
Strong understanding of Agile and SAFe product-management practices, including product ownership, Program Increment Planning, backlog refinement, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, and iterative delivery.
Experience defining product outcomes and using qualitative and quantitative measures to evaluate value, adoption, user experience, operational impact, and delivery performance.
Experience working with software engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, data, analytics, AI/ML, architecture, DevSecOps, operations, and program-management teams.
Experience using product and agile work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, ServiceNow, Productboard, Aha!, or comparable platforms.
Strong analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, negotiation, conflict-resolution, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment while effectively coordinating priorities and decisions across distributed teams.
Prior experience supporting government client programs in a comparable mission or technical domain is preferred.
Experience supporting federal modernization, cloud migration, enterprise data, digital services, cybersecurity, systems integration, or large-scale technology transformation programs is preferred.
Experience with human-centered design, customer experience, service design, digital transformation, analytics-informed product management, or AI-enabled product capabilities is preferred.

Education

Bachelor's Degree is required.
Preferred fields of study include Business Administration, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Product Management, Operations Management, Public Administration, or a related field.
MBA or Master's Degree in a relevant field of study is preferred.

Certificates, Licenses and Registrations

Relevant product-management, Agile, and program-management certifications are preferred.
Preferred certifications include SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), Project Management Professional (PMP), Pragmatic Institute product certifications, Certified Product Manager, or comparable product-management, Agile, and delivery-management credentials.

Communication Skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to present product strategies, roadmaps, prioritization recommendations, value measures, risks, trade-offs, and delivery plans to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Ability to communicate mission needs, user needs, product decisions, complex delivery dependencies, and product performance clearly to executive leadership, government clients, program management, delivery teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to write clear, concise, and well-organized product documentation, roadmaps, requirements, backlog artifacts, decision records, reports, and related content in a highly confidential manner.

Clearance Requirements

S. citizenship or eligibility to obtain a government PIV credential is required.
Ability to successfully complete a federal background investigation and receive a federal suitability determination is required.
Ability to obtain and maintain required client access credentials and any applicable clearance is required.
Ability to satisfy E-Verify employment eligibility verification requirements is required.

Travel

This position is primarily remote.
The client may direct or approve occasional in-person participation for planning, transition, training, meetings, workshops, or other program events.

Environmental Requirements

Mainly a routine office environment.
May be required to lift up to ten (10) pounds.
Must be flexible in working extended hours when required to support program priorities, critical delivery milestones, and client needs.

roduct management, technology partnerships, and enterprise cloud ecosystems .

Chief Product Officer

Product

THE OPPORTUNITY

Harrison Gray Search is partnering with a nationally recognized, fee-only, majority employee-owned RIA to identify a Senior Product Manager. Our client is investing meaningfully in its technology platform to support a growing, geographically distributed advisor base, and this role owns the roadmap for one of the firm's core product pods. It sits at the intersection of business strategy, advisor experience, and engineering execution, and reports directly to the Chief Product Officer.
The firm recently appointed its Chief Product Officer and is building its product organization from the ground up. The central initiative is an internal advisor platform that consolidates the 15 to 20 systems advisors use daily (portfolio management, financial planning, custodial, CRM, and meeting tools) into a single firm-owned data layer and advisor experience, with an AI-driven intelligence layer on top. A pilot launches this fall, with firm-wide rollout planned for early 2027. These are the first product hires in that organization.
The firm is hiring for up to three Senior Product Managers, each aligned to a distinct pod: the core advisor platform, business analytics and reporting (including Power BI dashboarding and marketing/digital lead data), and the AI intelligence layer (agents, model governance, and cost optimization). Candidates should indicate which pod best fits their background.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Product Manager leads the roadmap, development, and enhancement of technology solutions that support the wealth management business. As a privately held Registered Investment Advisor, our client is committed to delivering exceptional client experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and fiduciary-driven advice.
The Senior Product Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy, sets and defends priorities directly with business leadership, and partners with engineering (in-house and outsourced), operations, compliance, and advisors across a growing and geographically distributed advisor base. This role requires seasoned product management judgment, the ability to navigate ambiguity in an early-stage product organization, and a strong understanding of financial services technology and regulatory constraints.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Own and defend the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the assigned pod's internally developed and third-party integrated applications
Set pod-level OKRs and align initiatives with the firm's strategic objectives, advisor needs, client experience goals, and regulatory requirements
Identify and champion opportunities to automate workflows, improve operational efficiency, and create competitive differentiation through technology
Develop and present business cases, trade-off analyses, and success metrics for major product initiatives, including resourcing asks

Product Development

Translate ambiguous or competing business requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications
Own backlog prioritization for the pod based on business value, customer impact, technical feasibility, and regulatory considerations
Partner with engineering leads, including outsourced development partners, throughout the Agile development lifecycle, including scoping and sequencing multi-quarter initiatives
Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing, user acceptance, and product releases for the pod
Establish quality bars and iterate based on continuous feedback and usage data

Stakeholder Management

Serve as the pod's primary liaison between business leadership and technology teams
Act as the product partner to the pod's business-leadership counterpart, jointly accountable for adoption outcomes
Engage advisors, operations, compliance, client service, and executive leadership directly to gather feedback and validate priorities
Facilitate workshops, product demonstrations, and roadmap reviews for cross-functional and executive audiences
Communicate product strategy, timelines, risks, and release plans to stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership

User Experience & Process Improvement

Analyze advisor workflows across a diverse, geographically distributed advisor base and identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve usability
Leverage customer feedback, analytics, and operational metrics to drive product enhancements and prioritization decisions
Champion user-centered design principles and drive adoption of new capabilities across offices

Vendor & Platform Management

Own relationships with third-party technology providers and integration partners relevant to the pod, including contract and renewal discussions
Evaluate new technology solutions, lead build-vs-buy analysis, and recommend enhancements to the firm's technology ecosystem
Direct API integrations and data exchange between portfolio management, CRM, custodial, financial planning, and reporting systems

Compliance & Risk Management

Partner with Compliance, Information Security, and Legal teams to ensure the pod's products meet applicable regulatory requirements
Incorporate security, privacy, and governance requirements into product planning from the outset of major initiatives
Own audit readiness and documentation for the pod's technology initiatives

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

No formal direct reports. As the product team scales, provides mentorship, technical and product guidance, and work-in-progress review for Product Managers or Associate Product Managers within the pod, and may lead hiring and onboarding for pod-level product roles.

ROLE-SPECIFIC PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Own pod-level roadmap outcomes and OKRs, delivering high-quality software products on time and within scope
Improve operational efficiency through automation and workflow optimization across the pod's product area
Enhance client and advisor experience through intuitive digital capabilities, measured by adoption and satisfaction metrics
Ensure solutions comply with required and desired regulatory compliance, with minimal escalations from audit or compliance review
Represent the pod credibly and independently in front of executive leadership

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree a plus.

Experience

Product management, business analysis, or technology product ownership experience within an RIA, wealth management, broker-dealer, or wealthtech organization. Familiarity with how advisors work and what advisory leadership needs from technology is required.
5+ years of software product management experience is the target, including demonstrated ownership of a product area or roadmap with minimal oversight. The firm will consider less experienced candidates with a strong wealth background and exceptional track record.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and product management methodologies, with experience shaping process for a team rather than only following it
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to and influencing executive stakeholders
Experience translating complex, sometimes competing business requirements into technical solutions and defensible trade-offs
Demonstrated ability to operate independently in an ambiguous, early-stage environment

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with advisor technology platforms such as Tamarac, Orion, Salesforce, eMoney, MoneyGuide, trading, document management, and client portals
Knowledge of custodial platforms and financial data integrations, including data aggregation or data lake initiatives
For the analytics pod: Power BI and digital marketing analytics experience
For the intelligence pod: experience shipping AI agents or LLM-based features, including governance, model tuning, and cost management
Experience mentoring or informally leading other product managers
Experience integrating or migrating technology stacks following an acquisition or merger

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary of $130,000 to $180,000, commensurate with experience
Annual team-based incentive/bonus opportunity
Equity ownership opportunity following demonstrated performance in the role
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage effective day one
HSA/FSA options, company-paid life, AD&D, and disability
401(k) with company match (Roth and Traditional)
Generous PTO, at least 10 paid holidays, parental leave, summer hours

WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY

Direct roadmap ownership for a core product pod at a nationally recognized RIA at meaningful scale
Direct report to a newly appointed Chief Product Officer, with executive-level visibility and influence over the firm's technology strategy
Ground-floor role in a product organization being built now, with a defined platform initiative and launch timeline
Majority employee-owned firm with meaningful long-term equity upside for team members who perform
Modern product org: pods, OKRs, Agile, direct partnership with business-leadership counterparts

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Hardware
jobs.description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is building the world's most accessible robotics platform to bring advanced automation into manufacturing and beyond, with intuitive hardware and software that empower human productivity.

Overview

Industrial hardware has been slow-moving and hard to iterate on for decades. We're trying to change that—bringing a consumer-grade pace of iteration and craft to a world that hasn't seen much of either. Most hardware products ship once and live with their decisions for years. Ours need to move fast, get into the field, get tested against reality, and improve—because a robot that doesn't hold up on a factory floor doesn't just frustrate a customer, it stops their production line.

We're looking for a Hardware PM who is a builder first. Someone who wants to own a product from a blank sheet of paper through to a customer relying on it every day. Someone who understands the market well enough to know what's worth building, and who treats every prototype as a question to be answered rather than an answer to be defended. Someone with product sense and taste who can tell the difference between "ships" and "good.”

What You Will Do

Own product discovery, strategy, and delivery for a hardware product area from 0-1—from market insight and concept through to a shipped, supportable product.
Build a sharp point of view on the market: who the customer is, what they're solving for today, where competitors fall short, and where the real opportunity is.
Drive iterative testing loops - prototype, test against real-world conditions, learn, and revise quickly.
Go deep on customer problems -talk to users, visit sites, understand how hardware actually gets used in the field.
Define what we're building and why, with clear specs and requirements that engineers can run with.
Work hands-on with mechanical, electrical, and firmware engineers to make trade-offs between cost, manufacturability, performance, and schedule.
Collaborate with design and engineering to de-risk assumptions early, before they're expensive to fix.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in hardware product management, ideally with hands-on experience building robotics products.
Experience taking a hardware product from 0-1 - from early concept and market validation through to a released product.
You're comfortable running iterative test-and-learn cycles with physical prototypes, not just software.
You've built and shipped things you're proud of - not just managed process.
You think critically about customer and market problems and can break down ambiguity into structured decisions.
You have design and engineering sense and care about craft - you notice when something is off and it bothers you.
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

Mechanical engineering degree (or related discipline), with real hands-on design or build experience.
Experience running structured tests on physical products - DOE, prototype validation, reliability or environmental testing.
Familiarity with CAD tools (SolidWorks, Fusion 360), DFM/DFA and manufacturing processes (injection molding, sheet metal, CNC), and electromechanical systems, motors, or controls - enough to read a drawing, sanity-check tolerances (GD&T), and make informed trade-offs with engineers.
Prior experience at a robotics, automation, or industrial equipment company, with a feel for how that market evaluates and buys products.
Startup experience owning a product end-to-end across both hardware and software, without staying confined to one discipline.

Compensation And Benefits

The salary range for this role is $160,000 to $225,000, depending on experience. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

Compensation Range: $160K - $225K

About Rentvine

Rentvine is the fastest-growing property management software company in the industry, ranked #60 on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list. Our powerful, cloud-based platform helps property managers streamline operations, reduce manual work, and deliver a better experience for tenants and owners. Behind that innovation is a team-first culture that puts people at the center. We care deeply about building a company where smart, driven individuals can grow, feel supported, and do the best work of their careers. Our people aren't just part of our success—they're the reason for it.

Please Note: Rentvine is unable to provide employment sponsorship now or in the future for any position.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Accounting Pod — the team responsible for one of the most critical and differentiated parts of the Rentvine platform. Trust accounting is at the heart of what we do, and this role sits at the intersection of product strategy and hands-on execution.

You'll own the roadmap for our accounting surface while also rolling up your sleeves to drive delivery. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and customer success to build features that make complex financial workflows feel effortless — and you'll help infuse AI and automation into areas where it can meaningfully reduce manual work for our customers.

What You'll Own

Trust Accounting Workflows

Own the product vision and roadmap for Rentvine's trust accounting engine — the ledger, reconciliation flows, month-end close, and compliance guardrails that property managers depend on daily.
Drive improvements to the monthly accounting workflow, reducing approval friction and surfacing anomalies earlier while preserving human oversight on high-value transactions.
Deeply understand property management accounting regulations and proactively shape features that keep Rentvine ahead of compliance requirements.

AP/AR & Owner Disbursements

Own the end-to-end experience for accounts payable and receivable, including vendor payments, owner distributions, and tenant billing.
Identify friction in the disbursement workflow and deliver features that improve speed, accuracy, and transparency for property managers and their owners.
Work closely with customers to understand real-world pain points around payment timing, exceptions handling, and reporting.

AI & Automation in Accounting

Partner with Rentvine's AI Pod to identify high-value automation opportunities within accounting — from intelligent transaction categorization to anomaly detection to assisted reconciliation.
Define where AI creates genuine leverage (reducing tedious manual work, catching errors) vs. where human judgment must remain in the loop.
Help shape the product thinking around an accounting-focused agent workforce, with a bias toward augmenting — not replacing — the property manager's expertise.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Translate customer research, support data, and market signals into a prioritized, shippable roadmap in collaboration with engineering and design.
Write clear, well-scoped product specs and acceptance criteria using Rentvine's planning frameworks (Shippable Feature Slices).
Lead sprint ceremonies and maintain pod momentum — unblocking teams, making tradeoff calls, and communicating progress to leadership.
Build deep relationships with power users and key accounts in the accounting domain; you'll be in customer conversations regularly.
Track feature adoption and impact metrics post-launch; use data to inform iteration priorities.
Represent the Accounting Pod in cross-pod planning cadences and help elevate the broader product organization.

Qualifications

5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in PropTech, property management software, or a closely adjacent domain.
Strong command of property management accounting fundamentals — trust accounting, owner disbursements, ledger management, or similar.
Demonstrated ability to own both strategy (roadmap, vision) and execution (delivery, scoping, unblocking) — a genuine player-coach.
Experience working on or alongside AI/ML product initiatives; comfort defining where automation belongs and where it doesn't.
Excellent communication skills — you can write a crisp spec, run a customer discovery call, and present a roadmap to executives with equal confidence.
Strong analytical instincts; comfortable pulling data, running adoption analyses, and translating numbers into product decisions.
Experience with modern product tooling: Linear (or similar), customer research platforms, and analytics tools.
Candidates MUST currently reside in the United States of America to be considered - East Coast preferred

Even Better If You Have

Direct experience with Rentvine, AppFolio, Buildium, or another property management platform.
Background in fintech, accounting software, or payments.
Exposure to agentic AI product development — understanding of how agent-based workflows change the PM's job.
Familiarity with API ecosystems, partner programs, or platform product thinking.

About Savvy Wealth

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)
Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)
Great Place to Work Certified™

The Role

The Senior Product Manager role is a high-impact role, you will operate in a very dynamic environment where you’ll get to proactively identify market opportunities across the business and lead the product direction & strategy to tackle them.

You will play a critical role in identifying market opportunities to expand value to existing customers and build new product lines. In doing so, you will be responsible for determining which products we should build next, the scope of each product surface area, what metrics we should drive towards, and more. You will also be responsible for leading projects from inception to production while partnering closely with engineering, design, and cross functional business partners to drive strong and rapid execution.

There’s an endless amount of opportunity that we can be pursuing; yet the ability to focus and place our bets on a few highly impactful areas is how we’ll continue to win. You’ll hold the mantle in determining what those bets are and then relentlessly drive towards the finish line on a high velocity team.

In order to succeed in this role, the right candidate should be adept at navigating an ambiguous and fast-paced environment with limited guidance. You’d be a great fit if you aspire to be a future organization leader or founder.

Responsibilities

Identify the best market opportunities for the business to pursue and create a compelling product vision & strategy around pursuing the opportunities.
Determine and articulate the actionable plan that will incrementally improve the product towards the product vision.
Build and continuously update the roadmap with a clear prioritization framework and rationale to meet the goals set out.
Research the market, customer, and the customer’s problem by keeping up to date on industry news & trends, participating in user research and discovery calls, collaborating on customer surveys, and synthesizing the firehose of customer feedback.
Write product specifications for everyone to align on the problem to be solved, goal(s), scope of work, success metrics, project plan, and other relevant information to help engineers, designers, and cross-functional team members develop the product.
Own projects on the roadmap end-to-end to ship high-quality products for our customers.
Work with engineers and designers to drive projects to completion, unblocking any issues that come up along the way.
Come up with the right messaging for products for each relevant audience (end customer, marketing, sales, etc.)
Evaluate whether products have been successful in achieving their goals using metrics and feedback.
Leverage non-software solutions (e.g., third parties, manual processes) whenever necessary to get the job done.
Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment to ensure everyone is educated on the latest product developments.

Must Have

5+ years of product management experience.
2+ years of experience at a high growth tech startup.
Experience working with engineers and designers in developing B2B software products.
Led at least one successful product/business line at a high growth tech startup.
Strong business, design, and technical sense.
Strong experience using various AI tools in your workflow (Cursor, Claude, Claude Code, etc.)

Nice To Have

Experience working at B2B fintech tech, technology-driven financial services, and/or wealth management technology companies.
Stood up a new product line or services business from zero.
Experience evaluating, negotiating with, and building relationships with vendors.
Experience with RIAs and/or broker-dealers and their compliance rules.
Previously a founder, or thinking about becoming one.
BS/MS in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity package
Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays
Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans
Company 401(k), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans
NYC office in the heart of Manhattan
Lunch and snacks provided in the office
Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care
Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Salesforce
jobs.description:
Uncommon Schools is a nonprofit network of high-performing public charter schools dedicated to providing an exceptional K-12 education in economically disadvantaged communities. Operating in Boston, Camden, New York City, Newark, and Rochester, we are committed to closing the college completion gap and preparing every student for college and beyond. Our students consistently exceed national benchmarks
, reflecting our dedication to their success. We invest deeply in our educators
, offering weekly coaching, feedback, and professional development to ensure excellence in teaching and leadership. Join us to work hard, do good, and make a lasting difference!

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager, Salesforce serves as the lead technical expert and strategic thought partner for Uncommon Schools’ Salesforce platforms. Sitting within the Data & IT team, this role translates organizational priorities into a clear technical roadmap that supports critical enrollment, marketing, operational, and financial goals. By bridging technical execution with strategic planning, you will ensure our CRM platform delivers high-value capabilities and seamless user experiences across central teams and schools. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional leaders, manage system architecture and data flows, and partner with technology vendors to optimize enterprise systems that directly support our mission.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Execution

Set and champion the technical vision and roadmap for all Salesforce instances (including Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Service Cloud) aligned with organizational goals and enrollment constraints.

Evaluate build, buy, consolidate, and retire decisions across the CRM portfolio and present investment cases to non-technical senior stakeholders.

Identify new platform enhancement opportunities, including automation workflows within Marketing Cloud.

Drive system roadmaps and maintenance strategies, managing upgrades, testing, backups, and integrations with enterprise applications.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives, and 8-to-12-week Planning Increment sessions.

Lead cross-functional problem-solving for complex technical projects involving multiple vendors, internal software systems, and data warehouses.

Build and maintain collaborative cross-functional communities, facilitating communication to break down functional silos.

Partner with Business Process Owners, Regional Superintendents, Chiefs of Staff, and School Operations Leaders to design effective system processes and workflows.

Data Governance & System Architecture

Define and maintain data flows, system-of-record boundaries, and data handoffs between Salesforce and other core enterprise systems (e.g., student information systems, enrollment tools).

Partner with System Architects, Data Architects, and Data Governance teams to establish record ownership, access levels, retention rules, and standard data dictionaries.

Drive data quality across the portfolio, managing data cleansing efforts and removing technical debt.

Ensure all CRM capabilities comply with enterprise cybersecurity guidelines, family data privacy requirements, and artificial intelligence usage guidelines.

Operations & Enablement

Manage day-to-day platform administration, establishing policies for user access, security roles, system usage, and reporting.

Manage vendor contracts, renewal processes, and tier-3 support escalations to ensure high performance.

Design and deliver train-the-trainer sessions and training programs for business process owners, school leaders, and service desk staff.

Develop and maintain centralized Knowledge Base articles and documentation covering system processes, troubleshooting, and best practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

5–6 years of relevant experience in Salesforce product management, system administration, or technical project implementation.

Hands-on experience working across Salesforce products, including Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Service Cloud.

Experience leading Agile processes, managing project backlogs, and executing multi-stakeholder technical plans.

Demonstrated ability to design business processes, troubleshoot complex technical root causes, and manage platform governance.

Strong communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of experience within a K–12, higher education, or EdTech environment.

1+ year of experience building prompt-based tools leveraging large language models (LLMs).

Working knowledge of help desk ticketing software (e.g., Zendesk).

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk and working on a computer.

Not sure if you meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply—we're excited to learn what you bring.

Additional Information

Our people are what make us Uncommon.
We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support the personal health, wellness, and finances of our staff and their families. Our compensation philosophy values equity & fairness and attracting & retaining top talent.

Compensation

The full compensation range for this role is $117,200-$142,000.

Typically, new hires who fully meet the qualifications and experience expectations for the role will start at or near $124,300.

Starting compensation below this reflects candidates with less experience or qualifications. Offers near the top end of the range are reserved for candidates who significantly exceed the qualifications, bringing extensive experience and specialized expertise beyond what is listed.

Compensation determinations consider relevant experience and tenure with Uncommon Schools. Additionally, because we value internal growth and tenure, current staff members are not subject to salary caps within this range.

Work Environment

Uncommon is an in-person organization with a commitment to at least three days each week at our Central Office in downtown Manhattan (100 Church Street). Candidates must be based in the NYC or Newark region and be required to travel monthly to regional locations (such as Rochester, Boston, or Camden) for 2 to 3 days at a time.

Benefits

19 days of paid time off
3 weeks of paid Winter and Summer org-wide holidays
Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision insurance plans
403(b) retirement savings program + employer match
Paid leave of absence options (parental, medical, disability, etc.)
Mental health and counseling support + wellness benefits
Pre-tax flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts

*A detailed list of all benefits is located HERE.

We are dedicated to building a team that brings a wide range of perspectives and experiences, reflective of the communities we serve---with over 70% of our staff identifying as people of color. Our organization values respect and open dialogue on important topics that shape our school culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Uncommon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We also ensure that individuals with disabilities receive all privileges and benefits associated with employment and are provided reasonable accommodations for the interview process and to perform core job functions. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.description:
About Stepful

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our Values

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.
Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.
Build together: We win when we rely on each other.
Own it: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The Opportunity

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

What You'll Do

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.
Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.
Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.
Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.
Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.
Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.
Use AI and automation to deliver more personal support at scale, so tech empowers our coaches and instructors instead of replacing them.
Define and track success metrics tied to student engagement, retention, completion, satisfaction (NPS), and job placement. We're not a feature factory and have no intention of becoming one!

What You'll Bring

7+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record building consumer-facing products
Proven success moving engagement, retention, or conversion metrics for a large user base, with launches you can point to
Strong product fundamentals: structured discovery, hypothesis-driven experimentation, focused prioritization, roadmap ownership, and clear documentation
A deep, genuine obsession with users, and comfort turning qualitative insights and messy data into clear product decisions
Comfort working with complex data sets and writing SQL to generate your own insights
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to earn trust quickly with operators, instructors, execs, and technical teams
The ability to clearly articulate tradeoffs, make decisions with imperfect information, and find the 80/20 quickly
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including crafting narratives that drive alignment and action

Bonus Points If

You've built products in EdTech, healthcare, workforce development, or another mission-driven industry
You've designed experiences for adult learners, career changers, or underserved populations
You've built products that blend self-serve software with human support, such as coaching, tutoring, or customer success

Interview Process

Step 1: Intro Call with Talent Acquisition Lead

Step 2: Call with hiring manager (past project deep dive and mini case)

Step 3: Take-Home Case Study and Presentation

Step 4: Onsite interview at office in SoHo, NYC

Compensation

New Hire Base Salary Bands:

Senior I - $143,000-$181,000

Senior II - $167,000-$211,000

Please note we do not have a bonus structure at this time so all cash compensation will come in the form of base salary. The total compensation package will also include our benefits package and an equity (ISOs) package.

Compensation for this role will fall within the pay range listed and will be determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications as well as interview evaluation. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

About Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

Morgan Stanley is committed to helping its employees build meaningful careers and we strive to be a place for people to learn, achieve and grow.

Department Overview

In the Wealth Management division, we help people, businesses and institutions build, preserve, and manage wealth so they can pursue their financial goals

Wealth Management (WM) Platforms manages industry-leading platforms, across all WM channels and client segments, to provide a unified digital experience, unlock growth, and deliver efficiencies for Advisors, Clients, and Institutions. WM Platforms consists of nine sub-teams including: Field Experience & Platforms, Digital Client Experience & Platforms, Workplace Platforms, Automation & Workflow Solutions, Digital Trading & Investing, UX Design & Research, Strategy & Execution. Business Control & Support, and the Chief Operating Office.

The Product Platforms team is responsible for coordinating activities between the business (trading desk, sales, product, legal, compliance, risk, business control) and the Tech & Ops organizations. The Capital Markets Platform team covers the full suite of capital markets products, including Equities, Options, Fixed income, Syndicate, FX, Futures, etc. In this role, you will have the opportunity to become a subject matter expert in Capital Markets business flows, with an initial focus in Equities and Options, to help to renovate associated technical infrastructure and tools.

What You'll Do In The Role

Support product owners with definition and prioritization of product roadmap, release planning, and development and communication of business requirements
Assist with critical user journeys, use cases, workflows, and business processes that align with the product vision/goals and address critical user and control needs
Support prioritized product backlog identify, groom, and validate epics and user stories for agile sprints
Assist with backlog refinement and sprint planning ceremonies to communicate requirements
Specify acceptance criteria, review testing cases/scenarios and perform and oversee user acceptance testing as needed
Analyze, define, and manage data flows/models and diverse datasets to define requirements and expected behavior for Morgan Stanley's digital planning solutions
Work closely with the technology team to assure effective communication of requirements and rapid delivery of key product releases
Collaborate with key stakeholders from business, technology, UX, risk, cyber & fraud, communications, legal & compliance to elicit requirements
Prepare presentations, user demos, and status updates
Gather, organize, and assimilate internal and external feedback to identify and prioritize product gaps, enhancements, and new features
Collaborate with UI/UX team to develop information/interaction architecture, user flows, wireframes, and visual design comps
Team up with program management office to effectively organize and plan product releases
Define, collect, and track KPIs and product/program adoption and usage metrics evangelize for adoption

Skills Required

Capital Markets product knowledge that can be leveraged for a product owner position
3-5 years of experience as a software business or systems analyst with track record of delivering new innovative web or mobile applications within an agile/scrum development process
Proven track record of delivering successful digital products on time and within scope.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
BA or BS preferred, but not required

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product - Oncology
jobs.description:
About Viz.ai

Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the #1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional Director or Senior Director of Product to define, build, and scale the next generation of oncology products at Viz.ai — a role at the intersection of oncology, product, commercial strategy, AI, and customer experience. We're looking for someone who deeply understands the oncology ecosystem and can translate unmet needs into products that clinicians love, customers buy, and that ultimately help more patients access lifesaving treatments.

You'll operate at multiple altitudes: understanding the oncology market, engaging leading KOLs and customers, defining product strategy, writing detailed PRDs, rapidly prototyping new experiences, and partnering with engineering, design, product marketing, sales, clinical, and Inbound Product Management to get products into clinicians' hands. The ideal candidate combines the market instinct of a commercial leader, the customer obsession of a great product manager, and the execution rigor of a product builder.

What You'll Own

Define the Oncology Product Strategy

Build a differentiated oncology product strategy grounded in customer needs, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and Viz's unique strengths — informed by deep, ongoing relationships with oncology KOLs, clinicians, and health-system leaders.
Identify unmet needs and market gaps where technology can meaningfully improve patient care and create commercial value, and translate them into business cases that help leadership prioritize investment.
Spend significant time directly with customers and users, and maintain a current view of competitors, emerging technology, and evolving oncology care models.

Build Products People Actually Use

Own products end-to-end — from insight and concept through requirements, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization — writing PRDs that clearly connect the user problem, requirements, and business rationale.
Partner with Design, Engineering, and Inbound Product Management to build products that are intuitive and clinically meaningful, and that stay consistent with the broader Viz platform.
Use modern AI-native and agentic tools (eg. Figma Make, Claude Code, Claude Design) to test ideas directly with customers before committing engineering resources.

Drive Go-to-Market in Partnership with BD, Commercial & Clinical

Partner with BD, Commercial, Sales, and Product Marketing to build go-to-market strategy, articulate value proposition and positioning, and identify lighthouse customers and design partners — this is joint ownership, not a solo mandate.
Partner with Clinical and the Chief Medical Officer to make sure go-to-market claims and positioning are clinically sound.
Define and monitor metrics across adoption, engagement, customer value, commercial performance, and patient impact.

Qualifications

8+ years of oncology-adjacent healthcare experience (clinical, commercial, diagnostics, or life sciences), with a sophisticated understanding of the oncology ecosystem and clinical workflows.
5+ years of product management experience building and launching complex healthcare, software, AI, or technology products.
A highly commercial mindset — comfortable sizing markets, understanding buyers, and connecting product decisions to revenue and growth, working in true partnership with BD and Commercial rather than owning commercial strategy solo.
Strong relationships within the oncology ecosystem, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly build credibility with leading clinicians and KOLs.
Strong understanding of modern AI products and real enthusiasm for agentic, AI-native development — comfortable prototyping your own ideas rather than only spec'ing them for someone else.
Excellent written and verbal communication, able to move fluidly between clinicians, engineers, commercial teams, executives, and customers.
Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, in areas with no established playbook.

Bonus Qualifications

Oncology clinical licensure (MD, APP/PA/NP, or RN with oncology specialization) a plus, but not required.
Experience with oncology-specific EHR or workflow systems (e.g., Epic Beacon, iKnowMed, ARIA).
Experience with life sciences or pharma partnership models in oncology.
Advanced degree (MD, MBA, or MPH) a plus, but not required.

How We Think About Product

We believe great healthcare products start with the patient but succeed by deeply understanding the people responsible for delivering their care. We're looking for someone who is obsessive about engagement — it isn't enough to build something technically impressive; it has to fit naturally into clinical workflows and be good enough that clinicians actively want to use it.

The strongest candidates move seamlessly between conversations — from an oncologist explaining where a workflow breaks down, to a customer explaining why solving it matters, to a BD or Clinical partner shaping the go-to-market plan together, to a leadership team hearing the business case for why we should invest.

This is an opportunity to build first-of-kind products in an environment where the answers don't already exist. Above all, you should be motivated by our mission to increase access to lifesaving treatments and build products that meaningfully improve care for people with cancer.

Why should you join us?

If you are looking to make an impact, we are mission-driven and are making a difference in peoples’ lives every day.
If you want to be a part of an amazing team , our people are the heart of everything we do.
If you are a self-starter and naturally motivated, our work is driven by curiosity, innovation and team collaboration which allows us to leverage our skills immeasurably.

We are a remote-first company across the U.S. and EU, with a team in Tel Aviv operating in a flexible hybrid model, conveniently located near a train line.

Viz.ai is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Messaging & Communities
jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in New York, San Francisco, Mountain View, or Bellevue.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Our mission. Gen Z is entering the workforce at scale and bringing new expectations for how professional relationships begin and grow. They are gravitating toward spaces where people with shared interests can exchange ideas, learn from one another, and build identity and trust over time. Unlike one-way content experiences, communities create an ongoing loop of participation and belonging: every conversation adds context, strengthens relationships, and gives people a reason to return. By bringing together trusted identity, the professional graph, messaging, and global reach, we can create spaces where people return, contribute, and build relationships that move their careers and lives forward.

What this role is: We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to build a new member product at the intersection of messaging and communities. Think of the best parts of modern messaging and community products, rebuilt for the professional world and powered by what makes LinkedIn unique. This is a true zero-to-one role. You will define the vision, find the wedge, validate the core use cases, launch an MVP, and build toward product-market fit. There is no established playbook. We need someone who is excited to write it.

What you’ll do:

You will operate like a founder: close to members, close to the product, and close to the details. You will move from insight to prototype to launch quickly, learn from what works and what does not, and bring engineering, design, data science, research, trust, and operations along with you.
You will bring deep expertise in messaging and communities: how conversations start and persist, why people join and return, and how product mechanics shape participation and belonging. Success is not simply more messages sent. It is healthy, retained communities where members keep showing up and form relationships that matter.

Why are we here:
The best opportunities often come through people: someone who shares your interests, understands what you care about, introduces a new idea, or opens a door you did not know existed. And today, your network is far more fluid than a list of connections. It includes the people you learn from, exchange ideas with, and build relationships with over time in the communities where you belong. Our job is to help every professional find their people; and turn shared interests into relationships that move their work and lives forward

Responsibilities

Define the vision and strategy for a new LinkedIn experience spanning messaging and professional communities.
Discover the strongest member needs, identify the right initial wedge, and turn those insights into a focused roadmap.
Lead the product from concept through prototype, MVP launch, early adoption, and rapid iteration.
Define the core product systems that help people discover, join, participate in, and return to healthy communities.
Establish product-market fit signals centered on retention, repeat participation, community health, and meaningful professional relationships.
Build trust, safety, moderation, and member control into the product and operating model from the beginning.
Make clear trade-offs across member value, quality, speed, safety, and long-term scale.
Align cross-functional teams and senior leaders around the opportunity, priorities, risks, progress, and key decisions.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product management or an equivalent role.
5+ years of experience building and scaling high-quality messaging or community products for large and diverse audiences.
Deep product judgment across conversation design, discovery, identity, participation, retention, notifications, trust and safety, moderation, and community health.
A hands-on builder who can move easily between strategy and execution, make decisions with imperfect information, and lead through ambiguity.
Strong technical, analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Suggested Skills

AI Fluency
Zero-to-One Product Development
Consumer Product Strategy
Trust, Safety, and Community Health
