Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases.
You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Director, Product Marketing – Upstream Late-Stage PSMA is a senior strategic leader responsible for shaping the commercial vision, long-term lifecycle strategy, and value creation for Telix’s late-stage PSMA imaging portfolio—including Illuccix®, Gozellix®, and future lifecycle expansion opportunities.

This upstream role serves as the strategic bridge between product development, medical, regional commercial teams, and executive leadership. As Director, you will own the strategic narrative, guide commercial input into late-stage development, and ensure each product is optimally positioned for sustained growth and competitive advantage across all major markets.

The Director plays a critical leadership role in influencing pipeline decisions, aligning teams, and driving high-impact commercial strategy that supports Telix’s multi-product PSMA franchise.

Lead the development, refinement, and execution of commercial and lifecycle strategies for Illuccix®, Gozellix®, and late-stage PSMA programs.

Strong ability to synthesize scientific, clinical, communicate commercial insights into strategic decision-making.
Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional teams in complex, matrixed environments.
Strong financial and analytical acumen, with experience developing sophisticated forecasts and investment cases.
Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder leadership skills.
Advanced project leadership and organizational capabilities.

Strong alignment between late-stage development priorities and commercial needs.

Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for formulating and leading the company's product design strategy and establishing a design ecosystem driven by user needs and business objectives. This role holds comprehensive responsibility for product experience, interaction design, visual design, and the development of the design system.

The position involves close collaboration with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer experience teams to translate user insights, business goals, and technical capabilities into competitive product experiences. Additionally, the VP is responsible for building and developing the product design team, driving design standardization, optimizing design processes, fostering innovation, and ensuring that product experiences align with the company's overall brand and product strategy.

II. Key Responsibilities
1. Product Design Strategy
Formulate the company's mid-to-long-term product design strategy and development direction.
Establish product design principles, methodologies, and quality standards.
Translate corporate product strategies and business goals into clear design directions.
Evaluate industry, user, and design trends to identify opportunities for product experience innovation.
Participate in corporate product and business strategic planning, providing expert design-related advice to senior management.
2. User Experience (UX) and Product Experience (PX)
Lead the overall User Experience (UX) and Product Experience (PX) strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of target user needs, behaviors, and usage scenarios.
Drive user research, user journey analysis, and usability testing.
Optimize product information architecture, interaction flows, and core user experiences.
Establish mechanisms for the continuous collection and application of user feedback.
3. UI and Visual Design
Oversee product interfaces, visual language, and interaction design direction.
Establish unified visual design standards for products.
Ensure design consistency across various products and platforms.
Review design proposals for core products and major features.
Collaborate with the brand team to ensure product experiences align with brand positioning.
4. Design System Development
Build, manage, and continuously optimize the company's design system.
Define design components, interaction specifications, and visual standards.
Drive the adoption of the design system across different products and teams.
Collaborate with engineering teams to enhance collaboration efficiency between design and development.
Reduce redundant work and improve product development efficiency through design standardization.
5. Product Development Collaboration
Collaborate with the CPO and product management teams to define product development direction.
Work with engineering and technical teams to drive the implementation of design solutions.
Participate in product planning, requirements reviews, and product launch processes.
Balance user needs, business goals, technical feasibility, and development costs. Ensure design deliverables are completed on schedule and to a high standard, and successfully implemented in the product.
6. Design Innovation
Track trends in AI, digital products, interaction technologies, and design tools.
Explore new product design methodologies, technologies, and user interaction patterns.
Drive the effective application of AI-assisted design, prototyping, and design automation tools.
Encourage the team to engage in design experimentation and innovation.
Translate innovative outcomes into actionable product experience improvements.

Establish collaboration mechanisms with product, engineering, marketing, brand, sales, and customer experience teams.
Align goals and priorities across different teams during the product development process.
Support product experience design for key clients, markets, and business initiatives.
Report product design strategy, project progress, and key outcomes to senior management.
Establish effective communication channels between design and business teams.

Recruit, develop, and manage the product design team.
Define the design team's organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, and performance management systems.
Mentor and develop Product Designers, UX Designers, UI Designers, and Design Managers.
Implement mechanisms for design reviews, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
Foster a professional, collaborative, and innovation-oriented design culture.

Develop annual budgets and resource plans for the product design department.
Optimize the allocation of design personnel, external resources, and design tools.
Manage design vendors and external design agencies.
Adjust design resource priorities based on product strategy.
Evaluate the relationship between design investment and product business outcomes.

Over 20 years of experience in product design, UX/UI, product experience, or related fields.
Over 8 years of experience in design team management or senior design leadership.
Experience managing design for large-scale digital products, software, platforms, or complex products.
Deep understanding of UX, UI, interaction design, and design systems.
Strong product mindset, user-centric mindset, and business acumen.
Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear product design solutions.
Excellent cross-functional communication, strategic planning, and leadership skills.

Master's degree preferred.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. 
With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.
Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.  

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to contribute to product strategy for Armada's federal and defense-facing solutions. You will engage directly with defense and government customers to understand mission and warfighter edge compute requirements, translate them into clear product requirements, and work cross-functionally to close capability gaps across Armada's hardware, platform, monitoring, and ISV application layers.  
This is a hands-on role for a self-starting product manager operating at the intersection of Armada's product organization and the defense and intelligence community. You will determine your own methods and approach on new assignments, exercise judgment across ambiguous and sensitive requirements, and frequently advise engineering, field, capture, and go-to-market partners on product matters within the federal domain. You'll also help build and champion standardization across the team — establishing consistent processes, frameworks, and best practices that scale with our growth.  
In this role, you will define and deliver platform capabilities that meet the unique requirements of defense, intelligence, and federal mission environments, such as disconnected operations, classified workloads, zero-trust security, and compliance with government standards, while maintaining alignment with Armada's commercial platform roadmap.  

Location & Clearance

Location: This role is remote within the United States, with periodic travel to customer sites and Armada offices  
Clearance: An active Top Secret (TS) or Secret clearance is strongly preferred; candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance  
Team: This role sits on Armada's Federal PM team and reports to the Federal product lead  

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Customer Requirements & Mission Understanding  

Engage directly with defense and government customers to understand edge compute requirements for warfighter and other mission-critical scenarios  
Translate complex defense customer problems into clear, specific, and actionable product requirements  
Identify and prioritize gaps in Armada's solution set - spanning hardware, platform, monitoring, and ISV applications - needed to address defense and federal use cases  

Product Ownership & Delivery  

Contribute to the roadmap for Armada's federal product area, from requirements definition through development, QA, and launch  
Partner with engineering to scope and deliver solutions that meet defense-grade requirements for security, reliability, and mission assurance  
Determine methods and approach on new initiatives, exercising independent judgment given ambiguous, sensitive, or classified requirements  

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement  

Serve as the primary product interface between defense customers, field teams, and engineering  
Advise sales, capture, and field teams on technical and product strategy for federal opportunities  
Support proposal development, technical evaluations, and customer briefings as the product subject matter expert for federal solutions  
Translate mission requirements from DoD, IC, and federal agencies into scalable platform capabilities  
Balance classified and unclassified customer needs while maintaining a unified core product architecture  
Drive secure edge-to-cloud capabilities supporting disconnected, intermittent, and denied environments  
Partner with security and compliance teams on DoD security requirements, NIST, RMF, and zero-trust architectures, including classified and air-gapped deployment models  
Guide product features needed to support ATO processes and government compliance requirements  

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience, Master's and 6+ years, or PhD and 3+ years, with 5+ years in product management for infrastructure, platform, cloud, or defense-related compute products  
Active U.S. security clearance at the Secret level required  
Experience in the defense industry, particularly around compute used in warfighter or other mission-critical scenarios  
Demonstrated ability to understand defense customer problems and translate them into specific, actionable product requirements  
Strong background in distributed systems, cloud platforms, edge computing, or infrastructure software  
Demonstrated ability to determine methods on new assignments and exercise judgment across variable, ambiguous factors  
Excellent written and verbal communication with technical, defense, and business audiences  
Direct experience supporting U.S. Government or Defense customers (DoD, IC, or federal agencies)  
Strong understanding of mission environments, classified systems, and defense operational constraints  
Familiarity with secure system design, zero-trust principles, and classified deployment models  
U.S. Citizenship required  

Preferred Qualifications:

Active TS/SCI clearance  
Experience with ISV application ecosystems within defense or government environments  
Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native technologies  
Experience delivering hardware-integrated or edge computing products for defense, industrial, or public sector customers  
Experience with edge computing platforms in defense or austere environments  
Experience supporting ATO processes or RMF documentation  
Prior military, intelligence, or government service experience

You own customer problems from discovery through launch and iteration, applying strong judgment to determine when AI should assist, recommend, draft, automate, or stay out of the way.

You bring deep customer empathy, analytical rigor, technical curiosity, and strong design instincts to products where model behavior, context, quality, and trust directly shape the user experience. Lead roadmap development, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and product execution across distributed teams while resolving friction points and maintaining alignment around the highest-impact opportunities

Drive coordinated feature launches with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Operations, then monitor adoption and use qualitative and quantitative feedback to continuously improve the product

Experience building AI-powered products, automation, assistants, copilots, agents, search, recommendation systems, workflow software, or other technically complex products
Technical fluency with AI product concepts including large language model capabilities and constraints, model behavior, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, reliability, latency, cost, and safety
Experience defining product metrics, evaluations, quality measures, adoption funnels, and feedback loops for products where success depends on both user behavior and system performance
Expertise in agile development, product strategy, product lifecycle management, user experience principles, and product analytics
Experience with product analytics and growth stack tools (i.e. Amplitude, Segment, Braze, LaunchDarkly...)
Proven experience driving team efficiency or output quality through the strategic use of AI tools and automation
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience

A multi-dimensional background with a breadth of cross-functional interests or depth of specialized mastery
Personal resilience to learn from scratch, and successfully thrive in ambiguity
Deep customer obsession and motivation to understand the practical realities of helping Pros save time, grow profitably, and deliver excellent service
Strong product and design judgment that makes powerful technology feel simple, useful, trustworthy, and respectful of the user’s workflow
Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and analytical skills within a metrics-driven, fast-paced environment
Ability to operate effectively at strategic and tactical levels, moving fluidly from product vision and portfolio priorities to requirements, prototype feedback, launch readiness, and post-launch iteration
Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences that creates alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Go-to-Market, Operations, and leadership
Hands-on curiosity with AI tools and emerging capabilities while remaining grounded in customer outcomes rather than novelty

jobs.description:
Vice President, Product Management

Location: United States | Full-Time | Remote / Hybrid / On-site
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer / Chief Operating Officer

About the Role

We are looking for a Vice President, Product Management to lead product strategy, product planning, roadmap development, and cross-functional product execution across the organization.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for defining product priorities, translating business and customer needs into product strategies, and building a disciplined product management function. The VP, Product Management will oversee product planning, requirements, prioritization, lifecycle management, performance measurement, and coordination across Product, Technology, Operations, Design, Compliance, and other functions.

You will work closely with executive leadership and leaders across Technology, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Customer Operations. The role will ensure that product decisions are aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, operational capabilities, and long-term organizational priorities.

Because the organization is continuing to build and scale, this role will have significant influence over product management processes, roadmap development, product governance, prioritization frameworks, and the structure of the product organization.

The ideal candidate is commercially aware, customer-focused, analytical, and comfortable moving between product strategy, detailed execution, and executive-level decision-making.

Responsibilities

• Lead the overall product management function, including product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, lifecycle management, and product performance.

• Develop and maintain a product strategy aligned with organizational objectives, customer needs, market opportunities, and long-term business priorities.

• Partner with executive leadership to translate strategic goals into clear product priorities, initiatives, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

• Establish standardized product management processes, frameworks, documentation standards, and decision-making practices across the organization.

• Own the product roadmap and ensure that product initiatives are appropriately prioritized based on business impact, customer value, resources, dependencies, and execution requirements.

• Conduct market, customer, competitive, and business analysis to identify product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

• Work closely with Technology and Engineering to translate product requirements into practical development plans, milestones, and deliverables.

• Partner with Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, and other stakeholders to ensure product requirements account for operational, regulatory, governance, and risk considerations.

• Establish clear product requirements, business cases, success criteria, KPIs, and performance measurement frameworks for major product initiatives.

• Oversee product discovery, requirements gathering, prioritization, launch planning, adoption measurement, and product lifecycle management.

• Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Business Development to incorporate customer feedback, market intelligence, commercial priorities, and go-to-market requirements into product planning.

• Establish structured processes for collecting, evaluating, prioritizing, and incorporating customer and stakeholder feedback.

• Monitor product performance, adoption, customer engagement, operational impact, and business outcomes and provide regular reporting to executive leadership.

• Evaluate product economics, resource requirements, development priorities, and expected business impact to support informed investment decisions.

• Identify product risks, dependencies, execution constraints, and opportunities and coordinate appropriate mitigation or improvement plans.

• Support the evaluation and development of new products, features, services, partnerships, integrations, and strategic product initiatives.

• Establish product governance standards covering prioritization, approvals, documentation, lifecycle decisions, and cross-functional accountability.

• Improve product management tools, workflows, analytics, documentation, and operating processes to support organizational growth.

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing product management organization as product and business requirements expand.

• Maintain a high standard of customer focus, analytical rigor, commercial judgment, accountability, communication, and execution discipline across the product organization.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a senior product leader who combines strong product strategy expertise with commercial judgment, customer understanding, analytical capability, and the ability to build scalable product organizations.

The strongest candidates will typically have:

• 20+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, product development, technology, business strategy, or a related field.

• Significant leadership experience managing product managers, product teams, or complex product portfolios at a senior level.

• Demonstrated experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and product management processes.

• Strong understanding of product discovery, requirements management, product lifecycle management, customer research, prioritization, and product performance measurement.

• Proven ability to translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product strategies and actionable roadmaps.

• Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to evaluate product opportunities, business cases, market conditions, and expected outcomes.

• Experience working closely with Engineering, Technology, Design, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex product initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities.

• Strong understanding of product KPIs, customer metrics, business performance indicators, and product analytics.

• Experience launching, scaling, improving, or managing products throughout different stages of the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive decision-support skills.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

• Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing product management professionals.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Marketing, or a related field required. MBA or other advanced credentials are strongly preferred.

Experience in financial services, fintech, technology, payments, trading, SaaS, enterprise software, or other complex technology-driven environments is a plus.

We are also interested in candidates from high-growth technology companies, financial institutions, consulting firms, SaaS businesses, enterprise technology companies, and organizations with sophisticated product management functions.

jobs.title: VP of Digital Product
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY:
BIRDY GREY

Birdy Grey is a direct-to-consumer brand whose mission is to celebrate friendships during one of the most important milestones in a person’s life: their wedding.

Founded in 2017 by best friends Grace Lee (Founder & Chief Creative Officer) and Monica Ashauer (Co-Founder & Chief Strategy Officer), Birdy Grey offers affordable bridesmaid dresses starting at just $89, groomsmen suits starting at $199, plus fun gifts and accessories for everyone in the wedding party. Since day one, we've dressed over 2 million bridesmaids and we're proud to be a trusted resource for brides and grooms on their most cherished day.

THE OPPORTUNITY:
VP of Digital Product

REPORTS TO:
CEO

LOCATION:
US - Remote

Headquartered in Los Angeles, CA with an office in New York, NY, Birdy Grey supports remote work for eligible roles. We ask that all employees travel to either office once a quarter. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Our digital experience is where our customers discover us, decide, and buy, and it is increasingly a source of competitive advantage. Those customers arrive at very different points in their journey: a bride planning a year out, a bridesmaid buying a dress this week, a groom outfitting his party, a guest who needs something to wear. One store has to serve all of them well. Digital Product is central to our company strategy, and we are seeking a senior leader who wakes up every day thinking about that experience. Reporting to the CEO, the VP of Digital Product owns the Digital Product organization across Product Management, Product Design, Site Merchandising, and Web Operations, and is accountable for the commercial performance of the store. This is a player-coach role from day one. You will set the strategy and lead the team, and you will also personally own the roadmap for our core shopping experience: framing problems, writing requirements, working tradeoffs with Design and Engineering, reading the results, and partnering with Engineering Management to run the delivery process. As the team matures, the role may move up and out of the day-to-day but it does not start there.

Scope Of Responsibilities

Strategy & Roadmap

Own the digital product vision, strategy, and roadmap, balancing near-term commercial opportunities with the larger customer and platform investments that compound over time
Build a single scorecard for the store that shows how our levers trade off against one another on the same real estate
Accountable, with Marketing and Merchandising, for conversion, revenue, and lead generation through the digital experience

Product Management (hands-on)

Personally lead the core shopping experience roadmap: discovery, requirements, prioritization, scoping and estimation with Engineering, launch, and measurement
Supervise the lead generation and product design roadmaps and keep them aligned with the core
Align stakeholders when priorities compete, and communicate progress and results to executive leadership

Product Design

Set the standard for the end-to-end customer experience across UX, interaction design, and visual execution
Bring customer research into the process early and move from concept to prototype to validated solution
Evolve a scalable, component-based design system in Figma that makes both Design and Engineering faster

Experimentation & Analytics

Own the A/B testing program: a clear testing roadmap, a hypothesis and scorecard for every test, timely readouts, and rapid iteration
Own product reporting and KPIs, and do the analytical work yourself when a result doesn't make sense

Site Merchandising & Web Operations

Own how customers discover and navigate the assortment across search, navigation, collections, landing pages, listing and detail pages, and recommendations, in partnership with Merchandising
Own the day-to-day operation of the store: product activation, content management, campaigns and promotions, site launches, QA, and release readiness, automating wherever possible

Personalization & AI

Build personalized customer journeys in partnership with Creative and Marketing
Integrate AI thoughtfully, where it makes the experience better or the team faster, in partnership with Engineering

Team

Lead complex initiatives across Engineering, Marketing, Merchandising, Creative, Operations, CX, and Analytics so launches arrive as complete customer experiences
Build, coach, and develop the Product and Design team and the operating system behind it: roadmap visibility, requirements, tracking, and launch process

THE RIGHT CANDIDATE:
QUALIFICATIONS & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s Degree Required

Experience / Requirements

12+ years in product management in ecommerce or consumer digital, including leading a product function and developing people
A track record of personally leading customer-facing digital products from discovery through launch and measurement, with commercial results you can point to
Deep experience with experimentation and conversion optimization, and the analytical skills to interrogate the data yourself (SQL or a BI tool)
Experience running a roadmap process across multiple teams and presenting it to executive leadership
Technical depth to engage engineering credibly on architecture, estimates, and integration tradeoffs
Fluency in the drivers of business performance and in modern ecommerce platforms, content management, analytics, and testing tools
Clear writing and strong stakeholder management
Excited about AI and actively leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Copilot) to accelerate your own work and identify opportunities to embed AI-driven automation across operations
Impeccable organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform data deep dives to surface actionable insights.
Proactive problem solver with the ability to troubleshoot and/or escalate issues effectively.
Hard working and willing to roll sleeves up - no job is too big or too small.
You have an entrepreneurial spirit. You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, fluid environment. You are comfortable with ambiguity and take initiative to lead projects.

Nice To Haves

Start-up experience
Interest in bridal and fashion
Apparel, fashion, bridal, or another considered-purchase category
Direct experience leading Product Design, Site Merchandising, or Web Operations alongside Product Management
Personalization, recommendations, search, or AI-enabled shopping experiences

WHY BIRDY GREY:
BENEFITS & PERKS (for eligible Full-Time Employees)

Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and performance + Annual Performance Bonus
Healthcare Benefits: 100% employer covered medical dental & vision plans, 50% spouse and dependent medical coverage + access to One Medical + Mental Health Benefits
Retirement: 401K + up to 4% match after 3 months
Generous PTO: Flexible Open PTO Policy + 11 paid holidays
Wellness: A monthly wellness day + monthly wellness stipend + summer Fridays
Flexibility: Partial remote with a high level of autonomy and accountability
Employee Discount: Free bridesmaid dresses + 50% discounts on Birdy Grey products
Family Benefits: 3 months of paid parental leave
Purpose: Join in the success of a high-growth, 80% women, minority founded, early-stage startup by driving performance and building out new processes

Highlights

#22 on BuiltIn’s Best Startups to Work for in LA

Join a Women Founded Small Business blazing trails in the Bridal industry
Birdy Grey is making waves on BuzzFeed, The Knot, Brides, People, Allure, PopSugar, Bustle and more
Named #5 on LA’s 50 Hottest Startups in 2020 by Pitchbook & Dot.LA
Customers can participate in Birdy Grey’s giveback program with The Princess Project, a non-profit that provides prom dresses and accessories to teens in need

Job Description

HUMAN CAPITAL MANAGEMENT

Our division recruits, develops and rewards the people of Goldman Sachs. Our teams advise, design and implement strategies, processes and technologies that help our people advance professionally, drive productivity and help the firm and our clients achieve superior results. We look for individuals with strong problem solving and analytical skills, innovative thinking and intellectual curiosity who want to make an impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset, our people.

Summary:
Our HCM Strategy team is seeking an experienced Vice President to drive global, large-scale transformational Artificial Intelligence initiatives. You will be instrumental in leveraging cutting-edge AI platforms to enhance employee experience, deliver quantifiable automation benefits, and build resilient HCM solutions across our firm.

As a Vice President, you will lead the strategy, design and delivery of enterprise-wide HCM AI platforms and solutions from initiation to completion. You will apply exceptional organizational skills, strategic foresight, and impeccable implementation abilities. A strong focus on integrating systems across the full employee lifecycle – from recruitment to retirement – will be essential. You will collaborate with HCM, technology, and business leaders to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and implement scalable AI solutions aligned with organizational goals.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, evidenced by a proven track record of successful AI product design and implementation.

Responsibilities

Articulate and lead the HCM product vision and strategic roadmap, aligning with HCM and business objectives.
Continuously modernize our AI approach by monitoring new AI patterns, assessing fit-for-purpose use cases, and driving implementation playbooks from pilot to production.
Develop robust business cases for new AI products and enhancements, including financial justification (ROI) and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Lead and empower cross-functional teams to deliver complex solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and successful outcomes.
Foster strong partnerships with Data, Engineering, PMO, and HRIS teams to ensure seamless execution and integration.
Monitor the evolving AI landscape and translate relevant innovations into HCM strategy and roadmaps.
Uphold and ensure adherence to governance, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards across all HCM products.
Strategically manage vendor relationships, encompassing platform evaluation, selection, contract negotiation, and ongoing performance oversight.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Product Management, Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
Minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, leading the strategy, development, and launch of complex, large-scale products – with concrete experience delivering AI-enabled products and / or implementing AI capabilities in enterprise environments
Demonstrated expertise in the full product lifecycle management from conceptual design and strategic planning to successful launch and sustained adoption.
Proven ability to strategically prioritize, define, and manage a diverse product roadmap, consistently delivering high-value features and solutions that meet market needs and exceed stakeholder expectations.
Exceptional organizational acumen and advanced time management capabilities, adept at navigating complex product interdependencies and driving efficient execution across global, cross-functional teams.
Proficiency with enterprise-grade product management platforms (e.g., Jira), analytics tools, and collaboration software.
Superior executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts, influence diverse stakeholders, and present effectively to senior leadership.
Highly analytical with advanced strategic problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, capable of identifying root causes, anticipating challenges, and developing innovative solutions.
Proven ability to thrive both independently and as a collaborative leader within a matrixed organizational structure, fostering teamwork and accountability.
Agile Product Owner/Scrum Master, or other relevant product management certifications are highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise HCM systems including Oracle HCM Cloud.

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT Enterprise Architecture Data & Corp Tech team, the ServiceNow Product Manager is a product‑ led, outcome‑ driven, and enterprise‑ focused role, accountable for driving enterprise value from the ServiceNow platform by owning product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes across one or more ServiceNow domains (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CMDB).

This role has a strong focus on strategic service architecture and service catalog design, ensuring that services are intentionally defined, consistently structured, and clearly consumable across the enterprise. The Product Manager ensures that ServiceNow is not only functional, but organized as a well‑ architected portfolio of services aligned to business capabilities, technology strategy, and risk controls

The position requires deep functional understanding of ServiceNow features, Asset Management and data models (CSDM, CMDB) to guide how services are designed, exposed, and governed—balancing flexibility, standardization, and platform sustainability.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Ownership

Define and own the product vision, multi‑year roadmap, and strategic outcomes for assigned ServiceNow product areas.
Translate enterprise and business priorities into clearly defined product outcomes, ensuring alignment with technology strategy, risk posture, and regulatory expectations.
Make informed product decisions on capability usage, configuration vs. customization, and technical tradeoffs, balancing speed, sustainability, and platform health.

Strategic Service Architecture and Catalog Management

Define and govern the service architecture within ServiceNow, ensuring services are clearly defined, structured through consistent taxonomies, and mapped to capabilities and existing workflows
Ensure service and catalog design aligns with CMDB integrity, data quality, reporting needs, and downstream integrations.
Drive simplification and rationalization of services to reduce duplication and complexity

Enterprise Stakeholder Leadership

Act as the primary product authority for business leaders, and technology partners
Lead structured discovery and prioritization discussions focused on ServiceNow usage beyond request‑based demand fulfilment
Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication, product roadmaps, and value‑based prioritization.

ServiceNow Capability Enablement

Maintain a deep, working understanding of ServiceNow platform features, including workflows, data models, CMDB concepts, integrations, reporting, and user experience patterns.
Work with Architecture, Infrastructure, Asset Management teams to define and implement Resiliency boundaries in CMDB.
Define CMDB governance to improve data quality and communication.
Guide engineering and delivery teams to maximize out‑of‑the‑box capabilities and enforce standard usage patterns across the platform.
Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise principles for platform stability, upgrade readiness, performance, and data integrity.

Backlog, Intake & Prioritization

Own the end‑to‑end product backlog, intake process, and prioritization model across assigned domains.
Ensure all work delivery meets product readiness criteria, including clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and success measures.
Balance new demand with platform sustainability, technical debt reduction, and operational improvements.

Measurement & Value Realization

Define and track product‑level KPIs such as adoption, cycle time, data quality, user satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
Regularly review performance metrics to identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, and improved value realization.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Minimum of 10+ years of ServiceNow experience
Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

10+ years of hands‑on experience working with ServiceNow in a senior product, functional lead, or platform ownership capacity.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise‑scale platforms with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.
Strong understanding of ServiceNow usage to deliver outcomes, including:
Workflow orchestration, forms, data models, CMDB, and integrations
Core modules such as ITSM, ITOM and ITAM,
Reporting, dashboards, and data quality considerations
Strong product mindset with the ability to frame problems, define outcomes, and prioritize based on value and risk.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts in clear, executive‑ready language
CSA and CIS in ITSM, Data Foundations (Must have)
CIS in Event Management and Service Mapping (preferred)
ServiceNow Technical Architect certification (preferred)
ServiceNow AI capabilities implementation

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Amazon Customer Service Data Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Customer Service Data Intelligence is hiring a Principal Product Manager - Technical to own how we prove that the artificial intelligence serving our customers is safe, correct, and fair.

Customer Service Data Intelligence builds the data and intelligence foundation for Amazon Customer Service. When a customer contacts Amazon, the systems that resolve their issue need context — what they said, what they ordered, what they already tried. Our organization is responsible for turning those interactions into a governed, trustworthy foundation that models and applications can safely consume, and for the privacy and security controls that make consuming it possible at all.

This role exists because of a specific shift. When people handled every interaction, trust was a matter of training and policy. When artificial intelligence handles interactions autonomously, across every channel, trust becomes a matter of architecture. You cannot train an agent into good judgment after the fact, and you cannot audit your way to confidence in a system making decisions continuously. The property has to be engineered in — and increasingly, it has to hold for interactions no person will ever review.

You will own the product charter for that engineering. That means building the capability to verify an automated decision against policy before it executes rather than sampling it afterward, the capability to test our own agents adversarially and continuously rather than waiting for someone to find the gap first, and the capability to show that automated decisions treat customers consistently regardless of the marketplace they contact from, the language they speak, or the channel they use.

The most interesting part of this role is that the problem is genuinely unsolved. There is no vendor to buy this from and no established playbook to copy. You will define what "provably safe" means for customer-facing artificial intelligence at Amazon's scale, then build the products that make it the default path rather than the careful path. You will do it alongside security engineers, applied scientists, and legal partners, and your work will set the standard other teams build against.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for security and privacy intelligence across Amazon Customer Service artificial intelligence systems
Define requirements for translating customer service policies into machine-verifiable logic, so automated decisions can be checked against policy before they execute rather than sampled afterward
Own the product roadmap for continuous adversarial testing of customer service agents, including pre-launch security posture scoring as a launch requirement
Define and operate a fairness verification and monitoring framework that measures whether automated decisions produce consistent outcomes across customer segments, and escalates when they do not
Map product capabilities to regulatory obligations so compliance evidence is generated as a byproduct of operation rather than assembled on request
Chair the cross-organization governance forum that resolves policy conflicts, approves time-bounded exceptions, and closes the loop from a detected issue to an updated and re-verified policy
Partner with security engineering, applied science, legal, and agent-building teams to turn findings into launch standards other teams build against
Write the documents that drive decisions at director and vice president level, and define the metrics that show whether the safe path is also the fast path

A day in the life

Your week is split between three kinds of work. The first is depth: sitting with applied scientists and security engineers on how a policy becomes a formal constraint, or reading the output of an adversarial test run against one of our agents and deciding whether what it found is a bug in the agent or a gap in the policy. The second is decision-forcing: chairing the governance forum where security, legal, and the agent-building teams bring cases that need a call — restrict this agent, update that policy, accept this risk — and making sure each decision leaves with an owner and a date. The third is writing. This organization runs on documents, and the roadmap you own gets funded, sequenced, and defended in prose.

You will also spend real time on other teams' problems, because the fastest way to make the safe path the default is to make it cheaper than the alternative for the team shipping next month.

About The Team

Customer Service Data Intelligence builds the foundation that everything else in Customer Service depends on: how interaction data is captured, governed, enriched, traced, and safely consumed. Our teams span data and software engineering, applied science, analytics, and the privacy and security work that determines what any of it can be used for.

We are at an unusual moment. Language became computable, which turned two decades of customer conversations from an operational cost into the most valuable behavioral signal Amazon has — provided we can use it safely. That condition is the work. We are a builder-heavy, document-driven organization that would rather solve a problem once, centrally, than watch every team solve it badly on their own.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management
Experience owning and leading significant projects from concept to deployment
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
Experience within a customer service/contact center environment
- Experience building security, privacy, or compliance products
- Experience working with legal and regulatory stakeholders on data protection or artificial intelligence regulation

Whole Foods Market is known as the number one grocer suppliers want to be in, and our merchants are central to that reputation. Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Role

At Salesforce, the Developer Experience & Observability organization is on a mission to deliver a world-class development environment for more than 15,000+ internal engineers. We build the integrated products, platforms, and tooling that engineers – and an increasing number of AI agents – use to take code from idea to production. Our scope spans the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), from local and cloud-based development environments through source control, build systems, testing, code review, CI/CD, deployment and observability.

We are fundamentally reimagining the SDLC for the agentic era. Our ambition goes beyond faster code generation: we are redesigning how engineers and AI agents build software together by removing toil, shortening feedback loops, and helping teams ship high-quality software with confidence. This means turning emerging AI capabilities into trusted developer experiences that work at enterprise scale.

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to join our DX Product Management team. In this role, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for key developer products and platforms that sit in the path to production for all Salesforce engineers.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad organizational influence. You will partner closely with engineering and executive leadership, champion developers as customers, and turn their most important problems into products they adopt and value. If you are a product leader who can lay out a clear strategy, dive into technical details, build and experiment with AI tools, and obsess over developer experience, this is your opportunity to be at the forefront of driving impact across thousands of engineers.

In This Position, You Will

Set the product vision and strategy: Define a compelling direction, sequenced roadmap, and investment priorities Translate strategy into clear requirements and iterative delivery. Make deliberate choices about what to build, buy, improve, or retire, balancing developer needs, technical debt, security, cost, and long-term business goals.
Champion the voice of the developer: Build trusted customer relationships through interviews, advisory boards, surveys, workflow research, and product telemetry. Uncover the root causes of developer friction, translate those insights into focused product opportunities, validate solutions, and close the feedback loop.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Security Compliance and Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager Technical to own the direction of a portfolio of security products with company-wide security, risk, and compliance impact, and to own one of those products directly.

You will define how our products come together: where each one begins and ends, which capabilities belong where, and what the single experience looks like for a builder or a security team moving across them. You will also hold the product function for our most widely adopted product, so the portfolio direction stays anchored to a real backlog rather than becoming strategy at a distance.

This role operates where the business opportunity and the product strategy are not yet defined. You will often need to establish what the problem is before proposing what to build. You will influence engineering priorities, partner-team roadmaps, and security strategy across multiple VP organizations, without owning those teams.

Key job responsibilities

Own portfolio direction. Define how the products relate to each other, where capabilities belong, and what we stop doing. Make the calls on whether a new capability extends an existing product or justifies a new one.
Own a flagship product. Hold the product function for one product directly, including the roadmap and the ranked backlog as single prioritizer.
Define strategy where none exists. Establish the problem, the customer, and the multi-year direction in spaces that are ambiguous today, and bring clarity others can execute against.
Influence across organizations. Build the partnerships our products depend on across security, compliance, legal, and builder-tooling teams in other VP organizations, and reach agreement on approach and sequencing without authority.
Set the measurement bar. Define what outcome we are moving and hold the portfolio to it, replacing activity metrics with evidence that security posture improved.
Develop the product function. Raise the bar on product management practice on the team, mentor product and program managers, and participate in hiring.

A day in the life

You will move between horizons. In the same day you may resolve a boundary question between two products, review a specification with a senior engineer, and reset expectations with a partner team whose roadmap ours depends on.

You will spend meaningful time outside our organization, because most of what limits us is a dependency or a relationship we have not built yet. You will write the documents that make ambiguous, contested decisions reviewable by senior leadership, and you will own the outcome of those decisions.

About The Team

We are a team of product managers, program managers, engineers, and security engineers building the products that make security the default rather than a gate. Our portfolio spans three things: preventing issues at the point code is written, assuring that controls are implemented and evidenced, and turning security signals into risk intelligence that tells leaders which risks are worth their attention. Each product has one named owner for what we build and why, and one named owner for delivery, so ownership is unambiguous by design.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management
Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience owning a suite of related products or a platform portfolio
Experience with security, risk intelligence, compliance, or governance products
Experience building developer-facing platforms adopted at scale across a large engineering population
Experience with AI-assisted development tooling and agentic workflows
Experience turning regulatory obligations into durable product capability
Experience mentoring product managers and raising the bar on product practice
MBA or equivalent

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Elemental Inference is an AI-powered video understanding service that analyzes live and file-based video in real time, producing structured metadata that drives monetization, content transformation, and audience engagement at scale. The service delivers capabilities including intelligent video reframing, real-time highlight detection, automated subtitling, and contextual metadata for advertising workflows. Our customers today include the world's largest broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues. The core technology, real-time visual understanding at scale, is applicable to any domain where video carries signal that needs to be extracted and acted on.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of Elemental Inference. This is a single-threaded owner role. You will define what we build, why we build it, and how we bring it to market. You will work directly with applied scientists training video foundation models, engineers operating a real-time inference service, and customers running production workloads on it.

This role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of AI/ML product development and commercial execution. You will own the P&L, define pricing and packaging strategy, and drive adoption across a portfolio that spans AI inference, video monetization, and content intelligence. You will make trade-off decisions between expanding into new capabilities and verticals versus deepening quality and reducing cost on what exists today. You will represent Elemental Inference to AWS leadership, cross-org partners, and directly to customers.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product strategy, roadmap, and P&L for Elemental Inference. Set pricing, define packaging, monitor revenue, and adjust GTM approach based on adoption data and customer feedback.
Prioritize features based on customer requirements, revenue impact, competitive dynamics, and technical feasibility. Make explicit scope decisions between breadth (new capabilities, new verticals) and depth (quality, latency, cost).
Partner with the applied science team on model roadmap decisions. Translate customer needs into science requirements and define the bar for production readiness.
Drive cross-service integration with adjacent Elemental services (monetization, live encoding, VOD processing) to deliver end-to-end intelligent media workflows.
Lead cross-org initiatives that span multiple AWS organizations, building alignment on joint product development where shared customer problems require coordinated solutions.
Engage directly with strategic enterprise customers to validate product direction, close design partnerships, and drive adoption of launched features.
Define and manage the partner ecosystem strategy for data dependencies (sports data providers, content licensing) that enable product capabilities.
Identify and evaluate expansion opportunities where the core technology creates value in adjacent domains beyond the service's initial market.
Represent Elemental Inference at industry events and with AWS leadership. Communicate product vision, competitive positioning, and business performance with clarity.

About The Team

AWS Elemental provides the most comprehensive portfolio of media services in the cloud, purpose-built to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video at global scale. We support technology that delivers outstanding viewing experiences to millions of viewers worldwide, from the largest live sporting events to 24/7 linear channels and on-demand libraries. Our customers include the world's leading broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues.

7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the media, video, streaming, or advertising technology industry
Experience with real-time inference systems or video processing at scale
Experience working directly with applied science or machine learning teams on model development decisions

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, External Services, AWS, GenAIUX
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

The AWS CX GenAIUX team is building intelligent, personalized experiences that meet users where they are. We believe that different personas—builders, operators, decision-makers, learners—deserve purpose-built GenAI applications tailored to their workflows, mental models, and goals. We are a fast-moving team that values customer obsession, bias for action, and thinking big. We believe that our customers need not to learn AWS, rather we should learn customer’s and enable them to build on AWS wherever and however they prefer. We follow their intent and help them build.

Our team sits at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and User Experience — Our vision is to cater to the need of every personality of the customers, define the future of persona driven applications and democratizing innovation for all customers on earth. We believe that different personas — builders, operators, decision-makers, and learners — deserve purpose-built GenAI applications tailored to their workflows, mental models, and goals. We measure success trust earned, adoption of applications and enhancing the AWS adoption.

We're building the future of how people and AI work together on cloud infrastructure, and this role is central to that vision.

About The Role

Model a "builder PM" culture where hands-on experimentation is the norm, not the exception.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager - Technical to define the ever-evolving persona strategy for AWS's GenAI-powered customer applications, establish the application frameworks that translate persona insights into a portfolio of applications, and drive flywheel for success of our customers at AWS.

This requires a person who can drive a vision with conviction, remain stub-born on the vision yet flexible on the journey. This is a usability problem as much as a technology problem. The challenge is envisioning product for differentiated experiences where each customer intuitively understands the GenAI applications to leverage, trusts them enough to integrate into their life, delegate progressively complex work, and feels in control throughout. You will define how different customer personas experience trust, autonomy, and transparency differently — and translate that into distinct product experiences.

organization-level alignment on what we build, for whom, and why.

This is not a "strategy-only" role. In the era of Generative AI, the most impactful product leaders are hands-on builders who prototype before they prescribe, validate with working artifacts before writing documents, and earn engineering credibility by building alongside their teams. We expect you to be fluent in the tools and technologies you're shaping — capable of prompting, prototyping, and evaluating GenAI systems firsthand (a hands-on builder).

This is a high-ambiguity, high-impact opportunity to make a difference in AWS customer’s life with technology revolution. The problem space is largely undefined: we do not yet have a systematic understanding of how millions of AWS users (both tech and non-tech), e.g. from junior developers to C-suite executives should experience AI-native workflows differently. You will define the strategy, build the mechanisms, set the direction that an experienced engineering team executes against, and personally validate critical bets through hands-on prototyping. You will operate with significant independence, and influencing leadership, roadmap decisions across AWS CX with laser focus on Customers.

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Persona Strategy & Frameworks (Org-Level)

Define and own the persona strategy for AWS GenAI experiences — establishing a scalable, data-driven framework that the broader organization uses to segment, prioritize, and serve differentiated customer cohorts
Set the methodology for persona research (qualitative and quantitative), and direct L5/L6 PMs, UX researchers, and data scientists who execute against it
Establish a living persona framework that becomes an organizational asset — referenced in OP1/OP2 planning, used by engineering to make architecture decisions, and adopted by adjacent AWS teams

Portfolio Strategy & Application Definition

Translate persona insights into a portfolio of GenAI application concepts, defining the investment thesis for each: target persona, differentiated value, technical moat, and business model
Own the "working backwards" narrative at the portfolio level — authoring L7-grade PR/FAQs that articulate the 3-year vision and secure L8–L10 sponsorship. Supplement narratives with functional prototypes that make the vision tangible.
Make hard prioritization decisions across competing application investments, using a rigorous framework that balances customer impact, technical feasibility, time-to-value, and strategic positioning

Product Roadmap & Org-Level Alignment

Define success metrics grounded in customer outcomes — adoption by persona, task completion rates, trust signals (autonomy granted over time), friction reduction, and retention — with clear input/output metric trees that teams can decompose and own
Identify and escalate strategic trade-offs to senior leadership with clear recommendations

Cross-Functional & External Leadership

Influence senior leadership (L8–L10) with compelling, data-backed narratives that shape organizational priorities and resource allocation
Drive cross-org partnerships (Console, Documentation, Well-Architected, Training & Certification) to ensure persona insights are leveraged broadly
Represent AWS externally — customer advisory boards, re:Invent sessions, whitepapers, live demos — as the thought leader on persona-driven GenAI experiences
Engage directly with external AWS customers to understand their workflows, observe how they interact with agent experiences across personas, and ensure design decisions are grounded in real behavior
Attract, mentor, and develop PM talent; raise the product management bar across the team. Model a "builder PM" culture where hands-on experimentation is the norm, not the exception.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of technical experience (software development, ML/AI systems, or other hands-on engineering work)
10+ years of technical product management, program management, or engineering experience, with at least 5 years at a senior/principal level owning portfolio-level strategy
Experience delivering large-scale products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through launch
Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
Demonstrated experience shipping AI/ML or Generative AI products at scale
Hands-on experience building with GenAI tooling — evidence of personal prototyping, prompt engineering, or building functional demos/POCs (not just writing requirements for others to build)
Proven ability to operate in high-ambiguity environments — defining both the problem and the solution where neither is well-understood
Track record of influencing org-level strategy and driving alignment across multiple teams (engineering, science, design, business)
Experience establishing mechanisms and frameworks adopted beyond your immediate team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced technical degree (MS/PhD in CS, AI/ML, HCI, or related field)
Understanding of Large Language Models, agentic architectures, agentic solutions, and conversational AI — sufficient to discuss architectural trade-offs independently with tech team
Experience with AI development tooling (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, LangChain, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses)
Experience with UX research methodologies — usability testing, customer journey mapping, behavioral analytics, persona development, ethnographic research, Jobs-to-Be-Done
Track record of external thought leadership (conference talks, published papers, live demos at industry events)
Knowledge of AWS services and the AWS customer ecosystem

WHY "HANDS-ON" MATTERS FOR THIS ROLE

In the GenAI era, the speed of innovation means the gap between "strategy" and "execution" must collapse. AI products are probabilistic — their behavior can only be understood through direct experimentation, not specification documents. A PM who hasn't prompted the model, stress-tested edge cases, or built a working prototype simply cannot make informed prioritization decisions about what to build next.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience

The AI Monetization Product Team
within the AI Experiences organization at Microsoft is responsible for building and scaling advertising, commerce, and revenue-generating experiences across Microsoft's AI and consumer ecosystem. We Are Hiring Multiple Principal Product Managers, To Help Shape The Future Of Advertising And Monetization Experiences. Depending On Background And Expertise, Candidates May Focus On One Of Two Areas

Advertising Platform & Systems: Building the foundational services, infrastructure, data systems, experimentation frameworks, and platform capabilities that power scalable advertising products.
Consumer Advertising Experiences: Building intuitive, engaging, and AI-powered search, discovery, shopping, and advertising experiences that connect consumers with relevant products and services.

In either area, you will define product vision, influence strategy, and collaborate across engineering, design, data science, and business teams to deliver impactful solutions for advertisers and consumers.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, and Product Marketing to deliver customer-focused solutions.

Navigate ambiguity, influence across organizational boundaries, and build alignment among stakeholders.

Experience using data, experimentation, and customer insights to drive decision-making.

Experience improving product, customer, or business metrics through experimentation and optimization.

Mentor other product managers and move the team toward better, AI-forward ways of working.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Tech, Amazon Manufacturing Services
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) is seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Tech to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the manufacturing execution and automation intelligence stack powering Amazon’s first advanced manufacturing facility — a highly automated, first-of-its-kind operation. This facility integrates industrial robotics, end-to-end manufacturing automation, and digital manufacturing to produce systems for Amazon’s global fulfillment network.

Key job responsibilities

Manufacturing Execution Product Strategy

Own the 2–3 year product roadmap for the manufacturing execution stack — from scheduling UX through operator tools to AI-powered optimization
Define the product vision that connects AI-native scheduling intelligence to the physical shop floor experience
Develop and maintain the execution technology strategy across P0 (manual + semi-automated), P1 (AGV integration, real-time optimization), and P2 (AI-enabled autonomous control)
Write compelling narratives (PR/FAQs, 6-pagers, OP docs) that articulate product strategy and secure investment from leadership

Scheduling & Operator Experience

Serve as the operational product partner to the scheduling engineering team — translating manufacturing floor needs, pain points, and workflows into product requirements
Own the operator-facing scheduling experience: how assignments surface, how disruptions are communicated, how overrides are captured, and how the system explains its decisions to the right audience
Drive the scheduling system’s authority progression (Shadow → Advisory → Co-Pilot → Decision Maker) by defining success criteria, measuring override rates, and building supervisor trust through UX design
Define product requirements for scheduling and explainability tools from the operator/supervisor perspective

Machine Connectivity & IIoT

Own the product vision for machine connectivity — defining how equipment telemetry flows from factory floor to data lake to decision systems
Define integration requirements for manufacturing equipment onboarded at the manufacturing facility (industrial lasers, robotic welding cells, automated coating lines, autonomous mobile robots)
Develop product requirements for digital twin capabilities — real-time equipment state, simulation for what-if analysis, and predictive modeling
Partner with automation engineers to define the machine-to-cloud data contract for each equipment class

AI/ML & Continuous Improvement

Define and execute product strategy for AI-driven manufacturing intelligence: predictive maintenance, automated quality inspection, process parameter optimization, and autonomous cell control
Own requirements for the data platform layer that enables ML — feature stores, event streams, model serving infrastructure
Drive the feedback loop between quality outcomes (first-pass yield, scrap rates) and upstream process adjustments — ensuring the system learns and improves continuously
Define the operator interaction model for AI recommendations — when to alert, when to auto-act, when to require human confirmation

Shop Floor Quality & Compliance

Own the product experience for in-line quality: inspection workflows, non-conformance reporting, root cause analysis tools, and SPC dashboards
Define how quality data flows back to both the scheduling system (for replan triggers) and the enterprise system (for financial variance reporting)
Partner with Quality Engineering to translate ISO 9001:2015 requirements into tool capabilities and audit-ready data records

A day in the life

In the morning, you review overnight production data from our prototyping factory — the scheduling system’s override rate dropped to 7% this week, and you’re preparing the case to promote it from Shadow to Advisory mode. You pull the override-reason breakdown to identify two UX issues driving unnecessary supervisor interventions, then draft requirements for the engineering team.

Mid-morning, you join the scaled factory equipment onboarding review. The laser cutting integration team needs a decision on telemetry frequency — you work through the tradeoffs between data granularity (better for predictive maintenance models) and network cost (lower in batch mode), landing on a tiered approach by signal type.

After lunch, you’re on the prototype factory floor shadowing a powder coating operator through a disruption scenario — a rush order just reshuffled the queue, and you observe how the shop floor app communicates the change. The operator missed the notification; you sketch a design change in your notebook.

You close the day reviewing the ECO blast-radius prototype with the engineering team. An engineering change landed that affects 47 in-flight orders — the impact visualization needs to surface at-risk-dollars more prominently for the Change Control Board’s decision meeting tomorrow.
