Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), shop floor scheduling, or production control software
Experience managing technical products or online services in manufacturing or industrial environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
Experience in practical work applying ML to solve complex problems
Experience with concepts such as system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
Knowledge of cutting-edge production technologies and delivery workflows
Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related discipline
Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents
Knowledge of IIoT protocols (OPC UA, MTConnect, MQTT) and industrial data integration
Experience in high-volume, high-mix manufacturing environments (metals fabrication, welding, coating, assembly)
Experience with ISO 9001 or similar manufacturing quality management systems
Knowledge of Industry 4.0 principles, smart manufacturing architectures, or software-defined manufacturing

Overview

Core Search and AI team (Bing) is looking for people who want to build the next generation of search using advanced AI technologies, especially large language models, at scale. We are responsible for the largest machine learning models at Microsoft by volume and take pride in being the first in the world to solve many practical AI at Scale challenges. Our work spans a very large scope of scenarios including delivering high quality search results from a massive document corpus, query and document understanding, retrieval and reranking model for search results optimization, as well as AI search grounding, etc.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Principal Applied Scientist with solid machine learning expertise and can adopt state-of-art AI technologies to improve the relevance for the next generation of search. 

As a team, we leverage the diverse backgrounds and experiences of passionate engineers, scientists, and program managers to help us realize our goal of making the world smarter and more productive. We believe great products are built by inclusive teams of customer-obsessed individuals who trust each other and work together closely.  We collaborate regularly across the company to find technological breakthroughs from groups like Microsoft Research to infusing AI into the rest of Microsoft products like Office and Azure.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we believe that artificial intelligence will play a critical role in accomplishing that mission. The Core Search and AI team is the leading applied machine learning team at Microsoft responsible for delivering the highest-quality search experience to over 500M+ monthly active users around the world in Microsoft’s search engine, Bing and other dependent search engines such as Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, and new startups like Neeva.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

You will lead one or more big initiatives leveraging your expertise across a broad research landscape, including advanced research methodologies and applied techniques. You’ll gain deep knowledge of a service, platform, or domain, and drive product opportunities by sharing emerging industry trends and applied technologies.
You will review business requirements and incorporate research insights to meet strategic goals. You’ll provide directions on the types of data and machine learning model strategies needed to solve complex problems and apply deep subject‑matter expertise to drive measurable business impact.
You will support the onboarding of new team members and help develop academic collaborators into effective contributors within multidisciplinary teams. You’ll identify promising research talent, engage with the academic community, and strengthen Microsoft’s long‑term recruiting pipeline.
You will advance LLM post‑training and alignment techniques by designing, implementing, and evaluating novel methods that improve reasoning quality, safety, controllability, and factual grounding across large‑scale models.

You will drive collaborate across disciplines—including research, engineering, product, and design—to shape long‑term strategy for search, alignment, and retrieval‑augmented systems.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
jobs.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do

Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

Who You Are

You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.
You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in London or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.description:
Description

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

Based in Melbourne, Sydney or Canberra, we offer relocation support for candidates moving from other states.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

The architectural decisions being made now - how we structure services, implement security controls, and automate at scale - will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade. You won't be inheriting someone else's design choices. You'll be making them.

Your Opportunity

Imagine standing at the intersection of strategy, technology, and national purpose, where every product decision you make shapes how an entire AWS cloud region serves Australia's most critical missions. As a Senior Product Manager – Technical, External Services (PMT-ES), you won't just manage a product backlog. You'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of externally-facing AWS services. From defining the technical vision and product strategy, through architecture and launch, to driving adoption and operational excellence with the engineering and IT leaders who depend on your services every day.

This is a role for someone who thrives on complexity, brings deep full-stack technical fluency, and craves impact at scale. You'll define technical requirements alongside engineering teams building the next generation of cloud infrastructure, evaluate architecture trade-offs across performance, scalability, and security, and serve as the voice of the customer for external engineers and IT professionals integrating AWS services into their most critical workloads. When a customer escalation hits, you'll own it, diving deep with engineering to understand the problem, resolve it, and communicate clearly back to technically sophisticated customers.

The Region Services team is redefining how AWS designs, builds, and operates regions. You'll engage directly with technical decision-makers at Australia's most important organisations, understanding how they architect their solutions, generalising requirements across diverse customer personas, and driving service awareness, adoption, and evolution. Your work will directly accelerate Australia's cloud capability and set the standard for how sovereign cloud regions evolve worldwide.

If you're energised by working at the deepest technical levels of cloud services, engaging directly with the engineers and architects who build on AWS, and delivering products that genuinely change how nations operate in the cloud, this is your moment.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for externally-facing AWS services in the region, defining service vision, strategy, technical requirements, and roadmaps, while driving capacity planning and service performance.
Define and prioritise product roadmaps by engaging directly with external technical customers (engineers, architects, IT professionals), analysing usage data, service performance metrics, and competitive dynamics to anticipate where customers need to go next.
Partner deeply with engineering teams on architecture decisions, evaluating proposals across performance, scalability, latency, and security trade-offs. Define detailed technical requirements and hold engineering to high standards for service quality.
Serve as the Voice of the Customer distilling requirements from diverse sets of technical customers, understanding how the service integrates into their architectures, and generalising needs across customer personas to define the right product direction.
Own service adoption and operational excellence driving awareness, adoption, and performance optimisation with customers. Own customer escalations, and service communications until issues are resolved.
Collaborate across engineering, design, finance, sales, legal, and operations to align stakeholders, make smart trade-offs, and deliver outcomes that balance customer value with business sustainability.

A day in the life

Your morning begins with a review of service readiness dashboards, tracking which services are on track for launch, where integration testing is surfacing issues, and which customer workload requirements are driving prioritisation decisions. You spot a gap between a customer's architecture needs and a service's planned launch configuration, and pull together the data to make the case for adjusting the rollout sequence.

By mid-morning, you're in a technical design review with the engineering team. A service needs to meet specific compliance requirements before it can go live so you're evaluating the architecture against these constraints, defining the technical requirements, and working through trade-offs between launch timeline and operational readiness.

After lunch, you join a working session with a customer's cloud architects who are planning to migrate mission-critical workloads into the region. They need to understand which services will be available at launch, how they'll perform at scale, and what their migration path looks like. You walk through the region's service roadmap, capture their architectural requirements, and feed those directly into your prioritisation decisions.

The afternoon shifts to a cross-functional alignment session. You're bringing together engineering, capacity planning, compliance, and business development to resolve competing priorities for the launch window. You present your readiness assessment backed by customer commitment data and technical dependency analysis, and drive the group to a decision on what ships in the initial launch versus the fast-follow roadmap.

You end the day knowing that the region you're building will directly enable Australia's national security community to operate with confidence in the cloud and that tomorrow will bring an entirely new set of technical challenges worthy of your expertise.

About The Team

The Region Services team redefines the way AWS designs, builds, and operates AWS regions to enable new cloud infrastructure and services offerings to customers across every industry and of every size, including startups, enterprises, and public sector organisations.

jobs.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Director of Growth to lead our Product organization focused on customer and business growth for McAfee. This is a high-ownership leadership role responsible for how customers discover, buy, and stay subscribed to our products. You'll own the customer commerce funnel: conversion, monetization, and retention of a global, direct-to-consumer subscription business.

This is the right role for someone who is obsessed with the customer experience, thinks in experiments and segmentation, is fluent in the economics of subscriptions (conversion, AOV, retention, LTV, ARPU, churn), and can turn a roadmap of products, capabilities, and optimizations into measurable revenue. You'll lead a high performing growth PM team and partner closely with marketing, payments, finance, and legal to grow revenue and strengthen retention.

This is a Hybrid position located in New York, New York, Frisco, Texas or Newport Beach, CA. You will be required to be onsite on an as needed basis likely a few times a month. When you are not working onsite you will work from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance of New York, New York, Frisco, TX or Newport Beach, CA and are not offering relocation assistance.

Position Details

What You'll Own

The full-funnel growth strategy across acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention with clear, quantified targets each quarter.
The end-to-end purchase experience across desktop and mobile web, desktop and mobile apps, retail channel, and the conversion rate it drives.
Pricing & packaging - support testing and launching new plans and offers, and their impact on ARPU and take-rate.
Subscriber retention and LTV, including renewal, payment method optimization, win-back, and monetization programs.
The growth dashboard and KPI targets (conversion rate, revenue, ARPU, LTV, churn/retention, fraud reduction).
The Growth team - its talent bar, experimentation maturity, and bench of future leaders.

What You'll Do

Set the growth strategy and translate it into a prioritized roadmap with measurable quarterly goals.
Build and scale an experimentation engine - hypothesis, design, statistical rigor, and a fast learn-and-ship cadence of A/B tests.
Optimize the purchase experience to maximize conversion and reduce friction across markets and devices.
Design and run pricing, offer, and packaging tests that grow ARPU and take-rate without eroding conversion or retention.
Drive retention and LTV through data-informed onsite and in-app interventions.
Lead, mentor, and grow the team, raising the bar for talent and developing future leaders.
Partner cross-functionally with eCommerce, marketing, payments, data, and finance to turn new capabilities and customer experiences into compounding commercial wins.
Report results transparently to leadership and hold the team accountable to outcomes.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in growth, product, monetization, or eCommerce, with 3+ years leading and developing teams.
Proven track record growing a subscription or D2C eCommerce business - measurable impact on conversion, retention, and LTV.
Deep fluency in subscription economics and metrics: revenue, LTV, ARPU, churn/retention cohorts, and customer segmentation.
Hands-on experience building and running an experimentation program (A/B and multivariate testing) and making decisions from data.
Strong command of pricing & packaging strategy and offer design for recurring revenue.
Experience optimizing purchase and conversion flows, ideally across websites and apps across multiple geographies.
Comfort working closely with engineering, payments, marketing/lifecycle, data, and finance.
Excellent communicator who can set strategy, align stakeholders, and hold a team accountable to outcomes.

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Senior Director, PM - AI Agent Systems

AI agents can reason about what needs to happen. Getting them to reliably do work inside the software businesses actually run on is the next frontier.

We’re building Systems Integration Agent: computer use for the enterprise. It learns how to operate applications like SAP, Oracle, and Workday, then turns that knowledge into reusable, code-backed actions. The challenge goes beyond making an impressive demo: customers need automation they can trust with consequential business processes.

Our team operates as a small startup within Salesforce AI Labs, separate from the main engineering and product organizations. You’ll work directly with the team’s leader and engineers, alongside customers, with the autonomy to shape an early product and the resources of Salesforce to back you up.

As Senior Director of Product Management, you’ll help turn early production success into a repeatable product business. You should be as comfortable investigating a failed customer workflow as presenting the product strategy to executive leadership.

Build Directly With Customers

Work alongside enterprise customers to understand their processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and define what successful execution actually means.
Partner with engineering and forward-deployed engineers to take workflows from initial exploration through production adoption.
Distinguish customer-specific requirements from recurring needs that deserve investment in the core product.

Own Product Strategy and Prioritization

Decide where to focus first: which customers, systems, and workflows offer the strongest combination of customer value and repeatable adoption.
Make explicit tradeoffs between winning a new customer and building capabilities that make the next ten deployments easier.
Translate customer requirements and technical constraints into clear product decisions.

Partner with engineering and design to make recording, building, testing, debugging, and operating workflows accessible to the people who own those processes.
Define how users understand what an agent can do, verify its results, recover from failures, and retain control over consequential actions.
Establish product-level success criteria and release gates grounded in task completion, correctness, intervention rates, and time to value.
Build a path from hands-on onboarding toward increasingly self-service adoption.

Take the Product to Market

Partner with Salesforce stakeholders across product marketing, sales, pricing, security, and legal to bring the offering to market.
Shape positioning, packaging, and the customer journey from first demonstration to evaluation, purchase, and production use.
Build a growth strategy that connects enterprise buying decisions with hands-on technical validation and practitioner credibility.
Keep leadership aligned on the investment needed, the evidence behind the strategy, and the decisions that will determine what happens next.

You’ve taken an enterprise software product from ambiguity into production adoption. You can explain the decisions you owned, what customers actually used, and how the product changed after launch.
You have hands-on experience bringing AI-powered products to users. You understand why model quality alone is insufficient and can reason about evaluation, reliability, latency, cost, and human oversight.
You are technically fluent. You can engage deeply with engineers on agent behavior, APIs, workflow state, permissions, and failure recovery without needing to be the implementation owner.
You build directly with customers. You can move between a CIO’s business objectives and a process owner’s daily work, turning both into focused product decisions.
You demonstrate senior product judgment. You’ve owned consequential roadmap and investment tradeoffs, aligned teams without relying on reporting lines, and stayed accountable for outcomes.
You want to remain hands-on. You’re comfortable testing the product, writing precise requirements, investigating failures, and doing the detailed work required to get an early product right.

Enterprise automation, integration platforms, RPA, developer tools, or agent-based products.
Products used across systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, or Salesforce.
Combining enterprise sales with self-service evaluation or product-led adoption.
Working with forward-deployed engineering teams.

Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our FinTech Team, focusing on payments. FinTech is a key area of investment for the company and a cornerstone of our future growth. As the successful candidate, we will rely on your honed product management skills combined with your experience in the Fintech space to shape the trajectory of this product. This role can be performed remotely across Canada or the US (some exceptions may apply).

Product Management at Clio:

Clio’s mission is to ‘transform the legal experience for all.’ If you’re into ‘mission-driven’ product management this might be the place for you!

Our market opportunity is rare in its scale and powered by a strong business model, Silicon Valley based investors and advisors, and a product management team which is global and world-class (if we do say so ourselves)! Clio is growing rapidly with massive growth opportunities for Product Managers.

Speaking of Product at Clio… we’ve worked hard to develop an excellent product management culture with empowered PMs who are highly regarded and influential within the organization. Our team is composed of seasoned professionals from a diverse set of product backgrounds. Clio invests heavily in developing Product Managers, growing leaders and in the broader Product communities in which we operate.

We pride ourselves on being ‘human and high performing’ and creating a workplace where you can be challenged, supported and bring your whole self to work.

What you’ll work on:

Product Leadership

As a Senior Product Manager and in conjunction with your Developer and Designer counterparts (your triad) you will drive successful outputs and outcomes in your product area. Working from the overarching strategy set by your Senior Director of Product, you will develop a strategic roadmap in conjunction with your peers that moves our business forward and evangelize this throughout the company.

Strategy and Prioritization

You will drive customer and market research, identify opportunities, develop unbiased business cases and determine priorities that help Clio best deliver on our mission and against our annual OKRs. You will build conviction in the initiatives that you chose to invest in and be willing to pivot when priorities change or new information comes to light.

Market and Customer Understanding

As such, constant communication with customers, (existing, churned and prospect) as well as a deep understanding of the markets in which we operate will be expected. This will be complemented by deep quantitative data to complete the customer picture.

Coaching and Mentoring

Clio will look to you to coach and mentor other Product Managers in their craft and, in conjunction with product leadership, contribute to the continuous up-levelling of the product function as a whole.

What you have:

A fintech background (payments, billing, and accounting preferred) with solid financial literacy skills
Experience autonomously developing a strategic roadmap with measurable business impact

Have the genuine ability to put yourself in our customers’ shoes and operate from a place of empathy
Are enthusiastic to learn a new, complex domain and the humility to ask for help when needed

Proven experience participating in building and scaling a payments business
Demonstrable experience self serving answers, insights and data from a variety of data analytics tools

At Flexcar, our mission is to make car ownership flexible, affordable, and enjoyable for everyone. We’ve created a month-to-month option that is more affordable than buying and more flexible than leasing. Our members are saving money and choosing a model that fits how real life actually works. Building a better model of car ownership takes more than technology. It takes people who value clarity, fairness, and real human experience.

Flexcar is looking for a Senior PM to join its fast-moving product team and take on high-impact IC work across multiple product verticals. You’ll be tasked with getting up to speed on Flexcar’s business model, deeply understanding our customers’ needs, and moving some of our most important product work forward. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a pre-scoped roadmap to execute against: you'll be identifying opportunities with the clearest value, building the business case, executing across whichever combination of engineering, design, operations, and cross-functional partners the problem requires, and reading out on impact.

The right person for this role is energized by that level of ownership, excited to take on that responsibility within a business that is rapidly growing, and eager to grow a skillset that extends beyond the traditional PM role
.

What You'll Do

Own product areas end-to-end.
You'll be accountable for outcomes across one or more product verticals. What "shipping" looks like varies week to week: sometimes it's a significant feature launch, sometimes it's a policy change, a process redesign, or an analysis that unlocks the next decision.

Contribute in a variety of ways.
At Flexcar, features get built in a lot of different ways, with different engineers, different cross-functional partners, and sometimes with you writing the first version yourself. You'll be comfortable moving between those modes, and equally comfortable closing the loop: pulling the data, building the rationale, and assessing whether what shipped moved the needle.

Work in the in-between spaces.
A lot of our highest-leverage product work happens before and after major launches: deep problem definition, stakeholder alignment, competitive research, building out pilots, and post-launch learning. You'll be expected to find and own that work without being told to.

Execute through cross-functional collaboration.
You’ll need to communicate your ideas clearly and build trust across the organization. Software development at Flexcar has a broad impact and ensuring that all teams are along for the ride will be a priority.

Build with AI, thoughtfully.
We've scaled AI tooling quickly across the team. We expect Senior PMs to be able to write and ship basic code, prototype designs, and build solutions in our agentic infrastructure. That said, the tools are the easy part: we are focused on finding critical thinkers who pursue creative solutions.

Required

What We're Looking For

Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience
5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2–3 years owning a product area independently without requiring heavy support or direction
Proven capacity to build seamlessly with partners in engineering and design
Strong analytical instincts and genuine comfort with data. You should be the kind of person who builds a data-driven case before forming an opinion
Track record of operating effectively in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments
Genuine AI curiosity: you've been using these tools in your actual workflow, not just experimenting
Demonstrated ownership mentality: you notice what's broken and fix it without being asked
Experience working with and influencing cross-functional stakeholders beyond a core squad (finance, marketing, operations, legal, vendors, etc.)

Nice to Have

Prior experience at a company with both significant technological and operational complexity
Prior experience working in a startup or similar growth-phase environment
Experience building or shipping AI-assisted features or tooling, using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Claude Design

What Tops Off The Tank

Rest & Relaxation: Flexible PTO policy.
Future Savings: Benefit from a 401(k) plan with company match from day one.
Benefits: Excellent, low-cost healthcare coverage including: medical, dental, vision, eligibility day one.
Drive a Flexcar! Discounted employee rate on Flexcar products and no annual membership fee.
Weekly Pay
And other amazing perks!

jobs.description:
Purchase, NY/ 1 New York Plaza

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, investment management, and wealth management services to clients worldwide. Digital Client Experience & Platforms is building secure, scalable, and intuitive client-facing capabilities that help protect clients, enable digital adoption, and support trusted engagement across web and mobile channels.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product Manager to own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for client platform Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This leader will serve as a builder-operator for a critical identity and security platform, delivering secure-by-design authentication capabilities that protect clients while preserving a seamless digital experience. The role requires strong product judgment, execution discipline, and the ability to align engineering, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, legal, compliance, design, operations, and channel stakeholders around a measurable roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Platform Ownership

Own the MFA product vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly delivery plans across web, mobile, and shared client platform capabilities.
Define reusable authentication capabilities, adoption patterns, and integration standards that can scale across multiple client journeys and channel teams.
Translate security, fraud, regulatory, and client experience objectives into clear product outcomes, prioritized features, and measurable success criteria.
Develop the target-state roadmap for enrollment, step-up authentication, trusted devices, device binding, recovery, factor management, and channel migration.

Delivery, Execution & Operating Discipline

Lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, operations, design, and channel product teams from discovery through production launch.
Convert product strategy into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and launch readiness artifacts.
Manage dependencies across identity, session management, device intelligence, fraud decisioning, client servicing, contact center tooling, and digital channels.
Drive disciplined product rituals including prioritization, backlog grooming, stakeholder reviews, delivery governance, testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.

Risk, Controls, Privacy & Governance

Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Fraud Operations, Chief Data Office/Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure MFA capabilities meet internal control standards and external regulatory expectations.
Own product documentation and governance artifacts, including risk assessments, control mappings, audit evidence, exception handling, change approvals, and operational readiness materials.
Embed privacy, consent, data minimization, resiliency, and auditability considerations into product design and delivery decisions.

Client Experience, Adoption & Operational Excellence

Optimize MFA experiences to reduce friction while maintaining strong protection, including prompt frequency, factor choice, enrollment completion, recovery flows, accessibility, and servicing escalation paths.
Partner with UX research, design, analytics, and servicing teams to validate journeys, identify drop-off drivers, and improve client and advisor outcomes.
Define production health expectations, including observability, incident readiness, defect prioritization, operational playbooks, and post-launch performance reviews.

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director Product Management - Technical

About Mastercard

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Role Summary

We are looking for a **Principal Product Manager – Technical** to lead product strategy and execution for **global, real‑time switching and authorization platforms**.In this role, you will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of **mission‑critical transaction processing capabilities** that operate at massive scale with strict requirements for availability, latency, resiliency, and correctness. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, operations, and business leaders to deliver platforms that support billions of transactions and enable reliable, secure payment experiences worldwide. This is a **senior individual contributor role** with broad influence across teams, regions, and portfolios.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Vision* Define and own the long‑term product vision and strategy for switching and authorization platforms.* Translate complex customer, business, and ecosystem needs into clear product roadmaps and priorities.* Identify and drive new platform capabilities that improve transaction reliability, scalability, and performance.* Make data‑driven prioritization decisions balancing customer value, risk, regulatory needs, and time‑to‑market. Technical Product Leadership* Serve as the product authority for real‑time authorization and switching systems.* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to influence design decisions while maintaining product accountability.* Define clear product requirements, including functional behavior and non‑functional expectations such as availability, latency, throughput, and resiliency.* Ensure operational readiness, monitoring, and observability are integral to product delivery. Roadmap & Execution Ownership* Own and manage multi‑year product roadmaps, including near‑term delivery and long‑term modernization initiatives.* Define epics, features, and user stories with clear outcomes and success metrics.* Evaluate trade‑offs between new capabilities, technical sustainability, ecosystem impact, and operational risk.* Use in‑market performance data and platform metrics to continuously refine priorities. Stakeholder & Customer Engagement* Represent the voice of customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in product decisions.* Collaborate across product, engineering, operations, risk, and business teams to drive alignment and execution.* Communicate complex technical and product concepts clearly to executive and non‑technical audiences. Leadership & Impact* Act as a mentor and role model for other product managers.* Influence across the organization without direct authority.* Raise the bar for product excellence, technical rigor, and customer focus.

All About You

Required Qualifications*

Significant experience in **Technical Product Management** for large‑scale, distributed, high‑availability systems.* Strong understanding of real‑time platforms, APIs, integration patterns, and modern software delivery practices.* Proven ability to lead complex initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across a matrixed organization.* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Qualifications. While not required, experience or familiarity with **payment cryptographic and security services** is a strong plus, including:* EMV and authorization cryptographic flows such as **ARQC, ARPC**, and related issuer validation mechanisms* **Account Authentication Value (AAV)** and e‑commerce authentication constructs* **PIN‑based services**, including PIN validation and PIN translation* **Tokenization and digital enablement services**, such as **MDES (Mastercard Digital Enablement Service)*** **Magnetic Stripe services** and legacy transaction processing concepts* Working knowledge of how cryptographic services integrate with authorization and switching platforms in a real‑time payment environment. This knowledge helps accelerate impact but is **not a prerequisite** for success in the role.Why Join Us* Work on platforms that power **global commerce at massive scale*** Influence products with **network‑wide, real‑world impact*** Collaborate with world‑class engineers, architects, and product leaders* Grow your career while shaping the future of digital payments.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

New York City, New York: $187,000 - $318,000 USD

CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy ,
creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.

The Role

CCC is seeking a Principal Product Manager for our Outbound Subrogation product, one of the most consequential and underserved categories in the insurance economy. More than $30 billion flows through subrogation workflows every year, yet most carriers are still operating on outdated, manual processes. This role will have the opportunity to bring subrogation into the AI era, with an unprecedented scale of impact.

We are relaunching this product in 2027 with the ambition of building it into a category-defining platform. You will define the product strategy, own the roadmap, shape the architecture alongside engineering and data science, and be the expert in the room when carriers evaluate what to buy. You will work with a dedicated set of development pods, significant autonomy, and close partnership with senior product leadership. This role starts as an individual contributor with a clear path to building and growing your team as the product scales.

Key Responsibilities:

Own and drive the product roadmap for Outbound Subrogation user experience, including prioritization of features, data capabilities, AI enhancements, and integrations
Translate market signals, customer research, and competitive intelligence into a clear, defensible strategy you can articulate from the carrier floor to the executive team
Set and track the metrics that matter to carriers: dollars recovered, identification rate, cycle time, and other ROI signals. Be accountable for moving them.
Partner with data science and engineering on topics from architecture for next-best-action and workflow design to how LLM-based capabilities like explainability are deployed and governed
Conduct customer research with recovery managers, subrogation adjusters, and carrier teams; get concepts in front of real users and make hard product decisions based on what you find
Represent the voice of the user in every internal product and prioritization conversation; maintain a continuous feedback loop between the field and the roadmap
Contribute directly to working software alongside engineers, using AI coding tools as a part of how you work - not only a manager delegating a spec, but as a builder participating in the work
Build and own the ROI case for the product: define how carriers measure value from subrogation tooling and hold the product accountable to those measures
Partner with sales, customer success, and product marketing on go-to-market execution, sales enablement materials, and carrier-facing ROI narratives
Support active sales cycles as the product expert: show up in carrier conversations and help close deals by articulating value credibly to buyer stakeholders from operations leads to C-suite

6+ years of product management experience in enterprise software or high-growth SaaS (preferred); Principal designation will be determined based on scope and experience
At least one 0-to-1 product build or major relaunch in a startup or high-velocity environment
Demonstrated experience building and shipping AI-driven or data-intensive products with LLMs, scoring models, or ML pipelines as core components
Track record of working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders to validate product direction, plan for and track adoption, and support commercial outcomes
Deep experience in at least one complex, regulated vertical (insurance, fintech, healthtech, legaltech, or similar); direct subrogation or claims experience is a meaningful differentiator
Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias toward action and learning over extensive upfront planning

You are a product professional who has built and shipped a product with meaningful business outcomes. You are comfortable in enterprise sales environments. You can construct a compelling ROI case, work alongside client partners in an active deal, and support the sale by making customers excited to work with you and watch your roadmap come to fruition.
You have the discipline to stop work that is not driving the expected results. You define success criteria before you build, test early, and have the honesty to pause investments where the data doesn’t support a path forward.

jobs.description:
Who We Are At Osmo

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone.

We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.

About The Role

We're hiring a Software, Technical Program Manager to embed directly with Osmo's Software and AI organization. You'll be the connective tissue between our ML engineers, applied ML scientists, software engineers, and the rest of the company — driving how and when we build, managing complex dependencies, and removing blockers so the team can move. It's a role that rewards curiosity: the more you understand how the system actually works, the better you'll be at anticipating where it breaks.

This is a software-specific TPM role, and we mean it. You'll need to be technically credible with engineers and ML scientists at a detailed level — comfortable in a design review, comfortable reading code, comfortable understanding a model architecture decision and its downstream impacts. You'll be driving technical execution and cross-functional delivery inside one of the most ambitious applied AI problems in the world, which takes real tenacity when timelines get hard and real kindness when you're the one asking a stretched team for more.

What You'll Do

Be the Execution Thought Partner — Partner directly with software and ML leadership on execution strategy, resource planning, and timeline delivery.
Turn Ambition Into Milestones — Translate product and scientific ambitions into clear, actionable engineering milestones, and build the operational roadmap from architecture to deployment.
Build Your Own AI-Powered Tools — Use AI tools and workflows in your own work for progress tracking, dependency mapping, and operational efficiency.
Own Execution and Dependencies — Identify cross-functional blockers, make timeline tradeoffs visible, and drive them to resolution with tenacity, not just escalation.
Structure Release Readiness — Build deployment schedules for ML models and software systems.
Sit Close to the Real Work — Be in design reviews, read the code when you need to, and stay genuinely curious about how the system actually works.
Develop Deep Technical Intuition — Understand architectural bottlenecks, latency risks, and integration challenges.
Translate Across the Technical Divide — Move execution status and risk between technical teams and stakeholders, with the kindness to make hard news land without losing the substance.
Bring Structure Without Bureaucracy — Scope and sequence ambiguous initiatives without adding process for its own sake.
Surface Risk Early — Bring blockers forward with proposed solutions, not just escalations.
Set the Bar — Help define what good technical program management looks like at Osmo.

Who You Are

10+ Years of Combined Depth — Software/ML engineering plus program management or TPM experience.
Fluent in the ML Lifecycle — Data, training, evaluation, validation, deployment.
Technically Fluent, Not Just Technically Aware — Reads code, follows model architecture discussions in real time.
A Proven Technical Execution Driver — Delivered complex, multi-team projects, with the tenacity to see them through when things slip.
An AI-Native Operator — Fluency with modern AI tools and a track record of using them in your own work.
Curious by Default — Walks into an undefined space and asks the questions that produce clarity, rather than waiting to be told the plan.
A Clear, Confident Communicator — Bridges technical and business stakeholders with the kindness to bring people along.
Willing to Push Back — Comfortable challenging senior leaders when timelines or resources don't add up.
Bachelor's degree or higher in CS or equivalent experience.
Hybrid in Elizabeth, NJ — Available hybrid at 3 days.

Ways To Stand Out

You Still Write Code — Moved into program management but still write code by choice.
You've Shipped Applied AI at Scale — Orchestrated delivery of applied ML products or platforms.
You've Built the Process, Not Inherited It — Built engineering delivery process from scratch, with the tenacity that takes.
You Validate It Yourself — Comfort with Python, SQL, or notebooks to self-check status.
You've Built Tools That Mattered — Built AI-powered tools that materially improved org operations.
You've Been a Trusted Execution Partner — Partnered with founders or senior technical leaders directly.
You Drive Without Authority — Drives alignment through kindness and credibility rather than a title.

What We Offer

Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles
401(k) savings plan and employer match
Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
Flexible PTO and paid family leave
Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

Cantor Fitzgerald’s Investment Banking division is establishing a dedicated AI function and seeks a Vice President to own the end‑to‑end creation, deployment, and adoption of AI tools across all deal‑making activities. Reporting to the Head of AI, you will partner with bankers, compliance, and technology teams to design solutions that embed directly into pitch preparation, financial analysis, diligence, and market surveillance, driving measurable efficiency and competitive advantage.

Responsibilities

Design and build AI‑powered applications for core IB workflows such as pitch decks, comparable company analysis, CIM drafting, diligence summarization, client research, and market surveillance.
Own the full development lifecycle: data sourcing, LLM integration, backend logic, and user‑facing interfaces; prototype rapidly and iterate based on banker feedback.
Integrate solutions with firm data infrastructure including FactSet, PitchBook, SEC EDGAR, and internal databases to deliver context‑aware insights.
Establish technical standards, architectural guidelines, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails to ensure production‑grade performance and compliance.
Collaborate with coverage groups to translate high‑friction tasks into tractable AI problems and serve as senior liaison on AI strategy.
Create and maintain enablement assets—documentation, training, support channels—and drive adoption through measurable metrics.
Manage the AI request intake pipeline, prioritize initiatives, scope deliverables, and communicate timelines to stakeholders.
Monitor deployed tools for performance, usage, and issue resolution; continuously refine based on real‑world data.
Contribute to the long‑term AI roadmap, resource planning, and hiring recommendations for the function.
Navigate compliance, data sensitivity, and regulatory constraints, partnering with InfoSec and Legal as integral collaborators.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance, or a closely related financial services role.
Deep functional fluency in IB deal processes including pitch construction, financial modeling, CIM preparation, and capital markets execution.
Hands‑on experience architecting and deploying LLM‑based solutions, including context pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and cost/quality trade‑offs.
Full‑stack prototyping skills with ability to integrate data sources, build backend logic, and create user‑friendly interfaces.
Proficiency in a programming language (e.g., Python, JavaScript) and familiarity with financial data APIs such as Bloomberg, PitchBook, or SEC EDGAR.
Demonstrated ownership mindset with a track record of identifying problems and delivering end‑to‑end solutions.
Strong judgment in ambiguous, high‑stakes environments and ability to set direction without complete information.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical concepts for senior bankers and convey IB context to technology teams.
Experience designing AI solutions within compliance, data security, and regulatory frameworks.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or a quantitative field; advanced degree is a plus.

Compensation- $170,000- $200,000

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Ads
jobs.description:
🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “ Best Places to Work"
and Built In’s “ 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is hiring a Principal Product Manager, Ads
to reimagine and build an advertising solution for the next generation of our platform.

TeamSnap today has a scaled advertising business. For years, top national and regional brands have reached millions of youth sports families through the TeamSnap app. What's next is building an ad product for where we're going. As we bring our millions of parents, coaches, and players onto a new, unified TeamSnap experience, the ads business gets rebuilt with it, from a blank slate.

This is a unique and rare product opportunity. You'll be rebuilding advertising at a company that has already proven the demand — real advertisers, real revenue — and playing the lead role in deciding what the future of advertising looks like at TeamSnap. The formats, the placements, the measurement, and the standards that keep all of it worthy of the families who trust us and deliver on our advertisers' objectives.

You'll own the product side of that ad platform end to end — partnering with Design on native ad experiences, with Engineering on the serving and measurement infrastructure, and with our Ad Sales team on the inventory and packaging they take to market. You'll report to VP Product and work closely with senior leaders across the company on one of TeamSnap's top strategic priorities.

What You'll Do:

Own the advertising product roadmap end to end — from ad format and placement strategy through serving infrastructure, targeting, measurement, and reporting.
Design and launch native, integrated ad experiences in partnership with Product Design. Our thesis is that ads on TeamSnap should feel like part of the product and drive value for both our consumer users and advertisers.
Own the serving and targeting stack: ad server implementation, trafficking and campaign delivery workflows, private marketplace deal setup, and the first-party signal work that makes our inventory worth buying — getting the right context to the ad call so it can be used for targeting.
Build the measurement foundation: impression and viewability tracking, event instrumentation, third-party verification where advertisers require it, advertiser-facing reporting, and the experimentation framework to improve placements and creative over time.
Own ad quality, density, and user experience standards — where ads appear, how often, and what we won't do.
Partner with Ad Sales and Revenue Operations to turn product capability into sellable inventory — packaging, the targeting taxonomy they sell against, rate card inputs, and campaign delivery and pacing.
Model and forecast the business. Build the volume, fill rate, and eCPM models that tell us which placements are worth building, and what has to be true for a given format to pay for itself.
Own privacy and compliance requirements for ad targeting and data use, in partnership with Legal — including how children's data is treated, given the families we serve.
Work in ambiguity. Break down an undefined space into a sequenced plan, make practical tradeoffs between revenue, engineering cost, and user impact, and bring partners along with a clear point of view.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

7-10 years in product management, with meaningful time spent on the publisher/supply side of the ads ecosystem — building and monetizing ad inventory inside a consumer product.
Direct experience launching or scaling ad products in a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android), including the platform-specific realities: SDK integration, ATT and IDFA, store policy, app release cycles, and how those constrain what you can ship and when.
Deep, hands-on technical fluency with the publisher ad stack: ad server implementation and trafficking (Google Ad Manager or equivalent), programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals, key-value and audience targeting, ad SDK integration, VAST and video formats. You should be able to hold your own in an engineering design review.
Command of the economics: fill rate, eCPM, RPM, sell-through, viewability, latency, and how each moves in response to product decisions. Comfortable pricing inventory without an auction to tell you what it's worth. You can build the model yourself and defend the assumptions.
Experience working alongside a direct ad sales organization — translating between what sales wants to sell and what the product can actually deliver, and building the packaging that closes the gap.
Demonstrated judgment about ads and user experience. A track record of shipping monetization that didn't degrade the product, and clear thinking on where the lines belong.
Strong data instincts. Comfortable in product analytics tools (Amplitude or similar) and SQL-adjacent enough to interrogate your own funnels rather than waiting on someone else to.

Bonus:

Experience with rewarded video, pre-roll, or other video monetization formats.
Background in a subscription business where advertising had to coexist with a paid tier without cannibalizing it.
Working knowledge of children's privacy regimes — COPPA and its state-level equivalents — as they apply to advertising.
First-party data and audience signal work: building the pipeline that carries publisher context into targeting decisions.
Familiarity with sports, media, or a community-driven consumer platform.

Got cold feet? If you're thinking you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying
. We're all humans with special talents that go beyond what's listed here.

Compensation

We're committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum
starting point for this role is $180,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

🖥 Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

🎩 Total Rewards

We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool
Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)
100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family
401K to help you invest for the future
$1,500 annual learning and development stipend
Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events
Generous home office allowance to set you up for success
TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter
A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!
TeamSnap Total Rewards

🏆 Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Are you passionate about shaping the future of natural food ingredients? We are partnering with a global leader in natural color solutions to identify a Senior Global Product Manager
who will drive the strategy, innovation, and commercial success of a portfolio of natural color pigments used across food, beverage, and pet food applications!

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for developing global product strategies, optimizing portfolio performance, and translating customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence into profitable growth initiatives. You'll collaborate closely with Commercial, R&D, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and regional teams to bring innovative products to market and maximize portfolio value.

Develop and execute global product portfolio strategies and long-term roadmaps.
Drive product lifecycle management, portfolio optimization, and innovation priorities.

Lead pricing strategy, profitability analysis, and portfolio performance reviews.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager- Growth
jobs.description:
About Us

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

Vida Health is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Growth
to own the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of critical pieces of the member journey - onboarding and retention. You will drive engagement, retention, and health outcomes for hundreds of thousands of members across Vida’s clinical and behavioral programs.

This role sits within Vida’s Member Experience group, which owns the full consumer journey from onboarding through long-term engagement and retention. Reporting to the Director of Member Experience, you will partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Clinical teams to ship high-impact product improvements while helping lay the foundation for Vida’s next-generation personalized experience.

This is a high-autonomy IC role with room to grow. You will balance near-term product execution (improving core features, running experiments, reducing friction) with contributing to longer-term 2.0 vision work. The ideal candidate is a strong executor who can drive results in the current product while thinking strategically about where the experience needs to go.

Responsibilities

Drive growth and onboarding across landing page, eligibility, and onboarding for Vida Health’s core member funnel.
Devise experiments based on rigorous, thoughtful, data-backed hypotheses.
Iterate on experiments by analyzing results and addressing new bottlenecks
Re-architect onboarding to reduce early drop-off and drove lift in registration.
Own the member growth product backlog and support roadmap development: prioritize, scope, ship, and measure improvements to early experience (landing pages, onboarding, first clinical visit).
Drive A/B testing and rapid experimentation to improve engagement, activation, and retention metrics.
Manage bug triage and quality for the member experience; ensure a reliable, performant product.
Partner with Engineering and Design to maintain product velocity, unblock delivery, and manage technical tradeoffs.
Translate client requests and stakeholder input into well-scoped product work without compromising member experience quality.
Own member experience metrics, including engagement, retention, churn, activation rate, and NPS.
Build, maintain, and report on dashboards in Looker and PostHog; establish regular data review cadence and ensure learnings are socialized.
Analyze user behavior to identify friction points, drop-off patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Design and interpret experiments; bring data-informed recommendations to product and leadership forums.
Work closely with Design to develop and iterate on UX improvements and ensure member-first thinking in all product decisions.
Partner with Clinical Teams to ensure product changes support care delivery, medication management, and coaching workflows.
Collaborate with other PM's to ensure seamless handoff from enrollment into the core experience.
Coordinate with marketing to improve re-engagement and lifecycle messaging.
Socialize updates and learnings clearly and consistently with cross-functional partners across the organization.
Contribute to the Vida 2.0 vision by surfacing insights from current product performance, member feedback, and competitive analysis.
Help stand up user research infrastructure: recruit participants, support moderated testing, synthesize findings.
Support concept validation and prototype testing for next-generation member experiences.
Additional responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree at a minimum.
3-5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years shipping consumer or patient-facing digital products.
Proven track record improving engagement, retention, or activation metrics in a mobile or web product.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable with SQL, product analytics tools (Looker, PostHog, Amplitude, or similar), and A/B testing frameworks.
Experience running the full product lifecycle: discovery, scoping, shipping, measuring, iterating.
Excellent cross-functional communication: able to work effectively with Engineering, Design, Clinical, and Business stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities.
Clear, concise writer who can turn complexity into actionable product artifacts.

Preferred

Healthcare or digital health experience: chronic care, telehealth, behavior change programs, GLP-1 management, or similar.
Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, or AI/ML-powered product features.
Familiarity with behavioral design frameworks (BJ Fogg, COM-B, habit formation, nudge theory).
Experience with React Native or mobile app development workflows.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager - Risk and Compliance
jobs.description:
At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.
Summary:

At Morgan & Morgan, we’re constantly challenging people’s idea of what an injury law firm can be, and technology plays a major role in how we serve our clients. We are in a unique position as the largest injury firm in the world to continuously deliver a delightful and consistent experience for people facing the greatest challenge of their lives.  
We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to join our Risk and Compliance product team. In this senior leadership role, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for one of our core product areas – managing a team of Product Managers and driving deep collaboration across Engineering, Design, Data, and executive leadership. You’ll be accountable for defining what we build, why we build it, and how we measure success. This is an in-office position 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office. Relocation assistance is not available.  
Responsibilities:

As a Group Product Manager, you will own the health and direction of a major product area that supports a multi-billion dollar business unit. This is not a pure-play management role – you will remain deeply engaged in product discovery, definition, and delivery alongside your team. We value operators and builders over theorists: success here is measured by what ships, what improves, and what outcomes are achieved. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
Product Vision & Strategy:

Own the product vision and strategy for our Risk and Compliance team. Define a compelling, multi-quarter roadmap, translate firm-wide priorities into a clear product thesis, and continuously refine direction based on data, user research, and operational realities.  

Hands-On Product Ownership:

 Stay actively engaged in the work – writing requirements, shaping feature specs, reviewing designs, and participating in discovery for high-priority initiatives. Lead by example and maintain deep product context across your area.  

AI Integration & Workflow Innovation:

 Identify and drive opportunities to inject AI and automation into existing client and attorney-facing workflows. Move beyond net-new AI features to systematically evaluate where intelligence can accelerate, simplify, or transform how work gets done across the firm.  

Team Leadership & Development:

 Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers. Set clear expectations, build a high-performance culture, balance workloads, and develop each PM’s skills and career trajectory.  

Cross-Functional Execution:

 Drive tight collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations teams to deliver products on time and with high quality. Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain delivery momentum across parallel workstreams.  

Executive Stakeholder Management:

 Build trust with senior leaders and key business stakeholders. Communicate product strategy, tradeoffs, priorities, and progress with clarity and confidence. Represent the product perspective in executive forums.  

Outcomes & KPI Ownership:

 Define what success looks like for your product area. Establish leading and lagging metrics, monitor adoption and performance post-launch, and drive rapid iteration informed by results.  

Go-to-Market & Adoption:

 Partner with Operations, Legal, and L&D to develop and execute adoption plans for new capabilities. Ensure rollouts are smooth, well-communicated, and sticky.  

Capacity & Portfolio Management:

 Maintain a healthy team backlog, balance competing priorities across the product portfolio, surface resource constraints early, and make prioritization tradeoffs transparent to leadership.  

Qualifications:

6+ years of professional experience within Risk and Compliance environments.
8+ years of experience in product management, product operations, consulting, business integration, or a related leadership role; including PE-backed operational environments.
Demonstrated success managing and developing teams of Product Managers or cross-functional contributors, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
Proven ability to identify and inject AI tools and automation into existing business workflows – not just greenfield AI products, but pragmatic integration that drives measurable efficiency and outcome improvements.
Active use of AI as a force multiplier in your own work; leveraging AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, writing, prioritization, and decision-making.
Strong data fluency and able to define KPIs, interpret product analytics, run or commission user research, and drive evidence-based prioritization.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder influence skills – comfortable presenting strategy and navigating competing priorities with senior leadership.
Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-workstream product initiatives from concept through launch and iteration.
Executional track record – you are known for getting things done, not just framing problems. Candidates who thrive here have a bias toward shipping, iterating, and driving operational improvement over process documentation or theoretical frameworks. 

Nice to Have:

Exposure to the legal industry and technology in law firms.  

Experience in Agile, Scrum, or Kanban delivery environments.  

Familiarity with enterprise legal tech platforms or case management workflows.  

Experience in a high-growth or PE-backed organization scaling consumer or B2B products.  

Track record of building or launching AI-native product capabilities.  

Salary Range:
$220,000–$250,000 USD + Bonus Potential  

Salary Range: $220,000 USD - $250,000 USD

Morgan & Morgan is a leading personal injury law firm dedicated to protecting the people, not the powerful. This success starts with our staff.  For full-time employees, we offer an excellent benefits package including medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan,  paid time off and paid holidays.
