jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Investment Platform
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Global X operates a large and growing ETF platform across multiple markets. Our investment desk runs on proprietary technology built in-house for portfolio management, trading, and the operational workflow around it. We are hiring the founding product owner for that platform — in effect, the operating system for our trading and portfolio management desks — measured on adoption and business impact rather than delivery milestones.

The mandate is to make expert work easier and give the business more capacity: guided workflows where a process is multi-step, expert surfaces where they genuinely help. Deciding where that line falls is the substance of the role — in a regulated domain where accuracy is a compliance matter and your users will tell you immediately when something is wrong.

This is a product role for someone who builds. A clickable prototype is the preferred form of a specification. We are an AI-forward team, and product is expected to move at the same speed as engineering. You will help shape the product function as the platform and the team grow around it.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Workflow Definition

Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap, sequenced by business value and defensible to stakeholders who each want their own priority first.
Decide what becomes a guided flow and what stays an expert surface, and own the defaults — grounded in observed usage, not the loudest request.
Design workflows that hold up across markets, calendars, and regions rather than encoding the practice of a single desk.
Track ETF market structure developments and regulatory change, and translate their implications into product direction.

Prototyping & Hands-On Delivery

Prototype your own proposals with AI product tooling and put something clickable in front of a portfolio manager rather than describing it.
Do your own analysis. Query the data, quantify the case, and bring evidence rather than anecdote.
Write requirements and acceptance criteria an engineer can build from directly, and run delivery against a visible, prioritized backlog.

Commercial Impact & Platform Growth

Own the business case. Quantify where the platform creates capacity, reduces risk, and shortens time to launch, and make that case to leadership.
Drive expansion beyond the initial desk: identify the next adopters across teams and affiliated businesses, and build the plan to bring them on.

Adoption, Risk & Governance

Own adoption: readiness criteria, sequencing, champions, training, and the communications that carry each stage of rollout.
Define how AI-assisted and agent-initiated actions behave in the product — what a user sees, what requires approval, and what is recorded.
Partner with compliance and risk so controls, approval thresholds, and audit evidence are designed in, and assess risk with regard for the firm’s reputation and obligations.

You Are

Energized by building alongside engineers, and happiest when something is in front of a user.
A self-starter who does well with ambiguity and a wide remit.
Curious beyond your comfort zone, and quick to learn a domain in depth.
Willing to challenge convention, and disciplined about bringing evidence when you do.
Precise. You would rather be right than fast, and you know when the two are not in conflict.

Qualifications

7+ years in product management, product ownership, or senior business analysis for investment or trading technology, buy side or platform vendor.
Hands-on output: prototypes, demos, internal tools, or analyses you built yourself and would enjoy showing us, and fluent daily use of AI tooling to produce them.
Working knowledge of the investment operations lifecycle: portfolio construction, order and execution flow, holdings, corporate actions, benchmarks, NAV, and reconciliation.
Ownership of a platform build for expert users, including the adoption effort and the judgment about what to simplify.
A commercial instinct: you have made a business case, quantified its return, and been held to it.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or certification (CFA, MBA) a plus.

Nice To Have

ETF-specific experience: creation and redemption, basket construction, primary market workflow, and index tracking.
1940-Act fund and SEC-registered adviser context; recordkeeping (Rule 204-2), Regulation S-P, and 15(c) board reporting.
Institutional investment platforms as a buyer, implementer, or product owner; or technology as part of a firm’s client-facing narrative.

Compensation Range

$190,000-$210,000 plus annual bonus

Global X does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters.

Compensation & Benefits

Global X offers a competitive total compensation package, including base salary, annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits program:

Competitive base salary with annual performance-based bonus
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company matching
Generous paid time off and company holidays
Professional development and continuing education opportunities
Hybrid work flexibility
Life and disability insurance
Wellness programs and employee assistance program (EAP)

About Global X

Global X was founded in 2008. For more than fifteen years, our mission has been empowering investors with unexplored and intelligent solutions. Our product lineup features a wide range of ETF strategies and more than $94 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026. While we are distinguished for our thematic, income, and international ETFs, we also offer core and other funds to suit a wide range of investment objectives. jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a leader in serving the global financial services marketplace and the only professional services firm with a separate business unit dedicated to the financial services industry – the Financial Services Organization (FSO). Our focused model and bold ambition have put us at the center of the events that continue to reshape and redefine our industry, working side by side with a range of clients from our most venerable institutions to dynamic new entrants across Banking and Capital Markets, Wealth and Asset Management, Insurance, and Real Estate, Hospitality and Construction. Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry in which financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing and secure. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then come join our dynamic FSO team!

The opportunity

The Product and Experience Design (PxD) Team, part of the Platforms competency within FSO Technology Consulting, works collaboratively with clients to transform their businesses through disruptive innovation and human-centered design. The team helps clients modernize systems, processes, operating structures and products, while applying AI-enabled methods to improve how opportunities are identified, concepts are tested, requirements are developed and product decisions are made. We support the development of high-performing business and customer-facing platforms and services in a rapidly changing and competitive environment. Our team helps clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by defining technology and product strategies, designing AI-enabled solutions and supporting the execution of complex transformations.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate and results-oriented Product Manager who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical experience using AI-enabled tools and methods to support product discovery and delivery. The successful candidate will be an effective problem solver who can identify appropriate opportunities to apply AI, use these capabilities responsibly and validate AI-generated outputs with business, design and technology stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to support our clients in transforming their businesses through product management. As a Product Manager, you will work with multidisciplinary feature teams, including user experience experts, architects, engineers, data and AI specialists and others, to define and launch products and services for large global organizations. You will use user-centered, data-driven and AI-enabled methods to synthesize research, identify unmet needs, develop and test concepts, define business requirements and support product decisions. You will advocate for users throughout the product lifecycle and apply human judgment to validate AI-generated insights and outputs. You can simplify complex processes and touchpoints, prioritize opportunities, contribute to product roadmaps, manage product backlogs and coordinate teams to release quality products within planned timelines. You understand modern platform structures, cloud architectures, digital platforms and enablers, data strategy considerations, and the opportunities and limitations of AI-enabled products. In addition, you understand how product and delivery organizations operate within complex, regulated national and global companies. Outside client engagements, you have experience supporting business development activities, such as pursuits and proposals, and practice-building activities such as mentoring colleagues and developing or delivering training.

Skills And Attributes For

Strategy and Organization
Support the development of product strategies that align with business objectives, identify appropriate opportunities for AI-enabled capabilities, and account for technology, data, experience design, risk and adoption considerations
Support the definition of product organization and operating models, including product taxonomy, organizational structure, funding methods, product delivery processes, governance models and decision rights, while considering the roles, skills, controls and human oversight needed for AI-enabled product development
Improve portfolio management with product metrics and OKRs that align work to business objectives and increase transparency/traceability of outcomes

Technology Delivery
Support technology delivery by using traditional and AI-enabled research and requirements tools to translate product vision, customer insights, business rules and enterprise knowledge into traceable business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; validate generated outputs with subject-matter experts; and help prioritize backlogs and maintain roadmaps
Support cross-functional teams of designers, engineers, data and AI specialists and testers through the software development lifecycle, using rapid prototypes and AI-assisted tools to test concepts, workflows and value hypotheses before implementation and deployment
Advocate for and help operationalize cross-functional practices such as user testing, experimentation, functional and regression test automation, evaluation of AI-enabled features, and alignment with industry, client, risk and regulatory standards

Product Enablement
Use traditional and AI-enabled product management tools, such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Aha!, Productboard, requirements repositories, AI assistants, enterprise knowledge tools and prototype-driven development platforms, to support discovery, prioritize opportunities, develop requirements, test concepts and deliver technology solutions
Use product analytics software and frameworks, such as Pendo and Amplitude, together with AI-enabled analysis, to synthesize user feedback, research, behavioral data and product performance; identify patterns and unmet needs; and translate findings into testable hypotheses and actionable recommendations
Advise on and implement best practices and standards for experience design, agile delivery, technology, data and responsible AI, adapting methods to client needs and established governance
Apply AI-enabled methods across selected parts of the product lifecycle—including research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, requirements development, backlog refinement and product analytics—to improve speed and quality. Use approved tools and reusable prompts, validate outputs and follow established safeguards for responsible use

Core Consulting
Construct and communicate a compelling story to rally the client around potential changes and associated benefits
Drive desired outcomes defined in client engagements and carry through to implementation
Begin developing long-term client relationships and networks and cultivate business development opportunities.
Effectively work with client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment.
Demonstrate an understanding of the current technology and AI environment, relevant financial services trends and the evolving product management toolchain, and apply that understanding to engagement delivery and client service issues

To qualify for the role you must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 3 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate work experience. Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 2 years of work experience.
Experience using AI-enabled tools or methods to support one or more product activities—such as research synthesis, opportunity assessment, requirements development, rapid prototyping or product analytics—with appropriate human review of generated outputs
Proven delivery skills including the ability to identify issues and risks and escalate appropriately, manage communications with EY and client team members, and be accountable for client deliverables
Facilitate discussions with technical, design and business subject-matter resources to document requirements, establish a vision, and articulate alternatives for future state solutions across various domains and channels.
Has supported product vision, defined and managed product roadmaps, prioritized and managed backlogs, and supported product or technology launches. Experience should include contributing to the identification of suitable AI-enabled opportunities, testing value or feasibility through prototypes or experiments, and defining measurable outcomes for AI-enabled features
Can participate in and drive ideation sessions, standups, sprints and scrums.
Has specific domain knowledge and understands the market, customer, technology, data, AI and regulatory dynamics affecting the product, including the opportunities, limitations and risks of applying AI in a complex financial services environment
Experience with successfully managing projects with defined deliverables and budgets. Experience must include budgeting and managing the schedule; client relationship management; communicating strategically around key issues; conflict resolution and consensus building.
Must have a thorough understanding of complex information systems and technology organizations and to be able to work effectively between the application, data infrastructure, operations and security architectural spaces
Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; manage communications with the project sponsors and manage the delivery of an engagement workstream.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
Requires domestic and regional travel up to 80% to serve client needs.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience working alongside data, analytics or AI specialists to shape use cases, define outcomes and test AI-enabled features
Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation and evaluation methods, including approaches for validating the quality and usefulness of AI-generated outputs
Relevant product management, agile, design, cloud, data or AI training or certifications

What We Look For

We’re interested in self-motivated individuals who can easily function in a high demand, performance-driven environment. In addition we’re looking for people who recognize the accomplishments of the team before the individual and are sought after as people developers. If you’re passionate about problem-solving and helping our clients with some of their most complex issues, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 15 days of vacation plus ten observed holidays and three paid personal days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Excellent training and development opportunities through established programs and on-the-job training
Feedback on your performance that will accelerate your growth

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and consulting services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

jobs.title: Head of Business Technology Engineering
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Business Technology Engineering team builds the systems the company runs on. We own the internal platforms every employee uses and our collaboration tooling, and we embed engineers directly with Legal, Security, Communications, Product Operations and other business functions to rebuild how their work gets done with Claude at the center. Our mandate is to make Anthropic the best-run company in the world at using its own models internally, and to be the example our customers point to.

We are hiring an engineering leader to run this org. You will lead a growing engineering organization across two tracks: Platforms
, which builds and operates the shared systems the company depends on, and Forward Deployed
, which drops into a business function, proves Claude wins on a real workflow, hands off, and moves on. You will partner on defining the roadmap, build relationships with functional leaders, grow the team, and shape what forward deployed engineering looks like inside a frontier AI lab.

You'll report to the Head of Business Technology and IT, within the Security organization, and you’ll make up the full Business Technology function along with a team of Business Systems Analysts and Product Managers. Together, BizTech partners closely with IT Engineering on corporate systems and endpoints; with Security Engineering on data handling and permissions for agentic workflows; with Labs and Product on dogfooding and the internal builds that become external patterns; with GTM, who point Enterprise customers at this team as the reference for how Anthropic runs internally; and with the leaders of Legal, Workplace, Communications, Product Operations and Product Support, who are your customers.

Responsibilities

Lead and scale a global org of engineers; hire, level and develop the leads under you.
Partner, develop, and execute a year-plus roadmap for how Anthropic's business functions work with Claude, and the success metrics that go with it.
Run the Platforms track: reliability, velocity and scale of Claude Support and the platform layer that every employee depends on.
Run the Forward Deployed track: engagement portfolio, prioritization across functions, handoffs to durable owners, and adoption that actually moves.
Be the technical executive partner to the leaders of Legal, Workplace, Comms, Product Ops and Product Support; make the case for ambitious deployment and for the boundaries on it in the same conversation.
Partner with Labs and Product on dogfooding: feed load-bearing signal back ("here is the eval that shows the gap") and ship internal builds that become external product patterns.
Represent how Anthropic runs internally to Enterprise customers alongside GTM.
Set the engineering bar: production-adjacent builds, eval rigor, reusable patterns, responsible internal deployment with real data and real permissions.

You may be a good fit if you

Have 12+ years in software engineering and 6+ years leading engineers, including at least 3 years managing managers and at least one org of 20+ across multiple domains that you structured yourself
Have run internal-tools, business-systems or platform engineering at a company that added functions faster than it added engineers, and can speak to reliability outcomes on the platform side and adoption outcomes on the embedded side
Lead through technical judgment: whether or not you've been hands-on lately, you can go from an agent architecture to its eval design to its failure modes with your engineers, and your reviews make their builds better
Can walk a General Counsel, a Head of Workplace or a room of senior engineers with strong opinions through a trade-off, make a recommendation, and bring them to a decision they'll commit to
Can hold a high bar on craft while saying no to low-leverage work, and explain the no to the person who asked.
Want real ownership of how a frontier AI lab runs itself on its own models, and care about doing that responsibly — real data, real permissions, real people on the other end

Strong candidates may also have

Forward deployed, software engineering or applied AI leadership experience with external customers.
Product management experience or a track record partnering closely with PMs and analysts.
Experience with corporate systems (Salesforce, Workday, Google Workspace, Slack) at platform scale.
Have built the career rubric or leveling framework for a new kind of engineering role, or stood up a forward deployed function from zero

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.description:
About Stellar Health:

Historically, US Healthcare has relied on a fee-for-service reimbursement system where providers are paid based on the quantity of patient visits and procedures, rather than the quality of health outcomes.

At Stellar Health, we help primary care providers put patient health first. Our platform - a mix of technology, people, and analytics - supports providers at the point of care, delivering real-time patient information, activating practice staff, and empowering providers and care teams with incentives that reward the work they are already doing to keep patients healthy. Using the Stellar App, our web-based, point-of-care tool; practices receive a simple checklist of recommended actions that support the best quality care. Providers and care teams are then paid monthly for each action they complete, and Payors save money in reduced healthcare costs along the way.

Stellar is a US-based Health-tech backed by Top VCs ( General Atlantic, Point72, & Primary Venture Partners) with an established product & proven operating model. We’ve shown that we make a real difference for physician practices and their patients.

About the position:

The VP, Product Management owns the active roadmap, planning cycles, and delivery execution for Stellar’s product squads, encompassing areas like Total Cost of Care, EHR and Integrations, and Data Platform. This is the role that turns Stellar’s product strategy into a reality, through consistent, high quality shipping, building and leading a team of 4 Product Managers, and setting the bar for how Stellar plans, prioritizes, and delivers against its highest-value bets in value-based care.

Reporting to the SVP Product, this role has full ownership of squad-level strategy and execution — the SVP sets company-wide product vision and drives external-facing growth; this VP makes sure the organization underneath it delivers. It’s a build-and-run mandate: shape how a 4-squad product org plans, hire and grow the PM bench behind it, and be the standard-bearer for what disciplined, high-velocity product management looks like at Stellar.

This role also acts as the connective tissue across the broader organization, partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Implementations, Operations, and Growth to maximize the impact of our development efforts.

How you'll make an impact:

Be the management layer between the SVP Product and Stellar’s 4 independently run squads — own day-to-day delivery and act as the primary escalation point for all 4 PMs
Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team of Product Managers — running performance reviews and career development, and building a bench Stellar can count on beyond this roadmap cycle.
Hold every PM on the team to a high bar: size work against real capacity before committing, dig into root causes instead of guessing at fixes, make explicit tradeoffs rather than build wish lists, stay aligned with engineering and stakeholders when priorities shift mid-quarter, read their own OKR metrics instead of just reporting status, and know enough to question an engineering estimate or a vendor claim.
Own capacity tracking and execution measurement across all squads. Proactively call out risks and work with the PMs to mitigate them.
Build and run the roadmapping process — cadence, format, OKR-to-project traceability. More broadly, establish and improve necessary team processes, while also retiring unnecessary ones.
Coordinate with Design and Engineering to ensure we ship our roadmap consistently and with the highest quality.
Coordinate with Product Marketing, Ops, and Growth to drive awareness and adoption of new and future capabilities.
Coordinate with Technical Implementations, Enterprise Analytics, and DevOps leadership so their work stays aligned with the 4 product squads
Develop and share POVs on the work we’re doing at Stellar, and be willing to disagree and commit if necessary

What you'll bring:

At least 12 years of relevant career experience in product, tech, healthcare, or some combination thereof, with at least 6 in product management, with career growth and additional responsibilities added along the way
At least 5 years of people management experience, including managing a multi-person Product Management team — hiring, coaching, and performance management, not just individual PM execution.
Experience running a roadmap or capacity governance process across more than one team.
Comfortable holding PMs accountable to a plan without owning the deep domain expertise of every squad they run.
Comfortable operating without formal authority over adjacent functions — able to build working agreements with other depts and escalate conflicts appropriately.
Healthcare or health-tech background a plus, particularly value-based care — several squads’ work is EHR-integration- and VBC-specific.

Perks & Benefits:

Stellar offers a carefully curated selection of wellness benefits and perks to our employees:

Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits
Flexible PTO
Universal Paid Family and Caregiver Leave
Wellhub+ Gym Memberships
Pre-tax commuter benefits, HA, FSA plans
Company sponsored One Medical memberships and Citibike memberships
Medical Travel Benefits
JOON, a flexible lifestyle spending account that gives our team a monthly stipend to spend on what matters most to them
Stock Options & a 401k matching program
A broad calendar of company sponsored social events that for our in-office and remote employees
Company sponsored lunch for all NY HQ employees

Diversity is the key to our success
. Stellar Health is an equal opportunity employer and we are open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We believe that diverse teams -and the different identities, cultures, and life experiences our team members bring to the table- enable us to create amazing products, find creative solutions to interesting problems, and build an inclusive working environment.

Stellar Health Employment Privacy Notice

At Stellar Health, your privacy and security as a job seeker is a priority no matter where you are in the interview process
. As recruiting scams have become more prevalent, please take note of the following practices to ensure the legitimacy of any interaction with our team.

Please note that any communication from our recruiters and hiring managers at Stellar Health about a job opportunity will only be made by a Stellar Health employee with an @stellar.health email address.
Stellar Health does not utilize third-party agencies for recruitment services and does not conduct text message or chat-based interviews. Any other email addresses, agencies, or forums may be phishing scams designed to obtain your personal information.

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Development leads the overall development, innovation, and lifecycle management of the company's wine portfolio. This involves driving the entire process of new product development, from concept, formulation, and style development to testing, production, market launch, and continuous optimization, taking into account consumer needs, market trends, brand strategy, and business objectives.

This role requires close collaboration with teams in winemaking, purchasing, quality, supply chain, marketing, sales, and finance to establish a systematic product development system, continuously expand the wine portfolio, and ensure that new products align with the company's brand positioning, quality standards, cost targets, and market demands.

Core Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy and Portfolio Management
Develop the company's medium- to long-term wine product development strategy and product innovation roadmap.

Analyze, optimize, and manage the existing product portfolio throughout its lifecycle.

Identify product innovation opportunities based on consumer needs, market trends, sales performance, and the competitive environment.

Establish portfolio strategies across different price ranges, grape varieties, regions, and product lines.

Drive the development of core products, seasonal products, limited-edition products, and emerging categories.

2. New Product Development
Lead the entire development process of new wine products, from concept to commercial launch.

Collaborate with winemakers, product development, and quality teams to determine product style, flavor, specifications, and quality standards.

Participate in the evaluation of grape varieties, regions, raw materials, and suppliers.

Organize product testing, consumer testing, and internal tastings, and continuously improve based on feedback.

Establish product development phases, approval processes, timelines, and commercialization standards.

3. Market and Consumer Insights
Continuously research wine consumption trends, consumer preferences, channel changes, and competing products.

Analyze the needs of different consumer groups regarding flavor, packaging, price, and product positioning.

Translate market research and consumer data into actionable product development directions.

Collaborate with the marketing team to develop product positioning, brand story, and launch strategies.

Monitor new product launches and product portfolio changes by competing brands.

4. Cross-Departmental Product Commercialization
Develop new product launch plans in collaboration with marketing, sales, and channel teams.

Ensure product development is aligned with sales channels, customer needs, and business objectives.

Coordinate production capacity, inventory, packaging, and time-to-market with the supply chain and operations teams.

Work with the finance team to develop product cost, pricing, and profit models.

Establish cross-departmental collaboration mechanisms from product concept to large-scale commercialization.

5. Packaging and Product Experience
Participate in the development of wine bottle shapes, labels, packaging, gift boxes, and related product materials.

Ensure packaging design aligns with brand positioning and target consumers.

Work with design, marketing, and supplier teams to drive packaging development and updates.

Optimize product specifications and packaging formats based on channel requirements.

Conduct cross-departmental analysis of product quality issues and drive improvement measures.

Establish a post-launch performance tracking system.

Analyze sales revenue, sales volume, gross profit margin, market performance, and customer feedback.

Develop expansion, adjustment, repositioning, or exit strategies based on product performance.

Report regularly to senior management on product portfolio performance and innovation project progress.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a leader in serving the global financial services marketplace and the only professional services firm with a separate business unit dedicated to the financial services industry – the Financial Services Organization (FSO). Our focused model and bold ambition have put us at the center of the events that continue to reshape and redefine our industry, working side by side with a range of clients from our most venerable institutions to dynamic new entrants across Banking and Capital Markets, Wealth and Asset Management, Insurance, and Real Estate, Hospitality and Construction. Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry in which financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing and secure. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then come join our dynamic FSO team!

The opportunity

The Product and Experience Design (PxD) Team, part of the Platforms competency within FSO Technology Consulting, works collaboratively with clients to transform their businesses through disruptive innovation and human-centered design. The team helps clients modernize systems, processes, operating structures and products, while applying AI-enabled methods to improve how opportunities are identified, concepts are tested, requirements are developed and product decisions are made. We support the development of high-performing business and customer-facing platforms and services in a rapidly changing and competitive environment. Our team helps clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by defining technology and product strategies, designing AI-enabled solutions and supporting the execution of complex transformations.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate and results-oriented Product Manager who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical experience using AI-enabled tools and methods to support product discovery and delivery. The successful candidate will be an effective problem solver who can identify appropriate opportunities to apply AI, use these capabilities responsibly and validate AI-generated outputs with business, design and technology stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to support our clients in transforming their businesses through product management. As a Product Manager, you will work with multidisciplinary feature teams, including user experience experts, architects, engineers, data and AI specialists and others, to define and launch products and services for large global organizations. You will use user-centered, data-driven and AI-enabled methods to synthesize research, identify unmet needs, develop and test concepts, define business requirements and support product decisions. You will advocate for users throughout the product lifecycle and apply human judgment to validate AI-generated insights and outputs. You can simplify complex processes and touchpoints, prioritize opportunities, contribute to product roadmaps, manage product backlogs and coordinate teams to release quality products within planned timelines. You understand modern platform structures, cloud architectures, digital platforms and enablers, data strategy considerations, and the opportunities and limitations of AI-enabled products. In addition, you understand how product and delivery organizations operate within complex, regulated national and global companies. Outside client engagements, you have experience supporting business development activities, such as pursuits and proposals, and practice-building activities such as mentoring colleagues and developing or delivering training.

Skills And Attributes For

Strategy and Organization
Support the development of product strategies that align with business objectives, identify appropriate opportunities for AI-enabled capabilities, and account for technology, data, experience design, risk and adoption considerations
Support the definition of product organization and operating models, including product taxonomy, organizational structure, funding methods, product delivery processes, governance models and decision rights, while considering the roles, skills, controls and human oversight needed for AI-enabled product development
Improve portfolio management with product metrics and OKRs that align work to business objectives and increase transparency/traceability of outcomes

Technology Delivery
Support technology delivery by using traditional and AI-enabled research and requirements tools to translate product vision, customer insights, business rules and enterprise knowledge into traceable business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; validate generated outputs with subject-matter experts; and help prioritize backlogs and maintain roadmaps
Support cross-functional teams of designers, engineers, data and AI specialists and testers through the software development lifecycle, using rapid prototypes and AI-assisted tools to test concepts, workflows and value hypotheses before implementation and deployment
Advocate for and help operationalize cross-functional practices such as user testing, experimentation, functional and regression test automation, evaluation of AI-enabled features, and alignment with industry, client, risk and regulatory standards

Product Enablement
Use traditional and AI-enabled product management tools, such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Aha!, Productboard, requirements repositories, AI assistants, enterprise knowledge tools and prototype-driven development platforms, to support discovery, prioritize opportunities, develop requirements, test concepts and deliver technology solutions
Use product analytics software and frameworks, such as Pendo and Amplitude, together with AI-enabled analysis, to synthesize user feedback, research, behavioral data and product performance; identify patterns and unmet needs; and translate findings into testable hypotheses and actionable recommendations
Advise on and implement best practices and standards for experience design, agile delivery, technology, data and responsible AI, adapting methods to client needs and established governance
Apply AI-enabled methods across selected parts of the product lifecycle—including research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, requirements development, backlog refinement and product analytics—to improve speed and quality. Use approved tools and reusable prompts, validate outputs and follow established safeguards for responsible use

Core Consulting
Construct and communicate a compelling story to rally the client around potential changes and associated benefits
Drive desired outcomes defined in client engagements and carry through to implementation
Begin developing long-term client relationships and networks and cultivate business development opportunities.
Effectively work with client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment.
Demonstrate an understanding of the current technology and AI environment, relevant financial services trends and the evolving product management toolchain, and apply that understanding to engagement delivery and client service issues

To qualify for the role you must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 3 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate work experience. Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 2 years of work experience.
Experience using AI-enabled tools or methods to support one or more product activities—such as research synthesis, opportunity assessment, requirements development, rapid prototyping or product analytics—with appropriate human review of generated outputs
Proven delivery skills including the ability to identify issues and risks and escalate appropriately, manage communications with EY and client team members, and be accountable for client deliverables
Facilitate discussions with technical, design and business subject-matter resources to document requirements, establish a vision, and articulate alternatives for future state solutions across various domains and channels.
Has supported product vision, defined and managed product roadmaps, prioritized and managed backlogs, and supported product or technology launches. Experience should include contributing to the identification of suitable AI-enabled opportunities, testing value or feasibility through prototypes or experiments, and defining measurable outcomes for AI-enabled features
Can participate in and drive ideation sessions, standups, sprints and scrums.
Has specific domain knowledge and understands the market, customer, technology, data, AI and regulatory dynamics affecting the product, including the opportunities, limitations and risks of applying AI in a complex financial services environment
Experience with successfully managing projects with defined deliverables and budgets. Experience must include budgeting and managing the schedule; client relationship management; communicating strategically around key issues; conflict resolution and consensus building.
Must have a thorough understanding of complex information systems and technology organizations and to be able to work effectively between the application, data infrastructure, operations and security architectural spaces
Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; manage communications with the project sponsors and manage the delivery of an engagement workstream.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

Experience working alongside data, analytics or AI specialists to shape use cases, define outcomes and test AI-enabled features
Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation and evaluation methods, including approaches for validating the quality and usefulness of AI-generated outputs
Relevant product management, agile, design, cloud, data or AI training or certifications

We’re interested in self-motivated individuals who can easily function in a high demand, performance-driven environment. In addition we’re looking for people who recognize the accomplishments of the team before the individual and are sought after as people developers. If you’re passionate about problem-solving and helping our clients with some of their most complex issues, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 15 days of vacation plus ten observed holidays and three paid personal days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. jobs.title: Senior Director of Payments Product
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the role?

Etsy Payments is responsible for providing a delightful and trusted payments experience to our 90MM+ buyers and 5MM+ active sellers. Etsy Payments processes over $10B of volume/year across 60 countries and 20 currencies. As Senior Director of Payments Product, you will lead the product team that enables Etsy to accept the payment methods that our buyers trust, provide frictionless buyer checkout, and ensure that payments reliably work. You will also lead the teams that ensure sellers can see their financial transactions, receive timely payouts, and seamlessly complete tax and compliance requirements. You will set the vision for the Payments team and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Legal to build trusted payment experiences across every channel where Etsy listings appear — in-person, social, and agentic commerce.

This is a full-time position reporting to the VP, Marketplace Trust.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

The Payments Product Team Operates At The Intersection Of Trust, Growth, And Financial Infrastructure. The Team Is Organized Into Five Specialized Squads, Each With Deep Ownership Over a Distinct Dimension Of The Payments Experience

Buyer Payment Experience focuses on how buyers pay — from checkout conversion and alternative payment method (APM) expansion (Apple Pay, Affirm, Revolut, CashApp) to guest checkout optimization and payment-related messaging.
Money Movement works on the infrastructure that keeps payments flowing: authorization rate optimization, decline reattempts, payout redundancy and the path to 100% EP100 uptime, and launching new payment rails globally.
Payments & Seller Compliance owns Etsy's regulatory and compliance obligations — seller identity verification, PCI compliance, and fraud-adjacent risk controls that protect both the marketplace and its sellers.
Seller Financial Experience owns what it feels like to be a seller managing money on Etsy: financial holds, payment account design, manual billing, and the seller ledger — tools used by millions of sellers worldwide.
Tax manages Etsy's global tax obligations, navigating marketplace facilitator laws, withholding tax, import fees, digital services tax, and 1099 reporting — in a regulatory landscape that never stops shifting.

The culture is rigorous and collaborative. PMs run tight discovery cycles, work closely with stakeholders from day one, and are always expected to always keep the customer at the heart of their work.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Setting and evolving multi-year payments strategy — translating Etsy's North Star of accelerating the marketplace flywheel through trusted financial experiences into quarterly roadmaps across five squads.
Representing Payments in senior cross-functional forums with Legal, Finance, Accounting, and the exec team — on issues ranging from tax policy and regulatory response to payment network relationships and financial risk.
Driving high-stakes product decisions: for example, weighing in on which payment methods to launch next and in which markets, how to design financial holds in ways that don't erode seller trust, and how to balance auth rate interventions with COR.
Managing regulatory and compliance timelines with real financial consequences — including seller reverification programs protecting hundreds of millions in exposure, 1099 infrastructure, withholding tax implementations, and evolving digital sales tax requirements across multiple countries.
Hiring, developing, and retaining product managers across IC and manager levels; coaching squad leads on navigating ambiguity, sizing trade-offs, and running effective discovery.
Serving as connective tissue between Payments and the broader Marketplace: ensuring buyer-facing checkout improvements, seller financial tools, and platform investments reinforce each other and ladder to company goals.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

10+ years building and scaling product teams in payments, fintech, or financial services with at least 4 years of managing Product Managers
Deep experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure — with working knowledge of payment rails, authorization flows, compliance frameworks (PCI, KYC/AML), and/or tax obligations
Proven ability to set multi-year product strategy and translate it into executable roadmaps across large, cross-functional teams
Track record of shipping complex, high-stakes products in regulated environments — balancing growth objectives with legal, compliance, and risk constraints
Strong financial acumen; able to model trade-offs, size opportunities, and present confidently to senior finance and legal stakeholders
Experience working across global markets, including navigating varying regulatory requirements by geography
Exceptional cross-functional influence — comfortable leading without authority across Engineering, Legal, Finance, Design, and Operations

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 283,000.00 - 383,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 255,000.00 - 345,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. jobs.title: Curacity - Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join Connecticut Innovation’s vibrant community of innovators? Connecticut Innovations (“CI”) is Connecticut’s strategic venture capital arm, and we are passionate about serving our portfolio of 220+ companies across various industries, with strengths in life sciences, technology, and climate tech.

Come join Curacity: Hotel marketing software that turns media into revenue!!

Location: New York City (Hybrid) or Atlanta, GA

Salary: $150K

Reports to: VP of Product

About Curacity

Curacity is a two-sided marketplace connecting travel brands that need to be discovered with the publishers, travel writers, and content creators travelers actually trust. Hotels and cruise brands define the editorial coverage they need; our network of publishers and creators produces original content; Curacity coordinates the fulfillment and measures the outcomes.

We operate two products on that network. Newsletter places original editorial recommendations in front of publisher subscriber audiences and ties the resulting bookings back to the content that drove them. Vista AI builds the distributed editorial footprint that determines whether a property gets recommended when a traveler asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, or Gemini where to stay.

Curacity partners with publications including AFAR and Travel + Leisure, and was named among Inc. 5000's Top 20 Travel & Hospitality Companies and Digiday's Best Content Marketing Platform of 2024. We are headquartered in New York with an office in Stamford, CT.

Role Overview

Curacity is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own VISTA AI.

This is a senior individual-contributor role responsible for the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, adoption, and retention of VISTA AI, including its intelligence and matching capabilities. You will report to the VP of Product and lead through influence across engineering, data science, design, customer success, sales, marketing, and Curacity's media organization.

VISTA AI already provides customers with visibility into how their brands appear across AI-driven travel discovery. Your mandate is to make that visibility increasingly credible, useful, and connected to action — turning signals into the systematic matching logic that determines which publishers cover which hotels on which topics, replacing today's manual process with product-driven intelligence.

You will partner closely with an AI Data Analyst who will investigate signals, develop measurement methodologies, and evaluate which inputs are meaningful. Your job is to connect that research to customer problems and commercial outcomes: deciding what Curacity should build, how customers should experience it, and whether it is driving sustained value.

Curacity's competitive distinction is not measurement alone. Most AI visibility tools stop at reporting. Curacity connects measurement to an editorial network that can actually change the numbers — and this role owns the intelligence that makes that connection work.

Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for VISTA AI and its intelligence layer.
Own the product lifecycle from customer discovery and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Own the systematic matching logic that determines which publishers and creators cover which hotels on which topics for VISTA AI — replacing manual matching with product-driven intelligence.
Build the product that surfaces topically relevant, curated content opportunities to the right creators, informed by hotel profiles, topic gaps, and performance history.
Establish a deep understanding of the needs and workflows of hotel marketers, commercial leaders, revenue teams, destinations, cruise lines, and other VISTA AI users.
Evolve the existing visibility layer — measuring how hotel brands appear in AI recommendations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, Gemini, and other systems — into a product customers trust and engage with repeatedly.
Translate customer questions such as "Where are we visible?", "Why are competitors outperforming us?", and "What topics need editorial attention?" into product capabilities.
Partner with the AI Data Scientist to define, test, and validate signals, methodologies, benchmarks, and product hypotheses.
Define requirements for dashboards, benchmarks, alerts, competitive intelligence, and recommendation-rate reporting.
Lead initiatives to improve onboarding, activation, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
Develop a structured customer-feedback program in partnership with customer success and sales.
Define and monitor product KPIs, identifying where customers disengage and leading improvements to the experience.
Partner with go-to-market teams on positioning, packaging, launches, customer education, and sales enablement.
Maintain a clear view of how hotels are monitoring and improving AI visibility — understanding the competitive landscape not just at the feature level but at the thesis level, since most competitors are measurement-only and Curacity's value is connecting measurement to the editorial network that moves the numbers.

The primary measure of VISTA AI's value is whether customers' AI recommendation rates improve. This PM does not control every variable that produces lift — content execution, publisher quality, and the behavior of AI systems all contribute — but owns the intelligence and matching quality that determine what coverage gets created and where.

Success will be measured through:
Demonstrated recommendation-rate lift for VISTA AI customers on their priority topics.
Customer activation and time to first meaningful insight.
Adoption of visibility, intelligence, and matching features.
Monthly and weekly engagement among target customer roles.

Qualifications

Five or more years of product-management experience, including meaningful ownership of a B2B data, analytics, intelligence, measurement, or AI-enabled product.
Familiarity with generative-engine optimization, LLM evaluation, recommendation systems, citations, sentiment analysis, or AI-monitoring products.
Experience with two-sided marketplaces, particularly products where matching quality is a core differentiator.
Experience taking complex data and turning it into clear, actionable customer experiences.
Strong product judgment, especially the ability to distinguish an interesting analytical finding from a valuable product capability.
Experience partnering with data scientists and engineers on experimentation, signal development, data quality, recommendations, ranking, or machine-learning products.
Experience building or owning systematic matching, recommendation, or optimization logic — products where the software makes allocation or prioritization decisions that previously required manual judgment.
Strong analytical fluency and comfort making decisions with incomplete or noisy data.
Strong customer-discovery skills and a willingness to engage directly with users throughout the product lifecycle.

jobs.description:
Overview

About PHOENIX

PHOENIX Retail, LLC is a retail platform operating the Express and Bonobos brands worldwide.

About Express

Express is a multichannel apparel brand dedicated to a design philosophy rooted in modern, confident and effortless style whether dressing for work, everyday or special occasions. Since its launch in 1980, the brand has embraced a design philosophy rooted in modern, confident and effortless style. Express ensures you look and feel your best, wherever life takes you. The Company operates over 400 retail and outlet stores in the United States and Puerto Rico, the express.com online store and the Express mobile app.

About Bonobos

Our Bonobos menswear brand is known for being a style instigator and offering perfect-fit risks through our innovative retail model and personalized experience. Launched online in 2007 with its signature line of chinos, Bonobos now offers a variety of styles available to order online and to try on at any one of our 50 Guideshop locations and at www.bonobos.com. Our Guideshops are in-real-life stores that deliver one-on-one service and expert fit advice. Don't think traditional retail, Bonobos is something you haven't seen before.

Location Name

Columbus Corporate Headquarters

Responsibilities

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Product Manager, Digital will serve as the key architect of the end-to-end customer journey across Express and Bonobos, synthesizing web, mobile, and physical store touchpoints-including retail locations and Bonobos Guideshops-into a cohesive omnichannel ecosystem. Operating at the intersection of technology, data science, merchandising, and digital operations, you will define and execute the strategic roadmap for core commerce funnels, customer acquisition, loyalty platforms, and post-purchase pathways. By collaborating with Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing teams, you will leverage both traditional product management frameworks and AI-powered personalization (such as semantic search and recommendation engines) to build scalable, high-conversion features that drive customer retention, brand loyalty, and measurable growth across both brands.

Key Responsibilities
Visionary Roadmap Development: Establish a long-range strategy for AI-driven personalization. Manage a complex framework utilizing proprietary datasets, machine learning models, and external technology solutions to optimize customer LTV, retention, and acquisition.
System Architecture & Deployment: Oversee the full lifecycle of recommendation engines across digital platforms, such as mobile apps, email, and commerce pages (Cart, PLP, PDP, and homepage). Engineer filtering and ranking logic to boost conversion rates and product visibility.
Customer Acquisition & Funnel Conversion: Drive continuous conversion rate optimization (CRO) across landing pages, product listing pages (PLPs), search discovery, and the shopping cart. Own the global checkout architecture to minimize purchase friction and increase Average Order Value (AOV).
Loyalty, Retention & Lifecycle Messaging: Lead the product strategy for digital loyalty programs and account portals. Partner with CRM and Marketing teams to leverage marketing automation platforms (email, SMS, and push notifications) to deliver targeted customer lifecycle campaigns that increase customer retention and Lifetime Value (LTV).
Post-Purchase Experience & Operations: Own the digital customer experience from order confirmation to doorstep delivery. Define the roadmap for transaction tracking, shipping alerts, order routing, and modern omnichannel fulfillment pathways like Buy Online, Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Curbside Pickup, and Ship-to-Store.
Vendor Ecosystem & Strategic Sourcing: Actively evaluate, pilot, and manage third-party software vendors (e.g., search engines, payment gateways, review platforms, loyalty engines, and CRM systems). Run structured RFPs and Proof of Concept (PoC) tests to balance proprietary builds against external integrations.
Experimentation & Growth Culture: Establish a rigorous culture of experimentation. Plan, launch, and analyze systematic A/B and multivariate tests spanning acquisition pages, checkout variants, post-purchase flows, and lifecycle campaigns to validate customer value and financial return.
Efficiency & Return Mitigation: Utilize AI/ML to minimize product returns-specifically those related to fit-extending personalization beyond top-line revenue. Prioritize LTV cohorts and return reduction as core success metrics.
Business Case Modeling & Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex technological initiatives and platform performance metrics into clear, executive-friendly business cases and financial metrics (CAC, LTV, Conversion, Return Rate Reduction) to align senior leadership across the Phoenix brands.

Required Experience & Qualifications
Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, IT, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 7+ years of Digital Product Management experience, with a proven track record of owning consumer-facing eCommerce products, AI/ML-powered search relevance and recommendation systems, customer checkout funnels, loyalty platforms, or digital marketing technologies.
Retail/Omnichannel Context: Prior background working in retail eCommerce, multi-brand consumer platforms, or omnichannel environments (such as integrating physical point-of-sale systems with digital profiles) is highly preferred.
Frictionless Execution: Demonstrated success scaling digital products from pilot to high-volume coverage, resulting in measurable customer conversion gains or transactional efficiency.
Analytical and Results-Driven: Mastery of data-driven decision-making, using web analytics (e.g., GA4), customer metrics (CAC, AOV, LTV), and statistical hypothesis testing (A/B testing).
Collaborative Leadership: Outstanding communication skills with a proven capacity to lead and align cross-functional teams of Software Engineers, UI/UX Designers, Data Analysts, and business stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
Platform Familiarity: Familiarity with modern eCommerce platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS), Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), or content management system (CMS) integrations.
Advanced Personalization & AI/ML Expertise: Possess a deep understanding of varied personalization strategies, including hybrid models, content-based filtering, and collaborative techniques alongside modern AI/ML methodologies.

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

We are looking for an experienced and impact-driven Senior Product Manager to play a key role in the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of Graykey. Graykey is one of our most strategic and differentiated product lines that sits at the intersection of hardware, software, and digital forensic workflows. Reporting to the Director, Product Management, this role is responsible for translating customer and business needs into a clear product vision and executable plans, while partnering closely with Software Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Hardware, and Customer Success.

This role is well-suited to someone who thrives in highly complex, mission-critical

environments and is comfortable navigating tightly coupled hardware/software systems, evolving platform integrations, and customer-driven innovation. You will act as a strong advocate for customer needs, balancing technical feasibility, scalability, cost, and time to market in partnership with cross-functional teams.

What You'll Do

Partner with engineering and design to build products that make a real difference in people’s lives by helping uncover the truth and protect the innocent;

Meet with Law Enforcement, Public Sector and Private Sector Leaders and customers in the Digital Forensics and Investigations domains to inform prioritization and product decisions;

Drive product integration efforts across Magnet Forensics’ ecosystem, ensuring Graykey delivers seamless value as part of a larger platform experience;

Support go-to-market activities including positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and sales enablement;

Role Responsibilities

Fully understand market problems and use cases by gathering feedback from product stakeholders (i.e. Customers, Users, Internal Stakeholders) and observing market dynamics - always seeking to fully comprehend the core underlying pain or challenge;

Define clear customer and business outcomes, and be able to translate those into software deliverables and requirements, and drive them to delivery with cross-functional teams;

Contribute to long time portfolio and platform strategy where Graykey is a critical differentiator;

5+ years of experience in a Product Management role with significant ownership of complex products, ideally spanning software and hardware systems;

Demonstrated customer empathy – recognizing and caring genuinely about the motivations, challenges and frustrations of our customers and advocating for solutions to resolve them;

Strong interpersonal communications skills - comfortable with presenting to customers, executive level stakeholders and other internal audiences;

Strong collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence at all levels and create trust and strong relationships;

Bachelor’s Degree or College Diploma in a Technology Related Program, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience working on hardware products, particularly those tightly integrated with software

Prior experience in the Digital Forensics industry, Cybersecurity, or Law Enforcement.

Demonstrated strong technical fluency, comfortable discussing transaction lifecycles, state machines, APIs, events/webhooks, retries, idempotency, processor integrations, reconciliation, settlement, and failure handling
Used payment, risk, financial, or operational metrics to make product decisions
Operated with high autonomy and incomplete information, contributing from week one
