jobs.description:
Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever.

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms
for Yahoo Mail,
to lead the product strategy and execution for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared technology integrations. This role owns the horizontal capabilities that power Yahoo Mail experiences across all platforms, including authentication, identity, privacy, security, and foundational client frameworks.

This is a senior, highly cross-functional role that works deeply with application engineering teams, experience-focused product managers, and central platform and infrastructure teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that Yahoo Mail clients remain secure, compliant, scalable, and adaptable as the product ecosystem evolves.

A critical dimension of this role is guiding Yahoo Mail through large-scale platform transitions and service realignments, ensuring continuity for users and partners while enabling independent execution across multiple organizations. This work requires strong systems thinking, excellent stakeholder management, and comfort operating in complex commercial and technical environments.

What You’ll Do

Own the product vision and roadmap for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared services across web, iOS, Android, and emerging surfaces.
Define and shape the strategic roadmaps for Yahoo Mail client platforms, including decisions around codebases, architectural patterns, and technology investments that enable long-term scalability and maintainability.
Partner closely with application engineering teams to ensure client platforms are built and operated in a cost-efficient manner, balancing performance, developer velocity, and operational complexity.
Drive adoption of modern technologies and platform capabilities to deliver fast, reliable, and secure user experiences across all clients.
Partner with AI and platform teams to enable client-side support for AI-powered experiences, ensuring Yahoo Mail clients can securely and efficiently integrate capabilities such as intelligent assistance, personalization, and emerging AI-driven features.
Lead cross-platform initiatives spanning authentication, identity, privacy, security, and compliance, in close collaboration with central platform teams.
Act as the connective tissue between client engineering, experience-focused product managers, and backend platform teams, ensuring cohesive end-to-end execution.
Drive platform consistency while enabling differentiated experiences across clients where appropriate.
Lead complex platform transitions, service separations, and long-running partner support programs that require coordination across multiple teams, organizations, and external stakeholders.
Ensure client platforms are resilient to organizational change, capable of operating independently where required, and aligned with long-term commercial, legal, and regulatory constraints.
Represent Yahoo Mail in executive-level discussions related to platform strategy, technical risk, timelines, and tradeoffs.
Define and track success metrics across performance, security posture, reliability, cost efficiency, and developer productivity, using data to guide prioritization and investment decisions.

What We’re Looking For

Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of platforms, infrastructure-adjacent products, or large-scale client systems. Experience building and operating consumer applications at scale is strongly preferred. Direct experience with email platforms or messaging systems is a strong plus, given the unique technical, operational, and trust challenges of email.
Application Platform Leadership: Proven ability to define and evolve shared capabilities used by many teams, balancing consistency with flexibility while keeping end users and business customers connected through reliable, scalable platforms.
Technical Depth: Strong technical fluency across client architectures, authentication and identity systems, privacy and security controls, and platform integrations. Familiarity with the complexity and constraints of email ecosystems (deliverability, trust, abuse prevention, identity, and standards) is highly valued.
Complex Program Ownership: Demonstrated success leading ambiguous, multi-year initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, external dependencies, and contractual considerations, while maintaining operational stability and user trust.
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to align engineering, legal, privacy, security, commercial, and executive stakeholders around a common plan, particularly in environments where platforms serve both consumers and enterprise partners.
Product Judgment: Strong instincts for risk management, sequencing, and tradeoffs in high-impact, high-visibility environments, with a focus on protecting user trust and long-term platform health.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical, organizational, and platform concepts to senior audiences.
Mission & Product Mindset: A genuine interest in building products that empower people in their day-to-day lives, with an appreciation for email as a vital, enduring communications tool that continues to have real-world impact at a global scale

Your Day-to-Day

Partner with client and platform engineering leaders to translate strategic goals into executable roadmaps.
Collaborate with experienced product managers to ensure platform capabilities enable high-quality user experiences across all clients.
Work closely with identity, authentication, privacy, and security teams to ensure compliant and secure implementations.
Lead planning and execution for major platform changes, transitions, and long-term initiatives.
Identify risks early, drive alignment on mitigation strategies, and keep senior leadership informed.
Serve as a trusted product leader for some of the most complex and foundational work within Yahoo Mail.

The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe's creative community connects millions of makers every month, from first-timers to industry icons. We're building the Creative Agents that will define how those creators work in an AI-native world. Behind every good agent is a lot of high-leverage execution: the tools it can call, the skills it knows, and whether each one actually works when a creator needs it. Right now a lot of our focus sits at the harness and model level — we still need to dig deeper into the tools and skills layer, and it needs a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on role. You'll live in the details of how our tools and skills behave, drive fit-and-finish across the experience, ship improvements constantly, and build the measurement that lets a fast-moving team know it's getting better. You'll sit embedded in a cross-functional team of PMs, designers, and engineers, partner closely with our AI Platform (AIP) team, and use AI by default in everything you do.

What you'll do

Own the tools and skills lifecycle end to end — triage what the agent needs, spec it, coordinate the build with engineering, test it, and iterate based on how it performs in the wild. This is the core of the role.
Own UX fit-and-finish prioritization — partner with design to sequence the UX polish work across tools and skills, make the calls on what ships when, and push it through to done.
Improve tool and skill quality day to day — hunt down flaky triggers, wrong outputs, and rough edges, and drive them to fixes before creators feel them.
Help build out evals — partner with the team on defining what "good" looks like for each tool and skill, building test sets, and turning fuzzy quality issues into measurable, trackable signal.
Work with AIP — partner with the AI Platform team on tools and skills integration and dependencies, and make sure our needs are represented in their roadmap.
Structure and refine prompts and system instructions, running tight experiment loops to improve how tools and skills behave.
Close the loop with clear, regular reporting on tool and skill quality and reliability so the whole team knows where things stand.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. A background in Computer Science or Engineering is preferred.
5+ years in product management or an equivalent area, shipping consumer or creator products.
Enough technical depth to work closely with engineers, reason about how tools and skills are built, and dig into root causes yourself.
Daily, hands-on use of AI tools, and genuine curiosity about how agents and LLMs behave.
A track record of driving UX quality and fit-and-finish across a product, working closely with design, and prioritizing well when there's more to do than time to do it.
Strong data and experimentation instincts: you can define a metric, read a dashboard, and tell signal from noise.

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: New York, NY, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
Experience with AI/ML technologies and integrating them into consumer or enterprise user experiences.

Preferred qualifications:

Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
Experience partnering with AI/ML research teams, model builders, or working with large-scale generative AI foundation models (e.g., LLMs).
Experience in the education technology (EdTech) sector or in pedagogical principles.
Demonstrated ability to navigate pivots and advocate for product needs across executive leads within large organizations.
Strong ability to define product metrics, analyze data, and translate insights into actionable product requirements.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require product managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique issues we face daily in the education sector. AI will change the future of education and work in profound ways, and our products—Classroom, Gemini, Search, YouTube, and Workspace for Education—are at the forefront.

As a Senior Product Manager for Google for Education, you will define the product goals and strategy for bringing AI-based innovations to our learning and teaching tools. You will plan requirements, identify user needs, and user products through the entire life-cycle. You're equally at home explaining your team's product strategy to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in AI model integration with engineers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Define and drive the product strategy, goals, and roadmap for AI-based learning and teaching innovations across the Google for Education portfolio.
Leverage AI tools and models to solve complex educational problems and scale the impact for students and teachers globally.
Define and manage a product portfolio solving problems that goal high business impact for the organization and product area.
Partner seamlessly with UX research to understand the evolving needs of educators and learners, translating those insights into clear product requirements.
Ensure all AI-driven features adhere to safety, privacy, and accessibility standards, particularly regarding student data and learning environments.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Marketing
jobs.description:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.

Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

Ro is looking for a Director of Integrated Marketing
to lead the development and execution of our highest-priority integrated marketing campaigns.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a marketer who knows how to take a strong creative idea into a cohesive campaign that reaches consumers across paid, owned, and earned channels. You’ll bring together Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Insights, and other channel teams around a shared campaign strategy and ensure that every part of the campaign works together to maximize its impact.

You’ll be accountable for integrated campaigns from early strategy and planning through launch and performance assessment. You’ll propose how an idea should come to life across channels, identify the moments and tactics that can make it bigger, establish the campaign plan and operating cadence, and drive alignment among the cross-functional team and prioritize exceptional execution.

At Ro, Directors are both leaders and operators. This role will initially be an individual contributor, but will have significant cross-functional leadership responsibility. You should be equally comfortable shaping the strategy for a major campaign and getting into the details required to make it successful.

What You’ll Do

Lead Ro's highest-priority integrated campaigns

Own the integrated marketing strategy and execution for major consumer campaigns, including celebrity partnerships, brand moments, and other high-priority launches.
Translate campaign objectives, audience insights, product claims, and an aligned creative concept into a clear integrated marketing strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels.
Identify opportunities to maximize a creative concept across channels, ensuring we're not simply adapting the same idea everywhere but taking advantage of what each channel can uniquely contribute.
Build the campaign architecture: define the role of each channel, key moments, sequencing, dependencies, and how the pieces work together to create greater impact.
Maintain a holistic view of the consumer experience and ensure campaigns feel cohesive wherever consumers encounter Ro.

Orchestrate cross-functional teams

Serve as the single accountable marketing lead for assigned integrated campaigns, bringing together teams across Brand, Product Marketing, Growth,Communications, and other functions.
Partner with Product Marketing to understand the consumer insight, value proposition, and product claims we can credibly bring to market.
Partner closely with Brand as they develop the creative concept, helping pressure-test how ideas can extend across channels and identifying opportunities to maximize the concept once aligned.
Partner with channel owners to determine how the campaign should come to life within their channels, bringing their expertise into the integrated strategy rather than prescribing channel execution.
Create clarity across complex initiatives by establishing priorities, roles, decision points, dependencies, timelines, and operating rhythms.
Anticipate risks and resolve cross-functional blockers before they compromise the quality or timing of a launch.

Raise the bar for integrated marketing at Ro

Develop a repeatable approach to integrated campaign planning that enables teams to move quickly without sacrificing strategic rigor or executional excellence.
Push teams to think beyond individual channel deliverables and identify opportunities for ideas to build on one another across the entire campaign.
Bring a strong point of view on what makes integrated consumer marketing effective and help evolve how Ro shows up during our biggest marketing moments.
Create strong feedback loops after launches, partnering with channel teams to understand performance and translating those learnings into better future campaigns.

Be a hands-on leader

Personally drive the work required to move campaigns from strategy through execution rather than relying on a large team to do it for you.
Move fluidly between strategic thinking and executional detail—from determining how a campaign should show up across the consumer journey to resolving an issue that could put a launch at risk.
Lead through influence, building trust and alignment across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.
Operate comfortably in ambiguity and bring structure and momentum to complex, fast-moving initiatives.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of experience in integrated marketing, brand marketing, consumer marketing, or related roles, within a high-growth consumer, DTC, or digitally native business.
A track record of personally leading large, cross-channel consumer campaigns from strategy through launch, with clear examples of the role you played and the impact the work had.
Experience orchestrating campaigns across a mix of paid, owned, and earned channels, with enough fluency across disciplines to connect the work while respecting the expertise of functional channel owners.
Strong consumer and creative judgment. You know what makes an idea compelling and can identify opportunities to make a strong creative concept work harder across channels without needing to be the person who develops the creative concept.
Experience partnering closely with Brand/Creative, Product Marketing, Growth/Performance Marketing, Social, Communications/PR, and Lifecycle/CRM teams.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership. You can create alignment, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and hold teams accountable without relying on reporting lines.
Strong operational instincts and attention to detail. You know that exceptional campaigns require both a strong idea and excellent execution.
Experience operating in a lean, fast-moving organization where senior leaders are expected to both set direction and execute.
Low ego and high ownership. No part of getting an important campaign successfully into market is beneath you.

In your first year, you'll have established yourself as the person Ro turns to when we need to bring a major marketing moment to market exceptionally well.

Our highest-priority campaigns will have a clear integrated strategy, stronger coordination across teams and channels, and a cohesive consumer experience from first exposure through conversion and beyond. Brand will have a partner who helps maximize great creative ideas across the full marketing ecosystem; channel owners will have clarity on how their work contributes to the larger campaign; and Product Marketing will be able to maintain deeper focus on product positioning, claims, launches, and channel strategy rather than serving as the operational owner of every major campaign.

We welcome qualified candidates of all races, creeds, genders, and sexuality to apply.

The target base salary for this position ranges from $175,000 to $211,000, in addition to a competitive equity and benefits package (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

Ro recognizes the power of in-person collaboration, while supporting the flexibility to work anywhere in the United States. For our Ro’ers in the tri-state (NY) area, you will join us at HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays. For those outside of the tri-state area, you will be able to join in-person collaborations throughout the year (i.e., during team on-sites).

At Ro, we believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths — and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, training and promotion, termination, and any other terms and conditions of employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, familial status, age, disability and/or any other legally protected classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: AI Builder, Emerging Talent Manager (Manager/Sr. Manager/Director)
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As the Manager of Emerging Talent for the AI Builder Program, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high-caliber team of AI-native graduates, and bring a completely fresh approach to problem-solving.This is not a traditional engineering management role; it is a frontier-pushing leadership position designed to channel that native AI mindset into boundary-breaking, real-world customer transformations. It is a blend of people leadership, technical direction, consulting mentorship
, and program development
- with an exciting focus on pioneering AI approaches to delivering extraordinary outcomes.

We are looking for a strong people leader with reasonable technical fluency
to guide and develop a team of new computer science graduates. In this role, you will focus on people leadership and business mentorship, helping your team navigate their early careers while ensuring operational excellence. You will confidently engage with customers
across a diverse cross-section of accounts (from Mid-Market through Enterprise Strategic) and serve as a strategic partner

Your primary mission is to translate their unique, intuitive relationship with AI into enterprise-grade success and translate academic computer science excellence into real-world, customer-facing success. You will help your team navigate the frontier of generative AI and Agentforce, architect agent reasoning, and confidently engage with customers to drive business transformations. Additionally, you will play an active role in driving the architecture and execution of our Grad Builder Program
, overseeing projects, managing development plans, and delivering advanced technical and consultative training.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership & Talent Development (40%)
Channel AI-Native Superpowers: Champion and harness the unique, fast-paced 'group chat' collaboration styles and intuitive AI habits of recent graduates, turning their fresh perspectives into a competitive advantage for our delivery teams.
Manage & Mentor: Act as the direct people manager for a cohort of Emerging Talent AI Builders. Deliver regular 1:1s, performance reviews, career development planning, and compensation management.
Bridge the Gap: Help AI natives pivot from 'building experimental side projects' to deploying production-grade, secure, and ethical enterprise software, showing them how to scale their boundary-pushing ideas responsibly.
Consulting Coaching: Teach technical grads how to "translate tech into business value." Coach them on active listening, stakeholder management, discovery sessions, presentation skills, and handling pushback from customers.
Cultivating Belonging and Long-term Engagement: Establish a vibrant, inclusive atmosphere. Provide guidance through the specific challenges of early-career excellence, including managing rapid advancement paths, addressing imposter syndrome, and meeting the distinct professional needs of high-potential recent graduates.
Technical Leadership & Project Governance (30%)
Agentforce Guardrails: Guide graduates through the design of agentic reasoning, prompt engineering, and tool calls. Ensure they are evaluating AI outputs with strict engineering rigor rather than trial-and-error.
Technical Coaching: Support Graduates in building scalable and secure agentic solutions. Act as an internal technical sounding partner when a Graduate encounters roadblocks, ensuring they are equipped to succeed.
Graduate Builder Program Enablement & Strategy (30%)
Pioneer Continuous Upskilling: Foster an active, experimental lab culture where testing the absolute limits of generative AI and Agentforce is celebrated. You will use insights gained from your cohort's rapid experimentation to feed back into the broader organization's upskilling initiatives.
Project Matching & Bench Management: Oversee the pipeline of customer work, strategically pairing Grads with projects that stretch their technical capabilities while balancing business needs.
Development Milestones: Build, track, and optimize a 12-to-24-month competency matrix detailing when a Grad is expected to master specific technical tracks (e.g., Real-Time Infra) and consulting pillars.
University Recruiting Partner: Collaborate with the University Recruiting team to interview, assess, and attract top-tier Computer Science talent from target universities.

The Ideal Profile

You can speak their language...

You have a deep background in computer science or software engineering. You understand object-oriented programming, data structures, and the current landscape of LLMs/prompt engineering.

and you can teach them yours.

You are a seasoned consultant or customer-facing tech lead. You know how to read a room, handle a tough customer question during a live deployment, and unpack complex business requirements into technical user stories. You view communication, empathy, and business acumen as core engineering skills. Crucially, you are energized by working with early-career talent who naturally think AI-first. You know how to guide their ambition to push boundaries, helping them refine raw creativity into high-impact business strategy.

Qualifications & Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a highly technical discipline.
Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, software engineering, or a highly technical customer-facing role.
Leadership: 1+ years of experience managing technical teams, acting as a tech lead, or significantly mentoring early-career engineers/consultants.
Technical Fluency: Proficient in at least one classic powerhouse language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java) and a solid understanding of modern web architectures (React, REST APIs, GraphQL). A passion for high quality code and best practices (OOP, SOLID, Git, etc.)
AI/LLM Curiosity: Practical, hands-on experience or profound familiarity with Generative AI frameworks, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience managing university graduate programs, technical rotation programs, or tech boot camps.
Direct experience with the Salesforce ecosystem, Apex, or building on Agentforce.
Background in Enterprise Agile delivery and technical scoping.

Why This Role is Unique

Unlike traditional engineering managers who operate strictly behind the scenes, or traditional consulting managers focused purely on utilization metrics, you are at the epicenter of a workforce revolution. You are not just teaching a syllabus, you are leading a generation of AI natives who will fundamentally rewrite how businesses operate. In this role, you have a blank canvas to push boundaries, experiment with leading-edge agentic technology, and serve as the premier showcase for Salesforce's company-wide up-skilling strategy. If you want to change the trajectory of early-career professionals while actively redefining the future of work itself, this is your platform.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) organization is looking for an experienced technical product manager to lead the development of digital twin product capabilities for the GREF Internal Tools Product team. GREF provides real estate transactions expertise, business partnering, space and occupancy planning, design and construction, capital investment program management, facility maintenance, and operations all contributing to the employee experience and leveraging places and programs to enable culture to thrive at Amazon. Within GREF, the internal tools team establishes and builds products that enable GREF employees to deliver an exceptional workplace experience for Amazonians.

In this role, you will build a 0 to 1 digital twin product that creates a living digital representation of GREF's physical real estate portfolio. The product will continuously update to reflect any change to its physical counterpart throughout the lifecycle, creating a closed loop of feedback in a virtual environment. Core capabilities will include real time monitoring of environmental factors, space utilization, and equipment health across facilities; predictive maintenance powered by IoT data and AI to identify equipment issues before breakdowns occur; simulation tools that enable users to model changes and optimize space planning; and energy and cost management features that monitor performance and reduce waste. They will dive deep into the systems, sensors, and data that underpin GREF's real estate portfolio and develop a keen understanding of how real time information can drive smarter facility decisions. They will work cross functionally to define a north star vision for how digital twin technology can transform portfolio management, space optimization, and operational efficiency across GREF. A track record of delivering results in a fast paced, dynamic environment is a must. Being self driven, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities is key to success. Define the product architecture for real time monitoring of environmental conditions, space utilization, and equipment health across GREF's global facility footprint

Establish metrics and key performance indicators for success

We are looking for a visionary and hands-on leader to join us as Head of Digital Product for China, a strategic, consumer-centric leadership position with end-to-end accountability for shaping the full digital product and consumer experience for millions of customers in China. This covers the entire omni-channel journey — from online/offline integration to key local platforms like WeChat Miniprogram and China Digital Marketplaces. Your mission

Your mission is to shape and articulate a compelling product vision and long-term strategy for On’s omni-channel digital consumer experiences in China. You will serve as the center of consumer, digital experience, technology, and project management, owning how our products attract, engage, and retain customers across all commercial channels — Retail, Wholesale, Local DTC (WeChat), and China Marketplaces — ensuring experiences are premium, locally relevant, and globally scalable. As the strategic owner of the China customer product portfolio, you will define how data, personalization, and seamless cross-channel journeys come together to drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and commercial growth. You will guide the evolution and integration of both global platforms and locally built capabilities, ensuring a seamless, end-to-end customer journey across offline and online touchpoints, with a core focus on WeChat Miniprogram and China Digital Marketplaces. A core part of your mission is to elevate Digital Product in China to a true strategic partnership — deeply understanding customer and business needs, shaping direction early, and co-owning outcomes with Technology and Commercial leadership. You will serve as a key connector between China and the global organization, turning local insights into global advantage and helping build a world-class, interconnected digital experience that fuels On’s growth in China and beyond. Partner with Tech and Data leaders to leverage modern technologies and AI-driven capabilities where they create meaningful customer and business impact. Leverage Data for Growth & Impact Establish a data-driven decision-making culture, defining success metrics tied to customer engagement, retention, and commercial performance. Use insights and experimentation to guide prioritization, justify investments, and continuously improve outcomes. Act as the China Product Voice Globally Represent China’s product needs and opportunities within the global organization. Your story

Proven Product Leadership: You bring 10+ years of experience in Product Management, including senior leadership roles where you’ve led teams delivering complex, customer-facing products at scale. You have a strong track record of owning outcomes across strategy, execution, and impact. Strategic & Customer-Centric Mindset: You possess a sharp strategic mindset and the ability to translate complex business and customer challenges into clear, actionable product visions and roadmaps. You naturally connect customer needs, business objectives, and product strategy, and you know how to make trade-offs that drive long-term value. Inspirational People Leader: You are a people-first leader with a passion for building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product teams. You are skilled at navigating complex stakeholder environments, building alignment, and influencing decisions across regions and functions. Global Mindset, Local Impact: You have experience working in global organizations, partnering across cultures and time zones. You are comfortable representing local needs on a global stage — and translating global strategy into meaningful, impactful execution in China. Fluent in English and Mandarin: You are able to operate confidently in cross-cultural environments.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager – Retention & Post-Purchase
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Digital Product Manager – Retention & Post-Purchase

About Bombas:

Bombas is a comfort focused premium basics brand with a mission to help those in need. The company launched in 2013, after the founders learned that socks are the #1 most requested clothing item at homeless shelters. From there, they set out to solve that problem, donating a pair of socks for every pair they sell. How do you donate a lot of socks? You sell a lot. And how do you sell a lot? You make the most comfortable socks in the history of feet. Millions of pairs sold and donated later, Bombas has continued to innovate within its mission and product, introducing new socks, as well as underwear and t-shirts, the #2 and #3 most requested clothing items at homeless shelters, all while continuing to make a positive impact on the community where we all work and live.

Click here to see what it's like to work inside the Bombas Hive!

The word Bombas is derived from the Latin word for bumblebees. Bees work together to make their hive a better place. At Bombas, we’re inspired by that. We know it’s the collective efforts of our team that keeps the Hive alive and strong - a team that is diverse and inclusive. Different perspectives strengthen our ability to make the most comfortable versions of the products people wear closest to their bodies every day and to serve the communities where we all work and live. We are committed to continuously building a Hive where all are welcomed, seen, and heard regardless of age, color, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, genetics, physical or mental ability, protected veteran status race, religion and sexual orientation. As a team, we will strive to create room for different experiences and empower all voices.

Based on the specific needs and job requirements, this role will be working out of our Bombas HQ in New York City.

About the Job:

We are looking for an analytical, customer-obsessed team player to join our Digital Product team as our Senior Digital Product Manager – Retention & Post-Purchase
, reporting directly to our Head of Digital Product. The ideal candidate has digital product management experience in the second half of the customer journey: everything after the order is placed, including order tracking, returns and exchanges, accounts, self-service support, personalization for returning customers, and the surfaces a repeat customer sees first.

This is an opportunity to own a mission from the start, leading a dedicated group of engineers and designers to turn a completed purchase into the next one. We are standing this team up now, and the post-purchase work running inside other teams today transfers to you. Your first big bet comes together with the Head of Digital Product, since we have few learnings in this space so far. After that ramp, the strategy is yours: discovery, hypotheses, and the iteration roadmap. The mandate is the customer-facing experience end to end. The platform underneath it (identity, customer and order data, internal agent tooling) sits with dedicated platform teams you partner with rather than own.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for post-purchase, retention, and returning-customer surfaces, including order tracking, returns and exchanges, the account experience, order history, self-service support, and personalization.
Move the team north star: sessions returning to a meaningful product interaction within 30 days of a purchase. Own the input metrics beneath it (repeat rate, account creation and login rate, self-service resolution rate, post-purchase surface engagement) and report on them.
Own personalization for returning customers. Define what a repeat session sees and the rules behind it (reorder, size and fit memory, recently purchased, replenishment timing), working from the customer and order data our platform teams expose, and prove which rules earn their place.
Treat the post-purchase journey as one product surface rather than a set of vendor screens, including self-service returns, exchanges, and order status, with a stated target for support contacts avoided and no loss in customer satisfaction.
Direct our checkout optimization agency: set the roadmap, prioritize the test pipeline, review and approve the work, and communicate results internally. Checkout completion stays your metric even though an external team builds against it.
Serve as the primary product partner to Retention and CRM so on-site surfaces and lifecycle messaging (email, SMS, Braze) run as one journey instead of two roadmaps.
Run discovery alongside delivery and own A/B tests end to end: define hypotheses, size and monitor experiments, report findings, and write down the results, including the ones proving an idea wrong.

What we’ll love about you:

Motivated by the retention problem at a brand with no loyalty program. The levers here are product, experience, and timing rather than points.
You have a point of view on personalization: which signals earn a changed experience, and where personalization stops being useful and starts being intrusive.
You get results through an external team as comfortably as through your own engineers.
Happy owning an experience without owning the systems under it. You get what you need from platform partners through clarity about the customer outcome rather than by taking over their roadmap.
You read cohort and funnel data yourself before asking an analyst for a pull.
A proactive communicator who shares context early and brings the right people in at the right time.
Belief in our mission and understand the importance of giving-back

What you’ll love about us:

We are a team of smart, interesting, diverse, funny, and loving people.
We offer competitive compensation, employer paid health, medical and dental benefits, 401k with match, paid parental leave, snacks, socks and a fun, relaxed office environment.
We take the responsibility to make sure you are excited, happy, and find fulfillment in your work very seriously.
We value fun. This is why we host office lunches, offsite team outings and company retreats.
We believe in giving back to the community and helping those in need, which is why we volunteer as a team regularly.
We believe success comes from the collective effort of all, which is why all full-time employees receive equity in the business.
We understand the value of health, relaxation, spending time with friends and family, and traveling the world and offer flexible paid time off for all full-time employees. This includes over 20 paid company holidays, year-round "Flexible Fridays" and unlimited vacation, sick, and wellness days.
We understand the importance of communication and offer a monthly phone stipend for all full-time employees.
We believe a healthy body equals a healthy mind, so we offer a $100 monthly wellbeing reimbursement to all full-time employees.

What you’ll bring:

Digital product management experience with meaningful time on post-purchase, accounts, retention, personalization, subscription, or loyalty surfaces in DTC or eCommerce.
A track record of moving a repeat or retention metric with measurable, sustained impact.
Experience directing an agency or external development partner to ship customer-facing work, owning the outcome rather than the status report.
Strong experimentation practice: A/B tests run end to end, scoped properly, with findings reported in a way building confidence in the methodology. Hands-on with product analytics and experimentation tooling (for example Optimizely, GA4, Contentsquare, Looker).
Technical fluency in how site experience surfaces are built and rendered: templates, content models, component reuse, and how personalization rules reach a live session. Enough to partner credibly with Engineering on what is feasible in-session versus what needs precomputing.

Bombas is committed to delivering competitive and equitable pay for our employees.

Each component of the Bombas total rewards package, including benefits and pay, is aimed at contributing to an environment where team members have resources to manage their lives and are enabled to focus on doing their best work.

The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $152,000 and $162,000/year
. However, the base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, market factors, and business need.

The Bombas total rewards package offered for this position may also include other elements, such as annual bonus and equity target award opportunities as well as medical, financial, and well-being benefits. Additional details of these benefits will be provided if a candidate receives an offer of employment.

If hired, the position is “at-will” and the Company reserves the right to modify any component, plan, or program of the total rewards package at any time, for any reason.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any employment testing, or otherwise participating in this hiring process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@bombas.com
.
Only requests related to accommodations will be responded to.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Vice President of Product Design

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

The position is accountable for establishing a strong design vision, improving customer experience, accelerating product innovation, and building a world-class product design organization.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18 years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team at Toast is on a mission to deliver a trusted, scalable, and governed data foundation that empowers every team at Toast to make decisions with speed and confidence. As Toast scales and AI becomes central to our product and operational strategy, EDS serves as the engine behind that ambition—building the infrastructure, governance frameworks, and data products every business function depends on.

As a Senior Data Governance Product Manager, you will be the primary operational executor within EDS's governance function. Reporting directly to the Director of Enterprise Data Governance, you will build and run the policies, processes, and programs that make Toast's data trustworthy, compliant, and discoverable every day.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable running a cross-functional workshop with business stakeholders and configuring metadata standards in a data catalog—combining strategic thinking with a strong bias toward execution.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

Drive Governance Program Operations: Manage and maintain the Data Domain Model, ensuring clear ownership assignments. Facilitate the Data Governance Council (agendas, action tracking, meeting facilitation), partner with Data Stewards across domains, and track program adoption metrics and maturity KPIs for leadership.
Execute Policy & Compliance Standards: Support the development, documentation, and roll-out of enterprise data policies. Monitor compliance, coordinate remediation with domain owners, maintain the policy register, and assemble governance documentation for audits and risk reviews.
Lead Business Glossary & Metadata Management: Own day-to-day operations of Toast's Business Glossary by facilitating definition workshops and certifying terms with domain owners. Partner with the data catalog team to enforce metadata standards, build onboarding guides, and run regular office hours to drive user adoption.
Advance Data Strategy & Maturity: Support the enterprise data strategy through stakeholder synthesis and executive materials. Coordinate data maturity assessments, synthesize outputs into actionable recommendations, and deliver training programs to raise data literacy across the company.

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

Experience: 5+ years in data governance, data management, or analytics. Proven track record of supporting or implementing governance programs (stewardship models, policy execution, catalog rollouts) and driving adoption in fast-moving, complex environments.
Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA DMBOK).
Working knowledge of modern data stack platforms (Snowflake, dbt, cloud data warehouses).

jobs.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Humorphic Labs
jobs.description:
Description

Humorphic Labs builds AI systems that work as teammates rather than tools. We ship them six months or more ahead of anyone else. The Lab is small on purpose, so it can change direction in a day.

Humorphism concerns the quality of the working relationship between a person and an AI system. It asks whether the system acts proactively, adapts to the person and the situation, earns trust, manages attention, and strengthens human judgment. This role turns those behaviors into testable questions, then answers them with working systems.

You will own the scientific agenda. You will convert a fuzzy behavioral goal into an end-to-end plan that covers data, agent architecture, evaluation, and the product experiment that tests it. You will write code every week and build large parts of the experimental stack yourself, because it does not exist yet.

The first focus areas are agentic products where a domain expert holds judgment the system cannot replace. Amazon Connect places an assistant beside a person handling a live conversation. AWS Bio Discovery places one beside a scientist running experiments. Both need evaluation that measures collaboration quality rather than task completion alone.

The role changes shape as the Lab matures. It starts as hands-on science in close partnership with product and engineering. Later it moves inside a product team to carry adoption of what the Lab proved.

Key job responsibilities

Own the scientific strategy for human-AI collaboration across agentic and multimodal systems.
Convert desired interaction behaviors into falsifiable hypotheses, evaluation tasks, and system requirements.
Build the evaluation system that measures teammate behavior, trust, adaptation, human contribution, and failure recovery.
Design agent systems that use memory, tools, planning, and recovery, then test them with the people who do the work.
Design data collection and curation for language, speech, and interaction traces.
Build significant parts of the experimental stack yourself, because that stack does not exist yet.
Diagnose failures across data, models, orchestration, evaluation, and product interaction.
Define the requirements engineering needs to turn a proven method into a product capability.
Partner with design, product, engineering, and behavioral research from problem definition through product validation.
Run experiments with partner product teams, then report what worked, what failed, and what changed as a result.
Set the standard for reproducible experiments, evidence, and scientific review inside the Lab.
Mentor scientists and engineers without moving away from hands-on work.
Represent the work in internal reviews and in appropriate external scientific venues.

A day in the life

Your week has two centers of gravity.

Most days you build. You take a claim about how a teammate should behave, design the smallest experiment that can falsify it, and run it. You read interaction traces from real sessions, then argue with the engineers about what they mean.

The rest of the week belongs to the people the work is for. You sit with a contact center agent or a bench scientist and watch where the system helps and where it intrudes. You leave with the next hypothesis. Often you leave with evidence that kills the last one.

About The Team

The Lab is a lead who still writes code, an Applied Scientist, and engineers. Applied AI Solutions leadership approved it with one instruction, to explore the limits of what we can build, and one number, to ship six or more months ahead of anyone else.

You own the agenda, the hypotheses, and the evaluation. The engineers build the systems that test them, then the products that carry the ones that survive. Neither seat hands work over a wall.

We have a sunset clause. Once a capability is proven and integrated into its product, the Lab moves to the next frontier.

Basic Qualifications

PhD in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or a related technical field, or a Master's degree with equivalent applied science experience, or an equivalent body of work
Experience developing agentic AI systems or large language model applications through an end-to-end product cycle
Experience designing evaluation for systems that have no standard benchmark
Experience writing substantial research or production code in Python or a comparable language
Experience leading complex scientific work across engineering and product partners
Evidence of independent decisions in ambiguous, consequential technical environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning
Experience with multimodal models across language, speech, and vision
Experience with speech systems or real-time conversational systems
Experience measuring collaboration quality, trust, adaptation, or human contribution in AI systems
Experience building agent systems that use memory, tools, planning, and recovery mechanisms
Experience founding a scientific program, or joining an early team before that team had established its methods
A record of scientific influence through publications, patents, open-source work, or deployed systems
Experience mentoring senior scientists and engineers without moving away from hands-on work
Experience partnering with design, product, and behavioral research from problem definition through product validation
Experience taking a proven method into a product team and staying until that team adopted it

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The next era of enterprise technology will not be won by simply knowing the platform. It will be won by helping customers make the right architectural choices as AI reshapes how data, applications, experiences, security, and work come together.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Architecture & Innovation
to lead a multi-layered organization of Core Technical and Enterprise Architecture leaders and highly experienced talent across CBS.

This is not a traditional architecture leadership role.

We need a leader who can see around corners, create a point of view, mobilize teams quickly, and translate emerging technology into clear choices for customers and our field, someone who can move comfortably between an executive customer conversation, a deep architectural debate, a strategy session with Sales and Solutions leadership, and an executive update on what we are learning across the business.

You will lead teams responsible for helping customers understand how to govern AI responsibly, activate the full Salesforce platform, prepare data and architecture for production, and reimagine experiences as new technologies emerge.

Just as importantly, you will create leverage. The best work of the organization should not remain inside a single account or team. You will turn what we learn into strong points of view, architectural patterns, field guidance, and repeatable approaches that make the entire CBS organization better.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale an Exceptional Architecture Organization

Lead and develop a multi-layered organization of frontline leaders and senior architects across a diverse set of architecture and innovation disciplines
Create a high bar for technical excellence, customer impact, pace, accountability, and executive presence
Build an environment where teams are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment thoughtfully, and bring forward new ideas before they are asked
Develop strong leaders who can independently run their businesses while operating as one integrated architecture organization
Attract, grow, and retain exceptional architecture talent while creating clear opportunities for career development and succession

Create the Architectural Point of View

Establish clear, proactive perspectives on the architectural questions our customers are facing across AI, data, security, governance, integration, platform strategy, emerging technology, and digital experiences
Anticipate where customer architecture is heading and ensure CBS is prepared to lead those conversations, not react to them
Move quickly from signal to insight to action, without waiting for perfect information when the field needs direction
Translate complex technical shifts into simple frameworks, reference architectures, patterns, and recommendations that customers and account teams can act on
Ensure the organization consistently connects architectural decisions to business outcomes, platform strategy, and the customer's path to production

Lead the Most Important Customer Conversations

Serve as a trusted architecture executive for strategic customers navigating complex transformation decisions
Lead conversations that help CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and other technology leaders understand choices, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities
Elevate conversations beyond products and features to how the customer's technology landscape must evolve for an agentic enterprise
Create confidence when the answer is complex, multiple technologies are involved, or the path forward is not yet obvious
Step into critical opportunities and escalations with urgency, clarity, and strong executive judgment
Lead and participate in key customer on-sites, SICs, and workshops, as well as conferences (TDX, DF, etc.)

Make Customers Builder-Ready

Ensure architecture teams create the clarity required before hands-on building begins: business outcome, use case and scope, target architecture, data and grounding, actions and integrations, trust guardrails, dependencies, and path to production
Partner closely with Builder leadership so Builder teams enter engagements understanding the architecture, key decisions, dependencies, and definition of done
Maintain a clear distinction between architectural leadership and hands-on implementation while ensuring the two motions operate seamlessly together
Identify architectural blockers early and mobilize the right teams to resolve them before they slow execution
Help create repeatable patterns that move customers faster from strategy and experimentation to production

Be an Exceptional Cross-Functional Partner

Operate as a deeply trusted partner to Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, Product, Engineering, and other specialist organizations
Bring teams together around the customer problem rather than organizational boundaries
Create clear roles and handoffs while maintaining shared accountability for the customer outcome
Partner with peers generously. The goal is not for Architecture to own every technical conversation, but to make every team around it stronger
Surface patterns from the field to Product and Engineering, and help translate product direction back into actionable guidance for customer-facing teams

Amplify the Work of the Team

Make exceptional work visible and reusable across CBS and Salesforce
Identify the ideas, architectures, customer lessons, and innovations that should be elevated beyond an individual engagement
Turn field learning into executive-ready narratives, POVs, reusable assets, and scalable enablement
Create mechanisms for architects to share ideas, challenge one another, and continuously raise the technical bar
Give individual architects and leaders visibility for their work, and create opportunities for the team's strongest voices to influence customers, the field, and our product strategy

Communicate With Clarity and Influence

Maintain strong communication with senior leadership on customer signals, architectural trends, emerging risks, team priorities, and opportunities
Distill a complex portfolio of work into the few things executives need to understand and act on
Bring recommendations, not just updates. Surface issues early, frame tradeoffs clearly, and propose a path forward
Build trust through transparency, strong judgment, and consistent follow-through
Represent the organization with credibility at every level, from deeply technical teams to Salesforce executives and customer C-suites

What Success Looks Like

You will know this organization is succeeding when:

Customers seek us out for the broader technical vision, not simply for answers to product questions
Our architects shape decisions earlier, before architecture becomes a blocker to execution
Builders start ready, with clearer architecture, dependencies, guardrails, and success criteria
Our best thinking scales, rather than remaining trapped inside individual accounts
Executive leadership has clear visibility into what the organization is learning, where customers are struggling, and where Salesforce should lean in
The team moves with urgency, taking initiative and creating direction rather than waiting for requests
Our leaders and architects are recognized voices with customers, internally, and in the broader technical community
Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, and Product view Architecture as one of their strongest partners

What We're Looking For

Transformational Leadership

Proven experience leading leaders and senior technical talent through change. You create clarity, raise standards, build followership, and translate strategy into action.

Architecture & Technology Depth

Deep understanding of enterprise architecture and modern technology landscapes, including cloud platforms, data, AI, integration, identity, security, governance, APIs, and modern application and experience architectures. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you must know how to lead experts and connect the pieces.

Executive Presence

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical topics with senior customer and internal executives. You can simplify without losing substance and are comfortable challenging assumptions when needed.

Customer and Business Acumen

You understand that architecture exists to enable a business outcome. You can connect technical choices to value, risk, speed, adoption, and long-term platform strategy.

Strong Point of View

You are intellectually curious and proactive. You develop perspectives on where technology and customer needs are heading and are comfortable putting a recommendation on the table.

Bias for Action

You operate with urgency. You identify what needs to happen, mobilize the right people, and move. You are comfortable making progress in ambiguity and adjusting as new information emerges.

Organizational Influence

You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across organizational boundaries. You can align strong leaders with different priorities around a common outcome without relying on hierarchy.

Executive Communication

You know how to manage a complex portfolio upward. You surface what matters, make risks visible early, amplify the work of your team, and consistently bring senior leaders clarity and recommendations.

Talent Leadership

You are passionate about developing leaders and creating an environment where exceptional technical talent can do the best work of their careers.

THE LEADERSHIP PROFILE

We are looking for an operator, architect, storyteller, and multiplier: someone technical enough to earn the trust of our strongest architects, strategic enough to shape the direction of the business, customer-focused enough to command a C-suite conversation, and collaborative enough to make the organizations around them more successful.

Most importantly, we want a leader who does not wait for the future to arrive. They help define it.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Description Summary

The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.

The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.

Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).

As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.

Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience.

Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.

Experience building and deploying AI applications.

Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset

will play an important role in shaping and executing product strategy for Western Union’s digital asset products, built on Western Union’s global payment network and the issuance of USDPT. This role is expected to operate across multiple digital asset initiatives as the portfolio evolves, partnering with business, engineering, treasury, and external ecosystem stakeholders to identify new opportunities, define product strategy, and scale adoption across Western Union's global network.

Define and manage requirements for digital payments, stablecoins, tokenization, and settlement solutions while ensuring regulatory and policy compliance.
