jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description:
TL;DR:
If you:

Have yourself designed complex physical systems;
Can translate customer workflows into a coherent, scalable product;
Have a rigorous understanding of AI models, agents, evals, and failure modes;
Have taken an AI product from early capability to sustained use;
Are as happy and capable being hands-on, as you are building and leading a team;
Share our vision of an AI engineer for the physical world…

… you should apply for this role!

About P-1 AI

At P-1 AI, we are building an AI engineer agent for the physical world named Archie. We maximize Archie’s anthropomorphism so that he fits seamlessly into existing engineering teams and workflows in the form factor of a human engineer. Archie today is at the level of a junior mechanical and electrical engineer, with a quantitative intuition over the product design space and the ability to use complex engineering tools—the same tools his human teammates use. Archie's tech stack includes a custom agentic harness, structured design representation, continual skills learning, and small custom post-trained models using proprietary semi-synthetic training data sets and environments which create a deep competitive moat. Our ultimate aim is to build engineering ASI. We recently announced a $50 million Series A financing led by NEA, which added former General Electric CEO Jeff Immelt to our board. The round also included the addition of several AI luminaries from Anthropic and Nominal to our existing angel investors from Google and OpenAI.

About The Opportunity

This is one of the most impactful roles in the company. You will work alongside the CEO to refine and translate the product vision for Archie into an actionable roadmap and strike the delicate balance between vision-driven and customer-driven product development. You must bring to the role a thorough understanding of how complex physical products are designed today, as well as a nuanced perspective on the capabilities and limitations of modern AI models and harnesses. You will be a key driver of our product strategy and execution, and as such you must be a true believer in our mission to build an engineering ASI for the physical world.

About The Role

Continuously map our ambitious vision into a focused product strategy and feature roadmap.
Embed with customers, understand their workflows, and inject customer use cases into the product roadmap.
Develop feature specifications and requirements alongside the engineering teams.
Work alongside engineering leaders to drive overall product architecture.
Lead product from emerging AI capability to trusted, sustained use in real engineering environments, setting a rigorous bar for performance, evals, reliability, and graceful failure modes.
Build and lead a world-class product team—while staying deeply hands-on with discovery, design, and delivery.

About You

You have intimate familiarity with engineering design for some class of complex systems. If the complex systems align with our target product verticals: data center cooling and power systems, automotive, aerospace and defense—so much the better.
You are deeply embedded in the AI ecosystem and have a thorough understanding of how modern AI works, its limitations, and its failure modes.
You’ve taken an AI product from early capability to sustained customer adoption.
You love the 0->1 part of the journey, being hands on, attracting top talent, and motivating a team.
You share our conviction that AI building the physical world will be beneficial and transformative for the human experience.

Location:

Remote (US/Canada) or in-office in San Mateo, CA. Remote employees spend one week out of six working together on-site in our San Mateo office. Relocation support available.

Benefits

Competitive salary, bonus, meaningful equity ownership, healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and unlimited PTO.

Interview Process

Introductory call (30 mins)
Biographical/behavioural interview (45 mins)
Case study interview (60 mins)
CEO interview (30 mins)

Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Team Overview

Insurance New Markets & Strategic Partnerships is KKR Insurance’s dedicated team focused on growing the firm’s insurance and reinsurance platform. The team’s mandate is to expand KKR Insurance’s footprint beyond its core relationships and existing platform, including new partnerships, new channels of growth and new products. The group partners closely with investment teams, commercial team, insurance leadership, and external clients and distribution partners to diversify KKR’s funding sources and grow assets under management across new channels and geographies.

Position Summary

KKR is seeking an experienced Principal / Director to join the Insurance New Markets and Strategic Partnerships team and drive the expansion of funding sources with a focus on Defined Contribution. This individual will lead the design, structuring, and go-to-market strategy for guaranteed income within Defined Contribution. Sitting at the intersection of product strategy, structuring, client coverage, and distribution enablement, they will help shape KKR insurance’s long-term growth strategy in this channel.

Role & Responsibilities

Strategy, Development & Client Coverage

Own the Defined Contribution channel strategy for insurance —building the roadmap for entry and scale and partnering with key leaders across both functions to define, evaluate, and recommend specific growth opportunities for insurance within Defined Contribution
Lead end-to-end product development and structuring for in-plan or lifetime income solutions designed for distribution through Defined Contribution
Analyze the competitive landscape, end-participant needs, regulatory developments (SEC, FINRA, state insurance regulators, ERISA), and platform trends to identify product gaps and channel expansion opportunities
Build and manage strategic relationships with asset managers, record keepers, consultants, trust managers, and other external parties in the KKR ecosystem
Represent the firm externally as a thought leader on in plan annuities and lifetime income within DC

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as central point of coordination across investment, legal, compliance, distribution, marketing, commercial and client teams for insurance opportunities in Defined Contribution
Partner closely with public policy & affairs, legal, compliance, and operations to ensure product structures meet fiduciary, regulatory and operational standards
Monitor channel performance and product uptake, incorporate asset manager or plan sponsor feedback, and drive continuous improvement

Qualifications

9+ years of experience in asset management, insurance, and/or annuity product distribution, with direct exposure to product development and/or channel strategy at a top-tier asset manager, insurance carrier, or alternative platform. Direct knowledge of the DC ecosystem strongly preferred
Strong track record designing and launching annuity or retail insurance products, and/or building out new distribution channels (DC, RIA, independent broker-dealer)
Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder-coordination skills, partnering effectively with senior leaders across insurance, distribution, commercial, and investment teams
Strong technical proficiency across insurance, multi-asset solutions, portfolio construction, and annuity/insurance product mechanics
Comfort leveraging AI tools to accelerate market/competitive analysis, product research, and reporting

Player coach mindset, leading by example

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship.

We are a team of problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1. We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India—embracing both hybrid and remote work to bring the best minds together, wherever they are. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.

As Chief Product Officer, you will lead ASAPP's product strategy and portfolio through the next stage of growth. You will turn differentiated AI technology into products that enterprises buy repeatedly, deploy successfully, and scale. You will decide where ASAPP invests, what we become world-class at, and how the needs of an individual customer become durable platform capability.

This is a role for a strategic product leader who is still hands-on. You will operate at the executive level with customers and company leadership, and you will go deep with your product teams, researchers, engineers, and designers on requirements, architecture, production data, customer workflows, and technical tradeoffs. You will bring enterprise AI judgment, commercial instinct, and operating rigor to build a product organization that holds a high standard.

What you'll do

Strategy and portfolio

Set product direction: Define the vision and priorities for the ASAPP portfolio. Make clear choices about where we can create durable differentiation and translate customer, market, and technology shifts into a focused roadmap.
Turn technology into products: Partner with Research, Engineering, Delivery, and Security to convert advances in AI into products that are intuitive, reliable, and commercially valuable to customers.
Productize customer needs: Work directly with customers to understand their most important problems, find the patterns that repeat across enterprises, and convert those patterns into reusable product and platform capability.

Ownership and quality

Own products end to end: Lead products from incubation and early product-market fit through production deployment, adoption, expansion, and scale. Establish clear ownership, success metrics, and accountability across the portfolio.
Deliver customer outcomes: Make sure customers can deploy ASAPP’s GenerativeAgent and reach measurable value. Hold the bar on reliability, integrations, usability, configurability, adoption, speed to value, and business results.
Decide from production data: Stay close to how products and capabilities actually behave in production. Use telemetry, customer feedback, operational data, and business metrics to find issues, improve quality, and set investment priorities.
Hold the AI quality bar: Set a high standard for AI quality, evaluation, safety, reliability, latency, and observability. Partner with technical teams on the tradeoffs between speed, quality, cost, and scale.
Focus and execute: Establish clear priorities and make the hard tradeoffs. Say no when it is warranted, concentrate teams on what matters most, and partner with Engineering to ship with urgency, stability, and technical excellence.

Organization and market

Shape how we sell and deploy: Work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Delivery to refine positioning, packaging, segmentation, and product strategy based on what customers actually buy, deploy, adopt, and expand.
Lead across functions: Build trust across Research, Engineering, GTM, Delivery, and company leadership, and align the organization around product priorities and customer outcomes.
Build the team: Recruit, develop, and retain outstanding Product and Design talent. Build an organization with strong leaders, clear accountability, and excellent judgment, while staying personally engaged in the decisions that matter.

What you'll need

Enterprise AI product experience: Significant experience building and scaling AI products that enterprise customers run in production. Strong familiarity with modern generative AI, agentic systems, and workflows powered by AI.
Technical product depth: Able to engage meaningfully with researchers and engineers on AI systems, orchestration, knowledge and retrieval, evaluation, safety, latency, reliability, data, and platform architecture. You do not need to be a researcher, but you cannot outsource technical product judgment.
Builder mentality: A record of personally building products through ambiguity, finding product-market fit, and scaling from there, rather than inheriting mature products or businesses.
Enterprise product judgment: Experience in complex B2B environments with deep integrations, many stakeholders, demanding production requirements, and deployments that run for years.
Customer and commercial instinct: Comfortable with senior enterprise customers, and able to tell the difference between what one customer asks for and what the broader market will repeatedly value, buy, and deploy.
Productization ability: Demonstrated ability to find the common pattern across customer needs and turn it into a scalable product or platform capability.
Operating rigor: Strong prioritization, metrics orientation, and accountability. Comfortable making difficult tradeoffs and focusing teams on a small number of important outcomes.
Leadership: Proven ability to attract, develop, and lead exceptional Product and Design talent while remaining personally engaged in important product decisions.
Entrepreneurial spirit: Thrives in constant change, limited structure, rapid learning, and evolving product market fit.
Relationship builder: Can build trust across Research, Engineering, Sales, Delivery, and the executive team, and bring those groups together around clear product choices.

Enterprise customer experience, contact center, or communications products.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Vice President of Product Design  

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

The position is accountable for establishing a strong design vision, improving customer experience, accelerating product innovation, and building a world-class product design organization.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18 years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril is at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain. We're the architects of mission autonomy and resilient mesh architectures, delivering scalable software solutions that meet some of the most urgent national security needs. By working hand-in-hand with elite teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering we craft cutting-edge, end-to-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities.

About The Job

Anduril’s Strategic Defense business line is seeking a talented Product Manager to join our rapidly growing team in Washington, DC or Seattle, WA. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping and delivering features and services critical to the next generation of autonomous air and missile defense systems. You will develop domain expertise and perform thorough discovery to devise innovative autonomy capabilities ready to meet unprecedented defense needs. These capabilities will be robust, reliable, and controlled, while appropriately leveraging the latest in AI/ML technologies and rigorous approaches to AI safety. If you are someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, is comfortable owning execution end-to-end without a dedicated program manager, and has a passion for contributing to national security, then this role is for you!

What You'll Do

Own the product roadmap for key autonomy capabilities with attention to both backend services and interfaces supporting UI-based oversight, explainability, and control. You will translate high-level strategic objectives and urgent warfighter needs into detailed, actionable product roadmaps and specifications.
Define autonomy behavior and the human-machine interfaces for it — decision authority, operator overrides, engagement constraints, and the safety and controls guardrails that govern automated decision-making.
Support software execution for this capability in conjunction with engineering: sequence workstreams, surface and resolve cross-team dependencies and blockers, track delivery against plan, and hold engineering, test, and program stakeholders accountable to schedule.
Proactively communicate roadmaps, execution status, and goals to stakeholders and manage expectations of delivery. Escalate large trade offs and necessary decision points as needed.
Operate as the owner of the autonomy capability area. Work with business development, proposal, marketing, and compliance leads to communicate product capabilities externally. Participate in large-scale customer exercises and demonstrations.
Work hands-on to deliver new capabilities across the lifecycle of the product, from initial release and onboarding, through day-to-day improvements. Validate and experiment along the way, acting as the voice of the user throughout.
Work in coordination with engineering and test stakeholders to define and monitor key metrics to measure success, including autonomy performance, safety, and controls behavior in operationally relevant conditions.
Interview and iterate with defense operators and subject matter experts, develop insights from such interactions, and propagate user needs clearly through the organization.
Develop relationships to bridge business and technical worlds. Build tech alongside prolific engineers and designers, and then zoom out to work with business development, operations, customer success, marketing, and finance teams in order to ensure success. Along the way, you’ll help define and drive product team culture and best practices.
Partner closely with test engineers and program teams to devise rigorous testing scenarios that validate key functionality, demonstrate operational utility, and drive rapid iteration cycles.

Required Qualifications

Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance (Top Secret clearance preferred)
3-5 years in software product management, ideally in highly technical areas which may include autonomous systems, AI/ML products, developer solutions, etc.
Working fluency in autonomy and controls concepts — state estimation, planning, and closed-loop control — sufficient to reason about system behavior and its limits with engineers
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A foundational understanding of back-end web technologies & distributed systems to consider capabilities and limitations
Demonstrated aptitude for prototyping solutions, including through AI code generation
Proven ability to decompose and organize technically complex projects in a structured approach
Demonstrated ability to drive software execution directly — planning, dependency management, and schedule accountability
Aptitude for working with internal and external stakeholders, across a wide range of technical comfort
Ability to travel for discovery and testing purposes (surges up to 50%)

Preferred Qualifications

Active U.S. Secret security clearance
Hands-on experience shipping autonomous systems, robotics, guidance/navigation/control, or mission autonomy software
Familiarity with mathematical optimization problems (e.g. assignment, resource allocation, scheduling, trajectory optimization) and the tradeoffs between optimality, runtime, and operator trust
Experience with AI safety, assurance, or verification and validation for learning-enabled or automated decision-making systems
Background in operations research, optimization, or applied mathematics through experience or education
Defense, national security, or aerospace domain familiarity through experience or education
Experience working in a developer focused product team (for example, in cloud services, SDK development, or internal platform infrastructure)
Experience supporting test design and execution for technically complex, combined hardware/software systems

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Suzy

Suzy is a teammate: an always-on partner who has a deep understanding of the business — its customers, its market, its competitive landscape — and puts that knowledge to work. Suzy is here to propel teams forward, so they walk into every decision faster, sharper, and act with real conviction.

This means our customers need to feel that shift in every interaction they have with us, not just read about it in a press release.

The Role

Suzy is looking for a Senior Level Product Manager who treats time with customers as the job, not a break from it.

This role sits at the center of the business, not off to the side of it. You will spend real time with the customers who depend on Suzy every day, translate what you hear into product decisions that matter, and make sure Sales and Product are never telling two different stories about what we can do and where we are headed. As Suzy asks its customer base to trust us with something bigger than a research tool, you will be one of the people responsible for making sure that trust is earned — and that our reputation reflects the caliber of what we are actually building.

You will also own the machinery that determines whether that trust holds up: the evaluation pipeline and quality loops behind our AI capabilities. What we serve customers is only as good as how rigorously we measure it, and Product owns that call.

This person is someone who reads the market — the shifts, the tailwinds, the gaps that have yet to be moved on — and turns that into a strong, well-argued point of view about what customers need next and how to deliver it. Say it plainly. Defend it in a room where people disagree, because you have done the work to earn the conviction, not just the opinion.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Discovery & Voice of the Customer

Run a standing cadence of customer conversations — a set number of discovery calls every week, not a burst before planning — with particular focus on our new ICP, where our assumptions are least tested.
Get in front of customers constantly — calls, QBRs, site visits, win/loss conversations — and treat that time as core product work, not a break from it.
Let that cadence drive three things, not one: what we build, how we engage customers in the product, and how we go to market.
Turn what you hear into a clear, prioritized point of view on what the product should do next, backed by data and specific customer stories, not generic feedback themes.
Build the ongoing habits — customer advisory input, structured feedback loops — that keep customer input flowing into product decisions year-round, not just at renewal time.

The Evaluation Pipeline & AI Quality

Own the evaluation pipeline and the go/no-go on changes to evals, the prompt system, and prompt chaining — everything that materially drives the quality of what we serve customers.
Define eval strategies, quality loops, and failure-mode design: what we measure, what constitutes a regression, and what has to pass before a change reaches a customer.
Decide when to trust the model and when to defer to a human, and make that boundary explicit in the product rather than implicit in the code.
Hold the line on quality when speed and rigor are in tension, and be able to explain the tradeoff to Engineering, to leadership, and to a customer.

Adoption & Retention

Move usage of our AI capabilities beyond chat and chat-built surveys, into the surfaces where customers do the rest of their work.
Own the retention curve for your area and get it where it needs to be — know which behaviors predict renewal and design deliberately toward them.
Define what success looks like for your area and hold the team to it — adoption and retention, as well as the harder-to-measure signal of whether customers are more excited about the product than they were two quarters ago.
Root the roadmap in customers' real jobs to be done, not just the feature requests sitting in the backlog, so the product solves the underlying problem instead of the surface ask.

The Product–Commercial Operating Rhythm

Build and run a formal cadence connecting the roadmap to renewals and open deals: what needs to be true by when, and what it is worth in dollars.
Sit at the connective point between Sales and Product: bring what Sales is hearing in the field into roadmap conversations, and translate the roadmap into language Sales can use with confidence in front of a customer.
Partner directly with Sales and Customer Success on renewal and expansion conversations where product credibility is the deciding factor.
Build the proof points, demos, and talk tracks that let Sales tell the product story as well as Product does.
Partner on pricing and packaging so the value the product creates is value Suzy actually captures — pricing is part of the product, not a number handed down after the fact.

Market & Landscape Sensing

Maintain a regular read on our competitive set — what they are shipping, how they are positioning, and where they are winning.
Look beyond it: study how other vertical-AI companies build their products and their businesses, and what is moving in software broadly.
Turn that read into a point of view the company can act on — where we should follow, where we should differentiate, and where the market is about to move without us.

Product Strategy & Execution

Own the roadmap and prioritization decisions for your area of the platform, balancing customer signal, business strategy, and technical feasibility.
Drive the business forward, not just the product — connect the features and metrics you own directly to what moves retention, expansion, and new business.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Marketing to ship work that customers actually notice.

Evangelism & Reputation

Act as one of Suzy's most visible champions for the product — able to explain what Suzy does, why it matters, and where it is headed, to a customer, a prospect, or a new hire, with the same conviction every time.
Find where Suzy is already delivering real value for customers and make sure that story gets told — to the market, to prospects, and back to the team doing the work.
Represent Suzy in customer-facing forums, webinars, and industry conversations that call for a credible, energetic product voice in the room.

Leadership Without the Org Chart

Set the standard for what strong customer instincts look like — in prioritization debates, in customer conversations, in how the team talks about the product — and hold the people around you to it.
Build enough trust across Product, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success that people seek out your opinion before a decision gets made, not after.
Show up as someone who raises the level of everyone around them, regardless of reporting lines.

Definition of Success

This role is accountable for helping Suzy meet its bookings targets, not only for delivering the roadmap.
Gross revenue retention shows measurable improvement — this individual can point to the specific actions that drove GRR.
The retention curve for AI capabilities improves, and usage extends meaningfully beyond chat and chat-built surveys.
A customer discovery cadence is running consistently, with a documented trail from what we heard to what we shipped.
Eval coverage and quality loops are in place for every AI surface we ship, and quality regressions are caught before customers find them.
A product–commercial cadence is operating, and the roadmap can be tied to specific renewals and deals with dollar values attached.
Customers should be able to point to specific product changes that resulted directly from their feedback.
Sales must have a partner in Product who makes deals easier to close and renewals easier to defend.
Suzy's reputation among its existing customers should be measurably stronger than it was one year earlier, reflected in more than usage metrics alone.
The roadmap should reflect a clear, defensible point of view rather than an unfiltered list of incoming requests.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Skills

6+ years in product management, with direct ownership of roadmap and prioritization decisions.
Experience shipping LLM-powered or AI-native product surfaces, with hands-on ownership of evals, prompt systems, or model quality — you have decided what "good enough to ship" means and defended it.
Fluency in quality measurement for probabilistic systems: designing eval sets, reasoning about failure modes, and knowing where a human belongs in the loop.
A demonstrated track record of building real relationships directly with customers — not just reading research summaries about them.
A track record of moving adoption and retention curves, not just shipping features.
Experience working closely with a Sales or Customer Success organization, ideally in B2B SaaS or another enterprise environment.
Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving product; Suzy is mid-transition, and this role will be as much about defining the work as executing it.
A sharp, clear communicator who is equally credible in front of an engineer, a CMO, and a customer.

Ready to help brands hear the real human voice behind the data? Apply now and be part of Suzy’s next chapter in AI-powered insights.

Benefits

We take care of our employees and their families. We have generous health dental and vision benefits, and our 401K plan vests immediately
A friendly, fun, and collaborative work environment that allows for frequent exposure to executives
The opportunity to make an immediate impact as a part of a fast-growing company
The target base compensation for this role is $220,000 - $250,000 / yr.

Suzy is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to ensure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Suzy is committed to protecting its customers, employees, partners, and the company as a whole, from damaging acts that are intentional or unintentional. Effective security is a team effort involving the participation and support of every user who interacts with company information/data and systems. It is the responsibility of each individual to help protect company information assets.

jobs.description:
Libra Solutions helps simplify and ease the burden of legal processes for plaintiffs, heirs, and the attorneys and doctors who serve them. By combining financial strength with technology-driven innovation, we simplify difficult legal processes, reduce delays, and help people access both money and the care they need, when they need it most. Our companies are leaders in their industries!
MoveDocs streamlines the coordination of medical, financial, and professional services for personal injury cases—improving efficiency for attorneys, care providers, and their clients. Oasis Financial is the largest and most recognized plaintiff funding brand in the nation, having helped 400,000+ plaintiffs access more than $2 billion in funding while their personal injury cases progress. And through Probate Advance, we enable heirs to access their inheritance without waiting through the lengthy probate process.

Together, under the Libra Solutions banner, we support a nationwide network of more than 45,000 attorneys and 10,000 healthcare providers - creating a powerful platform to deliver faster, more seamless outcomes for our customers.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own product strategy and execution for C3, Libra's internal case management and operations platform. C3 is the backbone of Libra's funding operations — supporting underwriting, negotiations, servicing, payment processing, document management, and workflow automation across multiple business lines.

This role has a dual mandate: (1) deliver measurable product and business outcomes for C3 by partnering with domain-aligned engineering teams to ship high-quality features at pace, and (2) help the product organization work smarter and ship faster using modern AI tools, rapid prototyping, and AI-assisted product development practices.

The ideal candidate brings strong product judgment, UX instincts, and technical fluency, with a blended background across product, engineering, and design/UX. They know how to identify the right problems, validate them quickly, prototype early, and partner cross-functionally to turn ideas into reliable, scalable solutions. They are comfortable operating in a high-throughput delivery environment where engineering capacity is growing and product's ability to keep domain-aligned squads well-fed with refined, validated work is a critical success factor.

This role will report to the VP, Product Management (C3) and can be worked remotely with occasional travel.

Key Responsibilities:

AI-Assisted Product Management

Use tools such as Claude and other AI platforms to accelerate discovery, synthesis, competitive analysis, requirements drafting, UAT plan generation, and day-to-day product work — maintaining refinement velocity as engineering capacity grows
Identify where AI, automation, or decision-support can improve C3 operational workflows and internal user outcomes
Partner with engineering on AI-assisted development practices that improve speed, clarity, and experimentation during build cycles
Define appropriate guardrails, fallback paths, and human oversight for AI-enabled experiences within C3

Strategy & Discovery

Lead discovery efforts, competitive analysis, and user interviews to ensure product teams are solving the right problem — not just delivering requested features
Partner with the VP, Product Management and cross-functional leaders to continuously develop, refine, and execute a clear product vision and strategy for C3 aligned to company goals, customer needs, and measurable outcomes
Identify high-value operational and business problems through research, data, workflow observation, stakeholder input, and structured engagement with operations subject matter experts
Validate opportunities with agility through rapid prototyping, MVPs, and customer feedback
Develop deep domain knowledge in C3's operational areas — including underwriting, negotiations, servicing, payment processing, and document management — to reduce dependency on SME availability and improve requirements quality over time

Delivery, Execution & Engineering Partnership

Partner with domain-aligned engineering teams to ensure squads have a continuous pipeline of well-refined, validated work — owning the "what and why" while collaborating with engineering on the "how."
Facilitate intake, prioritization, and sequencing of product initiatives, enhancements, epics, MVPs, and features based on impact, urgency, risk, and learning value
Shape product experiences through strong UX judgment, including workflow design, usability, information hierarchy, and friction reduction for C3's internal user base
Turn ambiguous business requests into clear product requirements, MVP definitions, and end-to-end experience decisions
Author product initiatives, epics, and features, and collaborate with engineering partners to identify and refine user stories and acceptance criteria
Coordinate structured SME engagement with operations teams — respecting their bandwidth constraints while ensuring requirements capture the business rules, process exceptions, and domain nuance that drive quality
Lead or participate in UAT planning and execution, either directly or by creating structured UAT plans and partnering with SMEs to complete validation

Measurement & Outcomes

Define success metrics for every significant initiative and evaluate performance using customer feedback, usage data, operational metrics, and failure analysis
Track whether shipped features deliver expected business outcomes. When results fall short, make explicit and documented iterate, stop, or pivot decisions — closing the accountability loop between delivery and realized value
Communicate roadmap decisions, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to stakeholders
Partner with operations, legal, compliance, and go-to-market teams to support rollout and adoption of C3 capabilities

Requirements

7+ years of Product Management experience in software, workflow, or operations-heavy environments, with at least 3 years in a senior PM or equivalent role
Demonstrated ability to keep multiple engineering squads fed with refined, validated work in a high-throughput delivery environment — maintaining backlog health and requirements quality as delivery velocity scales
Hands-on fluency using modern AI productivity tools such as Claude and similar platforms to accelerate research, synthesis, prototyping, requirements drafting, and day-to-day product work
Strong understanding of how AI can be integrated into products and workflows, including the practical strengths, limitations, risks, and design considerations of LLM-enabled experiences
Ability to define and evaluate success for AI-powered features using metrics, feedback loops, production observations, and failure analysis rather than surface-level novelty
Strong product judgment and the ability to move from discovery to delivery to measurable business outcomes, with demonstrated accountability for whether shipped features achieved their intended results
Strong UX instincts and ability to simplify complex operational workflows for internal users
Experience working with or alongside domain-aligned engineering teams, technical product owners, or embedded engineering leads in an agile delivery environment
Proven ability to develop domain expertise in complex operational environments and to engage subject matter experts in structured, time-efficient ways that respect their operational commitments
Experience in legal tech, healthcare, insurance, claims, fintech, or other regulated environments
Experience balancing innovation with compliance, privacy, and operational reliability
Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Excellent communication, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

Background spanning engineering, product, and design/UX, or deep experience working across all three
Experience with internal operations platforms, case management systems, or workflow-heavy B2B applications
Experience in personal injury, medical funding, legal funding, or adjacent verticals where business rules are complex and domain knowledge is a critical product input
Familiarity with workflow automation or decision engine platforms
Experience partnering with domain-aligned engineering squads or embedded technical product owner models

Benefits

We believe taking great care of our customers starts with taking great care of our people. That's why we offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including a choice of multiple medical plans, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k) with generous company match, flexible spending accounts for medical and dependent expenses, and time off to recharge.

jobs.description:
We live in a world where everything has become convenient. Now you can get a ride anywhere, buy anything, answer any question with just a couple clicks on your phone. Convenience isn’t a luxury, it’s an expectation.

So why not renting? It’s still a chore to get utilities set up, buy renters insurance, get air filters changed, handle pest control, and more.

That’s why we’ve built the world’s first Resident Experience Platform that makes resident onboarding, resident services, and ancillary revenue effortless for property managers.

We’re passionate about turning friction into triple win experiences for residents, property managers, and investors. That way renting can be easy and rewarding for everyone.

And now you can join us. Apply today to join 300+ passionate, creative people who strive to make a difference each day so residents, property managers, and investors all win – creating the ultimate Triple Win.

Role Snapshot

Second Nature is seeking a senior product executive to lead Product Management as a portfolio of businesses. This is the most senior product management role at the company, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer with regular, direct exposure to the CEO/Founder and executive team given the strategic weight of the portfolio.

This role leads a team of Group Product Managers, each accountable for a product line as a business. Working with that group as general managers of their product lines to drive business outcomes is central to the job.

Why This Role Exists

Benefits

Second Nature is converting strong bookings growth into long-term enterprise value by expanding the Resident Benefits Package category. This leader owns whether expansion happens, through a Product Management organization accountable for unit economics, revenue, and retention. The scoreboard:

Attach rates across the core portfolio, with the mechanisms understood well enough to repeat as product lines expand
The share of new revenue carried by newer product lines, broadening the portfolio beyond its current base
Retention and new logo acquisition, with clear attribution to the work that drove them
Unit economics across the portfolio, improved without trading away growth
A roadmap that is a rationalized allocation of investment against business outcomes, resourced to execute and delivered against

This is a business leadership role first, expressed through outstanding product management. The right person is as fluent discussing customer lifetime value, unit economics, and market opportunity as they are discussing a roadmap or a discovery plan.

They read a business review the way an operator does - what is working, what is not, and what needs to change - and translate that read into clear direction for the leaders and teams who report to them. This leader treats product excellence as something measured by customer experience as well as business outcomes and holds the same standard across the portfolio.

The First 100 Days

Discovery is funded as protected capacity, and prioritization is running on demand-side customer data
Investment is focused on what customer evidence supports, and the organization understands the reasoning
Group Product Managers are accountable for enrollment, revenue, and retention targets within their Product Domains
The attach rate growth mechanism is defined for the core lines and being tested

How This Leader Operates

Commercial Curiosity: Asks what moves revenue and what customers will pay for before asking what to build
Disciplined Prioritization: Allocates investment against a stated methodology, and can explain what was displaced, what it cost, and why, whenever priorities change
Talent Multiplier: Raises the bar on product talent and develops product managers into general managers of their lines
Bias to Action Under Ambiguity: Moves decisions forward with imperfect information, and is energized rather than destabilized by speed and ambiguity
Evidence Over Conviction: Changes direction when customer evidence contradicts the plan, including when the plan was theirs
Cross-Functional Authority: Aligns GTM, Finance, Operations, and Engineering behind portfolio priorities using business logic those functions recognize, and carries Product Management's point of view on company-level questions that extend beyond its control
Extreme Ownership: Owns the outcome, not the handoff - stays accountable when the result depends on work outside their control

Cross-Functional Partnerships

This role's success depends on four partnerships, each with a clear division of ownership:

Engineering: Peer partnership on capacity, feasibility, and delivery. Product sets business outcomes and priorities; Engineering owns technical execution
Finance and RevOps: Unit economics, line-level attribution, pricing, and portfolio margin
Go-To-Market: Positioning, distribution strategy, new logo acquisition, and attach-rate mechanisms
Customer Success and Operations: Retention drivers, post-sale experience, and the service constraints that shape adoption

Experience & Qualifications

Has run multiple product lines simultaneously as distinct businesses, each with its own revenue, margin, and growth accountability, and has done so through a period of rapid growth rather than in a steady-state portfolio
Has led a product organization of 20+ including a layer of product leaders, and has developed product managers into general managers rather than only hiring the capability in fully formed
Has personally carried revenue and margin accountability for a product line, not delivery accountability alone
Has operated inside a founder-led organization through a period of rapid growth and fast-changing direction
Has partnered directly with GTM and Finance leadership on pricing, packaging, and commercial strategy

We get it. Requirements can sometimes hold people back from applying to a job, but don’t let that be the case here. If you believe you have the skills it takes to elevate this role, team, and company, we encourage you to apply for this role.

Remote Work Statement

This is a remote-first, work-from-home position with required bi-annual in-person company meetings in January and July (business travel covered by Second Nature). You must be available during scheduled working hours, with a distraction-free work environment and reliable high-speed internet.

Why Second Nature?

🤩 Culture: Diverse, inclusive, supportive, and growth-focused

Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.
401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting
Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year
11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan
Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
$500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year
Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month
Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month
Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Product Manager to own the Platform product suite — the foundational capabilities, control plane, and developer tools that customers use to provision, manage, automate, and govern their infrastructure. This includes Vultr's REST APIs, Console, CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, Billing, Account Activity, Audit Logs, Regions, IAM, Sub Accounts, Admin, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets. Together these products form the platform layer that every Vultr customer interacts with and that every infrastructure product depends on to reach customers. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency in platform engineering, API design, and developer experience, combined with a strong product instinct for building tools that make infrastructure feel effortless. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require close partnership with Compute, Network, Storage, Security, and AI teams to ensure every new infrastructure launch is programmable, governed, and intuitive from day one. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of independent cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end Platform product suite roadmap — covering developer surfaces (REST APIs, Console, CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, ISOs) and account-level capabilities (Billing, Account Activity, Audit Logs, Regions, IAM, Sub Accounts, Admin, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets)
Define Vultr's platform and developer experience strategy aligned to infrastructure roadmap, reliability goals, and the needs of both digital-native builders and enterprise customers adopting the cloud
Drive the customer-facing platform surface across APIs, Console UI, CLI, SDKs — ensuring consistency, completeness, and a coherent experience across all touchpoints
Own the API as a product — define versioning strategy, deprecation policy, rate limiting, pagination, error handling, and authentication flows that make Vultr's API a first-class developer experience
Own the Console as a product — drive the web-based control plane experience, working with design and frontend engineering to make complex infrastructure operations intuitive and efficient
Own the Terraform provider, CLI, and SDKs — ensure our infrastructure-as-code and programmatic tooling stays current with API changes and represents best-in-class developer tooling practices
Own the account management and governance product surface — Billing, IAM, Sub Accounts, Audit Logs, and Admin tools that give customers control over access, spending, and compliance posture
Own the operational product surface — Regions, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets that customers use daily to manage and automate their infrastructure at scale
Work closely with engineering on technical tradeoffs across API design, authentication flows, rate limiting, caching strategies, SDK generation, CLI architecture, and Console frontend performance
Build products for two customer profiles — digital-native builders who want speed and simplicity, and enterprise adopters who need IAM, audit trails, sub-account governance, and programmatic control
Ensure new infrastructure and platform launches are API-first and Console-ready by design through strong partnership with compute, network, storage, security, and AI teams
Define and measure platform health metrics — API availability, latency, error rates, SDK adoption, Console task completion rates, CLI active usage, and developer satisfaction
Stay current on modern platform engineering trends, including API design patterns, SDK generation, developer portals, infrastructure-as-code, identity and access management, and the evolving state of cloud developer experience

Qualifications

7+ years of product management experience in cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, infrastructure-as-code, or API products
Deep understanding of platform engineering — you've designed, shipped, or maintained APIs, CLIs, SDKs, or developer tools at scale
Experience defining product strategy and roadmaps for platform or developer-facing products at scale
Experience with cloud account management and governance products — billing, IAM, audit logging, sub-accounts, or equivalent enterprise access control systems
Strong technical background — ability to engage with engineering on API design, authentication flows, rate limiting, SDK architecture, and frontend performance
Experience with infrastructure-as-code ecosystems — Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar
Track record of shipping developer-facing products with measurable impact on adoption, task completion time, or developer satisfaction
Experience with cloud provider platforms — you've worked on or extensively used AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean, Linode, or similar. You know what good and bad cloud UX feels like
Experience with API lifecycle management — versioning, deprecation, backward compatibility, and developer communication
Experience working across cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing, sales) in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Compensation

$180,000 - $200,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

jobs.description:
Capital Markets & Analytics - Senior Director, Product Management

Do you want to be part of a team transforming an entire department by discovering business needs, uncovering where value lies, and working with technology, design, subject-matter experts, and finance professionals to create optimal product and platform solutions? Do you want to help lead the creation and growth of an empowered new product management team? Does the idea of seeing your impact directly with internal customers excite you? If so, we want you!

Capital Markets & Analytics Product Management is a unique and high profile space, responsible for discovering, delivering and optimizing products and capabilities that fundamentally transform how our Capital Markets associates work and enable us to deliver valuable insights using modernized technologies and core data services. In addition to your contributions on overall portfolio and product strategies, you’ll also play a key role in building our Product Management organization. You’ll help shape our culture and our people, provide mentorship for your teammates and be an ambassador for Product Management and for the Finance Product & Data Solutions team.

Our product team is part of a larger group focused on the transformation of Finance at Capital One.

This is a unique Capital Markets opportunity to define and execute on a bold product vision from inception! The Product Manager will collaborate closely with customers including: Treasury, Trading, Balance Sheet Management, and Risk & Capital Analytics.

Our key priorities are revolutionizing the Capital Markets and Analytics platform through:

Product Innovation- Delivering innovative products and platforms, driving forward the vision for Capital Markets across balance sheet risk management, treasury, and trading functions.

Optimization- Re-envisioning and streamlining the overall finance experience inclusive of trading, risk management, collateral management and end of month close.

Data Streamlining- Revamping the data ecosystem to consume and leverage streamlined and enriched data end to end.

In the Product Management role, you will:

Establish the vision, strategy, and execution of Treasury, Trading, and bank balance sheet risk management products, data, and services through understanding of the strategic Finance direction and technology architecture and big picture business needs.
Create frameworks for and directly manage the prioritization of the work, capabilities, components, and infrastructures that are used by multiple customer solutions and customer facing products.
Confidently communicate and evangelize product and portfolio strategy across large organizations and executives to influence stakeholders to align behind the objectives
Create and provide frameworks for regularly and systematically using data to uncover opportunities, track product performance, and drive decision making
Prioritize, negotiate and remove blockers to orchestrate successful launch or optimization cycles
Inspire, enable and empower teams to execute with a sense of urgency to deliver solutions and on priorities

What we are looking for:

Proven experience in and passion for ideating, building and implementing great digital products
Experience with Treasury and Capital Markets products and data
Experience in organizational change management including transforming and improving ways of working and interaction models
Deep knowledge of the Product Management discipline and experience in building and maturing Product teams
Strong ability to set a vision and lead, develop and inspire teams to develop innovative products that have high adoption and drive value for internal customers
Exceptional communication skills -- an engaging storyteller at ease presenting to executives
Creative problem solver who provides leadership at the intersection of the human, business and technology dimensions.
Blend of both strategic and tactical thinking -- someone who can identify and prioritize opportunities in highly ambiguous contexts, and then organize work in deep detail; aligning long term vision with iterative execution
Aptitude to champion strategic technology initiatives to leap-frog current constraints and deliver transformational value
Strong quantitative background to support data-informed decision making
Collaborative, team player attitude with the ability to navigate and influence the organization
Superior problem-solving skills with strong strategic, white-spacing thinking
Inspiring people leader

jobs.title: Director, Business Operations — Product & Go-To-Market
jobs.description:
Overview

As Brooklinen continues to grow, how we bring new products from concept to market is more important than ever. We’re hiring a Director, Business Operations — Product & Go-To-Market to strengthen the connection between product development and go-to-market execution—bringing greater clarity, accountability, and momentum across teams.

In this role, you’ll connect the people, processes, and priorities behind our product lifecycle, helping teams stay aligned, navigate complexity, and move work forward from early development through launch.

Reporting to our SVP of Operations, you’ll partner closely with Brooklinen’s executive team and functional leaders to evolve how we operate today and build a more connected, scalable model for the future.

What You’ll Own

Product Development & Launch Orchestration

Drive the cross-functional operating cadence that supports the product development process from concept through launch
Partner closely with Product Development, Merchandising, Production, Creative, Digital, and Marketing teams to align milestones, dependencies, and timelines
Ensure key handoffs across teams are clear, well coordinated, and executed with accountability
Identify areas where the process can move faster or operate more smoothly and lead improvements

Go-to-Market Process Leadership

Strengthen the cross-functional go-to-market process across product, brand, digital, and channel teams
Ensure launches are coordinated across stakeholders with clear ownership and timelines
Partner with marketing, site, and merchandising teams to ensure product launches land smoothly across channels
Act as a central coordinator for launch readiness, keeping teams aligned while maintaining momentum

Cross-Functional Execution & Influence

Lead high-priority initiatives that require coordination across multiple functions and senior stakeholders
Build credibility quickly through strong judgment, subject matter expertise, and a collaborative approach
Navigate competing priorities with objectivity, helping teams make practical tradeoffs in the service of the business
Maintain momentum by identifying risks early and resolving blockers quickly

Operational Excellence & Scale

Strengthen how teams work together across product development and launch by bringing clarity to timelines, handoffs, and decision points
Introduce practical ways of working that improve cross-functional coordination without unnecessary complexity
Translate lessons from launches and initiatives into better ways of operating going forward
Help lay the foundation for a scalable business operations capability over time

What Success Looks Like

Product development and launch timelines feel clear, coordinated, and easier for teams to execute against
Cross-functional partners trust this role’s judgment and view the individual as a valued thought partner
Teams collaborate more smoothly across product, marketing, digital, and operations
Product launches come to market with stronger alignment and fewer last-minute surprises
The organization gains a more consistent and scalable way of bringing products to life

What You Bring

10+ years of experience in business operations, product operations, or cross-functional leadership within consumer brands
Deep expertise in soft goods product development.
You are fluent in how products move from concept through sampling, development, approvals, production, and launch
Experience building or improving cross-functional go-to-market processes
Exceptional relationship-building and influence skills with the ability to establish trust quickly across teams and senior stakeholders
Strong situational leadership and negotiation skills when navigating competing priorities
A builder’s mindset with the ability to introduce structure where needed, while remaining pragmatic and flexible
High standards, strong follow-through, and a bias toward action
Experience working within brands known for strong product development and go-to-market operating models in soft goods, apparel, or consumer goods environments is a plus

Compensation

Base salary range: $165,000–$190,000, plus equity and a 15% target bonus.

Compensation is determined based on experience, skills, and market data.

Benefits & Perks

Up to 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage (employee-only)
Fertility & family-building support (up to $20,000 lifetime)
401(k) with a 4% company match
16 weeks fully paid parental leave
20 vacation days (25 after 5 years) plus year-round Summer Fridays
Hybrid work schedule with two core in-office days (Tues–Thurs)
Remote Thanksgiving week and remote last week of December
Up to four additional remote weeks per year with approval
40% employee discount plus seasonal product allowance
One Medical, Talkspace, and $1,000 per year via Joon for wellness
One-month paid sabbatical at five years

Why Join Us?

Brooklinen is a place where thoughtful people do meaningful work — with warmth, clarity, and shared purpose. We value care, collaboration, balance, and continuous growth. If this role excites you, even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Diverse experiences and perspectives make us stronger.

About Brooklinen

Brooklinen was founded in 2014 with a simple belief: that comfort can bring happiness. Today, we’re one of the largest soft goods brands in the U.S., designing for real life and real homes with products that pair elevated quality and accessible pricing. Our assortment — from sheets and towels to thoughtful additions for the modern bedroom — has earned over 100,000 five-star reviews and recognition from Architectural Digest, Good Housekeeping, Wirecutter, and more. We’re growing thoughtfully, evolving intentionally, and committed to creating a home for people who care deeply about their craft — and each other.
