jobs.title: Data Science Director (IC)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Data Science Director IC who is passionate about developing, measuring, and strategizing investments in the Monetization Ranking AI space. Our Monetization AI system utilizes state-of-the-art Machine Learning/AI to ensure every ad impression is meaningful. It is central to the entire ads experience we offer to users and advertisers and generates the vast majority of Meta’s revenue. The mission of this role is to drive data-informed decisions and shape the long-term strategic direction and operational model of the Monetization AI Ranking space in an IC capacity.The Data Science Director will collaborate with Engineering and Product executives across Meta Ads and the Family of Apps Monetization teams. The candidate will have extensive experience in large-scale AI development, measurement, and data product management, and will be enthusiastic about cutting-edge AI advancements. They should have a proven ability to influence executives through their data, framing, technical, and communication skills.

Data Science Director (IC) Responsibilities:

Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and cross-functional teams to inform, influence, support, and execute strategy and investment decisions for the Ads AI space
Contribute to the long-term technical vision and strategy for analytics methods and metrics to enhance the quality and efficiency of Ads AI at scale
Work with engineering and other data scientists to build and improve AI development, automation, experimentation, and measurement methods and metrics, ensuring high-quality throughput and impact
Develop an understanding of complex, large-scale AI development, experimentation, and measurement systems, as well as broader industry challenges, to identify current and future risks and opportunities
Inspire and lead a team of data scientists and managers across multiple teams in close collaboration with other Data Science Directors and Managers

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of experience in analytics and data science, leading analytics work in IC capacity, working collaboratively with Engineering and cross-functional partners, and guiding data-influenced product planning, prioritization and strategy development
Experience working effectively with multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams, including Engineering, PM/TPM, Analytics and Finance
Experience framing and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience with predictive modeling, machine learning, and experimentation/causal inference methods
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We are a leaned-in platform where users come with active intent, not a place to watch funny dance videos or doom scroll through news. As such, we are positioned to succeed in Shopping in a differentiated way. As a platform, we are uniquely positioned at the intersection of search, social and commerce. The full-funnel experience across homefeed, search, and related pins - combined with the ability to save, collaborate and curate - enables users to have dynamic, multi-session journeys and go seamlessly from inspiration to action. These journeys are rarely linear and Pinterest enables statefulness better than any other platform - allowing users to stop and start, refine down, broaden out and come back to where they left off - seamlessly navigating between discover, decide and do.

What You’ll Do

Develop and execute a cohesive Search Personalization strategy and roadmap in close partnership with, Product, Engineering, Design and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Incorporate innovative new Search Personalization features into our models that tap into the unique user intent on Pinterest. You’ll create products that help users find inspiration, browse products and ultimately find the item they want to buy.
Investigate and hypothesize opportunities to improve the relevance of search results on Pinterest.
Partner closely with a wide range of disciplines including engineering, data science, design, research, marketing, legal, strategy, and other product managers to define, measure, and drive execution.

Strong product sense: Strong product sense and ability to collaborate and get buy-in from stakeholders while setting a longer term vision.
Experience building AI/ML products: Demonstrated success in product management or related experience at fast-growing companies particularly working on AI/ML based products.
Bring structure to ambiguity: Proven ability to lead in ambiguous environments, aligning across functions, teams, and orgs to deliver on time in a highly collaborative environment.
Expert at weaving together data, user feedback, and intuition: Strong analytical skills to define product strategy and drive decision making, making appropriate trade-offs based on data analysis and qualitative feedback from Pinners.
Previous experience in search is a plus but not required.
Technical strength: You’ll partner closely with Engineering teams working with a wide variety of technologies, including Machine Learning.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as computer science or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: AI Advisory Principal
jobs.description:
Scale AI's Advisory practice is the most forward-leaning bet in our go-to-market motion. We're not waiting for clients to hand us a scope — we get in front of the decision, shape the right AI problems before a build begins, and make Scale the obvious partner for what comes next.

Advisory is the structured answer to the question enterprises are already asking us: "What should we build, and where do we start?" It's a discovery and scoping phase that runs before delivery — designed to land bigger contracts, drive more predictable execution, and accelerate expansion. By 2027, it will be Scale's default first engagement with new enterprise clients.

As an AI Advisory Principal, you lead Scale's Advisory work in your vertical, end-to-end. In pre-sales, you shape and qualify opportunities alongside Account Executives and sell the Advisory phase to clients. In delivery, you're the Directly Responsible Individual on engagements — owning the client relationship, running the discovery and scoping work, and accountable for the outcome. Underpinning both, you build out the vertical point of view — the industry and AI expertise that makes Advisory credible — and, as one of the function's first hires, help build the Advisory motion itself. This is a hands-on role: you do the advisory work, not just manage it.

What You'll Own

You own the engagement and the vertical — from the first pre-sales conversation through the final readout.

Lead engagements end-to-end. You're the Directly Responsible Individual on engagements — owning the client relationship, running workshops, leading the final readout, driving the direction, and accountable for the outcome (use-case selection, SOW quality, delivery). You coordinate and direct the Solutions Engineers, Designers, Tech Leads, and DSGs on the engagement without managing them directly.
Sell Advisory in your vertical. You build the approach, lead the Advisory portion of key pre-sales meetings, bring industry roadmap examples from buyer peers, and qualify opportunities with Account Executives — and you represent Scale and Advisory at industry events.
Build the vertical point of view. You develop your vertical's point of view — the AI-shaped problems, best practices, technology and learnings, and buyer-peer and competitor intelligence that make Advisory credible in the field.
Grow the playbook from the field. You surface what's working and what isn't across your engagements, document the patterns and reusable approaches, and work with DSGs to update the Advisory approach based on build feedback.
Manage your Consultant. You manage the Consultant on your engagements and overall — coaching them, giving feedback, and owning their professional development — and you provide input on Consultant hiring.

Qualifications

Ideally, you’d have

Senior manager or principal equivalent experience at a Tier 1 firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG ideally); 7+ years of work experience. AI strategy or transformation experience strongly preferred.
Scoping, proposal, and pitching experience — comfortable shaping and selling an engagement, not just delivering it.
The judgment to advise clients directly on where AI creates value — identifying and shaping the right, AI-shaped use cases for their business.
The technical credibility to speak to AI builds credibility and to work closely with Solutions Engineers on feasibility.
A classic consulting toolkit e.g. strategy, operating-model, governance, change management, and exec-ready storytelling to assist clients in developing an AI strategy
Experience designing and facilitating client workshops.
A natural relationship-builder who establishes trusted-advisor credibility early, paired with the judgment to own outcomes independently.
Strategic but hands-on: able to think at the level of a client's AI agenda and still get into the day-to-day work of an engagement.
Willingness to travel 30-60 percent, which can include international trips depending on the account.

Nice to Have

Deep expertise in at least one enterprise vertical (Consumer, Financial & Professional Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences) — the industry depth to be credible with senior stakeholders.
0-to1 experience developing or deploying GenAI applications in an enterprise setting.

Job Title

Vice President of Product Design

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 17+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Enablement to join our Product Practice team. This role is located in New York, NY.

The Product Practice ensures BNY has world-class capabilities powering industry-leading products enabling us to deliver solutions at scale for our clients. The Product Practice sets standards and serves as enabler across the product lifecycle.

Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Technology, Data, and business stakeholders.

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Sr. Director, Product Management, UHNW Platform to lead the strategy and evolution of the platform supporting Mercer Advisor’s Regis Group—our integrated offering designed to serve ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients with complex, family office–level needs.

This role has end-to-end responsibility for the product strategy, client and advisor experience, and technology roadmap for the Regis platform. You will define how the platform—spanning people, process, and technology—should evolve to support a highly differentiated client segment, translating complex business needs into clear product direction, well-architected workflows, and actionable requirements.

Operating at the intersection of business, operations, and technology, you will own what we build and why, working in close partnership with external partners and the technology team, responsible for how solutions are built, and with the advisory teams who use those solutions and are responsible for delivering successful client outcomes. While highly strategic in scope, this role is also hands-on, requiring direct engagement in discovery, workflow design, and product definition.

A critical aspect of this role is developing a deep understanding of how advisors, investment professionals, tax specialists, estate planning strategists, and operational teams work in practice. You will engage directly with stakeholders across the organization—observing workflows, identifying friction points, and synthesizing often inconsistent inputs into clear problem definitions and scalable platform solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in complexity, brings structure to ambiguity, and balances strategic vision with disciplined execution and follow-through to measurable business results.

Essential Job Functions For This Role Include

Product strategy, discovery, and client experience ownership

Define and own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for the Regis platform to balance near-term priorities with long-term transformational goals
Translate business strategy, client needs, and advisor feedback into a cohesive, prioritized product direction
Develop a deep, first-hand understanding of workflows across advisors, clients, and operational teams through direct engagement
Synthesize diverse and sometimes conflicting inputs into clear problem statements and high-impact opportunities
Identify root causes of friction and design scalable, integrated workflows that improve client and advisor experience
Bring structure to an evolving environment, shifting from reactive development to intentional product design

Product definition and solution design

Translate Regis Ultra High Net Worth and Family Office business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and process flows
Lead product discovery and solution design to ensure the right problems are being solved
Partner with engineering and architecture teams to design solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned to long-term platform goals
Ensure consistency and integration across a multi-system platform ecosystem
Own Regis platform adoption to drive utilization of new process flows, measure advisor and client engagement with platform capabilities, and provide hands-on enablement support to ensure use as designed

Roadmap management and delivery execution

Define and manage a prioritized product roadmap, balancing business impact, user needs, technical constraints, and dependencies
Align roadmap decisions with strategic objectives while operating within budget and resource constraints
Partner with internal technology team and external partners to translate priorities into execution plans
Remain actively engaged through delivery to ensure outcomes align with product intent and business objectives

Cross-functional leadership and platform stewardship

Serve as the central point of alignment across Product, Technology, Operations, Investments, Compliance, and external partners
Facilitate decision-making across competing priorities, trade-offs, and sequencing considerations
Influence stakeholders at all levels without direct authority and lead cross-functional initiatives
Oversee the evolution of a multi-system platform ecosystem, ensuring it remains integrated, scalable, and aligned to long-term needs

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

10+ years of experience in product management, platform strategy, or related roles
Experience with UHNW or family office environments
Proven experience leading complex, multi-system platform initiatives in cross-functional environments
Demonstrated ability to operate across both strategic planning and hands-on execution
Strong experience in product discovery, workflow design, and requirements definition
Track record of translating complex business needs into well-designed product solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with comfort operating in ambiguous environments

Experience with CRM systems, portfolio management tools, and client reporting platforms

What Success Looks Like

A clearly defined and aligned product roadmap supporting the growth of the Regis platform
Measurable improvements in client and advisor experience and adoption of both new and existing capabilities
A cohesive, scalable platform that reduces friction and improves operational efficiency

Champion tooling and platform decisions, such as Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, AEP, and CJA, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and operational excellence

7+ years of experience in product analytics, experimentation, product management, or related fields
Proven success leading teams, managers, and high-performing organizations
Expertise in digital analytics, experimentation, and data-driven product decision-making, including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, AEP, and Customer Journey Analytics
Experience building and scaling processes, standards, and operating models across multiple teams
Exceptional ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and influence executive stakeholders
Strategic and people-focused leader with strong technical acumen, a balance of long-term vision and execution, and a passion for developing talent and high-performing teams

Familiarity with Agile, Lean, and product development best practices at scale

Certifications in Agile, Product Management, Experimentation, or Analytics 

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships
jobs.description:
Job Description

About Semarchy

Semarchy was founded in 2011 in Lyon, France, by a team of passionate data experts with a clear mission: modernizing master data management. Over the years, we’ve expanded our capabilities into Data Management, Integration, and Intelligence, building a unified design experience that accelerates revenue growth, modernizes workflows, and boosts enterprise AI initiatives.

Headquartered in Arizona, USA, with global offices across France, the UK, and India, Semarchy serves over 400 clients worldwide, including Fortune 500 leaders. Trusted by industry innovators, our adaptive, modular approach helps organizations achieve data-driven success in as fast as 12 weeks.

About The Role

Semarchy’s Snowflake Native App achieved proven product-market fit in Year One of the partnership, with multiple enterprise wins already on the books. Rapid growth in pipeline, awareness, and interest — combined with the joint Semarchy/Snowflake roadmap — is creating a major scaling opportunity for 2026 and beyond.

The Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships is a unique hybrid leadership role that sits at the intersection of product and partnerships. You will own two tightly connected missions: driving deep technical and product alignment with our strategic technology partners — initially with Snowflake and Microsoft — and driving product management for Semarchy’s Snowflake-native solutions so that our roadmap and our partners’ platforms advance together as one strategy.

This role is strictly focused on technical alignment with partners — product roadmaps, platform capabilities, integrations, and joint solution architecture — not on commercial or sales plays, which are owned by our alliance and sales teams. That said, you must bring strong commercial savvy: an understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales so that technical alignment translates into market impact.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Product Management (based in France) for your product management responsibilities. Snowflake is our most mature partnership and the immediate priority, with Microsoft — where our technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — as the second strategic focus. Beyond these, this role owns Semarchy’s broader technology partnership strategy and will explore potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role to start, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the partnership portfolio scales. It is built for someone with high agency: a builder who creates structure, drives follow-through, and earns the trust of partner product and engineering organizations.

Location:
USA, remote, in the Central or Eastern time zone. You will collaborate daily with our product and engineering teams in France and coordinate regularly with technology partners primarily based in the western USA, so working hours that bridge both are essential.

Job Requirements

Must Have

10+ years in enterprise software, including 5+ years in technical partnerships, partner engineering, solutions leadership, or product management roles within cloud ecosystems.
Proven success driving technical and product alignment with one or more of: Snowflake, Microsoft/Azure, or other major cloud data platforms.
Hands-on product management experience: gathering requirements, writing specifications, managing a backlog, and partnering with engineering to ship.
Deep working knowledge of the modern data stack (cloud data platforms, data management, integration, or analytics).
Commercial savvy: a strong understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales teams.
Comfortable operating across technology, product, and executive relationships, including with senior partner product and engineering leaders.
Strong program management skills and high agency — driven to get things done; elite communication and soft skills, including the ability to translate technical depth for commercial audiences.
Based in the US Central or Eastern time zone, with the flexibility to overlap with teams in France (mornings) and partners on the US West Coast (afternoons); willingness to travel (~25%) for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry events.

Nice to Have

Direct experience with Snowflake Native Apps, Snowpark, or building solutions on the Snowflake Marketplace.
Experience with the Microsoft Partner ecosystem and marketplaces.
Domain expertise in master data management (MDM), data integration, data products, semantic intelligence.
Experience working in a globally distributed organization across US and European time zones; French language skills are a plus.
Experience building and leading partner engineering or product teams.

Job Responsibilities

Technology Partnership Strategy & Technical Alignment (initially with Snowflake and Microsoft)

Define and own Semarchy’s technology partnership strategy, exploring and prioritizing potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.
Own the technical relationship with our strategic technology partners: lead roadmap discussions, technical alignment, and advanced configuration conversations with partner product and engineering counterparts.
Ensure Semarchy capitalizes early on new Snowflake platform capabilities, and that our Native App strategy stays ahead of the Snowflake roadmap.
Deepen technical alignment with Microsoft — where Semarchy’s technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — including integration architecture, platform certifications, and marketplace technical requirements.
Build relationships with partner engineering, partner technical, and ISV teams to establish Semarchy’s technical credibility on each platform.
Establish and maintain joint technical escalation paths with Support and Professional Services for pre/post-sales support and joint problem resolution.
Serve as the technical voice of the partnerships in reviews with Semarchy leadership.
Establish the repeatable playbook — technical evaluation, product integration, roadmap alignment — that future technology partnerships will follow.
As the portfolio scales, help define the team needed to support it, with the opportunity to hire and lead.

Product Management

Drive product management for Semarchy’s partner-aligned solutions — expanding our Snowflake-aligned capabilities and our alignment with Microsoft Fabric — working day-to-day with the Head of Product Management and engineering teams in France.
Gather and synthesize requirements from customers, partners, partner field teams, analysts, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized roadmap for the Snowflake Native App and related capabilities.
Produce specifications, refine and organize the product backlog, and partner with engineering to deliver high-value features and product iterations.
Champion the solutions internally and externally — with customers, partners, analysts, and field teams — and feed their input back into product strategy and positioning.

Cross-Functional & GTM Collaboration

Work closely with product marketing and marketing to ensure positioning, launch content, and partner-facing assets accurately reflect joint technical capabilities.
Support sales and alliance teams as the technical authority on partner platforms — helping them understand what is possible, what is roadmapped, and how joint solutions are architected.
Partner with enablement teams to develop technically accurate training, demos, and assets for internal teams and partner field organizations.
Ensure Snowflake, Microsoft, and Semarchy owners are connected across Product Management, Support, and Professional Services, and keep Product, GTM, and Operations working against one shared partner plan.

What Success Looks Like

Snowflake and Microsoft product and engineering teams know exactly who owns the technical relationship with Semarchy.
The Snowflake solutions roadmap is visibly shaped by partner and customer input, and product releases land in sync with partner platform milestones and joint GTM motions.
Sales, marketing, and alliance teams have a trusted technical authority on partner platforms — joint solutions are well-architected and well-understood.
Product, GTM, and Operations work against one shared partner plan.

Job Benefits

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy.

For those applicants in the CA, CO and NYC area, the salary range for this role is $225K to $250K base plus variable incentive. The salary offered will be based on experience, role, and location.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to building an inclusive work environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and respect. If there is anything we can do to ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Our division recruits, develops and rewards the people of Goldman Sachs. Our dynamic HCM Strategy team is seeking an experienced Vice President to drive global, large-scale transformational initiatives. You will be instrumental in leveraging cutting-edge applications and AI to enhance employee experience, deliver quantifiable automation benefits, and build resilient HCM solutions across our firm.

As a Vice President, you will lead strategy, design and delivery of enterprise-wide HCM platforms and solutions critical projects from initiation to completion. You will apply exceptional organizational skills, strategic foresight, and impeccable implementation abilities. A strong focus on integrating systems across the full employee lifecycle – from recruitment to retirement – will be essential. You will collaborate with HCM, technology, and business leaders to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and implement scalable solutions aligned with organizational goals.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, evidenced by a proven track record of successful product management delivery.

Articulate and lead the HCM product vision and strategic roadmap, aligning with HCM and business objectives.
Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise-wide HCM systems and tools, from conception to successful implementation.
Lead and empower cross-functional teams to deliver complex HCM solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and successful outcomes.

Champion a data-driven approach by overseeing user research, stakeholder interviews, and continuous product feedback loops to inform decisions.

Strategically manage vendor relationships, encompassing platform evaluation, selection, contract negotiation, and ongoing performance oversight.
Manage vendor relationships including platform selection, contract negotiation, and performance oversight.

Minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, leading the strategy, development, and launch of complex, large-scale database and data-intensive products, preferably within the financial services industry or a similarly regulated, fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated expertise in the full product lifecycle management of data architecture projects from conceptual design and strategic planning to successful launch and sustained adoption.
Strong foundational knowledge of data architecture concepts, including data structures, relational and non-relational data stores, data modeling, data warehousing architectures, ETL/ELT pipelines, and business objects/semantic layers.

Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Business Objects, Tableau, Power BI) and an understanding of how data products serve downstream analytics and business intelligence consumers.
Proven ability to strategically prioritize, define, and manage a diverse data product roadmap, consistently delivering high-value features and solutions that meet market needs and exceed stakeholder expectations.
Exceptional organizational acumen and advanced time management capabilities, adept at navigating complex data platform interdependencies and driving efficient execution across global, cross-functional teams.
Proficiency with enterprise-grade product management platforms (e.g., Jira), analytics tools, and collaboration software.
Superior executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex data architecture concepts into business value, influence diverse stakeholders, and present effectively to senior leadership.
Highly analytical with advanced strategic problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, capable of identifying root causes, anticipating challenges, and developing innovative, data driven solutions.
Proven ability to thrive both independently and as a collaborative leader within a matrixed organizational structure, fostering teamwork and accountability.
Agile Product Owner/Scrum Master, or other relevant product management certifications are highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise HCM systems including Oracle HCM Cloud.
Hands-on or working knowledge of Snowflake architecture, including data lakes, data mesh concepts, and cloud-native data platform design.
Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks, security tools and practices.
Understanding of data security, privacy regulations, and compliance requirements relevant to financial services.
Exposure to data cataloging and lineage tools and techniques

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Own the cross-module surface area with clear accountability across the funnel

jobs.description:
Overview

The Director of Pediatric Product Delivery of Accreditation and Certification Operations (ACO) is a vital member of the leadership team in ACO and reports either to the National Leader or to the Executive Director of Acute Programs. This role provides leadership and strategic oversight specific to pediatric hospitals, children’s health systems, and pediatric-focused accreditation and certification programs. This role works collaboratively with all divisions of Joint Commission to provide leadership and vision in support of the business.

The Director of Pediatric Product Delivery is responsible for engaging staff, managing and developing relationships, supporting retention and mission expansion within pediatric hospitals and children’s health systems, managing staff within a pediatric pod structure, and contributing to the organization’s safety culture.

Responsibilities

Drive mission expansion and retention strategies within the pod, with focused attention on children’s hospitals, pediatric specialty programs, and pediatric service lines. Oversee all pediatric hospital and children’s health system account types within the pod structure, including freestanding children’s hospitals and pediatric programs within integrated health systems.
Contribute to the development and execution of annual business plans.
Oversee the comprehensive strategy to build organizational engagement and partnership to improve pediatric program retention rates.
Oversee the development and implementation of pediatric-focused strategic account plans that address the unique operational, regulatory, and safety needs of children’s hospitals. Support pod members in the implementation of strategies to drive growth, enhance customer satisfaction, and build long-term partnerships.
Direct a team/pod of Account Executives and Organization Engagement staff supporting children’s hospitals and pediatric programs. Oversee recruitment, orientation, and development of team; contribute to the development of resource documents, policies and procedures to guide pod activities; evaluate staff performance; and allocate workloads within the pod to ensure timely completion of tasks and program goals.
Support on-call activity including availability to surveyor cadre, field directors, staff, and executive leadership. Extra support is needed during significant survey impacts due to natural disasters.
Implement operational activities through all phases of the accreditation and certification cycle by planning, organizing, and monitoring:
Program performance (gains, losses, program growth, program margins, market share)
Survey volume budget and variances
Review and approve pricing adjustments
Processes withdrawals
Review reports to strategically analyze account distribution
Responsible for the uniform and consistent application of corporate accreditation/certification policies as they relate to pediatric hospitals, children’s health systems, and pediatric specialty programs
Facilitates immediate resolution of issues/problems from officers that affect operations
Records Maintenance updates to accounts (denials, reinstatements, UA orgs, history fixes)
Biannual manual reviews by supported program(s)

Participates in the development and testing of pediatric-specific accreditation and certification initiatives. Including product development, education programs, publications in Perspectives and E-dition, standards and survey process development through collaboration with Field Directors and Executive Leadership, and any other resource that support the accreditation and certification programs.
Lead/participate on multiple performance improvement and other teams or committees and advisory groups of the corporation as requested by the leadership team. Facilitate operational changes.
Applies accreditation policy consistently to ensure the integrity of the accreditation process and supports the pod in explanation of policy to customers.
Use reports and data to foster timeliness of accreditation activity and support program performance.
Actively contributes to the successful achievement of pod performance objectives through effective division (SSM, SIG, OQPS) and enterprise team involvement and proactive communication and collaboration as necessary.
Collaborate with Marketing to develop program specific value proposition content, AO battlecards, and other resources to support pod members in mission expansion opportunities.
Senior Leadership Support:
Support Leadership in performing delegated project work
Serve as back up for director meetings and fulfill Director duties when Director is out of the office
Identify critical factors that will affect the outcome of a decision, evaluate options and navigate risk when operational issues arise

Develop pod goals, program goals, performance expectations, and key performance indicators (KPI).
Leading expert on pediatric and children’s hospital supported programs for pod and division; responsible for the direct implementation of all mission expansion, retention, and operational activities and decisions within ACO.
Participate in Advisory Council meetings on-site and off-site as needed. Deliver presentations throughout the year to inform staff, customers, and other divisions about operational changes.
Support program delivery and program enhancements to meet the needs of customers and overall business.

Qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree is required; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Five to seven years of experience within the health care industry in a pediatric-focused role is preferred.
Previous supervisory experience is necessary, including expertise with Joint Commission accreditation processes.
Comprehensive knowledge of financial analysis and proficiency with database management software applications are required.
Willingness to travel as needed, up to 15%.
Must possess a thorough understanding of supported pod and division programs and participate actively in all ACO operational decisions.
Proven ability to drive strategic growth and long-term partnerships with organizations.
Must excel in relationship building and have a customer centric mindset.
Salesforce CRM pipeline management and daily administration to track interactions is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Marketing Agent
jobs.description:
About Us:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support thousands of
restaurants across North America
, helping process $1B+ in gross food sales
while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees
. Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash. 

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni
. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position:

Most independent restaurants have no marketer, no agency, and no time. They have a diner list they've never used and a channel mix they've never optimized. Your job is to close that gap by doing their marketing for them and not by handing them one more thing to manage.

As Senior PM for the Marketing Agent domain, you'll own strategy and execution for how ChowNow markets on behalf of tens of thousands of restaurants. You'll take a product that today asks an owner to configure campaigns and evolve it into one that proposes them, runs them, and proves what they earned. 

This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Product and will own the domain outright; No direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note:
ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

You put restaurants first.
You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

You celebrate diversity.
You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are.  You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

You raise your hand.
You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

You keep reaching.
You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

What You'll Own:

Campaign creation and automation
across email and SMS

The diner database and consent model.
Restaurants own their diner relationships on ChowNow, and you own what makes them usable

The agentic layer
that turns a restaurant's data into marketing action without adding work to their day

Marketing measurement.
You'll set the company standard for incrementality and hold the org to it

Activation.
A campaign tool nobody turns on is a tool that doesn't exist, so adoption is your problem, not a GTM handoff

You Should Apply If:

You have 5+ years of product management experience, including products you owned from problem definition through launch

You have hands-on experience with lifecycle or campaign products. Email, SMS, CRM, automation, or segmentation, in something you shipped and then operated

You have hands-on experience building with AI or agents. Shipped work rather than experiments

You have working fluency in SQL and product analytics. You pull and interpret your own data

You have experience owning metrics where attribution was contested, and defending a measurement approach to stakeholders 

About Our Benefits:

Expected Base Salary:
$158,000 - $200,000 (depending on candidate location and experience)

Ongoing training and growth opportunities

A "Best Place to Work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience

Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans

Mental Health Coverage - we offer several programs to support your mental health and wellness goals

Unlimited Paid Vacation. We expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life

7 weeks of baby bonding time for all new parents (within the first year of birth or adoption), 8 Weeks of Paid Pregnancy Leave

401(k) Matching

Employer-contributing student loan assistance program or continuing education reimbursement program

Employee Stock Incentive Plan

Pet insurance for your fur babies

Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly

Enough freedom to spread your wings while still holding you accountable

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform - Knowledge & Retrieval
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe's data platform is a vertical data intelligence stack: raw signals are governed and routed at ingestion, enriched and catalogued into curated enterprise definitions, and ultimately transformed into retrieval-ready, agent-optimized knowledge assets. The knowledge tier sits at the top of that stack. Curated definitions become trustworthy, retrieval-ready knowledge. AI agents, self-service analytics, and enterprise decision systems consume this knowledge every day.

As Senior Product Manager for this layer, you own its execution throughout the entire process. This includes how knowledge assets are modeled, published, maintained, and delivered to consuming agents via retrieval and integration interfaces. You'll turn a multi-quarter roadmap into shipped capabilities, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and peer platform PMs. This is a builder's role at the sharp end of Adobe's agent-ready data strategy.

What You'll Own

Own the product roadmap — develop and drive a 6–12 month roadmap for knowledge-asset modeling, retrieval APIs, agent-integration interfaces, and embedding/RAG pipelines, prioritizing and re-prioritizing against shifting platform needs.
Lead delivery from inception to launch — provide project leadership and day-to-day management spanning engineering and build, making thoughtful quality / customer-value / time-to-market tradeoffs and mitigating risk.
Own knowledge freshness and lifecycle — define how curated definitions are ingested, versioned, deprecated, and kept current, so consuming agents never retrieve stale or orphaned knowledge.
Deliver the trust signals for the knowledge layer—freshness, lineage, and quality—so knowledge assets can be safely consumed by agents, while contributing these signals to the platform-wide agent readiness score.
Build human-in-the-loop correction workflows at the knowledge layer — define what triggers human review of a knowledge asset, and how corrections propagate to downstream consumers.
Write clear engineering PRDs — translate platform requirements into prioritized features, crisp specifications, and concrete performance measures and safety thresholds.
Partner across the platform team — align with peer PMs owning metadata, event telemetry, and cross-cutting governance so retrieval and embedding surfaces are built on governed, trustworthy foundations.
Prototype to think — use vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to stand up quick, testable prototypes that reduce risk in build choices ahead of engineering dedication.

What You Require To Succeed

Track record: 7+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years owning a data platform, data infrastructure, or enterprise data product end to end — not just contributing to one.
AI knowledge-stack fluency: Working knowledge of knowledge-graph concepts, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, MCP servers, and agent skills, plus a working understanding of how agents and models consume data and what makes an asset "agent-ready."
Quality workflows: Experience with human-in-the-loop quality and correction workflows in production data systems.
Specification skill: Ability to write engineering PRDs that translate complex technical systems into clear user problems, prioritized features, and measurable success metrics and guardrails.
Rapid prototyping: Ability to design and build quick prototypes through vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to de-risk decisions before engineering invests.
Systems thinking and business judgment: able to reason about the platform as a causal chain rather than independent features, and to articulate how a decision drives adoption, retention, and downstream platform value.
Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to drive cross-functional delivery across engineering and program through influence rather than authority, with comfort operating at ambiguous (roadmap) and precise (specification) altitudes simultaneously.

About The Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work cross-functionally across Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success to translate strategic partnerships into measurable outcomes for customers.

Global consulting and advisory partners are essential to helping enterprises move from AI strategy to production deployment. PwC brings global reach, deep industry and functional expertise, technology and transformation capabilities, and longstanding relationships with complex and regulated enterprises. This role will lead OpenAI’s global partnership with PwC and create the strategy, operating model, and field motions needed to turn that relationship into repeatable customer and commercial impact.

This role is based in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week.

About The Role

We are hiring a Partner Director, PwC to serve as the single accountable owner of OpenAI’s strategic relationship with PwC globally. You will define the partnership thesis and joint business plan, build executive alignment, activate PwC’s industry, advisory, technology, sales, and delivery organizations, and develop repeatable go-to-market motions that accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will move fluidly between senior executive engagement, joint account and opportunity strategy, solution and delivery alignment, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. Success requires a strong understanding of how a large, matrixed professional-services organization operates, commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align teams without relying on formal authority.

The ideal candidate has led a high-impact global alliance with PwC, built measurable pipeline and customer outcomes through partnerships, and knows how to convert company-level strategy into productive field behavior and successful deployments.

In This Role, You Will

Own the global PwC relationship, including alliance strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery quality, and long-term expansion.
Develop and execute a joint business plan with clear priorities, investments, decision rights, milestones, and measures of success.
Build trusted relationships across PwC’s global and regional leadership, industry and functional practices, alliance teams, client partners, sales organizations, architects, and delivery leaders.
Translate executive commitments into repeatable field motions spanning account mapping, opportunity qualification, co-selling, solution development, technical engagement, delivery handoffs, and escalation.
Shape joint propositions and transformation plays that combine OpenAI products and capabilities with PwC’s industry, advisory, technology, data, security, risk, governance, and delivery strengths.
Lead joint account planning and strategic customer pursuits with PwC and OpenAI field teams, with particular focus on complex and regulated enterprises.

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect
jobs.description:
About Metagenics

For over 43 years, Metagenics has had the mission to help people live happier, healthier lives through the life-changing power of nutrition.

We believe the way we do business is as important as the business we do; that a company in the nourishment business should nourish its people, too. So, we incorporated healthy, sustainable care into every dimension of our culture. Our diverse and expansive team are a prime example of the power of a people-first approach. We know first-hand, when an organization prioritizes internal growth and fosters empathy, its people come together to set an example of what the world can become.

Join us in being the world’s leading healthcare professional-grade VMS company!
⠀

The Role

Metagenics is investing meaningfully in the modernization and convergence of its global technology stack. Over the next several years we will unify our enterprise systems, modernize our commerce and integration architecture, scale a portfolio of production AI programs, and evolve toward a Centers of Excellence operating
model.
To do this well, we need a Principal Solution Architect who can hold the whole picture — the systems, the data, the integrations, the security posture, the operational readiness — and set the technical direction that our teams and delivery partners execute against.
This is a highly visible role, working directly with the CTO, technology leadership, and executive stakeholders across the business. You will become the enterprise’s technical center of gravity.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy and Standards

Own the enterprise reference architecture across ERP, ecommerce, data, integration, and AI layers
Set architectural patterns, standards, and technology selection criteria that every technology function executes against
Chair the Architecture Review Board and sign off on architecturally significant decisions

Cross-functional Technical Direction

Serve as the peer-level technical advisor to each area leader across ERP, Ecommerce, Data & AI, Security, and IT Operations
Ensure major transformation programs share consistent integration, data, identity, and observability patterns
Prevent point solutions from calcifying into new legacy

Enterprise Transformation Architecture

Own the target-state architecture for our global ERP consolidation onto a single modern platform
Own the target-state architecture for our global ecommerce convergence — including B2C, B2B / practitioner, subscriptions, payments, tax, and fulfillment
Own the platform architecture for our generative AI programs — including LLM routing, retrieval patterns, data pipelines, guardrails, and observability

Middleware and Integration

Rearchitect middleware and integrations across disparate enterprise systems — evolve a large point-to-point integration estate into a governed, event-driven architecture
Set the strategic direction for the enterprise integration platform, ensuring it simplifies as major systems converge
Establish clean separation of concerns — no business logic living in middleware where it doesn’t belong

Data

Define the enterprise data architecture — master data, event streams, warehousing, and downstream consumption for BI, AI, and operational reporting
Establish clean ownership between the transactional stack and the analytical / AI stack

Security, Compliance, and Resilience

Partner with the Head of Security on architecture-level controls — identity, access, data classification, encryption, network segmentation
Ensure compliance with applicable regimes including NIS2, FSSC 22000, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and regional privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)
Design for resilience — RTO/RPO targets, disaster recovery patterns, and business continuity

What You'll Need

Experience / Training / Education

15+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 5 years as a senior or principal-level architect at a global company
Direct hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations and/or Customer Engagement) at scale — including multi-country / multi-legal-entity deployments
Direct experience architecting modern ecommerce platforms — Shopify strongly preferred; comparable modern commerce platforms also considered
Deep understanding of integration architecture — iPaaS platforms, event-driven patterns, API-first design
Experience architecting modern data platforms — Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable
Working knowledge of generative AI architecture — RAG, agent patterns, LLM routing, evals, and guardrails

Preferred Experience

Consumer goods, life sciences, or regulated food / manufacturing industry background
Direct experience with NIS2, FSSC 22000, ISO 27001, SOC 2 compliance regimes
Experience with practitioner or healthcare-professional channels and the pricing, payment, and rebate models that come with them
Prior experience standing up or scaling a Center of Excellence operating model

You'll Love This Job If You're

A systems thinker — able to hold the whole picture without losing sight of the seams
Decisive and pragmatic — comfortable making calls with incomplete data and revisiting them cleanly when evidence changes
Comfortable influencing at the executive level — you can carry a technical argument into a senior leadership or board conversation without losing the audience
A builder, not just a governor — you ship reference implementations, not just publish diagrams
A coach and multiplier — you make the architects and engineers around you better

Compensation

is $180,000/yr. to $218,000/yr.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for a technically deep product leader who can operate from executive strategy to detailed product requirements. You will own a business-critical product area spanning robotics, perception, embodied AI, simulation, edge and cloud infrastructure, and fleet operations.

You will work closely with Applied Science, Engineering, customers, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to translate emerging research and customer needs into reliable, scalable products. Success means creating a clear path from customer problem to scientific investigation, production deployment, and measurable business value.

Build deep relationships with strategic customers, understand their business and technical objectives, and translate those needs into repeatable product capabilities.
Serve as the product counterpart to Applied Science and Engineering, defining target use cases, requirements, evaluation metrics, operating constraints, and production-readiness criteria.
Own product areas such as multimodal perception, sensor fusion, spatial understanding, robot learning, navigation, manipulation, simulation, human-robot interaction, and fleet intelligence.
Prioritize across research, platform capabilities, customer commitments, technical debt, and commercialization opportunities.
Define success measures including task completion, intervention rate, safety, latency, reliability, generalization, deployment time, utilization, and cost per task.
Drive the full product lifecycle from discovery and prototype through beta, launch, scaled deployment, and continuous improvement.
Identify and mitigate risks across AI models, robotics software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, security, safety, and operations.

Lead launches, customer enablement, product positioning, technical collateral, demonstrations, and executive presentations.
Influence across teams without formal authority and mentor other product managers.

Experience defining product metrics, technical requirements, business cases, and production-readiness standards.
Proven ability to lead exceptionally complex, cross-organizational initiatives independently.

Are you ready to reimagine how hundreds of thousands of builders interact with AWS databases every week? Can you imagine a future where millions of compute instances are upgraded to the latest database version in seconds, with zero downtime? Are you excited by the idea of agentic database experiences, enabling AI services to interact with the most important organizational data?

The Database Services team is looking for an exceptional product leader. This role is a rare intersection of UI/UX creativity, database foundations, agentic development, and scale across a fleet of millions of compute instances.

We need someone who can reimagine the entire database lifecycle for the next generation of AWS builders. The challenge is to take complex database operations and make them intuitive and scalable. You'll design how we keep customers, both IT developers and AI-based agents, informed, ensuring they always know what's happening with their critical infrastructure. Most importantly, you'll give customers more control over their database experience—transforming what has traditionally been a source of anxiety into something they can confidently manage on their own terms.

We're looking for an exceptional product manager, a builder who's obsessed with delivering for the next generation of AWS customers.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

jobs.description:
Description

FBA AI Science and Analytics accelerates FBA's AI-native transformation by building, integrating, and scaling AI-powered data & science products and seller-facing experiences that drive operational efficiency and growth across Fulfillment by Amazon globally. We're seeking a creative, industrious, customer-obsessed PM who is passionate about applying GenAI techniques to solve real-world data and science challenges at scale.

As a Product Manager Tech in our FBA AI Science and Analytics organization, you will lead the strategy and execution of multiple critical GenAI initiatives, including but not limited to: (1) a Semantic Data Layer that delivers semantically consistent, disambiguated data through a machine-readable interface to every AI application across FBA—eliminating per-application integration costs, metric re-derivation, and the concept-entity ambiguity that drives inaccurate AI outputs; (2) an AI-Powered Anomaly Detection system that autonomously identifies, diagnoses, and surfaces data quality issues and business metric anomalies; and (3) a Data Deep-Dive Agent that autonomously investigates business questions through data mining—surfacing root causes, trend shifts, and actionable insights without manual exploration.

You will drive product innovation across unified, secure, and intelligent AI solutions used by seller-facing application builders across FBA, as well as end-to-end AI-native experiences that solve high-frequency seller workflows — from inventory optimization and inbound efficiency to demand shaping and capacity planning. Your work will directly shape a future where AI is not a separate tool for sellers to adopt, but a native layer woven into every seller's decisions, operations, and growth strategies — delivering actionable insights in minutes rather than days.

Key job responsibilities

GenAI Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the product vision for LLM-powered science and data agents, spanning prompt engineering strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, semantic parsing, and agent orchestration frameworks that enable autonomous reasoning at scale. Collaborate with scientists to evaluate trade-offs between fine-tuned domain models and in-context learning approaches for optimal accuracy-latency balance.
Semantic Layer & Knowledge Graph Design: Own the product requirements for FBA's centralized semantic layer, defining ontologies, entity-relationship schemas, disambiguation logic, and machine-readable metadata standards that LLMs consume to produce accurate, governed outputs. Work with scientists to develop techniques that minimize hallucination in downstream agents.
LLM Agent Development: Partner with applied scientists and engineers to design, evaluate, and ship production LLM agents across multiple FBA domains for internal and seller-facing applications. Define evaluation frameworks incorporating composite accuracy metrics, confidence calibration, chain-of-thought verification, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop fallback mechanisms.
Stakeholder & Science Partnership: Work closely with the science and tech teams on model selection, fine-tuning strategies, retrieval pipeline optimization, and agent loop engineering. Translate research advances in LLMs, tool-use, and multi-agent systems into shippable product features.
Metrics & Evaluation: Define success metrics grounded in agent accuracy, query correctness, latency, coverage, and real time-savings. Own end-to-end evaluation including LLM-as-judge frameworks, human evaluation protocols, and A/B experimentation for agent capabilities.
Rapidly Evolving AI Landscape: Stay current with advances in foundation models, agentic architectures, harness engineering, semantic parsing, and enterprise AI tooling. Identify and prototype emerging capabilities—such as multi-step reasoning, self-improving agents via reflection loops, structured generation with constrained decoding, and tool-augmented inference—for incorporation into the product roadmap.

A day in the life

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include conducting user research, analyzing adoption and productivity data, and making data-driven decisions to guide product development. You'll oversee the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through launch and iteration, ensuring that products meet quality standards, earn user trust, and deliver measurable business value. You'll partner closely with engineering and science teams to define v1 experiences that prove concepts quickly, measure impact in real time, and stop what isn't working even when it's popular.
