jobs.title: Principal Applied Research Scientist – Generative AI and NLP
jobs.description:
Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever.

A Little About Us

The Mail Intelligence team is the brain behind the inbox. We are responsible for building the next generation of platforms and services that enable Yahoo to deliver deeply personalized, intelligent, and context-aware experiences to hundreds of millions of users globally. We process billions of messages and manage data on a petabyte scale. Using cutting-edge AI algorithms and foundation models, we extract knowledge and interconnect information from diverse sources to simplify our users' lives. Building this knowledge provides many challenges in the areas of natural language processing, machine learning techniques, and petabyte-scale data processing. You will build tools and workflows to make it easier to manage and act on this vast information, applying your insights to build innovative consumer applications for Yahoo Mail.

A Lot About You

You are a seasoned Applied ML Researcher who thrives at the intersection of theoretical innovation and production-grade execution. You don't just follow the latest LLM trends; you understand the mechanics of transformer architectures and how to optimize them for massive scale. You have expertise working across multiple ML and NLP spaces—including summarization, information extraction, classification, and ranking—at a very large scale. You have hands-on experience with knowledge distillation and believe that a model is only as good as its evaluation framework and low-latency production performance. You combine strong research fundamentals with pragmatic production instincts, comfortably navigating ambiguity to drive high-impact initiatives independently while mentoring and elevating engineering peers.

Responsibilities

Lead R&D: Drive the research strategy and development of deep learning and generative AI models specifically tailored for large-scale email and communication data.
Model Innovation & Optimization: Define and advance approaches for fine-tuning and adapting open-source foundation models using parameter-efficient techniques (LoRA, adapters) and quantization-aware training.
Efficiency at Scale: Design and implement knowledge distillation to transfer complex capabilities into smaller, high-performance models operating under strict latency budgets.
Modern Evaluation Strategy: Establish and standardize robust evaluation frameworks, including LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, synthetic evaluation datasets, and human-in-the-loop validation.
Product Integration: Build repeatable, scalable training and evaluation workflows for high-throughput production environments.
AI-Augmented Development Workflow: Integrate AI pair-programming tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) and automated LLM workflows to accelerate experimental iteration, code generation, and research prototyping.
Strategic Future-Proofing: Set technical direction for agent-based systems, tool-use paradigms, and long-term generative AI roadmaps.
Technical Mentorship & Governance: Raise the bar for technical excellence by guiding researchers, shaping org-wide AI technical strategy, and establishing best practices for model validation.

Qualifications

PhD (preferred) or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field.
9+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning and deep learning, with significant hands-on work in NLP and generative models at scale.
Demonstrated experience fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA or other parameter-efficient methods.
Experience with knowledge distillation, model compression, and/or training smaller models from larger teacher models.
Hands-on experience using LLMs for pseudo-labeling and synthetic data generation to create high-quality training datasets.
Experience building and evaluating LLM-based agents, including tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and reasoning workflows.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures (encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder) and modern generative transformer techniques.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for generative systems, including prompt-based evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge approaches, and automated output validation.
Hands-on experience incorporating AI pair-programming tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) or LLM workbench environments into daily developer and research workflows.
Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, along with Hugging Face tooling.
Experience building scalable data pipelines and training workflows for large datasets.
Strong experimental rigor and ability to translate research ideas into production-ready systems.
Excellent communication skills and ability to operate effectively in cross-functional, fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with large-scale distributed training and inference.
Experience building, deploying, and optimizing models for on-device or resource-constrained environments (quantization, pruning, distillation).
Experience with agent frameworks, tool use, or multi-step reasoning systems.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, preference optimization (RLHF/DPO), or model alignment techniques.
Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in NLP or generative AI.
Experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and large-scale experimentation infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!

Amazon's Retail Business Services (RBS) team is looking for a Principal Program Manager to drive a new investment in **Systems Persona Awareness**—a capability that enables Amazon systems to better understand the personalized needs, context, and intent of individual customers to unlock new conversion opportunities.

## Overview of the role

Customer expectations are rapidly shifting toward experiences that understand them as individuals rather than treating every shopping interaction the same. Customers have different needs, preferences, circumstances, and intent—and Amazon has an opportunity to make its systems increasingly aware of those differences.

Today, many Amazon systems operate with limited understanding of the customer's broader persona and personalized needs. This creates an opportunity to evolve from generalized customer experiences toward **persona-aware systems that can recognize customer context, anticipate needs, and deliver more relevant experiences.**

The Principal Program Manager, Systems Persona Awareness will lead this new investment, defining the strategy and mechanisms required to make Amazon systems more customer-aware and unlock incremental conversion opportunities. This leader will work across product, technology, science, and business teams to translate customer understanding into scalable capabilities and measurable business outcomes.

Define the long-term strategy and vision for **Systems Persona Awareness**, establishing how Amazon systems can better understand and respond to personalized customer needs.
Identify high-value customer personas, needs, and use cases where greater system awareness can create meaningful improvements in customer experience and conversion.
Develop mechanisms and frameworks to assess how effectively Amazon systems understand customer context, intent, preferences, and needs.
Partner with product, technology, science, and business teams to translate persona insights into scalable customer experiences and measurable conversion opportunities.
Identify gaps in Amazon's existing systems and develop a prioritized roadmap for improving personalization and customer relevance.
Establish mechanisms to measure the impact of persona-aware experiences on customer engagement, satisfaction, and conversion.
Influence senior leadership by translating customer insights, data, and experimentation into clear strategic recommendations and investment decisions.
Drive alignment across multiple organizations and operate effectively in a highly ambiguous, cross-functional environment.
Establish mechanisms that scale persona awareness beyond individual experiences and enable broader adoption across Amazon systems.

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Mgr
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.

Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.
Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.
Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.
Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.
Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.
Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.
Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.
Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.
Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.
Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.
You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.

We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

jobs.title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
jobs.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.

You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

What You'll Do

Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.

Who You Are

You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.

The United States base range for this position is $281,196 – $401,709 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know – we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Spotify transformed music listening forever when we launched in 2008. Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a Senior Principal, Product Management to deliver our strategic vision for the Developer Platform
. You will manage foundational services, APIs, and infrastructure, driving the roadmap that empowers internal teams and partners to scale confidently.

You will treat the platform as a product
, shifting platform engineering from reactive, ad-hoc support into proactive, self-service experiences. Grounded in industry research (DORA, CNCF, Team Topologies, etc..), you will introduce golden paths, a discoverable developer portal, self-service tools, and high-quality documentation to reduce cognitive load and support burdens across Twilio.

Collaborating with product leaders, engineering, architecture, and design, you will define the future of developer experience, tooling, deployment, and operational capabilities, acting as the steward for evangelizing our developer platform capabilities and narrative and driving roadmap prioritization across a scalable cloud platform.

Key Skills

Platform-as-a-Product Expertise: Proficiency in applying product management methodologies—including user research, roadmapping, and KPI definition—to internal infrastructure.
Architectural & Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD) and observability frameworks, enabling credible engagement with engineering leads.
Developer Experience Design: Proven ability to identify developer friction points and architect solutions like developer portals, golden paths, and documentation-as-code to drive self-service.
Stakeholder Influence & Evangelism: Capacity to build compelling narratives that align cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Security) and drive internal platform adoption.
Performance Analytics: Experience defining and using success metrics (DORA, adoption, reliability) to advocate for data-driven product strategies.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

Own the Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy for foundational services, ensuring the roadmap balances technical debt, scalability, and new feature velocity.
Transition to Self-Service: Actively shift the platform from reactive, 'ticket-based' support to a scalable, proactive product model by establishing paved roads and service catalogs.
Lead Cross-functional Integration: Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Security leads to ensure platform solutions are extensible, compliant, and meet the unique needs of internal developers.
Drive Developer Productivity: Champion continuous improvements in APIs, SDKs, and sandbox environments to reduce time-to-first-deploy and cognitive load.
Measure and Optimize: Establish governance frameworks and KPI dashboards to track adoption, support deflection, and reliability, iteratively refining the platform based on usage data and developer feedback.
Customer focus: Deeply understand customer needs and advocate for customer-centric product & engineering practices, using developer interviews and usage data to translate requests into root causes.
Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the voice of the Twilio platform across the organization (internal development platform, deployment systems, developer experience and tooling, etc.), ensuring stakeholder needs are well understood and incorporated into the product planning process.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:
12+ years of product management experience building large scale cloud services platforms; specifically building cloud native commerce systems for usage-based and metered products at a very large scale
Proven track record of results including establishing ambitious goals, achieving /over-achieving those goals and taking overall responsibility for customer and business outcomes
A track record of driving companies through ground-breaking change with the ability to see the big-picture while also being hands-on in the details
Executive presence with strong communication skills, and ability to communicate business value and product features/benefits and influence at the highest levels to drive change
Data-driven, outcomes oriented and a problem solver
Customer obsessed - passionate about the customer journey and the customer experience
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, or equivalent experience

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in The Bay Area or Seattle area

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C.: $233,100.00–$259,000.00
Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $246,780.00–$274,200.00
Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $274,140.00–$304,600.00

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

The Workforce & Intelligent Routing platform
controls how Capital One connects customers with the right support at the right time. We build the tech and data tools that power Card Servicing’s entire workforce—handling real-time work routing, demand forecasting, and scheduling. It’s practical, high-impact product work: making sure agents have fair, sensible schedules and customers get connected to someone who can genuinely solve their issue.

About The Role

As Sr. Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end Workforce Management product suite and lead the PM team behind it. You’ll oversee everything behind Card Servicing’s forecasting, capacity planning, schedule generation, and real-time operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll need to balance long-term strategy with a strong grasp of the underlying engineering, helping the team navigate complex technical, vendor, and operational tradeoffs.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap: Set a clear vision for the platform so the team builds toward long-term goals rather than just reacting to incoming requests.
Team Leadership: Coach and mentor a team of Product Managers, driving high standards and focusing on measurable outcomes rather than just output.
Delivery & Operations: Own the core scheduling and planning tools, directly influencing agent experience, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
Vendor Management: Translate Capital One’s technical and security needs for external vendors, while helping internal stakeholders plan around vendor roadmaps.
Technical Collaboration: Partner with Tech Leads to resolve architecture tradeoffs, clean up data pipelines, and ensure live deployments run smoothly.
Portfolio Prioritization: Balance immediate leadership demands with long-term platform health and technical dependencies.
Cross-Functional Influence: Work across Enterprise Data and Tech teams to ensure our workforce data is integrated and scalable across the company.
Executive Communication: Translate complex platform constraints into clear business terms for senior leaders, and convert business goals into actionable technical plans.

Capital One Product Framework

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value

The company has built a durable market position on the strength of deep client relationships and customization, but that model now needs to evolve into a modern, scalable SaaS platform capable of doubling the customer base without doubling the codebase. The engineering organization has operated without a formal leadership layer for years, and there is no formal product management function. The incoming CPTO will unify product direction and technology execution under a single accountable seat, bring structure and product management maturity to a team of experienced developers, and establish an AI-first operating rhythm.
You will join ZAP Solutions directly as a core member of the leadership team, reporting to the CEO. jobs.title: Sr Director, Product Development Lead - 591
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases.
You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Sr Director, Product Development Lead is entrusted with owning and leading the global development of late-stage radiopharmaceutical compounds for therapeutic oncology indications. This role provides cross-functional leadership across clinical, regulatory, CMC, quality, manufacturing/supply chain, and commercial, and drives governance, decision-making, and risk management to deliver program milestones and support regulatory interactions and approvals. This role may include direct people management of one or more Project managers. As a strategic thinker and clear communicator, the role requires a hands-on approach to aligning stakeholders, maintaining an execution-ready integrated plan, and presenting program status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Key Accountabilities

Development Leadership: Lead the Global Program Leadership Team (GPLT) and hold accountability for cross-functional commitments across CMC, Clinical, and Regulatory. Set and communicate GPLT program objectives in alignment with the Tx BU objective cascade model, ensuring clarity on shared program outcomes vs. functional objectives. Develop and maintain the Global Development Plan (GDP) and Target Product Profile (TPP), ensuring these remain current and drive aligned decision-making across the matrix team.
Strategic Direction: Showcase courage in strategic thinking, guiding matrixed teams through complex decision-making and risk management processes.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Foster a collaborative spirit, working seamlessly with teams spanning clinical, non-clinical, regulatory affairs, quality, manufacturing and supply chain, commercial, medical affairs and program management to formulate plans that achieve program milestones and objectives.
Program Governance & Change Management: Drive integrated cross-functional planning and confirm readiness for key milestones and inflection points; ensure scope, timeline, and budget impacts are assessed and elevated appropriately for leadership review (e.g., Product Management Committee) and that decisions are documented and communicated.
Risk Ownership & Communication: Identify, assign ownership of, and actively manage program risks/issues; communicate risks, mitigations, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
Budget Planning & Forecasting: Lead program-level budget planning and forecasting in partnership with Finance and functional leads; monitor spend vs. plan, surface variances, and drive timely re-forecasting and trade-off recommendations to support portfolio decisions.
Regulatory Pathway Design: Partner with Clinical and Regulatory Affairs to craft the ideal development pathway for approval, aiming to meet product attributes and commercial objectives.
Regulatory Interactions & Communication Alignment: Lead cross-functional preparation for key health authority interactions (e.g., FDA Type B), ensuring consistent internal communication, clear objectives, aligned messaging, and timely delivery of high-quality briefing materials and responses.
Executive-Ready Program Reporting: Maintain clear, decision-focused reporting (dashboards, milestone tracking, red/amber/green risks) and ensure critical risks are visible to appropriate leadership teams with recommended actions and owners.
Development Planning: Create and execute comprehensive product development plans and data packages, paving the way for informed go/no-go decisions and continuous progression towards product approval.
CMC/Supply & Vendor (CDMO) Alignment: Partner with Technical Operations, Quality, and external vendors to ensure manufacturing readiness, GMP compliance, and supply continuity; proactively identify constraints and develop mitigation plans that protect clinical execution and regulatory commitments.
Stakeholder Engagement: Engage subject matter experts and thought leaders, both within and outside the organization, fostering rich scientific dialogue, extracting insights, and refining development plans and strategies.
Global Study Execution & Enrollment Enablement: Collaborate with Clinical Operations and regional teams to anticipate recruitment risks (including competing trials), support site activation strategy, and drive actions that protect enrollment and global data consistency.
Inclusive Leadership & Communication: Foster an inclusive, respectful team culture, including use of inclusive language in communications and reinforcement of constructive cross-functional collaboration.

Education And Experience

Master’s or PhD in medical, pharma or biotech field strongly preferred; 12+ years in pharma/biotech required.
Minimum of 5+ years leading cross-functional product teams within the pharma/biotech domain.
Prior experience in oncology development and/or radiopharmaceuticals will be a distinct advantage.
Experience in clinical Phase 2, Phase 3 and through approval required, specifically in the therapeutic area assigned.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically, communicate effectively, and collaborate in a matrixed team environment.
Direct people management experience is considered an advantage.

Key Capabilities

Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected
Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges
Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do
Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results
Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges
Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language
Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals
Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges
Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts
, we strive to be extraordinary
, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity
. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives.
Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world. We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Dragos Cloud
jobs.description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About The Role

Dragos is seeking a principal-level Product Manager to lead the Cloud Platform product team, responsible for replacing the existing Customer Portal and building the unified customer experience at platform.dragos.com, backed by a centralized API layer that serves SaaS users, on-premises deployments, and machine integrations alike. This role owns the vision, roadmap, and execution to unify Dragos's distributed portals and capabilities, including WorldView threat intelligence, Neighborhood Keeper, managed services, AI, documentation, and artifact access, into a single seamless experience across cloud and hybrid on-premises deployments. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, product teams, internal stakeholders, and customers to shape and execute the platform roadmap.

Responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and quarter-over-quarter roadmap for the Dragos Cloud Platform, replacing the existing Customer Portal with a unified experience that brings every customer-facing capability together under a single login.
Define the platform architecture strategy, including the central API layer, authentication and identity approach, and how the platform consistently serves both SaaS and hybrid on-premises customers.
Lead the integration of Dragos's key product surfaces, including threat intelligence, community defense, managed services, AI, and compliance reporting, into the unified platform experience.
Own artifact delivery, fleet management, and entitlement features, giving customers a single place to download platform updates and content, monitor their on-premises deployments, and manage their product subscriptions.
Drive a coherent customer experience across the SaaS portal and on-premises interfaces, and define proactive service flows that surface the right support and success touchpoints at the right moment.
Partner with feature teams across Dragos to align on integration boundaries, shared platform services, and a consistent API surface.
Engage directly with customers and customer-facing teams to discover and validate use cases, gather feedback, and iterate on product direction.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, make prioritization and trade-off decisions, and communicate requirements to Engineering with clear business rationale.
Define and track product KPIs, including platform adoption, migration progress, and time-to-value for newly integrated capabilities.
Support Sales with competitive insights and customer guidance; shape go-to-market positioning that connects the unified platform to customers' operational continuity and security operations needs.

Qualifications

10+ years of Product Management experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, cloud products, or multi-product unified experiences, ideally in cybersecurity or adjacent technology domains.
Strong understanding of cloud platform and API architecture, including centralized API design serving multiple client types, authentication and identity at scale, and multi-tenant SaaS delivery.
Experience leading platform consolidation or portal replacement, including managing feature migration, driving customer adoption, and maintaining continuity across the transition.
Technical fluency with APIs, data models, and backend workflows, with the ability to partner closely with Engineering and make informed architecture trade-off decisions.
Proven track record of shipping successful products, including outcome-driven roadmap management, go-to-market strategy, and backlog prioritization.
Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, sales, and executive stakeholders.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a collaborative approach to team dynamics and willingness to travel (~10%) for customer meetings, conferences, or company events.
Experience with fleet or device management, entitlement and subscription visibility, or compliance reporting features in enterprise SaaS products (a plus).
Direct experience with OT/ICS cybersecurity, either on the customer side or having built or supported an OT security product (a plus).

Salary: $220,000

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company on a mission to shift the advantage from attackers to defenders. Our flagship product, the NodeZero® platform, autonomously executes real attack techniques in production—safely, without agents or disruption—to help organizations find exploitable weaknesses, fix what matters most, verify remediation, and continuously prove their resilience.

NodeZero helps organizations understand risk across their internal networks, external attack surface, cloud environments, identities, data, and web applications. Customers use the platform to replace assumptions with evidence: what an attacker can actually exploit, how an attack can move through the environment, what the business impact could be, and whether a fix truly worked.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We are committed to solving common security problems including ineffective tools, false positives, alert fatigue, blind spots, checkbox security culture, cybersecurity skills shortages, and the time and expense of point-in-time manual assessments. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls committed to respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote-first company, we require a minimum 25Mbps consumer-grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Director of Product Marketing to lead the product marketing function at a defining moment in Horizon3’s growth. This role will establish the strategy, operating model, and talent system that turn product marketing into a measurable engine for category leadership, pipeline creation, sales productivity, customer adoption, and revenue growth.

You will report to the VP of Corporate & Product Marketing and lead a team of product marketers, currently expected to include three direct reports. You will work across Product, Engineering, Attack Research, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Corporate Communications, Alliances, and Revenue Operations to ensure Horizon3’s capabilities are understood, differentiated, adopted, and converted into business outcomes.

Product Marketing Strategy & Category Leadership

Define and execute the product marketing strategy across the NodeZero platform, aligning portfolio priorities with Horizon3’s corporate narrative, growth objectives, market opportunity, and revenue plan.
Establish a clear architecture for how Horizon3’s capabilities—including internal, external, cloud, identity, Kubernetes, web application, precision defense, threat detection and response, and compliance solutions—fit together as one proactive security platform.
Lead the evolution of Horizon3’s market position from autonomous pentesting and adversarial exposure validation toward a broader, evidence-based proactive security and CTEM operating model.
Translate product and market strategy into clear buyer narratives for CISOs, security leaders, SecOps, ITOps, cloud-security, identity, application-security, infrastructure, compliance, and offensive-security teams.
Identify the highest-value market opportunities, buying centers, use cases, and customer segments, then prioritize product marketing investment against business impact.
Serve as a senior product marketing voice in executive planning, annual operating plans, board preparation, analyst engagements, industry events, and strategic customer conversations.

Product Launch & Go-To-Market Operating System

Create and scale a repeatable launch methodology that aligns Product, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Communications, and channel teams around one plan.
Establish launch principles, stage gates, briefs, roles, timelines, readiness requirements, measurement standards, and post-launch reviews.
Ensure every launch begins with a validated customer problem, a differentiated market position, a clear audience, proof points, a field activation plan, and defined business outcomes.
Oversee the development of messaging, positioning, pricing and packaging inputs, buyer journeys, launch content, campaign requirements, enablement, analyst materials, and customer communications.
Create a consistent process for moving product feedback, field intelligence, customer evidence, and competitive insights back into Product and executive decision-making.
Measure launch performance and use results to improve future launches, portfolio investment, and go-to-market efficiency.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing product marketing team with clear charters, ownership boundaries, priorities, and measures of success.
Set a high bar for strategic thinking, technical fluency, customer empathy, writing quality, operating discipline, and commercial impact.
Build an effective portfolio model that allows individual PMMs to own their areas while maintaining consistent company-wide messaging, process, and standards.
Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain exceptional product marketing talent as the organization grows.
Establish regular team operating rhythms including planning, work-in-progress reviews, launch reviews, skill development, and performance conversations.
Create opportunities for the team to build reusable assets, deepen customer and market expertise, and increase leverage through repeatable systems and AI-assisted workflows.

Revenue Alignment, Enablement & Customer Adoption

Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to define how product marketing contributes to pipeline, conversion, deal velocity, win rates, expansion, retention, and customer value.
Develop a consistent enablement system spanning messaging, discovery, qualification, solution narratives, demo guidance, objection handling, competitive responses, sales plays, and training.
Ensure the field can communicate both technical proof—real attacks, exploitable paths, verified impact, and verified fixes—and executive value, including reduced exposure, faster remediation, and defensible security assurance.
Partner with Customer Success and Customer Marketing to create adoption, expansion, advocacy, and customer-proof programs that connect product use to measurable outcomes.
Establish a structured process for capturing win/loss insights, customer feedback, field requests, and recurring objections, then convert those insights into action.
Build scalable campaign-in-a-box and partner-ready packages that allow regional, field, channel, and demand teams to activate product narratives consistently.

Messaging, Content & Market Influence

Own the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of Horizon3’s product narratives across the full customer journey.
Guide the creation of proof-first content including product pages, solution briefs, technical blogs, buyer’s guides, white papers, customer stories, webinars, executive POVs, analyst materials, demos, and presentations.
Ensure technical claims are accurate, differentiated, supportable, and grounded in customer evidence, product capability, or validated research.
Partner with Corporate Communications, Analyst Relations, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and Alliances to amplify product stories through integrated programs.
Help Horizon3 educate the market on the shift from vulnerability volume and theoretical risk to verified exploitability, prioritized remediation, and continuous resilience.
Build a durable content and evidence system that makes high-quality product marketing faster to produce, easier to reuse, and more effective in-market.

Product, Engineering & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to Product and Engineering leadership, helping connect roadmap decisions to customer problems, market shifts, competitive dynamics, and commercial opportunity.
Establish productive working relationships with Attack Research and technical subject-matter experts so the company’s deepest capabilities become understandable and valuable to the market.
Represent the customer and market perspective in portfolio planning, prioritization, packaging, launch readiness, and roadmap discussions.
Resolve cross-functional ambiguity by clarifying decision rights, owners, dependencies, and next actions.
Build alignment across a fast-moving global organization without relying solely on formal authority.
Model direct, evidence-based, and respectful communication in high-stakes decisions and executive conversations.

AI Operations Transformation & Marketing Excellence

Lead the product marketing organization’s adoption of AI-assisted workflows that improve research, content development, personalization, competitive analysis, enablement, reporting, and operational scale.
Define responsible standards for using AI in product marketing while protecting accuracy, security, brand quality, customer trust, and human judgment.
Identify high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work, accelerate time to insight, and improve the quality and consistency of PMM outputs.
Build shared systems, templates, prompt libraries, knowledge resources, and quality-control practices that increase team leverage without creating disconnected one-off experiments.
Use data, automation, and structured feedback loops to continuously improve the product marketing operating model.

Measurement, Planning & Business Management

Define the product marketing scorecard, including launch readiness, pipeline influence, conversion, competitive performance, sales productivity, content engagement, adoption, expansion, and customer-proof metrics.
Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, and marketing leadership on planning, budget allocation, headcount planning, forecasting, and resource tradeoffs.
Establish reliable reporting that communicates progress, business impact, risks, dependencies, and recommended actions to executive leadership.
Use Salesforce, product analytics, market intelligence, win/loss data, and customer insights to make investment decisions and improve performance.
Hold the function accountable for outcomes, not activity volume, while preserving the quality and rigor required for a technical cybersecurity category.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of B2B product marketing experience, including significant experience in enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or another complex technical category.
4+ years of experience leading, coaching, or managing product marketers and building high-performing cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated success defining product marketing strategy and operating models across multiple products, segments, or buying centers.
A track record of launching and scaling complex technical products with measurable impact on pipeline, revenue, adoption, retention, or market position.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity markets, buyer journeys, competitive dynamics, and the process of turning technical differentiation into commercial advantage.
The ability to move fluently between executive strategy and technical detail, building trust with board-level leaders, product executives, sales teams, engineers, security practitioners, and customers.
Exceptional writing, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Experience building repeatable launch, enablement, content, customer-insight, and measurement systems.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, create clarity, and drive decisions across a high-growth organization.
Strong business judgment, analytical skills, and comfort using data to prioritize investments and assess performance.

Nice to Have

Experience marketing offensive security, autonomous security, cloud security, identity security, application security, exposure management, CTEM, vulnerability management, security operations, or adjacent enterprise cybersecurity products.
Experience working with a product-led, sales-led, partner-led, or hybrid go-to-market model.

jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future of Amazon Customer Service (CS) with us. Quality & Escalation’s vision is to deliver exceptional customer experiences that restore customer trust through continuous inspection, innovation, and improvement. Q&E exists to provides Tier 2 support to frontline teams when the ‘Andon cord’ is raised on customer experience issues. We resolve customer escalations across all sources while focusing on identifying and eliminating their root causes. We design and implement frameworks to measure service quality and lead technology and programmatic initiatives to continuously improve the quality of service across all CS interactions and touchpoints. Q&E is a large and impactful Operational, Program and Product teams across 6K Amazonians, spanning 30+ countries. (keep this in)

A key strategic priority for our organization is building the Customer Interception Model (CIM), Amazon CS's intelligent service recovery platform.

CIM transforms CS from reactive issue resolution to proactive customer recovery. By combining AI with customer, operational, and conversational signals, CIM detects service failures in real time, understands customer context, determines the appropriate recovery action, and orchestrates automated or human-assisted resolution. Through proactive recovery at scale, CIM enables Amazon to continuously earn and rebuild customer trust.

The Principal Product Manager – Tech, CIM owns the long-term product vision, strategy, and technical roadmap for one of Amazon CS's most strategic AI capabilities. This candidate will define how Amazon detects customer experience failures, reasons over customer and operational context, selects the optimal recovery strategy, and orchestrates automated and human-assisted resolutions across CS.

This role requires exceptional product judgment, deep technical fluency, and the ability to influence across Engineering, Applied Science, Data & Artificial Intelligence, Customer Experience, Operations, Finance, and other Partner teams. The successful candidate will translate complex business problems into scalable AI-powered products that improve customer trust and outcomes, reduce customer effort, lower our cost to serve, and redefine how Amazon delivers CS at global scale.

Key job responsibilities

Define, own, and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for CIM, translating customer needs and business opportunities into scalable AI-powered product solutions.
Own product-level success metrics aligned to organizational goals, including improving customer trust, reducing repeat contacts and customer effort, strengthening foundational AI capabilities, and lowering cost to serve.
Lead end-to-end product execution across highly matrixed organizations, partnering closely with Eng, AS, D&AI, Ops, CX, Q&E, and partner product teams to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
Synthesize complex business, operational, and technical requirements into clear product narratives (PRFAQs, BRDs), prioritization frameworks, and execution plans that align senior stakeholders and enable scalable delivery.
Establish mechanisms to intake, prioritize, track, and measure product commitments, leveraging analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decision making to continuously improve customer recovery outcomes.
Optimize and evaluate product performance across the customer recovery lifecycle, using customer insights, telemetry, and operational metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Demonstrate deep technical fluency across AI systems, platform integrations, distributed architectures, and product dependencies, enabling effective partnership with engineering teams and informed product trade-off decisions.
Operate autonomously with high judgment in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments, driving clarity where none exists while balancing rapid delivery with long-term platform scalability.
Influence product strategy across multiple organizations, aligning senior leaders around a shared vision while driving execution through collaboration rather than authority.
Develop and mentor the Technical Product Management community across the organization, fostering capability growth, technical excellence, and leadership development.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

You will collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams worldwide and within TTS to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. Own the product vision and roadmap for a defined risk detection and prevention area, aligning priorities with engineering, science, and business stakeholders against shared goals.

Define product requirements and success metrics for automation, machine learning, and tooling investments that improve fraud prevention accuracy and operational efficiency.
Drive data-informed product decisions by leveraging business analysis, risk trends, and customer friction insights to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities within your area.
Build scalable measurement frameworks and continuous monitoring products focused on carrier partner compliance and emerging risk areas.
Partner across engineering and science teams to translate new technologies (ML models, signals, identity verification) into shipped product capabilities.
Mentor junior product managers and business analysts, and contribute to the norms and standards of the product team.

About The Team

Relay Trust is the fraud prevention and risk management product team within Amazon's Transportation Technology and Services (TTS) organization. Our mission is to protect Amazon's middle-mile transportation network, our carrier partners, and ultimately our customers from fraud, misuse, and abuse at global scale. We build products powered by machine learning, real-time signals, and data-driven decision systems that detect and prevent risk across identity verification, cargo integrity, and carrier compliance.

TTS's vision is to reinvent how customers of all sizes move goods, powered by tech, driven by science, and guided by data. Our systems process thousands of decisions per second, integrate signals from GPS, cameras, and device telemetry, and directly influence billions of dollars in transportation

Every new model capability Firefly ships should show up everywhere a creator might want it, immediately — without each surface rebuilding the same prompt-to-output experience from scratch. Build The Generation Experience As a Platform

Be an exceptional partner to design

You’ll lead and develop a team of Renewals Managers, partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, and Customer Success, and serve as a trusted commercial voice in front of strategic customers. This is a builder’s role: you’ll be one of the first dedicated leaders for this function, so the processes, culture, and standards you set become the template.

What You'll Do

Build and lead the renewals team. Hire, develop, and retain a team of Renewals Managers. Define how the function covers the customer base, set the performance bar, and create a culture of accountability and customer-centricity.
Own the renewal number. Own renewal bookings, gross and net retention, on-time renewal metrics, forecast accuracy, and renewal pipeline health. Identify risk early and implement mitigation strategies to reduce churn and contraction.
Define the operating model. Establish scalable renewal playbooks, stage definitions, qualification criteria, and operational rigor — adapted for the realities of consumption-based revenue rather than fixed contract cycles.
Forecast with rigor. Drive accurate weekly and monthly renewal forecasting and reporting that leadership can plan against, grounded in usage data and customer health signals.
Drive expansion at renewal. Partner with Sales and Customer Success to convert adoption depth into expanded commitments, and lead executive-level renewal conversations for strategic accounts where required.
Collaborate across the GTM organization. Work with Sales on territory and account strategy, with Deal Desk and Finance on pricing, terms, and approvals, and with Strategy & Operations on forecasting and field alignment.
Lead with an AI-first mindset. Use data, automation, and tooling — including Claude — to optimize renewal processes, monitor KPIs, and continuously raise the bar on performance.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

8–12+ years of experience in SaaS, PaaS, or consumption-led businesses, with significant exposure to renewals, retention, sales, or customer success
3–5+ years of people management experience leading renewals, retention, or commercial teams
A proven track record of owning and exceeding renewal and retention targets in complex, enterprise deal cycles
Excellent forecasting and pipeline management skills, with a reliable, evidence-based approach to calling the number
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders — Sales, Finance, Deal Desk, and Customer Success — at all levels
A strong analytical mindset and comfort using data to drive decisions

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Direct experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing models, and the unique retention dynamics they create
Background in data, AI, cloud, or developer-platform businesses
Experience building a renewals or retention function from the ground up, including playbooks, forecasting cadence, and team structure
Experience operating across multiple regions and markets
Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. You own the engagement and the vertical — from the first pre-sales conversation through the final readout.

Lead engagements end-to-end. Track record of driving user acquisition and engagement across emerging markets, the Android ecosystem, and expanding consumer cohorts (e.g., younger demographics).

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

You will solve some of our most complex growth issues, building tailored strategies across iOS and Android, navigate rapid evolution of Conversational and GenAI, and unlock growth across mature and emerging markets.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Overview

Microsoft AI’s content team is building the next generation of content with user understanding, and personalization systems behind experiences across Edge, Windows, Copilot, and partner surfaces that reach hundreds of millions of people. We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to drive personalization, user understanding and how that translates to our content ranking systems.

You will define personalization and ranking strategy end to end: how user interests are represented, how candidates are retrieved, how content understanding and user signals become ranking features, how models are trained and evaluated, and how the final ranked experience trades off relevance, freshness, quality and long-term user value. You will set the vision for AI-native personalization, i.e. generative recommendation, agentic user understanding, and closed learning loops while also coordinating with our content ranking product managers.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer product, ML systems of rigor, AI-native workflows and organizational leadership. You’ll operate with high agency and set directions that multiple teams execute against and align senior stakeholders across MAI and partner organizations.

Responsibilities

Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered personalization across recommendation systems, user and content understanding, agentic memory, and generative AI content experiences.
Translate user and product goals into clear requirements for ranking, retrieval, profile generation, memory, data pipelines, evaluation, and serving systems.
Own communication with senior MAI leadership on overall strategy and investment.
Own the ranking objective and how it integrates personalization: decide what models optimize for, balancing engagement, retention, content diversity, safety, and long-term user value, and translate that into label strategies, training data requirements, and model plans.
Drive how signals become ranking features, including user behavior, content understanding, quality, freshness, and context. Work cross functionally to set quality bars for what enters the feature store and the models.
Design how Edge, Windows, Copilot, and partner surfaces consume the shared ranking stack through clear interfaces, per-surface tuning, and quality bars that scale integration.
Own the evaluation and experimentation framework: offline metrics that predict online outcomes, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and proving ranking lift on engagement, retention, and business outcomes.
Set strategic direction for the personalization platform — user profiles, agentic memory, content understanding, generative recommendation, and serving infrastructure — ensuring compounding capability over time.
Align VP-level stakeholders across MAI and partner organizations, set prioritization frameworks, and influence resource allocation across multiple teams.
Partner with privacy, consent, legal, and policy teams to make ranking trustworthy by design.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s Degree AND 15+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development, OR equivalent experience.

Preferred

17+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development, OR equivalent experience.
7+ years building consumer-facing recommendation, personalization, search, feed, or content ranking products at scale.
Track record of defining and landing product strategy at the organizational level, influencing investment decisions and aligning senior leadership behind a technical product vision.
Experience owning ranking or recommendation objective functions end to end — deciding what models optimize for, not just how they optimize.
Deep experience with ranking and personalization platform architecture: user profiles, candidate retrieval, ranking models, signal pipelines, feature stores, evaluation systems, and multi-surface integration.
Experience with generative AI, LLMs, agents, user memory, or retrieval and ranking systems in production consumer products.
Strong technical fluency across ML systems, ranking architectures, data pipelines, experimentation platforms, and scalable serving infrastructure.
The combination of consumer product taste, systems rigor, and organizational leadership — caring about both the quality users feel and the strategy that compounds value over time.

Description

The primary responsibilities of the Search Marketing organization are to drive web site traffic, maximize channel revenue and improve the end customer experience wherever they are in their shopping journey across the web. We manage Earned (SEO) and Paid Search marketing channels on external search engines and emerging partners including AI driven experiences and run experiments with a view to programmatically improve our ROI and find levers to grow the Amazon stores business. Our channel is one of the largest levers for Amazon business and new customer acquisition. We work with internal customers across all levels of the organization worldwide and enjoy the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-growing organization.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to lead Paid Search channel marketing for one of Amazon's largest managed traffic driving channels. In this role, you will lead the development and execution of the paid and organic digital marketing strategy. This is a high-visibility position with scope for creativity and self-development. You will develop a detailed understanding of digital marketing (SEO/SEM in particular) and understand the long-term financial impact of customer behavior trends. The role requires a highly analytical mindset as well as a curiosity to seek out new possibilities. You should be strong at and attracted to the analytical and technical side of digital marketing as well as to the creative and experimental side, consistently using one to inform the other. You will be comfortable thinking big and diving deep. You will be the single point of contact and a dedicated owner for specific areas of the business and will be the search team's expert for that product line, gathering insights and applying learnings to additional lines of business / countries.

The successful candidate will think strategically and execute rigorously. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. You will anticipate and remove bottlenecks, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus constraints. You will be at the center of the customer experience and need to dive into the customers’ responses, incremental business impact, and budget justification on your program, which requires strong analytical skills. You Earn the Trust of your stakeholders and influence them. You look around corners for potential opportunities or challenges and proactively put in place plans to address them.
