Develop deep search channel insights and understanding in partnership with retail teams, other marketing channel teams, and international stakeholders
Translate channel insights into test plans, product/feature proposals, and opportunities for optimization
Define and run tests, including A/B experiments to test new vendor features and/or inform new product development using your judgement across relative priorities
Conduct in-depth analyses to refine our understanding of the search space and uncover additional optimization opportunities
Translate analytical findings into actionable insights and concise business actions and recommendations

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a partner sync shaping how AI-powered Ad formats replace traditional search targeting approaches for optimization. Before your coffee gets cold, you're reviewing an ML model classifying millions of queries into intent channels with scientists. After lunch, you're sizing a campaign across WW marketplaces, then pivoting to a social commerce API integration review. You'll juggle external partners, science teams, marketing managers across countries, and engineering sprints — often in the same hour. If you thrive in organized chaos and get energy from connecting generative AI, programmatic advertising, and real-time bidding — this role is for you.

Search Marketing drives how Amazon acquires customers through search-based experiences worldwide. We operate billions of ad interactions daily across major search platforms, optimizing in real-time to bring the right customers to Amazon. Our mission: maximize customer acquisition efficiency through automation, science, and strategic partner relationships. The team blends product management, applied science, engineering, and marketing, building AI-powered systems that replace manual processes at global scale. We're a small, high-autonomy group where individuals own entire product areas end-to-end, ship fast, and influence billions in revenue. Culture is data driven, experiment-heavy, and biased toward action.

jobs.description:
Description

The FBA Inventory team is responsible for one of the most strategically critical and technically complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: managing the inventory volume sent to and stored in the Amazon Fulfillment Network (AFN) across 1MM+ sellers worldwide, while enabling sellers to grow at the pace they desire. Our team sits at the intersection of seller economics, network operations, and latest science thinking — uniquely positioned to align incentives between Amazon and sellers to maximize GMS, optimize network health, and deliver a best-in-class seller experience.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, results-oriented Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned inventory enforcement orchestration running inventory removal driven defects down to zero. This is a rare opportunity to own a platform that directly influences seller trust at scale, the integrity of Amazon's compliance posture across every marketplace, and the efficiency of the global fulfillment network. You will drive the strategy and roadmap spanning policy-authoring systems, action APIs, appeal-aware control logic, and the lifecycle-of-record systems that power them — building products that resolve policy intent, seller remediation, appeal state, and removal eligibility upstream, so downstream inventory and removal systems can correctly take execution actions.

Key job responsibilities

Own the FBA platform roadmap for Project Atlas — Amazon's durable target-state architecture for policy-owned enforcement orchestration — and the next-generation enforcement experience that turns downstream systems into stateless executors of upstream policy decisions.
Drive the shift to policy-owned enforcement, replacing bundled downstream workflows with discrete, policy-issued action primitives each with its own timing, owner, and result.
Build seller-protecting controls that make enforcement deterministic, transparent, and appeal-aware — including irreversible-action gates checked against active appeal state, undo/resume logic, and a single lifecycle-of-record so sellers never receive conflicting dates, channels, or instructions.
Scale the enforcement platform beyond compliance — partnering with policy, science, and marketplace teams to extend the model to any future use case that touches inventory, offers, orders, removals, or seller communication, while distinguishing reversible (Compliance-Pending) from irreversible (Disposition-Required) violations.
Lead cross-functional alignment across CPP/Policy Manager, DISCO, Paragon/AHD, Issue Store, AFT/TASC, FBA, and Retail on the action API contract, policy-authoring validation, and evaluation/enforcement grain alignment — transforming fragmented, downstream-owned enforcement into an automated, policy-driven system with zero unauthorized removals.

10+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Social Advertising
jobs.description:
Description

Have you ever discovered a product through a creator you follow on social media, then bought it on Amazon? Do you wonder how brands find the right creators to partner with at scale?

We are building a new social advertising product that helps brands find customers on social media apps through creators. As the Principal PMT for this new product, you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap. You'll define how brands discover high-affinity creators, how campaigns get activated, how creators get compensated, and how the whole system integrates with Amazon's existing advertising products (DSP, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Creator Ads). You need to be fluent in both worlds: how creators build audiences and monetize content on social platforms, AND how brands evaluate and buy media programmatically.

This is a 0-to-1 role. You would be building a new product from the ground up, working backwards from what brands and creators need to define how the product serves both customers and how it goes to market. If you have built creator tools, advertising products, or multi-sided marketplaces, and especially if you have done more than one of those, we want to talk.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities

As a Principal Product Manager-Technical for this new product, you will be responsible for building a new product at the intersection of the creator economy and advertising technology. To thrive in this role, you will need to demonstrate:

Bilateral Fluency: You understand both sides of the marketplace: how creators build audiences, create content, and monetize on social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) AND how brands evaluate, buy, and measure media programmatically. You can context-switch between a conversation about creator authenticity and one about ROAS measurement without losing either thread.
0-to-1 Builder Instinct: You are an expert at evaluating whether to take a scrappy approach or spend the time to build a durable solution. Every wrong call here costs precious time. You have a track record of getting this right consistently in ambiguous, early-stage environments where there is no playbook to follow.
Cross-Org Influence: This product delivers most of its value through other teams' systems. You will do significant away-team work in Ads, Associates, and external platform integrations. You earn trust from day one and maintain it through hard conversations where you push partner teams to do things they would not otherwise prioritize.
Data-Grounded Conviction: You use data to form strong opinions, state them clearly, and update them when evidence warrants. You do not hedge conclusions the data supports, and you do not overstate conclusions it does not.
Technical Depth: You can engage meaningfully with scientists on matching algorithms, with engineers on API design, and with ads teams on DSP integration architecture. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand the tradeoffs well enough to make product decisions that are technically sound.

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing creator-brand match quality metrics and slates of individual creators from yesterday's pilot cohort. A brand partner wants to understand why certain creators rank high for their category. You pull the attribution data and walk them through the quantitative signal: which creators are driving conversions for their brand, at what volume, and how that compares to their managed roster. You then shift to qualitative evaluation of the creator's content, audience fit, and brand alignment. Mid-morning, you're in a working session with the science team debating whether to weight recent conversion velocity or lifetime brand affinity more heavily in the matching algorithm. After lunch, you're drafting the integration spec for how campaigns for this new product will surface inside the DSP console, negotiating scope with the Ads PM who owns that surface. By end of day, you're reviewing creator compensation scenarios with the Associates team, making sure the economics work for the brand (willing to pay), the creator (worth their time), and Amazon (sustainable margin).

About The Team

The team is a small group of applied scientists, and engineers. We work across Amazon's creator ecosystem (Associates, Influencer Program, Creator Connections) and ads platform to build something that blends the best parts of both worlds. You would be joining at the stage where there is a solid data hypothesis and brand demand, but the core product decisions are yours to guide.

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of end to end product delivery experience
8+ years of technical product or program management experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience technical product management
Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
5+ years working in at least one of: creator/influencer platforms, social commerce, or affiliate marketing
Familiarity with at least one programmatic advertising platform (e.g., Amazon DSP, Google DV360, The Trade Desk, Meta Ads Manager)
Experience launching products in multi-sided marketplaces

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Direct experience in BOTH creator/social platforms AND advertising technology (the bilateral intersection is what makes this role unique)
Experience at a social platform (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest) or creator economy company (LTK, Impact, CreatorIQ, Grin)
Hands-on experience managing campaigns or building features within a programmatic advertising platform (not just familiarity)
Track record of taking a product from 0-to-1 (not just optimizing an existing product at scale)
Familiarity with affiliate marketing economics and creator compensation models

What if you could teach machines to make millions of delivery decisions — faster, smarter, and more efficiently than ever before? This isn't about incremental optimization. This is about building intelligent systems that autonomously orchestrate one of the most complex delivery networks on the planet — in real time, at massive scale.

You will define and drive the product roadmap for AI/ML-powered solutions across the Sub Same Day delivery network — from supply chain planning and real-time capacity allocation to delivery and anomaly detection. Description

The Opportunity

What if you could teach machines to make millions of delivery decisions — faster, smarter, and more efficiently than ever before? We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech who's obsessed with the intersection of artificial intelligence and real-world operations to join Amazon's Sub Same Day team. This isn't about incremental optimization. This is about building intelligent systems that autonomously orchestrate one of the most complex delivery networks on the planet — in real time, at massive scale.

You will define and drive the product roadmap for AI/ML-powered solutions across the Sub Same Day delivery network — from supply chain planning and real-time capacity allocation to delivery and anomaly detection. You'll identify high-impact business problems ripe for AI disruption, translate them into well-scoped technical product requirements, and build the business case to secure investment. Your multi-year product vision will leverage state-of-the-art techniques — large language models, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and graph neural networks — to fundamentally reimagine how last-mile delivery works at Amazon scale.

You will serve as the connective tissue between data scientists, system development engineers, business intelligence engineers — ensuring technical feasibility, architectural soundness, and delivery velocity. You'll own the end-to-end product lifecycle: from problem framing and data pipeline design through model development, A/B experimentation, production deployment, and continuous iteration. This means making hard trade-off decisions across model accuracy, latency, infrastructure cost, and customer experience — with a deep understanding of the technical constraints and opportunities. You'll drive technical debt reduction and platform scalability, ensuring AI systems are production-grade, fault-tolerant, and built for exponential growth.

You will partner with operations, logistics, finance, and science teams to ensure AI solutions are grounded in operational reality and deliver measurable business value. You'll influence senior leadership with data-driven narratives, translating complex ML concepts into clear strategic recommendations, and build scalable processes for feature prioritization, sprint planning, and release management across distributed engineering teams.

What Makes This Role Different

Your AI products will make decisions affecting millions of packages daily across Amazon's fastest-growing delivery channel. You'll work with large-scale ML platforms (SageMaker, custom training infrastructure), and production inference systems operating at sub-100ms latency. Sub Same Day is still early in its AI journey — you'll have the rare opportunity to define the foundational AI strategy from the ground up, not just optimize existing systems. From the data that feeds models to the customer experience those models create — you own the full stack of outcomes.

Lead the product strategy and roadmap for AI/ML initiatives in the Sub Same Day delivery network

Define and prioritize product requirements based on customer needs and business impact
Develop business cases and ROI analysis for new AI initiatives
Drive technical requirement gathering and documentation

Monitor key performance metrics and adjust strategies based on data-driven insights
Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts
Champion product innovations to senior leadership and key stakeholders

A day in the life

Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on Our Mission

As the Director of Patient Product Marketing, you'll be the strategic voice of the patient inside Zocdoc's Product Marketing organization. Reporting to our VP, Product Marketing, you'll own the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM strategy for the entire patient-facing portfolio–defining how millions of consumers discover, choose, and come to trust Zocdoc. In this role, you will lead and scale a high-performing team of PMMs, pairing deep market insights with visionary audience strategies that accelerate customer adoption and long-term business growth. By staying ahead of where healthcare is going, you’ll paint a clear picture of the future for patients while helping to shape our product strategy. Are energized by building and coaching a team of product marketers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role...

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Sr. Product Manager to join our team and lead the development and enhancement of our personalization services on HBO Max. As a Sr. Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in defining the product strategy, driving innovation, and delivering exceptional user experiences. Your expertise and leadership will guide the direction of personalized and automated recommendations, ensuring they remain at the forefront of industry trends and customer expectations.

Your efforts will help us scale to >100m customers and become the leading streaming company. You will identify and quantify customer problems, determine approaches to address them, and A/B test different features to solve them. You will be part of a team of Product Managers focused on Personalization, working closely with Software Engineers and Data Scientists.

The team has a diverse range of skill sets, experience in AI, Machine Learning, Recommenders, related fields across streaming media, e-commerce, and from top-flight tech firms. You will partner with Editorial and Marketing professionals and discuss regularly with company executives.

Your Role Accountabilities...

We’re seeking a seasoned Sr. Product Manager to lead personalization efforts at WBD. This role is central to our mission to create intelligent, adaptive, and trusted experiences across HBO Max. The ideal candidate has deep experience with ML-driven recommendation at scale, thrives in technically complex ecosystems, and is equally fluent in data science, user behavior, and business impact.
As a key contributor for personalization at WBD, you will:
Define Strategy:
Own the end-to-end product strategy for ML-powered personalization and discovery. Identify opportunities that align with WBD’s strategic goals and improve engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Drive Roadmap:
Lead roadmap development for personalization systems, coordinating closely with engineering, data science, UX, and content teams to prioritize initiatives that balance innovation, quality, and speed.
Evolve the User Experience:
Champion customer-centricity by leveraging experimentation, user research, and behavioral data to design and optimize personalized experiences across surfaces.
Orchestrate Systems Thinking:
Manage complex ranking systems and feedback loops. Understand how data (user signals, content metadata) flows through algorithms and influences outcomes across product surfaces.
Stakeholder Leadership:
Partner with executives, engineering leaders, data teams, and content strategists to align roadmaps, communicate outcomes, and translate vision into action.
Benchmark and Differentiate:
Monitor trends in personalization, ML tooling, and competitors’ discovery experiences to inform roadmap priorities and strategic pivots.
Measure Impact:
Define KPIs that align with both user value and business metrics (e.g., engagement, diversity, and relevance). Use experimentation and analytics to optimize performance and guide iteration.
Launch & Iterate:
Lead go-to-market for personalization & recommendation capabilities, ensuring internal readiness, high-quality rollout, and learning-based iteration cycles.

Qualifications & Experience...

5+ years of product management experience, with significant time spent on ML-driven products or content discovery systems.
Proven track record of shipping consumer-facing personalization or recommendation systems at scale.
Strong technical fluency—able to engage meaningfully with engineering and data science on ranking models, data pipelines, AI, and ML evaluation.
Deep understanding of A/B testing methodologies, statistical analysis, and product experimentation frameworks.
Systems thinker who can connect the dots between algorithmic performance, customer experience treatments, and business outcomes.
Excellent communicator who can synthesize complexity for a range of audiences, from executives to junior engineers.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in agile environments; familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (preferred but not required).

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $126,000.00 - $234,000.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

Senior Product Manager, OXO

Department:
Product Development

Work Location:
New York, NY Hybrid (work 3 days onsite)

Hybrid Schedule:
At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.

You are, or you will become, a specialist in the category and have an in-depth understanding of consumer behavior in the space. jobs.description:
About Beeline Medicines

Beeline Medicines is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing and delivering category-leading precision therapies to transform the lives of people living with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. With a portfolio of potential best-in-class and first-in-disease therapeutic candidates that directly target key pathways governing dysregulated immunological and inflammatory responses, the Company is developing medicines that have the opportunity to provide durable, life-changing impact. Led by an established executive team and backed by world-class life science investors, each day Beeline Medicines is determined to bring the scientific rigor and operational excellence to get to what matters for patients – realizing a world where people with immune-mediated diseases can live life fully.

Job Summary

The Director, CMC Product Development – Biologics is a senior technical and operational leader responsible for the end-to-end CMC development of biologics drug product candidates, from early formulation through process development, clinical supply, and regulatory submission. Reporting to the Executive Director, CMC Product Development, this individual drives the drug product development strategy for large molecule programs including monoclonal antibodies, fusion proteins, and other biologic modalities. This role works cross-functionally with Analytical Development, Drug Substance Process Development, Quality, Clinical Operations, and external CDMOs to ensure integrated, timeline-aligned delivery of all biologics drug product CMC activities.

Work Arrangement & Location:

Remote -
This position is designated as remote; the incumbent will be expected to travel to Beeline Medicines’ offices on a periodic basis to support in-person collaboration, team engagement, and business operations. The frequency and scheduling of such visits will be determined at the company's discretion based on business need.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Define and execute the biologics drug product development strategy, encompassing formulation development, fill-finish process development, primary container-closure selection, and device development where applicable.
Lead formulation development activities for protein-based therapeutics, including excipient screening, formulation optimization, forced degradation, and compatibility studies.
Oversee drug product process development and scale-up, including fill-finish requirements, technology transfer to CDMO partners, process characterization, and validation readiness.
Author and review biologics drug product sections of regulatory submissions (IND, BLA, Type A/B meeting packages) and lead or support FDA/EMA interactions on drug product CMC topics.
Select and technically govern CDMO partners responsible for biologics drug product manufacture, including clinical supply chain coordination, change control oversight, and deviation management.
Collaborate with Analytical Development to define drug product release and stability specifications, in-process controls, and comparability strategies for process and formulation changes.
Partner with Clinical Operations and Supply Chain to ensure uninterrupted clinical supply across Phase 1–3 trials, including labeling, packaging, and cold chain logistics planning.
Integrate Quality by Design (QbD) principles, Design of Experiments (DoE), and risk management tools into biologics drug product development decisions.
Evaluate novel drug delivery technologies, and device requirements as applicable to the biologics pipeline, including prefilled syringe and autoinjector platforms.
Contribute to CMC due diligence assessments and portfolio planning by evaluating the manufacturability and development feasibility of biologic drug product candidates.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Education: Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
10+ years of CMC biologics experience with demonstrated expertise in drug product formulation and/or fill-finish process development in pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry
Deep technical expertise in biologics formulation science, including protein stability, aggregation mitigation, excipient selection, lyophilization cycle development, and container-closure systems.
Comprehensive knowledge of ICH Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11, relevant biologics CMC guidelines (Q5A–Q5E), and FDA/EMA drug product development expectations; experience authoring BLA drug product sections.
Proven experience managing biologics drug product CDMO relationships, including technical oversight of fill-finish operations, process scale-up, process qualification, and commercial readiness.
Experience with lyophilized and liquid formulation development for parenteral biologics, including primary packaging compatibility and extractables/leachable considerations.
Working knowledge of biologics drug substance processes (upstream/downstream) sufficient to effectively partner with Drug Substance teams on interface activities and integrated CMC planning.
Proven track record of operating effectively in pre-commercial, resource-constrained environments — balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution and infrastructure building.
Experience managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships at the senior level, with the ability to influence without authority and align diverse teams around shared program goals.
Exceptional ability to translate complex CMC biologics science into clear, decision-ready narratives for executive leadership, cross-functional partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring high-quality regulatory documents, scientific reports, and executive-level presentations.
Collaborative communication style with the ability to establish trust quickly across Research, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and external partners in a matrixed organization.

Salary Range

Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable local law. A discretionary annual bonus and long-term incentive award (e.g., equity) may be available based on individual and Company performance.

Job Title:
Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience

Location:
Remote, USA

About The Company

Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com.

About The Role

As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners.

You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering.

What You'll Do (Job Duties/Responsibilities)

Strategy & Vision

Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product
Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making
Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through
Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale

Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution

Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur
Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations
Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data
Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration

Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders
Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike
Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers

Who You Are (Job Qualifications)

8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process
Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different
Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations
Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production
Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well
Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy
A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast

Skills & Competencies

Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work
Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model
Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions
Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design
Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction
Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric
High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment

Experience aligning product strategies to content calendars, franchise launches, and major brand moments.

Strategic, commercially driven and decisive.

Deep respect for creative storytelling, brand integrity and guest experience.

Collaborative, influential, and confident at executive and board level.

Sustained growth in retail revenue, margin and inventory efficiency.

Creative excellence and franchise alignment across all product ranges.

A scalable, resilient global product organization with strong succession planning

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Partner Search
jobs.description:
Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

Director, Product Management, Partner Search

A Little About Us

Yahoo Search helps millions of people find information, answers, products, services, and inspiration across the web. In addition to our owned and operated Search experiences, Yahoo powers Search for a broad ecosystem of third-party distribution partners across browsers, software, APIs, and other consumer and B2B experiences.

The Partner Search team is responsible for growing and evolving that ecosystem. We build products and platform capabilities that help partners deliver high-quality Search experiences, grow user engagement and lifetime value, improve monetization, and scale their businesses with Yahoo. The team works at the intersection of consumer Search, partner platforms, APIs, monetization, traffic quality, data, and business development.

About The Role

We are seeking a Director of Product Management, Partner Search
to lead product strategy and execution for Yahoo’s third-party Search business.

This is a hands-on product leadership role that combines individual product ownership with people management. You will manage a small team of Product Managers while also directly owning a meaningful product area. Together, the team will be responsible for growing partner traffic and revenue, improving retention and lifetime value, increasing monetization, and making Yahoo’s partner Search platform more scalable and differentiated.

You will define product strategy across partner experiences, Search distribution, APIs, data and reporting, monetization, and platform capabilities. You will also identify and develop new B2B products and distribution opportunities that expand how partners can work with Yahoo.

The role requires strong commercial judgment, technical fluency, and comfort working directly with external partners. You will partner closely with Business Development and Partner Management, while serving as the senior Product counterpart in partner discussions, shaping joint product opportunities, diagnosing performance issues, and translating partner needs into scalable Yahoo products.

We are looking for someone who can operate like a product GM for the partner Search portfolio: setting direction, developing new ideas, driving measurable growth, coaching PMs, and personally getting into the details of product, data, APIs, traffic quality, monetization, and partner performance.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and performance of Yahoo’s Partner Search portfolio, with accountability for partner traffic, revenue, retention, lifetime value, monetization, and platform scalability.
Lead and develop a small team of Product Managers while personally owning a meaningful product area and remaining deeply engaged in product discovery, prioritization, execution, and performance.
Develop a deep understanding of distribution partners, their users, business models, traffic sources, and economics, using partner feedback, product data, market context, and performance trends to identify the highest-value opportunities.
Define product strategy for third-party Search experiences, balancing partner needs, end-user value, platform scalability, traffic quality, and Yahoo business objectives.
Improve partner configurability and flexibility across Search experiences, features, branding, data, APIs, and integrations, while avoiding excessive operational or technical complexity.
Drive initiatives that improve user retention, engagement, search volume, and lifetime value across distributed traffic, identifying and testing the product levers that strengthen repeat usage and partner economics.
Optimize monetization across partner experiences through new features, Search experience improvements, traffic and query optimization, and other product levers that improve revenue while maintaining partner and user value.
Identify, prototype, and launch new B2B Search products and distribution opportunities, including new partner capabilities, commercial experiences, APIs, and product models that expand Yahoo’s addressable market.
Build scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off partner solutions, including partner data and reporting, Search and XML APIs, syndication capabilities, configuration frameworks, and reusable platform services.
Own and improve critical partner ecosystem capabilities related to traffic quality, integrity, and compliance, including areas such as chain of custody, invalid traffic, domain matching, parked domain traffic, and partner traffic governance.
Use experimentation and performance measurement to guide decisions, define success metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and continuously identify new monetization and growth “jolts” across the partner portfolio.
Partner closely with Business Development, Partner Management, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Monetization, Legal, Privacy, and other teams to launch new capabilities and improve existing partner integrations.
Serve as a senior Product counterpart to strategic partners, helping shape joint product roadmaps, identify new opportunities, diagnose issues, and translate partner-specific needs into scalable product investments.
Monitor the health and evolution of the partner portfolio across adoption, traffic quality, retention, monetization, partner satisfaction, competitive dynamics, and platform cost to determine where to invest, simplify, or change direction.

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of Product Management or equivalent experience, including significant experience building and scaling consumer, platform, partner, distribution, or monetization products, with proven experience managing PMs and driving large-scale platform or distribution portfolios.
Experience leading Product Managers while continuing to operate as a hands-on product leader with direct ownership of meaningful product scope.
Demonstrated success growing a product or business through improvements in traffic, engagement, retention, lifetime value, revenue, monetization, or distribution.
Experience working with external partners in a B2B2C, platform, syndication, distribution, OEM, browser, marketplace, or similar ecosystem.
Strong product and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand partner economics, identify new growth opportunities, and balance partner needs with end-user and business outcomes.
Technical fluency sufficient to work deeply with engineers on APIs, partner integrations, data flows, platform architecture, experimentation systems, traffic quality, and scalable configuration capabilities.
Strong analytical skills and experience using product data, experimentation, cohort analysis, retention, LTV, traffic quality, and monetization metrics to guide product decisions.
Demonstrated ability to translate individual partner needs into scalable platform products rather than relying on one-off custom solutions.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to work directly with senior external partners and communicate product strategy, performance, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executives.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, identify new product opportunities, and move fluidly between long-term strategy and detailed product execution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Search distribution, sponsored Search, Search syndication, browser or OEM distribution, or other large-scale third-party Search ecosystems.
Experience building or managing Search APIs, XML APIs, syndication products, developer platforms, or APIs designed for third-party product integration.
Familiarity with Search monetization, RPM optimization, advertiser economics, traffic quality, invalid traffic, domain matching, parked domains, or related Search marketplace concepts.
Experience building configurable B2B or B2B2C platforms that support multiple partner types, business models, and integration patterns.
Experience developing new partner-facing products or commercial models that created incremental distribution, revenue, or strategic value.
A track record of generating fresh product ideas, testing new growth and monetization opportunities, and turning successful concepts into scalable products.

The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Agentic Workflows
jobs.description:
We’re Changing the PropTech Industry

We’re a profitable, growth-stage company building industry-leading martech and data products for the PropTech space. Our focus is on our category-leading AI and data SaaS products with triple-digit growth rates.

We’re a fully remote team of 100+ spread across the U.S. from coast to coast. We operate on a strict no a**holes policy and are proud to have built a community of highly performant people that take our work seriously, but not ourselves. And, we're looking for exceptional people to help further accelerate our growth.

While we’ve raised $30MM+ to date from some of the world’s best investors, we’re profitable with a strong balance sheet and an indefinite runway. We pride ourselves on achieving rapid growth without having to incinerate capital.

About Our Products

ApartmentIQ is the all-in-one data platform powering smarter decisions across multifamily—covering 40M units with daily property and market intelligence used for surveys, research, and revenue management. We're trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI, delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to lead a new AI-native initiative. This is a 0-to-1 role: You’ll move from customer conversation to shipped product faster than most companies write a spec, work directly with customers, and build alongside product leadership, design, and engineering. We want someone who thinks like a product leader and can also get their hands dirty with design, prototyping, and rapid iteration. If you’ve been called “the person who just gets things built,” this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Own the product line end to end — from discovery and positioning through launch and adoption
Decide where models belong in the experience and where they don’t — the judgment calls that separate a product that is genuinely AI-native from AI bolted onto reporting
Ship fast. Write specs, design workflows, build prototypes, and work side-by-side with designers and engineers to get features into production
Design evaluation frameworks to systematically measure output quality — build test suites, analyze answer patterns and edge cases, and use those signals to iteratively improve performance
Define and validate the guardrails that make the product’s output safe, explainable, and trustworthy when real dollars ride on it
Shape the data foundation the product stands on — what we need, what has to be normalized, and which questions that finally lets us answer
Stand up customer feedback loops (weekly cadences with key accounts across operators, asset managers, and ownership groups) and use those signals to prioritize ruthlessly
Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and our existing product teams to make sure the product lands well and drives adoption

What We’re Looking For

Builder mentality over pedigree. We care about what you’ve shipped and how quickly
9+ years in product management at a high-growth startup or tech company — including at least one product you owned from 0-to-1, end to end
Shipped 0-to-1 products that customers actually use — not just features on a roadmap slide. Founder and co-founder backgrounds encouraged
Strong product instincts with design sensibility
Fluency in leading customer discovery and translating messy qualitative feedback into clear product direction
Experience defining quality metrics and building evaluation loops — you’ve measured whether something is working and used those signals to make it better
Hands-on with LLMs: A large part of this job is the model layer, so ideally you have built with modern AI tools or have a track record of learning new technology fast
Bias to action and iteration over perfection and process
A background in BI, analytics, or data platforms is welcome if you’re clear-eyed that this generation of the category gets built differently
Proptech, multifamily, or real estate experience is a plus but not required

Why Choose Us

Remote-First:
We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You’ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.
Competitive Compensation:
We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You’ll receive a
competitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.
Paid Time Off:
Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family’s biggest milestones.
Your Health Matters
: Stay healthy with high-quality Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Peace of Mind (On Us):
We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.
Protection for Your Whole Crew:
Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.
Invest in Your Future:
Secure your financial goals with our 401k Program, helping you build for the long term while you help us build the company.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Endpoint Security and XDR
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.

What You Will Be Doing:

Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.
Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.
Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.
Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.
Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.
Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.
Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.
Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

What You Bring:

Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.
Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.
Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.
A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.
A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.
A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.
Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

Bonus Points:

Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.
Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.
Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.
Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.
A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.
Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Security & Privacy Responsibilities:
Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. jobs.title: Director, FX and Money Markets Operations Product Owner - COO Group
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Royal Bank of Canada is seeking an experienced Director-level professional to serve as Product Owner for FX and Money Markets Operations. This strategic role leverages significant domain knowledge of FX markets, trading workflows, and post-trade processes to shape RBC's operations in this key business line. You will oversee the development and management of our client-facing FX platform, translate operational needs into technical solutions, and ensure regulatory and operational compliance. This position drives operational efficiency, automation, and settlement risk mitigation while collaborating with front-office stakeholders to ensure operational readiness for ongoing industry transformation and evolving regulatory environments. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a lasting impact on one of RBC's most critical business functions.

What will you do?

Drive a modern FX and Money Markets global operations platform and manage the product backlog; collaborate across teams to implement features supporting trade lifecycle, risk mitigation, and compliance
Develop and implement efficient processes aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements; design solutions optimizing FX and Money Markets processing across multiple venues and asset types
Establish and track key performance indicators and service level agreements for settlement volumes, cycle times, exception rates, and operational efficiency gains; conduct regular process reviews and root cause analysis of settlement failures
Assess emerging technologies (AI, blockchain, real-time settlement capabilities) for potential adoption and support platform enhancements, system migration, and regulatory audits
Collaborate with internal departments (front-office, middle-office risk, compliance) to streamline FX and Money Markets processes; serve as escalation point for complex problems and client inquiries
Build and manage relationships with external infrastructure providers (CLS Net, DTCC, counterparties); deliver monthly and ad-hoc reporting on settlement metrics, operational risks, and regulatory compliance
Stay updated on industry regulations and regulatory developments across all jurisdictions; ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements related to settlements; manage regulatory examinations and audits
Serve as subject matter expert on FX and Money Markets operations processes; advise front-office, risk, compliance, and technology teams; lead strategic projects such as FX Modernization readiness and settlement infrastructure upgrades.

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have:

Minimum 10–15 years of progressive experience in capital markets operations, with substantive exposure to FX and Money Markets operations
Proven track record leading operational transformation initiatives, including process redesign and change management
Strong understanding of trade settlement, clearing mechanics, payments, regulatory frameworks (including post-trade regulatory regimes), and operational risk management across multiple jurisdictions
Demonstrated experience navigating technology transitions and managing operational readiness for significant market infrastructure changes
Exceptional leadership and communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively across large, diverse, matrixed teams; proven ability to translate complex operational matters for senior leadership and regulators.

Nice-to-have:

MBA or equivalent advanced degree in Finance, Business Administration, or related field

jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Product Design
to join our Fund and Investor Solutions team. This role is based in New York, NY.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer with experience working with, defining, and designing complex systems to bring creativity, strategic insight, and user-centered thinking to our team. This role requires an individual who excels in collaboration, design execution, and the ability to drive impactful user experiences.

The Ideal Candidate Will Bring the Following Expertise

Craft

User-Centered Design – Lead with a user-first approach, ensuring all design choices address user needs, behaviors, and insights from research. Drive a seamless and intuitive product experience by deeply understanding our users.
Journey Mapping – Map and analyze end-to-end user journeys across customers, operations, servicing teams and systems to identify pain points, key moments, and opportunities for improvement. Use journey maps to align teams on a shared vision of user needs, ensuring a cohesive and supportive experience at each stage.
Interaction and UI Design – Demonstrates mastery in designing complex web interfaces and workflows, creating products that are both highly functional and visually engaging. Skilled in developing intuitive layouts, navigation patterns, and interaction models for intricate systems. Thoughtfully uses animation and micro-interactions to guide users, making complex tasks more approachable and enhancing the overall product experience.
Proficiency in Design Tools – Possess advanced skills in tools such as Figma and Miro, to create high-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, and mockups that clearly communicate interaction models and UI specifications.

Systems thinking

Design System Knowledge – Experience with and contribute to a global design system that ensures visual consistency across interfaces. Develop workflow patterns and components that can then be reused by other teams.
Complex Systems Knowledge – Bring an understanding of the unique challenges of designing and maintaining complex systems, with an ability to distill intricate requirements into clear design solutions that facilitate user understanding and interaction.

Collaboration and Communication

Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to align design efforts with business goals, transforming complex requirements into clear, functional design solutions that respect technical constraints.
Effective Communication and Storytelling – Articulate design concepts and rationale to diverse stakeholders, making complex ideas accessible. Use storytelling to engage others in the product vision, fostering alignment and enthusiasm.

Mentorship and Leadership

Skilled in guiding junior designers, providing constructive feedback, and elevating team standards. Fosters a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration within the team.

A portfolio is required to be considered for this position

A portfolio is required and should demonstrate strong interaction design, systems thinking, and experience working in complex or ambiguous problem spaces. A Figma link with view access is acceptable.

Experience

Typically, a candidate at this level will have 12+ years of experience
designing digital products, including time spent on complex, enterprise, or regulated systems. Prior domain expertise is less important than demonstrated ability to learn new domains and apply strong design principles effectively.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

Objectives – The Problems You’ll Solve

First 45 Days: Establish a Clear Point of View on the Lending Market and Where We Can Win

Objective
:

Clarify the lending segments where we see the most natural fit — by institution size, lending model, workflow maturity, and operational pain points.
Evaluate early customer usage to identify which workflows deliver real value and which rely on workarounds or heavy services.
Review deal histories, renewals, and stalled opportunities to understand our true buying triggers, hesitation points, and perceived gaps.
Build a concise, data-backed point of view on where Lending’s traction is credible and where it remains unproven.
Identify the 2–3 lending workflows most likely to anchor early product-market fit.

First 90 Days: Define the Lending Strategy in a Way That Scales Beyond Individual Deals

Objective
:
Turn early traction into a strategy that internal teams can understand and execute consistently.

Create the first version of the Lending strategy narrative: who the product is for, what problems we focus on first, and what outcomes we commit to delivering.
Establish simple product-market fit indicators (adoption moments, activation patterns, renewal signals) and socialize them across Product, CS, and Sales.
Position Lending relative to competitive alternatives (manual processes, LOS add-ons, BPO/consultants) with clarity about where we win.
Work with Product Marketing to turn findings into practical talk tracks and discovery flows that accurately reflect lender realities.
Align teams on what we are not pursuing yet to protect focus and prevent dilution of early wins.

First 180 Days: Create Repeatable Value Delivery for the First Credible ICP

Objective
:
Prove that we can consistently deliver value to a defined lender segment, not as isolated wins but as repeatable outcomes.

Shape the roadmap around the workflows that matter most to the chosen ICP; reduce distractions from adjacent, unvalidated requests.
Identify and close the most painful early gaps, e.g., missing workflow steps, data handoff inconsistencies, configuration friction, or dependency gaps.
With CS and Implementation, define and test the “first 90 days of value” plan for Lending accounts, iterating as needed.
Capture evidence from early implementations: time to value, iteration cycles, customer satisfaction, and reference ability.
Ensure the product experience clearly communicates workflow value, exceptions, data movement, and outcomes.

First 360 Days: Turn a Promising Product Into a Scalable Lending Line

Objective
:
Set the trajectory for Lending to become a durable growth engine.

Show credible movement across product-market fit signals: repeatable wins in a defined ICP, stronger renewal health, more consistent usage patterns, and fewer surprises in deals.
Maintain a forward-looking roadmap that deepens workflow quality where we have traction and cautiously expands into adjacent steps where customers are already pulling us.
Partner with Revenue leadership to align product capabilities with realistic commercial expectations and ensure pipeline assumptions reflect what the product can actually deliver.
Validate a small number of expansion opportunities (adjacent lending workflows or new institutional segments) based on real customer demand.
Become the central voice for the Lending line and be clear on what Lending is for, why we are focusing where we are, and how the product will evolve to reinforce early signals.

Strategic thinking

Understands how lenders manage workflows, risk, and compliance, and turns that insight into a sequenced strategy for building product-market fit.

Analytical

Differentiates real traction from noise using customer behavior, adoption patterns, and deal signals; builds simple measures to track product-market fit progress.

Engages deeply with lenders to uncover true operational needs and turns these into meaningful product decisions.

Follow-through

Turns strategy into deliberate, high-importance workflow depth and reliable delivery, shaping early implementations that confirm or challenge the plan.
