Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in!

Our Product Managers (PMs) have ownership over product optimizations and features, from independently run experiments to major product decisions. Backed by strong analytical skills and business acumen, and inspired by access to senior leadership and transparency into how they make product decisions, our PMs develop insights that lead to new product ideas and Duolingo’s next beloved feature.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

About The Role...

Come and be a product lead within our Growth Pillar. Growth is core to our mission at Duolingo; helping users find and build a habit with language learning is tied to our ability to make the product fun and engaging every single day. We work on a wide variety of features that build and strengthen habits, like streaks, quests, leaderboards, notifications, and are always inventing new features to address user needs.

You’ll own product strategy and execution across a broad set of opportunities to improve our user retention, with an eye towards DAUs as our north star. Our app is extremely visual, so you’ll work closely with Product Design and Product Writing to make sure users understand and appreciate any new feature, and you’ll work closely with Engineering to understand how we bring it to life. We’re looking for someone who can work cross-functionally to develop new ideas, run fast experiments, and turn what we learn into product strategy that helps more learners build lasting habits.

🧠 You will...

Own product strategy and execution for a new growth team, from identifying opportunities to shipping and iterating on solutions
Drive the team’s roadmap across high-impact workstreams, with DAUs as the north star
Lead product features through their full lifecycle: ideation, prioritization, specification, development, launch, analysis, and iteration
Work closely with engineers, data scientists, ML/AI partners, product writers, and designers to create more retentive experiences ￼ ￼
Improve core team metrics such as retention (short and long term), L7, and relevant feature adoption / usage
Partner closely with leadership to help shape the direction of one of Duolingo’s top teams for driving top-line impact

Experience generating outstanding results as a Product Manager on a consumer mobile product
Significant experience working on growth or growth-adjacent product surfaces, ideally owning DAU/WAU or retention metrics
Experience owning product strategy and execution for a growth-related feature, including identifying new opportunities, prioritizing work, and driving launches from concept through iteration
Strong product instincts and analytical judgment, with the ability to use experiments and data to make meaningful decisions
Ability to independently drive alignment and make progress in ambiguous spaces without waiting to be told what to do
Excitement about moving quickly, learning from fast experimentation, and shaping product strategy
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Design, Psychology, or equivalent

Advanced degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, Psychology, or equivalent
Experience working on consumer products with high-frequency engagement loops (e.g., health, wellness, fitness, mobile games) ￼
Strong judgment for how to balance short and long term retention, particularly in a freemium app with monetization (either IAPs or subscriptions) as a guardrail

About Sotheby's

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

The Senior Product Manager will support the VP of Product in owning, defining and driving the product roadmap for this new initiative, translating the business case into a shippable platform across a sequence of releases. This role will work closely with the VP of Product, engineering, design and the broader founding team to convert the product vision into precise requirements, sequenced releases and a defensible build-versus-buy point of view across the core platform. The ideal candidate is a motivated, detail-oriented operator who is comfortable running point on a complex, multi-workstream launch, translating ambiguity into a scoped roadmap, and partnering with a small, senior team to ship a premium product on a fixed date.

Responsibilities

Support the VP of Product in owning and maintaining the product roadmap across a sequence of major releases and the backlog beyond.
Run day-to-day agile ceremonies and stakeholder meetings across product, engineering, design and the wider operating team; track work in progress and unblock the delivery team.
Write precise, concise product requirements and specifications for core platform domains (identity, access, booking, payments, member services, CRM) in partnership with design and engineering.
Develop and maintain a point of view on build, buy or hybrid for each platform domain, and manage the resulting vendor and integration decisions behind a controlled interface layer.
Partner with membership, experience and service delivery leadership to ensure the platform supports the end-to-end member journey.
Own content-architecture and discovery requirements for member-facing editorial, ensuring it is structured for both member consumption and long-term platform needs.
Lead working sessions to make key decisions, remove obstacles and surface risks against a fixed launch timeline, escalating trade-offs to the VP of Product with clear recommendations.
Develop strong working partnerships with cross-functional leaders (Marketing, Finance, Legal) to keep the platform aligned to business objectives and launch dates.
Take on both tactical and strategic work depending on team needs, from Agile ceremony facilitation to stakeholder workshops and executive-ready materials.

Ideal Experience & Competencies

4–6 years of product management experience in e-commerce, membership, hospitality or technology platforms, ideally including at least one 0-to-1 or ground-up product launch.
Demonstrated interest in art, luxury or cultural institutions; an undergraduate degree in a technical field or a quantitative discipline is a strong plus.
Comfortable operating against a fixed, externally-driven launch date across multiple parallel workstreams (identity, booking, payments, content, CRM).
Organized, collaborative and flexible, able to work calmly and professionally under time-sensitive deadlines with a small, senior team.
Persuasive, with excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write requirements a stranger could build from.
Logical problem solver with strong attention to detail and a data-first mindset, including familiarity with engagement scoring, retention or CRM-driven product work.
Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and managing third-party vendors behind a defined interface layer.
Listens well to stakeholders and business owners while staying focused on delivering a high-quality, premium member experience.
Nimble with requirements gathering, analysis and documentation; and knows standard product management frameworks.
Functions well in an agile environment and has prior experience with cross-platform digital transformation projects.
Comfortable working on a confidential, pre-announcement initiative and maintaining discretion outside the immediate team.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $140,000-$150,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered.

jobs.description:
About Traba

Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain.

We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships.

But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale.

We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses.

You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0-to-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them.

This role reports directly to our VP of Product.

What You’ll Do

Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform
Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities
Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams
Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners
Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work
Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance
Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions
Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture
Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact
Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback

What We’re Looking For

Real agent builder.
You have launched customer-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously.

0-to-1 operator.
You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists.

AI-native problem solver.
You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs.

First-principles thinker.
You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks.

Customer-embedded builder.
You believe the best products are built shoulder-to-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer-embedded product development models is highly valued.

Technical depth.
You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details.

Builder mentality.
Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process.

Deeply collaborative.
You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life.

What You’ll Bring

5 – 7 years of experience as a Product Manager
Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes
Experience building AI-native products or customer-facing agent systems
Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams
Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas
Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles
Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience building with modern AI systems
Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area
A strong work ethic and desire to build a category-defining company

Benefits

📈 Start-up equity
💰 Competitive Salary
🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage
🍽️ Dinner Provided via Grubhub & stocked kitchen for NY employees
🚍 Commuter benefit
🎤 Team building events
🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit
🌴 Flexible PTO
✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health

Salary Range Details

The compensation range for this position is set between $180,000 and $210,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long-term success and upside of the business.

The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high-performing team in a fast-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real-time decision-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem-solving that drives meaningful impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.

Our Values

Dream Big -
We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic -
Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset -
We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

Customer Obsession -
We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, investment management, and wealth management services to clients worldwide. Digital Client Experience & Platforms is building secure, scalable, and intuitive client-facing capabilities that help protect clients, enable digital adoption, and support trusted engagement across web and mobile channels.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product Manager to own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for client platform Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This leader will serve as a builder-operator for a critical identity and security platform, delivering secure-by-design authentication capabilities that protect clients while preserving a seamless digital experience. The role requires strong product judgment, execution discipline, and the ability to align engineering, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, legal, compliance, design, operations, and channel stakeholders around a measurable roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Platform Ownership

Own the MFA product vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly delivery plans across web, mobile, and shared client platform capabilities.
Define reusable authentication capabilities, adoption patterns, and integration standards that can scale across multiple client journeys and channel teams.
Translate security, fraud, regulatory, and client experience objectives into clear product outcomes, prioritized features, and measurable success criteria.
Develop the target-state roadmap for enrollment, step-up authentication, trusted devices, device binding, recovery, factor management, and channel migration.

Delivery, Execution & Operating Discipline

Lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, operations, design, and channel product teams from discovery through production launch.
Convert product strategy into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and launch readiness artifacts.
Manage dependencies across identity, session management, device intelligence, fraud decisioning, client servicing, contact center tooling, and digital channels.
Drive disciplined product rituals including prioritization, backlog grooming, stakeholder reviews, delivery governance, testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.

Risk, Controls, Privacy & Governance

Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Fraud Operations, Chief Data Office/Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure MFA capabilities meet internal control standards and external regulatory expectations.
Own product documentation and governance artifacts, including risk assessments, control mappings, audit evidence, exception handling, change approvals, and operational readiness materials.
Embed privacy, consent, data minimization, resiliency, and auditability considerations into product design and delivery decisions.

Client Experience, Adoption & Operational Excellence

Optimize MFA experiences to reduce friction while maintaining strong protection, including prompt frequency, factor choice, enrollment completion, recovery flows, accessibility, and servicing escalation paths.
Partner with UX research, design, analytics, and servicing teams to validate journeys, identify drop-off drivers, and improve client and advisor outcomes.
Define production health expectations, including observability, incident readiness, defect prioritization, operational playbooks, and post-launch performance reviews.
Coordinate rollout, communications, training, and change management with digital channels, field/service organizations, and support teams.

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Define and track product, risk, and operational KPIs including MFA enrollment rate, challenge success rate, authentication latency, factor adoption, step-up frequency, fraud loss reduction, account takeover indicators, recovery completion, contact drivers, and defect trends.
Use data, client feedback, incident learnings, and control findings to continuously improve the roadmap and quantify risk reduction, resiliency, and experience gains.

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of product management experience, including ownership of platform capabilities used by multiple applications, channels, or teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering authentication, identity, security, fraud, risk, or client protection products in a regulated environment; financial services experience strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of MFA methods and tradeoffs, including push, OTP, authenticator apps, device binding, trusted devices, account recovery, biometric-enabled flows, FIDO2/WebAuthn, and risk-based or adaptive authentication.
Proven ability to influence and execute across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, compliance, legal, design, analytics, operations, and senior business stakeholders.
Experience defining product metrics, analyzing performance data, and using evidence to prioritize roadmap investments and operational improvements.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting roadmap decisions, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs, and funding needs to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity standards and protocols such as OAuth/OIDC and SAML, and familiarity with modern web and mobile authentication patterns.
Experience with device intelligence, fraud decisioning, risk scoring, account takeover prevention, or AI-enabled risk signal integration.
Experience improving account recovery, identity proofing, client support tooling, and operational workflows for identity-related issues.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, agile delivery practices, governance forums, and product financials or investment planning.

Core Competencies

Platform-first product strategy and roadmap ownership
Security-by-design mindset balanced with client experience outcomes
Structured execution, delivery governance, and operational discipline
Risk, controls, privacy, and compliance fluency
Data-driven decision-making, measurement, and continuous improvement
Executive communication, stakeholder influence, and cross-functional leadership

jobs.description:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

About The Role

The Marketplace is where MoneyLion customers see their financial options and act on them. It brings together MoneyLion's own money tools and a wide range of partner products, and customers count on us for the full picture and a clear sense of what actually fits their situation. We care a lot about the trust customers extend to us, and about turning it into long-term relationships that grow with them as their financial lives change.

As Principal Product Manager, you'll take on the hardest, highest-stakes problems in the Marketplace, including the cross-cutting ones that shape where it heads and that no single team fully owns today. You'll set direction in your area and influence it well beyond, working through other teams as much as with your own. This is a hands-on role — you'll be in the details with your team day to day, not directing from a distance. The space is moving quickly, so reading customer and market signal and turning it into the bets we make next is a core part of the job. You'll report to the Director of Product.

Key Responsibilities

Own the most complex, cross-cutting problems in the Marketplace from problem to launch to iteration, and be accountable for how they move customer and business outcomes.
Set the strategy and roadmap for your area, and make the case for the bets worth making.
Take on ambiguous problems before they're well defined. Frame them so other teams can move in parallel, and set the direction they build against.
Work closely with design, engineering, and data science to ship, and partner with research and analytics to understand what customers actually do.
Build buy-in across the company, and collaborate with partners and adjacent teams (covering both B2C and B2B).
Raise the bar for product craft around you.
Use experimentation to learn quickly and iterate.
Have a real point of view on where AI belongs in the Marketplace, from more personal and timely guidance to experiences customers trust with their money.
Use AI as a teammate in your day-to-day to raise product quality and team speed.

Experience

About you:

8+ years of product management experience, including consumer apps, with a track record of taking hard, ambiguous problems from unclear to shipped and scaled.

What You'll Bring

A strong feel for UX and what "good" is for consumers, and the judgment to push for it.
Fluency with data. You use it to find problems, size opportunities, and decide, and you know when the numbers aren't enough.
An experimentation mindset. You'd rather test a real question than argue about it.
Comfortable driving work across teams you don't own.
Hands-on experience using AI in your own workflow, and a point of view on where it belongs in the product.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build alignment across teams.
Experience building B2C products.

Nice To Have

Background in fintech, or in another regulated, trust-heavy consumer space such as insurance or healthcare.
Experience with marketplace products.
B2B exposure, or familiarity partnering with B2B-facing teams.

Personal Attributes

Genuinely curious about personal finance and how people make decisions about money.
Highly empathetic. You start from the customer's situation, not the feature.
At home with complexity and a natural systems thinker. You can hold a lot of moving parts in your head and reason about how they connect.
Tuned in to where consumer software is heading and what the best products are doing.
Comfortable when the path isn't fully mapped, and willing to do the unglamorous work to unblock the team.

Location: New York, NY (Onsite 3 days per week)

Compensation

The annual base salary for this position is expected to be between $200,000 and $250,000. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes 401(k) match, health insurance options, disability coverage, life insurance, and unlimited paid time off. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies related to the role.

What’s Next

Your CV will be reviewed together by the recruiter and hiring manager to assess the scope of your role, the impact you’ve delivered, and how your experience aligns with the position. If shortlisted, the recruiter will invite you to an initial Zoom conversation to discuss your background, what’s compelling you to Gen, and walk you through the interview process.

Important Application Note – When you apply, please include your current city and country and let us know your work status (e.g. visa status, right to work in the relevant country, etc.).

Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

Interview Process

TA Screen
Assignment
Hiring Manager Interview
Cross-Functional Panel (individual interviews with Design, Engineering Lead, and Data/Marketing)
Executive Interview

Company Description

About the Team:

CRM Voice AI builds autonomous voice agents for customer service that resolve customer interactions end-to-end and drive significant value for the business. We're a team inside ServiceNow's CRM business unit, shipping production voice AI with enterprise customers today and scaling aggressively. Our agents run on a real-time streaming pipeline with best-in-class ASR, TTS, and LLM orchestration, integrated into the same platform where many of our customers already manage their front, middle, and back-office workflows. For those that don't, the voice agent is often the tip of the spear that brings them in. We compete directly against well-funded AI startups and CCaaS incumbents, and we're winning.

Job Description

How We Work:

We work in pods - small, dedicated teams embedded with a single enterprise customer, building their voice agents from first call to self-sufficiency. A pod owns the full lifecycle: agent shadowing, conversation design, build, production go-live, and the handoff that makes the customer self-sufficient so the pod can move on to the next one. Each pod pairs forward-deployed engineers with a product manager who owns both the customer outcome and the product learning that comes from it.

Every PM on this team runs at least one pod directly and has visibility across others. You're in the customer's world - on their calls, in their systems, solving their problems - while simultaneously shaping what the product becomes. The learnings from your pods feed directly into the platform roadmap and into repeatable, productized assets that scale beyond any single customer.

What This Role Owns

You run two pods closely - hands-on through the full build lifecycle with two enterprise customers simultaneously, from agent shadowing through production go-live. You'll become one of the most experienced people in the company at knowing what it actually takes to ship a voice agent that works in the real world.
Your second area of focus is the tooling and intelligence layer that makes voice agents better and easier to build. This spans automated evaluation frameworks (how do we systematically measure whether a voice agent is good?), analytics (what happened on that call and why?), admin experience (how does a customer manage and improve their own agents?), and smarter agentic design patterns like deterministic procedures that give agents reliable behavior on structured tasks. You're building the infrastructure that lets this team, and eventually our customers, move faster and build better agents.

Why This And Not Somewhere Else

This role puts you directly in front of enterprise customers running production voice AI from day one. You're not waiting to earn customer exposure - it's the job. The pod model means you'll accumulate more production voice AI experience in a year than most PMs get in several, across different industries, different contact center environments, and different conversation types. At the same time, the evaluation frameworks and agentic design patterns you build have reach well beyond your own pods. This team has a direct seat at the platform table, so the tooling you create shapes how ServiceNow thinks about voice agent quality at scale.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical role such as engineering, solutions consulting, or technical program management where you owned product outcomes.
Comfort with data and evaluation. You think naturally about how to measure whether something is working and how to build systems that do it at scale.
Experience working directly with customers or end users on technical products. You don't need enterprise sales experience, but you need to have been in the room where the work happens.
Strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand API contracts, and hold your own with engineers on system design.
An instinct for repeatable process. You see a problem solved once and immediately think about how to solve it for every customer.

Even Better

Experience with conversational AI, voice technology, or contact center operations.
Background building evaluation frameworks, QA automation, or analytics products.
Familiarity with agentic AI design patterns and how to give an AI agent reliable, structured behavior alongside open-ended reasoning.
Coding ability in any language. You won't write production code, but PMs on this team who can prototype, script, and dig into data move faster.
Experience with telephony environments: SIP, CCaaS platforms, real-time media handling.

Additional Information

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $143,200 - $243,400
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

YOUR MINDSET

You have developed fluency in disciplines most people keep separate. You don't see creative strategy, experience strategy and media strategy as different languages. You see them as different expressions of the same brilliant strategic thinking and that fluency informs everything you do.
You believe that the best creative ideas scale, that strategic coherence matters, and that you grow by collaborating with people who think differently than you. You contribute with conviction and follow-through. You help build a culture where people understand how their work fits into something bigger and you are here for more than your role. You understand that ideas and how they reach people are equally important—not one secondary to the other.

ROLE OVERVIEW

You will develop and execute a range of integrated strategy projects for one or two B2B brands. One of those brands is a multi-brand healthcare enterprise where you will translating strategic direction into inspirational insights and briefs that enable great creative, content and experience execution to come together.

This role demands fluency in two disciplines that most separate: Brand Strategy and Connections Strategy. You work from both perspectives simultaneously. You don't just translate between them,you hold them together with clear strategic thinking that helps them operate as one. You understand how strategy needs to live across earned, owned, and paid channels—including social and influencer partnerships and sales enablement.

You turn strategic direction into clear big ideas and briefs grounded in buying group insight and media possibility. You work with creative content, experience and media teams to help them understand how their work fits together into a coherent whole and inspire both to think bigger and think together. You are the bold strategic voice in the room who helps teams see how their work connects and why that connection matters.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Development — Ideas & Brief

Translate strategic direction into powerful Catalyzing Ideas and briefs grounded in creative insight and contextual possibility
Build the strategic rationale—not just what we're doing, but why it matters and how it moves the business
Develop brand worlds that breathe life into ideas—articulating character, conviction, and edges with specificity
Help creative teams uncover the strategic insight that should drive their work. Identify how ideas work across the full B2B lifecycle. Help media teams see how that idea scales. Understand how ideas need to live in social and influencer contexts
Develop content and sales enablement strategies that support the buying experience – going beyond the expected to elevate the brand a thought leader in the category while optimizing for LLMs

Strategic System Operationalization

Identify WHERE ideas reach the right buying groups and HOW they show up in context—across paid media, owned channels, social platforms, and influencer partnerships
Research and surface buyer signals that inform where and when strategy becomes relevant and urgent
Understand signal stacking—how multiple signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Help teams understand how their work feeds the whole and why that connection matters

Cross-Disciplinary Alignment & Leadership

Work with creative, content, media, social, and influencer partners to ensure strategy translates consistently across all touchpoints
Help creative teams understand the experience strategy and what's possible. Help media teams understand creative strategy and what ideas demand. Bridge social and influencer thinking into the broader strategic conversation.
Bridge creative and media conversations so both disciplines understand they're working from the same foundation
Think all languages simultaneously—you are fluent in creative strategy, experience strategy, content strategy AND media strategy, weaving them together

Stakeholder Communication & Relationship Building

Brief brand partners and internal stakeholders on strategy with clarity and confidence
Be a reliable strategic voice partners turn to when asking "how should this idea work?" or "how does this fit what we're doing?"
Engage with senior team to gather input and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities

Team Contribution & Development

Support team leadership by modeling integrated thinking
Mentor junior strategists, helping them understand systems thinking, not just tactical execution
Ask good questions that help teams think beyond their discipline
Contribute to creating psychological safety where people challenge siloed thinking

Measurement & Learning

Help monitor how strategy translates in market and gather feedback for refinement
Support measurement that tracks whether the system is working, using data as feedback not just reporting
Contribute insights on how ideas are propagating and whether signals are clustering as predicted

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In short

In short: We are seeking a highly collaborative, and agile leader to step into the role of Head of Growth & Expansion, LATAM. Reporting directly to the General Manager of LATAM, you will be a unique strategic contributor driving the future footprint of On across Latin America and the Caribbean. In this high-impact position, you will be a critical partner supporting both direct and distributor markets on our omnichannel strategy. You will act as the unified voice for LATAM in global and regional forums, bringing an integrated, cohesive point of view that represents the region's growth opportunities. This is a dynamic, high-visibility role designed for a master of project delivery who loves turning complex visions into reality. You will orchestrate high-priority regional initiatives while scaling of future strategic categories, serve as the region's champion for AI initiatives, and spearhead the GTM integration across our direct markets and distributor led markets.

Your mission

The Voice of LATAM: Serve as the primary representative and strategic voice for the LATAM & CAC region in high-level global and regional forums. Bring a highly integrated, single point of view that represents regional nuances and opportunities. - Omnichannel Strategy Integration: Partner with regional and global stakeholders to coordinate and support our omnichannel strategy across both direct and distributor markets. Seamlessly bridge regionally led wholesale plans with distinct, globally led E-commerce and Retail DTC initiatives. - Integrated Go-To-Market (GTM) Orchestration: Design and lead an integrated, highly cohesive regional GTM process across Brazil, Mexico, and Distributor markets. - AI Champion & Leader: Spearhead and champion the rollout of AI initiatives across LATAM. Identify opportunities to leverage AI to drive operational efficiency, enrich customer experiences, and elevate cross-functional productivity. - Category Launch & Strategic Growth: Partner with Global and Americas leaders to not only launch brand-new product categories but also aggressively scale and grow future categories in LATAM. Specifically drive the long-term acceleration and market share of our Apparel category by collaborating closely with DTC Global Leaders across digital, e-commerce, and retail channels. - Master Project Management: Drive end-to-end execution of complex, highly confidential regional projects. Act as the central PMO hub for high-impact growth initiatives that keep On ahead of the curve. - Shape the Growth Pipeline: Lead and support the development of robust regional business cases for expansion initiatives, assessing the viability of new distribution channels, store openings, and strategic decisions. - Orchestrate Strategic rollouts: Support the regional implementation of global initiatives, successfully launching new business verticals, expanding product categories, and embedding advanced operating models across the region. - Maximize Long-Range Performance: Collaborate with regional and channel commercial leaders to build, optimize, and challenge regional Long-Range Plans, ensuring alignment with overarching financial and brand targets. - Drive Omni-Channel Execution: Act as the central orchestrator for cross-functional teams, driving seamless, omni-channel execution of strategic projects to deliver a premium, unified brand experience.

Your story

Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, business development, PMO, or strategic expansion within the sports performance, footwear, premium consumer goods, or technology industries. - Matrix & Stakeholder Navigation: Proven track record of operating successfully in a highly matrixed global organization. - Master of Project Delivery: A proven track record of managing complex, cross-functional projects from concept to execution. Outstanding structural thinking, prioritizing capability, and the ability to steer multi-stakeholder initiatives under tight timelines. - Omnichannel & Go-To-Market Acumen: Deep understanding of omnichannel retail dynamics, wholesale lifecycles, and commercial operating models (Wholesale, Retail, E-com, and Distributor-led) across Latin American markets. - AI & Innovation Curiosity: A forward-thinking mindset with experience leading or championing digital innovation, digital transformation, or AI-driven projects within business operations. - Highly Strategic & Comfortable with Ambiguity: Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where you navigate confidential, yet-to-be-disclosed initiatives, turning uncertainty into structured, actionable project roadmaps. - Exceptional Communication & Influence: A culturally agile communicator and strong relationship-builder who can synthesize diverse perspectives into a single regional point of view and influence senior global leaders without formal authority. - Languages: Complete fluency in both English and Spanish is required. Proficiency in Portuguese is a strong asset to support our Brazil market. Travel: Open and available to travel approximately 20–25% of the time across regional offices (São Paulo, Mexico City, etc.) and global headquarters.

Meet the team

At On LATAM, we are passionate about movement, our community, and pioneering what's next. As the Head of Growth & Expansion, you will be a vital, core member of the LATAM Leadership Team, working alongside other senior regional leaders in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. We operate with the Explorer Spirit—embracing extreme ownership, honest communication, and mutual respect. This role offers an unparalleled leadership platform to shape the future of a global hyper-growth brand in one of its most exciting, fast-evolving regions.

What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination. You will drive the execution of product strategy across multiple products and teams within the EPE portfolio, prioritize outcomes across value streams, and create long-term product roadmaps that are aligned with technology roadmaps. You will lead Product Owners in delivering value, while coordinating with product, DT, and business stakeholders to set high-level priorities.

Position Requirements

Require a strong IT infrastructure background with deep expertise in network connectivity and access, as well as proven experience ensuring network reliability, availability, and performance across complex enterprise environments.
The successful candidate will have deep understanding of networking concepts, either from work in that technical area or as a product leader for a large networking team.
The network environment is nationwide in a distributed model that is unique. This role will lead the established product owners in a much-needed strategy layer, helping to ensure the portfolio goals are being translated to the product owners while ensuring the needs of customers and partners are met.
This position will work closely with the portfolio product leader as well as the leaders of both architecture and the network team.

Responsibilities

Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap

Apply and reinforce effective Product Management practices.
Develop a deep understanding of business objectives and processes to inform product priorities across multiple products of varying complexity.
Support the development and maintenance of a comprehensive long-term product strategy within a portfolio to deliver business value.

Prioritization

Manage the prioritization and backlog of features and user stories based on business value, customer feedback, and technical feasibility, ensuring the team works on high-priority items.

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with stakeholders, including business leaders, customers, and development teams, to ensure everyone is aligned with the product vision.

Cross-Team Collaboration

Coordinate with Product Manager, Product Owners, Engineering, Architecture, Agility Enablement, and other stakeholders to ensure that features for customers and frontline employees are cohesive and deliver business value towards running a successful passenger railroad.

Thought Leadership

Capture, develop, and promote effective Product Management practices within DT and with stakeholders.

Agile Framework

Implement and champion the principles of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), ensuring agile methodologies are followed.

Metrics and Analysis

Define and track success metrics to measure the value and identify areas for improvement or pivots.

Leadership & Communication

Strong leadership, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical delivery.

Required Technical Skills

Deep understanding of networking concepts as they apply to a distributed network.
Concepts such as firewalls, cloud, vlan, and segmented networking will be predominant topics in conversations.
Should be well versed in ITSM concepts including change management practices.
Ability to prioritize and make data-driven decisions.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Experience with Jira Software, Confluence, FigJam, Jira Align, AgilityHealth, and similar tools.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applied experience.
Required: 9-12 years of relevant experience, leadership experience in managing product teams and influencing senior level management and key stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience with agile methodologies, with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) experience preferred.
Candidates with POPM or ITIL certifications will rise to the top of the candidate pool.

About DigniFi:

DigniFi’s Point-of-Sale financing solution helps 2,000+ partners increase revenue, drive accessory orders, and decrease deferred repairs. We partner with dealerships and service centers to offer financing products at the point of sale for auto repairs, service, parts, accessories, maintenance packages, and more.

As DigniFi continues to grow, our success depends on deep integrations with the software platforms dealerships already use every day. This role sits at the center of that strategy.
Our mission is to help auto dealers and service centers grow by offering their customers innovative, inclusive financing. Our vision is to make financing for the needs of daily life accessible and inclusive.

About The Role:

As Chief Product Officer, you will lead DigniFi's Product and Engineering organizations and play a key role in shaping the company's product strategy and future growth. You will be responsible for building a product vision that drives customer value, product monetization, and business results while ensuring our teams are aligned and focused on execution. This role requires a strong cross-functional leader who can connect product, technology, and business priorities, remove barriers to execution, and build high-performing teams that deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers and partners.

Product Strategy & Vision
Define and communicate the company's long-term product vision and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
Establish product strategy that supports product monetization, revenue growth, customer acquisition, merchant engagement, and operational efficiency.
Prioritize product investments based on business value, customer insights, data, and market opportunities, with a clear focus on commercial impact and monetization opportunities.
Identify emerging technologies and industry trends to maintain a competitive advantage.
Partner with different team leaders to develop and prioritize product roadmaps that support tribe objectives and company strategic priorities.
Ensure product investments are aligned with cross-functional business goals and deliver measurable business value, with a focus on product monetization and revenue generation.
Foster collaboration across tribes to identify opportunities for innovation, process improvements, and scalable technology solutions.

Product Management
Lead the Product Management team through all phases of the product lifecycle, from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.
Ensure product roadmaps are aligned with company priorities and Tribe objectives, with a strong focus on execution and measurable business outcomes.
Champion customer-centric product development using data, user feedback, and market research.
Define product success metrics and monitor product performance, including adoption, engagement, monetization, and revenue impact.

Engineering Leadership
Lead the Engineering organization to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure technology solutions.
Partner with engineering leadership to establish technical strategy, architecture, and development standards.
Balance speed of delivery with system stability, quality, and security.
Promote modern software development practices, agile delivery, and continuous improvement.
Ensure Engineering resources are effectively aligned to support tribe priorities while maintaining technical excellence, platform stability, and long-term architectural goals.
Promote collaboration between Engineering and business teams to accelerate execution and delivery while balancing speed, quality, security, and scalability.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner closely with Credit & Risk to develop underwriting, fraud, servicing, and decisioning capabilities that support responsible growth.
Collaborate with Sales to understand customer and merchant needs, improve product adoption, and prioritize enhancements that drive revenue.
Work with Operations to improve internal processes and customer experiences through technology.
Partner with Compliance and Legal to ensure products meet regulatory requirements and industry standards.
Collaborate with Marketing on product positioning, launches, and go-to-market strategies.
Build strong cross-functional partnerships to align priorities, remove execution barriers, and ensure teams are working together to deliver product and business outcomes.

Executive Leadership
Serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on product, technology, innovation, and product monetization opportunities.
Present product strategy, technology initiatives, and performance updates to the Executive Team and Board of Directors.
Build strong partnerships across departments to align priorities and drive effective execution.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Establish KPIs and operational metrics for Product and Engineering, including metrics that measure product adoption, monetization, revenue impact, and delivery.
Ensure efficient allocation of resources to maximize business impact.

Team Leadership
Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing Product and Engineering teams.
Coach and mentor leaders to build organizational capability.
Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and career development opportunities.
Create an environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and collaboration.
Build a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability by empowering Product and Engineering leaders to actively participate in and support cross-functional tribes.
Develop leaders who can influence without formal authority, collaborate effectively across departments, and contribute to the success of the broader organization.
Hold Product and Engineering leaders accountable for execution, delivery, and measurable business outcomes.

Who You Are:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Product Management, Engineering, or Technology.
5+ years leading Product and Engineering teams.
Experience building and executing product strategy in a fintech, financial services, SaaS, or technology organization.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and delivering complex technology initiatives.
Strong understanding of Agile product development and software engineering practices.
Experience managing product portfolios, roadmaps, and technology investments.
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in consumer lending, embedded finance, payments, automotive technology, or financial services.

Experience working with APIs, partner integrations, and platform-based products.
MBA or advanced technical degree.
Experience in a high-growth or investor-backed company.

Why You’ll Love Working at DigniFi:
High-growth opportunity with terrific upside potential.

Founded to provide aid to people when they unexpectedly need help...responsible, respectful, and transparent access to a better financial future for our customers.

Excellence-driven organization that values work/life balance.

We’re a tight-knit team that values collaboration and genuinely loves working together.

Ultimate workplace flexibility.

What’s In It for You: 
Flexible PTO 

12 Paid Holidays 

Up to 80% Employer-Paid Premiums for Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance 

Long-term Disability Insurance 

Basic Life Insurance 

Paid Parental Leave 

Matching 401k 

Where You Will Work: 

This position is remote.

About 3E

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

We're looking for a Senior Product Go-To-Market (GTM) Manager
who won't just support product launches but will help define how they succeed in market.

This is more than a product launch role. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Product and Commercial teams, partnering across Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, and Commercial Enablement to bring innovative solutions to market. You'll help build the processes, playbooks, and commercial motions that accelerate growth, strengthen customer adoption, and shape how we go to market as our business continues to evolve.

It's also an exciting opportunity to help launch disruptive, next-generation AI products that embed intelligence into customer workflows and create meaningful impact in an industry ready for innovation. At 3E, AI isn't just part of our products, it's part of how we work. We embrace AI-first ways of working to help our teams move faster, make better decisions, and continuously improve how we deliver value.

We're growing quickly, expanding our product portfolio, and evolving how we bring products to market. That means priorities can shift, new opportunities emerge, and you'll often help create scalable processes rather than simply follow established ones. If you enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, influencing without authority, and building while delivering, you'll thrive here.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys driving collaboration across a roadmap to achieve business outcomes, creating scalable go-to-market processes, enabling commercial teams with effective sales plays and training, refining product and solution positioning, and partnering cross-functionally to make big things happen. You'll own strategic planning and program management for our product launch lifecycle, lead launches for new capabilities, evolve our solution positioning, and enable our commercial teams with the tools, messaging, and processes they need to accelerate growth. You'll also monitor customer adoption and product usage to help maximize long-term customer value.

What You'll Do

Product Launch Program Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, Commercial Operations, Customer Experience, and other teams to lead end-to-end launch planning in Jira, ensuring alignment and execution across the organization.

Lead Product Launches

Leverage our launch framework to coordinate cross-functional go-to-market efforts, including positioning, messaging, enablement, and execution planning. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver successful launches that drive adoption, revenue growth, and customer satisfaction.

Market Insights & Customer Understanding

Mine win/loss data, Gong conversations, customer feedback, and market trends to refine product positioning, identify opportunities, and strengthen go-to-market strategies.

Product Positioning & Messaging

Develop compelling product positioning and differentiated messaging for key buyer personas while ensuring new capabilities align with our broader solution narrative.

Commercial Enablement

Equip Sales, Account Management, and Customer teams with the training, resources, pricing guidance, sales plays, and enablement materials needed to confidently bring solutions to market. Lead commercial campaign launches and monitor performance across targeted initiatives.

Performance Monitoring

Track key performance indicators through SFDC, Gong, Pendo, and other tools to measure campaign effectiveness, pipeline growth, product adoption, and customer engagement.

Strategic Planning & Continuous Improvement

Develop and execute go-to-market strategies that drive growth, identify new opportunities, improve commercial processes, and build scalable ways of working that support long-term success.

Adaptability

Continuously evolve GTM strategies based on customer insights, market feedback, product evolution, and performance data to ensure continued commercial success.

What Makes You a Great Fit

4+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, or product marketing with accountability for GTM strategy and orchestration— ideally in B2B SaaS, information services, or regulatory/sustainability tech.
Broad GTM Expertise focused on sales enablement and driving growth: Should have a strong working knowledge of product management/product launch process, sales enablement best practices, and B2B software sales process. A proven track record of developing and executing high-impact GTM strategies that led to product adoption, market expansion, or revenue growth. Understands how GTM strategy translates to Commercial teams’ day-to-day roles.
AI and Commercial Tech Acumen: High acumen for use of key (or similar) technologies including Claude, Jira, SFDC, Pendo, and Gong.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Strong project management skills to manage complex projects and drive execution across teams.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively communicate with various stakeholders.
Analytical Skills: Strong market sensing skills. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
Leadership/Influence: Exceptional collaborator with the ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams. Must be skilled at aligning stakeholders around a shared vision while driving accountability.
Experience in a high-growth mid-sized software or data company is highly valued.

Based in the US in one of the states where 3E is authorized to hire, and eligible to work without sponsorship.

You'll Thrive Here If You...

Enjoy bringing structure to complex, fast-moving environments.
Love building scalable processes instead of simply maintaining existing ones.
Are energized by cross-functional collaboration and influencing without direct authority.
Have a builder's mindset and enjoy creating new playbooks.
Are curious, adaptable, and quick to learn new products and technologies.
Embrace AI and continually look for ways to work smarter and more effectively.
Enjoy seeing the direct impact your work has on customers, commercial teams, and business growth.

Our US Benefits Include

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance and disability coverage
Open PTO and parental leave
401(k) plan with company matching
Employee assistance program
Voluntary supplemental benefits (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness)

Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding Los Angeles), Colorado (excluding Denver), Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois (excluding Chicago), Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York (excluding New York City), North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington.

Visit our Website or follow us on LinkedIn

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. You’ll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering (PDE), as well as Go-To-Market (GTM) teams, to contribute directly to product development—shaping what we build, how we measure success, and how we iterate.

You will also play a pivotal role in designing and developing Slack’s agentic data delivery platform. By connecting the dots across our data backend, metrics foundations, and insights analyses, you will help us achieve true data self-serve capabilities within an AI and agentic context.

At Slack, we foster a positive, diverse, and supportive culture. We look for people who are curious, bold, and eager to improve every day. Our team values being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all, collaborative.

jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

Code Metal is hiring its first Head of Product to own the company's product strategy, organization, and operating model. The Head of Product will sit at the intersection of Engineering, customers, and go-to-market and answer a fundamental question for the company's next phase.

The Head of Product will own the product layer built on top of Code Metal's core technical capabilities, including the continued evolution of our platform and the development of new products and experiences that make those capabilities accessible to customers. The mandate is to translate powerful underlying technology into products that solve clear customer problems, are easy to understand and adopt, and create natural paths to broader platform usage.

This person will report directly the CEO and the company's technical leadership to determine what products should be built on top of Code Metal's foundational technology, for whom, and in what sequence, while partnering closely with Sales to refine packaging, positioning, and the path from initial customer entry point to broader adoption.

The successful candidate will have done this before: taken differentiated foundational technology and built compelling products on top of it, creating the product experience, packaging, customer adoption, and commercial motion required to bring that technology to market.

What This Person Will Own:

Product Strategy & Vision: Define the product strategy for Code Metal's platform and establish a clear view of where the company will, and will not, invest.
Core Product Platform: Own the product direction and evolution of our platform and creating a coherent experience and roadmap across Code Metal's technical capabilities.
Zero-to-One Product Development: Work closely with Engineering to identify customer problems, develop new products and capabilities, validate them with customers, and take them from concept through market launch and adoption.
Customer Discovery: Build a disciplined approach to understanding engineering-led customers and translating their requirements into durable product insights rather than one-off feature requests.
Product Roadmap & Prioritization: Establish the mechanisms for making clear product and engineering tradeoffs across customer commitments, platform investments, technical debt, and long-term strategic opportunities.
Packaging & Commercialization: Determine how Code Metal's capabilities are organized, positioned, and packaged into products that customers can understand and purchase.
Go-to-Market Enablement: Partner tightly with Growth and Sales to create product narratives, use cases, demonstrations, competitive positioning, and technical enablement that make the platform easier to sell.
Sales Partnership: Participate directly in strategic customer conversations, particularly during the company's current stage, helping Sales understand customer requirements and helping customers understand the product's technical and business value.
Engineering Partnership: Serve as the primary product counterpart to Engineering and technical leadership, ensuring customer and market priorities are translated into clear product decisions without compromising technical integrity.
Product Organization: Build a high leverage, technically credible, high-output Product organization.

What we're looking for:

10+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including 5+ years leading scaled Product organizations.
A true builder who is comfortable starting with ambiguity, incomplete information, and an immature organizational structure.
Highly technical product executive. Must understand complex technical systems well to challenge assumptions, ask incisive questions, and partner with Code Metal's engineering organization.
Hands-on and comfortable operating without a large Product organization. This person should expect to personally conduct customer discovery, write product strategy, pressure-test requirements, support strategic deals, and drive prioritization.
Has strong product taste and can distinguish between a customer request, a repeatable product need, and a strategically important platform investment.
Commercially minded. Understands that great product leadership at Code Metal includes helping the company sell, package, and communicate its technology, not simply managing an engineering roadmap.
Comfortable making hard prioritization decisions and saying no when customer requests or internal initiatives do not support the broader product strategy.
Low ego and highly collaborative across Engineering, Growth, Sales, Solutions, and forward-deployed teams.
Has personally taken a deeply technical product from ground zero to market, rather than primarily inheriting mature products, established roadmaps, or functioning product organizations.
Has partnered closely with Sales to commercialize a product, including participating directly in customer conversations and learning what made the product sell, or fail to sell.
Has strong experience working with deeply technical engineering organizations and can earn credibility with engineers, architects, and technical founders.
Has translated emerging technical capabilities into products that can be repeatedly sold and deployed rather than remaining bespoke solutions.
Has experience establishing product-market fit, not simply scaling after product-market fit was already established.
Ideally has built products for developers, engineers, security teams, infrastructure teams, or other highly technical users.

Benefits

Pay depends on experience, but we strive to be at the upper end of the salary range
Health care plan with 100% premium coverage, including medical, dental, and vision
401k with 5% matching
Paid Time Off (uncapped vacation, plus sick and public holidays)
Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangement
Relocation assistance for qualifying employees

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Scale has been the leading AI data foundry, helping fuel the most exciting advancements in AI, including frontier model training, enterprise adoption, defense applications, and autonomous vehicles. Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions

We're looking for a Senior AI Product Manager
to build and own Scale's Cybersecurity portfolio
— the data, environments, and evaluations frontier labs use to train and measure security capability in their models. This is a build role: you will define the strategy and standards for a product line that does not exist yet.

Security is where the hardest problems in agentic AI now sit. An agent that can find a vulnerability, prove it reproduces, and patch it without breaking the system is doing work that takes a skilled human days. Measuring that honestly requires reproducible execution environments at scale and practitioners who have actually done the work. Scale has the first, proven across SWE-Bench Pro, SWE Atlas, and our contributions to the Terminal-Bench lineage. You will build the second.

You Will

Own the roadmap and strategy for Scale's Cybersecurity portfolio across training data, RL environments, agentic task suites, and evaluation products — and stand the product line up end to end, from task taxonomy and sourcing through pricing and first external release.
Define the capability map we train and measure against: vulnerability discovery, proof-of-concept reproduction, patch generation and regression safety, secure code review, supply-chain analysis, malware and binary analysis, detection engineering, and incident triage.
Make the strategic call on where Scale competes across the offense–defense spectrum — which capabilities we build training data for, which we only measure, and which we decline.
Partner with ML researchers and security practitioners on task specifications, grader design, and verifiable rewards, holding to execution-grounded verification wherever possible: a task counts as solved only when the reproducer fires or the patch holds without breaking functionality.
Drive the infrastructure roadmap — reproducible vulnerability images, fuzzing and build toolchains, sandboxed execution, network-segmented ranges, automated verification — and build sourcing pipelines that scale past hand-curation.
Own the responsible-development posture: containment, coordinated disclosure for live vulnerabilities surfaced during task construction, need-to-know handling of sensitive artifacts, and customer vetting, working with Security, Legal, and Policy to make these processes real rather than nominal.
Establish governance for data quality, contamination prevention, license and IP hygiene, reproducibility, and release management.
Recruit and steward a contributor network of working practitioners — vulnerability researchers, exploit developers, malware analysts, detection engineers, incident responders — and design quality controls that hold up when reviewers are validating work at the edge of their own expertise.
Own external partnerships across open-source benchmark collaborations, academic security groups, and enterprise data partnerships.
Work directly with frontier labs and enterprise customers to understand where their models fail on security work, translate that into roadmap, and partner with GTM on launches and thought leadership.

Ideally, You'd Have

Real cybersecurity work under your belt, rather than security-adjacent product experience: vulnerability research, fuzzing and crash triage, reproducer development, patch and root-cause analysis, exploit development, malware analysis, red teaming, detection engineering, or incident response. Competitive CTF, published CVEs, a bug bounty record, or OSS-Fuzz contributions all count.
5+ years in product management, technical program management, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles — or equivalent depth as a practitioner with a clear pull toward product ownership.
A working view of the AI-for-security evaluation landscape and where it falls short: CyberGym, Cybench, CVE-Bench, BountyBench, CyberSecEval. CyberGym sets the bar we hold ourselves to — real vulnerabilities sourced at scale, execution-grounded verification, and tasks hard enough that frontier agents still clear only about a fifth of them.
Enough software engineering depth to read unfamiliar code, reason about runtime behavior, and hold your own with senior engineers and ML researchers.
Familiarity with how models are post-trained and evaluated, including agentic scaffolds and container-based rollout infrastructure.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to drive alignment across cross-functional organizations.
Sound judgment on dual-use questions, and genuine care about building capability measurement that helps defenders more than attackers.
Entrepreneurial mindset, bias for action, and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
