jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Who We Are

IREX is a global solutions provider that partners with communities and institutions in the United States and around the world to cultivate leaders, expand access to education, and create economic opportunity. With deep expertise, a forward-looking vision, and world-class practices in AI for Education, Future-Ready Workforce, Higher Education Solutions, Leadership Development, and Online Safety, IREX delivers innovative and proven solutions that help people, institutions, and communities thrive in a rapidly changing world.

About The Role

The Director of Information Technology serves as IREX’s senior operational and technical leader for Information Technology and as the designated deputy to the Chief Technology Officer for delegated operational and technical matters. The Director provides technical leadership across cloud and infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, enterprise applications and integrations, AI and automation, service delivery, and technology partners. The Director serves as IREX’s senior technical escalation point and is expected to work directly within technology platforms when needed. As deputy to the CTO, the Director provides operational and technical continuity, independently resolves matters within delegated authority, and represents the technology function as delegated by the CTO.

We’re looking for our next team member – could it be you?

Range: $160,000 - $190,000

What You’ll Do

Technology Operations and Infrastructure

Lead day-to-day technology operations and maintain a stable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology environment.
Provide hands-on technical leadership for Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, networking, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and identity and access management.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex issues and participate directly in troubleshooting and resolution.
Establish and maintain architecture, configuration, lifecycle, and operational standards in coordination with the CTO.
Ensure technology platforms are appropriately monitored, maintained, patched, backed up, documented, and supported.
Provide technical direction for IREX offices and programs operating across different countries and technology environments.
Maintain and test appropriate business continuity, disaster recovery, system resilience, and technology recovery capabilities.

Enterprise Applications and Integration

Lead the operational management and technical integration of IREX’s enterprise application portfolio, including ERP, HRIS, CRM, Microsoft 365, collaboration and knowledge platforms, and other business systems.
Work with business owners to translate requirements into practical technical solutions, system improvements, and integration opportunities.
Lead or participate directly in system implementation, configuration, integration, enhancement, migration, and troubleshooting.
Use APIs, scripting, Power Platform, and other integration technologies to improve interoperability and reduce manual processes.
Ensure enterprise applications have appropriate ownership, security, documentation, lifecycle management, integration, and support models.

AI, Automation and Agent Platforms

Partner with the CTO to translate AI and automation priorities into practical technical solutions.
Provide technical leadership for Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and related AI and automation capabilities.

Cybersecurity Operations and Technology Risk

Implement, operate, and maintain technical security controls across identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, logging and monitoring, and configuration management.
Provide technical oversight of cybersecurity vendors and managed security services, including validating that delivered work meets IREX requirements.
Support incident response, audits, risk assessments, and remediation activities, including evidence collection and technical investigation.
Escalate significant cybersecurity incidents, unresolved technical risks, and proposed exceptions to security requirements to the CTO.

Strategy Implementation & Governance

Implement the IT strategy and governance framework established by the CTO, translating strategic direction into executable workplans, operational practices, and measurable milestones.
Lead execution of delegated strategic initiatives across infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, automation, and service delivery to ensure progress against organizational priorities.
Track implementation progress, identify risks or barriers to delivery, and recommend adjustments to timelines, sequencing, or resourcing for CTO review and decision-making.
Establish practical governance routines, documentation, and decision-support processes that improve consistency, accountability, and operational follow-through across IT initiatives.
Ensure technology changes are adopted effectively by the organization through careful planning, stakeholder coordination, communications, training, and post-implementation support.
Provide the CTO with timely updates, analysis, and escalation of issues requiring strategic direction, policy decisions, or executive-level intervention.

Teamwork/Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a trusted technology advisor to departments and program teams, helping translate operational needs into practical, secure, and sustainable technology solutions.
Partner with functional leaders to understand business priorities, assess technology implications, and align IT support with organizational goals and user needs.
Influence and guide non-technical stakeholders by clearly explaining technology options, trade-offs, risks, and implementation impacts in accessible terms, building understanding and support for technology decisions and organizational change.
Facilitate cross-functional planning and coordination for technology initiatives that require shared ownership, process changes, user adoption, or operational readiness.
Build collaborative relationships across the organization to improve technology engagement, strengthen adoption of enterprise systems, and support consistent use of tools and platforms.
Represent IT in delegated cross-functional meetings and working groups, ensuring decisions are informed by technical feasibility, security considerations, user experience, and long-term sustainability.

Budget & Vendor Management

Manage technology vendor relationships within delegated areas of responsibility, including coordinating services, monitoring performance, resolving issues, and validating deliverables.
Review and approve vendor invoices within delegated authority, ensuring charges are accurate, aligned with contracted services, and supported by appropriate documentation.
Partner with the CTO and Procurement to support vendor sourcing, renewals, contract coordination, and evaluation of vendor performance and value.
Monitor budget spend for assigned technology services, licenses, tools, and vendor engagements, identifying variances, risks, or opportunities for cost control.
Provide input and analysis to support technology budget planning and forecasting, while recognizing that overall IT budget ownership and final budget accountability remain with the CTO.
Maintain practical oversight of software licensing, subscriptions, support agreements, and managed service arrangements to promote cost-effectiveness, compliance, and continuity of service.

User Support and Service Delivery

Oversee technology support and service delivery for IREX employees and programs.
Sustain a customer service mindset across IT support and service delivery, ensuring staff receive responsive, respectful, and solutions-oriented support.
Establish and monitor service levels and appropriate performance indicators.
Monitor responsiveness using defined service expectations, such as timely acknowledgment, prioritization, escalation, and resolution of support requests based on urgency, impact, and agreed service levels.
Ensure effective escalation and resolution of complex or high-impact issues.
Identify recurring issues and address underlying technical or process causes.
Promote a culture of accountability and continuous improvement by using service trends, user feedback, and recurring issues to improve processes, communication, and the overall technology experience.
Use ticket trends, service metrics, user feedback, and recurring issue analysis to identify continuous improvement priorities and implement practical changes that improve reliability, user satisfaction, response quality, and service consistency.
Maintain appropriate technical documentation, procedures, knowledge resources, and user guidance.
Build trust with internal users by setting clear expectations, communicating proactively, following through on commitments, and ensuring technology support is aligned with staff needs and organizational priorities.

Our Culture is Our People

At IREX, our culture is built on our people—and on how we work together to create meaningful impact every day. We look for colleagues who bring purpose, curiosity, collaboration, and a bias for action to help strengthen communities and advance our mission.

Successful candidates build trust across differences, move ideas into action, seek new perspectives, adapt to change, and represent IREX with authenticity and professionalism. We value people who bring strong expertise and a generous team spirit to work that advances our mission.

What You’ll Bring

Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on technical capability, judgment, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technology issues and make sound technical and architectural decisions.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, identity, endpoint management, enterprise applications, integration, automation, AI platforms, and cybersecurity.

Ability to independently evaluate and challenge vendor recommendations.
Strong leadership and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to operate effectively in a lean technology environment with competing priorities.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
12+ years of progressive IT experience, including senior responsibility for enterprise technology operations.
Demonstrated experience combining hands-on technical work with leadership of IT teams and complex technology initiatives.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, identity and access management, and modern cloud environments.
Hands-on experience building automation with Power Platform, including Power Automate flows, connectors, and integrations.
Experience with enterprise applications, systems integration, scripting, APIs, and workflow technologies.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity controls, technology risk management, business continuity, and operational resilience.
Experience managing vendors, managed services, technology budgets, and complex technical projects.

You must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At IREX, you’ll work alongside committed, passionate, and collaborative colleagues who are united by a shared mission—making it a truly rewarding place to work. We offer learning, development, and growth opportunities, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your overall well-being.

The company supports enterprise customers globally and is continuing to invest heavily in the next generation of data- and AI-powered products. They are currently looking to add a VP, Data Platform & Product Management

This leader will define how data is ingested, governed, processed, and activated across a global software product ecosystem. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, AI/ML, GTM, and executive leadership to build the data foundation supporting the organization's next generation of products.

Responsibilities Of The VP, Data Platform & Product Management

Define and own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for an enterprise data platform.

Build and scale platform capabilities supporting AI/ML and analytics initiatives.
Lead and develop Product Management teams across the data domain.
Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on platform scalability, reliability, security, and performance.

Define metrics around platform adoption, data quality, latency, and customer outcomes.
Partner directly with C-level executives and senior leaders across Product, Engineering, GTM, and other functions.
Evaluate emerging data technologies and architecture patterns, including real-time streaming, lakehouse, and distributed data platforms.
Engage with customers and external stakeholders to help inform product and platform strategy.

Required Experience/Skills for the VP, Data Platform & Product Management:

10+ years of Product Management experience with significant leadership experience at the VP, Head of Product, or Senior Director level.
Experience within a large, established enterprise software or B2B SaaS organization.
Proven experience owning and building an enterprise data platform end-to-end, beginning with ingestion.
Deep technical understanding across modern data architecture, infrastructure, streaming, cloud data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, APIs, and governance.
Experience leading Product Management teams across complex platform initiatives.
Strong experience partnering with and influencing C-level executives.

We're an organization with a national footprint that's large enough to never lack for a new challenge, but small enough for an opportunity to make an impact and influence decisions. Come make a difference at MGIC.

PURPOSE

Serves as a liaison between MGIC and technology partners by managing integration initiatives that support the business and customer experience strategies. Leads cross-functional efforts to deliver integration solutions and enhance MGIC’s position within the mortgage technology ecosystem.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Engages with mortgage technology providers to advance integration objectives and business priorities.
Facilitates partner onboarding and integration initiatives by serving as the primary point of contact for coordination, issue resolution, project planning, communication, and successful delivery.
Partner with Marketing to contribute to the go-to-market plan for new B2B API integrated solutions and significant MI-related enhancements to existing B2B partner platforms.
Conducts research and analysis to support roadmap prioritization, integration, enhancements, customer experience improvements, and new partnership opportunities.
Coordinates with technology providers to prioritize and adopt integration strategies that align with business objectives and improve customer outcomes.
Identifies and resolves operational, technical, and relationship-related issues through collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
Attends industry conferences, customer meetings, and partner’s events to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and enhance visibility to technology capabilities.
Travel up to 20% of the time.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Experience / Background

5+ Years of experience related to the essential duties as described above.
In-depth understanding of mortgage origination, servicing, secondary market operations, and the mortgage technology ecosystem.
Knowledge of integration concepts, digital product delivery, and partner enablement strategies.
Understanding of B2B API integration product deliverables and management concepts.
Understanding of MISMO standards development and maintenance.
Ability to independently manage complex relationships and influence decision-making among internal and external partners.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to evaluate multiple solutions and make sound business recommendations.
Ability to translate and communicate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations across multiple audiences.
Proven project leadership skills with accountability for delivering results across cross-functional teams.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and consensus-building skills.
Ability to identify strategic opportunities and align recommendations with business objectives and customer strategies.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering | AI / Fintech | New York

$250k-$300k base + meaningful equity

Some Head of Engineering roles are really management jobs - this one isn't.

I'm working with a well-backed Seed-stage AI/fintech company in New York that is building infrastructure to make business verification faster, more reliable and easier to scale globally.

They're looking for a Head of Engineering who has already made the transition from strong engineer to engineering leader, without leaving the engineering behind.

You'll spend roughly half your time building and half leading.

That means writing production code, making architecture decisions and getting deep into technical problems, while also hiring the team, setting the engineering bar and working directly with the founders on product and company direction.

You'll take responsibility for engineering as the business moves through its next stage of growth.

You'll:

Remain hands-on in the codebase and ship alongside the team
Build and scale the engineering organisation
Own the technical vision and architecture as the platform grows
Lead the company's AI engineering strategy and production AI systems
Work directly with the founders on product direction, UX and technical priorities
Set the hiring bar and recruit the next generation of engineers
Build systems capable of supporting demanding enterprise customers across multiple markets

This isn't a role for someone looking to manage engineering from a distance.

The background we're looking for:

The strongest people for this role will have spent meaningful time in early-stage startups, ideally Seed through Series B
, and know what it feels like when the product, team and architecture are all evolving at once.

You'll likely have:

7-15 years in software engineering
Built and led an engineering team, rather than simply inheriting one
Written production code recently and still enjoy being close to the technical work
Owned architecture and technical direction as a product scaled
Shipped AI/ML systems into production
Strong product instincts and the ability to influence what gets built, not just how
Experience building B2B or enterprise software
A Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or similarly technical background

Experience in fintech, identity, KYC/KYB, fraud, risk or another regulated environment
would be highly relevant, but isn't essential.

The Opportunity:

This is an early leadership hire in a company with strong backing, real customer traction and ambitious plans to expand internationally.

The engineering problems sit across AI, data, workflow automation, enterprise infrastructure and complex business verification.

You'll have genuine influence over the product, architecture, engineering culture and team that gets built from here.

The remit is broad by design.

You'll be expected to think like an engineer, product builder and company leader rather than operating inside a narrow engineering-management box.

Package:

Base:
$250k-$300k
Equity:
Meaningful ownership
Location:
New York City
Working pattern:
Strong preference for being in the office
Visa:
Transfers can be considered

Who should apply?

If you've previously been a Founding Engineer, Engineering Lead, Head of Engineering, Director of Engineering or hands-on CTO
, this could be particularly relevant.

Especially if your career has looked something like:
build the product → hire the team → lead the team → keep building

If you're still happiest when you can review the architecture, write code, talk to a customer and interview an engineer in the same week, I'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Description

At Cryptic Vector, we are dedicated to mission success. We take the time to understand our customers' needs, delivering products that perform when our nation needs them most. We understand that properly supporting the most unique missions of the United States government requires the nation’s best. Our focus is on creating a culture where the best and brightest want to grow, learn, and stay. If coming up with out-of-the-box solutions is your specialty, then you’ll feel right at home at Cryptic Vector. We are solving the country’s most unique problems in an environment where problem solvers and hard workers thrive. We've replaced corporate red tape with transparency and servant leadership. Honestly, it’s hard not to love this culture!

We value the individual experiences that our team members add to our culture and capabilities. Please don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet the exact qualifications! We are interested in varying levels of experience.

Director of Engineering

We’re looking for an experienced, people-focused Director of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization. In this role, you’ll own engineering talent management, drive high-quality technical execution, and build the processes and culture that enable mission success. You’ll partner closely with Program Managers and Division Directors to ensure the right talent is in the right places while developing the next generation of technical leaders.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how engineering operates across the company—establishing consistent standards, balancing resources across competing priorities, and fostering a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and mission impact.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage the engineering organization
Own engineering talent management: hiring, development, mentoring, performance, and retention
Ensure the right engineering talent is assigned to programs, IRADs, and proposals
Establish consistent engineering processes, standards, tools, and best practices across locations and divisions
Drive engineering execution with a focus on quality, schedule, technical rigor, accountability, and follow-through
Identify skill and capability gaps and develop recruiting or training plans to address them
Develop technical leaders and create clear career paths for engineers
Balance engineering resources across competing program and business priorities
Partner with Program Managers and Division Directors to ensure programs have the technical resources needed to succeed
Own engineering metrics and organizational health (utilization, staffing, attrition, recruiting needs, skill mix, etc.)
Foster a strong engineering culture focused on collaboration, technical excellence, innovation, and mission impact

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant leadership experience
Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling high-performing engineering teams
Experience owning talent management processes (hiring, performance management, development, and retention)
Demonstrated ability to drive engineering execution against quality, schedule, and technical standards
Experience establishing engineering processes, standards, tools, and metrics
Strong ability to partner with program and business leadership in a matrixed environment
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
Active security clearance (or ability to obtain one) preferred depending on program needs

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a technical or related field
Experience leading multi-site or multi-division engineering organizations
Background in defense, intelligence, or government contracting environments
Experience with resource planning, capacity management, and organizational health metrics
Demonstrated success developing technical leaders and career frameworks
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

This role requires use of technical data subject to U.S. Government contract restrictions, therefore this posting is only for U.S. Citizens.

jobs.description:
Location:
This is a hybrid remote/in-office role.

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team:

The Medidata Platform unifies the entire trial lifecycle, from design to closeout, in a single AI-driven ecosystem. The Medidata Platform gives every team a single connected foundation. It simplifies work for sites while giving sponsors and CROs greater oversight and predictability, lowering development costs, accelerating enrollment, and improving the patient experience.

Who you are:

You will report to the Senior Director of Software Engineering within the Platform team and collaborate with product, PMO and QA and your teams of engineers. You will build high quality products and tools relied upon by all internal engineering teams and customer-facing functions at Medidata. Our applications are built with a variety of technologies and hosted on AWS. As a Director, you'll be challenged both to develop new features in response to market demand and improve the performance and scalability of our applications to meet the growing user base, as well as define the technical vision for your areas of responsibility. You will also lead the engineering organization through the adoption of AI-augmented workflows and Spec-Driven Development (SDD), ensuring that technical strategies maximize efficiency and innovation.

Responsibilities:

You will lead multiple engineering teams spread globally
Keep your team unified, motivated and connected to the our goals
You will use your previous experience to help improve engineering processes
Handle ambiguities and guide data-driven, collaborative decision-making
You will lead your teams to turn the technical vision into reality by collaborating with architects and other teams
Maintain good awareness of software engineering best practices
Strategic Priority Balancing: Establish and maintain a rigorous operational framework that balances competing engineering demands. Prioritize 60% of effort on high-value feature delivery, 30% on deliberate architectural modernization and technical debt reduction, and 10% on operational efficiency to ensure long-term scalability

Competencies:

AI-Augmented Engineering & Ways of Working
Experience in driving organizational adoption of AI-augmented workflows, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
Ability to balance autonomous agentic systems with human oversight, ensuring quality and alignment with business goals
Focus on data-driven decision-making, using metrics to measure AI ROI and productivity gains
Strong change management skills to foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement in an AI-first environment

Technical Leadership

Cloud-native architecture design with emphasis on scalability and reliability
Technical vision development and communication
DevOps practices and continuous delivery experience

Business Acumen

Strong understanding of software product development lifecycles
Experience with digital transformation strategies

jobs.title: Director of Cloud Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

At Wizards of the Coast, we connect people around the world through play and imagination. From our genre-defining games like Magic: The Gathering® and Dungeons & Dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. That’s where you come in!

The Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering leads Hasbro's critical infrastructure transformation: moving completely from on-premises data centers to AWS. This role also involves implementing cloud-native security to enable active detection and response. It is an enterprise-wide position supporting Hasbro and its studios, including Wizards of the Coast.

Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure Engineering and Operations, this is a senior leadership role. You will be responsible for Cloud Platform Engineering, Data Center Services, and Site Reliability Engineering. You will run the associated P&Ls and FinOps subject area. You will also lead the governance model for a rapidly growing AWS environment.

What You'll Do

Cloud Platform, Strategy & Reliability

Define and own the multi-year cloud strategy and roadmap. This includes target-state architecture and hybrid/multi-cloud posture. Establish cloud as an internal product with clear SLAs and a self-service, paved-road platform model.
Own the on-premises to AWS migration end to end, holding the organization accountable to achievements and business outcomes.
Own the retained data centers. Manage planning, contract posture, and daily operations through and beyond the migration. This ensures the hybrid estate runs as one platform, not two.
Lead a customer-first platform organization: develop secure, well-managed, modular elements built to accelerate studio and partner engineering teams,
Establish Site Reliability Engineering as a new field. Define the operating model and charter, then develop it: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call maturity, and DR/BCP for cloud-hosted workloads.

Account Management & Oversight (in collaboration with Cybersecurity)

Own the development and day-to-day operation of the AWS multi-account structure, including organizational units, account vending, and Landing Zone/Control Tower guardrails, as accounts scale through the data center migration.
Define and enforce account lifecycle policies: provisioning, tagging standards, ownership assignment, decommissioning, and access review.
Maintain a governance framework aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework, focusing on the Cost Optimization and Security pillars. Audit accounts for drift and collaborate with your teams to address issues.
Own Service Control Policies, tagging enforcement, and account-level compliance reporting as a durable operating approach in this field, not a one-time cleanup.
Collaborate with the Hasbro Cybersecurity and Identity teams to strengthen cloud security posture across guardrails, CSPM, and Defender for Cloud, and advance the implementation of an active SIEM, including analytic rules, KQL detections, and automated response.
Partner with Network and Identity leadership to develop Zero Trust at the cloud edge, integrating user-based policy with cloud network controls.

FinOps & Cost Management

Own the cloud P&L, handling a multi-year program budget.
Establish and lead the FinOps operating rhythm: cost allocation, showback to business units and studio teams, forecasting, and variance reporting.
Be responsible for the lifecycle of commitment-based discounts, including coverage, utilization, and renewal strategy, to improve savings without over-committing.
Establish unit economics for cloud-hosted workloads (cost per environment, per service, per studio) so engineering and business collaborators can understand cost-to-value tradeoffs.
Identify and promote optimization opportunities such as rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, and architecture changes, in collaboration with studio and partner engineering teams.

Vendor & Collaboration Management

Own the AWS partner relationship: enterprise agreement terms, credits, support for blocking issues, and roadmap alignment.
Partner with Finance and Procurement on budget planning, invoice reconciliation, and true-up processes tied to the multi-year migration budget.
Act as the governance and cost point of contact for studio engineering teams.
Serve as the executive-facing owner of cloud, delivering VP reporting on account health, governance posture, and cost trends, with cross-functional roadmap alignment across Identity, Network, Cybersecurity, Finance, Central Tech, and studio engineering.

Team Developement

Build and develop a layer of cloud architects and subject-matter experts across cloud providers, governance, compliance, and security.
Build, mentor, and develop a management and principal engineer layer across Cloud Platform Engineering, Cloud Security Operations, and SRE or equivalent experience; own organizational structure, headcount, hiring, and performance.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of infrastructure and cloud engineering, with 5+ years leading teams, including experience managing managers.
A proven track record owning enterprise-scale AWS environments and delivering a large-scale data center to cloud migration end-to-end.
Deep AWS platform proficiency and demonstrated governance ownership at scale, across Landing Zone, Control Tower, multi-account structure and guardrails, tagging and policy enforcement, Well-Architected-aligned auditing, EKS, cloud networking, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
Demonstrated FinOps leadership, having owned a multi-million-dollar cloud budget and driven measurable unit-cost improvement.
Platform engineering leader with a customer-centered approach, having developed secure and well-controlled reusable components that noticeably improved the teams you assist, in an organization that puts internal customers' needs first rather than directing them.
Experience building and scaling engineering organizations. This includes composing org structure, hiring, and developing leaders below you. You will mature functions that did not previously exist. You have the executive presence to translate infrastructure risk and investment into business language at the VP level.
A security-forward approach, having partnered with cybersecurity and identity organizations to harden a cloud estate and operationalize detection and response.

NICE TO HAVE

AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional; FinOps Certified Professional.
Practical experience in implementing Microsoft Sentinel and Defender for Cloud.
Site Reliability Engineering organization expansion focusing on SLOs, error budgets, and on-call maturity.
Exposure to Zero Trust and SASE architectures and cloud access based on user verification.
Experience in a multi-studio, multi-BU entertainment or gaming enterprise environment.

SentiLink stops more than 150,000 fraud attempts and verifies more than 3 million identities every day to protect both institutions and consumers. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role

We’re looking for a strong Senior Engineering Manager to lead a backend/platform-focused engineering team responsible for powering SentiLink’s core products.

This team owns the backend systems, external APIs, and services that power these experiences, as well as the technical foundation that ensures the product is scalable, reliable, and secure.

You will lead a small but growing team of engineers responsible for building API-driven systems, evolving our platform architecture, and enabling product teams to move quickly with confidence.

This role sits at the intersection of backend platform development, technical architecture, and people leadership. You’ll partner closely with product, data science, infrastructure, and front-end engineering teams to deliver high-quality systems in a fast-moving environment.

We are looking for a manager who is fundamentally a strong backend engineer and enjoys staying close to technical work, contributing to architecture, guiding design decisions, and unblocking complex systems challenges.

This is a remote, US-based position.

Technologies: React, Golang, Python, PostgreSQL (RDS), Docker, OpenSearch, AWS technologies (Lambda, Cognito and other standard services)

Lead and grow a team of 10 Senior & Staff backend/platform engineers building the systems that power Intercept and other critical applications
Drive execution across planning, prioritization, and delivery with a focus on reliability and scalability

Work closely with infrastructure to improve system reliability, observability, and developer experience
Contribute to architectural decisions and guide the long-term evolution of our platform
Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, and operational excellence
Support incident response and ensure systems meet SLA expectations
Hire, mentor, and develop engineers while maintaining a high hiring bar
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
Contribute to code and technical problem-solving as needed

Strong background as a senior or staff-level backend engineer
Deep experience building API-driven systems using languages like Golang, Python, or similar
Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and system design
Experience owning and evolving backend architecture in production environments
Track record of shipping complex, customer-facing or platform systems
Comfortable leading technical discussions and diving into implementation details

Broadridge is hiring! We are seeking a seasoned executive leader to oversee our global trading systems server infrastructure while serving as the organization's senior authority on information security strategy. This role demands a leader who operates at the intersection of cyber defense, strategic planning, and organizational leadership, requiring someone who can build and inspire world-class distributed teams, safeguard critical trading server environments, and communicate risk posture effectively to the senior management.

This is not a hands-on technical role. It is a strategic management position requiring mastery of people leadership, cybersecurity governance, and long-range planning.

Responsibilities:

People Leadership & Team Building

Lead, mentor, and scale a globally distributed infrastructure and security organization spanning multiple time zones and geographies
Recruit, retain, and develop top-tier talent; foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Establish clear career development paths, succession planning, and performance frameworks for all direct and indirect reports
Drive organizational design to ensure optimal coverage of 24/7 operations worldwide

Information Security & Risk Governance

Serve as the senior security executive accountable for the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all trading server infrastructure assets
Define and execute the enterprise information security strategy, policies, standards, and frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2)
Own the security risk register; present cyber risk exposure, mitigation strategies, and incident reports to senior leadership
Own incident response governance: ensure robust playbooks, regular tabletop exercises, and executive-level crisis communication protocols
Drive a security-by-design culture across all infrastructure engineering practices, embedding security into CI/CD pipelines, automation workflows, and AI-driven operations
Oversee vulnerability lifecycle management—from discovery through remediation SLA enforcement—across all globally distributed assets
Ensure compliance with all applicable financial regulatory requirements (SEC, FINRA, FCA, MAS, or equivalent) and manage relationships with internal/external auditors

Infrastructure Oversight & Strategy

Provide strategic direction for on-premises server and hybrid-cloud environments supporting low-latency trading systems, market data, and exchange connectivity
Develop and maintain a rolling infrastructure and cybersecurity roadmap tied to business growth, regulatory evolution, and threat landscape shifts
Lead strategic initiatives: technical debt elimination, platform standardization, EOL remediation, and next-generation infrastructure adoption
Define investment cases for the executive leadership—balancing cyber resilience spending against operational efficiency gains
Establish OKRs and KPIs that connect cybersecurity and infrastructure performance to business outcomes
Drive convergence between infrastructure operations and development teams through strategic CI/CD integration and infrastructure-as-code adoption—without requiring hands-on technical execution
Identify and pilot emerging technologies—AI/ML for threat detection, automated response orchestration, predictive infrastructure health—translating innovation into operational advantage

Qualifications:

10+ years of progressive leadership in cybersecurity and/or infrastructure management within financial services, electronic trading, or capital markets
Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or equivalent senior information security leadership role
Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading high-performing globally distributed teams with personnel across multiple regions
Deep familiarity with regulatory and audit frameworks relevant to trading firms: SOX, SEC/FINRA, FCA, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001
Exceptional executive communication skills with direct experience presenting to Boards of Directors, audit committees, and C-level stakeholders
Experience managing vendor relationships, budgets in excess of $10M, and cross-functional initiatives

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC
Familiarity (strategic/oversight level) with:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux and hardened OS environments

jobs.description:
Description

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.

Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

Department: IS- Cybersecurity

Location: 3535 Market Street, hybrid

Summary:

The Senior Director, Cybersecurity Engineering and Operations reports to the CISO and provides multi-faceted leadership for all cybersecurity architecture functions. The role is responsible for leading the implementation, operation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of Penn Medicine cybersecurity protection platforms. This role oversees the engineering and operational support of enterprise security controls that protect users, devices, networks, applications, remote access, cloud services, and other critical technology assets across the organization.

The Senior Director drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, process optimization, platform modernization, automation, and service maturity initiatives across the cybersecurity program. This role is accountable for improving the efficiency, scalability, reliability, and effectiveness of cybersecurity services through standardized processes, technology rationalization, workflow automation, metrics-driven performance management, and ongoing operational enhancements. The position partners closely with business, clinical, and technology leaders to reduce risk while enabling innovation and supporting the organization's evolving cybersecurity strategy.

Responsibilities:

Lead cybersecurity engineering and operations teams responsible for implementation, configuration, lifecycle support, and operational reliability of enterprise protection technologies.
Establish operating models, service expectations, support processes, and platform ownership standards for cybersecurity systems across the enterprise.
Oversee enterprise firewalls, network segmentation controls, secure web gateways, remote access technologies, VPN services, cloud-delivered network security capabilities, and related network protection platforms.
Ensure network security controls are designed, implemented, maintained, and optimized to reduce risk while enabling clinical, research, and business operations
Direct endpoint protection capabilities including next-generation antivirus, endpoint detection and prevention controls, application control, ransomware protection, attack surface reduction, device control, and endpoint compliance technologies.
Maintain protection strategies across workstations, servers, virtual environments, remote users, and emerging endpoint/device platforms
Own platform lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, policy and configuration maintenance, capacity planning, vendor management, technology refreshes, monitoring, documentation, and service continuity planning.
Drive improvements in platform reliability, performance, scalability, supportability, and measurable security outcomes.
Advance automation, orchestration, workflow integration, API-based data exchange, and operational efficiencies across cybersecurity platforms.
Support modernization efforts that improve visibility, reduce manual work, standardize security control deployment, and enable faster execution of cybersecurity priorities
Partner with Cyber Defense, GRC, IAM, Privacy, Infrastructure, Clinical Operations, Cloud, Application Development, and business stakeholders to prioritize and implement security improvements.
Translate operational risks, platform gaps, and emerging threats into clear engineering roadmaps, remediation plans, and executive-level status reporting.
Lead, mentor, and develop cybersecurity engineering and operations staff through workforce planning, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and skills development.
Provide coaching and mentorship to nurture the development of staff in line with organization’s mission and values.
Build organizational readiness to absorb future cybersecurity engineering capabilities, including identity security engineering, data protection technologies, cloud security platforms, AI security controls, and other emerging protection services as assigned.
Performs duties in accordance with Penn Medicine and entity values, policies, and procedures.
Other duties as assigned to support the unit, department, entity, and health system organization.

Education or Equivalent Experience:

Bachelor's degree is required.
12+ years of IT experience is required.
7+ years of cybersecurity experience is required.
Master's degree OR 7+ years of management/leadership experience is preferred.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.

Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Title : Director, Power Infrastructure O&M - Data Center Operations

Basic Function:

The Director – Data Center Power Infrastructure Operations & Maintenance (O&M) provides leadership for operations, maintenance, reliability, for the HV portion of the SB Energy's data center electrical infrastructure portfolio.
This role will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, efficiency, safety, and commercial performance of electrical infrastructure supporting the data center building. The scope will include utility interconnections, substations, high-voltage distribution systems, backup power systems, and critical electrical assets outside the DC facility.
The successful candidate will serve as the leader and owner of the power infrastructure portfolio, driving performance optimization, asset reliability, budget accountability, contractor management, compliance, and reliability and uptime of the system. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in high-voltage electrical infrastructure and mission-critical operations with strong business acumen and stakeholder management capabilities.
Duties and Responsibilities: 

Operational Leadership

Lead the OM and operational performance of data center HV power infrastructure (substations and transmission lines) assets across multiple sites.
Own reliability, availability, capacity, and performance objectives for the electrical infrastructure portfolio.
Develop and execute strategies to maximize uptime, resiliency, and lifecycle value of critical assets.
Ensure continuous operation of utility substations, switchyards, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, and medium/high-voltage distribution networks.
Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across all facilities.
Establish and monitor operational KPIs, including:
Power Availability
Electrical Reliability
MTBF/MTTR
Capacity Utilization
Energy Efficiency
SLA Compliance

Lead root cause analysis for major incidents and implement corrective actions.
Develop and implement proactive predictive maintenance programs using condition monitoring, asset health analytics, and failure forecasting to identify potential equipment issues before they occur, minimizing operational risk.

Develop and manage critical spare parts strategies to optimize inventory levels, minimize MTTR (Mean Time to Repair), reduce outage duration, and consistently meet customer availability and uptime requirements.

Best Practices

Follow manufacturer specifications
and NETA standards
.
Integrate condition monitoring
(infrared, vibration, oil analysis) for predictive maintenance.
Maintain records
of all tests, inspections, and repairs for compliance and asset management.
Ensure safety protocols
for high-voltage work, including lockout/tagout and PPE.

High Voltage & Substation Management

Oversee operation and maintenance of substations up to transmission-level voltages.
Ensure compliance with utility requirements, interconnection agreements, and electrical standards.
Manage inspection, testing, and maintenance programs for:
Power Transformers
GIS/AIS Switchgear
Protective Relaying Systems
Circuit Breakers and switches
Bus Systems
SCADA Networks
Power Quality Equipment
Control building, etc.

Ensure proper execution of switching procedures, outage planning, and energization activities.
Support commissioning and acceptance testing of new substations and electrical infrastructure projects.
Drive initiatives to improve system reliability and reduce operational risk.

Commercial & Financial Management

Own annual operating budgets and long-range business plans for power infrastructure assets.
Monitor operating expenditures and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Develop business cases and ROI analyses for capital improvement projects.
Manage forecasting and lifecycle replacement planning of critical electrical equipment.
Support asset valuation, portfolio planning, acquisitions, divestitures, and expansion initiatives.
Partner with finance, procurement, and accounting teams to achieve financial targets.

Vendor & Contractor Management

Serve as the primary interface for:
Electrical O&M Providers
EPC Contractors
Utility Companies
OEMs
Consulting Engineers
Service Vendors

Manage contract performance, service-level compliance, and commercial negotiations.
Ensure preventive and predictive maintenance activities are executed according to established schedules.
Track and manage warranty claims, service agreements, and corrective action programs.
Oversee all non-contracted services including vegetation management, infrastructure repairs, and emergency response activities.

Reliability & Critical Facility Operations

Ensure all facilities meet targeted uptime objectives and service level commitments.
Develop reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), predictive maintenance and condition-based maintenance strategies.
Monitor electrical system health through SCADA, BMS, EMS, and monitoring platforms.
Evaluate equipment performance trends and identify potential risks before failure occurs.
Lead emergency response planning and incident management programs.
Drive implementation of predictive analytics and digital monitoring tools.
Establish asset lifecycle management strategies, including health indexing, remaining useful life (RUL) assessments, refurbishment planning, and end-of-life replacement roadmaps for critical electrical infrastructure.
Lead reliability data analysis and continuous improvement initiatives by tracking equipment performance, failure trends, KPIs, and lessons learned to improve fleet reliability, reduce forced outages, and optimize maintenance practices.

Stakeholder Management

Have strong sense and ownership of meeting and exceeding customer requirements
Interface with leadership, investors, customers, utility partners, regulators, and external stakeholders.
Present operational performance, risks, financial results, and improvement initiatives to senior management.
Support customer audits, utility inspections, regulatory reviews, and due diligence activities.
Act as the primary operational representative for site visits and strategic reviews.

Safety & Compliance

Champion a strong safety culture across all sites and contractors.
Ensure compliance with:
OSHA Standards
NFPA 70E
NERC Requirements (where applicable)
NEC Standards
Utility Safety Procedures
Environmental Regulations

Lead electrical safety programs including:
Arc Flash Studies
Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
Energized Work Procedures
Switching Authority Programs

Conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure operational compliance.

Team Leadership

Lead and develop a team of engineers, technicians, and operational staff.
Build organizational capability and technical expertise in high-voltage operations.
Establish succession planning, training programs, and performance management processes.
Mentor future leaders while fostering a culture of accountability and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Power Engineering, Engineering Technology, or related technical discipline.
Master's Degree preferred.
Professional certifications such as PE (Professional Engineer), PMP, NETA, Data Center Certifications & Certified Energy Manager (CEM), NERC Certifications (preferred)

Minimum 10 years of experience in industrial, utility, mission-critical, or power infrastructure environments.
Minimum 7 years of experience managing high-voltage electrical systems, substations, transmission/distribution assets, or data center power operations.
Minimum 3 years of people leadership experience.
Experience supporting hyperscale, colocation, enterprise data center, utility, or mission-critical facilities preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale electrical infrastructure portfolios exceeding 100 MW preferred.

Strong knowledge of:
High Voltage (HV) and Medium Voltage (MV) systems
Utility Interconnections
Substation Operations
Protection & Control Systems
SCADA Systems
Power Transformers
Switchgear and Relay Coordination
Generator and UPS Systems
Data Center Electrical Architecture

Single-Line Diagrams
Three-Line Diagrams
Protection Schematics
Control Logic Drawings

Experience with power system analysis, troubleshooting, and reliability engineering.
Working knowledge of:
NEC
IEEE Standards

NETA Standards
Utility Operating Practices

Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with significant careers.

Role Summary

We are evolving our Service Management team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in service management, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical services at LSEG.

What You will be Doing:

We are looking for people with a passion to learn, and who bring a continuous improvement mentality to our team!

Support Managers maintain Service Level Objectives for the systems they own. Constantly measuring and improving availability, latency, and overall system health is at the core of our team's purpose.
Write automation to scale systems sustainably, prevent service issues, or when they occur, quickly recover service.
Partner with development teams to improve system reliability, observability, and release velocity.
Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, postmortems, and root cause analysis and resolution.
Be a vocal advocate of strong/sound engineering practices that allow us to build, deploy, and run scalable, reliable, and performant services.
Enablers for Cloud migration working with foundation and migration teams from the inception of the projects performing architectural reviews, operational acceptable testing and configuring Datadog dashboards and metrics.
Be part of continuous learning and development culture.

What You will Bring:

A Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with scripting languages such as: Shell, Python, or similar.
Experience in maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
Hands on Experience with one of the following cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Knowledge on Docker and Kubernetes.
Observability tools like Datadog, Dynatrace or similar.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
Incident response and running blameless post-mortems.
Proficient in Git workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

Minimum 8-10 years in the industry
Experience on DevOps concepts and way of working
Experience with algorithms and data structures.
Understanding of identity and access management, and application security.
Native Azure relational databases.

We use Datadog and BigPanda for our observability stack, Terraform for our cloud infrastructure, and EntraID as our IAM solutions but we're very open to incorporating your experience with any other tools.

Career Stage:

Manager

Compensation/Benefits Information:

LSEG is committed to offering competitive Compensation and Benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $114,200 - $190,400.

Please be aware base salary ranges may vary by geographic location, city and state. In addition to our offered base salary, this role is eligible for our Annual Incentive Plan (AIP/”bonus plan”). Target AIP rates will be commensurate with role level and posted career stage. Individual salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and equivalent experience. LSEG roles (excluding internships and part-time roles of less than 20 hours per week) are typically eligible for inclusion in our LSEG Benefits program, which includes offerings of: Annual Wellness Allowance, Paid time-off, Medical, Dental, Vision, Flex Spending & Health Savings Options, Prescription Drug plan, 401(K) Savings Plan and Company match. LSEG’s Benefits plan also includes basic life insurance, disability benefits, emergency backup dependent care, adoption assistance commuter assistance etc.

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership
, Excellence
and Change
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

TE Connectivity is seeking a Senior Manager for Manufacturing & Process Development Engineering - Power Cables for our Digital Data Networks business unit. The Sr. MPDE Manager will lead a team of process development and automation engineers tasked with developing assembly processes for power cable assemblies and coordinating with the manufacturing engineering team on the transition to mass production.

This position will be located remotely in the US.

Job Requirements

Allocate and balance the work across direct reports; review and provide timely performance feedback to direct reports; mentor, develop and motivate them; help resolve people/functional issues in the team to achieve targeted performance and retain key talent.

Lead a team of engineers who will:
Develop power cable assembly manufacturing process in accordance with LEANPD product development.
Drive for excellence in existing manufacturing technologies and methods.
Strive to implement new manufacturing technologies to provide improved process and tolerance control.
Support Product Development in the optimization designs (DFM) and piece parts for manufacturability; realizes sample tooling, product samples and prototypes.
Design, develop, and qualify tooling and processes to meet TE DDN quality and production standards.
Support supply chain to verify supplier compliance and capability.
Act as the binding element between product development and manufacturing engineering, ensuring the effectiveness and efficiency of this critical interface.
Maintain communication with project management team to understand current and future strategic business needs
Prioritize and time manage a portfolio of projects/work efforts based on criticality and business need
Provide readouts to Director and VP level cross function management as necessary
Work with Mexico operations team to assign resources necessary for the successful execution of new product development
Facilitate and coordinate cross-function communication across globally matrixed organizations

What Your Background Should Look Like

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/electrical - related majors, and 13+ years’ related experience including 8+ years related, managerial-level experience in multinational manufacturing sites
Familiar with Lean, Six Sigma. etc. industrial methods/tools
Experience in power cable assembly industry, preferred
Fluent in English, with good presentation skills
Familiar with MS software
Familiar with industrial specification (i.e. IPC 620)
Familiar with Stamping / Plating / Molding / Assembly processes

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

About Te Connectivity

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

Compensation

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $158,600 – $237,900 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

Benefits

A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD

TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees
from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com
. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

jobs.title: VP Principle Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team's Passion

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience - shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win - clients, LPL, and most importantly our employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what's possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Generate Interest

LPL Financial is seeking a Vice President, Cloud Lead to help shape the future of our cloud technology ecosystem and drive the development of scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise platforms. This role offers the opportunity to influence technology strategy, guide cloud transformation initiatives, and work closely with business and technology partners to deliver innovative solutions that support LPL's strategic objectives.

As a key technology leader, you will collaborate with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Release Management, and Infrastructure teams to design and implement cloud-native and hybrid-cloud solutions. This role is ideal for someone passionate about modern software engineering, cloud architecture, platform scalability, and engineering excellence.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Cloud Lead is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications and platform services within cloud and hybrid-cloud environments. This role provides technical leadership across solution architecture, cloud engineering, application development, platform modernization, and software delivery. The position partners with business and technology stakeholders to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards, technology roadmaps, and business goals while maintaining scalability, security, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and development of scalable enterprise applications and platform services within cloud and hybrid-cloud environments.
Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Release Management, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions aligned with strategic objectives.
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, support, and ongoing enhancement.
Design solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and cloud engineering best practices.
Develop and support highly scalable platform components, APIs, applications, and services that serve enterprise business needs.
Provide advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and technical support for complex application and platform issues.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend architecture, process, and platform improvements to enhance performance, reliability, and scalability.
Contribute to solution planning, technical estimates, and roadmap development activities.
Maintain technical documentation and ensure solutions are properly documented throughout their lifecycle.
Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and adoption of best practices.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in software development, application architecture, and enterprise technology delivery.
5+ years of experience designing and developing cloud or hybrid-cloud solutions.
5+ years of experience with full-stack application development utilizing technologies such as C#, Angular (or similar frameworks), and relational databases.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting solutions on AWS cloud platforms.

Core Competencies

Expertise in cloud architecture and cloud-native application development.
Knowledge of microservices architecture, distributed systems, and modern application design patterns.
Understanding of DevSecOps methodologies, software delivery practices, and automation frameworks.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence technical direction and drive organizational change.
Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing engineering talent.
Knowledge of domain-driven design, test-driven development, and software quality practices.

Preferences

Cloud engineering or cloud architecture certifications.
Experience with AWS technologies including ECS, EKS, Fargate, VPC, S3, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, IAM, EC2, Lambda, and serverless architectures.
Experience with source control systems, CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and continuous delivery practices.
Experience developing API-driven, messaging, or event-streaming solutions utilizing technologies such as Apache Kafka or StreamSets.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.

Pay Range:

$159,959.00 - $266,564.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

We are the Adobe Pro Video group, responsible for building next generation professional video editing solutions and workflows. This leader will transform operational, manufacturing, product, and supply chain data into scalable engineering solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This role oversees the development of data systems supporting manufacturing operations, yield management, product genealogy, quality, inventory, supplier performance, and data center hardware lifecycle management. The Director partners closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, IT, Product Management, and Business Intelligence teams to build modern, scalable platforms that improve operational efficiency, visibility, and business performance.
