Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Hybrid Work Location:
Bloomington, IL

Hybrid Work Arrangement:
A "Hybrid" position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in office and from their home. Work arrangements could change over time based on business need. Hybrid work arrangement for Enterprise Technology is defined as residing within a 180-mile radius of the Hubs and Corporate.

Responsibilities

State Farm’s Infrastructure, Workplace, and Technology Services (IWTS) area is seeking an experienced Technology Director
to lead our Enterprise Endpoint Services organization. This director will define and execute strategy, engineering, delivery, and continuous improvement of endpoint technology services that enable a secure, reliable, and modern computing environment for employees and agents across the enterprise.

The Technology Director is accountable for the engineering, lifecycle management, security, automation, operational health, and modernization of enterprise endpoint platforms across PC, virtual desktop, and mobile. This leader will establish the long-term technology vision while ensuring operational excellence through standardization, automation, proactive engineering, and data-driven service management.

Working across Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, Procurement, Vendor Management, Agency Business, Claims, and external technology partners, this leader will shape the future of endpoint computing through engineering innovation, platform modernization, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines strategic technology leadership
with deep engineering expertise
and a passion for building resilient, scalable technology platforms that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise Endpoint Services strategy aligned to State Farm's technology vision and business objectives.
Define multi-year technology roadmaps for endpoint engineering, lifecycle management, automation, endpoint security, and platform modernization.
Lead enterprise modernization initiatives that improve endpoint reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments that improve operational capabilities while reducing complexity and technical debt.
Provide strategic leadership for enterprise endpoint engineering capabilities, including Endpoint and Desktop Platform Engineering, Endpoint Configuration and Policy Management, Endpoint Automation and Performance Engineering, Monitoring, Health Analytics, Workplace Technology Standards and Enterprise Virtual Desktop Services.
Lead engineering teams responsible for designing, building, securing, automating, and continuously improving enterprise endpoint platforms.

Establish engineering practices that improve platform reliability and service availability.
Lead strategic relationships with managed service providers, hardware manufacturers, software vendors, and technology partners.

Leadership

Foster a culture centered on ownership, innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
Coach leaders while building organizational capabilities that support future technology needs.
Promote collaboration across engineering, infrastructure, architecture, security, and business organizations.
Lead organizational change and technology transformation initiatives across the enterprise.

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.
5+ years leading enterprise endpoint engineering, workplace infrastructure, enterprise computing, or workplace technology services.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale endpoint environments supporting tens of thousands of enterprise devices.
Proven success leading enterprise modernization, platform engineering, and technology transformation initiatives.
Experience managing complex technology portfolios, multi-million-dollar budgets, and strategic vendor relationships.

Experience with enterprise technologies including:

MacOS Enterprise Management including JAMF

Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)

Enterprise software deployment and application lifecycle management

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

About You And This Role

Dow
has an exciting opportunity for a Technology Director
! In this role, you will define and lead the strategy for advancing digital capabilities within Digital Operations work processes. You will identify and prioritize opportunities where intelligent automation can improve decision-making, strengthen operational performance, and create sustainable business value. You will guide responsible adoption in partnership with Operations, technology, data, cybersecurity, and business teams, while maintaining a strong focus on safety, reliability, governance, and the needs of Dow sites and businesses. You will also provide mentoring and coaching to people leaders and professional individual contributors and foster an inclusive, collaborative environment grounded in integrity, customer focus, continuous improvement, and empowerment.

This position can be located at any Dow location in North America, Latin America, or Europe.

Responsibilities

Implement Operations strategy for advancing digital capabilities and responsible use within work processes.
Own accountability for oversight and implementation of the strategy within Digital Operations.
Partner with site, production, functional, and business leaders to understand operational needs and identify high-value opportunities.
Translate business priorities into practical digital solutions that streamline processes, strengthen reliability, and deliver measurable value.
Collaborate with Operations, technology, data, cybersecurity, and business teams to develop scalable solutions and integrate them effectively into existing work processes.
Establish clear measures of success and monitor adoption, operational performance, and value realization.
Build organizational understanding of advanced digital capabilities and support teams.
Develop and implement technology strategies aligned to site, function, and business needs.
Drive continuous improvement of technology-based performance and strategic guidance to senior leadership on emerging digital capabilities, operational opportunities, and associated risks.
Oversee digital technology improvement efforts, working with site/production leadership.

Required Qualifications

A minimum of a bachelor's degree or relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E5 or Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class or Sergeant ranking.
A minimum of 10 years of relevant working experience.
For U.S. Applicants: A minimum requirement for this position is the ability to work legally in the United States.  No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of permanent residency (green card) process.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong digital background & understanding of advanced digital portfolio within Manufacturing.

Skills

Technology Strategies: The ability to develop and execute long-term technology strategies that align with business objectives, industry trends, and emerging technologies to drive innovation and competitive advantage.
Business Strategies: The ability to translate business goals into actionable technology initiatives, evaluate market opportunities, and influence strategic decisions that support organizational growth and profitability.
Budget Management: The ability to effectively manage technology and innovation budgets, prioritize investments, allocate resources, and deliver projects that achieve financial and operational objectives.
Continuous Improvement: The ability to identify opportunities for process, technology, and performance enhancements, driving efficiency, quality, and operational excellence through continuous improvement initiatives.
Reliability: The ability to establish and maintain reliable technologies, systems, and processes by proactively identifying risks, improving performance, and ensuring long-term operational sustainability.
Technical Mentorship and Coaching: Ability to coach and mentor others on the application of specialized technical knowledge.
Decision-Making: Ability to make data-based decisions for safe and effective operations.
Collaboration: Ability to interact with a diverse group of people, including customers, technicians and other engineers.  You must be able to communicate clearly both up to leadership and laterally to peers and be able to influence results and negotiate conflict.

Ad
ditional Notes

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform to join our team. This is a remote (within the US) role, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise Data Platform in the IT Data Strategy department. In this role, you will be a key technical and strategic leader responsible for driving the architecture, strategy, and continuous evolution of our modern enterprise data platform.

You will lead the central data team, balancing its evolution into a highly effective, self-service platform team while actively supporting critical, high-impact, organization-wide data initiatives. A core focus of this role is preparing both the central data team and federated business intelligence units (such as Sales, Marketing, and other internal business functions) to become AI-ready, implementing strategies to embed AI directly into daily data analytics. This is a critical leadership position requiring a passionate innovator who is equally comfortable defining high-level strategy, establishing platform governance, and rolling up their sleeves to tackle complex, hands-on technical challenges.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform to join our team. This is a remote (within the US) role, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise Data Platform in the IT Data Strategy department. In this role, you will be a key technical and strategic leader responsible for driving the architecture, strategy, and continuous evolution of our modern enterprise data platform.

You will lead the central data team, balancing its evolution into a highly effective, self-service platform team while actively supporting critical, high-impact, organization-wide data initiatives. A core focus of this role is preparing both the central data team and federated business intelligence units (such as Sales, Marketing, and other internal business functions) to become AI-ready, implementing strategies to embed AI directly into daily data analytics. This is a critical leadership position requiring a passionate innovator who is equally comfortable defining high-level strategy, establishing platform governance, and rolling up their sleeves to tackle complex, hands-on technical challenges.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

Drive Platform Strategy, Architecture, & Evolution: Define the long-term technical roadmap, architecture, and strategy for the Enterprise Data Platform (utilizing Snowflake, dbt, Matillion DPC, and Streamlit). Balance the evolution toward modern platform operating models (medallion and mesh architectures) while actively supporting critical, high-impact, organization-wide business initiatives
Enable Self-Service & Mesh Architectures: Empower decentralized business functions (such as Sales, Marketing, and Finance) to be entirely self-sufficient. Establish the fundamental analytics layers (Raw, Transform, Analytics) and deliver standard data contracts, allowing federated BI teams to easily build and run their own custom data models
Embed AI into Data, Pipelines, & Analytics: Advance both the central and federated teams to become truly AI-ready. Design and implement strategies to embed AI directly into enterprise analytics, including building complex data pipelines (ETL), custom data apps, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG / Graph RAG) architectures directly on the data platform
Architect AI-Driven Platform Operations & Governance: Implement frameworks for robust platform governance, data observability, and transparent cost attribution to optimize compute resources and Snowflake token consumption. You will be directly responsible for building and embedding automated AI systems (AIOps) to streamline platform operations—leveraging AI/LLMs for token cost optimization, automated metadata cataloging, and auto-triage of daily pipeline alerts
Lead with Continuous Innovation & Hands-On Execution: Lead from the front as a hands-on manager who can jump into the codebase to tackle complex projects, prototype advanced workflows, or troubleshoot critical pipelines when required. Constantly research and evaluate the latest market trends and modern data technologies to keep our platform ecosystem at the cutting edge

Who You Are (Success Profile)

Act as an owner with a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between defining high-level strategy and executing hands-on technical tasks.
Approach complex data challenges as a natural problem-solver, energized by finding elegant solutions that deliver maximum business impact.
Lead with deep integrity and accountability, building trust across the organization through transparent actions and high standards.
Think at scale by connecting daily engineering initiatives to the global company mission and designing robust, future-proof data solutions.
Foster high-trust collaboration by championing team success, participating in a healthy feedback culture, and driving cross-functional alignment.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

AI Readiness Strategy: Demonstrated experience driving technical strategies to transition traditional data structures and business intelligence teams into AI-ready units
Proven Leadership: 5+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and growing high-performing data engineering, platform engineering, or analytics engineering teams
Snowflake & dbt Expertise: Deep architectural and operational knowledge of Snowflake and dbt (analytics engineering, modeling standards, testing)
Enterprise AI Infrastructure & Data Prep: Hands-on knowledge of designing data pipelines (ETL), analytics, and building/serving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures—including Graph RAG—on cloud data platforms
Self-Service & Mesh Experience: Practical experience implementing or operating within a self-service data platform environment and a Data Mesh architectural framework (Raw, Transform, Analytics)
Modern ETL & Engineering Foundations: Strong hands-on experience with cloud-native ETL/ELT tools (preferably Matillion Data Productivity Cloud or similar) and strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL (CI/CD, Git, automated testing)

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

Extreme Technical Depth: The ability to jump into the codebase, write complex code/models, and confidently lead the implementation of complex, highly technical data projects
Advanced AI & Applications in Snowflake: Experience leveraging Snowflake’s advanced AI capabilities (e.g., Cortex, Snowpark) and building custom data applications using Streamlit

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin, TX | New York, NY | Lisbon, Portugal | London, UK

About The Role

As the Engineering Manager for our Developer Observability Platform you will manage a high-velocity customer-obsessed team. Your mission will be to empower customers by making their telemetry discoverable and actionable in one place.

The team is international and distributed, they move fast and are deeply attuned to customer feedback. They bring a deep range of observability experience from major companies and fast-moving startups. This is a deeply cross-functional role that will need to understand the nuances of monitoring some of our most complex and high volume primitives such as Workers, Workers for Platforms, Agents, and Durable Objects. This is a high-visibility role that will be directly interfacing with some of our biggest customers.

Responsibilities

Deliver excellent customer outcomes above all else. Whatever is required - building, planning, deciding, designing, communicating - you are accountable and get it done.
Set the technical and product vision along with your PM and Engineers. Build the right thing at the right time.
Building an observability platform for the current AI driven ecosystem. Agents empower new types of platforms capabilities even as they require new types of observability.
Own the operational aspects of your platform such as SLOs, incident response, customer escalations, and technical debt. Reliability is its own feature.
Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers. We have a high bar and expect you to raise it.
Cultivate a team culture that values fast iteration, high agency, and ownership.
Work cross-functionally with a range of platform and product teams to instrument and surface meaningful data in actionable ways.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience

A minimum of 8 years of relevant industry experience, including at least 4 years managing software engineering teams.
Proven track record leading teams that have shipped and operated complex, large-scale systems and data-driven applications. Preferably in observability, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, edge/proxy systems, or high-scale APIs.
Significant technical depth, with the ability to guide architectural discussions, make credible technical decisions, review designs, and unblock your team.
Strong developer tools taste. You have used and built enough observability products to know what makes them delightful or painful.
Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop senior engineers, and to build high-performing, inclusive teams that ship. You care about teams and team culture.
A hands-on approach to leadership: you consider yourself a builder, stay close to the code, know the numbers, know the customer, and know what to build next.

Bonus Points

Working on hosted customer-facing observability products
Instrumenting observability in global-scale, production environments
Implementing observability (OTLP, OLAP databases such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, etc)
Experience building with Cloudflare’s Developer Platform and have opinions on where we could improve, especially with respect to observability.

For Portugal-based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000 - €122,000

Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence & Data Engineering
jobs.description:
About Salud Healthcare

At Salud Healthcare, we are transforming how value-based care is delivered by empowering clinical and operational teams with data-driven insights. As a growing MSO, we serve provider groups, supporting better patient outcomes through smart infrastructure, modern technology, and people-first innovation.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Business Intelligence & Data Engineering to own our data platform and analytics end-to-end — the Databricks Enterprise Datawarehouse with curated data marts, a governed semantic layer and BI, and the engineering discipline behind the data-adjacent applications. This is a builder-first leadership role: you will set the technical direction for data, lead by example on quality and delivery, and grow a team that turns a data-and-analytics group into a stable engineering organization.

You will be the technical leader who guarantees data quality at the source — so that upstream disruptions never propagate. You will own a single source of truth for metrics through a modern semantic layer, and you will bring the requirements discipline, review, testing, environment parity, and cost governance that keep a healthcare data platform trustworthy and auditable.

This role is ideal for a data leader who has built and operated a lakehouse and BI stack inside a healthcare MSO or comparable value-based-care organization, has strong opinions on modeling and governance, and wants to build a high-leverage function from a strong foundation.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform (EDW 2.0 / Databricks)
·            Own the Databricks medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold): pipeline reliability, Delta/Unity Catalog governance, lineage, and performance.
·            Keep the Gold layer trustworthy and observable — monitor freshness and alert on failure, not just success.
·            Set standards for ingestion from payer, claims, clinical, and Salesforce sources.

Semantic Layer & Business Intelligence
·            Own a modern, governed semantic / metrics layer (Cube or Looker) as the single source of truth for business metrics — consistent numbers across every consumer.
·            Own the reporting the business runs on: accurate, timely, and governed dashboards for leadership and operations.

Data Quality & Integrity
·            Put data-quality gates and controls in place so upstream disruptions (e.g., provider / organization data) don't propagate downstream.
·            Instrument freshness, completeness, and reconciliation checks; make failures loud and traceable.

Engineering Standards & Delivery
·            Establish requirements defined and frozen per sprint, PR review, tests that assert effect, trunk-based delivery, and dev / QA / prod parity — across pipelines and the apps built on top of them.
·            Operate the 2-week sprint cadence (JIRA, GitHub, Confluence); champion AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor) as a daily team practice, kept under human review and tests.

Cost & Security Governance
·            Own per-workload cloud cost governance on Azure and Databricks: budgets, caps, owners, tagging, and right-sizing — so an ungoverned run can never surprise us again.
·            Enforce private networking, least-privilege access, and HIPAA-aligned controls (audit logging, encryption, access review) across the data estate.

Team Leadership & Roadmap
·            Lead and grow the data engineering and BI team, and direct the offshore full-stack engineer(s); build hiring pipelines and lead interview loops.
·            Partner with clinical, operations, and finance stakeholders; protect focus with a single, prioritized roadmap instead of many half-built efforts.

Required Qualifications

·            10+ years in data engineering / business intelligence, with at least 3 years leading teams.
·            Fluent in Databricks / Spark — hands-on with the lakehouse, Delta, Unity Catalog, and SQL warehouses.
·            Fluent in a modern semantic-layer BI platform — Cube or Looker (LookML) — building governed, reusable metrics; PowerBI reporting a strong plus.
·            Strong SQL and dimensional + semantic data modeling.
·            Healthcare industry experience is REQUIRED — you understand payer, claims, and clinical data and its sensitivity (HIPAA, HITECH, PHI, BAAs). MSO / IPA / ACO / value-based-care experience strongly preferred.
·            Proven delivery discipline — sprints, code review, testing, and CI/CD — for data and/or application teams.
·            Cloud data platforms (Azure preferred); data governance, lineage, and data-quality practice.
·            Excellent communication with executives and business users; you translate between the two.

Preferred Qualifications

·            Direct experience at a healthcare MSO, IPA, ACO, or value-based-care organization is strongly preferred.
·            Medicare Advantage specifics: HEDIS, HCC / risk adjustment, MMR, eligibility, and claims (X12 837/835/834/270/271).
·            dbt, Airflow / Astronomer, or comparable data-platform tooling.
·            Application-adjacent engineering (FastAPI / React, Azure Container Apps) to credibly govern the app teams.
·            Salesforce data pipelines; FinOps / cloud cost management.
·            Experience leading distributed or offshore teams across time zones. healthcare setting.

jobs.description:
Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.

About Trial Library

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.

Trial Library is seeking an experienced Head of Engineering
to lead our engineering organization and build the next generation of our AI-native platform. You will lead Engineering and Infrastructure while partnering closely with Product to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing software. This is a hands-on leadership role for an engineering leader who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, building production AI systems, and mentoring exceptional engineering teams in a fast-paced startup environment. You'll help shape the technical direction of our platform while remaining deeply engaged in architecture, engineering execution, and technical decision-making.

Your Responsibilities:

Lead and scale Trial Library's Engineering organization, fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.
Partner with Product to translate business and customer needs into scalable technical solutions.
Own software architecture, engineering execution, platform reliability, and technical delivery.
Lead application engineering, AI engineering, infrastructure, DevSecOps, IT, and platform operations.
Design and build cloud-native systems supporting AI-powered products, including LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, model evaluation, and production inference services.
Drive engineering excellence through modern software development practices, CI/CD, testing, observability, and operational excellence.
Build resilient, scalable infrastructure capable of supporting rapid product growth and evolving AI workloads.
Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams while creating an environment of continuous learning.
Partner cross-functionally with Clinical, Customer Success, Commercial, and Operations to deliver reliable customer experiences.
Ensure platform security, privacy, and compliance with HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements.
Balance engineering velocity with scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long-term technical health.
Stay current on emerging AI technologies and engineering best practices to continuously improve our platform.

Your Requirements:

8+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including engineering leadership in startup or high-growth environments.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and scaling SaaS platforms.
Strong technical background in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, APIs, and modern software engineering practices.
Experience building and operating production AI systems using large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, machine learning infrastructure, or related technologies.
Experience designing scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
Demonstrated success recruiting, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams.
Ability to balance rapid product delivery with platform reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments
Experience within healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, HIPAA, and SOC 2 is a plus.

Why Trial Library

Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows

Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company-building and decision-making

Our Core Values

Ally is our favorite moniker
The broadest reach is worth the effort
Celebrate measurable improvements in access and outcomes
Fearless advocates for representation in research
Incentives matter to stakeholders choosing our products
Taking initiative is actually giving
We are accountable for the experience of patients and providers
Empathy and humility are the real dynamic duo

jobs.description:
About Us

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description

The Equity Management team is looking for a seasoned Director of Software Engineering to take on one of the most consequential roles in the organization — leading the Platform & Architecture vertical. Reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering, you will be responsible for greenfield development as well as the core existing application with a mature enterprise customer base and multiple Fortune 100 broker relationships.

You will own the success of a true 0-to-1 platform modernization — a ground-up greenfield project to build an equity platform as an Azure cloud-native application. You will join the initiative in its early phase and drive the teams through MVP and GA on an aggressive timeline. insightsoftware is an AI-first organization, and this initiative is utilizing pure AI Spec-Driven Development (SDD) with GitHub SpecKit and Claude Code in the Azure stack (Azure SQL, Data Lake, Fabric, AKS, Entra, .NET, Angular). This is the single-most strategically important initiative in the organization. You'll partner directly with Solution Architecture, Engineering, Product Management, and UX in achieving cross-functional success. Technical direction for the modernization sits with the Solution Architect, functional direction sits with the Product team, execution sits with the Engineering Manager — your role owns the program delivery and holds every contributing team accountable.

You will also own the existing application ecosystem running the business today — the core CEM platform and all broker integrations that 1,200+ customers depend on every day, top to bottom, from front-end to database. You'll own the stability, health, and delivery of the legacy application, and migration to the new platform when it is ready.

You are the right person for this role if you thrive in leaning into ambiguity and forging the path ahead, are not afraid to fail fast, and recognize that sometimes it's better to proceed without all the facts rather than standing at the fork in the road waiting for the perfect circumstances. Extreme accountability, cross-team collaboration & leadership, client-facing, strong communication — these are a few of the traits that describe the ideal candidate. You'll lead these initiatives with somewhere between 4-6 teams, all with Managers and Senior Managers reporting directly to you.

Responsibilities

Modernization Initiative - Ownership & Delivery Accountability

Own overall delivery accountability for the modernization initiative — defining the plan, sequencing execution, and driving it to completion.
Partner closely with the Solution Architect, who owns technical direction and architecture decisions for the initiative; this role owns translating that direction into a resourced, sequenced, accountable delivery plan.
Continue to push boundaries in Spec-Driven Development (SDD), encouraging Lean and fail-fast experimentation. Grow the usage and adoption of modern AI development practices.
Own Engineering and QA/Automation directly for the modernization initiative, while driving Product and UI/UX as a matrixed, non-reporting partner toward the same outcome.
Establish and enforce delivery standards and definition-of-done discipline consistently across Engineering, Product, and UX/Design.
Proactively identify misalignment, blockers, and undecided cross-functional questions before they surface on their own - engineering, product, and design each report through different leaders, and this role is accountable for the seams between them.
Hold Engineering, Product, and UX/Design equally accountable for delivery commitments. This is a cross-functional accountability role - success requires driving outcomes with partners outside your direct reporting line, not just within it.
Communicate program status with complete candor to the Sr Director, VP, and executive stakeholders — including surfacing bad news early rather than smoothing it over in status reporting.

Broker & Core CEM Portfolio Delivery

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for insightsoftware's broker integration programs.
Own delivery accountability for the core Certent Equity Management (CEM) platform serving 1,200+ global customers, ensuring committed roadmap items and client-critical fixes are delivered on schedule.
Balance capacity and prioritization across the initiative, broker programs, and core CEM delivery; escalate tradeoffs to the Sr Director directly and early when competing demands threaten committed dates.
Serve as the single point of delivery accountability across this full portfolio — executive leadership should get one clear, consistent narrative regardless of which program they're asking about.

Team Leadership & People Management

Own people leadership across 4-6 teams, each led by a Manager or Senior Manager, spanning platform modernization, Broker Applications & Broker Integrations, Core CEM Application, and Platform Services.
Coach and develop the managers and senior managers reporting to you — including calibrating what kind of leadership a given team or program actually needs, and adjusting staffing decisions as needed.
Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and retention across your organization; partner with the Sr Director on headcount and org design for the vertical.
Shield your teams' capacity from competing delivery pulls; escalate conflicts when external demands threaten committed delivery.
Build a high-trust, high-accountability culture — explicitly encouraging fast, reversible decisions over prolonged research cycles, and rewarding people who proactively surface risk.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years of software engineering experience in enterprise SaaS environments, including 5+ years leading multiple managers or senior managers at Director level or equivalent scope.
Demonstrated track record driving large, ambiguous, cross-functional programs to completion — defining the plan, sequencing execution, and holding every contributing team accountable, regardless of reporting line.
Demonstrated pattern of proactively surfacing organizational risk or misalignment that nobody asked you to look for — not just responding quickly to problems once they're visible, but actively investigating whether the plan everyone believes is true actually is.
Bias toward the smallest end-to-end slice that proves a concept works, over fully building out any one piece in isolation — comfortable shipping something rough and connected rather than something polished and disconnected.
Skilled at continually measuring progress against the next most important priority, and realigning the team and plan as that priority shifts — rather than executing a fixed plan on inertia.
Structures deliverables and sequencing to proactively avoid blockers and dependency conflicts before they occur — rather than resolving blockers reactively after they've already stalled a team.
Technical fluency in modern software architecture and Azure cloud-native platforms to partner credibly with a Solution Architect and translate technical direction into a delivery plan. This role is not expected to make architecture decisions.
Experience in data architecture — Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Data Lake & medallion architecture with temporal tables.
Experience managing a portfolio with real external/customer stakes — client-facing programs, SLAs, or regulated delivery commitments, including direct customer-facing communication.
Strong executive communication skills — able to deliver complete, candid status to senior leadership, including surfacing problems early.
Demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity — able to forge a path forward without a fully-defined plan handed down in advance.
Experience with modern software delivery practices: Agile/Scrum, CI/CD pipelines, code review standards, and definition-of-done discipline.
Experience managing distributed, global teams across multiple time zones.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent work experience.
Proven track record in spec-driven or AI-assisted development methodologies.

Preferred

Background in financial services, equity compensation, banking/brokerage integrations, or adjacent regulated domains.
Direct experience delivering enterprise SaaS programs serving 1,000+ clients.

Engineering Manager / Director / VP — EO/IR & C5ISR Systems

Clearance:
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret clearance or have an Active Secret/TS clearance preferred.  
Travel:
Up to 15-20%, including customer sites, test ranges, and integration facilities

About the Role

We design, build, and integrate electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor systems and integrate full C5ISR (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) surveillance solutions for military and border security customers. Our systems combine long-range thermal and visible cameras, laser rangefinders, radar, precision positioners, and AI-enabled command-and-control software into fielded, mission-ready towers and platforms operating in some of the most demanding environments in the world.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager/Director
to lead our multidisciplinary engineering organization — spanning optical, mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineering — from early concept through fielded, sustained deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can manage people and programs while still being credible in system technical solutions, requirements development, design approach, system performance, and system analysis of alternatives.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Team Management

Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional engineering team (optical/EO design, mechanical/positioner design, electrical/power, embedded and application software, and systems engineering).
Set engineering standards, design processes, documentation discipline (SOSA/MOSA-aligned architecture, ISA compliance, configuration management).
Own hiring, performance management, career development, and resource planning across engineering disciplines.
Foster a culture of design rigor, root-cause problem solving, and field-reliability focus, given systems are deployed in extreme and remote environments.

Technical & Program Ownership

Serve as technical authority for EO/IR sensor suite design (MWIR/LWIR thermal, SWIR, visible-day cameras), precision pan-tilt positioners, laser rangefinders, radar, and C2 integration.
Drive systems engineering for full C5ISR integration: sensor fusion, video tracking/ATR, edge processing, power (solar/battery/hybrid), communications (MANET, satcom, cellular, fiber), and command-and-control (C2) software interoperability (e.g., TAK, OPTIC-class government C2 environments).
Lead trade studies and architecture decisions balancing range performance, size/weight/power (SWaP), environmental survivability (temperature extremes, wind, salt fog, precipitation, dust), and lifecycle maintainability (LRU-based field repair).
Experienced in troubleshooting of systems and EO/IR cameras
Lead technical proposal support for government RFIs/RFPs, including performance specifications, ROM costing input, and technical volume authorship.
Interface directly with government and prime-contractor customers (DoD, DHS/CBP, and international partners) on requirements definition, technical exchanges, and test/demonstration events.

Program Execution & Quality

Manage engineering schedules, budgets, and deliverables across concurrent development and sustainment programs.
Ensure designs meet applicable military and environmental standards (MIL-STD-810 shock/vibration/environmental, IP-rated enclosures, EMI/EMC as applicable).
Oversee test planning and execution, including range/field demonstrations in extreme environments (e.g., cold-weather Northern Border testing, desert, maritime).
Own root-cause investigation and corrective action for system issues, feeding lessons learned back into design.
Ensure compliance with applicable export control regulations (ITAR/EAR) and government cybersecurity/interface requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Program Management, Business Development/Capture, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain to align engineering execution with contract and business commitments.
Support proposal and capture activities with technical content, performance data, and system configuration recommendations.
Represent Engineering in customer-facing reviews (PDR/CDR-style reviews, demonstrations, and technical interchange meetings).

Required Qualifications

Works with development engineers to develop, execute, and track the testing of new and existing products and accessories. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This job is responsible for building and leading a team to deliver technology products and services that meet business outcomes. Key responsibilities include developing a technology strategy, ensuring technology solutions comply with applicable standards, promoting design, engineering, and organizational practices, and advocating and advancing modern, Agile solution delivery practices. Job expectations may include coaching, mentoring, providing feedback and hands on career development, identifying emerging talent, fostering leadership skills, and managing stakeholders.

Overview:

An exciting opportunity exists within Enterprise Risk & Finance Application Production Services (ERF APS) for an experienced Application Support Lead to join the Global Financial Crimes (GFC) Application Production Services team supporting the firm's critical Sanctions technology portfolio.

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for ensuring the stability, resiliency, and operational excellence of business-critical Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) applications. The successful candidate will lead production support activities, drive continuous service improvement, strengthen operational risk management practices, and partner closely with technology, compliance, and business stakeholders to deliver highly available and resilient services.

This role offers a unique opportunity to develop deep expertise in Financial Crimes technology while supporting applications that enable the firm's regulatory compliance and risk management objectives. The position provides broad exposure to enterprise technologies including Hadoop, Teradata, Informatica, and cloud-based monitoring platforms, while advancing knowledge of application resiliency, incident management, problem management, observability, and automation practices.

The ideal candidate is a proactive technology professional with strong technical and analytical capabilities who thrives in a fast-paced production environment and is passionate about operational excellence, service reliability, and continuous improvement.

You will play a critical role in protecting the bank and its customers by supporting technology solutions that help identify, prevent, and manage financial crime risk. This position offers the opportunity to combine technical leadership, operational excellence, and risk management expertise while working with some of the firm's most critical regulatory applications.

Responsibilities:

Builds and manages teams by performing financial activities to inform workforce strategy and hiring practices, setting and tracking maturity and quality objectives, and training employees/teams to address feedback and achieve quality and performance objectives
Facilitates performance and career development of employees/teams through performance reviews, coaching, and creating development plans that are needed to build competencies and skills
Manages solution delivery and application performance in production (app health, resiliency, performance, security, enterprise data management standards, audit exams and reviews), ensuring all relevant risk, financial, and compliance policies are met
Manages relationships with business and technology partners and leads and creates followership in Communities of Practice in the organization
Contributes to the technology strategy for their technical domain
Creates an inclusive and healthy working environment and helps to resolve organizational impediments/blockers
Ensures that execution is aligned with product strategy by working with product management and other stakeholders
Lead day-to-day production support activities for the Global Financial Crimes Sanctions portfolio, ensuring platform stability, availability, and performance
Drive rapid diagnosis, triage, and resolution of production incidents, minimizing customer and business impact
Manage application health, operational risk, audit findings, and compliance obligations while driving remediation and control improvements
Partner with business, compliance, risk, infrastructure, and development teams to ensure effective support of critical Financial Crimes applications
Provide leadership during major incidents and production events, coordinating technical teams through resolution and recovery activities
Conduct root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions to prevent recurring issues
Monitor and manage complex batch processing environments, ensuring timely completion of critical business workflows
Lead application resiliency, business continuity, and disaster recovery testing activities to ensure operational readiness
Drive automation initiatives, observability enhancements, and process improvements to reduce operational toil and improve service reliability
Develop and maintain operational procedures, support documentation, runbooks, and knowledge management artifacts
Deliver executive-ready communications, operational reporting, and service performance metrics to stakeholders and leadership
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence across the support organization

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications within large-scale, highly regulated environments
Proven experience leading production support teams and managing mission-critical applications
Strong technical and analytical skills with experience supporting both proprietary and vendor-based technology solutions
Experience supporting applications within financial services, banking, or other regulated industries
Demonstrated experience managing production incidents, service restoration efforts, and problem management activities

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership

jobs.title: Senior Director, Customer Health & Critical Accounts
jobs.description:
The Role

MongoDB is building two connected capabilities that determine how we protect and grow our most important customer relationships: a Critical Accounts program that catches at-risk accounts early and drives them to a durable resolution, and a Customer Health Platform, an AI-powered one-stop shop for customer insights, combining health, adoption, engagement, and experience data with proactive risk identification and recommended actions.

This role owns both. You will build and lead the Critical Accounts function end to end: the framework, the global operating model, and the executive reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio. You will also set the long-term vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform: what it scores and alerts on, which teams and use cases it serves next, and how it becomes the one-stop shop for customer insight across the company. You will be accountable for how MongoDB identifies, intervenes on, and learns from customer risk, and for where the Customer Health platform goes next.

This is a build role. You are creating the operating rhythm, the standards, and the team structure as much as you are running them.

This role can be based out of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

What You Will Do

Own and Build the Critical Accounts Program

Design and iterate on the global Critical Accounts framework: entry/exit criteria, account archetypes, playbooks, health assessment templates, and Get Well Plan standards.
Design the central Critical Accounts org structure and hire a lean program management team, establishing this as a durable, well-resourced function within Customer Strategy. This team is the connective tissue that ensures every qualifying account is triaged, resourced, tracked, and ultimately graduated with documented outcomes.
Own intake and triage standards so every qualifying nomination is validated, classified, and assigned a process lead and resource plan without delay.
Design the path for Critical Accounts to move beyond human nomination alone, working with Customer Health to define the signals and thresholds that proactively detect at-risk accounts and surface them for the cohort, so nominations come from both human judgment and the platform's early-warning detection.
Own program coordination: the master tracker of active critical accounts, cross-functional stand-ups with Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Product and Engineering, the 90-day checkpoint process, and resource rebalancing as account needs evolve.
Own executive reporting for the program: weekly account status, monthly portfolio readouts with trend analysis, and quarterly summaries covering program KPIs, churn prevented, and cost-to-save ratios.
Set and track program KPIs, de-escalation rate, time-to-exit, CSAT delta, churn prevented, resource hours per account, and refine investment tiers based on actual data.
Lead post-mortem reviews for every graduated account and route findings into QBRs, product prioritization, and process improvements, ensuring learnings reach the business within one quarter of exit.

Lead Customer Intelligence & AI

Own the multi-year vision and strategy for the Customer Health Platform, defining what it becomes beyond a Customer Success tool: the single, trusted platform for customer insight that every GTM function draws on to understand and act on customer signal
Set the roadmap priorities for expanding Customer Health's reach: new data sources, new use cases, and new next-best-action and AI-driven experiences
Make the platform-level calls on scope, sequencing, and investment as Customer Health scales across functions, as we as align with cross-functional executives on the path forward
Ensure Customer Health and the Critical Accounts program reinforce each other: account health scores and signals should feed directly into critical account identification, triage, Get Well Plans, and portfolio reporting.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Marketing, and GTM on how Customer Health orchestrates and surfaces insight: who gets alerted about which issues, when, and through which channel (internal vs. external), and how health data and alerts show up in the comms and UI layer for account teams, customers, and partners.

Provide Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the connective tissue across Customer, Product & Technology, Engineering, and GTM leadership for everything related to customer risk, intelligence, and intervention.
Give executives real-time, high-trust visibility into both the Critical Accounts and Customer Health portfolio

What You Will Bring

12+ years in Customer Success, Program Management, or Customer/GTM Operations, ideally in a consumption-based or B2B SaaS company, with several years in a people-management or senior program leadership role.
A track record of building a program or function from the ground up, not just running an existing one, including designing frameworks, standing up teams, and establishing executive reporting.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements under pressure; direct experience with a critical accounts, save, or escalation management program is strongly preferred.
Experience managing people leaders or senior individual contributors, with the judgment to set direction and hold others accountable without needing to run every workstream personally.
Strong cross-functional leadership without direct authority, and the ability to align Director- and VP-level peers across functions to a shared plan.
Executive-grade written and verbal communication; comfort presenting portfolio health, program KPIs, and business cases to senior leadership and, at times, the board.
Data-driven approach to management: builds and tracks KPIs rather than relying on status updates, and is comfortable reasoning about scoring, health signals, or model-driven recommendations even without an engineering background.
Familiarity with technical customer challenges (cloud, data infrastructure, or database preferred) and with how account teams actually work day to day.
High composure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations, with a bias toward bringing decisions and solutions rather than problems.

Nice to Have

Experience building and managing a Critical Accounts or similar escalation/save function, from designing entry/exit criteria and playbooks through running the portfolio day to day.
Experience owning or sponsoring an AI-powered customer intelligence, account health, or GTM tooling initiative spanning multiple functions.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, AWS Developer Tools
jobs.description:
Description

Software development is undergoing its most fundamental transformation in decades. AI agents are becoming the primary way developers build and operate software — agent activity spans nearly a million AWS accounts, and agents now make tens of billions of AWS API calls every month. The AWS Developer Tools organization sits at the center of this shift. Our mission is to make AWS the fastest and safest place to build, deploy, and operate production applications through AI agents.

Our portfolio spans the full lifecycle of building on AWS. The Agent Toolkit and our evaluation and benchmarking systems make agents effective on AWS; the Code* services accelerate the path from code to production; CloudFormation and CDK make infrastructure change fast and safe.

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to own the vision, strategy, and execution across this portfolio. You will lead a large team of technical product managers spanning agent enablement, the software development lifecycle, infrastructure as code, and cloud operations. The market for agent-native development is being created right now, and this role decides where AWS places its bets.

About This Role

Senior Engineer – Backend (Java) – Vice President

Aladdin Engineering – Investments & Trading Engineering

Are you interested in building innovative technology that crafts the financial markets? Do you like working at the speed of a startup, and solving some of the world’s most exciting challenges? Do you want to work with, and learn from, hands-on leaders in technology and finance?

At BlackRock, we are looking for Software Engineers who like to innovate and solve sophisticated problems. We recognize that strength comes from diversity, and will embrace your outstanding skills, curiosity, and passion while giving you the opportunity to grow technically and as an individual.

We invest and protect over $9 trillion (USD) of assets and have an extraordinary responsibility to our clients all over the world. Our technology empowers millions of investors to save for retirement, pay for college, buy a home, and improve their financial well-being.

Being a technologist at BlackRock means you get the best of both worlds: working for one of the most sophisticated financial companies and being part of a software development team responsible for next generation technology and solutions.

What are Aladdin and Aladdin Engineering?

You will be working on BlackRock's investment operating system called Aladdin. Aladdin is used both internally within BlackRock and externally by many financial institutions. Aladdin combines sophisticated risk analytics with comprehensive portfolio management, trading, and operations tools on a single platform to power informed decision-making and create a connective tissue for thousands of users investing worldwide.
Our development teams reside inside the Aladdin Engineering group. We collaboratively build the next generation of technology that changes the way information, people, and technology intersect for global investment firms. We build and package tools that manage trillions in assets and supports millions of financial instruments. We perform risk calculations and process millions of transactions for thousands of users every day worldwide!

Being a Member Of Aladdin Engineering, You Will Be

Tenacious: Work in a fast paced and highly complex environment.
Creative thinker: Analyze multiple solutions and deploy technologies in a flexible way.
Great teammate: Think and work collaboratively and communicate effectively.
Fast learner: Pick up new concepts and apply them quickly.

Responsibilities

This role is for an experienced backend engineer to become an integral part of the Analytics & Compliance Engineering team that is building the next generation analytics factory for Aladdin. We are seeking a candidate with strong people and project management skills to lead a team of engineers in rearchitecting and modernizing a core service in the Aladdin analytics and reporting estate. In this role, you will drive collaboration across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to deliver a modern, API-first solution. The ideal candidate will be able to establish an in-depth knowledge of all parts of the system, design and implement scalable solutions, and lead the team to successful delivery.

Strong experience with the client-server model and inter-process communication technologies is a must to work with our myriad Java services, which act as both consumers and producers of data. The candidate will solve complicated problems in large scale data systems by applying their knowledge of data modeling and database technologies. API design will be a facet of the role, requiring partnership with clients to deliver our data in an efficient and performant manner. A key differentiation will be the ability to apply AI-native skillsets to accelerate the product development life cycle through a modern operating model and agentic tooling to increase implementation velocity. As a senior member of the team, the applicant will be expected to lead and mentor junior engineers and collaborate directly with stakeholders. Experience deploying and operating software in a production environment will also be highly beneficial.

BA/BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
7+ years of experience in software development using Java
Excellent communication skills, time management, organization, and attention to detail
Experience working with global, multi-functional project teams
Robust object-oriented design pattern knowledge and implementation experience
Experience with inter-process communication frameworks like gRPC and REST
Advanced knowledge and experience working with relational and NoSQL databases
Experience with multi-tier application architecture and high performance distributed and in-memory caching solutions
Experience adhering to software development life cycle standards, including test driven development, unit testing discipline, agile development, and CI/CD strategies
Experience with agentic development and applying AI tooling to the product development life cycle
Creativity and resourcefulness to problem solve independently
Passion for learning and implementing new technologies

Skills That Would Be a Plus

Experience handling large volumes of time series data and building associated services and APIs
Experience with message streaming technologies such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
Familiarity with API specifications and standards like OpenAPI
Experience with cloud-based data warehouse solutions like BigQuery and Snowflake
Experience with cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Terraform
Proficiency with the Linux environment and command-line tools
Knowledge of telemetry and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk
Experience in application performance tuning using tools like AppDynamics, VisualVM, and JMeter
Experience in the finance industry and knowledge of financial products/markets

Make a Real Difference, Every Single Day

As a nonprofit leader in aging, Eskaton helps people live well, longer — with trusted guidance at every stage. We believe aging should be a vibrant, supported, and celebrated journey, not an experience to face alone. For over 55 years, Eskaton has been a cornerstone of Northern California, growing a network of 23 communities dedicated to older adults and the people who care for them. When you join us, you're not just starting a job. You're stepping into a career where your work creates a real impact on people's daily lives and strengthening the communities we call home.

We Invest in You (Because You Invest in Others)

We know that to take great care of our residents, we must take great care of you. We are genuinely committed to your health, your happiness, and your future. That’s why we offer:
Financial Security:
Competitive pay and a 401K matching program to help you plan for your own future.
Total Wellbeing:
Comprehensive benefits that support your physical and mental health.
A Place Where You Belong:
We celebrate diversity and equity across the entire aging spectrum, ensuring every team member feels seen and valued.

Our DNA (Core Values)

We’re looking for people who align with our mission and want to grow with us. The successful candidate combines enterprise judgment, technical fluency, humility and a growth mindset; translates complexity into clarity; leads through influence; builds trust; and visibly models Eskaton’s core values and high-performance culture:
Welcoming:
Creates warmth, belonging and psychological safety; listens first, invites diverse perspectives and designs with residents, team members and operational leaders.
Bring (Y)our Best:
Sets high standards, comes prepared with data and options, communicates clearly and follows through on commitments.
Empowerment:
Clarifies expectations and decision rights, removes obstacles, shares information and trusts others to own outcomes.
Growth:
Seeks feedback, learns continuously, adapts, solves problems and raises the bar through measurable improvement.

Essential Job Functions

The Chief Data and Technology Officer (CDTO) is responsible for advancing Eskaton’s enterprise digital, data, artificial intelligence (AI), integration, innovation and technology-enabled transformation agenda. Reporting to the President & CEO and serving on the Senior Team, this leader connects strategy, people, operations, experience, data and technology to simplify how Eskaton works, strengthen resident and team member experiences, improve decision-making and build a scalable foundation for future growth.
The CDTO leads with a human-centered design mindset and embeds Eskaton’s core values—Welcoming, Bring (Y)our Best, Empowerment and Growth—into how priorities are set, decisions are made and change is led. The CDTO advances a high-performance culture grounded in belonging, clarity, accountability, collaboration, candid feedback, continuous learning and disciplined follow-through, ensuring solutions are useful, intuitive, accessible, integrated, secure and adopted and that digital investments produce measurable organizational value.

Digital Experience & Human-Centered Design

Develop the multiyear digital roadmap and human-centered design standards; engage residents, team members and operational leaders in co-design, pilots and testing.

Enterprise Data, Analytics & Responsible AI

Establish enterprise data governance, ownership, quality, privacy, architecture and common definitions; advance reliable dashboards, analytics and predictive insights.
Govern responsible AI use cases that reduce administrative burden and improve service, quality and productivity, with clear guardrails for oversight, privacy, security, ethics, accuracy and vendor risk.

Integration, Interoperability & Enterprise Architecture

Create the enterprise integration roadmap and standards across resident, clinical, workforce, financial, operational, sales and communication platforms.
Reduce fragmented systems, duplicate entry and reconciliation; establish scalable platform, interface, vendor, lifecycle and due-diligence playbooks for growth.

Innovation & Emerging Capabilities

Lead a disciplined innovation pipeline to identify, test, measure and scale practical technologies that strengthen wellbeing, health span, connection, independence, learning, engagement and workforce effectiveness.

Enterprise Transformation, Change Management & Adoption

Lead transformation as an organizational change discipline, creating welcoming and psychologically safe engagement; defining clear outcomes, decision rights and ownership; empowering leaders and teams with information, authority, training and support; and reinforcing accountability, feedback, adoption and continuous improvement.
Maintain a transparent portfolio of priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions, adoption measures and realized benefits; hold leaders and vendors accountable for outcomes.

Technology Strategy, Operations & Stewardship

Provide executive leadership for technology strategy, investments, platforms, infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, continuity, support services, vendor performance and value realization.

Growth Enablement & Enterprise Leadership

Ensure digital, data, AI, integration and technology strategy supports master planning, service models, management services, affiliations, acquisitions and future communities; assess readiness and investment early.
Partner with the President & CEO and Senior Team to sequence the transformation agenda and present priorities, investments, risks and progress to executive leadership and the Board.

Starting annual salary ranges from $250,000 to $355,000. Factors such as scope, responsibilities, experience, education, job-related skills, internal equity, and market considerations may influence base pay.

Experience, Qualifications, Key Success Measures, & Other Requirements

Preferred Experience & Qualifications

Significant progressive leadership across digital strategy, enterprise technology, data/analytics, integration, innovation, experience design and organizational transformation, with demonstrated cross-functional implementation, adoption and benefit realization.
Experience with enterprise data governance, analytics, integration and responsible AI; senior living, healthcare, hospitality, human services or another complex multi-site service environment preferred.
Strong business and financial acumen; experience evaluating investments, vendors, operating models, risk and strategic tradeoffs and presenting decision-quality recommendations to executives and Boards; demonstrated alignment with Eskaton’s values and a high-performance culture balancing excellence, accountability, empowerment, learning and stakeholder impact.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required; advanced degree or equivalent executive experience preferred.

Key Success Measures

Success will be evidenced by measurable improvement in enterprise capability, user experience, adoption and business value—not simply by the completion of technology projects.

Digital experience

Greater ease of use; fewer workarounds and avoidable support needs.

Trusted data & AI

Leaders use consistent measures; governed AI delivers measurable value.

Integration & architecture

Core platforms exchange data effectively; duplicate entry and fragmentation decline.

Transformation & adoption

Initiatives meet readiness, training, adoption and operational targets.

Benefits & innovation

Investments and pilots show defined outcomes and evidence-based scaling decisions.

Technology & security

Reliable services and actively governed cybersecurity, privacy, continuity and vendor risk.

Growth readiness

Repeatable standards support affiliations, management partners, services and communities.

High-performing team

Values are visible in daily leadership; expectations and priorities are clear; feedback is timely; people are empowered to own outcomes; commitments are honored; and teams continuously learn, collaborate and improve.

Key Relationships

Internal:
President & CEO; Senior Team, community and operational leaders; People & Culture; Finance; Clinical Quality; Risk/Compliance; Growth; Marketing & Brand; and enterprise support functions.
External:
Residents and families; Board and Board committees; technology, data and cybersecurity partners; consultants; innovators; research organizations; and affiliated or managed organizations.

Role Distinction

This is not a traditional information technology leadership position. The CDTO serves as Eskaton’s enterprise integrator for digital experience, trusted data, responsible AI, interoperability, innovation and technology-enabled change—ensuring that technology is a strategic capability that improves how people experience Eskaton and how the organization performs.

The final candidate must successfully pass Eskaton's post offer, pre-employment testing which includes a criminal background check, drug test, TB screen test and health screen. All new hires are required to sign an arbitration agreement as a condition of employment.
