jobs.description:
VP of Engineering | Perm | On-site, Texas | Nuclear

About the Company

My client is a venture-backed nuclear energy startup in Texas, taking a first-of-a-kind power plant from detailed design through NRC licensing and into construction. This is the top engineering seat under the CTO, reporting to them directly and accountable for delivery all the way to first power. They want someone who has already delivered hardware on a tight clock, can make the hard calls in a design review, and knows how to build a team that good engineers want to join and stay on.

What you'll be doing

- Carrying technical delivery for every engineering discipline on the plant: nuclear core work (materials, neutronics and thermal-hydraulics), mechanical systems, the other major plant subsystems, and integration of the whole.
- Running the engineering side of the integrated master schedule, finding the critical path, managing handoffs between subsystems, and raising schedule risk while there is still time to act on it.
- Running every team's design reviews and making sure each decision is captured and traceable, whether it's a change order, an interface control document or a design basis call.
- Making sure engineering hands NRC relevant documentation it needs, on time and to regulatory standard, from inputs to the safety analysis to design basis documentation and other licensing material.
- Keeping the core design and system description documents current as working tools, together with the CTO and COO.
- Planning engineering headcount across every technical discipline, deciding scope, priority and hiring order against program milestones and budget.
- Finding, assessing and closing senior engineers in physics, nuclear, mechanical and systems integration, often competing with national labs and defense primes for the same people.
- Setting up cross-functional teams so the core group and the other major subsystem groups can work in parallel without interface problems piling up.
- Defining how engineers grow, get paid and get measured, with levels and pay bands that run from individual contributor to principal.
- Shaping a culture built on rigor, candor and ownership, where the whole team shares ownership of the schedule.
- Leading the technical side of the biggest purchases, from major subsystem equipment to long-lead core components, writing the specs and RFPs and choosing suppliers for hardware with few commercial precedents.
- Managing outside technical help (universities, national lab partners, independent advisors) that validates designs and qualifies components.
- Owning engineering's interface with construction contractors during the plant build, making sure the site's civil and mechanical work matches plant requirements.
- Putting the engineering documentation system in place (design standards, drawing release, configuration control, and a document hierarchy that serves internal decisions and regulator review alike) while keeping it lean enough to cover traceability and the safety basis and no heavier.
- Building safety analysis into the design from day one, and pushing a build-and-test mindset that trusts test results over paper margin and gets real data in time to inform the design.

What you'll bring

- 3+ years of senior technical leadership on a major hardware program, within 15+ years of engineering overall. Standout program leaders with less time in the field will be considered.
- You've shipped hardware with little or no precedent while the clock was running, in aerospace, defense, nuclear, big-science facilities or another deep-tech field.
- Experience scaling an engineering team: hiring, setting its structure and technical bar, and growing the careers of your reports.
- You treat the schedule and engineering resourcing as a single problem.
- Clear, direct writing and efficient reviews, plus the ability to put complex technical issues in front of investors, regulators or executives precisely and briefly.
- You take the program's success personally, set that standard for the team, and keep it collaborative.

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in at least one of the plant's main technical areas, for example nuclear systems or complex mechanical systems, so you can run design reviews credibly, weigh the trade-offs and challenge loose requirements.
- Familiarity with NRC licensing pathways.
- Having run a program at an early-stage hardware or deep-tech company, with thin headcount, a hard budget ceiling and an unforgiving schedule.
- Supplier relationships you built for first-article or novel hardware that ordinary purchasing processes can't handle.
- Comfort partnering closely with a founder-CTO, balancing technical authority with the job of leading an organization.

What our client offers

- Strong base pay and benefits, plus equity with real upside at this stage
- Full-time and fully on-site in Texas, with regular travel to vendors, national labs and the plant site

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will provide strategic and operational leadership for the technology function of CapitalSage Vantage, ensuring that technology, digital platforms, products, infrastructure, data and cybersecurity capabilities effectively support the Company's business strategy and growth objectives.

The CTO will lead the development and execution of the Company's technology strategy, oversee technology architecture and engineering, drive product innovation and digital transformation, and ensure the reliability, scalability, security and performance of all technology platforms.

The role will work closely with the GCEO/GMD, business and functional leaders to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions, strengthen technology governance, optimise technology investments and build a high-performing technology organisation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute a technology strategy aligned with CapitalSage Vantage's business objectives, growth plans and product roadmap.
Provide strategic technology leadership and advise Executive Management and the Board on technology opportunities, risks and investments.
Establish technology priorities, architecture principles, standards and governance frameworks.
Assess emerging technologies and determine their relevance and potential business value.
Drive continuous technology innovation and digital transformation across the business.

2. Product Engineering & Digital Platforms

Provide leadership for the design, development, deployment and continuous improvement of digital products and technology platforms.
Ensure technology solutions are scalable, reliable, user-centric and commercially viable.
Oversee the product engineering lifecycle from requirements definition through development, testing, deployment and post-production support.
Establish effective software development methodologies, engineering standards, code quality practices and release management processes.
Ensure appropriate integration of internal systems, third-party platforms, APIs and technology partners.
Drive automation and technology-enabled improvements to customer and operational processes.

3. Technology Architecture & Infrastructure

Own the Company's technology architecture and ensure that systems are scalable, resilient, secure and fit for purpose.
Oversee cloud infrastructure, networks, databases, enterprise applications, systems integration and technology operations.
Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.
Review and optimise technology infrastructure to support business growth and increasing transaction/user volumes.
Develop and maintain appropriate technology standards and documentation.

4. Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Technology Risk

Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity and information security in collaboration with the appropriate risk, compliance and security functions.
Ensure technology platforms are designed and operated in accordance with applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements.
Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, security monitoring and remediation of technology risks.
Establish and maintain effective access management, data security, backup and recovery controls.
Ensure appropriate data protection and privacy-by-design practices are incorporated into technology and product development.
Support regulatory examinations, audits and technology risk assessments as required.

5. Data, Analytics & Technology Intelligence

Establish a technology and data architecture that supports reliable business intelligence and data-driven decision-making.
Promote effective use of data across products, operations, customer experience, risk and commercial functions.
Ensure appropriate data governance, quality, availability and security.
Leverage analytics, artificial intelligence and automation where they can create measurable business value.

6. Technology Operations & Service Delivery

Ensure stable, reliable and efficient day-to-day technology operations.
Establish appropriate service management, incident management, problem management and change management processes.
Monitor technology performance against agreed service levels and business requirements.
Ensure timely resolution of critical technology incidents and minimise business disruption.
Develop appropriate technology disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.

7. Technology Governance, Budget & Vendor Management

Develop and manage the technology budget, ensuring optimal allocation of technology resources and investments.
Establish governance processes for technology projects, architecture, procurement and implementation.
Evaluate and manage technology vendors, consultants and strategic technology partners.
Lead technology procurement and contract negotiations in collaboration with Procurement, Finance and other relevant functions.
Monitor technology costs and identify opportunities for efficiency and optimisation.
Ensure appropriate documentation, controls and accountability across the technology function.

8. Technology Projects & Transformation

Lead major technology transformation and implementation projects from conception through delivery.
Establish clear project objectives, milestones, budgets, risks and success measures.
Ensure technology projects deliver agreed business outcomes and value.
Work with business stakeholders to manage requirements, priorities, dependencies and change adoption.
Ensure appropriate testing, deployment and post-implementation reviews.

9. Team Leadership & Capability Development

Build, lead and develop a high-performing technology organisation comprising engineering, infrastructure, product technology, data and other relevant technology capabilities.
Establish appropriate organisational structures, roles, performance expectations and succession plans.
Develop technical leadership capabilities and promote continuous learning and innovation.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, security, engineering excellence and customer focus.
Attract and retain high-calibre technology professionals.

10. Business Partnership & Innovation

Partner with Commercial, Product, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Customer Experience and other functions to identify technology-enabled opportunities.
Translate business challenges into practical and scalable technology solutions.
Support the development of new products, services, channels and revenue opportunities.
Continuously evaluate the customer journey and identify opportunities to improve digital experience through technology.
Represent CapitalSage Vantage in relevant technology, fintech and digital ecosystems.

11. Performance & Reporting

Establish and monitor appropriate technology performance metrics and service standards.
Provide regular reports to Executive Management on technology performance, projects, risks, costs, incidents and strategic initiatives.
Track technology investments against expected business outcomes.
Ensure technology priorities remain aligned with evolving business requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
12–15 years of progressive experience in technology, with significant experience leading technology teams and enterprise-scale technology environments.
Demonstrated experience in a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Technology, Director of Technology or comparable senior technology leadership role.
Strong experience in software engineering, digital platforms, cloud infrastructure, systems architecture and technology operations.
Experience within fintech, financial services, payments, digital financial products or technology-driven businesses is highly desirable.
Demonstrable experience taking digital products/platforms from development through deployment and scale.
Experience managing technology budgets, strategic vendors and complex technology projects.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, information security, data protection and technology risk.
Experience working with APIs, system integrations, cloud technologies, databases and modern software development environments.
Relevant professional certifications in technology, cybersecurity, cloud, architecture or project management will be an advantage.

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Manager, S3
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon S3 Tables is the first cloud object store with built-in Apache Iceberg support, purpose-built for storing and querying tabular data at massive scale. It is fully managed, continuously optimizing, and delivers up-to 10x higher transactions per second than Iceberg tables on general purpose S3 buckets, all within the same foundation that gives S3 eleven nines of durability. Customers are bringing their most demanding analytics workloads to S3 Tables, from streaming ingestion of IoT and application telemetry to multi-petabyte lakehouses powering multiple AWS and partner query engines, and a growing wave of AI agents that query data directly through the Model Context Protocol. Our mission is simple and ambitious which is to make S3 Tables the best place on Earth to store and query Iceberg data, and reinvent what an analytics-native object store can be.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the multi-team S3 Tables organization. In this role, you will own the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution for the service, working at a scale that very few engineers in the industry ever encounter. Your organization will ship innovations that customers feel directly in query latency, cost per terabyte scanned, ingestion throughput, and the simplicity of running an open lakehouse on AWS.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, open-source table formats, and large-scale analytics. You will help define how Iceberg evolves in the cloud, partnering with the Apache Iceberg community and with engine teams across AWS and partners to make sure S3 Tables is the gravitational center of the open analytics ecosystem. Internally, you will partner with S3 storage, indexing, and control plane teams, and with AWS analytics leadership, to deliver a service that is both deeply integrated and uncompromisingly open.

We want a leader who thinks big, invents on behalf of customers, and is energized by problems that only show up at S3 scale. The bar is high and the opportunity to shape how the world stores and analyzes its data is higher.

S3 Tables is a new, fast moving team building within the most durable and scalable storage system ever built. We are early in our journey, the product is young, the customer base is growing quickly, and the surface area in front of us is large. We are doing this in the open with Apache Iceberg, obsessing over customer workloads, and inventing in places others assume are solved. If you want to help build something into what it can become, rather than maintain what already is, this is the team.

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow a multi-team organization of senior engineers and engineering managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, deep ownership, and customer obsession.
Define and execute a 1 to 3 year technical roadmap, balancing near-term customer wins with long-horizon bets on query performance, table maintenance, metadata scale, and Iceberg evolution.
Drive architectural decisions for distributed systems at exabyte scale, including metadata services, compaction and optimization pipelines, snapshot and transaction management, and engine integrations.
Make S3 Tables the highest performing, most cost effective home for Apache Iceberg anywhere, and contribute back to the Iceberg open source project.
Partner with product, business, and AWS analytics leadership to translate customer needs into engineering priorities that move adoption and trust.
Establish operational excellence standards across availability, durability, latency, and throughput, and lead the org in exceeding them as the service scales.
Recruit, develop, and retain top talent, building a diverse, high performing organization with a strong pipeline of future leaders.
Represent S3 Tables in senior leadership reviews, customer engagements, and external forums with clarity and conviction.

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

As an Engineering Manager, you will assume a critical leadership position overseeing a highly impactful, global organization of software engineers. You will define the strategic technical outlook to elevate the infrastructure, tools, and platforms we build for the global automotive industry and our Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) partners.

Drawing on your automotive industry expertise, you will navigate the unique requirements, quality standards, and integration patterns of deploying features for assisted and automated driving. You will be expected to set technical direction, influence across teams, and mentor other engineers, as well as be in creating and delivering impactful systems.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a Small Team Within Alan, On a Mission To Redefine The Future Of Care By democratizing Access To Medical Expertise
. The Clinic Is Two Crews Building One Experience

Mo.
An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up
on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.
Clinic Platform.
The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs
across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise
(through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What You'll Build And Who You'll Work With

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience.
Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.
➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters.
More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.
🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care.
Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

About the Team
The USDS JV Threat Detection and Response team is responsible for protecting TikTok’s people, data, and systems from threats that originate within the organization. We partner across Security, Legal, HR, IT, and Engineering to detect, investigate, and mitigate insider risks ranging from data exfiltration and policy violations to fraud and unauthorized access.

About the Role
As the Head of Advanced Threat Management Operations, you will own end-to-end threat defense operations in the JV Secure Environment, spanning both cyber and physical domains. This is a highly technical, visionary leadership role. You will move the organization away from legacy workflows—such as pulling massive data into a centralized Splunk instance before generating alerts—and instead pioneer an agile, decentralized, and intelligent defense model.

You will lead the team into an AI-enabled future where Agentic AI powers the entire threat management lifecycle: from autonomous detection engineering and real-time case enrichment to automated incident response. Your scope covers product-level application security at internet scale, global logging and data source intake strategy, and a modernized physical threat defense program.

Responsibilities
- Next-Gen Cyber Operations: Drive the strategy for monitoring, detection, and response across our consumer-facing internet products at the application level, moving far beyond standard corporate enterprise security.
- AI & Agentic Automation: Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents to manage detection engineering, execute real-time telemetry enrichment, and orchestrate complex response playbooks.
- Modern Data & Logging Intake: Define the data ingestion and edge-processing strategy tailored for high-volume internet products, optimizing for real-time telemetry without relying on legacy centralized SIEM bottlenecks.
- Major Incident Command: Coordinate with the Head of Cyber Crisis & Critical Incident Manaagement on large-scale, highly complex security incidents across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
- AI-Driven Physical Security: Oversee physical security monitoring operations, shifting the paradigm from manual screen-watching to computer vision and AI-enabled anomaly detection to optimize resource allocation.

Qualifications

Minium Qualifications
- Experience: 10+ years of dedicated experience in cybersecurity, specifically within the tech industry or high-scale internet product environments.
- Technical Background: A proven, rigorous engineering or highly technical cyber background. You must be able to go deep into application code, distributed systems, and modern cloud architecture.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Fermi America™ (Nasdaq & LSE: FRMI) is pioneering the world's largest next-generation private HyperGrid™ campus, Project Matador, located on approximately 8,400 acres in the Texas Panhandle near Amarillo. The campus is designed to deliver up to 17 gigawatts of highly redundant, behind-the-meter power to hyperscale artificial intelligence data centers, integrating the nation's largest combined-cycle natural gas generation complex, utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), utility grid interconnection, and one of the most ambitious nuclear power programs in the United States.

With first power targeted for 2027 and nearly $1 billion in committed financing secured, Fermi America is one of the most consequential energy infrastructure companies in the United States. The Head of Engineering is a critical leadership role at the heart of this mission.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Head of Engineering is Fermi America's senior technical authority and Owner's Engineer for Project Matador's HyperGrid™ campus. This executive owns the engineering standards, design basis, and technical decisions for the program from conceptual design and front-end engineering design (FEED) through detailed engineering, construction support, commissioning, and handover to operations. Detailed engineering is executed by Fermi America's contracted engineering partners and EPC contractors; the Head of Engineering directs, reviews, approves, and holds those partners to account across a multi-technology portfolio spanning gas-fired generation, high-voltage transmission and substations, campus utilities, data center power infrastructure, and battery energy storage, with utility-scale solar PV and nuclear generation in future phases.

The role builds and leads a corporate engineering organization of Principal discipline engineers who serve as Fermi America's subject matter experts, owns the Engineering Management System, leads the technical interfaces with EPC contractors, engineering partners, OEMs, and the interconnecting utility (SPS/Xcel), and ensures all engineering deliverables meet Fermi America's safety, quality, regulatory, schedule, and performance requirements. The group is fully capable of performing design where Fermi America elects to do so; its primary function is owner-side technical leadership of the partners who execute the work.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Strategy

Define and own the engineering strategy for Project Matador, ensuring technical coherence across gas-fired generation, high-voltage transmission, data center power, BESS, and future solar PV and nuclear systems.
Establish and enforce engineering standards, codes of practice, design criteria, and design verification requirements across all disciplines, coordinated with the Director of Quality, who owns QA/QC.
Lead the engineering organization structure, resource planning, and capability development to support the phased delivery of up to 17 GW of generation capacity.
Provide technical vision and leadership to the COO, executive leadership, and Board on engineering risk, innovation, and delivery strategy.
Champion a safety-by-design culture, embedding HSSE requirements into all engineering deliverables from concept through commissioning.

Power Generation Engineering: Gas & BESS

Provide owner technical direction and oversight of the combined-cycle gas turbine (CCGT) program engineered by Fermi America's EPC and engineering partners, including Siemens Energy and GE gas turbines, heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs), steam turbines, and associated balance-of-plant systems.
Direct and approve battery energy storage system (BESS) sizing and integration engineering performed by Fermi America's engineering partners, including containerized battery systems, inverters, thermal management, protection and control, and grid integration.
Review and approve FEED and detailed engineering packages, technical specifications, equipment datasheets, and vendor drawings from EPC contractors and OEMs.
Provide engineering support to Procurement and Commissioning for factory acceptance testing (FAT) of major equipment and for resolution of technical punch list items through commissioning completion.

High-Voltage Electrical & Grid Engineering

Direct and approve the engineering of the campus's high-voltage transmission and distribution infrastructure, performed by Fermi America's HV engineering partner in coordination with SPS/Xcel, including substations, switching stations, overhead lines, underground cables, and protection and control systems.
Direct grid interconnection engineering, including system impact studies, protection coordination, power flow analysis, and SPS/Xcel interconnection technical deliverables, including large load interconnection studies.
Set the electrical design basis for the campus grid interface to data center power infrastructure (substations, switchgear, and transformers) and provide engineering review in support of Data Center Delivery, which owns the data center electrical scope including UPS systems and standby generation.
Ensure grid and power system engineering complies with NERC reliability standards, SPS/Xcel interconnection requirements, and applicable IEEE and ANSI codes.

Controls, SCADA & Digital Engineering

Own the design basis and architecture of the campus-wide Distributed Control System (DCS), SCADA, and Energy Management System (EMS) architecture.
Lead the development of control system philosophies, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm management strategies, and cybersecurity frameworks for operational technology (OT) in accordance with NERC CIP standards.
Direct the digital twin strategy for generation asset monitoring, predictive maintenance, and operational optimization.
Ensure seamless integration of all generation technologies (gas, BESS, grid interconnection, and future solar PV and nuclear) into the campus EMS/SCADA platform.

Civil, Structural & Site Engineering

Oversee civil and structural engineering for all generation facilities, campus utilities, substations, transmission structures, data center foundations, and site-wide infrastructure.
Direct geotechnical, environmental, and hydrological engineering studies and ensure findings are incorporated into design standards.
Manage the engineering interface with Site Infrastructure, Construction, HSSE and Permitting, and Data Center Delivery to ensure designs are constructable, cost-effective, and permit-compliant.

Future Phase Generation: Nuclear & Solar PV

Serve as the senior engineering interface for Fermi America's nuclear program as it advances, working with nuclear technology vendors, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), and specialist nuclear engineering consultants; oversee engineering inputs to NRC license applications, safety analysis reports, and site characterization studies in accordance with applicable NRC regulations, ANSI/ANS standards, and DOE requirements.
Plan the internal nuclear engineering capability required to support pre-licensing, design certification, and later construction and operations phases, scaled to program timing.
Direct owner oversight of utility-scale solar PV engineering when that phase is initiated, including array design, DC/AC power conversion, substation integration, and SCADA connectivity.

EPC, Engineering Partner & OEM Technical Management

Lead the technical review and approval of EPC contractor and engineering partner deliverables, ensuring compliance with Fermi America's engineering standards and project specifications.
Perform the Owner's Engineer function, acting as Fermi America's technical authority in disputes, claims, and technical variation assessments in support of Operations' contractor commercial management.
Maintain technical interfaces with key OEM partners for gas generation, solar module and inverter suppliers, BESS manufacturers, and nuclear technology vendors.
Oversee engineering sign-off as required on construction completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and performance testing milestones.

Regulatory & Permitting Engineering

Provide engineering support to Fermi America's HSSE and Permitting organization for federal, state, and local permitting, including SPS/Xcel interconnection filings, TCEQ air quality permits, NRC license applications, and Texas PUC filings.
Ensure engineering deliverables support Fermi America's TCEQ air permit applications and amendments, environmental impact assessments, and grid code compliance documentation.
Liaise with regulatory agencies at the technical level and represent Fermi America's engineering position in regulatory proceedings.

Engineering Management System & Standards

Establish and maintain the Engineering Management System, including design review and verification processes, management of change (MOC), and document control.
Own engineering risk registers and lead technical risk workshops at key project milestones.
Define and enforce engineering standards for all disciplines, ensuring alignment with applicable US codes (ASME, IEEE, ANSI, NFPA, API, NEC) and international standards where applicable.
Lead lessons-learned processes and drive continuous improvement in engineering performance across the program.

Requirements

Essential

Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering.
15+ years of progressive engineering experience in the power generation or energy infrastructure sector, with at least 7 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
Deep technical expertise in combined-cycle gas turbine power plants and in high-voltage transmission and substations, with working knowledge of battery energy storage systems and data center power infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations on major capital projects ($500M+ CAPEX).
Strong track record of managing EPC contractor engineering deliverables, Owner's Engineer functions, and OEM technical interfaces.
Owner-side experience directing multiple concurrent engineering partners and EPC contractors on a single program, including technical authority over their deliverables.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in Texas or ability to obtain reciprocal licensure.
Experience with transmission service provider interconnection engineering, including large load interconnection studies with a utility such as SPS/Xcel, NERC reliability standards, and US power system codes (IEEE, ANSI, NFPA, NEC).

Desirable

Experience with nuclear power engineering, NRC licensing processes, or advanced nuclear technology development (SMR, Gen IV).
Experience with utility-scale solar PV engineering and grid integration.
Familiarity with NERC CIP cybersecurity standards for operational technology and industrial control systems.
Experience with behind-the-meter private grid design and multi-technology hybrid power system integration.
MBA or major project leadership qualification (e.g., PMP, APM PMQ).
Experience working on first-of-a-kind or gigawatt-scale energy infrastructure programs in the United States.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Title:
Director, Systems and Electro-Optical Engineering

Position Description:
Protingent Staffing has an exciting direct hire Director, Systems and Electro-Optical Engineering opportunity.

Job Description:

Looking for a Director of Systems and Electro-Optical Engineering to lead the group that defines how our LiDAR sensors are architected, specified, and optically realized. The role brings systems architecture, systems engineering, optical design, and laser engineering under one leader, so that the trade-offs between optical design choices and system-level performance requirements are owned in one place rather than negotiated across teams.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. The Director owns the product architecture and requirements baseline, leads a team of senior individual contributors, and is the system-level technical authority for the sensor within Engineering. The role partners with the Chief Scientist on technology direction and with the VP of Engineering on program execution. The scope may expand over time as the organization grows.

Job Responsibilities

Systems Architecture: Own the end-to-end sensor architecture: requirements decomposition, interface definition, and system-level trade studies across optical, laser, electronic, mechanical, and software subsystems. Establish and maintain the product specification and interface baseline where it does not yet exist, and govern it where it does.
Electro-Optical Design: Lead optical design and laser engineering as an integral part of systems architecture. Own the trade-offs between beam characteristics, transmit and receive optics, laser parameters, and system performance (range, resolution, object separability, signal-to-noise, eye safety).
Sensing Strategy and Requirements: Own the system-level requirements and acceptance criteria for how the sensor scans and samples the scene, including how sensor output is consumed by downstream perception systems. Firmware and software teams implement against these requirements; this role defines them.
Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of senior individual contributors spanning systems architecture, systems engineering, optical design, and laser engineering. Set technical standards, calibrate performance, and build the ladder from Systems Engineer through Principal levels.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the system-level interface between Hardware, Firmware, Software, Product, Quality, and Operations. Drive root-cause analysis of system-level and electro-optical failures.
Requirements Management: Establish requirements management that traces customer and product requirements to architecture and design decisions across the product lifecycle.
Technical Governance: Chair system-level design reviews and gate reviews. Ensure design decisions are documented, change-controlled, and traceable to requirements.
Program Execution: Partner with Program Management and the VP of Engineering to set technical milestones, manage technical risk, and deliver systems and electro-optical work products on program schedules from prototype through production.
Customer and Executive Engagement: Represent the systems and electro-optical capability in customer technical reviews, and report architecture health, technical risk, and resourcing needs to the VP of Engineering and, as needed, the executive team.

Job Qualifications:

10+ years of engineering experience in electro-optical or sensor systems, with at least 4 years leading senior individual contributors or engineering teams.
Proven track record architecting and shipping electro-optical sensing products (LiDAR, imaging, ranging, photonics, or similar) from concept through production.
Depth in at least one of optical design or laser engineering, and fluency in the other, sufficient to own trade-offs across both.
Strong systems engineering fundamentals: requirements decomposition, interface control, and design review governance.
Experience establishing a requirements and architecture baseline in a company that did not yet have one, and transitioning designs from prototype to production under change control.
Experience with electro-optical and system-level failure analysis.
Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication, with the ability to translate technical detail for executive and customer audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Job Qualifications

Experience with scanning LiDAR architectures and their interaction with downstream perception software.
Familiarity with laser safety standards (IEC 60825) and with functional safety or sensor qualification standards (ISO 26262, automotive or aerospace environmental qualification).
Experience with high-reliability electronics and single-point-failure analysis for demanding environments.
Experience scaling an engineering function within a growth-stage hardware company.
Experience presenting to boards, investors, or enterprise customers on technical roadmaps.

Description

Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

Amazon's Worldwide Sustainability team is building the science and technology infrastructure that makes our sustainability commitments real — auditable, automated, and actionable at Amazon's scale. At the center of that infrastructure is the Carbon Intelligence Platform: the system that calculates emissions across Amazon's businesses, powers planning and abatement decision-making, and serves external sustainability products for partners and customers outside Amazon.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead the engineering team building and operating this platform. This is a player-coach role — you will set technical direction, manage and grow a team of engineers, and stay close enough to the code and architecture to make the hard technical calls yourself. You will own production systems that business unit leaders, finance teams, and external partners depend on for numbers they report publicly and use to make consequential decisions.

This role sits at a distinctive intersection: technical depth and organizational scope at the same time. You will partner with research and sustainability scientists whose methodologies — increasingly AI and ML-enabled — your team implements in production. You will own an external-grade API surface that commercial sustainability products depend on to serve customers outside Amazon. And you will build an AI-native engineering team: one that builds AI/ML systems in production *and* uses AI-assisted development and testing as standard workflow, measuring success by the pace at which new capabilities reach customers reliably.

Your ability to communicate and influence others will be a key to success. You are a results-oriented, customer-focused manager who gets excited about diving deep, running hard, and delivering a big impact.

Carbon Intelligence Systems

Every carbon calculation that any Amazon business unit or external partner relies on runs through systems you own and operate
External-grade API surface consumed by commercial sustainability products — versioned, rate-limited, documented, and reliable at external SLAs

Drive AI-native engineering practices: AI-assisted development and testing as standard workflow, measured by velocity and reliability of customer-facing delivery
Hire, develop, and retain strong engineering talent

Receive methodology and model specifications from the science team and build the production infrastructure that makes them reliable at scale
Triage production failures independently and surface systematic patterns back to the science team on a defined cadence

differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (inclusive diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Experience building and operating AI/ML production systems — model serving, inference pipelines, drift detection, and retraining automation

Track record of hiring and developing strong engineers

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Engineering Manager.

About The Job

As a Senior Engineering Manager in Communication Identity Domain, you will lead the engineering teams behind Porting, Hosting, and A2P Messaging. Your teams own the products that let customers bring their own numbers onto Twilio (Porting), enable existing numbers for messaging without a full port (Hosting), and register and operate compliant Application-to-Person (A2P) messaging campaigns at scale — the gateway that determines whether a customer's messages actually reach their end users' handsets. Porting and Hosting are high-value, white-glove transactions: each one touches an existing customer's live production number, or a prospective customer's number that already works elsewhere and needs to keep working seamlessly through the transition. That makes operational maturity a core part of the value we deliver — precise execution, clear communication, and dependable outcomes are what earn a customer's trust in the Communication Identity Domain. Delivering on that requires deep, reliable integration with a broad ecosystem of carriers, aggregators, industry registries and the expertise to orchestrate that complexity into a smooth, trustworthy experience for the customer. It also means investing in efficient, well-instrumented Ops Tooling that gives your team and our internal support organizations clear visibility into every port, hosting activation, and campaign — so issues are caught and resolved quickly, and operational excellence scales with the business. You will own the people strategy, delivery execution, and stakeholder relationships for a team responsible for the trust-building work of moving and activating phone numbers for existing and prospective customers.

You will be expected to champion AI-driven development practices, ensuring your engineers adopt LLMs and agentic tools to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and stay at the forefront of modern software engineering. Your mission is to build a high-performing team that consistently ships reliable, customer-obsessed products - while balancing the competing demands of external product commitments, internal platform obligations, and operational tooling investments.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

DRAW THE OWL: Own the delivery roadmap for the Communication Identity Domain, including customer-facing services, internal platform APIs, and Ops Tooling. Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers to translate long-term technical strategy into executable quarterly plans and measurable outcomes.
ACCELERATE WITH AI: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, or internal LLMs) within your team. Set expectations for AI-augmented workflows, measure the impact on team velocity, and create the psychological safety for engineers to experiment with new tools.
BE AN OWNER: Take full accountability for your team’s operational excellence, including system reliability, incident response, on-call health, and security posture. Make high-judgment calls that balance speed, quality, and risk.
WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Serve two customer bases with equal rigor. For external customers, partner with Product Management to ensure communication identity workflows are seamless and developer-friendly. For internal customers, proactively engage with dependent engineering teams to understand their needs, gather feedback on your team’s APIs and Ops Tooling, and ensure your platform enables them to move faster. Ground every decision in customer data and feedback from both audiences.
EMPOWER OTHERS: Recruit, develop, and retain a world-class engineering team. Build a culture of psychological safety, candid feedback, and career growth. Coach your engineers-from mid-level to staff-to reach their full potential and take on increasing ownership. Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion in every hiring and development decision.
RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Navigate competing priorities across external product features, internal platform needs, and Ops Tooling investments. Balance requests from multiple stakeholders-Product Management, internal engineering teams, and operations-with a clear framework for saying “no” to protect focus. Ensure resources are aligned to the highest-impact work across all three pillars.
WRITE IT DOWN: Communicate team strategy, progress, and risks clearly and consistently to engineering leadership and cross-functional partners. Author team plans, post-mortems, and decision documents that create transparency and alignment.
BUILD BRIDGES: Act as the primary point of contact between the Communication Identity Domain and its stakeholders. Manage relationships with Product Management, external-facing teams, and internal engineering teams that depend on your services and Ops Tooling. Proactively communicate roadmap plans, surface trade-offs, negotiate priorities, and ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into what your team is delivering and why.
NO SHENANIGANS: Model integrity in every interaction. Create an environment where engineers feel safe raising concerns, surfacing problems early, and challenging the status quo. Hold yourself and your team to the highest standards of ethical behavior.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:
15+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5+ years in engineering management, leading a team of 10+ engineers and directly managing individual contributors.
Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background in designing and operating highly available, cloud-native distributed systems. You don’t need to write code daily, but you MUST be able to engage deeply in architectural reviews, evaluate technical proposals, and earn the trust of your senior engineers.
Cloud-Native Fluency: Deep familiarity with AWS ecosystems (Lambda, EKS, DynamoDB, Kafka), microservices patterns, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Kubernetes, Terraform).
AI-Forward Mindset: Demonstrated experience driving AI tool adoption within your engineering team. You should be able to articulate a clear vision for how AI accelerates your team’s delivery and quality.
Delivery Excellence: Proven track record of shipping complex software products on time and at high quality. Experience with agile methodologies and a data-driven approach to measuring team health and productivity.
People Leadership: A track record of building diverse, inclusive, high-performing engineering teams. Experience with career frameworks, performance management, and growing engineers from mid-level to staff-plus.
Clear Communication: Strong ability to communicate technical strategy, trade-offs, and team plans to engineering leadership, cross-functional partners, and your direct reports.
Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage relationships across multiple stakeholder groups with competing needs. Experience balancing external customer commitments with internal platform obligations and communicating trade-offs transparently.
Operational Rigor: Experience owning system reliability for mission-critical services, including incident management, on-call rotations, and SLO-driven operational improvements.

Desired

Platform & Tooling Leadership: Experience leading a team that builds internal platforms or operational tooling serving other engineering teams, with a product mindset toward internal customers.
Team Scaling: Experience growing and evolving a team through periods of change, including onboarding new engineers, reshaping team processes, and managing through ambiguity.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $207,200.00 - $259,000.00

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 30th November, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Lead the adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve internal efficiency and accelerate product and business outcomes.

Own the overarching technology strategy across staff infrastructure and external user- and partner-facing products, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and mission-aligned.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Selective, we don't just insure uniquely, we employ uniqueness.

Selective is a midsized U.S. domestic property and casualty insurance company with a history of strong, consistent financial performance for nearly 100 years. Selective's unique position as both a leading insurance group and an employer of choice is recognized in a wide variety of awards and honors, including listing in Forbes Best Midsize Employers in 2025 and certification as a Great Place to Work® in 2025 for the sixth consecutive year.

Employees are empowered and encouraged to Be Uniquely You by being their true, unique selves and contributing their diverse talents, experiences, and perspectives to our shared success. Together, we are a high-performing team working to serve our customers responsibly by helping to mitigate loss, keep them safe, and restore their lives and businesses after an insured loss occurs.

Overview

Selective Insurance is seeking a Director of Claims Software Engineering to lead the delivery and ongoing support of complex, strategically important software solutions. This leader will oversee Software Engineers and Team Leads, align technology solutions with business and customer needs, and provide hands-on technical leadership across new initiatives, enhancements, modernization, and production support. The Director will serve as a trusted escalation point when teams encounter difficult engineering challenges, helping clarify options, evaluate tradeoffs, and determine the appropriate path forward. Success in this role requires a leader who can develop people, influence across the organization, and provide credible technical guidance in a complex enterprise environment.

Responsibilities

Lead a portfolio of Claims business applications and engineering initiatives, balancing delivery commitments, operational stability, modernization, and technical debt reduction.
Provide technical direction across solution architecture, application design, integrations, data, security, performance, scalability, resiliency, and production support.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for engineering teams, helping diagnose complex issues, evaluate tradeoffs, remove technical roadblocks, and determine clear next steps.
Provide leadership for Azure cloud-based solutions, including cloud architecture, migration, platform services, cost management, governance, security, resiliency, and operational support.
Partner with business and IT leaders, including teams outside of Claims IT, to understand objectives, requirements, costs, risks, dependencies, and timelines and translate them into scalable technology solutions.
Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Digital, and other technology teams to ensure cross-functional solutions align with strategic roadmaps, standards, and target-state architecture.
Establish and reinforce engineering standards, including design and code quality, testing, observability, documentation, security, DevOps, and release practices.
Lead architecture and design reviews for high-impact solutions and ensure key technical decisions are documented, communicated, and understood.
Guide teams through production incidents and recurring technology issues, ensuring effective root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and long-term remediation.
Forecast and allocate team capacity across initiatives, support work, and technical priorities while managing competing demands.
Own delivery performance across scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk, and communicate progress and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
Define and report meaningful engineering and delivery metrics, including capacity, quality, defects, reliability, productivity, and efficiency.
Recruit, lead, coach, and develop managers, team leads, engineers, and consulting partners while building a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Mentor technical leaders and engineers, strengthen technical decision-making across teams, and create development opportunities that support career growth.
Participate in the evaluation, selection, acquisition, and implementation of vendor software and engineering tools that support business and technology objectives.
Drive well-planned quality improvement and modernization initiatives that improve maintainability, resilience, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
Extensive hands-on software engineering experience with modern application development technologies, frameworks, web-based solutions, and enterprise architectural patterns.
Proven experience leading software engineering teams and developing managers, team leads, and engineers in a complex enterprise environment.
Demonstrated ability to act as a senior technical escalation point, guide teams through ambiguous or high-risk engineering challenges, and establish clear next steps.
Deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, service and API design, integration frameworks, security principles, data considerations, and modern engineering practices.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs across applications, integrations, infrastructure, data, security, performance, scalability, and operational support.
Experience establishing and governing engineering standards, architecture and design reviews, code quality practices, automated testing, observability, DevOps, and production readiness.
Experience leading large-scale application modernization efforts, including the reduction of technical debt while balancing business priorities and delivery commitments.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services and practices, including cloud-native application design, migration patterns, identity and access management, networking, monitoring, security, cost optimization, and cloud governance.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI and GenAI capabilities within enterprise applications, moving beyond pilots to reliable and measurable production outcomes.
Experience with business process management platforms; Pega experience is preferred.
Experience managing employees and onsite and offshore consulting partners, including workforce planning, performance management, hiring, and talent development.
Proven leadership ability to influence technical direction, build alignment across business and technology organizations, and lead teams through complex technical and organizational challenges.
Demonstrated ability to establish trusted partnerships and drive outcomes across Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Digital, and other organizations outside of Claims Technology.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, facilitate decisions, and deliver compelling presentations to technical and executive audiences.
Strong ability to manage multiple initiatives, competing priorities, risks, dependencies, and timelines.
Experience in Property & Casualty insurance is a plus.

Total Rewards

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range

USD $163,000.00 - USD $220,000.00 /Yr.

Selective is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means we respect and value every individual’s unique opinions, beliefs, abilities, and perspectives. We are committed to promoting a welcoming culture that celebrates diverse talent, individual identity, different points of view and experiences – and empowers employees to contribute new ideas that support our continued and growing success. Building a highly engaged team is one of our core strategic imperatives, which we believe is enhanced by diversity, equity, and inclusion. We expect and encourage all employees and all of our business partners to embrace, practice, and monitor the attitudes, values, and goals of acceptance; address biases; and foster diversity of viewpoints and opinions.

jobs.description:

A Senior Forward Deployed Engineering Manager (Senior FDE Manager) leads multiple pods of FDEs across several strategic enterprise customers, defining the delivery model, engineering standards, and talent strategy for the FDE practice at scale. This is not a Solutions Architect management role and not a consulting engagement manager role. Senior FDE Managers own organizational-level outcomes — they set the technical direction across multiple concurrent customer programs, build and scale the FDE team, and drive the mechanisms that ensure consistent engineering excellence and measurable business impact across the entire portfolio.

Senior FDE Managers operate at org-level scope. They lead 15–30+ engineers, influence technical decisions across multiple customer engagements and AWS teams simultaneously, and define what "great" looks like for forward-deployed AI engineering management. Lead the FDE delivery organization. Own delivery across multiple customer engagements and FDE pods. Staff and structure teams for optimal customer coverage. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Manager, Relational Database Services
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) is one of the fastest growing services in AWS, running millions of customer databases across every commercial and sovereign region. Keeping those databases current, secure, and healthy at that scale is one of the hardest and most consequential problems in managed databases. Our vision is to provide the best in class release and patch management available.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to build the next generation of how RDS patches, upgrades, and manages the software lifecycle of every database we operate.

You will lead multiple engineering teams reinventing how we deliver operating system, engine, and platform software updates to customer fleets, with the goal of making patching and upgrades a best-in-class, low-touch, and trustworthy experience. You will own the strategy and delivery of advanced patching and upgrade systems designed for the next generation of the cloud: safer automation, richer customer control, and near-zero-downtime maintenance. You will set the multi-year technical vision, hire and grow a strong org, and partner across RDS, database engines, and AWS security to raise the bar on how customers keep their databases current.

The right leader is equally comfortable defining strategy in ambiguity and diving deep into the mechanics of fleet-wide software delivery. You think in terms of customer trust, operational safety, and long-term platform leverage, and you build teams that ship durable systems rather than one-off fixes.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for RDS patching, upgrades, and software lifecycle management across the entire managed fleet.
Build and lead several engineering teams delivering net-new systems for advanced patching and upgrade orchestration, safety, and automation.
Raise the bar on maintenance safety: minimize customer-visible downtime, expand automated validation and rollback, and shorten the time from CVE disclosure to fleet-wide remediation.
Partner with database engine, security, and operations teams to align on a coherent software lifecycle strategy for the next generation of the cloud.
Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing organization; grow managers and senior engineers and set a high standard for operational and engineering excellence.
Represent the patching and lifecycle strategy to senior AWS leadership and to customers, and drive alignment on long-term direction.

A day in the life

You spend your morning in a design review for a new upgrade-orchestration system, pushing the team on how it behaves during partial failure and how it earns customer trust. Midday you review fleet health and remediation metrics with your leads, decide where to invest to raise the bar on critical patch SLAs, and unblock a cross-team dependency with the engine teams. In the afternoon you work with a principal engineer on the multi-year lifecycle vision, then meet with a manager on their team's hiring and growth plans. Throughout, you are balancing near-term operational commitments against the net-new platform you are building.

jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology?

At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives, and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You will thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. By harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact, innovating at the speed of life.

At Cepheid, we are enthusiastic about improving health care through fast, accurate molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you will make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges.

Together, we bring MORE change to the world.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Manager, Operational Technology Programs & Operations Excellence
is responsible for leading strategic programs that improve the reliability, security, compliance, and effectiveness of manufacturing technology environments across Cepheid’s global operations.

This role serves as a bridge between Operations, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Cybersecurity, and Information Technology, ensuring that operational requirements are translated into scalable technology solutions that deliver measurable business value. The role leads cross-functional programs involving operational technology infrastructure, manufacturing cybersecurity, network architecture, computerized system modernization, and operational excellence. Depending on business needs, this individual may serve as a Program Manager, Project Manager, Business Lead, or Operations Subject Matter Expert.

This position reports to the Senior Director, Systems Engineering
and is part of the Systems Engineering organization located in Sunnyvale, California
, and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead strategic Operational Technology and manufacturing technology programs across Cepheid’s global manufacturing sites, driving improvements in reliability, security, compliance, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
Manage complex, cross-functional programs involving OT infrastructure, industrial networks, computerized manufacturing systems, cybersecurity, system modernization, and operational improvements.
Establish program governance, project plans, resource requirements, risk mitigation strategies, performance metrics, and executive-level communications.
Serve as the primary Operations liaison with Information Technology and Cybersecurity teams, translating manufacturing and business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Lead manufacturing technology modernization initiatives, including infrastructure refreshes, operating system upgrades, asset lifecycle management, technology standardization, and operational readiness.
Represent Operations during solution design, business impact assessments, testing, validation, deployment, change management, and sustainment activities, ensuring manufacturing continuity and stakeholder readiness.
Apply the Danaher Business System, Lean principles, and continuous improvement methodologies to establish scalable governance, improve program execution, and standardize technology practices across sites.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related technical field.

Functional Experience:
Eight or more years of experience in manufacturing technology, operational technology, engineering, information technology, manufacturing operations, or related functions within complex manufacturing environments.

Leadership Experience:
Three or more years of experience leading cross-functional programs, projects, or workstreams across multiple functions or sites, including demonstrated experience influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

Program Leadership:
Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute program charters, project plans, governance structures, risk mitigation plans, implementation strategies, performance metrics, and executive communications for complex technology initiatives.

Manufacturing and OT Expertise:
Working knowledge of manufacturing operations and Operational Technology environments, including industrial infrastructure, computerized manufacturing systems, industrial networks, asset lifecycle management, and production support processes.

IT/OT Cybersecurity and Compliance:
Experience partnering with IT, Cybersecurity, Quality, and Validation teams on initiatives involving IT/OT network segmentation, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, technology controls, computerized system validation, or regulated manufacturing requirements.

Business Partnership and Communication:
Demonstrated ability to translate operational needs into technical requirements, facilitate decisions across technical and nontechnical stakeholders, manage organizational change, and communicate program risks, priorities, and outcomes to senior leadership.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Life sciences, medical device, diagnostics, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another regulated manufacturing industry.
Manufacturing systems such as MES, SCADA, industrial automation platforms, data historians, or connected factory technologies.
OT cybersecurity frameworks, GxP-regulated environments, computerized system validation, or enterprise-scale manufacturing technology transformation.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

jobs.description:

At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives, and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

Together, we bring MORE change to the world.
