The Senior Manager, Operational Technology Programs & Operations Excellence
is responsible for leading strategic programs that improve the reliability, security, compliance, and effectiveness of manufacturing technology environments across Cepheid’s global operations.

This role serves as a bridge between Operations, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Cybersecurity, and Information Technology, ensuring that operational requirements are translated into scalable technology solutions that deliver measurable business value. The role leads cross-functional programs involving operational technology infrastructure, manufacturing cybersecurity, network architecture, computerized system modernization, and operational excellence. Depending on business needs, this individual may serve as a Program Manager, Project Manager, Business Lead, or Operations Subject Matter Expert.

This position reports to the Senior Director, Systems Engineering
and is part of the Systems Engineering organization located in Sunnyvale, California
, and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead strategic Operational Technology and manufacturing technology programs across Cepheid’s global manufacturing sites, driving improvements in reliability, security, compliance, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
Manage complex, cross-functional programs involving OT infrastructure, industrial networks, computerized manufacturing systems, cybersecurity, system modernization, and operational improvements.
Establish program governance, project plans, resource requirements, risk mitigation strategies, performance metrics, and executive-level communications.
Serve as the primary Operations liaison with Information Technology and Cybersecurity teams, translating manufacturing and business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Lead manufacturing technology modernization initiatives, including infrastructure refreshes, operating system upgrades, asset lifecycle management, technology standardization, and operational readiness.

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related technical field.

Functional Experience:
Eight or more years of experience in manufacturing technology, operational technology, engineering, information technology, manufacturing operations, or related functions within complex manufacturing environments.

Demonstrated ability to translate operational needs into technical requirements, facilitate decisions across technical and nontechnical stakeholders, manage organizational change, and communicate program risks, priorities, and outcomes to senior leadership.

jobs.title: LSS MU - Director Engineering
jobs.description:
Dematic has an immediate need for a Director of Engineering who will lead the Engineering function of the Modifications and Upgrades Business Unit for the United States. This role is part of the North America Lifecycle Solutions and Services team (commonly referred to as Aftermarket) that works to support our existing customer sites with modifications and upgrades to their systems based on our proven experience to help improve their safety, lower their costs and be more productive through all phases of the system’s lifecycle. Because of the large installed base of Dematic equipment and the breadth of solutions portfolio that Dematic designs, manufactures and/or integrates, this team delivers many projects with many different end customers from retail store distribution to food & beverage manufacturers to e-commerce. Typical projects that our team completes include updating PLC controls, rebuilding linear sorters, replacing worn components on Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems, or growing the capacity of a shuttle system by adding aisles. Work schedules are also highly variably with most onsite work happening over weekends and holidays around the clock to limit customer operational impact.

The Director leads a department of approximately 100 Mechanical and Controls, promoting a safe work environment, best in class customer satisfaction, outstanding employee experience and predictable financial results. Responsibility spans roughly $300M of business across 250+ active projects and reports to the Sr. Director of Engineering of Modification and Upgrades.

We offer:

Career Development
Competitive Compensation and Benefits
Pay Transparency
Global Opportunities

Learn More Here: Logistics and Supply Chain Careers at Dematic

Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $159,000 - $233,200 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Tasks and Qualifications:

What You Will Do In This Role:

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Mechanical and Electrical/Controls Engineers, encouraging a culture of inclusion, accountability, and CI.
Set clear expectations, lead performance, and support career development of team members.
Provide oversight for a large portfolio of concurrent mechatronic projects of varying scope and complexity, including controls software, WMS/WCS/WES, PLC updates, system upgrades, equipment rebuilds, system takeovers, and capacity expansions.
Ensure effective transition from Sales to Operations, including pre-contract support, estimating input, and leadership of project kickoff processes.
Drive the development and execution of comprehensive project plans, including implementation, testing, acceptance, cutover, and launch strategies.
Act as the primary point of escalation for sophisticated project, customer, financial, or technical issues, ensuring timely resolution.
Ensure alignment and coordination across software, controls, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, installation, vendors, subcontractors, and integrator partners.
Own financial performance across the engineering project portfolio, including forecasting, revenue recognition, cost-to-complete, and profitability analysis.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive issue management and governance.
Ensure accurate project closeout and turnover to service and support organizations.
Develop and handle departmental budgets and business plans.
Identify new business opportunities and direct sustaining engineering projects.
Serve as a customer technical partner concern point, building positive relationships and ensuring service standards are met or exceeded.
Support identification of follow-on business opportunities in collaboration with sales and lifecycle services teams.
Represent engineering in long-term planning, operational reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What We Are Looking For:

Bachelor’s degree or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of successful experience leading Project Engineering teams, preferably in automation, logistics, manufacturing, or software-intensive environments.
Proven experience leading large teams and large-scale project portfolios with significant revenue responsibility.
Strong understanding of automation systems, controls architectures, and systems integration; proven working knowledge of industrial and enterprise software systems.
Experience with contract administration, procurement processes (RFP/RFQ), subcontractor management, and risk management.
Proficiency with engineering tools and MS Office; SAP, Power BI, SharePoint or equivalent.

Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Business Description

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTI) is the technology organization at the core of Blackstone’s businesses and growth initiatives. We design and deliver enterprise platforms and services that manage risk, create efficiency, and improve transparency across the firm and its global community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTI operates with an entrepreneurial mindset—collaborative, fast‑moving, and outcome‑driven—while maintaining the rigor required to support a complex global enterprise. We value leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we expect our leaders to help the firm maintain its competitive edge.

Job Description

The Vice President, Service Management is responsible for defining and executing the Enterprise Service Management vision, strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap. This role owns the Service Management Platform, ensuring it delivers scalable, secure, and innovative capabilities that support business operations and long-term growth, with the unique opportunity to replace the existing tooling and introduce a new, AI-Native Service Management platform across the firm.

As a key leader in the firm's digital transformation agenda, the Vice President will drive modernization of Enterprise Service Delivery through intelligent automation, AI-enabled workflows, predictive analytics, and continuous service innovation. The role is accountable for evolving the digital employee experience by designing seamless, best-in-class service interactions that improve productivity, simplify engagement, and increase adoption across the enterprise.

The Vice President, Service Management champions service delivery best practices across Technology, Operations, HR, Procurement, Finance, Facilities, and Corporate Services, driving alignment on where services and capabilities should be centralized, standardized, and consistently implemented. This role brings clarity, accountability, and discipline to shared services while enabling teams to move faster, reduce friction, and deliver better business outcomes through well-designed, well-governed services.

By combining platform ownership, operational excellence, and experience-led design, this role will deliver measurable business outcomes through increased automation, improved service quality, enhanced employee satisfaction, reduced operating costs, and a unified enterprise service management ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Service Management Strategy & Transformation
Partner closely with Corporate and Operational business units across the firm to understand business priorities, operating models, and service needs.
Define and execute an Enterprise Service Management strategy, operating model, governance framework, and transformation roadmap to increase cycle times, reduce employee friction, and improve auditability.
Building trusted relationships across all functions and ensuring the firm’s service management capabilities, platform investments, and service delivery priorities align with business objectives.
Scope and drive an enterprise-wide Service Transformation program that improves service quality, operational efficiency, and workforce productivity.
AI, Automation & Platform Leadership
Drive the modernization of the firm’s Service Management ecosystem through AI, automation, workflow orchestration, and predictive analytics.
Lead the adoption of intelligent automation and generative AI to enable proactive, scalable, and data-driven service delivery.
Collaborate closely with both technology and functional leaders to develop subject matter expertise of Blackstone's critical corporate and operational workflows.
Identify opportunities to use AI to streamline processes, reduce manual efforts, and accelerate digital transformation across the enterprise.
Employee Experience & Service Delivery
Own the digital employee experience, including self-service, knowledge management, virtual agents, portals, and omnichannel engagement, transforming the way Blackstone employees interact with Technology and Corporate services across the firm.
Establish, develop, and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including line of business CAOs and COOs, to solicit feedback on employee experience, increase technology adoption, improve accessibility, and reduce friction across the employee journey.
Collaborate with Technology Support Leaders to establish service standards and experience metrics that drive productivity, satisfaction, and continuous improvement.
Operational Excellence, Governance & Leadership
Oversee enterprise service delivery across Technology, HR, Finance, Procurement, Facilities, and other corporate functions.
Drive process standardization, governance, performance management, and continuous improvement across shared services.
Lead high-performing cross-functional teams, manage strategic vendor partnerships, and deliver measurable outcomes through automation, cost optimization, service quality improvements, and enhanced employee experience.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Technology Transformation. Experience with Service Management, IT Operations, Digital Workplace, and Enterprise Platforms are preferred.
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale service delivery, platform modernization, or shared services organizations.
Demonstrated leadership experience with accountability for program outcomes and execution.
Proven experience building relationships and collaborating effectively across investment teams and corporate functions in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Proven experience balancing strategic vision with execution‑level detail.
Demonstrated success driving digital transformation initiatives through AI, automation, analytics, and process optimization.
Proven experience leading complex initiatives involving multiple technical teams and business partners.
Self‑starting, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
ITIL v4 certification preferred.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technology field.

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure Security Engineering - EDA Clusters
jobs.description:
Securing NVIDIA’s EDA clusters is not a matter of deploying the standard security stack. These workloads are too large, too long-running, and too performance-sensitive for the off-the-shelf playbook to simply apply. That constraint is the job. We’re hiring an engineering leader to build and run Infrastructure Security Engineering for EDA Clusters: the team responsible for implementing security controls across the compute, storage, and networking that NVIDIA’s hardware engineers design silicon on, spanning on-prem data centers and multi-cloud environments. You’ll operate as the peer counterpart to NVIDIA’s company-wide security organization and to hardware infrastructure engineering, translating enterprise security intent into controls that hold up at EDA scale without slowing chip design down.

Much of this is a build, not a maintain. You’ll have the authority to decide where standard tooling applies, where it actively cannot, and what NVIDIA engineers instead then lead a team to do it. If your depth is in large-scale networking and compute infrastructure at a hyperscaler, a security product company, or anywhere fleets and fabrics are the day job and you’ve carried real accountability for the security properties of those systems, you are exactly who we want to talk to. We don’t expect you to arrive fluent in every security product category; we do expect you to own security outcomes from day one and to acquire the remaining domain breadth fast. Strong infrastructure mastery plus sharp security instincts beats a broad product résumé here. This is a role for someone who believes security engineering is engineering: automation, instrumentation, and secure-by-default infrastructure not tickets, exceptions, and spreadsheets.

What You’ll Be Doing

Build and lead the team. Grow and direct a team of engineers with a bias toward practical, production-proven results, and develop the leaders within it. Own the technical roadmap. Partner with various other security teams and infrastructure engineering to architect the roadmap for EDA-specific security controls and ship them into production.
Make the network and platform your control plane. Protection doesn’t depend just on what’s running inside the node.
Engineer around hard constraints. Determine where conventional endpoint and workload security tooling fits, where it doesn’t, and design the alternative: security that protects multi-day compute jobs without degrading them.
Make enforcement uniform. Drive consistent application of security frameworks across on-prem data centers and multi-cloud platforms where “consistent” means enforced, not documented.
Run the full lifecycle of core infrastructure security technologies: selection, deployment, operation, and eventual replacement.
Automate the evidence. Build the KPIs, instrumentation, and audit workflows that make security posture across EDA systems continuously visible treating compliance evidence as an engineering output, not a manual exercise.
Think like an adversary. Mitigation planning across network, storage, and compute.
Champion security by design, embedding automation and secure defaults into the infrastructure lifecycle instead of bolting them on afterward.

What We Need To See

12+ overall years building and operating production infrastructure at scale - network, compute clusters, and storage including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams. A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.
Deep networking expertise applied to large compute environments.
Hands-on depth operating compute fleets at scale - provisioning, lifecycle, and the operational realities of long-running, high-value jobs.
Deep understanding of hyperscaler methodologies for operating large-scale systems with security and reliability as co-equal goals.
Experience securing performance-sensitive or high-throughput environments where standard agent-based tooling was constrained and you engineered a workable answer.
Extensive history of building and guiding engineering teams responsible for complex distributed or multi-cloud architectures.
Demonstrated ability to drive unified outcomes across organizational boundaries, with partners who do not report to you.
Exceptional communication skills credible with individual engineers and executive leadership in the same day.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Built or operated infrastructure security capabilities at a hyperscaler or a security product company — you’ve engineered detection and enforcement systems, not just deployed someone else’s.
Experience with kernel- and fabric-level observability and enforcement - eBPF, in-line and out-of-band inspection, DPU/SmartNIC offload - as an alternative to heavyweight in-node agents.
Track record leading security or platform engineering inside EDA, HPC, or large research-cluster environments. Breadth across security domains - IAM, EDR/XDR, CNAPP, CSPM, vulnerability lifecycle, zero-trust architectures - or a demonstrated pattern of picking up new domains fast.
Experience driving infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code so secure configuration is the default state rather than an audited one, plus familiarity translating SOC2 / ISO27001 into real technical controls.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 19, 2026.

jobs.title: Head of Global Customer Engineering - Internal EDA Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Every NVIDIA GPU starts as a job on our internal EDA infrastructure. Thousands of hardware engineers designing next-generation silicon depend on it being fast, available, and frictionless and when it isn’t, tapeout schedules feel it. This team is the difference. We’re hiring a hands-on engineering leader to develop our Global Customer Engineering for Internal EDA Infrastructure - the organization sitting directly between our chip designers and the platforms they run on. This is a multi-team leadership role spanning managers and tech leads across a globally distributed organization, and it comes with two co-equal mandates: A world-class customer engineering organization for EDA infrastructure - reactive when it must be, proactive by design. The Kubernetes platform team that delivers one of our customer services end to end.

You will design software solutions, and automation pipelines to eliminate operational overhead. When encountering recurring toil for customer engineering, your immediate impulse is to engineer permanent automated remedies. Staying directly connected to live production environments is essential hence the end-to-end Kubernetes platform responsibility.

What You’ll Be Doing

Build the leaders. Grow and develop the leaders running a globally distributed team of customer-facing engineers who own the reactive support queue for EDA infrastructure - escalating into service engineering with clean, high-quality signal.
Develop the Kubernetes platform. Run the K8s platform team as a first-class customer engineering service: availability, roadmap, developer experience, and the operational excellence behind it.
Ship the L0 AI support layer. Own the evolution of our AI support agent from FAQ bot to a system that safely resolves real issues against real internal systems - and measurably removes volume from human queues.
Set the bar. Define and defend SLOs for operational performance, and win genuine stakeholder buy-in.
Stay close to the metal. Drive deep support and continuous improvement across EDA job schedulers (LSF/Slurm), Kubernetes platforms, and the internal LLM harnesses our chip designers depend on.

What We Need To See

12+ overall years building and leading engineering support organizations, spanning reactive and proactive customer engineering.
5+ years of experience leading a globally distributed organization, including developing managers and leaders.
Proven ability to influence technical roadmaps by turning support trends into engineering requirements that actually ship.
Deep technical familiarity with Kubernetes, EDA workloads, job schedulers, and AI/LLM infrastructure foundations.
Track record of leveraging automation and AI/ML to improve support efficiency and drive ticket volume down.
Exceptional communication skills - credible with individual engineers and executive leadership in the same day.
A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Led a platform team and a customer facing team simultaneously, and made each one better because of the other.
You’ve architected “self-healing” support ecosystems where a customer engineering team builds and owns the tools it runs on including “shift-left” tooling that resolved issues before a ticket ever existed.
You’ve led the full lifecycle of generative AI / LLM-based support assistants, well beyond basic chatbots, into systems that integrate deeply and safely with internal infrastructure.
Run LSF, Slurm, or Kubernetes at a scale where manual intervention was the bottleneck and you personally led the automation that removed it.

jobs.description:
Securing NVIDIA’s EDA clusters is not a matter of deploying the standard security stack. These workloads are too large, too long-running, and too performance-sensitive for the off-the-shelf playbook to simply apply. That constraint is the job. We’re hiring an engineering leader to build and run Infrastructure Security Engineering for EDA Clusters: the team responsible for implementing security controls across the compute, storage, and networking that NVIDIA’s hardware engineers design silicon on, spanning on-prem data centers and multi-cloud environments. You’ll operate as the peer counterpart to NVIDIA’s company-wide security organization and to hardware infrastructure engineering, translating enterprise security intent into controls that hold up at EDA scale without slowing chip design down.

Much of this is a build, not a maintain. You’ll have the authority to decide where standard tooling applies, where it actively cannot, and what NVIDIA engineers instead then lead a team to do it. If your depth is in large-scale networking and compute infrastructure at a hyperscaler, a security product company, or anywhere fleets and fabrics are the day job and you’ve carried real accountability for the security properties of those systems, you are exactly who we want to talk to. We don’t expect you to arrive fluent in every security product category; we do expect you to own security outcomes from day one and to acquire the remaining domain breadth fast. Strong infrastructure mastery plus sharp security instincts beats a broad product résumé here. This is a role for someone who believes security engineering is engineering: automation, instrumentation, and secure-by-default infrastructure not tickets, exceptions, and spreadsheets.

What You’ll Be Doing

Build and lead the team. Grow and direct a team of engineers with a bias toward practical, production-proven results, and develop the leaders within it. Own the technical roadmap. Partner with various other security teams and infrastructure engineering to architect the roadmap for EDA-specific security controls and ship them into production.
Make the network and platform your control plane. Protection doesn’t depend just on what’s running inside the node.
Engineer around hard constraints. Determine where conventional endpoint and workload security tooling fits, where it doesn’t, and design the alternative: security that protects multi-day compute jobs without degrading them.
Make enforcement uniform. Drive consistent application of security frameworks across on-prem data centers and multi-cloud platforms where “consistent” means enforced, not documented.
Run the full lifecycle of core infrastructure security technologies: selection, deployment, operation, and eventual replacement.
Automate the evidence. Build the KPIs, instrumentation, and audit workflows that make security posture across EDA systems continuously visible treating compliance evidence as an engineering output, not a manual exercise.
Think like an adversary. Mitigation planning across network, storage, and compute.
Champion security by design, embedding automation and secure defaults into the infrastructure lifecycle instead of bolting them on afterward.

12+ overall years building and operating production infrastructure at scale - network, compute clusters, and storage including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams. A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.
Deep networking expertise applied to large compute environments.
Hands-on depth operating compute fleets at scale - provisioning, lifecycle, and the operational realities of long-running, high-value jobs.
Deep understanding of hyperscaler methodologies for operating large-scale systems with security and reliability as co-equal goals.
Experience securing performance-sensitive or high-throughput environments where standard agent-based tooling was constrained and you engineered a workable answer.
Extensive history of building and guiding engineering teams responsible for complex distributed or multi-cloud architectures.
Demonstrated ability to drive unified outcomes across organizational boundaries, with partners who do not report to you.
Exceptional communication skills credible with individual engineers and executive leadership in the same day.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Built or operated infrastructure security capabilities at a hyperscaler or a security product company — you’ve engineered detection and enforcement systems, not just deployed someone else’s.
Experience with kernel- and fabric-level observability and enforcement - eBPF, in-line and out-of-band inspection, DPU/SmartNIC offload - as an alternative to heavyweight in-node agents.
Track record leading security or platform engineering inside EDA, HPC, or large research-cluster environments. Breadth across security domains - IAM, EDR/XDR, CNAPP, CSPM, vulnerability lifecycle, zero-trust architectures - or a demonstrated pattern of picking up new domains fast.
Experience driving infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code so secure configuration is the default state rather than an audited one, plus familiarity translating SOC2 / ISO27001 into real technical controls.

jobs.title: Head of Global Customer Engineering - Internal EDA Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Every NVIDIA GPU starts as a job on our internal EDA infrastructure. Thousands of hardware engineers designing next-generation silicon depend on it being fast, available, and frictionless and when it isn’t, tapeout schedules feel it. This team is the difference. We’re hiring a hands-on engineering leader to develop our Global Customer Engineering for Internal EDA Infrastructure - the organization sitting directly between our chip designers and the platforms they run on. This is a multi-team leadership role spanning managers and tech leads across a globally distributed organization, and it comes with two co-equal mandates: A world-class customer engineering organization for EDA infrastructure - reactive when it must be, proactive by design. The Kubernetes platform team that delivers one of our customer services end to end.

You will design software solutions, and automation pipelines to eliminate operational overhead. When encountering recurring toil for customer engineering, your immediate impulse is to engineer permanent automated remedies. Staying directly connected to live production environments is essential hence the end-to-end Kubernetes platform responsibility.

What You’ll Be Doing

Build the leaders. Grow and develop the leaders running a globally distributed team of customer-facing engineers who own the reactive support queue for EDA infrastructure - escalating into service engineering with clean, high-quality signal.
Develop the Kubernetes platform. Run the K8s platform team as a first-class customer engineering service: availability, roadmap, developer experience, and the operational excellence behind it.
Ship the L0 AI support layer. Own the evolution of our AI support agent from FAQ bot to a system that safely resolves real issues against real internal systems - and measurably removes volume from human queues.
Set the bar. Define and defend SLOs for operational performance, and win genuine stakeholder buy-in.
Stay close to the metal. Drive deep support and continuous improvement across EDA job schedulers (LSF/Slurm), Kubernetes platforms, and the internal LLM harnesses our chip designers depend on.

What We Need To See

12+ overall years building and leading engineering support organizations, spanning reactive and proactive customer engineering.
5+ years of experience leading a globally distributed organization, including developing managers and leaders.
Proven ability to influence technical roadmaps by turning support trends into engineering requirements that actually ship.
Deep technical familiarity with Kubernetes, EDA workloads, job schedulers, and AI/LLM infrastructure foundations.
Track record of leveraging automation and AI/ML to improve support efficiency and drive ticket volume down.
Exceptional communication skills - credible with individual engineers and executive leadership in the same day.
A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Led a platform team and a customer facing team simultaneously, and made each one better because of the other.
You’ve architected “self-healing” support ecosystems where a customer engineering team builds and owns the tools it runs on including “shift-left” tooling that resolved issues before a ticket ever existed.
You’ve led the full lifecycle of generative AI / LLM-based support assistants, well beyond basic chatbots, into systems that integrate deeply and safely with internal infrastructure.
Run LSF, Slurm, or Kubernetes at a scale where manual intervention was the bottleneck and you personally led the automation that removed it.

jobs.title: Director of Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

MaxLinear is seeking a Director of Product Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following:

Build and mentor engineering talent while fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and innovation
Drive seamless transition of products from design to manufacturing and own product manufacturing performance throughout the entire product lifecycle
Lead product bring-up, silicon validation, characterization, qualification, and production release activities
Define organizational strategy, goals, KPIs, and resource plans aligned with company objectives
Collaborate closely with cross functional organizations to optimize performance, yield, testability, and manufacturability
Establish manufacturing readiness criteria and ensure successful product ramp
Own product yield improvement initiatives across wafer fabrication, assembly, and final test operations
Implement statistical process control (SPC), DOE, FMEA, and advanced analytics techniques.
Analyze product and test data to identify yield detractors and implement corrective actions
Develop strategies to improve cost of test, manufacturing efficiency, and overall product margins
Support customer escalations, product quality investigations, and field-return analysis
Establish and manage OSAT scorecards and KPIs to ensure world-class execution in quality, yield, cost, delivery, and cycle time

Qualifications

Experience with releasing products on advanced CMOS Process nodes (16nm and below)
Deep knowledge of mm-wave, RF, Mixed signal and CMOS logic circuit principles
Knowledge and experience with ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), such as Verigy and Teradyne
Experience with Data Analysis S/W such as Galaxy, Data Conductor or DataPower to create Characterization Reports and monitor production Yield
Experience recruiting, managing, and mentoring an engineering team
BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 13 years of experience, or MS + 11 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 8 years of experience

Compensation And Benefits

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $ 187,000 to $251 , Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

Overview

At KeHE, we’re obsessed with creating solutions, unboxing potential, and serving others - and it all starts with you. As an employee-owned distributor of natural and organic, specialty, and fresh products, we’re committed to making a positive impact and scaling our success together. With a culture that fosters development and opportunity, you’ll be embarking on a career that’s moving forward. When you join KeHE, you’re becoming part of a team that is a force for good.

Primary Responsibilities

The Director of Infrastructure Engineering will lead the modernization of the company’s infrastructure organization from a traditional, legacy operating model to a secure, automated, cloud-enabled infrastructure platform engineering function. jobs.title: Director, Data Center Networking
jobs.description:
Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

Crux AI is led by CEO, Ben Treynor Sloss, who spent over two decades in executive technical leadership at Google, led the creation of Google’s global network, and founded the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) discipline
. At Crux AI, we treat operations and network infrastructure fundamentally as a software engineering problem.

What You'll Do

Crux AI is standing up multi-gigawatt TPU cluster fabrics and edge networking from zero. As Director, Data Center Networking, you will own the network layer end-to-end, from powered shell to the production fabric moving traffic at line rate.

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will build and scale our global network engineering function from scratch. This is a true hands-on, builder seat, not a supervisory position.

You will lead an elite group of unusually senior network and automation engineers, acting as the chief technical authority interfacing with Google’s TPU networking teams. You must thrive on high autonomy and revel in ambiguity, translating complex physical and logical constraints into concrete engineering priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

In This Role, You Will

Build & Lead the Network Engineering Org: Recruit, structure, and develop an elite global team of senior network engineers across North America and Europe to scale ahead of rapid fleet builds.
Set Fabric & Edge Architecture: Establish the global plan-of-record design standards for high-density TPU supercomputing clusters.
Own Network Provisioning: Define and execute network provisioning, turn-up, and burn-in procedures from powered shell through Level 5 / IST commissioning, optimizing the velocity of capacity delivery.
Own Network Reliability & Observability: Drive fabric reliability, incident response, and telemetry/observability in tight coordination with SRE, establishing self-healing automation to remediate faults before they impact customers.
Drive Network Automation & IaC: Own network automation from day one, establishing Infrastructure-as-Code as the mandatory basis for all configuration.
Direct Google TPU Engineering Partnership: Serve as the primary technical authority partnering with Google’s TPU networking teams on fabric integration, link qualification, and co-engineering roadmaps.
Cross-Functional Infrastructure Alignment: Partner with Capacity Delivery, Facility Operations, and the Energy Manager on site handoffs and constraints; align with SRE on reliability and observability.
Optimize Network Economics & Margins: Feed network cost, lead times, and hardware procurement inputs into the capacity plan of record and cost/margin models.

SIGNALS OF SUCCESS

After 60 Days In This Role

Assessed active site network architectures; established working relationship with Google TPU networking teams; published the standardized fabric design adopted as plan of record for upcoming builds.

After 6 Months

Delivered a production network turn-up on the first site; automated provisioning workflows to eliminate manual config; onboarded initial senior network engineering hires across geographies.

After 1 Year

Standardized network architecture deployed as reference design across the fleet; fabric incident response running on automated telemetry rather than heroics; function delivering defensible cost/lead-time models to the business.

Experiences

EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH

15+ years in large-scale data center, ISP, or hyperscale network engineering, with 7+ years leading network engineering teams.
Deep Knowledge of High-Performance Fabrics: Hands-on mastery of high-throughput AI/ML or HPC networks at hyperscaler or neocloud scale.
Data Center Provisioning: Track record standing up network provisioning and turn-up processes using Infrastructure-as-Code techniques across multiple data center builds, partnering directly with construction, MEP, and capacity delivery teams.

Attributes

Senior Talent Magnet: Track record of attracting, evaluating, and leading senior network engineers who excel in fast-paced, high-stakes infrastructure environments.

Mindset

Builder Mindset & Ambiguity: A true "builder, not supervisory" orientation; comfortable owning 2am fabric escalations early on, navigating ambiguity, and establishing structure amidst rapid growth.
AI-Agentic First: Active utilization of AI agents and automated workflows to streamline network diagnostics, telemetry parsing, and provisioning or an enthusiastic commitment to adopting them rapidly.

Nice To Have (Preferred, Not Required)

Hyperscaler / Neocloud Leadership: Network engineering leadership at a hyperscaler or leading neocloud during rapid growth.
TPU / GPU Cluster Operations: Direct experience with TPU/GPU interconnect fabrics, collective communication debugging, and scale-out burn-in testing.
Hyperscale Supplier Partnership: Experience managing technical co-engineering relationships with major technology/silicon partners comparable to Google.
Expert-Level Technical Depth: CCIE/JNCIE-level technical rigor (formal credential not required).
0-to-1 Org Building: Experience building a network engineering function from scratch.

We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation
Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

Full suite of other optional benefits

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

VP, Data & Analytics Engineering

About Your Role

As VP, Data & Analytics Engineering, you will lead Data & Analytics Engineering for the business-facing tier of the enterprise data ecosystem. You will work with data platform, governance, AI, product, risk, operations and business leaders to transform curated data into trusted, discoverable, secure and easy-to-consume products. Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will lead multiple delivery capability domains within Platform Engineering focused on improving software delivery across SiriusXM. You will be accountable for the teams, technical leads, shared platforms, and operating standards engineering organizations rely on to develop, validate, secure, package, and release software at scale. In this role, you will define and execute the annual and multi-year delivery engineering strategy and roadmap, ensuring that our platforms and tools measurably improve developer productivity, software quality, operational consistency, release reliability, adoption, and security posture. You will establish shared engineering standards and governance, influence senior leaders across engineering, infrastructure, security, and product, and make investment, staffing, and prioritization decisions that build a strong organization and develop future leaders.

What You’ll Do

Lead Organization and Roadmap: Lead multiple delivery capability domains and the engineers and technical leads responsible for them. Own the annual and multi-year roadmap for platform investments, establish priorities and success measures, and align capacity, staffing, vendor, and tooling decisions with Platform Engineering leadership and senior stakeholders.
Drive Strategy and Execution for Core Delivery Capabilities: Direct the strategy, tooling, and execution across CI/CD, artifact management, production containers, code quality, and security scanning, with a focus on specific outcomes:
Accelerating Delivery: Improve development speed, release reliability, and consistency across teams through CI/CD tooling and shared components.
Standardizing Artifacts and Containers: Ensure software packages, build outputs, and containerized workloads are reliable, traceable, secure, and standardized for easy consumption and delivery.
Improving Quality and Security Posture: Drive capabilities for code quality and security scanning to enhance maintainability, engineering effectiveness, and enable secure-by-default delivery practices by shifting security earlier in the development lifecycle.

Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with security, infrastructure, developer experience, and application engineering teams to identify friction, improve workflows, and deliver scalable shared solutions.
Operational Accountability and Excellence: Own technical and organizational decision-making for the delivery engineering portfolio, ensuring solutions align with broader platform strategy and business goals. Set priorities across multiple concurrent efforts, resolve cross-functional trade-offs, and manage material risks, dependencies, service reliability, capacity, and investment decisions.
Performance, Standards, and Governance: Establish and evolve engineering processes, delivery standards, governance, and secure-by-default practices. Use adoption, developer productivity, delivery performance, reliability, quality, and security metrics to evaluate platform effectiveness and hold teams accountable for measurable operational outcomes.
Develop Talent and Organizational Capability: Coach and develop technical leads and engineers, build a strong leadership bench, and create succession and development plans. Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR on hiring, organization design, workforce planning, performance management, and staffing decisions across the delivery engineering portfolio.
Enterprise Adoption and Executive Influence: Drive adoption of shared delivery platforms and standards across multiple engineering organizations. Present recommendations, performance results, risks, and investment trade-offs to senior management and secure alignment on changes that affect company-wide software delivery.
Resource and Vendor Stewardship: Plan and manage the team’s operating capacity and approved tooling or vendor investments, balancing cost, reliability, security, and developer experience while ensuring resources are aligned to strategic priorities.

What You’ll Need

Typically has 7 or more years of experience with 3 or more years of management experience managing software engineering teams, including responsibility for multiple capability areas, technical leads, or managers, and demonstrated success developing leadership talent.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Domain Expertise: Experience with one or more core delivery domains: CI/CD systems, artifact repositories, container platforms, code quality tooling, software supply chain controls, or security scanning platforms.
Strategic & Technical Judgment: Strong technical judgment and understanding of modern software delivery architecture, with the ability to challenge technical decisions, assess risk, and guide complex trade-offs. Demonstrated ability to contribute to engineering strategy, improve processes, and align execution with business priorities.
Team and People Leadership: Experience leading multiple engineering capability areas and delivering results across complex, cross-organizational technical initiatives. Strong people leadership skills encompassing coaching and mentoring senior engineers, technical leads, and managers; performance management; succession planning; talent development; team building; and organization design.
Operational Excellence and Communication: Strong organizational and operational leadership skills, including annual and multi-year planning, portfolio prioritization, execution management, service accountability, risk mitigation, capacity planning, and vendor or tooling investment decisions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive-influence skills, with demonstrated ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders, resolve sensitive cross-functional trade-offs, and gain adoption of shared standards across multiple engineering organizations.
Experience using automation, AI-assisted development tools, or workflow optimization to improve delivery efficiency and engineering productivity is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
ComPsych Ⓡ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResources Ⓡ and AbsenceResources Ⓡ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.

About The Role

We're modernizing how ComPsych builds technology — new customer-facing web and mobile experiences, a unified design system, and AI-powered capabilities across our products. That means raising the engineering bar for how we design, build, and operate software, with Engineering, Product, and Design working together end to end.

AI is part of how we engineer, not a productivity add-on. Our engineers use agentic development as standard equipment — writing clear specs, delegating meaningful work to AI agents, and applying strong technical judgment to what comes back. Our platform carries behavioral health data for millions of members, so reliability, privacy, and correctness are non-negotiable — not a tax on velocity. As a Senior Engineering Manager, your organization is your product: you're accountable for what multiple teams ship, how the group operates as AI changes the job, and the managers and engineers who grow under your leadership. Your job isn't to run any one team day to day — it's to create the conditions, standards, and talent pipeline that let several strong teams move with high ownership and autonomy.

What You'll Do

You're accountable for the organization you lead — delivery, technical judgment, production health, and how your teams work with AI — operating across multiple teams rather than inside a single one:

Build and grow a strong engineering organization, not just a single team. Create clarity, accountability, and growth so multiple teams — and the managers or leads within them — can take on increasing scope and perform at a high bar.
Create a credible delivery system across teams. Make priorities, ownership, dependencies, and capacity visible across the group you lead, and resolve the tradeoffs that no single team can make on its own.
Partner with Product and Design leadership on outcomes and execution at the domain level. Get pulled into discovery early, turn business priorities into executable plans across teams, and negotiate scope directly when AI-driven planning speed outpaces what engineering can safely validate and ship.
Hold the engineering bar across your organization. Ensure important technical decisions get the right depth of review everywhere you're accountable, and build the standards that make good judgment repeatable without your direct involvement in every decision.
Own the health of what your organization puts into production. Make sure every team you're accountable for can operate what it ships and respond effectively when things fail, and use delivery, quality, and reliability signals to know where to intervene and fix structural causes rather than recurring symptoms.
Set how your organization works with AI, and shape talent and standards around it. Define the delegation, verification, and review practices multiple teams adopt, evolve hiring and leveling criteria to reflect AI-native skills, and mentor other managers on coaching their engineers through the same shift.

What We're Looking For

You've led engineers and managers through the hard parts of scaling an organization. You've set expectations, coached people at different levels, managed performance, supported career growth and promotions, and handled difficult conversations directly — across more than one team.
You have technical depth engineers and managers trust, across more than one technical domain. You can engage meaningfully in design reviews for Java, Python, C#, or similar systems, challenge API contracts and data models, and reason about failure modes and testing strategy well enough to hold other managers accountable for the same rigor.
You've owned production engineering across multiple teams running on AWS or Azure. You've been accountable for observability, SLOs, on-call, incident response, and postmortem follow-through at a scale beyond a single team's services.
You know how to lead an organization that builds secure, privacy-sensitive systems. You can challenge authentication and authorization decisions, ensure threat modeling and sensitive-data handling are addressed up front across teams, and drive security findings through remediation. Experience with PHI/HIPAA or comparable regulated environments is preferred.
You run engineering with evidence, not anecdotes, at the organizational level. You've used delivery, quality, reliability, and team-health signals — cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, escaped defects, MTTR, or operational load — to compare teams fairly, decide where to intervene, and report meaningful progress to leadership.
You improve the system instead of becoming the system, at a scale beyond one team. You create teams and managers who can make decisions and move independently, remove organizational friction a single EM can't fix alone, and treat dependency on you as something to eliminate, not evidence of your value.
You've led AI-first engineering in practice, and shaped how other managers do the same. You've directed agents on real work, established how engineers delegate and verify meaningful implementation, and helped other managers adapt their teams' operating model as the bottleneck moved from implementation to specification, review, or decision-making.

Bonus: experience managing other engineering managers, leading an organization through a similar AI-native transition, or shaping hiring and leveling criteria at the org level.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will lead multiple delivery capability domains within Platform Engineering focused on improving software delivery across SiriusXM. You will be accountable for the teams, technical leads, shared platforms, and operating standards engineering organizations rely on to develop, validate, secure, package, and release software at scale. In this role, you will define and execute the annual and multi-year delivery engineering strategy and roadmap, ensuring that our platforms and tools measurably improve developer productivity, software quality, operational consistency, release reliability, adoption, and security posture. You will establish shared engineering standards and governance, influence senior leaders across engineering, infrastructure, security, and product, and make investment, staffing, and prioritization decisions that build a strong organization and develop future leaders.

What You’ll Do

Lead Organization and Roadmap: Lead multiple delivery capability domains and the engineers and technical leads responsible for them. Accelerating Delivery: Improve development speed, release reliability, and consistency across teams through CI/CD tooling and shared components.
Standardizing Artifacts and Containers: Ensure software packages, build outputs, and containerized workloads are reliable, traceable, secure, and standardized for easy consumption and delivery.
Improving Quality and Security Posture: Drive capabilities for code quality and security scanning to enhance maintainability, engineering effectiveness, and enable secure-by-default delivery practices by shifting security earlier in the development lifecycle.

Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with security, infrastructure, developer experience, and application engineering teams to identify friction, improve workflows, and deliver scalable shared solutions.
Operational Accountability and Excellence: Own technical and organizational decision-making for the delivery engineering portfolio, ensuring solutions align with broader platform strategy and business goals. Set priorities across multiple concurrent efforts, resolve cross-functional trade-offs, and manage material risks, dependencies, service reliability, capacity, and investment decisions.
Performance, Standards, and Governance: Establish and evolve engineering processes, delivery standards, governance, and secure-by-default practices. Use adoption, developer productivity, delivery performance, reliability, quality, and security metrics to evaluate platform effectiveness and hold teams accountable for measurable operational outcomes.
Develop Talent and Organizational Capability: Coach and develop technical leads and engineers, build a strong leadership bench, and create succession and development plans. Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR on hiring, organization design, workforce planning, performance management, and staffing decisions across the delivery engineering portfolio.
Enterprise Adoption and Executive Influence: Drive adoption of shared delivery platforms and standards across multiple engineering organizations. Present recommendations, performance results, risks, and investment trade-offs to senior management and secure alignment on changes that affect company-wide software delivery.
Resource and Vendor Stewardship: Plan and manage the team’s operating capacity and approved tooling or vendor investments, balancing cost, reliability, security, and developer experience while ensuring resources are aligned to strategic priorities.

Typically has 7 or more years of experience with 3 or more years of management experience managing software engineering teams, including responsibility for multiple capability areas, technical leads, or managers, and demonstrated success developing leadership talent.

About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell’s AI Connectivity Group is at the forefront of enabling the world’s leading cloud hyperscalers to move data faster and more reliably inside and between data centers. Our PAM4 DSP technology powers 200G, 400G, and 800G intra-datacenter connectivity, while our Coherent DSP technology enables 100G and 400G inter-datacenter links. Marvell is the trusted partner driving the industry’s transition from Copper PHY to high-speed optical connectivity.

What You Can Expect

As a Sr. Staff Manager, Product Engineering
in Marvell’s AI Connectivity Group, you will lead a team of product engineers responsible for the productization of cutting-edge datacenter connectivity solutions. You will drive new product introduction (NPI) from early silicon bring-up through mass production, while building and developing a high-performing, globally distributed team. This role requires both deep technical expertise in high-speed connectivity and strong people leadership to ensure successful execution across multiple concurrent programs.

Team Leadership & People Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of product engineers across multiple sites and regions, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Hire and develop a diverse, engaged, and effective team — ready to take on new work and future leadership roles.
Manage performance, both motivating for top performance and taking action on poor performance.
Model and hold others accountable for demonstrating Marvell’s core behaviors and setting a tone of global inclusion.
Understand change initiatives; communicate and lead them effectively within the team.

NPI Program Execution

Oversee multiple concurrent NPI programs for high-speed datacenter connectivity products (PAM4, Coherent DSP), including silicon bring-up, DFT validation, and test methodology development.
Provide strategic direction, hands-on technical guidance, and mentorship to drive successful NPI development across a global team of product engineers.
Ensure timely delivery of engineering samples to support early customer engagement and validation.
Lead cross-functional reviews and drive resolution of technical and operational issues impacting product readiness.

Yield, Quality & Test

Drive yield characterization, root cause analysis, and correlation across bench, wafer sort, and final test to meet cost and quality targets.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives in test infrastructure, data analytics, and product engineering best practices.
Apply quality management tools (GR&R, Cp, Cpk) and statistical data analysis to ensure product quality and reliability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations

Align team goals to organization goals; develop work plans to guide the team and reduce redundancies.
Establish and adjust team priorities; allocate resources to deliver on plan and resolve disputes to remove roadblocks.
Partner with operations and supply chain to scale production capacity, qualify alternate sources, and improve manufacturing efficiency.
Develop mutually beneficial working relationships with internal/external customers, suppliers, and partners; develop and monitor specific plans to deliver results.
Clearly communicate BU strategic priorities and function strategy to enable team understanding and alignment.

Business & Financial Accountability

Deliver results against team and BU plans; measure programs, project plans, and team progress with clear accountability.
Plan and execute innovative team deliverables, services, and solutions.
Understand internal/external customer needs and actively communicate them to team and management to inform decision-making, applying Marvell’s Brand Pillars (Dynamic, Attentive, Real, and Tenacious).

What We're Looking For

Education

M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field.

Experience

10+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a strong track record in product engineering, device physics, and end-to-end NPI workflow.
3+ years of people management experience, with demonstrated success in building and leading high-performing engineering teams.
Deep expertise in high-speed connectivity technologies (PAM4 DSP, Coherent DSP, or equivalent), with hands-on experience in silicon bring-up, yield optimization, and test strategy.
Experience with advanced technology nodes (10nm and below) preferred.
Proven success in managing cross-functional teams and mentoring engineers across regions in a global matrix organization.

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of yield analysis, quality management tools (GR&R, Cp, Cpk), and statistical data analysis.
Proficiency with ATE concepts (e.g., Advantest 93K, UltraFlex), test handlers, and wafer probers.
Familiarity with high-speed optical/electrical interface standards (e.g., 200G/400G/800G PAM4, 100G/400G Coherent).

Leadership & Soft Skills

Demonstrated ability to build effective teams, set goals, motivate, and coach team members.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, operations, and executive teams.
Self-directed, capable of managing complex projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong decision quality — able to make sound, timely decisions in urgent and non-routine situations.
Nimble learner who applies new concepts quickly and drives continuous improvement.
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

143,560 - 215,000, $ per annum

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K , one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock® , Borderlands® , Mafia , Sid Meier’s Civilization® , and XCOM® , as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K , TopSpin® , and PGA TOUR® 2K . We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

What We Need

We are seeking an experienced and inspiring Senior Manager, Infrastructure, Network and Cloud Engineering to lead the team that builds and operates the foundation our games run on: datacenter and compute, global network and edge services, and cloud platforms.

Based in Austin, TX, this role leads a distributed service and operations team across multiple sites and time zones. You will own how the team is staffed, how it spends its time, and how safely it operates, balancing on-call, project delivery, keep-the-lights-on work, and incident load across a hybrid estate spanning on-premises datacenters and public cloud.

This is first and foremost a leadership role, not a hands-on engineering one. Technical direction and roadmaps sit with our Staff+ engineers and Technical Program Managers, and you partner with them closely. What we need from you is judgment, structure, and communication: the ability to understand what your engineers are telling you, ask the questions that surface risk, and turn infrastructure complexity into decisions that studios, security, finance, and executive leadership can act on. Your leverage comes from the team you build, the clarity you create, and the conditions you set for others to do their best work. That said, this is not a domain you can lead from the outside. We are looking for someone whose career has been built in infrastructure, and who has the scar tissue to prove it.

What You Will Do

Lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of network, cloud, and systems engineers, including hiring, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Own capacity planning for the team across all four demands on its time: on-call, project delivery, KTLO, and incident response. Make the trade-offs explicit, and say no clearly when the math does not work.
Translate technical roadmaps set by Staff+ engineers and TPMs into staffing plans, sequencing, and realistic commitments, and flag early when scope and capacity have diverged.
Run a service and operations team to a high standard: on-call rotations that are humane and sustainable, clear escalation paths, defined ownership, and follow-through on action items after every incident.
Ensure the team is well prepared for major incidents, including trained and confident Incident Commanders, rehearsed escalation and communication paths, and blameless post-incident review that actually changes the system.
Hold the team to its engineering standards, including Infrastructure-as-Code, Git-based change management, peer review, documentation, and monitoring, understanding why these patterns matter operationally and what good looks like, while trusting your engineers on the implementation.
Set the norms for transparency and communication that let a distributed team operate safely and with confidence: written-first, decisions recorded, status visible without anyone having to ask.
Partner with studio, SRE, and security teams as their operational counterpart, shaping capacity plans, launch readiness, and support models well ahead of ship dates.
Own cloud spend and datacenter capacity for your area, with clear forecasting, allocation, and optimization practices.
Represent infrastructure to leadership and to non-technical stakeholders through concise written updates, clear risk framing, and honest status.
Manage vendor and partner relationships alongside procurement and contract cycles, including evaluation, negotiation support, and performance review.
Build follow-the-sun coverage and healthy working norms across sites, so the team scales without burning out.

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit

Significant experience leading engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.
A career built in infrastructure, network, cloud, or platform organizations. You have spent years close to production systems and understand the work because you have lived it, whether your seat was engineering, operations leadership, or technical program management. Adjacent-industry management experience alone will not prepare you for this team.
You have been accountable for production infrastructure during a major incident or a high-stakes launch, and can talk credibly about what went wrong and what you changed afterwards.
Direct experience managing a service or operations team carrying production and on-call responsibility, not only project-based delivery teams.
Demonstrated capacity planning ability. You can model a team's load across on-call, delivery, KTLO, and incidents, and defend the resulting plan to leadership.
Working understanding of the Incident Commander role and modern incident management practice, enough to staff the rotation, coach your ICs, and hold the communication line during a major incident.
Proven experience leading globally distributed teams through asynchronous communication, where written clarity and timezone-aware process replace hallway conversations.
Enough fluency in cloud, Infrastructure-as-Code, and networking concepts to follow a technical discussion, weigh risk, and know when to escalate or bring in expertise. We are not looking for someone to design or build the systems themselves.
Comfort with hybrid environments. You understand why not everything moves to the cloud, and can hold a balanced conversation about the trade-offs.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can brief an executive in five sentences, run a productive disagreement with a peer team, and give an engineer feedback they can actually use.
Experience in gaming, media, or another latency-sensitive, launch-driven industry is a plus.
You thrive when leading technical teams through ambiguous, high-impact work, and you measure your success by the systems your team runs and the engineers they become.
