jobs.title: Director, ECO Technology & Data
jobs.description:
Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

About The Role

Happen Bank’s BSA Team, part of the Compliance Department, maintains an effective BSA/AML and Sanctions compliance program designed to protect the Bank from being used to facilitate money laundering, terrorist financing, and other illegal activity. As Director, ECO Technology & Data, you’ll lead the data, technology, and transaction monitoring strategy across the BSA/AML program, including Know Your Customer (KYC), transaction monitoring, and sanctions and watchlist screening.

You’ll also help advance broader regulatory compliance data and technology capabilities, identifying opportunities to strengthen compliance through modern technology, analytics, AI, and automation while maintaining the rigor and governance required in a regulated financial institution.

What You'll Do

Define and execute the strategy for BSA/AML data, technology, analytics, and transaction monitoring capabilities, aligning investments with regulatory requirements and program priorities
Serve as the primary leader for BSA/AML data and technology needs across business lines, partnering across Compliance, Technology, Risk, and other teams to deliver scalable solutions
Own the performance and ongoing evolution of BSA/AML technology, coordinating production issue resolution, system enhancements, and optimization across internal platforms and third-party vendors
Lead technology implementations that strengthen the BSA/AML program, including large-scale solutions supporting case investigations, transaction monitoring, KYC, sanctions, and watchlist screening
Build and manage the transaction monitoring rule development program, including rule design, optimization, analytics, and performance monitoring to effectively identify potentially suspicious activity
Partner with Model Risk Management on model governance, validation engagements, annual reviews, and remediation of identified issues
Own BSA/AML data requirements across risk assessments, reporting, quality assurance and controls, validation, regulatory inquiries, and issue remediation
Use AI and automation thoughtfully to improve transaction monitoring, analytics, and compliance workflows while maintaining appropriate rigor, explainability, governance, and human oversight
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team, setting clear priorities and accountability while advancing the team’s technical, analytical, and compliance capabilities

About You

10+ years of experience in banking or financial services, with deep expertise in BSA/AML data, technology, analytics, or transaction monitoring
Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Strong command of KYC, transaction monitoring, sanctions and watchlist screening, and the data and technology capabilities that support them
Experience with BSA/AML technology platforms such as Verafin, Bridger, Oscilar, or similar solutions, with an understanding of emerging tools and technologies
Demonstrated experience leading quantitative analytics functions, including setting strategy for model or transaction monitoring optimization and driving adoption across teams
Experience operating in fast-paced, dynamic environments and delivering high-quality outcomes across competing priorities, complex regulatory requirements, and evolving business needs
You set a high standard for how your team applies rigor, judgment, and integrity to BSA/AML risk decisions
You build strong partnerships across Technology, Risk, Compliance, and business teams and create alignment around strategy, priorities, and execution
You have a clear perspective on where AI creates genuine leverage across BSA/AML data and technology and have translated that perspective into how your team operates. You stay engaged with evolving regulatory expectations around AI, model risk, and data governance and maintain a high standard for responsible adoption
You lead through ambiguity, set direction for the function, develop strong talent, and hold your team accountable for measurable outcomes rather than activity

Nice to Have

Experience with sanctions and watchlist screening technology
Experience supporting regulatory examinations related to BSA/AML or Sanctions programs
CAMS or similar AML certification

Work Location

San Francisco, Lehi, New York

The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level.

Time Zone Requirements

Local hours (PT, MT, ET)

While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary.

Travel Requirements

As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this position is 175,000-230,000. The base salary of the role will be determined by job-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings).

We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more.

Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We believe that a variety of perspectives will make our teams and business stronger as we work together to transform the traditional banking system.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at interviewaccommodations@happen.com.

Notice on AI Tool Use

For select roles and locations, candidate interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by tools such as artificial intelligence (AI) to assist our hiring managers with the application process.

You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription, and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. We will not discriminate against you if you choose to opt out.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information from or about you: contact information, identifiers, professional and employment-related information, sensory information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment.

We will only share your interview, transcription, or summary with persons whose expertise or technology is necessary to process your application, evaluate your fitness for a position, and administer or support the tool. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Disclosure.

We will delete any recording of your interview promptly but in no event later than 30 days after making a hiring decision.

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
College Board
– Technology

Location
: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type
: This is a full-time position

About Technology At College Board

We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.

About The Team

Create is a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving how educators author tasks and assessments. Create Core is the platform team within Create that builds the shared foundations the authoring applications are made from: a rich text editing library, canonical item and task data models, a centralized metadata service, and APIs/interfaces for interacting with assessment data.

Core's users are other engineering teams as it builds and maintains foundational libraries and services for our applications. Its repositories run as an internal open-source project that engineers can propose changes to. The team does critical work that the rest of the ecosystem depends on, so quality, developer experience, and accessibility are fundamental aspects of the role.

  About the Opportunity 

As Engineering Director, Create Core, you will lead the platform team at the center of College Board's authoring ecosystem. This is direct team leadership: you will manage a small group of experienced engineers, work closely with Product to define the roadmap, and be accountable for team health, delivery, and the long-term coherence of the platform.

The role asks you to treat the platform as a product. Your users are the engineers on Create's application teams, and success looks like those teams shipping faster because Core's foundations are solid, well-documented, and easy to adopt. You will prioritize Core's investments against real application needs and steward the contribution model that lets consuming teams help build what they use.

Leaders in this space are expected to operate at or near a senior engineer level in system design and code quality, with the ability to review code, assess technical tradeoffs, and guide teams toward sound implementation decisions. You will partner closely with the domain's Principal Engineer on technical strategy, with application engineering directors on adoption and boundaries, and with product and design leaders on where the platform goes next. Success in this role is measured by the health and effectiveness of the Core team, the trust application teams place in the platform, the degree to which shared foundations reduce duplicated work, and the environment you create for engineers to learn, experiment, and do their best work.

 In This Role, You Will

Provide Platform Leadership & Delivery (40%)

Lead the Create Core team directly, setting clear goals and expectations while enabling engineers to own execution.
Work in close partnership with Product and the application teams to prioritize the Core roadmap, balancing new capabilities against the stability and support obligations.
Run the platform as a product: gather needs from consuming teams, make deliberate build/decline decisions, and communicate direction so application teams can plan against it.
Act as the point of decision for platform scope, adoption sequencing, and cross-team trade-offs involving Core.
Develop deep understanding of the business needs your team serves to provide leadership and consistent messaging around the work of the team.

Technical Leadership & Quality (30%)

Guide the architecture of shared libraries and services.
Hold a high bar for developer experience: documentation, paved paths, reference implementations, and local-first tooling that make Core easy to adopt
Ensure accessibility is built into the foundations, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA across Core components with assistive-technology testing in the definition of done
Partner with the Principal Engineer and architects to evolve data models, editor architecture, and platform boundaries as the ecosystem grows

Build a highly engaged, and high-performing team (30%)

Cultivate norms that support strong communication, a positive working culture, and an engaged team.
Define ceremonies that support your high-performing Agile team, while maximizing productive work time.
Actively cultivate the superpowers of team members and leverage these to develop products.
Support diversity and inclusion from the perspectives of demographics, skills, and experience.
Manage work culture to ensure the mission and operating principles of College Board are consistently recognized and utilized to promote a productive and fair work environment.
Support and invest in the growth of your team members.

About You, You Have

7 years’ experience in Agile software application development, applying knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques to a broad range of life-cycle activities to meet the requirements for highly secure, data-heavy applications.
Proven expertise delivering web-based products or platform-level features in cloud-first environment using modern development tools.
Written and reviewed production code using preferred technologies: TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React.
Ability to design and evaluate AWS-based architectures with best practices.
Experience managing teams of 4 to 8 direct reports, including both junior-level and higher-level individual contributors.
Accountability for the technical output of the team, either through personal experience or strong communication with engineers.
Experience overseeing product or platform features, infrastructure, and vendor management, ensuring compliance with internal policies.
Comprehensive experience in all aspects of people management, including hiring, engaging, and developing team members, with a proven track record of successful leadership.
Experience leading engineering and architecture discussions, bringing stakeholders to agreement.
Exceptional planning, prioritization, and execution skills, delivering results on time and on budget in fast-paced environments.
Experience establishing new teams and laying foundation for new products, ideally within a large organization.
Outstanding communication and leadership abilities, building trust quickly across teams and levels, and effectively coaching team members with timely, balanced feedback.
Able to travel 3-5 times a year to our NYC or Reston, VA office  
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer

All Roles At College Board Require

A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. 
Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process 

Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck, we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach To Compensation

The hiring range for this role is $140,000 - $175,000
Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

About College Board

College Board reaches more than 7 million students a year, helping them navigate the path from high school to college and career. We’re a mission-driven, not-for-profit membership organization dedicated to excellence in education. Founded 125 years ago, we are committed to clearing a path for all students to own their future. We pioneered programs like the SAT® and AP® to expand opportunities for students and help them develop the skills they need. About Evvy

At Evvy, we believe the female body shouldn’t be a medical mystery.
We are a precision women’s health company leveraging the vaginal microbiome to improve outcomes across a woman's lifespan. Backed by $30M+ from leading investors, we serve over 100,000 patients and 3,000 providers nationwide with our validated Vaginal Microbiome Test and AI-powered personalized care platform.

Through this work, we have built the world’s largest dataset on the vaginal microbiome — a proprietary foundation that will drive breakthroughs in infertility, preterm birth, gynecological cancers, and beyond.

Why join now?

Evvy is a generational opportunity in women's health — and we're at the inflection point.

We’ve built a dataset no one has. Evvy has generated the world’s largest vaginal microbiome dataset from 100,000+ patients, uncovering novel biological markers underlying women’s health conditions that collectively cost the healthcare system $180B+ annually.
Validated, AI-first platform. We’ve built a comprehensive testing and care platform that unlocks personalized treatment pathways for each patient. Our work is supported by research published in major peer-reviewed journals and presented at major clinical conferences (including ACOG, ASRM, IDSOG, and more).
Proven traction, massive opportunity. We serve 100,000+ patients and 3,000 providers nationwide, with rapidly growing revenue and an expanding suite of diagnostics and treatments to improve outcomes across condition areas. We've only scratched the surface.
Top tier team, investors, and partners. Our world-class team is backed by industry leading investors, including General Catalyst, Left Lane Capital, US Fertility, Catalio Capital, and Labcorp.

We're looking for high-horsepower, mission-driven people who find it unacceptable that the female body is still a medical mystery — and want to help change that.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to help build the technical foundation for the future of women’s healthcare.

At Evvy, engineering sits at the center of everything we do — from diagnostics and patient experiences to AI-powered personalization, clinical operations, and data infrastructure. This role is about using modern engineering and AI-native development to dramatically increase the speed, leverage, and ambition of what a small team can accomplish.

As Head of Engineering, you’ll report directly to the CEO and lead Evvy’s technical vision, architecture, and execution as we scale. You’ll oversee the evolution of our platform across patient experiences, internal tooling, AI-powered workflows, clinical infrastructure, and data systems — helping ensure we move quickly without compromising quality, reliability, or trust.

We’re looking for someone deeply hands-on and intensely product-minded. You should be excited about working directly in the weeds with the team: reviewing architecture decisions, unblocking engineers, experimenting with new tooling, prototyping systems, and helping the organization adopt the newest AI-enabled development workflows. You should have strong instincts for how modern engineering organizations operate in an AI-native world — where lean, highly-leveraged teams can execute roadmaps that previously required significantly larger organizations.

Evvy is a primarily in-person team based in NYC. Given the cross-functional nature of this role, our ideal candidate is located in NYC.

What You'll Do

Technical Vision & AI-Native Execution
Translate Evvy’s company and product vision into a scalable technical roadmap across engineering, AI, and data infrastructure
Define architecture and technical strategy that enables a lean team to move exceptionally quickly without sacrificing reliability or scalability
Identify and deploy modern AI-enabled engineering workflows, tooling, and infrastructure that increase developer leverage and execution speed
Stay deeply hands-on with architecture, implementation details, debugging, and technical problem-solving
Establish best practices around architecture, code quality, security, scalability, and AI-assisted development workflows
Partner closely with ML and research teams to bring AI-powered systems and algorithms into production

Engineering Leadership & Culture
Lead, mentor, and grow Evvy’s engineering organization
Build a culture of ownership, urgency, product thinking, and technical excellence
Create an engineering organization that embraces modern tooling, rapid iteration, and continuous learning
Balance short-term product velocity with thoughtful infrastructure investments and long-term maintainability
Partner closely with the CEO on hiring, org design, and long-term technical strategy

Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Operations, CX, Marketing, and Growth teams to build systems that solve real user problems
Ensure engineering decisions are grounded in user value, business impact, and operational scalability
Help shape roadmap prioritization, technical tradeoffs, and execution planning across the company
Serve as the voice of engineering across all levels of the organization

Security, Privacy & Infrastructure
Own Evvy’s vision for platform security, privacy, and technical trust
Manage internal systems access and compliance processes related to sensitive healthcare and patient data
Evaluate new vendors, tools, and infrastructure through both technical and compliance lenses
Help ensure Evvy remains best-in-class in data privacy and responsible healthcare infrastructure

What We're Looking For

You are:
Deeply product-minded and obsessed with building systems that create real user value
Intensely hands-on and excited to work directly alongside engineers in the weeds
AI-native by default — constantly exploring how new technologies can accelerate development and increase leverage
Energized by building lean, high-output engineering teams that can execute ambitious roadmaps quickly
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making thoughtful decisions with imperfect information
A strong technical leader who can balance speed, quality, scalability, and pragmatism
Passionate about building strong engineering cultures and mentoring high-performing teams
An exceptional communicator across technical and non-technical stakeholders

You have:
10+ years of engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering leadership roles
Experience leading engineering organizations through high-growth startup stages (Series B and beyond)
Experience building and scaling consumer-facing platforms, internal systems, or data-intensive products
Strong architectural instincts across modern web infrastructure and AI-enabled systems
Experience deploying modern AI tooling and workflows across software development processes
Experience hiring, mentoring, and managing engineers while remaining highly technical yourself
Familiarity with modern engineering stacks similar to Evvy’s (Python/Django, React, PostgreSQL, AWS, Snowflake, etc.)

Helpful but not required:
Experience in healthtech or other regulated industries
Experience productionizing ML/AI systems
Experience with HIPAA, security certifications, or privacy-sensitive infrastructure
Experience supporting diagnostics, ecommerce, or patient-facing healthcare platforms

Working at Evvy

Evvy is a primarily in-person team based in New York, NY with a strong culture of collaboration and connection. We work from the office 4 days a week (Wednesdays remote), and we genuinely enjoy spending time together: team dinners, happy hours, and shared wins are part of the rhythm here.

Our Values

Start with the why.
We tie everything back to a user need or company goal.
Figure it out.
We take initiative, embrace ambiguity, and build from first principles.
Create win-wins.
We solve problems with patients, partners, and the business in mind.
Own it to the end.
We close every loop and take pride in the details.
Stay eleven steps ahead.
We anticipate, plan, and act with foresight and speed.

Company Benefits

Flexible PTO
$1K learning and development budget
Health, dental, and vision insurance, plus HSA plans
401(k) plan (Roth and traditional)
Monthly team events
Free Evvy membership
Paid parental leave

Evvy is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Head of Data Platform & AI
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

Octave is looking for a Head of Data Platform & AI to lead the technical vision and execution across our data platform and emerging AI, machine learning, and Data Science capabilities. This role will own and evolve Octave’s data and AI/ML technical foundation, set the technical/strategic direction for AI/ML in close partnership with Product and cross-functional business leaders, and build the team required to execute that vision as Octave grows.

This is a leadership role for a builder. While you will set strategy, lead the team, and operate as a senior cross-functional partner, you will remain close to the technology and be expected to contribute directly to architecture, prototypes, technical evaluation, and difficult engineering problems. You will initially lead a Data Platform team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business leaders across Octave.

Management Responsibilities:

Develops, coordinates, and implements systems, policies, procedures, and productivity standards.
Provide leadership and guidance to the team, ensuring the achievement of goals and objectives.
Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of projects and initiatives within the team.
Establish and monitor operational processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Streamline operational processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall organizational performance.
Implement best practices, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and develop strategies to achieve operational excellence.
Ensures a safe, secure, and compliant work environment.
Accomplishes staff results by communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
Build and manage a high-performing team, including hiring, training, and development.
Provide leadership to the team, including setting goals, providing guidance, and ensuring the team's overall success.
Set performance expectations and goals for team members. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and address performance issues.
Identify skill gaps within the team and develop strategies for filling those gaps. Support employee development through training, mentoring, and coaching. Identify high-potential employees and create succession plans.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Define Octave’s Data & AI Technical Vision
Develop and own the technical strategy and roadmap for Octave’s data platform and AI/ML capabilities, while shaping company-level direction and investment priorities by bringing a data and AI perspective to decisions about where Octave competes and how it grows.
Own company-level KPIs spanning Octave's AI/ML and Data Platform areas — defining the measures that matter, holding accountability for outcomes against them, and reporting on progress to the executive team.
Partner closely with Product and cross-functional leaders to identify where AI, machine learning, and Data Science can create meaningful customer and business value, and own the technical strategy and capabilities required to bring those opportunities to life.
Serve as Octave’s senior technical leader and thought partner on data, AI, ML, and Data Science.
Help Product, Engineering, and business leaders evaluate opportunities, understand technical feasibility and tradeoffs, and shape Octave’s approach to emerging capabilities.
Develop a clear point of view on where traditional machine learning, predictive modeling, generative AI, LLM-based systems, and other approaches are appropriate.
Establish principles for when Octave should build capabilities internally, leverage third-party platforms or models, or partner externally.
Balance near-term delivery with the foundational investments required to support Octave’s longer-term strategy.

Lead AI/ML and Data Science Technical Strategy
Establish the technical capabilities required to develop, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production AI and machine-learning systems.
Work with Product and business leaders to translate promising AI/ML opportunities into well-defined technical initiatives.
Ensure AI/ML initiatives are grounded in clear customer or business outcomes rather than pursued as standalone technology projects.
Guide technical experimentation and prototyping to validate opportunities before making significant investments.
Establish rigorous approaches to model and system evaluation, experimentation, observability, feedback loops, governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
Determine the Data Science, ML Engineering, and Applied AI capabilities Octave needs over time and develop an appropriate organizational model to support them.

Own and Evolve the Data Platform
Own the architecture and evolution of Octave’s centralized data platform and the systems that collect, transform, store, govern, and serve data across the company.
Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, observable, secure, and straightforward for downstream consumers to use.
Establish strong engineering practices around data quality, testing, lineage, documentation, monitoring, and reliability.
Build scalable interfaces and data products that enable analysts, Product, Engineering, and other teams to work effectively with trusted data.
Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions that balance scalability and technical quality with the speed required in a fast-growing company.
Avoid unnecessary complexity and ensure platform investments are justified by real customer, product, or business needs.

Enable a Decentralized Analytics Organization
Treat analysts embedded within Octave’s product and business organizations as key customers and partners of the Data Platform.
Partner with analysts and their leaders to understand common needs, remove technical bottlenecks, and improve access to reliable and well-modeled data.
Establish shared technical standards, platform capabilities, and ownership models that allow decentralized analytics teams to move quickly without creating unnecessary fragmentation.
Create clear ownership boundaries between the centralized Data Platform organization and embedded analytics teams.
Build foundational data capabilities that allow analysts to spend more time generating insights and less time solving recurring infrastructure or data-quality problems.

Build the Capabilities and Team Octave Needs
Lead, mentor, and develop the existing Data Platform team while remaining close to the technical work.
Continuously assess the technical capabilities required to execute Octave’s evolving data and AI strategy.
Develop existing team members where appropriate and recruit exceptional external talent when specialized skills or experience are missing internally.
Proactively identify capability gaps rather than scaling the organization through headcount alone.
Build additional specialized capabilities—including Data Science, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or other disciplines—as product and business needs warrant.
Determine when capabilities should live centrally, be embedded within Product or Engineering teams, or operate through another organizational model.
Develop strong technical leaders and individual contributors and create an environment characterized by high standards, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and pragmatic execution.
Build an organization that can scale without introducing unnecessary layers or process.

Remain a Hands-On Technical Leader
Stay sufficiently close to the technology to provide credible technical leadership and make high-quality architecture and engineering decisions.
Dive into system design, architecture, data modeling, prototypes, code, technical evaluations, or production issues when your involvement can materially accelerate the team.
Personally engage with emerging AI/ML technologies enough to develop an informed point of view on their capabilities, limitations, and relevance to Octave.
Serve as a technical thought partner to Data Platform engineers, Product engineers, analysts, and senior company leadership.
Set a high technical bar while empowering the team to own execution.
Use technical depth to simplify problems and help the company avoid both underinvestment and unnecessary overengineering.

Required Skills:

Strong technical foundation and prior experience as a highly capable individual contributor before moving into leadership.
Strong understanding of traditional machine-learning and Data Science approaches and newer AI capabilities, including LLM-based systems and generative AI.
Strong judgment around build-versus-buy decisions and the ability to assess rapidly evolving technologies pragmatically.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to move fluidly between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior business and product leaders.
Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving organization where senior leaders remain close to execution.

Education & Experience:

8+ years of experience building and leading data platform, data engineering, Data Science, ML, or AI capabilities in high-growth technology environments.
Demonstrated experience architecting and building modern data platforms and production data systems.
Meaningful experience applying machine learning and/or AI to real-world product or business problems and taking solutions from experimentation into production.
Experience partnering closely with Product teams to identify and deliver technically sophisticated product capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose organizational capability gaps, build new technical capabilities, and recruit senior, specialized technical talent to fill them.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

We’re human beings first.
We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.
People deserve better than status quo.
We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.
No bystanders. No stars. No tourists.
Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.
Partnership paves the path ahead.
We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.
Quality is crucial at scale.
Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.
Progress is a process.
In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.
There are people behind every data point.
We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.
Must be able to observe and communicate information on company provided laptop.
Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.
Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
The Role

At Crisis Text Line, our data platform powers the technology, research, and insights behind our crisis services—and it’s evolving quickly as our products, global reach, and AI/ML capabilities grow.

In this role, you’ll lead a lean Data Engineering team with broad ownership across our production data ecosystem. You’ll shape the evolution of our Databricks and AWS platform, tackle complex challenges across reliability, governance, data quality, and multi-tenant architecture, and build the infrastructure that enables what comes next in AI/ML. You’ll pair deep technical leadership with strong people leadership—developing engineers, setting technical direction, and creating an environment where a versatile team can do its best work while continuing to grow its capabilities and impact.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership

Oversee the evolution of our Databricks-based lakehouse and ML platform, defining the technical roadmap for data pipelines and AI/ML infrastructure.
Drive infrastructure-as-code practices with Terraform and make key architectural decisions that enable scalable, reliable global data systems.

Platform Maturity

Ensure reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across Databricks and AWS by implementing observability, monitoring, and SLA frameworks for critical data pipelines.
Establish best practices for DataOps, AI Engineering, and data quality while balancing innovation with technical debt and tracking KPIs for platform health, productivity, and business impact.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Research teams to deliver scalable, compliant data solutions.
Collaborate with Developer Platform, Security, and Compliance teams to align shared infrastructure, governance, and business priorities.

Team Leadership & Development

Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing data and ML engineering team focused on innovation and reliability.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning across the organization.

Qualifications

Required

10+ years in data engineering, infrastructure, or ML platforms; 5+ years in people leadership.
Proven experience building Databricks + AWS ecosystems.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Terraform with strong AI Engineering principles.
Track record improving observability, automation, and data reliability.
Experience with data governance and compliance (HIPAA/SOC 2).
Excellent communication and stakeholder partnership across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred

The following experience would be useful, but we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every item:

Built or scaled an AI Engineering function or major data modernization program.
Managed global or multi-region data environments.
Experience balancing innovation with operational stability and cost control.
Mix of enterprise discipline and startup agility.

Leadership Fit

Coaching-oriented, people-first manager who leads with clarity and trust.
Values autonomy, accountability, and measurable impact.
Embodies CTL’s mission-driven, collaborative culture.

Department Summary

The Build department brings together Engineering, Product, and Design to create and evolve Crisis Text Line’s technology platform. Together, we build trusted, accessible experiences for people seeking crisis support and the tools our global partners need to deliver it—supported by scalable architecture, connected data, and thoughtful use of predictive technologies.

Reliable High-Speed Internet Required: Must have a stable high-speed internet connection to support seamless remote collaboration, virtual meetings, online job tasks, etc.

For United States-based candidates: The target salary range for this position, across the United States, is $135,520 - $156,790. Starting salary will vary based on location, qualifications, and prior experience. Candidates will learn the range specific to their location during the interview process. We pay competitively in the tech-forward nonprofit space and offer a robust benefits package.

This is a remote position within the United States. No visa sponsorship available for this position.

Crisis Text Line recognizes that we are all unique human beings with unique life circumstances, and our benefits package aims to be as flexible as possible to support your needs as you work to promote mental well-being for people, wherever they are. Our benefits package is thoughtfully designed using an equity lens, with input from our team and from industry best practices.

Exceptional time management and organizational skills.
Demonstrated high level of project management and consulting skills.
Demonstrated expertise in Learning Management Systems, or similar applications, including design, testing, research of industry standards and enhancement suggestions.
Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, collaboration, and team building skills. Professional level writing, editing, and oral communication skills are required, including the ability to present technical materials to a large, non-technical audience.

Microsoft Office suite proficiency.

West Virginia University is a place of purpose and community. We take pride in our profound impact on the state of West Virginia and are committed to the personal and professional growth of our employees.

About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Target as a tech company? Absolutely. We're the behind-the-scenes powerhouse that fuels Target's passion and commitment to cutting-edge innovation. We anchor every facet of one of the world's best-loved retailers with a strong technology framework that relies on the latest tools and technologies, and the brightest people, to deliver incredible value to guests online and in stores.

Target Technology Services is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that guests and team members need and deserve. Our high-performing teams balance independence with collaboration, and we pride ourselves on being versatile, agile and creative. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out.

As a Director of Technology, Enterprise Modernization,
you will be responsible for leading Target's enterprise modernization strategy and execution efforts. This team plays a critical role in accelerating Target's long-term technology transformation by creating enterprise-wide clarity, coordinating execution across multiple portfolios, and enabling engineering organizations to modernize legacy platforms and systems at scale.

Unlike traditional engineering leadership roles, success in this position is achieved through influence, collaboration, and execution across distributed teams rather than direct ownership of all engineering delivery. You will lead a team of Technical Program Managers and engineers responsible for defining modernization strategies, driving enterprise-wide alignment, identifying cross-portfolio dependencies, and solving common challenges that enable engineering teams to move faster.

Use your skills, experience, and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals.

As a Director of Technology
, you'll lead the Enterprise Modernization
organization by understanding, advocating, and communicating company objectives, vision, and strategy to senior leaders and stakeholders across Technology. You will turn complex and ambiguous challenges into clear strategies, actionable roadmaps, and measurable outcomes that drive enterprise impact.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Product, and Business teams to identify modernization opportunities, establish priorities, and coordinate execution across multiple portfolios. You will develop and foster key stakeholder relationships and provide clear, consistent communication on progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, and areas requiring leadership support.

In this role, you will act as a change agent, helping teams navigate large-scale transformation while creating alignment across organizations that may not report directly to you. You will bring a strong bias for action and sustained follow-through, driving decisions to closure, holding owners accountable, and ensuring complex cross-portfolio work continues to move forward. You will continuously determine what is best owned within portfolios versus solved centrally, and establish the common solutions, standards and capabilities that can accelerate progress across the enterprise.

You will leverage your technical expertise to understand complex architectures, connect dependencies, challenge assumptions, and ask the right questions to remove obstacles and drive execution. Strong technical judgment and credibility are essential to shape technical direction and engage effectively with senior engineers, architects, and technology leaders.

Additionally, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of technical program managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and measurable outcomes. You will create an environment that encourages collaboration, problem-solving, innovation, and continuous improvement while helping team members grow their skills and careers.

The impact of this role is substantial. Mainframe modernization and broader enterprise transformation efforts are ultimately delivered by engineering organizations across Merchandising, Supply Chain, Stores, Finance, and other portfolios. This team serves as a force multiplier by creating clarity, solving the right problems centrally, and helping those organizations execute more efficiently and effectively.

Strong business acumen and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes

You'll have the latitude to shape the team to fit where the platform is headed rather than inherit it as-is. This is a role for a decisive leader who'll roll up their sleeves early, bring the discipline to scale, and earn trust through action.

Champion engineering across the company: bridge business needs and engineering reality with non-technical stakeholders — clearly, directly, without ego.
Partner directly with the Senior Director of Product and CEO to align technical execution with product strategy and ensure Cambium's technology improves user experience, data transparency, and operational functionality.
Build, mentor, and scale the engineering team: hiring, career ladders, performance, and retention. Culture, craft, and ownership are non-negotiable.
Put in place the processes, team structure, and capacity planning that let a growing team ship predictably.
Own the engineering budget and technology strategy, including build-vs-buy decisions, vendor selection, and how AI tooling factors into headcount and team design.
Own the data strategy across business systems of record like NetSuite and Hubspot (owned by other depts) and our custom platform (owned by engineering): set the standards for how they exchange data and which one is the source of truth.
Apply AI/ML tooling with intention — enhancing platform capabilities without losing focus on resilience and scalability.

15+ years leading engineering teams at scale; Series B or growth-stage experience required. A track record of hiring, mentoring, and building cultures of ownership.

You measure your impact by what the organization ships, not by your own output.
Familiar with the challenges of keeping data consistent across multiple databases — sync issues, conflicting sources of truth, schema drift — and has worked through both technical and organizational solutions to address those challenges.
Proven ability to move through ambiguity without losing momentum or dropping projects.
Strong backbone: you give and receive direct feedback, push back with conviction, and build trust through honesty. You collaborate closely with other teams, translating complex business requirements into practical technical solutions.

Position Overview

While titled as a Managing Director, Educational Technology Ventures within the University of Kansas structure, this role carries the scope and responsibility of a senior technology executive, comparable to a Vice President–level leader in industry. The Managing Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for a comprehensive, cloud-based assessment platform, overseeing product development, engineering, platform operations, and security.

The Assessment & Technology Solutions team supports the Kite® platform and Dynamic Learning Maps® (DLM®) assessments, which annually serve hundreds of thousands of students across multiple states. These include high-stakes assessments designed for students with the most significant cognitive disabilities, as well as general education populations. The platform plays a critical role in enabling equitable and accessible assessment experiences at a national scale.

This position is responsible for guiding the continued evolution of a mature, mission-driven technology platform, ensuring reliability, scalability, and innovation in support of state partners and educational outcomes.

The successful candidate will bring a balance of strategic vision and operational execution, with a collaborative leadership style suited to an established and high-performing team. This individual will be motivated by both the technical challenges of operating a national-scale platform and the meaningful impact of supporting educational access and equity.

Role Distinction

This leadership role combines the scope of a large-scale SaaS technology organization with the mission and stability of a public research university. The Managing Director will lead a highly experienced, cross-functional team spanning engineering, architecture, quality assurance, DevOps, data, and operations.

The position offers the opportunity to shape a long-term technology and product vision, including platform modernization, cloud-native optimization, and the thoughtful integration of emerging technologies such as AI/ML into the assessment lifecycle.

About The Achievement & Assessment Institute (AAI)

The Achievement & Assessment Institute is a nationally recognized leader in large-scale assessment and educational and well-being research. Its work supports state education agencies across the country and contributes to improving outcomes for student populations.

The University of Kansas offers a collaborative environment, a strong institutional mission, and a comprehensive benefits structure, including retirement, health, and professional development opportunities. Lawrence, Kansas, is consistently ranked among the top college communities in the United States.

Job Description

35% — Technology Strategy, Platform Leadership & Operations

Develop and execute a multi-year product and technology strategy for the Kite platform.
Lead cross-functional teams responsible for software development, cloud infrastructure, platform operations, security, and technology delivery.
Ensure platform reliability, scalability, performance, availability, and security within a cloud-native AWS environment.
Establish operational priorities and oversee day-to-day technology operations.
Drive continuous improvement of technology services, delivery practices, and operational processes.

25% — Stakeholder Engagement, Product Alignment & Strategic Planning

Partner with state agencies, researchers, institutional stakeholders, and executive leadership to align technology solutions with educational and assessment needs.
Communicate product roadmaps, implementation priorities, timelines, and strategic initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
Support long-term strategic planning and platform sustainability efforts.
Collaborate with organizational leadership to align technology initiatives with institutional goals and operational objectives.

20% — System Modernization & Innovation

Oversee system modernization initiatives, including re-platforming and cloud optimization efforts.
Lead and support AI/ML integration opportunities and process automation initiatives.
Guide architecture improvements that enhance scalability, resiliency, efficiency, and user experience.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to support organizational growth and operational effectiveness.

15% — Organizational Leadership & Resource Management

Foster a strong organizational culture focused on collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Provide leadership support, mentorship, staffing oversight, and employee development opportunities.
Manage vendor relationships, consulting partnerships, and contract administration activities.
Oversee budget planning, financial stewardship, and resource allocation to support strategic and operational goals.

5% — Other Duties as Assigned

Perform other related duties and strategic initiatives as assigned in support of the mission and operational needs of the Achievement and Assessment Institute.

Position Requirements

This position is expected to reside in Kansas and will work fully on-site during the initial onboarding period to support a comprehensive understanding of the role, team, systems, and operations. Once successfully onboarded, the position may transition to a hybrid schedule with a minimum of three days per week on-site, splitting time between KU’s Lawrence and Edwards campuses based on organizational and business needs.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Seven (7) years of progressive experience in software development, technology, or product management roles
Five (5) years of leadership experience managing large, cross-functional teams (engineering, product, QA, and operations), at a senior director, VP, or equivalent level
Demonstrated success owning and operating enterprise SaaS platforms end-to-end, from concept through deployment and ongoing operations as evidenced by application materials
Five (5) years of experience working with cloud-native architectures, with a strong preference for AWS environments
Proven expertise in agile delivery and DevOps practices at scale, including CI/CD and high-availability system management as evidenced by application materials
Three (3) years of experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into products, platforms, or operational workflows, with an emphasis on responsible and secure implementation
Strong track record of building stakeholder trust and aligning technology strategy with organizational and client needs as evidenced by application materials

This position requires a formal degree in the cited discipline area(s) to ensure that candidates have advanced knowledge, analytical skills and professional competencies necessary to perform the duties of the position. The level of degree is commonly recognized as the standard qualification for similar roles in the public and private sector, ensuring that the university remains competitive with industry aligned practices, enhances collaboration with external partners, and supports the delivery of services and programs that meet professional and market-driven expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

Ten (10) years of experience leading product or technology organizations in complex, regulated, or high-availability environments
Experience supporting high-volume, mission-critical platforms, ideally in education, assessment, or similarly regulated domains as evidenced by application materials

Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, PgMP, Agile/Scrum)

A cover letter that describes how you meet the required and preferred qualifications

Markem-Imaje, A Dover Company, is a trusted world manufacturer of product identification and traceability solutions, offering a full line of reliable and innovative inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print and apply label systems. Markem-Imaje delivers fully integrated solutions that enable product quality and safety, regulatory and retailer compliance, better product recalls and improved manufacturing processes.

Based in Downers Grove, IL, Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of approximately $8 billion.

The Role

The mission of the Engineering Manager is to provide R&D leadership for the product line and coordinate a multi-discipline product development team (electrical, mechanical, AME, & firmware disciplines). The incumbent will partner with the Drop on Demand (DoD) cross-functional leadership team to support the delivery of the business revenue and profitability targets included in business Annual Operating Plan and Strategic Plan. They will ensure that projects in the portfolio are properly staffed, efficiently executed and that the technical risks are managed successfully. They will partner with Global R&D discipline leaders to guarantee that discipline best practices are respected, and MI’s platform strategy is successfully implemented.

Job Responsibilities

Ensure all R&D aspects of programs are carried out in accordance to MI's processes.
Collaborate with the Discipline Leaders and project managers roles to define and execute projects to clear scope, on time, on budget and quality.
Maintain customer satisfaction at acceptable levels by delivering the proposed hardware value and promptly resolve customer issues which involve product design.
Collaborate with the cross-functional team to make adequate trade-offs between value creation, material cost, serviceability, testability, changeability, etc.
Drive quality and efficiency within the embedded software team that is located in multiple sites across multiple time zones.
Be the change management leader and demonstrate value from the agreed upon company-wide initiatives. Promote platform module adoption in DoD products.
Contribute to the development of a solid DoD hardware and ink product line roadmaps.
Build and maintain resource plans of appropriate granularity for the short/medium/long term and, using a skills matrix approach, coach and develop the team accordingly. This should include an active team development plan.
Develop new vendors
Establish/manage relationship with external engineering service partners.
Direct R&D personnel from multiple engineering disciplines as an effective team that is committed to organizational goals and fosters collaboration.
Collaborate with global R&D disciplines to build/recruit/further adjust the team to meet the needs of our programs
Ensure that our products meet or exceed applicable regulations, certifications requirements and reliability requirements.
Ensure that engineering discipline standard, methods and tools are developed with the needs of the programs in mind and effectively deployed.
Promote improved quality levels with reliability engineering best practices and Six Sigma methodologies.
Monitor operating and capital expense budgets to achieve company objectives.
Assist and guide intellectual property experts.
Ensure projects are kept on schedule and work to mitigate issues as they arise
Train, Develop, Mentor Engineering Team through the use of a skills matrix and training plan.
International travels: ~1 trips/quarter on average to visit customers and vendors; to other engineering facility in Salem, NH ~3 trips/month on average
Mix of laboratory and office environment

Job Requirements

Masters' degree in a related science field with a minimum 7 years of experience in various R&D roles, including growth thru an organization as an engineering individual contributor.
Minimum of 5 years, with a PhD, working on new product development projects
Must demonstrate experience in cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Service, Finance, etc.
Exposure to marking and coding equipment is a plus.
Proven track record of managing technical teams to deliver products on time
Promotes Markem-Imaje core values of integrity, innovation and respect for people.
He/she will embrace fully the responsibility and accountability for the results of his/her team.
Independent thinker, able to assess a variety of risks and to suggest appropriate mitigation plans. Does not hesitate to speak up when something is not right.
Good leadership skills with experience in an international company.
Strong rigor in all conducted activities.
Able to build trust with colleagues and subordinates and capable of convincing people even without direct authority.
Self-motivated and demonstrates an ability to motivate others.

The right candidate if you are aligned to our values and culture:

Collaborative entrepreneurial spirit
Winning through customers
High ethical standards, openness and trust
Expectations for results
Respect and value people

Atlanta, GA (preferred) with Tues, Weds, and Thurs on-site  
New York City, or NYC metro, considered.  
Reports to:
Sr. Director of IT  
Role type:
Full-Time, Exempt  

About PopUp Bagels

PopUp Bagels is not just a bagel company—we’re a cultural movement. Our stores are small, our vibes are loud, and our energy is contagious. From signature neon and iconic bullhorns to our “Not Famous but Known” mirror, we’ve reimagined not just how a bagel is created, but how it’s enjoyed: Grip, Rip and Dip!
With a cult-like following, massive social presence, and unparalleled collaborations with top companies, partners and Brand Ambassadors PopUp Bagels is defining a new food lifestyle brand.  

We keep things simple, but we do them really, really well. And our customers agree.  

The Role

We're looking for a Director of Technology to own the systems that run PopUp Bagels day to day. This is a hands-on role for a builder — someone who can write and read code, uses AI tools to move faster, and is just as comfortable shipping a website update, chasing down a connectivity issue, or building the report an operator needs. You'll own ORBIT, our internal operations platform, along with our digital properties, our data and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath it all. Our platforms team owns the ordering platforms themselves; you own the systems, data, and reporting that sit around them. As we grow, you'll build the standards and infrastructure that let us scale without adding friction.  

Essential Responsibilities:

Own and evolve ORBIT, our internal operations platform — building new tools and reporting on it, folding standalone systems into it, and expanding what it can do for the business; this requires real comfort writing code and working with AI tooling  
Own our digital properties, including the website and app — updates, releases, uptime, content accuracy, and vendor coordination  
Build the data foundation the company runs on, bringing sales, operations, and platform data into a single trusted source and turning it into reporting people actually use  
Own analytics across our digital channels, including third-party ordering and delivery performance — tracking, attribution, dashboards, and the insight that comes out of them  
Lead how we adopt AI internally — finding where it creates leverage, rolling it out to teams, and managing the tools and spend behind it  
Manage our technology infrastructure, including network and connectivity across corporate and store locations, and the vendor relationships behind it  
Own identity and access — how our teams log in, what they can reach, and keeping that organized and secure as we grow  
Support finance and operations with the reporting they need by making sure our systems capture the right data in the first place  
Serve as the technical resource and trainer for the tools our operators and franchise partners rely on, building real enablement rather than just answering tickets  
Run technical support and escalation across the business, finding the pattern behind recurring issues instead of fixing the same thing twice  
Partner with the platforms team on integrations, data flow, and reporting requirements across our ordering and delivery platforms  
Document processes, build standards, and create the training that lets the stack scale as we add units and markets  

Required Education, Experience, and KSAs:

5–8 years of experience in technology, digital operations, or systems ownership — ideally in multi-unit restaurant, retail, or hospitality  
Hands-on technical ability: you can write and read code, work with APIs, and query data yourself rather than routing everything to a vendor  
Working fluency with AI tools and a genuine interest in using them to build and automate  
Experience with low-code and database platforms such as Airtable, and with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI  
Strong analytics skills across web and digital channels — tracking implementation, attribution, and dashboard building  
Experience managing websites and apps, including releases, content, and vendor coordination  
Familiarity with third-party delivery and catering platforms and the sales and channel-level reporting they produce  
Practical infrastructure knowledge across multiple sites — networks, connectivity, access management, and vendor escalation  
Comfort translating technical detail for non-technical operators, and the patience to train rather than just fix  
Franchise or multi-unit experience a strong plus  
A troubleshooting instinct — you find root causes instead of applying repeat workarounds  
Positive, resourceful, and calm under pressure  

Physical Requirements

The following physical requirements are representative of those that must be met to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with qualifying disabilities.  

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer   
Ability to use standard office equipment, including computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone  
Occasional standing, walking, bending, or reaching as needed in an office environment  
Ability to lift and carry items up to 15 pounds on an occasional basis (e.g., files, office supplies, equipment)  
Visual acuity sufficient to read printed and digital documents, spreadsheets, and financial reports  
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and via video conference  
Travel to corporate offices, franchise locations, and for external meetings may be required (estimated up to 30%)

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Cat Digital is the digital and technology arm of Caterpillar Inc., leveraging the latest technologies to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers. With over 1.5 million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics, and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world.

Our websites and eCommerce applications are the key digital enabler to Caterpillar’s aftermarket parts and services growth strategy. Delivering on the Caterpillar brand promise of premium, high-quality solutions is an important element in accelerating the development and deployment of Caterpillar’s expanded capabilities in eCommerce.

The Senior Software Engineering Manager for Search is responsible for setting the technical direction and overseeing the execution of advanced search solutions. This role combines strategic vision, hands-on technical expertise, and leadership to build scalable, high-performance search platforms that deliver exceptional user experiences.

What You Will Do

Define and implement a long-term technical vision for the search platform to ensure scalability and adaptability to growing data volumes and query complexity. Understand major product and service groups and apply that knowledge across business scenarios.
Build detailed technical architecture for search solutions specifically focused on websites content.
Responsible for recruiting, managing, and mentoring one or multiple teams of software engineers to achieve shared departmental objectives. Use leadership strategies to align teams around shared objectives and outcomes.

Strong experience as a Software engineering manager, Software Architecture manager, Software product manager managing 10+ team members

The Director of Process Engineering will serve as the strategic leader for the global process engineering organization. Lead disciplined engineering approaches, including structured problem solving, process characterization, validation, FMEA, troubleshooting, data analytics, and lifecycle management to strengthen process capability and robustness.
Drive continuous improvement and standardization initiatives that improve quality, reliability, speed, flexibility, and cost effectiveness across manufacturing processes and equipment platforms.

Proven experience standardizing engineering practices, building technical capability, and harmonizing skills, tools, and governance across teams or manufacturing sites required.
