.

Our mission
is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents
. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies
and platform engineers across 100+ countries
. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads
and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide
. We’re a Series B
company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital
, and we’ve raised $69M
to date. Learn more at upbound.io
.

Upbound is building the control plane for the modern enterprise. As the company behind Crossplane, the open-source CNCF project that extends Kubernetes into an AI-native cloud control plane, Upbound enables organizations to compose, manage, and operate infrastructure and services through declarative, programmable control planes. Upbound Cloud delivers hosted, multi-tenant control planes that power platform engineering teams at scale.

The Management Plane is how customers experience all of it. It is the unified API surface, the interface they work in, the catalog they discover content through, and the systems that connect, license, and bill everything they run. As we scale into the next phase of growth, we are hiring a Senior Manager to lead this group.

Areas of Ownership

Hub — The Upbound Hub API, which indexes and aggregates control planes across an organization and provides unified API access, multi-tenancy, and organization context regardless of where those control planes run.
Console — The primary frontend client and user experience for the entire Upbound platform, spanning single control plane views, multi-control-plane management, and organization-level operations.
Marketplace — The distribution and discovery layer where users and customers find providers, functions, configurations, and extensions.
Middleware — The platform services the business depends on: billing and metering, licensing and entitlements, Connect, and the identity and access plumbing that ties them together.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for growing a team, defining the architecture of the Management Plane, and ensuring these four surfaces operate as one coherent product rather than four adjacent ones.

In this role, you will …

Management Plane Strategy

Own the long-term technical direction for Hub, Console, Marketplace, and middleware. Ensure they present a single coherent experience to customers whether their control planes run in Upbound Cloud or in their own environment. Define the architectural direction for the Hub API, multi-tenancy, and organization-level identity and access management. Drive the reliability and performance standards these surfaces are held to.

Middleware and Commerce

Own the systems that turn product usage into revenue: metering, usage aggregation, billing, licensing, and entitlement enforcement. Ensure these systems are accurate, auditable, and resilient, and that they can support new packaging and pricing without a rewrite each time. Partner with Finance and Revenue on the operational side of billing correctness.

AI-Native Access

Ensure the Hub API is a first-class interface for autonomous agents as well as human operators, with the declarative, programmatic access agentic workflows require. Evolve the Console toward a multi-modal experience that works alongside those workflows rather than around them.

Team Leadership

Lead senior ICs and tech leads directly. Grow the team deliberately against the roadmap, raise the hiring bar, and develop engineers into senior and lead roles. Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, on-call ownership, and production excellence across the Management Plane surfaces.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product, Design, GTM, Finance, and Customer Success. Translate enterprise requirements around security, multi-tenancy, packaging, and entitlements into platform capabilities. Represent the Management Plane in conversations about pricing changes, packaging, and customer-facing reliability.

You are a good fit if you have…

7+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers directly
Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS products at scale
Strong API design fundamentals, including versioning, backward compatibility, and designing for third-party consumers
Hands-on experience with at least one commerce or platform middleware domain: billing, metering, licensing, entitlements, or identity and access management
Track record of owning production reliability for customer-facing services, including incident response and on-call culture
Has built or intentionally restructured a team, not only inherited one
Technically credible with senior and principal engineers while operating at the roadmap level

Skills / Traits

Leadership: Sets direction and quality standards for a group of senior engineers who need clarity more than supervision. Earns followership through judgment and technical credibility rather than title.
People Management: Develops engineers deliberately toward their next level, runs consistent 1:1s and feedback loops, and addresses underperformance directly instead of waiting for a review cycle.
Decision-Making: Makes calls with incomplete information on a surface where reversals are expensive. A published API, a data model, or a billing schema is hard to walk back, so the bar for thinking a decision through is higher here than in most teams.
Communication: Translates fluently between engineering, Product, Design, Finance, and GTM. Writes clearly enough that a pricing change or an API deprecation can be understood by everyone it affects without a meeting.
Problem-Solving: Drives to root cause on correctness problems rather than stopping at a mitigation. Comfortable reasoning about a discrepancy that only shows up in one tenant's invoice.
Prioritization: Balances roadmap commitments against revenue-blocking middleware work, reliability debt, and customer escalations, and can explain the tradeoff to the people who lost the argument.
Project Management: Delivers predictably across four tightly coupled surfaces where a Hub API change can block Console and Marketplace at the same time. Manages dependencies and sequencing without adding process for its own sake.
Adaptability: Absorbs shifts in packaging, pricing, and agentic access requirements without rearchitecting each time. Adjusts approach when a framework or plan stops serving the team.
Risk Management: Treats billing accuracy, entitlement enforcement, and API compatibility as areas where mistakes cost real money and customer trust. Builds the guardrails, auditability, and testing to catch problems before customers do.
Technical Proficiency: Credible in API design, multi-tenant data modeling, and identity and access patterns, with enough frontend depth to lead Console work substantively rather than defer on it.

It is a plus if you have…

Familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem
Frontend or full-stack depth, enough to lead Console work substantively
Experience with marketplaces, developer catalogs, or package distribution systems
Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the systems behind them
Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure or developer-tools companies
Familiarity with how AI agents consume infrastructure APIs

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

Director of Manufacturing Engineering

Company Details:

Our company is a leader in the architectural metal products market with six operating locations in the USA. Family-owned and managed company 75 years strong. We distribute, fabricate, and finish (anodize and paint) aluminum and other products primarily for the commercial construction market.

This position will be responsible for 3 key areas:

Application Engineering and increasing revenue
Product Manager of ERP system
Engineering and Technical experience specifically with metal forming/fabrication and welding with Engineering CAD understanding.

The owners have been handling these job duties, but 1 of them is retiring in February, 2027 and would like a person to take over. Looking for experience in the metals industry and experienced with High Mix/Low Volume manufacturing environments. Essentially, possesses the final technical authority on manufacturability.

Mission

The Director of Manufacturing Engineering exists to turn technical uncertainty into revenue. When Sales brings a hard inquiry, this role's job is to know our true capability better than anyone on the floor, actively find the honest, buildable path to yes rather than defaulting to a cautious no, and build the investment case when winning the work requires new tooling. And when the honest answer really is no, this role says so — the goal is more revenue we can deliver on.

The Director of Manufacturing Engineering
is responsible for being the technical authority for how, where, and when shop orders are manufactured. This role owns enterprise-wide equipment and process capability knowledge, applying sound engineering judgment grounded in OEM specifications and hands-on manufacturing expertise to replace operator assumption and overly cautious decision-making.

Required:

Bachelor's degree in engineering (B.S.) from a four-year college or university; or ten years of related metal fabricating experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with ERP or production-scheduling systems is required.
Experienced with Lean Manufacturing philosophy and have experience with Lean tools such as visual manufacturing controls, 5S, waste reduction, and root cause analysis.
Prior application engineering or customer-facing technical solutioning experience is highly preferred.
Project management experience leading equipment installations, software deployments, or similar capital or process initiatives from planning through completion is required.
Familiarity with CAD is a plus.
Experience in a metal forming and welding environment is essential
Experience in Commercial Construction Building Products, especially aluminum window, door, skylight, curtain wall, and storefront would be a big plus.
Must have excellent communications skills

Job Responsibilities:

Serve as final technical authority on manufacturability: determine whether and how Company can fabricate and finish a given job in-house before sales quotes or declines work.
Serve as the application engineering escalation point: when Sales or a Project Manager brings a ‘can we make this?’ inquiry, actively work the problem — with Production personnel and customers as needed — to find an honest, buildable path to yes rather than defaulting to a cautious no, and equip Sales with what they need to convert a viable inquiry into a sale.
Train and equip Project Managers across all locations to make first-line manufacturability and solution decisions independently for standard requests, reserving engineering escalation for non-standard or complex jobs.
Assist with scheduling as needed: understand how Company Enterprise generates production schedules from quoted operations and standard time data, and guide General Managers, Project Managers, and administrative staff across all six branches on how to use and maintain accurate schedules.
Identify and recommend tooling and capital equipment investments that expand in-house capability, including cost and payback justification.
When Company is close to winning a job but cannot yet fulfill it without additional tooling or equipment, build a business plan for the CEO specific to that opportunity — investment required, cost, and payback — so capital decisions are made against real, near-term revenue rather than speculative capability building.
Serve as engineer-project manager for significant, approved engineering projects as needed — including new machine installations, software deployments, and other major process enhancements — owning scope, timeline, and budget from planning through completion.
Execute, configure, and maintain Company Enterprise's manufacturing ERP functionality under the CEO's product direction, including multi-branch job routing; document system logic and configuration so scheduling and routing knowledge does not depend on any single individual.
Directly manage the Compliance Management, CAD Services, and Quality Assurance functions.
Own the engineering aspects of regulatory compliance management.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance using Lean tools — visual manufacturing controls, 5S, waste reduction, and root cause analysis.
Monitor product consistency, customer complaints, safety hazards, and remakes across locations to identify systemic technical issues and drive corrective action.
Ensure staff receive timely, appropriate technical training and development. Mentor and develop staff through a supportive, collaborative approach.
Escalate unresolved disagreements with the VP of Manufacturing to the CEO for final decision.

The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.

The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.

Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.

The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e. <50 people and $10M in revenue, and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led in that capacity. You’ve also ideally held a prominent role at at a company that has scaled, i.e. 50-250 people and >$50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.

What we're looking for

A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat
A proven track record of building successful products. You are willing to be hands on and get in the weeds. This is a ~17 person org and a 30 person company. While you are ultimately in charge of managing the team we expect you to be a hands on operator and willing to roll your sleeves up

Low ego and mission driven. Your energized by the mission of the company and by building a team, motivating them, and partnering with world class founders
Excellent communication and people leadership skills

VP Product / CPO at a technical B2B SaaS company.

Collaborate closely with Marketing, Finance, and Operations leadership to enhance user experience and data connectivity.

5+ years of senior leadership experience, including direct team and P&L management

Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, uptime SLAs, and production excellence.

CIO

2–5, including on-site support resources across Rose Bio's four locations (Rockville, MD; Memphis, TN; Northridge, CA; Keele, UK)

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An overview of this role

As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.

What you’ll do

Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.

What you’ll bring

Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.

About The Team

The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.

jobs.description:
← All open rolesEngineering

Vice President, Engineering

Toronto or RemoteFull-time

TL;DR

Company: Sensei Labs
Product: Conductor — the AI-powered operating system for strategic programs
Reports to: CTO
Team: 7 direct reports (4 software engineers, 2 quality engineers, and the Platform/DevOps team)
Partnering closely: 2-person Product team and 4-person GTM team
Location: [Toronto / remote]

About Us

Sensei Labs builds Conductor, an enterprise strategy execution platform that governs billions of dollars in program value across hundreds of enterprise programs. Our customers are Fortune 500 transformation offices, global consultancies, and private equity value creation teams. Conductor covers the full lifecycle from portfolio planning through benefits realization, with our Harmony AI layer woven into every surface rather than bolted on.

We've been in the market for more than ten years, we're SOC-2 compliant with a single-tenant architecture, and we do all of it with a deliberately small team. That's the interesting part of this job.

We launched a full rewrite of our Conductor platform a few months ago and are midway through the effort to reach Conductor Modern. Over the next year (or so), this will give us the chance to migrate all our customers and partners to the new version and sunset our old code.

The role

You'll own engineering execution for Conductor: how the team is structured, how work gets from idea to production, and how quickly and reliably we ship. You'll drive the technical strategy and architecture direction, and you'll own the machine that turns that direction into shipped software.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a role that manages managers. With six engineers, you'll be in the code, in the reviews, and in the architecture discussions — while also being the person accountable for delivery, hiring, growth, and the team's day-to-day health. If you want a position where you can both set long-term strategy and have immediate day-to-day impact, this is the seat.

As part of our modernization, you’ll be directly involved in any remaining architectural and technical decisions for Conductor Modern and be a key part of planning for the customer migration and the ultimate sunsetting of the existing codebase.

This is the third leg of the Sensei Labs stool, along with our established Product and GTM leaders. You’ll work closely with them to shape and implement Product’s vision and to enable our GTM team to sell and deliver value to our customers and partners.

What You'll Own

Delivery. Planning, sequencing, and shipping against a roadmap you help build with Product. Predictable releases, visible progress, honest tradeoffs.
The team. Coaching and growing six engineers, running performance and career conversations, hiring as we scale, and keeping the bar high without burning people out.
Cloud platform and reliability. Architecture, scalability, cost, and operational excellence for a single-tenant enterprise SaaS platform. Uptime, performance, and security posture are yours. You'll lead our Platform/DevOps team alongside product engineering, setting direction for infrastructure and application architecture, performance and scalability, cloud cost management, and the tooling that the rest of engineering builds on. Uptime, operational excellence, and security posture are yours.
AI in the product. Partnering with Product on how Harmony AI evolves — agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and permission-aware AI behavior in an enterprise context.
AI in how we build. Making our SDLC substantially faster and more automated: AI-assisted coding, code review, and test generation; CI/CD; automated quality gates. We want an engineering org where a small team ships like a large one, and you'll be the one who builds that.
Engineering–Product partnership. Working shoulder to shoulder with Product on discovery, scope, and sequencing. You'll be expected to have opinions about the product, not just the plumbing.
Enterprise trust. Security, compliance, and the technical side of customer and prospect conversations when it matters.

What We're Looking For

Cloud infrastructure and application architecture at depth.

You've architected, built, and operated production cloud SaaS at meaningful scale — not just supervised it. You're fluent across both layers: the application architecture (service boundaries, data modeling, API design, and the patterns that keep a large codebase evolvable) and the infrastructure underneath it. Hands-on depth in Azure and/or GCP is essential, along with container orchestration on Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, networking and identity, and the observability and cost discipline that keep a cloud platform healthy as it grows. You understand multi-tenancy versus single-tenancy tradeoffs, data isolation, performance under enterprise load, and what "SOC-2 compliant" actually costs an engineering team.

Real product instinct.

You've worked in product-led environments where engineering shapes what gets built. You can push back on a spec, spot the simpler solution, and reason about customer value — especially in complex B2B software where the user is an enterprise operator, not a consumer.

Team leadership with your hands still dirty.

You've led and grown engineering teams (roughly 5–20 people) as a player-coach. You've hired well, given hard feedback, and relentlessly tuned the delivery process.

AI fluency, both directions.

You've shipped AI or LLM-backed features into production — and you've also rebuilt how a team works using AI-assisted development and automated SDLC tooling. You can tell the difference between AI that creates leverage and AI that creates cleanup work.

Startup temperament.

You're comfortable being both the strategist and the person who fixes the flaky test. You'd rather own an outcome than a headcount number.

Nice to have

Enterprise PPM, EPMO, transformation, or professional services domain experience
Experience with Microsoft 365 / SAP / Jira / Power BI integration ecosystems
Background in selling or supporting technical evaluations with Fortune 500 or PE buyers
Experience taking a mature product through an AI-era re-platforming or modernization

Your first year

By 90 days — you know the codebase, the team, and the roadmap; you've shipped something meaningful yourself; and you've given us a clear read on our biggest delivery and technical risks.
By 6 months — the development lifecycle is measurably faster, with AI-assisted workflows and automated quality gates that the team actually uses. Release cadence is predictable.
By 12 months — engineering is a genuine competitive advantage: shipping AI capability into Conductor at a pace that surprises much larger competitors, with a team that's grown in both size and capability.

Why this role

Small team, real enterprise customers, an established product, and an unusually good excuse to rebuild how software gets made. You won't be one VP among many, and you won't be managing a slide deck about AI transformation — you'll be doing it, on a product whose entire premise is helping large organizations actually execute.

jobs.title: Technology Strategy Manager/Sr Manager, Financial Services
jobs.description:
Technology Strategy Manager / Senior Manager - Financial Services Industry

We Are:

Technology Strategy, and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors
in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. Our mission is to help client business executives disrupt their industry
and utilize technology to capture market share.

Technology strategy leverages deep business expertise combined with technology know-how, empowering clients to be more competitive by leading initiatives that unlock value and drive growth. We enable leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help our clients disrupt their markets through creating strategies that capabilities in operating model, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies such as GenAI, rethinking business models for growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. We help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:

An expert at advising Financial Services
clients on technology strategies to achieve their vision and operational goals. You have an abundance of energy and drive, resilience, and a passion for collaborating with senior executives. You love continual learning and are intrigued by new challenges. You have a flair for breaking down complex issues into logical parts and constructing analyses driving actionable recommendations. You’ve got top notch communication and leadership skills and a natural talent for appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

In Technology Strategy you will:

Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite defining strategy at the intersection of both technology and business .

Articulate a compelling technology vision with industry and functional expertise .

Shape the role of technology in business strategies to capture market share.

Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities based on detailed assessment and analysis of current technology footprint.

Drive strategic opportunities which incorporate innovative technology solutions into broader business transformations.

Develop operating models and business cases leveraging disruptive technologies.

Lead the creation of well-articulated thought leadership assets that present innovative insight, knowledge, guidance, and recommendations on a specific market-relevant technology strategy.

Pressure-test assumptions made by leadership teams, including AI-generated insights.

Validate AI-assisted analysis with logic, experience, and domain knowledge.

Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, modeling, and scenario analysis.

Use critical judgement to Know when AI outputs are directionally useful vs. when they are unreliable.

As a Manager/Sr. Manager you will:

Lead team, project, and program as well as corresponding deliverables while supervising and mentoring full teams.

Build strong relationships with senior clients that go beyond the workplace, including beginning to develop C-suite relationships; drive a spirit of collaboration and teaming with client while serving as a true trusted advisor

Drive thought leadership, asset development, and intellectual capital efforts with targeted input from more senior resources; identify and advance ideas for new opportunities

Support Business Development, building understanding of how to architect and position proposals and SOWs

Facilitate to drive results and gain consensus for action; able to address difficult client conversations and engage senior client stakeholders to drive meaningful outcomes

Travel as needed

Here’s What You Need:

As a Manager:

Minimum 1 year of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm

Minimum 5 years of proven experience in at least one of the following: operating model strategy, M&A, tech value and cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.

Minimum 5 years of experience writing business cases.

Minimum 2 years of experience leading or managing small teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.

Bachelor’s degree

As a Senior Manager:

Minimum 3 years of strategy consulting experience at a consulting firm

Minimum 6 years of experience in at least two of the following: operating model strategy, technology in M&A, tech value cost take-out, or technology driven revenue growth strategy.

Minimum 6 years of experience writing business cases.

Minimum 5 years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations.

Bachelor’s degree

Bonus Points if:

Comfortable using AI tools for research, synthesis, and analysis.

Ability to evaluate AI outputs critically.

Understanding of data limitations, bias, and model risk

You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.

You have shown critical thinking, ability to question decisions and provide creative solutions.

You can manage junior members of the team and can develop them for more responsibility.

You have effective communication and people skills to manage relationships with clients.

You have strong presentation skills: ability to synthesize information and the ability to bring a message forward.

You lead in driving insights and recommendations using data models and visualization tools, demonstrated advanced research skills.

You can develop practical roadmaps that support the enabling of technology transformation.

You can manage a variety of projects with increased complexity.

You have developed project management abilities and have reported and escalated on time to managerial level.

About Nightfall

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

About The Role

We're hiring a VP of Engineering to own our engineering organization end to end — architecture, delivery, and the day-to-day operating rhythm of a team split across the Bay Area and Bangalore. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has grown up through engineering, not just managed it: we're looking for a builder who can still get into the weeds on hard technical problems while running the org.

Responsibilities

Lead the engineering team in designing and delivering high-quality software solutions that meet business requirements.
Lead and scale a distributed engineering org spanning Palo Alto and Bangalore, building the systems and trust that make a cross-continent team operate as one.
Develop and implement engineering processes and standards to ensure consistency and quality across projects.
Collaborate with the CEO and other senior leaders to define and execute the company's technology strategy.
Manage and allocate resources to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the engineering team, staying hands-on enough to review architecture decisions and unblock hard problems.
Build and maintain a strong engineering culture that fosters innovation and continuous improvement across both the US and India.
Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in software engineering and recommend new tools and methodologies to improve our development process.
Work closely with the Product team to define product roadmaps and ensure engineering resources are aligned with product priorities.
Champion secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices by ensuring the integration of security at every stage, from design to deployment.
Advocate for and ensure adherence to secure coding standards and design principles such as least privilege, defense in depth, and zero trust.
Ensure sensitive data is handled securely, leveraging encryption, tokenization, and data masking as appropriate.
Lead the engineering response during security incidents, ensuring timely containment, resolution, and communication to stakeholders.
Drive root cause analysis and implement lessons learned from incidents to prevent recurrence.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree or Ph.D. preferred.
At least 8 years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
A track record of growing from a hands-on technical role into engineering leadership — we're looking for someone who built the org, not just inherited one.
Experience joining a B2B SaaS company at an early stage (e.g., a founding engineer or one of the first engineering hires) and growing with it through significant scale — ideally 5+ years at one company, moving from IC through senior leadership.

Strong technical skills in software development, architecture, and design.
Experience managing and mentoring large engineering teams, including demonstrated experience building or closely partnering with an engineering team based in India — someone who knows how to make a Bay Area / Bangalore org function as one team, not two.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and senior leaders.
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Startup experience strongly preferred; comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving Series B environment.
Background in security, infrastructure, or data-intensive systems; direct security engineering experience (data protection, authentication, auditing, threat detection) is a strong plus.
Based in Bay Area, with a hybrid work rhythm.

Nice to Have

Experience at a cybersecurity or data security SaaS company.
Experience with data infrastructure or large-scale data processing systems.
Track record shipping AI/ML-powered features in production.

jobs.title: Director/VP of Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Engineering | Autonomous Systems & Real-Time Software

Tempe / Phoenix, Arizona | ~$225k Base + Significant Equity

What if your next engineering leadership role gave you the opportunity to define the architecture, build the product, hire the team and put your fingerprints on an entirely new technology platform?
We're partnering exclusively with an early-stage technology company building at the intersection of drones, autonomous systems, AI and physical security
.

They're looking for their first senior software engineering leader
.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a mature organization, manage from a distance or spend their days exclusively in meetings.

They need a genuine player-coach
.

You'll operate with Principal-level technical ownership while building the engineering organization around you. Initially, that means architecting systems, writing and reviewing code, shipping critical features and solving production problems yourself. As the company scales, you'll recruit and develop the engineers who increasingly take ownership alongside you.

What You'll Build

At the center of the opportunity is a real-time operational platform that enables security professionals to remotely monitor, pilot and ultimately automate physical systems across complex environments.

You'll have the freedom to shape the platform end-to-end across:
Real-time, operator-facing interfaces
Drone control and remote operations
Live data and video
Cloud infrastructure
APIs and external integrations
Reliability, security and observability
Connected physical systems
AI-assisted and increasingly autonomous capabilities

One of your earliest challenges will be helping overhaul the existing product and enabling operators to pilot drones directly through the platform
.

There is no predetermined technology playbook you're being hired to follow.

You'll determine what should be retained, what should be rebuilt, how the architecture should evolve and which engineers need to be hired next.

Who We're Looking For

You may come from autonomy, robotics, drones, aerospace, gaming, simulation, geospatial technology, public safety, physical security or another environment where sophisticated software interacts with the real world
.

Direct defense or drone experience is not required.

What matters more is that you've personally built and shipped complex software, understand real-time systems and production reliability, can architect across the full stack, and still genuinely enjoy being close to the technology.

You should also have experience hiring, mentoring or leading engineers
. The ambition isn't to remain a team of one. It's to build an exceptional engineering organization around the platform you help create.

Experience using modern AI coding tools and software agents
as part of serious production engineering would be particularly relevant.

Why This Opportunity?

Because genuine greenfield engineering leadership roles are rare.

You'll work directly alongside product leadership, operators and customers. You'll see how your software performs in real operational environments and have the authority to improve it.

You'll help decide the architecture.
You'll build critical parts of the product.
You'll hire the team.
You'll establish the engineering culture.
And you'll have meaningful equity in what you're helping create.

Most importantly, the mission has tangible human consequences: using technology to protect people, extend the capabilities of security professionals and reduce the need to put humans in harm's way.

The company is establishing its engineering organization in Tempe/Phoenix
. There is some flexibility during the initial build-out, but this is ultimately an onsite opportunity for someone who wants to build closely alongside the team.

Compensation:
Approximately $225k base, with flexibility for exceptional candidates, plus a significant equity component.

If you're an engineering leader who still considers yourself a builder and the idea of creating something from the ground up is more exciting than inheriting something already finished, I'd welcome a confidential conversation.

Please share your updated resume and upcoming availability.

jobs.description:
Own the system-level vision that turns first-of-a-kind fusion hardware into a cohesive, scalable reality—leading the integration of breakthrough science and engineering on the path to commercial fusion energy.  
The Head of Systems Engineering will lead the systems engineering function at   Realta  Fusion,  establishing  technical requirements, driving system integration, and ensuring our magnetic mirror fusion devices meet performance, safety, and operational  objectives . This senior technical leadership role demands  expertise  in complex system architecture, requirements management, and integration of multidisciplinary subsystems. You will bridge plasma physics, mechanical, electrical, nuclear, and  controls  engineering teams to ensure coherent system design and successful execution from experimental devices through commercial deployment. The ideal candidate combines deep systems engineering  expertise  with strategic leadership, thriving in a first-of-a-kind hardware environment where disciplined systems thinking directly  impacts  our ability to deliver commercial fusion energy.    
Realta Fusion is a rapidly growing start-up developing compact magnetic mirror fusion energy systems to address the biggest challenge of our time – tackling global climate change while ensuring a sufficient energy supply for at least ten billion people on (and off) earth. We are building a team with diverse talents dedicated to making fusion energy a  real  solution to humanity’s most pressing problem .  
Key Responsibilities

Systems Architecture & Requirements

Define and maintain system architecture for fusion devices across experimental, pilot, and commercial product lines 
Establish and manage technical requirements from physics performance through operational, safety, and regulatory constraints 
Lead system decomposition and allocation of requirements to subsystems and components  
Develop and  maintain  interface control documents across mechanical, electrical, plasma, and control systems  
Drive design trades balancing performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and risk    

Integration & Verification

Lead system integration activities ensuring subsystems work together to meet top-level requirements 
Define verification and validation strategy including analysis, testing, inspection, and demonstration 
Oversee commissioning and acceptance testing of fusion devices and major subsystems  
Manage technical reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) ensuring design maturity and readiness  
Drive resolution of integration issues and  interface  conflicts across engineering disciplines    

Team Leadership & Development

Build, lead, and mentor systems engineering team (initially 2-3, scaling to 8-12)  
Establish systems engineering processes, tools, and best practices for fusion development 
Recruit systems engineers with experience in complex hardware integration    
Develop systems engineering capability across the broader engineering organization    

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Partner with plasma physics to translate physics requirements into engineering specifications  
Work with mechanical, electrical, nuclear, and controls leads to ensure integrated system design  
Coordinate with operations on maintainability, operability, and lifetime performance requirements    
Support manufacturing and assembly planning to ensure buildability and integration sequence  

Program Support & Risk Management

Provide systems engineering support to experimental campaigns and pilot plant development programs 
Lead technical risk assessment and develop mitigation strategies for system-level risks 
Support project management with integrated schedules, technical dependencies, and critical path analysis    
Represent systems engineering perspective in executive decision-making on technical priorities and resource allocation    

  External Engagement

Represent systems engineering capabilities to investors, partners, and technical stakeholders  
Collaborate with national laboratories and research institutions on systems engineering best practices for fusion 
Engage with regulatory agencies on system safety analysis and compliance strategies    

Qualifications

Education & Experience

BS in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred 
15+ years systems engineering experience in complex hardware programs (aerospace, defense, energy, accelerators, research facilities)  
5+ years leading systems engineering teams or serving as chief engineer on major programs    
Demonstrated  track record  integrating multidisciplinary systems from requirements through commissioning    

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in systems engineering processes including requirements management, functional analysis, interface management, and V&V  
Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and control systems to  facilitate  integration across disciplines    
Proficiency  with systems engineering tools (DOORS, Cameo,  modeling  and simulation)    
Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approaches    
Knowledge of systems safety analysis (FMEA, fault trees, hazard analysis)    
Familiarity with technical reviews, configuration management, and engineering change processes    

Leadership & Execution

Proven ability to lead technical teams and influence across organizational boundaries 
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with systems-level thinking  
Excellent communication skills translating between technical specialists and executive leadership    
Experience making critical technical decisions with incomplete information and competing constraints    
Comfortable in fast-paced environments balancing rigor with speed of execution

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

As the Director of Solution Architecture, you will serve as the executive technical leader bridging Commercial, Product Management, and Field Operations. You will recruit, mentor, and lead a high-caliber team of Principal Solutions Architects, establishing global reference architecture, customer onboarding frameworks, and technical field enablement. You will act as an executive sponsor for tier-1 enterprise accounts, ensuring customer success across bare-metal compute, platform orchestration, and FinOps.

Job Requirements

Basic Qualifications: Experience: 15+ years of technical architecture/engineering experience in cloud infrastructure, high-density AI/HPC, or neocloud environments.
People Leadership: 5+ years of experience leading, hiring, and managing high-performing Solution Architecture or Technical Account Management teams.
Cloud & AI Breadth: Strong technical fluency across GPU acceleration (NVIDIA DGX/Blackwell), container orchestration (Kubernetes), high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), and cloud cost models.

 Preferred Qualifications: Proven track record of supporting multi-million dollar enterprise AI cloud commitments (e.g., Microsoft, tier-1 AI labs).
Deep understanding of distributed LLM training frameworks (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, Ray) and inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM).
Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field.

Job Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Scale: Build, mentor, and scale a world-class team of AI Solution Architects and HPC specialists across key North American hubs.
Field Execution & Strategy: Establish repeatable architecture frameworks, customer PoC blueprints, and technical discovery loops to accelerate enterprise deal cycles.
Executive Customer Sponsorship: Act as the primary executive technical advisor for tier-1 enterprise clients, leading architecture design reviews for multi-thousand GPU deployments.
Commercial & Product Alignment: Partner closely with Commercial leadership on high-stakes proposals, while synthesizing field telemetry and customer requirements into direct feedback for Product Management.
Technical Thought Leadership: Represent IREN at major industry events, authoring whitepapers and reference designs on high-density GPU deployment, liquid cooling, and green AI infrastructure.

Job Benefits

The IREN Package  
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.   
Compensation  
Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
Total Compensation package may be inclusive of short-term and long-term incentives.
Relocation (as applicable and based on successful candidate circumstances)

Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage – 100% company paid for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents

401(k) retirement plan with company match
Financial wellness tools and resources

Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Flexible work arrangements

Growth & Development  
Opportunities for advancement and internal mobility
Training and personal development opportunities

Lifestyle & Culture  
Company events and team-building activities

jobs.title: Vice President, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Vice President, Software Delivery is responsible for enterprise software delivery execution, platform modernization, and engineering operating model transformation across the Business Unit. This leader owns delivery outcomes across squads, drives platform consolidation strategy, establishes engineering governance standards, and ensures alignment between business priorities, enterprise architecture, AI initiatives, and technology execution.

The Vice President serves as the senior technical delivery leader for the organization, overseeing Business Unit delivery leadership while partnering closely with Product, Infrastructure, DevOps, Database, Security, AI, PMO, and Operations leadership. This role will guide the transition from fragmented delivery models into standardized, platform-oriented engineering capabilities that improve scalability, reduce duplication, accelerate delivery velocity, and strengthen operational reliability.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience deploying AI-enabled engineering practices and tools to maximize engineering productivity and efficiency while expanding quality, automation, and operational reliability across the software delivery lifecycle.

What You Will Own

This role owns enterprise software delivery performance and KPI accountability across Business Units, including delivery predictability, quality, operational stability, production health, and execution against strategic roadmap commitments. The Vice President will also own the technical leadership system centered on Tech Lead accountability, embedded architectural ownership, consistent KPI governance, disciplined PSR execution, and PMO-supported cross-department initiative delivery.

Essential Responsibilities

Collaborate with architecture and delivery peers on enterprise vision and strategy for Software Delivery across all Business Units.
Own delivery KPIs for predictability, quality, operational stability, and production health.
Lead platform consolidation and modernization into reusable services, APIs, and common engineering patterns.
Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, code review, automated testing, security scanning, release readiness, rollback, observability, and incident learning.
Drive measurable improvement in deployment frequency, lead time, defect escape rate, change failure rate, incident trends, and delivery predictability.
Ensure enterprise architecture standards and AI directives are adopted across products and squads.
Partner with Product, Infrastructure, DevOps, Database, Security, AI, PMO, Operations, QA COE, and Support to align enterprise initiatives with delivery execution.
Oversee Daily Management, KPI reviews, release readiness, production health reviews, and PSR execution across Business Units.
Drive AI-enabled engineering capabilities that improve developer productivity, test automation, defect reduction, documentation, incident analysis, and operational insight.
Establish responsible AI usage standards that balance productivity with security, compliance, maintainability, and quality.
Represent Software Delivery in executive customer, partner, and stakeholder discussions.
Build and coach high-performing delivery leadership teams, including BU leaders, Domain Software Managers, and Tech Leads.
Oversee CapEx and OpEx alignment, resource planning, and platform/tooling investments tied to delivery velocity and stability.

Qualifications

Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of software engineering leadership experience, including 7+ years leading multiple teams or Business Units.
Proven success leading platform transformation, modernization, consolidation, and governance across legacy and modern systems.
Experience implementing scalable engineering governance models, Agile/Lean delivery practices, and measurable flow and quality improvements.
Demonstrated experience deploying AI-enabled engineering practices, developer productivity tooling, or intelligent automation within software delivery organizations.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership capability.
Successful completion of the Nlets fingerprinting background assessment.

Technical Background

Experience across enterprise software delivery, platform ecosystems, APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, observability, and reliability engineering.
Ability to evaluate platform strategy, delivery tradeoffs, architectural direction, modernization paths, AI-enabled engineering practices, and operational risk.
Familiarity with SaaS or large-scale digital platforms, internal developer platforms, distributed systems, and legacy modernization.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic Mindset: Aligns delivery, platform consolidation, modernization, AI adoption, and business growth.
Ensures Accountability: Owns enterprise delivery outcomes and creates clear accountability across BU leaders, Domain Software Managers, Tech Leads, Scrum Masters, PMO, QA COE, and Support.
Builds Effective Teams: Develops strong delivery leaders and strengthens succession planning, coaching, ownership, and continuous learning.
Customer Focus: Ensures delivery models improve customer outcomes, reliability, operational excellence, and predictable execution.
Cultivates Innovation: Advances modern engineering, automation, platform capabilities, and AI-enabled productivity while maintaining governance discipline.
Decision Quality: Balances speed, quality, reliability, security, scalability, maintainability, and business value.
Communicates Effectively: Aligns Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, Database, Security, AI, PMO, Operations, and executive stakeholders.
Complex Ecosystem Delivery: Orchestrates execution across product, platform, infrastructure, quality, support, and operations domains.

Success in the First 6 Months

Establish enterprise delivery governance, KPI operating model, decision rights, Tech Lead accountability, and PMO engagement rules.
Define platform consolidation roadmap, modernization priorities, shared service opportunities, and legacy deprecation approach.
Improve delivery predictability and operational KPI performance quarter over quarter.
Standardize release readiness and production health reviews across Business Units.
Strengthen alignment with Infrastructure, DevOps, Database, Security, AI, Product, and PMO leadership.
Launch initial AI-enabled engineering productivity initiatives with measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, automation, or operational effectiveness.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.

Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

Vice President of Infrastructure & Capital Projects
Company: Byrd's Volta Hub
Location: Hybrid / DMV & Northeast Corridor Operations (Remote flexibility with travel)
Employment Type: Full-Time / Executive Leadership
About Byrd’s Volta Hub:
Byrd’s Volta Hub is pioneering the next generation of transportation infrastructure. We are deploying a high-growth network of highway EV "Super Hubs" that combine ultra-fast DC fast charging with zero-labor automated micro-markets and productivity work spaces. We are scaling rapidly along major U.S. transit corridors, anchoring our Phase 1 rollout across the vital New York to Washington, D.C. (I-95) corridor.
Position Summary:
We are seeking an elite, execution-focused Vice President of Infrastructure & Capital Projects to take full ownership of our national site development, civil engineering, grid interconnection, and modular construction program.
Reporting directly to the Founder & Principal, this executive will manage the entire lifecycle of our multi-site physical buildout. You will serve as the core operational leader during institutional private equity due diligence and oversee massive capital deployment, ensuring our projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and in strict alignment with federal grant (NEVI/CFI) compliance guidelines.
Key Responsibilities:
* Capital Program Delivery: Direct end-to-end execution of site development—from land acquisition, municipal zoning, and permitting to civil engineering and construction across multi-state transit corridors.
* Grid Interconnection & Energy Integration: Manage complex high-voltage utility relationships, substation tie-ins, and the integration of on-site Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and solar generation assets.
* EPC & Vendor Procurement: Lead the negotiation and management of Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contracts, charging hardware manufacturers, and modular retail fabricators.
* Regulatory & Grant Alignment: Coordinate closely with our public finance teams to ensure all site construction meets federal and state funding standards (including NEVI and CFI guidelines).
* Institutional Governance: Act as the technical and operational voice during private equity and infrastructure fund reviews, presenting milestones, risk mitigation plans, and budget pacing.
Professional Qualifications & Requirements:
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive executive leadership managing large-scale capital projects, energy infrastructure, EV charging networks, or heavy commercial real estate development.
* Technical Mastery: Deep familiarity with high-voltage electrical architecture, DC fast-charging (DCFC) technology, microgrids, and local/federal zoning frameworks.
* Track Record: Proven history of successfully delivering multi-site physical infrastructure portfolios on schedule and within stringent financial budgets.
* Leadership: Exceptional cross-functional leader capable of managing external engineering firms, general contractors, and internal technical stakeholders.
What We Offer:
* Competitive executive compensation package (Base + Performance Bonus).
* Meaningful equity participation in a high-growth national infrastructure platform.
* The opportunity to architect the future of highway energy and transit automation.
To Apply: Please submit your resume and a brief overview of your largest multi-site infrastructure or EV charging deployment project directly through LinkedIn/Indeed or to our executive team.

Trust. Service. Security.

Director, Cybersecurity IAM Engineering provides leadership and guidance to senior cybersecurity colleagues, leading high-performing teams in the strategic engineering of Identity and Access Management solutions for the enterprise.

Responsibilities

The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineering Leader is responsible for leading the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operation of enterprise IAM platforms and services. This role oversees a team of engineers responsible for identity governance and access lifecycle management. The leader partners closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application development, risk, compliance, and business teams to ensure secure, scalable, and user-friendly access solutions across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IAM engineers and technical specialists.
Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and career development plans.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
Recruit, retain, and develop top IAM engineering talent.

IAM Strategy & Architecture

Define and execute the enterprise IAM roadmap aligned with business and security objectives with a specific focus on transforming IAM controls and processes using Agentic AI.
Drive modernization initiatives including Zero Trust, adaptive access controls, and cloud identity services.
Establish IAM reference architectures and engineering best practices.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to improve security posture and user experience.

Engineering & Delivery

Oversee design, implementation, and support of IAM platforms, specifically Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Directory Services (Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP), and API and agentic Identity management.
Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and compliant and leverage Agentic AI Technology
Drive automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to improve efficiency and reduce risk.

Security & Risk Management

Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement strong identity controls and access governance.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal security policies.
Lead remediation efforts related to identity-related audit findings and security risks.
Support incident response and investigations involving authentication or access control issues.

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with executive leadership, security teams, application owners, and business stakeholders.
Communicate IAM strategy, risks, metrics, and program progress to senior management.
Influence enterprise-wide adoption of identity standards and best practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.
8+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, or Infrastructure Engineering.
3+ years of people leadership experience managing technical teams.
Deep understanding of IAM concepts including authentication, authorization, federation, identity governance, and privileged access management.
Strong understanding of cloud security and identity services across AWS, Azure, and GCP, Active Directory, RACF as well as authorization structures used within applications.
Experience leading large-scale IAM transformations and modernization initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with DevSecOps, API security, and identity automation.
CISSP, CISM, CIAM, CCSP, or equivalent certifications.
Experience implementing Zero Trust security architectures.
Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
Experience leading deployment of Agentic AI solutions for Information Security process and controls.

This role oversees a team of engineers responsible for identity governance and access lifecycle management. The leader partners closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application development, risk, compliance, and business teams to ensure secure, scalable, and user-friendly access solutions across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IAM engineers and technical specialists.
Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and career development plans.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning.
Recruit, retain, and develop top IAM engineering talent.

IAM Strategy & Architecture

Define and execute the enterprise IAM roadmap aligned with business and security objectives with a specific focus on transforming IAM controls and processes using Agentic AI.
Drive modernization initiatives including Zero Trust, adaptive access controls, and cloud identity services.
Establish IAM reference architectures and engineering best practices.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to improve security posture and user experience.

Engineering & Delivery

Oversee design, implementation, and support of IAM platforms, specifically Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Directory Services (Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP), and API and agentic Identity management.
Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and compliant and leverage Agentic AI Technology
Drive automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to improve efficiency and reduce risk.

Security & Risk Management

Partner with Cybersecurity teams to implement strong identity controls and access governance.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal security policies.
Lead remediation efforts related to identity-related audit findings and security risks.
Support incident response and investigations involving authentication or access control issues.

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with executive leadership, security teams, application owners, and business stakeholders.
Communicate IAM strategy, risks, metrics, and program progress to senior management.
Influence enterprise-wide adoption of identity standards and best practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.
8+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, or Infrastructure Engineering.
3+ years of people leadership experience managing technical teams.
Deep understanding of IAM concepts including authentication, authorization, federation, identity governance, and privileged access management.
Strong understanding of cloud security and identity services across AWS, Azure, and GCP, Active Directory, RACF as well as authorization structures used within applications.
Experience leading large-scale IAM transformations and modernization initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with DevSecOps, API security, and identity automation.
CISSP, CISM, CIAM, CCSP, or equivalent certifications.
Experience implementing Zero Trust security architectures.
Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
Experience leading deployment of Agentic AI solutions for Information Security process and controls.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Role Overview

At Cboe, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

The goal of the Cboe Platform Engineering group focuses around building a scalable and secure foundations platform, enabling the Cboe operations, software engineering and application teams to deploy, validate, and operate their services in production, improve resiliency of the service and increase organizational efficiency by reducing operational toil and increase system efficiency through architectural evolution. 

The Senior Manager of Platform Engineering will play a pivotal role in driving the design, implementation, and management of our cloud-native infrastructure across both public cloud (AWS) and on-premises Linux environments. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Platform Engineering, this role will lead a team of platform engineers responsible for building scalable, secure, and resilient platforms — running workloads across hybrid infrastructure focused on outcomes.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

Lead and manage a team of platform engineers responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud-native infrastructure across AWS and on-prem Linux/Kubernetes environments. 
Lead the architectural design of platform solutions across hybrid (cloud and on-prem) environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security best practices are incorporated. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, architect solutions, and ensure successful delivery of platform projects. 
Drive the adoption of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles and practices, leveraging tools such as Terraform and Pulumi to automate and standardize deployments across cloud and on-prem. 
Establish and maintain robust monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure the reliability and performance of the platform across cloud and on-prem. 
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development. 
Champion a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability within the Platform Engineering Team and across the organization. 

The ideal candidate has 

8+ years of experience with major Cloud vendors including AWS, Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure, with strong expertise in AWS. 
Hands-on experience operating cloud-native workloads on Kubernetes in both cloud and on-premises Linux environments. 
Proven experience leading and managing high-performing engineering teams in a fast-paced environment with a record of project delivery and architecture of production systems. 
In-depth knowledge of cloud-native and platform architecture principles, best practices, and design patterns. 
Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, and Jenkins. 
Proficiency in container orchestration technologies, especially Kubernetes. 
Strong understanding of Linux systems administration, networking, security, and compliance requirements across hybrid environments. 
Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. 
Thorough understanding of the financial markets a plus. 
AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, and/or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD), or equivalent, are highly desirable. 

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $170,000-$220,000 in Kansas, $187,000-$242,000 in Chicago, and $212,500-$275,000 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.
