jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager – AI & Network Infrastructure
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

We are looking for a forward-thinking, hands-on Technical Product Development Manager to direct the growth and strategic expansion of our next-generation Network Automation. This role combines technical leadership with strategic business acumen to build and launch advanced AI products and enterprise services. The ideal candidate brings a comprehensive understanding of AI industry trends, commercial models, and corporate strategy, backed by deep expertise in AI architectures, model frameworks, and agentic systems. Strong familiarity with Edge computing, Cloud environments, Data Centers, and AI-focused NeoClouds is required.

Key requirements include hands-on expertise with agentic AI runtime infrastructure (such as AI Gateways, Routers, MCPs, and Semantic Caching) across Cloud, Edge, Data Center, and NeoCloud environments, along with a strong foundation in software-defined networking paradigms like SD-WAN and SASE.

Responsibilities Will Include

Network & AI Integration: Drive the convergence of enterprise WAN topologies—specifically SD-WAN and SASE frameworks—into a unified AI Fabric optimized for high-throughput, low-latency East-West and North-South traffic flows.
AI Agent Services: Architect and productize AI services, including AI Gateways, intelligent AI Routers, token brokering, token monitoring, standardized Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for context retrieval, and low-latency Semantic Caching layers.
Intelligent Network Automation & Evolution: Apply AI technologies to automate operations, optimize service delivery, and advance capabilities toward fully autonomous networks.
AI Platform Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in architecting and deploying scalable AI platform infrastructure to support agentic services. Proficient in agent identification, orchestration frameworks, as well as real-time intelligence and monitoring.
Lead end-to-end design and execution of AI Proof of Concepts (PoCs) in public cloud and lab environments.
Benchmark network performance, prompt/response latency, GPU utilization, and context-fabric efficiency under real-world AI inference and training workloads.
Formulate product roadmaps and commercial models based on deep market analysis of public hyperscalers, edge nodes, on-premise data centers, and GPU-first NeoClouds.
Monetize fabric capabilities by defining service levels (SLAs), enterprise security frameworks, and API/MCP integrations for autonomous agent workflows.

What We’re Looking For...

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Five or more years of technical product management/development experience delivering enterprise-grade networking or AI software platforms.
Strong conceptual and technical foundation in DIA, EVPL, MPLS, SD-WAN, SASE, zero-trust security, or high-density data center network architectures.
Hands-on experience developing AI solutions across Edge, Cloud, traditional Data Centers, or specialized AI NeoClouds (GPU-as-a-Service).
Experience quickly prototyping, testing, and validating technical concepts in lab and multi-cloud environments before scaling to production.
Demonstrated success analyzing market trends and customer requirements to drive GTM strategy.
Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Knowledge of AI Gateways, AI Routers, vector/semantic caching mechanisms, and context standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
AI market trend analysis including unit economics (GPU/token costs), AI services, prices and GTM strategies.
Hands-on familiarity with agentic frameworks, knowledge graphs, and context retrieval pipelines.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Job Description

Leads and oversees a department of over 100+ staff members and an operating budget of approximately $80M.In addition, oversees capital projects related to evolving information technology needs. Directs the delivery of information technology services to schools and offices for Baltimore County Public Schools (BCPS), including the learning management system, student information systems, web services, and business software.Position oversees data security, strategic technology planning, system-wide one on one computer initiative, disaster recovery planning, continuity of operations planning, e-rate program, systems integrity, applications programming and networking of voice, video, and data communications.Ensures that the department’s operations support the system-wide goals and priorities.Offices include Network Support Services, IT Operations, IT Security, Enterprise Solutions, and Enterprise Resource Planning.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership to set strategic technology direction and priorities for the school system. Provide administrative and instructional systems and infrastructure that are implemented and maintained to meet internal organizational requirements.
Establish and monitor controls to evaluate performance in meeting program, budget, and school system objectives.
Collaborate with schools, offices, and divisions to ensure the effective implementation of technology across the school system; manage multiple complex initiatives and achieve results within established cost, schedule, functionality, performance, and quality requirements.
Manage and develop Department of Information Technology staff and foster effective partnerships with vendors, schools, offices, and divisions. Promote a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and modernization through technical training, professional development, knowledge sharing, and best practices.
Implement data security, system analysis, design, development, testing, and quality assurance methodologies.
Advise executive leadership regarding technology strategy, emerging technologies, cybersecurity risks, and technology investment priorities.
Lead the development, refinement and integration of BCPS’ Digital Ecosystem in Student Information, Learning Management, Professional Learning, Digital Content, Instructional Tools, and Employee Effectiveness.
Ensure learning technology interoperability standards for data security, web accessibility, integration, rostering, and analytics are applied.
Supervise staff and communicate effectively while establishing and maintaining effective working relationships. Ensure and maintain confidential information.
Supervise large scale initiatives while effectively handling multiple implementation projects.
Oversee a variety of technology architectures including web-based, cloud, client/server, centralized, and distributed computing models.
Provide knowledge of vendor management and large-scale software package implementation. Identify and analyze new technologies, systems, and applications to determine requirement, compliance and system compatibility.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education, Training and Experience:

Master’s degree from an accredited college or university.
Master’s degree with an emphasis on information technology, public administration or a related field preferred.
Eight years of related experience with at least five years managing information technology systems.
Information technology experience in a public education setting is preferred.

Note: Other combination of applicable education, training, and experience which provide the knowledge, skills and abilities necessary to perform effectively in the position, may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Thorough knowledge of IT systems engineering, design, development, and support.
Thorough knowledge of computer operations, programming, and systems analysis in a large SQL, or equivalent environment.
Thorough knowledge of the systems development life cycle (SDLC).
Knowledge of personal computers and office software applications.
Knowledge of presentation software applications.
Thorough knowledge of contract and vendor management.
Skill in planning IT initiatives and analyzing their strategic business impact.
Demonstration of outstanding oral and written communications skills.
Demonstration of strong leadership and management skills.
Strong technical, process improvement, team building, human relations, organization and computer skills.
Skill in public speaking.
Skill in the use of personal computers and office software applications.
Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships.
Skill in serving as a liaison.
Ability to identify and manage technology trends and their impact on business strategies and goals.
Ability to manage challenges in a large public-sector setting.
Ability to drive enterprise technology objectives.
Ability to provide leadership, guidance, and coordination for major system-wide initiatives.
Ability to coordinate the activities of departments.
Ability to maintain sensitive and confidential information.
Ability to supervise staff.
Ability to communicate effectively.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Ability to handle confidential information effectively.
Ability to supervise staff members.
Ability to supervise large scale initiatives.
Ability to multi-task and handle multiple implementation projects at one time.

Physical And Environmental Conditions

The work of this class is generally sedentary and performed in an office environment. Work includes the operation of office equipment, including personal computers, and occasional limited physical activities. Work of this class involves travel throughout the county and to locations outside of the county.

Work schedules may include evenings and weekends. Employees may be required to work beyond their normally scheduled hours with little or no advanced notice.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Director of Engineering
to lead the engineering organization at Chromalloy’s Tampa Castings
facility and help drive the next phase of growth for our aerospace casting operations. This role provides strategic and operational leadership across production and process engineering, tooling, dimensional/layout engineering, new product introduction (NPI), and process automation initiatives.

As a key member of the site leadership team, you will lead a team of approximately 40 engineering professionals while advancing critical business priorities including automation, digital transformation, capacity expansion, yield improvement, and technical talent development. The successful candidate will foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and customer satisfaction..

Work That Matters

At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability
. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. As a people leader, you'll play a key role in developing talent, improving processes, and delivering results that help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.

Location
: On-Site, Tampa, FL
Travel:
Approximately 10-20%

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead all site engineering functions, including production and process engineering, tooling design and operations, dimensional/layout engineering, NPI, and PMA program execution.
Develop and execute the engineering strategy supporting site growth, capacity expansion, operational excellence, and customer commitments.
Drive process automation initiatives including robotics, cobots, CNC integration, digital manufacturing technologies, and AI-enabled process controls.
Sponsor and oversee the rollout of TeamCenter and digital-thread technologies to strengthen engineering processes, product lifecycle management, and data-driven decision making.
Partner with Operations, Quality, Continuous Improvement, EHS, and HR leadership to achieve site performance objectives.
Improve manufacturing yield, reduce scrap and rework, and drive engineering-led process improvements across core, wax, shell, casting, and post-cast operations.
Lead tooling and dimensional engineering teams to ensure execution of critical production and new product development requirements.
Build, develop, and retain a high-performing engineering organization through succession planning, coaching, capability development, and strategic hiring.
Manage engineering priorities, resources, and capital projects to ensure successful execution of automation, tooling, and manufacturing initiatives.
Interface with customers, program offices, and regulatory stakeholders on technical matters, product performance, and engineering compliance requirements.
Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer specifications, export control requirements, and all applicable engineering standards.
Champion a culture of continuous improvement utilizing structured problem-solving methodologies and operational excellence principles.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience
within aerospace, aviation, industrial gas turbine, or advanced manufacturing environments.
Direct experience with aerospace investment casting processes, including core, wax, shell, casting, and finishing operations.

Knowledge of equiax, directional solidification (DS), and single-crystal (SX) casting technologies.
Demonstrated experience leading large, multi-disciplinary engineering teams, including managers, supervisors, engineers, and technicians.
Proven track record leading complex engineering organizations through growth, transformation, succession, or organizational change.
Experience delivering significant capital projects, automation initiatives, or manufacturing technology programs with measurable business impact.
Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, process control, quality systems, and product development processes.
Experience partnering across operations, quality, supply chain, and executive leadership teams to achieve business objectives.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders from the shop floor to executive leadership.
Ability to establish clear priorities, develop talent, drive accountability, and deliver results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Experience with automation technologies such as robotics, cobots, machine vision systems, CNC automation, AMRs, or AI-enabled manufacturing solutions.
Experience with TeamCenter, Siemens NX, CAD/CAM systems, PLM platforms, SPC tools, or digital manufacturing systems.
Working knowledge of AS9100, FAA-regulated environments, and aerospace customer requirements.
Advanced degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, or a related field.

of the system — including agentic orchestration, reasoning, fused memory, RAG retrieval, perception models, recommendation systems, and model optimization.

You will own the intelligence substrate that powers every AI experience Lenovo ships across millions of devices. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role, combining deep technical understanding with the ability to operate across multiple layers of the AI stack.

We recently introduced Qira,
our new cross‑device Personal AI that works seamlessly across Lenovo and Motorola products. More information can be found here: https://news.lenovo.com/pressroom/press-releases/lenovo-unveils-lenovo-and-motorola-qira/

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Infrastructure & SRE
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

Postman is seeking a strategic and results-driven engineering leader who is passionate about cloud agnostic infrastructure, operational excellence, and enabling engineering teams to operate autonomously and build with confidence.

As Head of Infrastructure, you'll lead a talented and geographically distributed team of engineers across the SF Bay Area, India, and Europe, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. You'll own the infrastructure that underpins one of the world's most widely used API platforms, an environment handling ~80,000 requests per second at the front door, and be responsible for its reliability, scalability, and evolution. In addition to infrastructure, you'll own the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) function at Postman, setting the standards and practices that keep the platform reliable at scale. You'll work closely with engineering managers, product managers, and platform teams to drive the technical roadmap for our cloud agnostic infrastructure and reliability practices, ensuring we can support a large and rapidly growing engineering organization.

If you're passionate about building resilient, scalable infrastructure, have a proven track record of leading distributed engineering teams, and thrive in fast-paced environments where your decisions have company-wide impact, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

Hire, manage, mentor, and coach a geographically distributed team of infrastructure and SRE engineers across SF Bay Area, India, and Europe, helping them grow both technically and professionally.
Drive and uphold a culture of respect, integrity, inclusion, ownership, and accountability within the team.
Set clear goals and provide regular feedback to ensure your team is motivated and aligned with the platform and company vision.
Build a high-performing team with the skills and practices to reliably operate and evolve cloud agnostic infrastructure at scale.
Foster psychological safety and cross-regional collaboration across time zones.

Technical Leadership

Own the architecture and evolution of Postman's cloud agnostic infrastructure, driving improvements that increase reliability, performance, and cost efficiency at scale.
Lead the design and implementation of infrastructure improvements across Kubernetes, Cluster API, Argo, Helm, Crossplane, service mesh (Istio), AWS, and Azure environments.
Own the SRE function end to end: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, incident management, and reliability engineering practices across the platform.
Set the technical direction for how Postman's infrastructure and reliability practices evolve to support a large engineering organization with hundreds of services and dozens of teams, with a focus on enabling product teams to operate autonomously.
Partner with platform, security, and product engineering teams to ensure infrastructure and reliability decisions align with broader company goals.
Ensure infrastructure and reliability best practices are upheld across the organization, including GitOps, CI/CD, observability, on-call, and incident response.

Project Management

Own the infrastructure and reliability roadmap, balancing operational reliability with longer-term architectural investments.
Break down complex infrastructure and reliability initiatives into clear, actionable milestones and manage delivery on time and at high quality.
Proactively identify and resolve roadblocks, working across teams to unblock engineering work and minimize customer impact.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, and security teams to align on infrastructure and reliability priorities and constraints.
Foster open communication within and across teams, promoting transparency on system health, risk, error budgets, and roadmap.
Represent infrastructure and SRE in leadership forums, advocating for technical needs and communicating clearly on trade-offs.

Operational Excellence & Site Reliability Engineering

Own Postman's SRE function, establishing and evolving on-call practices, escalation policies, monitoring, and incident management across the company.
Define and track SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for critical services, using them to guide investment decisions and prioritization.
Drive a blameless postmortem culture, ensuring incidents produce durable learnings, clear action items, and measurable follow-through.
Drive a culture of continuous improvement, learning from incidents, automating toil, and reducing operational burden so that product engineering teams can ship independently.
Champion proactive reliability practices such as load testing and capacity planning to stay ahead of scale.
Maintain high standards for security, cost management, and infrastructure quality across all environments.

About You

You are a seasoned infrastructure and reliability leader with deep technical expertise and a track record of building and managing high-performing, distributed infrastructure and SRE teams. You've owned large-scale cloud agnostic environments and the reliability practices that keep them running, and know how to balance the demands of keeping the lights on with investing in architectural improvements that compound over time. You understand that great infrastructure and reliability engineering are ultimately about enabling teams to move fast independently and with confidence.

Must Have Qualifications

15+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or site reliability engineering, with 7+ years in an engineering management or leadership role.
Proven experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Cluster API, Argo, Helm, and Crossplane in large-scale production environments.
Experience with service mesh technologies, including Istio.
Deep experience with both AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience building or leading a Site Reliability Engineering function, including on-call, incident management, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement cloud agnostic infrastructure that enables engineering teams to be autonomous and self-sufficient.
Experience supporting a large engineering organization: multiple product teams, hundreds of services, high deployment frequency, and significant traffic scale.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex infrastructure and reliability topics for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-Have

Experience with GitOps workflows and infrastructure-as-code at scale.
Familiarity with FinOps / cloud cost optimization practices.
Prior experience in a SaaS or API-focused product company.
A passion for developer experience: building infrastructure and reliability practices that make product engineers faster and more confident.

The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $290,000 to $340,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data & Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.
For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.
As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!
About the AI Platform Organization

Mitratech’s AI mission is to turn its legal data and products into a unified, safe AI platform that powers the top legal workflows in every core solution and drives meaningful gains in legal team productivity and AI-influenced revenue.  

The organization is designed using Team Topologies: stream-aligned product teams sit at the top, an AI Platform layer sits in the middle, and Cloud & Data Foundation sits below. This role sits at the foundation layer and builds the infrastructure and data capabilities the rest of the AI organization depends on.  
About the Role

This role leads the Data & Cloud Platform function for the AI organization. It is accountable for the data and infrastructure foundation that makes higher-level AI platform capabilities and product experiences possible.  

The role blends cloud platform engineering with strong data responsibilities: building a unified access layer across fragmented product data stores, shaping how shared agent memory and context systems should work, operatingthe cloud foundations underneath the AI platform, and helping execute the broader data strategy.  

This is explicitly a hands-on leadership role. The team begins small — likely one to two direct reports — and you are expected to spend roughly half of your time writing and reviewing production code while the organization scales.  

What You Will Do

Own the cloud and data foundation for the AI organization — shared runtime infrastructure, CI/CD patterns, and platform services used by AI teams  

Design and build a unified data access layer for agents and AI features so they can interact with a coherent interface rather than bespoke storage and retrieval systems in each product  

Define where shared AI data should live — agent memory, context stores, and shared service datasets — while partnering with product teams that have compliance or customer-specific reasons to retain specialized storage patterns  

Build and operate data ingestion and transformation pipelines that support AI workloads and analytics, including ETL and lakehouse-style patterns where needed  

Shape the technical execution of the organization’s data strategy, especially around scale, operability, cost, and long-term maintainability  

Partner with the AI Quality & Governance team to support privacy-sensitive data handling, PII-aware workflows, and safe access patterns for observability, memory, and trace data  

Provide platform patterns, reference architectures, and reusable services that help product teams migrate toward shared foundations instead of building fragmented point solutions  

Hire, mentor, and grow the team over time — the function may later mature into separate data-platform and cloud-platform groups  

What We Are Looking For

You have 8+ years of software engineering experience including meaningful experience leading engineers as a manager or technical lead. You have built and operated shared platform and data systems in production across multiple teams.  

Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, or internal platform engineering  

Hands-on experience building or operating shared data systems: ETL/ELT pipelines, internal data services, warehouse or lakehouse environments, or other multi-team data platforms  

Experience designing platform APIs or integration layers that make complex infrastructure or fragmented systems easier for other teams to consume  

Demonstrated exposure to production AI systems, especially where data architecture and infrastructure materially affect quality, reliability, latency, or cost  

Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the architecture is evolving and the right answer may be a combination of shared services, integration layers, and selective platform consolidation  

A strong bias toward hands-on execution, systems thinking, and building scalable foundations that other teams can trust  

Experience with agent memory, retrieval systems, semantic search, or data architectures optimized for LLM-powered applications and Snowflake

Nice to Have

  Experience in multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments  

Experience in legal technology, enterprise SaaS, or regulated environments where access controls, auditability, and customer-specific constraints shape technical design  

The Stack Context

Engineering environment primarily uses Python and TypeScript  

Platform operates across AWS and OCI  

Currently leveraging FiveTran and DBT in our ETL to Snowflake  

Data infrastructure investment is active — lakehouse / warehouse patterns and agent memory architecture are early-stage  

Why This Role

This role sits at the foundation of Mitratech's AI engineering organization. You will design and build the data and cloud infrastructure that AI platform capabilities and product teams depend on — a unified data access layer, shared agent memory systems, and the cloud runtime underneath it all. You will work across the full AI organization, set the patterns other teams build on, and own a function with broad technical reach and long-term strategic importance.  

We will disclose intended pay ranges in our job ads for US-based opportunities – This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. Anticipated Pay Range: $190K – $210K Annually USD

Total compensation includes US employee benefits and annual bonus eligibility.

STD, LTD & Group Life Insurance

Remote Work

jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Join an iconic brand that is redefining the pickup truck and rugged SUV marketplace.

As the Senior Manager of Software Engineering for Order Management Platform, you will lead the engineering team responsible for Scout's system of record for customer vehicle orders and the orchestration platform that manages order state transitions throughout the vehicle purchasing and delivery journey.

You will be responsible for the engineering strategy, execution, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of the Order Management Platform while building and developing a high-performing team of software engineers. Working closely with Product Management, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, Customer Experience, and Enterprise Systems teams, you will deliver critical capabilities that power Scout's direct-to-consumer business model and support a world-class customer purchasing experience.

This role combines people leadership, technical ownership, strategic planning, and delivery accountability for one of the most business-critical domains within Scout's digital ecosystem. The role aligns with Scout's engineering leadership structure, bridging team-level execution and broader domain ownership.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for the Order Management platform.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Drive hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, and succession planning activities.
Mentor senior engineers and help develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Partner with Staff Engineers to raise the overall technical maturity and effectiveness of the team.

Domain Ownership

Own engineering execution and operational excellence for Scout's Order Management Platform.
Drive the evolution of the platform responsible for managing order lifecycle events and order state transitions from reservation through vehicle delivery.
Ensure seamless integration between Order Management Platform and key business systems including CRM, Payment, Finance, ERP, Manufacturing, Inventory, Logistics, Delivery, and Customer Experience platforms.
Balance delivery of business capabilities with long-term investments in platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
Lead engineering efforts supporting:
Order creation and management
Vehicle configuration and change management
Pricing and incentives
Financing and leasing integrations
Vehicle allocation
Production readiness
Fulfillment and delivery preparation
Customer order status and communications

Technical Leadership

Partner closely with Staff Engineers and architects to define the technical direction and long-term roadmap of the Order Management Platform.
Drive engineering best practices across architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and operational readiness.
Participate in architecture reviews and key technical decision-making processes.
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, resiliency, performance, and maintainability.
Influence platform modernization initiatives and technical investment decisions.
Drive the application of AI and intelligent automation capabilities within the Order Management domain to reduce manual processes, improve order accuracy, accelerate issue resolution, and enhance customer and employee experiences.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and partner with Product, Architecture, and Data teams to incorporate high-value AI capabilities into Order Management Platform workflows, operational processes, customer communications, and platform strategy.

Product Delivery & Execution

Partner with Product Management to translate business objectives into technical solutions and execution plans.
Drive predictable delivery of roadmap commitments through effective planning, risk management, dependency coordination, and execution oversight.
Align engineering priorities with business goals while balancing short-term delivery and long-term platform sustainability.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, Customer Experience, and IT teams.
Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple business domains and enterprise systems.
Build strong partnerships with vendors, enterprise teams, and external technology partners where required.
Help drive alignment across teams to deliver end-to-end customer and business outcomes.

Operational Excellence

Establish and track operational metrics for system availability, reliability, performance, and service health.
Own production readiness, incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement processes.
Ensure engineering teams maintain operational ownership and accountability for production systems.
Drive automation, monitoring, alerting, and observability best practices.
Establish service-level objectives and reliability standards for critical order processing workflows.

Location & Travel Expectations
:

This role requires regular attendance in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

10+ years of software engineering experience.

What you'll gain

jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.

Preferred Education

None

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Strong hands-on technical background with ability to dive deep into complex systems
Deep frontend engineering expertise: Strong understanding of modern web development (React, TypeScript, component design systems)
Proven ability to distill complex technical domains into clear patterns and best practices
Experience creating reusable patterns/frameworks adopted across multiple teams or products
Track record of elevating team capabilities through mentorship and knowledge sharing
Demonstrated success partnering with Product and Design to drive execution
Experience managing or collaborating closely with other engineering managers
Experience managing multiple product areas or technical domains simultaneously

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience managing managers or leading leaders
Domain knowledge in at least one TEAR area: Security (RBAC, SSO, BYOK, encryption), Networking (VPC, PrivateLink, routing), or Billing/Payments (subscription models, usage tracking)
Experience evolving platform teams to serve broader organizational needs
Proficient with or highly curious about AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
Track record of driving developer productivity improvements through tooling, automation, or process innovation

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Manager - Ecosystems & Integration
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

Postman is seeking a strategic and results-driven engineering leader who is passionate about APIs, partnerships, ecosystems, collaboration, and developer success.

As the Sr. Engineering Manager for Ecosystems & Integration, you’ll build and lead a talented group of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence while guiding the team to build scalable, reliable, high-performance features that power the future of our Ecosystem. You’ll work closely with other engineering managers, product managers, and designers to drive the vision and execution of the product roadmap that will empower developers + partners to create rich, integrated experiences that will help teams create, collaborate, manage, and scale their APIs and solutions. This position requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of developer ecosystems and a passion for delivering exceptional developer experiences. You will define our technical strategy to achieve our ecosystem goals, including how extensibility, integration frameworks and public APIs work at Postman, how integrations look, feel, and behave to our end users, and how customers discover, install, and buy apps via a marketplace.

If you’re passionate about building products that make an impact, have a proven track record of leading engineering teams to success, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, we want you on our team!

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Development

Hire, manage, mentor, and coach several teams of engineers, helping them grow both technically and professionally.
Drive and uphold a culture of respect, integrity, inclusion, ownership, and accountability within the team.
Set clear goals and provide regular feedback to ensure your team is motivated and aligned with the product and company vision.
Design strategies for developer success across many areas, including those that are still in the early stages of finding their product-market fit.
Experiment, design, and influence rigorously the creation of new kinds of experiences for consumers and the new business models that will support builders, creators, partners, and developers.

Technical Leadership

Facilitate and coordinate the technical design and execution of complex features for Postman’s ecosystem platform ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability for millions of customers and partners everywhere.
Partner with leaders at strategic companies in the ecosystem to define high value product offerings through Postman app as well as the partner app and marketplaces.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineering managers, to deliver high-quality, customer-focused features.
Ensure engineering best practices are upheld, including code reviews, testing, and continuous delivery.

Project Management

Own the engineering roadmap for Ecosystem, including Developer Tooling, Strategic Integrations and Marketplace, balancing short-term delivery with long-term technical and business investments.
Break down complex initiatives into clear, actionable milestones and manage the delivery of these projects on time.
Proactively identify and resolve roadblocks, ensuring your team meets its deadlines and delivers features with high quality.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, and design teams to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Foster open communication within the team, promoting collaboration and transparency.
Represent the engineering team in meetings with leadership, advocating for technical needs and constraints while aligning with broader company goals.

Operational Excellence

Ensure the reliability and performance of Ecosystem products by driving operational best practices for monitoring, logging, and incident response.
Optimize the team’s workflow by implementing automation and improving processes where needed.
Maintain a high level of code quality and system robustness by promoting test-driven development and continuous integration.

About You

You are a seasoned engineering leader with a passion for building great products, fostering strong teams, and solving challenging technical problems. You have a track record of managing high-performing engineering teams and driving technical projects from concept to delivery geared towards helping 3rd party developers build impactful apps quickly and successfully (ex. Shopify, Atlassian, HubSpot, Slack, etc.)

Must Have Qualifications

10+ years of experience as a software engineer, with 5+ years in an engineering management or leadership role.
Experience building and launching 0 → 1 ecosystem features, platform extensibility (UI components, frameworks, APIs), developer tooling and/or products for external technical audiences.
Proven experience leading teams in fast-paced, agile environments.
Strong background in backend or frontend development (experience with React, Java a plus).
Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor engineers, helping them grow and succeed.
Experience managing the full software development lifecycle, from design through production support.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-Have

Familiarity with API development, cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
Prior experience working in a SaaS or cloud-based environment.
A passion for building systems that prioritize scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $260,000 to $300,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity

jobs.description:
At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity, and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.  

About the role:

CHANEL is looking for a Senior Technical Delivery Manager, CRM Technology & Client Data
to join our US TECH CRM team in New York City.
The Senior Technical Delivery Manager, CRM Technology & Client Data at CHANEL acts as the bridge between strategic Salesforce CRM vision, the business and hands-on execution. This Delivery Senior Manager is the primary subject matter expert for Salesforce Data 360 and the Chanel CRM ecosystem (Salesforce Data 360, Marketing Cloud, Google BigQuery). Strong partnership with the Tech Data 360 Product Owner, on the strategic roadmap, is necessary. The ideal candidate has expertise in and is responsible for designing, validating, and leading the implementation of scalable and innovative technical solutions.

The Senior Delivery Manager is a technical program manager who will dive deep into data models, integration patterns, and platform capabilities to guide business stakeholders on how to best leverage our client data platforms to solve complex business challenges. This IC role will partner with several internal teams to define and manage initiatives to drive the business in a complex luxury retail environment. The role will manage the vendor, working with business stakeholders, internal PM/BA team, testers, and other internal and external technology teams to ensure on time and successful delivery of the CRM roadmap.

What impact you can create at CHANEL: 

Translate Architecture into Action: In close partnership with the CRM Architect, deconstruct high-level architectural blueprints into detailed technical designs, data flows, and actionable user stories for the development team
Own Project-Level Design: Serve as the technical design authority for the delivery team, making critical implementation decisions for components within Salesforce Data Cloud (e.g., data stream configuration, identity resolution logic, Calculated Insight formulas)
Ensure Architectural Adherence: Act as the guardian of the architect's vision during implementation, ensuring all development work strictly adheres to established enterprise standards, patterns, and best practices
Lead the Build: Lead the Agile Delivery Team responsible for executing the CRM technical roadmap. Manage sprint planning, resolve technical roadblocks, and ensure the on-time delivery of high-quality code
Hands-On Validation: Conduct proof-of-concepts and personally validate new Salesforce Data Cloud features to confirm their suitability and application against the architectural design
Implement Best Practices: Own and enforce the team's engineering standards, including environment management, release protocols, code versioning (CI/CD), and deployment methodologies
Drive Quality: Implement and manage rigorous code review processes, automated testing, and QA practices to ensure the stability and integrity of all deliverables
Technical Problem Solving: Act as the primary escalation point for the most complex technical issues within the platform, performing deep-dive analysis and orchestrating solutions
Maintain an expert-level, feature-by-feature understanding of the Salesforce Data 360 Cloud platform and its integration capabilities
Advise the Product Owner and business stakeholders on the practical application and effort required for new features, grounding their requests in technical reality
Provide continuous feedback to the CRM Architect on platform performance, limitations, and opportunities for improvement discovered during implementation

 You are energized by: 

Being highly collaborative, adaptable to different audiences and ways of working
Ability to navigate and influence cross-functionally, acting as a team player
Strong relationship management skills
Entrepreneurial spirit
Strong organizational & management skills, ability to multi-task concurrent projects and help team adhere to deadlines
Ability to independently identify issues, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions

 What you will bring to the team: 

Hands-On Technical Leader: A "player-coach" who is as comfortable leading a technical design session as they are reviewing complex code and configuration. This captures the essence of being both a manager and a practitioner
Pragmatic & Analytical Problem-Solver: Possesses a strong analytical mindset to independently diagnose complex issues, balanced with the pragmatism to balance technical excellence with the practical needs of business delivery
Collaborative & Influential Communicator: A natural collaborator who can build strong partnerships with architects and developers, and effectively communicate and influence across all levels, from technical teams to senior business leaders
Expert Delivery & Project Manager: Demonstrates proven organizational skills to manage concurrent projects, indirect teams, and vendor partners, ensuring deadlines are met and teams are aligned
Commitment to Engineering Excellence: Shows meticulous attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality, robust, and scalable solutions.
Highly Desired: Salesforce Data 360/ CDP Cloud Consultant
Strongly Preferred: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform Developer I, Data 360 Consultant, and/or other relevant consultant certifications
Understanding of CRM, CDP, Data Analytics, Data Processing (Master Data Management, Data Quality Management) and Consumer Databases principles
Strong knowledge and experience of Consumer databases and CRM development and configuration
Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
Demonstrated use of basic AI in the current role, such as automation of administrative tasks or personal productivity examples, must have
Knowledge of Agentforce Vibes for rapid prototyping, very nice to have

Position Logistics:  

Based in New York City with hybrid work model – 3 days on-site minimum in Midtown Manhattan - New York City (NYC preferred, will consider candidates for office in Piscataway, NJ)
Minimum of 7 years CRM / CDP / Data 360 experience, with Salesforce expertise (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data 360/CDP and Salesforce Core)
Highly Desired: Salesforce Data 360/ CDP Cloud Consultant
Strongly Preferred: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform Developer I, Data 360 Consultant, and/or other relevant consultant certifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. A master’s degree is a plus.

Chanel, Inc. reserves the right to edit, change, or make exceptions on designations where circumstances where deemed appropriate.  

Compensation:   

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $87,500-$175,000.  A base salary is one component of the total compensation for this position. Other forms of variable pay [may/will] be offered for this position. Other components [may/will] include bonus potential, benefits, and/or perks.   

Benefits and Perks:

Family and care giving benefits (inclusive of parental leave, fertility support, MilkStork, and Care.com Membership)   
Generous paid time off policies to include vacation, holiday, sick and volunteer days    
401K and other incentives    
Robust healthcare offerings; medical, dental, vision, MDLIVE (virtual care), One Medical, Flexible Spending Accounts (Health Care & Dependent Care), Health Savings Account and Employee Assistance Program   
Life insurance, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Health Advocate, International Business Travel Accident & Medical, and Commuter Transit & Parking   

Additional Information:   

Chanel is a private company whose values are grounded in creating conditions for people to perform at their best and feel fulfilled and confident in their work. We offer a unique work environment where individuals are encouraged to better understand the brand, the business, and motivations, so that together we can unlock the possibilities of growth. This is reflected in:

At CHANEL, we are intentional in promoting Diversity & Inclusion. We foster respect, empathy, and dignity for all.  We believe strongly that the diversity of our people across the full spectrum of human differences is essential to our organisation and the connections we have with each other and our clients.    
We offer Employee Resource Groups in the US that are voluntary, open to all, employee-led groups formed around a shared identity or lived experience, whose aim is to foster a diverse, inclusive, and equitable community aligned with the values and missions of the communities they support.   

Chanel Community:

CHANEL Community empowers our employees to channel their passions, talents and sense of purpose to contribute to and learn from our communities.   
Employees are encouraged to take time off annually to volunteer through the CHANEL Community. CHANEL also matches employee donations to select charitable organizations.

CHANEL Mission 1.5° is our climate action plan. It is focused on transforming the business in line with the ambitions of the Paris Agreement on climate change to limit the average global mean temperature increase to 1.5 degrees Celsius above preindustrial levels.

Since 2011, Fondation CHANEL’s mission is for women and girls to be free to shape their own destiny.  Through multi-year partnerships with financial and technical support, Fondation CHANEL is committed to improving the safety and autonomy of women and adolescent girls around the world, impacting over a million women and girls in its first 10 years.       
For more information, please navigate to the Fondation Chanel website here

jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Sr. Director, Strategic

Technology Alliances

At Black Duck Software, we are redefining how organizations secure software across the modern development lifecycle. As a leader in application security testing, software composition analysis, software supply chain security, and application security posture management, we help organizations build trust into every stage of software development.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Strategic Technology Alliances to establish and scale Black Duck’s technology partnership ecosystem. This highly visible leadership role will define alliance strategy, build transformative technology relationships, and create integration-led growth opportunities that accelerate innovation, customer value, and revenue.

Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to prioritize and operationalize strategic integrations.
Define and track metrics including integration adoption, partner-sourced pipeline, influenced revenue, customer engagement, and ecosystem growth.
Develop scalable playbooks that move partnerships from Discovery to Pilot to Commercialization to Scale.

Build a World-Class Alliance Function

Create governance processes, scorecards, stage-gate frameworks, executive steering committees, QBRs, and KPI dashboards.
Establish disciplined operating rhythms that enable transparency, accountability, and measurable business outcomes.
Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority across Sales, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, and Legal.
Serve as Black Duck’s primary executive leader for technology alliance strategy and ecosystem expansion.

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First Year, You Will

Establish Black Duck’s technology alliance operating model and governance framework.
Build a prioritized portfolio of strategic technology partnerships.
Launch high-value integrations that enhance customer value and platform differentiation.
Create measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth.

Required

jobs.description:
Sr Director, Product Management (PXDP65)

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

As part of the Global Payments Network Product team, you will help lead and own the core authorization domain that sits at the center of every transaction we process: authorization decisioning, rules and configuration, routing, resiliency, and trust (fraud/risk signaling, credential validation, tokenization). This leader will be accountable end-to-end for the platform's ability to authorize transactions correctly, securely, and reliably at scale across all networks (DN, DCI, PULSE) and schemes, setting the highest bar for change control, testing, and uptime given that any defect in this domain directly threatens live money movement — while drawing a clear, defensible boundary between what belongs in the core versus what should live in adjacent domains (boarding, client servicing, settlement, regulatory/risk, data & insights, etc.). The ideal candidate has deep experience running mission-critical, high-availability transaction-processing systems in payments or financial services, a track record of building platforms designed for products not yet imagined rather than re-architecting around today's requirements, and the organizational maturity to partner closely with peer domain owners, product, and risk/compliance stakeholders during a major platform migration and cutover.

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions

Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment
