jobs.title: Senior Building Technology Systems Director
jobs.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.
Ensure technical execution aligns with organization-wide technical expertise and capabilities.
Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.
Engage resources in response to areas in need of improvement, fostering a culture of quality.

jobs.title: SAP Technology and D&A Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Director, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by analyzing their needs, implementing software solutions, and providing comprehensive training and support. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. Translating the vision, you set the tone and inspire others to follow, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will be a guardian of our reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will create a healthy working environment while maximizing client satisfaction and cultivating the potential in others. By actively teaming across the PwC Network, you will leverage our collective strength to identify market gaps and convert opportunities into success for the firm.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic direction and business development efforts within SAP technology consulting
Overseeing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
Managing client engagements to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
Implementing software solutions and providing training for seamless integration of business applications
Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and insights generation
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful outcomes for the firm
Developing new ideas and solutions to drive thought leadership and innovation
Balancing long-term and short-term strategic thinking to address system-level enablers
Cultivating potential in others through mentorship and leadership across the PwC Network

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
Leading strategic technology planning and systemic thinking initiatives
Excelling in strategic questioning and innovation for client solutions
Cultivating potential through coaching and feedback within teams
Promoting technological advances in SAP environments

The salary range for this position is: $155,000 - $410,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law. 

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled or the posting is removed, unless otherwise set forth on the following webpage. Please visit this link for information about anticipated application deadlines: https://pwc.to/us-application-deadlines

jobs.title: SAP Technology and D&A Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Director, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by analyzing their needs, implementing software solutions, and providing comprehensive training and support. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. Translating the vision, you set the tone and inspire others to follow, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will be a guardian of our reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will create a healthy working environment while maximizing client satisfaction and cultivating the potential in others. By actively teaming across the PwC Network, you will leverage our collective strength to identify market gaps and convert opportunities into success for the firm.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic direction and business development efforts within SAP technology consulting
Overseeing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
Managing client engagements to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
Implementing software solutions and providing training for seamless integration of business applications
Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and insights generation
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful outcomes for the firm
Developing new ideas and solutions to drive thought leadership and innovation
Balancing long-term and short-term strategic thinking to address system-level enablers
Cultivating potential in others through mentorship and leadership across the PwC Network

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
Leading strategic technology planning and systemic thinking initiatives
Excelling in strategic questioning and innovation for client solutions
Cultivating potential through coaching and feedback within teams
Promoting technological advances in SAP environments

The salary range for this position is: $155,000 - $410,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. jobs.title: Senior Building Technology Systems Director
jobs.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.

jobs.title: Senior Building Technology Systems Director
jobs.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.
Ensure technical execution aligns with organization-wide technical expertise and capabilities.
Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.
Engage resources in response to areas in need of improvement, fostering a culture of quality.

The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Senior Manager, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results, motivating and coaching teams to solve complex problems. You will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate, while developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive teams that contribute to the success of our firm.

In this role within our Business Application Consulting practice, you will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. You will craft and convey clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story, apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems, and validate outcomes with clients. Your ability to direct teams through complexity and demonstrate composure in challenging situations will be crucial in driving operational efficiency and achieving project success.

jobs.description:
VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure

About the Opportunity

A national workforce development organization dedicated to connecting skilled, work-authorized professionals to career-aligned employment across the United States is seeking a VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure. The organization focuses on creating economic opportunity, scaling programmatic impact, and leveraging modern technology and artificial intelligence to drive operational efficiency and positive participant outcomes.

Role Overview

The VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure is responsible for defining and executing the organization’s technology strategy and infrastructure across internal operations and externally facing digital products. Reporting to the President and working closely with the CEO and executive leadership, this leader guides the organization toward an AI- and product-first model while upholding operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. This role operates in a full-time, remote capacity within the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Own the overarching technology strategy across staff infrastructure and external user- and partner-facing products, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and mission-aligned.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap encompassing staff infrastructure, IT operations, data systems and reporting, platform evolution, core digital products, and system integrations.
Translate organizational strategy into sequenced roadmaps with defined timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and metrics.
Provide executive leadership with clear tradeoff analyses and recommendations on priorities based on organizational capacity and impact.
Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and release planning.
Partner with product leadership to guide technical architecture, build-versus-buy evaluations, platform selection, integration strategy, and delivery for participant and partner platforms.
Establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI adoption in collaboration with cross-functional committees, covering data privacy, security controls, vendor risk management, quality assurance, bias mitigation, and human oversight.
Build the technical foundation for AI readiness, focusing on data quality, system integrations, and scalable infrastructure for feature deployment and experimentation.
Oversee internal IT operations and service delivery, including help desk support, hardware lifecycle management, access controls, onboarding, offboarding, and technical troubleshooting.
Define IT service standards, manage vendor relationships and managed service provider contracts, and lead staff training initiatives to maximize adoption of organizational infrastructure and AI tools.
Oversee the customer relationship management (CRM) platform and associated systems as the operational backbone for programs, development, and reporting.
Direct enterprise data strategy in collaboration with research and evaluation leadership to maintain reliable governance, dashboards, and reporting for program improvement, funding requirements, and executive decision-making.
Implement a consistent project management framework across technology initiatives to maintain accountability, predictability, and cross-functional transparency.
Lead cybersecurity strategy, data protection controls, and operational risk management, maintaining a risk register and presenting mitigations to executive leadership and the Board.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Proven experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing digital products or platforms, including demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence.
Strong program and project delivery discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities in a resource-constrained environment.
Experience with AI implementation, data governance, and enterprise systems.
Demonstrated experience partnering with product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and technical execution.

Demonstrated commitment to the organization's workforce development mission.

Experience with Salesforce CRM platforms.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short-term disability and life insurance; paid parental leave; paid time off; a retirement plan with an employer match; and a remote work schedule.

jobs.title: FinOps Platform Engineering, Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
This is a hybrid remote/in-office role, Iselin, NJ

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team:

FinOps operates like a product team: the business — Engineering, Product, Finance, Procurement, and Operations — is our customer, and cost/usage insight is the product. The FinOps Platform Engineering, Sr. Manager is the technical builder who makes that possible: this role owns the tooling, integrations, and automation that let FinOps operate as an autonomous, standalone unit rather than a group of people manually pulling numbers on request.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the Sr. Manager level. You will design, code, and ship the FinOps platform yourself — the title reflects seniority and scope of ownership, not a coordination or people-management function.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain the tooling and integrations that connect cost and usage data sources — AWS, Snowflake, and HDC (our clinical data cloud) — into a unified FinOps platform.
Build automated tagging enforcement and validation pipelines against the framework defined by the FinOps Architect, so compliance is built in at deploy time, not checked after the fact.
Build self-service tools and APIs that let Engineering, Product, and Finance pull their own cost and usage insights on demand — treating internal stakeholders as customers of a product, not requesters in a queue.
Own the data pipelines feeding executive and team-level dashboards (ThoughtSpot, Unified Portal), including reconciliation logic that ties attributed and unattributed spend back to the invoice — automating what would otherwise require manual analysis.
Automate cost allocation, showback/chargeback calculations, and unit-economics computations (e.g., cost per trial, cost per environment).
Instrument and meter AI/LLM usage and spend across providers — token-level telemetry, attribution to teams and workloads, and integration with gateway and measurement tooling — so AI cost is as visible and governable as cloud cost.
Build integrations with vendor and procurement systems to automate renewal tracking, contract data ingestion, and scorecard generation.
Build anomaly detection and automated alerting on cost and usage data, closing the gap between a monthly report and a real-time signal.
Build automation to audit and optimize Savings Plan / Reserved Instance coverage, rather than tracking it manually.
Partner with Engineering to instrument systems for cost and usage telemetry at the source, including detection of cost regressions introduced by code and configuration changes.
Own the technical roadmap for FinOps tooling, including build-vs-buy decisions on platform components.
Apply standard engineering rigor — version control, testing, CI/CD — to the FinOps tooling stack.
Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.

Qualifications:

7+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, with a Bachelor's degree; hands-on experience building FinOps or cloud cost management capabilities, products, or services is a strong plus.
Demonstrated fluency building with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as an integral part of your production engineering workflow.
Hands-on engineering skills: proficiency in Python or a comparable language, strong SQL, and experience designing APIs and data pipelines.
Hands-on expertise with AWS and Snowflake, including integrating with cloud provider billing and usage data (e.g., AWS Cost & Usage Reports, Snowflake usage views) and BI/analytics platforms (e.g., ThoughtSpot, Tableau).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, CI/CD) sufficient to enforce tagging and policy at deploy time.
Ability to design and ship self-service tooling for internal stakeholders — a product mindset applied to an internal function.
Experience building alerting or anomaly-detection systems, or automating financial/operational calculations, is a plus.
Experience metering or governing AI/LLM usage and spend (token-level cost attribution, LLM gateways, or usage telemetry) is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Building Technology Systems Director
jobs.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.
Ensure technical execution aligns with organization-wide technical expertise and capabilities.
Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.
Engage resources in response to areas in need of improvement, fostering a culture of quality.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering - Policy and Data Platform
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/13/2026

Location: Milpitas, CA or Boston, MA Preferred Hybrid

Alternate Locations: Open to remote anywhere in the US for candidates outside of these locations

Meet the Team

You will join the Policy and Data Platform team, the group responsible for building the security policy systems that protect customers' environments. The team builds the platform that lets customers define, enforce, and manage security policies at scale across their infrastructure. This work spans UI, data engineering, platform architecture, and policy enforcement, with a strong emphasis on reliability and trust. The team works across Cisco to enable other teams to integrate with the platform, strengthening the signals used to recommend new policies and expanding the number of enforcement points.

Your Impact

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the Policy and Data Platform.
Build and scale a multi-team engineering organization, developing managers and senior engineers.
Translate customer security policy needs into durable technical systems.
Partner with product and security teams to align platform capabilities with customer needs.
Set engineering standards and operational practices that improve platform reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, with 15+ years of software engineering experience.
5+ years of experience in an engineering leadership role managing managers or senior engineers.
Experience architecting and scaling data platforms or policy systems in production.
Experience managing engineering budgets and resource planning for an organization of 30+ engineers.
Experience delivering large-scale distributed systems from design through production launch.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building systems that secure customer environments, such as access control, firewall, or workload protection policies.
Familiarity with security policy enforcement across cloud, network, or hybrid environments.
Strong communicator able to translate technical tradeoffs into business terms for executives.
Experience building and scaling engineering teams through periods of rapid growth.
Demonstrated ability to build trust and alignment across cross-functional, matrixed organizations.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Team

We are hiring a Head of Engineering to own the craft, quality, and technical direction of a roughly 30-person engineering organization. This is deliberately not a role about growing headcount to 150. It is a role about making a small, senior team produce output that looks like a much larger one — by raising the engineering bar, tightening the systems that move real money, and being genuinely in the code and the architecture rather than adjacent to it.

You will lead through a mix of direct reports and a small group of engineering managers and tech leads, partnering closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance. You will spend your time on design reviews, incident retros, hiring, and the handful of technical bets that determine whether we can support the next order of magnitude of transaction volume.

If your ideal week is entirely calendar blocks and roadmap decks, this is not the right role. If your ideal week includes a hard design debate, a code review that changes someone's mind, and a coaching conversation that raises a manager's ceiling, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Set and own Rain’s engineering quality bar across system design, code review, testing, observability, documentation, and technical decision-making, ensuring correctness is treated as critical for systems that move customer funds.
Provide hands-on technical leadership by staying active in the codebase, reviewing critical PRs and designs, prototyping high-risk components, debugging production issues, and making key architectural and build-vs.-buy decisions.
Own the technical architecture and strategy across card issuing, wallets, ledger, money movement, onchain settlement, and integrations with card networks and banking partners.
Drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence by establishing SLOs, improving incident response, capacity planning for 10x growth, and designing resilient systems with graceful degradation, idempotency, and replay capabilities.
Build security, compliance, and correctness into the platform by design, partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, and Security to meet PCI, SOC 2, fraud-control, regulatory, and blockchain infrastructure requirements.
Increase engineering velocity without sacrificing quality through improvements to CI/CD, developer tooling, local environments, technical debt management, and architecture that enables teams to ship safely and independently.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization by coaching engineering managers and technical leads, maintaining a high hiring and performance bar, establishing clear team ownership, and partnering effectively across Product, Design, Risk, Compliance, and GTM.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

10+ years building production software, including 4+ years leading engineers — ideally as a Head of Engineering, Director, or Senior EM at a company where the systems handled real consequences.
Currently and demonstrably hands-on. You have written or reviewed meaningful production code within the last year and you want a role where that continues.
Deep experience with distributed backend systems at scale: data modeling, consistency and idempotency, queues and event-driven design, and the operational reality of running all of it.
A track record of raising an engineering bar. You can point to specific practices you introduced and the measurable change in quality, velocity, or reliability that followed.
Real reliability ownership — you have carried a pager, run incident command during a serious outage, and built the follow-through that kept it from recurring.
Experience in payments, fintech, banking infrastructure, or another domain where money, ledgers, or regulatory obligations made correctness non-negotiable.
Strong hiring and coaching instincts, with managers or senior engineers you have developed who would work for you again.
Clear written communication. You can make a complex technical tradeoff legible to a CEO, a compliance officer, and a partner's engineering team in the same week.
Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You would rather ship something correct this quarter than design something perfect for next year.

Bonus attributes:

Hands-on experience with card issuing, processing, or the Visa and Mastercard network stack.
Working knowledge of stablecoins, onchain settlement, custody and key management, or EVM and Solana infrastructure.
Experience operating under SOC 2, PCI DSS, or bank and program-manager oversight.
Experience leading distributed or multi-region teams.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits
🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals
💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan
📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness
📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals
🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits
✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $280K - $380K

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

The Sr. Director of Engineering Operations & Security will lead the organization responsible for how Vida builds, ships, secures, and operates from the test suite and the deploy pipeline, through our cloud infrastructure and corporate IT estate, out to the client data integrations and escalation paths where our enterprise customers feel every failure directly. Own test strategy and automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud platform, and developer environments.
Set and enforce the quality gates and deployment practices that let product engineering move quickly without breaking things.
Drive measurable improvement in developer productivity, build and deploy reliability, and time to recovery.

Unify on-call and incident practice across the organization.
Additional resposibilities as needed.

Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Team

We are hiring a Head of Engineering to own the craft, quality, and technical direction of a roughly 50-person engineering organization. This is deliberately not a role about growing headcount to 150. It is a role about making a small, senior team produce output that looks like a much larger one — by raising the engineering bar, tightening the systems that move real money, and being genuinely in the code and the architecture rather than adjacent to it.

You will lead through a mix of direct reports and a small group of engineering managers and tech leads, partnering closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance. You will spend your time on design reviews, incident retros, hiring, and the handful of technical bets that determine whether we can support the next order of magnitude of transaction volume.

If your ideal week is entirely calendar blocks and roadmap decks, this is not the right role. If your ideal week includes a hard design debate, a code review that changes someone's mind, and a coaching conversation that raises a manager's ceiling, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Own engineering strategy and architecture across card issuing, wallets, ledger, money movement, onchain settlement, and integrations with card networks and banking partners — including the multi-year technical roadmap that gets us there.
Set and own Rain's engineering quality bar across system design, code review, testing, observability, documentation, and technical decision-making, ensuring correctness is treated as critical for systems that move customer funds.
Go deep where the risk is. You won't own day-to-day code, but you will review critical designs, weigh in on the highest-consequence architecture and build-vs.-buy decisions, and be technical enough that no one can hand you a bad design and have it pass.
Drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence by establishing SLOs, improving incident response, capacity planning for 10x growth, and designing resilient systems with graceful degradation, idempotency, and replay capabilities.
Build security, compliance, and correctness into the platform by design, partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, and Security to meet PCI, SOC 2, fraud-control, regulatory, and blockchain infrastructure requirements.
Increase engineering velocity without sacrificing quality through improvements to CI/CD, developer tooling, local environments, technical debt management, and architecture that enables teams to ship safely and independently.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization by hiring and coaching engineering managers and technical leads, establishing clear team ownership and boundaries, and owning headcount planning and the performance bar.
Operate as a member of the leadership team — translating company strategy into technical plans, partnering across Product, Design, Risk, Compliance, and GTM, and representing engineering to the board, banking and network partners, and customers.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

15+ years building production software, including 8+ years leading engineers and meaningful time leading managers.
Current technical credibility. You have written or reviewed meaningful production code recently enough that an architecture review is a place you add value, not a place you nod along.
Deep experience with distributed backend systems at scale: data modeling, consistency and idempotency, queues and event-driven design, and the operational reality of running all of it.
A track record of raising an engineering bar. You can point to specific practices you introduced and the measurable change in quality, velocity, or reliability that followed.
Real reliability ownership — you have carried a pager, run incident command during a serious outage, and built the follow-through that kept it from recurring.
Experience in payments, fintech, banking infrastructure, or another domain where money, ledgers, or regulatory obligations made correctness non-negotiable.
You have hired and developed engineering managers, not only engineers. There are leaders you grew who would come work for you again.
Clear written communication. You can make a complex technical tradeoff legible to a CEO, a compliance officer, and a partner's engineering team in the same week.
Executive range. You are as comfortable in a board or partner conversation as you are in a design review, and you can hold a technical position under commercial pressure.
Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You would rather ship something correct this quarter than design something perfect for next year.

Bonus attributes:

Hands-on experience with card issuing, processing, or the Visa and Mastercard network stack.
Working knowledge of stablecoins, onchain settlement, custody and key management, or EVM and Solana infrastructure.
Experience operating under SOC 2, PCI DSS, or bank and program-manager oversight.
Experience leading distributed or multi-region teams.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Are you a technology leader who enjoys connecting business strategy with innovative technology?
At ENVE, we're looking for an experienced technology leader to help shape the future of our technology within our newly global organization. This isn't a traditional IT management role. We're seeking someone who can build teams, develop technology strategy, and translate business priorities into scalable technology solutions that help our company grow. Since 2007, we’ve been driven by innovation, precision, and passion for creating world-class products. Our team is made up of dedicated professionals who take pride in their work and support one another in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do…

This role combines strategic technology leadership with practical execution. You'll help define ENVE's technology roadmap while leading the people, vendors, and systems that keep our business moving.

Enterprise business systems and ERP strategy
Internal IT operations and technology support

The position will also provide cross-functional oversight of Quality, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Field Service, and R&D activities and report key priorities, risks, and progress to senior management.

Key Responsibilities:

Functional Oversight and Management:

Provide functional oversight of Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Field Service, and R&D activities, ensuring alignment with company priorities and applicable regulatory and quality requirements.
Directly supervise the Quality Systems Manager and Field Service and Product Engineering Manager, providing guidance, prioritization, and support while maintaining appropriate functional ownership within each area.

Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and escalation of significant quality, regulatory, manufacturing, service, or product-development issues.
Support resource planning, prioritization, and coordination of activities necessary to maintain regulatory approvals, product quality, manufacturing continuity, and product-development objectives.

Maintain knowledge of applicable U.S. and international medical device regulations, standards, and guidance, including FDA requirements, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 series standards, MDSAP, EU MDR, and other applicable market-specific requirements.
Prepare, coordinate, and maintain U.S. and international regulatory submissions, registrations, licenses, and technical documentation, including FDA submissions and international market approvals.
Manage ongoing regulatory activities for marketed devices, including registration renewals and amendments, responses to regulatory questions and questions and requests for additional information, and coordination with regulatory authorities, distributors, authorized representatives, consultants, and other international regulatory partners.
Evaluate and document the regulatory impact of proposed product, design, software, manufacturing, supplier, labeling, and process changes and determine whether regulatory notification, submission, additional testing, or other regulatory action is required prior to implementation.
Review and approve product labeling, Instructions for Use (IFUs), specifications, marketing materials, and other product documentation for consistency with applicable regulatory requirements and cleared/approved intended uses.
Support regulatory strategy and requirements for new products, accessories, product improvements, and entry into new international markets, including identification of applicable standards, testing, documentation, and submission requirements.
Coordinate regulatory activities involving external test laboratories and other technical resources to obtain applicable safety, performance, EMC, software, or other testing and documentation needed to support regulatory compliance and market approvals.
Monitor changes to applicable regulations and standards, assess their potential impact on existing products and registrations, and coordinate implementation of necessary actions.
Maintain regulatory records and documentation in accordance with Aesthetics Biomedical's QMS and ensure regulatory commitments and requirements are appropriately communicated to affected functions.

Participate in CAPA, nonconformance, complaint, and change-control activities when regulatory or technical input is required.
Participate in product risk-management activities in accordance with ISO 14971.

Ensure regulatory and engineering activities are appropriately documented within the QMS.

Assist with investigation and troubleshooting of manufacturing nonconformities, product failures, complaints, and field service issues, including root-cause investigation and implementation of appropriate technical corrections.
Support manufacturing and field service activities as needed, including process/equipment validation, production troubleshooting, supplier and contract manufacturer support, and complex device troubleshooting or repair.

Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in regulatory affairs within the medical device industry.
Familiarity with ISO 13485, MDSAP, ISO 14971, QMSR, and IEC 60601 preferred.
Understanding of medical device design controls, verification and validation, and engineering change processes preferred.
Strong technical troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong technical writing, documentation, and organizational skills.
Ability to work cross-functionally with Regulatory, Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Field Service, suppliers, contract manufacturers, test laboratories, and international partners.

High-Performance Culture
Customer Focus
Operational Excellence
Innovation
Financial Strength

Own it
