Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Sr. Director, AI Platform Engineering

Job Summary

The Sr. Director of AI Platform Engineering leads the engineering teams supporting Evolent's enterprise AI platform initiatives, with a focus on three capability areas: the document pipeline, event-driven architecture, and agentic user interfaces. The role is accountable for engineering execution in these areas — staffing the teams, delivering the software, and operating it in production — working within the platform direction set with Enterprise Architecture and Product.

This is a build-the-team-while-you-build-the-platform role. The leader will stand up and grow multiple engineering teams from an early-stage footprint and deliver capability on a roadmap where later work depends on the foundations landing first. Success requires equal strength in enterprise-scale delivery judgment and in hiring, organizing and developing engineering talent under delivery pressure.

Architectural direction and platform design standards are set in partnership with Enterprise Architecture. This role is a primary contributor to and implementer of them rather than their sole owner. The Sr. Director partners closely with Architecture, Product, Data Engineering, Security and the core system engineering teams, and represents the platform engineering organization in executive forums. As a leader in the engineering organization, the Sr. Director fosters a culture of quality, customer obsession, product mindset, and technical excellence.

What You Will Be Doing

Support New Enterprise-Scale Platform Initiatives

Lead the engineering teams delivering the document pipeline, event-driven architecture and agentic user interface capabilities, from build through production support.
Support roadmap sequencing with architecture and product partners, so foundational capabilities land ahead of the work that depend on them and hold that sequence when delivery pressure argues for shortcuts.
Implement the platform contracts and standards agreed with Enterprise Architecture and contribute to the engineering perspective that shapes them before dependent teams build against them.
Drive capabilities from first production consumer to broader enterprise adoption, proving each one at production volume rather than declaring it complete at first release.
Partner with the infrastructure and security organizations on the underlying cloud, messaging and hosting foundations the platform depends on.

Build and Grow the Teams

Stand up and scale the engineering teams behind each capability area, including the team topology, role mix and skill profile each one requires as it moves from early build into production operations.
Recruit, hire and onboard engineers and engineering managers at pace, and set the hiring bar for full-stack, platform, integration and UX engineering roles on the platform.
Mentor and develop engineering and technical staff, foster leadership and technical growth, and build a bench as the organization grows.
Build and maintain a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement, with domain expertise and quality treated as first-class outcomes.

Contribute to Technical Direction and Standards

Work with executive leadership, enterprise architecture, product management, and other stakeholders to shape the platform's roadmap and long-term strategy and translate it into executable engineering plans.
Apply and reinforce enterprise standards for software development, architecture, and quality assurance.
Oversee development and delivery of scalable, high-quality software consistent with the approved architecture, with observability, cost telemetry and operational readiness built in from the start.
Support the core system engineering teams in defining integration seams, migration paths and fallback handling so existing systems adopt platform capabilities incrementally.
Act as a trusted partner to the business by understanding its needs deeply, influencing through technical expertise, and representing the engineering organization in discussions on progress, risks and opportunities.

AI-Enabled Delivery

Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, and lead teams that use them, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting and analysis activities.
Ensure AI-generated outputs are evaluated and validated for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before they reach production.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
Contribute reusable prompts, workflow templates, engineering playbooks and AI-assisted development patterns that benefit the broader engineering organization.
Deliver systems that leverage AI services, APIs, agents and automation capabilities where appropriate, partnering with architecture, security and platform teams on how those capabilities are integrated into enterprise applications.

Governance and Compliance

Follow and enforce enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling and Responsible AI practices across the teams.
Ensure no confidential, regulated or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
Establish peer review and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions and ensure audit visibility and traceability are built into the capabilities the teams deliver.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 7+ years in leadership roles managing large, distributed teams.
Proven track record of delivering complex, enterprise-scale software projects on time and within budget, including at least one initiative launched from inception rather than inherited in flight.
Demonstrated experience building engineering teams as part of a new initiative: defining the organization, hiring at pace, and delivering while the team is still forming.
High technical acumen, with the ability to influence technical strategy beyond immediate team scope.
Strong technical expertise in software architecture, API development and system integration, and deep understanding of cloud services and DevOps practices.
Experience using AI-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar tools, and familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted testing and AI-enabled software delivery practices.
Experience establishing effective engineering operating models and implementing agile methodologies across teams to drive predictable delivery.
Exceptional leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to lead through change, build a product mindset, and foster a culture of innovation and accountability.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to align technical strategies with organizational goals and priorities.
Outstanding communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization and articulate complex technical concepts clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare domain knowledge, particularly medical claims, prior authorization and clinical documentation workflows.
FHIR experience — especially prior-authorization workflows (PAS implementation guide, X12 278 crosswalk) or other healthcare interoperability (HL7v2, CDA).
Knowledge of Domain Driven Design and of identity, access control and observability patterns for AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services, models or agents into production applications, including human-in-the-loop review and approval workflows.
Azure cloud experience (Azure AI services, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, containerized deployment).
Experience delivering solutions built on event-driven architectures and enterprise messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus.
Experience delivering document processing or content pipelines at production scale.
Experience delivering production user interfaces for operational workflows, including review, approval and role-based access.

Healthcare, payer, or other regulated-domain engineering experience

Responsibilities

Own successful delivery outcomes across the ERP & Value Chain platform portfolio while governing engineering realization delivered through Enterprise Business Services (EBS), strategic technology partners, and Enterprise Platform Engineering.
Establish accountability for engineering quality, platform health, release readiness, environment strategy, operational readiness, and cross-platform dependencies across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and Research & Development platforms.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, AV Behavior Safety Engineering (GPSSC)
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE‑ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. Our mission is to help GM deliver trusted automated‑driving products. As the central authority for automated driving system (ADS) safety, SAFE‑ADS brings together experts from across the company to develop and maintain a comprehensive safety case including safety performance indicators for GM’s automated‑driving technologies.

GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion—and autonomous vehicle safety is essential to achieving that vision.

As Sr Manager, AV Behavior Safety Engineering, you will lead the strategy and support execution for how GM defines, measures, and validates the safety of SAE Level 3 – 4 Automated Driving Systems powered by machine‑learned models. You will report into the AV Safety Strategy and Assurance organization and directly influence launch decisions for GM’s next generation of automated driving products.

If you are passionate about safety, have deep experience in autonomous vehicle development and validation, and are a proven technical leader in AI/ML‑driven systems, this role is an opportunity to shape how millions of people experience safe automated driving.

The Role

The AV Safety Strategy and Assurance team is seeking a hands‑on technical senior manager with extensive experience in the end‑to‑end development lifecycle of autonomous vehicle behaviors, from ODD and behavior definition through simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road validation.

You will:

Lead Technically

Reference and interpret standards such as ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO 5083, and AVSC best practices to define GM’s strategy for safe autonomous system development, validation and deployment
Own the behavior‑focused portion of the ADS Safety Case, including key claims, sufficiency criteria, and recommended evidence for AV behavior safety performance.
Collaborate with Software Validation, Embodied AI, Simulation, and Safety Metrics teams to define the end‑to‑end AV behavior validation methodology for AI‑driven systems.
Set the strategy for how we systematically break down ODDs and how performance is validated per behavior and in aggregate.
Collaborate on evaluation metrics, human benchmarks, and safety launch targets for AV behaviors and overall system performance. This includes supporting development of safety performance indicators (SPIs) for AV behaviors.
Assess AV performance across safety and reliability dimensions using simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road data and provide clear, prioritized feedback to engineering teams
Define and run an assurance process to verify the sufficiency criteria and safety targets to support launch readiness

Lead People

Hire, lead, and develop a high‑performing AV behavior safety engineering team.
Set clear goals and expectations, provide coaching and mentorship, and grow the team’s technical depth in AV behavior safety, validation, and safety case development.

Why This Role Is Unique

Impact at Scale: Your work will directly influence how GM brings safe automated driving systems to millions of customers.
End‑to‑End Ownership: You will own the strategy, framework, and evidence assessment for AV behavior safety.
Cross‑Functional Reach: You will collaborate across AI, software, validation, simulation, metrics operations and vehicle program teams, shaping the direction of GM’s automated driving roadmap.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
8+ years of experience in machine learning, engineering, data science, or a related field
8+ years in autonomous vehicle or robotics development or related field
Demonstrated experience working on production‑intent AV programs
Track record providing technical safety leadership in AV development (e.g., defining safety strategies, risk assessments, validation methodologies, safety case contributions).
Deep understanding of AV behavior development: defining ODDs, behaviors, and evaluation criteria; analyzing simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road test data; and generating prioritized, actionable recommendations for developers.
Experience applying AV safety standards and best practices, such as ISO 5083, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and AVSC practices
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs to executives and non‑technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross‑functional teams (Software, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, Product, Program Management, Operations) without direct authority.
Strong problem‑solving mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and a proactive attitude toward learning and continuous improvement.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including hiring, leading, and growing high‑performing technical teams.

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
Programming & Frameworks: Python, R, Java, PySpark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, SQL
Machine Learning & AI: Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, RAG, Deep learning, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), SVM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Decision Trees, Clustering
Cloud & Big Data Platforms: (Preferred Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Machine Learning, Databricks)), Nice to Have (AWS (S3, SageMaker, Bedrock) or Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, AI Platform) )
Deployment & MLOps: MLflow, Model Monitoring & Versioning, Docker & Kubernetes, GitHub, Jira
Data Analysis & Visualization: Tableau, PowerBI, Pandas, NumPy

Compensation
: The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.

The salary range for this role is $250,600 and $384,600. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.

Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies.

This role is categorized as remote. This means the selected candidate may be based anywhere in the country of work and is not expected to report to a GM worksite unless directed by their manager. The selected candidate will be required to travel <25% for this role.

Job Description

OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) AI Infrastructure is at the forefront of building a cutting-edge, ultra-high-performance GPU platform designed to support AI/ML/HPC workloads. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution, creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance.

Our team is responsible for designing and developing fundamental architectural changes for GPU delivery, health monitoring, triage automation, and diagnostic services. These are essential for running distributed AI/ML/HPC workloads across thousands of GPUs, leveraging technologies like RoCE and InfiniBand.

We're looking for an experienced front-line engineering manager to lead and support AI Data Plane (DP) team. You'll build a highly available, massive scale, integrated cloud service in a distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment for hyper-scale AI customers.

You'll bring experience in leading engineering teams, including hands-on technical management and on-call experience. You have technical experience with high-performance, mission-critical environments. You demonstrate strong ownership, solid communication skills and a bias for action. You're comfortable leading projects, communicating with senior leadership, and growing your team.

Why Join Us?

Innovative Projects: Build groundbreaking solutions for our customers from the ground up.
Exciting Times: Be part of a young, fast-growing team working on ambitious new initiatives.
Dynamic Environment: Collaborate in a vibrant, agile environment where learning and adaptability are key.

jobs.title: VP, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE & Observability Platform)
jobs.description:
Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Education Desired

Bachelor of Computer Science

Job Description

About the role~

Production reliability is a board-level priority, and we are placing it in one hands-on leader. We are hiring a Vice President of Engineering to found and lead our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) platform organization and own the mission end to end~ raise observability maturity and materially reduce production incidents across the engineering estate. You will do it by making agentic engineering the core method of the function — using AI agents to run the platform itself, and putting AI agents in the hands of product engineers so they can meet the company's observability requirements and SRE goals with far less manual effort.

This is a builder's role with executive visibility. You will stand up a central platform team that treats reliability and observability as a product, deliver an aggressive multi-phase roadmap, and change how thousands of engineers instrument, operate, and take ownership of what they ship — in a large, complex, tech-debt-heavy environment where the winning strategy is paved roads over mandates. Central to that is a two-part AI mandate~ making this function fully agent-native, and delivering AI agents to product engineers so they can fulfill their observability requirements and the company's SRE goals with far less manual effort.

You will report directly to the SVP of Platform Engineering and partner with leaders across engineering, product, and the executive team. The mission has a named executive sponsor and committed funding; your job is to turn that mandate into outcomes.

The AI mandate~ two transformations you will lead~

Role

Agentic engineering is not a side initiative in this role — it is central to how the function operates and to the value it delivers to the enterprise. You will be accountable for two connected transformations~

Transform this function to be fully agent-native

Re-found the platform organization around agentic engineering. Agents — not manual toil — should carry the load of instrumenting legacy code, investigating incidents, generating configuration, assisting on-call, and, over time, executing guarded remediation. You will build the agent control plane, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses that make this safe, and turn the function into the company's proof point for what disciplined, agent-first engineering looks like at scale.

Put AI agents in the hands of product engineers for observability and SRE outcomes

Deliver AI agents to product engineers as part of the paved road so they can meet the company's observability requirements and SRE goals with far less manual effort — agents that instrument their services, generate SLOs, dashboards, and alerts, investigate incidents, and assist on-call. These agents, and the reliability, evaluation, guardrails, and cost governance behind them, are how product teams hit reliability targets at scale. This role owns the SRE platform~ the agents it provides serve observability and reliability, not product-feature development.

What You'll Own

The SRE platform organization — a central platform team plus embedded/partner SREs, an enablement function, and a cross-cutting reliability champions network
The observability & reliability platform — telemetry pipeline (OpenTelemetry), metrics/logs/traces backends, dashboards and alerting, the SLO and error-budget system, incident management, and RCA/correlation
The paved road — shared instrumentation SDKs, templates, and dashboards/alerts/SLOs-as-code that make golden-signal observability near-automatic
The agentic engineering stack — internal agents for instrumentation, investigation/RCA, config generation, on-call, and guarded remediation — plus the agent control plane, guardrails, and evaluation that keep them safe
The agentic paved road for product engineers — AI agents delivered to product teams to instrument services, generate SLOs/dashboards/alerts, investigate incidents, and assist on-call — so they meet observability requirements and SRE goals with minimal manual effort, backed by guardrails and evaluation
Reliability & AI governance — error-budget policy, blameless incident and postmortem practice, AI safety and human-in-the-loop controls, and the metrics reported to senior leadership
The roadmap, budget, and vendor strategy — an ~18-month phased plan, the operating budget, tooling selection, and cost governance for both telemetry and AI workloads

Key Responsibilities

Set the strategy and vision. — Own the enterprise strategy for reliability, observability, and agentic engineering. Define what “reliability as a product” and “agent-native engineering” mean here, and keep both tied to business outcomes
Build and lead the organization. — Recruit, structure, and grow a high-performing platform organization spanning SRE, platform, and AI engineering — hiring and developing senior, staff, and principal talent and the managers who lead them
Deliver the roadmap. — Execute the phased plan — mobilize and instrument, build foundations, scale and standardize the paved road with SLO coverage and error-budget policy, then bring proactive and agentic capabilities to production — on aggressive, overlapping timelines
Make the function agent-native. — Drive adoption of internal agents across the platform's own work, with least-privilege access, blast-radius limits, human-in-the-loop controls, and evaluation before any increase in autonomy
Put agents in product engineers' hands. — Deliver AI agents through the paved road that let product engineers meet observability requirements and SRE goals — instrumenting services, standing up SLOs, and resolving incidents — with far less manual effort, backed by guardrails and evaluation
Make reliability measurable. — Stand up SLOs and error budgets, modern incident management, and blameless postmortems; establish error-budget policy in partnership with leadership
Drive adoption across the estate. — Win teams over with paved roads and lighthouse wins, not mandates — through reliability reviews, enablement, office hours, and published before/after results
Own the tooling and its economics. — Select and evolve an industry-leading, OpenTelemetry-native and AI-native tool stack, with cost and cardinality governance built in from the start for both telemetry and inference
Operate as an executive partner. — Manage stakeholders across engineering and product, report progress and reliability/AI metrics to the CTO and executive team, and steward budget and headcount

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days — organization mobilized and sponsor alignment confirmed; reliability baseline established; 2–4 lighthouse services selected; instrumentation underway with the first golden-signal dashboards and SLOs live; the first internal agents piloted
By 12 months — the paved road is self-service and adopted by tier-1 teams; SLOs and error-budget policy are in effect; on-call load and alert noise are measurably down; the function is operating agent-first; and product engineers are using the SRE agents to instrument and meet SLOs with far less manual effort
By 18 months — proactive and guarded agentic capabilities are in production; the program hits its targets — a significant reduction in Sev1/Sev2 incidents, mean-time-to-resolution cut substantially, full SLO coverage on tier-1 services, and a healthier on-call — and the company's SRE goals are being met at scale through agents that product engineers rely on

Required Qualifications

15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years in senior engineering leadership leading SRE, platform, infrastructure, or AI organizations at scale — including managing managers
A proven track record of improving reliability and reducing production incidents across a large, complex, multi-team estate (thousands of engineers and/or services)
Demonstrated experience building and operating production AI and/or agentic systems at scale — with a working command of LLMs, agent frameworks and orchestration, retrieval, evaluation (evals), guardrails, and AI/agent observability
Experience establishing AI governance and safety for production agents — least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop controls, blast-radius limits, and evaluation-gated autonomy
Deep expertise in observability (OpenTelemetry; metrics, logs, traces), SLOs and error budgets, incident management, and cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code)
Experience running an internal platform as a product — paved roads, developer experience, and adoption measured by usage, not decree — and enabling other teams to build on it
A demonstrated ability to drive org-wide change through influence in a large, matrixed organization rather than through mandate
Excellent executive communication — able to translate reliability and AI strategy into business terms and present to C-level stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

A track record of building internal AI/agent developer tooling that other engineering teams adopted at scale
Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-availability, high-compliance environment
Familiarity with a modern reliability and AI stack — e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana or a major observability SaaS, PagerDuty or Slack-native incident tooling, SLO tooling, and LLM/agent observability and evaluation platforms
A track record establishing error-budget policy and a genuinely blameless postmortem culture
Advanced degree in a relevant field

Leadership Competencies

Technical credibility — deep enough to earn the trust of senior engineers and make hard architecture, tooling, and AI calls, while leading through others
AI fluency & responsible innovation — moves fast on agentic capability while insisting on evaluation, guardrails, and safety
Systems thinking — sees the whole sociotechnical system — tooling, incentives, culture, and cost
Change leadership — moves a large organization through influence, evidence, and paved roads
Talent magnet — attracts, grows, and retains exceptional engineering and AI leaders and specialists
Bias for delivery — ships outcomes on aggressive timelines and is accountable for measurable results
Psychological safety — builds a blameless, high-trust culture where failure is analyzed, not punished

This is a senior leadership role responsible for scaling teams, defining long-term architecture strategy, and shaping how enterprises adopt programmable control planes through a thriving ecosystem.

In this role, you will…

Control Plane & Enterprise Strategy

Help define and drive the long-term vision for hosted control planes and ecosystem extensibility.
Ensure Marketplace, UXP, APIs, and Extensions operate as a cohesive control plane experience.
Shape how platform engineering teams compose infrastructure through Crossplane-powered abstractions.
Drive reliability, scalability, and production-grade control planes at scale.

Ecosystem Leadership

Own the strategy for Upbound Marketplace as the distribution layer for Crossplane providers, extensions, and control plane building blocks.
Grow and strengthen the provider ecosystem (ISVs, cloud providers, platform partners).
Enable extension frameworks that allow customers and partners to build on top of Upbound control planes.
Ensure ecosystem experiences are intuitive, secure, and enterprise-ready.

Organizational Leadership

Lead managers and managers-of-managers across multiple teams.
Scale engineering org structure to support product velocity and ecosystem expansion.
Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, uptime SLAs, and production excellence.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and deep technical craftsmanship.

Cross-Functional Influence

Partner closely with Product, GTM, Alliances, and Customer Success to align ecosystem strategy with revenue goals.
Translate enterprise customer needs into scalable control plane capabilities.
Represent engineering in executive-level conversations around ecosystem expansion and AI-native infrastructure.

You are a good fit if you have…

10+ years of engineering leadership experience, including leading managers of managers.
5+ years building or scaling cloud-native, infrastructure, or platform engineering products.
Deep familiarity with Kubernetes and the Cloud Native ecosystem.
Experience building SaaS control planes or distributed systems at scale.
Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, declarative systems, and extensibility frameworks.
Proven experience growing ecosystem-driven products (marketplaces, providers, plugins, or integrations).
Track record of delivering reliable production services with strong uptime and performance standards.
Ability to operate strategically while diving deep technically.

It is a plus if…

Experience with Crossplane and/or Kubernetes.
Background in platform engineering or internal developer platforms.
Experience building multi-tenant control plane architectures.
Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure companies.
Passion for programmable infrastructure and AI-native systems.

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

GEA Group, located in York, PA, is searching for a Director of Engineering to lead our North American Business Unit!

The Director of Engineering & Application Engineering is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and performance of the Project Engineering and Application Engineering functions within GEA Compression Technologies North America. This role ensures the delivery of safe, compliant, innovative, and commercially successful engineered solutions that meet customer requirements and support the strategic objectives of the business.

As a member of the North American Senior Leadership Team, the Director partners closely with Sales, Operations, Project Management, Service, Supply Chain, and Finance to drive profitable growth, operational excellence, product innovation, and organizational development. Engineering Leadership

Application Engineering & Technical Sales Support

Facilitate knowledge sharing, best practice adoption, resource collaboration, and alignment of engineering processes across regions.

jobs.title: Director, Mac & Mobile Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Corporate IT organization is on a multi-year transformation to modernize the digital workplace, elevate employee experience, and enable secure, scalable, and frictionless productivity across the enterprise. Client Engineering is a critical pillar of this strategy, responsible for delivering highly reliable, secure, and intuitive endpoint platforms that support Visa’s global workforce.

We are seeking a dynamic, transformational leader to join our team as Director, Client Engineering – macOS. This role owns Visa’s global macOS platform strategy, engineering, and operations—defining the end-to-end platform vision; driving modern management practices; and ensuring a best-in-class employee and developer experience at scale.

The Director operates at the intersection of engineering excellence, security and risk partnership, user experience, and operational rigor—setting standards, shaping investment decisions, and leading cross-functional execution across a complex, regulated global enterprise.

Job Scope

This role has global responsibility for macOS platform architecture, engineering, lifecycle management, and service delivery across Visa. You will partner closely with Information Security, Workplace Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure the macOS platform is secure, resilient, and optimized for modern work.

This role aligns to Visa’s Director job architecture and carries accountability for strategy, people leadership, financial stewardship, and cross-functional delivery.

Key Focus Areas

The ideal candidate should be passionate about:

Exceptional employee and developer experience — delivering a secure, intuitive macOS platform that removes friction and improves productivity.
Modern, scalable platform management — strengthening zero-touch provisioning, configuration baselines, compliance-by-design, and automation.
Security and risk partnership — building a hardened, auditable, resilient platform aligned to enterprise security and regulatory expectations.
Operational excellence — measurable reliability, incident/problem management discipline, and continuous improvement rooted in telemetry and customer feedback.
Shift-left and self-service enablement — reducing recurring issues through standardization, automation, and clear knowledge and tooling.
Engineering culture and talent — building and developing a high-performing global team with strong standards, accountability, and inclusive leadership.
Vendor and financial stewardship — optimizing commercial strategy and total cost of ownership while increasing platform value.

Key Responsibilities

Transformational Leadership: Inspire, motivate, and guide the macOS client engineering organization to deliver secure, reliable, and delightful outcomes at global scale.

Define and communicate a clear multi-year macOS platform vision and roadmap; translate strategy into executable quarterly outcomes and measurable KPIs.
Lead, coach, and develop a global team of macOS engineers and platform specialists; build talent pipelines, succession plans, and meaningful career paths.
Establish a culture of accountability, engineering excellence, and continuous learning; encourage constructive debate and psychological safety while driving decisions to closure.

Strategy & Platform Leadership: Own the end-to-end macOS platform strategy aligned to Digital Workplace and Security roadmaps.

Develop and execute modernization plans covering device management, OS lifecycle, patching, software delivery, compliance, and automation.
Drive adoption of modern Apple ecosystem capabilities (e.g., zero-touch provisioning, declarative management, secure identity, virtualization, and developer tooling) where they improve scale, reliability, and experience.
Act like an owner: shape investment trade-offs, optimize total cost of ownership, and ensure resources are directed toward highest-impact outcomes.

Engineering & Architecture: Serve as the senior technical authority for macOS platforms, tooling, and endpoint integrations.

Establish engineering standards, configuration baselines, and architectural patterns for macOS at enterprise scale; ensure designs are simple, supportable, and secure-by-default.
Lead design and implementation of endpoint management capabilities (e.g., MDM, EDR, identity, compliance, patching, software delivery), ensuring interoperability across the broader digital workplace ecosystem.
Think big and challenge the status quo by identifying emerging approaches that improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and accelerate secure delivery.

Operational Excellence: Own service health, reliability, and performance of the macOS environment.

Define and track platform KPIs, SLAs/SLOs, and experience metrics; use telemetry to identify patterns, prioritize improvements, and eliminate repeat issues.
Ensure strong operational processes for incident management, root cause analysis, change management, and continuous improvement; learn from mistakes and harden systems and processes.
Drive standardization, documentation, and knowledge practices (SOPs, runbooks, KBs) that enable shift-left support and reduce time-to-restore.

Security & Risk Partnership: Embed security, compliance, and resiliency into platform design and daily operations.

Partner with Cybersecurity and Risk teams to ensure macOS platforms meet Visa’s security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Lead implementation of security controls including device trust, endpoint protection, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and compliance attestation.
Hold ourselves and each other accountable for secure operations and timely remediation; ensure risk is transparent and actively managed.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Build trust-based partnerships that align platform capabilities with user and business needs.

Listen and learn from internal customers (employees, developers, support teams) to understand pain points and prioritize platform investments that improve experience and productivity.
Own vendor strategy and commercial oversight for Apple and endpoint management partners; manage performance, roadmaps, and commercial negotiations.
Communicate effectively with senior leadership on platform strategy, health, risks, and investment decisions; decide quickly and move fast while balancing security and operational rigor.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications

12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD
12+ years of progressive experience in endpoint / client platform engineering with deep focus on macOS.
Demonstrated experience leading macOS platforms at enterprise scale (e.g., 10k+ devices).
Strong knowledge of Apple enterprise ecosystem, macOS internals, device management, and security frameworks.
Experience in software development, GenAI development and application a huge plus
Proven ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels in a large, complex organization; strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder influence.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.
Experience in highly regulated, global enterprise environments.

Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $186,200.00 to $ 298,200.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Director Technology for Impact & Sustainability plays a pivotal role in supporting the Senior Director across two growing, mission-driven departments (Humanitarian Technologies & Technology for Sustainable Climate) focused on applying technology for social impact and climate sustainability. This individual is responsible for operational execution, strategic alignment, partnership engagement, financial oversight, contract management, and organizational growth across the Technology for Impact portfolio. In addition to leading shared operations and growth functions across both departments, the Director serves as the primary staff leader for the Technology for Sustainable Climate Matrix Organization (TSCMO), providing strategic leadership, operational oversight, partnership development, and execution of climate technology initiatives, programs, events, and its committees and subcommittees.

This role serves as a key advisor to the Senior Director, helping to translate strategic objectives into scalable programs and ensuring the efficient management of people, processes, budgets, and external relationships. The Director will play a central role in the growth, sustainability, and visibility of the department's work.

The Director will directly supervise 4+ direct reports while providing leadership and direction for the continued growth and effectiveness of both functions.

Key Responsibilities

Drive strategic leadership and operational excellence across Humanitarian Technologies and Climate Tech, scaling systems and processes for organizational growth.
Lead the identification, design, incubation, and execution of new strategic initiatives across Humanitarian Technologies and Technology for Sustainable Climate, ensuring the continued growth, relevance, and sustainability of both departments in alignment with emerging sector needs, organizational priorities, and external opportunities.
Manage contracts and procurement processes; coordinate with legal, finance, and external vendors to ensure compliance and timely execution.
Oversee budgeting and financial management across both portfolios, including planning, tracking, and reporting for multiple initiatives.
Develop and manage partnerships with internal IEEE units and external organizations (industry, academia, NGOs) to support programmatic growth and alignment.
Lead the development and coordination of marketing, branding, and outreach strategies for both departments, in partnership with communications teams.
Ensure consistent and compelling visibility of the departments’ work across internal and external platforms (e.g., reports, social media, website, events).
Oversee the design, implementation, and reporting of impact metrics across programs to assess outcomes, demonstrate value, and inform decision-making.
Support strategic planning cycles and portfolio management, ensuring alignment with IEEE’s organizational vision and values.Serve as a senior advisor to the Senior Director, providing analysis, strategic insight, and recommendations on key organizational decisions.
Lead the overall strategy, growth, governance, and execution of the Technology for Sustainable Climate Matrix Organization (TSCMO), ensuring alignment with IEEE priorities and long-term climate technology objectives.
Serve as the primary staff liaison to TSCMO volunteer leadership, overseeing subcommittees, working groups, annual planning processes, reporting requirements, and committee effectiveness.
Develop and execute a growth strategy for TSCMO, including new initiatives, strategic partnerships, sponsorship opportunities, events, thought leadership activities, and external engagement opportunities to ensure there is a clear value proposition for the organization.
Lead the development of TSCMO’s annual operating plan, strategic priorities, value proposition, and impact reporting framework.
Identify, cultivate, and manage strategic relationships within IEEE and beyond, including with industry, government, academia, nonprofit organizations, multilateral institutions, and climate technology stakeholders to expand TSCMO’s influence and impact.
Oversee the execution of climate technology programs, challenges, summits, and special initiatives aligned with TSCMO priorities.
Direct the development of thought leadership, reports, presentations, and communications materials for all technology for impact programs that strengthen IEEE’s visibility and leadership position within technology for good space.
Provide leadership, coaching, performance management, and workload prioritization for 4 direct reports, ensuring alignment of staff resources with organizational priorities and program objectives.
Oversee portfolio-wide resource allocation, staffing plans, operational priorities, and organizational effectiveness across both departments.

Travel Information

25% Domestic and International may include nights and weekends

Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferably in Engineering, Business, Marketing or International Relations Req
Master's or other advanced degree Req

Work Experience

10-15 years Proven track record in the planning, development, incubation and deployment of strategic programs in the technology for impact space Req
At least 4 years of experience in Technology for Sustainability required Req

Skills And Requirements

Proven experience leading operational and strategic initiatives within complex organizations, including the ability to translate high-level strategic priorities into scalable programs, processes, and operational systems, while applying an entrepreneurial, start-up mindset focused on innovation, agility, and growth.
Experience in operations, program management, strategy, or organizational leadership, preferably within technology, social impact, climate, international development, nonprofit, or membership-based organizations. Experience working in complex global and multi-stakeholder environments is strongly preferred.
Strong leadership and supervisory experience, including managing staff, coordinating consultants and contractors, and supporting volunteer leadership structures such as boards, committees, or working groups. Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across both direct and indirect reporting relationships.
Proven experience building, scaling, and sustaining organizational programs, partnerships, and initiatives from concept through implementation and growth.
Demonstrated experience overseeing large-scale program portfolios, including operational planning, implementation, financial management, contract oversight, and continuous improvement of processes and systems.
Strong understanding of sustainability, climate technology, environmental innovation, energy transition, or related sectors.
Strong experience managing budgets, financial planning, and program resources, including coordination with finance, legal, and procurement teams to ensure compliance with organizational policies and effective use of resources.
Proven ability to develop and manage strategic partnerships with internal teams and external stakeholders across industry, academia, nonprofits, and international organizations.
Experience leading the promotion and visibility of programs focused on social and environmental impact, ideally within technology or innovation initiatives, through marketing, communications, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
Demonstrated ability to design, track, and communicate program metrics and impact data, translating results into reports, presentations, and insights that inform decision-making and demonstrate program effectiveness.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing high-level materials such as executive briefings, strategic reports, presentations, and impact summaries for diverse audiences.
Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex challenges, build consensus among diverse stakeholders, and develop practical solutions that support organizational goals.
Demonstrated flexibility, adaptability, and organizational leadership in fast-paced and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence.
Experience working with volunteer governance structures, advisory boards, committees, consortia, or multi-stakeholder coalitions.
Demonstrated ability to balance strategic leadership, portfolio management, and operational execution across multiple functions and teams.
International Travel is required (30% of time)

jobs.description:
Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payment Technology. We were founded 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. InComm Payments works with the most recognized and valued brands in the world, and we are partnered with most of the world’s leading merchants to deliver leading payment products and solutions.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future.

You can learn more about careers at InComm Payments here: www.incomm.com or connect with us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, or Our Blog.

Inside InComm from InComm on Vimeo.

About This Opportunity

We are actively seeking a Director over our Network Security Engineering Team. This is a remote opportunity and can sit anywhere in the US. This is a great opportunity for a hands on leader to provide sound guidance and mentoring to a strong team of engineers.

Responsibilities

Steering a forward-looking security engineering function at one of the world’s leaders in prepaid and payment solutions.
Leading and mentoring a team of skilled network security practitioners covering infrastructure security.
Develop security tooling, process, and automation efforts across the network.
Advocate for security best practices, acting as a bidirectional conduit to senior leadership and ensuring a network security presence at all stages of product lifecycle.
Presenting key data on the network security of InComm’s infrastructure and security to leadership; helping drive continual security improvements and methodology.
Participate in designs of architectural systems to ensure that network security and privacy are maintained.

Qualifications

Ability to develop and advance the network security roadmap through products such as firewalls, secure remote access, DDoS, AMS, micro segmentation, and other evolving technologies that meet business objectives.
Develop and maintain network security standards for switches, routers, load balancers, etc.
Report progress to internal stakeholders, management, and executive leadership.
Participate in continual process improvement to streamline existing processes and implement new ones where appropriate to reduce time to resolution and create a better customer experience.
Work with a global team to open, track, triage, prioritize, document, escalate and communicate timely and accurate status and reporting.
Communicate with technical and non-technical internal and external customers both verbally and written to provide clear, concise status updates, requests for assistance and directions for next steps.
Responsible for service and project pre-planning, execution, wrap-up, and lessons learned activities.
Creation of service/project documentation and delivery workflows.
Maintain a good working knowledge of InComm products, services, and technologies.
Partner with compliance and audit teams to fulfill regulatory requirements.
Minimum of 10+ years of information security experience.
5+ years working in a leadership capacity.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent organization and presentation skills.
Ability to effectively interface and communicate with IT resources, business contacts, and clients.
Ability to work effectively with others in a team environment.
Ability to work within and lead cross-functional teams.
Experience handling PCI, HIPPA and PII data is required.
Excellent understanding of the security tools landscape
Strong leadership, technical development, organizational, team building and management, communication and interpersonal skills.
Technical background in the Network Security is desired.

Education & Certifications

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field is preferred, but not required.
A CISSP certification is preferred, but not required. Career development plan to include certifications upon hire.

The Role

We are looking for a Director, Engineering – Personal Card Technology who brings expertise leading engineering teams that build high performance systems and customer facing digital applications. In Wealth Cash Solutions - Personal Cards, we are embarking on a multi-year journey to improve our debit and credit card programs – including enhancing our ability to service customers over our live channels, improving the digital experiences (web and mobile), and optimizing our vendor partnership structure. Join us to be a part of a fast-paced team that follows a strong product mindset and uses customer and market feedback, and strong engineering practices to develop highly critical and scalable card technology systems that can be leveraged by multiple products across Fidelity.

The Value You Deliver

Progressive Engineering Leadership

Provide Engineering expertise, thought leadership and partnerships across Product Management, Engineering and Human-Centric Design teams
Provide technical and functional oversight with product management teams to ensure we are building the best products, platforms, and experiences for our customers.
Work collaboratively with your product partners to create and execute the teams backlog
Collaborate with architecture and Platform Engineering teams on setting technical direction and ensure alignment with our technology strategy.
Ensure engineered solutions address scale, reuse, and high availability requirements by using platforms and established patterns and practices.
Accelerate and increase efficiency by continuously improving engineering and operations practices.
Engage as an authority on technology, staying abreast of and contributing to external industry trends, advancements, and innovations in technical areas of expertise.

Engaging Engineering Leadership

Create and promote the vision, roadmap, and expectations for your engineering teams to achieve engineering excellence in all results.
Define and implement a plan to attract, hire, build and retain the optimal skills for your Teams.
Facilitate learning at scale to promote skill, career, and development growth for technologists on the team
Maintain and share knowledge and expertise on the evolving needs of customers, internal and external markets, and industry trends and changes across our community.
Lead team members through a high degree of organizational complexity in support of cross-domain and cross-product area work.
As the direct reporting manager for technologists, you will be responsible for engineering delivery, people management and maintaining engineering standards
Advance Diversity and Inclusion through promotion of inclusive hiring practices, mentoring, and coaching.

The Skills And Expertise You Bring

15 years of functional experience in product management and/or technology, with a high level of agile, analytical, and coaching skills.
Proven experience working hands-on on software engineering problems - Development of APIs, Consumer facing applications, scaling cloud-based solutions, etc.
Experience in application architecture design and development on Cloud based infrastructure (AWS / Azure) using various architecture patterns (e.g., Distributed, Serverless, Event Driven, Microservices etc.) and can articulate the right paradigm for the problem at hand,
Experience delivering highly secure, scalable, and resilient consumer facing native mobile applications.
Experience working with DevOps metrics and should demonstrate awareness of managing, improving, and advocating for these metrics to drive Engineering Excellence
Experience partnering with Product and Business teams to break down strategy into practical mission, goals, and priorities.
Track record of inspiring the creativity and innovation of teams, creating a culture of inclusion, experimentation, exploration, and continuous learning.
Ability to collaborate across business units, with peers and leadership to ensure objectives, KPI's and standards are aligned.
Ability to attract, hire and build a pool of diverse, engaged engineers with the skills needed today and in the future.
Ability to connect with and influence all levels of the organization and motivate change
Fostering fun at work

jobs.title: Director, Platform Services - onsite Frisco, TX
jobs.description:
WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US

At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday.

We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team.

About The Role

The Director of Platform Services is responsible for the strategy, architecture, standards, governance, engineering, deployment, modernization, and operational leadership of Welltower’s compute technology ecosystem across corporate offices, data center and property environments, and cloud platforms. This leader owns the end-to-end compute technology roadmap, ensuring secure, resilient, scalable, automated, and cost-effective compute capabilities across on-premises infrastructure, AWS, Azure, and hybrid deployments.

The Director will evaluate, select, standardize, and oversee the lifecycle of compute platforms including traditional server infrastructure, virtualization, container platforms, cloud compute services, operating systems, configuration management, monitoring, and automation tooling. This role partners closely with application development teams, IT Services, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, data teams, service providers, Operating Partners, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable compute services, enable infrastructure as code, accelerate delivery, and expand customer self-service capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Compute
Technology Strategy & Governance

Define and execute the enterprise compute technology strategy for Welltower corporate locations, data center environments, property technology needs, and cloud platforms.
Establish standards, reference architectures, and governance for traditional server infrastructure, virtualization, containers, operating systems, cloud compute, storage-adjacent compute patterns, and hybrid hosting models.
Evaluate and select compute hardware, platforms, cloud services, automation tools, managed services, and service providers to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, cost-effective, and operationally supportable.
Develop technology standards that support consistent deployment across corporate offices, senior housing properties, outpatient medical properties, business applications, and enterprise shared services.
Ensure compute architecture supports both on-premises infrastructure and cloud-based deployments in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity, workload placement, resilience, compliance, and cost optimization.

On-Premises, Cloud & Hybrid Compute Platform

Own the roadmap, standards, and lifecycle management for physical servers, blade or hyperconverged infrastructure, virtualization platforms, operating systems, container platforms, cloud compute services, and related management tooling.
Lead the design and implementation of reliable compute capabilities for corporate applications, property operations, analytics, integration platforms, development environments, and enterprise shared services.
Define workload placement standards across on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Azure based on performance, resiliency, security, compliance, scalability, and cost considerations.
Oversee compute services including virtual machines, autoscaling, image management, patching, configuration management, backup integration, monitoring, logging, and capacity planning.
Partner with Information Security and Enterprise Architecture to ensure compute designs align with zero-trust principles, identity and access standards, vulnerability management, encryption, and regulatory requirements.

Deployment, Modernization & Lifecycle Management

Lead compute deployment planning, modernization, upgrades, refresh programs, and migration initiatives across on-premises, AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
Establish repeatable deployment models for new workloads, cloud landing zone consumption, acquisitions, application modernization, property technology services, and enterprise platform initiatives.
Oversee maintenance programs for compute hardware, firmware, operating systems, virtualization platforms, cloud images, licensing, warranties, and support contracts.
Define patching, upgrade, change, release, and environment management practices that reduce risk while maintaining business continuity.
Coordinate with application owners, development teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, managed service providers, and Operating Partners to deliver consistent, reliable compute outcomes across distributed environments.

Automation, Infrastructure as Code & Developer Enablement

Drive automation-first practices for compute provisioning, configuration, deployment, patching, scaling, monitoring, and operational recovery.
Lead adoption of infrastructure as code and policy as code practices using modern tooling to deliver consistent, auditable, repeatable, and secure environments across on-premises, AWS, and Azure.
Partner closely with development teams to align compute services with application architecture, CI/CD pipelines, environment needs, performance requirements, and release velocity.
Build reusable templates, patterns, guardrails, and service catalogs that enable customer self-service while maintaining security, compliance, cost, and operational standards.
Advance platform engineering capabilities that reduce friction for product teams, improve speed to value, and increase consistency across development, test, staging, and production environments.

Vendor, Partner & Service Provider Management

Lead evaluation, selection, contract input, and performance management for compute technology vendors, cloud providers, managed service providers, automation platforms, and implementation partners.
Establish vendor standards for platform selection, implementation quality, documentation, supportability, automation readiness, and operational handoff.
Manage technology roadmaps, lifecycle planning, licensing, cloud consumption, budgets, renewals, and cost optimization across compute platforms and services.
Ensure compute technology supports business applications, development teams, analytics platforms, integration services, property operations, enterprise productivity, and customer-facing technology needs.
Partner with internal teams and Operating Partners to align compute services with business requirements, application roadmaps, compliance expectations, and operating model needs.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Define KPIs and service performance metrics for compute platforms including availability, performance, capacity, provisioning speed, automation adoption, self-service consumption, incident response, compliance, and lifecycle health.
Drive automation, infrastructure as code, standardized configuration management, monitoring, documentation, and operational efficiency improvements.
Lead compute lifecycle planning, budgeting, asset management, cloud cost management, and vendor performance management.
Support acquisitions, new workload onboarding, application modernization, cloud migrations, property transitions, and international expansion from a compute technology perspective.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Build and lead a high-performing compute technology engineering, platform, and operations team.
Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development opportunities for compute architects, cloud engineers, platform engineers, automation engineers, analysts, and operations resources.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, documentation, automation, operational discipline, developer empathy, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver secure, reliable, automated, and scalable compute experiences across corporate, property, on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of this employee for this job.  Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

TRAVEL

Regular travel may be required to support corporate offices, data center environments, property deployments, acquisitions, modernization initiatives, operating partners, vendor assessments, and key enterprise initiatives.

Experience

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

10+ years of progressive experience in compute technology, infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, systems engineering, or enterprise technology operations.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA (metro areas)

About Cloudflare

At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before.

About The Team

The Developer GTM organization is a startup within Cloudflare, driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most exciting place for developers to build.

About The Role

As the Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering, you will lead a team of high-performing technical experts who help customers understand the business value and technical details of Cloudflare’s ecosystem. You will serve as a strategic partner to sales leadership, advising on programs to grow developer revenue and supporting complex strategic opportunities. In this leadership capacity, you will bridge the gap between technical sales and product engineering, ensuring your team effectively acts as the feedback loop that evolves our product offerings.

What You Will Do

Strategic Oversight: Develop and execute the long-term technical sales strategy in partnership with regional and country sales leaders to drive pipeline and revenue for the Cloudflare Developer Platform.
People Management: Directly manage, mentor, and grow a team of Solution Architects, ensuring they successfully serve as trusted technical advisors and regional leads.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary liaison with executive leadership, Product Management, and Product Marketing to align goals and deliver data-driven value propositions and customer stories.
Budget and Resource Allocation: Manage the annual budget and make critical resource allocation decisions to ensure the team is staffed and equipped to meet customer needs and business goals.
Executive Engagement: Support your team in aligning perceived business and technical value with C-Level executives at strategic customer accounts.
Product Evolution: Oversee the creation of a succinct feedback loop between the field and internal teams to refine the product roadmap based on customer usage and competitive intelligence.

Who You Are

Technical Sales Leadership: Significant experience leading technical teams, with a background of 7+ years in technical sales of cloud computing, storage, or full-stack engineering.
Strategic Planning: Proven ability to develop programs that drive sales strategy and pipeline generation in a complex technical environment.
Deep Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of modern Web Technologies, Cloud Architecture, AI/ML, and the advantages of Distributed Serverless Platforms.
System Design Authority: Ability to mentor teams on Systems Design theory and practice for distributed, full-stack applications to solve complex client needs.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated success collaborating with Product, Marketing, and Sales to drive revenue and customer adoption.
Application Materials: Candidates must submit a resume/CV detailing their experience with team leadership and technical architecture.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Platform Proficiency: Practical experience where you have built applications or solutions using Cloudflare Workers.
Industry Certifications: Holding current AWS Solutions Architect or GCP Cloud Architect certifications.
Developer Workflow Knowledge: Strong understanding of CI/CD practices, versioning, and system integrations to better guide the team on developer workflows.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $244,000.00 - $310,000.00 OTE

For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000.00 - $295,000.00 OTE

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1

This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever.
