jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering - Machine Learning Simulations
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart's Machine Learning and Simulations Platform team builds and operates the infrastructure behind ML model training, features engineering, inference, and marketplace simulation. Our simulation platform answers one question before any change reaches a borrower: what would this new ML model, price, or fee have produced for real applicants? It replays historical data through production pricing logic in isolated environments, and it is now the shared tool every machine learning team at Upstart uses to size the impact of a launch. Our priorities are reliability teams can bet a launch on, fidelity to production we can prove, cost per simulation stays in check as usage grows, and coverage that extends across the lending funnel and into new loan products.

As the Senior Engineering Manager, Machine Learning Simulations at Upstart, you will lead the team that owns this platform. Today machine learning teams run roughly a thousand simulations a month on it. Your job is to make it production-grade, cut its cost while usage doubles, and open it to Analytics and Finance teams who need the same answers about pricing and portfolio strategy. You will work across machine learning, pricing, product, analytics, and infrastructure teams, many of whom own the logic your platform has to reproduce faithfully.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Own the engineering roadmap for Upstart's marketplace simulation platform, and decide which teams and use cases it serves next
Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers working across distributed services, offline data pipelines, and large-scale compute
Raise simulation reliability and accuracy to a level teams trust for launch decisions, including automated checks that detect drift between simulated and production results
Reduce the cost of each simulation as usage grows, through smart architecture and compute choices
Extend simulation coverage across the lending funnel and into new loan products, partnering with the teams who own each stage of pricing and decisioning logic
Turn recurring questions from machine learning, analytics, and capital markets partners into self-serve simulation workflows

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management experience
Experience leading engineering teams that build and operate backend platforms or distributed systems in production
Experience delivering platform or infrastructure programs that span multiple teams
Proficiency with some or many of the following: Python, Kotlin, AWS, Kubernetes, Databricks, Spark

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of simulation, backtesting, experimentation, or offline model evaluation systems
Experience supporting machine learning teams or operating MLOps infrastructure, including model inference, workflow orchestration, and offline feature pipelines
Knowledge of lending, pricing, credit risk, or marketplace economics
Ability to treat compute cost and efficiency as an engineering goal alongside reliability
Ability to build shared platforms where partner teams own part of the logic, and to keep those interfaces steady as systems evolve
Experience developing senior engineers and emerging engineering leaders

Position location
This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements
The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements
As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range

$195,300 - $270,400 USD

What You'll Love

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City (opening Summer 2026!)

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

The ideal candidate brings recent hands‑on engineering experience, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to senior leadership.

Own end‑to‑end technical delivery for Contact Center operational data platforms, ensuring reliability, scalability, and alignment with evolving business priorities.
Provide technical leadership for the modernization of Contact Center data architecture, supporting application migrations, AI‑driven capabilities, and real‑time operational data use cases.

Design and oversee scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Java, Spring, Kafka‑based technologies, and GCP native services (Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage).
Establish and enforce engineering best practices for coding standards, CI/CD, data quality, reliability, security, and observability.
Maintain hands‑on involvement in solution design and complex problem‑solving while providing technical direction to engineers across onshore and offshore teams.

Proactively identify and mitigate technical debt, delivery risks, and scalability constraints that could impact AI enablement or customer experience outcomes.

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Build sustainable delivery capacity by strengthening leadership bench, improving execution predictability, and promoting strong team ownership across the portfolio.

What you have

Required Qualifications

15+ years of recent, hands‑on data engineering experience, with a strong focus on real-time data ingestions, APIs, and distributed systems.
5+ years of technical leadership experience, owning delivery for complex, business‑critical platforms.
5+ years of people leadership experience, leading multiple cross‑functional engineering teams.

Proven experience leading large‑scale data platform migrations or modernization initiatives.

Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, including presenting technical strategies, risks, and outcomes to non‑technical audiences.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Director, Software Engineering
Position Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Director of Software Engineering
to provide strategic and technical leadership for the development of sophisticated, mission-critical software supporting advanced industrial, manufacturing, and defense-related programs.

This senior leadership role will be responsible for establishing the software engineering vision, shaping technical direction, and overseeing the delivery of secure, dependable, and high-performance software platforms. The Director will work across engineering, product development, systems engineering, manufacturing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management organizations to ensure software capabilities support both current operational requirements and long-term business objectives.

The successful candidate will bring a combination of deep software engineering expertise, organizational leadership, architectural judgment, and experience delivering complex systems in highly regulated or technically demanding environments.

Key Responsibilities
Establish and execute a long-term software engineering strategy aligned with organizational objectives, product roadmaps, and evolving technology requirements.
Provide technical direction across multiple software development programs and ensure consistent engineering practices across teams.
Lead the architecture, design, development, integration, verification, deployment, and sustainment of mission-critical software.
Oversee engineering organizations responsible for embedded, application, platform, systems, and other software technologies as appropriate.
Work closely with product and systems engineering leadership to translate customer and operational requirements into scalable software solutions.
Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to ensure software development activities effectively support production, integration, testing, and lifecycle requirements.
Establish appropriate architectural standards, development methodologies, coding practices, and engineering processes.
Champion modern software development approaches, including automation, continuous integration and delivery, DevSecOps, automated testing, and disciplined configuration management.
Promote appropriate adoption of cloud, data, artificial intelligence, automation, and other emerging technologies where they provide meaningful business or technical value.
Ensure software solutions meet applicable requirements for security, reliability, safety, quality, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.
Collaborate with cybersecurity and information assurance teams to incorporate security throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating it as a final-stage activity.
Establish engineering metrics and performance indicators to monitor delivery, quality, reliability, technical debt, productivity, and operational effectiveness.
Identify technical risks and organizational constraints and develop strategies to address them before they affect program execution.
Balance near-term delivery commitments with longer-term investments in architecture, infrastructure, tooling, modernization, and engineering capability.
Provide technical guidance during major design reviews, architecture decisions, program planning activities, and critical issue resolution.
Ensure engineering teams maintain appropriate documentation, development standards, test strategies, and configuration controls.
Support the evaluation and introduction of new technologies, tools, platforms, and development methodologies.
Coordinate software development activities across geographically distributed teams and ensure effective collaboration between locations and functions.

Organizational Leadership
A major component of this position is building and developing a strong engineering organization.
The Director will:
Lead and mentor engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
Establish clear organizational structures, responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations.
Recruit, develop, and retain highly skilled software engineering professionals.
Build succession plans and create opportunities for technical and leadership development.
Foster an environment where engineers are encouraged to challenge assumptions, propose improvements, and take ownership of technical outcomes.
Promote collaboration between software, systems, hardware, manufacturing, product, quality, and cybersecurity organizations.
Develop a culture centered on accountability, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and measurable improvement.
Encourage knowledge sharing and consistency of engineering practices across teams and locations.
Help create an inclusive environment in which diverse technical perspectives contribute to better engineering decisions.

Program & Product Partnership
The Director will serve as a senior software representative in broader product and program discussions. This includes partnering with stakeholders to establish realistic development strategies, prioritize technical investments, and align engineering capacity with business needs.
You will help ensure that software roadmaps remain synchronized with product development, system architecture, manufacturing schedules, customer requirements, and future technology initiatives.

The role will also involve communicating complex technical issues to senior leadership, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, resource requirements, and recommended courses of action.

Quality, Safety & Security
Because the software supports high-consequence applications, strong attention to reliability and compliance is essential.

The Director will help ensure that engineering teams:
Apply appropriate software quality and verification practices.
Incorporate cybersecurity principles throughout development and deployment.
Follow applicable safety, regulatory, contractual, and industry requirements.
Maintain rigorous configuration and change-control processes.
Identify and mitigate reliability and security risks.
Establish appropriate automated and manual testing strategies.
Address defects and technical debt systematically.
Maintain traceability between requirements, implementation, verification, and released capabilities.
Continuously improve engineering processes based on lessons learned and measurable performance data.

Strategic Technology Leadership
Beyond day-to-day delivery, this position will help define the organization's future software capabilities.

The Director will evaluate emerging technologies and determine where modernization can improve engineering efficiency, product capability, scalability, security, or competitiveness. This may include evaluating new development frameworks, automation platforms, AI-assisted engineering tools, distributed architectures, advanced simulation environments, data platforms, or other technologies relevant to the organization's products.

The ideal leader will understand that modernization is not simply about adopting new technology; it requires thoughtful architecture, disciplined implementation, effective change management, and measurable business or engineering outcomes.

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a strategic engineering leader who remains technically credible while operating effectively at an organizational level. You should be comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed technical discussions and have demonstrated success leading complex software organizations.

Strong candidates will typically bring:
Significant experience leading software engineering organizations.
A strong background in software architecture, development, integration, and delivery.
Experience managing engineering managers and senior technical professionals.
Demonstrated success delivering complex, high-reliability or mission-critical software.
Experience working in environments where security, safety, quality, and regulatory requirements are important.
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and development methodologies.
Experience establishing technical strategy and multi-year engineering roadmaps.
Strong program and stakeholder management capabilities.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing technical teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
The ability to make sound technical decisions while balancing schedule, cost, risk, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Leadership Profile

We are looking for a leader who can combine technical depth with organizational vision
. The successful candidate will be able to establish direction without unnecessarily restricting innovation, create accountability without compromising collaboration, and make difficult engineering decisions while keeping teams focused on mission and customer outcomes.

This is an opportunity to influence the technology strategy of a sophisticated organization, shape the next generation of software capabilities, and build an engineering culture capable of delivering dependable solutions for some of the most technically challenging applications in the industry.

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Machine Learning Engineering team inside Checkr’s Data & ML organization. This team sits at the heart of our product's strategic advantage, making millions of background checks faster, more accurate, and more trustworthy.

The Team Owns Three Connected Areas

Core product intelligence: NLP and classification systems, entity resolution, profile integrity, model accuracy, and the production services that power Checkr’s products.
Workforce integrity: resume and identity fraud, multi-signal risk detection, and new products that help customers identify sophisticated hiring fraud
ML and agent infrastructure: evaluation systems, observability, model lifecycle, agent orchestration, and reusable infrastructure that helps every team ship reliable AI faster.

This is an engineering leadership role, not a research-management role: you will lead ML engineers across seniority levels, stay close enough to the work to set technical direction, and hold the team accountable for production outcomes. You will decide where ML should continue to create a strategic advantage for Checkr.

You will also shape Checkr’s broader AI strategy. The near-term agenda includes building a measurable accuracy moat in our core products, launching an end-to-end workforce-integrity product, and creating the evaluation and knowledge infrastructure required to operate AI agents in a regulated domain. This role reports to the Sr. Director of Data & ML within Engineering. This role is based in San Francisco. We are looking for someone who is seeking less process and more shipping, less paperwork and more results.

What You’ll Do

Lead and grow the ML Engineering team. Hire, coach, and develop ML engineers. Set clear ownership, grow technical leaders, and build a team that generates its own roadmap.
Set the strategy and roadmap. Turn ambiguous company priorities into a focused, multi-quarter ML agenda. Put investment on work that improves customer outcomes, revenue, accuracy, reliability, or cost. Stop work that does not.
Raise the production engineering bar. Models and agents ship as dependable software: clear APIs, tests, CI/CD, observability, on-call ownership, and defined reliability targets.
Build the ML operating model. Establish shared approaches to evaluation, golden sets, training-data provenance, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, retraining, latency, and cost. Replace artisanal evaluation with repeatable systems.
Advance core product intelligence. Guide systems for classification, information extraction, entity resolution, profile integrity, and accuracy. Make model quality measurable in production and drive the feedback loops that improve it.
Launch new AI and fraud products. Partner with Product, Security, Operations, and go-to-market teams to turn signals across identity, resume, device, and employment data into customer products.
Lead Checkr’s agentic transition. Guide the design of AI systems that combine specialized models, LLMs, tools, and governed knowledge.
Operate as an executive partner. Explain technical choices and risks in plain language. Align Product Engineering, Product, Operations, Legal, Security, and company leadership when incentives or constraints conflict.
Model AI-native leadership. Use AI to increase the team’s speed and ambition. Keep ownership of every output. As generated code becomes cheaper, raise the bar on judgment, verification, and system design.

What You Bring

10+ years building software and machine learning or AI systems, with a clear progression in scope and impact.
3+ years managing ML or software engineers, including hiring and developing senior and staff-level technical leaders.
A strong software-engineering foundation and a record of shipping ML systems that run in production.
Technical depth across the ML lifecycle: data and labeling, experimentation, model selection, deployment, APIs, CI/CD, observability, evaluation, retraining, and incident response.
Sound judgment across classical ML, deep learning, LLMs, rules, and conventional software.
Experience setting direction for NLP, classification, extraction, entity resolution, risk, fraud, recommendation, or similarly complex applied-ML domains.
Fluency with modern LLM systems, including structured outputs, tool use, agent orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, latency, quality, and cost trade-offs.
A record of translating an ambiguous business problem into a sharp roadmap, measurable outcomes, and shipped systems.
Strong people leadership. You create leverage through clear ownership, candid feedback, delegation, and coaching.
Executive-level communication and cross-functional influence. You can make a hard technical trade-off legible to senior leaders and leave the room with a decision.
You use modern AI tools to move faster, verify their output, and can spot plausible-looking work that should not ship.
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Nice to have

Built ML infrastructure or MLOps platforms used by multiple teams.
Document intelligence, OCR, graph systems, identity resolution, trust and safety, fraud, or risk.
Operated ML in a compliance-sensitive domain such as fintech, legal tech, HR tech, healthcare, or security.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The University at Buffalo
(UB) invites nominations and applications for the position of Assistant Vice President of Infrastructure (AVP). Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer, the AVP will be responsible for leading the Enterprise Infrastructure Services and Network and Communication Services units across UB's three campuses.

University at Buffalo

Impactful research
,scholarly distinction, transformative student experiences, and far-reaching service to local, state, national, and international communities define UB's mission as one of the nation's leading public research universities. UB was founded in 1846 as a private medical college located in downtown Buffalo and joined the SUNY network in 1962. SUNY is the largest state university system in the United States, and UB is a flagship campus and the largest and most comprehensive public research university within the system. In 1989, UB was among the first public universities in the Northeast to be admitted into the AAU. Over the years, UB's scope and mission have expanded significantly as it has grown into a world-renowned research university that is the thriving heart of the regional community, a national leader in public higher education, and a global hub for excellence in research and education.

UB enrolls more than 32,000 students (approximately two-thirds undergraduate and one-third graduate and professional students) and offers more than 500 degree programs at the baccalaureate, master's, professional, and doctoral levels acrossits 12 decanal units
. UB has a distinguished faculty of over 1,500 full-time members. UB is currently undertaking its largest faculty­ hiring initiative in recent history, Advancing Top 25: UB Faculty Hiring
, with plans to recruit upward of 200 full-time faculty over the next two years.

UB is home to more than 120 research centers and institutes; its current annual research expenditures, including those in affiliated institutions, exceed $425 million. UB's academic programs and facilities are located on three distinct campuses in the Buffalo metropolitan area. UB's North Campus, located in the suburb of Amherst, is the university's main undergraduate campus and home to the university's primary athletics and cultural facilities. Three miles to the south, on the northern edge of the City of Buffalo, is the university's historic South Campus, home to many of the university's professional schools. The focal point of UB's third, downtown campus center is the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, on which UB's state-of-the-art Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences is in proximity to the university's health and life science partners. UB also competes in the prestigious Mid-American Conference and at the highest level of National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) competition, the FBS Division I level.

With an annual operating revenue of $850 million, UB and its affiliated entities generate an estimated economic impact of $2.1 billion annually in New York State. The university's total workforce of over 9,000 full-time equivalent employees makes it one of the region's largest employers. UB is also a leader and an active partner with the more than 20 public and private colleges and universities in the Buffalo-Niagara region.

The Position

The Assistant Vice President for Infrastructure (AVP)
is a dynamic and visionary leader that is a strategic partner and advisor to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer (VPCIO)
. This is a VPCIO Cabinet Leadership
position that plays a pivotal role in shaping and growing the UB Information Technology (UBIT)
organization to align with and advance the university's goals. As a member of the VPCIO Cabinet, the AVP will ensure that UBIT’s people, processes, and technology are equipped to support the university's mission. The AVP directs special projects and strategic priorities as assigned by the VPCIO, spanning institutional planning, cross-divisional partnerships, and IT governance. This position serves as a senior thought leader in the university’s digital transformation efforts, proactively contributing towards the future direction of technology at the university.

The AVP for Infrastructure
provides strategic leadership for the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS
) and Network and Communication Services (NCS)
units, ensuring UB’s network, cloud, data center, and core computer environments remain secure, reliable, and scalable, while advancing technologies, systems, and processes to meet UB’s goals. Working closely with campus partners and IT leadership, the AVP drives coordinated service delivery, continuous improvement, and infrastructure innovation that supports the university’s academic, research, and administrative needs.

This is a newly created role, and the AVP
will have the opportunity to shape how these two units – each with its own history, culture, and operating rhythm – come together as a single, unified infrastructure organization. The successful candidate will build trust across both teams while also thinking beyond day-to-day operations: reassessing UB’s data center footprint, advancing a deliberate cloud and colocation strategy, and positioning the university’s infrastructure to support an ambitious research and AI agenda. The AVP
will need to balance the discipline required to keep mission-critical systems running with the vision to challenge long-standing practices and move UBIT’s infrastructure into closer alignment with where the university is headed.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership

Provide strategic direction and oversight to the EIS and NCS units, which includes establishing and advancing a cohesive portfolio strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals and VPCIO priorities, ensuring coordination across infrastructure and communication systems, emerging technologies, and customer-facing services
This role carries a substantive policymaking function. By directing the planning, design, and operation of the university’s data networks, telecommunications, and enterprise infrastructure systems, the AVP leads the establishment and enforcement of the technical and operational policies that guide campus wide technology use, reliability, security, and compliance. The position’s regular engagement with senior academic and administrative leadership ensures that infrastructure standards and related policies align with institutional priorities.
Lead long-range and annual planning, including workforce and succession planning, budget oversight, and investment prioritization to ensure sustainable operations and future-ready capabilities
Assess the current structure, staffing levels, and operations of EIS and NCS, and lead the organizational changes needed to address staffing gaps, evolving service demands, and succession needs, given the significant portion of both units’ workforce eligible for retirement in the coming years
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement by promoting professional development, mentoring leaders, and enabling teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and customer-centered IT solutions

Drive Strategic Alignment

Ensure that IT initiatives are closely aligned with the university’s strategic goals and mission
Work with university leadership to shape, prioritize, and execute projects that support academic, administrative, and research objectives, while balancing divisional advocacy with institutional priorities and shared enterprise outcomes

Foster Synergies

Promote collaboration and synergy among UBIT departments including but not limited to Innovation, Enterprise Application Services, IT Customer Experience, and Research IT
Leverage strengths and expertise to create a cohesive, efficient IT environment that enhances performance and innovation

Innovate and Transform

Champion innovation and transformation and identify opportunities for technological advancements, process improvements, and new initiatives that move the university forward
Lead the evaluation and evolution of UB’s data center strategy, including assessment of colocation options and consolidation of aging, decentralized data center and server infrastructure across campus
Advance UB’s cloud adoption strategy, building on early planning efforts to shift appropriate administrative and enterprise systems to cloud and hybrid-cloud environments
Partner with UBIT’s Innovation and Research IT units, and academic and research partners to ensure infrastructure supports the university’s growing AI and research computing needs
Champion improvements in customer service and responsiveness across EIS and NCS, working to change perceptions of infrastructure as a barrier to progress and building stronger partnerships with academic and administrative units

Build and Strengthen UBIT

In partnership with other AVPs and senior leaders within UBIT, build and strengthen the VPCIO organization in operating as an integrated leadership team
Develop and implement strategies to enhance the capabilities and effectiveness of UBIT while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and ensuring that the VPCIO is well-positioned to support the university's evolving needs

Buffalo Niagara

As a world-renowned research university, UB's intellectual capital and innovation are playing a vital role in Buffalo's resurgence as a thriving city that is a magnet for talented professionals, artists, entrepreneurs, and innovators who recognize the tremendous energy and momentum gathering here. Home to one of the nation's fastest growing populations of college graduates, the Buffalo­Niagara region, with 1.2 million residents, is the state's second largest major metropolitan area, exceeded only by New York City. The region includes a diverse blend of communities, each with its own distinct personality, yet commonly characterized by a distinctly neighborly way of life, an unpretentious nature and spirited loyalty among residents. Buffalo's own strong sense of community, easy lifestyle, and affordability regularly place it in top ten lists from a variety of national publications for its overall quality of life.

Rich in natural resources and beauty, the Buffalo-Niagara area is a four-season region that offers the best for seasonal sports enthusiasts. University at Buffalo fans enjoy a full complement of NCAA division I sports with the UB Bulls, as well as the NFL's Buffalo Bills, the NH L's Buffalo Sabres, Triple­A baseball's Buffalo Bisons, and the National Lacrosse League's Buffalo Bandits.

Less than a two-hour drive from Buffalo across the United States-Canada border is Toronto, the cultural, entertainment, and financial capital of Canada. Buffalo is also ideally located for easy access to many of America's major cities. The Buffalo-Niagara International Airport offers direct flights to more than 20 cities, including New York, Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, and Washington, DC, all only an hour's flight away.

UB has played a central role in the creation of a strong, sustainable knowledge economy and thriving entrepreneurial culture that are driving Buffalo's revitalization. Exemplified and driven by the centrally located Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, UB's Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, Buffalo is experiencing a period of tremendous progress and momentum as well as unprecedented regional investments in the industries of the future and in the assets that ensure a satisfying quality of life for all its citizens.

Further, we responsibly acknowledge the continuing impact of settler colonialism on the Haudenosaunee and their territories.

jobs.title: Director of Production Automation and Process Engineering
jobs.description:
CI Solutions is expanding its production capacity and preparing to open a new production facility, including the addition of four to five automated UV digital printing systems.
We currently have dedicated project management, production management, and engineering resources. This role will work alongside those teams, with a specific focus on production automation, systems integration, and scaling the operation from a single production line to multiple coordinated production units.

The initial focus will be developing a complete understanding of the existing equipment and end-to-end production workflow. This leader will then define how the operation must change to support multiple production lines efficiently. They must understand the intricacies of moving from one line to many, including job routing, equipment utilization, shared resources, staffing, maintenance, quality control, production visibility, redundancy, and exception handling.

The primary objective is to build a scalable and increasingly automated production model that can sustainably reduce standard lead times from approximately 20 business days to 7–10 business days without sacrificing print quality, personalization accuracy, data integrity, or service reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the strategy for scaling CI Solutions production environment from a single-line workflow to multiple coordinated production units.
Clearly articulate the business case for production investments, including expected capacity, labor impact, throughput improvement, operating risk, cost, and return.
Define how jobs should be scheduled, routed, prioritized, balanced, and reassigned across multiple production units.
Design processes that prevent equipment expansion from creating additional manual handoffs, disconnected workflows, or new production bottlenecks.
Determine which production functions should be centralized, and which should be managed at the individual line level.
Establish a scalable operating model for shared resources such as data preparation, prepress, quality control, maintenance, material handling, packaging, and shipping.
Automate data validation, personalization setup, job creation, proofing, production release, job routing, inspection, reconciliation, sorting, labeling, and reporting wherever practical.
Define the software, integration, and reporting capabilities required to manage multiple production lines.
Partner with engineering and software teams to translate production needs into clear system requirements and prioritized development work.
Lead the planning and operational launch of the new production facility.
Support the installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production ramp-up of 4-5 additional automated UV digital printing systems.
Validate that the facility’s electrical service, environmental controls, ventilation, networking, equipment layout, material flow, safety systems, and supporting infrastructure meet the needs of a multi-line production operation.
Develop standards for equipment configuration, calibration, UV curing, ink adhesion, color consistency, registration, white-ink applications, preventive maintenance, and changeovers.
Design the production environment for resilience so that equipment maintenance or failure does not unnecessarily stop the entire operation.
Establish measurable standards for cycle time, throughput, equipment utilization, uptime, work in progress, spoilage, rework, labor efficiency, personalization accuracy, and on-time completion.
Work closely with production management on execution while maintaining ownership of automation, process design, capacity planning, and scalable production architecture.

Required Experience:

10+ years of progressive experience in print manufacturing, production automation, process engineering, or industrial operations.
Demonstrated experience scaling an operation from one production line to multiple coordinated lines or production units.
Experience designing automated workflows that connect data intake, production equipment, quality control, and fulfillment.
Direct experience with large-format, industrial, or high-volume UV digital printing.
Ability to translate business goals and operating constraints into technical equipment, software, facility, and staffing requirements.
Experience developing capacity models and business cases for equipment, automation, and facility investments.
Experience installing, commissioning, and completing acceptance testing for new production equipment.
Strong understanding of job routing, production scheduling, line balancing, bottleneck analysis, preventive maintenance, redundancy, and process control.
Experience working across production, engineering, software, project management, and executive leadership.

CI Solutions develops secure identity and credentialing solutions for schools and other organizations. We value long-term relationships, approach our work with integrity, and take pride in delivering products our clients depend on every day.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
IT and Programming - Memphis, Tennessee

Department IT and Programming

Employment Type Full-Time

Minimum Experience Manager/Supervisor

Role Summary

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, focused engineering team and stay close enough to the code to review it, debug it, and occasionally write it. We are not looking for someone who manages from a spreadsheet.

You will own delivery of our recovery intelligence platform, the engine that finds third-party liability recovery opportunities our clients would otherwise never see. That work spans the full stack: web and desktop interfaces, middle-tier services, the API layer that connects them, and the SQL underneath it all. Some of the estate is modern, containerized, and running on Azure. Some of it is a mature Windows desktop application that has been earning revenue for years and still needs to be supported while it evolves. You will be comfortable with both, and clear-eyed about how to move from one to the other without breaking what works.

The technical range here is real: API engineering, web and WinForms front ends, backend services, microservices, containerization, Kubernetes, and Azure. So is the ownership. This is a small company, which means the person in this seat sets the engineering standard rather than inheriting one. This is a remote position; candidates in or near Memphis, TN are preferred.

Core Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and grow a small software engineering team, setting technical standards, running planning and delivery cadence, and removing blockers.
Own end-to-end delivery for the recovery intelligence platform: scope, sequence, estimate, ship, and support what you ship.
Design and build the API layer and middle-tier services that expose platform capability to internal applications and external partners.
Work across the stack, from web user interfaces and the existing Windows desktop application through backend services and data access.
Design, write, and tune SQL: schema design, stored procedures, indexing, and query performance on large data sets.
Decompose monolithic components into microservices where it earns its keep, favoring incremental migration over rewrites that put revenue at risk.
Containerize workloads and operate them reliably on Kubernetes in Azure.
Own the build and release path: source control strategy, code review, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and release quality.
Direct the day-to-day work of outsourced development partners, holding them to the same standards for code quality, security, and documentation.
Hold the line on non-functional requirements: security and PHI protection, performance, reliability, logging, and observability.
Reduce single points of failure by documenting undocumented business logic and spreading institutional knowledge across the team.
Balance new capability against technical debt, and make the tradeoff visible rather than silent.

Qualifications

Experience

8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years leading or managing a development team.
Strong hands-on background in C# and .NET, including API engineering and REST service design.
Experience building and maintaining both web applications and Windows desktop applications (WinForms or comparable).
Strong SQL Server skills: complex queries, stored procedures, schema design, and performance tuning.
Practical experience with microservices architecture, containerization, and Kubernetes.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including compute, storage, identity, and managed Kubernetes.
Experience owning CI/CD pipelines and modern source control practice, such as Azure DevOps or equivalent.
Track record modernizing a legacy application incrementally while keeping it in production.
Knowledge of healthcare and insurance data is strongly preferred.

Required Competencies

Technical credibility with engineers, earned by staying close to the code rather than above it.
Judgment about sequencing and risk, especially when the system in question is generating revenue today.
Solid engineering habits: version control, testing, code review, reproducibility, and documentation.
Ability to spot opportunities while organizing data chaos and cutting through noise.
Clear communication of technical tradeoffs, status, and risk to both technical and business audiences.
Self-starter with a track record of achievement who will roll up sleeves to tackle hard projects.

Education

S./B.A. required in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

License/Certification

Azure certification (e.g., AZ-204 or AZ-305) preferred.
Kubernetes certification (e.g., CKA or CKAD) a plus.

Preferred

Deeper experience with healthcare, insurance, or claims data in a regulated, high-compliance environment.
Experience managing nearshore or offshore development partners.
Experience with event-driven architecture, message queues, and integration patterns.
Experience introducing automated testing to a codebase that did not previously have it.
Located in or near Memphis, TN.

Who is Intellivo?

As an industry market leader in subrogation, Intellivo empowers health plans and insurers to maximize financial outcomes by identifying and pursuing more reimbursement opportunities from alternative third-party liability (TPL) payers. Through innovative technology, Intellivo accelerates the identification of reimbursement opportunities while eliminating burdensome outreach to plan members. With a 26-year history of excellence, Intellivo proudly represents more than 200 of the country’s largest health plans.

We are Intellivators – forward-thinking pioneers building the technologies that Fortune 500 employers, health plans, TPAs, providers, and billing organizations rely on to ensure responsible claim payments. Fueled by our experience and innovative startup mentality, we are growing fast.

Benefits That Support You Inside and Outside of Work

401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match

Employee Assistance Program with counseling, financial coaching, legal resources, career coaching, and wellness support

A high-performing, collaborative culture built on ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact

jobs.description:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

This is a people manager role that will lead teams to drive strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well-respected people leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies.
Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF.
An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes.
Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products.
A professional with a track record of coming up with new ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects.
Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with a cross-functional team of scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered platforms and solutions that change how customers interact with their money.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

Basic Qualifications:

PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 6 years of experience in Applied Research or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 8 years of experience in Applied Research
At least 5 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications [choose applicable set based on focus of role]:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related fields
LLM
PhD focus on NLP or Masters with 10 years of industrial NLP research experience
Core contributor to team that has trained a large language model from scratch (10B + parameters, 500B+ tokens)
Numerous publications at ACL, NAACL and EMNLP, Neurips, ICML or ICLR on topics related to the pre-training of large language models (e.g. technical reports of pre-trained LLMs, SSL techniques, model pre-training optimization)
Has worked on an LLM (open source or commercial) that is currently available for use
Demonstrated ability to guide the technical direction of a large-scale model training team
Experience working with 500+ node clusters of GPUs Has worked on LLM scaled to 70B parameters and 1T+ tokens
Experience with common training optimization frameworks (deep speed, nemo)

Behavioral Models
PhD focus on topics in geometric deep learning (Graph Neural Networks, Sequential Models, Multivariate Time Series)
Member of technical leadership for model deployment for a very large user behavior model
Multiple papers on topics relevant to training models on graph and sequential data structures at KDD, ICML, NeurIPs, ICLR
Worked on scaling graph models to greater than 50m nodes Experience with large scale deep learning based recommender systems
Experience with production real-time and streaming environments
Contributions to common open source frameworks (pytorch-geometric, DGL)
Proposed new methods for inference or representation learning on graphs or sequences
Worked datasets with 100m+ users

Optimization (Training & Inference)
PhD focused on topics related to optimizing training of very large language models
5+ years of experience and/or publications on one of the following topics: Model Sparsification, Quantization, Training Parallelism/Partitioning Design, Gradient Checkpointing, Model Compression

Finetuning

Demonstrated knowledge of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidance
Experience deploying a fine-tuned large language model

Data Preparation

jobs.title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

MySQL Server Core Engineering develops the foundational database capabilities that enable MySQL to deliver high performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence for open-source users, enterprise customers, and cloud services.

As a Director, you will lead a broad Core Engineering organization responsible for critical database-server technology. You will set technical and organizational strategy, establish roadmap and investment priorities, develop engineering leaders and talent, and partner across product, cloud-service, and engineering organizations to deliver strategic customer and business outcomes.

This role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep experience in database systems or comparable infrastructure software. You will guide complex architectural and execution decisions while balancing innovation with the compatibility, quality, security, and operational standards expected of a mature, globally deployed database platform. You will also help advance MySQL as a more contribution-driven open-source project through strong technical stewardship, clear architecture, high engineering standards, effective contributor workflows, and community collaboration.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development

Set the multi-year technical and organisational strategy for MySQL Server Core Engineering, aligning database-platform investments with product strategy, cloud-service priorities, customer needs, and open-source commitments.

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for foundational database capabilities, including areas such as data management, query processing, transactions, concurrency, replication, security, performance, reliability, and operational tooling.

Establish organisational standards for compatibility, security, scalability, resilience, upgrade-ability, and operational readiness across the core database platform.

Make or sponsor high-impact technical decisions involving architectural direction, major migrations, compatibility commitments, lifecycle management, and long-term technology investments.

Shape MySQL’s evolution as a contribution-driven open-source project by sponsoring improvements in architecture, developer experience, governance, contribution workflows, technical documentation, and community collaboration.

Software Development and Coding, Design, Testing, and Optimization

Establish the engineering vision, quality bar, and execution model for complex database-server development across the organization.

Ensure teams deliver software that meets demanding requirements for correctness, performance, scalability, reliability, security, compatibility, and maintainability.

Sponsor major architecture, design, and specification reviews; ensure technical decisions align with strategic product outcomes and long-term platform health.

Drive organization-wide investment in engineering excellence, including automated testing, performance validation, diagnostics, observability, developer productivity, release readiness, and defect prevention.

Guide leaders in managing technical trade-offs across feature delivery, customer impact, operational risk, security, compatibility, and technical debt.

Ensure engineering teams maintain clear, stable, and well-governed interfaces across database components, services, tools, and supported integrations.

Software Architecture, Software System Structural Design

Own the architectural direction and long-term technical health of the MySQL Server Core Engineering portfolio.

Lead senior technical and engineering leaders in defining architecture principles, reviewing complex designs, and ensuring consistent technical standards across teams.

Drive strategic modernisation and simplification initiatives that improve platform scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and development velocity.

Partner with product, cloud-service, security, and other engineering leaders to align architecture decisions with business priorities, customer requirements, and future market needs.

Establish effective mechanisms for technology evaluation, architecture governance, technical-debt management, and investment prioritization.

Ensure that the organization makes timely, high-quality decisions on complex technical issues with broad product, customer, or business impact.

Issue/Defect Collaboration, Software Products Support

Provide executive technical leadership for high-impact customer, production, performance, availability, security, and product-quality issues.

Partner with product, cloud-service, support, and engineering leaders to establish clear escalation paths, decision mechanisms, and communication practices for critical issues.

Ensure teams deliver timely mitigation, root-cause analysis, durable corrective actions, and systemic prevention for broadly impactful issues.

Use customer feedback, operational evidence, and issue trends to guide quality investments, architectural improvements, and roadmap prioritization.

Represent the organization in executive-level discussions on major customer issues, technical risk, product commitments, and strategic remediation plans.

Practices and Standards Compliance, Security and Compliance

Set and enforce organizational expectations for secure software development, data protection, engineering quality, regulatory alignment, and operational risk management.

Ensure leaders establish and maintain appropriate security, compliance, privacy, code-quality, release, and operational standards across their teams.

Sponsor proactive identification and remediation of systemic technical, security, compatibility, and reliability risks.

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and cloud-service leaders to ensure core database technologies meet applicable enterprise and service requirements.

Promote a culture of technical accountability, rigorous review, clear documentation, and continuous improvement.

Development Operations, System Maintenance

Ensure the organization maintains strong operational discipline for software maintenance, lifecycle support, upgrades, patching, release readiness, and incident response.

Set expectations for reliable operational practices, including automation, testing, observability, diagnostics, performance management, and service-health improvement.

Lead investments that strengthen product availability, supportability, upgradeability, and operational efficiency across the database platform.

Ensure lessons from customer issues, production incidents, and service operations are incorporated into product strategy, engineering practices, and technology roadmaps.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution

Set the strategic roadmap, investment priorities, operating model, and delivery expectations for the MySQL Server Core Engineering organization.

Lead multiple teams through complex, interdependent initiatives; ensure clear ownership, realistic milestones, effective resource allocation, and proactive risk management.

Balance short-term product and cloud-service commitments with sustained investment in architecture, quality, security, performance, reliability, technical debt, and open-source ecosystem health.

Provide senior leadership with transparent visibility into roadmap progress, material risks, investment trade-offs, staffing needs, and decisions requiring executive alignment.

Collaboration & Partnership

Build strong partnerships with senior leaders across engineering, product management, cloud services, support, security, and the open-source ecosystem.

Align cross-functional organizations on shared roadmap outcomes, technical dependencies, customer commitments, and strategic investments.

Represent MySQL Server Core Engineering in senior-level planning, architecture, product, and business discussions.

Create an organizational culture that encourages constructive challenge, diverse technical perspectives, clear decision-making, and shared accountability for outcomes.

Problem Solving

Lead resolution of the organization’s most complex and consequential technical, operational, customer, and business challenges.

Provide strategic judgment and direction when decisions require balancing customer impact, delivery commitments, technical risk, organizational capacity, and long-term platform health.

Ensure leaders use rigorous analysis, system-level understanding, and root-cause methods to address issues and prevent recurrence.

Drive systemic improvements where recurring issues indicate architectural, process, capability, or operating-model gaps.

Continuous Learning

Maintain strategic awareness of database systems, cloud platforms, open-source ecosystems, customer needs, and industry technology trends.

Build an organization that continuously develops technical depth, leadership capability, domain knowledge, and cross-functional understanding.

Identify critical skill gaps and establish talent-development, hiring, knowledge-sharing, and succession strategies for specialized database and systems expertise.

Encourage leaders to create learning opportunities that strengthen innovation, technical judgment, engineering effectiveness, and organizational resilience.

Continuous Improvement

Lead a sustained improvement agenda across architecture, engineering quality, delivery practices, developer productivity, operational excellence, and contributor experience.

Prioritize improvement investments based on customer impact, strategic value, technical risk, organizational scalability, and long-term return.

Establish mechanisms to measure engineering effectiveness, identify systemic bottlenecks, and drive accountable improvements across teams.

Advance MySQL’s contribution-driven open-source model through strong technical stewardship, transparent development practices, maintainable design, and effective engagement with contributors.

Performance and Development

Build and lead a high-performing leadership organization through clear expectations, coaching, talent development, accountability, and succession planning.

Develop managers and senior technical leaders who can independently lead complex technology areas, make sound decisions, and build strong teams.

Establish a talent strategy that attracts, retains, and develops specialists in database systems, systems software, cloud technologies, and open-source engineering.

Ensure consistent, equitable performance management, promotion, recognition, and career-development practices across the organization.

Partner with Human Resources and senior leadership to plan organizational capability, leadership succession, and workforce needs in support of long-term strategy.

Qualifications

Career Level - M4

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

As the Data Center Engineering Operation (DCEO) Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

As the DCEO Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

Key job responsibilities

Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.
Operate independently with limited direct management
Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

About The Team

Please ensure you apply with your CV in English.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
Experience with power management and power monitoring systems
This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge of critical data center equipment
Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains
