jobs.title: VP/ Sr. Director - Global Head of Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Help turn payment fraud protection into a compelling financial business case.

At Eftsure, we’re scaling our presence across the United States and looking for a VP or Senior Director - Global Head of Value Engineering
who can connect our technology to the financial outcomes that matter most to CFOs, treasury leaders and finance teams.

This is a 100% remote opportunity anywhere in the US
, working closely with our Sales team on strategic and enterprise opportunities.

If you’re commercially minded, financially savvy and love translating technology into a clear story around ROI, risk reduction and business value, this could be a great opportunity to join a growing global fintech.

About Eftsure

Eftsure is a fast-scaling SaaS fraud technology platform protecting B2B payments through real-time vendor verification and payment protection. In a world of increasingly sophisticated cybercrime and payment fraud, we help businesses transact securely and avoid paying the wrong people.

As we continue to expand internationally, our goal is to become the Security Standard for B2B payments.

About The Role

As our Value Engineer, you’ll partner closely with Account Executives to build the financial and commercial case for Eftsure.

You’ll work directly with prospects and customers to understand their current environment, quantify risk and opportunity, and demonstrate the measurable value Eftsure can deliver. That means taking platform capabilities and translating them into the language of CFOs, treasury teams and senior finance leaders - from ROI and risk reduction through to operational and financial impact.

This isn’t a traditional technical pre-sales role. We’re looking for someone who can sit at the intersection of finance, technology and enterprise sales, helping customers understand not just what Eftsure does, but why the investment makes commercial sense .

You’ll also have the opportunity to help build and shape Eftsure’s Value Engineering capability as we scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

Partner with Account Executives on strategic and enterprise opportunities, developing compelling and quantified business cases that translate Eftsure’s capabilities into financial outcomes.
Build and maintain value calculators, ROI models and tools that enable meaningful value conversations earlier in the sales cycle.
Work directly with prospects and internal stakeholders to understand their current state, business challenges and future needs.
Present findings, recommendations and business cases to C-Suite, senior management, treasury and finance stakeholders.
Translate technical capabilities into clear, credible and measurable business value.
Partner with Customer Success to track KPIs, monitor value and demonstrate post-sale value realization.
Contribute to thought leadership through presentations, webinars and content around payment fraud risk and financial controls.
Help build and continuously improve Eftsure’s Value Engineering frameworks, tools and processes as the function grows.

What we’re looking for

You’ll bring 3+ years’ experience in Value Engineering, Value Consulting, financial or treasury management, or a related pre-sales function - ideally within B2B SaaS or fintech.

You’ll Also Have

Strong financial acumen and confidence discussing the metrics, risks and priorities that matter to CFOs and finance leaders.
Experience building ROI models and quantified business cases.
Excellent client-facing communication and relationship-building skills.
Confidence presenting to C-Suite and senior stakeholders.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and broader proficiency across Microsoft Office.
The ability to take complex or technical platform capabilities and turn them into a simple, compelling financial story.
Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
A self-motivated, adaptable mindset and an interest in building processes and frameworks from the ground up.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or a related field.

Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, QAD or Epicor, or value engineering/ROI modelling platforms such as Cuvama, will be highly regarded. Working knowledge of GAAP, general ledger processes and cash flow forecasting would also be advantageous.

Why Eftsure?

This is an opportunity to join Eftsure at an exciting stage of our US growth and have genuine influence over how we demonstrate value to the market.

You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing and Finance, have exposure to senior customer stakeholders, and play an important role in helping strategic customers understand the financial impact of protecting their B2B payments.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to combine financial acumen, commercial strategy and technology while helping businesses protect themselves from payment fraud, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Vice President of Applications is a senior technology and transformation leader responsible for the strategy, delivery, optimization, and support of enterprise clinical and revenue cycle applications across the health system. This role provides executive oversight for the electronic health record platform, with a required depth of experience in Epic/Cerner or Cerner (Oracle Health), as well as adjacent clinical, operational, and revenue cycle systems that enable safe, efficient, integrated, and digitally enabled care delivery.

The VP will serve as a key partner to clinical, operational, financial, and technology leaders to transform workflows, improve clinician and patient experience, strengthen revenue cycle performance, and accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence, automation, and data-driven capabilities. This leader will be accountable for aligning application strategy with enterprise priorities, ensuring reliable service delivery, and advancing measurable outcomes across quality, access, productivity, financial performance, and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Reporting Relationship and Key Partnerships

This position typically reports to the Chief Digital and Information Officer, Chief Information Officer, or equivalent senior executive. The role partners closely with the Chief Medical Information Officer, Chief Nursing Informatics Officer, Chief Financial Officer, revenue cycle leadership, operational executives, compliance, information security, data and analytics, enterprise project management, and vendor partners.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise applications portfolio supporting clinical care, revenue cycle, patient access, pharmacy, laboratory, imaging, interoperability, and other health system operations.

Provide executive oversight for Epic/Cerner strategy, governance, implementation, optimization, release management, upgrades, support, and adoption across clinical and revenue cycle domains.

Develop and execute a multiyear applications roadmap aligned with health system strategy, clinical transformation, financial stewardship, regulatory priorities, and digital innovation goals.

Partner with clinical, operational, and financial leaders to redesign workflows that reduce friction, improve safety and quality, enhance provider and caregiver experience, and support standardized, evidence-based care.

Advance revenue cycle transformation by optimizing Epic/Cerner and related platforms to improve registration, authorization, coding, charge capture, billing, denial prevention, collections, and overall financial performance.

Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions that improve productivity, reduce manual work, strengthen decision support, and enable scalable operations.

Establish strong application governance, prioritization, and portfolio management practices that balance enterprise needs, operational demand, resource capacity, cybersecurity, compliance, and return on investment.

Ensure high-quality application service delivery, including incident management, problem resolution, service level performance, user support, change management, release readiness, and communication.

Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing applications organization with strong capabilities in Epic/Cerner, clinical informatics, revenue cycle systems, project delivery, vendor management, business analysis, testing, training, and customer service.

Collaborate with data, analytics, and AI leaders to embed actionable insights, predictive models, automation, and responsible AI practices into clinical and operational workflows.

Oversee vendor relationships, contract performance, platform roadmaps, and partner accountability for Epic/Cerner and other strategic application partners.

Maintain compliance with healthcare regulations, privacy and security requirements, documentation standards, change control processes, and audit expectations.

Measure and communicate outcomes using clear performance indicators tied to clinical effectiveness, revenue cycle value, application reliability, adoption, optimization, and user satisfaction.

Transformation Focus

This leader will be expected to move beyond traditional application support and serve as an enterprise transformation partner. The VP will help the organization use Epic/Cerner, AI, automation, analytics, and workflow redesign to simplify care delivery, reduce administrative burden, improve throughput, strengthen access, enhance documentation quality, and optimize revenue cycle performance. The role requires the ability to translate strategic priorities into executable technology roadmaps and measurable operational outcomes.

Qualifications

Required Education:
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, healthcare administration, business administration, clinical discipline, or related field.

Required Experience / Skills:
10 years of progressive healthcare information technology leadership experience, including significant experience leading clinical applications in a hospital, integrated delivery network, academic medical center, or large health system environment. Experience with Epic/Cerner/Cerner, including leadership responsibility for Epic/Cerner/Cerner implementation, optimization, upgrades, application support, governance, or enterprise roadmap planning. Demonstrated experience supporting or transforming clinical workflows, revenue cycle operations, patient access, and interdisciplinary care delivery through technology-enabled change. Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams and manage complex portfolios of applications, projects, vendors, budgets, and operational priorities. Experience applying AI, automation, analytics, or intelligent workflow capabilities to improve healthcare operations, clinical effectiveness, or administrative productivity. Strong understanding of healthcare operations, clinical informatics, revenue cycle processes, interoperability, regulatory requirements, privacy, security, and enterprise change management. Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, clinicians, operational leaders, and technology teams through clear communication, collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and disciplined execution.

Sr. Manager, IT Strategy & Security, onsite in Melville, NY

Our client in Melville, NY is seeking a strategic, hands-on IT leader to drive cybersecurity, infrastructure, AI governance, and digital transformation initiatives across the organization. Key Responsibilities:

✅ Lead cybersecurity, risk management, and compliance initiatives (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 13485)
✅ Oversee infrastructure, cloud environments, networks, VoIP, and end-user support
✅ Drive AI governance, tool evaluation, integration strategy, and data protection programs

✅ Partner with leadership to identify and implement technology-driven business improvements

Qualifications:

✔ 5+ years of IT leadership experience with a focus on security and strategy
✔ Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, etc.)
✔ Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise networks
✔ Hands-on experience with AI governance, risk management, and system integrations

• Direct visibility to executive leadership
• Opportunity to shape the company's cybersecurity and AI strategy
• High-impact role driving digital transformation and innovation

Key Focus Areas

Cybersecurity strategy, governance & incident response

jobs.title: Senior Director of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Director, Software Engineering will lead a globally distributed software engineering organization across the US, India, and Poland, setting technical direction and delivering scalable software solutions that create meaningful customer and business value. This role combines technical and organizational leadership across software architecture, engineering practices, AI-enabled development, and complex software platforms. The leader will partner across Product Management, Program Management, clinical teams, business stakeholders, and technology organizations to translate customer needs into engineering outcomes while balancing innovation, delivery, quality, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, privacy, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Lead a globally distributed software engineering organization across the US, India, and Poland, fostering collaboration, accountability, ownership, inclusion, continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
Define and execute an AI-first engineering strategy using AI-assisted development, automation, modern engineering practices, and emerging technologies to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and increase engineering productivity.
Establish technical standards, software architecture principles, engineering practices, and development methodologies that enable scalable, secure, reliable, maintainable, and extensible software solutions.
Provide technical leadership for complex software platforms spanning cloud, edge computing, distributed systems, data, analytics, and intelligent capabilities, guiding architecture and technical direction through strong software engineering and system design principles.
Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through development, release, deployment, and operational support, while advancing cloud-native development, DevSecOps, automation, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and quality engineering practices.
Partner with Product Management, Program Management, clinical teams, Quality, Security, Regulatory, business stakeholders, and technology leaders to translate customer needs and feedback into prioritized engineering outcomes, manage dependencies, resolve technical trade-offs, and drive adoption and measurable business value.
Influence product roadmaps, technical strategy, architecture decisions, and investment priorities by balancing customer value, business objectives, technical sustainability, and engineering excellence.
Build and develop engineering leadership and technical talent through hiring, mentoring, and development of engineering managers and technical leaders, while establishing an effective global operating model and consistent engineering standards across regions.
Ensure software solutions meet GE HealthCare expectations for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, privacy, and operational excellence.
Communicate technology strategy, execution progress, risks, opportunities, recommendations, and business outcomes effectively with executive leadership, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

jobs.title: Director of  Information Technology (Seattle or San Francisco)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Beale Infrastructure Group is a rapidly growing developer and owner of next-generation digital infrastructure assets, focused on delivering hyperscale data center campuses for leading global technology companies. The Company specializes in complex, large-scale projects that require significant coordination across land acquisition, power procurement, utility partnerships, and construction execution.

Operating at the intersection of real estate, energy, and technology, Beale's platform is designed to address the increasing demand for high-capacity, energy-efficient data infrastructure driven by cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and enterprise digital transformation. The Company partners closely with utilities and local communities to secure reliable power solutions and enable long-term, sustainable development.

Backed by Blue Owl Capital's Real Assets platform, Beale benefits from deep institutional capital, a disciplined investment approach, and an experienced leadership team with a proven track record in digital infrastructure development. The Company is in a high-growth phase, with an expanding pipeline of projects across key U.S. markets.

Position Overview

The Director of Information Technology will own the day-to-day operation of Beale's corporate technology environment. This is a hands-on, user-facing role, working alongside our managed IT services partner and our VP of Corporate Security.

This individual will be directly responsible to establish or update cross-platform capabilities, such as Beale's identity and access management (IAM); administer our systems; manage the device fleet; maintain and evolve the productivity suite; and activate further security capabilities and controls.

Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional business partners, the Director will keep a fast-moving company productive and secure from day-one onboarding to conference-room AV to tested backups while building the practical IT controls that support the Company's ISO 27001 and audit-readiness programs. The ideal candidate is a 'roll-up-your-sleeves' operator who has led IT evaluation, selection, and implementation in a growing company (start-up experience preferred); directly deployed and administered IAMs; fluent across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace; and enjoys fixing things as much as planning them.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the day-to-day owner and administrator of Beale's corporate technology environment - Microsoft 365and Google Workspace tenants, identity, devices, networks, and business applications.
Maintain, optimize and migrate (as necessary) email, calendar, file management & sharing, chat & collaboration, etc.
Design, deploy, and administer Beale's identity and access management (IAM) foundation on Okta or a similar identity platform SSO/SAML and OIDC integrations across the SaaS estate, SCIM-based automated provisioning and deprovisioning, MFA with phishing-resistant factors, and role- and group-based access.
Configure and operate the security capabilities, including but not limited to Defender, Intune, Entra conditional access, and Purview in partnership with the VP of Corporate Security.
Operate identity day to day: onboard applications into SSO, maintain separated admin accounts, keep joiner-mover-leaver access timely and least-privilege, and run quarterly access reviews.
Manage the mixed device fleet hands-on: MDM enrollment, configuration profiles, encryption, patching, and asset inventory from purchase through retirement.
Run employee onboarding and offboarding end-to-end with HR and our managed IT services partner, so new hires are productive on day one and departing access is closed out the same day.
Direct our managed IT services partner tickets, escalations, projects, and service levels while serving directly as the escalation point.
Be responsible for office technology in Beale U.S. offices (networks, Wi-Fi, AV, and conference rooms) and dependable connectivity for field teams at active project sites.
Implement backup and recovery for cloud collaboration data, and verify that restores actually work.
Administer the IT and SaaS vendor portfolio: licensing, renewals, spend tracking, and rationalization of overlapping tools.
Build and operate the practical IT controls behind the Company's ISO 27001 and audit-readiness programs: documented processes, access reviews, change discipline, and evidence collection.
Strong AI fluency or willingness to become proficient to permit integration of AI into our daily work.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related field preferred.
8+ years of hands-on IT administration and/or engineering experience, including time as the senior (or only) IT resource in a lean, high-growth company.
Proven, hands-on experience deploying and administering an enterprise identity platform, Okta strongly preferred (Entra ID or similar considered): SSO/SAML and OIDC app integrations, SCIM provisioning, MFA and adaptive access policies, and privileged account separation; Okta certification a plus.
Deep working expertise administering Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Defender) and Google Workspace; experience running cross-platform email and calendar migrations preferred.
Experience managing Mac and Windows fleets through MDM, with practical networking skills (firewalls, Wi-Fi, VLANs) for office environments.
Experience directing a managed services provider while staying personally accountable for outcomes and quality.
Familiarity with ISO 27001 and/or IT general controls and comfortable operating controls and producing audit evidence, not just writing policy.
Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and prioritization skills; calm under pressure and service-oriented at every level of the company.

Why Join Beale

Build Something Meaningful: Step into a high-impact role building the technology backbone of a fast- growing digital infrastructure platform at a pivotal moment in its expansion
Front-Row Seat to Industry Growth: Work on cutting-edge, hyperscale data center developments powering cloud computing, AI, and the next generation of digital innovation
True Business Partnering: Collaborate directly with senior leaders as a trusted advisor on critical projects
Backed to Scale: Join a platform supported by Blue Owl Capital, bringing deep capital, stability, and a strong track record in digital infrastructure investing
Entrepreneurial & Collaborative Culture: Be part of a lean, high-performing team where your voice matters and you can influence how the IT function evolves
Venture Beyond Your Lane: While specializing in corporate IT, gain exposure to security, compliance, and construction-technology matters as the platform grows

This role is based in: Seattle, WA or San Francisco, CA

Compensation: $215k - $250k + annual performance bonus

Beale offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. Individual salaries within our ranges are determined through a variety of factors, including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography.

jobs.title: Director of Operational Technology
jobs.description:
About Canopy Aerospace & Defense

Canopy A&D is built to accelerate the future of advanced materials for space, defense, and maritime systems. Canopy delivers specialized materials and components that carry customers from concept through sustainment. Canopy A&D’s advanced signal attenuation technologies and production-scale manufacturing accelerate the fielding of platforms that are faster, cooler, and quieter. Our adaptive approach ensures solutions evolve at the pace of shifting challenges, keeping our customers ahead of the curve.

Role Summary:

Canopy Aerospace & Defense is seeking a hands-on Director of Operational Technology to serve as second-in-command to the CIO and to own day-to-day manufacturing technology and IT operations from our Irvine, California facility. The OT environment is the center of gravity for this role: the machine-tool network, the controllers and inspection systems attached to it, and the segmentation and controls that keep that environment both running and compliant.

The successful candidate will be on the production floor and in the network room weekly — troubleshooting a controller segment, validating a restore, closing a control gap — while leading a team, managing vendors, owning a budget, and standing behind the environment during customer and third-party assessments. Uptime on the shop floor and demonstrable compliance are the same problem here, and this role owns both.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Technology

Own the manufacturing network and every device on it: CNC and multi-axis machining centers, CMMs and metrology, thermal processing and coating equipment controls, PLCs, HMIs, SCADA and historian systems, test cells, and shop-floor data collection
Maintain an accurate, continuously updated OT asset inventory — controller model, OS and firmware version, network address, criticality, owner, and patch or compensating-control status
Design and enforce segmentation between enterprise and plant-floor zones using a defensible zone-and-conduit model (Purdue / ISA-95, IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82). Own the industrial DMZ and control every conduit that crosses it
Manage legacy and ‘unpatchable’ machine controllers through isolation, allowlisting, media control, jump-host access, monitoring, and documented compensating controls that survive assessor scrutiny
Own secure, controlled transfer of NC code, program files, and inspection data between engineering, ERP/PLM, and the shop floor — including removable-media policy and its technical enforcement
Set network, security, and remote-access requirements for new equipment at the purchase-specification stage, in partnership with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Facilities. Vendor remote access is a decision this role owns, not a concession made at installation
Own OT business continuity: controller images, post-processor and parameter backups, tested restores, and documented recovery objectives for production-critical systems

IT Operations

Own day-to-day IT service delivery for multiple sites — incidents, requests, change and problem management — and serve as senior escalation and, when needed, the person who does the work
Maintain up-time for systems that stop the line: ERP/MES, DNC and machine-tool file transfer, shop-floor data collection, quality and inspection systems, labeling and travelers, time and attendance
Own core infrastructure and its lifecycle: Windows Server and Active Directory, Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, virtualization, enterprise networking, storage, backup and disaster recovery, and endpoint management
Support the environments behind ERP, CAD/CAM, PLM, simulation, and metrology, including license servers, high-performance workstations, and large-file storage performance

Compliance — CMMC, ITAR and SOC 2

Continue to maintain and sustain compliance across CMMC, ITAR, and SOC 2 for both IT and OT scope — not a one-time certification push, but ongoing operation of the control set, evidence generation, and audit readiness as a standing condition of the environment
Sustain NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 technical controls across the CUI enclave including in-scope OT assets; own SSP contributions, POA&M closure, SPRS scoring inputs, annual affirmation support, and boundary scoping decisions defensible to a C3PAO, DIBCAC, or a prime’s supply-chain security team
Enforce ITAR and EAR technical-data controls in the technology environment: U.S. Person access restriction, data residency and tenancy controls, controlled sharing with customers and suppliers, and auditable access records
Support SOC 2 examinations and AS9100 surveillance by operating controls continuously and producing evidence on demand rather than assembling it retroactively
Lead technical incident response for the site — containment, eradication, recovery, forensic preservation, and the 72-hour DoD reporting workflow under DFARS 252.204-7012 — with the CIO, Legal, and the Facility Security Officer

Leadership

Lead, coach, staff, and hold accountable the site IT/OT team; act as the CIO’s deputy to site leadership, Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Finance
Manage MSP, VAR, and equipment-vendor relationships including service levels, security flow-downs, and performance escalation; own the site operating and capital technology budget

Required Qualifications:

Minimum 10 years in information or operational technology, including at least 4 years leading a team with direct-report and budget accountability
Minimum 5 years supporting discrete manufacturing; aerospace, defense, or another regulated manufacturing sector required
Demonstrated hands-on experience with OT / industrial control environments — machine-tool networks, PLC/HMI/SCADA, or shop-floor data collection. Governance-only OT exposure will not be competitive
Direct experience implementing and sustaining NIST SP 800-171 controls, and participation in at least one CMMC readiness effort, DIBCAC assessment, or equivalent third-party assessment of a defense environment
Working knowledge of DFARS 252.204-7012, SPRS scoring, CUI handling, and ITAR-controlled technical data in an IT/OT context
Ownership of ERP operations in manufacturing (Epicor or similar) and of ERP/MES/PLM integrations; core Microsoft and enterprise networking depth
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent additional directly relevant experience
U.S. Person requirement. Must be a U.S. Person as defined at 8 U.S.C
1324b(a)(3) and 22 C.F.R
120.62, and able to pass a background investigation. On-site in Irvine five days per week; after-hours and weekend support required

Preferred Qualifications:

Active or eligible U.S. Government security clearance (Secret or higher)
Experience with IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and Purdue/ISA-95 architecture applied to a live plant; OT-aware monitoring and asset discovery
Experience in Microsoft GCC High / Azure Government, and with a segmented CUI enclave that includes OT assets in scope
Multi-site or multi-entity manufacturing group experience; AS9100 and NADCAP familiarity; certifications such as GICSP, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CCNP, or CMMC RP/CCP

Additional Requirements

Must have professional working proficiency reading, writing, and speaking English
Ability to work in office, lab, and manufacturing environments with occasional exposure to noise, chemicals, dust, industrial equipment, and temperature variations
Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer workstation
Frequent use of hands and fingers for data entry, keyboarding, and mouse use
Ability to view computer screens for prolonged periods
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and via email
Ability to use a computer to complete assignments 
Willingness to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
Willingness to travel to other Canopy A&D sites as needed

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

About This Role

Job Title: Director, Engineering - Transmission Line

At QISG, our Transmission Line teams play a vital role in the safe, reliable, and efficient delivery of power across communities and regions. We design, build, maintain, and upgrade high-voltage transmission infrastructure that supports the backbone of the electric grid. Whether working on new construction, line upgrades, or critical maintenance, our teams ensure projects are executed with the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance. Our work involves both traditional methods and the latest industry innovations to deliver sustainable, cost-effective, and reliable solutions for our customers.

The Director of Engineering for Transmission is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, design, and implementation of transmission line projects. This role involves managing a team of engineers and technical staff, ensuring that projects meet regulatory, safety, and quality standards, and supporting the company's strategic objectives. The Director will collaborate with other departments, stakeholders, and external partners to drive innovation, efficiency, and operational excellence in the company's transmission engineering activities.

What You'll Do

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and technical professionals.
Establish and maintain a high-performance culture, with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and talents.
Oversee the planning, design, and execution of transmission and substation projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and regulatory requirements.
Develop project budgets, schedules, and resource plans, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Manage risks and resolve issues that may impact project scope, quality, and delivery.
Provide technical guidance and expertise in the design and optimization of transmission and substation systems.
Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and regulatory changes, and integrate best practices into the engineering processes.
Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards in all engineering activities.
Contribute to the development of the company's strategic plans and objectives, particularly in the areas of transmission and substation infrastructure.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and technologies that can enhance the company's competitive position.
Collaborate with other departments, such as Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, regulators, contractors, and suppliers.
Represent the company at industry forums, conferences, and regulatory meetings, advocating for the company's interests and promoting its capabilities.
Other duties as assigned

What You'll Bring

Minimum of 15 years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage electrical projects.
Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited university.
P.E. license required.
Proven track record of successfully leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
Strong technical expertise in structural, civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering, with a comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices.
Expert knowledge of electric utility engineering and construction standards.
Advanced knowledge of utility industry processes including scheduling, contracts, coordinating and managing all disciplines.
Excellent business acumen and experience managing departmental budgets.
Knowledge of process and procedures for project controls and estimates.

jobs.title: Director of Network Engineering
jobs.description:
Director, Network Engineering & Operations

Direct Hire

Remote + Up to 25% Travel (Domestic and International. Active US Passport is required)

Position Summary

The Director, Network Engineering & Operations leads the implementation, support, and continuous improvement of secure enterprise network services across multiple countries. The role is accountable for reliable connectivity among offices, remote users, cloud platforms, data centers, on-premises environments, and third-party services while ensuring that network designs and operating practices comply with applicable regulatory, data-residency, privacy, cybersecurity, and telecommunications requirements.

The Director leads network engineers, service partners, carriers, and vendors and works closely with Cybersecurity, Cloud, Infrastructure, Architecture, Service Management, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Facilities, Procurement, and business leadership. The role combines strong technical expertise with operational discipline, documentation, stakeholder communication, and the ability to support a globally distributed environment. This is a remote position; some domestic and international travel will be required for site assessments, implementations, migrations, major incidents, and strategic planning.

Top Responsibilities

Architecture of all physical, virtual datacenters, and office networks
Required Expertise: Fortinet, Azure, Palo Alto, Enterprise Identity, Zscaler, Wireless, Circuits (DIA, Broadband)
ITSM/ITOM systems interconnection (Halo, NetBox, FortiManager/Analyzer/Authenticator/EMS)
Office/Workplace networking and circuits, VLAN design, Secure Access Design/Implementation
Operations / support design

Network Architecture, Design and Implementation

Plan and execute Network integration and migration to cloud
Architect of global network implementation, roadmap, engineering standards, and operational maintenance of Office cloud and on-premises environments.
Stand up full Fortinet Estate to service existing and new Datacenter, Cloud, and Office networks
Cloud Micro segmentation
Cloud NVA standup, design, maintenance, routing
Network DR design, execution, and demonstration

Network Team Leadership

Lead the design and implementation of secure, resilient networks that connect offices, cloud platforms, data centers, on-premises systems, remote users, and business partners across multiple countries.
Translate business growth, geographic expansion, application, security, resilience, and user-experience requirements into scalable network plans.
Provide technical and operational leadership for local-area, wide-area, wireless, internet, remote-access, cloud-connectivity, and network-security services.
Establish governance, service ownership, decision rights, performance expectations, escalation paths, and lifecycle standards.
Advise senior leadership on network architecture, regulatory considerations, operational risks, costs, dependencies, and modernization priorities.
Develop reference architectures and engineering standards for routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, segmentation, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, load balancing, and internet connectivity.
Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity patterns that support Azure, other cloud services, private infrastructure, offices, remote users, and third-party providers while maintaining performance, security, availability, and cost discipline.
Lead technical discovery, site assessments, capacity planning, implementation planning, testing, cutover, rollback, stabilization, and operational handoff.
Architect with the goal of utilizing Microservices / Containerization wherever possible (i.e. Azure Kubernetes Services)

Network Security and Regulatory Compliance

Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, and Privacy teams to identify and address country-specific regulatory, data-residency, privacy, encryption, monitoring, cross-border connectivity, and telecommunications requirements.
Ensure network architecture and operations comply with enterprise security standards, regulatory obligations, contractual commitments, and audit requirements.

Architectural Platforms and Network Engineering

Own Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Zscaler, and Cisco Meraki technology portfolios across enterprise networking and security use cases.
Build Cloud NVA architecture in Azure, AWS, etc. and design for integration of on-premises assets with an eventual goal of moving to an all-cloud footing
Establish boilerplate hardened configurations, templates, firmware standards, lifecycle plans, testing requirements, and secure deployment patterns, using automation wherever practical.
Guide implementation and operation of secure access service edge and zero-trust network access capabilities, with preference for Zscaler (think SASE and Network ID-gated transit).
Drive platform rationalization and interoperability while avoiding unnecessary complexity, duplicated capabilities, unsupported configurations, and vendor lock-in.
Ensure network tools integrate effectively with identity, endpoint, cloud, security operations, monitoring, configuration-management, and service-management platforms.
Design and implement NetBox as the network source of truth, including network CMDB capabilities, parameter documentation, reporting, and API-based integrations with ITSM and ITOM platforms.

Network Operations and Service Reliability

Lead day-to-day network operations, event monitoring, incident response, problem management, change management, capacity management, and service restoration.
Establish, engineer, and own NMS system(s) (i.e. PRTG)
Establish service-level objectives, availability targets, operational metrics, on-call expectations, escalation procedures, and major-incident communication practices

Cloud and On-Premises Connectivity

Partner with Cloud and Infrastructure teams on routing, private connectivity, cloud firewalls, virtual networks, network security groups, DNS, traffic inspection, hybrid service dependencies, and complex connectivity troubleshooting.
Troubleshoot performance and connectivity issues that span applications, identity, security controls, carriers, cloud platforms, and physical networks.

Documentation, Governance and Communication

Create and maintain accurate network diagrams, standards, inventories, IP address plans, data flows, firewall documentation, runbooks, operating procedures, support models, and recovery plans.
Ensure implementation plans include scope, dependencies, risks, testing, approvals, communications, cutover procedures, rollback steps, validation criteria, and operational acceptance.

Vendor, Carrier and Financial Management

Contribute to vendor evaluation, product selection, contract support, renewals, service reviews, escalation, and performance management.
Identify cost and service improvements through carrier optimization, platform consolidation, contract negotiation, automation, and demand management.

Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and mentor network engineers, technical leads, contractors, and service partners supporting a global environment.
Define responsibilities, priorities, performance objectives, engineering practices, on-call coverage, and delivery expectations.
Manage workload, capacity, recruitment, performance, cross-training, succession planning, and professional development.
Promote accountability, technical excellence, disciplined change, proactive risk management, strong documentation, and continuous improvement.
Build effective working relationships across cultures, regions, time zones, technical teams, and business functions.

Required Qualifications

5 or more years of progressive network engineering and operations experience, including at least 2 years in technical leadership or people management roles.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise networks across multiple countries and time zones.
Deep expertise with the Fortinet portfolio, including FortiGate, FortiGate NVA, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiLink, Fortinet SD-WAN, FortiClient EMS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiAuthenticator.
Experience with NetBox, including API-based integrations and use of relevant plugin libraries.
Experience using Semaphore, Terraform, or similar tools for network automation and infrastructure as code.
Experience with Zscaler or Palo Alto Prisma Access, including secure access service edge or zero-trust network access capabilities.
Deep expertise with Azure networking and hybrid cloud connectivity, including private connectivity, virtual networks, cloud firewalls, routing, and traffic inspection.
Experience in a regulated, audit-intensive, financial services, insurance, or multinational organization.
Intimate knowledge of routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, segmentation, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, internet connectivity, monitoring, and network troubleshooting

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, cloud, security, or ITIL certifications.
Fortinet NSE5 or greater preferred
Cisco CCNA or greater preferred
Microsoft, Palo Alto certifications a plus
Experience with network automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, observability, and API-based operational tooling.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, international expansion, office openings, relocations, or consolidations.
Experience managing telecommunications carriers, managed network services, enterprise licensing, contracts, and global vendors.

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

Role Description

As the Director of Corporate Infrastructure, you will drive efforts to oversee the design, implementation, and operation of our corporate networks. This includes the IT Infrastructure DevOps, Security and SRE teams. You have a deep understanding of infrastructure as code, configuration as code & networking technologies, strong business acumen, lead through data and metrics, and operate with a high level of rigor and accountability. You are responsible for the reliability, scalability, sustainability, and efficiency of SoFi’s network infrastructure.

As a member of the Corporate Infrastructure leadership team, you are directly accountable for the teams that are responsible for driving efforts to evolve and build our next-generation corporate network (to include infrastructure and wifi). This includes managing all aspects of our network - engineering and operations to improve user experience and performance, and also supporting the multi-terabit backbone network that interconnects edge PoPs, corporate offices, data centers, and cloud gateways.

You will lead a diverse team through highly technical problems to achieve our overall strategic, operational, and financial goals. You will build and lead a high-performance team, displaying technical proficiency to support and scale the scope of our network operations. Collaboration and partnership with our lines of business will be essential as you help lead the transformation of our network to meet new demands and use cases.

Responsibilities

Directly accountable for managing the software, hardware, and overall health of SoFi’s network.
Develop the multi-year networking architecture, strategy, and roadmap aimed at implementing an advanced network architecture to support SoFi’s evolving business needs, inclusive of SoFi and its subsidiaries.
In partnership with Corporate Infrastructure leadership, develop and implement standards, such as MDF layouts and rack elevations, across all of SoFi.
Clearly define scope, objectives, key results, and develop a clear detailed plan for the execution of technical projects that are tightly aligned with business objectives.
Foster a healthy and collaborative culture that embodies SoFi’s values and continue to make SoFi one of the best places to work.

Requirements

BS degree in a technical or engineering discipline or relevant years of experience.
12+ years of experience in network engineering, software, and distributed systems, including 6+ years managing high performance teams at scale.
Technical experience in scaling a multi-vendor networking environment.

Technology & Engineering Leadership
Strategic Vision: Define and execute the global technology roadmap for the KYC platform, transitioning legacy workflows into modern, high-throughput, automated systems.
Engineering Excellence: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing global engineering organization, fostering a culture of technical innovation, agility, and operational discipline.

Required:

Minimum 15+ years of experience in technology leadership, with a proven track record of managing large-scale, global engineering organizations within Tier-1 financial institutions.

Preferred:

Experience with cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, and deploying AI/ML models for intelligent document processing (IDP) and entity resolution.

Degree (Engineering/Computer Science or MBA) preferred.

As a Senior Manager Data Engineering (Technology Architect), you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, high-performance data platforms that enable data-driven decision-making. Translate client requirements into system design and develop solutions that deliver measurable business value.
Lead, design, develop and deliver large-scale data systems, data processing, data transformation, and data platform modernization initiatives.
Build and optimize batch and streaming data pipelines across modern cloud data platforms and distributed processing frameworks.
Support AI-enabled engineering use cases by designing high-quality data foundations, retrieval patterns, context engineering approaches, and scalable data services that power agentic and machine learning solutions.
Automate data platform operations and manage post-production systems, observability, quality, reliability, and operational processes, including telemetry pipelines that capture prompt, response, trace, latency, token, and cost data for AI-enabled services in a queryable form.
Conduct technical feasibility assessments and provide project estimates for the design and development of solutions.
Mentor, support, and grow junior team members while contributing hands-on to delivery.

Your Skills & Experience:

Demonstrable experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines and production-grade data platforms.
Hands-on experience with at least one leading public cloud data platform: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform;
Experience with Databricks as a data engineering platform is strongly preferred, including working with notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake, or similar lakehouse patterns.
Strong Python proficiency and practical experience using Python-based tooling for data engineering, automation, platform development, or AI engineering workflows.
Implementation experience with column-oriented database technologies such as BigQuery, Redshift, Vertica, or similar platforms; NoSQL database technologies such as DynamoDB, Bigtable, Cosmos DB, or similar; and traditional database systems such as SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL.
Experience implementing data pipelines for both streaming and batch integrations using tools and frameworks such as Glue ETL, Lambda, Google Cloud Dataflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, Spark Streaming, or similar technologies.
Experience with data modeling, warehouse design, fact/dimension implementations, and modern lakehouse or data mesh patterns.
Experience with code repositories, continuous integration, automated testing, release management, and production support practices.
Familiarity with MLOps concepts and the data engineering responsibilities required to support AI/ML deployment, validation, monitoring, rollback, and operational reliability.
Ability to handle module or track-level responsibilities while contributing to tasks hands-on.
Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team.

AI Engineering & Modern Data Platform Experience:

Exposure to AI engineering patterns, including context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation support patterns, agent architectures, and production data services that support AI-enabled experiences.
Experience building and maintaining the pipelines behind retrieval systems, including document parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental reindexing, alongside the vector databases, graph databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval structures they feed.
Exposure to agentic platforms or cloud AI services such as Vertex AI, Azure AI services, AWS AI services, or comparable platforms; specific platform experience is less important than understanding how AI engineering differs from traditional data engineering.
Practical experience deploying agents, integrating agent frameworks, or supporting agentic workflows in production or near-production environments is a plus.
Experience building evaluation data infrastructure for AI systems, including ground-truth and golden datasets, offline evaluation pipelines, and the data scaffolding behind LLM-as-judge and regression testing.
Experience modeling and persisting agent state, including session context, conversation history, and memory stores, treating them as a durable storage and data modeling problem rather than an application detail.
Support AI-enabled engineering use cases by designing high-quality data foundations, retrieval patterns, context engineering approaches, and scalable data services that power agentic and machine learning solutions, applying the same lineage, provenance, and data contract rigor to context and retrieval sources that you would to a production warehouse.
Experience with agentic harnesses or orchestration tools such as Pi, Hermes Agent, or similar platforms is a plus, but not required.
Experience with Snowflake and zero-copy architecture patterns is a plus, particularly for retail, financial services, energy, or CPG-oriented use cases.

Developer certifications for AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or related cloud/data platforms.
Demonstrated experience applying AI engineering concepts in practical business environments rather than only academic or research settings.
Hands-on experience supporting AI/ML and LLM lifecycle needs such as model deployment support, monitoring, validation, shadow deployments, release management, and evaluation or data quality measurement for both predictive models and generative systems.
Experience in retail, financial services, energy, CPG, logistics, manufacturing, or other data-rich industries where applied AI and large-scale data engineering are used to solve operational or client-facing problems.
Understanding of Agile, product, and delivery methodologies in consulting or client-facing environments.

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. We are seeking a Director, Power Infrastructure to build Bitdeer's global power infrastructure capability by developing long-term strategy, advancing technical excellence in data center power systems, and enabling reliable, scalable power for our global AI infrastructure expansion.

Develop Bitdeer's global power infrastructure strategy and roadmap.
Lead utility, transmission and regulatory engagement for new power opportunities.
Support site selection and power infrastructure planning for AI data centers.
Provide strategic guidance on grid access, interconnection, substations and transmission planning.

Extensive experience leading power infrastructure strategy, utility engagement, or grid interconnection for large-scale, multi-country data center or infrastructure programs.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Manager Data Engineering

As a Senior Manager Data Engineering (Technology Architect), you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, high-performance data platforms that enable data-driven decision-making. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to architect, build, and optimize data solutions that support business objectives and drive innovation.

Your Impact:

Combine your technical expertise and problem-solving passion to work closely with clients, turning complex ideas into end-to-end data solutions that transform our clients’ business.
Translate client requirements into system design and develop solutions that deliver measurable business value.
Lead, design, develop and deliver large-scale data systems, data processing, data transformation, and data platform modernization initiatives.
Build and optimize batch and streaming data pipelines across modern cloud data platforms and distributed processing frameworks.
Support AI-enabled engineering use cases by designing high-quality data foundations, retrieval patterns, context engineering approaches, and scalable data services that power agentic and machine learning solutions.
Automate data platform operations and manage post-production systems, observability, quality, reliability, and operational processes, including telemetry pipelines that capture prompt, response, trace, latency, token, and cost data for AI-enabled services in a queryable form.
Conduct technical feasibility assessments and provide project estimates for the design and development of solutions.
Mentor, support, and grow junior team members while contributing hands-on to delivery.

Your Skills & Experience:

Demonstrable experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines and production-grade data platforms.
Hands-on experience with at least one leading public cloud data platform: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform;
Experience with Databricks as a data engineering platform is strongly preferred, including working with notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake, or similar lakehouse patterns.
Strong Python proficiency and practical experience using Python-based tooling for data engineering, automation, platform development, or AI engineering workflows.
Implementation experience with column-oriented database technologies such as BigQuery, Redshift, Vertica, or similar platforms; NoSQL database technologies such as DynamoDB, Bigtable, Cosmos DB, or similar; and traditional database systems such as SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL.
Experience implementing data pipelines for both streaming and batch integrations using tools and frameworks such as Glue ETL, Lambda, Google Cloud Dataflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, Spark Streaming, or similar technologies.
Experience with data modeling, warehouse design, fact/dimension implementations, and modern lakehouse or data mesh patterns.
Experience with code repositories, continuous integration, automated testing, release management, and production support practices.
Familiarity with MLOps concepts and the data engineering responsibilities required to support AI/ML deployment, validation, monitoring, rollback, and operational reliability.
Ability to handle module or track-level responsibilities while contributing to tasks hands-on.
Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team.

AI Engineering & Modern Data Platform Experience:

Exposure to AI engineering patterns, including context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation support patterns, agent architectures, and production data services that support AI-enabled experiences.
Experience building and maintaining the pipelines behind retrieval systems, including document parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental reindexing, alongside the vector databases, graph databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval structures they feed.
Exposure to agentic platforms or cloud AI services such as Vertex AI, Azure AI services, AWS AI services, or comparable platforms; specific platform experience is less important than understanding how AI engineering differs from traditional data engineering.
Practical experience deploying agents, integrating agent frameworks, or supporting agentic workflows in production or near-production environments is a plus.
Experience building evaluation data infrastructure for AI systems, including ground-truth and golden datasets, offline evaluation pipelines, and the data scaffolding behind LLM-as-judge and regression testing.
Experience modeling and persisting agent state, including session context, conversation history, and memory stores, treating them as a durable storage and data modeling problem rather than an application detail.
Support AI-enabled engineering use cases by designing high-quality data foundations, retrieval patterns, context engineering approaches, and scalable data services that power agentic and machine learning solutions, applying the same lineage, provenance, and data contract rigor to context and retrieval sources that you would to a production warehouse.
Experience with agentic harnesses or orchestration tools such as Pi, Hermes Agent, or similar platforms is a plus, but not required.
Experience with Snowflake and zero-copy architecture patterns is a plus, particularly for retail, financial services, energy, or CPG-oriented use cases.

Set Yourself Apart With:

Developer certifications for AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or related cloud/data platforms.
Demonstrated experience applying AI engineering concepts in practical business environments rather than only academic or research settings.
Hands-on experience supporting AI/ML and LLM lifecycle needs such as model deployment support, monitoring, validation, shadow deployments, release management, and evaluation or data quality measurement for both predictive models and generative systems.
Experience in retail, financial services, energy, CPG, logistics, manufacturing, or other data-rich industries where applied AI and large-scale data engineering are used to solve operational or client-facing problems.
Understanding of Agile, product, and delivery methodologies in consulting or client-facing environments.

Additional Information

An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration.
Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Flexibility to support work-life balance.
Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family.
Generous paid leave and holidays.
Wellness program and employee assistance.

Pay Range:
$160,000-$262,000

jobs.description:
About Us

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

About This Role

At QISG, our Substation Engineering teams play a critical role in strengthening and modernizing the electric grid. We engineer, construct, upgrade, and maintain substations that transform, control, and protect the flow of electricity from generation sources to transmission and distribution systems. From greenfield substation builds to complex expansions and retrofit projects, our teams deliver safe, reliable, and high-performance infrastructure that supports grid stability and long-term energy resilience. By combining proven engineering practices with advanced technologies and innovative solutions, we provide cost-effective, sustainable, and dependable outcomes for our customers and communities.

The Director,
Engineering Project Manager – Substation
provides technical leadership, project coordination, and engineering oversight required to deliver these projects successfully. This role manages the full project lifecycle, from proposal and scope definition through detailed design, procurement support, construction coordination, commissioning, and project closeout. The Engineering Project Manager ensures that engineering deliverables are complete, constructible, compliant with standards, and aligned with project schedules and budgets.

Reporting to the Engineering Director, the Engineering Project Manager will serve as a key liaison between engineering, construction, and client teams, driving collaboration, resolving technical challenges, managing risk, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and company procedures across substation projects.

What You'll Do

Strategically collaborate with engineering and operational leadership on technical goals and oversee engineering work.

The Director, Enterprise Execution & Strategic Initiatives leads the definition, planning, governance, and execution of complex, high-priority enterprise initiatives spanning multiple business functions, organizations, and leadership stakeholders.

The Senior Manager, IGA is a senior technical and client-facing leadership role focused on driving Identity Governance and Administration engagements from strategy through execution, with SailPoint and Saviynt as core platforms of expertise. This role requires the ability to lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients – translating complex governance, compliance, and identity lifecycle requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.

Key Responsibilities

Lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures.
Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms.
Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows.
Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources
Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices.
Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem.
Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.
Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services).
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team.
Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients.
Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits.
Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role.
Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization.
Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions.
Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership.
Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP.

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is the senior executive responsible for the strategic direction, governance, and operational execution of all technology functions across the enterprise. This includes cybersecurity, enterprise applications, infrastructure and hardware, IT operations, help desk, end-user support, artificial intelligence and data science and the full portfolio of technology projects across all three brands. This role requires a leader who can operate at both the strategic and operational level — shaping long-term technology vision, including how artificial intelligence and machine learning are applied to create measurable business value, while ensuring day-to-day reliability of systems that directly impact store operations, customer experience, and revenue.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
In partnership with company leadership team, the CTO will be actively involved and lead in developing the vision and a road map to execute current and future company goals and objectives.
Support and refine current plan for the product roadmap including setting time frames and successfully drive to fruition and release. Develop plans for new products and enhancements including time frames, release and time to market.
Own the IT capital and operating budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources across infrastructure, applications, security, and support functions.
Direct the full software development cycle. Establish, refine and supervise the software development process, setting short-term objectives and assessing progress as defined by the selected software development methodology.
Manage activities so that products are developed on schedule, maximum efficiency and within quality standards and cost objectives that meet market demands.
Product Quality Assurance
Promote achievement of high-quality products through extensive and fool-proof yet efficient quality assurance process.
Integrate review and quality testing in the development cycle to ensure efficiency, avoid repeated errors and rejects, and ensure all the requirements are appropriately addressed.
Ensure that products and enhancements provide optimum solutions consistent with what customers need and improve their workflow and usage experience.
Strategy & Planning
Identify technology trends and evolving social behavior that may support or impede the success of the business. Evaluate and identify appropriate technology platforms (including web application frameworks and the deployment stack) for delivering the company’s services.
Establish a governance process that meets government, partner, and company expectations for customer information privacy and other regulatory compliance.
Acquisition, maintenance and cost-effective technology including internal infrastructure, systems and client integration.
Prepare department budget and resource/infrastructure requirements.
Execution & Implementation
Direct management of engineers/developers (on-shore and off-shore), DBAs, QA staff, product management, infrastructure and production support teams as well as technology partners and vendors.
Ensure high availability and resilience of systems supporting store operations, distribution centers, and corporate functions.
Oversee technology asset lifecycle management, hardware refresh cycles, and vendor/OEM relationships.
Drive standardization and operational efficiency across store-level technology deployments.

Own enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk management, ensuring protection of customer data, payment systems (PCI compliance), and corporate assets across all brands.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, state/federal privacy laws, data protection regulations).
Establish incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans; lead the organization through security incidents when they occur.
Oversee security operations, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and third-party/vendor risk assessments.

Own the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap, identifying and prioritizing high-value use cases across ecommerce, merchandising, marketing, supply chain, customer service, and store operations and all cross functional areas that drive measurable revenue growth, margin improvement, and cost efficiency across both brands and all three websites.
Champion the adoption of AI, across the technology team and the entire organization.
Establish an AI governance framework covering responsible and ethical AI use, data privacy, model risk management, bias mitigation, and compliance with emerging AI regulations, ensuring AI initiatives are deployed safely and in alignment with customer trust and brand standards.
Evaluate and select AI platforms, tools, and vendor/partner relationships (cloud AI/ML services, generative AI and LLM providers, AI-enabled SaaS and copilot tools) that accelerate time-to-value while effectively managing cost, security, and risk.
Drive a culture of AI literacy and experimentation across the technology organization and the broader business, including deploying internal AI tools that improve developer productivity, IT operations (AIOps), and enterprise efficiency.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of technology standards, industry trends, emerging technologies, and software development best practices
Define and communicate company values and standards for acquiring or developing systems, equipment, or software within the company. Ensure the company’s internal technological processes and customer-facing services comply with community expectations and applicable laws and regulations for privacy, security, and social responsibility.

Develop, track, and control the product management, development and deployment of annual operating and capital budgets for purchasing, staffing, and operations.
Display high-performance, high-energy leadership to direct team, collaboration with company leadership team
