The overall objective of this role is to lead complex engineering initiatives across various domains, including Business Intelligence (BI) tools, Big Data, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning. We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer with extensive experience building robust, high-performance, and large-scale applications. We are constantly evolving our significant software assets and are seeking a leader who is passionate about leveraging diverse technologies to drive technical excellence and innovation.

Team Background

The Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions. These tools allow sales, traders, operations staff and risk officers to manage Citi's exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software that provides a complete platform for their users: limit monitoring, exception management, stress testing analysis and escalation workflow capabilities are some key areas of focus.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership and development oversight to the wider team of Software Engineers/Analysts. Ensure application design adheres to the appropriate architectural and design patterns for scalable and intelligent systems.
Develop key software components personally, and use your code as a teaching tool across the team for patterns and techniques, especially concerning Agentic AI design and implementation.
Host sessions for design and code review at multiple levels of the organization. Improve our engineering standards and process to make the team more capable and efficient, embracing AI-assisted development practices, including the use of tools like Git Copilot and Devin AI.
Collaborate effectively with a large global team of software engineers, business analysts, dev-ops and support staff to deliver software solutions for the business.
Lead the adoption of new technologies where appropriate to solve business problems while adhering to Citi's architectural guidelines, with a strong focus on Agentic AI and Machine Learning frameworks.
Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level/junior developers and analysts, helping build the overall engineering capabilities of the team, particularly in AI/ML and intelligent systems development.
Appropriately assess risk when decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Ideal background

Full-stack developer with 10+ years of experience in designing and developing robust, scalable, and maintainable applications applying Object Oriented Design principles.
Hands-on experience in Web technologies (HTML, CSS, React JS), REST-APIs, and Backend using Java/J2EE technologies.
Deep experience with Big Data technologies and data platforms capable of handling vast datasets for training, serving, and managing AI models.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and deployment/packaging solutions such as Dockers/Kubernetes, OpenShift.
Experience with Agile software development processes with a strong emphasis on test driven development.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and experience in tools such as JIRA, BlackDuck, SONAR etc.
Deep understanding of JVM internals such as class loading and memory management.

Skills

Extensive experience working with most if not all the technologies listed below:

Java Core with extensive hands-on experience with concurrent programming.
Spring Framework including Core, Integration, Batch, JDBC, Hibernate.
Distributed Caching frameworks such as Oracle Coherence, Redis or equivalent.
Cloud computing technologies with practical experience working with containers, microservices and large datasets (Docker, Kubernetes).
Expertise in Big Data / Data Lake system architecture that supports enterprise data warehouse, real-time data processing, and large-scale data ingestion for AI/ML workloads.
Databases - RDBMS preferably Oracle, NoSQL preferably MongoDB.
Familiarity with Linux environment including scripting skills.
SDLC/Dev Ops - Git/BitBucket, CI/CD pipeline frameworks such as Jenkins, SonarQube, JIRA, any secure coding toolkits.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and optimize AI-assisted coding and development tools (e.g., Git Copilot, Devin AI) into team workflows to maximize efficiency and innovation.
Hands-on experience with data governance, metadata management, and data lineage platforms to maintain high data quality and auditability for AI systems.
Ability to evaluate design trade-offs and document choices effectively.
Demonstrated capacity to build sophisticated tooling for development and production team use.

Preferred:

Knowledge and experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau and Cognos for data visualization and reporting.
Experience with Big Data querying tools including Google BigQuery, Starburst, and DuckDB.
Experience with prominent Machine Learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face) and their deployment in production.
Deep understanding and practical application of Machine Learning algorithms (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning) and statistical modeling, with a focus on interpretability and bias detection in financial applications.
Knowledge of large language models, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and time-series analysis techniques as applied to Agentic AI and risk modeling.
Experience in designing, developing, and implementing AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making, adaptive learning, and complex interaction within a financial domain.

Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience, Master's degree preferred.

Role Summary

All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues have the opportunity to grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged and have the ability to impact health and lives of millions of people. Digital is at the core of how Pfizer delivers Breakthroughs that Change Patient’s Lives. Advanced technologies that accelerate research, development, manufacturing, and patient access to therapies are all made possible by the infrastructures that enable our Digital landscape.

The CISO, Infrastructure and Cloud Services organization delivers excellence in the pursuit of those breakthroughs through industry-leading infrastructure operations performance. We strive to revolutionize service dependability by applying advanced analytics to drive predictive detection and interventions. We place data at the heart of what we do and apply a relentless focus on continuous improvement to enable Pfizer’s business processes and patient outcomes.

The Sr. Manager, AMER LAN Engineering Lead designs, deploys, and maintains complex enterprise network infrastructures. They lead technical projects, mentor engineering staff, and manage network availability, security, and performance. This hands-on role requires high-level IT architecture with daily network engineering and operations tasks, along with team management of both Colleagues and Contractors.

The role blends people leadership with deep technical ownership: leading a team of engineers and contractors while personally driving architecture decisions, automation practices, and regional investment priorities.

As the AMER lead, this person partners closely with counterparts in EMEA and APAC to develop standardized, globally scalable network solutions, and serves as the global owner of IP address management (IPAM) allocations across the entire enterprise network. Success in this role means a resilient, secure, and automated regional network that aligns to a consistent global standard.

Role Responsibilities

People & Team Leadership

Manage the team - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of LAN engineers (Colleagues and contractors) across the Americas region.
Own People eXperience (PX) & administrative processes - Responsible for all PX and administrative documentation, including onboarding, timekeeping, contractor agreements, and record-keeping.
Drive performance - Conduct performance reviews, set goals and development plans, provide ongoing coaching, and manage staffing and resourcing decisions.
Manage Projects - Oversee project scopes, deliverables, and performance, ensuring alignment with regional and global standards.

Architecture, Design & Investment

Lead architecture and design - Own and facilitate architecture and design discussions for LAN and wireless infrastructure across the region.
Drive decisions - Translate design discussions into concrete decisions on hardware purchases, technology selection, and regional projects.
Own the roadmap - Define and prioritize the network roadmap, balancing lifecycle, capacity, security, and cost.
Manage projects & budget - Lead regional network projects end to end and provide input into budgeting and capital planning.

Automation, IaC & CI/CD

Automate the network - Champion network automation using Python, Ansible, GitHub, and other Automation Tools to reduce manual effort and configuration drift.
Practice Infrastructure as Code - Manage network configuration and infrastructure as code, using GitHub for version control, review, and collaboration.
Build CI/CD workflows - Establish a network design that allows for the creation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for network changes, including automated validation and testing.

Global IPAM Ownership

Own global IPAM allocation process - Serve as the global lead for IP address management (IPAM) allocations across the entire enterprise network.
Govern the address space - Define allocation standards, maintain accuracy of records, and coordinate IP planning across all regions.

Global Collaboration & Scale

Partner across regions - Workwith peers in EMEA and APAC to design solutions that scale consistently across a global, multinational enterprise.
Standardize globally - Contribute to global network standards, reference architectures, and best practices, ensuring regional alignment.
Represent AMER - Act as the regional point of accountability in global network governance and planning forums.

Bachelor’s degree required in a technical field such as Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering
6+ years of experience in a Sr. Network Engineering role
Design, manage, and troubleshoot complex large-scale networks.
IPv4/IPv6 subnetting, administration and planning
Expert level Industry certifications (CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent expertise)
A strong team player with excellent oral and written communication skills
Process oriented with great documentation skills.
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving and troubleshooting ability.
Self-starter with the ability to independently prioritize and complete multiple tasks with little to no supervision.
Strong knowledge of LAN and WLAN technologies
Experience managing vendor relationships and technology procurement at scale.
Proven experience leading a team of engineers and/or contractors, including performance management and HR/administrative responsibilities.
Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree major in a technical field such as Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and Ansible for network automation.
Experience managing a financial budget.
Experience operating in a large, regulated enterprise environment (biopharma, life sciences, or similarly regulated industry a plus).
Professional level Industry certifications (CCNP, CCSE, CISSP, or equivalent expertise)
Experience with design/implementation/troubleshooting Cisco/Meraki/Aruba Wireless technologies, Cisco Identity Service Engine, Cisco Catalyst Center, Ekahau App Suite
Experience with security access architectures (ISE/SGT, Adaptive Policy, Zero-Trust Network Access)
Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available service

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of engineering management experience leading mid-to-senior ICs.
Strong technical foundation with hands-on engineering background; fluency in Python, BigQuery and SQL.
Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform, or equivalent public cloud platforms with the ability to ramp quickly on GCP.
Proven track record managing and analyzing very large datasets to produce accurate forecasts and recommendations.
Demonstrated ownership and proactivity: you start conversations, drive alignment, and deliver outcomes without being asked.

Ensure activities comply with GMP, data integrity, and regulatory requirements.

Implement data collection, trending, monitoring, and visualization tools to improve manufacturing performance.
Evaluate emerging technologies, digital tools, AI solutions, and automation opportunities for clinical manufacturing.
Support development of dashboards and systems that improve operational visibility and decision making.

Success Measures

Reliable support of manufacturing operations with minimal equipment-related disruptions.
Timely execution of equipment upgrades and automation deployments.
Successful support of tech transfers and new product introductions.
High-quality investigation, CAPA, and change-control execution.
Implementation of technology and process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

Bachelor's Degree and Eight Years' Experience

It is a deliberate shift toward pipeline engineering, a highly technical, AI-forward function focused on architecting a modern, automated pipeline engine, governing funnel performance, and expanding outbound capability across both the SDR team and field sales. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building with AI and GTM technology, owns outcomes rather than activities, and brings a builder mentality to every process gap they encounter.

Pipeline Operations & SLA Discipline

Build and run a tiered MQL model that prioritizes leads by fit, intent, engagement, and readiness for human follow-up.
Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps on lead scoring, routing, follow-up SLAs, dispositioning, recycling, and funnel reporting.

AI, Automation & GTM Technology

Outbound, Sales-Led & ABM Pipeline Creation

Build a signal-based outbound motion that can scale to contribute 20–30% of pipeline, using account fit, intent, buying signals, and campaign context.
Align SDR activity to ABM plays, priority accounts, buying committee coverage, events, and campaign follow-up.
Test, measure, and throttle outbound capacity based on account priority, conversion rates, message performance, and pipeline contribution.
Expand SDR playbooks into sales plays actioned by field sales — enabling AEs to build and own their own pipeline channel.

Marketing Feedback Loop & Team Leadership

Create a closed-loop feedback system for Marketing on lead quality, message resonance, campaign performance, conversion barriers, and reasons for non-conversion.
Translate SDR learning into clear recommendations for targeting, messaging, content, nurture, campaigns, and sales readiness.
Lead the team through the move into Marketing, setting new expectations for collaboration, AI fluency, accountability, experimentation, and performance.
Partner with sales enablement and sales operations on guided prospecting for field sales.
Other duties as assigned

5–8+ years in B2B pipeline development, sales development, revenue marketing, or GTM operations, with 2–3+ years of people leadership.
Experience transforming or rebuilding a pipeline development function — not only managing an existing SDR team.
Hands-on fluency with AI and automation in a GTM context, including the ability to build workflows, evaluate tools, and train a team.
Strong understanding of lead scoring, routing, SLAs, funnel governance, SDR performance metrics, and pipeline reporting.
Experience building outbound or ABM motions using intent data, behavioral signals, account context, and personalized sequencing.
Strong cross-functional partner to Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Marketing Ops, Product Marketing, Demand Gen, Field Marketing, and ABM.

Company Overview

Biomerics is a world-class manufacturer and innovative polymer solutions provider for the medical device and biotech industries. As a vertically integrated company, we specialize in designing, developing, and producing medical devices for diagnostic and interventional procedures. We are focused on next-generation solutions for vascular access, electrophysiology, cardiac rhythm management, neurovascular, structural heart, and cardiovascular markets.

At Biomerics, we are dedicated to our diverse employee base. We understand that a strong, skilled, and engaged workforce is the foundation of our continued success as a business. We strive to live up to the Biomerics values in all our interactions. It is an exciting time to be part of our collective team, and there is no limit to the impact that can be achieved here at Biomerics. We improve and advance the lives of our employees and patients who depend on our products.

At Biomerics, we believe in integrity, partnership, empowerment and accountability, trust, agility, teamwork, and excellence, and we care. Our team-oriented, customer-focused corporate culture prioritizes building strategic, mutually beneficial partnerships with customers and our team members.

As a Plant Manager in the medical devices industry, you play a critical role in ensuring the efficient operation of manufacturing facilities that produce medical devices. Your responsibilities typically include overseeing production processes, maintaining quality standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and managing staff. Here’s a more detailed breakdown of what the role involves:

Responsibilities: (50,000 sq ft plant, 105 employees)

Job Summary

Responsible for efficient operation of engineering manufacturing facilities that produce medical devices. Oversee production processes, maintain quality standards, ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and supervise staff. Drive Improvements in Liquid Resin Casting work center by leading the team to design and develop processes, improve tooling, and streamline operations. Manage and improve Thermoforming Work Center through installation, setup and process development of new thermoforming equipment. Lead team to improve cycle times in CNC machining operations with fixture improvements, cutter path improvements, and labor utilization on 3-axis equipment. Manage projects to install and develop processes for new 5-axis CNC equipment to drive cycle time, setup, and labor efficiency. Lead root case analysis (RCE), reliability centered maintenance (RCM), and Six Sigma improvement initiatives. Develop fixturing to allow machining that required two setups in 3-axis to one setup in 5-axis. Leverage Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) work center to develop engineered solutions to reduce costs and move products from LRC to 3D Printing. Redesign plant floor layout to improve process flow, eliminating wasted motion and process to reduce cost and improve employee work.

Position supervises 1 Engineering Manager, 1 Facilities Manager, and 1 Production Manager overseeing production processes.

Requirements

Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related and 4 years of related experience in medical device manufacturing, which must include some experience in each of the following skills:

Establish and maintain compliant medical device manufacturing procedures, including overseeing engineering operations aligned with ISO standards, failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), hazard identification, and mitigation, and validation and verification (V&V); Direct automation and controls engineering (using PLC programming such as Allen-Bradley and Siemens, SCADA/HMI systems, machine vision systems, and robotics integration), manufacturing process engineering (using injection molding, CNC machining, cleanroom manufacturing ISO Class 7/8, laser and ultrasonic welding, micro-assembly & micro fabrication techniques), and statistical and analytical methods; Ensure plant operations compliance and optimizing facilities engineering in regulated environments such as Cleanroom HVAC and environmental control systems, EPA, OSHA, ISO, HEPA filtration, and calibration systems (metrology), equipment reliability engineering and maintenance strategies, and process safety and risk controls for HAZOP, HAZMAT, preventative safety engineering, and EHS compliance; Coordinating CAPA engineering for investigations and corrective and preventative actions and remediations, technical project management for new equipment installation, technology transfers, and process optimization, and cross functional collaboration with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Validation, Supply Chain, and Automation Teams; Financial planning and control of budgets, designing capital expenditure projects justifications for machinery acquisition and production expansions, profit and loss, absorption, labor, overhead, and expenses, cost analysis control, cost improvement projects, and new products introduction; and Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by guiding plant floor data standardization, collection, utilization, lean operations, and seamless production execution to maintain quality management systems and regulatory compliance.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this, our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.com to learn more about us.

H1's Product Engineering organization is the engine behind the products that put our data in front of the people who need it most, health plans, digital health companies, life sciences organizations, and the clinical teams they serve. We build the client-facing products, APIs, integrations, and intelligent workflows that transform H1's rich underlying data into real decisions: which providers belong in a network directory, where clinical trials should run, and how healthcare organizations can operate with greater accuracy and trust. Product Engineering at H1 sits at the crossroads of complex data systems and enterprise software delivery, and our work directly drives revenue, client retention, and patient impact. We move fast, we own our products end-to-end, and we hold ourselves to a high bar — because in healthcare, the quality of what we build has consequences.

What You'll Do At H1

As a Director of Software Engineering at H1, you will own a high-impact product engineering domain and lead the team responsible for the client-facing products, integrations, and workflows within it. You will set the technical vision, build and develop your team, co-own the product roadmap with the PM, and serve as the trusted engineering voice across sales, customer success, and the broader organization. You will operate with real accountability; for delivery, for your people, and for the business outcomes that depend on your domain performing at its best.

You will:

Lead, grow, and develop a high-performing product engineering team; hiring, coaching, performance management, and building a culture where engineers do their best work
Partner with Product Management to co-own the roadmap, translating client needs and business priorities into a clear engineering strategy and delivery plan
Set technical direction; architecture standards, agentic workflow practices, and the bar for what good looks like — while staying close enough to engage meaningfully in system design decisions with your team
Own delivery accountability for your segment: on-time, high-quality releases that meet client SLAs
Run the engineering operating rhythm, manage on-call schedules, sprint planning, triage outages, retrospectives, and incident reviews, with structure and consistency
Manage competing priorities across Customer Support, sales, PM, and engineering, communicating tradeoffs clearly and making calls when the path isn't obvious
Serve as the senior engineering voice in cross-functional conversations; occasionally engaging directly with clients as a subject matter expert, though your primary surface is internal
Own multiple product lines simultaneously, bringing prioritization and clarity across a growing portfolio

About You

You are a seasoned engineering leader who has built and shipped SaaS products in complex data environments, and you know the difference between owning a product and managing a team that builds one. You take genuine pride in your people: you invest in them, challenge them, and measure your success by how they grow. You are comfortable at the intersection of engineering and business, equally capable of walking a client through how your product works and walking your engineers through a hard architectural tradeoff. You don't need to be writing code every day, but you stay close to the technology, you have a clear answer for how you use modern tooling and agentic workflows to stay effective, you understand how data moves through a system, and your engineers trust that when you weigh in on a technical decision, it's grounded in real understanding. You thrive in environments where priorities shift, ambiguity is constant, and the expectation is that you build the structure rather than wait for it. You are a clear communicator, a decisive decision-maker, and the kind of leader people point to when asked who made them better.

Requirements

10–15 years of software engineering experience with 3–5 years leading teams with direct reports
Proven track record owning a SaaS product end-to-end in a complex data environment, from technical architecture through client delivery and operations.
Experience managing multiple product lines simultaneously with a clear approach to prioritization and keeping teams unblocked.
Backend product engineering background: APIs, client-facing integrations, data-driven product surfaces, and visualization layers, this is not a data pipeline, infrastructure, or ML role.
Track record of building and developing engineering teams; people who grew under your leadership.
Able to articulate your agentic workflow and stay meaningfully close to the technology without coding daily; you can engage substantively in architecture and system design conversations with your team.
Strong communicator across audiences; executives, sales leaders, engineers, and clients, and a trusted technical voice in commercial conversations
Decisive under ambiguity; you own stakeholder relationships across CS, PM, sales, and engineering and communicate tradeoffs clearly
Preferred: experience in healthcare, medical, or insurance/payer technology; strongly preferred for the Health Plans role

Compensation

This role pays $190,000 to $265,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to stock options.

Anticipated role close date: 10/20/2026

H1 OFFERS

Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
Retirement options
Health & charitable donation stipends
Impactful Business Resource Groups
Flexible work hours & the opportunity to work from anywhere
The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Job Description

The Process Engineering department supports technical and scientific activities related to the manufacture of pharmaceutical products in AbbVie facilities or in contract facilities. The Director, through his/her section managers and direct reporting lines, will manage a technically diverse staff of highly specialized engineers and scientists. He/she is a key link between development organizations and operations/third party contract manufacturers and ensures a seamless link between pilot scale and full-scale manufacture. The director is accountable for all the activities of the department and provides technical/scientific and business leadership for the department. The director partners with manufacturing and quality in the identification, definition, and execution of projects and delivers technical requirements for the launch of products and supports the development of innovative solutions to problems and opportunities.

Responsibilities

Communicates and collaborates with internal (manufacturing, quality, engineering, S&T and other areas) and external partners to provide effective technical and business leadership in line with site goals and objectives.
Maintain and direct a highly diversified cross functional staff of professionals to ensure that all aspects of CMC life cycle management are completed on time, within budget and meet highest scientific, regulatory, quality, marketing and commercial standards
Develops engineering objectives and strategies that advance the site, and continually looks for opportunities for process optimization, cost avoidance and cost reduction.
Develop and communicate cost estimates, business plans, timelines and contingency plans to accomplish project and departmental objectives within agreed time scope.
Participate in capital plan input and capital project execution to advance manufacturing capabilities
Make final decisions related to project responsibilities
Represent AbbVie during audits to regulatory agencies (US/ROW as appropriate) by supplying verbal or written information with active participation.
Responsible for ensuring that all members of the Engineering team follow all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices and that all resources needed to do so are available and in good condition.
Provide leadership, coaching, training, and mentoring to direct reports. Negotiates, secures, oversees and ensures that all resources are available to meet the demands of the projects and site goals.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) is required to provide technical expertise.
10 + years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry formulation, including at least 4+ years of managerial experience.
Knowledge of AbbVie Engineering standards.
Demonstrated leadership and team building skills.
Strong problem-solving abilities.
Proven track record of managing projects through to completion.
Excellent communication skills with layers of management.

jobs.title: Sr Plant Engineering & Reliability Manager
jobs.description:
The APEX Power Co. Project in Hubbard, TX, currently under Phase 1 construction, is expected to expand to 1.6 GW. It features a diverse mix of generation technologies, including Siemens SGT-800/400 simple cycle turbines, MAN/Everllence 18V51/60G gas reciprocating engines, GE LM6000/LM2500 simple cycle turbines, Pratt & Whitney FT8 simple cycle turbines, and a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), enabling flexible, reliable power output. Future expansion may include additional GE aero and large frame units (6B, 7FA/7FB/7H) in simple or combined cycle configurations, allowing the plant to efficiently meet varying energy demands while supporting data center grid reliability.

Opportunity Summary

The Plant Engineering & Reliability Manager at the APEX Power Co. Project leads the site's engineering and reliability functions to support the safe, reliable, and efficient commissioning and operation of the facility. This role provides technical leadership for electrical, controls, mechanical, and plant systems; oversees engineering projects, reliability programs, capital improvements, and long-term asset strategies; and partners with Operations and Maintenance to resolve complex technical issues, improve equipment performance, and maximize plant reliability and availability.

As Plant Engineering & Reliability Manager, your responsibilities specific to the Pre-Commissioning Phase include:

Lead the site's engineering and reliability activities throughout pre-commissioning, ensuring mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, controls, and BESS systems are installed, tested, and ready for startup.
Oversee installation and commissioning of generation assets, BESS, and balance-of-plant systems, ensuring compliance with design specifications and acceptance criteria.
Manage engineering support for system turnover and startup by coordinating technical resources, resolving engineering issues, completing punch list items, and leading resolution of commissioning deficiencies, startup issues, and design concerns through Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective actions.
Oversee validation of DCS, PLC, protection, instrumentation, electrical, and control systems, ensuring control logic, alarms, interlocks, communications, and data acquisition systems perform as designed before commercial operation.
Establish the site's reliability program by developing asset criticality assessments, RCM strategies, FMEA/FMECA analyses, PM/PdM programs, and equipment reliability standards before commercial operation.
Direct implementation of condition monitoring technologies, including vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis, electrical diagnostics, ultrasonics, AOV/MOV testing, and online monitoring systems to establish equipment health baselines.
Ensure CMMS/EAM asset hierarchies, engineering documentation, as-built drawings, technical procedures, and reliability data are complete to support long-term plant operation.

Your scope of responsibility as the Plant Engineering & Reliability Manager includes the following primary functions:

Lead the plant's engineering and reliability programs to maximize the safety, availability, reliability, and lifecycle performance of generation assets, BESS, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment.
Provide technical leadership for complex mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, controls, and plant system issues, partnering with Operations and Maintenance to improve equipment performance.
Direct RCM, PdM, FMEA/FMECA, asset criticality, and condition monitoring programs using vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis, electrical diagnostics, ultrasonics, and AOV/MOV testing to optimize reliability and reduce lifecycle costs.
Monitor plant performance, equipment health, heat rates, reliability metrics, and operational KPIs, implementing engineering solutions to improve reliability, efficiency, and reduce forced outages.
Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations for equipment failures, forced outages, generation losses, and significant operating events, ensuring effective corrective and preventive actions.
Manage engineering projects, capital improvements, equipment upgrades, life-extension initiatives, and plant modifications, including Management of Change (MOC), while meeting schedule, budget, quality, and safety objectives.
Oversee engineering support for planned outages, major maintenance, and long-term asset management by integrating equipment condition, operational risk, and reliability priorities into maintenance planning.
Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical procedures, equipment specifications, CMMS/EAM data, technical documentation, and plant configuration records to support safe, reliable operations.
Coordinate with OEMs, contractors, engineering firms, and corporate engineering to develop long-term asset strategies, maintenance plans, budgets, and capital forecasts.
Lead and develop the engineering and reliability team while ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory, and company requirements and promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Perform other duties as assigned to support safe, reliable, and compliant plant operations.

NAES Safe

Safety is a core value at NAES, and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to remain mentally alert and work safely at all times. All NAES managers and supervisors have a direct and important role in ensuring that all work is performed in a healthy and safe manner. Effectiveness in carrying out this responsibility is part of the evaluation of each Supervisor’s performance.

Working Relationships

The Plant Engineering & Reliability Manager reports to the Plant Manager and supervises the site's engineering and reliability personnel. This role works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Environmental, Safety, and Administrative managers, partners with NAES Corporate Engineering Support Services, and provides technical leadership to support safe, reliable plant operations.

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

Physical requirements include standing for extended periods of time, climbing stairs and ladders, working from elevated platforms and walkways at varying heights, and routinely lifting up to 50 pounds.

Power plant environment that may involve entering confined spaces, crawling through narrow areas, and handling hazardous materials, with exposure to fumes, extreme temperatures, and noise. Work may include high heat near equipment and varying outdoor weather conditions.

Some duties may require the use of protective equipment, which can include hard hats, safety glasses, and eye protection, air masks/respirators, ear protection, chemical suits, flame-resistant clothing (FRC), hot gloves, high-voltage protective gear, and fall protection. Fit testing for respirators may be required. Strict smoking restrictions apply in and around the facility.

Fitness for Duty

All personnel will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program, which includes a post-offer physical examination, drug screening, and post-employment random drug screening.

Work Schedule

The Plant Engineering & Reliability Manager works a standard Monday to Friday day shift schedule. This position will occasionally necessitate extended working hours and flexible shifts as needed, including weekends and holidays, in response to schedules, workload demands, and plant conditions. Periodic callouts or “On call” status may also be required.

Some travel may be involved to participate in Manager, Owner, User Group, or other offsite meetings.

Compensation

This position offers an annual base salary ranging from $174,300 to $205,308 and includes eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

Qualifications & Professional Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field, is required. Equivalent industry experience in power generation, engineering, or military service may be considered in lieu of formal education.
Extensive experience leading engineering and reliability functions within a power generation or heavy industrial facility, providing technical leadership for mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, controls, and balance-of-plant systems.

Strong knowledge of power generation technologies, including gas turbines, reciprocating engines, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and balance-of-plant equipment, with commissioning, startup, and operational experience preferred.
Proven experience managing engineering projects, capital improvements, equipment upgrades, and plant modifications, including project planning, budgeting, execution, and Management of Change (MOC).
Ability to analyze plant performance, equipment health, heat rates, and operational KPIs to optimize asset performance and reduce forced outages.
Working knowledge of electrical power systems, instrumentation, protection systems, DCS/PLC controls, plant automation, and CMMS/EAM or operational data systems (e.g., OSIsoft PI or similar).
Experience developing engineering standards, maintenance strategies, and asset management programs while partnering with Operations, Maintenance, OEMs, contractors, and corporate engineering to improve plant reliability and performance.
Strong understanding of applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including NERC standards where applicable, with a commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and engineering team development.

Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

Our Platform Product Management organization is responsible for building and evolving the foundational capabilities that enable product, engineering, and business teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. The Senior Director, Platform Product Management will be responsible for shared platform capabilities, helping shape the long-term technology and product strategy that powers our applications across the business. This role requires a strategic product leader who can effectively operate at the intersection of business, technology, and organizational transformation.

What You’ll Do:

Define and execute a multi-year platform product strategy that aligns technology investments with business priorities and enterprise objectives.
Define and actively shape the platform portfolio, establishing clear product boundaries and identifying where First American should standardize, consolidate, build, buy, retire, or enable local flexibility to maximize reuse, enterprise leverage, and business value.
Lead a team of Product Managers and Product Leaders responsible for a portfolio of shared business and technology capabilities, including enterprise platforms and services, internal developer platforms, APIs and integrations, and other reusable capabilities that enable products and business teams across First American.
Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Business leaders to establish platform roadmaps and investment priorities.
Drive platform adoption across the organization by improving developer experience, self-service capabilities, onboarding experiences, and product usability.
Shape platform capabilities for an increasingly AI- and agent-enabled operating model, ensuring shared products and services are machine-consumable, observable, secure, and designed to reduce unnecessary human coordination and toil while enabling teams to move faster within appropriate guardrails.
Prioritize platform investments across competing demands, including new capabilities, scalability, reliability, security, technical debt, and operational excellence initiatives.
Establish measures of success and operational metrics that evaluate platform adoption, utilization, reliability, developer productivity, and business impact.
Lead cross-functional planning processes, ensuring platform strategies support both immediate business needs and long-term growth objectives.
Communicate platform vision, roadmap priorities, business cases, risks, and tradeoffs to executive stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.
Build strong partnerships across product and technology organizations to identify opportunities for shared capabilities, standardization, and enterprise leverage.
Build and lead a high-performing product organization, developing Product Managers and Product Leaders who operate with clear ownership, strong judgment, and increasing strategic altitude. Establish clear decision rights and accountability while creating an operating rhythm that provides proactive visibility into portfolio outcomes, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions needed from senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring:

10+ years of Product Management experience, including leadership responsibility for platform, technology, infrastructure, developer, or enterprise software products.
Demonstrated success developing and executing platform strategies that serve multiple products, business units, or customer segments.
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, cloud technologies, APIs, platform architectures, and enterprise technology ecosystems.
Proven ability to influence executive, business, and technology stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Experience balancing strategic investments, customer needs, technical debt, operational excellence, reliability, security, and compliance requirements.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect product investments to measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.
Experience with modern platform ecosystems such as cloud-native platforms, developer platforms, APIs and enterprise integrations, AI/agent-enabled capabilities, or other shared enterprise services, with demonstrated ability to translate emerging technology into scalable business and developer value.
Proven ability to influence executive, business, and technology stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Demonstrated experience leading through other Product Managers and Product Leaders, creating clarity and accountability across a portfolio rather than relying on direct personal ownership of individual products.
Preferred experience within highly regulated, complex enterprise environments where security, compliance, reliability, and risk management are critical considerations.

Pay Range: $197,200.00 - $263,000.00 Annually

jobs.description:
KPMG is building a product organization designed to help transform decades of industry experience into innovative, software-powered businesses. Backed by the scale, resources, and market presence of a global network, this organization operates with the energy, ambition, and pace of a startup. We are assembling a founding team of builders, innovators, and problem solvers who are excited by the opportunity to create new products, shape new ways of working, and help define the future of technology-enabled business at KPMG. If you thrive in entrepreneurial environments, embrace ambiguity, and are motivated by the potential to make a lasting impact from the ground up, we invite you to consider joining us on this journey.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, Platform Product Management to join our Product organization.

Responsibilities:

Shape the multi-year platform strategy and integrated roadmaps for an AI-native platform across multiple complex domains, aligning product, technology, and firm priorities
Own the capability inventory and assessment across advisory and relevant functions, identifying recurring workflows, agents, data models, and integrations that should become reusable platform assets — and harvest the best of them into the shared platform in collaboration with our engineering organization
Lead cross-domain recommendations on shared versus product-specific capabilities and build, buy, partner, or harvest options for senior product and technology leaders
Advise engineering and architecture leaders on cross-platform architecture and integration decisions, prioritize technical debt, and ensure reusable capabilities meet scalability, reliability, security, regulatory, and technical standards
Resolve major roadmap, dependency, reuse, and investment trade-offs across platform domains and product teams, using customer needs, technical feasibility, critical gaps, and platform value to guide decisions
Set platform adoption and reuse measures, using build-time, cost, reliability, and product-team outcomes; Drive internal adoption through evangelism, documentation and developer experience; Coach professionals and advance technical product-management practices across teams
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum ten years of recent experience in product management for technical products or platforms, including owning a B2B or enterprise platform product end to end
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Minimum of a high school GED is required; Minimum of twelve years of equivalent professional experience is required
Proven experience shaping platform strategy across complex technical products, platforms, or processes with results in platform adoption, cross product reuse, delivery speed, cost, or customer outcomes; experience in a complex or regulated environment is preferred
Deep technical product management experience, including product lifecycle management, cross-product prioritization, analytics and experimentation, and defining non-functional requirements (NFRs) and service level objectives (SLOs). Demonstrated fluency in application programming interfaces (APIs), data models, AI and agent frameworks, integration patterns, and technical debt trade-off decisions
Demonstrated daily use of AI across working practice, and platforms or products that have shipped or shaped where AI and agent frameworks were core rather than decorative; ability to guide shared versus product-specific capability decisions and develop build, buy, partner, or harvest recommendations
Ability to operate with limited oversight, advise senior product and technology leaders, resolve complex cross-platform trade-offs, and coach professionals in leading technical product-management practices; preferred experience with developer or internal platforms (i.e. Agent orchestration, connector and integration architecture, or governed AI tooling) with audit trails and human-in-the-loop controls with application, data, or legacy modernization tooling

jobs.title: Director, Global Enterprise & Rig Technology Operations
jobs.description:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

Since 1920, Helmerich and Payne has been the industry’s most trusted partner in drilling productivity and reliability. As the world changes, so does our approach. We are changing the landscape of drilling by using cutting-edge rig technologies and drilling solutions to build upon a century of success, all while continuing to deliver better outcomes for our customers.

At H&P, our people are our strength. We strive to continually lead with our Core Values that enable employees to develop on their H&P Journey. We believe that doing the right thing means creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that empowers our people to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Some companies offer career paths. We offer a Journey of a Lifetime. Let's go far, together.

Hear directly from our employees, and leaders about their unique journeys at Helmerich and Payne.

At a Glance

The Director, Global Enterprise & Rig Technology Operations is responsible for the global operation, reliability, and security of the technology infrastructure that keeps H&P's rigs connected and the enterprise running. Leading teams across the Western and Eastern Hemispheres, the Director owns rig connectivity and network operations; datacenter, cloud, and hosting operations; rig technology platforms; infrastructure and network security operations. The role is accountable for meeting drilling-critical availability targets through global coverage, including a follow-the-sun model for appropriate functions, and will continue to integrate and standardize the combined H&P and KCA Deutag technology estate.

In doing so, the Director ensures Global IT delivers reliable, cost-efficient, secure, and scalable services that support rig automation execution, real-time rig data flow, uninterrupted drilling operations, employee productivity, and H&P's global growth.

Location:
Tulsa Office

Work Type:
Onsite

Tulsa, OK

What You Will Do

Operating model: define and execute the operating model for enterprise and rig technology services, including service placement, role clarity, global handoffs, support coverage, and consistent standards across Tulsa, Aberdeen, India, field locations, datacenters, cloud, and rig environments.
Direct global infrastructure and rig technology operations: own the day-to-day operation, availability, and performance of rig connectivity, networks, datacenters, cloud and hosting, and rig-site technology platforms across all hemispheres.
Strategic infrastructure initiatives: lead infrastructure strategy and execution for major initiatives, including global operating model transformation, international rig infrastructure upgrades, NextGen Rig Network (NGRN) capabilities, space-based connectivity, and datacenter and cloud modernization, spanning FlexRig and T-Series rigs and all operating regions.
Lead follow-the-sun operations: design and run 24x7 coverage across Tulsa (US / Western Hemisphere), Aberdeen (UK / Eastern Hemisphere), and India, including NOC rotation and third-shift coverage, ensuring seamless handoffs, on-call structures, and major-incident response for drilling-critical services.
Rig connectivity and network operations: ensure rigs, offices, datacenters, and cloud are reliably and securely linked worldwide; oversee network engineering, rig and FlexRig networking, and connectivity for remote and offshore assets.
Datacenter, cloud, and hosting operations: own core compute, storage, virtualization, backup, and cloud hosting (including Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and GCP) that underpin rig and enterprise services; drive resilience, capacity planning, and cost efficiency.
Rig technology platforms: ensure the IT and technical platforms on the rigs, including edge and OT-adjacent systems, are reliable, secure, and support safe drilling; partner closely with Digital Drilling Solutions, Digital Operations, and field operations.
Infrastructure and network security operations: keep the global network and infrastructure secure as well as available; partner closely with the CISO and Information Security on incident response, hardening, and controls, aligned with a shared follow-the-sun response model.
Governance, risk, and compliance: partner with Cybersecurity and Governance, Risk & Compliance on identity and access dependencies, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, change control, audit readiness, and regulatory obligations.
Enterprise technology architecture: set infrastructure and platform architecture direction, standards, and governance; guide design decisions and technology selection in partnership with the principal architecture team.
Major-incident leadership: serve as the primary infrastructure leader during major technology incidents and disruptions; translate technical issues into business impact, coordinate cross-functional response, engage executive stakeholders when warranted, and ensure corrective actions and lessons learned are implemented.
Operational governance and resilience: own major-incident, problem management, and disaster-recovery readiness for infrastructure and rig technology; drive continuous improvement and reliability engineering.
Project and change governance: sponsor, approve, and govern infrastructure projects and enterprise change requests, ensuring business case, scope, funding, resourcing, vendor selection, risk management, testing, acceptance criteria, and benefits realization are sufficient before and during execution.
Executive communications: provide clear communications to IT and business leadership on infrastructure services, outages, risks, strategic tradeoffs, investment needs, and operational performance, using business language rather than unnecessary technical detail.
Post-merger integration and standardization: continue to integrate, rationalize, and standardize the combined H&P and KCA Deutag infrastructure estate toward a single global operating model.
MSP and vendor oversight: manage managed service providers and technology partners to defined SLAs and performance standards; partner with Supply Chain, who executes vendor negotiations and vendor management, providing the technical and performance requirements that inform sourcing and renewals.
Strategic vendor engagement: engage strategic vendors and managed service providers at executive and account-leadership levels to resolve issues, improve performance, manage escalations, and align roadmaps, while Supply Chain continues to execute negotiations and vendor management.
People leadership: lead, develop, and organize a global, multi-site team of managers and engineers across the Western and Eastern Hemispheres; build bench strength, on-call coverage, and succession.
Leadership standards: set expectations for managers, principals, and technical leaders consistent with H&P's job-architecture levels (for example P4, M2, M3, and M4) and coach leaders to bring recommendations, not just issues, across project engagement, incident response, change control, budgeting, vendor management, and planning.
Financial stewardship: partner with IT Business Operations on the infrastructure and platform budget, forecast, and savings, running the function with disciplined spend-to-value optimization.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred
15+ years of progressive infrastructure and operations experience, including significant leadership responsibility, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Advanced knowledge of enterprise infrastructure operations: networks, datacenter, cloud, virtualization, and hosting
Advanced knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and/or GCP) and hybrid operations
Knowledge of rig, drilling, or industrial / operational-technology (OT) environments strongly preferred
Advanced knowledge of network and infrastructure security operations and incident response
Advanced knowledge of IT service management, major incident, problem, and change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity
Advanced knowledge of enterprise technology architecture, standards, and governance
Demonstrated experience running 24x7, mission-critical operations to defined availability targets (follow-the-sun / NOC)
Ability to sponsor and govern complex programs and projects, including business case, resourcing, vendor selection, risk mitigation, acceptance criteria, and benefits realization
Experience partnering with Cybersecurity and Governance, Risk & Compliance on audit readiness and regulatory obligations
Experience managing managed service providers (MSPs) and technology partners to SLAs, including executive escalation and roadmap alignment
Proven leadership of large, geographically distributed technical teams
Experience with post-merger technology integration preferred
Financial acumen: infrastructure and platform budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization (FinOps)
Excellent executive communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills
Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including to rig sites (passport required)

What We Offer

At H&P, our commitment to our people is at the forefront, and that includes benefits that provide employees a sense of health and financial security. We know that life continues outside of employment and actively caring of our people is our priority.

Flexible Spending or Health Savings Accounts
401k match
Paid Leave Plans
Parental & Adoption Benefits
Disability Coverage
Employee Assistance Program
Educational Assistance
Learning & Development Opportunities
Flex-scheduling available for qualifying positions to achieve work-life integration
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

The job level and associated compensation for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and alignment with the role’s requirements. Final compensation for this role may vary depending on individual factors.

jobs.title: Director, Partner Architect
jobs.description:
Why Box needs you

The Business Development team at Box drives partnerships and strategic initiatives that play an outsized role in differentiating and scaling Box. We work closely with external partners and across functions to identify, deliver, and manage partnerships, new go-to-market efforts, and deep product integrations with leading hyperscaler, enterprise software, and AI companies.

With data + AI at the core of our Intelligent Content Management platform, partners are a force multiplier for how we deliver innovation, reach customers, and scale our impact. We’re seeking a Director, Partner Architect to lead technical innovation across our strategic partnerships and partner ecosystem. In this interdisciplinary role, you will collaborate and build with partners, develop and set direction for repeatable solutions and product integrations, and drive growth and market leadership.

This role will report to the Vice President leading Box’s strategic partnerships team. You’ll collaborate across sales, product management, solutions engineering, marketing, and customer success teams while engaging directly with partner and customer executives. As part of this entrepreneurial and results-oriented team, you will have an opportunity to shape and advance game-changing partnerships for Box.

What You’ll Do

Define and prioritize data + AI opportunities for solutions with key partners to reinforce Box's go-to-market plays and industry vertical and line-of-business focal areas, product roadmap, and corporate objectives.
Collaborate directly with strategic partners to identify, design, develop, and validate AI prototypes, demos, solution accelerators, and proof-of-concept integrations that showcase the combined value of Box and partner platforms.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor and builder for internal teams, customers, and market-leading AI platforms, hyperscalers, enterprise software partners, and consulting firms, guiding them from initial concept through scalable implementation to provide successful business outcomes.
Design and maintain technical playbooks, architecture diagrams, sample applications, demo libraries, deployment patterns, and positioning materials to enable and inspire internal teams, customers, and partners to build and scale solutions on Box's Intelligent Content Management platform.
Support internal teams and partners in high-value pre-sales engagements, including technical discovery, custom demos, and workshops, while enabling internal teams on partner solutions that accelerate joint growth by solving business challenges with technical capabilities beyond those of Box.
Translate technical insights and patterns from partner engagements to provide structured feedback to product, marketing, and sales teams based on partner and customer insights to continuously influence our solutions, product roadmap, and go-to-market strategy.
Represent Box externally through demos, solution design sessions, and clear communication of Box's product vision, helping partners understand and unlock the full value of Box.

Who You Are

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. Key characteristics for success in this role include (but are not limited to):

7-10+ years of experience in solution architecture, partner architecture, pre-sales solutions, sales engineering, technical consulting, product management, developer relations, or related roles in AI, SaaS, software, cloud/AI ecosystem, or consulting.
Strong fluency in modern AI, cloud, and SaaS technologies, trends, and integration patterns, with hands-on technical ability to build prototypes, validate designs, and deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Proven track record of engaging, enabling, and working with partners, customers, channel organizations, or systems integrators, including AI-native and enterprise app developers.
Strong solutions and enterprise understanding, combining an ability to map and architect AI solutions across AI, enterprise SaaS, and line-of-business platforms, skill in tactical enablement and deal support responsibilities, and a love of experimentation to turn complex partnership initiatives into actionable momentum.
Strong communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with comfort in both internal- and external-facing settings and the ability to establish trust across a range of technical and non-technical audiences and levels (from sellers to c-level executives).
Excel at connecting customer pain points with partner capabilities to design compelling solution narratives, with a passion for “showing, not just telling” through high-impact presentations, demos, and workshops.
Strategic, creative, self-starting mindset with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and thrive in ambiguity.

Box is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual base salary (or OTE if commissionable role) is dependent upon factors such as: knowledge, skill level, experience, and work location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits. For more information, check out our benefits and perks. In accordance with OFCCP compliance, here is the Pay Transparency Provision.

This role will proactively shape how customer information is captured, managed, and leveraged, ensuring systems and processes evolve in alignment with organizational priorities.

In addition, the Director will champion innovation in digital engagement and customer insights, identifying opportunities to apply advanced analytics and AI to enhance transparency, strengthen relationships, and unlock new value. This leader will guide multi-year technology roadmaps, influence investment decisions, and ensure NYPA’s customer technology capabilities remain robust, scalable, and future-ready.

Responsibilities

Direct and oversee the development and maintenance of the functional technology roadmap, strategy, plans, goals, budgets, and metrics.
Direct and oversee the execution of all technology related activities and processes, including recurring program management activities. (i.e., contracts, invoicing, third-party management).
Ensure system Product Owner business requirements, processes, and controls are socialized, enforced, and maintained across all stakeholders.
Provide system design and configuration guidance to stakeholders for and related module(s), which includes developing the conceptual design for solutions, making changes to system rules, formulas, algorithms, and attributes; preparing and maintaining test scripts, transferring changes to quality assurance environment and testing changes to ensure accuracy.

Strong knowledge of information systems analysis, design, development, and testing activities.
Demonstrated ability to recognize, analyze, and resolve problem situations as effectively as possible.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with senior level executives.
Strong analytical ability requiring a high degree of attention to detail.

jobs.title: Director, Test Engineering
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Lingo, we’re building a groundbreaking health platform that combines continuous biosensor data, real-time analytics, and personalized insights to help people live fuller, longer, and healthier lives. Our systems ingest millions of sensor readings daily, powering experiences for consumers and partners worldwide, with the reliability and scalability of cloud-native, enterprise-grade platforms.

We are looking for a Director of Test Engineering to help accelerate growth across the U.S., Spain, and India. In this role, you will build and lead a world-class, globally distributed software test engineering function. The role requires a hands-on leader who thrives in building, can roll up their sleeves alongside their team, and understands that quality in a consumer health platform is both a technical discipline and a direct expression of how much we care about the people using our product.

You will own the end-to-end software testing strategy across Lingo’s platforms, mobile applications, CGM and biosensor data pipelines, AI/ML models, and the broader consumer platform. You will also grow and unify a global team of software quality engineers who operate with the same standards and urgency regardless of time zone.

What You’ll Work On

Architect and scale a distributed software test engineering team across the U.S., Spain, and India, establishing the hiring strategy, team structure, and operating model that supports Lingo’s growth trajectory.
Create a unified quality engineering culture across geographies, operating with the same standards, tools, and sense of ownership.
Define career paths, mentorship frameworks, and performance expectations that attract and retain top quality engineering talent globally.
Oversee test function staffing, resource planning, budgeting, tooling, test platforms, and third-party vendor relationships across all regions.
Own the quality architecture and test strategy across Lingo’s full technology stack, iOS and Android consumer applications, CGM and biosensor data ingestion pipelines, AI/ML inference services, and backend platform services.
Lead verification strategy for biosensor and CGM data integrity, ensuring that data flowing from wearable hardware through ingestion pipelines to consumer-facing insights is accurate, reliable, and auditable.
Build and maintain the testing infrastructure required to support continuous, high-frequency releases across mobile and platform surfaces.
Establish standards for CI/CD integration of automated test suites, ensuring quality signals are fast, reliable, and actionable for engineering teams.
Champion a shift-left testing culture, embedding quality thinking into design and development rather than treating it as a gate at the end of the cycle.
Serve as the primary engineering owner for test-related compliance activities, including audit readiness, CAPA responses, and regulatory evidence across applicable standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, 21 CFR Part 11).
Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Legal to ensure test engineering practices remain aligned with applicable FDA, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements as Lingo scales internationally.
Translate regulatory requirements into practical engineering standards that the global team can implement consistently, without creating unnecessary friction in the development process.
Serve as the voice of software quality in product and engineering leadership discussions, surfacing risks, influencing roadmap prioritization, and ensuring that consumer experience software quality is a first-class consideration alongside feature velocity.
Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Platform Engineering leaders to define shared quality standards across Lingo’s technology organization.
Build post-deployment monitoring and observability capabilities that give the team real-time visibility into quality signals in production, particularly for biosensor data accuracy and AI/ML model performance.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years in software or test engineering, including 5+ years leading and scaling engineering managers and global quality teams.
Demonstrated experience building quality engineering functions—not just running them—including hiring, org design, tooling strategy, and culture development across distributed teams.
Hands-on background in mobile quality engineering (iOS and/or Android), with experience testing consumer-facing applications at scale.
Experience with quality strategy for data-intensive platforms, including IoT, sensor data pipelines, or real-time data processing systems.
Proficient with modern automation frameworks across mobile (Appium, XCTest, Espresso), API (REST Assured, Postman, Pact), and pipeline testing.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD systems and experience integrating automated quality signals into engineering delivery workflows.
Experience owning quality compliance in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, and related standards.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to represent quality engineering to senior leadership and external stakeholders across cultures and time zones.
Proven ability to lead through influence in a fast-paced, cross-functional consumer technology environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling engineering teams across US, European, and Asian geographies, with sensitivity to cross-cultural leadership and distributed team dynamics.
Background in AI/ML system testing, including model validation, drift detection, and testing for probabilistic outputs in consumer health contexts.
Experience with CGM, bio-wearable, or medical device software quality, particularly where hardware and software quality intersect.
Previous experience supporting Regulatory Affairs/Quality Assurance teams during FDA or CE mark audits in a consumer health or digital health context.
Background in non-functional and performance testing tools (e.g., Locust, JMeter, Gatling, k6) applied to high-throughput consumer data platforms.

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives :
www.abbottbenefits.com

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

The base pay for this position is $172,000.00 – $344,000.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.
