jobs.title: Senior Manager, Support Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Leads a rapidly growing, high-visibility Federal Customer support organization responsible for delivering responsive, high-quality service during critical customer events and throughout the support lifecycle. Manages managers and individual contributors while building the leadership capacity, operational discipline, and team capability required to scale successfully.

Oversees Command Center operations and serves as a senior escalation point for complex customer-impacting issues. Ensures the organization delivers timely intake, triage, issue resolution, escalation, communication, and coordination across internal teams and customer stakeholders.

Owns the operating model, staffing strategy, performance, and operational results for the organization. Partners closely with Workforce Management and leaders across Federal and Commercial Support to plan coverage, manage changing demand, respond to volume spikes, and deploy resources where they can have the greatest business impact.

This role requires a strong operational leader who can communicate clearly with senior executives and customer stakeholders, use data to drive decisions, and lead teams through fast-moving, high-visibility situations. The leader will help shape a growing organization and create meaningful development and advancement opportunities for managers and individual contributors.

Responsibilities

Customer Service and Support Advocacy:

Leads Command Center operations and customer support delivery for Federal Customers, ensuring timely, accurate, and effective service.
Serves as a senior escalation point for significant customer-impacting issues, operational risks, and complex support situations.
Establishes standards for customer engagement, issue handling, communication, documentation, and shift handoffs.
Ensures customer-reported issues are accurately documented, assigned, tracked, communicated, and resolved or routed to the appropriate technical, consulting, or product team.
Builds strong working relationships with customer stakeholders, Support Engineering, Consulting, Federal Support, Workforce Management, and other internal partners.

Problem-Solving and Resolution:

Oversees the resolution and escalation of high-impact support issues, ensuring clear ownership, timely action, accurate status communication, and appropriate handoff through closure.
Identifies recurring issues, volume drivers, operational gaps, and customer-impact trends. Leads cross-functional action plans to improve outcomes and reduce recurrence.
Coordinates with consulting, technical, product, infrastructure, quality assurance, and development teams to address complex issues and implement long-term solutions.
Ensures escalation paths, decision rights, response expectations, and communications protocols are clear and consistently followed.
Provides concise, executive-ready updates on material incidents, operational status, customer impact, risks, recovery actions, and decisions needed.

Operational Leadership and Resource Management:

Leads a growing organization of managers and individual contributors. Builds a scalable leadership structure that provides appropriate oversight, coaching, and accountability as the organization expands.
Owns staffing strategy, operational readiness, employee deployment, performance, and results for the organization.
Partners with Workforce Management to develop staffing plans, schedules, forecasts, capacity plans, contingency plans, and coverage models.
Partners with leaders across Federal and Commercial Support to align resource deployment with business needs and customer commitments.
Builds leadership capability and succession plans that support organizational growth, team development, and advancement opportunities.

Performance Monitoring and Management:

Defines and monitors operational KPIs, including contact volume, service levels, ticket intake and routing, resolution progress, backlog, escalations, customer-impact trends, and staffing performance.
Establishes real-time operational reporting and an executive update cadence that clearly communicates performance, customer status, emerging risks, key decisions, and required actions.
Uses data to identify capacity constraints, performance gaps, recurring issue drivers, and opportunities to improve staffing, workflows, and customer experience.
Leads operational reviews and converts findings into measurable improvements for customer support and service delivery.

Documentation, Knowledge, and Process Improvement:

Directs the development and maintenance of operating procedures, escalation paths, contact trees, shift handoff processes, and customer communication templates.
Ensures documentation is accurate, practical, and consistently used across the organization.
Drives knowledge management and training that prepare employees to handle customer inquiries, identify critical issues, and follow established triage and escalation processes.
Leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve the speed, quality, consistency, and transparency of support delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Leads complex operational initiatives across teams, ensuring staffing, readiness activities, timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables are actively managed.
Establishes and executes operating plans that support customer commitments, business priorities, resource readiness, and organizational growth.
Adjusts operational plans quickly in response to changing volumes, customer impact, staffing constraints, or business priorities.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Drives strong partnerships across Support Engineering, Consulting, Federal Support, Commercial Support, Workforce Management, Product Development, Infrastructure, and executive leadership.
Aligns teams on operating expectations, issue ownership, escalation paths, resource deployment, and customer communication.
Builds credibility with senior stakeholders through clear communication, disciplined execution, and sound judgment.

Problem Solving:

Leads teams in resolving complex operational and customer-support issues where rapid coordination and clear decisions are required.
Reviews critical issues, interprets complex data, identifies root causes, and directs actions that reduce customer impact and prevent recurrence.
Balances immediate customer needs with broader business requirements, ensuring resources are deployed where they have the greatest impact.

Continuous Learning:

Builds a team culture that values preparation, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
Identifies skill gaps and develops training plans that improve readiness for customer support, triage, escalation management, operational reporting, and cross-functional coordination.
Coaches managers and individual contributors to strengthen operational judgment, customer focus, data fluency, and leadership capability.

Continuous Improvement:

Leads the development and implementation of process improvements that increase the efficiency , consistency, and quality of support operations.
Uses performance data, employee feedback, customer feedback, and operational findings to prioritize improvement opportunities.
Ensures successful practices are standardized and applied across the organization.

Performance and Development:

Drives performance through clear expectations, regular feedback, coaching, and accountability aligned with Oracle performance management processes.
Develops managers and individual contributors to build a strong leadership pipeline and support career growth.
Leads hiring, talent planning, promotion readiness, and succession planning to maintain the capacity and leadership coverage required by the business.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience leading customer support, service delivery, command center, contact center, or technical operations teams.
Experience managing managers and individual contributors in a high-volume, high-visibility , time -sensitive environment.
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to communicate operational status, customer impact, risks, trends, and recommended actions to senior and executive leaders.
Strong analytical skills and experience using KPIs, operational reporting, and workforce data to make staffing and performance decisions.
Experience partnering with Workforce Management on forecasting, scheduling, capacity planning, and coverage models.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage escalations, and coordinate issue resolution across technical and business organizations.
Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment with changing demand, competing priorities, and critical customer commitments.

Terms and Conditions

U.S. citizenship is required.
Must be eligible to complete required background investigation and public trust or other applicable federal access requirements.
Role requires support for overnight, weekend, and other non-standard business hours as needed to meet business and customer requirements.
Kansas City is the primary preferred location.

jobs.title: Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About The Role

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is seeking an experienced and strategic leader to manage and advance the institution's research storage ecosystem. As the Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure within Research Information Services (RIS), you will lead the team responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance data infrastructure that supports world-class biomedical research, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and high-performance computing.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for St. Jude's scientific computing storage environment, encompassing active research storage, archival and object storage, cloud-integrated platforms, secure research environments, data protection services, and disaster recovery capabilities. You will define technology strategy, guide platform evolution, oversee major investments, and ensure operational excellence across systems that store and protect some of the institution's most valuable research assets.

Working closely with Information Services teams, research programs, administrative leadership, and external collaborators, you will serve as a trusted advisor on storage architecture, research computing operations, service quality, capacity planning, and technology roadmaps. The position also plays a critical role in aligning infrastructure capabilities with evolving scientific and institutional priorities.

A key responsibility of this role is managing strategic vendor partnerships, including operational governance, architecture reviews, service delivery management, procurement support, technology evaluations, and performance accountability. As the primary institutional representative for research storage platforms, you will ensure effective coordination among St. Jude stakeholders, technology partners, and the broader research community.

The successful candidate will oversee infrastructure supporting AI training and inference, high-performance computing, genomics, imaging, scientific instrumentation, and other data-intensive research workloads while maintaining robust business continuity, backup, and disaster recovery capabilities for mission-critical research services.

What You Will Do:

Storage Strategy & Architecture:

Develop and manage the roadmap for St. Jude’s centralized research storage platforms, including high-performance file systems, object storage, archival storage, cloud-integrated storage, and secure research environments.
Lead architecture planning for future growth associated with AI, machine learning, scientific computing, research instrumentation, and emerging research technologies.
Evaluate new technologies and vendor solutions to improve performance, resilience, scalability, user experience, and cost efficiency.
Support institutional planning for significant increases in research data volume and complexity.

Operations & Service Delivery:

Ensure reliable operation of research storage services supporting HPC, AI, regulated research environments, institutional applications, and data-intensive science.
Establish and monitor service-level objectives, operational metrics, capacity forecasts, and performance benchmarks.
Develop reporting and dashboards to support leadership decision-making, budgeting, procurement, and lifecycle planning.
Lead incident management, root-cause analysis, change management, and continuous service improvement activities.
Document procedures and operational knowledge to support transparency and transfer across the institution and to new staff as well as updating and supporting centralized asset management and information security.

Vendor & Partner Management:

Serve as the primary relationship manager for storage vendors.
Lead governance meetings, technical reviews, architecture planning sessions, and service performance assessments.
Review equipment proposals, quotations, statements of work, and technology recommendations.
Define RACI models, escalation processes, and operational responsibilities across internal teams and service providers.

Research Data Management & Governance:

Partner with researchers, data stewards, and RIS leadership to align storage services with institutional data management objectives.
Support storage governance, archival processes, retention strategies, and lifecycle management activities.
Collaborate with Information Security and compliance partners to ensure appropriate controls for sensitive and regulated research data.
Promote data stewardship, efficient resource utilization, and sustainable storage growth.

Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience:

Develop and maintain storage-related disaster recovery and business continuity strategies supporting institutional recovery objectives.
Ensure storage platforms are designed with resiliency, recoverability, backup, replication, immutable recovery, and cyber resilience capabilities.
Partner with Information Security, Technology Services, and RIS leadership to define recovery objectives, recovery procedures, and operational response plans.
Lead disaster recovery testing, recovery validation exercises, and documentation reviews.
Maintain architecture and operational documentation supporting audit readiness, business continuity, and disaster recovery requirements.
Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with storage infrastructure, vendor dependencies, capacity constraints, and emerging technologies.

Leadership & Team Development:

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of storage engineers, infrastructure specialists, and trusted consultants.
Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, innovation, collaboration, and customer service.
Support hiring, performance management, career development, succession planning, and workforce growth.
Build strong partnerships across RIS, Technology Services, Information Security, Shared Resources, and the research community.

Qualifications:

Required Education:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in business administration, computer science, data science, information science or related field.

Required Experience:

8+ years of progressive IT experience with experience managing small/mid-size teams, preferably enterprise-scale storage infrastructure, research computing environments, or large-scale data platforms.
Experience leading complex projects/delivery in terms of resources, vendors and budgets.
Experience managing teams in a supervisory/ leadership capacity, preferably 3+ years of experience leading technical teams or infrastructure operations.
Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.

Highly Preferred Experience:

Experience managing storage technologies across on-premises, colocation, and/or cloud environments.
Experience working with storage vendors, managed service providers, or strategic technology partners.
Strong understanding of storage architecture, capacity planning, backup, replication, data protection, disaster recovery, business continuity, on-premises and cloud data storage, and performance optimization.
Demonstrated success leading operational service delivery and infrastructure lifecycle management.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Experience:

Experience supporting high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), scientific computing, or large-scale research environments.
Experience administering or supporting IBM Storage Scale (GPFS), Lustre, or comparable parallel file systems.
Familiarity with object storage platforms and S3-compatible architectures.
Experience designing and operating multi-tiered storage ecosystems spanning flash, disk, archive, cloud, and replication tiers.
Knowledge of leveraging local NVMe resources, burst buffers, caching layers, or node-local storage to accelerate AI and HPC workloads.
Experience supporting genomics, imaging, microscopy, or other high-throughput research data pipelines.
Experience with storage benchmarking, observability platforms, telemetry, and capacity forecasting.
Knowledge of disaster recovery, business continuity, cyber resilience, and data protection frameworks.
Experience supporting GPU computing, distributed AI training, and large-scale analytics platforms.

Compensation

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $125,840 - $238,160 per year for the role of Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced, strategic leader to evolve the ServiceNow portfolio of products, associated data domains, data products, and services offered to IT, Security, and our Company's Business Divisions. The role will combine ownership of enterprise data and foundational platform capabilities with direct partnerships across Manufacturing, Research & Labs, and other business functions. The leader will stay up to date on key automation trends in the life sciences sector that center on ServiceNow; translate business priorities into a multi-year ServiceNow product roadmap; improve the quality and governance of critical enterprise data; and ensure the platform is ready to support AI-enabled workflows and future agentic capabilities.

This leader will also work closely with other leaders in the U.S. and international data products, services, and solutions organization to ensure that the organization’s needs are addressed appropriately and efficiently.

This is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role. The successful candidate will be expected to operate beyond traditional platform delivery—shaping product strategy, challenging existing ways of working, aligning senior stakeholders, and driving measurable business outcomes.

This is a hybrid role ( 3 days/ week in office) based in Rahway, NJ.

Position Responsibilities

Role Overview:
Responsible for framing the strategic vision and enabling the efficient and effective delivery of ServiceNow platform services across business divisions and technology organizations, while ensuring that ServiceNow data is optimized, governed, engineered for scale, and leveraged for immediate analytical, business, and GenAI use cases.

Manufacturing & Business Partnership

Serve as a senior strategic partner to our Company's Manufacturing Division, our Company's Research & Labs, Animal Health and other business stakeholders.
Translate business problems into prioritized ServiceNow products and capabilities, develop roadmaps, and drive execution of prioritized initiatives.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior business leaders regarding ServiceNow capabilities.
Anticipate emerging business needs and proactively shape solutions with stakeholders.

AI-Ready Enterprise Data & Platform Strategy

Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for ServiceNow data management capabilities, including the CMDB and related foundational data domains.
Establish ServiceNow as a trusted enterprise data and workflow platform by improving data quality, ownership, governance, completeness, accuracy and usability.
Define the future-state data model and operating approach for foundational data that enables IT, OT, asset management, enterprise architecture, security, risk and business workflows.
Lead the evolution of the CMDB toward a more federated, automated and AI-ready data foundation, including opportunities to apply automation and agentic capabilities.
Create and enforce enterprise data quality standards, ownership models, controls and remediation processes for critical ServiceNow data.
Prepare the ServiceNow data estate for AI use cases by improving semantic consistency, lineage, context, relationships and trust in enterprise data.
Partner with enterprise AI, governance, security and architecture leaders to ensure ServiceNow data and workflows can safely support AI-enabled and agentic experiences.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Data, Security, Infrastructure and business leaders to establish common definitions, standards and governance for enterprise data.

Product Management & ServiceNow Roadmap

Establish a product-oriented operating model across the portfolio, with clear product vision, outcomes, roadmaps, investment priorities, adoption measures and lifecycle management.
Continuously evaluate the ServiceNow product portfolio and market direction to determine what capabilities are appropriate for research laboratories, manufacturing plants, quality and compliance, security, risk and other regulated environments.
Partner closely with ServiceNow and strategic technology partners to influence product roadmaps, validate emerging capabilities, and ensure that our Company needs are represented.
Lead prioritization of demand, investment and capacity across a broad portfolio, balancing strategic transformation with sustainment and operational needs.

Team Leadership & Innovation

Lead a significant global organization spanning U.S. business-facing leadership and distributed engineering, development, testing and operations capabilities.
Build a strong leadership bench, including deputies and succession plans, to eliminate single points of failure and create scalable leadership capacity.
Establish the right balance between supplier-dependent delivery and internal ownership of sustainment and transformation capabilities.
Create a culture centered on customer service, business partnership, accountability, speed to value, and completing work across organizational boundaries.

Behavioral Competencies Required

Cross-Functional Leadership & Matrix Management:

Collaborative alignment: Proven track record of leading large, high-performing, cross-functional teams across IT, Manufacturing, Research & Labs, and Enterprise Data functions.
Enterprise representation: Confidently represent the data organization in Legal, Privacy, and Global Ethics forums to drive risk mitigation strategies.

Accountability & Delivery Excellence:

Autonomous execution: Operates independently with a strong sense of ownership over timelines, product quality, and delivery excellence.
Financial stewardship: Highly accountable for managing budgets, driving operational efficiencies, and optimizing compute/cloud costs at scale.

AI-Native Mindset & Continuous Improvement:

Challenges the status quo: Consistently looks for ways to modernize legacy processes and embed AI-assisted workflows into standard operations.
Adaptable leadership: Navigates changing business priorities while maintaining stability and reliability for core data products.

Strategic Vision With Operational Focus:

Anticipates gaps: Strategically understands our Manufacturing division and our Research & Development division business portfolio and proactively identifies data gaps or opportunities.
Scalable thinking: Balances immediate business needs with the necessity of building long-term, scalable, and highly reliable architectural solutions.

Functional Competencies Required:

Core Healthcare Data Domain Expertise:

Domain knowledge in pharma research, compliance, manufacturing processes & data domains.
Data synthesis: Proven ability to work with enterprise/central data functions to synthesize a wide array of structured and unstructured pharma datasets.

Data Platform & Pipeline Engineering:

Modern cloud architecture: Proven success in building, scaling, and maintaining modern data platforms and data pipelines (e.g., ServiceNow, AWS, Databricks).
Enterprise-scale operations: Hands-on experience managing data operations, SLAs, and data reliability at a massive, enterprise scale.

Agile Data Product Management:

End-to-end lifecycle: Deep experience directing the full product lifecycle for data products, from vision and requirements to release and adoption.
Modern delivery frameworks: Familiarity with agile product development methodologies and API orchestration for seamless data consumption.
Data Governance, Privacy & Security:
Compliance by design: Strong understanding of data privacy requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, GXP, GMP) and how to engineer compliance directly into data pipelines and products.

Required Minimum Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in analytics, data science, computational sciences, science, or computer science.
Master’s degree preferred in analytics, data science, computational sciences, science, or computer science.
13+ years of progressive technology and/or digital leadership experience in consulting, pharmaceuticals, or life sciences, with significant experience leading enterprise platforms, products, or data capabilities.
Strong experience with ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise workflow/platform ecosystem, including CMDB, ITOM, Asset Management, Enterprise Architecture and/or related data capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to partner with senior business executives, understand business strategy, and translate business needs into technology and product roadmaps.
Excellent communication, influencing, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to challenge conventional thinking constructively.

Required Skills

Backed by the scale, resources, and market presence of a global network, this organization operates with the energy, ambition, and pace of a startup. We are assembling a founding team of builders, innovators, and problem solvers who are excited by the opportunity to create new products, shape new ways of working, and help define the future of technology-enabled business at KPMG. If you thrive in entrepreneurial environments, embrace ambiguity, and are motivated by the potential to make a lasting impact from the ground up, we invite you to consider joining us on this journey.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, Platform Product Management to join our Product organization.

Responsibilities:

Shape the multi-year platform strategy and integrated roadmaps for an AI-native platform across multiple complex domains, aligning product, technology, and firm priorities
Own the capability inventory and assessment across advisory and relevant functions, identifying recurring workflows, agents, data models, and integrations that should become reusable platform assets — and harvest the best of them into the shared platform in collaboration with our engineering organization

Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Minimum ten years of recent experience in product management for technical products or platforms, including owning a B2B or enterprise platform product end to end

jobs.description:
About The Company

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

About The Role

Flow is seeking a Director of Engineering
to oversee building operations, maintenance performance, and critical systems across a portfolio of multifamily communities.

This role serves as the operational leader for engineering teams within an assigned region, partnering closely with General Managers, Assistant General Managers, and onsite maintenance teams to ensure our communities operate safely, efficiently, and to Flow standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with leadership experience across multiple properties. They are equally comfortable walking a mechanical room, reviewing a maintenance budget, analyzing operational metrics, and mentoring onsite teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Operations

Provide technical and operational support to engineering teams across multiple communities
Ensure consistent execution of preventative maintenance programs, work orders, unit turns, and repair and maintenance activities
Conduct regular property visits, inspections, and operational audits to verify compliance with company standards
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements that enhance service delivery and resident experience
Support General Managers and onsite leadership teams with engineering-related challenges and escalations

Engineering & Building Systems

Monitor the performance, maintenance, and uptime of critical building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevators, generators, access control, and fire & life safety systems
Lead troubleshooting efforts and support remediation of major maintenance-related issues
Ensure preventative maintenance schedules are executed and documented properly
Assist with planning and execution of deferred maintenance projects and system upgrades
Identify life safety, employee safety, and physical hazards and develop corrective action plans

Vendor & Contract Management

Manage relationships with service providers and contractors across the portfolio
Review vendor performance, scope of work, and contract compliance
Participate in bid processes and vendor selection efforts
Conduct regular business reviews with key service partners to ensure quality, responsiveness, and value
Recommend opportunities for contract optimization and cost savings

Financial Performance

Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning efforts
Monitor maintenance expenses, turnover costs, and service contract expenditures
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency while maintaining service standards
Assist with evaluating repair-versus-replace decisions and long-term asset planning

Compliance & Safety

Ensure properties operate in accordance with all federal, state, and local regulations
Maintain compliance with OSHA, EPA, NFPA, and applicable building and life safety codes
Support safety training initiatives and reinforce company safety standards
Ensure all required inspections, testing, certifications, and documentation are completed on schedule

Team Leadership

Coach, develop, and support onsite engineering teams and maintenance leaders
Participate in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training of engineering personnel
Assist with performance management and succession planning efforts
Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement

Reporting & Performance Metrics

Monitor and evaluate key operational metrics including preventative maintenance completion, work order completion times, unit turn performance, resident service feedback, compliance inspections, budget performance, and critical systems uptime
Provide regular reporting and recommendations to leadership teams

Ideal Background

5+ years of engineering, facilities, or maintenance leadership experience within multifamily, hospitality, commercial real estate, or a related industry
Experience overseeing operations across multiple properties or locations
Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, elevators, and fire & life safety systems
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations, EPA requirements, and NFPA codes
Experience managing third-party vendors and service contracts
Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and maintenance expenditures
Experience using Yardi or similar property management platforms
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned portfolio
Bilingual English and Spanish fluency highly preferred

Benefits

We take care of our people so they can do their best work.

Health and Wellness Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance and parental leave benefits. On-staff doctor, free therapy through SpringHealth, acupuncture, an Employee Assistance Program, and other wellness offerings.
Time Off PTO and paid holidays.
Financial 401(k) retirement plan, healthcare and dependent care FSAs, HSA-compatible plan options with annual employer HSA funding and pre-tax commuter benefits.
Life at Flow Weekly catered lunches, wellness classes and employee discounts on Flow hotel stays, grocer products, and merch.

jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow is opening a new AI engineering hub in West Palm Beach and hiring the founding leaders who will define its culture, teams, and technical direction from day one. If you've wanted the ownership of a startup with the scale of a global enterprise — this is that moment.

About The Role

Build and lead a world-class Mobile Platform Engineering organization in West Palm Beach that powers AI-native enterprise experiences across iOS and Android. This leader will hire exceptional mobile and AI talent, establish an AI-forward engineering culture, and deliver scalable mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications.

Build an AI-Native Engineering Culture in West Palm Beach

Establish and grow the Mobile Platform Engineering organization in West Palm Beach as a strategic hub for mobile and AI innovation.
Recruit, develop, and retain excellent AI, Android, iOS, and mobile platform engineering talent.
Embed AI-assisted development, automated quality systems, agentic workflows, and rapid experimentation into day-to-day engineering practices.
Create a high-performance culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, customer impact, and continuous learning.

Lead Mobile Platform Strategy and Execution

Own the technical roadmap for enterprise mobile platform capabilities across Android and iOS.
Establish and run on-call rotations, incident response processes, and a blameless postmortem culture that drives reliability improvements.
Define reusable frameworks, SDKs, and platform patterns that accelerate application development across multiple product teams.
Partner with Product, Design, AI, Infrastructure, and Business leaders to deliver differentiated mobile experiences.
Drive excellence in performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational rigor across the mobile platform.

Architect Enterprise Mobile Experiences

Design mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications across customer service, field service, operations, and productivity workflows.
Lead architecture for synchronization, offline-first experiences, notifications, inbox experiences, real-time interactions, and workflow execution.
Ensure applications perform reliably in low-connectivity and offline environments while meeting enterprise-grade security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Create seamless experiences across mobile clients, AI services, platform capabilities, and enterprise workflows.

Provide Technical Leadership

Lead critical architecture reviews and complex technical decisions across mobile, platform integration, and application layers.
Own the mobile build and delivery pipeline, including CI/CD reliability, build speed and test infrastructure.
Establish standards for observability, telemetry, mobile performance benchmarking, release quality, and production readiness.
Mentor Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical contributors.
Advance mobile innovation through AI-enabled workflows, modern development practices, and strong engineering fundamentals.

Why This Role

Engineering leadership roles that let you build a site from scratch — with a real charter, real resources, and real company-wide impact — are rare at any scale. This isn't a "manage the org" role. It's a "create the org" role.

For leaders who want to leave a mark on both the product and the people who build it, this is the opportunity.

Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience leading mobile engineering organizations (Android and iOS).
3+ years leading engineering managers or multi-team organizations.
Strong technical depth in mobile architecture, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native services, networking, security, data synchronization, and MAM/MDM enterprise integrations.
Track record building and scaling enterprise-grade mobile applications or mobile platforms used at large scale.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.

Specific AI Skills We Value

Experience building or integrating generative AI, LLM-powered experiences, AI agents, or copilots into mobile or enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and AI safety principles.
Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable ecosystems.
Understanding of on-device AI patterns, small language models, speech or vision models, real-time inference constraints, and mobile latency tradeoffs.
Experience applying AI to engineering productivity, including code generation, test generation, automated review, incident analysis, or quality automation.
Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, enterprise-grade mobile workflows.

This role will ensure that core platform features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the platform. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing healthcare data platforms and AI-enabled platform features in a growth-stage company

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s platform engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud and data platform capabilities aligned to business, clinical, and AI priorities.
Build and evolve the core platform tooling needed for observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cloud operations across GCP-based environments.
Own foundational platform capabilities for platform access, data access, identity-aware controls, service authorization, and secure environment provisioning.
Drive platform services and automation for data lifecycle management, including ingestion, validation, publishing, retention, archival, lineage, traceability, and audit readiness.
Partner with the Director of Data Engineering to strengthen Prolaio’s data architecture, API’s, data pipelines, and warehouse capabilities as part of the broader enterprise data platform.
Deliver reusable platform features and shared services that accelerate clinical research, analytics, data science, and data services teams.
Ensure platform features are designed with security, privacy, compliance, and HIPAA-aligned controls built in from the start, including support for regulated and validated environments.
Lead the development of AI-powered platform capabilities such as intelligent monitoring, workflow automation, metadata enrichment, and policy-aware access enablement.
Partner across Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, and Data teams to embed governance, operational controls, and regulatory readiness into the platform lifecycle.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing platform engineering team with clear ownership, strong execution discipline, and a mindset suited to a fast-moving growth-stage company.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms. Minimum 7 years of experience as Sr. Director/VP Engineering or Platform Engineering.
Demonstrated success as a senior engineering leader, including building, scaling, and coaching engineering teams while maintaining strong technical judgment and delivery accountability.
Proven experience designing, developing, and successfully delivering modern data platforms or platform engineering capabilities that support analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and enterprise data use cases.
Strong experience with GCP and cloud-native platform engineering practices, including infrastructure automation, observability, access controls, API-first architectures, and scalable service design.
Strong software engineering experience using Python and at least one of Java or .NET, with familiarity building internal platform features, services, or developer tooling; experience with SQL is required. Experience with Angular or React is good to have.
Deep understanding of the capabilities needed to support clinical trials, QMS ecosystems, clinical research, data science, analytics, and data services in regulated healthcare settings.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation.
Experience implementing data lifecycle management, governed data access, metadata or lineage-aware architectures, and platform controls that support traceability, reproducibility, auditability, and privacy requirements.
Strong working knowledge of healthcare security, privacy, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA and regulated system practices such as 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP-aligned controls, as they apply to platform engineering and patient-data systems.
Ability to operate as a self-starter in a cross-functional, matrixed, growth-stage environment, partnering effectively with CIO leadership, Engineering, Security, Quality, Clinical Operations, Product, Analytics and Data Science teams.

Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

The Director/Sr. Director, Data Engineering will lead and scale Prolaio’s healthcare data engineering capabilities that power its clinical intelligence products, real-world data pipelines, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services in a regulated environment, building secure, reliable, and AI-enabled data platforms that transform continuous, predictive, and shareable heart data into faster therapeutic discovery and better cardiovascular outcomes while operating as a self-starter senior leader in a growth-stage company. This role will ensure that core data engineering features and services are built with security, privacy, compliance, and auditability by design, and other regulatory expectations relevant to Prolaio’s clinical and patient-data environment. This role will partner with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Quality, Clinical Operations to embed security, privacy, HIPAA and regulatory expectations into every layer of the data engineering features. This is a role for a self-starter and experienced engineering leader who brings both organizational leadership and strong technical credibility in designing, building, and continuously enhancing data engineering and AI-enabled data pipeline features in a growth-stage company.

The Specifics

Lead Prolaio’s enterprise data engineering strategy and roadmap to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable data platform capabilities aligned to clinical, research, product, and AI priorities in regulated healthcare settings.
Architect and oversee end-to-end data flows and reusable pipelines for ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, publishing, retention, archival, and decommissioning across batch, streaming, and hybrid workloads.
Own the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and interoperable data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured clinical, operational, device, and patient-generated data relevant to Prolaio’s cardiovascular mission.
Define and enforce engineering standards for data modeling, lifecycle management, lineage, provenance, traceability, and auditability, embedding HIPAA, privacy, security, and GxP-aligned practices into day-to-day development workflows.
Partner closely with Data Architecture to design and govern conceptual, logical, and physical data models, apply healthcare standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC), and deliver analysis-ready, interoperable datasets.
Build and evolve robust data engineering capabilities across modern cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure) and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse), including orchestration, metadata, APIs, and integration patterns.
Lead the development of AI-enabled data engineering features such as intelligent data quality monitoring, metadata enrichment, semantic search, feature generation workflows, and automation that accelerate analytics, data science, and clinical research teams.
Collaborate with Quality, Clinical Operations, Security, Product, and Engineering to embed validation, change management, governed data access, master data management, and release readiness into the data platform lifecycle.
Establish and manage high-performing data engineering teams, providing clear ownership, coaching, and execution discipline suited to a fast-moving growth-stage environment, while influencing architecture and implementation decisions across a matrixed organization.
Support vendor and tool evaluation, including build-versus-buy decisions for data integration, quality, metadata, lineage, interoperability, and AI-enabled data management capabilities.

Why Prolaio?

Impactful Work:
You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
Innovative Environment:
You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
Professional Growth:
You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
Collaborative Team:
You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of experience in healthcare, medtech, life sciences, digital health, or another patient-focused environment, with meaningful responsibility for data platforms, platform engineering, or cloud-native enterprise platforms.
At least 7 years of experience as a Director or Sr. Director (or equivalent senior leadership role) leading data engineering or closely related data platform teams in growth-stage or innovation-driven organizations.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering healthcare data platforms that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, with proven success in regulated or validated environments.
Deep understanding of healthcare data domains (clinical trials, cardiovascular and physiological data, real-world data, claims, medication, socio-economic and behavioral data) and the application of healthcare terminologies and common data models (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP, CDISC).
Proven experience designing and operating end-to-end data flows, scalable pipelines, lineage, provenance, traceability, and data lifecycle management that support product, analytics, data science, clinical operations, quality, and data services use cases.
Strong familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, or comparable environments, including hands-on work with orchestration, APIs, and integration.
Strong software engineering and data engineering experience with Python and SQL and at least one of Java or .NET, with a track record of building internal data platform features, services, and developer tooling; experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular or React) is good to have. Experience in developing Agentic pipelines would be a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, matrixed organizations, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Clinical Operations, Quality, and Security, with a self-starter mindset and comfort with ambiguity in a growth-stage environment.
Familiarity with metadata, lineage, catalog, governance, and AI-enablement tools, including platforms for semantic indexing, vectorization, retrieval, and data lifecycle automation, and experience implementing governed data access and privacy-aware architectures.

jobs.title: Director of Physical & Digital Infrastructure
jobs.description:
La Rabida Children’s Hospital provides specialized, family-centered health care to children with medically complex conditions, disabilities, and chronic illness. Through expertise, compassion, and advocacy we help children and their families reach their fullest potential, regardless of their ability to pay.

Our not-for-profit hospital, licensed for 49 beds, helps transition children from neonatal or pediatric intensive care to home, by providing medical, rehabilitative and developmental care, and by training families to continue treatments and manage the necessary equipment in the home. La Rabida also provides extensive rehabilitation for those recovering from wounds or burns and treatment for exacerbations of chronic conditions.

The hospital’s enhanced pediatric patient-centered medical home provides primary care to children with complex medical conditions and their siblings. Children with medical homes elsewhere come to La Rabida for specialty services. La Rabida offers a wide range of specialty services provided to children with sickle cell disease, diabetes, and many others. Children are supported in their emotional and developmental growth, particularly in cases where such growth has been interrupted by accident or disease.

Finally, La Rabida provides forensic and treatment services for children exposed to abuse and neglect, comprehensive assessments for youth in care, early intervention for children between 0 and 3 years of age. Care coordination services for medically complex children are also provided for those who are covered by a health plan and receive care from providers in Cook County

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is seeking a visionary Senior Director of Product Strategy to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the intersection of product vision, market intelligence, and technical architecture — helping define not just what Salesforce builds next, but why and how.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Product Strategy, you will serve as a key architect of our forward-looking product innovation agenda. You will lead and grow a team of product strategists charged with identifying emerging white spaces, evaluating build-buy-partner options, and translating complex technical and market dynamics into clear, executable product strategies.

This role goes well beyond traditional corporate strategy. We are not looking for someone who reacts to the latest headlines or incoming M&A signals. We are building a team that gets ahead of trends — a group that proactively surfaces what Salesforce might be missing, stress-tests assumptions, and shapes the decisions that will define our product platform for the next decade.

From guiding the productization of emerging internal capabilities — spanning trust infrastructure, workflow automation, and agentic AI architectures — to framing investment theses around high-growth sectors like supply chain agentification, developer tooling, and AI-native systems of record, you will ensure Salesforce is building the right things, at the right time, with the right model.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Lead product strategy for forward-looking innovation, whitespace identification, and productization planning across Salesforce's AI and platform portfolio.
Drive product strategy for emerging offerings moving from internal capability to standalone or platform-integrated product — including trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI systems, and data platforms.
Own and evolve a strategic framework for evaluating build-buy-partner decisions, including how and when to integrate acquired technologies into the core Salesforce platform versus taking them to market independently.
Proactively identify and assess game-changing market shifts — including the agentic coding revolution, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source commercialization trends — and translate these into actionable investment recommendations.
Partner closely with the SVP to define 'what are we missing' across the product portfolio, filling gaps in strategic coverage that go beyond what reactive competitive intelligence can provide.
Synthesize inputs from engineering, product management, research, M&A, and external sources to develop clear, evidence-based points of view on where Salesforce should place strategic bets.
Perform quantitative and competitive analytics to size market opportunities, assess competitive positioning, and support investment recommendations with data-driven evidence.
Partner with regional leadership to expand Salesforce's product strategy footprint into European markets, accounting for local regulatory requirements, competitive dynamics, and go-to-market nuances.
Evaluate productization models — open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first — and build decision-making frameworks that account for monetization, competitive dynamics, and developer adoption.
Monitor venture investment trends, startup ecosystem signals, and technical research to stay ahead of emerging paradigms before they become conventional wisdom.
Present strategic recommendations and options to the SVP and cross-functional executives in a clear, structured, and data-supported manner.
Build and mentor a high-performing strategy team, establishing processes for ongoing horizon scanning, opportunity assessment, and strategic synthesis.

You're Our Person If

12+ years of experience spanning product management, product strategy, technology strategy, or innovation roles — preferably at an enterprise software or cloud platform company.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams of 3 or more strategists, researchers, or product managers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Deep working knowledge of AI and machine learning architectures, including agentic systems, LLM-based applications, and AI integration patterns within enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of systems of record, data platforms, and enterprise application architectures, including how AI layers are introduced into or layered atop traditional SaaS infrastructure.
Fluency in evaluating productization strategies, including trade-offs between open source, proprietary, platform-native, and standalone go-to-market models.
Experience participating in or supporting M&A strategy, including acquisition thesis development, integration planning, or build-buy-partner evaluation.
Ability to structure and communicate complex, multi-variable strategic analyses for senior executive audiences — in writing, in presentations, and in live discussions.
Comfort operating in contexts where the problem is not fully defined and the path forward requires both intellectual rigor and creative hypothesis generation.

Even Better If

Experience in product strategy or innovation roles at an AI-first company, an enterprise platform vendor, or a technology-focused management consulting firm.
Familiarity with agentic coding tools, developer platform ecosystems, and the competitive landscape around AI-assisted software development.
Knowledge of supply chain, operations, or vertical AI automation and process agentification at enterprise scale.
Track record of developing original investment or product theses — not simply synthesizing others' frameworks, but originating new points of view.
Exposure to venture capital, corporate development, or startup ecosystem dynamics, with the ability to translate investment signals into product strategy implications.
Builder's mindset: You are energized by creating new things — teams, frameworks, markets — not just running existing processes.
Experience working on both offensive (new market entry, new product launch) and defensive (competitive response, retention of strategic position) product strategies.
MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant discipline is a plus; demonstrated outcomes matter more than credentials

LI-Y*

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Product Management Director - Deployment Platform
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

We are seeking a Director-level Individual Contributor in Product Management to lead the strategy, development, and execution of our deployment and operational platform for Connetic, the next generation payment innovation from ACI Worldwide.

This role blends product leadership, DevOps strategy, and cloud-first deployment expertise, with responsibility for enabling secure, scalable, cloud-native and hybrid deployments across on-premises, private cloud, and SaaS environments.

You will define how mission-critical payment software is delivered, deployed, upgraded, and operated globally, across multi-cloud and enterprise environments, working across engineering, global markets, SRE, and customer-facing teams. This is a hands-on strategic role requiring deep technical fluency in cloud platforms, distributed systems, and deployment automation, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Drive the product definition, roadmap, and solution plans for deployment platforms, cloud infrastructure capabilities, and operational tooling.
Develop and maintain multi-year (3–5 year) product strategy and annual operating plans for DevOps, cloud deployment, and platform capabilities.
Define business cases and investment priorities based on market analysis, cloud adoption trends, and customer needs across SaaS and self-managed environments.

DevOps, Cloud & Platform
Own product vision for DevOps and cloud-enabled deployment tooling, including:
Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and GitOps models
CI/CD pipelines and release orchestration across environments
Environment provisioning across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-prem
Configuration management and secrets management
Observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)
Define standards for cloud-native architectures, including containerization (Kubernetes), service mesh, and microservices deployment patterns.
Establish automation frameworks to enable consistent, repeatable deployments across SaaS, hybrid, and on-prem environments.
Drive improvements in deployment velocity, reliability, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.

On-Prem, SaaS & Cloud Deployment Strategy
Define and deliver deployment models supporting:
Cloud-native SaaS platforms (multi-tenant and single-tenant)
Hybrid and multi-cloud deployments
Private cloud and on-premise (including air-gapped environments)
Design for portability across cloud providers and customer-managed infrastructure.
Own versioning, upgrade strategies, patching, blue/green and canary releases, and backward compatibility across environments.
Ensure architectures support:
High availability and fault tolerance
Disaster recovery and geo-redundancy
Elastic scalability and workload isolation in cloud environments
Ensure deployment and cloud architecture supports high-performance payment processing, including:
Wires, real-time payments, cards, and ACH
Low latency and high throughput requirements
Regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, regional compliance, data residency)
End-to-end encryption and secure key management
Partner with professional services, solution consulting, application, and payment product teams to ensure seamless delivery across all deployment models.

Customer & Market Engagement
Engage directly with enterprise customers, partners, and implementation teams to understand deployment, cloud adoption, and operational challenges.
Translate customer feedback, cloud migration needs, and market trends into actionable product capabilities.
Partner with Sales and Marketing on go-to-market strategy, including positioning cloud vs on-prem offerings, sales enablement, and customer adoption strategies.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with:
Engineering (platform, cloud infrastructure, and application teams)
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Security, Compliance, and Risk
Professional Services / Implementation
Influence architecture decisions to ensure deployability, operability, scalability, and cloud readiness are core design principles.
Act as a key bridge between platform engineering and customer-facing delivery teams.

Operational & Financial Accountability
Define and track key KPIs:
Deployment success rate
Release frequency and cycle time
Environment provisioning time
Cloud infrastructure utilization and efficiency
Drive continuous improvement through automation, telemetry, and data-driven insights.
Contribute to cost optimization strategies, particularly in cloud infrastructure and SaaS operations.
Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in Product Management, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
Proven experience managing enterprise software deployments across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem environments.
Strong knowledge of:
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
DevOps practices and tools (CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, etc.)
Distributed systems and microservices architectures
Experience with cloud-native and hybrid deployment models.

Competencies

Deep systems thinker with strong cloud, platform, and architectural expertise
Customer-first mindset with strong empathy for enterprise deployment and cloud migration challenges
Strong analytical and business case development skills
Ability to influence without authority and operate at executive level
High ownership with a bias toward execution, scalability, and measurable outcomes

Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Competencies)

Experience in payments, fintech, or regulated industries.
Familiarity with:
PCI-DSS, SOC2, and compliance-driven product development
Data residency and sovereign cloud considerations
Experience driving cloud transformation or SaaS platform adoption.
Proven ability to influence large, cross-functional organizations as a senior IC.

Work Environment:

Hybrid work environment
Majority of time spent on PC (Phys. Req.)
Travel as needed for customer and stakeholder engagement

Core Capabilities:

We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:

Ensure Accountability:
holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
Drives Results:
consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Customer Focus:
building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
Cultivate Innovation:
creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
Collaborates:
building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
Courage:
stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US
on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship
for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Public Policy, Business, Political Science, or Economics or equivalent practical experience.
15 years of economic development experience within a corporate organization (e.g., tax, policy, legal, real estate, etc.), law firm, accounting firm, consultancy, or government agency.
10 years of experience in contract negotiations.
10 years of experience developing business to business partnerships.

Preferred qualifications:

10 years of experience working in a commercial environment showcasing strength in B2B growth (GTM).
10 years of experience with any of the following: industrial-scale projects, real estate evaluation, acquisition, development, and construction, community collaboration, city/mayor development coaching.
10 years of experience with economic development impact studies or economic development marketing.

About The Job

As Director, Data Center Ecosystem, you will combine your market and tech industry knowledge to support Google's infrastructure growth. You will be a commercial leader who will help facilitate managed growth in data center locations. You will advocate for Google and the data center industry, while building bridges that positively connect our data centers needs with those of commercial infrastructure that we support.

In this role, you will work closely with a network of internal stakeholders as well as strategic community leaders. You will be a key liaison to commercially advise our communities on our growth plans. You will partner with the local Chambers and Mayors’ councils to facilitate collaborative engagements. This facilitation directly correlates to delivering commercial frameworks that minimize negative economic impact on hospitals, hotels, housing, restaurants, etc. as our localized presence brings growth to the communities.

Additionally, you will lead internal stakeholder alignment critical growth factors for each community and develop an alignment playbook that is specific to each community. This playbook focuses on the commercial side of developing local external affairs cross-county collaboration. In addition, you will be part of a core team advising localized leadership of managed growth expectations and infrastructure demands. Your knowledge of economic development, compliance, relationship and coalition building, policy and regulation, and company goals will position you to be an advocate for development and management of the global data center portfolio.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $256000 - $356000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Bridge the divide between the data center demand surge and civic/community processes that enable the strategic growth.
Orchestrate collaborations among connecting counties, small businesses, hospital systems, and regional employers.
Advise state teams on impacts of tax and impact funds vs intended outcomes.
Ensure the civic fabric of businesses are woven into growth plans that position the local communities to grow.
Develop process mapping for local tax flows and funding mechanisms at both state and local levels to advise state teams on gaps to address.
