jobs.title: Director of Technology- Process Development & Scale-Up
jobs.description:
Director of Technology- Process Development & Scale-Up

ElementUSA is seeking a Director of Technology – Process Development & Scale-Up to provide technical leadership across the development, scale-up, and commercialization of novel mineral and materials processing technologies. This role will lead and challenge multidisciplinary technical teams working across both hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical processes, ensuring laboratory and pilot development is focused not only on technical performance, but also on scalability, operability, economics, and commercial execution.

The Director will work closely with PhD scientists, metallurgists, chemists, process engineers, project managers, operations personnel, equipment suppliers, and external engineering partners to translate experimental results into maturing process flowsheets, design criteria, equipment requirements, and engineering packages.

A critical responsibility of this position will be establishing the technical-development management system that connects test campaigns, technical risks, pilot capabilities, process flowsheet maturity, engineering requirements, and scale-up decisions.

Technology & Process Development
Provide technical leadership across hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical process-development programs.
Lead, mentor, manage, and constructively challenge PhD scientists, metallurgists, chemists, and process-development personnel.
Review test campaigns to ensure clear objectives, hypotheses, success criteria, priorities, and actionable outcomes.
Challenge assumptions and results related to mass balances, recoveries, selectivity, reagent consumption, impurity behavior, energy requirements, process conditions, and scalability.
Drive maturation of integrated process flowsheets from laboratory concepts through pilot-scale demonstration and commercial readiness.
Identify critical technical unknowns and develop structured test programs to systematically retire technical and scale-up risks.
Ensure development work generates the data required for engineering design, economic evaluation, and commercial decision-making.

Technology Development Governance & Execution
Establish and maintain a practical management system for technology and process-development activities across laboratory, pilot, and scale-up programs.
Develop and manage KPIs, scorecards, trackers, and review cadences that provide clear visibility into technical progress, priorities, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Maintain an integrated view of active and planned test campaigns, including objectives, technical questions, success criteria, owners, schedules, results, conclusions, and follow-up actions.
Ensure testing is tied to specific flowsheet decisions, technical risks, scale-up requirements, engineering inputs, or economic assumptions rather than testing for testing's sake.
Develop and maintain a technical risk and unknowns register with defined test plans for retiring critical uncertainties.
Develop a pilot equipment and capability roadmap identifying what equipment is required, why it is needed, which test or scale-up objective it supports, timing, cost, and readiness.
Challenge proposed pilot equipment purchases to ensure capital is aligned with the process-development and commercialization roadmap.
Track technology maturity by major unit operation from concept to laboratory proof, pilot demonstration, engineering design basis, commissioning, and operations.
Establish technical readiness criteria and stage gates for advancing technologies into the next phase.
Lead recurring technology reviews focused on results, risks, decisions, priorities, and next experiments rather than activity reporting.
Provide the COO and executive leadership with a concise view of technical maturity, unresolved risks, upcoming decisions, resource requirements, and readiness for scale-up.

Scale-Up & Engineering Translation
Serve as a primary technical bridge between process development and engineering execution teams.
Translate laboratory and pilot results into process design criteria, mass and energy balances, process flow diagrams, equipment requirements, operating parameters, and other engineering inputs.
Work closely with project management and engineering teams to ensure technology packages are sufficiently mature before advancing into detailed engineering and capital execution.
Participate in equipment specification, vendor technical evaluations, pilot equipment selection, engineering reviews, and design decisions.
Clearly distinguish what has been demonstrated, what remains uncertain, and what additional testing is required before design assumptions are frozen.
Understand and support the progression from concept and FEL/design through procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, and steady-state operations.
Remain engaged through engineering, commissioning, and startup to ensure process-development intent is successfully translated into operating equipment.

Techno-Economic & Commercialization Support
Incorporate economic thinking throughout process development rather than treating economics as a downstream activity.
Evaluate process decisions considering recovery, selectivity, reagent consumption, energy demand, throughput, equipment requirements, waste generation, recycle streams, CAPEX, and OPEX implications.
Work with Engineering, Operations, Finance, and leadership to identify the major technical and economic drivers affecting commercial viability.
Help establish technical and economic stage gates for advancing technologies from laboratory development through pilot and commercial scale.
Identify development pathways that may be technically achievable but commercially impractical and recommend alternatives.

Pilot & Operations Support
Support commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of pilot and demonstration equipment.
Ensure lessons learned during pilot operations are captured and incorporated into future process and engineering designs.
Partner with Operations to establish operating windows, critical process parameters, sampling requirements, process controls, and operating procedures.
Support root-cause analysis and technical troubleshooting as technologies transition from development into continuous operation.
Maintain a strong connection between laboratory development and real-world plant operability, maintainability, safety, reliability, and workforce requirements.

Leadership & Organization Development
Manage and develop a multidisciplinary technical organization that may include PhD scientists, metallurgists, chemists, process engineers, laboratory personnel, and technical specialists.
Establish clear priorities, accountability, development objectives, and technical ownership across the team.
Create a culture where technical assumptions are constructively challenged and decisions are driven by data.
Balance scientific exploration with schedule, cost, commercialization priorities, and company objectives.
Develop technical talent and organizational capability as the company progresses from early-stage process development into commercial operations.

Candidate Profile
Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Mineral Processing, Extractive Metallurgy, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
Significant industrial experience across both hydrometallurgy and pyrometallurgy, ideally involving mineral processing, extractive metallurgy, critical minerals, metals refining, recycling, or related process industries.
Demonstrated experience developing and scaling processes from laboratory through pilot and/or commercial operation.
Strong understanding of hydrometallurgical operations such as leaching, precipitation, filtration, solvent extraction, ion exchange, crystallization, and solid/liquid separation.
Strong understanding of pyrometallurgical operations such as reduction, roasting, calcination, furnaces, thermal processing, gas handling, and solids processing.
Demonstrated ability to lead, manage, mentor, and challenge highly technical scientists and PhD-level personnel.
Experience developing process flowsheets, mass balances, design criteria, process-engineering deliverables, and structured technical-development programs.
Working knowledge of capital project development and engineering execution, including stage-gate/FEL processes, project management, equipment specification, vendor engagement, engineering reviews, commissioning, and startup.
Strong understanding of the relationship between process performance and commercial economics.
Demonstrated people-management experience and ability to build high-performing technical teams.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical information into clear recommendations for executive leadership, engineering, operations, and commercial stakeholders.

Join Us

If you’re excited by the idea of advancing sustainable mineral science and want your analytical work to make a measurable impact, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Title: Director of Broadcast Engineering

Requisition ID#: 4801

Location:

Louisville, KY, US, 40208

Property: Churchill Downs Racetrack

Pay Range

Churchill Downs Racetrack (“CDRT”), the world’s most legendary racetrack, has been the home of The Kentucky Derby, the longest continually held annual sporting event in the United States, since 1875. Located in Louisville, CDRT features a series of themed race days during Derby Week, including the Kentucky Oaks, and conducts Thoroughbred horse racing during three race meets in the Spring, September and Fall. CDRT is located on 175 acres and has a one-mile dirt track, a 7/8-mile turf track, a stabling area, and provides seating for approximately 60,000 guests. The stable area has barns sufficient to accommodate 1,400 horses and a 114-room dormitory for backstretch personnel. CDRT also has a year-round simulcast wagering facility . www.ChurchillDowns.com.

Job Summary

The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading all broadcast engineering operations supporting Churchill Downs Racetrack's live racing, television productions, simulcast operations, and special events. This hands-on leadership role oversees the installation, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of broadcast, audio, video, and broadcast IT systems that ensure reliable, high-quality production and venue operations.

Working closely with the Senior Director/Executive Producer, production leadership, operations, and broadcast partners, this position provides technical leadership for live broadcasts, engineering projects, infrastructure upgrades, and day-to-day operations while leading an engineering team in a fast-paced, high-pressure live production environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Broadcast Engineering & Technical Operations

Install, configure, maintain, and support broadcast equipment, videoboard operations, venue audio systems, and broadcast IT infrastructure.
Configure and support Evertz routers, RTS intercom systems, KVM systems, QSC audio systems, Dante audio networks, QAM headend systems, and fiber optic infrastructure.
Support day-to-day broadcast operations, live events, and television productions while ensuring operational readiness and system reliability.
Coordinate frequency management and signal distribution for major live events.

Engineering Leadership & Project Management

Lead and manage the broadcast engineering team while overseeing multiple technical projects and live event operations.
Participate in venue construction and infrastructure projects related to broadcast systems.
Provide overall design feedback for construction and infrastructure projects at appropriate times to ensure alignment with the multi-year lifecycle.
Provide technical leadership and make real-time operational decisions in a high-pressure live production environment.

Governance, Security & Lifecycle Management

Partner closely with Corporate IT, Information Security, and other technology teams to ensure broadcast networks, systems, software, and connected devices meet company security and technology standards.
Maintain accurate system and asset documentation, support security assessments and remediation activities, and actively participate in cross-functional troubleshooting through resolution.
Develop and maintain a multi-year lifecycle and technology roadmap for broadcast, audio, video, network, and supporting software infrastructure.
Proactively identify aging, unsupported, or end-of-life technologies and devices and participate in annual capital planning and budgeting to ensure critical systems are refreshed, upgraded, or replaced before they create operational, security, or reliability risks.

Broadcast Partner Support

Serve as the primary engineering liaison with broadcast partners regarding technical setup and venue requirements.
Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to support successful broadcast operations and live event execution.
Perform other duties as assigned.

REGULATORY

Ability to obtain and maintain a Kentucky racing license and successfully complete all applicable background check requirements.

Required Skills And Abilities

Advanced knowledge of broadcast engineering systems and live production operations.
Strong leadership, project management, process, and engineering team development skills.
Expertise supporting broadcast control room operations and production workflows.
Proficiency with QSC audio systems, Dante audio networking, Evertz routing systems, RTS intercom systems, and KVM infrastructure.
Strong understanding of broadcast IT networks, signal distribution, fiber optic systems, and RF frequency coordination.
Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across Broadcast Engineering, Information Technology, Information Security, Operations, and external partners, including shared ownership of troubleshooting and issue resolution.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and standard engineering documentation software.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree required; 12+ years of relevant broadcast engineering experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
10+ years of engineering management experience supporting broadcast or live production environments.
Demonstrated experience supporting live television broadcasts, studio productions, and major live events.
Experience in a sports venue required; horse racing experience preferred.
Experience with QSC audio systems, Dante networking, broadcast IT systems, fiber optic infrastructure, and venue broadcast operations.
QSC, Dante, Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE), and Fiber Optic certifications preferred.
Experience with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu preferred.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

Ability to lift, move, and install broadcast equipment weighing up to 70 pounds.
Ability to work on ladders, rooftops, elevated platforms, and in confined spaces.
Regular standing, walking, climbing, bending, kneeling, and moving throughout the facility to support engineering operations.
Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, rotating schedules, and extended hours as required to support racing events and live broadcasts.
Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure live production environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Work With Us

Churchill Downs Incorporated is an inclusive and fun place to work. We celebrate unique approaches and points of view. We believe diversity is a mindset that drives excellence. We’re always learning, evolving and growing. We innovate through mutual respect of ideas and collaboration. This allows us to build a common language that inspires our team members and propels us toward the achievement of our vision.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Applied Research
jobs.description:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

This is a people manager role that will lead teams to drive strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well-respected people leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies.
Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF.
An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes.
Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products.
A professional with a track record of coming up with new ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects.
Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with a cross-functional team of scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered platforms and solutions that change how customers interact with their money.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

Basic Qualifications:

PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 6 years of experience in Applied Research or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 8 years of experience in Applied Research
At least 5 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications [choose applicable set based on focus of role]:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related fields
LLM
PhD focus on NLP or Masters with 10 years of industrial NLP research experience
Core contributor to team that has trained a large language model from scratch (10B + parameters, 500B+ tokens)
Numerous publications at ACL, NAACL and EMNLP, Neurips, ICML or ICLR on topics related to the pre-training of large language models (e.g. technical reports of pre-trained LLMs, SSL techniques, model pre-training optimization)
Has worked on an LLM (open source or commercial) that is currently available for use
Demonstrated ability to guide the technical direction of a large-scale model training team
Experience working with 500+ node clusters of GPUs Has worked on LLM scaled to 70B parameters and 1T+ tokens
Experience with common training optimization frameworks (deep speed, nemo)

Behavioral Models
PhD focus on topics in geometric deep learning (Graph Neural Networks, Sequential Models, Multivariate Time Series)
Member of technical leadership for model deployment for a very large user behavior model
Multiple papers on topics relevant to training models on graph and sequential data structures at KDD, ICML, NeurIPs, ICLR
Worked on scaling graph models to greater than 50m nodes Experience with large scale deep learning based recommender systems
Experience with production real-time and streaming environments
Contributions to common open source frameworks (pytorch-geometric, DGL)
Proposed new methods for inference or representation learning on graphs or sequences
Worked datasets with 100m+ users

Optimization (Training & Inference)
PhD focused on topics related to optimizing training of very large language models
5+ years of experience and/or publications on one of the following topics: Model Sparsification, Quantization, Training Parallelism/Partitioning Design, Gradient Checkpointing, Model Compression

Finetuning
PhD focused on topics related to guiding LLMs with further tasks (Supervised Finetuning, Instruction-Tuning, Dialogue-Finetuning, Parameter Tuning)
Demonstrated knowledge of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidance
Experience deploying a fine-tuned large language model

Data Preparation
Numerous Publications studying tokenization, data quality, dataset curation, or labeling
Leading contributions to one or more large open source corpus (1 Trillion + tokens)
Core contributor to open source libraries for data quality, dataset curation, or labeling

We strive to be enterprising, respectful, inclusive, insightful, and tenacious in every aspect of our business, including our interactions with clients, colleagues, and the communities where we have a presence. The Director’s primary responsibility is ensuring that the IT team operates effectively, including providing people, project, and technical leadership. Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The Senior Manager, Infrastructure Engineering
leads a team of engineers responsible for the platforms and systems that power our global engineering organization. This role balances hands-on technical leadership with people management, driving the continued evolution toward cloud-native, containerized, and highly available infrastructure while building a high-performing, engaged team. The Senior Manager partners closely with engineering leadership, product, and cross-functional stakeholders to reduce developer friction, strengthen system reliability and security, and ensure infrastructure investments scale with business growth.

BigCommerce, part of the Commerce brand family, helps merchants increase sales at every stage of their growth. From small startups to mid-market businesses and large enterprises, we provide the leading e-commerce platform. Our customers can then concentrate on what's most important: growing their businesses. We enable our customers to build, innovate, and grow, collectively reshaping the e-commerce industry.

What You’ll Do

All aspects of managing distributed infrastructure and software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

Own execution of the platform and infrastructure roadmap for the team, translating broader infrastructure strategy into concrete quarterly priorities
Lead the team's continued shift toward cloud-native, containerized, and orchestrated environments (e.g., Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code)
Ensure core infrastructure, data, and messaging layers are built and operated to support global scale, performance, and availability targets
Drive developer productivity initiatives that reduce friction and cycle time across build, test, deploy, and observability workflows
Partner with security and platform architecture peers to ensure infrastructure decisions support reliability, availability, and security without sacrificing developer velocity
Manage a team of infrastructure/platform engineers, holding clear ownership of strategic areas of the codebase and technical roadmap

Manage performance, deliver regular and constructive feedback, and set clear goals aligned to business and team objectives
Identify and address talent and skill gaps through hiring, development, and organizational adjustments
Represent engineering needs, constraints, and contributions to product, sales, and other cross-functional partners
May periodically contribute to technical design, architecture review, or hands-on implementation as needed

Who You Are

8+ years of professional infrastructure engineering experience and 5+ years professional software engineering experience including 4+ years directly managing engineers
Proven expertise in cloud-native and platform architecture, including containerization, orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code
Hands-on experience optimizing global performance and security using modern edge and network platforms (e.g., Cloudflare)
Strong systems engineering foundation; able to evaluate system design trade-offs and identify architectural or application weaknesses
Solid UNIX/Linux fundamentals
Experience with backend and/or frontend development in Ruby on Rails, PHP, Python, Golang, Scala, Java, or similar languages

Experience operating within Agile methodologies (Scrum, XP, or Kanban)
Demonstrated ability to influence and align cross-functional and distributed stakeholders across multiple geographies
Excellent written and verbal communicator, comfortable giving direct, constructive feedback at any level of the business
Strong bias for action with a track record of driving complex, ambiguous initiatives from concept through production
Strong emotional intelligence; composed and effective in high-stakes or ambiguous situations
Skilled coach and mentor with a demonstrated commitment to employee development
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Prior experience in infrastructure, platform, or SaaS engineering environments strongly preferred
Track record of on-time, on-budget delivery with satisfied technical and business stakeholders

Work Where You Thrive

For candidates based in the Austin or Atlanta metro area, the position follows a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office, balancing focused individual work with meaningful in-person collaboration.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Design Manager

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India

Experience: Minimum 15 years overall; 7+ years in leadership

Working Days- Monday-Saturday

Employment Type: Full-time

Role summary

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design-for-manufacturability and cost‑efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands-on involvement in complex sheet‑metal product development.

Key accountabilities-

- Team leadership and people management

 - Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters).
 - Establish clear role descriptions, career ladders, KPIs, and individual development plans.
 - Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, succession planning, and calibration with HR and senior leadership.
 - Promote a culture of ownership, continuous learning, safety, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Technical ownership and hands-on design

 - Provide hands-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‑metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings.
 - Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries.
 - Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‑built documentation.

- Product development lifecycle & project leadership

 - Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full-scale production.
 - Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices).
 - Lead cross-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders.

- Manufacturability, cost optimization & supplier engineering

 - Own DFMA for sheet‑metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection.
 - Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead-time management.
 - Drive cost-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume-based sourcing strategies.

- Quality, compliance & reliability

 - Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements.
 - Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective & preventive actions.
 - Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required.

- Process improvement & systems

 - Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management.
 - Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model-based definition (MBD) where applicable.
 - Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

- Stakeholder management & reporting

- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements.
 - Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership.
 - Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings.

Deliverables & success metrics

- Deliverables

 - Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production.
 - DFMEA, tolerance stack-ups, verification & validation plans, prototype test reports.
 - Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials.

Required qualifications & experience (expanded)

- Education:
B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M.Tech/M.S. preferred.
- Experience:
Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‑metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity.
- CAD skills
: Expert-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‑metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent.
- Manufacturing knowledge:
Thorough understanding of sheet‑metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes.
- Systems:
Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions.
- Process skills
: DFMA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development.
- Leadership:
Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience.
- Communication
: Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
- Mobility:
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required).

Preferred / differentiating skills

- Certifications:
CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent.
- Domain experience
: Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense.
- Simulation:
Experience with sheet‑metal forming simulation (e.g., AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization.
- Tooling & fixtures:
Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies.
- Software:
Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar.
- Manufacturing exposure:
Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. What You Will Do As a Director, Customer Engineering

The Director, Customer Engineering is a senior leader who scales the Customer Engineering organization across a region, segment, or product domain. Leads multiple teams of Customer Engineers and their managers, sets the strategic direction for how Cloudflare technically engages with enterprise customers, and ensures the CE function operates as a unified, AI-augmented, high-performance GTM engine.

Reporting to a VP or Senior Leader of Customer Engineering, you will own commercial outcomes, team development, operational systems, and cross-functional execution - serving as the executive bridge between field reality and company strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership: Build, develop, and scale a multi-team CE organization across levels and geographies. Hire and develop front-line managers, create succession plans, and maintain a high bar for both technical and commercial talent.
Commercial Ownership: Own the CE number for your region, segment, or domain. Lead forecasting, pipeline reviews, win/loss analysis, and strategic account planning. Be accountable for new business acquisition, retention, expansion, and platform consumption targets.
GTM Strategy & Execution: Shape how Customer Engineering partners with Sales, Customer Experience, Professional Services, and Product. Define territory and account strategies, allocate coverage models, and ensure the CE function drives platform-led selling.
Executive Coaching & Standards: Elevate the capability of the CE management team. Coach managers on deal strategy, people development, technical architecture review, and executive communication. Set the standard for what great CE leadership looks like.
Operational Scale & AI Enablement: Build the systems, dashboards, and AI-augmented workflows that allow CEs to spend more time on high-value customer work. Champion automation, tooling, and repeatable plays across the organization.
Cross-Functional Influence: Represent Customer Engineering in executive forums, product roadmap discussions, and enablement planning. Translate field signals into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Support, and Marketing.
Customer & Market Presence: Act as an executive technical sponsor for strategic customers and prospects. Serve as a visible leader in industry events, executive business reviews, and executive customer engagements.
Culture & Transformation: Model Cloudflare’s values and drive the cultural evolution into the unified CE operating model. Ensure teams embrace full-lifecycle ownership, AI productivity, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years of experience in technical go-to-market roles with a demonstrated track record of building and managing high-performing teams in SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure companies. Prior experience managing managers and owning revenue targets at scale is required.
Revenue & Commercial Acumen: Proven experience owning and forecasting a large CE or Solutions Engineering revenue number in an enterprise B2B or infrastructure environment. Deep understanding of ACV, renewal, expansion, consumption, and platform economics.
Leadership & Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to inspire, coach, and develop senior managers and senior individual contributors. Comfortable presenting to and influencing C-level executives inside and outside Cloudflare.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to synthesize market signals, customer feedback, and business data into a clear operating plan for a multi-team organization.
Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Capable of representing the CE organization in executive reviews, board-level discussions, and large internal forums.
Technical Fluency: We do not expect directors to be hands-on across every technical domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate fluency in at least two or three of the areas below, with the ability to engage credibly in architecture and commercial conversations:
Internet fundamentals: Strong understanding of DNS, HTTP(S), TCP/IP, BGP, SSL/TLS, and network architecture.
Security: Foundational knowledge of WAF, Bot Management, Zero Trust, SASE, DDoS mitigation, and modern enterprise security posture.
Performance / Networking: Foundational knowledge of caching, latency, content delivery, traffic steering, and global network architecture.
AI & Platform: Familiarity with AI-augmented workflows, LLMs, automation, cloud platforms, edge services, and developer tooling.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

Cloudflare Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Cloudflare’s product portfolio, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, or AI/Workers platform.
Global Scale: Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
Transformation Leadership: Proven track record of leading through organizational change, role redefinition, and operating model evolution.
Executive Customer Engagement: Experience as an executive sponsor for Fortune 500 or strategic accounts.
Operational Rigor: Track record of building dashboards, playbooks, and scalable processes for technical field organizations.

Education:

Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Travel

This role may require travel up to 25–50% to attend customer meetings, executive briefings, team offsites, industry events, and in-person collaboration.

Compensation

This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the CE organization’s performance against new business acquisition, expansion, adoption, and retention targets.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

The company is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. The focus is on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, the organization develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. The work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

The organization is at a pivotal stage of growth as it approaches completion of the first year of its strategic plan. Over the next five years, the intention is to significantly expand reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

The company is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own the end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.

Key Responsibilities

Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance
Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization’s core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.

Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture
Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.

Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance

Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.

Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight

Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.

Who You Are

This individual takes ownership beyond their remit and does not wait for a clean, fully-scoped mandate before moving. About the Opportunity

The company is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. It addresses a significant economic inefficiency: millions of highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing substantial forgone wages and untapped productivity for the economy. The organization's model has proven effective, with jobseekers entering programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and being placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, the organization has supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy. The organization is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. It is committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. The organization operates nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes an American advantage.

This role is responsible for building and leading the organization's technology strategy and infrastructure to support both internal operations and externally facing digital products. This includes staff-facing technology as well as the technical infrastructure that enables jobseeker and partner experiences. This leader partners closely with the CEO, President, and executive leadership to ensure technology is a strategic enabler of the organization's mission, helping the organization transition towards an AI and product-first model while maintaining strong operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. The organization will integrate AI into all aspects to drive operational excellence, improve jobseeker opportunities and outcomes, and this role will help lead these efforts. The VP of Technology is expected to be both strategic and execution-oriented: setting direction, making tradeoffs clear, and delivering consistently across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & AI Infrastructure
Own the organization's technology strategy across staff infrastructure and jobseeker/partner-facing products, ensuring both are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned to mission outcomes.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering staff infrastructure and IT operations, data systems and reporting, Salesforce/platform evolution, core digital products (jobseeker portal, online learning, partner tools), and integrations/interoperability across systems.
Translate organizational strategy into a sequenced plan with clear timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures.
Provide clear tradeoffs and recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team on what to prioritize, defer, or stop based on capacity and impact.
Support sprint planning, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.

Product & Engineering Partnership (Jobseeker + Partner Products)
Partner deeply with Product leadership to deliver a reliable, scalable technology foundation for the organization's jobseeker and partner ecosystem.
Ensure strong cross-functional delivery across product/tech/programs, including planning, prioritization, technical feasibility, timelines, and adoption/change management.

Establish service standards (response times, escalation, documentation, internal communications) and continuously improve the staff technology experience.
Own vendor relationships and contracts across key systems and managed service providers.
Ensure all staff are trained to use the infrastructure and tools, including AI, to maximum effect. Delivery includes accountability to staff usage, ensuring technology is utilized with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.

Systems, Data, and Platform Leadership (Salesforce + Reporting)

Strengthen system usability, adoption, and reliability through clear requirements gathering, prioritization, and iterative improvements.
Own data strategy in partnership with research and evaluation leadership: governance, quality, reporting, and dashboard reliability.
Ensure the organization has trusted reporting that supports program improvement, fundraising narratives, and leadership decision-making.

Lead cross-functional execution so teams experience IT and technology as reliable, transparent, and partnership-driven.
Build a culture of accountability and follow-through within the technology function and across stakeholders.

Security, Risk, and Compliance

Ensure appropriate controls for systems that handle sensitive data.
Maintain risk register and communicate risks and mitigations clearly to the Executive Leadership Team and the Board as needed.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Solvable · Head of Engineering
Full-time · Orange County, CA (Newport Beach / Irvine, in person 3+ days) · Reports to CEO · Target start: November 2026

About Solvable

Solvable is rebuilding how Americans discover, evaluate, and access insurance.
We help consumers lower their auto and home insurance premiums without sacrificing coverage or service. Under the hood, we are building an AI-first marketplace powered by conversational agents, agentic marketing systems, predictive intelligence, and real-time consumer + carrier routing.
We've already helped millions of consumers save money. Now we're scaling aggressively and investing in owned platform, data, and decisioning capability as a core competitive advantage.
Why This Role Now

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to own the platform end to end: the data foundation, the conversion signal infrastructure, the owned consumer runtime, and the models that decide what we ask, show, route, and sell.
Our engineering team is senior and distributed offshore. It is producing real work. What it does not have is an owner in the business's time zone: someone accountable for architecture, delivery, and uptime who is awake when the numbers break and in the room when the decisions get made.
This is not a delivery-management seat.
This is not a role where you set strategy and delegate.

This is a builder's role with a leadership mandate. You'll write production code in your first 30 days, review everyone else's, and be personally accountable for systems that make money every hour. You'll know you're doing it right when the business stops asking which number is correct.

Your Impact

You will own Solvable's engineering function across four core domains.
1. Revenue Truth & The Data Platform

Own the data foundation end to end: ingestion, transformation, governance, lineage, and quality gates on a modern lakehouse
Reconcile spend, leads, routing outcomes, partner results, and gross profit into one source the business acts on
Replace fragmented, manually assembled reporting with governed, explainable, self-serve access
Set and hold the standard for freshness, accuracy, consent handling, and access control across consumer data

2. Measurement Infrastructure

Own the measurement infrastructure, canonical event model, and partner callback capture that carry attribution for every dollar of media spend
Migrate revenue-critical tracking off shared infrastructure without disrupting live revenue, validated in parallel, never big-bang
Make measurement reliable enough that media, finance, and our platform partners all work from the same numbers

3. Owned Runtime & Experimentation Velocity

Own the consumer experience and the monetization services behind it: intake, consent, routing, offer presentation, and partner handoff
Build the instrumentation that lets product run conversion, yield, and lifecycle experiments in parallel, idea to instrumented test in days rather than weeks
Protect uptime and latency on revenue-critical paths

4. Decisioning, ML & The Team

Sequence and build the intelligence layer: lead quality scoring, expected-value routing, and bind probability, trained on our own outcome data
Lead, mentor, and hold the technical bar for a senior distributed team across full-stack, data, and infrastructure
Own hiring, ramp, operating cadence, and capacity planning, including the US engineering roles that follow this one
Answer the question we ask of every role at Solvable: why can't a system do this?

Responsibilities

Set architecture and make the calls, then stay close enough to ship. You will be in the codebase.
Run delivery: sprint cadence, spec quality, and a forecast leadership trusts
Serve as the senior technical resource and daily escalation point for a distributed team several hours ahead
Own CI/CD, observability, role-based access, PII and consent handling, and auditability
Work directly with platform and data partners on integrations, requirements, and technical negotiation
Report to the CEO and present progress against gates to the board

What We're Looking For

Experience & Track Record

8+ years building software, 3+ leading engineering teams that shipped revenue-critical systems
You have personally owned a production data pipeline the business bet revenue on, and you know what it feels like when finance finds the error before you do
You have migrated off shared or partner infrastructure without breaking revenue
You have shipped production ML that changed an operational decision. Not dashboards, not research.
You have led engineers across a time-zone gap and you have a real method for it, not just good intentions

Technical Fluency (Non-Negotiable)

Hands-on with our stack or close equivalents: AWS (Fargate, Kinesis, Glue, Redshift), Python, TypeScript/Node, modern data tooling (dbt, Iceberg or equivalent lakehouse patterns), event-driven architecture
You have written production code in the last six months
AI-native. You use AI tooling to collapse execution cost and you expect the same from your team.
You think in tradeoffs and can defend an architecture decision on cost, risk, and time to revenue

Fit

You thrive in ambiguity and would rather define the plan than receive it
Performance marketing, lead generation, insurtech, or ad-tech experience is a strong plus. If you don't have it, you'll be fluent in CPL, RPL, ROAS, and attribution within your first month.
Based in Orange County or committed to relocating. This role exists because the business needs its engineering owner in the same time zone and the same building. Regular in-person time is the job, not a preference.

Compensation

Base salary is $210,000 to $250,000, and we anchor mid-market on cash so we can pay the difference in scope and equity. The package also includes an annual performance bonus gated on a year-end scorecard and an equity grant vesting over four years with a one-year cliff, which is where the real upside sits.

Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30 · Take the reins.
Own the delivery board, sprint cadence, and a forecast leadership trusts. Classify every route through our current tracking infrastructure: analytical, routing, monetization, and callback. Inventory source systems, owners, and access boundaries. One-on-ones with every engineer and with the media, product, and creative leads. Ship something small to production in week two.
Days 31–60 · Make the numbers true.
Daily reporting live with visible freshness and discrepancy states, validated against the incumbent path. Canonical event model implemented for revenue-critical flows. You are the engineering team's daily escalation point and the delivery path runs through you. Deliver your written read on team structure and what the org needs next.
Days 61–90 · Prove it.
Conversion signal fully owned and accepted by media and finance, with the legacy path decommissioned or on a dated plan. All new work shipping on our own CI/CD. First expected-value or lead-quality model specified against real outcome data. Next-year engineering capacity plan delivered, with the AI-leverage case for every proposed role.
How We Hire

Our process is built around live work, not rehearsed answers. Expect a real diagnostic exercise with no prep time, a system design conversation on a problem we are actually solving, a scenario walkthrough under time pressure, an onsite in Newport Beach, and backchannel references. It is demanding on purpose, and it is the same standard we hold ourselves to.

Solvable is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation ranges are good-faith estimates for Southern California and final offers depend on experience and scope.

At Anantara Grand Hotel Krasnapolsky Amsterdam, we’re looking for a Maintenance Manager who combines technical expertise with strong leadership — ensuring our iconic hotel remains in outstanding condition for both guests and team members.

Why you’ll love your journey with us

A competitive salary
based on Horeca CLA scale 10 and your experience and expertise.
An end-of-year bonus
equal to at least 75% of a gross monthly salary — a rare gem in the hotel industry.
Global team member rates
at over 560 Minor Hotels.
Friends & Family rates
to treat your loved ones worldwide.
50% savings on F&B
at 20 luxury hotels across Amsterdam.
A complimentary experience
stay to immerse yourself in the Anantara guest journey.
Free online & offline training
organized by our own Minor Hotels University.
Management development
programs to support your growth and career ambitions.
Health & lifestyle perks
including collective insurance, gym memberships, bike plans and more.

Your role in the journey

As Maintenance Manager
, you will lead the hotel’s technical operations, ensuring maintenance plans, safety procedures and projects are executed efficiently and effectively. You will act as a trusted advisor to the General Manager and take the lead on major projects, from renovations and refurbishments to equipment replacement and facility improvements.

Your responsibilities include:

Leading large-scale technical projects, including renovations, conversions and equipment replacements.
Managing and monitoring maintenance plans, priorities and budgets.
Coordinating quotations, suppliers, contractors and project proposals.
Creating work schedules, assigning tasks and guiding the Engineering team.
Managing external service providers for specialist maintenance and repairs.
Ensuring compliance with all technical, legal and safety requirements.
Maintaining certifications and inspections, including lifts, fire safety systems and other critical installations.
Monitoring the technical condition of facilities and planning preventive maintenance activities.
Developing project proposals covering timelines, budgets, quality standards and operational impact.
Maintaining environmental, energy and technical reports and documentation.
Ensuring the highest standards of safety for both guests and employees throughout the hotel.

What you’ll bring

A completed technical education.
At least 5 years of leadership experience within a technical department, preferably in a luxury or 5-star hotel environment.
Experience with maintenance management in hospitality, retail or a similar service-driven industry.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
A proactive, hands-on mentality and the ability to solve problems practically and efficiently.
A strong sense of responsibility for safety, compliance and quality standards.
The ability to remain calm under pressure and find effective solutions in demanding situations.
Excellent technical knowledge of installations, maintenance processes and building systems.
Strong communication skills in English; Dutch is a plus.
An entrepreneurial mindset with the confidence to take ownership and drive improvements.

Where your journey begins

In the heart of Amsterdam, overlooking the Royal Palace and National Monument,
Anantara Grand Hotel Krasnapolsky Amsterdam blends timeless elegance with modern flair. With 402 stylish rooms, over 2,000 square meters of meeting space, and a serene Spa & Wellness center, our hotel is a destination in itself.

Guests indulge in Michelin-starred dining at The White Room, sip signature cocktails at The Tailor, and enjoy the historic charm of Grand Café Krasnapolsky. The iconic Wintergarden
— dating back to 1880

jobs.title: Research Director
jobs.description:
【募集の背景、プロジェクトの説明】

Third Intelligenceでは、現在主流となっているTransformerアーキテクチャに留まらない、次世代のAIアルゴリズムの研究開発に取り組んでいます。
これらの研究成果を、自社サービスとして社会に実装することを見据え、「遍在型AGI」というコンセプトのもと、研究開発体制の強化を進めています。

2026年1月に完了した初回の資金調達ラウンドでは、研究開発および人材・計算機資源への投資を目的とした100億円の資金調達を実施しました。
また、共同創業者 兼 Chief Scientistとして松尾豊教授が参画しており、松尾研究所からカーブアウトした企業として、研究資産や知見を活用しながら事業を推進しています。

AI研究開発組織において、組織面の責任者として遍在型AGIの社会実装を推進するResearch Directorを募集します。研究者としての専門性を持ちつつ、組織マネジメント、採用活動、対外発信などを通じてAI研究開発組織の体制を強化していただきます。

【仕事内容】

当社のAI研究開発組織において、組織面の責任者として遍在型AGIの社会実装を推進するポジションです。研究者としての専門性を持ちつつ、組織マネジメント、採用活動、対外発信などを通じてAI研究開発組織の体制を強化していただきます。Research ScientistやResearch Engineerが成果を出せる環境を整備し、世界最先端の研究成果を生み出す組織を構築することがミッションです。

※現在海外にご在住の場合、日本への移住サポートも行わせていただきます。

■業務イメージ

研究者として自らも手を動かし、研究開発に従事
研究組織のビジョン策定や、それを実現するための採用戦略をTalent Acquisitionと連携しながら立案・実行
Research ScientistやResearch Engineerのピープルマネジメント、評価制度の構築、およびキャリア成長の支援
研究成果をプロダクト価値に転換するための、研究開発優先順位の意思決定とリソース配分
学会やメディア、SNSを通じた積極的なエバンジェリスト活動による、技術的プレゼンスの向上

【応募資格（必須・歓迎）】

■必須

基盤モデルを開発・運用した経験、または音声対話、マルチモーダル、外部公開システムなど、関連領域でのAIシステムのEnd-to-End構築経験
Transformerに関する一定程度以上の知見
Python, PyTorch, Distributed Training Frameworks (DeepSpeed, FSDPなど) の深い知識
深層学習や自然言語処理、LLM等の領域における、修士・博士号取得、またはそれに準ずる高度な研究実績
研究開発チームをリードし、プロジェクトを成功に導いた経験、またはエンジニアリングマネジメント経験
複雑な技術理論を、ビジネスサイドや外部のステークホルダーへ魅力的に伝える高いコミュニケーション能力
ネイティブ/マルチリンガルレベルの日本語会話能力

■歓迎

フロンティアモデルの開発・運用実績
英語による技術議論およびグローバルな開発体制における業務経験
国際的な技術コミュニティでの活動や、英語による高度な技術交渉およびドキュメンテーション能力
BigTech水準のHPCインフラストラクチャを、最高のパフォーマンスで利用するための最適化能力
C++/CUDAなどの低レイヤー言語を用いた計算グラフ最適化、またはAIアクセラレータ(ASIC など)に関する専門的な知識
10名以上の研究組織や開発チームの立ち上げ、および拡大をリードした経験
研究開発組織において採用をリードし組織のスケールを実現した経験
特許戦略の立案や、研究成果を事業に紐づけるための技術ロードマップの作成経験

【ポジションの魅力】

潤沢な研究開発資金と、AI研究の第一線で活躍する優秀なメンバーとともに、次世代のAI研究組織の構築を主導できます。
自らも研究者としての専門性を活かしながら、組織マネジメントや採用戦略の立案・実行を通じて、研究開発組織の成長に直接貢献できます。

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Application, Cloud and Offensive Security
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Director of Engineering for the Application, Cloud and Offensive security teams in the Security Engineering organization. Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud powering enterprises worldwide to store, process, and build intelligent applications on their most sensitive data. As AI has become more deeply embedded in what Snowflake and its customers do, the threat landscape has evolved at the same pace. This Director role was created directly in response to that convergence: a wide mandate with real influence across three security pillars and the visibility to shape how one of the most consequential technology platforms in the world stays ahead of emerging threats.

AS A DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Define and execute the security strategy across three core pillars: application security, cloud security assurance, and offensive security (including the red team program), setting direction and driving measurable outcomes across all three pillars.
Build and develop a high-performing security engineering organization, hiring top talent and creating a culture of rigor, ownership, and continuous improvement
Drive the offensive security program including red team operations, adversarial simulations, and proactive threat modeling to stay ahead of emerging attack vectors in an AI-accelerated threat landscape
Partner closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure leadership to embed security into Snowflake's AI products and cloud architecture from the ground up, not as an afterthought
Own the cloud security assurance function, ensuring Snowflake's cloud environment meets the security standards expected by enterprise customers and regulators worldwide
Translate security risk into business impact, communicating program status, emerging threats, and strategic priorities to executive stakeholders with clarity and confidence
Influence company-wide security posture through cross-functional collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and the broader CISO organization

OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SECURITY WILL HAVE:

12+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, with significant tenure in leadership roles overseeing multi-domain security programs (or equivalent experience)
Deep expertise across at least two of the three pillars: application security, cloud security, or offensive security, with working knowledge across all three
Proven track record building and scaling high-performing security engineering teams in a fast-paced enterprise technology environment
Strong command of cloud security architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud-native security controls, identity, and infrastructure security
Experience leading or overseeing a red team or offensive security program, with a clear understanding of adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
Exceptional ability to partner with product and engineering organizations, influencing secure-by-design practices and embedding security without creating velocity drag
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

Experience securing AI/ML workloads, large language model infrastructure, or AI-adjacent attack surfaces
Familiarity with security for multi-tenant cloud data platforms at enterprise scale
Industry certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, GREM, or equivalent
Contributions to industry security research, conference presentations, or open-source security tooling

WHY JOIN OUR SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Snowflake's security team sits at the intersection of two of the most consequential forces in enterprise technology: AI adoption at scale and the rapidly evolving threat landscape that comes with it. As the platform enterprises worldwide trust with their most sensitive data, Snowflake's security posture is a competitive advantage, not just a compliance checkbox. That framing changes what this team gets to do and the resources it gets to work with.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

The estimated base salary range for this role is $304,000 - $437,000.
Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS POSITION IS LOCATED IN SALINE, MI

About The Business

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for enterprises as a diverse team of creators and inventors. We operate with the speed and attitude of a start-up, combined with the scale and customer focus of one of the world's leading enterprise technology companies.

As OCI continues to expand its cloud and AI infrastructure footprint, the scale and complexity of our data center operations are increasing significantly. We are looking for an exceptional operations leader to build and lead the operating model required to support this growth across one of our large north America data center sites. This position will build and lead an organization of approximately 250 people

Responsibilities

Own and lead large-scale data center operations across one of Oracle's North America 'Go Big' sites, spanning deployment and ongoing production operations.
Build the operating model, systems, processes, and organizational capabilities required to run an increasingly large and complex data center footprint.
Create a highly scalable operations environment where growth is enabled through better systems, automation, processes, tooling, and operating mechanisms - not simply through incremental headcount.
Establish operating mechanisms that improve throughput, productivity, quality, reliability, and speed across the organization.
Oversee technician organizations responsible for hardware deployment, break/fix activities, GPU rack installation, compute infrastructure connectivity, and customer deployment.
Develop and drive the NPI process strategy, ensuring new infrastructure products, technologies, and deployment models can be introduced consistently and at scale.
Establish world-class spare parts and inventory management capabilities that ensure required hardware is available where and when it is needed without creating unnecessary operational cost or complexity.
Apply a strong software and automation mindset to data center operations, identifying opportunities to remove manual work, automate repeatable processes, and use systems and data to drive better operational decisions.
Partner closely with engineering, infrastructure, supply chain, construction, deployment, capacity planning, and other cross-functional organizations to improve the end-to-end data center lifecycle.
Develop the leadership bench and organizational capabilities required to support Oracle's continued infrastructure growth.

Significant experience leading large-scale, people-intensive operations in data centers, cloud infrastructure, fulfillment, logistics, manufacturing, or another highly complex operational environment.
Proven experience operating at hyperscale and building systems that allow organizations to grow significantly without increasing headcount proportionally.
Demonstrated ability to design operating models that manage work, capacity, throughput, productivity, quality, and performance systematically rather than relying primarily on organizational hierarchy or additional staffing.
A strong systems and software mindset, with a track record of using automation, tooling, data, and process engineering to improve operational performance.
Deep experience building repeatable operating mechanisms and scalable processes across multiple sites or large distributed organizations.
Strong understanding of data center hardware operations, including hardware deployment, break/fix, compute infrastructure, GPU rack deployment, inventory, spare parts, and repair operations.
