jobs.description:
We’re a well-funded start-up
. You’ll get a chance to wear many hats, be a part of a growing team, and have the potential for exciting financial and career growth.

Here’s what sets us apart.
We’ve set our sights on some of the biggest challenges facing biology today. We’re amassing a world class team of engineers, scientists, team builders and problem solvers to tackle these challenges heads-on. We’re passionate about developing the next generation technologies that will unravel the complexities of biology.

This is a unique opportunity to build,
be part of an exciting start-up and be surrounded by good humans who are super capable, humble and down-to- earth.

We are seeking a hands-on leader for our Head of Systems Engineering
to own the system architecture, technical budgets, and system-level verification and validation for the R3200 instrument platform, from current production configurations through the next generation architecture. This role reports to the SVP of Product Development and is a member of the Product Development leadership team. The person in this seat will define how the discipline operates, expands the team that runs it, and be accountable for whether our platforms meets their specifications and whether those specifications reflect what customers actually need.

Essential Duties include but are not limited to the following:

Create and own system models, define technical budgets, and use these tools to guide system and sub-system architecture decisions and manage tradeoffs.
Develop and implement system and subsystem level interfaces, test strategies and plans.
Drive fundamental understanding of complex systems which bring together hardware, consumables, chemistry, complex assays, analysis, bioinformatics, and cell biology.
Leverage insights of system fundamentals to improve performance, and to architect next generation systems.
Own system-level verification and validation strategy, including protocol definition, execution oversight, and the supporting documentation that carries the platform through phase-gate reviews.
Drive design transfer to manufacturing, partnering with Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to move systems from prototype through pilot builds to volume production, including process capability and yield improvement.
Partner with technical leaders and executive leadership to prioritize R&D initiatives and guide product roadmaps.
Hold make versus buy authority for subsystem development. Select and manage external design houses and specialty suppliers.
Define statements of work, technical acceptance criteria, and milestone structures for third party development. Approve or reject deliverable acceptance.
Own the bill of materials cost target from the systems side and drive the cost reduction roadmap with Operations and Supply Chain through component consolidation, tolerance relaxation where the error budget allows, and design simplification.
Own the system requirements architecture: the hierarchy from user needs through system, subsystem, and component requirements, with traceability maintained from each requirement to its verification evidence.
Own system-level risk management: system FMEA, hazard analysis, and the traceable link from identified risk through mitigation and verification to residual risk acceptance.
Establish design review cadence and standards, and enforce them across hardware, consumables, assay, software, and analysis contributions to the system.
Define and publish the systems engineering metrics that feed PDP stage gate reviews: requirement stability over time, verification coverage and first-pass rate, open system-level issues by severity, and specification margin at design freeze.
Set and own reliability targets (MTBF, uptime, mean time to repair) and the reliability growth plan to reach them: accelerated life testing, HALT and HASS where warranted, duty cycle definition, and wear-out characterization of consumable-contacting components.
Own the system-level failure mode catalog. Drive root cause analysis and corrective action for field failures with Service and Quality, and close the loop back into design.
Own the system-level control strategy that holds performance in specification across instruments, consumable lots, and time: calibration scheme, reference standards, drift monitoring, and the acceptance criteria for instrument release and periodic requalification.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of working time away from work location, including overnight/weekend, and/or international travel at time.

Minimum Qualifications

Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or Optical), Bio-engineering, Physics, or Biophysics.
Typically requires a minimum of 20 years of progressive experience in engineering, with 12+ years of leadership experience.
Proven history of key contributions to successful products from early stage to product launch and support of on-market products.
Advanced project management and phase gate development understanding and capability.
Working knowledge of quantitative design and process tools, including (p)FMEA, tolerance analysis, design of experiments (DoE), statistical process control (SPC), GR&R, and Cpk.
Demonstrated experience developing requirements and specifications and architecting complex scientific systems.
Strong communication skills and excellent attention to detail.
Experience with scientific computing tools (e.g. Python, R, Matlab).
Demonstrated ability to perform the Essential Duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD preferred.
Familiarity with optical, electrical, mechanical, and fluidics design and corresponding software.
Familiarity with molecular biology or cell biology.
Experience working under a formal design control or quality management system (ISO 13485, IEC 62304, or FDA 21 CFR 820).
Significant experience managing third party development and contract manufacturers.
Hands on experience with design software (SolidWorks, Zemax, OnShape, ePDM) is a plus.

jobs.title: Global Head of Child Safety - Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

TikTok's Global Child Safety Team (CST) serves as subject matter experts on the assessment and reporting of suspected child sexual exploitation happening on platform. Committed to keeping TikTok a safe and creative space for users of all ages, CST operates in a follow-the-sun model, providing daily coverage, reviewing incoming incidents and when appropriate, reporting those incidents to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children's (NCMEC) CyberTipline. From there, these reports are forwarded on to global law enforcement to support their investigations.

As the Global Head of Child Safety Operations within the Trust & Safety Team, you’ll be leading of a global team that ensures the timely detection and removal of content across the broad spectrum of online child endangerment, such as child sexual abuse and exploitation. Through close partnerships with Legal, Policy, and Product & Process teams, you will manage global time-sensitive escalations, and child sexual exploitation and abuse incidents to protect our online community.

You will also work closely with internal teams to create and streamline business and operational processes, and increase our overall operational efficiency and child safety investigative capabilities to ensure our products are free of any violative content.

The team is seeking an experienced leader with excellent judgment, exceptional partnering skills and a passion for protecting children.

Responsibilities:
- You will lead a team of Child Safety Leads and Specialists, ensuring daily operational effectiveness, set goals for the team, and be responsible for their wellness.
- You'll coach/mentor team members and devise development plans for their professional development.
- You'll lead and manage escalations of child safety requests, including from law enforcement, liaising with Legal, Policy, Product, Government Relations and Law Enforcement Operations colleagues whenever necessary.
- You'll identify risks and issues across the business and create programs and processes to solve them proactively. Establish regular reporting to keep stakeholders up to date on progress, findings and recommendations.
- You'll manage multiple projects of moderate-to-high complexity and scope. Work cross-functionally to ensure coordination and alignment on objectives and key results.
- You'll enhance our operational workflows via process improvements and identification of automation opportunities. Drive innovation regarding processes and best practices for implementing policies.
- You'll represent TikTok as a senior public-facing voice on our safeguarding and reporting mechanisms for child safety exploitation and abuse material, including participation in external forums with child protection organisations
- You'll keep abreast and evaluate the impact of global legislative, regulatory and legal developments related to the handling and reporting of child safety material.
- You'll define and implement a long-term strategy to deal with hiring and volume growth to continue to meet goals in this area for TikTok.
- You'll set, interpret performance metrics with the goal of impacting organizational change as a result.
- You'll address sensitive content issues, including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other objectionable material.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s):
- You have at least 5+ years of experience working with Trust and Safety issues with an emphasis on child safety, including online abuse.
- You have at least 5+ years of management experience leading operational and cross regional teams.
- You have experience in handling Law Enforcement Child Safety investigations and engaging with Law Enforcement.
- You have experience in reviewing or being exposed to sensitive content as a part of removal flows calibrations and escalations management.
- You have experience in managing multiple projects and devising team strategies.
- You have the ability to work successfully in cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders, and executives.
- You have excellent verbal and written communication, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Experience representing a company externally on safety issues with a range of government stakeholders and regulators

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

jobs.title: Sr. Director- Data, Models, and AI Risk Management | Retail Bank
jobs.description:
As a Senior Director in Capital One’s Retail Bank Division, you will apply your data risk management and technology expertise to the company’s Technology and Product organization. You will partner across Enterprise teams, Second Line of defense, and Technology teams to develop and support best-in-class industry risk identification and mitigation solutions in a manner that supports innovation and protects our customers, shareholders and associates. Collaboration with various teams will entail implementation of risk and control tools, techniques, and frameworks for the Retail Bank organization, as well as provide risk advisory services to the first line control owners. Your contributions will drive organizational change through effective and proactive risk identification, measurement, analysis and reporting in order to better manage the company’s risk in an open and collaborative environment.

This highly collaborative role will work with various stakeholders to deliver value-added risk management services to the stakeholders. You will have a high level of exposure across lines of business and have the opportunity to work with senior Tech and Business executives to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential risks to the Company. Proficiency in best in class critical thinking and a growth mindset is a must for this role. This individual will provide thought leadership on day to day data management processes and also provide broader thought leadership on how AI is shaping numerous other risk areas from Tech Risk to Third party risk. This individual will be responsible for building and enhancing existing risk management processes and framework to ensure that risk management is keeping pace with emerging risks.. The successful candidate will be a professional who understands various risk frameworks, control environments, technology functions, and organizations, with strong analytical, planning, strategic thinking, organizational and first rate communication skills. This role will report to the Head of Tech, Cyber, and Data Risk within the Retail Bank.

Responsibilities:

Provide departmental oversight and serve as a Subject Matter Expert regarding the evolution of AI risk across diverse control domains.
Keep pace with the speed of AI. Identify and implement continual program enhancements based on industry standards and best practices related to data and AI risk management
Partner with Retail Bank Tech and Business teams to assess their compliance with the divisional and enterprise data and model management requirements
Partner with the Managing data steward team to build a strategic point of view on evolution of data risk. Build and maintain risk oversight processes across key data risk areas including but not limited to data quality, data lineage and traceability, data transformation, and data usage in LLM and AI
Apply a solid understanding of control environments to proactively mitigate risks. Influence control owners and other stakeholders to build consensus on risk mitigation and remediation strategies including new risks that may be introduced with the use of AI
Actively engage in AI usage across the LOB across the full lifecycle including design, development, testing, deployment, post deployment monitoring. Provide thought leadership on building proactive risk management techniques.
Deliver clear and decision oriented report to key stakeholders and senior management on data and AI risk highlighting key issues, with proposed mitigations
Build a high performing Data and AI risk team by hiring and developing talent, fostering a culture of growth mindset and continuous learning, and establishing clear risk ownership across the function.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
At least 10 years experience in Technology Risk, Data Risk or Model Risk
At least 8 years of People Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

10+ years of People Management experience

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, API Developer Platform
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
The TikTok Marketing API team is responsible for building and managing the foundational programmatic infrastructure for TikTok’s advertising ecosystem, while enabling next-generation AI-native marketing workflows.
Our scope includes Marketing APIs, Organic APIs, Business Messaging APIs, developer platforms, SDKs, CLI tooling, MCP and agentic integrations, AI ecosystem enablement, and technology partner and agency co-development. We build the products and platform capabilities that allow developers, partners, agencies, and AI agents to programmatically create, manage, optimize, and scale advertising workflows on TikTok.

About the role
As a Senior Product Manager, AI Developer Platform, you will own key developer-facing platform products that power TikTok’s API and AI-native advertising ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of developer platforms, advertising technology, AI tooling, and partner ecosystems.

You will be responsible for defining and building products that help developers and partners integrate with TikTok more effectively, including APIs, SDKs, CLI workflows, MCP tooling, agentic enablement, documentation systems, developer experience improvements, and platform infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, product, product marketing, developer relations, partnerships, sales, and external technology partners to identify developer pain points, define product requirements, and ship scalable platform capabilities.
This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly between product strategy and technical detail: someone who understands developer needs, can reason about API design and integration patterns, has strong judgment on AI-native workflows, and can translate market and partner signals into a clear product roadmap.

Responsibilities:
- Define and own the product roadmap for AI developer platform capabilities across APIs, SDKs, CLI tooling, MCP integrations, agentic workflows, documentation, and developer experience.
- Partner closely with engineering to design and ship scalable developer-facing products, including API capabilities, authentication flows, tooling, schemas, validation systems, sandbox environments, observability, and integration support infrastructure.
- Deeply understand the needs of developers, technology partners, agencies, advertisers, and emerging AI agent ecosystems; translate those needs into clear product requirements and platform priorities.
- Evaluate how AI-native workflows, MCP/tool-calling standards, agent frameworks, and developer tooling trends should influence TikTok’s API and platform strategy.
- Drive product discovery across external partners and internal teams, including opportunity sizing, competitive analysis, workflow research, technical feasibility assessment, and developer feedback synthesis.
- Collaborate with partner-facing teams to identify integration pain points, product gaps, adoption blockers, and opportunities to make TikTok’s platform easier for developers and AI agents to use.
- Define success metrics for developer platform products, including adoption, integration quality, time to first successful call, developer satisfaction, API usage, feature adoption, error reduction, and partner business impact.
- Work across TikTok’s API surfaces, including Marketing APIs, Organic APIs, Business Messaging APIs, and emerging AI/agentic product capabilities.
- Align with senior leadership on product vision, platform priorities, investment tradeoffs, and long-term AI ecosystem strategy.
- Create clear product narratives, requirements documents, launch plans, and internal/external enablement materials to drive alignment and adoption.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 5 years or more of product management or closely related experience in developer platforms, API products, SaaS platforms, advertising technology, AI products, or enterprise software.
- Experience owning technical products such as APIs, SDKs, developer tools, platform infrastructure, integrations, automation products, or workflow systems.
- Strong technical fluency with APIs, authentication, request/response structures, webhooks, integration patterns, developer workflows, and system interactions.
- Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous developer, partner, or market needs into clear product strategy, requirements, roadmap priorities, and measurable outcomes.
- Strong analytical and business judgment; comfortable using data, metrics, developer feedback, partner insights, and market signals to make product decisions.
- Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product marketing, partnerships, sales, developer relations, operations, and external technology partners.
- Ability to communicate complex technical and strategic topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience building or managing AI-native developer platforms, agent tooling, MCP servers/tools, AI workflow products, LLM-integrated applications, or developer tools for AI agents.
- Experience with advertising APIs, marketing technology platforms, commerce platforms, or partner ecosystem products.
- Familiarity with AI application stacks, including LLMs, tool calling, agents, MCP, RAG, evaluation, prompt/tool design, workflow orchestration, and AI-assisted developer experiences.
- Experience with developer experience products such as SDKs, CLIs, docs platforms, sandboxes, debugging tools, schema validation, sample apps, or integration testing frameworks.
- Experience working with external developers, agencies, technology partners, or enterprise customers on technical integrations.
- Strong product sense for platform design, including balancing flexibility, usability, reliability, scalability, governance, and ecosystem growth.

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

Job Information

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $185600 - $374000 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to help build and scale engineering teams responsible for a new, cloud-native Stop Loss platform. This leader will be accountable for developing high-performing engineering teams, establishing strong technical and delivery practices, and partnering closely with Product, Architecture, business stakeholders, and external delivery partners.

The Senior Engineering Manager will lead engineers through the full software development lifecycle while helping teams translate business capabilities and architectural direction into well-designed, production-ready software. This role requires a leader who can operate effectively in a complex, fast-moving environment while creating the structure, clarity, and technical discipline teams need to deliver sustainably.

What You Will Do

Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams for a cloud-native Stop Loss platform.
Drive engineering execution and delivery for key platform capabilities.
Partner with Product, Architecture, and business stakeholders to turn business needs into technical solutions.
Guide teams through the full software development lifecycle, from design through production support.
Influence architectural decisions and ensure teams execute against agreed technical direction.
Create clear team structures, operating rhythms, ownership models, and delivery transparency.
Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and cross-functional coordination challenges.
Use metrics and delivery insights to improve predictability, quality, and team performance.
Lead across a blended delivery model of employees, contractors, and onshore/offshore vendor teams.
Manage vendor relationships, performance, delivery outcomes, and accountability.
Partner with vendors on staffing, onboarding, planning, and execution while maintaining ownership of engineering decisions.
Help scale the organization through recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and team growth.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and sustainable delivery.

An experienced engineering leader with a track record of building and scaling successful software engineering teams.
Skilled at leading complex, distributed teams that include employees, contractors, and vendor partners.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments with ambiguity and changing priorities.
Strong in both people leadership and technical leadership.
Able to translate strategic objectives into clear, executable plans and measurable outcomes.
Experienced partnering with Product, Architecture, and business leaders to deliver customer and business value.
Knowledgeable in modern cloud-native software development practices and engineering excellence.
Data-driven, using metrics and engineering signals to improve team effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
Confident challenging assumptions, plans, and technical approaches when needed.
Strong communicator who builds alignment across teams, stakeholders, and external partners.
Passionate about coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers and future leaders.

Director, Salesforce Platform Strategy and Delivery

Location:
Remote, United States
Time-zone preference:
Eastern or Central
Employment:
Full-time
No visa sponsorship - USA based only - no third parties

I’m recruiting a hands-on Director of Salesforce Platform Strategy and Delivery for my client, an established enterprise software company entering a significant period of commercial and operational transformation.

Salesforce is central to the business and connected to numerous teams, processes, and applications. The company has a mature environment, a substantial backlog, meaningful technical debt, growing integration demand, and several major business initiatives competing for limited platform capacity.

This role will bring structure to that environment while helping the team deliver. It is not a position for someone who wants to sit above the work, attend steering meetings, and delegate execution. The director must be willing and able to participate directly in triage, requirements, backlog management, solution decisions, QA, UAT, releases, deployments, troubleshooting, documentation, and platform improvement.

The Opportunity

The company has capable Salesforce professionals and is adding both leadership and engineering capacity. What it needs now is a single platform leader who can connect business priorities to disciplined execution.
You will be expected to:
Own the Salesforce roadmap and platform operating model.
Control intake, triage, qualification, prioritization, and escalation.
Turn a large and varied backlog into a sequenced, actionable body of work.
Balance urgent business demand with maintenance, platform reliability, and technical-debt remediation.
Establish predictable QA, UAT, release, deployment, and production-validation practices.
Work hands-on with administrators, developers, business users, and leadership.
Help clarify requirements and acceptance criteria before work begins.
Evaluate Flow, Apex, integrations, managed packages, and configuration decisions.

Vice President, Engineering

Toronto or RemoteFull-time

TL;DR

Company: Sensei Labs
Product: Conductor — the AI-powered operating system for strategic programs
Reports to: CTO
Team: 7 direct reports (4 software engineers, 2 quality engineers, and the Platform/DevOps team)
Partnering closely: 2-person Product team and 4-person GTM team
Location: [Toronto / remote]

About Us

Sensei Labs builds Conductor, an enterprise strategy execution platform that governs billions of dollars in program value across hundreds of enterprise programs. Our customers are Fortune 500 transformation offices, global consultancies, and private equity value creation teams. Conductor covers the full lifecycle from portfolio planning through benefits realization, with our Harmony AI layer woven into every surface rather than bolted on.

We've been in the market for more than ten years, we're SOC-2 compliant with a single-tenant architecture, and we do all of it with a deliberately small team. That's the interesting part of this job.

We launched a full rewrite of our Conductor platform a few months ago and are midway through the effort to reach Conductor Modern. Over the next year (or so), this will give us the chance to migrate all our customers and partners to the new version and sunset our old code.

The role

You'll own engineering execution for Conductor: how the team is structured, how work gets from idea to production, and how quickly and reliably we ship. You'll drive the technical strategy and architecture direction, and you'll own the machine that turns that direction into shipped software.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a role that manages managers. With six engineers, you'll be in the code, in the reviews, and in the architecture discussions — while also being the person accountable for delivery, hiring, growth, and the team's day-to-day health. If you want a position where you can both set long-term strategy and have immediate day-to-day impact, this is the seat.

As part of our modernization, you’ll be directly involved in any remaining architectural and technical decisions for Conductor Modern and be a key part of planning for the customer migration and the ultimate sunsetting of the existing codebase.

This is the third leg of the Sensei Labs stool, along with our established Product and GTM leaders. You’ll work closely with them to shape and implement Product’s vision and to enable our GTM team to sell and deliver value to our customers and partners.

What You'll Own

Delivery. Planning, sequencing, and shipping against a roadmap you help build with Product. Predictable releases, visible progress, honest tradeoffs.
The team. Coaching and growing six engineers, running performance and career conversations, hiring as we scale, and keeping the bar high without burning people out.
Cloud platform and reliability. Architecture, scalability, cost, and operational excellence for a single-tenant enterprise SaaS platform. Uptime, performance, and security posture are yours. You'll lead our Platform/DevOps team alongside product engineering, setting direction for infrastructure and application architecture, performance and scalability, cloud cost management, and the tooling that the rest of engineering builds on. Uptime, operational excellence, and security posture are yours.
AI in the product. Partnering with Product on how Harmony AI evolves — agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and permission-aware AI behavior in an enterprise context.
AI in how we build. Making our SDLC substantially faster and more automated: AI-assisted coding, code review, and test generation; CI/CD; automated quality gates. We want an engineering org where a small team ships like a large one, and you'll be the one who builds that.
Engineering–Product partnership. Working shoulder to shoulder with Product on discovery, scope, and sequencing. You'll be expected to have opinions about the product, not just the plumbing.
Enterprise trust. Security, compliance, and the technical side of customer and prospect conversations when it matters.

What We're Looking For

Cloud infrastructure and application architecture at depth.

You've architected, built, and operated production cloud SaaS at meaningful scale — not just supervised it. You're fluent across both layers: the application architecture (service boundaries, data modeling, API design, and the patterns that keep a large codebase evolvable) and the infrastructure underneath it. Hands-on depth in Azure and/or GCP is essential, along with container orchestration on Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, networking and identity, and the observability and cost discipline that keep a cloud platform healthy as it grows. You understand multi-tenancy versus single-tenancy tradeoffs, data isolation, performance under enterprise load, and what "SOC-2 compliant" actually costs an engineering team.

Real product instinct.

You've worked in product-led environments where engineering shapes what gets built. You can push back on a spec, spot the simpler solution, and reason about customer value — especially in complex B2B software where the user is an enterprise operator, not a consumer.

Team leadership with your hands still dirty.

You've led and grown engineering teams (roughly 5–20 people) as a player-coach. You've hired well, given hard feedback, and relentlessly tuned the delivery process.

AI fluency, both directions.

You've shipped AI or LLM-backed features into production — and you've also rebuilt how a team works using AI-assisted development and automated SDLC tooling. You can tell the difference between AI that creates leverage and AI that creates cleanup work.

Startup temperament.

You're comfortable being both the strategist and the person who fixes the flaky test. You'd rather own an outcome than a headcount number.

Nice to have

Enterprise PPM, EPMO, transformation, or professional services domain experience
Experience with Microsoft 365 / SAP / Jira / Power BI integration ecosystems
Background in selling or supporting technical evaluations with Fortune 500 or PE buyers
Experience taking a mature product through an AI-era re-platforming or modernization

Your first year

By 90 days — you know the codebase, the team, and the roadmap; you've shipped something meaningful yourself; and you've given us a clear read on our biggest delivery and technical risks.
By 6 months — the development lifecycle is measurably faster, with AI-assisted workflows and automated quality gates that the team actually uses. Release cadence is predictable.
By 12 months — engineering is a genuine competitive advantage: shipping AI capability into Conductor at a pace that surprises much larger competitors, with a team that's grown in both size and capability.

Why this role

Small team, real enterprise customers, an established product, and an unusually good excuse to rebuild how software gets made. You won't be one VP among many, and you won't be managing a slide deck about AI transformation — you'll be doing it, on a product whose entire premise is helping large organizations actually execute.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
THE PROBLEM

The hardest industrial brines are untreatable at economic cost today. Produced water in the Permian. Mining process water. Flue gas desulfurization. Cooling tower blowdown from data centers. These streams are the binding constraint on industrial growth, and conventional treatment — thermal evaporation, reverse osmosis, crystallizers — break down at exactly the salinities that matter most.

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Cetos Water is commercializing the first system designed to cost effectively handle them. Temperature Swing Solvent Extraction (TSSE) is a membrane-less, non-evaporative process that treats hypersaline brines at low temperature, recovering freshwater and critical minerals at a fraction of the energy cost of conventional systems. The technology originated at Columbia University and has been advanced in-house.

A fully continuous, multi-stage pilot is running today and hitting its targets. The company has been independently validated and funded by a series of mission-aligned institutions:
Winner, Wheaton Precious Metals Future of Mining Challenge ($1M non-dilutive, March 2026)
DOE ARPA-E RECOVER grant awardee
2025 Imagine H2O Accelerator cohort company, demo day winner
Creative Destruction Lab Minerals & Mining stream

We are a small, technically dense team building for deployment into real industrial environments, not for the lab, not for the pitch deck.

THE ROLE

This is the senior-most engineering role at Cetos. You will own how our technology becomes deployable industrial infrastructure — designing, building, and iterating systems that run in the field, under load, on real customer brine.

You'll start as a player-coach: hands on design, vendor engagement, and early builds, while leading the engineering function and working directly alongside our science team on the underlying chemistry. You will report to the CEO.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

System architecture & design
End-to-end design of TSSE systems from pilot through first commercial scale, including materials selection for hypersaline service, solvent recovery loops, thermal integration, and management of precipitation and scaling
Make first-principles tradeoffs between performance, cost, footprint, and reliability under real-world operating envelopes
Own the process architecture, P&IDs, equipment specification, and integration strategy for each deployment

Scale-up: pilot to field to commercial
Drive the transition from small pilots to field-deployable skid-mounted systems
Define what is off-the-shelf vs. novel — and how each will be validated, sourced, and integrated
Take a novel unit operation through an FEL-2 / FEL-3 stage-gate equivalent in an industrial context

Customer-facing engineering
Own the techno-economic model. At Cetos the TEA is an engineering deliverable, it decides which unit operations earn their capex, which R&D results matter, and which customers we pursue.
Translate real customer brine chemistries — produced water, lithium brine reject, FGD, tailings — into system specs, pilot plans, and a defensible business case: capex, opex, payback, $/m³
Integrate TSSE into existing plant infrastructure alongside customer process engineers and build technical credibility with engineering leadership at mining majors, upstream oil & gas operators, IPPs, and semiconductor fabs

Engineering with AI in the loop
Run the engineering function AI-natively, and set that tone by demonstrating it. You are the early adopter, the standard you set cascades into every engineer you hire and how you size the team
Build the leverage in deliberately: a controls library that generates the bulk of the code from prompts rather than a team of controls engineers writing it by hand; simulation and TEA sensitivity runs that would otherwise be a week of manual work; pilot data that tells you which experiment to run next instead of waiting for someone to read the plots.
Make the software and data decisions while the design is still open — instrumentation density, where control lives, what sits above SCADA. Those decisions cannot be bought back later.

Build the engineering function
Lead and grow the team; own the engineering roadmap and the hiring plan behind it
Stand up the discipline that carries us from first commercial system to fleet — design reviews, risk registers, commissioning protocols, stage-gates — knowing what rigor to add and what to skip
Run a sharp make-versus-buy strategy: what to vertically integrate, what to hand to EPCs, fabricators, and controls vendors, and the relationships to execute against it

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for someone with deep technical experience and first-principles fluency, the creative resourcefulness to solve novel problems under real constraints, and the communication skills to represent Cetos externally at the highest levels. Exceptional candidates may come from adjacent domains.
You have taken a first-of-a-kind process or hardware system from pilot to field deployment. Not just designed it on paper, but debugged it at 2am in a remote site when it was failing and the customer was watching
You have been early at a hard tech company where you helped translate a novel process into a real system under capital and time constraints
You have specified and procured skid-mounted process equipment for industrial deployment
You have built the business case, not just the system, payback, unit economics, $/m³, and used it to triage opportunities rather than punting the question to a commercial team.
You have already built AI into how you engineer. Named tools, in your own workflow, on real work — code and controls generation, simulation and modelling, data analysis, documentation.
You have a background in chemical engineering, separations, hydrometallurgy, or industrial water, with strong first-principles fluency in mass transfer, thermodynamics, and process design
You have integrated novel unit operations into existing industrial plants (mining, oil & gas, power, semiconductor, or similar)
You make sound decisions with incomplete data, find creative paths through hard problems, and know the difference between a risk worth taking and one worth retiring
You communicate clearly and credibly with senior stakeholders — customers, investors, DOE, and academic partners — and can translate deep technical work into language that lands
You care about what Cetos is building. Water is a real constraint on industrial growth, and you want to work on problems that matter
You want to build a company, not just a product, and you understand what it means to carry the technical credibility of an organization as it earns its first commercial customers

WHY THIS ROLE

Most deep-tech engineering roles give you one of three things: the novel technology, the commercial deployment, or the equity to matter. This role gives you all three.

Water is the binding constraint on industrial growth this decade — on mining expansion, on data center siting, on semiconductor buildout, on the energy transition itself. The infrastructure layer that unlocks it has not yet been built.

You will not just optimize a system. You will define how an entirely new class of industrial infrastructure gets designed, deployed, and scaled.

jobs.description:
In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Senior Software Engineering position at the Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions that support business needs.

About The Role

We're hiring a senior hands on engineer for the Morgan Stanley Equity Swaps technology team — the platform behind a market-leading, global front-office business. You'll be working hands-on inside a large-scale, real-time, event-driven system that processes significant volume every day, alongside a team actively modernizing the platform rather than just maintaining it.

This isn't a role where seniority means stepping away from code. You'll be designing, architecting, and building core components yourself, while also shaping technical direction and mentoring less experienced engineers on the team. Expect real ownership: you'll be trusted to make architectural calls, not just implement someone else's spec.

What You'll Do In The Role

Building and evolving a multi-threaded, Linux-based, real-time Java platform handling high-throughput event flows
Driving analysis, design, and architecture for complex, cross-team initiatives
Working with an interesting tech stack: RDBMS alongside technologies like MongoDB, Kafka, IBM MQ, Hazelcast, and Snowflake
Getting deeply hands-on with our large sharded MongoDB cluster, with the expectation of growing into one of the team's go-to subject matter expert on its design, performance, and operational behaviour
Becoming a technical expert on our core cashflow calculator — not just the code, but the underlying numbers, so you can reason confidently about whether outputs are actually correct, not just whether the system ran without error
Strengthening our test automation and deployment practices — we're steadily maturing toward greater CI/CD and are looking for engineers who want to help drive that evolution, rather than someone joining a fully-automated pipeline
Participating in L3 support for North America on a fair rotation — as a senior engineer, you'll be relied on to lead the hard incidents and ambiguous problems
Actively using AI tooling (Claude, Amp, Deep Search, and others) to accelerate the SDLC — we want engineers who are evolving their own workflow with AI while keeping strong technical judgment and oversight over what ships

What You'll Bring To The Role

10+ years of experience
Java, server-side, concurrent/multi-threaded programming, with Spring Boot (Core Spring) and JUnit
Solid understanding of message-based architectures (Kafka and/or IBM MQ)
Strong RDBMS skills — Sybase and/or DB2 preferred — with proficiency writing complex SQL
Unix/Linux scripting (Shell / Python)
Sharp problem-solving and analytical ability, with a track record of owning full SDLC delivery
Excellent written and verbal communication — you'll be expected to explain complex tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
Genuine interest in learning the business the platform supports, not just the tech

Desired Skills

Experience operating or tuning large-scale sharded MongoDB clusters
Comfort with financial calculations and a willingness to get into the weeds of numerical correctness, not just code correctness
Knowledge of the Equity Derivatives business
Experience integrating AI-assisted development tools into a real engineering workflow

Who Thrives Here

Strong technical instincts and happy owning ambiguous, complex problems end-to-end
Someone who wants technical leadership without giving up hands-on coding
A collaborator who can push back constructively with demanding stakeholders and hold a clear technical position
Genuine curiosity about the Equity Derivatives business itself, not just the codebase
A "can-do," solutions-first attitude when architectural tradeoffs get contentious

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. jobs.description:
Bentley Systems

This position can be remote, hybrid or on-site in a Bentley location.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Solution Engineering leads Bentley’s global technical sales organization and serves on the Account Advancement Group (AAG) leadership team, reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO). As a senior commercial and technical leader, this executive shapes how Solution Engineering translates Bentley’s technology and industry expertise into user value, competitive differentiation, and sustainable growth globally.

The VP leads Solution Engineering across AMER, EMEA, APAC, Medium, Small, and Bentley Learn, aligning technical and industry expertise with Bentley’s highest-value account and growth opportunities. The organization drives technical discovery, solution development, account engagement, adoption, and measurable ARR growth. The leader should bring a foundational understanding of the infrastructure and engineering software landscape and the workflows Bentley’s users rely on.

A key priority is evolving Solution Engineering into a more proactive, account-focused growth organization while building a new forward-deployed engineering capability at the intersection of infrastructure engineering and software development. These teams will combine domain expertise with software engineering, coding, AI, APIs, MCP integrations, agents, and data integration to work directly with accounts, rapidly solve high-value challenges, and turn successful solutions into repeatable capabilities that scale across Bentley.

While similar to traditional Forward Deployed Engineering models, Bentley may evolve this capability under an infrastructure-focused identity that reflects the combination of engineering expertise, software development, and AI.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the transformation of Global Solutions Engineering, setting the strategic direction and translating it into an effective operating model, including organizational design, workforce and capability planning, investment recommendations, resource allocation, and performance expectations across a 250+ person global organization.
Drive ARR, consumption, and account growth by aligning technical resources to the accounts, solutions, and opportunities with the greatest commercial potential.
Lead the evolution toward AI-enabled and Forward Deployed Engineering, expanding SE capabilities beyond traditional presales into AI agents, APIs, MCP integrations, automation, data integration, and solution development directly with accounts.
Establish Technical Discovery as a core discipline, deeply understanding account priorities, workflows, technology environments, and business challenges and translating those insights into actionable opportunities.
Increase proactive account engagement, shifting SE from primarily opportunity-driven support toward continuous technical engagement focused on identifying new use cases, adoption opportunities, and growth.
Strengthen technical account planning with Account Management, identifying whitespace, competitive displacement, modernization, technology adoption, and measurable pathways to ARR growth.
Modernize technical sales execution across discovery, solution architecture, demonstrations, workshops, proofs of value, technical validation, and technical closure.
Create scalable technical sales motions, turning successful discoveries, AI solutions, integrations, demonstrations, and workflows into repeatable approaches that can be deployed globally.
Connect pre- and post-sales execution by partnering closely with Professional Services and Data Optimization to accelerate implementation, modernization, adoption, consumption, and long-term account value.
Strengthen the SE–Product & Technology connection, creating a strong feedback loop for account requirements, product gaps, competitive intelligence, API needs, and emerging technology opportunities.
Accelerate adoption of strategic technologies, including Bentley Infrastructure Cloud, AI, APIs, MCP, digital delivery, acquired technologies, and emerging commercial offerings.
Lead organizational transformation through change, evolving skills, roles, operating models, and ways of working while maintaining execution, account continuity, and team engagement.
Build the next generation of SE talent, developing leaders and technical professionals with stronger AI, software, API, industry, commercial, and account-facing capabilities.
Establish measurable accountability, including account coverage, technical discoveries, resource allocation, pipeline influence, adoption, consumption, and contribution to ARR.
Create a high-performance culture with measurable accountability for business outcomes, organizational effectiveness, user impact, and talent health.
Represent Bentley with strategic accounts and industry leaders, providing executive and technical leadership in major account engagements, industry forums, conferences, and advisory groups.

Measures of Success / KPIs

Commercial Impact

ARR, consumption, pipeline influence, and technical win rates
New-logo growth, competitive displacement, and product/workflow expansion

Account Engagement

Strategic account coverage, proactive engagement, and technical account plan execution
Executive, technical stakeholder, and in-person engagement

Technical Discovery & Execution

Technical Discovery volume, quality, and conversion to opportunities
Proof-of-value success and identification of new use cases/workflows

Adoption & Consumption

Usage growth, strategic product adoption, and cloud/current-version migration
Removal of technical barriers to adoption and growth

Organizational Health & Leadership

Leadership bench strength and succession readiness
Key talent retention and employee engagement
Internal promotion and leadership development outcomes
Successful execution of organizational transformation initiatives

Operational Effectiveness

Solution Engineering productivity and coverage effectiveness
Investment efficiency and resource utilization
Reusable technical solutions and cross-functional execution across Sales, Services, Product, and Marketing

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate must operate as an enterprise executive, balancing short-term commercial performance with long-term organizational capability. They should demonstrate a track record of building and transforming large global organizations, influencing executive decision-making, developing senior leaders, and driving sustainable business outcomes through strategy, execution, and organizational health.

The successful candidate must be a commercially oriented technical leader, not simply the most technically accomplished person in the organization.

They should have significant experience leading global technical sales, presales, Solution Engineering, or related organizations within enterprise software or infrastructure technology; a demonstrated ability to connect technical engagement to measurable revenue outcomes; experience operating across regions and market segments; and the ability to engage credibly with both engineering practitioners and senior executives.

The individual must be equally comfortable discussing an account's engineering workflow, developing a technical engagement strategy, challenging a sales strategy, working with Product leadership on technology gaps, and managing a global organization against measurable commercial outcomes.

They should bring a strong bias toward execution, collaboration, accountability, and developing leaders—and understand that Solution Engineering succeeds when technical expertise translates into meaningful account outcomes and sustainable growth.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Customer Debug Engineering
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE

Step into a high-stakes leadership role at the intersection of cutting-edge silicon and global-scale AI deployment. As Senior Manager in the Platform Field Engineering team within Data Center Platform Engineering Group DPEG, you will build and lead a team of customer-facing debug engineers who own server- and rack-level hardware and firmware debug during customer bring-up and early deployment, with continued support through ODM factory build (NPI). Your team is the trusted technical bridge between AMD engineering, the world's largest data center customers, and global ODM partners. You set technical direction, develop talent, drive issues to root cause, keep customer deployments and ramp schedules on track, and roll up clear status to both internal and external leadership.

THE PERSON

You are a hands-on people leader who pairs deep system debug expertise with the executive presence to navigate intense customer escalations. You are equally at home in a customer bring-up lab chasing a field anomaly and in an executive review distilling fragmented data into a clear hypothesis and a decision. You lead without ego, influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, and treat the growth of your engineers as a personal success metric. You stay calm under pressure, are resourceful with scarce hardware, and believe customer success and technical excellence are inseparable.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership: Build, lead, and mentor a team of customer-facing debug engineers covering server and rack-level HW/FW debug across customer deployment and NPI. Set technical benchmarks and foster career growth.
Customer Debug & Field Resolution: Lead debug of platform bring-up, fleet anomalies, and early field failures at customer sites; drive issues to root cause and feed learnings back into design, validation, and manufacturing.
Escalation Management: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex server/rack debug, driving cross-functional resolution and owning the customer-facing narrative through to closure.
Status Reporting & Roll-Up: Own debug status tracking and prioritization, and roll up clear, decision-oriented updates for both internal and external (customer) leadership.
Factory Build Support: Support HW/FW failure triage during ODM factory build and EVT/DVT/PVT gates, ensuring build issues are driven to definitive root cause and corrective action.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive debug across design, validation, product engineering, firmware, and FA teams; align pre- and post-silicon debug with platform readiness and deployment schedules.
Resourceful Debug Under Constraint: Prioritize scarce hardware across competing customer escalations, maximize coverage through shared setups, and enable effective remote debug when physical access is limited.
Customer & ODM Engagement: Partner with customers, ODM teams, and Customer Program Managers; advise on AMD tools and debug methodologies, and contribute to technical and customer-facing documentation.

Preferred Experience

People Leadership: Recent years of experience managing customer-facing technical or engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, mentoring, and career development-ideally in data center, GPU, cloud, or HPC environments.
Debug Depth: Deep hands-on experience with server- and rack-level hardware and firmware debug, including pre- and post-silicon debug across CPU, GPU, FPGA, memory, connectivity, RAS, and hotplug.
NPI Mastery: Strong familiarity with hardware bring-up, validation, manufacturing, and test flows, and the transition from concept through EVT/DVT/PVT to volume production.
Influence & Execution: Proven ability to drive execution across global, cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
Customer & ODM Scale: Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale deployments and managing debug or quality programs across hyperscale, OEM, and enterprise customer segments and global ODM partners.
Quality & Reliability: Working knowledge of reliability and quality metrics (yield, DPM, FIT) and system-level failure triage and FA engagement.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to distill complex technical challenges into clear, decision-oriented messaging for executives and customers.
AI Integration: Interest or experience in leveraging AI tools to optimize debug and quality workflows and drive measurable efficiency gains.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Required: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree in a related technical field preferred

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead engineering teams within the Elastic Container Service (ECS) organization in Vancouver, BC. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. Snowflake is building the data and AI platform for the agentic enterprise. Enterprise Apps & Agentic Systems is applying that same standard internally by redesigning business domains from first principles and turning high-value workflows into software-defined, AI-native products.

We are hiring a Sr. Director to make Finance, OTC, Revenue, People, and Legal domains more agentic. This leader will own the product and engineering strategy across the portfolio, moving beyond application management to deliver intelligent products that understand context, act across systems, operate within guardrails, and involve people when judgment is required.

This leader will work directly with business executives to identify the work that should be eliminated, redesigned, or delegated to software. CORE MISSION:

Transform enterprise operations across Finance, People, and Legal by redesigning end-to-end workflows into AI-native products rather than adding incremental features to legacy apps.
Combine domain expertise, enterprise data, workflow automation, autonomous agents, and controls into a coherent operating experience.
Establish a product-led model where cross-functional teams co-own strategy, adoption, reliability, and business impact.
Build a scalable AI product lifecycle to rapidly prototype, evaluate, deploy, and scale intelligent agents across the organization.

Define and execute the multi-year product and engineering roadmap across Finance, HR, and Legal domains, aligning investments with high-value business outcomes.
Partner with C-level and executive leaders (CFO, HR, Legal) to challenge existing processes and redesign future-state operating models.

Lead cross-functional product pods accountable for adoption, workflow completion, and measurable value realization.
Ensure AI implementations maintain rigorous governance, auditability, SOX controls, data privacy, and security standards.
Define operational metrics to track agentic transformation, including automation rates, cycle-time reductions, exception management, and ROI.
Hire, mentor, and scale a world-class product and engineering team with strong AI fluency, business empathy, and operational excellence.
Manage portfolio budgets, vendor strategies, and technology partnerships to accelerate business outcomes.

OUR IDEAL SR. DIRECTOR, APPLICATIONS ENGINEERING WILL HAVE:

15+ years of experience in enterprise technology, product management, or software engineering, with 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary organizations at the Director level or above.
A demonstrated record of building and scaling software-defined products and AI-native or intelligent workflows in production, with measurable business impact.

First-principles product mindset focused on simplifying workflows, rapid prototyping, outcome ownership, and user-centric design.
Experience building product-led organizations with empowered teams, managing managers, and setting a high talent bar across product, program, engineering, and domain leadership.
Experience moving quickly from ambiguity to a working product, learning from usage, simplifying fragmented landscapes, and making hard prioritization decisions based on business value.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. Security is the critical enabler. We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Security Engineering to build and lead the FDE security team that protects production AI systems deployed in customer environments worldwide.

You will own the security delivery model for FDE: standing up the team, defining how security engineers embed with FDE delivery pods, and ensuring every customer engagement meets AWS and customer security standards without slowing delivery velocity. You are responsible for security outcomes across all active FDE programs simultaneously. You set the operating cadence, staffing model, and escalation paths that keep security moving at the speed of FDE: weeks, not quarters.

You lead a team of senior and principal security engineers while staying close enough to the technical work to make critical security decisions, unblock customer escalations, and earn the trust of customer CISOs. You build the team, develop the people, and own the results.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities

Build, develop, and lead a team of security engineers embedded across FDE customer engagements; own performance management, career development, and retention for a high-performing, geographically distributed security team
Define and operate the FDE security delivery model: how security engineers staff to pods, scope engagements, conduct reviews, and hand off to customers; create the mechanisms that ensure consistent security outcomes at scale
Own security delivery across multiple concurrent customer programs; prioritize security resources against the FDE engagement portfolio, resolve cross-engagement conflicts, and drive closure on security blockers impeding production deployments
Partner with FDE delivery leadership, AWS Security, and service teams to align security strategy with FDE's business objectives; represent security in FDE leadership forums and influence technical direction across organizational boundaries
Make high-judgment security risk decisions for FDE's most complex customer environments; serve as the escalation point for security architectural trade-offs that require balancing customer requirements, delivery timelines, and AWS standards
Engage directly with customer security leadership (CISOs, security VPs) to establish trust, align on security expectations, and resolve escalations that threaten customer relationships or production timelines
Drive the FDE security roadmap: identify capability gaps, prioritize investments in tooling, automation, and reusable security patterns, and ensure the team builds assets that scale the practice beyond individual engagements
Requires up to 25% travel

A day in the life

You start the morning in a standup with your security engineers embedded across three active FDE engagements, triaging a guardrail bypass finding from one pod and reprioritizing security review coverage for a new financial services customer onboarding this week. Mid-morning you're in a 1:1 with a senior security engineer working through their promotion narrative. In the afternoon you're reviewing the team's quarterly security metrics with FDE delivery leadership, then closing out the day interviewing a principal security engineer candidate. jobs.title: Engineering Director - Partner Enablement Applications
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Client and Partner Technologies (CPT) organization is chartered with enabling brilliant Netflix experiences on devices and building the foundational client systems and tools that make those experiences possible. Within CPT, the Partner Enablement Apps (PEA) group builds and evolves our suite of web applications that power the lifecycle of our device and payments partnerships.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead and scale the Partner Enablement Apps engineering organization. This group develops business‑to‑business applications that enable our device partners (TVs, streaming sticks, set‑top boxes, and other “10‑foot” devices) and operator partners (ISPs, telcos, TV and mobile carriers) to integrate with Netflix APIs, manage device and service lifecycles, and operate Partner Payment experiences (including bundling Netflix with their offerings). Our tools are used both by external partners and by Netflix teams to integrate, launch, operate, monitor, update, and retire partner experiences at scale.

In this role, you’ll drive the long‑term technical strategy, organizational health, and delivery excellence across multiple teams, ensuring our partner and internal experiences are reliable, intuitive, and ready for the next generation of integrations.

The Team

You will lead a growing engineering organization that is primarily based in Warsaw, Poland and includes team members in the United States, Brazil, Netherlands, and Taiwan. The organization currently consists of four domains and requires building strong relationships across time zones and fostering a cohesive, high-performing culture despite geographic distribution.

Strategic Leadership

Comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration, automated testing)

Data quality and engineering best practices

Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and implement scalable, performant, and reliable solutions
Stay current with industry trends, tools, and technologies, assessing their relevance and driving adoption where appropriate

Operational Excellence
