jobs.title: Director / Fellow – Developer Productivity & Platform, ROCm
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

ROCm is a 1,200-person engineering organization. The people in it are productive individually. The organization as a whole is not. Developers across firmware, kernel, build, and software teams encounter the same friction points — slow toolchains, fragmented workflows, bespoke local infrastructure assembled team-by-team to fill gaps nobody formally owns — and solve them independently, each time, in different ways. No one has owned this problem horizontally.

The problem is real, the scope is rare — a horizontal mandate across a 1,200-person engineering organization, with a clear problem and leadership support to address it. Developer experience roles at this scope don't come up often.
Build a function from scratch — you'll establish what developer productivity means at AMD, prove the model, and scale it. Budget exists to grow the team beneath you once the function is validated. This is a founding role, not a slot in an existing org chart.
Direct line to leadership — you'll report directly to the head of the Developer Organization, with the access and visibility to move quickly and escalate blockers without bureaucratic overhead.
Direct impact on AMD's open-source velocity — ROCm is AMD's bet on the AI software ecosystem. Engineering time is the constraint. This role directly attacks that constraint.
Breadth unusual for an IC — firmware, kernel, build, runtime, compiler, ML frameworks — this role touches all of it. If you want depth in one area, this isn't it. If you want horizontal breadth with genuine technical impact across a large, complex organization, it's a rare fit.

The Person

We're looking for a senior individual contributor to serve as the horizontal technical lead for developer productivity across the entire ROCm development organization. You'll sit in the Developer Organization (DevOps and QA), reporting directly to the head of that organization, but your mandate spans the full 1,200-person engineering body — surfacing the highest-friction points in the developer experience, and eliminating them: through infrastructure improvements, workflow redesign, or direct fixes to the development stack itself. The goal is measurable, durable improvement in engineering velocity across the company — not for one team, for all of them.

This is a solo IC role to start. You'll build the function and prove the model. We have budget to hire supporting engineers beneath you as the work matures, but the first job is to establish what this function owns, what it can change, and what it's worth.

Key Responsibilities

Own the developer productivity problem horizontally across ROCm — this is not a team-scoped role. You'll build a continuous, empirical view of where developers across the organization lose time: through direct interviews, instrumentation, friction logging, and analysis of build and CI data. This picture drives your roadmap.
Identify and eliminate the highest-leverage friction points — once you can see where the time goes, you prioritize ruthlessly. Some fixes are infrastructure (build caching, environment provisioning, test selection); some are workflow changes (pre-submit gates, LKG baselines, CI reproduction paths); some are direct improvements to the development stack (compiler feedback, incremental build tuning, developer-facing tooling). You'll own and drive all three categories.
Build shared tooling that replaces fragmentation — every ROCm component team has assembled workarounds for gaps nobody formally owns. Your job is to surface that work, identify what should become canonical, and drive consolidation into shared, maintained tooling — eliminating the incentive for any team to build their own infrastructure from scratch.
Partner with DevOps, QA, and component team leads — you will influence without authority across autonomous teams with their own roadmaps and priorities. Earning credibility requires deep technical fluency alongside organizational effectiveness; this role requires both.
Define and instrument the metrics that make productivity legible — build time, incremental compile time, time-to-first-green, environment setup time, onboarding completion rates. If we can't measure it, we can't improve it. You'll own the measurement framework and use it to demonstrate impact to engineering leadership.
Translate developer pain into infrastructure investments — you'll be the voice of developer experience on the DevOps roadmap. You'll bring structured evidence of friction points back to the teams who can address them, and help prioritize what gets built next.
Build and eventually lead a team — this role starts solo, but the expectation is that you'll prove the model and grow the function. Budget exists to hire supporting engineers beneath you; how you structure that team and when you pull that trigger is part of what you'll own.
Developer friction audit — a systematic, org-wide map of where the 1,200 developers in ROCm lose time today: slow builds, environment setup overhead, broken trunk, manual workarounds for missing automation. The output is a prioritized investment list, not a document that sits in a folder.
Build acceleration program — identify the highest-impact levers for reducing build latency across ROCm component repos: distributed build caching (sccache or equivalent), incremental build configuration tuning, faster CI test selection. Measure before and after; publish results.
Developer environment standardization — define and drive adoption of a reproducible, pre-configured developer environment standard (Dev Containers or equivalent) that eliminates weeks of onboarding archaeology and gives any engineer a working, fully-tooled environment within 15 minutes.
CI failure reproduction as a first-class workflow — today, reproducing a CI failure means finding a matching machine manually. You'll drive the infrastructure change that makes any CI failure interactively reproducible on equivalent hardware, eliminating one of the highest-friction moments in the development cycle.
Shadow infra consolidation — surface and evaluate the custom scripts, ad-hoc tooling, and bespoke CI configurations built by component teams to fill platform gaps; identify duplication; drive consolidation into shared, owned tooling with formal support.
Developer productivity KPIs — instrument and publish a quarterly developer productivity dashboard used by engineering leadership to set priorities and track improvement over time.

Preferred Experience

Software engineering experience with significant depth in developer tooling, platform engineering, build systems, or DevOps
Strong hands-on coding ability — this is an IC role; you will be in the code, not just driving process
Demonstrated track record of improving developer experience at scale across organizations of 100+ engineers — measurable outcomes required
Proven ability to operate horizontally across autonomous teams, building alignment and driving adoption without organizational authority
Deep understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure, and developer workflow tooling — you need to understand the problem space at a technical level to earn credibility with the teams you'll work with

Experience in GPU or systems software environments (kernel, firmware, runtime, compiler) — understanding what it actually feels like to develop in this stack is a significant advantage

About The Role

Sunday is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead and elevate a talented, close-knit engineering team through a pivotal moment. This role exists to protect and grow that momentum: setting technical vision, building org-level capability, and bringing in an AI focus.

This is a hands-on leadership role with real strategic ownership. You'll need to be credible in the weeds, able to understand what's happening in the codebase and the business, while also sitting close to company leadership, translating company vision into an engineering roadmap, and making the structural calls the team doesn't have bandwidth to make themselves.

Above all, we need a builder. Someone who gets genuinely excited about writing code and shipping products, not solely a people manager. You'll rally the team by being in it with them, and you'll partner directly with Product as a true collaborator, not an order-taker: we need someone who understands how product and engineering decisions shape each other.

Vision & Strategy

Develop a technical vision for engineering that ties directly to Sunday's business goals, and translate it into a 6–12 month roadmap built with Product and the Leadership Team
Build and own Sunday's AI strategy for engineering, establish a consistent approach to AI-assisted and agentic development, and use it to help the team move faster and fail faster

AI-Native Product Direction

Push Sunday toward becoming a genuinely AI-native product company, not a deterministic product with a chatbot bolted on, but one where core functionality is LLM-driven where it makes sense
Bring real excitement and a point of view about this shift, and get the team energized about building toward it together

Technical Maturity & Architecture

Identify and invest in the technical decisions that save the team time now, rather than accumulating further shortcuts

Org Building & Talent

Execution & Delivery

Hold the team accountable to its own goals; regularly evaluate team structure and workflow to keep the org moving quickly
Codify and disseminate engineering best practices, testing, code review, PR norms, and how those practices scale as AI-assisted development increases velocity, so speed doesn't outpace quality
Own engineering metrics — delivery against roadmap, quality/bug backlog, system performance and uptime, and team velocity, and use them to surface bottlenecks to leadership
Deliver honest, frequent, and respectful feedback, and build a culture where the team gives and receives it the same way

Cross-Functional Leadership & Product Partnership

Represent engineering as part of company leadership, communicate plans, tradeoffs, and challenges to other functional heads in terms the whole business can act on
Act as a true product partner given how much of Sunday's product is (and will increasingly be) LLM-driven; engineering and product decisions are directly intertwined, not sequential handoffs
Understand how product thinks, and bring engineering's perspective into product conversations early — this is a collaboration, not a request queue

What Success Looks Like

The team feels led, not managed, with clear priorities, cleared blockers, and visible follow-through
Strong opinions, held loosely: you set direction but trust engineers to own execution
The team has real conviction that engineering is heading in the right direction
A working AI strategy the whole team is aligned on, with visible gains in velocity and quality

What You Bring

Proven experience leading engineering at a small-to-mid-size or growth-stage company, with a track record of taking on increasing scope
A genuine builder, you want to be hands-on writing code and shaping product, not solely managing people and process
Strong individual technical credibility — you can go deep enough to earn trust with senior engineers, not just manage from a distance
Direct experience with, or strong enthusiasm for, AI-native product development — building products where core functionality is LLM-driven rather than deterministic, not just adding an AI chat feature to an existing product
Familiarity with LLM evaluation practices and tooling (Braintrust, Langfuse, or similar), given the shift toward non-deterministic, AI-driven functionality
Front-end depth, or demonstrated ability to grow it across a team
Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, and a clear point of view on how to scale them responsibly
A naturally curious, learning-oriented mindset, hungry to keep growing and to bring the team along with you
Experience building org structure, hiring processes, and team practices from a lighter-weight or informal state
A true product-collaboration mindset: understands how product and engineering decisions shape each other, and doesn't need — or want — a roadmap simply handed to them
A business-minded, collaborative style, comfortable building relationships across the whole company, not just within engineering
Humility and directness, able to talk openly about mistakes and how they were resolved, and to give feedback as a gift
A communicator who can move fluidly between technical depth and company-wide clarity

A Note on Team Culture

Sunday's engineering team values being in the weeds together, moving quickly, and staying focused on one clear, differentiated product direction. We're looking for a leader who amplifies that — someone the team describes the way they describe their best examples of leadership: present, communicative, and unafraid to tackle the hard stuff directly.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market.

Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026.

Mobility is one of the most highly-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Systems Engineering
to lead our Systems Engineering team and drive system-level requirements, architecture, integration, verification, and validation across our aircraft programs.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong systems-engineering fundamentals combined with meaningful depth in at least one engineering discipline. The successful candidate will work closely with hardware, software, GNC, aeromechanical, powertrain, manufacturing, and flight-test teams to ensure Pivotal aircraft are developed and verified as integrated systems.

Responsibilities

Lead and mentor Pivotal's Systems Engineering team, including requirements, systems integration, and verification activities
Own the aircraft and subsystem requirements-management process in JAMA, including decomposition, allocation, traceability, baselines, change management, and verification closure
Establish and maintain clear traceability from system requirements through lower-level requirements, verification requirements, test activities, and objective evidence
Lead development and execution of aircraft-level Verification and Validation (V&V) plans, compliance matrices, test requirements, and verification reports
Partner with engineering and flight-test teams to define verification through analysis, inspection, bench testing, SIL/HIL, ground test, UAV flight, and crewed flight as appropriate
Lead system architecture, functional allocation, and critical hardware/software and subsystem interfaces
Develop and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and resolve cross-functional interface issues
Drive technical integration across GNC, embedded software, electrical, battery, propulsion, aeromechanical, manufacturing, and flight test
Lead or support technical reviews including SRR, CoDR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and aircraft readiness reviews
Ensure system safety, failure behavior, degraded modes, and identified hazards are appropriately captured in requirements and verification
Support aircraft bring-up, troubleshooting, ground testing, and flight-test readiness
Develop practical, scalable Systems Engineering processes that improve execution without creating unnecessary process overhead

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
10+ years of engineering experience developing complex multidisciplinary systems, with demonstrated technical leadership or people-management experience
Strong experience with requirements development, decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification
Experience with JAMA, DOORS, Polarion, Codebeamer, or similar requirements-management tools; JAMA experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated experience developing and executing system-level V&V programs
Experience integrating complex hardware and software systems from development through test and release
Experience developing system architectures and managing subsystem interfaces and ICDs
Demonstrated technical depth in at least one discipline such as aircraft design, mechanical systems, electrical systems, embedded software, controls/GNC, autonomy, propulsion, or system integration and test
Ability to investigate and resolve complex multidisciplinary technical problems across engineering teams
Experience with aerospace, spacecraft, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other safety-critical electromechanical products strongly preferred
Experience with HIL/SIL, aircraft ground test, flight test, system safety, or structured aerospace development processes is preferred
Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional technical teams

The ideal candidate is a builder and technical integrator
, not simply a process owner. They understand the value of requirements discipline and rigorous verification while maintaining the speed, judgment, and hands-on technical engagement required to develop new aircraft.

Attributes aligned with Core Values

Safety Above All: Demonstrates a proactive safety mindset by embedding safety into daily work, identifying and mitigating risks, encouraging open dialogue about safety concerns, and continuously improving practices and protocols
Customer Focus: Puts customers at the center of every action by understanding their challenges, delivering meaningful value, and supporting their success
Work Better Together: Seeks and values diverse perspectives, builds cross-functional relationships, and fosters trust through empathetic, fact-based communication and commitment to shared decisions
Be the Pilot: Drives results with clarity and purpose by focusing on what matters most, adapting to change, taking initiative, and owning outcomes
Embrace the Unknown: Navigates ambiguity with resilience and bold thinking, challenges the status quo, and combines innovative ideas with practical approaches to overcome obstacles and drive progress
Respect for People: Fosters a high-performance culture grounded in respect, professionalism, and support by balancing high expectations with a healthy, collaborative environment and being a trusted, dependable teammate

Applicants must be eligible for employment in the United States and willing to work onsite at our HQ office in Palo Alto, CA.

jobs.description:
Build Our Future Together

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Our Combination Product Development team ensures that every device patients and providers rely on from prefilled syringes to autoinjectors is safe, intuitive, and built to last. We're looking for a Director of Human Factors to shape how patients and caregivers interact with our devices, and keep our commercial products performing reliably long after launch.

This is a unique, dual-scope leadership role. You will lead our Human Factors Engineering team driving usability strategy, study execution, and regulatory engagement for products in development while also overseeing our Sustaining Engineering function, which safeguards the quality, compliance, and performance of combination products already in the hands of patients. Combination product design control is the thread that ties both functions together, and a solid command of design inputs and outputs, verification and validation, design transfer, and change control is essential to succeeding in this role. If you want a role where design and lifecycle ownership meet, and where your team's work touches products from first usability study through years of commercial distribution, this is it.

When & Where

Location: East Greenbush, New York, United States
Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-5:00pm
Travel percentage: 15% domestic & occasionally international

What You’ll Do

Recruit, direct, mentor, and retain a high-performing team of human factors and sustaining engineers supporting multiple projects across development and commercial lifecycle stages; build onboarding and career pathways that help engineers across both disciplines grow
Bring prior people-leadership experience across technical, cross-functional teams, with the ingenuity and composure to prioritize competing demands under ambiguity, tact, and diplomacy
Build strong working relationships and move seamlessly across product design, engineering, clinical development, marketing, quality, and regulatory affairs including on submission strategy, content, and agency responses for HF-related questions
Serve as internal expert on human factors and combination product regulations/standards (IEC 62366, AAMI HE75, ISO 14971, FDA HF guidance, 21 CFR Part 4, 21 CFR 820 design controls, ICH Q8-Q11); ensure usability engineering and design control processes meet and exceed regulatory expectations while delivering real patient value
Apply end-to-end understanding of design control (inputs/outputs, V&V, design transfer, change control) to connect usability findings and sustaining changes back to the Design History File, keeping documentation aligned as products move from development to commercial distribution
Own design changes from concept through implementation; conduct design change assessments and technical evaluations for supplier, component, and manufacturing changes, including global filings and contract manufacturing changes as commercial footprint expands
Drive and document customer complaint investigations (root cause, CAPA) and maintain/evolve Risk Management Files using post-market surveillance and manufacturing data, with hands-on DHF/RMF management experience
Write and edit clear, accurate technical documentation (protocols, risk files, investigation reports, regulatory responses) and hold the team to the same standard; present team work, risks, and priorities to executive management and regulatory authorities, advising on process improvements and emerging regulatory issues

This Role Requires

BS/BA in Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, Biomedical Engineering , Cognitive Psychology, Human-Computer interaction or related field is preferred
Associate Director Human Factors: 10+ years of experience
Director Human Factors: 12+ years of experience
Level will be determined based on experience
Previous people leadership experience
Experience in medical device, biopharmaceutical combination products, or a similarly regulated environment
Prior experience with, or oversight of, sustaining engineering, design controls, or product lifecycle management for medical devices/combination products

jobs.description:
Crossroads Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Since 2005, Crossroads has been at the forefront of treating patients with opioid use disorder. Crossroads is a family of professionals dedicated to providing the most accessible, highest quality, evidence-based medication assisted treatment (MAT) options to combat the growing opioid epidemic and helping people with opioid use disorder start their path to recovery. This comprehensive approach to treatment, the gold standard in care for opioid use disorder, has been shown to prevent more deaths from overdose and lead to long-term recovery. We are committed to bringing critical services to communities across the U.S. to improve access to treatment for over 26,500 patients. Our clinics are all outpatient and office-based, with clinics in Georgia, Kentucky, New Jersey, North and South Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees and patients.

Day in the Life of a Director Clinical Systems Engineering

Key Responsibilities:

Lead structured requirements elicitation with clinical, pharmacy, front office, revenue cycle, quality, and compliance stakeholders; facilitate workshops, workflow walkthroughs, and design sessions.
Translate operational and clinical needs into clearly written functional and technical specifications that can be built, tested, and audited.
Produce and maintain requirements artifacts, including current- and future-state workflow maps, user stories with acceptance criteria, configuration workbooks, requirements traceability matrices, and test scripts.
Drive formal requirements review and sign-off prior to build; manage scope, change requests, and downstream impact analysis.
Evaluate whether business needs are best met through configuration, integration, third-party solution, or process change, and present recommendations with cost, risk, and effort trade-offs.

Interfaces, Integration, and Data

Oversee interfaces and data exchange across the application portfolio, including HL7 v2 and FHIR messaging, laboratory and toxicology results, e-prescribing and EPCS, PDMP, pharmacy and dispensing systems, and downstream reporting and analytics feeds.
Support eligibility, claims, and remittance transaction flows (270/271, 837, 835) through the organization’s clearinghouse and payer channels in partnership with the revenue cycle team.
Monitor interface queues and error handling; lead root-cause analysis and remediation with vendors, trading partners, and internal IT.
Develop and validate reports and data extracts using SQL and native reporting tools; ensure data definitions are consistent across systems.

Data, Reporting, and Analytics

Independently write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL across clinical, pharmacy, and financial data; build and maintain operational, regulatory, and executive reporting, extracts, and dashboards.
Own data validation for migrations and system changes, including reconciliation queries, record and field-level validation, exception reporting, and documented sign-off criteria.
Maintain the enterprise data dictionary and source-to-target mapping; investigate data integrity issues to root cause across configuration, interfaces, and workflow.
Present findings, methodology, and limitations clearly to clinical, operational, and executive audiences; apply minimum-necessary and 42 CFR Part 2 principles to all reporting and data sharing.

Implementation and Migration

Serve as the technical lead for site migrations onto the target EHR platform, including data extract and mapping, conversion testing, load validation, cutover planning, go-live support, and post go-live stabilization.
Define and execute validation protocols for high-risk clinical and financial data, including dosing history, active orders, allergies, diagnoses, consents, and patient balances.
Coordinate build, testing, and training readiness activities with implementation, help desk, and operations leadership to support wave-based go-lives.
Document and escalate migration risks, defects, and decisions; maintain issue logs through resolution.

Team Leadership and Service Delivery

Directly supervise two Clinical Applications Analysts, including work assignment, prioritization, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
Establish and enforce intake, triage, and service level standards for application requests; balance project workload against production support escalations.
Develop team competency in configuration, testing discipline, and documentation; build cross-coverage to reduce single-threaded dependencies.
Partner with the help desk and implementation teams to ensure clean handoffs between project delivery and ongoing support.

Vendor Management, Compliance, and Reporting

Manage day-to-day technical relationships with application vendors; review release notes, coordinate upgrades, plan regression testing, and hold vendors accountable to defect resolution timelines.
Ensure system configuration and documentation support HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, DEA, SAMHSA and state OTP requirements, state licensure, CARF or other accreditation standards, and payer requirements.
Maintain audit-ready records of configuration changes, access reviews, validation testing, and system decisions.
Report project status, risks, decisions, and key performance metrics to the Vice President, Clinical Applications and to senior leadership.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Preferred Education & Experience

Technical and Functional Competencies:

Advanced working knowledge of electronic health record and practice management system architecture, configuration, and release management.
Demonstrated proficiency in requirements elicitation and documentation methods, including workflow mapping, user stories, functional specifications, and traceability.
Working knowledge of healthcare integration standards and technologies, including HL7 v2, FHIR, APIs, and secure file transfer.
Advanced, hands-on SQL proficiency required — including multi-table joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregation, and window functions — with the ability to independently query, validate, and reconcile data across disparate systems without analyst support.
Working knowledge of healthcare EDI transactions and clearinghouse operations.
Understanding of behavioral health and substance use disorder clinical workflows, documentation, and billing requirements.
Demonstrated project management skills, including planning, resourcing, risk management, and structured status reporting to executive stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a small technical team.
Demonstrated data fluency: able to structure an analytical question, validate the underlying data, and present the result credibly to executives. Experience with business intelligence tools and with native EHR report writers.

Education and/or Experience
:

Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, information systems, computer science, healthcare administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred. Equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered.
Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive experience in clinical application configuration, systems analysis, or EHR implementation required.
Minimum of two (2) years of direct people leadership or formal project leadership experience required.
Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end requirements gathering for clinical or enterprise software initiatives required.
Hands-on configuration experience with at least one enterprise EHR or practice management platform required; behavioral health, substance use disorder, or OTP platform experience strongly preferred.
Experience supporting multi-site EHR implementation, consolidation, or data migration required.
Working knowledge of interfaces and integration (HL7, FHIR, API, SFTP) required. Demonstrated hands-on SQL experience is required and will be assessed during the interview process.
Knowledge of OTP and OBOT operations, including methadone and buprenorphine dispensing workflows, take-home regulations, and 42 CFR Part 2, strongly preferred.
Experience with a healthcare clearinghouse and familiarity with revenue cycle workflows preferred.
Professional certification such as CPHIMS, CAHIMS, PMP, Certified Scrum Product Owner, Six Sigma, or vendor-specific application certification preferred.
Ability to travel to clinic sites as required to support implementations, go-lives, and workflow assessments.
Experience building reports, extracts, or dashboards used by operational or executive leadership required; experience owning data validation for a system conversion strongly preferred.

This role will support one of the world's leading hyperscale cloud and data center customers, serving as the strategic business leader responsible for operational execution, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and long-term growth.

As a member of the site leadership team, you will oversee the overall success of a complex customer portfolio supporting next-generation data center infrastructure deployments. Lead business planning activities supporting customer growth, infrastructure expansion, and capacity scaling initiatives.
Ensure alignment between customer demand forecasts and operational capabilities.

Data Center Infrastructure Program Leadership

Oversee complex manufacturing programs supporting large-scale data center infrastructure deployments.
Drive capacity planning strategies to meet aggressive customer growth requirements and market demand.
Support new product introductions, production ramp-ups, infrastructure expansions, and operational readiness initiatives.
Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex supply chain, operational, and customer challenges.

Strong background in operational management, capacity planning, and cross-functional leadership.

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Position Overview

Citi is looking for a Director of Applications Development to lead the Customer Management domain within the Banking Operations organization, a function at the heart of Citi's customer management technology across Retail Banking, Wealth Technology and Mortgage. In this role, you will direct a team of engineering professionals, own a portfolio of technology investments, and shape the architectural direction of platforms that millions of customers depend on. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an experienced technology executive ready to drive business growth, operational excellence, and digital transformation at scale within a global financial institution. The ideal candidate is a proven leader who excels at building, mentoring, and unifying teams of managers and engineers . You are not just a leader, but a master craftsman who understands the intricate connections between customer demographics, client onboarding, CRM, Advisor tools, and the data transformations that powers them all. Critically, this role requires a hands-on practitioner with proven experience in designing and building enterprise-scale banking and wealth management systems, and who is an active AI practitioner, well-versed in using AI to augment the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization of professionals across multiple technical teams, setting clear direction on roles, accountability structures, and performance standards to maximize delivery effectiveness.
Own the architectural vision for the Customer Management domain, overseeing the design and evolution of systems spanning SOR platforms, Salesforce integrations, and Next-Generation Architecture built on Angular, Microservices, and Artificial Intelligence.
Manage a complex portfolio of 50+ active technology investments, balancing competing priorities across Retail Banking, Wealth Technology and Mortgage business lines to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery.
Provide executive oversight for a large portfolio of applications, including franchise-critical System of records and SaaS platforms , ensuring stability, compliance, govern safety & soundness and continuous improvement.
Oversee large-scale strategic programs, such as infrastructure migrations to public cloud and major customer data conversions across LOBs and technology tool migrations leveraging AI tools.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence and build consensus with senior executives, peers, and engineers across technology organizations.
Establish and govern technology delivery standards, ensuring all teams maintain current documentation, follow approved procedures, and operate within Citi's policy and control frameworks.
Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders across multiple lines of business to align engineering priorities with strategic objectives, presenting regular program reviews and progress updates to executive leadership.
Oversee change management processes for new and revised systems, ensuring appropriate controls, documentation, and approvals are in place for all implementations, including regulatory reporting changes.
Manage disaster recovery planning across the portfolio, overseeing testing cycles and approving permit-to-operate status for new applications entering production.
Assess technology and delivery risk across the organization, escalating issues with transparency and implementing corrective measures that protect the firm's operational integrity and client commitments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

15 or more years of experience in technology delivery or applications development within a large-scale, complex organization.
8 to 10 or more years of direct people management experience, including leading senior engineering managers and managing multi-team organizations through performance cycles, hiring, and organizational development.
Demonstrated ability to manage large engineering teams and multi-investment technology portfolios with accountability for quality, budget, and strategic outcomes.
Experience delivering technology solutions within the financial services industry, with working knowledge of financial products and the competitive landscape.
Advanced understanding of technology strategy and the ability to align engineering direction with business objectives at a senior organizational level.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant field.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

Master's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or Business Administration.
Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering architectures including Microservices, Angular-based front-end frameworks, Salesforce platform integrations, or AI-enabled application development.
Experience managing technology programs that span both legacy system environments and next-generation platform migrations.

What We Offer

Joining Citi at this level means taking ownership of technology that directly shapes the experience of Citi's customers and the performance of its most critical business lines. You will operate at the intersection of strategic leadership and technical delivery, with the authority and resources to make a lasting impact on one of the world's leading financial institutions.

Strategic influence over a large-scale engineering organization and a broad portfolio of high-value technology investments that underpin Citi's customer-facing platforms.
Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing flexibility alongside meaningful in-person collaboration.
The opportunity to accelerate digital transformation by driving the transition from legacy infrastructure to next-generation architecture across a globally significant technology function.
Direct partnership with senior business leaders and executives across multiple lines of business, positioning you at the center of Citi's technology decision-making.
Access to Citi's global learning and development resources, supporting continued professional growth at the most senior levels of the organization.
Competitive financial wellbeing package and benefits aligned to the seniority and scope of this role.
A performance-driven environment within a global institution where engineering leadership is recognized as central to business success.

Apply today to take senior ownership of Citi's Customer Management engineering organization and lead the technology transformation that will define the next generation of customer experience across a global financial institution.

jobs.description:
DIRECTOR, DIGITAL ENGINEERING

Thresh Consulting — Strategy in Action for the AI Era

Salary: $250,000–$295,000 + up to 30% performance-based bonus and equity potential
Location: Hybrid with client travel (NYC, Chicago or Denver preferred)

ABOUT THRESH

Thresh Consulting is a modern digital consulting firm built for the AI era—where strategy, execution, and craft come together to deliver real outcomes with speed. Our specialty is helping organizations design, build, and scale digital products that create exceptional customer experiences and drive measurable value.

ROLE OVERVIEW

This role will lead Thresh's rapidly growing Digital Engineering practice, owning delivery quality across every engagement, driving talent strategy and technical hiring, and pushing innovation across AI-enabled digital engineering that keeps Thresh ahead of the market.

You will define how the Digital Engineering practice embraces agentic AI, from single-agent loops to multi-agent orchestration graphs, to radically compress the distance between spec and shipped code, raising the bar on both engineering quality and the speed from concept to production.

You'll work closely with clients, leading technical strategy and full-stack delivery teams as the hands-on engineering leader for Thresh. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and others to scaffold applications and prototype complex features in real time, showing the team and clients what modern engineering velocity looks like.

This is a leadership-team seat, not simply an engineering lead role. We are looking for a rare combination: a deeply technical engineer and a polished, credible communicator. Someone equally comfortable diving into a complex architecture challenge and standing in front of a client CTO. You will own outcomes, and share in the upside that comes with them.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

PRACTICE LEADERSHIP & GROWTH

Develop new engineering offerings and points of view (e.g., AI-native delivery cycles, spec-driven development) that differentiate Thresh in the market.
Partner with the founders on demand planning, staffing, and the practice's contribution to firm growth.
Set the technical culture and quality bar for the practice, and represent Digital Engineering in firm-level decisions.
Sit on the firm's leadership team, contributing to firm strategy beyond engineering and carrying accountability for the practice as a business line, not just a delivery function.

AI-NATIVE DEVELOPMENT & PROTOTYPING

Build functional prototypes and MVPs in hours, not weeks, using tools like Cursor and Claude Code — whether live in client discovery sessions to unblock decision-making, or internally to validate concepts and show the team what modern engineering velocity looks like.
Establish spec-driven development as the default: typed contracts, version-controlled alongside code, written so an agent can implement against them and an experienced engineer can verify correctness against the spec rather than the diff.
Stand up evaluation harnesses and quality gates for AI-generated code so velocity never outruns correctness — tests, evals, and review patterns that make speed safe.
Design agentic workflows and orchestration, including MCP-based tool and context integration, so AI tooling compounds across the team rather than forking it.
Make build-vs-buy-vs-agent architecture calls and define Thresh's AI-assisted development stack, so every engineer spends time on business logic and innovation rather than boilerplate and repetitive patterns.

TECHNICAL STRATEGY & ARCHITECTURE

Define the technical north star for client engagements, balancing speed, quality, scale, security, and maintainability in every framework and architecture decision.
Architect enterprise-grade, full-stack applications — our default greenfield stack is Next.js + TypeScript on the front-end and Node, Go, or Python on the server, with the AI workflow layer built around the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs — while remaining pragmatic and working in the client's existing stack for brownfield work, and staying ahead of the curve on emerging frameworks and AI-assisted development practices.
Own reliability, accessibility, and compliance from day one — Core Web Vitals, error budgets, accessibility baselines, and incident readiness — and engineer to the security posture each engagement requires (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI), working directly with the client's security team.
Bridge the gap between Design and Engineering by leveraging AI to translate Figma designs into production-ready component code via token-driven, system-aware pipelines.

ENGINEERING LEADERSHIP

Lead, develop, and grow the Digital Engineering team — earning trust with engineers and raising the bar.
Coach your team on the fast-evolving AI-native delivery toolchain — coding agents, evals, orchestration, and whatever comes next — ensuring the team compounds velocity, quality, and creative problem-solving as the landscape shifts.
Conduct code reviews focused on architecture, logic, and patterns — not syntax checks that AI can handle.
Create a culture of continuous learning where engineers are always exploring new tools, techniques, and ways to deliver value faster.
Balance team capacity across multiple client engagements, ensuring quality and sustainability even when demand is high.

CLIENT ENGAGEMENT & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

Serve as Thresh's senior technical voice with client engineering leadership, setting the tone for exceptional delivery standards.
Own the technical relationship with C-suite and senior client stakeholders, presenting strategy and roadmaps as a trusted advisor.
Drive scoping, estimation, and proposal development for new engagements, shaping deal structure and technical approach before a contract is signed.
Design and lead clean handoffs to in-house client teams, ensuring Thresh's technical credibility outlasts any single engagement.

WHAT YOU BRING

10-15+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise across the modern full-stack, including architecting complex, scalable systems and delivering production-ready software under tight timelines.
Expertise in AI coding assistants: you should be a power user of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools
, capable of demonstrating how these tools transform the development lifecycle, including spec-driven development, evals for AI-generated code, and agent orchestration in production.
5-8+ years of engineering management experience, comfortable balancing strategic leadership with tactical execution: zooming out to set direction, then zooming in to unblock an engineer.
Polished, credible communicator, equally comfortable diving into a complex architecture problem with engineers and presenting strategy to a client CTO or executive audience.
Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward experimentation, always exploring what's possible with new tools and techniques, not limited to AI.
Practice-building or offering-development experience with a business development mindset: you've developed a team or capability as a business, not just delivered projects within one.
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience is strongly preferred, with a track record of owning commercial outcomes on the engagements you lead, protecting margin and growing account value, not just delivering to spec.

WHY THRESH

Competitive compensation and performance bonus eligibility.
Healthcare benefits and 401(k) with company match.
Opportunity to work on modern, high-impact products utilizing cutting-edge AI-assisted development tools.
A culture built on clarity, craft, and teamwork, with a commitment to human competency amplified by AI tools.
Lean, partner-led teams that ship fast: your work reaches production, not slideware
A seat at the leadership table and a compensation structure built to reward high performers.

What Is the Opportunity?

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

4+ years of hands-on software development experience, including demonstrated production delivery of AI solutions you have supported at scale.

The Associate VP, Technology Solution Implementation delivers new technological solutions to meet business needs within a specified scope while aligned to enterprise objectives. The Associate VP, Technology Solution Implementation requires a in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across segments and/or enterprise-wide.

The Associate VP, CenterWell Primary Care Technology leads engineering across a key segment of CenterWell Primary Care’s product offerings. The individual in this role is responsible for driving a team with full autonomy to deliver solutions supportive of the organizations “big rocks”. This individual influences system design to optimize support and ensures solutions meet the business objectives and requirements. The AVP, CenterWell Primary Care Technology’s team completes and coordinates implementation of design and requirements, testing, operational readiness, and transition to the appropriate production support team. The individual in this role will have strong working knowledge of contemporary cloud and data tools, concepts, and patterns, while also being a savvy partner to our business product and strategy leaders and can co-lead technology-rich business objectives. The ideal candidate will have experience delivering both greenfield capabilities and SaaS enhancements, while also having a strong delivery and program management background. Finally, the individual in this role will bring to the organization a wealth of relevant healthcare technology experience.

Responsibilities Include

Transform Provider Productivity Through AI at Scale. Lead the design and deployment of AI-driven capabilities including ambient documentation, chart summarization, pre-visit planning, coding assistance, inbox automation, prescription workflows, and intelligent clinical decision support. Measure success through reductions in provider administrative time, improved clinician satisfaction, and increased patient-facing capacity.
Own the Technology Portfolio Supporting Practice Operations. Direct the technology roadmap for front-office, back-office, and clinic operations, including patient access, scheduling, referrals, care team workflows, intake processes, operational command centers, workflow automation, and practice performance tools. Balance operational reliability with delivery of new capabilities that improve clinic efficiency and patient experience across multi-state markets.
Drive Executive-Level Business Outcomes Through Data and Operational Intelligence.

Partner with operational and clinical leaders to translate complex business challenges into technology solutions. Lead the development of operational data assets, automation capabilities, AI-enabled insights, and decision-support platforms that improve quality performance, risk adjustment, cost of care management, productivity, and growth objectives.

Lead Large-Scale Strategic Initiatives Across the Primary Care Enterprise. Serve as the technology executive responsible for major transformation programs including EMR optimization, AI adoption, workflow modernization, acquisitions and clinic integrations, operational resilience initiatives, and growth enablement programs. Regularly engage with senior executives to align investment priorities, manage risks, and ensure delivery of measurable business value.
Build the Future State of Intelligent Care Delivery Operations. Establish the long-term strategy for AI-enabled practice operations by identifying opportunities to automate manual work, orchestrate clinical and operational workflows, leverage agentic AI capabilities, and create reusable technology platforms that can be scaled across the Primary Care organization. Drive innovation while maintaining strong governance, operational excellence, and responsible AI practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

12+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for product development, engineering, data, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
5+ years leading cross-functional teams comprised of product managers, software engineers, data scientists, UX designers, architects, and clinical informaticists.
Demonstrated success delivering AI-enabled products and operational capabilities at enterprise scale.
Deep understanding of healthcare delivery workflows, particularly primary care, care management, quality improvement, value-based care, and provider operations.
Experience designing and implementing modern data platforms, interoperability solutions, and AI/ML ecosystems leveraging cloud-native architectures.
Proven ability to translate business, clinical, and operational needs into technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
Track record of creating exceptional user experiences for physicians, advanced practice providers, clinical staff, patients, and operational associates.
Strong understanding of human-centered design principles, user research methodologies, journey mapping, and digital product development.
Experience leading enterprise AI strategy, including generative AI, predictive analytics, intelligent workflow automation, decision support, and responsible AI governance.
Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including FHIR, HL7, APIs, and healthcare data exchange ecosystems.
Experience working with clinical, claims, operational, and consumer-generated health data.
Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing technology organizations through organizational growth, operating model transformation, and talent development.
Ability to effectively influence executive leaders, physicians, business stakeholders, and external partners without direct authority.
Strong financial management experience, including investment planning, vendor management, contract negotiations, business case development, and benefits realization.
Experience establishing product operating models, agile delivery practices, and outcome-based performance management.
Exceptional communication and leadership presence with experience presenting to senior executives, CIOs, CMIOs, clinical leaders, and boards.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$172,200 - $236,900 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description Of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: VP, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Expion Health is building the future of pharmacy economics.
As architects of prescription economics, we design how pharmacy value is created, aligning cost, clinical decisions, and performance into one accountable system that moves beyond rebates. We help organizations stay ahead of pharmacy market change with clear insight, bold thinking, and strategies built for what's next, leading the next era of prescription economics.

The Role

The VP of Technology Operations will serve as a strategic partner to the CIO/CTO, helping translate Expion Health's business priorities into scalable technology, product, data, and operational solutions. This role is intended to strengthen enterprise technology leadership by owning business solution architecture, platform roadmaps, product delivery alignment, and cross-functional execution, while partnering closely with existing infrastructure, support, and security leadership.

This is a rare kind of technology role. You will not sit above the work handing down blueprints, and you will not be buried in a single workstream. You will carry both: the judgment to shape where Expion's technology goes, grounded in real healthcare payer market knowledge, and the discipline to get a cross functional team across business solutions, delivery, and platform functions aligned and moving.

You will lead a team of employees and contractors, own a significant technology budget, and collaborate directly with our Chief Transformation Officer. If you have spent your career building technology in healthcare, understand what clients actually need, and want the authority to modernize the platform that meets that need, this role was built for you.

What You'll Own

Technology Leadership:
Collaborate with business unit leaders and provide leadership and support by developing data-driven strategies and recommendations that help them meet our strategic goals and objectives
Build technology strategy, product roadmaps and technology blueprints in collaboration with business unit leaders and operational leaders
Provide strategic and analytical support to senior leadership when evaluating and updating organizational goals and objectives
Create actionable insights and understandings through the analysis of both quantitative and qualitative data, building recommendations that directly address organizational goal and objectives
Work directly with senior leadership to identify, analyze and address key business opportunities and critical business challenges

Product Delivery:
Provide leadership and strategic guidance during the development, commercialization, implementation, and scaling of new products and platform capabilities.
Manage product delivery, engineering, operations, and client-facing teams to ensure roadmap priorities are clearly defined, delivery dependencies are managed, and the organization is prepared for successful rollout, ongoing service delivery, and growth.
Ensure implementations are delivered on time, aligned to approved roadmap priorities, operationally supportable, and measured against adoption, client satisfaction, scalability, quality, and business value outcomes.
Ensure ongoing operations are executed on-time as per expectations

Team Development:
Responsible for resource and budget forecasting to accomplish deliverables.
Collaborate with technical architects and engineering teams to develop the scalable solutions
Provide leadership, strategic direction, and management for delivering solutions

Collaboration:
Collaborate with functional and cross-organizational leaders to ensure that all Product, Sales and Client initiatives are successfully delivered
Collaborate with business leaders to ensure strategic roadmaps meet the business ongoing and future needs
Ensure that business goals are supported in a cost effective, timely manner, with a resulting high level of client satisfaction.
Work closely with sales and marketing teams to accurately represent capabilities of products
Support Sales in business development efforts as required

Take on other work as needed to support the broader goals of the department and the company.

Scope & Mandate

Role

This role owns a significant technology budget and a team spanning business solutions, delivery, and platform functions, combining direct employees and contract resources. Priority mandates for the first 12 to 18 months include:

Increase operational efficiency with automation and agentic AI solutions
Significantly compress implementation timelines, moving toward a leaner, faster delivery model
Ensure reliability and quality of technical Operations

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, healthcare administration, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus, but real experience matters more.
10 or more years of progressive experience in technology and business architecture, with a genuine command of the healthcare payer industry, medical claims cost management, and payer business process design.
Demonstrated knowledge of developing technology strategy to advance business models in medical claims cost management solutions
Demonstrated knowledge on leveraging technology tools to enable business operations or deliver new products
Demonstrated ability to scale technology operations
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business leaders to develop solutions
Demonstrated ability to adapt to changes in business and keep up with the industry
Demonstrated ability to execute on strategic vision on time and on budget
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders
Be comfortable with being part of a collaborative, nimble, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, startup-like environment
Enjoy pushing your skills and development to manage ambiguity, be adaptable, and cultivate innovation
Be comfortable getting into details and being part of execution as much as discussing and developing strategy

Bonus Points For

Experience building technology in pharmacy benefit management, health plan, or payer environments.
A track record guiding architects and engineers to scalable solutions that support analytics, automation, and AI enabled workflows, without owning technical delivery yourself.
Strategic thinking sharp enough to hold a long-term vision while still driving what needs to happen this quarter.
A knack for building real cross functional relationships and getting a growing organization to move in the same direction.
Genuine comfort navigating ambiguity and solving problems in an environment that is still being built.

Why Expion, Why Now

Expion Health is not asking whether pharmacy economics needs to change. We have decided, and we are building. This role carries real authority: you own a significant technology budget and the calls on how ExpionIQ gets built, and the platform you shape will be used by the health plans, employers, and PBMs who trust us with their pharmacy performance. You will inherit a strong foundation and a mandate to take it further, not a blank page and no support.

Own the outcome
and build boldly, improve relentlessly
are not slogans here. They are how we expect this role to operate. If you are ready to bring real healthcare technology expertise and real ownership to a growing organization, we want to talk.

Benefits & Perks

100% remote – work anywhere in the US
Medical, dental & vision insurance
HSA & FSA options
Access to GLP-1 weight loss program
Short & long-term disability
Life Insurance and AD&D
401(k) with company match
Paid Time Off
Phone & internet allowance
Town halls & direct access to executive leadership
A company that is genuinely investing in AI – and in you!

Expion Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Director of Business Systems & Technology | Quote to Cash
jobs.description:
Transform the systems that power the full customer and revenue lifecycle. As Director of Business Systems, you will lead the strategy, architecture, optimization, and execution of our end-to-end Quote-to-Cash technology ecosystem across Salesforce, CPQ, revenue recognition, ERP, billing, order management, and integrations. You will be responsible for building scalable, automated, and data-driven processes that support rapid organic growth, operational transformation, and potential acquisitions. We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and hands-on leader who can translate business priorities into scalable technology solutions while driving measurable improvements across Sales, Finance, Operations, and the customer experience.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the end-to-end Quote-to-Cash systems strategy, architecture, roadmap, and operating model across opportunity management, CPQ, pricing, approvals, contracting, order management, billing, revenue recognition, collections, renewals, reporting, and analytics.
Lead the strategic direction and continuous improvement of Salesforce and CPQ, including product catalogs, bundles, pricing rules, discounting, approvals, amendments, renewals, contract terms, data governance, integrations, releases, and technical debt.
Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Accounting to streamline commercial and financial processes, reduce quote-to-order cycle time, automate ASC 606 revenue recognition, improve billing accuracy, and minimize manual intervention.
Design and govern scalable integrations across Salesforce, CPQ, RightRev, ERP, billing, payments, and other critical platforms, establishing reliable monitoring, error handling, reconciliation, security, controls, and data lineage.
Lead cross-functional business transformation by identifying process bottlenecks, eliminating unnecessary manual work and duplicate systems, applying workflow automation and AI, and establishing KPIs such as quote velocity, order-processing efficiency, billing accuracy, manual touchpoints, and data quality.
Develop a multi-year Business Systems roadmap aligned with corporate growth and value-creation priorities, including repeatable technology integration playbooks for acquired companies, products, customers, and systems.
Build and lead a high-performing Business Systems organization while managing strategic implementation partners, vendors, budgets, governance, prioritization, release management, and executive stakeholder communication.

What You Will Likely Bring

12+ years’ experience in Business Systems, Enterprise Applications, Revenue Operations Technology, Finance Systems, or related disciplines, including demonstrated success leading or transforming complex Quote-to-Cash environments in high-growth organizations.
Deep experience with Salesforce and CPQ, along with strong knowledge of ERP, billing, order management, revenue recognition, financial systems, master data, data governance, controls, reporting, and enterprise system architecture.
Strong understanding of ASC 606 and its technology implications, with experience integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, billing, and revenue recognition platforms to support complex commercial and revenue events.
Proven experience leading large-scale systems implementations, business transformations, process redesign initiatives, and complex integrations while scaling systems through rapid organizational growth.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Sales, Finance, Operations, Accounting, and executive leadership.
Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, combining business acumen, analytical thinking, technical depth, urgency, accountability, and a focus on measurable outcomes.

What Could Set You Apart

Experience with RightRev or a comparable revenue recognition platform.
Experience operating in a private-equity-backed, sponsor-driven, highly acquisitive, or similarly fast-paced growth environment, including technology integration following mergers or acquisitions.
A track record of challenging legacy processes, building scalable operating models, and applying automation and AI to improve revenue, margin, cash flow, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer. 

Range

Minimum: $163,000 USD Maximum: $277,000 USD

The salary range provided reflects the national average for this job title and does not represent compensation specific to Epicor Software Corporation. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and market factors relevant to the position.

jobs.title: Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
About Chalk

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineering is where Chalk meets its customers. Our FDEs are exceptional software engineers who integrate Chalk’s platform with the best ML and engineering teams in healthcare, finance, and consumer technology — running technical pilots that win deals, onboarding new customers, and engineering feature pipelines that power use cases like fraud prevention, cancer detection, and product recommendation.
Working directly with our founders, you'll lead this team and define its future. You'll own the strategy for how Chalk engages customers technically — from pre-sales pilots through onboarding, support, and expansion — and build the organization, processes, and playbooks that let the function scale with our growth. FDE is one of the most strategically important and fastest-growing functions at Chalk, and this role will shape what it becomes.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What you will do

Lead, develop, and retain Chalk's team of Forward Deployed Engineers across New York and San Francisco, and own an aggressive hiring plan as the team scales

Own the systems that make the team run — support triage and rotations, escalation paths to Engineering, onboarding playbooks, and the processes for rolling out platform changes to customer environments
Partner closely with Sales and GTM leadership on technical pilots, evaluations, and the technical strategy behind our most important deals
Partner with Engineering leadership to channel customer learnings into the product roadmap and to sharpen the internal tooling FDEs rely on
Stay hands-on: dive into customer architectures, unblock hard technical problems, and set the technical bar for the team

What we're looking for

10+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years leading customer-facing engineering teams (forward deployed, solutions architecture, field engineering, or similar)

Experience across both pre-sales and post-sales complex enterprise motions: technical pilots and evaluations as well as onboarding, support, and account expansion

jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

The Director E&E, Delivery is both a people manager and client leader. This person has a disciplined approach to managing our most important clients through project and program management whether it is a single large project or multiple projects that make up a program. The successful candidate is detail-oriented but can also think of the ‘big picture’ strategy to drive our client’s business forward, while building long-lasting client relationships. Has the ability to manage various types of concurrent projects from research & strategy, design, development, and deployment of web and software products. Capable of managing complex programs with multiple projects and project management resources in dynamic client environments. Has strong client-facing and strategic leadership experience along with expert program/project management skills. Has extensive experience managing direct reports with a focus on performance, career growth, and project/program management skills. They will use their expertise to coach and grow their team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Define, manage and execute various types of creative projects for clients in order to maximize client business objectives, manage client expectations, and maintain profitability.
Establish the creative operating model, communication, plan and tools to be used by the program to ensure successful delivery.
Directly manage creative project management team members, providing ongoing mentorship, career development, and performance guidance.
Ability to coach team members on best practices and act as a partner in solving client challenges.
Lead the development and implementation of standardized creative processes and tools across the Delivery team.
Oversee and deliver daily internal and client-facing status updates for engagements
Balance strategic and operational thinking with strong attention to detail and execution.
Serve as the primary point of contact between clients and internal creative teams, ensuring clear and consistent project communication.
Make creative resourcing recommendations and monitor team bandwidth and effectiveness; assess program pacing and delivery health to ensure viability. Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills. The ideal candidate will not be hesitant to have conversations with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the success of the project or program.
Excellent problem solving, organization, time management, and risk management skills.
Experience in management and merging project artifacts into a program scale set of artifacts used to orchestrate the larger set of initiatives and optimize delivery and minimize negative risk.

Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
