jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Development - Clients & Accounts
jobs.description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About The Team

Clients & Accounts Platform (CAP) owns the core client and account models at the heart of our product — the foundation every other team builds on top of. We build the uncompromising, simple, fully digital in-app onboarding experience Wealthsimple is known for, guiding clients from sign-up through funded accounts in minutes, not days, and almost always with no human intervention. On the backend, our platform defines and enforces the compliance and product requirements every team relies on; on the frontend, we orchestrate the onboarding modules — KYC, identity verification, agreement signing, and more — that show up across nearly every Wealthsimple product.

We're a full-stack team, and we're both platform-facing (other engineering teams are our customers) and product-facing (clients are). Our services are critical tier — when they go down, most of Wealthsimple stops working — so we hold ourselves to five nines of uptime while still shipping and iterating at tech-company speed. It's demanding work, and one of the highest-impact places to build at Wealthsimple.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager to lead Accounts Engineering, one of the teams inside CAP. Accounts Engineering builds new account types (Business Accounts, RESPs, and more), defines the core account configurations that unlock new product features, and evolves the account domain model that the rest of the company builds against. You'll manage a team of roughly 8 full-stack developers.

This team moves fast. There is always more demand than capacity — no shortage of ideas, product asks, or backlog. Your job is to turn that pressure into a high-velocity, high-quality team that ships work the company can rely on for years.

In this role you'll have the opportunity to:

Build and lead a high-velocity, high-quality full-stack engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance managing, and promoting senior ICs
Orchestrate and drive alignment on the team's architectural north star, and make sure every project ladders up to it
Partner with Product and Data Science to define the team's roadmap and resource projects — and make the hard prioritization calls when the list of things we want to do is (as always) larger than what we can actually do
Review, critique, and contribute to project technical planning — and stay close enough to the work to drive projects through to launch without surprises
Own your team's operational excellence: reliability, on-call health, SLAs, and the day-to-day quality of what we ship
Keep the team on the leading edge of AI-assisted engineering — across planning, code review, incident response, and anywhere else it can compound — and keep pushing that edge, treating "how much faster AI can make us" as a question we never stop asking

What we're looking for:

4+ years managing high-performance software development teams through multiple successful product launches, including coaching and growing senior and staff ICs
Strong full-stack technical background — system design chops are essential, and front-end depth is a real plus. You lead from the front technically: you can sit in a design review and push back with substance, and you can spot what's missing in a project plan before the team does
A "ship it" mentality: you set a high bar for pace, iteration, and quality, and you build a team culture around it — including having the hard conversations when someone isn't meeting the bar
A track record of building teams from the ground up — hiring, performance managing, and promoting
Comfort operating under real pressure: you treat "we don't have enough capacity" as a strategy problem, not a complaint, and you make strong, opinionated calls when there's more to do than time to do it
Metrics-oriented: you don't speculate, you prove. You expect the same of the engineers you lead
An AI-first mindset — you use AI as a core part of how you and your team work, not as a side experiment
A strong communicator who makes their team's work visible across the organization and manages upward and across effectively — negotiating priorities with peer managers, setting expectations with stakeholders, and making sure leadership understands the trade-offs behind the roadmap

Nice-to-have's:

Experience in the fintech or banking industry
Experience managing both platform teams (where other engineering teams are your customers) and product teams (where clients are)
Hands-on experience with Rails, Kotlin, and/or React
Deep experience across both backend and frontend development
Comfortable writing your own SQL to answer your own questions about the business

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple:
We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement:
We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement:
We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring:
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

Responsible to provide senior leadership and technical/operational support to Engineering teams across all regions. Also provide support for environmental compliance, ADA compliance, acquisition, third party surveys, and Property Condition Assessments
Act as a resource for all technical operations as needed to include system air and hydraulic balancing reports, boiler, chiller and cooling tower maintenance and performance; mechanical and electrical system noise, vibration control, tenant work orders and preventative maintenance, and equipment overhauls or replacements
Develop and maintain engineering and operations procedures to include preventative maintenance, energy management, water treatment, fire life safety, environmental health and safety, physical asset and team development, hazardous materials communications plan, indoor air quality programs, budget operating costs estimates, and comparisons

jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About The Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations
, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach
role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.
Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.
Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.
Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.
Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.
Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.
Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.
Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.
Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.
Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.
Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.
Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.
Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.
Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

Experience

What Will Make You Successful

Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS
Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team
Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.
Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.
Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.
Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.
Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.
You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.
You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.
Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.
Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

What we offer:

Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk
Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of 20 vacation days and 12 public holidays
Enjoy the flexibility of three medical plans to choose from, with company contributions and an HSA when enrolling in an HDHP medical plan
Take control of your physical health with additional comprehensive benefit plans, covering dental, vision and Wellhub’s gym subscription from your start date
Rest assured that you’re covered by life and disability policies from your start date, with options to add extra protection through voluntary buy-up plans
Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan with company matching contributions
Care for your furry friends through partner discounts on pet insurance
Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party
Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones
Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave
Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes
Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years
Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Compensation
:

Compensation for this role is a combination of salary and stock options. The anticipated base salary range is $190,000 - $240,000 per year. Actual compensation may vary based on specific qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About The Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations
, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach
role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.
Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.
Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.
Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.
Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.
Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.
Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.
Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.
Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.
Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.
Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.
Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.
Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.
Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

Experience

What Will Make You Successful

Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS
Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team
Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.
Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.
Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.
Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.
Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.
You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.
You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.
Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.
Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of 20 vacation days and 12 public holidays
Enjoy the flexibility of three medical plans to choose from, with company contributions and an HSA when enrolling in an HDHP medical plan

Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

jobs.title: Lead Director - AI Governance Engineering
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

AI adoption across the organization is accelerating, and existing governance processes can add cycle time and rely heavily on manual review.

We are building an AI Governance Engineering capability to modernize governance through automation—shifting from approval-heavy workflows to registration-driven workflows with built-in controls, and continuous observability.

As Lead Director, AI Governance Engineering, you will create and lead a lean engineering team responsible for delivering governance-as-code:

platform-agnostic SDKs, APIs, and automated controls that help teams move faster while ensuring responsible AI guardrails are consistently enforced.

Key Responsibilities

Automated Use Case Intake & Risk Classification

Design unified intake APIs and user experiences that reduce friction and automatically populate metadata and integrate with application registration and provisioning workflows
Implement dynamic intake flows for ML, Generative AI, and agentic use cases.
Deliver automated inherent risk scoring and risk-based routing to provisioning and monitoring workflows.

Governance-as-Code Toolkits

Partner with AI Governance Data Scient to develop a platform-agnostic Python/SDK offering automated governance controls such as bias, drift, and AI safety testing.
Integrate governance checks into CI/CD pipelines so evidence is generated during development.

Enterprise Model & Use Case Registry Integration

Enable event-driven ingestion of intake data and model artifacts into the enterprise registry.
Support automated generation of audit-ready compliance artifacts and APIs for reviewers and auditors.

Self-Service Enablement & Automation

Expand policy-based routing for low- and high-risk AI use cases.
Automate proof-of-concept lifecycle patterns and accelerate access to approved AI environments.

Governance for Agentic Automation

Establish execution safety patterns for internal AI agents, including permission-scoped actions.
Partner with information security to implement runtime guardrails such as prompt filtering, data protection controls, and real-time observability.

Leadership & Collaboration

Build and lead a small, high-impact AI Governance Engineering team.
Partner with AI platform teams, governance, security, and privacy partners to embed technical controls into development workflows.
Define and track outcomes such as reduced intake complexity, faster cycle times, and improved governance transparency.

Required Qualifications

Experience leading software or platform engineering teams.
Strong system architecture skills across APIs, automation, CI/CD, and data platforms.
Experience building developer-facing tools such as SDKs, templates, or automation frameworks.
Familiarity with ML and Generative AI lifecycles and how governance controls can be validated through automation.
Ability to translate governance or risk requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Responsible AI concepts such as fairness, transparency, explainability, and auditability.
Experience integrating automated quality gates into Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
Background working in regulated or high-trust technology environments.

Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Analytics, Engineering, or related discipline. Master's degree preferred

What Success Looks Like

AI intake processes are simpler, faster, and largely automated.
Engineering teams have reusable SDKs and templates that make responsible AI the default.
Validation of controls shifts from self-reporting to automated checks and evidence.
Centralized observability provides real-time insight into AI usage, performance, and risk.

If you are excited about building trusted AI systems through practical engineering, we encourage you to apply—even if you do not meet every qualification listed. We value collaboration, learning, and curiosity.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

team — the team that owns the infrastructure and platform the rest of engineering builds on. From cloud infrastructure and databases to deployment pipelines, observability, and production operations, Foundations is responsible for keeping Qualified running reliably at scale while accelerating every product team that builds on top of it. Strong software engineering background with proficiency in languages such as Go, Python, TypeScript, or Ruby — this team builds software, not just operates systems.

Proficiency in agentic, AI-assisted development practices, with the ability to drive their adoption across a team.
A "driver" mindset: proactive, outcomes-oriented, and unafraid to roll up your sleeves when needed.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially in cross-functional leadership settings.

High-Growth Environment: Join us at a pivotal stage where you can establish best practices that will scale with our rapid growth and expansion.
Cutting-Edge AI: Lead a team operating the platform behind AI-powered B2B products, and drive agentic engineering practices that define how modern platform teams work.

If you're ready to take on a high-visibility role where you'll build the team behind the platform and help shape the future of our AI-powered products, we'd love to hear from you.

Unleash Your Potential

Lead, coach, and develop IAM engineers, contractors, and technical specialists.
Own operational health, support, maintenance, and engineering delivery for the myComcastAccess platform.
Drive SailPoint IdentityIQ and Radiant Logic platform strategy, adoption, and enhancements.
Manage IAM operations, escalations, service reliability, and capacity planning.
Partner across Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Application, and Business teams.

jobs.description:
Must be CST or EST

The Engineering and Business Systems team works collaboratively across Chainalysis’ Business Automation, Data and Systems organization to ensure that core business systems and platforms enable business policies and operational processes. Our job is to empower employees to do their best work by building the foundational systems and data products that drive business decisions and processes while accelerating Chainalysis’ growth.

As the Director, Business Systems & Platform Engineering, you’ll be at the forefront of positioning our technical teams to thrive in an AI-driven shift to headless, API and MCP-driven business systems architectures. You’ll own the integrated technical roadmap for building out the technology architecture as well as the underlying administration and engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software and data engineering leadership depth and can ramp quickly on the GTM and Finance systems domain. The role will lead a small organization that encompasses platform engineering, data engineering, integration engineering and systems administration.

In This Role, You'll

Lead the systems and engineering org through a shift from a traditional IT and admin-centric org to one centered around platform and data engineering.
Own the technical architecture, design, and delivery roadmap across business systems, enterprise data and integrations.
Directly manage and grow systems and engineering-track managers and direct reports including technical mentorship and career pathing.
Collaborate with team members to establish and codify standards, style guides, workflows, ceremonies and other engineering and systems practices into a single, coherent operating model that leverages AI and agentic processes.
Partner with colleagues in Product, Success and Program Management to prioritize and deliver the BADaS roadmap by translating business, process and product requirements into technical scope, staffing, and sequencing decisions.
Act as the internal technical counterpart to vendors and partners, including reviewing architecture proposals, approving technical designs, and owning technical builds.
Own security, RBAC, and data-governance posture of BADaS platforms, especially from an audit and access-control risk perspective.
Partner with engineering leaders across Chainalysis on best practices and to leverage platforms, components, solutions and code-bases that already exist.

We're Looking For Candidates Who Have

8+ years of experience in software, platform, or data engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers and engineering managers.
Strong organizational leadership: hiring, career pathing, and building succession depth across a multi-manager org that currently has real single-point-of-failure risk.
Comfortable operating in an ambiguous, transformation-in-progress environment.
Demonstrated ownership of team-based technical architecture and engineering practices: repo management, CI/CD, code review standards, test/regression discipline, etc.
Experience managing a technically mixed org (engineers, data engineers, and platform/systems administrators) and successfully raising the technical bar of the admin-facing work over time.
Data-first orientation focused on data architecture and flow
Strong working fluency in modern, event-based, service-oriented architectures using server-side JavaScript / TypeScript / Node.js within a primarily serverless AWS environment.
Deep experience with REST / GraphQL API architectures, relevant authorization strategies including OAUTH and JWT.
Familiarity with data engineering fundamentals and infrastructure including SQL, Python, dbt / data modeling, pipeline orchestration, batch vs near-real time ETLs and reverse ETLs, medallion architectures.
Experience with IaC platforms (e.g. Terraform) for DevOps and cloud infrastructure.

Nice To Have Experience

Modern AI-centric engineering workflows and practices.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and building autonomous AI agents.
Hands-on experience with graph theory and databases, especially as a context layer for Ai co-pilots, workflows and agents.
Track record of managing vendors and implementation partners on a complex platform build, including technical design review and sign-off authority.
Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms used in GTM and/or Finance (e.g. Marketo, Salesforce, NetSuite, Nue, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, Conga and DealHub) at an architectural and API level.

Technologies We Use

Python, Node.js
AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, S3, CloudWatch, VPCs, IAM)
Workato, Fivetran
Databricks, Airbyte
Terraform
Git, Github
Salesforce, Netsuite, Workday, Marketo, Clari, Adaptive

AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. About East Daley

East Daley Analytics is building the energy market intelligence platform for professionals who need to understand how North American oil, natural gas, NGLs, infrastructure, producers, and midstream companies connect. Our mission is to drive transparency in energy markets by combining proprietary data, asset-level models, expert research, and workflow-ready software.
Our Energy Data Studio® platform helps customers forecast, compare, and analyze infrastructure and commodity performance across crude oil, natural gas, and NGL markets. It brings together operational and financial data, production forecasts, pipeline utilization, takeaway capacity, contract terms, counterparty risk, regulatory filings, dashboards, and exportable datasets.
We are looking for a CTO to help scale East Daley from a high-value research and data business into a category-defining energy intelligence platform.
The Opportunity

This is a hands-on executive technology leadership role for someone who has built and scaled complex data, analytics, AI, and SaaS products—ideally in markets where domain expertise, data quality, and customer trust matter as much as software velocity.
The right leader will inherit differentiated market expertise, proprietary models, a growing Energy Data Studio platform, and a team with deep knowledge of energy fundamentals. Your mandate is to transform that foundation into a scalable, modern, secure technology platform supporting product-led growth, enterprise data delivery, AI-enabled workflows, and faster innovation.
This role is for a technology leader who wants to be close to the business, customers, and product—not someone who wants to run a detached engineering organization.
What You’ll Own

You will own East Daley’s technology strategy, architecture, engineering execution, data platform, software delivery, and technical talent strategy. You will partner with the CEO, product, research, data, commercial, and customer teams to turn East Daley’s proprietary intelligence into software, data products, APIs, analytics workflows, and scalable customer experiences.
The core mandate includes:
Platform strategy and architecture

Define the technical roadmap for Energy Data Studio and related data products. Establish a modern architecture supporting dashboards, APIs, data exports, customer workflows, internal modeling, and AI-enabled capabilities.
Data platform and model operations

Build scalable systems for ingesting, validating, transforming, versioning, and distributing high-value energy data. Strengthen data trust, lineage, transparency, and repeatable model workflows.
Product-engineering execution

Create a high-performance engineering model with clear roadmaps, delivery discipline, release management, observability, documentation, QA, and customer feedback loops. Increase product velocity without compromising analytical accuracy or customer confidence.
AI and automation strategy

Identify practical opportunities for AI, machine learning, and automation to improve data ingestion, anomaly detection, research workflows, forecasting, customer interaction, search, summarization, and product experience. The approach should be pragmatic and commercially grounded.
Customer-facing technology leadership

Engage with strategic customers, prospects, and partners to understand workflow needs and translate them into product priorities. Demonstrate East Daley’s technical credibility to sophisticated energy, finance, infrastructure, and trading customers.
Team leadership and talent development

Lead and scale engineering, data engineering, platform, and technical product functions. Recruit senior talent, raise engineering standards, and build a culture where domain experts and technologists collaborate deeply.
Security, reliability, and enterprise readiness

Ensure the platform meets institutional customer expectations for security, access control, uptime, permissioning, auditability, vendor management, and scalable delivery.
What Success Looks Like

In the first 6–12 months, success will mean:
A clear technology strategy tied to business growth, product strategy, and customer value.
An executable Energy Data Studio engineering roadmap with improved release velocity, prioritization, and accountability.
Core data workflows that are more scalable, observable, documented, and less dependent on manual handoffs.
Engineering, data, product, research, and commercial teams operating from a shared roadmap.
Improvements in customer usability, performance, data access, APIs, visualization, and workflow integration.
A credible path toward useful, trusted, differentiated AI-enabled energy intelligence capabilities.

The Profile We’re Looking For

We are interested in leaders who have built sophisticated B2B data, analytics, SaaS, or market intelligence platforms and operated at the intersection of engineering, data, product, and commercial strategy.
You may be a fit if you have:
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including senior engineering, VP Engineering, CTO, or equivalent roles.
Experience building and scaling data-intensive products, analytics platforms, workflow software, market intelligence platforms, or B2B SaaS products.
A track record of leading engineering teams through scale, including architecture modernization, technical debt reduction, platform reliability, and product execution.
Strong fluency in data platforms, cloud architecture, APIs, analytics workflows, data pipelines, governance, and enterprise software delivery.
Experience partnering across product, research, commercial, and customer-facing teams to turn domain expertise into scalable products.
A pragmatic view of AI and automation and the ability to identify use cases that improve product experience, productivity, or data quality.
Credibility with technical teams and executives, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.
A bias toward shipping and iterating while respecting East Daley’s commitment to accuracy, transparency, and analytical trust.

Energy experience is valuable but not mandatory. Curiosity and respect for complex domain expertise are mandatory.
Experience That Would Stand Out

Experience in energy, commodities, infrastructure, financial data, market intelligence, trading analytics, geospatial data, or regulatory data.
Experience building products combining proprietary and third-party data, forecasting models, visualization, and customer workflow tools.
Experience modernizing a founder-led or domain-expert-led technology organization while preserving what makes the company distinctive.
Experience scaling distributed engineering teams and building strong engineering culture.
Experience with data acquisition, entity resolution, time-series data, model versioning, BI/visualization, APIs, and customer-facing data delivery.
Experience commercializing AI/ML capabilities within a trusted B2B information product.

Why This Role Is Compelling

This is a rare opportunity to own technology for a business with real proprietary differentiation. East Daley is not building another generic dashboard product. We are building the system of record for energy market participants who need to understand asset-level fundamentals, infrastructure constraints, cross-commodity relationships, and financial exposure.
East Daley already has the domain expertise, models, customer trust, and proprietary data foundation. The CTO’s job is to turn that foundation into a platform that scales.
Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated base salary range is $250,000 to $300,000 annually
, depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated fit. The package also includes a target annual performance incentive of 20% to 30% of base salary
and comprehensive benefits. East Daley expects to hire within this range but may consider compensation outside it for an exceptional candidate.
Medical, dental, and vision coverage with company contributions.
401(k) with a 3% company contribution.
Flexible spending and health savings account options with company contributions.
Company-paid life, accidental death, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage.
Collaborative, in-person team environment in Greenwood Village, CO.
Dog-friendly office where team members may bring well-behaved dogs from time to time.

Why Join East Daley

An executive role with the opportunity to shape East Daley’s technology, product, and AI strategy.
A differentiated data and analytics platform serving a complex, high-value energy market.
Direct partnership with executive leadership, product, research, commercial teams, and customers.
The opportunity to scale a modern technology organization around proprietary data and domain expertise.
A fast-moving environment where technology directly influences innovation, customer value, and company growth.

Predictive Index Assessments

East Daley Analytics uses Predictive Index assessments as one input in our hiring process. Candidates are asked to complete the PI Behavioral Assessment and PI Cognitive Assessment as part of the evaluation process.
Equal Employment Opportunity

East Daley Analytics is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Director - Clinical Engineering Operations
jobs.description:
Job Requirements

Under limited supervision directs clinical engineering services and management for the assigned clinical engineering departments. Works with other directors to provide the full scope of clinical engineering services, including medical equipment planning, maintenance & support, and clinical system services.

Under the guidance of University of Maryland Clinical Engineering Council coordinates the implementation of the cooperative service model and is responsible for providing services to other affiliates in the University of Maryland Medical System (UMMS) as part of the University of Maryland Clinical Engineering Cooperative .

Principal Responsibilities And Tasks

The following statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all job duties performed by personnel so classified.

Operations:
Implements strategic plan that propels the department forward both operationally and technologically. Ensures the reliability and proper use of all medical equipment used within the institutions in order to maintain a safe environment and in full compliance with The Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards for Medical Equipment.
Manages the continuous operations of medical equipment
Tests and evaluates all systems through the effective utilization of staff and contracts.
Maintains effective communications with senior executive leadership, physicians, department heads, patient care staff, administrators, and managers to resolve long and short-term problems.
Ensures efficient and high-quality operations services to customers and users of medical equipment.
Provides technical counsel to staff on codes, standards, maintenance and repair of medical equipment. Consults with and facilitates nursing, ancillary, and medical staff regarding equipment operation.
Promotes customer involvement to identify and incorporate customer needs in the operational requirements of the clinical engineering department.
Plans, coordinates and directs all clinical engineering operations during any emergency; maintains communications with affected departments and centralized command center.
Builds partnerships with clinicians and clinical programs and develops a strong partnership between clinical engineering and information technology.
Maintenance/Life Cycle Management:
In collaboration with other leaders, designs and implements a risk/needs-based maintenance program based on sound maintenance practices and industry standards.
Implements and maintains preventive maintenance program that reduces risks and optimizes costs associated with corrective maintenance.
Reviews and evaluates funding sources and identifies, prioritizes and tracks shortfalls. Determines and communicates implications and risks of shortfalls to management.
Identifies and maintains a life cycle management plan for systems.
Identifies tracking mechanism for repairs and replacements.
Performs cost evaluation of repair versus replacement in life cycle management process.
Identifies systematic performance measures in order to monitor and evaluate the effective management of the life cycle program.
Utilizes contracts to supplement existing resources.
Design Standards and Compliance:
Develops and maintains design standards for medical equipment to maintain the highest consistency and efficiency of operations and meets clinical user requirements.
Ensures clinical engineering KPIs are met.
Ensures compliance with federal, state and local standards, codes, designs and regulations.
Coordinates the development of a process to manage information using modern, computerized database applications to ensure the record keeping continuity, compliance and integrity of all medical equipment are maintained.
Interacts with purchasing, clinicians, and engineering by developing guidelines and specifications to establish a cost and operationally effective new/replacement equipment program.
Capital Equipment Program Management:
Maintains equipment inventory and condition assessment status information for medical equipment.
Forecasts replacement requirements in collaboration with the medical equipment planning group based on risk-based criteria.
Leads capital program planning and execution for medical equipment replacement and new technology adoption and integration. Integrates new technology initiatives and existing capital equipment replacements to minimize institutional operating costs and capital investments.
Manages the processes for acquisition, installation, and testing of new medical equipment, in coordination with purchasing, project management, clinicians and users.
Human Resources:
Provides guidance and general direction for department operations, ensures accurate and timely production of work and the efficient and effective operation of the department including the formulation of operating policies and procedures.
Establishes and maintains effective management of operations personnel, engineers, and maintenance personnel, including identifying staffing needs, hiring, training and development, evaluation and termination.
Establishes and implements departmental performance standards. Measures performance against standards and initiates appropriate action when standards are not met. Investigates irregularities and policy violations and takes corrective actions in compliance with Human Resources policies and procedures.
Develops, implements and maintains a comprehensive and on-going organizational evaluation and restructuring process to meet the institution's evolving goals and objectives.
Reviews job descriptions, shop functions to determine and implement changes such as reclassification, restructuring and promotions.
Financial Management:
Develops and administers operating budget for clinical engineering and central maintenance pool.
Develops controls and initiatives that ensure cost effective management of staff, supplies and contracts.
Evaluates and controls purchases by operations personnel.
Negotiates and monitors contracts associated with the operations of clinical engineering and the central maintenance pool program.
Safety Management:
Develops, implements and maintains a safety management program in accordance with The Joint Commission standards notably the Environment of Care Standards for Medical Equipment Management and other applicable regulations, codes and standards.
Develops policies and procedures to ensure safe clinical engineering services.
Directs the risk management program for clinical engineering and medical equipment by identifying risk issues and resolving incidents and problems.
Responsible for the integrity and safety of medical equipment.
Is responsible for the environment of care medical equipment management plan and associated compliance, data collecting, and reporting activities.
In collaboration with leaders, develops and monitors departmental performance goals approved by clinical engineering management and reports on progress against the goals and overall program activities and results...
University of Maryland Clinical Engineering Cooperative
Is an Ex Officio, voting member of the University of Maryland Clinical Engineering Council
Oversees the implementation of the Cooperative’s programs and initiatives whose management and/or execution is assigned by the Council to the University of Maryland Medical System.

Work Experience

II. Education and Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Biomedical Engineering or related field required. Master’s Degree in biomedical engineering, or a related field preferred.
Formal Biomedical training is required
10 years professional experience in the field of clinical engineering, preferably in a hospital setting, or equivalent related qualifications and experience in an electronics field is required. 5 years of progressively responsible supervisory, budget formulation and execution, and management experience is required.

Skills

IV. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Knowledge of the engineering and application of key clinical technologies used in health care diagnosis and treatment sufficient to engage substantively in strategic and tactical discussions with subject matter experts on their use, efficacy, physical and operational characteristics, strategic value, acquisition and operating costs.
Comprehensive knowledge of The Joint Commission, local, state, federal codes, building codes, industry standards in medical equipment and clinical engineering fields is required.
Successful experience leading the planning, selection and adoption of new technology in a medical environment.
Knowledge of computer-based automated asset management systems is required. Demonstrated knowledge of microcomputer applications, including word processing, graphics, spreadsheets, and data management is required.
A high level of proficiency and demonstrated effectiveness in problem solving and implementing new programs related to increasing departmental and organizational operating efficiency is required. Highly effective interpersonal skills are needed to manage multi-trade teams and interact effectively with clinicians at all levels in the organization.
Highly effective verbal and written communication skills are required to work successfully with a diverse group of staff at all levels within the organization, including executive management and the Board of Directors.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions required to perform the essential functions of the Job

Benefits

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Compensation

Pay Range: $60.76 - $97.01

jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Cloud Platform — Kubernetes, Hyperscalers & Distributed Systems

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Platform
who will act as a player-coach engineering leader. You will lead a team of 6–10 engineers building and operating core platform services, owning delivery, people, and technical direction for the team's domain.

What You Get To Do In This Role

You will lead, grow, and develop a team of software engineers who design, build, and operate services within the cloud-native platform — owning hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance, and career growth for every member of the team.
You will own end-to-end delivery for your team's domain: setting priorities and roadmap with product and platform leadership, making scope and sequencing trade-offs, and ensuring commitments land predictably from design through production operation.
You will be accountable for the reliability, scalability, and operability of the services your team runs — establishing SLOs, on-call practices, and operational reviews, and driving down incidents and toil across hyperscaler, on-prem, and sovereign environments.
You will partner with principal and distinguished engineers, peer managers, and workload teams to align your team's work with the broader platform architecture, standards, and the needs of the teams that depend on the platform.
You will stay close to the work as a player-coach — reviewing designs and code, weighing in on architectural decisions, and occasionally building — so that technical judgment, not just process, sets the bar for the team.
You will build a healthy, high-trust engineering culture: clear expectations, honest feedback, an inclusive environment, and a team that raises the engineering bar for itself.
You will communicate crisply with leadership and stakeholders about status, risks, and trade-offs, and represent the team in planning, capacity, and escalation conversations.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work — whether adopting AI-powered tooling across a team, automating operational workflows, building agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about how AI changes the way a platform team is staffed and run.
10+ years building production software, including substantial hands-on experience operating distributed systems and running workloads on Kubernetes.
5+ years managing software engineers, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers and building teams that deliver.
A track record of leading teams to deliver complex, business-critical systems or services end-to-end, from design through production operation.
Hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP), including its core compute, networking, and IAM primitives.
Strong working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code — enough to review designs, challenge assumptions, and make sound technical trade-offs with your team.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain technical risks and trade-offs to both engineers and senior leadership.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Head Of Engineering

Team:
Engineering

Location:
Onsite - Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica & West LA)

Employment Type:
Fulltime, Salaried, Exempt

Reports To:
SVP of Product & Technology

About Plug

Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.

Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data-driven pricing, battery state-of-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end-to-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory.

Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth.

Why Plug

Here’s why you should be part of Plug:

You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
You'll be part of an AI-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level.
You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead our engineering team and help shape the technical foundation of a fast-growing Series A company. You will report to the SVP of Product and Technology and partner closely to align on product vision and how that is executed by engineering.

This is a player-coach role. You will spend roughly half your time as an individual contributor - arbitrating architecture decisions, staying close to the systems, and individual contribution across features and tech debt - and the other half leading the team: setting direction, building engineering culture, collaborating on AI-native processes, and growing the organization.

The team is small, talented and moves fast. You will be stepping into an organization that has strong individual contributors and real technical momentum. Your job is to raise the ceiling - and to encourage what is working. We are looking to hire additional engineers, so you will be growing the team from day one.

We are building a culture that cares about collaboration, encourages intellectual honesty, celebrates technical excellence, and is driven by the company's goals. We believe diversity of perspective and experience are key to building great products and technology and a thriving team. Sounds cool? Let's work together.

Key Responsibilities

Set the technical vision and engineering direction for the team, working in partnership with the SVP of Product and Technology to ensure engineering strategy is tightly coupled to business goals.
Partner with the SVP of Product and Technology on product direction, roadmap sequencing, and technology strategy; own engineering execution and delivery against that plan.
Collaborate across functions - product, operations, and business leadership - to ensure engineering work is well-aligned, well-communicated, and measurably impactful.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team - setting a high technical bar, building a culture of ownership, and retaining strong individual contributors by keeping them challenged and autonomous.
Be an architectural leader - drive the evolution of systems architecture, make sound technology tradeoffs, and help the team navigate the balance between velocity and long-term maintainability.
Continue to be an individual contributor roughly half the time - writing code, reviewing pull requests at depth, and staying close enough to the systems to have real technical credibility with the team.
Systematically identify and reduce technical debt with a pragmatic, incremental approach.
Partner with the SVP of Product and Technology to build an AI-native SDLC - bringing hands-on experience with agentic coding tools, working with product to structure requirements and context that improve agentic results, and iterating on practices over time to get measurably better outcomes.
Own engineering team planning, recruiting, and growth.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in software engineering, with 3+ years in an engineering leadership role where you continued to contribute directly to a production codebase.
Prior startup experience - has built or materially shaped an engineering function at an early-stage company where process was still being defined and priorities shifted regularly.
Currently contributing to a production codebase: writing code, reviewing pull requests at depth, and engaging with architecture decisions at the level of a strong senior engineer.
Has joined an existing engineering team with established contributors and a track record of building trust quickly, preserving contributor autonomy and momentum, and raising the bar without disrupting what is working.
Proficient in TypeScript with full-stack production experience across backend, frontend, relational databases, and API/webhook integrations. Our stack is TypeScript (Node.js + Next.js + React), Neon (cloud Postgres), Vercel, and AWS (ECS, S3, Redshift, Step Functions, Temporal). Experience with any of these is a strong plus.
Has built and managed systems that integrate deeply with HubSpot (or similar CRM) - treating it as a technical platform rather than just a CRM, including designing boundaries between HubSpot automation and application code to maintain system reliability.
Production experience with cloud infrastructure including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and observability tooling - has made and implemented decisions in these areas without reliance on a dedicated DevOps team.
Deep, hands-on experience with agentic AI development - including working closely with product to structure requirements, context, and acceptance criteria that improve agentic coding results, and a track record of iterating on those practices over time to measurably improve outputs.
Has hired, grown, and retained engineering teams: a track record of scaling headcount thoughtfully while preserving culture and contributor quality.
Strong communication skills - able to represent engineering credibly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and write clearly and concisely.
Authorized to work in the US for any employer.
Prior experience in automotive, EV, marketplace, or fintech systems is a plus.

Compensation And Benefits

Annual salary: $250,000 to $280,000

Salary ranges reflect independent, third-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.

Benefits:

Health, Vision, and Dental insurance
401(k) plan
Daily lunch stipend
Equity (based on role and performance)
Unlimited PTO
Fully stocked kitchen
Dog-friendly office
Ongoing opportunities for growth and development

This full-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is an in-person role. We welcome candidates from all locations to apply, provided they are willing to relocate for the role. Relocation assistance may be available for the right candidate on select roles. Sponsorship is not available at this time.

Position Summary

Dollamur is seeking a dynamic engineering leader to join our team in either an Engineering Manager
or Director of Engineering
capacity, depending on the candidate's qualifications, leadership experience, and demonstrated impact within a manufacturing environment.

This role provides a unique opportunity for accomplished engineering professionals to lead continuous improvement initiatives, drive manufacturing excellence, optimize processes, and enhance product quality across the organization. Candidates selected at the Manager level will have a clear pathway for growth into the Director role through expanded leadership responsibilities, strategic project ownership, and organizational development opportunities. Candidates hired at the Director level will serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, helping shape operational strategy and long-term organizational success. The position supervises two team members.

Regardless of level, the successful candidate will play a critical role in advancing manufacturing performance, developing technical talent, supporting operational scalability, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Applicable to both Engineering Manager and Director of Engineering levels

Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, SPC, Theory of Constraints (TOC), and other operational excellence methodologies.
Drive manufacturing process optimization, process standardization, workflow improvements, and engineering support for production operations.
Partner closely with Operations, Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Leadership teams to achieve organizational objectives.
Analyze operational, quality, and production metrics to identify trends, improve efficiencies, and support data-driven decision-making.
Support new product development, manufacturing implementation, and process scalability initiatives.
Lead root cause analysis, corrective action activities, and quality improvement efforts to improve product consistency and customer satisfaction.
Oversee engineering support for manufacturing technologies, automation initiatives, equipment implementation, and process modernization activities.
Develop, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures, engineering documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Manage engineering projects, priorities, and resources while ensuring objectives are completed on time and within budget.
Champion workplace safety initiatives and identify opportunities to improve ergonomic, operational, and process safety.
Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and cross-functional teams regarding manufacturing capabilities, equipment, product requirements, and process improvements.
Support ERP, MES, manufacturing analytics, and process documentation systems to improve operational visibility and efficiency.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement capabilities.
Ability to perform statistical analysis and apply engineering principles to operational challenges.
Experience creating layouts, workflows, work instructions, SOPs, and process documentation.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, production data, and quality metrics.
Effective project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ERP systems, CAD software, and manufacturing technologies.
Ability to work collaboratively with production personnel, leadership teams, suppliers, and customers.
Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.

Minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams, quality functions, or technical organizations.
Strong background in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, process improvement, and manufacturing systems optimization.
Experience managing cross-functional engineering and quality initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
Experience with ERP systems, manufacturing analytics, and process documentation systems required.

Experience designing, developing, implementing, or leading Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) or similar production management platforms preferred.
Demonstrated success leading organizational improvement initiatives that drive measurable operational and financial results.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development skills with the ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams.
Ability to develop and execute engineering strategies aligned with operational objectives and long-term business growth.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production systems, quality systems, and operational workflows.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to lead large-scale operational improvement initiatives and execute strategic engineering projects across multiple functions.
Strong financial and operational acumen related to manufacturing efficiency, capital investments, productivity improvement, and cost reduction.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, ERP systems, CAD software, manufacturing technologies, and data analytics tools.
Strong project and portfolio management capabilities with the ability to balance multiple strategic priorities.
Ability to interpret complex engineering, operational, and financial data and translate insights into actionable business decisions.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive team.
Ability to communicate complex engineering strategies and business initiatives in a manner that is understandable and engaging to associates at all levels of the organization.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining a focus on quality, execution, and continuous improvement.

At Dollamur, engineering is more than process improvement. It is a critical driver of innovation, operational excellence, and business growth.
