ADP is seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to lead the U.S. Money Movement organization.

This leader will oversee a global team of approximately 80+ engineers responsible for the development, modernization, resiliency, and production health of platforms supporting the collection and disbursement of funds for ADP clients, employees, agencies, and third parties. The role combines engineering leadership, platform ownership, operational accountability, and cross-functional partnership. The successful candidate must be able to lead a mission-critical technology organization while balancing platform stability, modernization, product delivery, risk management, and client commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering leadership

Lead, develop, and scale a globally distributed organization of approximately 80+ engineers.
Build a strong leadership bench across engineering management, architecture, data, DevOps, and production support.
Establish clear priorities, accountability, and operating rhythms across multiple teams.
Attract, retain, and develop high-performing technical and leadership talent.

Platform strategy and delivery

Own the engineering strategy and technology roadmap for U.S. Money Movement.
Ensure the reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of high-volume financial transaction platforms.
Continue modernizing the platform following its migration to AWS and upgrade to SAP S/4HANA, B/4HANA, HANA, and modern Linux infrastructure.
Reduce technical debt, simplify architecture, and modernize integrations.
Advance automation, observability, DevSecOps, data engineering, and software delivery practices.
Balance strategic transformation with near-term product and operational priorities.

Operational resiliency

Maintain end-to-end accountability for the production health of a Tier 1, mission-critical platform.
Strengthen resiliency, disaster recovery, monitoring, capacity management, and incident response.
Partner with Operations and business teams to meet payment-processing deadlines and client commitments.
Provide executive leadership during critical incidents and ensure root causes are addressed through durable corrective actions.
Use operational metrics and incident trends to drive continuous improvement.

Business, risk, and financial leadership

Partner with Product, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business leaders.
Translate business priorities into a coherent technology strategy and investment roadmap.
Ensure engineering practices and controls meet financial, regulatory, security, audit, and enterprise-risk requirements.
Manage a significant technology portfolio, including labor, infrastructure, software licensing, vendors, consultants, and support contracts.
Communicate complex technical and operational matters clearly to executive and technical audiences.

Scope

The organization supports core money movement processing, SAP financial capabilities, data and analytics, bank connectivity, payment integrations, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, production support, reconciliation, and enterprise integrations.

The platform operates at substantial scale, supporting hundreds of thousands of clients, tens of millions of workers, and annual transaction flows measured in trillions of dollars.

This role will be based out of our San Dimas, CA location. We are working in a hybrid work environment, working out of the office 3 days a week with the opportunity of working from home the other 2 days.

Required Qualifications

8+ years leading engineering organizations, including managers and senior technical leaders.
Experience managing a large, globally distributed engineering organization.
Proven ownership of mission-critical, high-availability transaction platforms.
Experience leading major cloud migrations, platform modernizations, or architectural transformations.
Strong knowledge of software engineering, systems integration, data platforms, DevOps, and production operations.
Experience managing significant budgets, vendors, and technology investment portfolios.
Demonstrated ability to lead through high-impact incidents and make sound decisions under pressure.
Strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in payments, payroll, banking, treasury, or regulated financial systems.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, HANA, or comparable enterprise financial platforms.
Experience operating large-scale applications in AWS.
Familiarity with ACH, wires, real-time payments, SWIFT, bank integrations, and reconciliation.
Knowledge of financial controls, cybersecurity, audit, compliance, and disaster recovery.

Leadership Profile

The Successful Candidate Will

Act as the owner of a critical business service.
Balance modernization with operational stability and disciplined execution.
Simplify complex technical and organizational problems.
Build strong teams while maintaining clear accountability.
Communicate transparently with executives, engineers, and business partners.
Make decisions based on client impact, business value, risk, and long-term platform health.

Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney's industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney's sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms.

Job Summary

The Sr. Manager, Foundations Engineering leads the day-to-day engineering execution, operational reliability, and platform delivery of the Foundations Engineering function within Ad Platforms - the internal capability layer that powers every service, application, and system in the organization. The organization owns and operates portions of the Ad Platforms infrastructure and developer platform stack directly, while also extending, operationalizing, and supporting shared enterprise platforms within the Ad Platforms ecosystem.

This includes leadership across platform engineering and DevOps, cloud infrastructure and runtime operations, SRE and reliability practices, database administration, observability enablement, and the infrastructure and platform capabilities supporting the Data Platform, BI ecosystem, and AI agentic and real-time ML platform. This role partners closely with centralized Platform Engineering and Infrastructure teams responsible for shared enterprise services and cloud platforms. This role reports to the Director, Product Software Engineering - AI Engineering + Foundations Engineering.

We are seeking a Sr. Manager who is deeply execution-oriented and operationally excellent - someone who thrives on building reliable, scalable systems, leading high-performing engineering teams through delivery, and improving platform quality and developer experience quarter over quarter. If you are a leader who takes pride in production stability, drives operational discipline without creating bureaucracy, and knows how to develop engineers while keeping the platforms running at scale, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Responsibilities And Duties Of The Role

Platform Engineering & DevOps

Manages and delivers the platform engineering and DevOps capabilities that power software delivery across Ad Platforms - including ownership and operational support of CI/CD systems, Kubernetes and container orchestration environments, Infrastructure-as-Code modules, deployment automation, shared cloud platform integrations across AWS (primary), Azure, and GCP, and internal developer tooling - improving deployment speed, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
Drives automation-first operational practices, golden-path engineering patterns, self-service engineering capabilities, and Ads-specific platform abstractions built on top of shared infrastructure platforms - accelerating engineering velocity, reducing operational toil, and improving onboarding, deployment reliability, and release consistency across Ad Platforms teams.
Serves as a primary operational ownership layer for Ad Platforms workloads running on shared infrastructure and platform services - partnering closely with centralized Platform Engineering organizations responsible for core cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability platforms.
Implements and enforces secure-by-default platform standards across Ad Platforms environments and delivery pipelines - including secrets management, deployment governance, engineering quality gates, vulnerability remediation, auditability, and compliance controls - in partnership with Security and centralized infrastructure teams.
Develops internal developer tooling and web-based operational interfaces that support service deployment, runtime management, and engineering productivity across Ad Platforms.

Reliability, Data & AI Platform Infrastructure

Establishes and operates reliability engineering practices across Ad Platforms foundational services and runtime environments - including SLO/SLI frameworks, incident management rigor, production readiness standards, operational health monitoring, and resiliency engineering practices - driving measurable improvements in uptime, stability, and deployment confidence.
Leads observability operations and enablement across Ad Platforms - including logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting frameworks, and operational instrumentation standards - partnering with centralized observability teams to ensure consistent and actionable visibility into system behavior and platform health.
Leads database engineering operations and data infrastructure enablement for Ad Platforms, including operational reliability, backup and recovery strategy, failover readiness, performance optimization, and modernization efforts across relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native data systems supporting transactional services, analytics, BI, and Data Platform workloads.
Builds and operates infrastructure and platform capabilities supporting AI agentic and real-time ML systems - including orchestration runtimes, inference platform enablement, GPU and compute orchestration, deployment automation, and governance-aligned operational frameworks - enabling AI Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and scale AI systems reliably and safely.
Executes FinOps and cost management practices across multi-cloud infrastructure and AI inference workloads - including capacity planning, cloud spend visibility, utilization optimization, waste reduction, and unit cost reporting - contributing to engineering efficiency and responsible resource utilization.
Leverages observability signals and automation to drive anomaly detection, incident prevention, and intelligent alerting across Ad Platforms services and platforms.

Team Leadership & Delivery

Leads, develops, and grows a high-performing engineering organization across Foundations Engineering's platform domains - managing engineers and technical leads directly, driving hiring and performance management, establishing execution cadence, and fostering a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering craft.
Owns delivery execution and roadmap commitments across Foundations Engineering domains - planning quarterly work, coordinating dependencies with AI Engineering, Product Engineering, Security, Data, and centralized Platform teams, leading postmortems and operational reviews, and continuously improving delivery predictability, production quality, and platform health.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training

10+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated depth in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or related foundations disciplines.
Proven people management experience leading engineering teams - hiring, coaching, performance management, and building engineering delivery culture within a platform or infrastructure organization.
Strong cloud infrastructure and platform engineering expertise - AWS required (hands-on operational depth); Azure and GCP experience valued; Kubernetes and container orchestration, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD platform operations at production scale.
Demonstrated reliability engineering experience - SLO/SLI design, incident management, production readiness practices, and observability across high-availability, distributed systems.
Database engineering and operational data infrastructure experience - managing relational and cloud-native databases at production scale, with exposure to data platform infrastructure (lakehouse, streaming, or orchestration systems) a strong plus.
Familiarity with AI infrastructure and ML platform operations - inference runtimes, agent orchestration infrastructure, GPU/compute platform management, or operational AI platform support sufficient to lead effective teams in these domains.
FinOps and cost management discipline - tracking cloud spend, driving capacity efficiency, eliminating waste, and communicating cost tradeoffs clearly.
Strong cross-team collaboration and communication skills - able to coordinate effectively with AI Engineering, Product Engineering, Security, Data, Finance, and centralized Platform Engineering teams, and to represent Foundations Engineering planning and progress to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in online advertising technology - familiarity with ad serving systems, programmatic platforms, campaign management, or streaming ad delivery infrastructure.
Experience building or contributing to an internal developer platform (IDP) - self-service engineering tooling, golden-path frameworks, platform abstractions, or developer experience improvements at scale.
Familiarity with Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Kafka, or similar cloud-native data platform technologies used in lakehouse or real-time streaming infrastructure.
Experience with AI/ML runtime infrastructure - vector databases, embedding pipelines, model serving, inference systems, or agent execution platforms.
Background in high-availability, high-scale real-time systems - live streaming, live advertising, event-driven architectures, or real-time bidding - operating across multi-cloud environments.
Demonstrated practice in automation-first operational models - reducing operational toil through tooling, scripting, platform engineering, and infrastructure automation rather than manual processes.

Required Education

Location

Hybrid role: 4+ days/week in office – Glendale, CA or San Francisco, CA

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager, Repair Center Operations is responsible for building and scaling Oracle's centralized repair-center model for next-generation AI infrastructure. This role leads day-to-day repair operations and long-term capacity planning for Compute Tray (CT) repair, CDU validation, leak response, and regional expansion. Working across Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Design, Architecture, and Global Product Engineering, the senior manager ensures repair centers are staffed, equipped, and ready to support routine demand as well as surge events while driving improvements in diagnosability, repair velocity, and serviceability.

The role also serves as a key operational leader for the repair organization, translating product and infrastructure requirements into an executable staffing and facility plan. This includes establishing operating rhythms, tracking performance metrics, managing risk, and ensuring the repair network scales with current and future Oracle data center sites.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

Lead the planning, staffing, and execution of repair-center operations supporting GB200, GB300, and future AI compute platforms.
Own repair-center readiness, including capacity planning, shift coverage, resource allocation, and operational ramp for new sites.
Partner with Design, Architecture, Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Global Product Engineering to define repair-center requirements and resolve cross-functional issues.
Oversee repair workflows for Compute Trays, CDU validation, and leak-response activities to ensure safe, timely, and high-quality execution.
Establish and manage operating metrics, reporting, and escalation paths to maintain throughput, quality, and readiness across the repair network.
Drive standardization of repair-center processes, documentation, and best practices across current and future Oracle Repair locations.
Support regional scale-up by aligning permanent repair-center buildouts with demand forecasts, site deployment schedules, and new platform introductions.
Lead hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management for repair-center team members and supporting technical resources.

Core Responsibilities

Set clear priorities, manage competing demands, and ensure repair-center objectives are met on time and at the expected quality level.
Build strong cross-functional partnerships and maintain alignment across engineering, operations, supply chain, and site leadership teams.
Use data, trend analysis, and operational feedback to identify risks, improve repair performance, and recommend process enhancements.
Maintain a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and technical excellence within the repair organization.
Translate business needs into executable plans for staffing, space, power, tooling, and repair capacity.
Develop scalable operating models that support both steady-state repair work and surge events without disrupting broader deployment goals.
Communicate clearly with senior leadership on site status, risks, dependencies, and required decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Development
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is seeking a Senior Director, Technology Development to lead the manufacturing technology roadmap for the next generation of Oura products. This leader will connect Product Design, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, Materials, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to turn emerging technologies into scalable, repeatable production capabilities.

The role will build a technology development model that engages early in product definition, strengthens design for manufacturability, and creates reusable process platforms across programs. The initial focus areas are battery technology, zirconia and other brittle materials, PVD coatings, molding and encapsulation, and manufacturing automation.

This is a hands-on executive role requiring strategic leadership, deep technical judgment, supplier and factory engagement, and the ability to move technologies from concept through production.

What you will do

Own a multi-year roadmap for battery manufacturing, zirconia/brittle materials, PVD, molding/encapsulation, automation, and adjacent capabilities.
Build and lead a multidisciplinary team of senior engineers, technology developers, and subject-matter experts.
Establish reusable “golden processes” and technology platforms that improve yield, reliability, cost, cycle time, capacity, and launch speed across products.
Partner early with design and engineering teams to influence architecture, materials, tolerances, specifications, and process choices.
Create a disciplined development funnel from opportunity identification and experimentation through qualification, early validation, NPI, and ramp.
Lead supplier and contract manufacturer engagement, including process development, equipment selection, qualification, capability improvement, and scale-up.
Set technical readiness standards, maintain roadmaps and risk registers, and communicate clear investment recommendations to leadership.
Identify and protect proprietary manufacturing methods, process know-how, and other intellectual property.

Technology focus areas

Partner with battery, PD, electrical, quality, and supplier teams on cell architecture, energy density, safety, dimensions, tolerances, manufacturability and reliability.
Qualify new cell technologies, materials, suppliers, assembly methods, and automation, with robust controls for critical-to-quality characteristics.
Lead development of brittle material, forming, machining, sintering, finishing, inspection, and handling capabilities.
Improve yield, durability, cosmetics, and cost while establishing material specifications, process windows, failure-mode understanding, and qualification methods.
Drive DFM and design-for-process reviews with design teams, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
Advance PVD capabilities for functional and cosmetic requirements, including cleaning, pretreatment, buffer layers, masking, color control, adhesion, wear, corrosion, and rework.
Partner with ID CMF and PD to balance appearance, durability, capability, and cost.\
Own the roadmap for injection molding, epoxy molding, encapsulation, sealing, tooling, and dispensing.
Improve process windows, tooling, materials, equipment, and controls to deliver high yield, water-tightness, dimensional stability, and cosmetic quality.
Reduce defects including leakage, voids, incomplete fill, component damage, contamination, and cosmetic fallout.
Develop next gen molding processes and tooling to achieve the minimization, efficient encapsulation, high yield and faster turnaround.
Define the right level of automation across assembly, battery processing, molding, inspection, testing, kitting, and material handling—balancing quality, speed, flexibility, capital, and risk.
Lead automation from concept through equipment specification, supplier selection, buyoff, installation, qualification, ramp, and sustaining.
Advance robotics, machine vision, AOI, error-proofing, digital work instructions, process monitoring, and automated data capture.

What success looks like

A clear, funded roadmap aligned with product and manufacturing strategy.
Earlier, stronger technology and DFM input into product architecture.
Reusable process platforms that reduce launch risk, development time, and reinvention.
Improved capability and yield across battery, zirconia/ brittle material, PVD, molding, and automated operations.
Faster transition from technology demonstration to qualified production.
Stronger supplier capability, equipment standards, data systems, documentation, and intellectual property.
A trusted expert team that is effective across Product, Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, and Operations.

What you bring

15+ years in technology development, advanced manufacturing, process engineering, supplier industrialization, or a related field in consumer electronics, wearables, medical devices, semiconductors, or similarly complex products.
Proven experience building and leading multidisciplinary teams across materials, processes, equipment, and automation.
Deep expertise in several of the following: batteries, zirconia or brittle materials, PVD/coatings, molding/encapsulation, automation, precision assembly, or high-cosmetic manufacturing.
A track record of taking technologies from concept and experimentation through supplier qualification, NPI, ramp, and sustained improvement.
Strong knowledge of DFM/DFA, DOE, process capability, measurement systems, failure analysis, reliability, qualification, and statistical process control.
Experience defining equipment and tooling strategies, selecting technology partners, and influencing global suppliers and contract manufacturers.
Ability to connect technical decisions to product experience, quality, schedule, cost, capacity, and business value.
Excellent communication skills with technical and executive audiences.
Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

Benefits

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and equity packages
Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
Paid sick leave and parental leave

Services events and act as a point of escalation when needed.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Experience hiring, mentoring, and leading engineers.

jobs.title: Director of National Development, Engineering
jobs.description:
Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary range available for this position at the time of its posting. The salary range is between $71,041 and $89,867, depending on qualifications, experience, department budgets, and industry data.

Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

The director of national development has a primary responsibility for the strategic solicitation of individual gifts for the Case School of Engineering. This position is responsible for identifying, cultivating, soliciting and stewarding 125 prospects, including alumni, and non-alumni and a targeted group of local and national corporations and foundations for gifts of $100,000 to $250,000. Functioning as part of a university-wide development team, the incumbent will be expected to work collegially, and in partnership, with school-based colleagues and develop strong relationships with central development personnel and university trustees. This position will require that approximately 80% of their time be spent on direct face-to-face cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of donors and participate in planning and implementing school initiatives.

Essential Functions

Plan strategies for the identification, cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of gifts for a portfolio of 125 major gifts prospects with a giving potential in the range of $100,000 to $250,000; develop and implement strategic cultivation and solicitation strategies with the responsibility of raising private support and the achievement of personal fundraising goals. Develop and implement major gift prospect cultivation activities regionally and nationally in coordination with development and alumni relations colleagues. (65%)
Serve as development staff contact for chairs and other senior faculty; work with departments in the planning and implementation of departmental fundraising. Develop strategies to build a strong relationship with corporation and foundation partners, which may include the dean, associate dean and other senior staff of the school, president, provost and senior vice president of development and university relations. Develop major gift strategies that leverage corporation and foundation partnerships with on campus activities. (10%)
Serve as a member of the development staff and assist with the development and implementation of program strategies and overall departmental development plans to fulfill the mission of the school and the university. (10%)
Identify, qualify, recruit, train and manage alumni volunteers as appropriate, who will actively participate in the soliciting of gifts of all levels. Partner with volunteers to engage and cultivate individuals who have capacity to make gifts of $100,000 to $250,000 to the school. (10%)

Nonessential Functions

Provide assistance with other funding priorities as determined by the senior director of national development. (4%)
Perform other duties as assigned by the senior director of national development. (1%)

CONTACTS

Department: Frequent contact with dean, associate/assistant deans, department chairs, directors, faculty, students and staff as required to perform essential functions.

University: Contact with the president's office, vice presidents, deans, trustees, alumni, directors of administrative departments, faculty and staff as required to perform essential functions.

External: Daily contact with donors, alumni, foundation representatives, community organizers/advocates, corporate executives and federal, state and local government officials. Contact with visitors, academic boards and organizations as required to perform essential functions.

Students: Contact with undergraduate, graduate and professional students as required to perform essential functions.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No direct supervisory responsibility.

Qualifications

Experience: 7 or more years of professional experience required. Experience in higher education, including the areas of development, alumni relations, public relations, marketing or related fields preferred.

Education: Bachelor's degree required; prefer Master's degree.

Required Skills

High degree of energy, creativity, organization and interpersonal skills as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills required.
Must be able to work both independently and collaboratively with colleagues.
Computer proficiency (including Microsoft Office) and the ability to learn new programs.
Ability to demonstrate history of successful support, education, and advocacy for all students, aligned with the values, mission, and messaging of the university, while adhering to the staff policy on conflict of commitment and interest.
Ability to meet consistent attendance.
Ability to interact with colleagues, supervisors, and customers face to face.
Willingness to learn and work with artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies.

WORKING CONDITIONS

General office environment, some evening and weekend work hours will be required. Extensive travel required.

This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangement up to two remote days per week at the discretion of the department. New employees may begin a hybrid schedule upon approval from the supervisor, successful completion of an orientation period and signing the remote work checklist certification form.

Determinations as to granting reasonable accommodations for any applicants will be made on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.description:
Xumo, a joint venture between Comcast and Charter Communications, was formed to develop and offer a next-generation streaming platform for the entire entertainment industry. The company consists of three primary lines of business: Xumo devices, Xumo Play, and Xumo Enterprise. Powered by Comcast’s global entertainment platform, Xumo devices feature a world-class user interface with universal voice search capabilities, making it easy for consumers to find and enjoy their favorite streaming content. Xumo Play is a free ad-supported streaming TV (FAST) service offering hundreds of linear channels and on-demand options. Xumo Enterprise provides tools and services for content creators, distributors, and advertisers to make FAST content more accessible.

Job Summary

The role is instrumental in driving measurable growth across Xumo FAST (Play and Enterprise) businesses by setting platform engineering strategy, overseeing fiscal and operational performance, developing leaders, advancing scalable monetization, personalization, security, privacy, accessibility, and governance capabilities while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing engineering culture.

Job Description

Highly Preferred Qualifications/Ideal Experience:

Deep experience leading engineering organizations responsible for video, advertising technology, and data platforms at scale.
Proven success building and evolving cloud-based platform architectures that support high-volume consumer & enterprise products.
Experience scaling platforms from early-stage development through significant user growth.
Strong understanding of video streaming ecosystems, advertising technology, audience data, and platform monetization capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity & drive results in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Track record of managing & developing engineering leaders and established teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and high performance.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to partner effectively across product, data, operations, and business organizations.
Position is office based in Irvine, CA -4 days a week in office/1 day remote.

Responsibilities

Orchestrating engineering strategies aligned with Xumo FAST platform architecture across Video, Ad Tech, Data, Content Management System, and Backend domains, while fostering an environment that embraces continuous improvement and change.
Driving business objectives by implementing strategies that ensure operational excellence, accountability, and measurable impact on monetization, user engagement, and platform efficiency across the engineering organization.
Defining and overseeing execution of cross-functional, platform-level initiatives, ensuring alignment between Engineering, Product, and business priorities, and supporting delivery of large-scale, high-impact programs.
Directing data-driven analysis of operational and business metrics, monitoring project timelines, platform performance, and expenditures to ensure alignment with ROI and strategic priorities.
Managing comprehensive budget oversight, including forecasting for platform operations, development, and large-scale engineering initiatives supporting both Xumo Play and Enterprise businesses.
Leading platform development initiatives, including monetization capabilities such as advertising systems, data-driven personalization, and revenue-enabling technologies, translating these into scalable and maintainable platform solutions.
Benchmarking and optimizing work processes to meet company and industry performance standards, including improvements in system scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, and operational excellence across platform engineering.
Monitoring competitors, industry developments, and technological advances across streaming media, AVOD, and FAST markets to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, and inform platform direction.
Championing professional development by mentoring engineering leaders and building a strong leadership bench across Directors, Senior Managers, and Principal Engineers, enabling organizational scalability.
Inspiring team commitment, building shared vision, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing engineering culture across onshore and offshore teams.
Leading data security, privacy, accessibility, and governance across platform systems by applying industry best practices, supporting global privacy compliance frameworks, maintaining audit readiness, and coordinating cross-functional execution.
Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.

jobs.title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The company is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. It addresses a significant economic inefficiency: millions of highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing substantial forgone wages and untapped productivity for the economy. The organization's model has proven effective, with jobseekers entering programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and being placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, the organization has supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy. The organization is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. It is committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. The organization operates nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes an American advantage.

This role is responsible for building and leading the organization's technology strategy and infrastructure to support both internal operations and externally facing digital products. This includes staff-facing technology as well as the technical infrastructure that enables jobseeker and partner experiences. This leader partners closely with the CEO, President, and executive leadership to ensure technology is a strategic enabler of the organization's mission, helping the organization transition towards an AI and product-first model while maintaining strong operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. The organization will integrate AI into all aspects to drive operational excellence, improve jobseeker opportunities and outcomes, and this role will help lead these efforts. The VP of Technology is expected to be both strategic and execution-oriented: setting direction, making tradeoffs clear, and delivering consistently across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & AI Infrastructure
Own the organization's technology strategy across staff infrastructure and jobseeker/partner-facing products, ensuring both are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned to mission outcomes.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering staff infrastructure and IT operations, data systems and reporting, Salesforce/platform evolution, core digital products (jobseeker portal, online learning, partner tools), and integrations/interoperability across systems.
Translate organizational strategy into a sequenced plan with clear timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures.
Provide clear tradeoffs and recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team on what to prioritize, defer, or stop based on capacity and impact.
Support sprint planning, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.

Product & Engineering Partnership (Jobseeker + Partner Products)
Partner deeply with Product leadership to deliver a reliable, scalable technology foundation for the organization's jobseeker and partner ecosystem.
Ensure strong cross-functional delivery across product/tech/programs, including planning, prioritization, technical feasibility, timelines, and adoption/change management.

jobs.title: Director, AWS Catalog
jobs.description:
Description

The AWS data catalog is how customers find, understand, and govern their data on AWS. The AWS Glue Data Catalog is the metadata layer beneath AWS analytics. It holds the schemas, table definitions, and partitions that Athena, EMR, Redshift, Glue, and SageMaker need to plan and execute a query, which puts it in the data path of nearly every analytical workload our customers run, and its crawlers are how a large share of that metadata gets discovered and kept current in the first place. Alongside it, AWS Lake Formation governs fine-grained access to that data, and Amazon DataZone provides the business context, discovery, and lineage (domains, projects, and data products) that make a data estate comprehensible to the people and applications using it. Together these three services serve customers of every size, from day-one startups to the largest enterprises in the world, and hold the definitive record of the data those customers store in Amazon S3 and query with our engines. We are investing heavily to make working with that data dramatically simpler for customers, and to ensure the catalog operates at the hyperscale we expect AI agents, rather than people, to drive as they become the primary consumers of enterprise data. Catalogs have become the control point for enterprise data and AI, and we are at the very beginning of building the one customers standardize on.

As a Director of Software Development for the AWS Catalog organization, you will lead a group of top talent building the metadata, governance, and discovery layer for all data on AWS. You will own the AWS Glue Data Catalog and its crawlers, AWS Lake Formation, and Amazon DataZone, and you will drive the roadmap and deliver on three fronts at once: building a foundation that operates at a scale and request rate well beyond what any catalog handles today, with the availability and latency that every analytics service above you depends on; making governance simpler and stronger for customers who have to know and prove who can see what across a large data estate; and making the catalog the layer that AI agents reason through, with the discovery, semantic search, and business metadata that let an agent find the right data without being told where it lives. You will do this while holding a deep commitment to open standards, building on Apache Iceberg and the Iceberg REST Catalog and interoperating with third-party catalogs rather than locking customers in. You'll lead multiple engineering teams through managers across geographic locations, and you'll spearhead new technologies that change what a catalog is capable of. You'll be a leader in the business as well, owning the financial health and growth of your services. You'll personally engage with C-suite customers to represent AWS's data catalog strategy.

Success in this role requires a leader experienced in establishing and building relationships with a wide range of peers, including senior AWS executives, customers at all levels of experience and responsibility, deeply technical software and systems engineers within the team, and internal organizations. Because the catalog sits between storage and every analytics and AI service, this role rewards a leader who builds strong partnerships across engineering teams and brings them along behind a shared technical direction. This leader must have the proven skills to easily switch between weighing in on complex engineering details, taking a long-term view of the business, growing and developing the next generation of AWS leadership, and overall operating as a large-scale organization leader. It requires the judgment to balance urgent, high-value customer features against multi-year foundational investment, and the discipline to evolve a large and sophisticated installed base without disruption, for customers whose compliance posture depends on us. It requires an ability to prioritize work for the direct team and partner teams, establish goals, and focus attention on the most important inputs to drive the desired business outcomes. This leader must be capable of scaling themselves and their team to meet the ever-increasing demands of a fast-growing business, and will excel at hiring and developing technical talent. The catalog is in the path of every query our customers run, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is essential. Come build the catalog that every engine and every agent on AWS reasons through.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

15+ years of software development experience

10+ years in senior engineering leadership roles

Preferred Qualifications

Background in data analytics, engines and catalogs.

Proven experience scaling large engineering organizations across multiple geographies.

Track record of delivering customer-facing products with high velocity in a fast-moving, competitive landscape.

Experience leading product engineering, from ideation through design, build, deploy, and support.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated thought leadership.

Demonstrated ability to operate as a customer-facing technical executive.

Amazon Ads' Measurement, AdTech and Data Science (MADS) team is looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Software Development to lead engineering teams building our Performance Measurement systems.

You will own engineering teams responsible for how advertisers measure the performance of their ad campaigns, combining deterministic approaches with modeled approaches to deliver a complete and trustworthy view of advertising outcomes across channels, devices, and the full customer journey.

This role is at the intersection of big data systems engineering, applied science, and advertiser-facing product delivery. You will lead 30-50 engineers across multiple teams, owning petabyte-scale data pipelines that process billions of events daily, real-time and batch attribution systems, experimentation infrastructure (randomized controlled trials at scale), and privacy-preserving measurement architectures. Your systems directly inform how advertisers allocate billions in ad spend.

You think big, have a bias for action, and bring a history of delivering results in complex distributed systems environments. You thrive in ambiguity and are ready to scale advertising measurement. You are equally comfortable diving deep into system architecture as you are setting multi-year technical strategy with senior leadership.

The right candidate will possess a strong engineering leadership background, will have demonstrated experience building and operating large-scale data and ads systems, and will have a well-rounded understanding of advertising, causal inference, and privacy-constrained computation. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level technical strategy, but can also roll up your sleeves, dive deep into system designs, and unblock your teams when it matters.

You set technical direction, define system architectures, partner deeply with scientists to translate research into production-grade systems, and build engineering organizations that deliver at high velocity. jobs.description:
Description

How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Chief Engineers (CE) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures, and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.
Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
May assist in the build out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency
Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls.
Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.
Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance.
Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day to day tasks

Physical Requirements

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

A day in the life

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.

About The Team

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

3+ years of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel experience
Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
3+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance experience — OR — 3+ years of electrical facilities maintenance experience and 2+ year of mechanical facilities maintenance experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in construction, or experience in project management
Experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions
Can work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment

jobs.title: Director - Infra Engineering - Platform Security and Lifecycle Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

American Express Enterprise Cloud team is looking for innovators to help us build world-class applications, Cloud platforms and infrastructure supported by integrated CICD, Observability and security capabilities.

The Director Infrastructure Engineering – Platform Security and Lifecycle Management
is responsible for leading the strategy, governance, and execution of Platform as a Service and Middleware services lifecycle management across Private Cloud environments. This role leverages Gen AI/Agentic AI to drive fully automated platform upgrades, security posture management, capacity management, and operational resilience to ensure a secure, scalable, highly available, and compliant Private Cloud platform supporting mission-critical business applications.

The Director partners closely with Platform Engineering, Information Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, and Application Development teams to drive platform modernization, automate operations, reduce technology risk, and enable cloud-native adoption at scale.

Responsibilities

Private Cloud Platform Upgrade Strategy & Modernization

Define and execute the enterprise strategy and roadmap for Enterprise PaaS platform using Redhat Openshift and Data Middleware platform upgrades and lifecycle management.
Lead major version upgrades, cluster modernization, and infrastructure refresh initiatives across development, test, and production environments.
Establish standards, reference architectures, and best practices for platform lifecycle and security management.
Leverage Gen AI/Agentic AI to drive a fully automated pipeline for platform provisioning, upgrades, patching, and configuration management

Upgrades & Release Management

Own end-to-end upgrade planning, governance, risk assessment, and execution.
Establish upgrade readiness processes, validation frameworks, rollback strategies, and post-upgrade monitoring.
Coordinate with application teams to ensure platform compatibility and minimize business disruption during upgrades.
Manage lifecycle risks associated with OpenShift, Kubernetes, operating systems, middleware, and supporting infrastructure.
Track and report platform currency and technology lifecycle compliance metrics.

Security & Compliance

Establish and maintain a strong security posture across clusters and supporting infrastructure.
Lead vulnerability management, container image security, platform hardening, patch management, and remediation efforts.
Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
Partner with Information Security and Risk teams to manage security assessments, audits, and remediation activities.
Manage security exceptions and risk acceptance processes while driving long-term remediation strategies.

Capacity & Performance Management

Own capacity planning and forecasting for Platform, including compute, memory, storage, and network resources.
Develop predictive capacity models to support business growth and application onboarding.
Establish monitoring and reporting processes for cluster utilization, performance, and scalability.
Optimize infrastructure consumption and platform efficiency while maintaining service-level objectives.
Lead resource optimization initiatives to improve workload density and reduce infrastructure costs.

Leadership & Team Management

Build and lead high-performing cloud native DevOps engineers, Kubernetes administrators, security specialists, and capacity planners.
Foster a culture of operational excellence, continuous learning, innovation, and accountability.
Mentor leaders and technical experts within the organization.
Drive workforce planning, succession planning, and talent development initiatives.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Serve as the senior technology leader for Private Cloud platform services.
Partner with application development, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business leaders to align platform capabilities with organizational priorities.
Manage relationships with key vendors, managed service providers, and strategic partners.
Present platform health, upgrade status, security posture, risks, and capacity forecasts to executive leadership.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering & Operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform lifecycle management with a proven track record of leading teams in managing large-scale cloud infrastructure with a focus on automation, reliability and resilience.
Deep hands-on experience with any Kubernetes platform(multi-cloud preferred).
Experience building end to end platform upgrade and fleet management automation leveraging Gen AI / Agentic AI
Strong experience with:
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM)
Infrastructure automation tools like Ansible
Container platforms (OpenShift/Kubernetes)
Monitoring tools (Prometheus, OTEL, LOKI)
CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
Open source based messaging, caching, and database technologies like Kafka, Redis, Elastic

Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, and architecture.
Experience managing large-scale, mission-critical production environments.
Relevant certifications preferred
Experience with DevOps practices and methodologies, including CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Splunk, ELK, Dynatrace.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence decision-making at all levels of the organization.

Depending on factors such as business unit requirements, the nature of the position, cost and applicable laws, American Express may provide visa sponsorship for certain positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salaries
Bonus incentives
6% Company Match on retirement savings plan
Free financial coaching and financial well-being support
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits
Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacy
Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
Career development and training opportunities

For a full list of Team Amex benefits, visit our Colleague Benefits Site .

jobs.title: Director of Ops Technology
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. The organization is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. It is a three-time recipient of a prestigious industry award, backed by top investors.

Our Team

The team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. They embody core leadership principles in their work and culture. The organization is a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

This individual takes ownership beyond their remit and does not wait for a clean, fully-scoped mandate before moving. They lead through strong managers, but do not hide behind them: when something needs fixing, they are just as likely to jump in and fix it themselves as they are to coach someone else through it. They think critically and move fast, comfortable making calls with incomplete information and adjusting as they learn more.

This person will thrive in this role if they get energy from operating across multiple different functions, some they know deeply, some they are learning as they go, and they are honest with themselves and others about which is which. They will thrive here if they see an evolving scope as an opportunity rather than a liability.

What You'll Do

Own the tech stack and teams that run operations at the organization.
Lead established technical systems architecture and admin teams, redesigning the go-to-market stack for efficiency in an AI-first world.
Personally own and drive select high-priority workstreams and initiatives directly, not solely through delegation.
Deliver impactful, company-wide capabilities that improve business outcomes and drive key decisions, while supporting the business’s operating cadence.
Manage a team of managers and individual contributors across functions, stepping in directly wherever the situation requires it.
Drive AI-native transformation across every function owned, including hands-on build where appropriate.

What You've Done

Led a multi-function technical or operational organization, managing managers across domains.
Owned outcomes, not just outputs. Achieved business impact like growth, efficiency, conversion, retention, not just dashboards or insights. This role will help shape the future of the company.
Worked closely enough with data engineering, software engineering, or technical systems to troubleshoot issues directly, not just interpret reports from others.
Operated in a mid-size, high-growth company where building was required without inheriting mature infrastructure.
Navigated a role or organization structure that changed shape over time, and adapted their own scope and approach accordingly.
Built AI-native workflows or tooling that materially changed how a team or company operated, not incremental automation, but real step-function change in how work got done.
Collaborated closely with C-suite and executive leaders to shape strategy using data, including creating structure in ambiguity.

This role is not a fit if...

You prefer a role with a fully-defined, static scope; this organization and mandate are still being shaped, and will continue to shift based on where strengths land.
You lead primarily through delegation and expect managers to fully own execution; this role requires you to personally step in and drive work directly, not just direct others.
You rely on authority to get things done; success in this role requires influencing across teams with competing priorities, not just managing within your organization.

The hiring organization is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Exchange Traded Funds (ETF) Technology Delivery Lead – Managing Director
jobs.description:
State Street is seeking a seasoned technology executive to lead engineering and delivery for the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) platform supporting one of the firm's most strategic enterprise service. This role carries accountability for engineering execution, platform stability, operational resilience, technology modernization, and client commitments across a highly complex application ecosystem.

The successful candidate will lead globally distributed teams responsible for both mission-critical platforms and emerging cloud-native solutions. The environment includes large-scale transactional processing systems built on modern, enterprise scale technologies.

This role requires an exceptional leader who can simultaneously drive platform stabilization, operational excellence, risk reduction, modernization, and strategic transformation while serving as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders and client executives.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Delivery & Execution Leadership
Own delivery for a set of ETF applications, including architecture, engineering, quality assurance, release management, production support, and operational readiness.
Ensure predictable, high-quality execution against business priorities, regulatory expectations, client commitments, and service-level objectives.
Establish strong delivery governance, execution discipline, and accountability across globally distributed teams.
Drive continuous improvement in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
Platform Stability, Resiliency & Operational Excellence
Serve as the senior technology leader accountable for platform stability, resiliency, and production service quality.
Lead initiatives to reduce incidents, eliminate recurring production issues, strengthen operational controls, and improve service reliability.
Drive improvements in observability, monitoring, automation, self-healing capabilities, disaster recovery readiness, and recoverability.
Strengthen change management, testing, release governance, and production support disciplines to minimize operational risk.
Partner closely with Investor Services teams - Product, Global Delivery and Technology to improve end-to-end process reliability and client outcomes.
Act as the executive escalation point for critical incidents and ensure transparent communication through resolution.
Platform Stewardship & Modernization
Lead engineering teams responsible for critical technologies and large-scale batch-processing environments.
Balance stability, risk management, and business continuity needs while advancing long-term modernization objectives.
Develop and execute transformation roadmaps for application simplification, technical debt reduction, platform decomposition, and cloud migration.
Ensure institutional knowledge is retained while reducing concentration risk and modernizing skills across the organization.
Cloud & Engineering Transformation
Lead modernization initiatives leveraging AWS, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, data platforms, and cloud-native technologies.
Champion AI-enabled engineering and intelligent automation opportunities to improve productivity, quality, and operational effectiveness.
Establish modern engineering standards that improve scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
Governance, Risk & Control Excellence
Establish comprehensive governance frameworks covering delivery health, platform performance, risk management, control effectiveness, and service quality.
Drive proactive identification and remediation of technology, operational, and delivery risks.
Ensure adherence to enterprise risk management, cyber security, audit, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous risk reduction.
Talent & Organizational Leadership

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director for Sentinel Specialty Engineering
within the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This position will be located in Roy, Utah or Huntsville, AL
and will support the Sentinel program. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

What You Will Get To Do

Lead the Specialty Engineering organization within Sentinel Systems Engineering, supporting the Systems Engineering Element Lead.
Direct the implementation of specialty system engineering requirements and processes across the program segments, driving consistency and implementation across program/product teams at all national locations and multiple subcontractor locations.
Management (CAM) of specialty engineering work scope including planning, budgeting, and reporting.
Coordination of specialty engineering topics across various integrated product teams (IPTs).
Leadership and coordination of internal and external stakeholder engagements (engineering review boards, change control boards, customer sync meetings, formal working groups, and others).

Establish and direct the implementation of model-based digital engineering processes used in the design and development of Sentinel, at all levels of decomposition.
Ensure specialty engineering product quality and consistency for the Sentinel program.
Interface closely with the product/program team leadership and implement systems engineering priorities for the team.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for Specialty Engineering (Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, E3, and System Safety) including mentoring high potential leaders and advising program lead

Additional Responsibilities May Include

Horizontally integrate across System Engineering directorate as well as members of the Engineering and Manufacturing Operations organization to ensure consistency of systems engineering approach. This will help identify areas of opportunity to support upcoming challenges that are not currently being elevated.
Provide independent review of portfolio software, hardware and deliverables, focused deep dives in program and product teams, as well as driving compliance to processes and procedures.
Identify opportunities for and support of engagement activities across all programs.
Identify and mentor high potential technical leaders.
Provide advisement to all program leads (as required) and embedded resources.

Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
401k
Educational Assistance
Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
Paid Time Off
Health & Wellness Resources
Employee Discounts

This positions standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This position may offer relocation assistance.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in STEM with at least 10 years of progressive engineering experience, or Master’s and 8 years’ of experience.
Experience leading engineering teams/and or organizations to achieve a common goal.
Active US Government Secret clearance, investigation must have been completed within last 5 years

ICBM or complex aerospace systems experience
Experience in Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3), System Safety, Specialty Integration, and Compliance Requirements/Verification
Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) experience
Design Engineering/Computer-aided Design (CAD) experience
Prior experience interfacing with prime contractor site leads and USAF leadership personnel
Prior experience with Air Force Range Safety
Active DoD TS/SCI clearance
Experience leading the performance of tasks on schedule, at cost and achieving all requirements as either project lead, integrated program team or cost account manager

Strong understanding and broad application of complex engineering systems (engineering standards, configuration management, material review board, process control, tooling, facilities, software, etc.)
Strong oral and written communication skills, including demonstrated experience with high value customer presentations, with ability to focus on multiple projects with competing priorities
Experience in working closely with customers to ensure delivery of systems that meet warfighter needs
Ability to collaborate and achieve consensus when dealing with groups from diverse organizations and backgrounds
Demonstrated experience in making sound decisions in uncertain and difficult situations
Strong sense of urgency and work ethic in ensuring engineering meets customer and program expectations in a timely and efficient manner

Develop leaders and structure. Grow front-line managers and technical leads. Develop organizational structure and operating cadence that lets a fast-growing global team stay accountable, fast, and close to the customer.

Scale customer enablement through automation, design guides, simulation models and other high leverage means.

Own the reference design portfolio for AI and compute power delivery — delivered ahead of customer windows.

Own technical escalations end to end and close the loop from field learning back into the roadmap.

Qualifications

Proven organizational leadership. Demonstrated track record of building and scaling technical teams through periods of rapid growth, including managing managers, with a personal record of recruiting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent.

Datacenter power expertise. Deep experience with datacenter and server power delivery architectures spanning rack and bus bar distribution through intermediate conversion to the point of load.

Customer-facing seniority. Experience leading technical engagements with hyperscale, OEM, ODM, or ASIC customers, with the executive communication skills to be credible with engineers and senior decision makers alike.

Cross-functional influence. Ability to align cross-functional organizations without direct authority and make decisive trade-offs under schedule pressure.

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with 15+ years of relevant experience; or an advanced degree (MS or PhD) with 12+ years of relevant experience.

Substantial portion of that experience in power electronics, power management semiconductors, or datacenter power delivery, including direct people-leadership responsibility. Domestic and international travel to customer and Renesas sites is required.
