Regeneron’s Enterprise Data & AI organization is newly established and moving fast — built to drive AI transformation and adoption at scale across every part of the enterprise. This is a high-visibility, high-velocity position where the work is directly tied to business and scientific impact.

The Vice President, AI Technology, Innovation and Delivery is the first hire into this function. This leader establishes Regeneron's AI architecture foundation, stands up the engineering capability, and builds the practice before leading it. Accountable for translating frontier AI capabilities into production-grade solutions, this role defines the enterprise AI architecture vision, stands up Forward Deployment Engineering, and owns the AI innovation engine from horizon scanning to proof-of-concept to scaled deployment. As the organization matures, this leader will lay the groundwork for future sub-function leaders across architecture, engineering, and innovation.

The role works in close partnership with the Data & AI Engineering leader in Regeneron’s Global Capability Center (GCC) in India, where build and operate resides. Together, they ensure that what is designed is architected for platform-scale delivery and built to last.

This position reports to the SVP Chief AI Officer.

Core Responsibilities

Agentic AI Strategy & Platform Evaluation

Defines and owns the enterprise AI architecture vision, design patterns, and technical standards across Regeneron. Sets enterprise direction for agentic AI, evaluating and selecting platforms, frameworks, and architecture patterns. Strategy and platform selection reside in this role; build and operate sit within the GCC.
Determines where Regeneron builds, buys, or partners for agentic AI capabilities, ensuring strategic alignment with the GCC for build-and-operate execution.
Translates business problems into solution blueprints, architecture patterns, and integration pathways, owning design decisions from concept through prototype with production-grade rigor.

Enterprise AI Product Management

Leads a team of product managers and product owners accountable for Regeneron’s portfolio of enterprise AI capabilities. Each capability has a defined owner, a roadmap, and adoption metrics, ensuring AI solutions are treated as products, not projects: with clear business sponsors, measurable outcomes, and a path to sustained value.

Emerging Technology & Industry Intelligence

Tracks the AI frontier across models, platforms, agentic frameworks, and methods, and translates that intelligence into concrete recommendations tied to Regeneron’s business and scientific priorities.
Maintains a clear view of how AI is advancing across biopharma and life sciences and identifies where emerging capabilities can solve real problems or unlock new opportunities. Runs structured pilots with clear adoption criteria.

Forward Deployment Engineering

Stands up Regeneron’s Forward Deployment Engineering capability from the ground up. Deploys cross-domain squads that embed directly with business and scientific stakeholders to accelerate priority use cases. Operates in two modes: rapid deployment of configured GenAI and low-code/no-code solutions and structured prototype-to-handoff engagements for higher-complexity problems requiring GCC production engineering.
Defines the squad model, deployment playbook, and engagement standards, establishing the operational distinction between rapid-deployment and build-to-scale modes from day one.

People & Organizational Leadership

Builds, develops, and leads a multidisciplinary organization spanning product managers, applied AI engineers, solutions architects, and forward deployment engineers. Sets the technical bar, develops senior talent, and holds the organization to measurable outcomes.
Partners with GCC engineering leadership to ensure solutions are buildable, scalable, and maintainable at platform level. Defines and governs handoff standards between applied AI prototypes and GCC production engineering.
Represents applied AI to senior leadership across the enterprise. Partners with peers across Enterprise Data & AI to ensure delivery is integrated with data, MLOps, and governance functions.

20+ years leading applied AI/ML organizations through the full lifecycle — opportunity identification, architecture, prototype, and production handoff.
Demonstrated experience building and leading AI product management organizations — establishing product ownership, roadmaps, and adoption accountability for enterprise AI capabilities.
Strong product mindset paired with hands-on solution architecture depth; able to operate as both strategist and technical leader — not a pure people-manager.
Deep appreciation for the life sciences context — an understanding of how AI is reshaping drug discovery, clinical development, regulatory, and commercial functions in biopharma, and a genuine appetite to engage with Regeneron’s science. This orientation is essential to earn credibility with Regeneron’s scientific and operational leadership.
Deep familiarity with the current AI landscape: generative AI, agentic systems, LLM application architecture, retrieval and reasoning patterns, and modern AI/ML platforms.
Hands-on familiarity with low-code/no-code AI deployment and configured GenAI platforms; able to recognize when a business problem calls for rapid configuration versus custom engineering and build a team that executes both modes with equal discipline.
Proven track record building and scaling reusable AI capabilities across a complex enterprise.
Experience partnering with distributed engineering organizations; successful experience designing-to-handoff with a GCC team in India or similar global delivery model is strongly preferred.
Ability to communicate and influence effectively across Digital Technology groups, business units, and the GCC team in India.
Strong people leadership; experience leading leaders and building senior technical organizations in a competitive market.

Advanced Problem Solving: Partner with Process Development and site engineering to resolve long-standing constraints around double-sided mixed VIPPO, tight spacing, and rework capabilities.

Global Leadership: Mentor, direct, and grow engineering talent across our Richardson, Shanghai, and Penang hubs.

DFM rule set content and official rule change proposals.
Pre-DFM reports and centralized DFM findings registers.
Comprehensive fabrication, SMT, and assembly design guidelines.
Encoded Valor rules and automated design check workflows.

This position sits inside the DFx Center of Excellence and is not

Key Success Metrics

Total pre-DFM portfolio coverage and turnaround times below targeted SLAs.
Percentage of findings closed through concrete design or process changes.
Reduction of repeat DFM findings across product platforms.
Expansion of the automated checklist share within the design environment.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

Deep technical expertise in SMT manufacturing, PCB fabrication, and panelization rules.

Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. Elite is hiring a Director , Platform & Intelligence Value Stream to own the value stream end to end — the shared platform foundation every Elite product is built on, together with the productization of our AI and data capabilities. You will own the roadmap for orchestration, conversational AI, rules, unified access, and the event backbone, and turn those services into a reusable foundation that our financial, work-to-cash, and internal business product lines build on rather than around.

You will carry the what and why for the stream — a single prioritized backlog, roadmap sequencing, and requirements translation through release commitment and delivery — pair daily with an engineering delivery unit, and lead a small standing team of domain and analyst talent. Because the platform is horizontal, you will sit upstream of every customer-facing product line, and you will be measured on the return the stream delivers rather than on output volume.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform teams within the Platform Engineering organization. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role responsible for the foundational systems that store, ingest, and evolve the data powering ZoomInfo's entire go-to-market product suite.

You will lead a team of senior engineers across two core areas:

GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable), spanning scaling, performance, operational reliability, and the change data capture (CDC) systems that capture and propagate data change events downstream.
ZoomInfo Data Platform — ZoomInfo's analytical data store (BigQuery), including the ingestion pipelines and onboarding systems that bring new data in and keep it flowing accurately and efficiently, and the processes that ensure customer data deletion requests are handled promptly and compliantly.

This role sits at the foundation of ZoomInfo's data infrastructure — the reliability, scale, and integrity of these systems directly determine how fast we can onboard new data and how confidently we can serve it to customers. You will manage senior technical talent directly, setting technical direction, unblocking hard problems, and holding a high bar for engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

Lead and develop a team of senior engineers and tech leads across GTM Store and the ZoomInfo Data Platform.
Set the roadmap across both areas, balancing scaling and performance needs, new data onboarding velocity, compliance obligations, security and platform reliability.
Build a high-performance engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical rigor, and operational excellence for systems operating at large scale.
Manage senior technical individual contributors directly — setting expectations, providing technical guidance, and developing career growth paths for staff-level and senior engineers.
Serve as a trusted partner to the VP of Software Engineering, contributing to broader platform engineering strategy.
Establish clear prioritization frameworks to manage competing demands across scaling, new data onboarding, compliance, and reliability work.

GTM Store

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable) powering the go-to-market data product.
Drive scaling initiatives to keep pace with data growth and increasing query/read-write demands from downstream products.
Guide architecture decisions to improve performance, latency, and cost-efficiency at scale.
Establish and maintain operational best practices — monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and incident response — to ensure high availability.
Own the strategy and architecture for change data capture (CDC), ensuring data change events are captured, propagated, and consumed reliably by downstream systems, including the ZoomInfo Data Platform.
Guide the selection and evolution of CDC tooling and patterns to support real-time and near-real-time data change propagation at scale.
Ensure CDC systems maintain data consistency, ordering guarantees, and fault tolerance under high event volume.
Partner with Product and downstream engineering teams to understand data access patterns and evolve the store's schema, APIs, and change event streams accordingly.

ZoomInfo Data Platform

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the ZoomInfo Data Platform — the analytical data store (BigQuery) that consumes and serves data for downstream analytics and product use cases.
Own the architecture and roadmap for data ingestion pipelines, including those consuming CDC streams from the GTM Store, that bring new data sources into the platform.
Drive initiatives to ease and accelerate the onboarding of new data sources, reducing the engineering lift required to integrate each new dataset.
Establish standardized, repeatable ingestion patterns and tooling that shorten time-to-value for new data.
Ensure ingestion pipelines are reliable, observable, and scalable to handle growing data volume and variety.
Own the systems and processes that handle customer data deletion requests, ensuring they are executed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and related regulations.
Partner with Legal/Compliance and Product to evolve data deletion workflows as privacy regulations and customer requirements change.
Build observability and auditability into deletion workflows to provide clear evidence of compliance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enablement

Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements for scaling, new data onboarding, and compliance work that inform the platform roadmap.
Drive enablement programs — documentation and tooling — that help internal teams onboard new data sources faster and with less friction.
Represent the GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform in strategic planning conversations and technology decisions with company-wide implications.

Required

What You Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in software/platform engineering or data engineering, with experience operating at a senior leadership level.
Experience directly managing senior technical talent — staff engineers, tech leads, or senior ICs — and holding a high technical bar.
Strong working knowledge of large-scale operational (e.g., BigTable) and analytical (e.g., BigQuery) data stores and distributed systems, including experience scaling data infrastructure to handle high volume and throughput.
Experience with data ingestion pipeline architecture and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Debezium, Kafka Connect, Kafka, or similar streaming/CDC tooling).
Experience with data privacy and compliance practices, including handling data deletion / right-to-be-forgotten requests under GDPR/CCPA.
Demonstrated ability to balance platform reliability and performance work against feature and onboarding velocity.
Proven cross-functional partnership skills with product and business stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills — able to present strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership.

Preferred

Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data infrastructure, including BigTable and BigQuery.
Familiarity with event streaming platforms (Kafka) and workflow/pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar).
Experience building self-service tooling that accelerates data onboarding for internal teams.

What Sets You Apart

You lead through people. Your strongest technical asset is your ability to hire, develop, and empower exceptional engineers — and then get out of their way.
You connect technology to business outcomes. You see infrastructure investments not as technical projects but as enablers of speed, trust, and better decisions across the company.
You are a systems thinker. You see the connections between platform architecture, team structure, process design, and stakeholder experience — and you optimize across all four.
You are decisive under ambiguity. Competing priorities, legacy systems, organizational change, and imperfect information don't paralyze you — they sharpen your focus.
You balance vision with pragmatism. You can articulate a bold multi-year direction and then break it into quarterly deliverables your team can execute with confidence.
You build bridges. Engineering, analytics, security, and business teams all see you as someone who understands their world and advocates for shared outcomes.

How We Work

Be Relentless. We outpace and outcompete. We are smart, clever, and resourceful in everything we do.
Be Entrepreneurs. We hustle, move fast, take ownership, and make decisions. We are accountable and resilient.
Be Experts. We understand our customers deeply and demand domain expertise from everyone.
Be Innovators. We innovate not just in product, but in how we operate — driving outcomes no one thought were possible.
Be a Team. We are one team, working together to win. We collaborate and lean in to help each other.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director for Sentinel Specialty Engineering
within the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This position will be located in Roy, Utah or Huntsville, AL
and will support the Sentinel program. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

What You Will Get To Do

Identify and mentor high potential technical leaders.

Experience in Human Systems Integration, Nuclear Hardness and Survivability, Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3), System Safety, Specialty Integration, and Compliance Requirements/Verification

jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.

About The Role

As a Senior Manager, Engineering for DevOps, Infrastructure, and Release Engineering, you will lead teams responsible for the reliability, scalability, and safe delivery of our SaaS platforms. This role owns the end‑to‑end release lifecycle— through CI/CD, environment promotion, and production deployment—ensuring releases are repeatable, observable, auditable, and low‑risk.

You will balance senior‑level people leadership with deep technical oversight of release engineering systems, cloud infrastructure, and operational excellence. You will partner closely with Product Engineering, Quality Engineering, Security, and Operations to eliminate release friction, reduce deployment risk, and improve time‑to‑value without compromising stability or compliance.

This role is ideal for an experienced leader who has lived through failed releases, scale pain, and operational incidents—and knows how to design systems and teams that prevent them from recurring.

Your day to day

People & Organizational Leadership

Lead, coach, and grow DevOps, Infrastructure, and Release Engineering teams across geographies
Establish clear ownership and accountability across CI/CD, environments, and production readiness
Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career development planning
Hire, onboard, and retain senior DevOps and release engineering talent
Foster a culture of operational ownership, blameless postmortems, and high availability
Remove systemic blockers so teams can focus on building resilient delivery pipelines—not firefighting

Release Engineering & Delivery Excellence

Own the release engineering strategy for a SaaS platform supporting frequent, reliable deployments
Design and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines that support:
Trunk‑based or hybrid branching strategies
Automated testing gates (unit, integration, security, performance)
Progressive delivery (feature flags, canaries, blue‑green deployments)

Establish deployment standards, change classification, and risk levels across teams
Reduce release toil, manual steps, and human error through automation
Drive improvements in deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to recovery (DORA metrics)
Ensure consistent release processes across services, platforms, and cloud environment
Proven experience implementing and operating observability for cloud‑based SaaS platforms, including metrics, logs, traces, and alerting
Ability to integrate observability into CI/CD and release workflows to enable release confidence, faster incident detection, and reduced MTTR

Technical & Platform Leadership

Provide technical leadership across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments
Ensure infrastructure and delivery pipelines follow security, compliance, and cloud best practices
Partner with Architecture and Security to enforce:
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
Secure-by-default deployments
Policy-as-code and guardrails

Influence architecture decisions to improve operability, scalability, and release safety
Guide teams in designing systems that are observable, debuggable, and resilient
Needs a leader who treats releases as a product, not a task queue

Operational Excellence & Incident Readiness

Own production readiness standards and release go/no‑go criteria
Ensure clear incident response processes, escalation paths, and on‑call readiness
Lead post‑incident reviews with a focus on systemic fixes, not individual mistakes
Partner with engineering teams to reduce operational load and deployment risk over time

Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration

Partner deeply with Product, QE, Security, and Engineering leaders to align on release expectations
Communicate risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to senior and executive stakeholders
Represent DevOps and Release Engineering in customer, partner, and audit conversations as needed

What You Bring To The Team

At least 8 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles
At least 5 years managing engineering managers and/or senior technical teams
Prior hands‑on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines for SaaS platforms
Strong experience with AWS (primary), Azure, GCP.
Deep understanding of:
Release engineering principles
CI/CD automation
Infrastructure as Code
DevOps and SRE best practices

Experience supporting high‑availability, distributed systems in production
Strong track record improving reliability, deployment safety, and operational maturity
Excellent communication, decision‑making, and stakeholder management skills
Must have hands on experience in these key tools and technologies (representative, not exhaustive list):
CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
Infrastructure: Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep
Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
Release & Governance: Feature flags (LaunchDarkly), change management automation
Observability: CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
Security & Compliance: SAST/DAST tools, policy-as-code, secrets management

You hold relentlessly high bar for release quality and operational safety
You know when to slow down to move faster later
You can say “no” to unsafe releases—and explain why with credibility
You lead calmly during incidents and decisively after them
You model accountability, empathy, and engineering excellence in equal measure

What We Would Like To See, But Not Required

Demonstrable hands-on experience adapting to industry trends in automation and efficiency of code generation to modernize DevOps, CloudOps

Compensation:
Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.

What You’ll Get In Return

Unlimited paid time off – recharge when you need it
Work from anywhere – flexibility to fit your life
Comprehensive health coverage – multiple plan options to choose from
Equity for every employee – share in our success
Growth-focused environment – your development matters here
Home office setup allowance – one-time support to get you started
Monthly cell phone allowance – stay connected with ease

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.

AI Use in Recruitment

We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks. We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.

Adobe Intelligence Platform is the foundational AI infrastructure that powers agentic experiences across the Adobe product portfolio. It is transforming Adobe from a suite of best-in-class tools into a unified, AI-native ecosystem.

This platform encompasses agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, skill and capability catalogs, and the planning and reasoning layers that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows at enterprise scale.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to own the engineering vision and execution of building the Adobe Intelligence Platform. This is a pivotal role to invent, embed, and scale the latest in AI innovation into Adobe’s products. This role is highly visible and key to executing Adobe’s vision to transform the way creators and their teams work and create.

Define and drive a holistic and full stack engineering strategy for the Adobe Intelligence Platform.
Integrate platform components into web, desktop, and mobile surfaces, partnering with global teams to accelerate their timelines and unify the customer experience.
Grow the organization, including hiring world-class talent, structuring teams, and developing the next generation of AI leaders within Adobe.
Model and drive a new way of working, using the latest AI tooling to plan, review, and ship software.
Own the technology strategy, pairing with senior architects, to define the roadmaps for agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, agentic harnesses, and skill catalogs.

Align with Security, Privacy and Legal colleagues to ensure the platform has observability, security, and enterprise governance controls around safety and trust built into the end-to-end architecture.
Define the adoption strategy and own the outcome for partnerships internally: ensure Adobe Intelligence Platform is serving the needs of application teams at all levels and across Adobe’s 3 cloud offering areas.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Embark on a career putting innovative, reliable, and agile products and ideas into orbit, and beyond. Northrop Grumman has opportunities waiting for you that play a vital role in human space exploration, national defense, and scientific discovery, supporting multiple programs across the universe. With us, you’ll discover a culture of curiosity and collaboration that will have you Defining Possible from the day you start. Our space systems connect and protect millions of people on earth every day, now and for the future. Explore your future and launch your career today.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director 1, Test Engineering
in our SDS Division. This leadership role is located in Roy, UT
. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s Sentinel, sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

The Test Engineering Functional Homeroom is responsible for development, career growth, and leadership of a multi-disciplined test engineering team as well as test process and governance, training content development, KPI metrics, and organizational infrastructure of the Test Directorate. This team is also responsible for enabling execution of test planning, test execution, and test reporting to include lab, ground, and flight testing; lab design and operations; test data and instrumentation, system integration, and verification testing in support of Integrated Functional Capability to support successful program execution. Testing occurs at Northrop Grumman, various supplier, and US Government facilities throughout the US.

As a senior leader, you act with integrity and the highest ethical standards in everything you do. You enable your team to achieve predictable and balanced results, while satisfying the needs of internal and external partners. You treat all people with respect, and you model personal growth and continuous development. You know how to build an inclusive environment that attracts, retains, and inspires a diverse and engaged team. You develop trusted and valued customer relationships and communicate effectively, so that personnel throughout the organization are engaged, motivated, and connected to their work. You deliver excellence, strive for continuous improvement, and respond vigorously to change.

What You Will Get To Do

Lead a high-performing test engineering team in test planning, integration, and execution across the SDS Division portfolio of programs while reporting directly to the SDS Vice President of Engineering.

Develop and foster Test Engineering vision aligned to overall division engineering vision of world-class engineering.
Develop and drive progress of Test Engineering goals and milestones.
Drive technical rigor, ownership, and accountability in Test Engineering products and execution.
Lead a large team of cross discipline directors, managers, and professionals at various locations responsible for Test Engineering support of a portfolio of mission critical programs across all phases of EMD test (lab, ground, and flight) including instrumentation and test data collection.
Responsible for establishing and directing the implementation of test engineering process and governance driving consistency across program/product teams at all locations and multiple subcontractor locations.
Responsible for establishing and implementing test tools and automation to drive standardization and efficiency across the directorate.
Responsible for developing training to ensure test teams are trained and capable of test execution.
Participate in establishing and directing the implementation of model-based digital engineering processes used in the design and development of Test Engineering execution and test lab design at all levels of decomposition.
Ensure test engineering first time quality of products, manage auditing, and oversight functions including metrics development and management.
Interface closely with the product/program team leadership and implement test engineering priorities

Bachelor’s Degree in STEM and 10 year’s experience supporting U.S. Government contracts and customers and/or project management in other industries

jobs.title: Director of Product, Enterprise Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting-edge AI-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.

As trailblazers in end-to-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.

Our vision extends beyond mere problem-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.

Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.

About The Role

This is a player-coach role reporting to the SVP Product. You will help lead the product team while personally owning an important product area.

Your initial IC charter will be the Enterprise Platform: the APIs, integrations, workspaces, permissions, governance, and reliability requirements that make Axion secure, connected, and ready for complex manufacturers. As the team evolves, you may also step into priority Core Product work where your judgment and execution can have the greatest impact.

You will spend roughly half your time as a functional leader: running planning and reviews, setting the metrics that matter, coaching PMs, and owning the operating cadence between Product and Engineering. The other half you will spend as an individual contributor on the hardest platform surface area we have.

We are looking for someone who raises the ceiling on how this team works, not someone who adds a layer to it.

What You Will Own

Build great product

Personally lead Enterprise Platform from customer understanding through strategy, product definition, execution, launch, adoption, and learning, with flexibility to step into priority Core Product work.
Set the product direction for APIs, integrations, workspaces, permissions, governance, audit, and reliability in close partnership with customers, Design, and Engineering.
Make hard product choices and separate reusable capability from one-off requests while staying responsive to urgent customer and business needs.

Build the product operating system

Turn company and product strategy into clear outcomes, priorities, owners, and metrics through planning, reviews, demos, and decision follow-through.
Establish a productive cadence across Product, Design, and Engineering that improves how teams define problems, make tradeoffs, launch, measure results, and learn.
Give executives and the company useful visibility into product decisions, progress, and learning without creating unnecessary process.

Lead the team and portfolio

Manage and coach a small team of PMs, raising product judgment and craft while preserving clear ownership.
Create coherence across Agentic Product, Core Product, Data & Onboarding, and Enterprise Platform, including the dependencies and tradeoffs among them.
Partner closely with the SVP Product, Engineering, Design, Solutions, and GTM leadership.

How The Team Is Organized

You will lead a team covering four areas. Yours is Enterprise Platform. The other three:

Agentic Product
builds agent-powered products that move customer work forward: agent behavior, hypotheses, evidence, recommendations, and the human feedback and approval loop.

Core Product
owns the everyday customer experience: the issue view and lifecycle, investigation and resolution, monitoring and alerts, dashboards, and Studio.

Data and Onboarding
gets customer data and users into a trusted workspace faster: ingestion, transformations, mappings, taxonomy, workspace readiness, and activation.

What Success Looks Like In Your First Year

You deliver meaningful customer and business results in your own product charter.
Product, Design, and Engineering operate through a shared cadence that produces clearer decisions and stronger follow-through.
Product reviews and demos improve product quality, learning, and company alignment rather than becoming status meetings.
The PM team demonstrates stronger judgment and ownership, and Enterprise Platform has a clearer direction across integrations, controls, governance, and shared foundations.
The product team executes with less routine dependence on the executive above it

What We Are Looking For

Experience as a player-coach: you have led PMs while owning meaningful scope yourself, and you are not looking to stop building
Depth in enterprise platform product: APIs, integrations, permissions, governance, reliability, or AI
Technical judgment strong enough to earn engineering's trust and to make architecture-adjacent calls without deferring every one of them
Product operations instinct: you have installed planning, review, and metric practices on a team that did not have them
Executive presence: you can hold a room with our CEO, our customers, and our board, and you can disagree in it
Comfort with ambiguity and with detail. We are a company that argues about specifics, and the people who do well here find that energizing rather than exhausting

Nice to have

Building production AI, agent, workflow automation, data, or enterprise platform products.
Working in manufacturing, quality, reliability, or another complex operational domain
Experience at a company that scaled from Series B through the enterprise readiness curve

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

As part of BCG X, you will collaborate closely with consulting teams across a wide range of advanced topics. In this role, you will apply software development methodologies to deliver value to BCG Consulting teams, BCG X case teams, BCG X Product teams, and Practice Areas, acting as a subject-matter expert in software engineering and execution.

You will combine deep software engineering expertise with modern AI-native development practices, leveraging platforms such as Harness, cloud technologies, AI coding and engineering agents, automation and modern DevSecOps approaches to accelerate the journey from idea to production.

You will lead and enable teams across the full product lifecycle—from discovery, architecture and rapid prototyping through development, testing, deployment and ongoing optimisation—delivering solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient and production-ready. Assignments will range from rapid AI-enabled Proofs of Concept and MVPs to enterprise-grade products, with a focus on increasing engineering velocity, quality and developer productivity through intelligent automation and emerging AI capabilities.

Experts focus on developing BCG's thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team to bring the ‘best of BCG’ to our clients, Experts come from diverse backgrounds, with expertise often gained outside of BCG in industry, academia, or specialized consulting.

Notre filière d'experts-conseils

La filière d’experts-conseils (FEC) est essentielle pour permettre à BCG de répondre avec succès à la demande de ses clients en matière d’expertise approfondie et de capacités techniques avancées. Les experts ont une incidence de premier ordre sur les défis les plus complexes et les plus pointus des clients de BCG. Les experts se concentrent sur le développement du leadership intellectuel, des capacités commerciales et des actifs de propriété intellectuelle de BCG, et leur travail est essentiel à notre modèle de prestation de services. Travaillant au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire pour offrir le « meilleur de BCG » à nos clients, ces experts viennent d’horizons divers et possèdent souvent une expertise acquise à l’extérieur de BCG dans un secteur d'activité, le milieu universitaire ou les services-conseils spécialisés.

What You'll Bring

Technical Skills

Must have strong experience:

AI-native software engineering: Hands-on experience using Generative AI, AI coding assistants and/or agentic development tools to accelerate software design, development, testing, documentation and delivery; understanding of LLM-based applications, APIs, RAG and AI-enabled engineering workflows.
Modern software engineering: Strong proficiency with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, Unix/Linux development environments, Git and modern software development practices.
Full-stack development: Experience building scalable, responsive applications using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue, and backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django or Node.js.
Cloud & platform engineering: Strong experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, containerisation with Docker/Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform, and modern platform engineering practices.
Modern CI/CD & DevSecOps: Experience with enterprise CI/CD and automated software delivery platforms such as Harness, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or CircleCI, including automated testing, security, quality gates, deployment strategies and continuous delivery.
Data platforms & APIs: Strong SQL and database experience (NoSQL, Graph, Vector...), together with designing and integrating REST APIs and scalable data services.
Quality engineering: Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Pytest, Jest or Mocha, alongside modern approaches to test automation, continuous validation and AI-assisted software quality.
Engineering architecture & scalability: Track record of designing, developing and supporting secure, resilient and highly scalable software applications and services, with an understanding of modern application architecture, observability and production operations.
Developer productivity & automation: Experience using automation, reusable engineering patterns, developer platforms and AI-enabled tooling to improve engineering velocity, software quality and developer experience.

Job Requirement

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Significant experience in software engineering and engineering management, including leading 20+ cross-functional resources across geographically distributed teams and delivering enterprise-scale products, platforms and rapid MVPs.
Strong technical credibility with hands-on software engineering experience, combined with the ability to lead teams adopting AI-native development practices, modern engineering platforms and emerging technologies.
Demonstrated experience driving the adoption of Generative AI, AI-assisted development, automation and agentic engineering to improve software delivery velocity, quality and developer productivity.
Strong understanding of engineering culture, talent development, performance management and organisational leadership, ideally within a large-scale consulting, technology or software engineering environment.
Proven ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, ambiguous environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining a strong focus on outcomes, quality and execution.
Credible and inspirational technology leader with excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, able to engage confidently with engineers, product leaders, consultants and senior executives.
Strong understanding of modern Agile product and engineering practices, including Scrum, Kanban, DevSecOps and continuous delivery, with a track record of delivering complex programmes with excellence across quality, cost, speed and operational performance.
Experience establishing engineering standards, governance and AI/technology guardrails while enabling teams to move rapidly and experiment with emerging technologies.
A continuous-learning mindset, with the curiosity and leadership to evaluate and operationalise new AI, software engineering and delivery technologies that create measurable business value.

Other Skills (+)

Technical & Delivery Oversight

Thought partnering as a trusted advisor with stakeholders / consulting teams on software development, delivery, and architecture topics, working closely with lead engineers and business stakeholders
Taking ownership of technical envisioning, feasibility, budgeting, timelines, and objectives/plans for enterprise grade software applications
Responsible for periodic design and code reviews, coaching on new technologies, and sharing constructive feedback with team members
Solve complex business problems with technical solutions, identifying roadmap dependencies and collaborating with cross functional teams
Identify and build necessary technical capabilities within the team through upskilling, training, and setting best practices and standards for development, integration and testing

Lead software and AI engineering teams across the full people lifecycle, including hiring, team design, talent development, succession planning, performance management and retention, aligned to organisational priorities and investment.
Build a high-performing, inclusive engineering culture that encourages innovation, experimentation, continuous learning and responsible adoption of AI, while maintaining high standards of engineering excellence.

Problem Solving, Technical Leadership & Mentoring

Bring strong solution-architecture and hands-on engineering expertise across the end-to-end software and AI delivery lifecycle, from discovery and prototyping through production and optimisation.

jobs.title: Senior Director, RGM Product AI Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Role

Revenue Growth Management (RGM) is one of The Coca-Cola Company’s most important commercial capabilities, and not simply a pricing discipline. Coca-Cola positions RGM alongside brand building, innovation, and integrated execution as a core capability for topline growth, and our growth strategy names it a key commercial capability for determining where to play and how to win.

RGM connects consumer demand to the economics of the system. It determines what we sell, in which packages, at what price points, through which channels and customers, and with what promotional investment, all in service of balanced growth across transactions, volume, and price/mix. Done well, it finds incremental revenue pools and converts them into commercial action, improves the economics of every price, pack, assortment, and promotion decision, builds the affordability and premiumization ladders that bring more consumers into the portfolio, and gives Coca-Cola and its bottlers a common fact base for growing customer revenue and profit rather than simply negotiating price.

We are now reimagining RGM for the Agentic AI era, and we are building it ourselves. Our Global RGM Product is evolving from a suite of analytical solutions into an intelligent decision platform where AI agents interact directly with enterprise data, invoke advanced analytics and optimization models, run and compare scenarios, and hand commercial teams a recommendation with the reasoning attached. Work that once took an analyst a week (pulling the data, running the model, writing the story, defending the number) is being compressed into a conversation.

Few companies are attempting this at this scale, and fewer are still against decisions this consequential: real pricing, promotion, and portfolio moves, made across markets and bottlers. The work sits at the frontier of the CPG industry, spanning agent orchestration, retrieval over enterprise data, and the evaluation of non-deterministic and deterministic systems, and none of it is a research exercise. What we build ships to commercial teams who use it to make decisions the same week.

This is an opportunity to build, not just design, the next generation of commercial decision intelligence at Coca-Cola, and to establish the technical foundation for agentic RGM at global scale. The patterns set here will shape how one of the world’s largest commercial systems makes its most important decisions. If you want your work in front of real users, at real scale, from the first release, this is that role.

Role Overview

As Senior Director of AI Engineering for the Global RGM Product, you will own the intelligence layer of the RGM suite within a persistent, cross-functional product team working alongside Product Management, Data Science, Engineering, UX, Architecture, and RGM experts. This is a Senior Director-level, hands-on engineering role, with technical direction provided by the RGM Product Tech Lead.

RGM turns price-optimization and promotion-simulation runs into decks and insights that RGM teams act on. A pipeline reads the run export, computes the KPIs in code, has the model write the narrative, and a QA step reviews the result before anyone sees it. You will own everything the model touches in that chain: the prompts, the pipeline steps, the retrieval, and the evaluation numbers that say whether an output can be trusted. One house rule sits above the rest—code computes every number, and the model only writes the words.

Working in a product model, you will remain engaged throughout the product lifecycle—from discovery and prototyping new analyses on existing run data through eval-gated release, deployment, measurement, and continuous improvement. The work is judged on evidence: a prompt or pipeline change ships when the quality numbers improve, not when it feels better. The role is global and operates around the clock, supporting markets and teams in every region.

What You Will Do for Us

Own the prompt behind each pipeline node — validation, narration, slide planning, and QA review — versioned in source control alongside test inputs and expected outputs rather than maintained in a chat window.
Extend the LangGraph orchestration pipeline in Python: ingest run exports, compute KPIs with pandas, call the model for narrative, and route QA retries when a generated slide fails review.
Define and track the evaluation metrics for every run — the share of insights analysts rate gold or silver, the share hallucinated or missing a baseline, and volume coverage — and gate prompt changes on those numbers improving.
Build retrieval over reference material, including methodology documentation, QA references, and past runs, so generated text quotes the underlying data instead of guessing.
Prototype new analyses on existing run data, from new insight types to competitor-response summaries, promoting a prototype to a feature only when it has a test set and a user who asked for it.
Integrate the pipeline with the platform alongside the Tech Lead, ensuring every run artifact — prompts, computed KPIs, narrative, and QA verdicts — lands in the SQL Server schema with logging and observability.
Design human-in-the-loop guardrails so commercial users can see, challenge, and correct what the system generates before it reaches an OU or bottler audience.
Make and document technical decisions on model providers, orchestration approach, and hosting within enterprise security, privacy, and AI governance requirements.
Integrate LLM-based capabilities with the traditional machine learning, analytical, and optimization models that produce the underlying pricing and promotion recommendations.
Design for the system context: multi-market, multi-OU deployment, bottler-facing data boundaries, and role-based access to commercially sensitive pricing and promotion data.
Partner with the business consultant on insight quality, turning recurring user feedback into concrete pipeline and prompt changes and retesting with the same users once a fix ships.
Contribute to engineering standards for a codebase with non-deterministic components: testing, observability, and eval-gated releases.

Requirements And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field; Master’s degree preferred.
8+ years of software, data, or ML engineering experience, including deep hands-on Python running in production and operated by other people — services or pipelines rather than notebooks alone — with strong pandas and SQL.
Demonstrated experience shipping an LLM-enabled feature that real users used, with a clear account of what broke first and how it was caught.
Treats prompts as code: versioned, tested against a fixed input set, with one variable changed at a time.
Experience building LLM-enabled systems, including retrieval-augmented generation, text-to-SQL, prompt and agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain), vector stores, tool/function calling, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop guardrails.
Working knowledge of evaluation practice for generative systems: fixed test sets, rubric-based grading, hallucination and coverage measurement, and eval-gated release.
Ability to read price, volume, and revenue data by SKU and channel, and to spot claims the numbers do not support.
Precise written English; the quality of the pipeline’s output is bounded by the quality of its instructions.
Understanding of how to integrate AI applications with traditional machine learning, analytical, and optimization models.
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, API design, security, and cloud deployment.
Working knowledge of the Azure data and AI stack, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, MLflow, and Azure OpenAI Service, plus modern application patterns such as API-first middleware (FastAPI, Azure App Service, Azure API Management), Azure SQL, Key Vault, Azure Active Directory/Entra ID, Azure Monitor, and Azure DevOps CI/CD.
Familiarity with Revenue Growth Management concepts across pricing, promotion, assortment, and mix, and with the analytics behind them — elasticity modeling, optimization algorithms, and forecasting; preferred.
Exposure to CPG or bottler commercial data, including how pricing and promotion decisions cascade to execution at the point of sale; preferred.
Sufficient C# to read and reason about the .NET service layer the pipeline integrates with; preferred.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain model behavior, its limits, and its evidence to commercial audiences in business-relevant language.
Comfort operating in a matrixed, multi-market franchise environment where adoption depends on trust in the output.
A global role supporting operating units and bottlers in every region requires working across time zones, including early and late calls and availability outside standard business hours when markets or releases de

They are seeking an experienced Engineering Director to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team while providing technical leadership, project oversight, resource planning, and senior-level client leadership across complex MEP, energy, and infrastructure projects.

Working directly with the President and senior leadership, this individual will play an important role in connecting engineering with construction and overall project delivery while helping shape the continued development of the engineering organization.

This is a significant leadership opportunity for an accomplished engineering professional who wants to move beyond traditional department management and build toward broader organizational leadership over time.

Overview

The Engineering Director will lead an established team of approximately 10 to 15 engineering professionals supporting technically complex projects involving electrical and mechanical infrastructure, HVAC systems, central plants, building controls, electrification, lighting, energy efficiency, decarbonization, and multidisciplinary MEP systems.

This individual will oversee engineering quality, staffing, budgets, schedules, technical decision-making, team development, and project execution while working closely with construction management, project leadership, clients, and company executives.

The successful candidate does not need to personally perform every aspect of engineering production. The organization is looking for a leader who can provide technical credibility and direction while maintaining a broader view of project delivery, people, clients, and the business.

Candidates may come from either an Electrical or Mechanical Engineering background, with multidisciplinary MEP/building systems experience strongly valued.

Lead, mentor, and further develop a multidisciplinary engineering team.
Provide leadership across electrical, mechanical, MEP, energy, and building infrastructure projects.

About Technology.

Technology at Huge is powered by a global practice of creative technologists—spanning Engineers, QA specialists, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and ML Architects—we look beyond standard patterns to build resilient, enterprise-grade systems. We combine deep engineering rigor with innovation at the edge of agentic AI, modern data stacks, and cloud infrastructure. We don't wait for industry standards to set themselves; we engineer the intelligent systems that turn audacious strategic vision into production-ready reality.

The role.

Huge is looking for a Director of Technology to join the global technology team. The ideal candidate possesses a wide range of technical knowledge across multiple systems and solution types. They are skilled at quickly understanding problems and articulating recommendations that have an immediate impact. Someone who understands client business challenges and partners with clients and other disciplines at Huge to design transformative experiences and identify technology solutions to enable them.

You will drive organic business development alongside account leadership, implementing Huge’s delivery methodologies based on Lean and Agile principles. Additionally, you will influence best practices and standards across the technology department, guiding and ensuring Huge remains at the forefront of emerging technologies like Generative AI, neural networks, and advanced data solutions. Additionally, this role requires a collaborative spirit, working closely with creative leads to shape innovative and impactful experiences.

What you’ll be doing.

Collaborate with clients to understand their technology needs, recommend solutions, and establish strong client relationships.
Develop and execute a technology strategy that aligns with business objectives and drives innovation.
Oversee the assessment, planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and on budget.
Ensure the highest quality standards are maintained in technology development, including code reviews, testing, and performance optimization.
Identify and mitigate technology-related risks, ensuring security and compliance with industry standards.
Support relationships with technology vendors and partners to leverage their expertise and resources.
Foster technical client relationships and seek opportunities for organic growth on the accounts.
Partner with Huge cross-discipline account leadership to convert opportunities and support outbound business development activities.
Drive innovation within the Engineering craft community, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance our capabilities.
Foster behavioral values of continuous learning and professional development within the Engineering craft community, nurturing talent and promoting a collaborative environment.
Target Tech Stack
React Native, iOS, Android
Mobile commerce and native payments experience brings competitive edge, but not required

What we’d like to see.

Strong leadership skills with experience building, scaling, and mentoring engineering teams of 10+ developers.
Demonstrated success managing complex projects with multiple workstreams while maintaining quality and timeline accountability.
Proven ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
Experience managing multiple onshore and offshore teams; experience with globally distributed teams is nice to have.
An innate ability to foster relationships with all discipline partners at Huge regardless of seniority.
Ability to work under high levels of ambiguity to identify and evolve technology solutions.
Dedication to evolving the technology practice, developing materials and content for internal initiatives, and leading them.
Experience discussing delivery with client executives, clearly articulating your strategic approach to delivery in a non-technical manner, highlighting its differentiators and benefits over other approaches.
Experience with modern architectural patterns (e.g., Jamstack, MACH, etc.) and enterprise platforms (e.g., CMSes, DAMs, CDNs, etc.).
Have strong technical expertise in implementing, governing, and scaling multidisciplinary (S)SDLCs across digital organizations.
Proficiency in leveraging modern AI coding tooling (e.g., Gemini or Claude Code) to accelerate spec-driven development, automated refactoring, and AI-driven code reviews while maintaining strict code quality and test coverage.
Experience with autonomous multi-agent systems including task planning, memory management, tool calling/APIs, and evaluation frameworks.
Expertise in digital marketing technology stacks and their associated components.
Experience managing technical and non-technical stakeholders and articulating complex concepts in a way that non-technical audiences can understand.
Able to manage multi-vendor solution deliveries, manage prioritization, and mitigate risks.
Proven experience designing and implementing microservices architecture at scale, with particular expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP and Vercel).
Demonstrated success leading full-stack development teams across web and mobile platforms simultaneously.
Track record of successfully orchestrating complex third-party API integrations while maintaining system coherence.
Experience implementing robust authentication systems (Auth0) and content access control for premium/paid content.
History of architecting and scaling e-commerce solutions with particular focus on security and payment flows.
Experience implementing modern CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for rapid, reliable deployment.

This role is currently not available for hire or work in Colorado, New Mexico, and Hawaii, USA.

Huge is a design and technology company. We create products and experiences that grow the world’s most ambitious brands. We do this by designing experiences for people, not users, and uncovering new sources of growth by leveraging our creative talent, our proprietary platform LIVE and unlocking the advantages brought to us by emerging technologies. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Parallax Space is building critical mission infrastructure to enable rapid, reliable, and scalable access to space. We partner with commercial, civil, and national security customers to deliver high-performance satellite components, integrated payload systems, and mission capabilities that close critical gaps in modern space architecture.

Our model combines advanced engineering, mission execution, and scalable manufacturing to deliver high-TRL products and flight-ready systems at speed.

We are building the infrastructure backbone for the next generation of space systems.

Position Overview

Parallax Space is seeking an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the company’s technical organization, engineering execution, and product development strategy as we scale from early product development into repeatable flight systems and production execution.

This leader will be responsible for building and managing a world-class multidisciplinary engineering organization spanning systems engineering, mechanical, electrical, avionics, software, test, and mission hardware development. The role requires both strategic technical leadership and hands-on execution discipline, ensuring Parallax delivers mission-ready systems with the speed, reliability, and manufacturability required for commercial and national security space customers.

The Head of Engineering will serve as a foundational executive leader, shaping technical direction, scaling engineering processes, recruiting top-tier talent, and driving engineering excellence across every stage of the product lifecycle - from architecture and development through qualification, flight readiness, and production transition.

This is a high-ownership leadership role for a builder who thrives in fast-moving environments and understands how to balance engineering rigor with startup execution speed.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead and scale all engineering disciplines including systems engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, avionics, software, test, integration, and mission hardware development.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization capable of rapid product development and mission execution.
Define organizational structure, hiring plans, capability roadmaps, and technical leadership responsibilities.
Recruit, mentor, and retain top engineering talent.
Establish a culture of ownership, technical accountability, urgency, and continuous improvement.
Develop engineering career progression, leadership development, and performance expectations.

Technical Strategy & Product Leadership

Define and maintain the technical roadmap aligned with company growth strategy, customer demand, and product expansion.
Drive architecture decisions across spacecraft systems, hosted payloads, mission hardware, and enabling technologies.
Ensure engineering efforts align with product strategy, recurring production objectives, and business priorities.
Lead major technical trade studies, architecture reviews, and strategic design decisions.
Balance performance, manufacturability, reliability, schedule, and cost in engineering decision-making.
Partner with executive leadership on long-range technical planning and capability investment.

Engineering Execution & Product Delivery

Drive engineering execution across all active programs, internal product development efforts, and customer deliverables.
Ensure disciplined execution from concept development through design, build, integration, testing, qualification, and flight readiness.
Establish clear engineering ownership, execution cadence, milestone accountability, and technical reporting.
Lead engineering participation in PDR, CDR, TRR, FRR, qualification reviews, and mission readiness activities.
Remove technical and organizational obstacles impacting schedule or product delivery.
Support rapid issue resolution across development and mission execution efforts.

Engineering Operations & Process Excellence

Build scalable engineering operating systems, workflows, and execution infrastructure.
Establish standards for requirements management, configuration control, engineering documentation, release management, and technical change control.
Drive implementation of integrated engineering tools supporting product lifecycle execution.
Improve engineering planning, work prioritization, and cross-functional coordination.
Develop repeatable engineering processes that support both rapid development and scalable production.
Ensure strong design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test discipline across programs.

Quality, Reliability & Mission Assurance

Own engineering quality and technical mission success.
Establish robust engineering review, validation, verification, and failure analysis processes.
Drive root cause investigations and corrective action implementation.
Ensure products meet reliability, environmental, qualification, and customer performance requirements.
Support mission assurance rigor appropriate for high-reliability aerospace systems.
Partner with manufacturing and operations to ensure smooth transition from engineering into production execution.

Cross-Functional Execution

Partner closely with program management, manufacturing, supply chain, business operations, and mission execution teams.
Align engineering deliverables with company schedules, customer milestones, and financial constraints.
Support supply chain technical decisions, make/buy strategies, vendor qualification, and production readiness.
Collaborate with business operations and program leadership on resource planning and execution forecasting.
Support enterprise operational scalability through disciplined technical execution.

Customer, Mission & Business Development Support

Participate in customer technical engagements, proposal development, design reviews, and strategic technical discussions.
Support capture efforts with technical solution development and customer-facing credibility.
Represent Parallax engineering capability to commercial, civil, and national security customers.
Contribute technical leadership to new business pursuits, mission planning, and product roadmap expansion.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field.
12+ years of engineering experience in aerospace, defense, spacecraft, launch, or other high-reliability hardware environments.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams.
Proven track record delivering complex hardware systems from concept through qualification, deployment, or flight.
Deep understanding of systems engineering principles and full product lifecycle execution.
Demonstrated experience building scalable engineering organizations and technical processes.
Strong technical judgment across multidisciplinary hardware development.
Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-accountability startup environments.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational execution skills.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with spacecraft, satellites, hosted payloads, launch systems, or mission hardware.
Experience scaling engineering organizations in venture-backed or high-growth aerospace companies.
Experience supporting DoD, IC, NASA, SDA, or national security space programs.
Familiarity with FAR/DFARS contracting environments.
Experience in manufacturing transition and production scale-up.
Familiarity with configuration-controlled aerospace development environments.
Understanding of mission assurance and aerospace quality frameworks.
Familiarity with export-controlled programs and ITAR/EAR compliance.
Advanced technical degree (MS or PhD).

Core Competencies

Technical Leadership
Ownership
Strategic Thinking
Execution Bias
Systems Thinking
Organizational Leadership
Decision Making
Cross-Functional Leadership
Accountability
Communication
Problem Solving
Talent Development

Why Join Parallax Space

Join a team building critical infrastructure for the future of space. At Parallax Space, you will work on real hardware, real missions, and meaningful national-scale challenges alongside a high-performing team of engineers, operators, and builders.

Compliance

Parallax Space is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. Certain positions may require eligibility to access export-controlled information under ITAR/EAR regulations and/or the ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance.
