JOB DESCRIPTION

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking Technology Asset Management (TAM) Evergreen Leader to join our Technology Asset Management team in Lake Mary, FL or Pittsburgh, PA.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:

Enterprise Evergreen Strategy & Operational Leadership

Lead the Enterprise Evergreen function and manage a team of technology asset management specialists.
Define and execute the enterprise Evergreen strategy and roadmap.
Coordinate enterprise-wide End-of-Life (EoL) remediation across technology platforms.
Chair monthly Platform Resiliency Lead governance meetings to coordinate remediation priorities and resolve cross-platform dependencies.
Monitor Evergreen Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and proactively engage technology teams on emerging risks.
Drive continuous improvements that enhance operational efficiency, governance effectiveness, and technology resilience.

Software Product Lifecycle & Asset Governance

Own the enterprise software product catalogue and continuously improve software asset data quality.
Partner with IDIP Discovery and Normalization teams to resolve discovery, normalization, and data quality issues.
Oversee remediation of software discovery exceptions and toxic discovery rules.
Drive automation to improve issue triage, workflow efficiency, and operational scalability.
Lead the Product Owner Forum and establish governance practices that improve Product Owner accountability.
Manage the software product lifecycle

Technology Risk Governance, Controls & Metrics

Own the Technology Asset Management control framework supporting Evergreen compliance.
Lead implementation and adoption of enterprise technology lifecycle risk indicators.
Drive the consolidation of multiple Evergreen KRIs into a simplified enterprise reporting framework.
Integrate technology lifecycle metrics into executive reporting and risk dashboards.
Lead monthly Technology Asset Management governance reviews.
Produce and maintain executive reporting for senior leadership, including engineering scorecards, risk dashboards, Board-level reporting, and operational metrics.

Strategic Transformation & Automation

Lead strategic initiatives that expand the Evergreen program beyond traditional End-of-Life management.
Drive convergence of End-of-Life remediation and vulnerability management activities.
Develop automated notification and workflow capabilities that improve remediation outcomes.
Expand Evergreen governance to additional technology domains including containers, mainframe platforms, and core infrastructure software.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve scalability, and reduce manual operational effort.
Lead long-term capability development supporting enterprise technology lifecycle management.

Enterprise Governance & Stakeholder Leadership

Own the Technology Asset Management Policy, Standard, and supporting Procedures.
Chair the End User Governance Forum and coordinate enterprise end-user software governance activities.
Partner with Workplace Technology Services (WTS) to prioritize and execute remediation initiatives.
Maintain governance documentation aligned with regulatory expectations and evolving business requirements.
Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Technology Risk, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Software Asset Management, and senior technology leadership.
Influence enterprise decision-making through effective governance, communication, and stakeholder engagement.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in Technology Asset Management, Infrastructure Engineering, Technology Risk, Software Asset Management, or a related technology discipline.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise technology governance or technology lifecycle management programs.
Strong understanding of software lifecycle management, End-of-Life (EoL) governance, technology risk, and operational resilience.
Experience developing executive reporting, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), metrics, and governance frameworks.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving multiple engineering organizations.
Experience managing and developing high-performing teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, including engagement with senior leadership.
Experience partnering with Internal Audit, Risk, Compliance, and regulatory stakeholders, including supporting regulatory examinations, audit engagements, remediation activities, and the implementation of sustainable control improvements
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications: (Most important to least) *These skills are nice to have; Willing to train.

Experience within the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment.
Knowledge of IT Asset Management (ITAM), CMDB, ServiceNow, Flexera, BigFix, Tanium, or similar enterprise asset management platforms.
Experience implementing workflow automation and technology governance tooling.
Familiarity with software discovery, software normalization, software packaging, and software deployment processes.
Knowledge of technology risk frameworks, operational resilience practices, and regulatory expectations affecting global financial institutions.
Experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives and organizational change.
ITIL, CISSP, CRISC, CGEIT, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other relevant professional certifications.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who You Are

Metropolis is seeking a Senior Manager of Machine Learning Engineering within the Advanced Technologies Group to lead the technical vision and execution of our foundational systems that power our next generation of AI. You will oversee 4 critical pillars within the Machine Learning org:data engineering, annotation pipelines, ML Infrastructure and Deployment of Agentic AI solutions. You are a hands-on, senior technical leader with a broad dynamic range, capable of providing high-level strategic direction while remaining technically proficient enough to dive into the weeds with your team. Your mission is to transition state-of-art models into robust, autonomous production systems that automate complex enterprise workflows.You will partner closely with internal engineering teams and external vendors to build the scalable tools and data pipelines that define the future of recognition economy.

What You'll Do

Build and maintain scalable, compliant and auditable data infrastructure to serve computer vision and AI pricing use cases
Build scalable data engineering pipelines and automated annotation workflows (LLM-in-the-loop) to reduce reliance on manual labeling and accelerate model iteration
Own the MLOps lifecycle, including distributed training infrastructure, model registries, and low-latency inference services. Ensure high availability and observability for all deployed models
Define technical direction, lead and grow a high-performance team of data and ML infrastructure engineers to influence impactful business outcomes
Develop foundational systems to productionize agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) solutions for workflow automation to enhance our products
Enable Metropolis’s move into personalization and targeted advertisement through innovative ML data pipelines and feature stores
Collaborate with external vendors and annotation platform providers to ensure high-quality data for production models
Partner with other ML leaders (Growth , Edge deployment) and cross-functional leaders in Hardware, Platform, and Product engineering to align development roadmaps

What we're looking for

10+ years of professional experience in data and machine learning engineering with proven expertise in building enterprise-scale, auditable ETL pipelines and data governance mechanisms
5+ years of experience in leadership and management, ideally having managed other managers
MS or PhD in computer science and/or a quantitative discipline
Strong experience in distributed data processing like Apache Spark, Kafka, Cloud native data storage and processing services
1+ years experience building data /eval pipelines and deploying agentic AI solutions (LLMs and/or VLMs)
Experience managing technical programs, defining milestones, and communicating progress to diverse audiences
Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch
Strong proficiency with SQL and Python
Engage effectively with external data providers and vendors
Familiarity with computer vision systems and models (e.g. object detection, tracking, segmentation)

While not required, these are a plus:

Manage large scale datasets and database tools for data processing
Deploy ML services to the cloud with a focus on scalability and reliability
Operate in innovative, high-growth environments

4 Days in Office:
Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. jobs.title: Asst. Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
This is an overtime eligible manager position (OEM).

Primary function is to provide a working supervisor for the Engineering Department. Supervise the implementation of all property and equipment preventative maintenance and repairs, monitor life safety systems and utilities and corporate/franchise standards and local, state and national codes and regulations to protect assets, guests and employees

Essential Duties

Know all emergency procedures (fire, severe weather, bomb threats, guest accident/illness, etc).
Interview, hire, performance evaluations, resolve problems, provide open communication and recommend discipline and/or termination when appropriate.
Maintain a high standard of job performance for all hourly department employees
Maintain high department productivity
Implement and schedule property and equipment preventive maintenance programs in compliance with corporate/franchise standards and local, state and national codes and regulation.
Prioritize service requests; schedule vendors/contractors and monitor the service performed to ensure customer satisfaction, safety and convenience.
Test and examine the document, the life safety systems to ensure they are 100% operational at all times.
Monitor utility and document consumption to determine the effectiveness of current systems.
Review purchase requests and monitor expenses budget to ensure goals are met/exceeded.
Assist in the administration of the department by preparing and maintaining schedules, logs, records and other documentations to ensure a smooth operation and minimize liabilities.
Have the knowledge and skills to be able to efficiently and accurately repair HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, machinery, boiler, etc with a minimum need to call outside contractors.

GENERAL DUTIES

Know your work schedule and follow it with reliability
Work in a cooperative and friendly manner with fellow employees
Maintain professional attire and personal hygiene
Maintain a clean, neat and orderly work area
Perform your job according to standard operating procedures
Read, understand and follow all policies, procedures and practices as stated in the Employee Handbook
Implement management company and hotel’s safety and emergency policies and procedures (i.e. evacuation, first aid, etc) to include all safety hazards, following company’s OSHA Hazcom program and safe lifting techniques.
Utilize protective equipment, when applicable
Promptly resolve substandard (unsafe) conditions to supervisor
Promptly fill out an incident report for accidents, injuries, property damage or loss to supervisor
Keep accurate communication flowing freely among all hotel departments
Inform management promptly of any work-related problems or guest complaints
Practice “CARE hospitality” and provide guest satisfaction
Promote the hotel through goodwill, courtesy and a positive attitude
Attend all scheduled training classes and meetings
Train and supervise other employees as directed by SOP
Continue to learn and grow in your position
Perform any reasonable request as assigned or directed by management
Provide for a safe work environment by following all safety and security procedures and rules
Arrange for reasonable accommodations for person(s) with disabilities
Assist person(s) with a disability
Comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws and ordinances as they apply to the hotel, guests, and employees

Supervisory Responsibilities

Assume control of the Engineering Department in the absence of the Director of Engineering
Provide effective training and assistance to all hourly department employees
Work with outside contractors

Qualifications/Skills

Efficiently operate small hand tools such as drills, grinders, saws, etc.
Safely climb ladders and stairs
Efficiently and safely operate light machinery such as key cutter, drill press, radial arm saw, etc.
Understand and efficiently operate advanced electrical, plumbing, refrigeration and boiler systems
Stand and or walk for long periods of time
Efficiently handle test equipment, hand tools, keys, etc.
Lift and carry heavy objects such as boxes, televisions, ladders, etc.
Learn new tasks
Train other department members
Read and understand blueprints, schematic drawings and technical parts breakdown
Efficiently operate all building systems
Must have a valid driver license
Must be flexible enough to work any shifts including evenings, weekends and holidays

Education And/Or Experience

A minimum of 4 year degree from an accredited university in Engineering or related major or 4 years experience as a Chief Engineer or a combination of both experience and education

Flexible schedule require.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
From smartphones to solar panels, innovative technology is needed to create the devices we use every day. Silfex’s silicon components help make that technology a reality.

Silfex Inc., A Lam Research Company is the leading provider of precision silicon components used to make and operate semiconductor tools, which enable the trillion-dollar global electronics industry. Our company’s products are integral to the semiconductor equipment and optical markets. The outstanding team at Silfex makes that possible – through our people, we are advancing the world.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams’ achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone’s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Our Perks And Benefits

At Silfex, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits that start on your first day of employment.

Discover more at Lam Benefits

Job Descriptions

Essential Function:

The Director of Information Technology is a key member of the Silfex leadership team. This is a matrixed role with primary reporting into Lam GIS and strong dotted‑line accountability to Silfex, ensuring alignment to both enterprise standards and site‑specific business priorities. This position will be responsible to develop, maintain and execute the strategic technology plan for the company and to drive process improvement and streamline business processes with technology (this is inclusive of the company’s Industry 4.0 strategic and operational plans). This position is also responsible for the development, justification and implementation of IT and network integration plan between Silfex and parent company Lam Research. This position will manage all activities associated with the information technology systems in support of the company’s business and oversees the company's IT team across multiple sites. The leader and IT team will interact with other executives, management and stakeholders to ensure that the company is providing the appropriate performance level of IT services and capabilities.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Effectively plans, manages and controls IT operations across multiple sites.
Collaborates with business stakeholders to understand the company’s strategic and operational imperatives and develops and delivers an IT strategy and operational plan to support company needs and provides return on investment to justify proposed plans.
Develops an IT strategic roadmap that communicates and ensures continual alignment b/w IT, company and operational planning.
Establishes key relationships with Lam Research IT executive and support teams to understand their strategies, policies, etc and makes recommendations regarding how/when Silfex IT/Network will integrate to leverage capabilities and supports.
Provide leadership in planning and managing computer operations and production support, systems and database administration and network operations.
Manage day-to-day IT operations to improve infrastructure costs, performance and end user satisfaction.
Execute technical transformation to reduce cost, eliminate inefficiencies, and increase organizational capacity by modernizing IT platforms, consolidating systems, and enabling scalable, end‑to‑end digital capabilities aligned to Silfex and Lam operating objectives.
Responsible for providing business rationale and an innovative perspective to all technology problems and innovations.
Analyzes operational procedures, data needs, and existing information technology, including hardware and software, to determine efficiency, capabilities and limitations to propose future needs to support a rapidly scaling business.
Direct teams of technical and management staff in the successful fulfillment of IT service delivery commitments.
Confers with department managers to analyze current operation procedures, pinpoint problem areas, and determine areas for potential improvement of information services.
Foster and manage vendor structures to fit with the size and needs of a growing organization.
Understand business goals, drivers, context, and processes to suggest technology solutions that improve the organization.
Establish standards for system availability, fault tolerance, and recoverability aligned with business continuity objectives.
Drive telemetry‑driven operations, event‑based automation, and intelligent alerting to enable proactive service management.
Standardize automated recovery, health checks, and operational runbooks to support scalable, reliable operations.
Collaborate with engineering, operations and quality to develop the strategic roadmap for Silfex’s implementation of Industry 4.0 concepts – in such a way that access and use of data, information and technology provides targeted return on investment.
Pursue knowledge of personal strengths and the strengths of teammates in order to be more productive and leverage the time and talents of others.
Work closely with all departments to assist with needs assessments, messaging, timelines, and clarity.
Formulation of IT policies, procedures and performance management processes and measures.

Culture

Display a positive attitude and strong work ethic that reflects the Mission and Core Values of Silfex.
Create and maintain a culture where workplace safety is part of everything we do. Provide the safest possible workplace to our employees by modeling and following all company safety policies, reporting any incidents or unsafe conditions immediately to Silfex management. Wear all PPE as required by work area or job function.
Communication – Begin with the end in mind – Communicate boldly as well as effectively with empathy and respect to inspire teamwork and collaboration vertically and horizontally within Silfex.
Assist in applying lean manufacturing concepts and 5S. Demonstrate ownership of continuous improvement ideas and activities. Maintain organization and cleanliness, housekeeping and 5S within work area. Maintain these areas at the highest degree possible while responsibly escalating any maintenance issues.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field.
15+ years of proven success of increasing responsibility in an IT Leadership Role.
Experience using information technology in computer applications programming, systems programming, computer systems development, data telecommunications, database administration, planning of data/information processing, user services, or area networks.
A track record of successfully implementing IT strategies at an enterprise level, including the selection, implementation, operation and maintenance of large-scale systems over multiple hardware and software platforms.
The ability to operate in ambiguous situations and be flexible as the organization changes and grows.
Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and acknowledge challenges swiftly and directly; offer solutions and course-correct as needed.

Preferred Requirements

MBA or graduate degree in related field.

Physical Demands

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear.

The employee is occasionally required to lift up to 50 pounds. The employee regularly is required to lift up to 10 pounds. The vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is frequently exposed to work near moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The noise level in the environment is moderate.

Our Commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Silfex is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Engineer (Gen AI Platform Services: Agentic AI, Guardrails, Evaluation)
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, AI Engineer (Gen AI Platform Services: Agentic AI, Guardrails, Evaluation)

Overview
:

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good.
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.
You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example.
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.
You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 1 year of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

3 years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers

Senior Manager, AI Engineer (Gen AI Platform Services: Agentic AI, Guardrails, Evaluation)

Overview
:

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good.
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.
You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example.
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.
You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 1 year of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

3 years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology
jobs.description:
What We Do

At Leading Educators (LE)
, we know that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world.
That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, we partner with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology.
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential.
Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, we help educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive. Learn more about our work at leadingeducators.org.
Internal Candidate Application Deadline:
9/8/2026

External Candidate Application Deadline:
9/11/2026

Position

As Leading Educators' senior technology leader, you will shape and execute the organization's technology vision and strategy in direct support of our mission to ensure every student succeeds in school and in life. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll provide strategic leadership across technology strategy, systems and security, AI governance, organizational technology adoption, and technology operations—driving decisions that enable educators to focus on what they do best: teaching.
This is a role of significant influence and impact. You won't just manage infrastructure; you'll architect the technology ecosystem that empowers our team to work shoulder-to-shoulder with school systems to overcome instructional challenges, foster collaboration, and ignite new possibilities at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology. Every decision you make will ripple through our organization and ultimately support students' success.
Leading a small, talented technology team, you'll ensure that LE's technology investments are secure, scalable, sustainable, and—most importantly—effectively adopted across the organization. You'll build organizational capacity to translate technology investments into everyday practices that drive real results. This is an opportunity to lead with vision, mentor emerging talent, and demonstrate how strategic technology leadership advances educational excellence.
Do you have expertise in…

Developing and executing multi-year technology roadmaps that align IT strategy with organizational priorities, scalability, and long-term sustainability?

Leading technology transformation and modernization initiatives across complex organizations, including managing change, building adoption, and ensuring staff readiness?

Establishing governance frameworks and policies for responsible AI adoption, data protection, cybersecurity, and organizational risk management?

Managing technology vendors, budgets, and investments while maximizing value and ensuring quality service delivery?

Do you enjoy…

Translating complex technical concepts and strategic decisions into clear, compelling language for nontechnical leaders and stakeholders?

Building and developing high-performing teams, supporting professional growth, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and accountability?

Bridges technical solutions with organizational strategy and culture, ensuring technology serves people, mission, and organizational priorities rather than the reverse. 

Taking on strategic challenges that require both deep technical expertise and thoughtful change leadership?

If you've answered affirmatively to these questions and meet the following prerequisites, we urge you to seize this opportunity. This role calls for the following:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and 10+ years of progressive experience in technology, IT, enterprise systems, digital transformation, or related areas

Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities

Proven track record leading technology transformation, modernization, or systems change across an organization, including successful change management and adoption

Experience leading AI enablement, adoption, or governance within an organization, with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into responsible organizational use

Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, enterprise systems, technology risk, and governance, with the ability to provide strategic oversight of these areas

Experience developing and governing organizational technology policies and standards, including responsible AI use, data governance, and technology risk

Experience overseeing technology vendors, external partners, technology investments, and budgets

Proven ability to manage IT teams with a track record of supporting professional development and driving performance

Travel Requirements

This is a remote position that requires limited travel.

National travel for org retreats, programming, job related travel, donor meetings or professional development. 

Outside of the above mentioned travel, this person will work from a home office that must be located anywhere within the U.S. 

Questions? We’re here to help.

If you have questions about this role or about our hiring process at any point, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at talent@leadingeducators.org. This inbox is monitored regularly, and we aim to respond within two business days. To ensure your question receives a thoughtful and timely response, we kindly ask that you refrain
from emailing individual staff members or members of our HR team directly. The best way to connect with us is always through talent@leadingeducators.org.

Why Work at Leading Educators? 

Imagine being part of an organization where your ideas and perspectives are highly valued. At Leading Educators, we believe in fostering individual strengths, encouraging personal growth, and embracing innovative ideas. If you thrive in a remote working environment, with the added excitement of travel, we're the perfect fit for you. By joining us, you become part of a powerful community of peers nationwide. Regardless of your location, you possess the power to make a significant impact on both students and teachers who rely on us daily. Join Leading Educators and become an integral part of driving progress in education. 

Learn About Our Mission & Values:

Mission:

Leading Educators partners with school systems to sustain the teaching, leadership, and conditions for every student to succeed in school and in life.
Values:

Build on strengths:
We affirm and begin with the unique and collective talents, experiences, and wisdom of ourselves and others.

Continuously learn:
We develop ourselves and others. We apply new learning and deepened self-awareness to our relationships and practices.

Prioritize people:
We build trust and reflect on the impact of different perspectives and experiences.

Champion success for all:
We re-imagine structures, habits, and mindsets to ensure every learner has access to evidence-based learning opportunities.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools throughout our hiring process, from the moment a candidate applies through the offer stage, to support administrative tasks and the initial review of candidate materials. These tools help us organize, analyze, and surface relevant information efficiently, but they do not make hiring decisions.

All candidate materials—including applications, resumes, assessments, and interview feedback—are reviewed and evaluated by people. All hiring decisions, including interview selection, advancement, and offers of employment, are made by humans.

We use AI solely as a support tool to assist with early-stage reviews and process efficiency. We do not use AI in ways that discriminate based on protected characteristics, nor do we use ZIP codes or similar data to target or exclude protected groups. Our hiring practices are designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with equal employment opportunity standards.

Benefits

Compensation: 

If hired for this position, the base salary range is $127,487 to $172,483 per year.
Most new hires enter the range at a specific point based on their qualifications and the role level. For this position, the standard starting salary is $149,985, which is based on meeting the minimum requirement of 10 years of relevant experience.
If you have more than 10 years of directly relevant experience
, your starting salary may be adjusted higher within the range, up to a maximum starting salary of $159,627.
This approach ensures that candidates with additional experience beyond the minimum are recognized in the initial salary offer.

Benefits: 
100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for individual employees. Additional premium costs are covered 60% by Leading Educators for partners and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans. 
4% matching 401k plan, Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, childcare and commuter expenses, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits are valued at or above $9,000 for employees.

Time Off:

First three years of employment, full time staff accrue 22 days a year. 
Five additional days are accrued after the third and sixth year of employment.
Leading Educators also offer 16 additional paid days off for various holidays, including three floating holidays staff may use at their discretion.

Equal Opportunity Employment 

Leading Educators is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Infrastructure and Networking
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

Verizon Business is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Product Manager to join our AI Connect Infrastructure and Networking Product team. As a key driver of Verizon's AI Connect growth strategy, you will be responsible for scaling product adoption and ecosystem integration across the AI infrastructure value chain—including hyperscalers, GPU cloud providers, data center developers and operators, colocation providers, real estate partners, OEMs, and other emerging AI infrastructure companies. You will be focused on scaling networking products within hyperscale or high-performance computing environments designed for AI. You will own the growth funnel from initial market identification to commercial scale: optimizing product-market fit, driving platform adoption, structuring scalable commercial frameworks, and collaborating cross-functionally with product, network engineering, finance, and legal teams to ensure every growth initiative is commercially sound and technically deliverable.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution: Lead the 0-to-1 growth lifecycle to ensure alignment with AI Connect revenue objectives. Drive product-market fit from initial market mapping and target identification through commercial launch and active revenue expansion.
Data-Driven Market Growth: Conduct thorough analysis of the AI infrastructure landscape, including data center construction pipelines, power availability, GPU deployment trends, fiber route economics, and interconnection dynamics. Leverage these insights to optimize the product go-to-market funnel, inform growth strategy, and prioritize high-value segments.
Ecosystem Product Strategy: Define and manage the growth roadmap across hyperscalers, data center and colocation operators, real estate partners, OEMs, and emerging AI infrastructure companies. Identify product white space to build scalable solutions that convert Verizon's fiber footprint, optical services portfolio, and AI-ready facilities into recurring infrastructure revenue.
Growth Modeling & Commercialization: Develop scalable commercial models spanning optical and fiber-based services, such as Wavelength Services (10G/100G/400G+), optical extensions, programmable network fabric, data center interconnection, and AI-ready facility partnerships. Establish pricing constructs, capacity commitments, and route-specific terms optimized for rapid market adoption and platform stickiness.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with Product, Network Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Sales teams to shape offers and deal terms, and to ensure seamless execution from signature through delivery.
Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively and manage expectations with business sponsors, company executives, external partners, and customers, acting as a credible and technically fluent representative of Verizon AI Connect at the most senior levels.
Performance Measurement: Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) — pipeline value, signed contract value, revenue conversion, and partner health — to measure partnership success and inform continuous improvement.
Technology & Market Fluency: Possess a strong understanding of fiber products, services, and network fabric — including optical networking (DWDM), Wavelength Services, optical extensions, low-latency routing, and programmable, API-driven network fabric — along with data center fundamentals (power, cooling, density, interconnection) and the traffic patterns of AI workloads, including east-west requirements for training and data center interconnection and north-south requirements for enterprise inference. Stay ahead of the curve on emerging AI infrastructure trends to keep Verizon's strategy competitive.
Business Strategy: Define partnership business models, pricing strategies, target segments, execution plans, and financial business cases for AI Infrastructure and Networking opportunities.
Content Creation: Develop compelling partner-facing collateral, business cases, and executive presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For...

You'll need to have:

Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Six or more years of relevant experience in technology and/or telecommunications.
Demonstrated understanding of the AI infrastructure market, including fiber networks and optical services, data centers, colocation, and interconnection.
Experience originating, structuring, negotiating, and closing large, complex, multi-year commercial or partnership agreements — from inception to signing.
Experience with business models and/or business cases for infrastructure or connectivity services.
Experience with Business-to-Business partnerships, enterprise sales, or corporate development.
Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

An MBA and/or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience in a high-growth company or business unit, scaling a new product, partnership program, or revenue stream from early stage to significant scale.
Direct experience in data center development, fiber optic network development, or colocation — on either the operator or buyer side.
Existing senior-level relationships within hyperscale cloud providers, GPU/neocloud platforms, data center developers/operators, colocation providers, real estate/infrastructure investors, or AI infrastructure OEMs.
Working technical fluency in fiber and optical products and services — Wavelength Services, optical extensions, DWDM, network fabric, and low-latency routing — and data center infrastructure (power, cooling, interconnection) sufficient to lead credible conversations with network architects and infrastructure executives.
Familiarity with programmable and software-defined network services — API-driven provisioning, dynamic bandwidth, network-as-a-service, and self-service portals — and how they differentiate connectivity offerings for AI infrastructure customers.
Familiarity with AI workload networking requirements, including east-west traffic for GPU cluster interconnection, distributed training, and data center interconnection, and north-south traffic for enterprise inference and AI application delivery.
Experience structuring wavelength, interconnection, or data center connectivity transactions on the buy side or sell side.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex infrastructure concepts to diverse audiences, including C-level executives.
Strong financial acumen: ability to build and defend business cases, pricing models, and multi-year revenue commitments using solid ROI analysis.
Experience navigating large, matrixed organizations and building internal coalitions to get complex deals approved and delivered.
Ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
Experience leading or participating in industry panel discussions.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Role Overview

The Director, Product Management, Data

owns the data strategy, governance, and analytics foundation for the organization, closing one of our most critical gaps to scale. Reporting into the Operations organization within Agentforce Operations (formerly Regrello), this leader is accountable for establishing trusted datasets, unified metric definitions, and consistently high data quality across the entire customer lifecycle. Central to the role is a data-as-a-product mindset, treating datasets, metrics, and pipelines as products with clear owners, well-defined internal customers, and a managed lifecycle, so that leaders across the business can self-serve trusted answers rather than wait on a central team.

As both a builder and an evangelist for product management, the Director defines the vision and operating model for how data products are delivered, pairing industry best practices with hands-on execution to move the organization from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-driven operations. They own a prioritized roadmap for data products and platform investments, making deliberate build, buy, and extend decisions after assessing the existing Salesforce infrastructure, then connecting, extending, or building the integrated, value-driven analytics capability the business needs to operate and grow on a scalable foundation.

Beyond the platform itself, this role pioneers net-new AI agent capabilities and ensures the data foundation is AI- and ML-ready, so that agents and models can act on data that is trustworthy, well-governed, and fit for purpose. Success depends on partnership. The Director works closely with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Tech, Operations, Finance, and GTM to align on strategy, proactively manage risk, and build the relationships that turn a data vision into durable business impact.

The Director is also accountable for the success of the data products themselves, defining and tracking adoption, usage, trust, time-to-insight, and ROI to prove and grow their value over time. This is a unique opportunity to be a driver of change, shaping the direction of the company's data foundation.

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy & Vision: Define and execute a holistic data strategy aligned with broad business scaling goals
Data Quality & Governance: Establish standard governance models, define single-source-of-truth unified metric definitions, and drive high data quality across customer lifecycle touchpoints
Documentation & Discoverability: Improve data documentation, architecture transparency, and platform discoverability across teams
Value Measurement & Lifecycle Management: Measure the business value of data products, managing data tools and platforms through their end-to-end lifecycle
Infrastructure Assessment & Team Building: Conduct an initial comprehensive assessment of existing Salesforce data/analytics infrastructure vs. what needs to be connected, extended, or built, and build/lead the Data/Analytics team as necessary
Reliability & Data Contracts: Establish data contracts and SLAs for critical datasets, defining freshness, availability, and reliability standards that consumers and downstream AI systems can depend on
Trust, Privacy & Compliance: Safeguard sensitive and customer data through robust access controls, privacy, and regulatory compliance, ensuring the data foundation is secure and trusted by design
Data Literacy & Adoption: Drive data literacy and change management across the organization so teams confidently adopt and act on data products rather than simply receive them
AI & Agent Enablement: Build and govern the AI-ready data foundation that powers net-new AI agents, and define, curate, and maintain the library of agent skills and actions that let those agents take trusted, automated action across the customer lifecycle

Qualifications:

8–12+ years in Data Product Management, Data Strategy, Analytics, or Enterprise Governance, with a track record of driving data capabilities at scale.
Strong analytical and technical acumen, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex data architectures and lead central data functions across functional boundaries.
Deep familiarity with the Salesforce product ecosystem, architectures, and integrated data and analytics capabilities.
Proven track record in data governance and metric alignment, including defining single-source-of-truth frameworks and establishing high data quality across the customer lifecycle.
Strong product lifecycle management skills, with the ability to assess, build, extend, and manage value-driven data products and platforms.
Proven ability to leverage data, analytics, and platform capabilities to solve real business scaling challenges, eliminating fragmented spreadsheets and manual tracking.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across Product, Tech, Operations, Finance, and GTM teams.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with a proven capability to articulate data strategies and translate complex metrics into clear, actionable business insights.
Ability to succeed in a collaborative, fast-paced environment; flexible and capable of adjusting on the fly to evolving business demands with a strong sense of urgency.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, transitioning team practices from reactive reporting to proactive operational insights.
Experience in high-growth enterprise, SaaS, or complex ecosystem environments preferred.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Description

Are you excited to shape the future of browser and AI security?

Do you thrive on building impactful technology partnerships across the cybersecurity ecosystem?

Join our Business Development Team!

Akamai Enterprise Security is changing how organizations protect data centers and clouds from modern threats. Our team boasts experienced cybersecurity and data center experts. We are looking for talented individuals to inspire us and elevate our team.

Partner with the best

Managing day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of ISV, cybersecurity, and cloud partners
Identifying high-value integration use cases across Zero Trust, SSE/SASE, identity, and SIEM ecosystems
Partnering with Product and Engineering teams to scope, prioritize, and deliver technical integrations
Developing joint solution briefs, co-marketing programs, and field alignment strategies
Collaborating with Sales and partner field teams to drive partner-sourced pipeline
Supporting marketplace listings and co-sell programs with major cloud providers

Do What You Love

Have 3-5 years of experience in a technology alliances / partnerships, business development, sales or solutions engineering, product management, or technical program management role
Have hands-on exposure to building or supporting technical integrations (e.g., REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs).
Possess technical aptitude and curiosity: the ability to understand cybersecurity and cloud technologies, grasp integration(APIs, telemetry, policy enforcement), and translating into clear customer use cases.
Be familiar with modern security ecosystems including Zero Trust, IAM, and EDR
Have experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, sales, and marketing teams
Be knowledgeable in cloud marketplaces, browser security, or AI governance concepts

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Cloud and Edge:
Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:
We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $164,300 - $295,700/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Infrastructure and Networking
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

Verizon Business is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Product Manager to join our AI Connect Infrastructure and Networking Product team. As a key driver of Verizon's AI Connect growth strategy, you will be responsible for scaling product adoption and ecosystem integration across the AI infrastructure value chain—including hyperscalers, GPU cloud providers, data center developers and operators, colocation providers, real estate partners, OEMs, and other emerging AI infrastructure companies. You will be focused on scaling networking products within hyperscale or high-performance computing environments designed for AI. You will own the growth funnel from initial market identification to commercial scale: optimizing product-market fit, driving platform adoption, structuring scalable commercial frameworks, and collaborating cross-functionally with product, network engineering, finance, and legal teams to ensure every growth initiative is commercially sound and technically deliverable.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution: Lead the 0-to-1 growth lifecycle to ensure alignment with AI Connect revenue objectives. Drive product-market fit from initial market mapping and target identification through commercial launch and active revenue expansion.
Data-Driven Market Growth: Conduct thorough analysis of the AI infrastructure landscape, including data center construction pipelines, power availability, GPU deployment trends, fiber route economics, and interconnection dynamics. Leverage these insights to optimize the product go-to-market funnel, inform growth strategy, and prioritize high-value segments.
Ecosystem Product Strategy: Define and manage the growth roadmap across hyperscalers, data center and colocation operators, real estate partners, OEMs, and emerging AI infrastructure companies. Identify product white space to build scalable solutions that convert Verizon's fiber footprint, optical services portfolio, and AI-ready facilities into recurring infrastructure revenue.
Growth Modeling & Commercialization: Develop scalable commercial models spanning optical and fiber-based services, such as Wavelength Services (10G/100G/400G+), optical extensions, programmable network fabric, data center interconnection, and AI-ready facility partnerships. Establish pricing constructs, capacity commitments, and route-specific terms optimized for rapid market adoption and platform stickiness.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with Product, Network Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Sales teams to shape offers and deal terms, and to ensure seamless execution from signature through delivery.
Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively and manage expectations with business sponsors, company executives, external partners, and customers, acting as a credible and technically fluent representative of Verizon AI Connect at the most senior levels.
Performance Measurement: Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) — pipeline value, signed contract value, revenue conversion, and partner health — to measure partnership success and inform continuous improvement.
Technology & Market Fluency: Possess a strong understanding of fiber products, services, and network fabric — including optical networking (DWDM), Wavelength Services, optical extensions, low-latency routing, and programmable, API-driven network fabric — along with data center fundamentals (power, cooling, density, interconnection) and the traffic patterns of AI workloads, including east-west requirements for training and data center interconnection and north-south requirements for enterprise inference. Stay ahead of the curve on emerging AI infrastructure trends to keep Verizon's strategy competitive.
Business Strategy: Define partnership business models, pricing strategies, target segments, execution plans, and financial business cases for AI Infrastructure and Networking opportunities.
Content Creation: Develop compelling partner-facing collateral, business cases, and executive presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For...

You'll need to have:

Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Six or more years of relevant experience in technology and/or telecommunications.
Demonstrated understanding of the AI infrastructure market, including fiber networks and optical services, data centers, colocation, and interconnection.
Experience originating, structuring, negotiating, and closing large, complex, multi-year commercial or partnership agreements — from inception to signing.
Experience with business models and/or business cases for infrastructure or connectivity services.
Experience with Business-to-Business partnerships, enterprise sales, or corporate development.
Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

An MBA and/or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience in a high-growth company or business unit, scaling a new product, partnership program, or revenue stream from early stage to significant scale.
Direct experience in data center development, fiber optic network development, or colocation — on either the operator or buyer side.
Existing senior-level relationships within hyperscale cloud providers, GPU/neocloud platforms, data center developers/operators, colocation providers, real estate/infrastructure investors, or AI infrastructure OEMs.
Working technical fluency in fiber and optical products and services — Wavelength Services, optical extensions, DWDM, network fabric, and low-latency routing — and data center infrastructure (power, cooling, interconnection) sufficient to lead credible conversations with network architects and infrastructure executives.
Familiarity with programmable and software-defined network services — API-driven provisioning, dynamic bandwidth, network-as-a-service, and self-service portals — and how they differentiate connectivity offerings for AI infrastructure customers.
Familiarity with AI workload networking requirements, including east-west traffic for GPU cluster interconnection, distributed training, and data center interconnection, and north-south traffic for enterprise inference and AI application delivery.
Experience structuring wavelength, interconnection, or data center connectivity transactions on the buy side or sell side.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex infrastructure concepts to diverse audiences, including C-level executives.
Strong financial acumen: ability to build and defend business cases, pricing models, and multi-year revenue commitments using solid ROI analysis.
Experience navigating large, matrixed organizations and building internal coalitions to get complex deals approved and delivered.
Ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
Experience leading or participating in industry panel discussions.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Our company is a dynamic, fast-growing consumer electronics and technology company developing innovative hardware and software products that enhance how customers engage with their everyday experiences. The company is financially healthy, product-led, and entering its next stage of growth with a focus on building a stronger connected technology ecosystem across hardware, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled product experiences.

Additional company details will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead the delivery, execution, and day-to-day operating rhythm of our software engineering function, partnering with the CTO on technical direction and architecture strategy. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, improving architecture, mentoring engineers, and creating clear execution discipline.

This person will partner closely with the CTO, Product, and cross-functional leaders to translate business priorities into scalable technical plans. The ideal candidate brings strong engineering judgment, clear communication, and the ability to lead distributed teams while staying close enough to the code and architecture to make credible technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Execute the architecture roadmap, modernization strategy, and platform consolidation plan set with the CTO, and own their delivery and technical quality
Stay hands-on with architecture reviews, code/design evaluation, technical trade-offs, and complex engineering problem-solving
Build and run the engineering operating rhythm across planning, prioritization, release management, reliability, and incident response
Partner with Product and executive leadership to translate company priorities into clear technical plans, trade-offs, timelines, and dependencies
Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar, and create stronger accountability around delivery quality and follow-through
Lead distributed engineering resources, including full-time staff, external partners, and offshore/vendor teams
Implement practical standards for AI-assisted software development, including coding-agent usage, review practices, testing expectations, and risk controls
Improve engineering visibility through clearer communication around progress, blockers, risks, capacity, and technical decisions
Support hiring, team development, and process recommendations as the software organization scales

Qualifications and Requirements

Required

Strong hands-on technical depth with the ability to read and reason about code, review architecture, and make credible engineering decisions
Experience modernizing or re-architecting production systems without disrupting business operations
Depth in modern web/mobile stacks, including JavaScript/Node.js, React Native or comparable mobile frameworks, scalable backend services, and data architecture
Experience building engineering processes such as delivery cadence, planning rhythm, quality practices, reliability, incident response, and release management
Experience leading distributed, offshore, or vendor engineering teams with clear accountability for quality and delivery
Strong product partnership skills, including roadmap prioritization, trade-off discussions, estimation, and sequencing
Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred

Experience with cloud infrastructure, production reliability, test automation, and CI/CD
Experience with consumer mobile apps, subscription or in-app purchase billing, sports technology, consumer products, or connected hardware
Experience creating AI development standards, team training, documentation, or review workflows
Experience in a high-growth, founder-led, or lean operating environment
Working knowledge of AI coding agents or AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to guide team-level adoption responsibly
Interest in sports technology or consumer technology

Education & Experience

Required

10+ years of software engineering experience
4+ years leading engineering teams as a Director, Senior Engineering Manager, Head of Engineering, Principal-level leader, or equivalent
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

Advanced technical degree or equivalent experience
Prior experience scaling an engineering team, improving engineering operations, or modernizing a software platform

Benefits

Competitive salary and bonuses
Medical, dental, vision & supplemental coverage
401(k) with 3% match
Unlimited paid time off, including holidays and sick leave
Remote
