jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
About Us:

The Community Preservation Corporation (CPC) believes stable and sustainable affordable housing is the foundation of strong communities and we strive to contribute to comprehensive neighborhood revitalization through our lending and partnerships. A nationally recognized leader in affordable housing finance, CPC has provided a consistent source of capital to underserved housing markets throughout New York State since our inception in 1974.

Today, CPC stands as the largest CDFI solely committed to investing in multifamily housing, having invested more than $15 billion to finance the creation and preservation of more than 230,000 units of quality housing in neighborhoods across New York State and beyond. CPC has a robust construction lending platform, a mortgage bank, and equity and impact investment platforms that focus on our three goals: Expanding Affordable Housing, Closing the Racial Wealth Gap and Investing in the Green Economy.

As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that make a real difference in people's lives. We're looking for talented individuals who are passionate about our mission and share our values of commitment, respect, excellence, accountability, and collaboration.

Role Summary:

The Senior Director, Technology Operations is a key member of the Information Technology leadership team responsible for leading CPC's enterprise technology operations and ensuring the delivery of secure, reliable, and high-performing technology services that enable the organization's mission and business objectives.

Reporting directly to the CIO, this role provides strategic and operational leadership across IT Service Management (ITSM), End User Services, Infrastructure, Networks, Cloud Operations, Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity Operations, Technology Engineering, and Vendor Management. The Senior Director is responsible for establishing operational excellence through modern service management practices, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement while delivering exceptional employee technology experience.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, customer-focused technology leader with a passion for building high-performing teams, developing operational capabilities, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and service excellence. This individual will partner closely with business leaders and strategic technology partners to modernize CPC's technology operations, strengthen cybersecurity, improve operational resilience, and support the organization's continued growth and digital transformation.

What You’ll Do:

Leadership & Organizational Excellence

Build, lead, and continuously evolve a world-class Technology Operations organization that delivers exceptional customer experience, operational excellence, and business value.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IT professionals through coaching, performance management, training, succession planning, and career development.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centric service delivery.
Develop organizational capabilities, operating procedures, and service standards that enable scalable growth and operational maturity.

Technology Operations Strategy & Governance

Develop and execute CPC's Technology Operations strategy and roadmap in alignment with the overall IT strategy and business objectives.
Establish and mature IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities based on ITIL best practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Knowledge, Request, and Service Level Management.
Define operational KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and executive reporting to measure service performance, operational effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
Drive continuous service improvement initiatives through automation, process optimization, standardization, and operational governance.

Enterprise Technology Operations

Provide strategic leadership for enterprise technology operations supporting CPC headquarters and regional offices, ensuring highly available, secure, resilient, and reliable technology services.
Oversee End User Computing, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Networks, Cloud Services, Endpoint Management, Identity & Access Management, Operational Cybersecurity, and enterprise technology support.
Ensure operational readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle management across the enterprise.
Lead operational planning to support future business growth, modernization initiatives, and evolving technology requirements.

Technology Service Delivery

Ensure the delivery of reliable, secure, and customer-focused technology services that consistently meet or exceed established service levels.
Continuously improve the IT service portfolio, end-user experience, and operational efficiency through service optimization and automation.
Partner with business leaders to understand operational needs and translate them into scalable technology solutions.
Establish a service-oriented culture focused on responsiveness, transparency, communication, and measurable business outcomes.

Program & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight for Technology Operations projects, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
Prioritize operational initiatives and technology investments that improve reliability, security, scalability, and user experience.
Collaborate with the PMO and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise technology initiatives that support CPC's strategic objectives.
Sponsor and champion continuous improvement initiatives that increase operational maturity and reduce technology risk.

Vendor & Strategic Partner Management

Develop and manage strategic relationships with Managed Service Providers (MSPs), technology vendors, cloud providers, and external partners.
Establish vendor governance processes, performance metrics, service reviews, and contractual accountability to ensure delivery of high-quality services.
Lead vendor selection activities, including RFI, RFP, RFQ, contract negotiations, and ongoing performance management.
Optimize vendor relationships to maximize value, control costs, reduce operational risk, and support CPC's long-term technology strategy.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

Partner with vendor’s leadership to ensure operational security controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and infrastructure security are effectively implemented.
Support enterprise cybersecurity, compliance, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives through operational excellence and technology governance.
Promote a security-first culture across technology operations while ensuring reliable and resilient service delivery.

Skills and Experience:

15+ years of progressive experience in Information Technology, including leadership of enterprise IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Engineering, and Service Delivery.
Proven experience building, leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing IT teams with a strong customer service focus.
Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving operational excellence and continuous process improvement.
Strong technical expertise in enterprise networking, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, endpoint management, identity & access management, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, and cybersecurity operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting and maintaining enterprise firewalls, switches, wireless networks, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure, VPN, endpoint protection, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
Experience implementing and managing IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Knowledge, and Service Level Management.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity best practices, vulnerability management, endpoint security, disaster recovery, business continuity, and technology risk management.
Process-oriented leader with the ability to standardize operations, improve service delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and leverage technology to increase efficiency.
Proven experience managing Managed Service Providers (MSPs), technology vendors, strategic outsourcing relationships, and enterprise technology contracts.
Demonstrated success leading infrastructure upgrades, technology modernization initiatives, enterprise projects, and organizational change.
Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting, vendor management, procurement, asset lifecycle management, and resource planning.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience, demonstrated leadership, and relevant industry certifications will be considered.
Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, CompTIA, Azure, AWS, or cybersecurity certifications are preferred.

KPIs (success criteria)

Service Excellence

Achieve and maintain 90%+ End User Satisfaction while continuously improving the overall employee technology experience.
Meet or exceed established IT Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident response, request fulfillment, and service delivery.

IT Service Management (ITSM) Maturity

Successfully develop and execute the IT Service Improvement Plan (SIP), including:
Implementation of ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Knowledge Management processes.
Launch of an enterprise IT Service Portal and Service Catalog.
Implementation of standardized IT communications and customer engagement strategy.
Modernization of the IT Service Desk experience.
Enhancement of the new employee onboarding technology experience.

Operational Excellence

Improve service efficiency by reducing recurring incidents, increasing first-contact resolution, and optimizing service delivery through automation and process improvement.
Maintain high availability, reliability, and operational performance across CPC's enterprise technology environment.

Cybersecurity & Risk

Improve CPC's cybersecurity maturity by successfully executing the Cybersecurity Improvement Roadmap and achieving targeted SecurityStudio S2 assessment scores.
Ensure operational compliance with established cybersecurity policies, disaster recovery, business continuity, and technology governance standards.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Build and develop a high-performing Technology Operations organization while maintaining strong employee engagement, talent development, and succession planning.
Establish executive dashboards and operational KPIs that provide visibility into service performance, customer satisfaction, operational health, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What we offer:

Competitive compensation
401(k) retirement plans with employer match
Medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents
Commuter benefits
PTO for vacation, personal days, sick leave, holidays, jury duty, bereavement, parental leave, and disability
Tuition assistance program
Two “work from anywhere” weeks per year
Summer Fridays
Collaborative working spaces
Service days to support our communities
Employee development and engagement events
More about our offerings and culture here

This is a hybrid role where you will work from the Manhattan office two - three days a week. The salary range is $225,000 – $250,000, dependent on experience.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The Community Preservation Corporation does not provide employment sponsorship of any kind. Candidates are responsible for ensuring they meet all minimum qualifications for the position at the time of application.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director, Engineering will direct, set goals, institute operational policies, and coordinate activities of the engineering department to include the design, manufacture, and testing of components and products, and maintain quality standards, specifications and systems by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors and employees. The selected candidate will establish best practices that will provide support for FAA FAR component repair solutions, develop DER repairs, and have involvement with multiple aspects of the FAA FAR-145 component repair process.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Directs department activities and develops policies to design new products, modify existing designs, improve production techniques, and overall product quality associated with manufacturing and testing.
Resolves problems using solutions that involve new techniques, technologies, or concepts.
Analyzes technology trends, human resource needs, and market demand to plan projects.
Confers with management, production, and marketing staff to determine engineering feasibility, cost effectiveness, and customer demands for new and existing products.
Forecasts operating costs of department and directs preparation of budget requests.
Advises management of new developments which may affect profit, schedule, costs, customer relations, and/or inter-departmental relations.
Provides direction and example for interpretation and application of company policies and procedures to the engineering activities.
Maintains a working knowledge of new technologies which may improve operations and develops recommendations accordingly.
Maintains a working knowledge of safety policies and regulations to ensure duties of self and others are performed in a safe manner.
Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
Other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor of Science degree required, Aerospace or mechanical engineering.
Masters degree preferred.

Experience

Related work experience shall be a minimum of 10 years with at least 5 to 10 years of management role over engineering department.
Experience with the policies and procedures of the following regulatory agencies; FAA, EASA, and DOT, relative to Aircraft Fire Suppression and Safety Systems including Oxygen and Stored Energy Systems.
Candidate must have strong Mechanical engineering skills with experience of exotic Stainless Steels and related processes such as forming and welding. Experience in a short run production environment is also a job requirement.

Qualifications

Proven leadership and management experience to lead engineering teams.
Strategic mindset with regard to NPD planning.
Proven team player who has demonstrated capabilities in the following areas: excellent communication, presentation, leadership and interpersonal skills, well developed problem-solving skills; solid organizational skills; and the demonstrated ability to be self-directed and effectively relate to all levels of an organization.
Looking for a hands-on individual with the ability to see the big picture.
Ability to work well under pressure, multitask and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to set goals and objectives to meet Business expectations.
The right person will be ambitious and flexible who wants to learn and grow professionally.
Must read, write, and speak English fluently.

Direct Reports

5-10 direct reports

Typical Working Conditions

Work will be conducted mostly indoors in an office type environment.
Exposure to heat or cold will mostly be limited to when walking from one building to another. The use of PPE such as safety glasses and safety toed shoes are required in designated working areas.

Essential Physical Tasks

Must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.
Regularly required to sit or stand, walk, bend, and reach with hands and arms
Regular use of hands/fingers for handling, holding, grasping and typing on a computer keyboard
The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus

Other

Due to contracts with the United States Government, the candidate must be either a US Citizen or Green card holder
Travel: 10-15% as position may travel to other Midwest or North American MRO business or customer locations

Business Unit

The AMETEK Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) Group is a global provider of third-party maintenance repair and overhaul (MRO) services for commercial, regional, general aviation and rotor-wing aircraft. It offers a wide range of services, including avionics, fuel and fluid systems, heat transfer, hydraulics, oil, oxygen, power generation, pneumatics, radios, and safety equipment. AMETEK MRO businesses are AEM, Aeromedic, Ameron, Antavia, Avtech, B&S Aircraft, Drake Air, Muirhead Avionics, Southern Aeroparts, AMETEK MRO Florida and AMETEK Singapore. Its operations are FAA, EASA, CAAC and CAAS approved.
The pursuit of innovation and excellence are the driving force at AMETEK MRO. For decades, our businesses have served the MRO market offering total solutions. With a focus on innovation, performance and integrity, AMETEK MRO is well positioned in highly competitive market segments to expect continued business growth. Supporting this growth are our eleven certified repair centers and over 700 employees across the globe.

BUSINESS UNIT: DRAKE AIR

Drake Air is a leading FAA/EASA/CAAC/AS9110C/AS9100D certified repair station specializing in the maintenance, repair and overhaul of Heat Transfer Components (Heat Exchangers, Pre Coolers, Oil Coolers, Fuel Heaters and Accessory items) for all types of commercial, regional, general aviation, military and rotor wing aircraft. Innovation has been a cornerstone to Drake Air's success, as best reflected in our core replacement program called Nu-Matrix™. With Nu-Matrix the old core matrix is replaced using an FAA approved process, restoring the unit back to zero time and in full compliance with the Original Equipment Manufacturers specifications. Nu-Matrix has proven to provide customer's the same performance, reliability and service life of an OEM new unit for much less than the cost of a new part replacement. Drake Air’s highly skilled engineering and technical departments consistently provide repair alternatives that provide our customers excellent value and significant cost savings.
Acquired by AMETEK in 2008, Drake Air is a unit within AMETEK MRO’s Division, a recognized global provider of third-party MRO services to commercial, regional and general aviation customers as well as military, helicopter and business jet markets.
Website: www.drakeair.com

BUSINESS UNIT: SOUTHERN AEROPARTS

Southern Aeroparts (SAI) is an AS9110C and AS9100D certified repair station providing a broad range of maintenance, repair and overhaul services for commercial aircraft components. These services include electromechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic capabilities for all types of electric motors, cargo drives and actuators; fan reverser, flight control and landing gear actuation components; and pneumatic motors and valves. Additionally, SAI maintains a repair rather than replace mentality. Utilizing our full, in-house engineering and manufacturing capabilities and upon customer acceptance, SAI uses FAA/PMA approved parts and DER repairs. This approach allows SAI to continuously provide the cost-effective repairs to our customer base.
Located in Tulsa, OK, Southern Aeroparts maintains a repair rather than replace mentality. Utilizing full, in-house engineering and manufacturing capabilities, SAI is able to continuously provide innovative, cost-effective repairs.
Acquired by AMETEK in 2006, Southern Aeroparts is a unit within AMETEK MRO’s Division, a recognized global provider of third-party MRO services to commercial, regional and general aviation customers as well as military, helicopter and business jet markets.
Website: www.southernaeroparts.com

BUSINESS UNIT: B&S AIRCRAFT

AMETEK MRO B&S Aircraft Parts and Accessories, a Class I, II and III repair station with an Unlimited Rating from the FAA, is a recognized industry leader in starter generators, inverters, fuel systems, boost pumps and much more. B&S supports the business and general aviation markets, the US Military, commercial air carriers as well as rotor wing operators. Additionally, B&S has been chosen as the authorized repair center for a number of leading aircraft manufacturers such as Hawker Beechcraft, Cessna Aircraft and Pilatus.
Acquired by AMETEK in 2007, B&S Aircraft is a unit within AMETEK MRO’s Division, a recognized global provider of third-party MRO services to commercial, regional and general aviation customers as well as military, helicopter and business jet markets.
www.bsaircraft.com

Currency: USD

Salary Maximum: 200,000

Incentive: No

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Fast Growing Electonics Manufacturing Operation in Beaverton seeks an expeirenced Director of Engineering to join the leadership team. This is a key role that will oversee a team of 20-25 Engineers, including Manufacturing, Process, and Test Engineers. Qualified candidates should have prior experience in a PCBA manufacturing environment with knowledge of Surface Mount Techology. The company has doubled in size over the past 3 years with projects for signficantly more growth in the years ahead due to increased demand in the Defense and Space Industry. Awesome culture and great benefits.

Engineering Leadership & Team Management

Lead and direct the Engineering Team, establishing priorities, assigning resources, and ensuring timely completion of projects and deliverables.
Develop, coach, and mentor engineering staff to build technical capability, accountability, initiative, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
Establish and maintain engineering processes, standards, and performance expectations that support safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
Identify staffing, training, equipment, and resource requirements and make recommendations to executive leadership.
Promote continuous improvement, Lean/Six Sigma practices, standardization, and problem-solving throughout Engineering and Manufacturing.

Technology Development

Develop and maintain an engineering technology roadmap aligned with strategic objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.
Assess internal capabilities against current and future market and customer requirements and recommend investments in equipment, technology, software, and technical resources.
Evaluate emerging and disruptive technologies and identify opportunities, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Lead or support the selection, implementation, validation, and integration of new manufacturing technologies and equipment.
Maintain strong technical knowledge of PCBA manufacturing, SMT, high-level assembly, box build, test, and related manufacturing processes.

Sales & Customer Support

Serve as a technical resource to customers and prospects, working directly with customer engineering teams to evaluate designs, manufacturing requirements, and process improvements.
Partner with Business Development and Program Management on new opportunities, customer selection, and portfolio management.
Provide engineering input to quotations, including technology fit, DFM/DFT analysis, process requirements, tooling, equipment, and technical risks.
Evaluate customer designs and requirements against internal capabilities and identify opportunities to improve manufacturability, quality, reliability, and cost.

New Product Introduction

Direct Engineering's participation in the NPI process from quotation through production launch, ensuring effective transition of new products into manufacturing.
Establish and maintain robust DFM/DFT processes that support accurate quoting, manufacturability, quality, reliability, and cost objectives.
Oversee manufacturing process development, documentation, tooling, programming, and technical requirements for new products.
Ensure engineering support for quick-turn and complex product introductions.
Direct engineering support for component management, including regulatory requirements, declarations, obsolescence, and product lifecycle considerations.
Ensure Document Control provides accurate, timely, and controlled documentation for internal and customer requirements.

Operations Support

Provide engineering leadership and technical support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Process/Manufacturing Engineering teams in resolving complex production issues.
Lead defect review, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and process improvements for recurring or significant manufacturing issues.
Support validation planning and execution for processes, equipment, and manufacturing changes.
Provide technical direction for SMT, selective and wave solder, reflow, inspection, X-ray, test, rework, and other manufacturing processes.
Ensure engineering standards and processes comply with applicable customer, regulatory, quality, and industry requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in electronic manufacturing/EMS, including at least 5 years supporting new product introduction.
Significant experience leading engineering teams in an SMT/PCBA manufacturing environment.
Extensive knowledge of PCBA processes, high-level assemblies, box build, and electronics manufacturing technologies.
Experience in a regulated industry such as aerospace, defense, medical device, or similar.
Demonstrated experience leading organizational change, process improvement, and Lean/Six Sigma initiatives; Black Belt certification preferred.
Strong project management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Customer-facing experience with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to customers, suppliers, and internal teams.
Strong understanding of SMT equipment and processes, including printing, SPI, pick-and-place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, selective solder, and wave solder.
Experience with DFM/DFT, stencil design, reflow profiling, defect analysis, root cause analysis, and rework processes.
Working knowledge of IPC and J-STD requirements; Class 1-3 IPC training preferred.
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.
Understanding of business finance and the financial impact of engineering decisions.

jobs.title: Director- Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Covista is America's largest healthcare educator, serving more than 97,000 students and supported by a community of 385,000 alumni across five accredited institutions. Through personalized, tech-enabled education powered by 10,000 faculty and colleagues, Covista expands access to healthcare careers and addresses the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage at scale. Covista is the parent company of American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University.

Our colleagues come from a wide range of backgrounds, business, academia, healthcare, government and nonprofits, and are part of a culture where doing exceptional work and making a meaningful difference for students and society aren't separate goals—they're one and the same. This means creating an environment where colleagues can develop new skills, build careers that match their ambitions and see the tangible impact of their work on healthcare education and workforce development. Colleagues who deliver results and embrace new tools to work smarter are valued for their contributions. But what makes working at Covista distinctive is our impact. Our faculty and colleagues don't just support healthcare education—they shape it. This isn't abstract purpose work. It's solving real problems for real people in real communities while advancing careers.

We operate on a hybrid schedule with four in-office days per week (Monday–Thursday). This approach enhances creativity, innovation, communication, and relationship-building, fostering a dynamic and collaborative work environment.

For more information, visit covista.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Job Description

The Director, Data Engineering will own and operate Covista’s enterprise data platform — the cloud data lakehouse, integration and ingestion pipelines, data contracts, the Knowledge Catalog (governance, lineage, and PII/consent controls), and the DataOps practice that keeps it all running. This role is accountable for driving platform best practices, optimizing resource capacity and utilization, and ensuring robust governance around platform reliability, cost, and technical debt remediation.

As a strategic technology leader, you will own the “trust” contract with every data consumer — partnering closely with Data Science, Data Reporting, Applied AI, and business and institution stakeholders to guarantee trustworthy, performant data across Covista, ensure platform health, and foster innovation through proof of concepts (POCs) and forward-looking architecture.

Strategic Leadership

Own and evolve the enterprise data engineering strategy across the lakehouse, integration, and governance platforms, ensuring alignment with business goals and Covista’s data architecture principles.
Establish best practices and governance frameworks for platform development, data contracts, pipeline lifecycle management, and the Knowledge Catalog.
Platform & Technology Management
Oversee delivery and operations across the cloud data lakehouse (BigQuery, GCS), integration/ingestion tooling, the Knowledge Catalog (Dataplex), and the DataOps platform.
Drive standardization and modernization of the data platform, emphasizing scalability, automation, and reusability.
Own the roadmap for platform reliability, cost optimization, and lifecycle management across data engineering technologies.

Delivery & Flex Capacity Management

Implement a flexible resource model (FTE, contractor, and nearshore) to support project-based pipeline work, run-the-business operations, and spikes in demand.
Manage intake and prioritization of data engineering work, ensuring efficient allocation of internal and external resources.
Partner with Data Science, Data Reporting, and business units to support delivery of enterprise initiatives and transformation programs.
Data Trust & Quality Oversight
Own the “trust” contract with every data consumer, ensuring rigorous data contract enforcement, lineage tracking, and PII/consent controls are in place for all platform releases.

Technical Debt & Proof of Concepts

Evaluate and manage technical debt across the data platform; proactively drive remediation efforts through actionable roadmaps.
Promote a culture of experimentation through lightweight POCs, testing the viability of new data technologies and patterns before broad implementation.

People & Vendor Management

Lead and mentor a diverse team of data engineers, data architects, platform administrators, and vendors.
Cultivate a high-performing, inclusive culture with a focus on continuous improvement and technical excellence.
Manage external vendors (e.g., Atlan, Fivetran), contracts, and performance metrics to ensure delivery expectations are met.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
Ten (10) plus years experience in enterprise data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture roles.
Five (5) plus years experience leading data engineering or data platform teams.
Experience in higher education, healthcare, or other complex matrixed enviroinments a plus.
Deep experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google BigQuery, GCS), data catalog/governance tooling (e.g.,
Dataplex, Atlan), and integration/ELT tooling (e.g., Fivetran).
Proven track record in resource and capacity planning, technical delivery, and operational excellence.
Experience implementing platform governance, technical debt remediation, and upgrade strategies.
Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business and technology domains.
Demonstrated leadership abilities.
Strong project management, process, technical and financial management knowledge.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects and multiple employees simultaneously.

Additional Information

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $100,171.61 and $181,034.70. Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. jobs.title: Sr. Director, Software Engineering, Digital for Research & CMC Development
jobs.description:
The Role

We are seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead the software engineering organization supporting Research and CMC Development. Reporting to the Head of Digital for Research and CMC Development (D4RT), this leader will establish clear engineering standards and operating rhythms, drive accountability and predictable execution, and build a high-performing organization capable of delivering reliable, scalable digital solutions that advance scientific research and development.

This leader will oversee full-stack application and integration engineering capabilities, leading and developing engineering leaders and senior technical contributors while strengthening engineering practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering experience with strong operational and people leadership. They bring the technical credibility to effectively lead senior engineers, evaluate system-level tradeoffs, and develop exceptional technical talent. While this is not a hands-on development role, this leader will bring strong systems thinking, understand the broader implications of technical decisions, and empower technical leads and other senior contributors to provide technical leadership across the organization.

The successful candidate will also have significant experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations and a strong understanding of scientific Research and CMC Development environments. They will understand the scientific context, workflows, ways of working, and cross-functional dynamics required to translate complex scientific needs into effective digital and software strategies.

Here’s What You’ll Do

Software Engineering Operations

Lead the evolution of the software engineering organization, establishing the leadership practices, operating model, engineering standards, and talent capabilities needed to support a growing Research and CMC Development digital portfolio.
Build and develop strong engineering leaders and senior technical contributors, enabling them to grow talent, delegate effectively, establish clear ownership, and operate at the right level of technical and organizational leadership.
Establish clear and consistent expectations for performance and career progression across the engineering organization, creating transparency around what strong performance looks like and how individuals grow in scope and impact.
Establish effective engineering operating rhythms and portfolio management practices that provide visibility into priorities, capacity, resource allocation, commitments, delivery health, dependencies, and risks, enabling informed tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity.
Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and ownership in which teams deliver against commitments, leaders address systemic barriers to delivery and meaningful improvements to engineering practices and ways of working.

Application & Integration Engineering

Provide senior oversight across custom full-stack application and integration engineering capacities supporting scientific and operational workflows.
Guide engineering strategy across commercial SaaS platforms, custom applications, scientific systems, enterprise platforms, and data products, promoting reusable APIs, services, integration patterns, and shared capabilities.
Drive simplification and sustainability across the technology landscape, ensuring applications and integrations leverage sound cloud architecture and engineering practices and are designed with reliability, observability, security, scalability, and operational support appropriate to their use.

Partner with Product Management

Partner with Product Management to maintain alignment across product priorities, planned initiatives, engineering capacity, and existing commitments, enabling effective resource planning and informed portfolio tradeoffs.
Bring an engineering and systems perspective into product planning, helping teams understand how proposed solutions fit within the broader digital ecosystem and when software engineering capabilities are needed.
Develop engineering leaders who can partner effectively with Product leads, while working across D4RT leadership to strengthen Product–Engineering ways of working, shared planning, and decision-making.

Partner Across Digital

Build strong partnerships across Digital, including Data Engineering, DevOps and Cybersecurity to navigate shared priorities and dependencies and effectively leverage enterprise platforms, data products, standards, and expertise.
Bring an informed engineering perspective to cross-Digital initiatives and enterprise technology decisions, understanding their implications for Research and CMC Development and constructively influencing approaches where needed.

Drive Scientific & Operational Impact

Build trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Research and CMC Development, developing a deep understanding of scientific workflows, development processes, data flows, and decision-making needs to inform engineering strategy and priorities.
Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous scientific needs into pragmatic, scalable digital solutions that improve scientific and operational outcomes.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology experience, including 10+ years of engineering leadership experience with responsibility for engineering teams, leaders, and senior technical contributors.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant hands-on experience designing and delivering production software, with strong technical depth across modern software architecture, cloud-native engineering, full-stack development, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
5+ years of modern cloud architecture and cloud-native engineering principles, with experience evaluate architectural approaches and tradeoffs across complex software environments.
10+ years of leadership experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations, with direct experience supporting scientific Research, CMC Development, Technical Development, Process Development, or closely related R&D functions.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling software engineering organizations, including developing engineering leaders and senior technical talent, evolving engineering operating models and practices, and driving strong organizational performance.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience with scientific and laboratory technology ecosystems, including ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory automation, scientific data platforms, modeling or analytical systems, or related capabilities.
Experience integrating commercial scientific SaaS platforms within complex biotechnology or biopharmaceutical technology environments.
Experience applying AI-enabled engineering tools and practices to improve software development productivity, quality, and scalability, with the technical fluency to guide engineering teams on effective and responsible adoption.

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work.
That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $210,900.00 - $379,200.00. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.

By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Engineering Applications & Labs
jobs.description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

We are looking for a strategic leader to oversee Marvell’s global engineering applications and labs. This leader will define the roadmap for modernizing engineering tools, managing lab environments, and driving the migration of applications to the cloud. A key part of the role will be building an integrated development platform that unifies workflows, connects labs with engineering applications, and enables secure, scalable collaboration across global teams. Partnering with Engineering, IT, and Security, you will be responsible for driving developer productivity, safeguarding critical IP, and enabling the next generation of engineering innovation.

What You Can Expect

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Labs

Build and deliver a multi-year roadmap with Engineering, IT, Security, and Facilities.
Stand up a “Labs as a Service” model with centralized provisioning, standardized services, and dedicated IT support.
Improve utilization through asset rationalization, BU consolidation, and process/tool upgrades.
Enforce role-based access, patching/automation, secure remote access, and regulatory compliance.
Unify operating models, SOPs, and governance across business units, incorporating automation and AI where impactful.
Architect NAC, Wi-Fi, and network segmentation to protect IP and engineering data.
Oversee co-location strategies, cloud transitions, and domain decoupling for lab environments.

Engineering Applications & Integrated Development Platform

Own the strategy and roadmap for engineering applications (e.g., custom apps, Jira, Confluence, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD).

Build an integrated development platform that connects engineering applications, toolchains, and lab environments into a seamless ecosystem.
Modernize the engineering toolchain and integrate AI where it drives measurable productivity.
Champion DevSecOps to embed security early and automate compliance enforcement.
Ensure application resiliency, observability, and readiness for incident response across data centers and cloud.
Drive global standardization to improve scalability, reliability, and productivity across engineering sites.

Required

What We're Looking For

Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering, Technology, or related field.
15+ years in IT or technology leadership, including 5+ years in engineering applications or lab operations.
Proven success leading large-scale standardization or transformation across global teams.
Exceptional program management, stakeholder alignment, and communication skills.

Preferred

Familiarity with semiconductor workflows/tools (EDA, verification, silicon validation).
Strong understanding of lab functions (validation, bring-up, debug, test, failure analysis).
Experience with remote engineering workflows or lab automation.
Certifications: PMP, ITIL, Six Sigma (a plus).

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

190,280 - 285,000, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

jobs.description:
Why Rate is the BEST Place to Work

Rate is one of the nation’s top retail mortgage lenders, delivering a seamless, tech-driven experience that helps customers reach their homeownership and financial goals. Founded in 2000 and based in Chicago, Rate is licensed in all 50 states and D.C. and has helped over 2 million homeowners with a wide range of loan products, competitive rates and personalized service. From purchases and refinances to tapping into equity, Rate makes financing faster, simpler and less stressful. Our technology — including Same Day Mortgage, the Rate App, FlashClose℠, MyAccount and the Language Access Program — has earned recognition from HousingWire, Scotsman Guide, NerdWallet, the Chicago Tribune and Crain’s Chicago Business. Learn more at rate.com.

What Makes Our Team Awesome

We are a gritty group of passionate technologists on a mission to dominate the mortgage world!

The Information Technology Team within Rate passionately and consistently puts our customers first. We are building the latest technology to help create the best mortgage experience on the planet and get your mortgage, your way, anytime, anywhere. Whether that is improving our digital mortgage platform, automating loan coordination and underwriting processes, or building out the latest marketing and customer engagement platform, we’re doing it all. We build high-performing, self-organized, cross-functional agile teams that operate with minimal hierarchy. Information Technology team members hold themselves and others accountable and live and breathe the tenets of autonomy, mastery, and purpose.

What’s the Role?

Rate is seeking a technology leader to accelerate software delivery through practical adoption of AI coding tools, including Claude, Codex, and similar platforms. Responsibilities

Lead Rate’s strategy for AI-enabled software development across the full SDLC.

Launch pilots, train teams, and create repeatable practices that drive adoption beyond individual power users.
Measure impact through deployment frequency, lead time, PR cycle time, test automation, defect rates, and developer adoption.
Remove delivery bottlenecks across requirements, development environments, testing, approvals, and releases.

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This job is responsible for building and leading a team to deliver technology products and services that meet business outcomes. Key responsibilities include developing a technology strategy, ensuring technology solutions comply with applicable standards, promoting design, engineering, and organizational practices, and advocating and advancing modern, Agile solution delivery practices. Job expectations may include coaching, mentoring, providing feedback and hands on career development, identifying emerging talent, fostering leadership skills, and managing stakeholders.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technology Manager
to lead engineering teams responsible for enterprise AI, intelligent automation, digital capture, and document intelligence platforms. This role will help drive the next generation of business automation by leveraging Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Document Processing, workflow orchestration, and agentic automation to transform how information is captured, processed, and acted upon across the enterprise.

This leader will be accountable for driving technology strategy, engineering execution, platform modernization, and operational excellence across a portfolio of highly scalable business-critical platforms. The role requires a strong combination of people leadership, architecture expertise, AI knowledge, and large-scale technology delivery experience.

The ideal candidate is a mature engineering leader with deep experience managing complex technology ecosystems, delivering transformational programs, and building high-performing engineering organizations

Responsibilities:

Builds and manages teams by performing financial activities to inform workforce strategy and hiring practices, setting and tracking maturity and quality objectives, and training employees/teams to address feedback and achieve quality and performance objectives
Facilitates performance and career development of employees/teams through performance reviews, coaching, and creating development plans that are needed to build competencies and skills
Manages solution delivery and application performance in production (app health, resiliency, performance, security, enterprise data management standards, audit exams and reviews), ensuring all relevant risk, financial, and compliance policies are met
Manages relationships with business and technology partners and leads and creates followership in Communities of Practice in the organization
Contributes to the technology strategy for their technical domain
Creates an inclusive and healthy working environment and helps to resolve organizational impediments/blockers
Ensures that execution is aligned with product strategy by working with product management and other stakeholders

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of technology leadership experience in large-scale enterprise environments.
5+ years of experience leading engineering managers, architects, and software engineering teams.
Proven experience delivering complex technology transformation programs and strategic business initiatives.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise platforms supporting high-volume, mission-critical business processes.
Experience developing and executing technology strategies aligned to long-term business objectives.
Strong background managing complex distributed systems, enterprise integrations, and large-scale application architectures.
Experience driving platform modernization, cloud/container adoption, automation, and engineering transformation initiatives.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams across engineering, architecture, product, operations, and business organizations.
Experience building, scaling, and developing high-performing engineering organizations, including talent management, succession planning, mentoring, and workforce transformation.
Strong financial and resource management experience, including workforce planning, budget management, vendor management, and delivery prioritization.
Experience establishing engineering governance, SDLC best practices, quality standards, and delivery management frameworks.
Proven track record of driving operational excellence, platform reliability, resiliency, observability, performance optimization, and service stability.
Strong experience managing technology risk, security, audit, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and regulatory requirements in a complex enterprise environment.
Ability to influence senior leaders and effectively communicate technology strategy, business value, risks, and investment priorities to executive stakeholders.

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a mature engineering leader who can:

Set strategic direction while ensuring flawless execution.
Lead complex technology organizations through transformation and growth.
Develop future leaders and build organizational capability.
Balance innovation, scalability, governance, operational excellence, and risk management.
Create strong partnerships across business, product, architecture, operations, and engineering functions.
Translate emerging technologies and AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience leading enterprise AI, Intelligent Automation, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), or advanced workflow platforms.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, RAG, Semantic Search, and AI governance frameworks.
Experience with enterprise workflow orchestration, business process automation, API-driven platforms, and cloud-native architectures.
Knowledge of modern engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), CI/CD, platform engineering, and infrastructure automation.
Experience leading large-scale modernization programs involving legacy platform transformation and adoption of emerging technologies.

Overview

ABOUT THE POSITION

VHB’s Pennsylvania team is looking for a Senior Transportation Engineering Manager in the Transportation Department to join our growing team. The selected candidate could be in our Lansdale, Philadelphia or Camp Hill office.

VHB’s Transportation group has earned a reputation as one of the preeminent traffic engineering and transportation teams in Pennsylvania. This position provides an opportunity to lead complex transportation projects for federal, state, and local government clients and play an important role in expanding and shaping the group. We are looking for someone with a blend of project management skills, technical expertise, managerial skills, and innovative thinking.

Responsibilities

Serve as Senior Project Manager for federal, state, and local clients, including PennDOT and the PA Turnpike.
Develop and manage client relationships
Manage staff, and provide technical and professional development of staff
Assist with strategy for expansion of transportation services in Pennsylvania
Monitor project financial performance
Attend and lead meetings with clients, regulatory agencies, and stakeholders to establish their needs and discuss traffic analysis and transportation design/permitting issues
Execute scope associated with project delivery for transportation design projects for all stages from feasibility studies to final PS&E packages at letting.
Participate in professional organizations that promote relationships with clients and teaming partners
Develop new project opportunities, and prepare and manage proposal submissions

Skills And Attributes

Self-motivated, attention to detail and ability to multitask
Ability to think critically
Exhibits strong leadership skills
Strong computer skills (MS Office)
Strong and collaborative work ethic and ability to work well in a team environment
Substantial technical and project management experience
Ability to manage a multidisciplinary team of professionals
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Advanced knowledge of concepts, practices, and procedures in highway design
Thorough knowledge of PennDOT and PA Turnpike policies and practices in project delivery
Advanced knowledge of local and state regulations governing transportation design
Software exposure: MicroStation and Open Roads Designer; AutoCAD Civil 3D is a plus

Qualifications

B.S. in Civil Engineering, transportation planning or similar discipline
11-15+ years of professional transportation engineering experience, with at least 10 years of experience working in the PA market, required
PA Professional Engineer (PE) license required
Proven success in the transportation and/or state & local government market sectors
Experience with MD, DVRPC, City of Philadelphia is a plus

The full-time annual base salary range for this position, located in Pennsylvania, is $135,000 to $175,000. The base salary offered will be determined based on job-related factors, including geographic location, internal equity, experience, credentials, skills, education, work schedule, and other factors permitted by law. The posted salary range reflects base pay only. Additional compensation and benefits available to eligible employees are outlined in our Total Rewards Program.

Annual base salary is one component of VHB’s Total Rewards package. In addition to base pay, eligible employees may receive annual incentive compensation bonuses, spot bonuses, and merit-based salary increases, providing opportunities to increase earnings beyond base pay. VHB also offers a differentiating work experience , including a comprehensive benefits package that includes eligibility to participate in the VHB 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and recognition programs.

Details on VHB’s benefits package can be found here: Benefits Checklist

Building What’s Next, Together.

Our people make the difference. We foster a technology-empowered, people‑driven, future‑ready culture where agility, innovation, and collaboration shape how we work every day.

When You Join VHB, You’ll Find

Meaningful work on complex projects with real community impact
A collaborative, inclusive culture that values curiosity and shared success
Support to grow your skills and lead through change
Learning and development supported by evolving tools and technologies, including AI
Best-in-class benefits and a flexible, hybrid work environment

We’re growing across the East Coast and are consistently recognized as a great place to work. Ready to shape what’s next? Learn more about what sets our employee experience apart and connect with us.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Chief Engineer/Principal Software Engineer

Job Category: Engineering

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%

Type of Travel: Continental US

Anticipated Posting End: 10/30/2026

The Opportunity

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chief Engineer
to lead the "how" and "when" of technical execution for a large-scale government program. Partnering closely with our Chief Architect - who defines the long-term technical vision and system design - you will focus on delivery management, operational rigor, engineering standards, and team enablement. Leading a distributed team of 45+ engineers, you will provide end-to-end technical execution oversight for a modern data lake system supporting national critical operations.

In this role, you will translate architectural blueprints and complex requirements into scalable, disciplined, and predictable delivery—cultivating strong customer relationships to deeply understand mission needs and successfully realize them through execution.

Tech Ecosystem & Domain Scope

Modern Data Lake Platform: Drive the execution and delivery of a high-throughput, scalable data lake solution utilizing a modern technology stack hosted on AWS.
Massive Scale & Integration: Oversee the operational execution for a large volume of diverse data inputs, a broad user base, and an even larger downstream consumer community.
External Interfaces: Oversee the development, integration, and ongoing maintenance of various APIs supporting external data users and producers.

Responsibilities

Execution & Delivery Strategy: Own the implementation plans, technical roadmaps and delivery schedules, translating the Chief Architect's high-level designs into actionable, high-quality development sprints and releases.
Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and upskill a team of engineers across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) within classified government environments.
Engineering Standards & Processes: Establish robust coding standards, code review practices, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps workflows to ensure consistent, repeatable software delivery across all squads.
API & Integration Oversight: Ensure high availability, performance, and security for critical data ingestion pipelines and external producer/consumer APIs through rigorous engineering management.
Quality & Technical Debt Management: Drive Continuous Delivery, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration while balancing feature delivery with technical debt reduction.
Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a primary technical interface to leadership, government customers, and subcontractor teams, leading Technical Exchange Meetings (TEMs) and aligning execution with mission goals.
Risk & Resource Management: Proactively identify and mitigate technical, operational, and cross-team dependency risks while championing engineering best practices.

Qualifications

Required:

Clearance: Active TS/SCI Security Clearance.
Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Leadership Track Record: Proven experience as a Chief Engineer or senior technical delivery leader guiding large-scale teams (35+ personnel) through full SDLC in classified environments (Note: architectural vision is covered by our Chief Architect, so this role centers on execution, delivery, and team enablement).
Technical Execution & Operations: Extensive experience managing large-scale system deployments on cloud platforms (AWS), data engineering, distributed system principles, and Kubernetes-based deployments.
Methodologies: Proven experience leading Agile initiatives, distributed engineering teams, code quality assessments, and testing validation across multi-site workforces.
Additional Skills: Strong cross-functional communication, interpersonal collaboration, and the ability to manage multiple technical delivery tasks under tight deadlines.

Desired

Clearance: Active TS/SCI with adjudicated Polygraph.
Business Acumen: Ability to align engineering execution with programmatic and organizational goals.
Advanced Tech: Hands-on experience with modern data stack tooling, containerization (Docker), DevOps pipelines, and serverless computing.
Domain Expertise: Direct experience in intelligence community data systems, SIGINT/GEOINT mission processing, satellite tasking, or large-scale data lake implementations.
Mission Experience: Direct experience in one or more mission areas:
GEOINT mission planning and processing
Satellite command and control systems
Advanced mission and payload planning for satellite operations

What You Can Expect

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$114,600-$252,100

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

15 years of experience in a technical field bridging software engineering/AI and a scientific domain (e.g., computational biology, cheminformatics, physics).
7 years of experience managing and scaling specialized engineering, research, or technical incubation teams.
Experience with modern machine learning and Generative AI applied to scientific data (e.g., Graph Neural Networks, protein folding models, molecular dynamics, genomics).

Preferred qualifications:

PhD in Computational Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Bioinformatics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
Experience operating in a "strategic AI co-engineering" or highly technical incubation environment, building with external customers.
Familiarity with the complex regulatory, security, and data governance requirements inherent in scientific and healthcare enterprise environments.
Proven track record of engaging with C-level executives (CSO, CIO, Head of R&D) and driving complex technical transformations in scientific or highly regulated industries (e.g., Pharma, Life Sciences).
Strong reputation in the scientific AI community, with published research in journals, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific computing projects.

About The Job

The Google Cloud AI Blackbelt team is an external-facing incubation engine within the Applied AI Engineering (AAIE) organization. Our primary mission is to bridge the gap between Google's cutting-edge frontier research (including DeepMind) and enterprise production reality.

Within this organization, the AI for Science domain represents one of our most critical key bets. This specialized unit focuses on accelerating scientific discovery and R&D by bringing Google’s frontier scientific models (e.g., AlphaFold, specialized LLMs for genomics, computational chemistry, and material science) to the world's leading life sciences, healthcare, and industrial research organizations. We operate under a "strategic AI co-engineering" model, building complex scientific AI solutions directly alongside our customers' R&D and engineering teams.

As the Director of AI for Science, you will lead a highly specialized, global team of AI researchers, computational scientists, and forward-looking software engineers. You will be responsible for defining and executing the technical go-to-market and incubation strategy for our scientific AI portfolio.

You will act as the ultimate bridge between Google’s scientific research breakthroughs and commercial enterprise application. Serving as a trusted technical and scientific advisor to Chief Science Officers (CSOs) and R&D leaders at our "Lighthouse" accounts, you will drive the co-engineering of platforms that accelerate drug discovery, molecular simulation, and advanced scientific modeling.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Lead, scale, and mentor a specialized team of scientific AI co-engineers and researchers. Define the strategic roadmap for the AI for science incubation practice, aligning closely with DeepMind and Cloud Engineering.
Serve as the executive technical sponsor for major scientific and R&D accounts. Collaborate with customers to integrate frontier models into their proprietary R&D pipelines.
Act as the critical feedback loop between external scientific enterprises and Google's internal research teams. Translate early-adopter friction in scientific use cases into actionable insights that inform the commercialization of our scientific AI portfolio.
Drive the technical incubation and adoption of scientific bets to achieve significant market validation and ARR milestones.
Oversee the creation of production-ready reference architectures, scientific AI "recipes," and best practices to enable the broader Google Cloud Go-To-Market teams in the life sciences and healthcare verticals.
