jobs.title: Senior Technical Director, Hydrometallurgy & Mineral Processing Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking a Senior Technical Director, Hydrometallurgy & Mineral Processing Engineering
to join our South Jordan, Utah
office. This senior technical role will provide subject matter leadership for hydrometallurgical and mineral processing projects from concept and front-end development through scoping, pre-feasibility, feasibility, detailed execution, commissioning, and operational support.

The successful candidate will lead process engineering teams, shape technically robust flowsheets, direct laboratory and integrated pilot programs, and translate test results into practical process designs. The role combines hands-on technical work, project planning, client engagement, quality oversight, mentoring, proposal support, and collaboration with multidisciplinary study and execution teams.

The position will support projects involving lithium, uranium, vanadium, rare earth elements, copper, cobalt, zinc, and other base or critical minerals. The Senior Technical Director will work in office, laboratory, pilot-plant, and site environments and may lead teams across multiple locations and cultures.

Your Impact

Provide senior technical direction for hydrometallurgical and mineral processing studies and execution assignments, ensuring work is technically sound, fit for purpose, and aligned with agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
Lead development and review of design criteria, metallurgical balances, process flow diagrams, process descriptions, equipment lists, equipment selection and sizing, and process and piping documentation.
Develop, evaluate, and optimize hydrometallurgical flowsheets incorporating leaching, pressure oxidation, atmospheric leaching, resin-in-pulp, resin-in-leach, carbon-in-pulp, ion exchange, solvent extraction, precipitation, electrowinning, and membrane or nanofiltration technologies, as applicable.
Direct laboratory test work and integrated continuous pilot campaigns, including test planning, vendor or laboratory coordination, data analysis, interpretation of results, and definition of design inputs and scale-up criteria.
Apply process simulation and mass-balancing tools, including Aspen-based simulation and spreadsheet models, to evaluate process alternatives, utilities, reagents, recoveries, recycle streams, and operating performance.
Lead process contributions to concept, scoping, pre-feasibility, and feasibility studies, including process trade-off studies, technology selection, risk identification, capital and operating cost inputs, and technical report preparation.
Support project execution, equipment installation, commissioning, ramp-up, troubleshooting, and process optimization for new and existing facilities.
Identify and assess novel technologies and opportunities to apply existing technologies in innovative flowsheets, balancing technical maturity, operability, safety, environmental considerations, and economic value.
Act as a senior client interface by presenting findings, addressing technical concerns, communicating progress and decisions, and building trusted relationships with clients, laboratories, technology providers, vendors, and project partners.
Prepare and review technical proposals, scopes of work, study reports, design deliverables, technical papers, and presentations for client and professional audiences.
Mentor and coach process engineers and technical staff, promote sound engineering judgment, and strengthen consistent work practices, knowledge sharing, and quality review across project teams.
Work with project managers and discipline leaders to develop execution strategies, realistic work plans, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and risk mitigation actions for large or complex assignments.
Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities, supporting client engagement, developing repeat work, and positioning WSP capabilities in hydrometallurgy and critical-minerals processing.
Apply WSP administrative, financial, quality, safety, ethical, and professional conduct requirements in all project and field activities.

Core Technical Competencies

Hydrometallurgical flowsheet development and optimization from bench-scale testwork through pilot campaigns and commercial implementation.
Process design for leaching, solution purification, ion exchange, solvent extraction, precipitation, electrowinning, resin and carbon circuits, and membrane or nanofiltration applications.
Metallurgical accounting, mass and solution balances, process simulation, equipment sizing, and interpretation of laboratory and pilot data.
Critical- and base-minerals processing, with relevant experience in commodities such as lithium, uranium, vanadium, rare earth elements, copper, cobalt, and zinc.
Technology evaluation, process trade-off studies, scale-up, commissioning, operational troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
Technical leadership across study, engineering, execution, and commissioning phases, including multidisciplinary interface management.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, mineral processing, metallurgical engineering, mining engineering, or a closely related discipline.
More than 20 years of relevant process engineering and hydrometallurgical experience, including leadership of complex studies or execution assignments.
Demonstrated experience taking mineral processing projects from concept through feasibility and into execution, commissioning, or operations support.
Substantial experience planning, overseeing, and interpreting laboratory testwork and pilot-scale programs.
Strong scientific and analytical understanding of hydrometallurgy, process design, metallurgical balances, and process optimization.
Experience evaluating or developing technology and integrating novel or established technologies into practical flowsheets.
Proven ability to lead technical teams, plan work, manage schedules and quality, review deliverables, and communicate technical decisions clearly.
Established client-facing experience, including technical presentations, report writing, issue resolution, and relationship development.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, exercise mature technical judgment, and know when broader specialist or project leadership input is required.
Commitment to mentoring and developing engineers and technical staff and to working effectively with diverse, geographically distributed teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to prepare clear, defensible technical reports and proposals.
Commitment to workplace safety and ability to comply with WSP health, safety, drug and alcohol, harassment, ethics, and conduct requirements.
Ability to travel occasionally to laboratories, pilot facilities, client offices, and project sites, including remote locations, and to work schedules suited to project requirements.
Must successfully complete and pass WSP motor vehicle screening where driving is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional registration or active membership in a recognized mining, metallurgy, chemical engineering, or process engineering professional organization.
Demonstrated technical standing through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, short-course instruction, professional committees, or industry awards.
Experience collaborating with leading hydrometallurgical laboratories, consultants, technology providers, and operating companies across international projects.
Experience in consulting, proposal development, client account growth, and supporting the development of new or repeat work.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

Notice To Third Party Agencies

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. jobs.title: SAP NS2 Director, Cloud Infrastructure & DevSecOps
jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Company Description

SAP is the global market leader for business software and related services, and SAP National Security Services Inc.® (SAP NS2®) is an independent U.S. subsidiary, offering SAP solutions with specialized levels of security and support to meet the requirements of U.S. national security and critical infrastructure customers.

This position requires access to customer data; Must be a U.S. citizen.

SAP NS2 does not offer Visa sponsorships for this role. All internals must have manager’s approval to transfer.

Role Overview

SAP NS2 is seeking an accomplished Director, DevOps & Cloud Platform Engineering to lead the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of our secure cloud infrastructure and automation capabilities. This leader will own a critical function responsible for enabling highly available, scalable, compliant, and automation-driven cloud environments that support SAP products and services across a diverse customer base, including local, state, and federal government agencies, as well as private sector organizations supporting government-related missions.

This role is designed for a seasoned technology leader with deep expertise in multi-cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevSecOps, site reliability practices, and secure operations at scale. The successful candidate will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for designing, building, and operating provider-agnostic infrastructure solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, while driving standardization, resilience, and continuous improvement across the platform lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines executive-level leadership, strong engineering judgment, operational discipline, and hands-on technical credibility. This individual will play a key role in advancing SAP NS2’s cloud maturity by scaling infrastructure automation, strengthening reliability and security practices, and ensuring mission-critical environments meet demanding performance, compliance, and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing DevOps and cloud platform engineering organization, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Define and execute the strategic roadmap for cloud infrastructure, platform automation, operational maturity, and engineering standardization across a multi-cloud ecosystem.
Serve as the senior technical and people leader for infrastructure engineering, balancing long-term platform strategy with near-term operational execution.
Oversee the architecture, deployment, and lifecycle management of secure, scalable, resilient infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with a strong emphasis on Terraform, reusable modules, policy-driven automation, and platform consistency.
Drive the design and operational governance of provider-agnostic infrastructure patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP to support secure, repeatable, and compliant deployments.
Lead the evolution of configuration management and post-provisioning automation practices using Ansible and related tooling to support customer environments at scale.
Establish and enforce engineering best practices for GitLab-based source control, branching strategy, peer review, release governance, CI/CD, and change management across multiple repositories and teams.
Provide leadership for the deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of containerized and orchestrated platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes, with a focus on reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security.
Partner closely with product engineering, security, compliance, architecture, operations, and customer-facing teams to deliver infrastructure solutions aligned with business priorities, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements.
Champion DevSecOps and security-by-design principles, ensuring security, governance, and compliance controls are embedded into infrastructure architecture, automation pipelines, and operational processes.
Drive operational excellence through mature incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, service restoration, and post-incident improvement practices.
Provide executive oversight for troubleshooting and resolving complex infrastructure, platform, networking, and connectivity issues across hosted and customer-connected environments.
Ensure robust observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and telemetry capabilities are implemented and continuously improved across a multi-tenant, multi-cloud environment.
Lead efforts to improve service reliability, platform resilience, disaster recovery readiness, and operational performance for mission-critical workloads.
Oversee the development and maintenance of high-quality technical documentation, architecture artifacts, standard operating procedures, governance materials, knowledge base content, and technical advisories.
Identify and responsibly implement opportunities to leverage generative AI and intelligent automation to improve engineering productivity, consistency, speed, and operational effectiveness within approved security and compliance boundaries.
Manage organizational priorities, staffing, delivery planning, cross-functional dependencies, and execution risk to ensure successful delivery of both strategic initiatives and day-to-day operational commitments.

Knowledge and Skills

Proven leadership experience managing DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE teams in complex enterprise or regulated environments.
Deep expertise in AWS foundational and advanced services, including EC2, S3, IAM, Route 53, VPC, and related networking, security, and automation capabilities.
Deep expertise in Azure foundational services, including Virtual Networks, Application Gateway, Storage Accounts, Virtual Machines, Load Balancer, and Resource Groups.
Strong expertise in GCP foundational services, including Projects, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, and VPC.
Expert-level proficiency in Terraform, including module architecture, reusable design patterns, state management, policy integration, and multi-cloud deployment strategies.
Strong experience leading CI/CD transformation and infrastructure automation maturity across engineering organizations.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, and related tooling.
Experience with RBAC, identity provisioning, secrets management, and access governance, including integration with enterprise identity and security controls.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, SRE principles, and service reliability practices, including SLAs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational metrics.
Strong investigative and troubleshooting capabilities across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, Linux platforms, and network configurations.
Experience with observability, centralized logging, telemetry, and log processing in cloud-native and hybrid environments.
Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals, including IP routing, subnetting, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Strong Linux systems expertise, including deployment, hardening, performance tuning, patching, and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with enterprise workflow and service management platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and communicate effectively across executive, technical, operational, and customer stakeholder groups.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, or related technical disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams in a DevOps, infrastructure, cloud engineering, or platform operations environment.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, CI/CD platforms, Vault, Kubernetes, Docker, and identity/access management solutions.
Strong experience administering and securing Unix/Linux systems in enterprise or cloud environments.
Strong experience with networking, distributed systems, and cloud operations in highly available production environments.
Demonstrated success leading teams responsible for secure, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading teams responsible for large-scale, distributed, multi-cloud platforms supporting mission-critical workloads.
Demonstrated success building and scaling infrastructure automation and platform engineering programs in regulated, compliance-driven, or security-sensitive environments.
Experience supporting government, national security, defense, or critical infrastructure customers.
Strong background in incident command, operational excellence, service reliability, and continuous service improvement.
Experience implementing DevSecOps controls, compliance automation, and policy-as-code in cloud environments.
Ability to operate effectively as both a strategic leader and a technically credible engineering partner.
Proven track record of driving standardization, automation, resilience, and engineering maturity across infrastructure operations.
Strong problem-solving ability, sound judgment, and a high degree of ownership, accountability, and execution focus.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. jobs.title: VP of Engineering- San Francisco HQ
jobs.description:
About Orb

We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence.

Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar.

For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. For remote roles, we ask you to join us in person 1x per quarter. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do.

About The Role

This is a rare moment to lead engineering at Orb. As part of Adyen, we're taking Orb toward a massive revenue line, with Adyen's global sales org behind our distribution. You get the ambition and reach of a platform business, plus the scrappiness, ownership, and speed of an early-stage team.

You'll lead a ~30 person engineering team building infrastructure where correctness and scale aren't nice-to-haves. They're the product. Billing is unforgiving: every number has to be right, in real time, at volume. We're looking for a leader who's energized by the monetization and billing domain. Someone who wants to build the technical and process foundations for the next phase of growth, and who's ready to roll up their sleeves to do it.

In This Role You Will

Coach and grow our engineering managers and senior ICs via hands-on mentorship, clear growth paths, and real career development for the people building Orb.
Build our engineering leadership bench and own talent and retention strategy as the team grows and expands to multiple offices.
Set and clearly articulate technical strategy by holding your own in deep technical conversations, and raising the bar on how we design systems for correctness and scale.
Partner cross-functionally with GTM and our VP of Product to shape product, competitive, and monetization strategy.
Establish the technical and process foundations for Orb's next stage of growth: lightweight, high-leverage, and built to scale without slowing the team down.

About You

10+ years in engineering with several years leading engineering organizations, ideally at infrastructure, platform, or developer-tools companies.
Infra- or platform-heavy technical background, with real depth in distributed systems, data, and designing for correctness and scale.
You've scaled teams and systems through meaningful growth and you're excited to re-calibrate into scrappy, early-stage mode rather than run a heavy process.
Genuinely leaned into billing and monetization. Usage-based pricing and revenue infrastructure is a domain you find interesting and want to go deep on — this is central to the role.
A proven people leader who has coached managers, developed senior ICs, and built durable leadership benches, ideally across multiple offices.
A strong cross-functional partner who works naturally with product and go-to-market to turn technical strategy into business results.
Bias toward lightweight, high-leverage processes; you’ll build foundations that scale without bureaucracy.
Some domestic and international travel required.

Orb’s Tech Stack

At Orb, we believe great engineers can learn any stack, so you do not need experience with these specific tools, and we encourage you to apply regardless.

Frontend: Typescript + React + Tailwind CSS
Backend: Python
Datastores: PostgreSQL + Apache Druid+ Clickhouse
Streaming Platforms: Kafka + Spark Streaming
Cloud Platform: AWS

Benefits

Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance
One Medical membership
Unlimited PTO plus an additional week off between Christmas and New Year’s
401k plan
16-week paid parental leave with equity vesting
Commuter stipend
Catered lunches in the office
Annual learning & development stipend
Meaningful equity in the form of stock options

Equal Opportunity Employer

We work with each other day in and day out, and strongly believe that building a diverse and inclusive team is key to our long-term goals and success as a company. jobs.title: Vice President of Utility Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Build Something That Lasts

Utility Solutions Group is an established underground utility contractor specializing in directional drilling, jack-and-bore, civil excavation, and fiber optic infrastructure throughout the Southeast. With approximately 60 employees and a reputation for executing complex underground utility projects, we are entering the next phase of our company's growth.

As we execute our strategic expansion into electric utility, natural gas, municipal infrastructure, and transportation markets, we are seeking an experienced executive to lead this initiative. This is a unique opportunity for a proven industry leader to build and lead a new business division with the full backing of an established contractor that already possesses the people, equipment, financial resources, and field expertise to execute complex underground infrastructure projects.

This is not a traditional business development position. We are looking for a builder—someone with the vision, relationships, and operational expertise to establish the company as a premier utility infrastructure contractor throughout the Southeast.

The Opportunity

The Vice President of Utility Infrastructure will be responsible for developing and executing the strategic growth plan into municipal, electric utility, natural gas, and transportation infrastructure markets.

The successful candidate will bring an established network of owners, municipalities, electric and natural gas utilities, state Departments of Transportation, engineering firms, EPC contractors, and industry decision-makers. Their relationships should generate opportunities across municipal utility construction, electric utility infrastructure, natural gas distribution, cathodic protection systems, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and other underground utility infrastructure projects.

This executive will identify opportunities, estimate and pursue projects, recruit and build operational teams, and work directly with executive leadership to establish a new division capable of delivering complex underground infrastructure projects throughout the Southeast.

This role offers a rare opportunity to build something meaningful with the support of an entrepreneurial ownership team committed to long-term investment, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop and execute the Company's strategic growth plan for municipal, electric utility, natural gas, cathodic protection, and transportation infrastructure markets.
Leverage an existing network of industry relationships to generate qualified project opportunities.
Identify, pursue, estimate, and help secure profitable utility infrastructure projects.
Lead proposal development, estimating, contract negotiations, and strategic pursuits.
Develop and strengthen relationships with municipalities, electric and natural gas utilities, state Departments of Transportation, engineering firms, EPC contractors, and private developers to expand the Company's presence across underground utility, cathodic protection, and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) markets.
Help recruit, mentor, and build the project management, estimating, field supervision, and craft workforce necessary to support a growing utility infrastructure division.
Advise executive leadership on staffing, equipment, operational systems, safety programs, and investments required to successfully scale the division.
Represent the Company at industry conferences, association meetings, trade organizations, and networking events while strengthening the company's reputation throughout the utility industry.
Establish long-term client relationships that generate recurring revenue and sustainable growth.

Qualifications

Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience within utility infrastructure construction.
Demonstrated success developing business within municipal, electric utility, natural gas, transportation, or underground civil construction markets.
Existing, well-established relationships with municipalities, utility owners, Departments of Transportation, engineering firms, EPC contractors, developers, and other industry decision-makers.
Proven experience preparing estimates, responding to public and private solicitations, negotiating contracts, and winning profitable work.
Strong understanding of underground utility construction means and methods.
Experience helping build and lead operational teams—not simply generating opportunities.

About Graphcore

Graphcore is a global leader in artificial intelligence computing systems. We design advanced semiconductors and data center hardware that deliver the specialized processing power needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore belongs to a family of companies developing some of the world's most transformative technologies. Our AI Engineering Campus in Austin plays an important role in building the future of AI computing.

The Opportunity

As Technical Services Director, you will lead the teams that operate and evolve Graphcore's engineering labs, high-performance computing (HPC) platforms, and data center environments globally. You will be accountable for reliable, secure, cost-effective infrastructure that supports demanding engineering, AI, silicon-development, and validation workloads.

This role combines people leadership, infrastructure strategy, operational excellence, capacity and financial planning, procurement, and program delivery. You will partner with Engineering, Information Technology, Security, Finance, Facilities, Supply Chain, customers, and external suppliers. The position is based onsite in Austin and requires travel to company facilities, data centers, and supplier locations, including international travel.

What You'll Do

Lead, recruit, mentor, and develop the systems administration, lab operations, and technical services teams responsible for the facility supporting global Engineering and Research and Development.
Own the reliability, efficiency, protection, safety, supportability, and continuous improvement of engineering labs, HPC systems, and infrastructure facilities.
Establish service levels, operating standards, escalation paths, performance measures, monitoring, observability, automation, ticketing, and configuration-management practices.
Translate engineering and customer requirements into infrastructure roadmaps, capacity plans, procurement strategies, operating models, and executable investment programs.
Forecast compute, accelerator, storage, network, rack-space, power, cooling, and technical-support requirements across the infrastructure portfolio.
Lead global infrastructure programs from requirements and business-case development through procurement, deployment, operational readiness, service handoff, expansion, refresh, and decommissioning.
Own infrastructure procurement and supplier performance, including specifications, bills of materials, quotations, commercial negotiations, purchase orders, logistics, delivery schedules, and deployment coordination.
Develop and lead operating budgets, capital plans, expense frameworks, projections, lifecycle plans, and investment proposals for infrastructure operations and growth.
Build strategic relationships with hardware vendors, colocation providers, integrators, maintenance partners, and other technical service suppliers.
Ensure HPC environments are efficiently utilized, maintained, and capable of supporting large-scale engineering, AI, simulation, and hardware-validation workloads.
Maintain appropriate security, safety, operational, and compliance controls; support reviews involving frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC/SSAE, and PCI DSS where applicable.
Engage internal and external customers on infrastructure capabilities, requirements, service delivery, resilience, security, and compliance.
Provide concise executive reporting on infrastructure health, capacity, risks, budgets, supplier performance, service quality, and coordination of programs.

What You'll Bring

Significant leadership experience in global technical infrastructure, engineering labs, systems engineering, HPC, Information Technology operations, or data center services.
Proven success leading and developing geographically distributed technical teams, including managers and senior individual contributors.
Deep knowledge of HPC and data center environments, including server architecture, Linux-based systems, accelerators, high-speed interconnects, parallel storage, cluster management, workload scheduling, and monitoring.
Experience supporting semiconductor development, silicon bring-up, hardware validation, systems engineering, or similarly complex engineering environments.
A record of developing and executing multi-site infrastructure strategy, capacity plans, lifecycle programs, and operating models aligned with engineering and business priorities.
Experience operating business-critical compute and lab infrastructure with clear expectations for availability, performance, security, safety, and support.
Experience leading complex cross-functional programs involving Engineering, Facilities, Information Technology, Finance, Security, Supply Chain, and third-party vendors.
Strong procurement and commercial experience, including requirements, supplier evaluation, contract negotiation, purchase-order processes, logistics, and delivery management.
Experience developing global budgets, cost models, forecasts, investment proposals, and lifecycle plans for technical infrastructure.
Working knowledge of rack integration, structured cabling, power, cooling, physical security, capacity management, operational controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.
Strong strategic, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and explain complex issues to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Ability and willingness to work onsite in Austin and travel internationally as required.
A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing, deploying, or operating large-scale HPC clusters or supercomputing platforms.
Knowledge of GPU-accelerated computing, AI infrastructure, and NVIDIA reference architectures.
Experience with cluster schedulers, high-performance storage, high-speed networking, and infrastructure automation technologies.
Experience developing a global lab strategy or managing lab and data center operations across multiple countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, or India.
Experience operating colocation facilities and managing third-party data center providers.
Knowledge of data center power distribution, cooling systems, environmental monitoring, and capacity engineering.
ITIL, program-management, or project-management certification, or equivalent practical experience implementing service-management and delivery frameworks.
Experience with Visio, Bluebeam, AutoCAD, or other infrastructure design and drafting tools.

At Invitation Homes, our associates are the foundation of our success. We connect your work to real impact, invest in your growth, and welcome you to feel at home — because care isn't just something we say, it's something you experience.

Invitation Homes owns and operates homes in great neighborhoods across 16 top U.S. markets. We continue to innovate with smart home technology, an industry-leading maintenance app, and other lifestyle-enhancing services that make leasing easier than owning.

Our market teams — Leasing, Property Management, and Rehab, Turns & Maintenance — work together to deliver excellent resident experiences and maintain high-quality homes. Every associate plays a meaningful role in that mission.

Job Summary

The Director of Technology Delivery will partner with product and engineering to lead programs, projects, initiatives, and maintenance (BAU/KLO) delivery efforts for the assigned area(s). The director be responsible for implementing methodologies and processes, improving methodologies and processes, resource allocation, capitalization, agile reporting, staffing and maintaining a team of delivery resources (FTE and contingent labor), status reporting, program reporting, risk and issue management, delivery planning, agile coaching and maturation, supporting governance processes, and holistic enterprise delivery management as assigned. This role will regularly work with senior Technology leadership, Architects, Engineering leads, QA leads, Product Owners, Product Managers, the PMO, business stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

Invitation Homes does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities

Staff, manage, lead, grow, and mentor project managers, project managers, and agile leads.
SupportLead the implementation, enforcement, and continuous improvement of processes including but not limited to Scrum, Kanban, hybrid/custom, technology governance, enterprise governance, security, and shared services.
SupportOversee the implementation, enforcement, and continuous improvement of department tools including but not limited to QuickBase, Jira, and Confluence
Collaborate with Technology and Business Leadership on initiative priority, process changes, and delivery execution
Support and enforce Technology and Enterprise governance processes including intake, value/work ratings, discussion facilitation, recommendations, and communication of decisions
Drive the delivery of programs, projects and maintenance efforts in partnership with engineering and product leadership
Ensure that work is appropriately planned, managed, and tracked including, risk and issue identification, mitigation plan development, dependencies identified and tracked etc.
Anticipate and proactively mitigate risks, issues, conflicts and constraints
Pragmatically escalate issues to leadership for awareness, support, and/or action
Proactively and continuously review strategy, approaches, and plans to ensure alignment with company goals and needs; balance support for short term needs with long term strategic objectives
Analyze problems and make recommendations for improvements, including identifying and evaluating opportunities for growth, reduce operating expenses, and improve performance
Measure and analyze performance of assigned teams using appropriate tools and techniques; use the data to work with senior leadership to adjust training plans, team structures, and other areas for improvement
Establish, maintain, and manage relationships with Technology leads, stakeholders and vendors
SupportLead quarterly planning processes and meetings including preparation and meeting facilitation
Support contract management and negotiation as requested
Maintain project and financial data for effective and efficient reporting and internal audit compliance
Other works as assigned

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s Degree or related experience.
Minimum 3+ years in non-project management experience – BA, Product, engineering, testing, etc.
Minimum 8+ years’ relevant project management or agile lead experience, or equivalent experience, required.

Skills/Specialized Knowledge

Proven judgment and ability to manage multiple teams and a portfolio of work
Solid understanding of project management and agile methodologies, with the ability to teach and coach others
Keen ability to engage and lead delivery teams
Strong interpersonal, conflict management, and communication skills
Ability to influence peers and leadership to drive delivery and enforce process compliance
Effective documentation and reporting skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office
Prefer experience with QuickBase (low code platform), Jira, Confluence, and/or popular PPM platforms (Asana, Monday.com, Planview, Smartsheet, etc.)

Required Licenses or Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) / PRINCE II certification is a plus
Agile training and certifications (PSM, CSM, CPO, SAFe, etc.) are a plus

Other Requirements

Must maintain professional appearance.
Ability to be at work on a regular and consistent basis; Overtime may be required for this position.

Physical and Mental Demands

This position will spend long hours sitting and using office equipment and computers. The position may also entail light lifting of supplies and materials occasionally, up to and including 20 pounds in addition to reaching, stooping, standing, and walking. This position requires the ability to talk, hear, compare, compute, compile, copy, analyze, coordinate, synthesize, negotiate and communicate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Work Environment

Standard office working environment that may be busy and noisy at times.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is: $127,200.00 - $220,480.00, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws.

Compensation And Benefits

To attract and retain top talent, we're pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits, including:

Annual bonus program
Health, dental, vision, and life insurance
Long-term and short-term disability insurance
Generous paid time off plans include vacation accrual, sick time, standard holidays and floating holidays
401(k) with company matching contributions
Awesome work environment with casual dress
Team events and gatherings (Pre- and Post-Covid)

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Director Of Engineering, Maintenance & Reliability Location:
Memphis, TN Department:
Operations Reports To:
CEO / COO

Position Summary

Vanguard Soap is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Engineering, Maintenance & Reliability to lead the engineering, maintenance, and asset reliability functions across our industrial operations. This leader owns the performance, uptime, and longevity of the plant's equipment and facility infrastructure - maximizing asset reliability, minimizing unplanned downtime, and ensuring production capacity scales with rapid growth.

The role pairs deep reliability and process engineering expertise with strong maintenance leadership and disciplined capital project execution. The ideal candidate is a builder who can mature a reactive maintenance environment into a proactive, reliability-centered operation - implementing modern preventive and predictive maintenance systems, leading capital and automation projects, and developing a high-performing team of engineers, technicians, and planners.

Vanguard's manufacturing campus spans 14 acres and produces 40-50 million pounds of product annually with a team of more than 100 employees.

Key Responsibilities

ASSET RELIABILITY & MAINTENANCE EXCELLENCE

Build and lead a world-class maintenance organization spanning preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance across all production lines.
Implement and optimize a CMMS to drive PM compliance, work-order discipline, and data-driven maintenance decisions.
Establish reliability programs - Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA), and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) - to eliminate recurring failures and chronic downtime.
Drive measurable improvement in core reliability metrics, including OEE, MTBF, MTTR, and unplanned downtime.
Own MRO and critical-spares strategy to balance equipment availability against inventory cost.

ENGINEERING & CAPITAL PROJECTS

Lead process, project, and facilities engineering across all production lines and plant utilities.
Own the full capital project lifecycle: justification, design, procurement, installation, commissioning, and startup.
Evaluate and deploy automation, new equipment, and technology to expand capacity, efficiency, and reliability.
Manage equipment specification, vendor selection, and contractor execution for plant and facility projects.
Maintain facility infrastructure, utilities, and building systems to support safe, reliable operations.

CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & OPERATIONAL PERFORMANCE

Partner with Operations to improve line efficiency, throughput, and asset utilization.
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and TPM methodologies to reduce downtime, waste, and defects at the source.
Develop engineering and maintenance standards, SOPs, and documentation to ensure repeatability.
Use data and dashboards to prioritize improvement work and demonstrate ROI on reliability investments.

SAFETY, ENVIRONMENTAL & COMPLIANCE

Champion a zero-incident safety culture across all engineering and maintenance activities.
Ensure equipment and facility compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable environmental regulations.
Own critical safety systems, including lockout/tagout, machine guarding, and contractor safety.
Lead risk assessments, audits, and incident investigations with a prevention-first focus.
Support GMP and FDA compliance for equipment, utilities, and facility infrastructure.

LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT

Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers, maintenance technicians, planners, and supervisors.
Build organizational capability and bench strength to scale with company growth.
Own the engineering and maintenance budget, balancing cost, reliability, and capital priorities.
Serve as a key member of the operations leadership team and contribute to overall business strategy.
Drive accountability, performance management, and a culture of ownership.

Key Capabilities

Reliability Leadership: Proven ability to mature maintenance from reactive to predictive and reliability centered.
Engineering & Technical Acumen: Strong process, mechanical, and project engineering expertise.
Capital Project Execution: Track record delivering capital and automation projects on time and on budget.
Maintenance Systems: Hands-on CMMS implementation and data-driven maintenance management.
Continuous Improvement: Deep Lean, Six Sigma, and TPM expertise applied to asset performance.
People Leadership: Ability to attract, develop, and retain high-performing technical teams.
Business Acumen: Connects reliability and capital decisions to cost, capacity, and P&L impact.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive engineering, maintenance, and/or reliability leadership in manufacturing.
Prior experience as Director or Manager of Engineering, Maintenance, Reliability, or Plant Engineering.
Demonstrated success implementing preventive/predictive maintenance and reliability programs.
Hands-on experience with CMMS platforms and reliability metrics (OEE, MTBF, MTTR).
Track record leading capital projects, automation, and equipment installations.
Experience in personal care, chemical, CPG, food, or contract manufacturing strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, or Electrical) required.
Preferred: Advanced degree (MBA or Master's in Engineering) and/or CMRP certification.

Additional Requirements

Strong knowledge of GMP, FDA, OSHA, and environmental regulatory standards.
Experience supporting multi-shift maintenance coverage in a high-volume production environment.
Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, high-growth environment.

Block Engineering is an award-winning developer of quantum cascade lasers and chemical detection systems used in research, industrial, semiconductor, life sciences, and safety/security applications. The company is located in Southborough, Massachusetts (greater Boston metro area).

Block Engineering is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead our software development efforts. We are seeking a hands-on manager who can individually contribute to software coding and development while also leading the design and architecture of our code, as well as the management of other contributors.

All software development will involve embedded C/C++ and Python. Our target environments are Linux, ARM-based systems and other embedded devices.

The position is hybrid, with four days/week on-site at the Block Engineering HQ in Southborough, MA.

Responsibilities will include:

Coding/Development: Hands-on development of software applications using C and C++ in an embedded environment.
Lead the company’s integration of AI development tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.
Manage code infrastructure and documentation on services such as GitHub and Jira.
Ensure on-time delivery of projects including design documents, reference materials and tests.
Work with a multidisciplinary team to design, build, and test new solutions to meet customer requirements. Manage coding efforts of all contributors.
Ensure consistency of your code and input from those teams you integrate with. Design, write, debug, document, test and release software used for hardware control, algorithms, communication, etc.

The ideal candidate will have the following qualifications:

Proficiency in C, C++, and Python, including experience in embedded Linux environments.
BS degree or higher in Computer Science/Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
At least five years of experience as a lead contributor or manager of a development team.
Experience using AI tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.
Capacity to develop build and delivery infrastructure (GitHub Actions, Docker, etc.)
Any of the following would also be beneficial: experience with FPGA programming (VHDL/Verilog), algorithm optimization, and/or analytical instruments.
Ability to work successfully with people at all levels of the organization and within all functional areas. Excellent listening, written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, ASIC Design Engineering
jobs.description:
At Cornelis we’re building the future of AI and HPC networking with an AI-first approach to silicon and software development. We’re seeking engineers who are energized by working on cutting-edge ASIC design and distributed software systems, and who are motivated to push the boundaries on how AI can transform everything from chip architecture to system performance at scale.

Cornelis Networks delivers the world’s highest performance scale-out networking solutions for AI and HPC datacenters. Our differentiated architecture seamlessly integrates hardware, software and system level technologies to maximize the efficiency of GPU, CPU and accelerator-based compute clusters at any scale. Our solutions drive breakthroughs in AI & HPC workloads, empowering our customers to push the boundaries of innovation. Backed by top-tier venture capital and strategic investors, we are committed to innovation, performance and scalability - solving the world’s most demanding computational challenges with our next-generation networking solutions.

We are a fast-growing, forward-thinking team of architects, engineers, and business professionals with a proven track record of building successful products and companies. As a global organization, our team spans multiple U.S. states and six countries, and we continue to expand with exceptional talent in onsite, hybrid, and fully remote roles.

Cornelis Networks is looking for a Senior ASIC Design Engineering Manager to lead and grow our RTL design engineering team. Reporting to the VP of ASIC Engineering, with direct exposure to executive leadership, this leader will manage a team of talented design engineers and drive full-lifecycle development of Cornelis’ next-generation, high-performance networking ASICs. The role is accountable for building and driving RTL implementation schedules across all SoC subsystems and full-chip milestones. Success requires deep hands-on expertise in advanced RTL design implementation, methodologies, and SoC flows, from microarchitecture definition through RTL delivery, tape-out readiness, and cross-functional execution with Architecture, Design Verification, Emulation, and Physical Design. This leader will also own headcount planning, hiring, and organizational strategy to build a nimble, efficient, world-class design team. Exposure to AI-based design flows and methodology is preferred.

This role is intended for a senior engineering leader who can combine hands-on ASIC RTL design expertise with disciplined program execution, cross-functional coordination, and team building at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Own ASIC RTL delivery schedules across major milestones by tracking, monitoring, and reporting progress against committed plans.
Utilize data-driven insights to predict schedule risks and proactively reallocate human resources to keep the project on track.
Align RTL delivery schedules with DV and emulation enablement and manage feedback loops and dependencies efficiently.
Facilitate physical design handoffs by ensuring design teams provide high-quality RTL and constraints that minimize timing-closure iterations. Track physical design feedback and delivery schedules to support physical design signoff and tape-out milestones.
Lead long-term headcount planning and organizational design for the ASIC department. Identify skill gaps and execute global talent acquisition strategies that support the product roadmap.

Minimum Qualifications

15+ years in the semiconductor industry, preferably in high performance designs on advanced technology nodes, with at least 5 years in people management
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Deep understanding of the interaction between Design, Verification, Emulation, and Physical Design teams. You must know "how the work gets done" to manage the people doing it.
Proven ability to lead large engineering organizations through multiple full-cycle ASIC product launches in a remote environment. Ability to coordinate across multiple projects, manage risks and escalations, and work under tight schedules and budget constraints.
Strong technical expertise in microarchitecture development, RTL coding (Verilog/System Verilog), synthesis, STA/timing closure, physical design, and verification methodologies.
Exposure to one or more industry standards/protocol stacks such as PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, UALink.
Demonstrated ability to optimize designs for PPA (power, performance, area) and to integrate major subsystems (interconnect, I/O, memory).

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to AI based design implementation and verification flows, scripting for automation, milestone tracking and flow integration
Experience building globally distributed ASIC design teams and scaling engineering practices in a remote environment.

Location
: This is a remote position for employees residing within the United States.

We offer a competitive compensation package that includes equity, cash, and incentives, along with health and retirement benefits. Our dynamic, flexible work environment provides the opportunity to collaborate with some of the most influential names in the semiconductor industry.

At Cornelis Networks your base salary is only one component of your comprehensive total rewards package. Your base pay will be determined by factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience, and location relative to the hiring range for the position. Depending on your role, you may also be eligible for performance-based incentives, including an annual bonus or sales incentives.

In addition to your base pay, you’ll have access to a broad range of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as disability and life insurance, a dependent care flexible spending account, accidental injury insurance, and pet insurance. We also offer generous paid holidays, 401(k) with company match, and Open Time Off (OTO) for regular full-time exempt employees. Other paid time off benefits include sick time, bonding leave, and pregnancy disability leave.

Cornelis Networks does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. Cornelis Networks is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Customer Experience Engineering team at Robinhood sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real human impact. We build the systems that power how millions of customers get support — from intelligent chatbot deflection and ticketing tools to a first-of-its-kind private wealth product called Concierge, designed for high-net-worth customers. Our team of engineers spans iOS, Android, web, backend, and LLM/AI specializations, working closely with dedicated product managers and data scientists to ship products that set a new bar in the fintech space. We move fast, we iterate, and we take quality seriously.

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Agent Experience, you'll own the engineering execution of one of Robinhood's most ambitious and high-visibility zero-to-one products. You'll lead a team of engineers building premium, AI-powered features — natively within the Robinhood app for our highest-value customers. This role requires a leader who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, aligning closely with product leadership, and delivering reliably in a fast-moving environment with executive visibility. You'll be a key voice in shaping both the technical direction and the culture of this team!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team of ~15, owning hiring, performance, and career development across the full stack (iOS, Android, web, backend, and LLM/AI)
Partner closely with product managers and data scientists to define and execute the Concierge product roadmap, from initial scoping through launch
Drive delivery of complex, zero-to-one product features — including AI-powered financial planning tooling
Navigate ambiguity and product direction changes with clarity and composure, maintaining team focus and momentum through shifting priorities
Represent the engineering team in executive-level discussions, communicating progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership and the C-suite
Establish proactive quality measures, reliability standards, and engineering best practices suited to a high-risk, customer-facing product
Champion a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement within your team

What You Bring

8+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in an engineering management role leading teams of 10 or more
Demonstrated track record leading user-facing product development, ideally in consumer fintech, wealth management, or a high-stakes customer experience domain
Experience building or scaling zero-to-one products, including navigating high ambiguity and frequent direction changes
Strong cross-functional partnership skills — you've worked closely with product managers to define roadmaps and translated business goals into clear engineering plans
Comfort presenting to and engaging with senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders, including managing expectations in high-visibility settings
Proven ability to build and maintain service reliability standards and proactive quality practices on consumer-grade systems
Familiarity with LLM/AI systems, or experience working alongside teams building AI-powered features
Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with the ability to create clarity from complexity

Nice To Have

Experience in regulated financial products or familiarity with wealth management offerings (tax, estate planning, etc.)
Background in both platform/infrastructure and product engineering, enabling strong technical breadth across the stack
Experience supporting a team through organizational transitions or leadership changes

Leadership Expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here's what we expect from them:

Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, dedication, and technology.

Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.

Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What We Offer

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

jobs.title: Director, Network Infrastructure and Planning
jobs.description:
At Alaska Communications, we’re committed to putting our team first
, always being customer focused
, having a can-do attitude
, owning our results
and always acting with integrity
. This is what we hire for and what our team members exhibit each day. Want to make an impact with us?

We are unable to support remote international applicants or routinely sponsor work visas.

The Compensation Range For This Job Is

$130,725.00 - $178,707.00

Position Summary

Directs and manages the teams and programs responsible for planning, engineering, design, records accuracy, and lifecycle stewardship of network infrastructure supporting the ACS network. This role has complete ownership and accountability for Layer 1 infrastructure planning and design, including outside plant facilities, inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, fiber routes, ducts, conduits, structures, DC power capacity, rack location and availability, capacity, records, and related construction engineering. The role is also accountable for coordinating end-to-end network infrastructure plans across Layer 2 and Layer 3 domains, in partnership with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and the Network Architects, to ensure physical infrastructure, transport, aggregation, routing, resiliency, and growth plans are aligned to business, customer, operational, and capital priorities.

The Director, Network Infrastructure & Planning translates business demand, network strategy, service delivery requirements, reliability objectives, and funded project commitments into actionable infrastructure plans, budget inputs, engineering priorities, and implementation readiness. The position emphasizes accountable ownership of Layer 1 outcomes while providing shared planning accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network evolution.

Essential Functions

Essential Functions Statement(s)

Owns end-to-end planning and design accountability for Layer 1 network infrastructure, including OSP fiber, copper where applicable, ducts, conduits, poles, handholes, manholes, facility routes, splice plans, capacity, and physical network records.
Owns planning and availability accountability for inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, including DC power capacity, rack location, rack availability, physical space readiness, and related facility dependencies needed to support network growth, resiliency, and implementation readiness.
Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure plans support network reliability, route diversity, resiliency, serviceability, maintainability, constructability, permitting readiness, and economic utilization of facilities.
Oversees analysis of available and existing facilities, route constraints, capacity exhaust, customer demand, traffic growth indicators, and funded project requirements to determine new construction, rearrangements, removals, or augmentation needs.
Develops, maintains, and improves sustainable facilities records processes with the goal of complete, accurate, timely, and electronically accessible network records.
Provides shared accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network planning with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and network architects, ensuring Layer 1 infrastructure plans are coordinated with transport, aggregation, routing, peering, resiliency, and capacity strategies.
Partners with IP Engineering leadership and architects to translate strategic network architecture into practical infrastructure needs, including site readiness, fiber availability, route diversity, physical path constraints, equipment location requirements, and capital planning inputs.
Facilitates decision-making and escalation when Layer 1 infrastructure constraints affect Layer 2 or Layer 3 design alternatives, schedule, budget, resiliency, or service delivery commitments.
Develops budgetary inputs, capital forecasts, and business case support for approved and proposed network infrastructure projects.

Position Qualifications

Competency Statement(s)

Leadership – Ability to influence others to perform their jobs effectively and to be responsible for making decisions.
Accountability - Ability to plan, organize, measure, and coordinate multiple tasks to deliver the budget for product line, revenue, and profit.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
The Director of Information Technology serves as both the strategic architect and hands-on technical leader of our IT organization. This individual will report to the Chief People Officer and will operate at every altitude — setting the technology vision and infrastructure roadmap at the executive level, then rolling up their sleeves to work alongside the team on critical systems.

The Director will lead major infrastructure initiatives, including ERP and Warehouse Management System (WMS) implementations, while directly leading, mentoring, and managing a team of systems administrators, database administrators, platform engineers, and help desk technicians. As lead architect, this person will design and maintain a synergistic technology stack — cloud, on-premise, and SaaS systems working together as one cohesive whole — while staying close enough to day-to-day operations to monitor, coach, and continually sharpen the team’s technical skills.

This role also owns the technical architecture connecting our growing family of digital storefronts and partner platforms — our direct-to-consumer site, our professional/B2B ordering platform, our Amazon Brand Store, and the various partner and education portals that support our professional network — ensuring inventory, orders, and customer data stay accurate and in sync across every channel we sell through.

This role is fully on-site and can report to either our Mesa, AZ or Burbank, CA facility.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Infrastructure & Platform Architecture
Serve as lead architect for the company’s entire technology stack, designing and maintaining a synergistic ecosystem of cloud, on-premise, and SaaS systems that work seamlessly together.
Lead major infrastructure and platform initiatives from evaluation through go-live, including ERP and Warehouse Management System (WMS) implementations, upgrades, and integrations.
Expertly manage the Microsoft 365 ecosystem and guide the ongoing transition from on-premise servers to cloud solutions such as OneDrive/SharePoint.
Oversee network security, data integrity, and disaster recovery planning across the organization.
Evaluate and enhance current IT systems and solutions, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement.
Architect and manage the use of AI to augment and support expansion in this technology while ensuring proper safeguards for data integrity and security (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others).

E-Commerce & Digital Channel Architecture
Own the technical architecture and performance of the company’s direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront and its separate professional/B2B ordering platform, ensuring both integrate cleanly with core ERP, inventory, and fulfillment systems rather than operating as disconnected silos.
Manage the technical relationship with outside e-commerce development agencies and platform vendors supporting our web properties, keeping security patching, platform upgrades, and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.
Architect toward a more unified customer and partner data model across our growing set of web properties — consumer storefront, professional ordering portal, account management, partner concierge program, partner benefits site, and professional education platform — reducing fragmentation and manual reconciliation between systems.
Own the systems and integrations supporting our Amazon Brand Store and other marketplace/authorized-retailer channels, including catalog, inventory, and order-fulfillment data flow back into core systems.
Partner with Legal and Marketing to support brand-protection and anti-diversion efforts, including tools or processes to monitor unauthorized third-party sellers and marketplace listings.
Maintain compliance with regulatory requirements in the markets our web storefronts are accessible, including CCPA, GDPR, ADA, and other applicable regulations.
Ensure uptime, scalability, and checkout performance across all digital storefronts during peak-demand periods such as product launches, promotions, and holiday sales.
Evaluate and integrate commerce and marketing technology — personalization tools, AI-driven product recommendation features, loyalty programs, and subscription platforms — to support direct-to-consumer growth.

Team Leadership & Development
Directly lead, manage, and mentor a team of systems administrators, database administrators, platform engineers, and help desk technicians.
Stay hands-on to monitor, coach, and elevate the team’s technical skills — not managing from a purely administrative distance.
Build and sustain a collaborative, egoless, growth-focused culture, providing hands-on coaching and career development for direct reports.
Set clear performance expectations and KPIs for the IT department, and establish monitoring practices to track both system performance and team output.
Serve as the organization’s go-to technology expert, ready to dive into hands-on troubleshooting when critical issues arise.

Strategy, Budget & Governance
Develop and implement IT strategies, roadmaps, and budgets aligned with short- and long-term business goals.
Own the organization’s technology roadmap end to end, supporting both internal and external (B2B and B2C) needs.
Collaborate with executive leadership and department leaders to identify and fulfill current and future technological needs.
Work cross-functionally with divisional heads to tailor technology roadmaps to their specific business needs.
Manage technology vendor relationships, purchasing, and contract negotiations.
Identify and champion technologies that elevate products, services, and operational efficiency; stay ahead of technology trends to propose innovative, cost-saving, or revenue-generating solutions.

Additional Responsibilities
Other duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field required; a master’s degree and/or related certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CISSP) highly preferred.
A minimum of ten years’ experience in IT, with at least five years in a managerial or team-leadership role.
Demonstrated success leading, growing, and mentoring a multidisciplinary IT team.
Proven experience serving as lead architect for an enterprise technology stack, with the ability to design and integrate systems so they work synergistically rather than in silos.
Hands-on experience leading major infrastructure or platform transformations, such as ERP and/or WMS implementations.
Strong technical depth across systems administration, databases, platform engineering, network engineering, and network security — comfortable working alongside the team, not just directing from above.
Direct experience architecting or managing e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and Magento including their integration with ERP and order management systems.
Comfort managing a distributed web ecosystem spanning multiple platforms, subdomains, and vendors, with an eye toward consolidating and simplifying over time.
Experience managing outside e-commerce development agencies or platform vendors.
Familiarity with brand-protection, MAP enforcement, or marketplace-monitoring tools and practices is a plus.
Experience in telecommunications, databases, and storage systems.
Strong proficiency in computer systems (Windows and Mac).
Exceptional communication, organizational, analytical, and managerial skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and related software.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Role Overview

As the Director of AgentExchange Security & Labs, you will serve as a strategic architect and operational lead for our global platform innovation program and driving ecosystem security. This is a high-impact Individual Contributor (IC) role designed for a visionary operator who excels at driving cross-functional alignment without direct reporting authority.

You will be responsible for guiding matrixed teams to own the end-to-end lifecycle of Labs solutions and Security Review operational processes—from identifying critical market gaps to scaling adoption across the Trailblazer ecosystem. Cross-Functional Influence: Build and maintain highly durable, collaborative partnerships across matrixed organizations, including Legal, Product Security, Marketing, Solution Engineering, and Trailblazer Community teams.

Security Review Program & Operations
