Escalation Management: Serve as the designated lead for high-priority partner security escalations, unblocking technical reviews and resolving critical vulnerabilities with executive stakeholders.
Commercial Fee Architecture: Own the business and operational strategy for the Security Review fee structure, balancing ecosystem growth with program cost-recovery objectives.
Ecosystem Security Guardrails: Partner deeply with Product Managers and Product Security to optimize the technical baseline, significantly reducing the cycle time for complex ISV and Labs solutions to clear the AgentExchange Security Review.

AI-Accelerated Program Architecture

AI Tooling & Automation Strategy: Architect and own the AgentExchange Security & Labs AI-tooling roadmap to automate highly repetitive operational processes and scale ecosystem programs.
Advanced Content Automation: Lead the strategy for leveraging generative AI to build "Content-in-a-Box" deployment kits (including demo scripts, technical blog posts, and enablement decks), maintaining strict brand voice while shortening go-to-market timelines.

Data-Driven Insights & Reporting

Executive Narratives: Synthesize complex data regarding program health—such as install rates, user reviews, security posture, failure reasons, and platform adoption—into compelling, executive-level health reports for senior leadership.
Data Synthesis at Scale: Direct the harmonization of large, disparate datasets into clear, actionable, executive-ready "sources of truth" dashboards.
Strategic Lifecycle Actions: Translate ecosystem telemetry into definitive operational recommendations, such as sunsetting underperforming solutions or doubling down on trending technical categories.

Ecosystem Engagement & Thought Leadership

Public Representation: Present as a trusted platform expert at major community events and conferences (e.g., Dreamforce, World Tours, Community Dreamin’ events), demonstrating the "Art of the Possible" using Labs solutions.
Demand Generation Strategy: Coordinate with Marketing teams to drive visibility, organic demand, and community engagement for high-impact Labs solutions via social channels and the Trailblazer network.

Required Experience & Qualifications

10+ Years of Leadership: Extensive experience in program management, technical product management, or GTM strategy within a high-growth SaaS enterprise.
Proven Influence Without Authority: Documented success leading massive, cross-functional matrixed initiatives and aligning executive stakeholders up to the SVP/EVP level without direct reports.
Security Program Experience: Strong background navigating complex software security reviews, managing high-stakes client/partner escalations, or designing program operational structures.
AI & Automation Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience embedding LLM/AI workflows into business operational workflows to compress cycle times or scale organizational output, backed by measurable lift metrics.
Salesforce Ecosystem Expertise: Deep architectural and conceptual familiarity with the Salesforce platform (Admin, Developer, and Architect personas), AgentExchange, and the Trailblazer ecosystem.
Preferred Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform Developer I, and Platform Developer II.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Cross-Functional Influence: Build and maintain highly durable, collaborative partnerships across matrixed organizations, including Legal, Product Security, Marketing, Solution Engineering, and Trailblazer Community teams.

Security Review Program & Operations

Escalation Management: Serve as the designated lead for high-priority partner security escalations, unblocking technical reviews and resolving critical vulnerabilities with executive stakeholders.
Commercial Fee Architecture: Own the business and operational strategy for the Security Review fee structure, balancing ecosystem growth with program cost-recovery objectives.
Ecosystem Security Guardrails: Partner deeply with Product Managers and Product Security to optimize the technical baseline, significantly reducing the cycle time for complex ISV and Labs solutions to clear the AgentExchange Security Review.

AI-Accelerated Program Architecture

AI Tooling & Automation Strategy: Architect and own the AgentExchange Security & Labs AI-tooling roadmap to automate highly repetitive operational processes and scale ecosystem programs.
Advanced Content Automation: Lead the strategy for leveraging generative AI to build "Content-in-a-Box" deployment kits (including demo scripts, technical blog posts, and enablement decks), maintaining strict brand voice while shortening go-to-market timelines.

jobs.description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

“I can influence my income.”

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options
Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love
Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as the Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform at Capital Group.”

The Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform owns the shared AI capabilities that power Capital Group’s suite of AI-enabled products for our Global Client teams. This role defines the Enablement Intelligence Platform — the reusable intelligence that turns Client data into scoring and coverage intelligence, meeting-prep context, follow-up and CRM-capture services, engagement signals, and the marketing orchestration, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation standards behind them — so every AI-enabled product builds on it. It is a business-facing product leadership role: you define business requirements, value, product architecture, builder experience, and priorities, and you partner with engineering, architecture, product management, and data science to build it safely, consistently, and at scale.

You own the platform, its shared capabilities, and the roadmap for a suite of AI client products and the sales & marketing experiences they power — products that help decide who to engage, how to prepare, and what to do next. Much of this capability is delivered through our multi-year program to transform Sales & Marketing Enablement experiences and products.

You will use Capital Group’s proprietary insights, client relationships, and enterprise data to create client enablement products that are differentiated and trusted. The role requires strong experience building AI-first products and platforms, practical fluency with Salesforce or enterprise CRM, Adobe Experience Cloud, and the ability to influence and align partners across a complex organization.

What you will build

The Enablement Intelligence Platform: the shared AI capabilities — scoring and coverage intelligence, meeting-prep context, follow-up and CRM-capture services, engagement signals, and the orchestration, retrieval, and guardrails behind them — that all AI-enabled products reuse.
A suite of AI products that help decide who to engage, how to prepare, and what to do next.
Reusable capabilities — including governed data and content services, orchestration patterns, model and workflow integrations, and builder-facing tools — that compound across products, channels, and client segments.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

AI Platform & Product Leadership

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Client Enablement Intelligence Platform and the AI seller-assist products and sales experiences it powers.
Provide the shared AI capabilities as governed, reusable services rather than one-off features rebuilt in each product.
Define the product architecture for the platform, including orchestration patterns, reusable AI services, governed data and content services, model and workflow integrations, and the builder experience required for teams to build safely and consistently.
Sequence the platform-first mandate: establish the core capabilities first, then the sales experiences built on them.
Determine where automation, agents, and human judgment should combine to create the greatest value, and set standards for how AI experiences behave across products.
Translate AI opportunities into practical product use cases, experiments, evaluation criteria, launch plans, monitoring routines, and measurable outcomes.
Make informed trade-offs across business value, user needs, platform investment, delivery capacity, AI opportunity, and operational risk when setting priorities.

Product Management & Delivery

Align with business partners on the outcomes that matter and translate them into clear product direction, requirements, and measurable results.
Lead discovery, experimentation, and validation so the team builds the right capabilities before committing to build.
Author clear product requirements that map pain-points to platform features and workflows, and keep data flowing cleanly across products so sellers get one unified experience.
Own launch readiness, adoption, training, and communications, and measure success in Capital Group terms — meeting-prep time saved, engagement quality, coverage, and adoption across teams.
Establish success measures for platform health, builder adoption, AI adoption, experience quality, and business performance, using those insights to inform roadmap decisions and continuous improvement.
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance so client-data use and generative content strictly align with financial-services requirements.

People & Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with the Insights, Analytics, and Data Science teams, and the broader product organization on shared solutions and experiences.
Frame strategies, target metrics, and evaluation criteria.
Serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, building alignment without relying on direct authority.
Communicate strategy, priorities, roadmap, and results to leaders and stakeholders to support informed decisions and organizational alignment.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that encourages accountability, strong product craft, design taste, responsible experimentation, and continuous learning.

Required

Skills & Qualifications

10+ years of product management, including platform product management — building shared, reusable capabilities that other teams build on.
Strong experience building AI-first products and platforms — generative AI, agents and copilots, prompt and retrieval techniques, and evaluation.
Practical fluency with Salesforce or enterprise CRM capabilities, Adobe, and a strong understanding of enterprise client workflows and systems of record.
Strong product judgment and design taste, with the ability to distinguish good from great experiences and raise the bar for usability, trust, accessibility, and end-to-end experience quality.
Experience defining AI evaluation, monitoring, feedback, and governance practices that help teams test, launch, learn from, and scale AI-enabled capabilities responsibly.
Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder influence — leading across Business, Platform, Engineering, Data Science, and Insights & Analytics.
Excellent communication and collaboration, with a natural ability to align cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong influencing skills — able to rationalize, challenge, and prioritize to drive group decisions.
Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative, team-first approach consistent with Capital Group’s culture.

Preferred

Software, Technology, Financial services, asset management, or wealth management experience.
Familiarity with data governance, security, responsible-AI practices, and financial-services compliance and resilience for enterprise platforms.

“I can apply in less than 4 minutes.”

You’ve reviewed this job posting and you’re ready to start the candidate journey with us. Apply now to move to the next step in our recruiting process. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, check out our other opportunities and join our talent community.

“I Can Learn More About Capital Group.”

At Capital Group, the success of the people who invest with us depends on the people in whom we invest. That’s why we offer a culture, compensation and opportunities that empower our associates to build successful and prosperous careers. Through nine decades, our goal has been to improve people’s lives through successful investing. We know that our history is a testament to the strength of the people we hire. More than 9,000 associates in 30+ offices around the world help our clients and each other grow and thrive every day. Find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Glassdoor.‎

jobs.title: Director, Strategic Infrastructure Partnerships
jobs.description:
Director, Strategic Infrastructure Partnerships
Location: Dallas, TX
Type: Direct Hire
Overview
Our client is seeking a Director of Strategic Infrastructure Partnerships to lead and expand a critical ecosystem of technology and infrastructure partners supporting high-performance computing, AI, and next-generation data center environments.
This newly created role will centralize ownership of strategic partnerships that currently span multiple teams. The Director will establish a clear partnership strategy, strengthen executive relationships with key vendors, drive commercial value, and ensure partner capabilities align with the company’s infrastructure roadmap and growth objectives.
Serving as the primary business-side owner of the partnership ecosystem, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, infrastructure, engineering, procurement, finance, product, and sales teams to develop scalable partnerships across GPU and hardware suppliers, OEMs, data center providers, networking vendors, ISVs, and channel partners.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Partnerships
Build, manage, and expand strategic relationships with hardware OEMs, GPU suppliers, data center and colocation providers, networking vendors, ISVs, and channel partners.
Develop and own the strategic infrastructure partnership roadmap, aligning partner strategy with long-term business and technology objectives.
Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnerships across AI infrastructure, HPC, cloud, networking, and data center ecosystems.
Monitor emerging technologies, market trends, and competitive developments to identify new partnership opportunities.

Executive Relationship Management
Serve as the primary business contact for key strategic partners, including executive alignment, relationship governance, escalations, and performance management.
Create consistent structure and accountability around partner engagement across the organization.
Partner closely with infrastructure and technical leadership to streamline communication, decision-making, and vendor coordination.
Support partner enablement, certifications, technical training, and joint planning initiatives.

Commercial Strategy & Negotiation
Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, rebates, incentives, service levels, capacity commitments, and strategic agreements.
Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Compliance on contracts, risk management, and vendor governance.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization, vendor consolidation, improved commercial terms, and strategic sourcing efficiencies.
Track partner performance, contractual commitments, KPIs, delivery timelines, and service-level performance.

Infrastructure Planning & Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, procurement, finance, product, and commercial teams to align partner capabilities with business priorities.
Support supplier forecasting, capacity planning, hardware availability, and infrastructure deployment requirements.
Coordinate with colocation, networking, hardware, and infrastructure partners supporting data center expansion and new deployments.
Evaluate build, buy, and partner strategies for major infrastructure initiatives.

Go-to-Market & Ecosystem Growth
Develop joint go-to-market initiatives, including co-selling, solution integrations, strategic marketing programs, and partner-led opportunities.
Identify opportunities to expand the company’s market reach through strategic alliances and ecosystem relationships.
Conduct market and competitive analysis to evaluate emerging technologies, partners, and commercial opportunities.
Help shape the long-term partner ecosystem strategy supporting the company’s growth in AI and high-performance computing infrastructure.

Qualifications
8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, vendor management, strategic sourcing, or related technology infrastructure roles.
Experience building and managing strategic partnerships within cloud infrastructure, data centers, HPC, AI infrastructure, networking, or enterprise technology.
Strong relationships or experience working with hardware OEMs, GPU vendors, networking providers, colocation companies, or infrastructure technology partners.
Proven experience negotiating complex enterprise commercial agreements, pricing models, rebates, SLAs, and strategic commitments.
Understanding of AI/ML compute infrastructure, GPU environments, high-performance networking, cloud infrastructure, or data center technologies strongly preferred.
Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience evaluating pricing, capacity, supplier performance, and partnership economics.
Demonstrated ability to work across engineering, infrastructure, procurement, product, finance, legal, and executive leadership teams.
Strong executive presence with the ability to manage senior-level partner relationships and complex negotiations.
Highly analytical with the ability to evaluate market trends, vendor performance, and strategic build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions.
Comfortable building structure, processes, and strategy within a fast-growing and evolving organization.
Bachelor’s degree required. MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Security Program Experience: Strong background navigating complex software security reviews, managing high-stakes client/partner escalations, or designing program operational structures.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform
jobs.description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

“I can influence my income.”

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options
Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love
Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as the Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform at Capital Group.”

The Senior Manager, AI Client Enablement Platform owns the shared AI capabilities that power Capital Group’s suite of AI-enabled products for our Global Client teams. This role defines the Enablement Intelligence Platform — the reusable intelligence that turns Client data into scoring and coverage intelligence, meeting-prep context, follow-up and CRM-capture services, engagement signals, and the marketing orchestration, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation standards behind them — so every AI-enabled product builds on it. It is a business-facing product leadership role: you define business requirements, value, product architecture, builder experience, and priorities, and you partner with engineering, architecture, product management, and data science to build it safely, consistently, and at scale.

You own the platform, its shared capabilities, and the roadmap for a suite of AI client products and the sales & marketing experiences they power — products that help decide who to engage, how to prepare, and what to do next. Much of this capability is delivered through our multi-year program to transform Sales & Marketing Enablement experiences and products.

You will use Capital Group’s proprietary insights, client relationships, and enterprise data to create client enablement products that are differentiated and trusted. The role requires strong experience building AI-first products and platforms, practical fluency with Salesforce or enterprise CRM, Adobe Experience Cloud, and the ability to influence and align partners across a complex organization.

What you will build

The Enablement Intelligence Platform: the shared AI capabilities — scoring and coverage intelligence, meeting-prep context, follow-up and CRM-capture services, engagement signals, and the orchestration, retrieval, and guardrails behind them — that all AI-enabled products reuse.
A suite of AI products that help decide who to engage, how to prepare, and what to do next.
Reusable capabilities — including governed data and content services, orchestration patterns, model and workflow integrations, and builder-facing tools — that compound across products, channels, and client segments.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

AI Platform & Product Leadership

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Client Enablement Intelligence Platform and the AI seller-assist products and sales experiences it powers.
Provide the shared AI capabilities as governed, reusable services rather than one-off features rebuilt in each product.
Define the product architecture for the platform, including orchestration patterns, reusable AI services, governed data and content services, model and workflow integrations, and the builder experience required for teams to build safely and consistently.
Sequence the platform-first mandate: establish the core capabilities first, then the sales experiences built on them.
Determine where automation, agents, and human judgment should combine to create the greatest value, and set standards for how AI experiences behave across products.
Translate AI opportunities into practical product use cases, experiments, evaluation criteria, launch plans, monitoring routines, and measurable outcomes.
Make informed trade-offs across business value, user needs, platform investment, delivery capacity, AI opportunity, and operational risk when setting priorities.

Product Management & Delivery

Align with business partners on the outcomes that matter and translate them into clear product direction, requirements, and measurable results.
Lead discovery, experimentation, and validation so the team builds the right capabilities before committing to build.
Author clear product requirements that map pain-points to platform features and workflows, and keep data flowing cleanly across products so sellers get one unified experience.
Own launch readiness, adoption, training, and communications, and measure success in Capital Group terms — meeting-prep time saved, engagement quality, coverage, and adoption across teams.
Establish success measures for platform health, builder adoption, AI adoption, experience quality, and business performance, using those insights to inform roadmap decisions and continuous improvement.
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance so client-data use and generative content strictly align with financial-services requirements.

People & Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with the Insights, Analytics, and Data Science teams, and the broader product organization on shared solutions and experiences.
Frame strategies, target metrics, and evaluation criteria.
Serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, building alignment without relying on direct authority.
Communicate strategy, priorities, roadmap, and results to leaders and stakeholders to support informed decisions and organizational alignment.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that encourages accountability, strong product craft, design taste, responsible experimentation, and continuous learning.

Required

Skills & Qualifications

10+ years of product management, including platform product management — building shared, reusable capabilities that other teams build on.
Strong experience building AI-first products and platforms — generative AI, agents and copilots, prompt and retrieval techniques, and evaluation.
Practical fluency with Salesforce or enterprise CRM capabilities, Adobe, and a strong understanding of enterprise client workflows and systems of record.
Strong product judgment and design taste, with the ability to distinguish good from great experiences and raise the bar for usability, trust, accessibility, and end-to-end experience quality.
Experience defining AI evaluation, monitoring, feedback, and governance practices that help teams test, launch, learn from, and scale AI-enabled capabilities responsibly.
Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder influence — leading across Business, Platform, Engineering, Data Science, and Insights & Analytics.
Excellent communication and collaboration, with a natural ability to align cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong influencing skills — able to rationalize, challenge, and prioritize to drive group decisions.
Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative, team-first approach consistent with Capital Group’s culture.

Preferred

Software, Technology, Financial services, asset management, or wealth management experience.
Familiarity with data governance, security, responsible-AI practices, and financial-services compliance and resilience for enterprise platforms.

“I can apply in less than 4 minutes.”

You’ve reviewed this job posting and you’re ready to start the candidate journey with us. Apply now to move to the next step in our recruiting process. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, check out our other opportunities and join our talent community.

“I Can Learn More About Capital Group.”

At Capital Group, the success of the people who invest with us depends on the people in whom we invest. That’s why we offer a culture, compensation and opportunities that empower our associates to build successful and prosperous careers. Through nine decades, our goal has been to improve people’s lives through successful investing. We know that our history is a testament to the strength of the people we hire. More than 9,000 associates in 30+ offices around the world help our clients and each other grow and thrive every day. Find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Glassdoor.‎

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure - Stealth Aviation Safety Intelligence Startup
jobs.description:
UP.Labs is hiring a hands-on Head of Infrastructure for Scout, an AI-powered safety intelligence platform built in partnership with Alaska Airlines. The industry is high-stakes, tightly regulated, and still runs on reactive, form-based reporting.
The core problem: safety teams are fighting yesterday's incidents. Frontline reports pile up faster than analysts can triage them, the pattern that mattered is usually visible only in hindsight, and the systems built to catch risk before it becomes a catastrophic incident were built for compliance checklists, not prevention.
We're building the platform that fixes this - replacing slow, dropdown-based reporting with a real-time intelligence layer. Frontline employees report by voice, photo, or text, and Scout classifies, triages, and links related reports across workgroups so analysts spend their time on prevention, not paperwork. Built for aviation compliance (FAA Part 121, Safety Management System workflows), with Alaska Airlines live in production with more airline partnerships in the pipeline
As the first dedicated infrastructure leader, you'll own architecture, cloud infrastructure, and data infrastructure as the team moves from stabilization into production scale. You'll take over ownership of hardware, cloud, and systems work currently split across the existing engineering team, build the technical foundation to support enterprise customers at scale, and set the long-term infrastructure direction as Scout expands beyond its first airline partner. You'll also have access to the UP.Partners ecosystem - product, engineering, design, analytics, legal, talent, finance, and VC - to help accelerate execution.
In this role, you will:
Own Scout's cloud infrastructure end-to-end on Azure, including compute, networking, identity, storage, and cost/scaling decisions.
Architect and evolve the platform's infrastructure to support production-scale reliability as Scout moves from single-customer stabilization to multi-airline, multi-industry deployment.
Design and own infrastructure-as-code practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability across the platform.
Support the data infrastructure layer, including the pipeline between Scout's application and its Databricks data layer.
Lead load testing, performance, and reliability work ahead of and following production launch.
Build toward compliance-ready infrastructure as Scout works toward SOC 2 and ISO certifications over the next 18 months.
Partner closely with the Head of Engineering and existing team to take direct ownership of infrastructure work currently split across multiple people.
Establish security, backup, and disaster-recovery practices appropriate for an enterprise B2B platform serving safety-critical customers.
Manage vendor and cost relationships tied to cloud and infrastructure spend as the company scales.

Who you are:
A technical leader who has owned cloud infrastructure end-to-end at a lean, high-growth startup - not just executed within an already-built platform team's architecture.
Deep, hands-on with Microsoft Azure specifically - this is a hard requirement, not "cloud generally."
Hands-on and detail-oriented, comfortable making the actual architecture and design calls rather than implementing someone else's.
Experienced operating with a very small infrastructure team (1-3 people owning everything), not a large infra org with specialized sub-teams.
Comfortable in ambiguous, high-growth startup environments where priorities shift as the product moves from stabilization to scale.
Collaborative - able to work closely with engineering, data, and leadership, and to take over ownership of work currently spread across a small team without friction.

You should have:
Significant experience owning infrastructure/platform engineering, ideally at Director, Head of Infrastructure, Principal, or Staff level (title matters less than scope owned).
Deep Azure expertise across compute, networking, identity, and storage - non-negotiable for this role.
Strong architecture experience - real design ownership, such as leading a cloud migration, designing infrastructure from scratch at an early-stage company, or owning infra-as-code strategy end-to-end. This is a major plus.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM), CI/CD, and observability tooling.
Familiarity with data infrastructure and pipelines (Databricks experience a plus, not required).
Experience building toward compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) from an infrastructure/security standpoint is a strong plus.
Comfortable owning cost and scaling decisions independently in a lean team.
No specific industry background required - aviation, safety, or EHS domain experience is a nice to have, but not a factor for this role.

Why Join Us:
Own infrastructure for a platform already live in production with a major airline customer, expanding into additional airline and industry partnerships.
Take a system through the transition from single-customer stabilization to enterprise scale, with real architectural ownership from day one.
Work directly with Scout's CEO and Head of Engineering as the infrastructure voice in the room - not behind the glass.
Collaborate with UP.Labs, strategic partners, and investors to drive real impact in aviation and adjacent high-risk industries.
Earn meaningful equity in a company positioned to transform how high-risk industries prevent catastrophic incidents.
Remote-friendly. We care about output, not location.

We build high-growth technology startups that enable faster, cleaner, and safer movement of people and goods. Our platform is unique in three ways: Risk: We reward our entire team and ecosystem of partners with meaningful equity.
Technology: We build and launch scalable technology products that form the basis for each venture.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About The Team

The Technical Support Engineering - Infrastructure team sits within CoreWeave's Global Field Organization (GFO) and is the front line for every customer running AI and HPC workloads on our platform. Operating 24/7/365, the team supports the Kubernetes-powered infrastructure behind the AI revolution: GPU compute, high-performance networking and storage, Slurm/HPC clusters, and the large-scale, mission-critical training workloads that run on them.

We operate on a Direct-to-Expert
model. Instead of routing customers through generic support tiers, we get the right expert on the problem fast while a single owner stays accountable for the issue end-to-end. That means fewer handoffs, clearer ownership, and a high-touch experience that our customers feel on every ticket. The team is the connective tissue between our customers and CoreWeave's engineering organization. We triage and resolve deep technical issues directly, coordinate with Product Engineering, Specialist Field Engineers, and domain specialists when needed, and feed what we learn in the field straight back into the product roadmap.

About The Role

As the Senior Manager of Technical Support Engineering - Infrastructure, you'll own, scale, and continuously improve CoreWeave's infrastructure support function — a large, globally distributed 24/7/365 organization of skilled engineers who resolve our customers' most complex technical challenges with deep expertise, efficiency, and empathy. High-touch, expert-led support is one of CoreWeave's clearest differentiators, which gives this role prominent visibility and influence across the company.

You'll operate at the department level, setting the technical and operational bar for the entire function and designing the operating systems (coverage/staffing model, Direct-to-Expert
partnerships, quality program, metrics) that let support scale reliably. You'll lead with empathy and invest in each person's growth, while building the structure and processes that let the team scale with CoreWeave's hyper-growth without compromising the culture we care deeply about.

In This Role, You Will

Own the strategy, health, and performance of the entire 24/7/365 infrastructure support function, helping scale coverage and capability across regions and domains as CoreWeave grows.
Own talent acquisition and retention by hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers through diligent performance management and coaching tailored to each individual's needs.
Stay hands-on: dig into complex, customer-impacting issues alongside your team and serve as a senior technical escalation point, ensuring the highest quality of support.
Build and facilitate the enablement and career-development frameworks for onboarding, technical training, and progression paths that raise capability across the whole function and create a repeatable path for career growth.
Implement quality assurance measures, including ticket reviews and best-practice playbooks, that raise the bar on resolution speed, accuracy, and consistency.
Own the support operating model for the function including roles and responsibilities, escalation boundaries, coverage/staffing model, and the response and resolution targets (SLOs) that keep every customer's experience consistently excellent as volume scales.
Lead customer communication during critical incidents and resolve conflicts with clarity, composure, and empathy.

You've led a globally distributed team across time zones.
Leadership & Communication: proven ability to lead through senior talent and set direction for a function, with executive-level communication skills.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Data & Integrations Engineering
jobs.description:
Our healthcare system is the leading cause of personal bankruptcy in the U.S. Every year, over 50 million Americans suffer adverse financial consequences as a result of seeking care, from lower credit scores to garnished wages. The challenge is only getting worse, as high deductible health plans are the fastest growing plan design in the U.S.
Cedar’s mission is to leverage data science, smart product design and personalization to make healthcare more affordable and accessible. Today, healthcare providers still engage with its consumers in a “one-size-fits-all” approach; and Cedar is excited to leverage consumer best practices to deliver a superior experience.
The Role
Cedar is at a meaningful inflection point. We're building a new enterprise data foundation
to power the next generation of AI-driven products and client-facing analytics while simultaneously expanding our integration footprint
to support new product lines and go-to-market motions. The complexity is real, the stakes are high, and the environment is dynamic.
Transparently, this role comes with challenges to navigate. These teams sit at the intersection of client delivery, platform evolution, and operational reliability
, which means ad-hoc demands land here regularly and the roadmap can evolve mid-flight. You're not walking into a well-oiled machine; you're walking into an opportunity to build one. A big part of this role is establishing the processes, relationships, and stakeholder alignment that reduce that thrash over time, working closely with internal partners and customers to create more predictability for your teams. The right person for this role doesn't just tolerate the current environment. They see it clearly, stay steady within it, and consistently work to improve it.
As Sr. Director of Data & Integrations Engineering, you'll report directly to the CTO and head an organization of ~35 engineers across three teams ( Data Engineering, Integration Engineering, and Integration Support Engineering
) through three experienced engineering managers. You'll also be backed by Principal Engineers who own the deep technical vision and architecture for the org. Your job isn't to be the smartest technical person in the room; your principals have that covered. Your job is to make the whole machine run
: deliver with consistency, develop your people, reduce the organizational thrash that slows everyone down, and ensure the operational quality that our clients, partners, and internal teams depend on.
Who You'll Lead
Integration Engineering
is accountable for bi-directional data integrations between Cedar and healthcare provider EHR systems: Epic, Cerner, Athena, and more. The team services healthcare provider clients, delivers new implementations, enhances live integrations, and is building scalable integration frameworks to reduce go-live timelines and enable an expanding product surface. They are the technical engine behind Cedar's ability to grow.
Integration Support Engineering
is Cedar's integration reliability team: on-call response, incident management, root cause analysis, and escalation resolution. They own the SLAs that matter most to our clients and are evolving from a reactive response function toward a proactive, systems-thinking discipline, driving down incident volume through better observability, tooling, and upstream framework improvements.
Data Engineering
builds and evolves Cedar's enterprise data platform: ELT/ETL pipelines, data governance, Medallion architecture, and the real-time data foundations that power Cedar's AI-driven products. The team is mid-transformation, migrating from legacy infrastructure to a modern stack while simultaneously building net-new foundations for a next-generation analytics and intelligence platform that will drive all future product offerings. The stakes are high and the work is consequential.
What You'll Own
Delivery predictability.
Establish and maintain the processes, rituals, and accountability structures that keep three parallel workstreams (greenfield platform work, client-facing implementations, and live production operations) shipping on time and with high quality. You know how to right-size agile practices for the work at hand. Process pays rent; you believe that.
People and manager development.
Grow an effective layer of engineering managers and help them build high-performing, engaged teams. This is your primary lever. Your principals own the technical roadmap; your teams' health, growth, and culture live with you. You have a track record of developing first-time and experienced managers alike.
Operational excellence.
Own the reliability and SLA performance of Cedar's integration systems. Reduce MTTI, MTTR, and systemic incident rates. Build a culture where operational quality (observability, on-call discipline, postmortem rigor) is a first-class engineering value, not an afterthought.
Data platform evolution.
Partner with the Principal Data Architect to keep Cedar's data platform transition on track: migration from legacy systems, adoption of new architecture across the organization, and ensuring that downstream consumers (product engineering, data science, analytics, and AI/ML) have trusted, accessible data when they need it.
Integration scalability. Reduce the time and cost of onboarding new clients and enabling new product lines. Advance the integration frameworks and patterns that let your teams scale their impact without scaling headcount proportionally.
Organizational clarity and thrash reduction.
Build the structures (intake processes, prioritization frameworks, escalation paths) that protect your teams from the constant pull of ad-hoc requests and shifting priorities. You'll also coach your managers to run their teams with increasing autonomy: to hold a line, uphold a roadmap, and absorb pressure without needing escalation assistance. You'll build an org that operates with discipline even when the environment around it is noisy.
Cross-functional partnership.
Build effective relationships with Product, Data Science, Commercial, and Delivery Engineering. Represent your teams' capacity and priorities clearly; negotiate trade-offs constructively; keep issues surfaced and resolved before they become crises. You're a peer other leaders want to work with.
What You Bring
12+ years

in software engineering
or technical implementation
, with meaningful time in data-intensive, integration-heavy, or platform domains.
8+ years in engineering leadership

, including 4+ years managing managers, ideally with direct experience overseeing an org of 30+ engineers.
Solid technical grounding

in integration systems and data. You engage credibly with principals and managers on architecture trade-offs, operational risk, and build-vs-buy decisions. You don't need to be the deepest expert, but you need to know when to push back and when to trust.
High tolerance for ambiguity, with a demonstrated talent for reducing it.

Cedar moves fast and the environment is genuinely noisy. You don't need a clean brief to start moving. You've thrived in orgs where priorities shift, asks are imperfect, and the path forward requires synthesis rather than instruction. You create structure from chaos without waiting for someone else to hand it to you.
Operational instincts.

You've owned SLAs, on-call programs, incident management, or client-facing reliability commitments, and you've built the systems and culture to sustain them.
Effective cross-functional stakeholder management, including executive presence.

You can translate between engineering realities and business priorities without losing either side. You've navigated trade-off conversations with product, finance, and executive audiences, and you're comfortable representing your teams' work, priorities, and risks clearly in front of C-suite leadership.

Preferred 
Healthcare domain experience

, particularly in revenue cycle management, EHR data models, or healthcare interoperability (HL7/FHIR). The integration complexity at Cedar is significant, and domain context accelerates both credibility and impact.
AI-forward mindset

. You believe agentic developer tooling is a genuine force accelerator, not a passing trend, and you set expectations from the front on adoption. You actively model AI-native workflows for your managers and teams, and you create the space and expectation for engineers to integrate these tools into how they build, debug, and ship. You've seen what happens when a team gets this right, and you want to make it happen again.

Compensation Range and Benefits
Salary/Hourly Rate Range*: $280,500 - $330,000 
This role is equity eligible 
This role offers a competitive benefits and wellness package

*Subject to location, experience, and education
What do we offer to the ideal candidate?

A chance to improve the U.S. healthcare system at a high-growth company! Our leading healthcare financial platform is scaling rapidly, helping millions of patients per year
Unless stated otherwise, most roles have flexibility to work from home or in the office, depending on what works best for you
For exempt employees: Unlimited PTO for vacation, sick and mental health days–we encourage everyone to take at least 20 days of vacation per year to ensure dedicated time to spend with loved ones, explore, rest and recharge
16 weeks paid parental leave with health benefits for all parents, plus flexible re-entry schedules for returning to work
Diversity initiatives that encourage Cedarians to bring their whole selves to work, including three employee resource groups: be@cedar (for BIPOC-identifying Cedarians and their allies), Pridecones (for LGBTQIA+ Cedarians and their allies) and Cedar Women+ (for female-identifying Cedarians) 
Competitive pay, equity (for qualifying roles), and health benefits, including fertility & adoption assistance, that start on the first of the month following your start date (or on your start date if your start date coincides with the first of the month)
Cedar matches 100% of your 401(k) contributions, up to 3% of your annual compensation
Access to hands-on mentorship, employee and management coaching, and a team discretionary budget for learning and development resources to help you grow both professionally and personally

About us 

Cedar was co-founded by Florian Otto and Arel Lidow in 2016 after a negative medical billing experience inspired them to help improve our healthcare system. With a commitment to solving billing and patient experience issues, Cedar has become a leading healthcare technology company fueled by remarkable growth. "Over the past several years, we've raised more than $350 million in funding & have the active support of Thrive and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z).
As of November 2024, Cedar is engaging with 26 million patients annually and is on target to process $3.5 billion in patient payments annually. Cedar partners with more than 55 leading healthcare providers and payers including Highmark Inc., Allegheny Health Network, Novant Health, Allina Health and Providence.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a senior engineering leader to own the technical roadmap for our enterprise-scale data and AI infrastructure. You will lead a multi-disciplinary engineering organization, set data platform and cloud architecture direction, and act as the bridge between hands-on solution design and commercial/vendor accountability. This role combines strong architectural credibility with people leadership, governance ownership, and stakeholder management across global clients.

Responsibilities

Lead, grow and develop a multi-disciplinary engineering organization, providing mentorship to Development Leads and engineers, ensuring team composition is adequate, and hiring to fill gaps.
Set and own the technical roadmap for the data platform, defining reference architectures and design patterns (e.g. medallion/layered architectures) that scale across multiple business units and data domains.
Provide guidance, coaching and mentorship in modern data engineering practices, web application development, and best practices for diagnostics, debugging, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting.
Work with Product and Engineering teams to scope, plan and estimate the technical roadmap, aligning it to broader business goals and helping to forecast delivery timescales.
Evaluate solution options against business requirements and organizational standards; champion rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept work to validate designs and de-risk delivery.
Provide architectural oversight and mentorship to architects and engineers; maintain high standards of design documentation and contribute to the evolution of architectural reference models.
Foster constructive debates between Product, Engineering and UX teams to create scalable, client-focused solutions that solve business problems with software in the shortest sustainable lead-time.
Establish and run governance frameworks for applications and data products, including certification and stewardship processes; ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and regulatory standards.
Own platform security posture: access control, secrets management, naming/tagging conventions, and certification of new data products. Lead the triage and remediation of platform security or data incidents.
Build visibility into cloud and compute cost drivers; drive FinOps practices to optimize spend across environments. Design repeatable onboarding processes for new tools, analysts, and integrations.
Manage vendor relationships, procurement processes and commercial contract negotiations, ensuring legal and compliance requirements are met. Provide technical oversight of 3rd party supplier partnerships.
Lead platform modernization and migration programs, including planning, sequencing, and risk management for large-scale technology transitions.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, assessing their potential impact and benefit to the overall business strategy, particularly AI/agentic capabilities and data infrastructure innovations.

Candidate Profile

Proven experience leading data engineering or data platform teams at a senior/head level, ideally within a large or matrixed organization.
Industry experience working with Data platforms is essential, with strong background in dimensional data modelling, data pipeline development and data engineering in support of web applications.
Strong hands-on background in modern cloud data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) and major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Solid understanding of data governance, access control, and security practices in cloud environments.
Experience with large-scale ETL/ELT design and migration programs.
Demonstrated experience with cloud cost management and FinOps practices.
Experience managing vendor contracts, procurement, and commercial negotiations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences and global/matrixed teams.
A structured, specification-driven approach to requirements and delivery, with a preference for disciplined, release-oriented delivery.
Able to demonstrate evidence of applying technology to solve business problems.

Requirements

Strong working knowledge of modern cloud data platforms (Azure Databricks/Spark using Python and associated frameworks, or Snowflake equivalent).
Strong working knowledge of cloud storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Blob storage, or equivalent).
Strong experience of building data reporting and visualisations using PowerBI, Tableau, or equivalent tools.
Strong knowledge of SQL and data modelling principles.
Experience in application development with proficiency in Python or JavaScript frameworks.
Strong knowledge and experience of hosting in major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Familiarity with how AI/ML and agentic systems are integrated with enterprise data platforms.
Solid understanding of data governance, access control, and security practices in cloud environments.
Knowledge of delivering solutions using a microservice architecture with RESTful protocols and event-driven architectures.
Knowledge and experience of implementing Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery.
Ability to quickly learn and apply emerging programming languages, frameworks, and platforms.
Comfortable working in an agile environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and business audiences.

Preferred

Experience in building applications in MERN (Mongo, Express, React, Node) using Webpack, Typescript, and GitHub.
Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes and containerized deployments (AKS).
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or n8n.
Experience of code quality, test, CI/CD and package managers such as Jest, Lint, Brigade, and Helm.
Experience with Kafka and event-driven architecture patterns.
Experience with identity/access management integrations (Okta, Entra ID).
Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio) and advanced networking patterns.
Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs, ABAC solutions, and CMS platforms.
Experience with C4 model architecture documentation (PlantUML or similar).
TOGAF or other enterprise architecture certification.
Cloud architecture certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate).
Familiarity with the AdTech/MarTech ecosystem.

jobs.description:
Since 2008, Smule has been transforming music from a passive listening experience into a collaborative, social form of creative expression. Our mission is to bring people together through music, empowering anyone, anywhere, to create, share, and connect through song. Today, tens of millions of people use Smule to make music together, creating more than 20 million songs every day. From aspiring singers to lifelong music lovers, our global community comes together to collaborate, discover new talent, and express themselves through music.

At Smule, you'll have the opportunity to build products that inspire creativity, foster meaningful connections, and bring joy to millions of people around the world.

About The Role

Smule is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead teams building scalable, reliable, and AI-powered consumer experiences for our global community. This leader will play a key role in accelerating Smule’s transformation into an AI-first engineering organization, driving innovation, technical excellence, and operational performance across critical product and platform initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, a passion for emerging AI technologies, and a proven track record of building high-performing teams and consumer products at scale.

This is a hybrid role with 1-2 days in office at our Salt Lake City or Bay Area offices.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead engineering teams and managers to deliver product and platform roadmaps with high execution quality, operational reliability, and team performance.
Drive Smule’s AI-first engineering practices by embedding AI-assisted development, automation, machine learning/deep learning systems, and modern developer productivity tools into daily engineering workflows.
Evaluate and adopt emerging AI, deep learning, and software engineering technologies that improve product innovation, platform scalability, and engineering productivity.
Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, and technical leaders on roadmap planning, prioritization, release execution, AI initiatives, platform modernization, and technical debt reduction.
Establish and uphold engineering standards for architecture, code quality, testing, security, documentation, observability, and production readiness.
Define and track engineering KPIs for delivery velocity, product quality, system reliability, operational health, and team effectiveness.
Build and develop high-performing engineering teams through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.
Lead operational reviews, incident follow-ups, and continuous improvements to engineering execution, reliability, and readiness.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
8+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including technical leadership and people management responsibilities.
3+ years leading engineering teams, including Software Engineers, Technical Leads, and/or Engineering Managers.
Strong AI fluency, including practical experience applying AI-assisted development, automation, machine learning, deep learning, or AI-powered product capabilities.
Proven experience building, scaling, and operating high-volume consumer-facing products and services.
Strong technical depth in one or more areas such as mobile engineering, backend systems, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML platforms, or platform engineering.
Experience driving engineering transformation initiatives, including AI adoption, developer productivity improvements, automation, or platform modernization.
Deep understanding of modern software development practices, including agile delivery, CI/CD, testing automation, observability, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated ability to balance speed, quality, scalability, reliability, and business priorities.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Bonus Points For

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
Experience building AI-powered consumer features, deep learning systems, recommendation systems, personalization platforms, audio/video technology, or creator tools.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
Passion for music, creativity, and social connection.

And here’s the best part - we’re a national company that offers a small-company feel, a cultural balance that’s hard to come by but very real at SHAZAM. Your growth and development are top priorities and you’ll be surrounded by talented individuals and postured to make a real difference in the company. As a team member at SHAZAM, you’ll be an essential part of our mission as we work together strengthening financial institutions.

This is a hybrid position based out of our Johnston, IA office.

What We’re Looking For

SHAZAM is looking for a VP of Infrastructure
tolead the vision, strategy, and execution of our enterprise technology infrastructure. This senior leadership role is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, scalability, and performance of our critical technology environments while driving innovation and operational excellence across the organization. This role will work closely with executive leadership to align technology investments with business objectives and support SHAZAM's continued growth and innovation.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop teams responsible for infrastructure, systems, networks, telecommunications, cloud platforms, and operational support.
Ensure the availability, security, scalability, and performance of mission-critical technology environments supporting 24/7 operations.
Analyze industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and continuous improvement across the technology landscape.
Develop and implement plans for capacity management, technology lifecycle planning, infrastructure modernization, staffing, and cost optimization.
Evaluate, recommend, and oversee the implementation of technology hardware, software, security solutions, and network infrastructure.
Establish and maintain policies, procedures, and controls that ensure information security, regulatory compliance, and business continuity.
Manage infrastructure architecture, disaster recovery readiness, and operational resilience initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with executive leadership, business stakeholders, vendors, and strategic partners.
Oversee departmental budgets, technology investments, vendor contracts, and resource planning to maximize business value and return on investment.
Provide regular updates, reporting, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board of Directors as needed.
Ensure effective communication and coordination among stakeholders, technical teams, and business partners to deliver reliable and innovative technology solutions.

What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years experience in technology infrastructure, enterprise systems, networking, cloud computing, or related technology disciplines.
7+ years of experience leading and developing technical teams within a complex technology environment.
Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure, including Windows and UNIX/Linux operating systems, networking, telecommunications, virtualization, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity.
Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical environments with stringent uptime, security, and performance requirements.
Proven experience managing budgets, technology investments, vendor relationships, and contract negotiations.
Strong understanding of information security principles, regulatory requirements, risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.
Ability to work collaboratively across departments and build strong internal and external business relationships.
Ability to respond to operational issues outside of normal business hours and support the needs of a 24/7 technology environment.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly for business needs.

What’s In It For You

A mission-driven company with a strong sense of purpose
A hybrid work environment that values flexibility and collaboration
Opportunities for professional development and career growth
A culture that values innovation, integrity, and community impact
Excellent benefits:
Health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Flexible spending and health savings accounts
Life insurance and short- and long-term disability provided at no cost
Time away from work – PTO, VTO, paid parental leave, and company holidays
Educational assistance

jobs.title: Vice President - AI Safety Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Role Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Vice President – AI Safety Platforms
to build and lead our enterprise AI safety engineering initiatives. As generative AI in financial services evolves from simple prompt-response workflows to autonomous agentic systems that execute multi-step plans, call APIs, and interact directly with internal systems, establishing robust safety mechanisms and standardized evaluation protocols is essential.

In this role, you will recruit and lead dedicated engineering pods focused on developing a unified company-wide agentic evaluation framework
, real-time LLM guardrail services, and automated governance controls. As the senior technical authority for AI safety, you will collaborate closely with core AI platform teams, risk control functions, and business units to drive necessary enhancements to the core AI platform (such as telemetry hooks, API capabilities, execution sandboxes, and data logging infrastructure) to ensure all enterprise AI deployments operate safely, verifiably, and in compliance with institutional standards.

Key Responsibilities

Unified Agentic Evaluation Framework
Company-Wide Architecture:Design, build, and deploya single, company-wide agentic evaluation frameworkthat standardizes how teams across all business lines benchmark, test, and measure AI agent performance prior to production deployment.
Trajectory & Multi-Step Reasoning Assessment:Implement evaluation methodologies that score autonomous planning quality, tool-calling precision, multi-turn state retention, trajectory efficiency, and error-recovery behaviors.
Continuous Monitoring & Production Drift:Integrate automated evaluation pipelines into runtime environments to continuously audit agent execution traces, detecting reasoning drift, tool failure modes, and unexpected trajectory shifts in production.
Domain-Specific Benchmarking:Establish standardized test suites and synthetic evaluation benchmarks tailored to complex financial workflows, such as automated research, risk assessment, and operational task execution.
LLM Guardrails Infrastructure & Real-Time Controls
Low-Latency Guardrail Engine:Architect and scale enterprise guardrail microservices that inspect prompt inputs, retrieved context, and model outputs in real time to prevent data leakage, policy violations, and unvalidated execution.
Tool-Use & Action Control:Implement runtime policy gateways that inspect and authorize tool calls before execution, ensuring agents operate within authorized data boundaries and action scopes.
Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Triggers:Build configurable escalation workflows and approval gates that automatically pause execution for high-risk operations (e.g., money movement, client record modifications, or external communications) until human authorization is granted.
Core AI Platform Enhancements & Governance Integration
Drive Platform Enhancements:Partner directly with the core AI Platform team to drive the implementation of safety APIs, telemetry hooks, developer SDKs, and MLOps/LLMOps pipeline integrations.
Auditability & Execution Telemetry:Define and enforce technical standards for immutable audit logging, execution tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry standards), and principal identity propagation across all agentic workflows.
Regulatory & Model Risk Alignment:Translate model risk management standards (e.g., SR 11-7 / SR 26-2 guidance, FINRA supervision requirements) into automated engineering safeguards and policy checks.
Engineering Leadership & Strategic Oversight
Team Building & Mentorship:Hire, develop, and mentor high-performing engineering teams specializing in applied machine learning, AI safety, and enterprise platform engineering.
Strategic Roadmap:Own the technical roadmap for enterprise AI safety infrastructure, setting clear milestones for evaluation framework adoption, runtime latency optimization, and governance automation.
Stakeholder Collaboration:Articulate technical risk profiles, evaluation metrics, and safety architecture to risk committees, model validation teams, and executive leadership.

Key Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Role Level:Vice President experience (or equivalent senior engineering leadership) in financial services or large-scale enterprise software environments.
Education:Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Systems Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
Engineering Leadership:4+ years leading applied ML or software engineering teams in building platform infrastructure or microservices.
Software Engineering Depth:8+ years of hands-on software development experience (Python, Go, Java, or C++) building microservices, high-throughput APIs, or enterprise platform services.
AI & Agentic Expertise:Technical fluency with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, function calling / tool integration, and agentic execution paradigms (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP server architectures).

Preferred Experience & Technical Skills

Agentic Evaluation:Direct experience building agent evaluation frameworks and metrics (e.g., LLM-as-a-Judge, G-Eval, trajectory trace evaluation, task completion scoring).
Guardrail Frameworks:Hands-on experience integrating low-latency guardrail tools and runtime filters (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Llama Guard).
AI Observability & Tracing:Experience with LLM and agent tracing tools (e.g., LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix, MLflow) and structured audit logging infrastructure.
Platform Engineering Alignment:Proven ability to partner across teams and drive key governance capabilities into core shared platforms.

Salary Range

The expected base salary for this New York, NY, United States-based position is $130000-$250000. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year-end.

The role will set product and technology priorities, lead high-performing multidisciplinary teams, and partner across Product, Technology, Loyalty, Brand, Commercial, Hotel Operations, and regional stakeholders to turn business strategy and guest insight into a compelling roadmap, high-quality releases, and measurable commercial impact.

Your Day-to-Day

Set and activate a bold product and technology vision for IHG’s direct digital ecosystem, translating guest, owner, and commercial insight into 3–5 year strategic plans, annual investment priorities, and measurable value creation.
Assist the business in product management for the app, web to drive direct revenue contribution.
Partner with internal teams and external technology providers to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing digital capabilities.
Champion enterprise-wide product and platform initiatives across functions, aligning stakeholders, shaping priorities, and driving delivery that advances IHG’s commercial, loyalty, brand, and hotel performance goals.
Assess emerging technology, user needs, customer touchpoints, and current-state capability gaps to identify the highest-impact product opportunities and guide future-state digital experiences across the guest journey.
Build compelling business cases for new initiatives, including cost-benefit analysis, return on investment, portfolio rationalization, product retirement opportunities, and profitability drivers.
Establish clear success metrics, performance standards, release schedules, annual targets, budgets, and delivery tracking to ensure product investments translate into reliable capabilities and measurable customer and commercial outcomes.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team, including recruiting talent, setting departmental goals and KPOs, coaching and succession planning, managing performance, and building senior-level relationships that secure support for the strategic direction.

What We Need From You

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work-related experience, with 12+ years of progressive experience across product marketing, product management, digital technology, and platform leadership.
Demonstrated experience leading the architecture, development, operation, and modernization of high-volume digital platforms across multi-cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform.
Strong command of cloud-native architecture, including microservices, APIs, event-driven integration, containers, serverless computing, data platforms, identity and access management, and resilient multi-region operations.
Experience directing modern mobile and web engineering, including native iOS & Android development. Application architecture and delivery for responsive and accessible user experiences, front-end frameworks, content management platforms, API-driven architecture, experimentation, performance optimization, and search-engine optimization.
Experience establishing engineering standards for continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, release management, observability, site reliability, incident response, disaster recovery, and technical-debt reduction.
Demonstrated ability to oversee platform security, data privacy, payment security, regulatory compliance, responsible handling of guest and loyalty data, and enterprise integrations across loyalty, reservations, CRM, content, search, personalization, payment, and analytics platforms.
Proven ability to translate business strategy and performance, stability, conversion, experimentation, and operational data into technical direction, architecture roadmaps, delivery plans, investment cases, and measurable platform outcomes while leading globally distributed engineering teams and technology partners.
