About the Team
The USDS TikTok Moderation team is a specialized organization within the TikTok USDS Joint Venture. Our mission is to build a safe, trustworthy, and compliant e-commerce ecosystem specifically for the US market. We operate at the critical intersection of advanced AI/LLM technology and stringent data security protocols.

About the Role
As the Head of TikTok Shop Moderation, you are the owner of moderation at TikTok Shop in the US. This is a high-impact leadership role to ensure our content moderation decisions on TikTok Shop align with our rigorous safety standards and USDS compliance protocols.

You are responsible for keeping TikTok Shop a safe, compliant, and trustworthy marketplace. The function reviews TikTok Shop related product listings, creators and content for policy compliance, works with Governance teams on policy standards, and supports relevant enforcements. In this role, you will manage both an in-house team, as well as outside vendors to support our mission. Furthermore, you will also drive LLM based solutions to complement and enhance human-based moderation efficiency.

- Responsible for TikTok Shop moderation efficiency, accuracy and costs.

- Harness the capabilities of advanced large language models (LLM) to enhance overall moderation.

- Strong ability to manage remote vendors effectively to deliver moderation efficiency and accuracy. Strong ability to produce insights from moderation operations to drive iterative improvements to governance policies
- Strong ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional partners

The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with broad product influence, cross-functional leadership, and strong customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership for the Conformal LEC and ECO product areas, driving architecture, algorithm development, implementation, and product execution.
Lead strategic initiatives to improve scalability, performance, capacity, quality, and debug effectiveness for complex IC verification and ECO flows.
Drive AI-related innovation within Conformal, identifying and executing opportunities to improve verification productivity, debug efficiency, and user workflows.
Solve complex technical and customer challenges, including critical escalations, methodology development, root-cause analysis, and delivery of robust software solutions.
Collaborate with R&D, Product Engineering, Product Validation, Product Management, and customer-facing teams to define product direction and deliver differentiated customer value.
Mentor senior engineers, provide architectural guidance, and promote engineering excellence and innovation across the broader organization.
Influence the long-term roadmap and technical strategy for formal verification, equivalence checking, ECO, and AI-assisted verification technologies.
Engage with strategic customers and industry partners to understand emerging requirements and translate them into product and technology innovations.

Required Qualifications

Extensive EDA software development experience, with strong expertise in formal verification, logic equivalence checking, ECO, synthesis, or related digital design technologies.
Strong C/C++ development experience and a deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, debugging, object-oriented design, and large-scale software architecture.
Proven track record of leading complex, high-impact technical initiatives and delivering production-quality software from concept through deployment.
Strong knowledge of digital design flows, logic synthesis, formal methods, RTL-to-netlist verification, and semiconductor design methodologies.
Ability to provide cross-functional technical leadership and influence product direction across organizational boundaries.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in a geographically distributed engineering environment.
Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep experience with commercial EDA products for formal verification, LEC, ECO, low-power verification, synthesis, or adjacent technologies.
Knowledge of AI/ML technologies and experience applying AI techniques to EDA, verification, debug, or engineering-productivity workflows.
Experience with scripting languages such as Tcl, Python, Perl, or shell scripting.
Experience working in Linux/Unix development environments and optimizing large-scale, performance-sensitive software systems.
Experience partnering directly with leading semiconductor customers on complex technical requirements and escalations.

Recognized as a technical leader in formal verification and ECO technologies.
Drives innovation and technical direction beyond immediate project or team boundaries.
Translates customer challenges and market needs into differentiated, scalable product capabilities.
Accelerates the adoption of AI technologies across the Conformal product family.
Develops technical talent and raises engineering quality across the organization.

This is an opportunity to lead highly visible verification technologies used by leading semiconductor customers to solve complex IC design challenges. You will join a team that values innovation, technical excellence, collaboration, and a supportive work environment while helping shape the future of formal verification, ECO, and AI-driven verification methodology.

Here at OCI we’re building the world’s largest AI clusters and we’re the fastest at bringing them to market. The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort.

As part of this focus on AI workloads and customers we’re building provisioning, repair, monitoring, maintenance, configuration and validation systems that enable us to deliver high quality GPU clusters to our customers and operate them with high availability. These systems are responsible for firmware management of the GPUs, the high speed backend NICs and automated validation and for GPU servers. Together they build the GPU specialization on top of the general compute Data plane which enables us to deliver high performing and high availability offerings to our customers.

In this role you would lead the software development organization building out and operating these systems and work with some of the largest players in the AI space building systems that operate at unprecedented speed, scale and reliability. You should be a systems specialist with exposure to low level drivers and firmware, knowledge of repair systems, able to architect broad systems interactions, while being very hands-on, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and lower-level system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.

Responsibilities

 Candidate will be responsible for providing leadership, direction and strategy.
 Establishing and development of organization to meet and execute on strategy.
 Working with geographically distributed teams and contribute to the success of their and of other related teams.
 Delivering large scale project on-time with the high quality

Required Qualifications 

MS or BS in Computer Science, or equivalent experience

5+ years of experience managing Software Engineering teams.

12+ years of software engineering experience

Strong communication skills, analytical skills, and project management skills

Preferred Qualifications:

7 - 10+ years’ experience delivering and operating large scale, highly available systems with exposure to low level drivers, firmware and systems debugging.

Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals.

Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures.

Strong experience and detailed technical knowledge in high performance computing and GPU systems.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Leads one or more platform teams; defines tactical and key strategic elements for middleware evolution serving multiple consumers. Accountable for performance, cost control, and reliability outcomes; escalations for distributed debugging and upgrade safety. Drives significant cross-team improvements to observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Engages stakeholders inside and outside the group; socializes migration plans and adoption playbooks.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams.
Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk.
Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements.
Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project.
Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas.
Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions.
Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

Continuous Learning:

Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

Continuous Improvement:

Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

jobs.title: Client Service Delivery Senior Manager – Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and, Interactive, Technology, and Operations services, all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 738,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners, and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com .

CSD is a senior leader responsible for the end-to-end delivery of infrastructure managed services across a portfolio of enterprise clients. Operating across the full infrastructure stack — hybrid cloud, on-premises, network, security, and end-user computing — the SDM serves as the primary executive relationship owner, ensuring contractual SLAs are met, operational excellence is sustained, and client satisfaction drives organic growth. This role combines strategic account leadership with operational governance, requiring a leader who is equally comfortable in a boardroom presenting quarterly business reviews and, on the floor, driving incident resolution with technical teams Additionally, you have the communication and people skills to inspire teams to bring their A-game.

The Work:

Client Relationship & Account Governance

Serve as the senior point of accountability one or more enterprise client accounts across the managed services portfolio.

Lead Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and Quarterly Service Reviews (QSRs), presenting performance data, risks, and improvement roadmaps.

Build trusted advisor relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders (CIO, CTO, CISO) to understand evolving business priorities.

Proactively identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities in alignment with account and sales teams.

Service Delivery & SLA Management

Own end-to-end delivery accountability across hybrid cloud & on-premises, network & and end-user computing services.

Ensure consistent achievement of contractual SLAs, OLAs, and KPIs; drive root cause analysis and remediation for chronic underperformance.

Oversee the ITIL-aligned service management lifecycle including Incident, Problem, Change, and Capacity Management.

Partner with NOC, SOC, and infrastructure operations teams to ensure 24x7 service continuity.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Define and drive service improvement plans (SIPs) aligned to client outcomes and MSP profitability targets.

Champion automation and tooling initiatives to reduce MTTR, manual effort, and cost-to-serve.

Monitor operational dashboards and reporting; translate data into actionable insights for both client and internal audiences.

Financial Management

Own the P&L for assigned client accounts; manage revenue recognition, margin, and cost optimization.

Forecast and manage workforce, licensing, and infrastructure costs in line with contractual commitments.

Identify out-of-scope activity and lead commercial conversations around contract amendments and renewals.

People & Vendor Leadership

Lead a multi-disciplinary delivery team of engineers, analysts, and coordinators (direct and matrix) across the globe.

Set performance objectives, conduct reviews, and build a culture of accountability and continuous learning.

Manage third-party subcontractors and OEM/vendor relationships to ensure integrated service quality.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Required Skills:

Minimum 10+ years in IT infrastructure operations or managed services, with at least 5 years in a client-facing service delivery leadership role.

Minimum 5+ years experience managing full-stack infrastructure environments: hybrid cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP), on-prem data center, network and EUC.

Minimum 5+ years experience managing multi-million-dollar client accounts and P&L ownership within an MSP or outsourcing environment.

Minimum 2+ years experience leading geographically distributed and cross-functional teams in a 24x7 operational model.

Minimum 2+ years experience with infrastructure monitoring, observability platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, SolarWinds), and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points If:

Proficiency in Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)

ITIL v4 Foundation or above

Experience in the Resources Industry, specifically in Energy (Oil and Gas)

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country's largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

Job Description

Position Purpose:

This position is responsible for directing all activities related to the management of the Mid-Atlantic Engineering Department for the successful delivery of the overall capital plan for the region. Projects will include Water and Wastewater Projects, including water treatment upgrades, pump stations, storage tanks, pipelines, and other facilities, and wastewater upgrades related to wastewater plants, lift stations and the collection system.

The candidate works closely with Engineering and Operations personnel, managing and coordinating program activities utilizing a cross functional team approach.

The candidate works with a variety of internal and external stakeholders to ensure the capital plan is developed and delivered to meet the system needs, while working with Regulators on compliance and rate filing activities, and being part of a Team to implement the Company's strategic growth plan.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities

Accountable for delivery of $50M+ of water/wastewater projects annually, including conceptual design/development, coordination of pilot testing, development of the project plans and project delivery through closeout.
Responsible for hiring, supervising, managing, mentoring the Engineering Team.
Works closely with the rate department to develop capital plans and testimony for rate filings as well as testifying before rate commissions as needed.
Support or lead business development efforts and participate in external professional activities that enhance Veolia's standing with state, regional, and national environmental and economic regulators.
Ensure corporate Technical and Environmental Health and Safety/Security standards are incorporated into the design specifications of projects.
Manage environmental and governmental permitting in coordination with local business unit staff.
Support the oversight of construction management personnel to ensure timely completion of assignments, budget compliance and adherence to applicable standards.
Drive efficiency into project delivery through the monitoring of delivery metrics and utilization of alternate procurement and delivery methods.
Provide monthly reports to management regarding the status of capital projects and issues affecting project performance.
Participate in the development of engineering design and delivery processes and standards.
Provide technical expertise on engineering and operational issues and support facility condition assessments for water/wastewater operations.
Ability to work transversally with corporate and local business units.

Work Environment

Successful candidates must be willing to travel to the various business unit sites as per job requirements.
Job sites generally located within a 30-mile radius of the local office with the occasional requirement for sites that are a longer distance.
The Director of Engineering for the Mid-Atlantic region will be based in either Wilmington, DE or Harrisburg, PA, with regular presence required at both office locations.

Qualifications

Education/Experience/Background:

Bachelor's Degree in Civil, Mechanical or Environmental Engineering.
Minimum 15 years of experience managing water/wastewater design and construction projects and upgrade projects for treatment plants, pumping stations, wastewater collection systems and water transmission/distribution systems.
5+ year Experience leading and managing multi-faceted teams.
Experience utilizing alternate project delivery methods (design-build, integrated project delivery) and contracting methods (guaranteed maximum price, reimbursable).

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Thorough working knowledge of water and wastewater processes and system development.
Superior personal effectiveness skills, visible "leadership by example" utilizing participative management involving employees and teamwork whenever possible.
Strong project management skills (initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, controlling and closing).
Strong communication, presentation and reporting skills.
Computer skills (MS Project, Google Suite, Oracle PeopleSoft, Oracle Hyperion or other planning/performance/budgeting tools a plus).
Financial analysis skills, including budget management, ongoing assessment of project risks/opportunities and basic accounting knowledge.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training

Professional Engineer License (PE) required.
PMP and/or Construction Management certifications a plus.

Additional Information

Benefits:
Veolia's comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. Pay and benefits for employees represented by a union are outlined in their collective bargaining agreement.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end-to-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.

If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.

Summary Of The Director, Enterprise Software

The Director of Enterprise Software is a senior technical and people leader responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of Qualifacts’ enterprise services. This role sets the technical vision, raises the bar for engineering excellence, and builds high-performing architecture and development teams.

Responsibilities For The Director, Enterprise Software

Define and evolve the enterprise architecture vision, standards, and guidelines for services and applications; mentor architects, tech leads, and engineering managers to uphold and advance them
Lead and inspire cross-functional engineering teams in close partnership with QA, Product Management, DevOps, and Infrastructure leaders to deliver high-quality software on predictable timelines
Establish and enforce a high bar for non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, security, reliability, observability) and ensure best practices are consistently applied
Own delivery excellence: drive continuous improvements in quality, velocity, and efficiency while reliably meeting commitments
Communicate goals, priorities, responsibilities, and progress clearly and objectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ensure adherence to (and continuous improvement of) internal design, coding, documentation, and architectural standards
Define, track, and act on KPIs that reflect team health, delivery performance, and technical quality.
Identify opportunities to modernize platforms, processes, and tooling; sponsor and lead organizational improvements

Qualifications Of The Director, Enterprise Software

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
7+ years of progressive leadership experience managing software architecture and development teams on large-scale systems and digital transformation initiatives
15+ years of hands-on experience designing and building scalable web and mobile software solutions
Proven experience applying Model-Driven Development (MDD) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in structured delivery environments
Strong background building containerized microservices (.NET Core) and serverless applications (e.g., AWS Lambda)
Hands-on experience with modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI, or equivalent)
Experience with application monitoring and logging platforms (ELK stack, New Relic, Splunk, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications Of The Director, Enterprise Software

Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7 or FHIR strongly preferred)
Prior success modernizing monolithic or legacy systems into cloud-native, microservices-based architectures, preferred
Demonstrated ability to influence product and platform roadmaps through technical insight, preferred

What Success Looks Like For The Director, Enterprise Software

Enterprise services and applications are architecturally sound, highly reliable, and continuously improving
Engineering teams consistently deliver high-quality work with strong predictability and healthy velocity
Architecture and coding standards are actively maintained and elevated by the organization
Strong partnership and trust exist across Product, QA, DevOps, and Infrastructure
Engineering talent is growing in capability and engagement under your leadership

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About The Role

We are looking for a seasoned engineering manager to scale up an established team. This role requires balancing out new product/capability builds with an emphasis on resilience and reliability. Expertise in distributed/financial systems that require high uptime is essential, knowledge around finance systems such as Netsuite is a bonus. The team owns a partner facing product and will require collaboration with product managers as well as go to market teams.

What You'll Do

Provide strategic direction and set up technical vision to raise our bar on reliability, scalability, and availability of our global infrastructure.
Manage cross-functional collaboration with orders, supply chain, finance and other GTM teams to initiate, drive critical business initiatives and deliver with high quality
Mentoring engineers on good architecture choices (tech spec reviews) as well as balancing out stakeholder requirements on latency.
Work with different organizations to build future roadmap alongside evolving business processes.
Build and lead the team through effective recruitment, mentoring, and leadership.

What You Bring

4+ years of experience in managing, leading, and inspiring a team of engineers, including hiring, retaining, and managing performance.
10+ years of work experience in a software engineering role, with proven technical leadership skills and expertise in designing scalable, reliable, and efficient solutions.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
Ability to spot gaps between process and tools, and a strong commitment to close them.
Proficient in agile team software development and strong project management, delivering complex projects within defined timelines and resource constraints.
Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams, communicating effectively, and aligning efforts to achieve common goals.
Experience with Python or Go, and familiarity with backend development flow, including server-side framework and database system.

Nice to Have

Experience with Kubernetes, AWS and Terraform
Experience with Netsuite (or any other ERP)
Experience building long term roadmaps and presenting to Executives.
Hands-on leadership experience managing platform teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
Experience implementing scalable and reliable solutions using modern cloud and DevOps practices.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits

Additional Information

We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

$200,000—$350,000 USD

Location:
Remote, United States
Department:
Product Development

Senior Vice President, Engineering
About Transit Technologies

Transit Technologies is transforming public transportation through modern SaaS platforms, data intelligence, and AI-driven innovation. Our solutions help more than 4,000 transportation organizations improve mobility for millions of riders each year across fixed route, paratransit, microtransit, school transportation, and non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT).
As we continue converging our portfolio of industry-leading products—including Ecolane, FASTER, Passio, TripShot, ByteCurve, and Vestige
—into a unified TransitOS
platform, we're building an engineering organization capable of delivering the next generation of transit technology.
We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys building high-performing teams, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering software that powers mission-critical transportation services.

Position Overview

The Director, Engineering – TransitOS
is responsible for the engineering delivery, technical execution, and overall health of Transit Technologies' demand-responsive product portfolio, including OnDemand, Paratransit, NEMT, and BrokerLink
.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys balancing people leadership with technical leadership. You'll lead engineering teams while remaining engaged in architecture discussions, design reviews, code quality, and technical decision-making.
You'll oversee approximately 10–15 software engineers, technical leads, and QA engineers
across both onshore and offshore teams while partnering closely with Product Management, Architecture, and peer Engineering leaders to deliver scalable, reliable software supporting transportation providers across North America.

What You'll Do

Lead High-Performing Engineering Teams

Build, lead, coach, and develop engineering and QA teams across multiple product lines.
Recruit, hire, onboard, and mentor exceptional engineering talent.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
Conduct regular coaching conversations, performance reviews, and career development planning.
Establish clear ownership across engineering teams while promoting strong cross-functional collaboration.

Drive Technical Excellence

Stay actively involved in technical design and engineering decisions.
Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
Help resolve complex technical challenges and remove obstacles for engineering teams.
Define and maintain engineering standards for:
Code quality
Testing
Documentation
Observability
Performance
Maintainability
Partner closely with the TransitOS Architecture team to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and platform convergence initiatives.

Deliver High-Quality Software

Own successful delivery of engineering initiatives from planning through production deployment.
Lead Agile planning, sprint execution, and PI planning activities.
Balance delivery of:
Customer-facing enhancements
Technical debt reduction
Platform modernization
Reliability improvements
Strategic convergence initiatives
Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams and shared platform services.

Ensure Reliability & Quality

Champion automated testing and modern QA practices.
Improve production reliability through monitoring, incident management, and operational excellence.
Lead root cause analysis and continuous improvement following production incidents.
Improve release quality while reducing production defects and operational risk.

Partner Across the Business

Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Product Owners to refine requirements and roadmap priorities.
Work with Architecture and Engineering leadership to ensure consistent engineering practices across TransitOS.
Support strategic customer discussions, technical escalations, and RFP activities when engineering expertise is required.

Product Domains You'll Support

This role oversees engineering delivery across Transit Technologies' demand-responsive solutions, including:
OnDemand

Real-time trip booking, routing, optimization, dispatch, rider applications, and driver experiences supporting modern microtransit services.
Paratransit

ADA eligibility, reservations, subscription trips, scheduling, dispatch, compliance, fleet management, and operational workflows.
Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)

Eligibility verification, trip scheduling, claims processing, billing, compliance, and reporting supporting healthcare transportation providers.
BrokerLink

Integration with major NEMT broker networks through APIs and EDI, including trip exchanges, status updates, billing reconciliation, and partner connectivity.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

10+ years of progressive software engineering experience.
4+ years leading engineering organizations delivering enterprise SaaS applications.
Experience managing engineering teams of approximately 10–15 engineers, technical leads, and QA professionals.
Hands-on technical leadership with the ability to participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions.
Proven success delivering scalable cloud-based SaaS products in Agile development environments.
Strong understanding of:
Distributed systems
APIs
Cloud architecture
Data modeling
System integrations
Production operations
Experience leading engineering teams through the complete software development lifecycle.
Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, coaching, and developing engineering talent.
Experience leading geographically distributed engineering organizations, including offshore development teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within public transportation, mobility technology, logistics, or transportation software.
Knowledge of demand-responsive transportation including:
Paratransit
Microtransit
NEMT
Experience with routing, scheduling, dispatch, or optimization platforms.
Familiarity with healthcare transportation, broker integrations, or NEMT workflows.
Experience working with one or more Transit Technologies platforms including:
Ecolane
FASTER
Passio
TripShot
ByteCurve
Vestige
Experience supporting public-sector customers or regulated industries.

Why Join Transit Technologies?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of public transportation technology while leading one of the company's most strategic engineering organizations.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Lead engineering for mission-critical transportation solutions used across North America.
Influence the technical direction of TransitOS.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization.
Partner directly with executive leadership on strategic initiatives.
Help modernize the technology powering the future of mobility.

Success in This Role

First 90 Days

Build relationships with engineering teams and key stakeholders.
Gain deep understanding of the OnDemand, Paratransit, NEMT, and BrokerLink platforms.
Assess engineering processes, team structure, and delivery health.
Take ownership of engineering execution and delivery planning.

Within 180 Days

Improve delivery predictability and engineering execution.
Strengthen testing, quality, and production reliability practices.
Fill key hiring needs and establish clear ownership across engineering teams.
Improve operational visibility and engineering performance metrics.

Within One Year

Deliver measurable improvements in software quality, reliability, and delivery velocity.
Successfully execute major roadmap and platform convergence initiatives.
Build a high-performing engineering organization recognized for technical excellence, execution, and customer impact.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Infrastructure Security Engineering - DGX Cloud
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID

JR2024800

Job Category

Engineering

Time Type

Full time

NVIDIA DGX Cloud is the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs. As an Engineering Manager within our Infrastructure Security Engineering organization, you will enable the engineers who secure a GPU fleet numbering in the hundreds of thousands. Your team does not write reports about risk. It engineers whole classes of risk out of existence, and delivers the result as paved roads the rest of DGX Cloud will happily take.

What You Will Be Doing

Grow the Team: Manage, coach, and develop a distributed team of senior security and infrastructure engineers. You own hiring, growth, and performance, and you build a bench deep enough that our capability never rests on one person. Heroics signal a system that needs fixing, so you protect sustainable pace.
Set Technical Direction: Partner with your engineers on the roadmap for our security control plane, our foundational security services, and the path toward autonomous security operations. Leadership owns the mission and the strategy; the team owns the execution.
Deliver Outcomes, Not Tickets: Run a lightweight planning rhythm where the team commits to a result and the reason it matters, then reflects openly on what to change next. We are measured by the risks we eliminate, not the tickets we close.
Assemble Teams Around the Work: Staff each effort with the smallest group who can deliver it, and a clear owner accountable for landing it. Teams form around the work and dissolve when it's done. Make that motion fast, fair, and a real growth opportunity.
Raise the Engineering Bar: Hold a high standard for what "done" means: tested code, observability, operational readiness, and documentation someone who didn't build the system can operate from. AI-assisted work ships with real human ownership behind it.
Communicate Risk Upward: Translate a complex, fast-moving risk picture into something executives can act on. Declare the unknowns honestly, turn risk assessment into measurable themes, and make trade-offs legible to the people funding them.
Multi-Functional Collaboration: Build the partnerships that make the work land. We operate horizontally across vertically organized teams, with influence rather than authority. Your credibility with DGX Cloud platform, SRE, networking, and broader NVIDIA security partners is a delivery mechanism, not a nicety.

What We Need To See

We are looking for high-caliber engineering leaders with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building and growing teams that engineer risk out of existence—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

Engineering Management: Experience (7+ years) managing engineers, within a broader career (14+ years) across software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, or security. You have grown people, not only shipped projects.
Technical Credibility: Enough hands-on depth in infrastructure, distributed systems, or security engineering to earn the trust of senior engineers. You can review a design honestly and recognize when an estimate doesn't add up. You don't need to be the best engineer in the room; you need to build the room.
Hiring and Developing Talent: A history of attracting, hiring, and growing excellent engineers, including people far more expert than you in their domain. You build interview and calibration practices that make hiring repeatable and fair.
Delivery Under Ambiguity: You can take a high-stakes, loosely defined mandate and turn it into sequenced, measurable delivery. You are comfortable proving a model on a few systems first, then using that success to expand.
Cloud-Native and Security Fluency: Working understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), identity and access, policy enforcement, and vulnerability management—enough to build it and ask the questions that matter.
Influence Without Authority: Experience delivering through partner teams you do not own, in environments where relationships, not org charts, determine whether the work ships.
Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

HPC/AI Infrastructure: Experience running teams that secure or operate high-performance computing environments, large GPU fleets, or multi-tenant platforms at cloud scale.
Security as an Internal Product: You have delivered security or infrastructure capabilities with real adoption metrics, where teams took the paved road because it was the easiest path.
Building a Function from Scratch: Experience standing up a team, a practice, or an engineering culture where none existed—charter, agreements, rituals, and all.
Scaling Without Dilution: A history of growing a team quickly while the bar went up rather than down. How have you scaled a team and raised the standard at the same time?

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 248,000 USD - 391,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 4, 2026.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Reach
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Riverside Insights' Potential & Placement vertical has a clear north star: ensure every student with exceptional ability, outstanding potential, or unique learning needs is found as early as possible and given the opportunity to thrive. CogAT and Iowa Assessments are how school districts do that today. Together they're a nearly $50M business already serving 3 million students.

This role is a rare one: building an enterprise-grade platform from the ground up inside an organization with a trusted brand, established product-market fit, and millions of students already served. You're not proving the market exists, you're building the infrastructure that lets it grow.

You won't inherit existing architecture, tech debt, or a team. You'll build all three, on the path to an ambitious target: a 2028 launch and migrating our first million students onto this new platform. This is Director-level scope and ownership, and it's hands-on by design; you're writing code, in the architecture, shoulder to shoulder with your engineers every day. You'll define the technical vision, then build the fully dedicated technical team to execute it, drawing on Riverside's existing talent and new hires you bring in, all within your first 60 days. You'll work closely with your product, psychometrics, and content team members to bring our vision to life.

Make no mistake: this isn't a B2C mobile app. You're architecting a complex platform, with multiple interconnected components, real production volume, built for the workflows of schools and districts, at the security bar of a regulated data environment.

This is a small company mandate inside an established organization. That means a lean, scrappy, agile mindset, moving with real speed and without ego, in pursuit of an industry-changing vision that gets millions more kids found and given the support they need.

This role reports to the Chief Technology Officer.

What You'll Do

Lead the 0-to-1 build. Own architecture, construction, and testing of the Reach platform through a Fall 2027 pilot, and the next-generation CogAT assessment through full 2028 launch.
Architect for B2B scale. Design a complex, multi-component platform built for real production volume and institutional buyers, meeting the compliance bar of a regulated data environment.
Build your team, within 60 days. Get deep on existing systems and the migration plan, then define the team you need and build it, drawing on existing talent and new hires within a 6-10 engineer budget.
Own the first migration wave. Ensure the initial cohort of customers moving onto the new platform gets a day-one experience that's better than what they had, not just a like-for-like switch.
Stay hands-on. Actively coding alongside your team, not reviewing architecture diagrams from a distance.
Own build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls on core technical dependencies, adaptive engine, test delivery, rostering, with clear, cost- and risk-informed recommendations.
Set the standard for AI-native engineering at Riverside, ways of working that let a small team move like a much bigger one.
Own technical roadmap execution. Translate the Product team’s roadmap into a technical plan, sequencing architecture and infrastructure work, including where and how AI gets built into core capabilities like the Reporting Engine.
Partner across the business. Regular demos of working software, transparent updates on progress, risk, and decisions needed.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Has worked as a principal engineer or architect on large, complex, enterprise-grade production systems
Has personally led a 0-to-1, B2B platform build as the senior technical owner
Has built and led a team, combining existing and new hires, to hit an ambitious goal
Has been the senior technical decision-maker on one project for at least 24 months
Experience architecting and scaling production systems on AWS
Experience operating in a regulated data environment (FERPA, COPPA, HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar)
Full-stack fluency, front-end, back-end, architecture, DevOps, and testing
Makes agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development the default way you build, not an add-on

What You'll Bring

Experience building assessment, test-delivery, or other high-stakes data platforms
Experience building data or analytics/reporting platforms at scale
Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or equivalent)
Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into a production product
Entrepreneurial background
Comfortable presenting to and earning buy-in from senior leadership

Physical Requirements

Remote
Travel approximatley 10 times a year for off-site team meetings
May require stationary positions, sitting or standing, for extended periods

DISCLAIMER

The above statements describe the general nature and level of the work performed by people assigned to this work. This list does not cover all possible duties, tasks, or responsibilities. Riverside Insights may amend or change responsibilities to meet the needs of the business and organization as necessary.

Benefits

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?

At Riverside Insights, achieving real results for students and educators is more than talk, it is what we do. As we grow, so will you, offering the chance to expand your skills on an ambitious, solution-focused team. Join us in making great work possible, where your well-being and dedication to making an impact go hand in hand. Job Description

The Director, Infrastructure & Operations is responsible for leading the organization's enterprise technology infrastructure and operational support functions. This role oversees the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continuous improvement of on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with primary emphasis on the reliability, security, scalability, and performance of the organization's on-premises data center and infrastructure environments. The Director leads teams responsible for servers, storage, databases, networks, virtualization platforms, end-user computing, disaster recovery, and cloud services while aligning technology operations with business objectives and regulatory requirements.

include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Infrastructure Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute an infrastructure and operations strategy aligned with business priorities, with on-premises infrastructure as the core environment and cloud services adopted selectively where they provide business value.
Lead modernization initiatives across data centers, compute, storage, networking, database, virtualization, automation, and cloud platforms.
Drive operational excellence, resilience, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
Evaluate relevant technologies and industry trends to support business growth, risk reduction, and long-term sustainability.

Operations & Service Delivery

Working alongside leaders across Technology, Product, UX, Security, Data, and Operations, you'll help shape how engineering delivers value throughout the business while ensuring every investment ultimately improves the customer experience.

the Engineering Managers you develop,

Balance strategic investments with near-term delivery commitments and business priorities.

Align engineering investments with customer needs and business priorities.
Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations with clarity and confidence.
Strengthen planning, prioritization, and execution across complex cross-functional initiatives.
Ensure engineering remains deeply connected to the outcomes that matter most.

Drive Operational Excellence

Continuously improve engineering processes that increase quality, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Scale delivery practices that enable teams to move faster without sacrificing quality.
Champion security, privacy, and compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement through operational metrics, retrospectives, customer feedback, and data-informed decision-making.

You'll Thrive Here If You...

Develop leaders with the same passion you develop technology.
Create clarity where others see complexity.

Balance long-term thinking with disciplined execution.
Communicate effectively with engineers, executives, and business partners alike.
Build alignment without relying on authority.
Care deeply about customer outcomes, engineering excellence, and team health.
Leave every team stronger than you found it.

The best candidates for this role don't simply manage engineering teams—they create environments where exceptional engineers and engineering leaders can thrive.
You'll be successful here if you:
Lead with humility, clarity, and accountability.
Invest in people before processes.
Build trust before driving change.
Challenge ideas while strengthening relationships.
Stay curious, adaptable, and customer-focused.

Make the people around you better.

Why This Role Matters

Every improvement your teams make—whether increasing platform reliability, simplifying the customer experience, accelerating software delivery, or developing future engineering leaders—helps more patients access the healthcare products and services they depend on.
You'll join a company that's investing heavily in technology, committed to developing exceptional leaders, and building an engineering organization where talented people can do the best work of their careers.

jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

This hybrid position requires onsite attendance three days per week at one of our office locations in San Diego, CA, South San Francisco, CA, or Princeton, N
J

Position Summary

The Director, AI Engineering is a strategic technology leader responsible for shaping and advancing the enterprise AI application and agent ecosystem. This role owns the AI platform and agent framework layer that enables scalable, secure, and impactful AI-powered solutions across the organization.

The successful candidate will drive the development of enterprise-grade capabilities including reusable agent templates, multi-agent orchestration, an internal agent publishing platform, self-service RAG solutions, tool and skill registries, prompt management, and evaluation and output validation frameworks. This leader will balance deep technical expertise with a passion for creating intuitive, low-code experiences that empower business users to independently build and deploy AI solutions.

Partnering closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders, the Director will ensure the AI platform remains secure, governed, scalable, and aligned with organizational objectives while delivering measurable business value and accelerating AI adoption across the enterprise.

Primary Responsibilities

Architect and maintain the enterprise agent platform - the system through which agents are developed, published, versioned, and coordinated, using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Anthropic Agents SDK, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
Engineer multi-agent coordination patterns enabling agents with distinct roles, data access, and functional scope to collaborate reliably on complex, multi-step business workflows.
Design and implement reusable agent templates, composable orchestration primitives, and agentic memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) that development teams and non-engineers can configure and deploy.
Build human-in-the-loop (HITL) escalation workflows and clearly defined agent action boundaries to ensure appropriate human oversight at high-risk decision points.
Lead the design and delivery of a self-service RAG builder, including ingestion pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector store integration, hybrid retrieval, and reranking surfaced through a low-code interface accessible to non-technical users.
Build and operate an enterprise tool and skill registry: a versioned catalog of APIs, functions, MCP servers, and data connectors that agents can securely discover and invoke, with schema contracts, authentication, and access controls.
Establish and manage the enterprise prompt management system with versioning, governance workflows, A/B testing, rollback capabilities, and domain-specific prompt libraries for commercial, medical, and R&D functions.
Own the evaluation and benchmarking methodology for agentic systems. Design rigorous, quantitative eval suites covering accuracy, faithfulness, groundedness, task completion, latency, cost, and safety. Implement automated regression detection in production.
Design and implement multi-layer guardrail frameworks including input/output validation, content moderation, hallucination detection, policy enforcement, and agent permission scoping aligned with AI governance policy and regulatory requirements.
Apply product thinking and user-centered design to platform tooling; track adoption metrics, gather user feedback, and iterate to reduce friction for non-engineer stakeholders across Commercial, Medical Affairs, R&D, and Corporate Functions.
Contribute to the enterprise AI strategy and portfolio roadmap; participate actively in the AI Governance Council providing expertise on agentic risk, safety, and platform governance.
Ensure all engineered solutions comply with global AI regulations, ethical AI standards, data privacy requirements (HIPAA, GDPR), applicable GxP processes, and enterprise security standards.
Mentor engineers and foster a culture of rigorous evaluation, responsible experimentation, and continuous improvement across the AI team.
Other responsibilities as assigned.

Education/Experience/Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred
8+ years of experience in AI/ML, software engineering, or a related field, including 4+ years of current, hands-on experience building production-grade agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications
Experience delivering self-service or platform tooling adopted by non-technical users
Expert-level proficiency with at least two major agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Anthropic Agents SDK, or OpenAI Agents SDK, including framework customization and development
Expert-level experience designing and implementing RAG solutions, including chunking strategies, embedding selection, vector databases, hybrid retrieval, and reranking methodologies
Hands-on experience developing enterprise AI capabilities including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, agent memory systems, human-in-the-loop workflows, tool registries, skill registries, and prompt management platforms
Experience building or integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and exposing enterprise capabilities to AI agents
Proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers, with a strong understanding of LLM architectures and traditional machine learning techniques
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate code generation, and improve engineering productivity
Experience working within regulated environments and AI governance frameworks, including GxP, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, or similar compliance standards
Biopharmaceutical industry experience, including familiarity with commercial, medical, research, clinical, or market access functions and relevant healthcare data sources
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed
An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered
Other duties as assigned

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedules or business needs.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for discretionary bonus and equity awards based on factors such as individual and organizational performance. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

Salary Range

$201,800—$252,300 USD

What we offer US-based Employees:

Competitive base, bonus, new hire and ongoing equity packages
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Employer-paid life, disability, business travel and EAP coverage
401(k) Plan with a fully vested company match 1:1 up to 5%
Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 2-year purchase price lock-in
15+ vacation days
13 -15 paid holidays, including office closure between December 24th and January 1st
10 days of paid sick time
Paid parental leave benefit
Tuition assistance

Create, implement an IPM program.
Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.description:
At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best-in-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.

Job Summary

The Director of Software Engineering is responsible for ensuring quality custom software development by managing software engineering operations, process, standards and rituals. The Director of Software Engineering manages a team practicing adapted Agile development in a DevOps environment. Currently, all infrastructure is infrastructure-as-code hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS); almost all software is written in Elixir. The Director of Software Engineering encompasses technical management, operational planning, mentorship and growth, culture development, internal stakeholder management, internal project management, and ensuring adherence to modern software development principles.

Duties & Responsibilities

Ensure the software engineering function for the department is reliable, secure, and responsive to the needs of internal teams.
Ensure the software engineering standards are documented and communicated throughout the function.
Work closely with the software engineering infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with process and data controls.
Document and share the software engineering operating model.

Manage the financial processes for the engineering function, including reviewing financial statements for accuracy, participate in developing pro forma, inform operating budget, support development of capital improvement project budgets, and approve budgeted procurements.
Provide leadership, guidance, and direction to Deputy Directors, Technical Leads, and senior engineering managers.
Oversee and establish best practices for people management, including retention, hiring, and performance management for the engineering function.
Collaborate with other projects and programs on joint recruitment efforts.
Support the professional development of direct reports and junior staff, including individual contributors and technical leads, helping them navigate their challenges, and ensuring they have the necessary skills and resources. Foster collaboration between different functional groups ensuring that technical staff work effectively with product managers, researchers, writers, and designers.
Inform and incorporate strategic plan goals into team processes, monitor status of action items and report status to stakeholders within the department and across the authority.
Define and articulate standards for software engineering and technology is developed to enhance public service delivery.
Oversee risk mitigation through quality assurance programs and compliance with MBTA policies.
Investigate and report incidents related to safety or quality concerns to appropriate departments.
Partner with MBTA Information Security to maintain compliance and observability standards.
Refine internal policies in line with security best practices and cloud/software development standards.
Be a committed, vocal, collaborative member of Engineering Leadership and push for improvemets in any/all dimensions of our work.
Participate in on-call rotation for technology systems and services.
Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

Supervision

Directly supervise one or more teams of software engineers.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
Seven (7) years of experience in agile software development environment.
Five (5) years of supervisory, managerial, and/or leadership experience.
Experience with 2+ programming languages from the TIOBE top 20.
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).
Experience with APIs / microservices / Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA).
Ability to work in a primarily sedentary environment as significant periods of time spent at a desk and on a screen.

Substitutions

A high school diploma or GED with an additional seven (7) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
An associate’s degree from an accredited institution and an additional three (3) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
A master’s degree in a related subject substitutes for two (2) years of general experience.
A nationally recognized certification, or statewide/professional certification in a related field substitutes for one (1) year of experience.

Preferred Experience & Skills

Management experience directing design-led software development teams (where the digital product is not the core service of the organization as a whole).
Experience in public sector, transportation agency, and/or civic technology team.

Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn's Data Center Engineering organization is responsible for the strategy, design, construction, deployment, operations, and continuous evolution of the infrastructure that powers LinkedIn's global platform. We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Center Engineering to lead a multidisciplinary organization responsible for data center operations, construction and delivery, infrastructure lifecycle management, capacity growth, and critical facilities engineering across a global portfolio.

This leader will provide strategic direction and operational leadership for LinkedIn's data center infrastructure, ensuring world-class reliability, scalability, efficiency, and cost effectiveness. The role requires a blend of executive leadership, technical expertise, program execution, and business acumen to support LinkedIn's rapidly growing compute and AI infrastructure demands.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience leading hyperscale, enterprise, or colocation data center environments and is capable of driving outcomes across engineering, operations, finance, real estate, sourcing, capacity planning, and executive leadership teams. Responsibilities align closely with LinkedIn's current Data Center Engineering portfolio, including operations, design and delivery, provider management, long-term capacity strategy, and advanced cooling initiatives.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

Define and execute LinkedIn's long-term data center engineering strategy, capacity roadmap, and infrastructure growth plans.

Lead global data center operations, engineering, construction, and delivery functions across multiple regions.

Develop organizational priorities, operating models, staffing plans, and investment strategies to support business growth.

Serve as the executive point of contact for data center providers, strategic partners, and senior leadership stakeholders.

Drive innovation across data center design, operational excellence, sustainability, automation, and AI infrastructure readiness.

Data Center Design & Construction

Lead the planning, design, construction, commissioning, and operational handoff of new data center deployments, expansions, and retrofits.

Establish and maintain engineering standards, Basis of Design (BOD) documents, commissioning requirements, and operational readiness processes.

Oversee design reviews of electrical, mechanical, controls, and critical infrastructure systems.

Partner with internal and external teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.

Support site selection efforts, technical due diligence, and infrastructure evaluations for future growth opportunities.

Data Center Operations

Own operational reliability, availability, and performance across LinkedIn's global data center portfolio.

Establish operational standards, maintenance programs, SOPs, EOPs, MOPs, and incident management processes.

Develop KPI-driven operational programs focused on uptime, safety, SLA compliance, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Lead crisis management and executive response during critical infrastructure incidents and service-impacting events.

Ensure facilities operate at peak efficiency while maintaining LinkedIn's resiliency and reliability standards.

Capacity, Provider & Business Management

Partner with Capacity Planning, Hardware Engineering, Networking, and Infrastructure organizations to align infrastructure delivery with future demand.

Lead relationships with colocation providers, contractors, equipment vendors, consultants, and service partners.

Drive lease negotiations, provider governance, business reviews, expansion planning, and commercial decision-making.

Develop annual operating and capital budgets and ensure disciplined execution against financial targets.

Prepare business cases for major investments, infrastructure upgrades, and strategic initiatives.

People Leadership

Lead and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and technical leaders.

Build a culture centered on safety, accountability, operational excellence, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Establish succession plans, talent development strategies, and career growth opportunities across the organization.

Foster strong cross-functional partnerships and alignment across engineering, operations, real estate, sourcing, finance, security, and legal teams.

Emerging Technologies

Lead the evaluation and deployment of next-generation data center technologies, including high-density compute environments and direct liquid cooling solutions.

Drive innovation in monitoring, automation, telemetry, sustainability, and operational efficiency.

Stay informed of industry trends and ensure LinkedIn remains at the forefront of data center engineering practices.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Construction Management, or a related technical field.

15+ years of experience in data center engineering, operations, construction, or critical infrastructure environments.

7+ years of experience leading engineering, operations, or construction teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience managing large-scale data center infrastructure programs across multiple facilities or regions.

Demonstrated expertise in mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure systems.

Experience managing multimillion-dollar capital and operating budgets.

Experience leading vendor, contractor, and colocation provider relationships.

Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Experience in hyperscale or large enterprise data center environments.

Experience with site selection, colocation strategy, lease negotiations, and provider governance.

Experience with liquid cooling, AI infrastructure deployments, and high-density compute environments.

Strong understanding of commissioning, integrated systems testing, and operational readiness processes.

Experience driving large-scale organizational transformation, standardization, and operational improvement programs.

Professional certifications such as PE, CDCE, CDCS, CDCP, PMP, ITIL, Uptime Institute, or equivalent.

Data Center Engineering, Design, and Construction

Data Center Operational Excellence

Data Center Colocation Strategy

Vendor & Contract Management
