jobs.description:
CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

The Mission

Join a high-growth healthcare SaaS provider dedicated to transforming patient outcomes through seamless technology. We’re looking for a strategic platform leader to scale our engineering culture, strengthen our cloud infrastructure, refine our technical roadmap, and mentor a high-performing team.

The Role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will bridge business strategy, product delivery, and reliable technical operations. You will oversee the evolution of our cloud platform, developer tooling, deployment practices, observability platforms, and shared engineering services, with a focus on scalability, reliability, security, team velocity, and developer experience. This role will help mature our GitOps operating model, including ArgoCD-driven Kubernetes delivery, environment consistency, deployment visibility, and auditable change management.

What You’ll Do

Lead & Mentor: Manage and grow a multi-functional platform engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and strong internal customer partnership.
Platform Architecture: Define and guide the architecture of shared platform capabilities, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, GitOps delivery with ArgoCD, observability platforms, identity, developer tooling, and reusable services that support full-stack product teams using C#/.NET, React.js, and SQL Server.
Cloud & Reliability Strategy: Drive our AWS infrastructure strategy, leveraging cloud-native services, automation, containerization, monitoring, and incident response practices for high availability and performance.
Observability & Operational Insight: Champion a modern observability strategy across applications, infrastructure, and data services, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, SLOs, incident response workflows, and executive-level visibility into platform health and customer-impacting reliability trends.
ArgoCD & GitOps Delivery: Establish and improve ArgoCD-based deployment patterns for Kubernetes workloads, ensuring Git remains the source of truth for environment configuration, release promotion, drift detection, rollback, access separation, and auditable production change control.
Compliance First: Ensure all engineering practices meet rigorous security standards (HIPAA, SOC2, & PCI).

jobs.title: Director, GTM Engineering & Systems Architecture
jobs.description:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

The Role

Ironclad is looking for a Director, GTM Engineering & Systems Architecture to build the agentic systems that will run our revenue organization. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead a team of GTM engineers, systems architects, and CRM developers while also building out a team of autonomous agents. You will also personally design and ship the automation and AI agents that take over the manual work our Revenue teams do today.

You’ll be responsible for building out a world class revenue tech stack. The stack is already strong, but we need a leader with both experience and a deep vision for what the future of GTM tech looks like and a passion for driving us there. It’s a unique mix of managing vendor relationships, evaluating new tech, consolidating old tech, and building the connections between our data warehouse, CRM, and the autonomous systems that will run Ironclad’s revenue engine.

We’re adding one GTM Engineer to the team this year, and that’s likely it for a while. The goal is getting more out of agents than out of additional hires. This role owns how Ironclad scales GTM operations globally through automation and AI.

What You’ll Own

Agentic Systems & Automation

Design and deploy autonomous agents to automate GTM workflows across Revenue, taking them from prototype to production systems the business relies on daily.
Own how agents connect to the CRM, the data warehouse, and the rest of the revenue stack, including what data they can see and what actions they’re allowed to take.
Implement essential guardrails, ranging from human-in-the-loop reviews for critical decisions to transparent permissioning, ensuring the team understands and trusts the agents' actions.
Stay ahead of where agentic AI is going, and turn that into what Ironclad builds next.

GTM Tech Stack

Set a multi-year vision roadmap for the tools that run the Revenue org, from forecasting and conversation intelligence to outbound engagement and the rest of the stack.
Keep a close eye on the evolving tech landscape, evaluating consolidation opportunities and identifying when legacy tech becomes obsolete.
Measure the adoption and impact of existing tech, partnering with the enablement team to ensure technology is being fully leveraged. And get the most out of existing tech before exploring further investments.

CRM & CPQ Platform

Own Ironclad’s CRM architecture, including CPQ and how it connects to the rest of the revenue stack.
Understand the voice and needs of the end users, staying close to field teams to ensure the system is meeting their needs.
Constantly stay on the search for ways to simplify and automate elements of the deal cycle, reducing the demand for manual and time consuming data entry.

Team & Technical Leadership

Set a technical bar high enough that you could personally build most of what you’d ask someone else to build.

Team Structure

This role reports to the VP, Revenue Operations & Enablement. It leads GTM engineering, systems architects, and CRM/CPQ administration functions. We’re adding one GTM Engineer this year. Autonomous agent development is a core initiative this role owns directly.

What You Bring

8+ years of hands-on experience building AI systems and managing GTM tech stacks.
A proven track record shipping production AI agents or LLM-powered systems. Comfortable with agent frameworks and building with current models.
Experience leading CRM and CPQ platform teams, including architecture, data model, and governance, at a company with GTM complexity.
A genuine builder. You’re comfortable writing code and shipping systems yourself, not just directing engineers who do.
Experience partnering with Revenue and Finance stakeholders, translating GTM needs into systems people actually adopt.
You have a high-ownership mindset and a low ego. You are comfortable running a team with a big, ambitious mandate.

OTE Range:
$184,000-$230,000

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a highly accomplished and hands-on technology leader to serve as the Head of Corporate Functions Engineering – VP
, responsible for building and leading a world-class engineering organization supporting Human Resources, Legal, Internal Audit, Global Security, Realty, and other Corporate Functions.

This leader will establish and scale a centralized engineering capability that serves as the technical backbone for Corporate Functions Technology. This role will play a critical leadership position in modernizing engineering practices, accelerating AI adoption, increasing delivery capacity, improving operational resilience, and establishing technical centers of excellence across the Corporate Functions portfolio.

Enable business teams to leverage trusted and governed data assets.

Performance testing
Security testing
Release quality controls

Establish engineering quality metrics, standards, and governance processes.
Improve production quality, deployment confidence, and customer experience.

Lead production support functions across the Corporate Functions technology portfolio.
Establish standards for:

Observability
Incident management
Root cause analysis
Problem management
Platform resiliency
Operational readiness

Build a highly effective support organization capable of supporting mission-critical business applications.
Drive improvements in uptime, service quality, support efficiency, and production stability.

Establish specialized engineering teams that can rapidly engage across strategic initiatives and critical technical challenges.
Build expert capabilities supporting:
Custom application development
AI implementation
Data engineering
Cloud engineering
Platform modernization
Performance optimization
Technical debt reduction
Production issue resolution

Provide expert technical resources that can accelerate delivery and solve the organization's most complex problems.
Act as the escalation point for significant technology and engineering challenges.
Talent Development & Organizational Leadership
Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent across multiple technical disciplines.
Build strong career paths across Engineering, AI, Data, Quality Engineering, and Production Support functions.
Develop future engineering leaders and technical experts.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
Establish technical communities of practice and skills development programs.

Must-Have Qualifications

15+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, technology delivery, or platform engineering.
8+ years of leadership experience managing large technical teams and complex engineering organizations.

Experience supporting enterprise platforms across HR, Legal, Audit, Risk, Security, or Corporate Functions domains.
Experience establishing Engineering Centers of Excellence and shared service delivery models.

Experience supporting global engineering teams and distributed delivery models.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

What Success Looks Like

jobs.title: LoopNet - Vice President, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Job Description

CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

LoopNet, the most popular place to find a space, is the #1 global commercial real estate marketplace. With more than 12 million global unique monthly visitors, LoopNet provides brokers, buyers and sellers with what they need to meet and make deals. LoopNet has established itself as the most effective and far-reaching digital marketplace for commercial real estate owners and brokers. We are not done yet! We continue to focus on driving expansion by increasing market share in the US and abroad, continuously innovating and enhancing the product and growing a powerhouse global team to reach our goals.

Learn more about LoopNet.

As the VP of Software Development for LoopNet, you will be responsible for leading all development and delivery of software. Your teams will design, develop, test, debug and implement operating systems components, software tools, and utilities; as well as determine systems software design requirements in addition to ensuring that system improvements are successfully implemented and monitored to increase efficiency. The selected candidate will help transition from current to large new scale systems software engineering policies, standards and procedures at CoStar.

You will work directly with the CEO, CFO, CTO, Senior Product Leadership to define the processes and technology required to support our growing business. In addition, you will provide hands on coaching and development to a team of 80+ software developers.

This role is located in our Irvine, CA office and has a schedule of 4 days on-site and 1 day work from home.

Responsibilities

Act as a player coach with 10+ years of industry experience managing multiple project development teams working on multiple concurrent projects
Coordinate the activities and deliverables across 10-15 teams while resolving issues and ensuring appropriate priorities
Mentor and manage Technical Managers in the normal execution of their responsibilities.
Interact regularly with technology and business executives
Conduct ongoing and in depth needs analysis (approximately 20% of total time) with client to obtain detailed business requirements
Successfully implement software development projects to specification and within scheduled timelines and budget parameters. Ensure proper software development practices are followed and provide guidance and/or assistance when necessary
Provide status reports and feedback to Business Management
Act as release manager to ensure product components are released for production deployment as tested
Work with internal and external clients to document project success criteria
Drive continuous improvement within Scrum team by focusing on engineering excellence
Work with recruiting to identify, hire and onboard top industry talent

jobs.description:
Vidably is building the evidence layer for commerce: verified buyer video, structured with AI, and tied to outcomes.

UGC video contains more product truth than specs, studio media, or text reviews because it shows fit, feel, use-case, and tradeoffs in real contexts. It is how people actually decide what to buy.

Today, the most impactful buyer video lives on platforms like TikTok and Reels, disconnected from product pages, outcomes, and brand control. Vidably brings that content onto owned commerce surfaces, uses AI to turn it into structured, SKU-level evidence, and measures what actually drives conversion. We share incremental value with creators, which unlocks far more high-quality buyer video and a system that learns what matters for each product.

This is the missing input for shopping agents. The same signals humans use to buy confidently are the signals an agent needs to recommend, compare, and explain products with real evidence, not guesswork.

Visibly is backed and supported by AI Fund. Founded by Andrew Ng, AI Fund is backed by over $370 million. As a venture studio, AI Fund works alongside entrepreneurs, venture funds, and corporate partners to build new companies rapidly and increase their odds of success.

This is an early-stage, hands-on role. You will own engineering end-to-end and make Vidably self-serve and reliable across real Shopify storefronts. Real storefronts are messy. Legacy themes and script conflicts are normal. We design for that.

Responsibilities for the Role Include:

Own the codebase and technical direction: architecture, quality bar, shipping cadence, production reliability
Own and evolve a live Shopify app and storefront integration, hardening it across OS 2.0 and legacy theme realities with safe rollouts and easy rollback
Extend the mobile web creator upload flow with Mux: QR → prompt → record/upload → consent →submit
Turn content readiness from manual workflows into product: review/approve/publish, SKU mapping, internal tooling to automation

s Like:

Onboarding new customers becomes boring and repeatable
Founder minutes per merchant drops materially because workflows are productized
We can scale customers without bespoke engineering per store

End-to-end production owner: you design, ship, operate, and debug; you close loops fast
Strong fundamentals: performance, reliability, security, and product/UX judgment (especially on conversion-sensitive surfaces)
AI-native builder: you ship production code with agentic tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, similar)

Thrive in ambiguity and a very small-team environment

We ship primarily in TypeScript today, but we prioritize fundamentals and AI-native

Nice to Haves

Shopify apps/theme integration experience, or embedded widget/SDK experience in hostile third-party environments
Video pipeline familiarity (Mux or similar)
Experimentation/analytics rigor: clean event design, integrity checks, debugging

jobs.description:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

The Role

Ironclad is looking for a Director, GTM Engineering & Systems Architecture to build the agentic systems that will run our revenue organization. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead a team of GTM engineers, systems architects, and CRM developers while also building out a team of autonomous agents. You will also personally design and ship the automation and AI agents that take over the manual work our Revenue teams do today.

You’ll be responsible for building out a world class revenue tech stack. The stack is already strong, but we need a leader with both experience and a deep vision for what the future of GTM tech looks like and a passion for driving us there. It’s a unique mix of managing vendor relationships, evaluating new tech, consolidating old tech, and building the connections between our data warehouse, CRM, and the autonomous systems that will run Ironclad’s revenue engine.

We’re adding one GTM Engineer to the team this year, and that’s likely it for a while. The goal is getting more out of agents than out of additional hires. This role owns how Ironclad scales GTM operations globally through automation and AI.

What You’ll Own

Agentic Systems & Automation

Design and deploy autonomous agents to automate GTM workflows across Revenue, taking them from prototype to production systems the business relies on daily.
Own how agents connect to the CRM, the data warehouse, and the rest of the revenue stack, including what data they can see and what actions they’re allowed to take.
Implement essential guardrails, ranging from human-in-the-loop reviews for critical decisions to transparent permissioning, ensuring the team understands and trusts the agents' actions.
Stay ahead of where agentic AI is going, and turn that into what Ironclad builds next.

GTM Tech Stack

Set a multi-year vision roadmap for the tools that run the Revenue org, from forecasting and conversation intelligence to outbound engagement and the rest of the stack.
Keep a close eye on the evolving tech landscape, evaluating consolidation opportunities and identifying when legacy tech becomes obsolete.
Measure the adoption and impact of existing tech, partnering with the enablement team to ensure technology is being fully leveraged. And get the most out of existing tech before exploring further investments.

CRM & CPQ Platform

Own Ironclad’s CRM architecture, including CPQ and how it connects to the rest of the revenue stack.
Understand the voice and needs of the end users, staying close to field teams to ensure the system is meeting their needs.
Constantly stay on the search for ways to simplify and automate elements of the deal cycle, reducing the demand for manual and time consuming data entry.

Team & Technical Leadership

Set a technical bar high enough that you could personally build most of what you’d ask someone else to build.

Team Structure

This role reports to the VP, Revenue Operations & Enablement. It leads GTM engineering, systems architects, and CRM/CPQ administration functions. We’re adding one GTM Engineer this year. Autonomous agent development is a core initiative this role owns directly.

What You Bring

8+ years of hands-on experience building AI systems and managing GTM tech stacks.
A proven track record shipping production AI agents or LLM-powered systems. Comfortable with agent frameworks and building with current models.
Experience leading CRM and CPQ platform teams, including architecture, data model, and governance, at a company with GTM complexity.
A genuine builder. You’re comfortable writing code and shipping systems yourself, not just directing engineers who do.
Experience partnering with Revenue and Finance stakeholders, translating GTM needs into systems people actually adopt.
You have a high-ownership mindset and a low ego. You are comfortable running a team with a big, ambitious mandate.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Software Engineering Management - AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

This role is for a senior engineering manager who leads a high-performing team of software engineers building AI-native and cloud-native applications on the ServiceNow platform. The Senior Manager combines deep technical credibility with strong people management capabilities, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. They are responsible for team performance, career development, hiring, and execution of key business initiatives. This role requires the ability to balance people development with business results, think strategically about AI integration and platform architecture, and influence across the organization to enable team success. The ideal candidate brings experience scaling AI-native teams and a passion for building leaders.

Responsibility Area: People Leadership & Development

Build, grow, and maintain a high-performing, diverse team of IC2-IC5 engineers; hire and develop talent at all levels
Set clear expectations for individual and team performance; establish metrics and goals aligned with business objectives
Conduct regular 1:1s with direct reports; provide coaching, feedback, and career guidance tailored to each engineer's growth stage
Create a culture of psychological safety, learning, and ownership; encourage experimentation and learning from failures
Support engineers through career transitions—from IC2 to IC3, IC3 to IC4, and technical-to-management pathways
Identify high-potential engineers and invest in their development; prepare emerging leaders for increased responsibility
Address performance issues promptly and professionally; provide clear paths for improvement or transition
Sponsor team members for growth opportunities, stretch assignments, and leadership development programs
Celebrate wins and recognize contributions; foster a positive, collaborative team environment
Model vulnerability, continuous learning, and AI-native thinking; lead by example in your own growth

Responsibility Area: Hiring & Team Building

Define hiring strategy and conduct recruitment for open positions; build a pipeline of qualified candidates
Lead technical interviews and assessments for engineering candidates at all IC levels; make hiring decisions
Partner with HR and recruiting teams on job descriptions, sourcing strategies, and candidate pipeline management
Evaluate cultural fit and potential; hire for values and growth potential, not just current skills
Onboard new engineers effectively; assign mentors and ensure smooth integration into the team
Build a team with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives; actively work to improve representation
Identify gaps in team capabilities (technical depth, domain expertise, AI/ML fluency) and address through hiring or development
Build relationships with external technical communities to attract and recruit top talent
Participate in employer branding and represent the organization at recruiting events and universities
Responsibility Area: Technical Strategy & Product Leadership
Work with product, design, and cross-functional partners to define product roadmap and technical strategy aligned with business goals
Establish technical direction for the team; make architecture and technology decisions that balance innovation, quality, and delivery
Ensure the team's technical approach stays current with AI/ML advancements and ServiceNow platform evolution
Champion AI-native thinking across the team and organization; help teammates understand how to build with AI at the core
Lead architectural reviews and technical decision-making; provide guidance on complex technical trade-offs
Advocate for technical investments (refactoring, infrastructure, tooling) that improve team productivity and code quality
Set quality standards for code, testing, and security; establish practices that enable sustainable delivery
Partner with IC4/IC5 engineers to set multi-year technical roadmaps and long-term strategic initiatives
Represent the engineering team in product and executive discussions; influence organizational priorities

Responsibility Area: Team Execution & Accountability

Drive team delivery of committed business objectives and product initiatives; maintain accountability for results
Establish clear sprint goals, work-item prioritization, and delivery timelines; remove blockers for team success
Track team metrics: velocity, quality, customer satisfaction, incident response, deployment frequency
Conduct regular retrospectives; identify process improvements and drive adoption of better practices
Manage team capacity; balance new feature development, technical debt reduction, and customer support
Ensure team participation in on-call rotation; monitor incident response and post-incident learning
Report on team progress, risks, and performance to senior leadership; provide transparent communication
Escalate critical issues or resource constraints; collaborate with peer managers to solve cross-team dependencies
Foster a culture of ownership where engineers take responsibility for quality, testing, and production outcomes
Lead team through organizational changes and initiatives; maintain morale and focus during transitions

Responsibility Area: Customer & Cross-Functional Engagement

Build and maintain relationships with key customers and stakeholders; understand their needs and priorities
Participate in customer meetings, technical escalations, and business reviews; represent engineering capabilities and constraints
Work closely with product management, customer success, and other teams; ensure alignment on priorities and capabilities
Lead customer-critical incident response; ensure timely and professional resolution of critical issues
Gather customer feedback and translate into product improvements; communicate back to customers how feedback is addressed
Advocate for customers' needs within the engineering organization; ensure customer voice is heard in decision-making
Build trust and credibility with customers through transparency, responsiveness, and technical leadership
Participate in strategic customer discussions and technology roadmap reviews

Responsibility Area: Organizational Leadership & Culture

Model the organization's values and desired behaviors; set tone for engineering culture within your team and across teams
Contribute to hiring and interview training of other managers; build bench strength in people leadership
Mentor junior managers or peers; contribute to manager development and leadership pipeline
Participate in engineering leadership meetings; contribute to organizational strategy and policy
Promote psychological safety, inclusion, and belonging; actively work to reduce barriers for underrepresented groups
Foster knowledge sharing across the organization; encourage your team to contribute to brown bags, documentation, and communities
Lead by example in work-life balance, continuous learning, and sustainable pace; prevent burnout
Encourage your team to engage with the broader tech community (conferences, open source, speaking, writing)

Responsibility Area: AI-Native Thinking & Innovation Leadership

Develop deep understanding of AI/ML capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns; become a thought leader on AI-native development
Coach your team on AI-native thinking—how to build systems with AI at the core, not as an afterthought
Help engineers understand prompt engineering, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and responsible AI principles
Establish practices for evaluation-driven development, hallucination detection, and model performance monitoring
Lead discussions on AI safety, data privacy, and responsible AI; ensure team builds with appropriate guardrails
Create learning opportunities for the team to stay current with AI/ML advancements and frameworks
Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve internal processes and team efficiency
Contribute to organizational conversations about AI strategy and responsible AI practices
Stay informed about LLM advancements, new models, and emerging techniques; share insights with your team

Qualifications

12+ years of professional software development experience, with 5+ years in AI-native systems, cloud-native architecture, or equivalent
4+ years of people management experience leading software engineers; track record of developing talent and building high-performing teams
3+ years managing application development on SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar); deep understanding of platform architecture and constraints
3+ years hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices
Demonstrated expertise in hiring, team building, and organizational development; ability to attract and develop top talent
Expert-level understanding of modern software engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, security, deployment
Strong technical credibility; ability to engage in technical discussions with IC4/IC5 engineers; hands-on coding experience still valued
Deep proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript; understanding of ServiceNow scripting and platform APIs
Track record of delivering significant business results through engineering teams; ability to drive accountability and execution
Experience scaling teams and organizations; demonstrated ability to work at multiple levels of complexity
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong coaching and mentoring skills; ability to develop engineers across all career stages
Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies; ability to adapt to team and organizational needs
Demonstrated understanding of data security, compliance, and responsible AI practices
Strong emotional intelligence; ability to navigate difficult conversations and build trust
Experience with performance management, feedback delivery, and difficult personnel decisions
Passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams where all engineers can thrive
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or related field
Experience leading teams through organizational change, technical migrations, or strategic initiatives
MBA or management certification is a plus; however, demonstrated people leadership capability is more important
Track record of developing talent into senior engineering leadership roles or managers
Active engagement with engineering and AI/ML communities; thought leadership through speaking, writing, or open source is a plus
Experience working with diverse teams and commitment to building inclusive organizations

, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. jobs.title: Director, Sales Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About The Role

This role is the tip of the spear for Flex's largest, most complex, and most strategically important deals. As we expand into new verticals and new enterprise relationships, we need a technical sales leader who can do more than present a demo. You'll own the solution layer of the sales process end-to-end: translating complex customer environments into winning proposals, building conviction with technical and executive stakeholders alike, ensuring that what we promise is something we can actually deliver, and working with Product & Engineering teams to ensure customer needs are a key input to internal roadmaps.

This is the founding hire for Flex's New Verticals Solution Engineering function. You'll start as a hands-on, high-impact operator with Director-level scope, and you'll build the foundation the function scales on: the playbooks, the demo environments, the discovery frameworks, and the hiring plan. As new vertical pipeline matures, you will recruit, hire, and lead a team of Solution Engineers, with a defined path to formal people leadership of the SE organization. We are looking for someone who wants to earn that mandate by winning deals first, then scale themselves through a team.

What You'll Do

Own the technical sale on our largest, most complex deals: Lead solution engineering activity for Flex's highest-priority opportunities in new verticals, from discovery and scoping through proof-of-concept, technical validation, and close.
Build trust with technical and executive buyers: Engage executive stakeholders at prospective partners. Translate Flex's capabilities into business outcomes that resonate at the board level and in the weeds equally.
Architect solutions that win and scale: Deeply understand each prospect's technology, data environment, and operational requirements. Design integration and deployment approaches that are commercially compelling and technically sound, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Flex Engineering to validate feasibility before we commit.
Drive proof-of-concept and pilot execution: Lead structured POCs and pilots that de-risk the decision for the customer and accelerate time-to-close. Define success criteria, coordinate Product and Engineering resources, manage execution, and turn results into momentum.
Partner with Sales to shape deal strategy: Function as a true co-owner of the deal alongside the Account Executive, contributing to account strategy, surfacing risks, and helping design the right commercial and technical structure.
Build the New Verticals SE function, not just the playbook: Document discovery frameworks, integration patterns, objection handling, and competitive differentiation as we enter each new vertical. Create reusable assets (demo environments, solution briefs, RFP libraries) that raise the floor for future deals and make every SE hire behind you productive faster.
Define and execute the SE hiring plan: Build the business case for headcount as vertical pipeline scales. Own the hiring bar: write role profiles, design the interview process, recruit, and onboard the first Solution Engineers on the team.
Grow into leading the team: As the function scales, transition from founding IC to player-coach to people leader. Set the operating rhythm, coach SEs on deal execution, and own quality across the SE motion in new verticals.
Partner deeply with Product and Engineering: Operate as the connective tissue between the field and the build. Synthesize technical feedback from deals into structured, prioritized product input, align Engineering on customer requirements during active cycles, and influence the roadmap by making the business case for what new verticals require.
Shape how Flex shows up in market: Partner with Marketing and Business Development on technical content, event presence, and thought leadership that builds Flex's credibility with enterprise buyers in new segments.

Key Qualifications

10+ years of experience in pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales, with at least 4 years operating in a senior or lead capacity on complex enterprise deals.
Demonstrated track record closing large, multi-stakeholder, technically complex sales cycles, ideally in FinTech, PropTech, payments, or adjacent SaaS/infrastructure categories.
Experience building or scaling an SE or technical pre-sales function: hiring SEs, developing talent, and establishing the processes and assets a team runs on. Formal people management experience is a strong plus; demonstrated readiness and ambition to lead a team is required.
Exceptional ability to engage and build credibility with C-suite and VP-level technical buyers; equally comfortable in a boardroom and in a technical architecture review.
Deep fluency in enterprise integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, ERP/property management system ecosystems) with the ability to get hands-on when needed.
Strong commercial instincts: ability to shape deal structure, anticipate objections, and understand how technical decisions affect economics on both sides of the table.
Experience operating in a greenfield or early-stage vertical context. Comfortable building process, playbooks, and teams from scratch rather than inheriting them.
Track record of functioning as a cross-functional bridge: influencing product roadmaps, aligning engineering teams to customer requirements, and partnering closely with marketing and BD.
Outstanding written and verbal communication; the ability to distill complex technical and financial concepts into clear, persuasive narratives for diverse audiences.
High ownership orientation: someone who treats the customer's success as their own, moves urgently without needing to be told to, and multiplies their impact through the people they hire and develop.
FinTech, real estate technology, or multi-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) and Tier 3 (Salt Lake City) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)

$232,000—$290,000 USD

Tier 3 (Salt Lake City)

$197,200—$246,500 USD

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

Competitive medical, dental, and vision

401(k) plan with company match

jobs.description:
Remote – US

Transform healthcare with us.

At Qualified Health, we're redefining what's possible with Generative AI in healthcare. Our infrastructure provides the guardrails for safe AI governance, healthcare-specific agent creation, and real-time algorithm monitoring—working alongside leading health systems to drive real change.

This is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to build the future of AI in healthcare, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on patient care. If you're ambitious, innovative, and ready to move fast, we'd love to have you on board.

Join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Summary

Qualified Health is seeking a Director of Epic Forward Deployed Engineering to build and lead the team that sits at the intersection of our AI platform and the health systems we serve. This is not a project management role—it’s a technical leadership position for someone who has lived inside Epic implementations, knows how health system IT and clinical informatics teams operate, and can credibly design integration solutions in front of a CMIO or Epic interface team. You will build and run a pod of Epic Forward Deployed Engineers embedded at our client sites, owning the end-to-end journey from Epic workflow discovery through live production delivery of AI-powered clinical tools.

Key Responsibilities

Build and lead a team of Epic Forward Deployed Engineers, setting hiring standards, mentoring the team, and establishing the playbook for how QH integrates with health system Epic environments
Serve as executive technical sponsor for 2–3 strategic health system clients, owning the integration relationship at the CIO, CMIO, and Epic Principal Trainer level
Lead solution design sessions with client Epic and clinical informatics teams to map AI output delivery paths—CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR sidebars, In Basket via SendMessage API, HL7 MDM T02 via Epic Bridges, and FHIR R4 write-back
Own the interface delivery roadmap for each client, managing calendar-driven dependencies (Epic interface configuration is the long pole) and setting realistic expectations internally and externally
Translate client clinical workflow requirements into clear platform specifications for QH’s data engineering and product teams
Establish and maintain a reusable integration playbook across Epic modules (MyChart, Ambulatory, ClinDoc, Bridges) so each new client engagement starts faster than the last
Represent QH at client governance forums, steering committees, and executive briefings
Collaborate with internal Data and Product Engineering teams to align forward deployed integration work with the core platform roadmap

Required Qualifications

8+ years in healthcare IT, Epic implementation, or clinical informatics, with at least 2 years in a leadership or principal role
Deep, hands-on experience with Epic’s integration ecosystem: Bridges (HL7 v2 interfaces), SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks, MyChart, and In Basket / SendMessage API
Proven track record running Epic go-lives or directing implementations at Epic partner organizations, Epic consulting firms, or large health systems
Executive-level communication—comfortable presenting architecture decisions to a health system CTO, facilitating workflow design sessions with clinical champions, and debugging interface issues with an Epic analyst in the same day
Experience managing client relationships end-to-end, including scope negotiation, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment across large, matrixed health system organizations
Familiarity with FHIR R4 interoperability standards and modern EHR integration patterns
Bachelor’s degree in a technical, clinical, or healthcare-related field

Preferred Skills

Epic certification in one or more modules (Bridges, Ambulatory, ClinDoc, MyChart, Orders)
Experience deploying or designing SMART on FHIR applications in production Epic environments
Background in clinical decision support design or clinical informatics roles inside a health system
Familiarity with healthcare AI or clinical NLP applications (e.g., risk stratification, autonomous coding, prior authorization)
Experience working across multiple EHR platforms beyond Epic (Cerner, Athenahealth, etc.)

What Success Looks Like

A repeatable, documented integration playbook that reduces time-to-live for each new client by 30%+ compared to baseline
Client Epic and clinical informatics teams who trust QH as a credible technical partner—not just a vendor
A Forward Deployed Engineering team that is proactive—identifying Epic configuration issues before they block delivery, not after
Clear, consistent feedback loops from the field into the product and data engineering teams

Impact & Growth Opportunity

This role is central to QH’s ability to scale. Every health system we serve runs Epic. Getting AI outputs into Epic workflows—trusted by clinicians, embedded in the right moment of care—is where clinical impact actually happens. The Director of Epic Forward Deployed Engineering owns that last mile. As QH scales to 100K+ users across 50+ health systems, this team and the playbooks you build will be a core competitive differentiator. The growth path from this role extends into VP-level technical leadership or a Chief Integration Officer function as the organization matures.

Why Join Qualified Health?

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a world-class team, that is poised to change the healthcare industry. We are a passionate, mission-driven team that is building a category-defining product. We are backed by premier investors and are looking for founding team members who are excited to do the best work of their careers.

Our employees are integral to achieving our goals so we are proud to offer competitive salaries with equity packages, robust medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible working hours, hybrid work options and an inclusive environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we live in. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Pay & Benefits:
The pay range for this role is between $190,000 and $240,000, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Director, GPU Supply and Strategic Partnerships (GPU Supply / Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
The Role

We are hiring a senior director to build, scale, and lead a global GPU supply organization as we have more active enterprise demand than we can currently fill organically.
This role is responsible for sourcing, securing, and activating NVIDIA GPU capacity at scale, which means finding the prospects, building the relationships, creating the deal structures, and hiring the internal team that will make that happen. You will operate at the C-level with data center operators and AI infrastructure owners, move quickly when supply becomes available, and build a function from the ground up.

We need someone who can source, engage, and close supply in a way that scales.

What You’ll Do

Supply Team Leadership and Market position

Own and develop strategic relationships with data center operators, GPU neoclouds, colocation providers, bare metal providers and AI infrastructure owners at the executive level
Represent the company externally as a senior supply-side leader, building durable partnerships that create preferential access and pricing advantage
Contribute to defining company’s position in the market ecosystem
Build, manage, and develop a high-performing supply team responsible for day-to-day sourcing, qualification, and activation of GPU capacity
Define team structure, workflows, and KPIs; establish repeatable systems for onboarding and managing supply partners at scale
Coach and develop team members to operate with speed, technical depth, and commercial judgment

Supply Strategy and Execution

Set supply strategy across geographies (US, EU, APAC), architectures (GB300, B300, H100, H200, and emerging GPUs like Vera Rubin), and deployment environments
Build and leverage a global network of GPU providers, including data centers, GPU neoclouds, bare metal operators, and AI infrastructure owners
Work directly with sales and solutions engineering to fulfill active pipeline by matching workload requirements (region, GPU, quantity, prepayment, price target) with available infrastructure
Evaluate infrastructure in detail, including network fabric (InfiniBand vs. RoCE vs. Ethernet), cluster topology, shared storage availability, CPU node availability, internet speeds, SLAs, and deployment readiness
Track real-time market pricing, regional supply dynamics, and availability constraints; act quickly to secure advantaged supply
Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, including pricing models, contract terms, SLAs, support, and where relevant, exclusivity or priority access
Identify and unlock non-obvious or underutilized sources of GPU capacity
Build repeatable systems for sourcing, onboarding, and activating supply partners at scale, including automation of outreach using AI tools
Partner with leadership to shape supply strategy, including geographic expansion, supplier concentration, and margin optimization

What Success Looks Like

A cohesive, high-performing supply team operating with speed and precision
Strategic data center and AI infrastructure relationships that create durable, differentiated access to GPU capacity
Consistently securing high-quality GPU supply that meets technical and commercial requirements of active deals
Increasing win rates and deal velocity through reliable, responsive supply coverage

jobs.title: Director, Sales Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About The Role

This role is the tip of the spear for Flex's largest, most complex, and most strategically important deals. As we expand into new verticals and new enterprise relationships, we need a technical sales leader who can do more than present a demo. You'll own the solution layer of the sales process end-to-end: translating complex customer environments into winning proposals, building conviction with technical and executive stakeholders alike, ensuring that what we promise is something we can actually deliver, and working with Product & Engineering teams to ensure customer needs are a key input to internal roadmaps.

This is the founding hire for Flex's New Verticals Solution Engineering function. You'll start as a hands-on, high-impact operator with Director-level scope, and you'll build the foundation the function scales on: the playbooks, the demo environments, the discovery frameworks, and the hiring plan. As new vertical pipeline matures, you will recruit, hire, and lead a team of Solution Engineers, with a defined path to formal people leadership of the SE organization. We are looking for someone who wants to earn that mandate by winning deals first, then scale themselves through a team.

What You'll Do

Own the technical sale on our largest, most complex deals: Lead solution engineering activity for Flex's highest-priority opportunities in new verticals, from discovery and scoping through proof-of-concept, technical validation, and close.
Build trust with technical and executive buyers: Engage executive stakeholders at prospective partners. Translate Flex's capabilities into business outcomes that resonate at the board level and in the weeds equally.
Architect solutions that win and scale: Deeply understand each prospect's technology, data environment, and operational requirements. Design integration and deployment approaches that are commercially compelling and technically sound, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Flex Engineering to validate feasibility before we commit.
Drive proof-of-concept and pilot execution: Lead structured POCs and pilots that de-risk the decision for the customer and accelerate time-to-close. Define success criteria, coordinate Product and Engineering resources, manage execution, and turn results into momentum.
Partner with Sales to shape deal strategy: Function as a true co-owner of the deal alongside the Account Executive, contributing to account strategy, surfacing risks, and helping design the right commercial and technical structure.
Build the New Verticals SE function, not just the playbook: Document discovery frameworks, integration patterns, objection handling, and competitive differentiation as we enter each new vertical. Create reusable assets (demo environments, solution briefs, RFP libraries) that raise the floor for future deals and make every SE hire behind you productive faster.
Define and execute the SE hiring plan: Build the business case for headcount as vertical pipeline scales. Own the hiring bar: write role profiles, design the interview process, recruit, and onboard the first Solution Engineers on the team.
Grow into leading the team: As the function scales, transition from founding IC to player-coach to people leader. Set the operating rhythm, coach SEs on deal execution, and own quality across the SE motion in new verticals.
Partner deeply with Product and Engineering: Operate as the connective tissue between the field and the build. Synthesize technical feedback from deals into structured, prioritized product input, align Engineering on customer requirements during active cycles, and influence the roadmap by making the business case for what new verticals require.
Shape how Flex shows up in market: Partner with Marketing and Business Development on technical content, event presence, and thought leadership that builds Flex's credibility with enterprise buyers in new segments.

Key Qualifications

10+ years of experience in pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales, with at least 4 years operating in a senior or lead capacity on complex enterprise deals.
Demonstrated track record closing large, multi-stakeholder, technically complex sales cycles, ideally in FinTech, PropTech, payments, or adjacent SaaS/infrastructure categories.
Experience building or scaling an SE or technical pre-sales function: hiring SEs, developing talent, and establishing the processes and assets a team runs on. Formal people management experience is a strong plus; demonstrated readiness and ambition to lead a team is required.
Exceptional ability to engage and build credibility with C-suite and VP-level technical buyers; equally comfortable in a boardroom and in a technical architecture review.
Deep fluency in enterprise integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, ERP/property management system ecosystems) with the ability to get hands-on when needed.
Strong commercial instincts: ability to shape deal structure, anticipate objections, and understand how technical decisions affect economics on both sides of the table.
Experience operating in a greenfield or early-stage vertical context. Comfortable building process, playbooks, and teams from scratch rather than inheriting them.
Track record of functioning as a cross-functional bridge: influencing product roadmaps, aligning engineering teams to customer requirements, and partnering closely with marketing and BD.
Outstanding written and verbal communication; the ability to distill complex technical and financial concepts into clear, persuasive narratives for diverse audiences.
High ownership orientation: someone who treats the customer's success as their own, moves urgently without needing to be told to, and multiplies their impact through the people they hire and develop.
FinTech, real estate technology, or multi-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. We have successfully navigated the "0 to 1" journey and are now scaling Agentforce for Supply Chain from 1 to 100. This involves moving beyond a single-stack startup architecture into a sophisticated, multi-environment global operation that serves the world’s largest enterprises and government entities.

This is a unique leadership opportunity to manage the production excellence of a high-growth AI product while balancing a complex technical landscape: from our modern Salesforce-native deployment to legacy environments and highly specialized custom deployments for global tier-one customers.

What You’ll Do

As the Director of Production Support Engineering, you will be the strategic leader and people manager for our embedded reliability organization. You will lead a high-caliber team of Lead and Principal Engineers (LMTS/PMTS) who are integrated directly into the product lifecycle.

Your challenge is one of orchestration and strategy. You will be responsible for defining the roadmap that allows us to scale our commercial Salesforce offering into a multi-region, multi-substrate powerhouse. Simultaneously, you will oversee the stability of our legacy and custom enterprise environments, ensuring our most critical customers receive "five-nines" reliability. You will also be the lead architect for our future, charting the course for Private Cloud Edition (PCE) and Government Cloud offerings that require the highest levels of security and sovereignty.

Responsibilities

Strategic Roadmap & Vision: Devise and champion a long-term infrastructure strategy that balances rapid AI product innovation with the rigorous demands of enterprise-grade reliability and global scale.
People Leadership: Manage and grow a world-class team of Production Support Engineers. You will be responsible for technical mentorship, career development, and maintaining a high-performance, low-ego culture.
Multi-Substrate Scaling: Lead the transition to a multi-region and multi-substrate deployment model within the Salesforce commercial cloud, ensuring our "Super Agent" architecture is resilient across global geographies.
Legacy & Custom Operations: Oversee the maintenance and support of our legacy environments and bespoke customer deployments, ensuring a seamless experience for long-term partners as they transition toward our modern stack.
Compliance & Sovereignty Strategy: Act as the primary stakeholder for our Private Cloud (PCE) and Government Cloud initiatives, ensuring our infrastructure meets strict regulatory and data-residency requirements without sacrificing developer velocity.
Operational Excellence: Define and hold the team accountable to SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. You will lead the "incident-to-insight" loop, ensuring production issues result in structural improvements to the product.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Security leadership to align infrastructure investments with the broader business goals of the Agentforce ecosystem.
Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.
Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.
Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.
Critically evaluate code (Human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in Production Engineering, SRE, or Infrastructure roles, with at least 3-5 years in a formal people management capacity.
Deep Technical Roots: You must remain highly technical. You are comfortable reviewing architecture designs for Kubernetes, Terraform, and distributed databases (PostgreSQL), and you understand the operational nuances of AI/GPU workloads.
Experience at Scale: A proven track record of managing production environments through a "1 to 100" scaling phase, ideally in a multi-region or multi-cloud context.
Strategic Clarity: Demonstrated ability to articulate a complex technical vision and turn it into an actionable roadmap that stakeholders can rally behind.
Enterprise Savvy: Experience supporting "Big Iron" enterprise customers with custom deployment needs and high-compliance requirements.
High-Stakes Leadership: Proven ability to lead through major incidents and complex architectural migrations with a calm, decisive approach.
AI-Forward Mindset: Experience leveraging AI tools to optimize team workflows and a clear vision for how AI will transform the future of production support.
A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering. Using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows
Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Government/Sovereign Clouds: Direct experience navigating FedRAMP, IL5/IL6, or similar high-security compliance frameworks.
Salesforce Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with Hyperforce, Salesforce Data Cloud, or the internal mechanics of a "Private Cloud Edition."
Hybrid Infrastructure: Experience managing the bridge between public cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and specialized enterprise environments.
Advanced Degree: M.S. in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Description

Provide leadership for one or more Network Engineering teams or a small group delivering hyperscale L3/L4 networking and cloud connectivity. Define tactical and strategic plans, drive significant cross-group improvements in reliability, security, and cost efficiency, and communicate progress and risks to leadership. Manage elements of the budget and are accountable for meeting budget targets across the teams you lead. May have a mixed team of Network Engineers and Network Hardware Engineers, coordinating the physical network platform lifecycle (planning, sourcing, qualifying, sustaining routers/switches, optics/OLS, timing, cabling) to ensure interoperable, cost- and power-efficient components that enable reliable, secure, and compliant services at scale

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:

Defines multi-quarter architecture roadmap for DC fabrics, routing policy, IPv6 strategy, failure domains, and traffic engineering across regions.
Leads cross-team design reviews and modernization programs (e.g., EVPN/VXLAN/SDN upgrades); enforces MOP/rollback and verification standards.

Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:

Standardizes VPC/VCN topologies, transit/peering, PrivateLink/service endpoints, NAT, and inter-/multi-cloud connectivity.
Optimizes L4/L7 load balancing and service-insertion at scale; enforces cost/SLO guardrails and capacity alignment.

Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:

Embeds zero-trust-aligned segmentation and policy frameworks; drives rulebase lifecycle and tech-debt reduction.
Leads audit readiness and risk reduction programs with Security/GRC; implements policy-as-code and preventative controls.

Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:

Institutionalizes IaC modules/collections and GitOps; mandates code reviews, policy-as-code, testing, and safe deployment patterns (canary/auto-rollback).
Sponsors platform/tooling investments; tracks and improves DORA metrics across teams.

Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:

Sets SLI/SLO policy for the group; ensures telemetry pipelines (SNMP/streaming, NetFlow/IPFIX, flow logs) support reliability, capacity, and security analytics.
Chairs capacity/performance reviews; directs right-sizing, routing optimization, and placement decisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:

Leads cross-group incident response and complex changes; coordinates executive updates on high-importance matters.
Influences adoption of standards across adjacent orgs; negotiates with vendors and partners within budget authority.

Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:

Publishes group-level standards, reference architectures, and runbooks; ensures traceability to requirements and controls.
Operates design/change councils across teams; drives consistent documentation quality and version control.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues, and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues.

Continuous Learning:

Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level. Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed.

Continuous Improvement:

Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments.

Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives. Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building some of the world's largest and most advanced GPU clusters to power the next generation of AI. The Strategic Customer Engineering (SCE) Core Infrastructure team—also known as the AI/ML Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineering team—provides white-glove engineering and operational support to OCI's most strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers.

As a trusted partner to our customers, we play a critical role in designing, deploying, operating, and optimizing the infrastructure that powers some of the largest and most demanding GPU and AI/ML environments in the world. Our team works closely with customers and internal engineering organizations to ensure exceptional reliability, performance, and scalability for mission-critical AI workloads.

We are seeking an experienced Core Infrastructure Engineering Leader to lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for delivering healthy infrastructure with optimal performance configuration. This leader will drive end-to-end technical customer execution including; POCs, technical troubleshooting, post-sale customer management/support, build automated solutions for provisioning, configuring, and monitoring AI/ML infrastructure to streamline operations and enhance productivity and optimize infrastructure performance.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Core Infrastructure Engineers responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure that supports our largest GPU/AI/ML customers.

Drive the design, development, testing, validation, and deployment readiness of our automated GPU Cluster deployment tool (like AWS Parallel Cluster, Azure Cycle Cloud) with Slurm and/or Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) to streamline operations and enhance productivity.

Build collaborative relationships with OCI Services team, customer and sales team to deliver reliable, scalable infrastructures. Act as a technical liaison between customers, core engineering teams, and support.

Work with OCI Strategic customers to grow our business in pre/post sales stages in a technical infra expert role.

Take ownership of problems and work to identify solutions. Ability to think through the solution and identify/document potential issues impacting your customers.

Optimize infrastructure performance by tuning parameters, optimizing resource utilization, and implementing caching and data pre-processing techniques.
