jobs.title: Sr. Manager, OTA Vehicle Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

RVT is redefining what a car can be by making continuous iteration and improvement core to the product. Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates are what make that model possible — allowing us to seamlessly and rapidly deliver the latest software to both engineering and customer vehicles. As a result, the OTA system sits on the critical path of RVT's entire development chain.

As Senior Manager of OTA Vehicle Engineering, you will lead the development of a highly cross-functional system at the intersection of hardware, software, manufacturing, service, and business operations. You will own the technical trajectory of the system, build the internal processes and institutions that allow it to scale, and balance the operational needs of today against the vision for tomorrow.

We are looking for a highly motivated leader who can operate credibly from the electrical layer to the business strategy layer, and who thrives in complex, ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

Responsibilities

Lead and grow the OTA vehicle engineering organization across multiple sites and time zones.
Own the technical direction and architecture of the OTA update system, spanning vehicle and infrastructure components.
Align OTA capabilities with company-wide program needs in partnership with hardware, software, manufacturing, service, and business operations.
Establish the development processes, test automation, and operational KPIs that keep engineers focused and productive.
Drive OTA initiatives from concept through operational delivery on customer vehicles.
Diagnose and remediate legacy technical, operational, and organizational debt within the OTA domain.

Leadership Qualifications

8+ years in software development, integration, or architecture, including 5+ years managing engineers.
Track record of leading cross-functional, multi-site teams to deliver a customer-deployed product from inception through operational delivery.
Proven ability to bring order to a complex product and stakeholder network — technically, operationally, and organizationally.
Ability to reason across the full stack, from electrical systems to business strategy, and speak authoritatively at each level.
Experience leading teams that build software platforms for complex electromechanical systems (aerospace, automotive, defense, or robotics).
Experience with systems engineering and architectural development.
Experience establishing software development processes, test automation, and operational KPIs.

Required

Technical Qualifications

High-performance C++ and/or Rust applications for co-habitated POSIX systems.
Embedded software in C and/or Rust for real-time operating systems.
Experience Developing test automation software in Python and Go.

Preferred

Experience in developing software infrastructure Over the Air Updates on deployed products
Experience with automotive diagnostic protocols UDS, SOVD
Experience with automotive communication protocols CAN, LIN, Flexray, ETH-UDP, ISO-TP over ETH-TCP

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs
.

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer (SWE) goes way beyond just Search. SWE Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a SWE Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. SWE teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Why This Role Matters

Our business runs on the systems this team keeps stable. As Director Application Support and Site Reliability Engineering, you will lead a global team of 12 engineers responsible for the health of 50+ business-critical applications and the middleware that connects them, holding uptime targets of 99.9-99.95%.

Beyond keeping systems running, you will lead the modernization of how a large support organization operates: automating manual work, improving observability, consolidating platforms, and building a team that engineers reliability rather than just reacting to outages.

This role carries direct executive visibility, real influence over budget and vendor relationships, and a clear path to broader technology leadership.

What You Will Build

Modern observability and monitoring across 50+ applications and middleware platforms, cutting the time it takes to detect and resolve issues.
Automation that eliminates repetitive manual support work and frees the team for higher-value engineering.
A consolidated, simplified support model across applications, middleware, and third-party products, with fewer tools and fewer handoffs.
Vendor and engineering partnerships that treat resilience as a shared engineering problem rather than a compliance exercise.
A high-performing, globally distributed team with clear growth paths and a strong culture of ownership.

Key Responsibilities

Service & Platform Leadership
Lead the global team of 12 engineers responsible for the operational health of 50+ business-critical applications, middleware platforms, and third-party products.
Own uptime, performance, and resilience against targets of 99.9-99.95%, and drive root cause resolution when targets are missed.
Build support models, escalation paths, and runbooks that scale as the application portfolio grows.
Lead major incident response and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes rather than repeat tickets.
Ensure new systems and releases are genuinely production-ready before they land in support.
Middleware & Integration Engineering
Lead operational support for middleware, integration platforms, and interfaces connecting the application portfolio.
Keep middleware environments secure, monitored, and performant through patching, upgrades, and capacity planning.
Partner with infrastructure, cloud, network, and security teams to design for resilience and fast recovery.
Modernize integration architecture over time, reducing fragility and technical debt in how systems communicate.
Third-Party Product & Vendor Partnership
Own the relationship and performance of externally supplied applications, SaaS products, and middleware vendors.
Hold vendors accountable to SLAs and resolution targets, and escalate firmly when service quality slips.
Shape vendor selection, onboarding, renewal, and exit decisions.
Ensure third-party products are woven into the team’s support and security practices from day one.
Resilience & Continuous Improvement
Define the KPIs and dashboards that show the team, and leadership, how the portfolio is actually performing.
Get ahead of operational and supplier risk before it becomes an incident.
Run post-incident and problem-management reviews that produce real fixes, not just documentation.
Lead modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform rationalization, and support model redesign.
People Leadership & Growth
Build and grow a high-performing global team of 12 engineers: hire well, coach directly, and create real paths for advancement.
Set clear expectations and give direct, useful feedback.
Design coverage and on-call models that are sustainable, not merely compliant.
Build a culture where engineers own outcomes and want to solve hard problems, not just close tickets.
Stakeholder Partnership & Communication
Build trusted relationships with business leaders, engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, and vendors.
Translate technical issues into business impact for senior leadership, clearly and without spin.
Represent the team in governance and planning forums, and bring outside perspective back to the team.

Knowledge, Skills, And Experience

Significant experience leading enterprise application support, production support, middleware operations, or related technology service teams, ideally at global scale.
Track record leading teams responsible for business-critical applications and platforms in a complex environment.
Strong grounding in incident, problem, change, release, and service management practices.
Experience managing third-party vendors and externally supplied technology within formal service frameworks.
Sound judgment on operational risk, control design, and resiliency.
Experience leading major incident response and driving stabilization.
Strong stakeholder management across business and technology functions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting.
Proven people leadership: hiring, coaching, performance management, and team growth.

Preferred

Experience in a regulated, high-availability, or global enterprise environment.
Familiarity with middleware and integration technologies such as APIs, message brokers, ESBs, application servers, iPaaS platforms, or comparable technologies.
Experience supporting hybrid environments spanning on-premise and cloud-based application estates.
Knowledge of service monitoring, observability, automation, and operational tooling.
Experience with vendor contracts, commercial support models, and cost management.
ITIL certification or equivalent practical service management experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Gaming Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix is building a cloud gaming platform - a feat achieved by only a handful of industry leaders. This is a foundational, high-visibility role at the center of that effort. The Director, Cloud Gaming Infrastructure will lead the team responsible for the operating system software, hardware, control plane, and transport that power Netflix's cloud games experience, delivering engaging, low-latency gameplay to members at scale while driving toward sustainable unit economics.

This role oversees a significant hardware investment supporting massive concurrent user scale, and is directly accountable for the technical and operational success of one of Netflix's key growth bets.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for cloud gaming infrastructure, spanning the Game OS, cloud gaming software stack, telemetry, control plane, and transport.
Lead and grow the engineering organization responsible for building and operating this infrastructure, including hiring into open technical leadership and IC roles.
Partner closely with hardware, OS, encoding, capacity planning, and SRE/Ops functions to deliver an end-to-end, reliable platform.
Drive the technical and economic innovation required to make cloud gaming viable at scale — this role is expected to find approaches that others have not.
Serve as the primary technical bridge between Infrastructure, Games Platform, and Games Studio, representing infrastructure capabilities and constraints in product and studio planning conversations.
Collaborate with peer leaders across Infrastructure and Games Platform teams to ensure coherent, well-integrated systems.
Set technical direction and quality bar for a domain with no established industry playbook, making judgment calls in the absence of proven patterns.
Report on infrastructure health, cost, and scaling risk to senior leadership, and translate business goals (member growth, engagement, unit economics) into infrastructure priorities.

Proven track record leading large-scale distributed systems engineering teams, ideally spanning software, hardware, and network/transport layers.
Deep technical expertise in one or more of: cloud infrastructure at scale, real-time/low-latency media delivery, game development, control planes.
Experience owning infrastructure with significant capital investment (hardware fleets, data center capacity) and being accountable for its economics, not just its uptime.
Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguous, emerging domains without established best practices, and to make sound technical bets under uncertainty.
Strong track record of cross-functional partnership with Product, Data Science, and adjacent Engineering orgs, including influencing without direct authority across dotted-line and peer relationships.
Experience managing and developing engineering managers and senior ICs, with the judgment to grow a team while augmenting individual skills with AI tooling.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to represent complex infrastructure tradeoffs clearly to both technical peers and senior/executive stakeholders.

Prior experience in console gaming, cloud gaming, game streaming, or interactive real-time media (e.g., WebRTC, game streaming protocols, encoding/transport optimization).
Background at a company that has built a large-scale gaming or media-streaming platform (e.g., console manufacturers, cloud gaming providers, video/live-streaming infrastructure teams).
Experience standing up or significantly scaling a new platform or product line from an early or emerging stage.
Familiarity with CDN or edge infrastructure economics, capacity planning, and fleet-level cost optimization.
Experience working within a company where infrastructure investment decisions are closely tied to a broader strategic "growth bet," requiring comfort with high visibility and high stakes.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

We are seeking a Chief Engineer with a proven track record in designing a next-generation vehicle product that transforms any vehicle into a software-defined mission system. As Chief Engineer you will lead the architecture and delivery of a vehicle-to-mission interface layer which abstracts power, data, networking, and control into a common environment for mission kits. Your leadership will drive both product design and production process optimization, ensuring that our systems are robust, cost-effective, and ready for the field.

What You’ll Do

Own the end-to-end architecture of the vehicle to mission interface layer
As Chief Engineer you will lead the architecture and delivery of a vehicle-to-mission interface layer which abstracts power, data, networking, and control into a common environment for mission kits.
This will include architecting a compute module for vehicle translation, a firmware layer for vehicle communications, and a software layer for communicating with B-kits
Define standardized APIs, data models, and ICDs that abstract vehicle systems into reusable mission services
Architect managed power and compute systems
Build the plug-and-play mission kit framework
Lead cross functional engineering execution from concept through production across hardware and software teams
Partner with OEMs, mission partners, and customers to drive platform adoption and deployment
Be the primary engineering contact for external and internal stakeholders
Interface directly with internal senior leader and represent the business with decision making authorities within the scope of product engineering

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, computer science, or related field required
Proven experience in designing new products and delivering hardware and software at scale
15+ years of experience in complex system architecture and integration
5+ years of experience leading multi-disciplined teams developing software enabled hardware products
Expertise in vehicle electrical and power systems (12-28V architecture, conversion, distribution, and load management)
Expertise in embedded systems and ruggedized compute platforms
Experience applying safety-critical frameworks including hazard analysis and safety case development
Proven ability to design system with fault isolation, fail-safe behavior, and non-interference – ensuring that mission systems cannot impact vehicle-critical functions
Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

Masters of Science degree in mechanical, electrical or systems engineering, computer science, or related field required
Strong technical, analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations and drive decisions
Experience with tools like JIRA and Confluence
Exposure to land-based systems, particularly with DoW experience
Holds Active Secret Clearance or higher

$253,000—$295,000 USD

Senior FDE Managers own organizational-level outcomes — they set the technical direction across multiple concurrent customer programs, build and scale the FDE team, and drive the mechanisms that ensure consistent engineering excellence and measurable business impact across the entire portfolio.

jobs.description:
RDQ427R330

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

As a Sr. Engineering Manager on the Agentic Service Platform team, you will be responsible for building the foundational service frameworks and runtime infrastructure that power every microservice at Databricks. The team's goal is to make every service at Databricks fast, reliable, observable, and secure by default, without each team having to solve these problems independently. The team owns the core agentic service platform: multi-language service and RPC frameworks, core libraries, request context propagation, overload protection, and abstractions that extend full platform capabilities to any language. The team’s work is high-leverage - a single improvement we ship benefits thousands of production services and thousands of engineers across the company.

The Impact You Will Have

Lead and scale a multi-faceted team of talented engineers, which may include line managers and senior/staff ICs, building core agentic service platform infrastructure used by every service at Databricks.
Own and set the multi-year technical strategy and organizational roadmap for a critical, cross-cutting domain within the agentic service platform.
Drive and ensure the predictable, high-quality delivery of complex, multi-quarter/multi-year strategic initiatives, often spanning multiple teams and product areas.
Champion the career development and growth of engineers and managers, including coaching senior (L5/L6) ICs and guiding line managers.
Proactively align and influence product and engineering leadership across multiple partner organizations to ensure the long-term success of the platform.

8+ years of engineering experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, service frameworks, or platform infrastructure
4+ years of engineering management experience leading strong technical teams
A track record of high technical judgment in building and operating large-scale distributed systems, and a deep understanding of customer interactions with platform products across multiple components.
Demonstrated success in attracting, hiring, and retaining top-tier talent and experience coaching and mentoring line managers or senior/staff level ICs. Proven ability to handle complex performance management and promotion cases.
Existing experience building and running cloud platforms, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn new concepts in the SaaS space.

jobs.title: Technical Director of Test & Evaluation
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

This position is looking for a highly motivated Director of Test & Evaluation Engineering with emphasis in developmental test, with additional experience performing test lead/manager responsibilities. You will work heavily with the program leadership and a wide spectrum of cross-departments to help build and lead a team focused on solving hard problems and changing the industry forever. Anduril is a rapidly growing company, and the right person for this role should be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment with many competing priorities.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all flight operations and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast-paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded, this is a fantastic opportunity.

What You'll Do

Serve as the Senior Director's primary technical advisor, maintaining a cross-divisional view of T&E readiness, risk, and capability gaps across Connected Warfare, Maritime, Air Defense, Intelligence, and Mission Systems.
Drive standardization of test architectures, methodologies, and acceptance criteria across software, hardware, and system-level testing—ensuring consistency without sacrificing development speed.
Act as connective tissue between division T&E efforts: identify where one division's test infrastructure, tooling, or lessons learned can accelerate another, and drive reuse.
Provide hands-on technical oversight of major qualification campaigns and developmental test programs, particularly those spanning multiple domains (e.g., autonomous maritime systems with air-defense integration).
Represent the T&E organization in technical reviews (e.g., TRRs, CDRs, PDRs) and program milestone gates, providing independent technical assessment and risk characterization.
Partner with data and software teams to improve test data pipelines, analysis tooling, and reporting—defining metrics that give leadership actionable visibility into test throughput, defect trends, and schedule risk.
Serve as a technical subject matter expert on multi-domain compliance frameworks (e.g., MIL-STD-810, DO-160, NAVSEA standards, MIL-HDBK-516), helping divisions navigate overlapping or conflicting requirements efficiently.
Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in how T&E work is planned, resourced, and executed. Build scalable processes and playbooks that let the organization grow without proportionally growing headcount.
Represent the T&E organization to military customers, government test agencies, and partner organizations as needed.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in test and evaluation, system validation, or multi-disciplinary engineering programs spanning both software-intensive and hardware-intensive systems.
Demonstrated technical depth across multiple domains (air, maritime, ground, counter-UAS, intelligence, etc.), with hands-on experience in developmental test, system integration (HIL/SIL), environmental/structural testing, and instrumentation.
Experience with software-intensive system testing, including autonomy, AI/ML model validation, sensor fusion, or similar disciplines.
Working knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., MIL-STD-810, DO-160, MIL-HDBK-516, NAVSEA standards) and the ability to navigate varied regulatory landscapes to enable rapid product deployment.
Proven ability to operate effectively without positional authority—influencing outcomes through technical credibility, relationships, and clear communication rather than org-chart power.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex, multi-domain requirements into unified, high-fidelity test solutions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present technical risk, test readiness, and compliance status to executive leadership and military customers.
Eligible to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.
A "bias for action"—a drive to solve and fix problems
In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years of experience in Test & Evaluation or related technical fields
Experience in a rapid-growth or startup environment within the defense or aerospace sector.
Familiarity with test range operations, flight test, maritime operations, and vehicle certification (air/seaworthiness processes.
Background in data-driven T&E improvement—building dashboards, automating test reporting, or implementing test data platforms.
Experience supporting or participating in government-led operational test and evaluation (OT&E) events.

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Test & Development Engineering
jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

As a Senior Manager for Test and Development, you will manage a team that performs full vehicle and sub-system development and validation testing, both on-site at Rivian’s Arizona Proving Grounds, and at other remote sites worldwide. Your team supports multiple focused development, support and validation testing areas; including Dynamics, Benchmarking, Powertrain, NVH, Body Controls, Chassis Durability, Homologation and others from the beginning of a program through production launch.

Responsibilities

Manage team workload, scheduling and budget; including resource allocations covering vehicles, staff, instrumentation, track scheduling and offsite logistics.
Coordinate with facility and on-site staff to ensure available resources (surfaces, facilities, etc.) are aligned to team needs and are meeting usability requirements.
Collaborate with Program, Fleet and domain / department teams to plan and optimize vehicle usage across limited assets. Advocate for priority where required to meet test timing.
Manage team resources to support early program system and vehicle integration bring-up, development and troubleshooting across multiple concurrent vehicle model lines and maturity timelines, for both the T&D team and other end-users.
Supervise team planning, preparation, execution and documentation of specific portions of the vehicle and component DVP&R using JIRA, FLOW, and Rivian proprietary tool sets.
Support asynchronous onsite and offsite test and validation activities, including field quality investigations, pre-production and post-production software quality testing, supplier and VIP visits and demonstrations, among others.
Develop and refine reporting and tracking tools to continually improve overall department and team efficiency; focusing on integration of emerging AI applications and in-vehicle utilities.
Create and modify documentation including test work instructions, Rivian test specifications, and summary reports from vehicle testing projects.
Perform subjective and objective evaluations in one or more areas of personal expertise for remote design and engineering teams.
Travel as needed (up to 25%) to support prototype vehicles, remote validation events, environmental testing, proving-ground activity, and other high-urgency support work

Qualifications

Team first mentality - as a multi-team manager in a highly cross-functional support role, you must be able to balance conflicting customer requests with team capabilities, develop and articulate timing plans and progress to stakeholders, all while growing a positive team culture.
Hands-on engineering capability across multiple vehicle systems, electrical integration, prototype hardware, and software-enabled development work, testing methods and instrumentation methodologies.
Experience and proven success operating within dynamic development timeline environments where rapid problem solving, self-direction, and results-driven flexibility are paramount.
Familiarity with Jira / Confluence workflows and documenting technical work clearly enough for cross-functional follow-through.
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Mechatronics, Aerospace, or similar engineering discipline.
10+ years of automotive prototype, vehicle integration, validation testing and/or development engineering experience required.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $153,300 - $191,600 for Arizona based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee).

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers
(Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists
(Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.
AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.
Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

Lead a team of full-stack software engineers responsible for the AI Experience Framework (AIUX) — the platform that powers ServiceNow's AI-first user interfaces. The team builds and supports modular, reusable conversational experiences using modern Lit-based web components, serving as the technical foundation for conversation-first applications.

Partner with product/App BU teams, core platform teams, and the many other UX component teams building on top of the framework.

Manage product development activities across the AIUX framework roadmap
Work with product management, design, support, and other dev teams to create high-quality, AI-first experiences
Manage daily activities of the development team, including planning and delivery
Solve difficult and often ambiguous problems spanning AI integration, performance at scale, and multi-team architecture
Guide architecture decisions across the request path — proxy, version-aware routing, server-rendered component runtime — in partnership with senior ICs
Set technical direction for framework-level APIs (context propagation, layout composition, state management) consumed by every downstream component team
Represent AIUX Framework in cross-org architecture and roadmap discussions, and act as an escalation point for the hardest production issues
Manage departmental resources, staffing, mentoring, and enhancing and maintaining a best-of-class engineering team

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving (may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the industry)
10+ years of experience with technologies relevant to ServiceNow and advanced coding skills with high-quality results, including deep expertise in JavaScript and substantial experience in Java or a similar OO language (C++, C#, Go acceptable)
5+ years of experience managing core software engineering teams
Experience coaching and growing engineers at various levels
Experience leading team members who require little oversight in completing assigned work
Experience providing direction, delegating assignments, and supporting a team to accomplish tasks
Advanced experience with modern UI frameworks (Angular, React, Vue, or Lit) and a passion for JavaScript/the Web as a platform, reusability, and componentization
Experience with open source tools and agile development environments
Working knowledge of server-side rendering/hydration and systems-level Node.js concerns (process/worker isolation, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 semantics, reverse proxying) — enough to guide and evaluate technical decisions made by the team
Ability to understand broad concepts and use those concepts to develop solutions for problems spanning AI integration, performance, and multi-team coordination
Experience completing projects based on company priorities, context, risks, and desired outcomes
Ability to understand and implement best practices and coding standards for role-specific requirements (programming languages and tools, network design, functional design, algorithms, patterns, design and development, etc.)
Track record managing multiple projects with material technical risk across teams and processes
Exposure to multiple technology stacks: Cloud Dev, Platforms, Web Dev, Frameworks, service-oriented architecture

Preferred — AIUX Framework Specific

Experience with build systems that emit multiple targets from one component source (server bundles vs. code-split browser bundles)
Familiarity operating services in Kubernetes and building/maintaining observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus) for production systems
Experience managing teams that build framework-level abstractions (component base classes, context/DI systems, event contracts) consumed by many other engineering teams

Job Description

The Senior Manager, Repair Center Operations is responsible for building and scaling Oracle's centralized repair-center model for next-generation AI infrastructure. This role leads day-to-day repair operations and long-term capacity planning for Compute Tray (CT) repair, CDU validation, leak response, and regional expansion. Working across Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Design, Architecture, and Global Product Engineering, the senior manager ensures repair centers are staffed, equipped, and ready to support routine demand as well as surge events while driving improvements in diagnosability, repair velocity, and serviceability.

The role also serves as a key operational leader for the repair organization, translating product and infrastructure requirements into an executable staffing and facility plan. This includes establishing operating rhythms, tracking performance metrics, managing risk, and ensuring the repair network scales with current and future Oracle data center sites.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

Lead the planning, staffing, and execution of repair-center operations supporting GB200, GB300, and future AI compute platforms.
Own repair-center readiness, including capacity planning, shift coverage, resource allocation, and operational ramp for new sites.
Partner with Design, Architecture, Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Global Product Engineering to define repair-center requirements and resolve cross-functional issues.
Oversee repair workflows for Compute Trays, CDU validation, and leak-response activities to ensure safe, timely, and high-quality execution.
Establish and manage operating metrics, reporting, and escalation paths to maintain throughput, quality, and readiness across the repair network.
Drive standardization of repair-center processes, documentation, and best practices across current and future Oracle Repair locations.
Support regional scale-up by aligning permanent repair-center buildouts with demand forecasts, site deployment schedules, and new platform introductions.
Lead hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management for repair-center team members and supporting technical resources.

Core Responsibilities

Set clear priorities, manage competing demands, and ensure repair-center objectives are met on time and at the expected quality level.
Build strong cross-functional partnerships and maintain alignment across engineering, operations, supply chain, and site leadership teams.
Use data, trend analysis, and operational feedback to identify risks, improve repair performance, and recommend process enhancements.
Maintain a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and technical excellence within the repair organization.
Translate business needs into executable plans for staffing, space, power, tooling, and repair capacity.
Develop scalable operating models that support both steady-state repair work and surge events without disrupting broader deployment goals.
Communicate clearly with senior leadership on site status, risks, dependencies, and required decisions.

jobs.description:
As a Director, Staff Engineer at Capital One, you will be a part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud.

You will work alongside our talented team of developers, machine learning experts, product managers and people leaders. Our Staff Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical and reusable solutions to complex problems. You will drive innovation at multiple levels, helping optimize business outcomes while driving towards strong technology solutions.

At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will promote a culture of engineering excellence, and strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where the ideas of others can be heard and championed. You will lead the way in creating next-generation talent for Capital One Tech, mentoring internal talent and actively recruiting to keep building our community.

Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical contribution. You will operate as a trusted advisor for our key technologies, platforms and capability domains, creating clear and concise communications, code samples, blog posts and other material to share knowledge both inside and outside the organization. You will specialize in a particular subject area, but your input and impact will be sought and expected throughout the organization.

About The Team

Business Cards & Payment's mission is to help businesses do more business - and the advent of Agentic AI offers massive new opportunities for BC&P to do so through real-time marketing and hyper personalized sales systems for business card customers.

We’re hiring a Staff Engineer who is ready to carve BC&P’s path towards an agentic future. Your mission will be to move BC&P beyond manual and reactive marketing and sales tools - helping us create our destination architecture for marketing platforms, build tools that help our sales teams be more effective, and help us lay the technical foundations of a real-time marketing strategy. You’ll make direct contributions in this role: both defining our long term technical strategy and hands on prototyping, launch, and scaling of agentic systems.

Example areas you’ll take on include:

Real-time, hyper personalized marketing systems that accurately & explainably prospect and engage new business customers.
Assistive technologies that arm our field agents with superhuman knowledge and context to grow deeper relationships and close more sales.
Exploration of autonomous sales agents (AISDRs) that self-improve via RLAIF.

As a Staff Engineer, you will be a technical expert defining the future of our architecture, collaborating across Capital One to drive innovation and deliver the systems that produce step function growth for our business.

You will lead through direct technical contribution: prototyping new features and systems, acting as a trusted advisor for key technologies, shaping our future architecture & evaluating what systems to build vs buy, and sharing knowledge internally and externally. Additionally, you will promote engineering excellence, foster an inclusive environment, and deeply mentor the next generation of technical talent.

If you are ready to work on some of the most cutting edge problems in our business, provide thought leadership, and have meaningful business impact, come join us in our mission to change banking for good!

Key responsibilities:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.
Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About The Team

The Senior Support Engineering team is responsible for ensuring that developers and enterprises can reliably build mission critical solutions using OpenAI models. We provide technical guidance, resolve complex issues and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our highly-capable models. We work closely with Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. We think from an automation-first mindset and leverage the latest in AI to scale our support operations. Join the Senior Support Engineering (SSE) team at OpenAI and help shape the future of Technical Support in the age of AI.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Support Engineering Manager to build and guide a high-performing team of experienced Senior Support Engineers with backgrounds in software engineering, site reliability engineering, and systems architecture. These engineers are trusted to operate with autonomy, tackle deeply technical challenges, and serve as the final escalation point before Engineering.

In this role, you'll lead a team focused on deep problem-solving, proactive reliability work, and customer-specific troubleshooting. You’ll drive the design and operations of OpenAI’s incident management processes, including tooling, automations, and training, and ensure they are scalable and resilient. You’ll also oversee strategic customer workload monitoring, alerting, and a 24x7 rotation to ensure high-priority issues are caught early and handled with urgency.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Technical Success, and field teams to improve the supportability of our products, reduce operational burden, and shape the future of AI-driven technical support. Your team will own incident response playbooks, build internal automations, and serve as technical stewards for our most strategic accounts.

This is an opportunity to define what world-class technical support looks like in the era of AGI. We're looking for a leader who combines strong technical depth with operational rigor, a passion for team development, and an automation-first mindset.

The ideal candidate will have a combination of technical capabilities mixed with strong leadership and systems building strength.

We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Build and lead a team of deeply technical and tenured Senior Support Engineers who bring backgrounds in software engineering, site reliability engineering, and systems architecture and are experts in diagnosing and solving complex issues on OpenAI’s technologies.
Own the continuous improvement of our incident management processes, including tooling, automation, and team readiness.

Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams to escalate, resolve, and prevent high-impact technical issues.

Shape support operations at scale by contributing to hiring plans and global shift coverage as we expand.
Play an active role in the broader Support leadership team, contributing to strategy, operations, and culture beyond your immediate team.

10+ years of experience in technical support engineering, software engineering, site reliability engineering, or a related technical discipline, including hands-on experience supporting production systems at scale.
5+ years of experience managing engineers or leading complex, multi-person technical projects, with clear ownership over delivery, execution, and outcomes.
Bring deep technical experience in application development or infrastructure, paired with a strong instinct for operational systems and customer reliability.
Are a strong cross-functional partner with a proven ability to influence engineering and product roadmaps through support-driven insights.
Take an automation-first approach and have a track record of implementing tooling or processes that scale support impact through AI and systems thinking.

Leads the design, architecture, engineering, and operational strategy for large-scale RDMA backend fabrics supporting AI, HPC, and cloud infrastructure. This role is responsible for building and scaling high-performance, low-latency network fabrics, driving end-to-end network architecture decisions, and leading teams responsible for fabric design, validation, deployment, automation, reliability, and lifecycle management. The Senior Manager partners with silicon vendors, platform engineering, systems architecture, capacity planning, and cloud infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and future-ready networking solutions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities – RDMA Fabric Design, Architecture and Scale

Lead architecture and design of large-scale RDMA fabrics supporting AI training, inference, HPC, and cloud workloads.
Define network topology, routing strategy, congestion management, resiliency, and capacity models for multi-cluster deployments.
Drive technology evaluation and roadmap decisions across Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, optical networking, and emerging fabric technologies.
Establish design standards, validation requirements, and deployment readiness criteria for production networks.
Partner with hardware, systems, and cloud engineering teams to ensure network architecture aligns with platform requirements.

Network Engineering, Validation and Reliability

Oversee lab validation, scale testing, performance benchmarking, and failure scenario analysis.
Lead root cause analysis for complex network incidents involving congestion, packet loss, latency, or fabric instability.
Develop strategies to improve network availability, performance, and operational excellence.
Drive change management and deployment governance processes across multiple engineering teams.
Establish SLOs, KPIs, and reliability metrics for large-scale backend networks.

Automation, Telemetry and Operations

Lead development of automation frameworks for deployment, configuration management, testing, and operations.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Security Incubation & Innovation
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Team:

The Security and Risk Engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers dedicated to delivering scalable, world-class AI-powered security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We value AI first solutions, clean architecture, intuitive user experiences, and a culture of continuous improvement. Security is a key strategic growth area for ServiceNow, and every engineer here plays a key role in driving innovation and shaping the quality and reliability of our security and risk products.

What you get to do in this role

Lead a high-impact engineering team chartered to reimagine cybersecurity through AI, creating AI-native products and capabilities that fundamentally change how security teams detect, investigate, prioritize, and respond to threats.
Drive zero-to-one innovation, rapidly translating emerging AI technologies and new ideas into prototypes, validated concepts, and production-grade enterprise solutions.
Define the technical vision and architecture for AI-native security solutions, leveraging frontier models, agentic AI, reasoning, retrieval, knowledge systems, and advanced ML techniques.
Explore and apply emerging AI capabilities to solve complex cybersecurity problems in fundamentally new ways—not simply augment existing products with AI.
Build autonomous and agentic security experiences that can reason over security context, orchestrate tools and workflows, and take appropriate actions with minimal human intervention.
Remain deeply engaged technically, providing architectural leadership and hands-on guidance on critical technology decisions, prototypes, and implementations.
Establish rapid experimentation and development practices that enable the team to learn, iterate, and deliver at startup speed while meeting enterprise requirements for security, reliability, scalability, and governance.
Partner closely with Product, UX, security researchers, customers, and engineering leaders to identify high-value problems and translate them into differentiated product experiences.
Build and develop a team of exceptional engineers with strong backgrounds in AI/ML, distributed systems, and cybersecurity, creating a culture of technical excellence, experimentation, and bold innovation.
Champion AI-native engineering practices, including extensive use of AI coding agents and autonomous development, testing, evaluation, and operational workflows.
Represent the team's technology and innovation with executives, customers, partners, and the broader engineering organization.

To be successful in this role, you have

Deep technical expertise in modern AI/ML, with demonstrated experience building production AI systems using LLMs, foundation models, agentic architectures, RAG, embeddings, knowledge retrieval, model evaluation, and related technologies.
A proven track record of building innovative AI-native products from the ground up, ideally taking new concepts from experimentation through enterprise-scale production.
Strong understanding of agentic architectures, including planning and reasoning, tool use, context and memory, multi-agent systems, evaluation, observability, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Strong technical foundation in software architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, data systems, and APIs, with the ability to go deep into architecture and code.
Experience applying AI to cybersecurity problems such as threat detection, vulnerability and exposure management, security operations, identity security, investigation, risk prioritization, or autonomous remediation strongly preferred.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience with modern AI frameworks and infrastructure; experience with Java, Go, or similar languages is valuable.
An innovator's mindset with the ability to challenge conventional approaches, identify opportunities created by rapidly evolving AI technology, and turn ambitious ideas into working products.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and balance rapid experimentation with the rigor required for enterprise-grade security products.
Experience building and leading highly technical engineering teams while remaining sufficiently hands-on to guide architecture and technical direction.
Strong product instincts and the ability to connect technology innovation to customer problems, differentiated experiences, and business outcomes.
Executive-level communication skills and the ability to articulate a compelling technical vision to engineers, customers, and senior leadership.

Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical and engineering leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI/ML-powered products and platforms in production.
Experience building AI-native products on modern cloud-native architectures from inception through production.
Hands-on experience with modern AI development technologies, including frontier LLMs, agent frameworks, retrieval/vector technologies, model evaluation and observability.
Extensive experience using AI-native development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent as part of the software development lifecycle.
Experience designing AI evaluation, safety, security, governance, and policy guardrails for production AI systems.
Experience in cybersecurity products or deep familiarity with modern security architectures and security operations is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
